details.short_description: Take control of Dreadwinter, your very own magical coffee shop! Explore a vibrant, fantasy world, master your craft, and turn a small café into a legend in this spooky, cozy coffee shop sim!

details.title: 2.3 Billion
details.short_description: A mesmerizing active incremental. It starts slow, with a few sparks. Then they're everywhere and you can barely keep up. Every reset, a new perk. A few hours in the flow. First goal: 2.3 billion. Of what? You'll have to play to find out.

details.title: Sort My Pigs
details.short_description: [No AI] Sort My Pigs is a 2D organizing simulator where you sort over 5,000 cute pigs into their correct pens. Pick a pig, find its pen, earn coins, and unlock upgrades as your farm grows. No timer, no pressure, just pure, cozy sorting bliss.

details.title: Forts of Canada
details.short_description: Forts of Canada is a single-player 2D strategy game about keeping eight historic Canadian forts standing. Manage supplies, recruit troops, fire the cannons, sail dangerous waters and plan battles before watching them unfold.

details.title: SUFA: Strike Fighter
details.short_description: Fly a modern strike fighter low over a real, 1:1 map of Israel. Thread the Tel Aviv towers, explore 120+ real places in Free Flight, fly six sorties from training to historic 1967 and 1981 strikes, and land it back home. Easy to learn, with a live coach.

details.title: Siberian Prison Builder
details.short_description: Build and run a Soviet prison camp in the frozen taiga. Plan cell blocks, keep the stoves lit and the prisoners fed, and hold the wire through blizzards, riots, fires and breakouts. Or grab a shiv and break out yourself.

details.title: Wrapuzzle
details.short_description: An original game of patience and relaxation where the jigsaw puzzles only have two edges! Reassemble them and wrap them around objects of your choice to display on your shelves. Human-made unique designs. Choose between 100 and 2,000 pieces, and have fun!

details.title: Arrow Hell
details.short_description: Play as a Magical Arrow and Fight for your Survival in the Space. A fast-paced arcade game packed with relentless and sci-fi enemy waves. Dodge, Attack & Upgrade and stand until the end in this Short & Minimally Designed Action Arena.

details.title: DEVILS : THE BORUTA REVENGE
details.short_description: DEVILS is an arcade-logic game with rpg elements created in the retro atmosphere of Commodore 64 computers. It was created using 16 colors known from Commodore 64. The game is available in two language versions: English and Polish.

details.title: MUKIMUKI NYANKOS
details.short_description: Online party chaos for up to 8 friends: train fluffy kittens in a neon gym until their muscles break the roof. Steal gains, suplex your friends, become a kaiju and survive laser pointers, Roombas and UFO abductions. Whoever weighs the most at 11 PM wins.

details.title: Embodybird
details.short_description: Embodybird is a small, physics-based game with continuous bird flight controls. Decide how hard to flap, how far to spread your wings—even how wide to fan your feathers! Fly, land, hunt, and carry your catch home before dark. EMBODY THE BIRD!

name: Story of The Needle In a Haystack

details.title: Story of The Needle In a Haystack
details.short_description: A cozy co-op tidy-up game with a compelling story. Clear an old barn filled with hay, explore rooms, upgrade your tools, and sell what you collect. Team up with friends to uncover the story as you search for a tiny needle.

details.title: Mapping Creator
details.short_description: Draw maps, make nations fight and create historical or fantasy timelapses with Mapping Creator: a tool to unleash creativity!

details.title: Lost Camp
details.short_description: After the death of your mother and with no other choice, you take the only job available: guarding and maintaining a lonely campsite in the mountains. But what seemed like a quiet place hides mysteries that will change everything.

details.title: The House on Grisewood
details.short_description: A top-down survival horror shooter set in a haunted manor. Explore room by room with a failing flashlight, scavenge ammunition and batteries, and fight or evade what stalks the dark. Reach the ballroom and end what laughs there, or hold out in an endless Zombie Survival modes.

details.title: Blackest Friday
details.short_description: Black Friday night, and the shoppers turned. Drive straight into the zombie crowd: back-to-back roadkills build a RAM combo, long drifts end in a TURBO. Turn loyalty points into coupons and survive until closing time.

details.title: Escape Your Boss
details.short_description: An overworked accountant in a ninja suit takes on his entire company. Fight your way out of Megacorp Tower in a pixel-art action platformer, solo or with up to three friends in online co-op.

details.title: Leila's Play
details.short_description: A ghost turns the theater upside down right before the first big performance of the young theater group "ShakesPeer". Explore the winding theater, solve puzzles and earn the trust of a diverse group of friends. A heartwarming adventure about friendship, inclusion and neurodiversity.

details.title: DeathSlots
details.short_description: The Rules are Simple: You must reach 1,000,000 Cash --- If you run out of cash you die!! 💀

details.title: Luma
details.short_description: Absorb light, mix pigments, and create moving art in a minimalist game of discovery. Uncover new possibilities at your own pace. Relax in Standard, raise the stakes in Hardcore, or push your limits in Mastery.

details.title: Metal Simulator
details.short_description: Start as a solo metal musician in 1970 and build the greatest metal band of all time! Write songs, release albums, recruit musicians, tour, grow your fanbase, and evolve with the changing sounds of metal across the decades.

details.title: Dome RPG
details.short_description: A boy named Taro once woke up in a mysterious world. Why is he here and how will he get out? Experience this world in Dome RPG and follow a text based prequel story in Dome Zero!

details.title: Necromancer: Revival of the Dead
details.short_description: Raise the fallen and build your own legion of the dead. Command the kings you defeat as elite summons, swap between 8 shot types and unleash screen-filling skills in this dark fantasy survival action game.

details.title: Survivors
details.short_description: Survivors is a tower defense game mixed with roguelite elements. Place your survivors, test your strategy, lose, earn resources, upgrade your defenses and try again, stronger.

details.title: Construction Site: Tidy Up Together
details.short_description: The delivery truck just tipped a whole building into one giant heap. Dig out bricks, logs, steel beams and Sash Windows, check the plan and fit every part into its glowing blueprint slot. Then bin the rubbish, return the tools and watch the lights come on, solo or with your crew.

details.title: System Critical 3
details.short_description: Step into the fast-paced, high-energy world of System Critical 3, the ultimate VR platformer-shooter designed exclusively for VR.

details.title: Second Saga
details.short_description: Second Saga is an adventure RPG where you can level up, raise your stats, learn from an extensive skill tree, and make important decisions while traversing a large, expansive, and rich stylized 2D world.

details.title: Div Zero
details.short_description: A VR puzzle adventure where dimensional fractures have torn reality apart. Explore environments destabilized by the rift, solve spatial puzzles hidden across 10 distinct scenes, and follow signals, symbols, and strange objects to uncover what caused the collapse.

details.title: 孤狼之春
details.short_description: This is a true-harem galgame set in a Western fantasy world.

details.title: NEKO-NIN exHeart SPIN! 2
details.short_description: Get ready to nyan-nyan and nin-nin in the latest entry in the NEKO-NIN exHeart franchise with even more ninja catgirls than ever before.

details.title: Duck Billiards
details.short_description: Duck Billiards is a bullet heaven where your attacks are determined by billiard balls and runs are lightning quick. Play as cool duck wizards and unlock lots of items and levels!

details.title: Dusky's Nook
details.short_description: Dusky's Nook is a cozy idle desktop game about a little mushroom guy living his life on a floating island, anywhere on your screen. He gathers mushrooms and head pats, levels up, and unlocks new looks for the island — and a friend or two along the way.

details.title: Core Valley
details.short_description: Build a home, grow your farm, and follow adventure beyond your doorstep. Core Valley blends cozy farming, crafting, fishing, and animal care with underground exploration, dungeons, and boss battles. Play solo or together in LAN co-op.

details.title: lucky me
details.short_description: A live-action interactive romance. Lin Yu joins a travel dating show as its only male contestant after failing his exams. Meet four women in first person, shape relationships through dates and choices, and discover multiple endings. Is the love on camera real?

details.title: Kings of Oros
details.short_description: Kings of Oros combines deep build customization with momentum-driven marble physics. Watch your stone soldiers violently clatter, bounce, and shatter as you craft game breaking builds. Instead of grids and dice rolls, experience real physics battles. Control the chaos with endless build variety.

details.title: Love is Undead
details.short_description: In this adventure game, play as a scientist immune to a deadly virus. Scavenge for resources, develop a vaccine, and test it on Amber, a recently infected girl. Manage supplies, explore dangerous areas, and build a bond that could save humanity. Enjoy post-apocalyptic life with a zombie girl!

name: Return to Campus II: Billionaire Heir Goes to School

details.title: Return to Campus II: Billionaire Heir Goes to School
details.short_description: Return to Campus 2 brings back absurd open-world comedy, now with online multiplayer! Play as a super-rich heir exploring a modern city and a medieval world. Complete quests, meet NPCs, cruise around, pick fights, and cause chaos across two eras.

details.title: Love, in Debt!?
details.short_description: Love, In Debt!? is a romance simulation game. You once had a beautiful relationship, but overnight you were fired, cheated on, and even got yourself in a huge debt! In order to survive, all you can do is work tirelessly! But why does it seem like you became a chick magnet after you're in debt?
developers: 华东理工大学创客空间

details.title: Llama 97 OS
details.short_description: Llama 97 OS is a lightweight, cozy virtual desktop experience. Gamify focus and productivity with various tools or customize your own LlamaSpace profile and check out your friends' profiles too!

name: The Old Circle: Ecos da Masmorra

details.title: The Old Circle: Ecos da Masmorra
details.short_description: A pixel-art action RPG for 1 to 4 players. Choose one of five classes, master real-time combat, shape your build with glyphs, runes and 50 gear sets, and descend through 21 dungeons with their own deadly rules to face 21 bosses, solo or in online co-op.

details.title: ANU: Tablets of Thoth
details.short_description: ANU: Tablets of Thoth is a 3D platformer adventure where you play as Anu, a reincarnated jackal god. Sprint, scale, swim, and sail across Ancient Egypt. Use Soul Syphon to defeat undead enemies, discover hidden secrets, collect artifacts, and stop the dark sorcerer Voodoo Vulture.

name: Note Defender: A Sight Reading Arcade

details.title: Note Defender: A Sight Reading Arcade
details.short_description: Memorize the notes on the treble and bass staffs as well as 9 ledger lines above and below them. This covers every key of a standard 88 key piano and most instruments.

details.title: D.U.B.B.I.O
details.short_description: Become D.U.B.B.I.O, a counter-terror AI deployed to the city of Sowrat. Juggle simultaneous hacking tasks to interfere with terrorists, gather the clues they leave behind, and deduce where they will strike and how they are armed. But this mission is only the surface of the operation.

details.title: Planet Sweep Company
details.short_description: Clean up the danger zone on an undeveloped planet and find hidden landmines! Planet Sweep Company is a game that brings the familiar fun of Minesweeper into 3D space. Analyze the number hints to deduce landmines, plant flags to clear dangerous zones, and build up your achievements!

details.title: Arcane Abyss
details.short_description: A pixel-art, turn-based roguelite deckbuilder where your cards are swords, axes and spears, and you throw them. Thrown weapons stay on the board: hit one with another to trigger Resonance, a combo attack that chains to nearby weapons. Synthesis moves abilities between weapons.

name: Escape from the abandoned mansion haunted by spirits!!

details.title: Escape from the abandoned mansion haunted by spirits!!
details.short_description: Kanae Yamada, a reporter for an occult magazine, visits a vast Japanese mansion abandoned for over 20 years and now notorious as a haunted location. Trapped inside, she must solve mysterious puzzles, uncover the intentions of an unseen presence, and find a way to escape.

details.title: Sakura Arms ~Radiant Duels~
details.short_description: Sakura Arms is a unique on-the-spot deck-building card game. Choose two Megami, combine their martial arts, anticipate your opponent’s tactics, and build a 10-card deck after seeing both sides’ selections.

details.title: Kill Or Be Killed
details.short_description: Kill Or Be Killed is a fast-paced action combat game where deadly combos and quick thinking decide who survives. Outsmart your opponents, punish their mistakes, and master your next move in multiplayer PvP or sharpen your skills solo against bots.

details.title: Fullower
details.short_description: Plant 100,456 flowers to decorate the Vegetable Boys' stage. A cozy first-person game about filling the empty terraced field around the stage with flowers, color by color.

details.title: Taiikooz War
details.short_description: Taiikooz War is a fast-paced, single-player zombie survival FPS. Survive hordes of the undead and plunge into a brutal where only survival matters.

details.title: Orion Blue
details.short_description: Orion Blue is a cozy fishing adventure set on a beautiful alien planet. Catch fish, gather resources, and build relationships with the locals. Play actively, or relax and let the game progress with Idle Mode.

details.title: Winx Club - Moonlight Quest
details.short_description: Fly into a brand-new Winx Club adventure! Play as Bloom, transform, take flight, and freely explore an open world inspired by the series. Unravel the mystery of the Festival of the 100 Moons.

details.title: Caster Crew
details.short_description: A 1–4 player co-op action roguelike where your voice becomes your spellbook. Speak incantations to cast magic, explore procedurally generated dungeons, collect powerful loot, visit shops, and face deadly multi-phase bosses together.

details.title: Jester`s Anger
details.short_description: A fast deckbuilding roguelike boomer shooter where your deck is your ammo. Hurl paint cards, playing cards and tarot spells to smash marble chess pieces to rubble, heal on their shards, and take revenge on The Hands - the giant chess player who ate the Jester's cake.

details.title: Raisin Universe
details.short_description: Turn your stream chat into the players. Viewers type in Twitch or TikTok chat to pop mines, race marbles and fight over property in 16 minigames and 3 party board games. Only you buy the game: your viewers play free.

details.title: Pixel Sky Waystation
details.short_description: Become the new manager of the Sky Island, make warm food and cool drinks there, and help those traveling long roads rest comfortably

details.title: Iris's Idle Log
details.short_description: An idle RPG for the corner of your screen. Follow Iris's long adventure, battle for equipment and resources, and grow Life Skills like Mining, Logging, Fishing, Cooking, Farming, Writing, Painting, and Commerce. Play or step away—Iris's day goes on.

details.title: Kitchen of Gods
details.short_description: Greece is starving, and even the gods have to cook! Build divine temples, gather ingredients, and feed the starving in this roguelite management adventure.

details.title: NULL VECTOR
details.short_description: Defend a central core in a neon geometric survival tower defense. Move and aim your operator, construct fortifications, research permanent upgrades, collect enemy ability modules, face evolving bosses, unlock endless mode, or cooperate online with up to four players.

details.title: Koishi’s Fishing Journal
details.short_description: A Touhou Project fan-made desktop idle fishing game starring Koishi Komeiji. Relax and fish, collect varied fish and rare merfolk, cook ordinary fish, gather precious merfolk ingredients, and sell dishes. Keep upgrading and unlocking your collection as Koishi’s fishing life unfolds on your desktop.

details.title: Zombie Day Protocol
details.short_description: Activate beacons, summon the horde, and shoot your way out! Survive a 25-day train journey in this first-person zombie shooter. Return aboard between battles to gear up and shape your build. Fulfill a mysterious company's contract and reach the survivors' camp alive.

details.title: Crystal Core
details.short_description: Incremental mining game about mining resources, digging up artifacts and upgrading your powers to obliterate everything.

details.title: LEARN CHINESE WITH 1000 PRINCES
details.short_description: Learn Chinese from scratch with 1000 princes! Choose from Chinese courses at different levels and themed courses taught by the prince teachers, ask them questions and receive their answers. Each prince teacher shares his own story while teaching you Chinese.

details.title: BE@RBRICK HEROES
details.short_description: Run, jump, and race your way to the finish together! Create your own missions, collect a variety of BE@RBRICK(BEARBRICK), and explore a growing MMORPG world filled with adventure. Play, create, and connect your way. LET'S PLAY & CONNECT!

details.title: Esper Overload
details.short_description: A roguelike with customizable skills and auto-battle!! Lead a squad of psychics and use the skills you’ve customized yourself to wipe out the monsters once and for all!

details.title: hamstyping!
details.short_description: Let's type together with this cute hamster! Don't squish it, okay?☆

details.title: PanicOperator
details.short_description: Flick weapons into your backpack and face the hordes in this action roguelite! Manage automatic attacks, swap overheated weapons, and merge gear. Arrange skill pieces before each run and spend earned gold on permanent upgrades. Build your own way to fight!

details.title: Soul of Slime
details.short_description: Build your slime with cards, combine six elements and watch your strategy unfold in automatic battles. Survive 10 rounds, then take the same build into Endless mode and push on for as long as your lives last.

details.title: Gliding Together
details.short_description: Hang-glide from the summit to the landing field across 15 hand-crafted worlds. Lean to steer, dive for speed, thread rings to build your streak and slip past canyon walls, cable cars and laser gates. Chase your best run solo, or race up to three friends online.

details.title: VITA: Observa.Momento.Adservo.
details.short_description: VITA is a third-person exploration game centered on observation, discovery, and the relationship between mother nature and human nature. You play as VITA-UNIT-05, an autonomous Ecological Observation Unit that awakens on an unfamiliar Earth.

details.title: ABLATION
details.short_description: A first person puzzle game where you carry one material at a time, and what you take from one surface, you can give to another.

details.title: HexWorldDefence
details.short_description: A hex-tile tower defense where every unit you place becomes part of the enemy's path. Build a maze, evolve your units and hold out for 51 waves.

details.title: Shadows of Hollow Creek
details.short_description: Uncover the truth. Survive the night. Hollow Creek is a narrative-driven psychological thriller game where investigative journalism leads Clara Pierce to an isolated town plagued by disappearances, buried secrets, and whispers of a witch. Some stories are better left untold.

details.title: Turf Wars: Slumika
details.short_description: Build a crew and run the streets of a generated city in the country of Slumíka. Cook and deal, fight rival gangs, dodge police heat, buy houses and stash your goods in this top-down crime sim. Every new game is a new city.

details.title: RouteDom
details.short_description: Build your kingdom tile by tile! Draw, place, and connect roads, fields, and resources to your city in a strategic puzzle inspired by the great tabletop classics. Easy to learn, hard to master: every placement counts.

details.title: Pulp Friction
details.short_description: Fruit-on-fruit kitchen brawls! Roll, slice and parry as one of 18 living fruits, carve chunks off your rivals until their core shows and be the last fruit standing. 15 party modes for up to 8 players online or 4 on one couch, plus co-op raids against the mold.

details.title: Ninja Kaizen
details.short_description: Free-to-play, turn-based ninja RPG. Master the elements, build your jutsu, bring a pet and join a clan to fight bosses and rivals worldwide. Rise from Genin to Sage and carve your name into the global rankings. Free Ninja Kaizen account required.

details.title: MoltKeeper
details.short_description: Build a creature from parts and watch it fight. Each win pays samples of the parts your enemies wore, until they are yours to research; the rarest are carried only by wild creatures. Release builds into the Wilds to fight other keepers while you're away. A free creature builder and auto battler.

details.title: Decksplorers: Into the Shell
details.short_description: Dive into the world of Decksplorers: Into the Shell, where deckbuilding card combat meets real-time action in a thrilling roguelite adventure! Master the art of strategic card play, swift reflexes, and exploration as you venture into the mysterious ever-changing caves of "The shell"

details.title: Runners Catchers
details.short_description: Get ready for a fast-paced, chaotic tag game for up to 8 players! Dash through obstacle courses packed with giant donuts and candy hazards. Evade your friends as a Runner, or hunt them down as a Catcher. Run. Jump. Catch. Escape.

details.title: Article 7
details.short_description: Article 7 is a short political thriller where you play as Arvenia’s Minister of Civil Authority during a national crisis. Review documents, weigh conflicting information, speak with members of the press, and decide whether to grant emergency powers to the Chancellor.

details.title: Gunline
details.short_description: A tower defence you fight in first person. One road, one base, and thirty kinds of enemies walking down it. You meet them yourself with six guns and and build different kinds of defensive turrets.

details.title: Carnival Stand Simulator
details.short_description: Grill it. Load it. Hand it over. Carnival Stand Simulator drops you behind the counter of a midway hot dog stand where the line never really ends. Serve fast, sell out, and build the busiest pitch at the fair.

name: Tidy Up the Royal Vault: Somehow I'm the Hero Now!?

details.title: Tidy Up the Royal Vault: Somehow I'm the Hero Now!?
details.short_description: A single-player cozy organizing sim. Bring order to a scattered royal vault by sorting coins, gems, and scrolls, discover hidden fragments of the hero's sword along the way, and unlock magic to make the work easier. By the end, somehow, you've become a hero.

details.title: Reel Collectibles
details.short_description: Cast a line, hook a pack of baseball cards, and fight it to the boat without creasing it. Rip your wax, file the cards, and work through fifty years of sets from 1950 to 1999. A 16-bit collecting game about the pull, the binder, and the grade.

details.title: Corporate Slave
details.short_description: A satirical side-scrolling office RPG. Walk the open floor plan, survive standups, reviews and layoffs, dodge the AI quietly absorbing your tickets, sneak job interviews on company time, and grind toward the only real win condition: enough money to never come back.

details.title: Dead Man's Clock
details.short_description: Dead Man's Clock is a fast-paced 2D pixel-art western shooter where every second counts. Fight through an endless saloon shootout, gun down outlaws to steal back precious seconds, chase high scores, and survive as long as you can before the clock strikes zero.

details.title: The Turbo Crown
details.short_description: Drive cannon-equipped toy cars, jump across giant furniture, and fly with nitro in arcade battles for up to 10 players. Fight online or against bots, master four game modes, and customize every piece with no pay-to-win advantages.

name: 奇迹觉醒之大天使传奇

details.title: 奇迹觉醒之大天使传奇
details.short_description: 在剑与魔法的世界中开启属于你的冒险，这是一款以角色成长、装备收集、BOSS挑战和多人战斗为核心的魔幻动作角色扮演游戏。选择你的职业，不断升级、转职、强化装备，挑战更强大的敌人，与其他冒险者共同争夺大陆至高荣耀。

details.title: SURVOLT
details.short_description: SURVOLT is a fast 3v3 arena sport. Pass to charge the ball, then shoot at moving wall targets: the more you pass, the more each hit is worth. Volleys, tackles, dives and a golden zone that doubles your points. Solo vs AI or online, no port forwarding.

details.title: Imp Pact
details.short_description: An incremental where an ageing man who cannot read makes his mark on an imp's contract, puts the imps to work on the rats in his cellar, and is billed for the trial period. Keep the interest current, in blood, every forty-five seconds, or he takes imps back, and is apologetic about it.

details.title: Honk
details.short_description: Honk is a free-to-play, one-button precision platformer where you race real players online. Tap to jump past spikes, pipes and rocket cats, climb the ranked ladder, battle through tournaments every few hours, build your own levels, and hatch over 100 skins for your collection!

details.title: A Million Trees
details.short_description: A logging and automation game that is solo or co-op. Set in a forest with A Million Trees you can Chop down. Each tree is then processed into smaller chunks or planks then sold. Using this money you can then buy chainsaws, upgrades, conveyors and machines for automation.

details.title: The Crash
details.short_description: Wake up or run! The Crash is a high tension 5-minute horror game where you are trapped inside a dream maze. Navigate the panic, avoid the monsters and find the way out.

details.title: Keep to the Blue
details.short_description: Explore a flooded post-apocalyptic world, battle your enemies, and upgrade your ship with the loot you find. But watch out for pirates!

details.title: MovingLog
details.short_description: A physics-based team party game for up to 12 players in four teams. One player hoists the log overhead while teammates ride on top, and where they stand decides how it tilts. Clear obstacles, ride a rival team's log to throw them off, and get your log and your whole team to the goal first.

details.title: SAAM Tactics
details.short_description: Catch creatures, raise and train them on your ranch, and win turn-based battles to claim a map one hex at a time. An easy-going strategy game with or without a timer as desired.

details.title: Destruction Snake
details.short_description: In Destruction Snake, you start with a basic mechanical snake and dive into swarms of enemies. Weave through the battlefield, shoot, burn, freeze, and destroy your way through the horde, collecting scattered resources to continuously strengthen your build.

details.title: Ultimate RPS Championship
details.short_description: Ultimate RPS Championship turns Rock, Paper, Scissors into a full-blown 90s arcade combat sport. Build a deck of specialized moves, read your opponents, customize your fighter, conquer the story campaign, and take your strategy into PvP (coming soon).

details.title: AbsoluteNeko
details.short_description: AbsoluteNeko is a co-op action game for up to four players set in a Japanese neighborhood. Play as stray cats, run along walls, cars and rooftops, slip past patrolling dogs, and regroup before time runs out. Meow to save caught friends, and take pictures of your cats in photo mode.

details.title: Run Man: Wash the Dish
details.short_description: $20K in the hole. Stuck in a Chinatown dish pit. Rent’s due, the boss is barking, and the clock is ticking. Turn a 99-cent sponge into a screen-clearing cannon, trigger explosive combos, and uncover rare loot. Stack cash under the table—and scrub your way to a green card!

details.title: Odds At Oddity
details.short_description: Odds At Oddity is a blackjack based roguelike deck builder. Manage your power betting deck, create diverse combinations and scale your points as far as you can go!

details.title: Super Money Ring
details.short_description: Roll as a ring to the goal as quickly as possible! Race ghosts worldwide for the fastest time on any of the 100+ carefully crafted levels! Find the secrets hidden in every level! Try the demo today!

details.title: Wanderer of Spaces
details.short_description: A lighthearted first-person puzzle game based on real architectural designs. Dive into the inner world of an architect, travel through realistic and imaginary spaces, and experience the architect's career from the beginning to self-fulfillment.

details.title: Snowday Co
details.short_description: Start with just a shovel and build your snow plowing business across an open-world town. Take on jobs, expand your territory, and keep up with whatever the winter throws at you.

details.title: Quiet Men: Mafia Simulator
details.short_description: A 1970s mafia simulator. Start with a back room, one street corner and a few friends, and build a Family the Commission has to respect. Every choice is remembered: men earn nicknames, debts come due, and someone is always talking to the feds.

details.title: Bauble
details.short_description: An action-stealth roguelite about newly sentient creatures investigating the sudden collapse of their ecosystem. Sneak, fight, and negotiate your way through expeditions, learning a little more about your planet each time.

details.title: Chromagami
details.short_description: Rip and tear through the competition in Chromagami, an interdimensional, fast-paced, handmade (literally) hero shooter. With 3 distinct origami characters, paper-built maps, and a boxload full of wacky events, learn to outfold both your friends and foes by putting them through the shredder!

details.title: Crounds
details.short_description: Crounds is a fast-paced PvP chess roguelike. Choose a powerful King, draft game-breaking upgrades, and bend the traditional rules of chess to destroy your opponent! Synergize your chaotic upgrades to create your winning strategy!

details.title: Vegetableau
details.short_description: A relaxing sliding tile puzzle game. Sort vegetables into contiguous groups across 15 levels of increasing difficulty. Try to beat your best time, challenge your friends to a race, or just play endlessly to relax.

details.title: Shape Sift
details.short_description: Build experimental sorting systems to separate, transform, and route flowing shapes in this minimalist physics-based automation puzzle game.

details.title: BRAVERUN
details.short_description: Thrilling action and epic boss battles! Dash through a 90s-style pixel world in the retro action RPG BRAVERUN — cut through hordes of enemies and face mighty foes!

details.title: Schoolgirl vs Fishman
details.short_description: Schoolgirls × Mermen × Sewers! A "drenched" horror adventure! Solve mysteries to find an exit, and decide: will you run or fight? Your choices branch the story. Can they escape this nightmare safely...?

details.title: Who Got In?
details.short_description: A driving simulator where every passenger is different. Meet unforgettable characters, make dialogue choices, earn money, upgrade your garage, and discover the unexpected stories waiting behind every ride.

details.title: Flag Conquest
details.short_description: An incremental roguelite auto-battler. Build a persistent army, program its tactics with Gambits, and take a fallen kingdom back one flag at a time across zones that never stop scaling. Retreat, bank what you earned, come back stronger. Deep prestige, an endless Tower, and King of the Hill.

details.title: Hyper-Realistic Fishing Sim
details.short_description: Cast your way through hordes of fish, explode arcade cabinets, and kill Poseidon in this tiny endless fishing combat game!

details.title: Orbisphere
details.short_description: A cozy arcade idle game about one small astronaut alone in a forgotten corner of the cosmos. Slingshot around planets to gather stardust and spend it to keep your machines humming while you're away. Every idle hour is earned. Navigate an asteroid belt, slice feral space worms and find your way home.

details.title: DinoBox
details.short_description: Drop dinosaurs,merge matching species, and evolve them into something bigger! DinoBox is a physics-based puzzle game where every 20 turns, a meteor strikes the box—destroying one dinosaur and potentially changing everything. Build bigger dinos, fill your encyclopedia, and see how far you can evolve!

details.title: Clicker Inc. - Generational Succession
details.short_description: Build a business empire across generations! Click to earn, hire employees for passive income, and use stocks, banks, and auctions to survive booms and crashes. Pass the company to the next CEO, unlock 100+ skills, complete achievements, and grow into a world-changing corporation!

name: A Heart-Stirring Date by Victoria Harbour: New Year's Eve at the Turn of the Millennium

details.title: A Heart-Stirring Date by Victoria Harbour: New Year's Eve at the Turn of the Millennium
details.short_description: 这是一款互动恋爱 + 港片商战悬疑影游。在千禧前的香港，你将扮演李洋，在失恋、追杀与资本争夺中寻找真相，你得先活下来，改变处境，也需要找到愿意与你站在一起的人。最后结局会是怎样的，我想把这个决定留给你。

details.title: Fired
details.short_description: FIRED is a retro-styled puzzle adventure game centered around the story of a young employee who gets FIRED while trying to expose the evil Orcus Corporation. Explore the world, solve puzzles, and work to take down Orcus.

details.title: Pixel Ping Pong
details.short_description: A relaxing idle incremental game where you break tiles, earn coins, and upgrade your growing swarm of balls. Aim your shots to speed up your progress, or sit back and let the game play itself.

details.title: Grape by Grape
details.short_description: A cozy vineyard idler where your cursor makes vines grow. Turn 14 grape varieties into aged wine, raisins, vinegar and pekmez; automate six connected estate stations and fill customer orders. No frantic clicking, no failure—just one more harvest, bottle and upgrade.

details.title: DISTRAIL
details.short_description: [Distrail] features a protagonist who suddenly becomes the 'director' of the final escape vessel project,and This is a visual novel game that tells the story of the 80 days the project takes place.

details.title: Minus Sixty
details.short_description: Minus Sixty is a single-player, first-person, story-driven adventure set in extreme cold. As mechanical engineer Viktor, head toward a village to repair its broken coal boiler. Gather resources, craft supplies, build fires to stay warm, manage your inventory, and overcome environmental obstacles.

details.title: Dungeon Overtime
details.short_description: Run the cleanup shift after fantasy heroes trash your dungeon. Assign slimes, skeletons, and mimics, turn manual cleanup into automation, and keep the next raid ready—all from a compact desktop window.

details.title: Starwreck Reclaimer
details.short_description: Pilot a combat salvager into a shifting starship graveyard in this top-down twin-stick action roguelite. Battle hostile machines, manage ammunition and hull integrity, choose risky protocols, recover valuable scrap, and build powerful weapon and module combinations.

details.title: Be A Chameleon
details.short_description: Save humanity, be the shining light against darkness, and destroy all evil. Not really..... it's a silly sandbox game where you play as a chameleon.

details.title: ESCAPE: FALSE COLORS
details.short_description: ESCAPE: FALSE COLORS is a 2–6 player multiplayer chase game! Paint your character, blend into the environment, and take on random roles each round. Killers hunt, sheriffs chase, and innocents fight to survive. Hide, disguise, and run. Who will make it to the end?

details.title: Haunted! But Sorted.
details.short_description: It's 1996. Wojak needs money, and his girlfriend Dodoo is counting on him. His job: the night shift at a shop in the middle of a graveyard. Haul in deliveries, sort every product and keep one eye on the dark. Play solo or co-op, but don't go outside alone.

details.title: Rot & Bloom
details.short_description: A cozy idle compost bin for your second monitor. Feed it scraps, watch them rot into a glowing garden, then drop a Mystery Scrap and hope for a garden-sized miracle — a bloom big enough to swallow the screen. Hire gnomes, grow a season tree, and let it tick away while you work.

details.title: Last Contract
details.short_description: Last Contract is a fast paced 2D action game set in a pixel art cyberpunk world that you need katanas, shurikens and quick reflexes to survive.

details.title: Astrolobe OS
details.short_description: A game console you can walk into. Astrolobe OS is an orbital station with a desk of your own, original games including TERMINAL ORION, and a real desktop for work. Full controller support for most controllers out of the box in every game, plus 4-player split screen on games that support it.

details.title: Who Am I
details.short_description: Lost in amnesia, face a horrific past rising from nightmares. Uncover the truth hidden in a diary. In this psychological horror where reality and hallucination blur, piece together memories before madness consumes you. When the truth is out, ask yourself: Who was I?

details.title: Little Christmas Workshop
details.short_description: An adorable, stocking stuffer-sized factory automation game

details.title: Hold My Cargo
details.short_description: A first-person smuggling sim. Buy low, sell high, stash the good stuff where customs won't look and talk your way past inspection. Grow from a rust bucket to a freighter, escape the galaxy, then do it again. Online co-op for 1–4 players arrives in the first major update.

details.title: Ball Breakers
details.short_description: Welcome to dodgeball-yeeting heaven. Throw, punch, block, catch, dodge, slide and more in this ball and powerup slinging mayhem simulator. What build will you master? The choice is yours but no matter what - you won't stop laughing, that much is a guarantee.

name: What Do You Meme?® The Video Game

details.title: What Do You Meme?® The Video Game
details.short_description: The smash-hit card game has gone digital! What Do You Meme?® The Video Game brings internet humor to the living room. Use your phone as a controller to battle your friends and build hilarious memes!

details.title: Enchantalot
details.short_description: Strike and enchant weapons on a magic workbench. Each success makes them stronger and worth more - but the higher you climb, the riskier every blow. Send your gear out on quests, collect relics that build on each other, and watch the numbers spiral out of control.

details.title: Parent Printer Driver Simulator
details.short_description: Relive the anguish of being your family's IT support! Scroll, paint, ski, type, and search through a wonderfully ugly internet of the past. Find the best, and least virus filled, printer driver for whatever kind of cheap off-brand printer your parents have. Or just play the skiing game...

details.title: Perfumer's Life Simulator
details.short_description: Run your own perfume shop in first person. Blend essences, bottle scents, age them in the vault, and sell to customers with exact tastes. Order stock, furnish the store, take commissions, and grow your reputation one bottle at a time.

details.title: 三国龙将传奇
details.short_description: 一款以三国乱世为背景的经典策略角色扮演游戏。玩家将招募三国名将，培养专属武将队伍，通过五大武将职业搭配、阵型配置与回合制战斗征战天下。体验丰富的三国剧情、装备养成、副本挑战及竞技场玩法，在群雄争霸的乱世中书写属于自己的英雄传奇！

details.title: ThrottleWave: Powerboats
details.short_description: Take the wheel of high-powered speedboats and battle your friends on the open water. Race for the finish line in high-speed circuits or test your precision in Gate Catching, where you must blast through spawning gates before your rivals steal the points.

details.title: I Am Octopus
details.short_description: 🐙What would you do if you woke up one day and you were an Octopus🐙 Even worse, being held captive by the evil Dr Docto who is back on his evil ways...and wait, is he using you as a test subject?

details.title: FlashWords: Wordfall
details.short_description: FlashWords: Wordfall is a language-learning word game where you guide falling words to their correct translations, clear the board, and unlock new vocabulary as you play.

details.title: Pocket Partner
details.short_description: A lightweight, fully customizable desktop companion. Bring 3D anime characters to your screen with full VRM support. Experience unprecedented control: import your own animations, edit materials, change facial expressions, save custom outfits, and interact with physics while you work or play.

details.title: The Chair Game
details.short_description: A slightly tricky physics action game about going home in an office chair. Casters are less obliging than you'd think: hills are hard work, stopping isn't easy, and one pebble can send you tumbling into the sea. Push off with your feet, spin the seat, lean back, chair and all — and still, go home.

details.title: Corporate Simulator
details.short_description: Climb from intern to CEO in this idle/incremental game where your company runs on a living spreadsheet. Hire, crush morale, rig the audits, and rack up ISO certifications... all the way to burnout or a golden retirement. 18 playable visual themes, dozens of hours of progression.

details.title: Hello Golem
details.short_description: Deep in the bowels of Cocoa Co. lays a terrible evil… Thankfully, June is on the case! Her courageous friend, Golem (that's you!), will venture the building in search of this evil. But be careful: you never know what else you may find there…

details.title: Moon Basketball
details.short_description: This is basketball. On the moon. Gravity is different and also there's jetpacks.

details.title: Legend Dary
details.short_description: A quirky retro platformer where an ordinary office worker sets out to win the princess's heart. Explore 70 stages across 3 unique worlds, collect keys and stars, earn coins, upgrade weapons, and unlock new characters.

details.title: One More Chop
details.short_description: One More Chop is a short, fast-paced incremental woodcutting game. Chop down trees, gather resources, craft axes, unlock skills, and invest your resources in an expansive upgrade tree to grow stronger!

details.title: Digi Dice
details.short_description: A rogue-like dice-building game. Craft your own dice, play them strategically, upgrade your modifiers and discover magnificent combos.

details.title: Parcel Panic
details.short_description: A VR arcade frenzy at the world's worst delivery hub. Sort fast, keep your combo alive, don't flip the fragile ones, and never leave your post. Just one more shift…

details.title: Coppersmog
details.short_description: Run a steampunk lab in a world being eaten by the Coppersmog conglomerate. Breed, mutate, and trade one-eyed blorbs, pick your way through an economy built to make you complicit, and hunt the Reversal: the one discovery that proves Aldous Puddlepot wrong.

details.title: Project: Summer Ice Bowling Online
details.short_description: A Christian-themed, story driven, anime-styled bowling video game in the Project: Summer Ice franchise!

details.title: VOX Zero
details.short_description: VOX Zero is a high-mobility 3D voxel survivors-like. Wield an arsenal of ever-mutating living weapons as you weave, leap, and dash through a multi-level amusement park, tear apart relentless hordes, and evolve every weapon into a devastating superweapon.

details.title: Equilibrium
details.short_description: Equilibrium is an atmospheric dark fantasy visual novel where your choices shape not only the story, but the protagonist herself. Uncover the secrets of a world shared by humans and demons—and decide whom to trust when reality begins to fall apart.

details.title: Flight Fights
details.short_description: You and up to 4 friends are the cabin crew on a flight spiraling into chaos. Serve meals, break up fights, unclog toilets, and stop the plane from descending into mayhem. Frantic local and online co-op for 1 to 5 players. No two flights go the same way twice.

details.title: Last Choice Hero
details.short_description: Is that choice really heroic? Guide an immortal Hero through absurdly cruel ultimate choices in this dark-comedy fantasy ADV.

details.title: Christmas Wonderland 8
details.short_description: A festive family friendly Hidden Object Game

details.title: Farm Bunnies
details.short_description: Plant, water and grow fruits and vegetables to fulfill orders. Play with your friends or solo and customize your rabbit. Explore each seasons and discover their set of mechanics in this co-op farming party game.

details.title: GO or STOP
details.short_description: GO or STOP reimagines the traditional game Red Light, Green Light as a social mind-game party game. Players alternate between seeker and runner. Runners shove, hide behind rivals, and race for first place, while the seeker watches for movement and stops them from reaching the finish.

details.title: Pickpocket
details.short_description: Pickpocket is an incremental game about stealing. Learn from your victims, get better loot, and advance through an extensive skill tree. Build your own crime empire!

details.title: Hysterical Strength
details.short_description: A boogeywoman driven by vengeance guides a mysterious boy north across a decrepit world, cutting down the warlords in her way. With an ancient blade, a magical top-break revolver, and the perfect combo of drugs, survive or live in this 2.5D hack-and-slash FPS hybrid adventure.

details.title: BumperMania
details.short_description: An online car brawler made of voxels. Ram the other cars until they fall apart or push them off the edge. Grab weapons from crates, like a lasso, an orbital laser or an hourglass that stops time. Last car standing wins. Play with friends or against bots.

details.title: Pizzeria: The Pizza Restaurant Sim
details.short_description: Build your own pizzeria from scratch! Roll the dough, slice the toppings, cook your sauce in a pot, bake the pizza in the oven and serve your customers. Tweak your recipes, furnish your restaurant, manage your money and become the neighborhood's favorite pizzeria.

details.title: Bunker Hill
details.short_description: Bunker Hill is a WW2 roguelike zombie shooter for 1-4 players. Fight through waves of undead that still haven't forgotten how to wield weapons.

details.title: Proper Football Boss
details.short_description: Remember when football was proper? Let us take you back 40 years — to when naming two subs was still a luxury and the only seven-figure salaries were in Italian lira.

details.title: Warden Campaigns
details.short_description: Warden Campaigns is a virtual tabletop where Game Masters build worlds, host multiplayer sessions through Steam, and create encounters that react to player choices. Set traps, automate consequences, and bring your party's story to life—your rules, your adventure.

details.title: Doomsday Anchor
details.short_description: Do a completely normal... anomaly containment job. It's just the fate of the entire world in your hands, no big deal, don't stress!

details.title: En Garde Gambit
details.short_description: A turn-based tactical roguelite where you and your enemies plan predictively for simultaneous resolution. Every move and attack resolve at once. Outwit enemies in various maps, with various skills/upgrades, in Singleplayer, co-op, and PvP.

details.title: Dice of Soul：刹那の裁定
details.short_description: Dice of Soul brings the Japanese dice game Chinchiro to turn-based combat. Make the most of each character’s skills and pick your targets carefully. Your roll determines how hard you hit, and a little luck can turn a clever play into a decisive blow.

details.title: Panda vs Meow
details.short_description: Play a round little panda fighting off cat hordes in this top-down survival roguelite. Mix weapons and relics, unleash active skills, and buy traits between waves. Collect matching archetype traits to activate synergies that change how you fight.

details.title: Lost in Ascension
details.short_description: Out of Orbit is a challenging vertical adventure where every jump matters. Navigate floating platforms, moving obstacles and unpredictable paths as you climb towards the unknown.

details.title: Tether and Talon
details.short_description: Tethter and Talon is deckbuilding turn based combat game that borrows elements from creature collectors and roguelites. Draft your team of Yokai, play their moves as cards and make your way through rounds of enemies and send evil back in the Nether.

details.title: Rash Decision
details.short_description: Co-op medical for 1-2 players. The Nurse examines a very unwell patient and SHOUTS the symptoms through a hatch. The Biochemist brews a cure from a deeply unreliable grimoire. Get it wrong and the patient mutates. Then mutates again.

details.title: The Clues
details.short_description: The Clues is a challenging logic deduction game set in Paw Town. Play as a cat detective, read the clues, and identify every Criminal and Innocent. No guessing, no luck—every handcrafted puzzle has a unique solution.

details.title: Riot Control: Europe
details.short_description: Isometric pixel-art tower defense parody. Waves of protesters march on the parliament, your only job is to stop there, by any means necessary.

details.title: Under The Counter
details.short_description: A roguelike where your weapon is a tree of absurd pills. Take the wrong prescription, descend the dungeon under Globnix, dodge telegraphed horrors, and build a run-ending arsenal from attacks and charms. Every seed is a new dungeon. Death is just a new dose.

details.title: The Longest Sword
details.short_description: Grow a sword that never stops getting longer, from arm's length to over 240 meters. Spin your blade through scarecrows, orchards and villages, sweep up coins for 141 upgrades, unleash double-length giant swings, and prestige to forge a blade huge enough to slice down the castle.

details.title: Le Cœur de l'Hydre
details.short_description: Dive in a dark world with Le Cœur de l’Hydre, a fantasy visual novel that blends art, science, and the occult. Meet various characters and mysterious creatures and take decisions to survive.

details.title: TILELIA
details.short_description: Collect cards, place buildings, and forge your own army in this roguelite auto-battler. Combine units, spells, and relics from different factions. Make the most of limited space and gold, and discover new combinations to overcome each battle.

details.title: 200 OK
details.short_description: A node-based idle game about running a server. Wire up requests, tune the bottlenecks, research your way from one uplink to a global edge. Calm, steady and fully offline-friendly.

details.title: Visual Novel: 3:17 PM
details.short_description: Eleven-year-old Asya arrives to visit her clockmaker grandfather in Chasovets, only to discover that time has frozen at 3:17. Alongside a talking cat and a boy collecting lost minutes in a jar, climb the old tower, solve the town's mystery, and give people back their tomorrow!

details.title: Horror Simulator
details.short_description: A night shift at the precinct turns into a nightmare when the terrifying "Subject #4" breaks free from the basement. No weapons, locked doors, dead comms. Navigate a maze of hallways, crack safes, and hide in the dark. Your shift lasts until 08:00. Will you live to see the dawn?

details.title: Tower of Misfits
details.short_description: A first-person co-op roguelite from one to 6 players. Pick one of twelve misfits, each with a weapon and an ultimate of their own, and climb a tower that never ends: a new world on every floor, bosses, perks, curses, and friends to fight over the chest with.

details.title: Earth Unbound
details.short_description: Lead a clandestine resistance in the occupied American Midwest of the 1920s. Recruit and train operatives, coordinate dangerous missions, and outwit the Occupation Bureau. Every assignment risks exposure, capture or death—and every outcome shapes your campaign.

details.title: Fishy Tidy Up
details.short_description: Grandpa's aquarium museum had a rough night: every tank cracked and 3,600 fish ended up on the floor. Fix the tanks, sort each fish into its own home by species, look and size, and bring nine rooms of sea life back in this cozy first-person tidy-up game.

name: Lost Places - Lonely Town - Collector's Edition

details.title: Lost Places - Lonely Town - Collector's Edition
details.short_description: Embark on an exciting expedition through a lonely town in the middle of nowhere. Explore detailed hidden-object scenes and solve mini-games to uncover the secrets of this abandoned place.

details.title: Geometry Platforms
details.short_description: WELCOME TO A GEOMETRIC SPACE ODYSSEY In a universe of collapsing forms, you are the last vector of resistance. Surviving hordes is half the battle—the ground beneath you is a dynamic, lethal threat! Brace for neon bullet hell, pinpoint physics, synth beats, and endlessly rewarding progression.

details.title: Vitrelium
details.short_description: Step into an atmospheric alchemy workshop. Mix substances, heat and cool liquids, distill vapors, and grow crystals. Discover reactions in a hands-on laboratory sandbox where real-world chemistry meets imagination.

details.title: 魔塔-织梦
details.short_description: A turn-based RPG featuring classic Magic Tower gameplay. Climb through tower floors, collect keys and gold, fight monsters in turn-based battles, solve puzzles, and uncover the truth behind the Demon Lord and the Princess at the tower’s peak. There are three distinct endings.

details.title: Tapal
details.short_description: Bring your favorite characters to your desktop! Tapal’s AI pals remember your conversations, start chats and share selfies. Import character cards and memories. To play together or run a tabletop campaign, install a third-party MCP or Skill for the game you want to play.

details.title: AREA 83
details.short_description: AREA 83 is a first-person survival horror shooter set inside a research facility overrun by the infected. Explore dark corridors, uncover classified experiments, manage limited supplies and fight to survive as you discover the terrifying truth behind the outbreak.

details.title: Merchants Of The Silk Road
details.short_description: Thrace, 1261. Raiders burned your village in the night. Your wife is gone. Your brother, your daughter and your son walk east in the column of Kareem of Tabriz, a slaver bound for the markets of Sivas, Samarkand and Turfan, and from there to China

details.title: Nachtfrost
details.short_description: Nachtfrost is a round-based WWII zombie survival shooter. Play alone or with up to three friends across six haunted wartime maps: board the windows, restore the power, earn points for perks and weapons, and survive the dead for as long as you can.

details.title: DeepSeaFishery
details.short_description: A deep-sea idle fishing game. Cast, let your fish grow and your crew work while you are away. Descend from the shallows to coral reefs, polar ice and volcanic vents, collecting 252 species. Hire helpers, upgrade your gear, then retire to trade the run for permanent talents.

details.title: Goblin Hoarder
details.short_description: Goblins and humans are at war, and the loot cave got broken into. Thousands of pieces of stolen treasure are now piled in a new cave, and it’s your job to sort them. Fill shelves, grow towers, unlock goblin upgrades and gadgets, and become the ultimate hoarding machine!

details.title: Last Thaw
details.short_description: Low-poly hardcore zombie survival where the cold is as deadly as the dead. Scavenge a 3.3 km map, build and defend a base, tune cars and drive out on frozen lakes, and hold out through the seasons, alone or in co-op with up to 8. No health bar: read your body.

name: L A C U N A

details.title: L A C U N A
details.short_description: A sci-fi exploration and probe-command simulation. Plot courses, scan unknown worlds, decode signals, and collect samples with a lone VESPER probe. Manage fuel, power, and damaged equipment over a delayed communications link, where careful planning keeps your mission alive.

details.title: KEYS
details.short_description: KEYS a rhythm game where you aim at the note with your mouse and hit the keys with WASD.

details.title: Idle Pirates
details.short_description: A pirate-themed incremental idle game! Destroy crates, collect treasure and venture deep into ships to rescue your crew to help you haul in even more loot. Fight your way deep into ships and take down mighty bosses.

details.title: Fire of Emotions
details.short_description: Stoke your inner flame and decide which desires to let in. Pride, Desire, Depression, Love, and other influences interact within you, shaping how life unfolds. Accept, Deny, or Abstain, but no response guarantees the outcome you intended. Let in too much, or too little, and you may become hollow.

details.title: Opolution
details.short_description: How far can you get before you wake? Explore five illustrated dreams, plan your next move in an open book, and turn familiar tasks into routines. At the dream press, make an adventure of your own, from its first location to its final line.

details.title: CatSitter - Remastered
details.short_description: A short and linear horror game with multiple endings. Play as Amy the photographer who, unknowingly, takes on a well-paid, weekend gig that turns out to house more secrets than she bargained for.

details.title: WebCreep.er
details.short_description: Get filthy rich... Without leaving the toilet.

details.title: Please Stop Feeding The Frog
details.short_description: A first person incremental game about feeding a frog. Kill cute backyard creatures, throw them into his mouth, sell the random garbage he burps out, and buy increasingly ridiculous weapons. The frog keeps getting bigger. What's the worse that could happen?

details.title: やさ死くシて
details.short_description: Welcome, Subject 03. It's time for your psychological experiments. Four experiments. 56 endings. Save others, abandon them, or put yourself first. Every choice is yours. A simple game, really. Just decide how to use your kindness. Heh. Can you be kind? To yourself—and to others.

details.title: EAT Your Way Out
details.short_description: Had enough for today? Grab a spoon and eat your way through living jelly. Sell what you swallow, upgrade your tools, and follow your curiosity toward the exit. There is no rush and nothing to fear. Just you, your spoon, and a strange little journey for the price of a bad vending machine decision.

details.title: Catkanoid
details.short_description: Catcanoid is a fast-paced, pixel-art roguelite brick breaker! Collect coins, spend them to upgrade your paddle and ball, and create powerful synergies. Help Julia the cat survive waves of enemies and defeat a challenging boss - Kuba the capybara!

details.title: Holy Night Survivors
details.short_description: Raise a holy heroine and fight undead hordes in this survival action game. Dodge enemies, evolve weapons, choose one transcendence per run, and grow stronger between battles across 15 chapters. Collect relics and 62 illustrated photo cards.

name: Just Take Me to My Floor!

details.title: Just Take Me to My Floor!
details.short_description: This is a short, rule-based elevator horror puzzle game where you aim to reach the 10th floor while following a series of eerie rules that change daily.

details.title: Dr. Harlow's Clinic
details.short_description: Treat patients and perform medical procedures as an ordinary hospital routine slowly descends into psychological horror. Finish your shift, watch your surroundings, and try to understand what is happening around you.

details.title: Zombie Incremental: The Last Outpost
details.short_description: Fight zombies. Earn gold. Upgrade your arsenal. Push deeper into a fallen world in this action-packed incremental shooter. Aim, dodge, and turn hard-earned upgrades into the firepower you need to survive the next wave.

details.title: Who A Meme I?
details.short_description: The King reads out an awkward situation, you answer with the perfect meme from your hand. Make the King laugh, climb from island to island and steal the crown. A 2-8 player online party game for friend groups. Note: prompts are currently in Turkish only.

details.title: 2Desktop
details.short_description: An anime desktop companion powered by AI that runs 100% on your PC, with no internet or subscriptions. Chat with Yue in English or Spanish, play your music and watch her react from her audio visualizer, or bring her into your streams as she reacts to your voice.

details.title: Triads
details.short_description: TRIADS is a sci-fi turn-based tactical combat game where you command cybernetically linked mechs across hex-based battlefields. Maneuver for position, manage initiative, exploit firing arcs and rear attacks, combine fire against key targets, and avoid dangerous Cybernetic Feedback.

name: Minesweeper: Find All the Bombs in the Minefield

details.title: Minesweeper: Find All the Bombs in the Minefield
details.short_description: Minesweeper goes big. In Find the Bombs, up to 4 players clear a giant minefield together, dig up every mine they flag, conquer guarded bases and fill them with coloured bombs. Or go head to head in ranked 1v1 duels on the same board, or take on the solo Race, where one mistake ends your run.

details.title: 捕捉小动物
details.short_description: A casual simulation game where you upgrade different nets and abilities to catch animals with various abilities, and experience the thrill of scratching off a scratch-off ticket to win a big prize.

details.title: Horde Hero
details.short_description: Survive monster swarms with 13 classes, 57 skills and a sprawling skill tree. Grow your build offline or pursue seasonal rankings with separate online progress. Free demo now available to download.

details.title: River Royale
details.short_description: Race 79 rival rivers down a real mountain island in a battle royale where you play as the water. Drop in from the sky, carve your route through the valleys, swallow lakes to grow, cut off smaller rivers and be the first to reach the sea.

details.title: Little Extinctions
details.short_description: Three subspecies descended from one gray ancestor meet again in a drought. Every creature carries a gene of three loci that sets its body and its behavior, and it eats, hunts, breeds, and forms packs on its own. As an alien biologist, you observe which lineages survive.

details.title: Scrapjump
details.short_description: A co-op horde shooter for 1 to 4 robots. Your mouse aims, each button fires one arm. Level up together, bolt new guns onto your arms, take down five Wardens and keep jumping to the next planet until the whole crew is scrap.

details.title: 一撇 One Stroke Short
details.short_description: There's a Chinese saying for a job that hasn't begun: the character is still one stroke short. You're the missing stroke in this puzzle adventure. Knock a character out of a sentence to clear the way, then play the four tones of Mandarin to make a path where there wasn't one.

details.title: NT Jigsaws: Northern Territory, Australia
details.short_description: A calm jigsaw and picture puzzle game made from 208 photographs of Central Australia and the Top End. Build the border, join pieces on the table, and watch a gorge or a desert sunset come together. No rush, no ads, and it saves the moment you stop.

details.title: Harem of Lies
details.short_description: She's hoping you'll banish the wrong woman. How sweet. Unveil 30 adult anime characters in a single-player deduction roguelike, expose disguised succubi, and unlock their stories. Every Court can be won by reasoning alone. No forced guesses.

details.title: Toddler Any Key: Work Machines
details.short_description: For toddlers and small kids who like big work machines. Press any key to advance the narrated picture book story. Dig, build and farm. Get used to a computer, finish small jobs and feel proud of what you’ve done. Encouraging and safe game for toddlers.

details.title: EGNAR
details.short_description: Discover the colorful world of Egnar! Learn to time your jumps precisely while using your cannon system to overcome obstacles, solve puzzles and defeat bad guys! Return to the essence of a 2D platformer, in which the player's precision, patience & problem-solving skills are put to the test.

details.title: The Spectrum Retreat: Redux
details.short_description: The Spectrum Retreat: Redux is an atmospheric and unsettling first person puzzle thriller, rebuilt from the ground up for modern hardware.

details.title: Gunship Together
details.short_description: Crew a gunship with your friends and accomplish complex and diverse missions! Upgrade your ship and make intense on-the-fly tactical decisions to accomplish each mission set before you. Make sure to practice your landings; a mission isn't successful unless you make it home!

details.title: Campfire Simulator
details.short_description: Build, light and tend a realistic campfire. Chop wood, brew tea, toast marshmallows and play guitar under the stars.

details.title: Cozy Cat Match 2
details.short_description: A free-to-start match-3 puzzle game with cozy cat-themed art and relaxing puzzles. Play the first 20 levels, create satisfying combos, and unlock the full experience through DLC.

details.title: Poppets & Plunder
details.short_description: Sail a cutaway brig through four seas of Navy gunships, witch-hunters and Company gold. Run the crew deck by deck, work the guns, and when you are outgunned, reach for the voodoo doll and push a pin into the enemy ship. A roguelite of real-time fights and costly magic.

details.title: Collapsed: Build to Break
details.short_description: The cannon is back. In this sequel to the physics puzzle game Collapsed, find the weak point and topple wood and stone structures with a limited supply of cannonballs. Then build your own levels in the editor and break those too.

details.title: Rolling Heads
details.short_description: The Rolling Heads is a multiplayer battle arena fighting game with literally Rolling Heads. Kind of like sumo wrestling on steroids.

details.title: 내일의 챔피언 (Tomorrow's Champion)
details.short_description: We've all dreamed of racing our own mini car, haven't we? Build and tune your mini racer, discover hidden Overdrives, and outsmart rivals with strategic pit stops. Race your way to the championship! BOOST ON!

details.title: Elysian Realms
details.short_description: A pixel-art tower defence game for PC. Hold the road across seven realms, and each one changes a rule of the game. Every run, won or lost, feeds a skill tree that carries over to the next. No account and no telemetry: it runs on your machine and nowhere else.

details.title: Be Original
details.short_description: In this game you have the one goal of making many original characters as you can. The two rules? you cant make a character you've already made and you cant make a popular character that already exist.

name: The Way: The Life and Ministry of Jesus

details.title: The Way: The Life and Ministry of Jesus
details.short_description: Experience the life and ministry of Jesus Christ in this 30-chapter, story-driven biblical adventure. Explore the world of the Gospels, meet the people who encountered Jesus, and walk the path that changed history.

details.title: Brick Blocks: Tidy Up Together
details.short_description: Someone tipped 10,860 toy bricks all over five brick-built towns. Grab a bucket, solo or in co-op for up to eight, and snap them back into 14 giant builds, from a rubber duck to a dragon. Finish one and it comes alive. Cosy first-person tidying with no timers and plenty of upgrades.

details.title: Paranormal Cleaner
details.short_description: Take late-night cleaning jobs in a first-person horror game. Load up your van, mop floors, vacuum rugs, and take out the rubbish. When a cupboard opens by itself or an unplugged washer starts knocking, decide how much of the checklist is worth finishing.

details.title: Pop Dynasty
details.short_description: Build your own talent agency in this idle management sim. Recruit from 200 Pop Stars, train them, send them on Tour, and fight for Trophies at the Awards. Your Agency keeps running even while the game is closed. And winning is only the beginning.

details.title: Core 31
details.short_description: You wake alone in an Arctic research station with no memory and a name written on your wrist. Eleven people are gone. Follow the notes you left yourself, get out across the ice, and find out what Core 31 brought up from under three kilometres of glacier.

details.title: One Tiny Delivery
details.short_description: A exploration game about delivering packages. Deliver various stuff to people residing on an island using one small three-wheeled truck. Explore the island and drive to the peak of the mountain to deliver one final package. Hear people's stories and take in the view around you as you drive along.

details.title: Submarine Escape
details.short_description: A first-person horror escape game set inside a ruined submarine, where the protagonist is gradually turning into a monster. Craft a cure to halt the mutation, uncover the truth behind the experiment, and safely escape the threats of the deep sea.

details.title: Untorra
details.short_description: Can you traverse the sands of time and remain intact?

details.title: Ruthenium Smash & Grab
details.short_description: Shoot the asteroids until they're small enough to collect. If anything hits the tail of asteroids you've collected, you lose them. Don't lose so many. Lose less. *Fewer.
Merge tiles, get buffs. Make number go up. Biggest score is best score.

details.title: Peer Into The Void
details.short_description: Catch what moved. The moves get smaller and smaller. Test your perception.

details.title: Irregular Earnings
details.short_description: Irregular Earnings is a multiplayer physics crime shooter. Three crews in suits fight over cash, briefcases and secret documents across one city. Trade, steal, cuff and shoot your way to the payout in a world where every body, bullet and car is simulated.

details.title: Cluckin' Crash
details.short_description: Cluckin’ Crash is an asymmetrical multiplayer party game where a chicken sprints through wild platform courses while a driver tries to crash, ram, and knock it off the map. Fast-paced best-of-five rounds create unpredictable physics chaos.

details.title: Bikini Island Cricket
details.short_description: A third-person sports party game that blends cricket with playful island mini‑games, stamina challenges, and popularity‑boosting antics, offering emergent mechanics and lighthearted chaos on Bikini Island.

details.title: Chill Pixels
details.short_description: *Life can be overwhelming: take a well-deserved, cozy break.* Relax to soothing lo-fi tunes and peaceful ambient sounds while coloring gorgeous pixel art illustrations. Unlock adorable companions, upgrade magical powers in the Zen Workshop, and collect 62 achievements!

details.title: Dead Harvest
details.short_description: Prepare your defenses. The dead are coming. Dead Harvest is a tower defense game where you must protect your territory from hordes of zombies. Your turrets won’t be doing all the work: you’ll also have to fight the zombies by running them over with your motorcycle!

details.title: SpellBall
details.short_description: SpellBall is a magical billiards game for 2–4 players. Sink balls, cast spells, and thwart your opponents' plans. Compete in duels or 2v2 team matches—either online or locally on the same computer. Master 100 spells, choose from 15 arenas, and develop your own unique playstyle.

details.title: El Coco
details.short_description: Psychological horror in first person, seen through the eyes of a child caught between a broken childhood and a reality falling apart. Explore a house where fear is only the beginning.

details.title: Woolhalla
details.short_description: A sheep’s epic journey to Valhalla — adventure alone or with your friends in co-op.

details.title: The Pit
details.short_description: WELCOME, UNIT. YOUR PURPOSE IS TO CLIMB. FURTHER INSTRUCTIONS ARE UNNECESSARY.

details.title: Punch Your Way Out
details.short_description: Punch through your prison cell, collect rubble, sell rocks, and buy upgrades to hit even harder. Break tougher blocks, dig deeper, and repeat. A simple, satisfying incremental game where every punch brings you closer to freedom.

details.title: SKYGUARD: Last Light
details.short_description: A minimalist incremental defense game. Start with one missile silo over your city, destroy screens full of threats, upgrade your firepower, and turn the Moon, the Sun, a black hole and even higher dimensions into weapons. Ten scales, ten chapters, ten doomsday ultimates.

details.title: Wandering Far
details.short_description: A desktop idle hiking game that keeps you company while you work or study. A girl and her little dog set off on a journey across your screen—with outfit changes, camping, treasure hunting, multiple display modes, and the option to set it as a live wallpaper.

name: Soul Land: Legend of the Battle God

details.title: Soul Land: Legend of the Battle God
details.short_description: A 3D MMORPG set in the world of Douluo Continent. Recruit iconic Soul Masters like Tang San and Xiao Wu, hunt powerful Soul Beasts, collect rare Soul Rings and Soul Bones, build your ultimate team, and rise from Soul Master to Titled Douluo—and beyond.

details.title: Saurora
details.short_description: Survive as a dinosaur on a 4 km island. Start as a hatchling, find food and water, stay away from the wrong animals and grow up. Play alone in free roam, or join an online server with friends, strangers and things that want to eat you.

details.title: Necro Helix
details.short_description: Necro helix is a roguelike RPG with 2-player online co-op. Explore 5 unique destinations, master 8 playable characters, and create powerful builds with 280 traits, 300 pieces of equipment, and the Flower Pact system. Face 40 bosses and uncover the secrets of the Deathlands!

details.title: Request Stop
details.short_description: A slow-burning commute horror. Something is slipping, a little each day. Wake up, eat, catch the bus. Work your job, then work on your life. Maybe you'll get it right tomorrow. Or another day.

details.title: Backrooms 95
details.short_description: Explore eerie liminal spaces in a low-poly Backrooms horror experience inspired by the aesthetics of forgotten 90s technology.

details.title: Conglomerate
details.short_description: One Earth, millions of cities, competing companies. Conglomerate is an economic simulation where every city is a moving part and every company is part of a shared global economy. Build supply chains, hire local workers and expand city by city.

details.title: Space Postal Service
details.short_description: Fly from planet to planet delivering mail to the folks who live on these tiny worlds. Get to know them, just be sure not to read the mail. Chill out and fly around this hand drawn, 2.5D simulated solar system, earn money for your deliveries while collecting stamps to fill your notebook.

details.title: HIGH HORNS
details.short_description: CLIMB TO CONQUER! Physics-based co-op VR climbing

details.title: Tonari Days: Your Desktop Companion
details.short_description: Tonari, a girl who lives in another world, keeps you company while you work. She lives freely on the other side of the window, and now and then she talks to you, plays calm music, reads books aloud, and helps with your PC. Get to know her, and something nice might happen.

details.title: Grand Theft Spy
details.short_description: Hundreds of people in the square wear your colour and your hat. A few of them are players, all after the same gems. Blend in, steal what the market wants and trade it in first, or spot the rival who moves wrong and take them down. Social stealth for up to 8 players, online or on LAN.

details.title: Cozy Puzzle Simulator 3D
details.short_description: Unwind with realistic 3D jigsaw pieces in four cozy rooms. Explore 100 puzzles, turn your own pictures into puzzles, and settle in with changing daylight, rain and relaxing music. Start small or take on 500 pieces, with your progress saved between sessions.

details.title: I Shall Seek Immortality
details.short_description: An idle xianxia game for the corner of your desktop — with online duels, a ten-seat arena, world bosses and Steam Market trading. Eight origins, retro stick-figure battles, companions and sects in an open world, plus a stealth mode and boss key.

details.title: Find Alien
details.short_description: A 1–4 player online co-op stealth game. Copy the appearance of Earthlings, hide your true identity, avoid surveillance and traps, rescue your captured alien friends, and escape together.

details.title: 冒牌特攻队
details.short_description: A comic-style top-down survival action game. Fight solo or in online co-op, wield multiple weapons, and modify their attacks with attachments. Move, aim, and adapt your equipment as waves of enemies close in, building a loadout that suits your playstyle.

details.title: Bento Together
details.short_description: Run a cozy bento shop solo or with friends in online co-op. Cook ingredients, pack lunchboxes, serve customers, and manage your supplies in this hands-on, first-person shop simulator. Unlock recipes and find your kitchen rhythm together.

details.title: Tidy Up Christmas Shop
details.short_description: 5,434 Christmas items are scattered across the shop. Put them back where they belong and enjoy the wonderful order. No timer, no stress. Upgrade your skills with the candy you earn and arrange colourful, twinkling Christmas items on the shelves of a huge two-storey shop as you like. Merry Christmas!

details.title: Sands of the Aftermath
details.short_description: Kite and windsurf survival in a world buried by sand: ride the dunes, grind the ruins, dig for water, grow your oasis – and find out what lies beneath the sand.

details.title: CHASA : Twilight Reaper
