details.short_description: Become a Grim Reaper in this isometric horde-survival action game. Choose your weapon, combine and ascend your skills, and challenge powerful Guardians. Shape your build with gear and the Spirit Vein passive skill tree.

details.title: Reliquary
details.short_description: A turn-based loot roguelite, solo or co-op. Pick a hero, cross cursed regions and turn every chest into a weapon: affixes, sets, relics, cursed items and the forge. Beat the bosses, raise the Corruption, come back stronger.

details.title: Grit & Greed
details.short_description: How much can you take and get away with?

details.title: SUSPECIES
details.short_description: Sculpt, Paint and Animate into literally anything! Show off your amazing talents in the SUSPECIES SHOW mode or Disguise and Hide in the environment in the HIDE & SEEK mode. up to 12 players, for private or public matches.

details.title: Overrafted!
details.short_description: Over rafted! is a co-op multiplayer game for up to four players. Divide the work as you steer, fish, gather supplies, and make repairs. Brave the chaos of shifting winds, currents, and sea creatures, and sail your crumbling raft as far as you can across an endless, unknown ocean!

details.title: Elite Engineering
details.short_description: Elite Engineering is the ultimate sandbox engineering game, characters, environments and creations all created by you and the community.

details.title: Can't See Shift
details.short_description: Mate. Three of you drive ONE van. The one steering can't see a thing, one's on the pedals, one's on the gears. The rest jump out with an axe, a winch and dynamite. 1-4 online co-op, every map generated from scratch. Just get the cake to the wedding. Good luck.

details.title: Guild Adventures
details.short_description: Guild Management Auto-Battler. Build your roster of adventurers and send them into monster-filled lands to battle, collect gold, loot, and items to sell on the Steam Community Market 💰. Upgrade your guild to take on increasingly dangerous and rewarding challenges.

details.title: Tales of Tonbrook
details.short_description: Tales of Tonbrook is a life-sim/RPG hybrid. When you receive an invitation to the prestigious Daverton Adventurer's Academy, you take it! Study, perform missions for the school to pay your way, explore the world, make friends, fish, farm, find hidden ruins, and much more!

details.title: AMEN: The Quiet Exodus
details.short_description: Cursed the womb that bears emptiness beneath its heart. For twenty-five years children have been born without souls, and a soul can only be restored by taking another’s. Ilaya Cassette wants to know what’s wrong with her. A gothic visual novel, fully voiced in Russian. Prologue and Part I out now.

details.title: Sort the Creatures
details.short_description: A cozy organizing game where you sort over 4000 adorable creatures into their matching terrariums. Discover more than 400 creature variations, unlock helpful abilities, and turn a colorful mess into a collection full of life.

details.title: Collapsus
details.short_description: COLLAPSUS™ is a one-of-a-kind block-crunching puzzle game all about gravity manipulation and resource management! Join Leon the Chameleon as you twist, tilt, turn, & flip to solve your way through endless, mind-bending puzzles!

details.title: Crop Dead
details.short_description: You aren’t quite dead yet, but you're slipping. Play as a ghost defending your own comatose body from endless hordes of ravenous enemies. Plant magical crops, harvest bizarre weapons, and cultivate an automated defense of undead flora to survive the tower and complete your resurrection ritual!

details.title: Ricochet: Moonlit Gardens
details.short_description: One clever shot. A glorious chain of light. Ricochet: Moonlit Gardens is a cosy arcade puzzler about bouncing through jewels, unleashing magic and chasing the perfect combo. Explore eight worlds, 112 story missions and 112 challenges, plus a fresh Daily Challenge.

details.title: 39D
details.short_description: 39D is a linear sci-fi horror visual novel. Once you cross the line, there’s only one way to go: down.

details.title: Words In Place
details.short_description: A spatial word puzzle: drag shaped letter pieces onto a cluttered grid and uncover hidden category words. Crossword-style intersections mean one placement can complete several words at once. Fit the pieces. Find the words. Feel the click.

details.title: Sanga no Jin
details.short_description: The nation is broken, yet the mountains and rivers remain. Send your troops, seize bases and unite a realm at war in this real-time Sengoku strategy game — a tale of a young lord and a childhood friend who becomes his rival, told on the battlefield.

details.title: Campfire
details.short_description: A two-player co-op deduction adventure where a grandchild and a late explorer's old apprentice finish an unfinished path. Each of you gets different clues on screen, by voice or by touch. Put them into words, compare them, and reach one answer together. Supports the DotPad tactile display.

details.title: Nobody Watching
details.short_description: Your inner child wants to kill you. A strategy game against cigarettes, sugar, coffee and beer.

details.title: Milk Frog, Love Me Again
details.short_description: A 3D neon roguelite about an un-deletable milk frog, absurd livestreams, and collecting meme cards. Mow down viruses, build broken synergies, decorate a frog home, and chase the ending before the chat moves on.

details.title: Night on Bald Mountain
details.short_description: Orbit, dodge, and touch! Light up the stars in an action game built around Night on Bald Mountain!

details.title: Punch Through
details.short_description: Punch your way through prison walls in a satisfying first-person incremental destruction game! Smash concrete, collect resources, earn money, and upgrade your strength, tools, and abilities. Break tougher walls, unlock powerful upgrades, and fight your way toward freedom!

details.title: Impersonal
details.short_description: You've come to your senses in a place that shouldn't exist. You have no face, no past, only two goals: to understand how you got here, and to find a way out.

details.title: Mall Chaos
details.short_description: The mall is closed, and your shift has just begun. Explore a multi-floor shopping mall in first person, pick up scattered products, and return them to the right shelves, tables, and racks.

details.title: Dungeon Crossing
details.short_description: A top-down puzzle game blending dungeon exploration with minesweeper deduction, featuring randomly generated dungeons, ever-rising danger, and five upgradeable skills. Read the number clues, mark the hazards, collect the key, and clear all 30 floors.

details.title: Song of Kings
details.short_description: Song of Kings is a puzzle platformer inspired by Sri Lankan myth. A Yaksha boy, captured by humans, must escape a ruthless king. Guided by his grandfather’s spirit and armed with a magical flute, he uncovers his heritage and fights to return to his people.

details.title: Sky Furnace
details.short_description: An aerial dieselpunk roguelite. Rusted ruins and the Furnace, a machine nobody remembered to switch off: for two centuries it has shot down anything that flies. Build your plane from cards; each sortie ends with a boss rising from the smoke. Squads of up to four players.

details.title: DIGITRE:SUM 10/20
details.short_description: Link adjacent numbers to total 10 or 20 on a rising board—a fast math action puzzle. Build CHAINs, collect TARGETs, chase SCORE, and cut CLEAR TIME. Soon, 10s and 20s jump out at you. Classic arcade play where every run shows your progress. Includes VS, PUZZLE, 50-clear BLITZ, and ENDLESS.

details.title: Hell Worlds Reinvigorated
details.short_description: A necromantic named Cyris leaves his homeworld for a strange odyssey through unknown realms, each one more horrible and bizarre than the next. Use your necromancer abilities to save the earth realm in this retro FPS filled to the brim with fantasy & mystery.

details.title: Equilibria
details.short_description: Release species on a small living planet, tip its balance and watch evolution answer. Populations adapt, split into new species and die out; continents drift, ice ages come and go, and clever species build villages and towns. A sandbox god game of ecology and evolution.

details.title: Defender of Darkness
details.short_description: An idle tower defense game: build fortifications, manage limited resources, cast spells, and decide which dark lords to save before the final battle against the forces of good. And don’t forget to raise your kraken!

details.title: Westward: Golden Cicada
details.short_description: A turn-based strategy roguelite inspired by Journey to the West. Pick routes, recruit Guardians, swap scriptures, and command every turn by hand. Each wipe burns a life lamp; lose them all and the run ends — but your merit survives into the next reincarnation.

details.title: Ashen Swarm
details.short_description: A gothic bullet heaven roguelite where you wield the power of deadly sins. The Judge knew not all were guilty, yet condemned the world. Burn hordes with Wrath, turn foes into swine with Pride and devour the fallen with Gluttony. Survive the swarm and face the boss of each arena.

details.title: Coy's Escape
details.short_description: 《科伊的逃亡》是一款2D回合制Roguelike卡牌游戏。带领三位命运交织的主角——科伊、莱斯莉与希娜，在崩坏的世界中搜集线索、构筑卡组、破解谜题，揭开末日背后的真相。200+张卡牌，无限可能的策略组合，每一次逃亡都是全新的故事。

details.title: Idle Raiders: Second Run
details.short_description: Idle Raiders: Second Run is an idle RPG about a band of pixel art heroes who farm, raid and loot on their own. You build their town, pick their gear, skills and AI, and send them out farming or into more than 25 raids. Version 2.0 of the browser classic from Pit Forest, rebuilt on a new engine.

details.title: Z-Defender
details.short_description: Tired of the military always losing to the zombie horde? Not here. Hold your base through wave after wave, earn cash from every kill, upgrade your guns, man your posts, and call in airstrikes. Hold the line.

details.title: ZodiacLottery
details.short_description: A lottery roguelike. Move animals to create winning tickets, then combine powerful synergies and unique relics to build massive jackpots!

details.title: a sproutingale
details.short_description: A hand-made dual-story delivered through handwriting and mixed media illustrations: Ek'mer guides the fae-kind on their journey through Hell while two doctoral students, Gus & Gwen, become friends.

details.title: Dreamfend
details.short_description: Dreamfend is a pixel-art roguelite survivor where you play as an old teddy bear guarding a sleeping child from nightmares. Fight off swarms of monsters, collect and upgrade weapons, find power-ups, hunt down every boss and survive the night. Just don't lose yourself — and don't lose the child.

details.title: Amberfall: Village Defense
details.short_description: A medieval fantasy village builder and auto battler. Gather resources, expand your settlement, and build a force of warriors, archers, and mages to face monster waves. When your village falls, spend earned Skulls on lasting upgrades and return stronger.

details.title: Fearwoods
details.short_description: Fearwoods is a 4 co-op survival horror where light and silence are your only weapons. Explore the cursed forest, uncover Aveline’s story, evade a relentless demon, and fight for escape before the darkness consumes you.

details.title: Flesh Grinding
details.short_description: Grind flesh. Gather blood. Upgrade. A first-person incremental horror game where you manage a macabre basement. Buy dark upgrades. boost your efficiency. and push your machinery to the limit while avoiding the terrifying entity that watches your every move.

details.title: Calcio 98
details.short_description: Calcio 98 is a single-player football management game set in the 1998/99 season and created by longtime fans of the classics like Premier Manager 98 or PC Fútbol 7. Lead your club across 18 leagues and 14 cups through tactics, transfers, squad development and finances.

details.title: Naishitai: The parts I'm missing.
details.short_description: Accompany Nai in her normal Sunday routine of watching TV, eating ramen and ruminating on her past.

details.title: Artillery Deluxe
details.short_description: A turn-based artillery duel with 40 weapons and destructible terrain. Draft your arsenal, adjust your aim, account for wind and outscore your opponent. Battle the AI, share one computer with a friend, or connect over LAN and direct online multiplayer.

details.title: 돌깨
details.short_description: Break rocks, uncover minerals, and build up your pixel-art mining workshop. Upgrade tools, automate the work, and start fresh with permanent abilities. Chase rare finds and jackpot rewards in this single-player incremental game.

details.title: Bet Shop Simulator Prologue
details.short_description: Run the neighborhood betting shop! Print bet slips, count out change and watch the match with your customers. A goal shakes the whole shop, a losing slip gets a TV smashed. Clean up, decorate, expand.

details.title: Cafe Card
details.short_description: Cafe Card is a coffee shop game where you prepare drinks and desserts by creating card combinations and serve them to customers.

details.title: Mechannihilation
details.short_description: Pilot a mech through escalating swarms in Survivors, lead an army to capture relays and break the enemy HQ shield in Commanders, or roam the Open World to raid outposts and hunt biome bosses. Pair maxed weapons to unleash EX attacks.

details.title: GrimKeep
details.short_description: GrimKeep is a roguelite dice-builder in a nightmare fairytale. Find items, roll your dice, and optimize your build to fire off massive damage. Cut through the horrors in the cursed city to get to the Princess. Then end her.

details.title: Steel Umbrella
details.short_description: Defend real cities from night raids on a satellite map of the Earth. Build launchers, nets and radar by day. At night, hunt drones and missiles in the dark before they hit.

name: フィルネティアの魔法雑貨店

details.title: フィルネティアの魔法雑貨店
details.short_description: Run your own magic shop as a young witch in this fantasy shop-management sim and action RPG. Defeat monsters in forests and mines, craft potions and accessories, then read the market and set your prices. Help the villagers and choose the crown or the Thieves' Guild to decide your ending.

details.title: Kirameki Quiz: Stargazer Hill Diary
details.short_description: A quiz game with a dating-sim twist. Spin the roulette through a 365-day campus calendar, meet 10 heroines and win their hearts in trivia duels. Over 5,000 English questions across 21 genres.

details.title: PixelHeroScramble Plus
details.short_description: Intercept the surging waves of pixels with a variety of units! Experience the ultimate fixed-route tower defense! Summon a wide variety of units to defend and conquer the battlefield. Where and when you deploy, upgrade or replace your units is up to you. Discover synergies and hone your strategy.

details.title: The Shrink Gun Game
details.short_description: Shrink everything and everyone. Fight your way to downtown, Upgrade and gain new abilities, Stomp the chief of the size police in this 3rd person action roguelite unlike any other

details.title: We Need a Bigger Ship
details.short_description: Your ship is your backpack. Cram weapons, supports and bags onto its grid, link them into combos and forge bigger guns, then hold off waves of enemies and giant bosses. Take your build into Ranked against other players' ships. It starts tiny. You'll need a bigger ship.

details.title: Hakoniwa Electric
details.short_description: "Hakoniwa Electric" is a cute relaxing puzzle game. Explore adorable isometric stages, solve puzzles, and light them up. Why not spend a leisurely year as Akari, who's taken over grandpa's electronics shop, helping with the monthly troubles from the townsfolk?

details.title: Last Couriers
details.short_description: Dive into the post-apocalyptic Zone in this fun co-op extraction action! As fearless couriers, harvest anomalous hogweed, craft batteries, and power up teleports to proceed. But your loot attracts infected enemies you can't permanently kill... Сan you hold the line and escape in time?

details.title: Everlasting Curse
details.short_description: Enter the witch’s hidden house, explore mysterious parallel worlds, switch between day and night, solve unique puzzles and minigames, uncover dark secrets, and break an ancient curse.

details.title: The Brave Few
details.short_description: The Brave Few is a combined arms WWII combat game. Experience historically based perspectives during major operations of World War II, from one of the brave few that fought in combat during World War II.

details.title: Little Dungeon
details.short_description: LittleDungeon is a third-person loot-driven action RPG. Choose from eight classes and tackle seasonal dungeons solo or in online co-op. Collect gear, combine sets and class weapons, and grow through equipment upgrades, weapon refinement and character advancement to shape your own combat style.

details.title: HypnoFish Inc.
details.short_description: HypnoFish Inc. is a first-person incremental game about working for a fishing mega-corporation. Hypnotize fish, sell your catch, purchase upgrades, and uncover the mystery of this fishy business!

details.title: Collapsle
details.short_description: Collapsle is a fast-paced match-three score attack roguelite set in the Gold Rush West. Create powerful synergies and score big, with tons of items, characters, customization options, and challenges to discover!

details.title: Tidy Up the Grocery Warehouse
details.short_description: One partner snapped, and Ultra Fresh Food needs your help. About 3,000 products hit the floor. Restore order to the grocery warehouse with handy abilities or your own two hands, then pick and pack orders until the shelves are empty.

details.title: Bibliopyre
details.short_description: A magical storm and a goblin horde tore a million forbidden pages from the Great Library. As the Warden Mage, burn them all: sweep piles with waves of fire, send ash flying home, and hear every book chime into place to the beat of the music.

details.title: Convoluted
details.short_description: Solve the mechanisms of a mysterious machine to find the way to its core. Deduce the patterns needed to connect Glimmer to glyphs in a unique logic puzzle system inspired by mathematical convolution.

details.title: Tinplate Scramble
details.short_description: Two factions battle across land and sky in Tinplate Scramble. Win firefights and melees on foot, pilot a fighter or hovercraft into the fray, and tip the scales in open skirmishes and handcrafted missions involving 100+ fielded units.

details.title: Backflip Madness
details.short_description: Backflip Madness is a fast-paced, parkour-flavored extreme sports game. Your goal is simple - make tons of spectacular tricks and stunts. Take it to the extreme!

details.title: XenoTechArena
details.short_description: Don’t defeat your enemies—make them collide! A roguelike arena shooter where up to 10,000 enemies swarm you. Blast them into each other to trigger chain reactions and wipe out hordes! Fuse classes, combine 100+ power-ups, and build your ultimate warrior with endless possibilities!

details.title: President FC: Football Club Owner
details.short_description: Build a football club from the lower leagues up. As the owner, hire your manager, discover players and develop young talent. Explore a detailed football world and shape your club over decades. Leave the team and tactics to your manager or have your say before each match.

details.title: Toast Flipper
details.short_description: Save your family as "Thoasten"! Drag, aim, and flip: In this brutally hard 2D physics platformer, you fling yourself golf-style through a dangerous kitchen, defeat evil bread bosses, and chase the ultimate best time on the global speedrun leaderboard.

details.title: Lootale Slash
details.short_description: Lootale Slash is a pixel-art action MMORPG. Explore a shared world, choose from six classes, conquer dungeons and world bosses, hunt rare gear, and create a playstyle that is truly your own.

details.title: Nine Below
details.short_description: A twin-stick arena shooter set in an arctic wasteland. Fight through a cult swarm, break the guardians, and kill the leader before the ritual completes. One continuous battle. No second chances.

details.title: Magic Kingdom
details.short_description: Legion Warfare，Roguelike，Loot Grinding，Semi-Automated Combat，Western Fantasy，Top-Down Combat. In the game, you will control the hero, lead a powerful army, release powerful magic, have a strong city defense, and coordinate resource collection to resist the enemy's strong attack
developers: Shanghai Lingwen Huanyu Game Co., Ltd.
publishers: Shanghai Lingwen Huanyu Game Co., Ltd.

details.title: 4Way: Driving
details.short_description: A challenging arcade racing game with the goal of setting high scores.

name: All Those Dungeons In Alva's Head

details.title: All Those Dungeons In Alva's Head
details.short_description: All Those Dungeons in Alva’s Head is a surreal, turn-based and skill-based dungeon crawler filled with quirky characters, mind-bending puzzles, and a kick-ass electro-pop soundtrack. Fight wacky creatures, explore bizarre dungeons, and uncover the strange secrets lurking in Alva’s mind.

details.title: ALL PASSENGERS BUCKLE UP
details.short_description: Run a budget airline in 1-6 player co-op. Check passports, load the bags, fly the route and keep the passengers fed while the jet catches fire around you. Take bribes, dodge storms and climb onto the roof mid-flight. Hit the quota or the whole crew is fired.

details.title: Whitopia
details.short_description: Experience pure calm through a short relaxing 3D painting simulation. Cover graffiti, clutter, and anything colorful in pure white. Earn rewards, unlock upgrades, and become more efficient as you restore a world where white is the only color allowed to exist.

details.title: Anomaly Bird
details.short_description: An anomaly-spotting game meets the bird you already know and love... or hate. See something wrong? Fly into the pipe.

details.title: Desert Echo
details.short_description: Echo is an AI consciousness, endlessly rebuilt. Defend the Core against relentless swarms, dimensional Rifts and sandstorms. Hundreds of enemies on screen. Build and upgrade turrets, hold the gates, level up your skills. No checkpoints. No mercy. Solo or co-op.

details.title: Worm Capitalist
details.short_description: Worm Capitalist is an incremental game about raising hungry worms, watching them devour everything pixel by pixel, and turning their poop into profit. Feed them, expand your colony, unlock upgrades, boost production, automate the process, and keep growing until the whole world is on the menu.

details.title: CastleGuard: Operation Graveyard
details.short_description: CastleGuard: Operation Graveyard is a round-based co-op shooter in low-poly. Survive wave after wave, earn points for every hit and every kill, and spend them to push deeper into the base — before the next round starts.

details.title: Insanitation
details.short_description: It’s Chaos VS Order in this fast-paced battle against family & friends. Will you create Chaos as a Cat - spreading fur, mayhem, & hairballs everywhere? Or restore Order as a Keeper - cleaning & mopping up the muck before Chaos takes over? Pick a side & grab your kibble or gear, & claim victory.

details.title: Collec
details.short_description: Open packs and collect a world of wildlife, dinosaurs, distant stars and curiosities. Admire your cards, trade with friends and build a team for five-card duels. A free game with one collection shared between the web and Steam.

details.title: In Time
details.short_description: In Time is a 4 player online co-op adventure. Chronosyn’s strange machine has brought back the dinosaurs, and only you and your team can set things back to normal. Explore an ever-changing environment and make it back to the machine all while hungry predators stalk your path.

details.title: Temporal Distortion
details.short_description: Triple Triad on a hex board, at a lamplit table. Place a pebble, then turn it to strike: the higher number takes the lower, and every pebble taken strikes on in a chain. No dice. Eight Distortion cards, four worlds, and a stranger across the table who knows whose story this is.

details.title: Tattie Bogle
details.short_description: You are the scarecrow. On a small farm at the edge of the woods, a Tomte's magic pulled you off your post and gave you a job: keep the harvest alive. Can you turn the place around before it all falls apart? A challenging fairytale roguelite, solo or 2-4 player online co-op.

details.title: Amnesty
details.short_description: Multiplayer survival FPS set over one night in a sealed-off city district. Your crew claims a house and boards it up. While the radio on your safe still works, dying just sends you back inside. Gold cases are loose in the streets, and every other crew wants the same ones.

details.title: STELLACATCH
details.short_description: Catch falling stars with nothing but your cursor. Purify the Eclipses, chain FEVER with your two Star Arts, and climb to the dawn of Layer 5000. Grow your own sky through builds, constellations, observatory decor and sweets in this star-catching action game for night-sky watchers.

details.title: Crumbs & Beats
details.short_description: Revive a silent speaker and rebuild the beat in this music-driven incremental arcade game. Shatter Crumbs, collect Echoes, unlock instruments, and stack upgrades into an evolving groove.

details.title: Dream Highway
details.short_description: A rhythm drive beneath alien megastructures. The music builds the road, sets your speed and lights up the sky. Steer to stay on the highway, lift the nose on the beat to catch orbs, and hold through the boosts. More songs, and your own music, are coming in updates.

details.title: Too. Many. Socks.
details.short_description: 4,000 socks. One giant mess. Find matching pairs, fill shelves, and complete orders in a cozy first-person sorting game. Then unlock a second workshop and build your own sorting lines with conveyors, robotic arms, and delivery robots.

details.title: Barn Rush
details.short_description: Grab food, haul it home, beat the clock. A colorful pixel time-attack roguelite on your own silly farm: draft upgrades until one little sheep has a tornado, a tractor and a snail on the payroll. Every run gets absurdly strong your way. Earn Feed to unlock new animals, themes, and cosmetics.

details.title: Sort Till You Sleep
details.short_description: A cozy first-person sorting game. A whole room is buried under 3,810 toy sheep in costumes: carry each one to its shelf, play bedtime mini games, uncover a few gentle mysteries, and when the last sheep is home, go to sleep.

details.title: Molehill Mountain
details.short_description: One swing, one fistful of gold! A cartoony mole-whacking incremental game. Bonk moles before time runs out, chain combos and critical hits, then spend your gold to upgrade your hammer. Hire a Storage Keeper to stop thief moles, and defeat giant boss moles to collect relics.

details.title: Big Bad Wool
details.short_description: Wolves in sheep's clothing versus watchful shepherds. Blend into the flock, fool your friends or spot the impostors. BigBadWool is an asymmetric hide-and-seek game for 2–6 players online, with bot practice to learn both sides.

name: Abyss Driller: An Incremental Mining Game

details.title: Abyss Driller: An Incremental Mining Game
details.short_description: An incremental mining game beneath the ocean. Pilot a drill-equipped submarine, gather ore and turn each haul into permanent upgrades. Fight deep-sea creatures with your spotlight, dodge their attacks and dive deeper.

details.title: Altitude Zero
details.short_description: Pilot a vintage hot air balloon through a freezing, desolate void. Manage your burner, survive hostile creatures, and land at abandoned stations before the darkness consumes you.

details.title: STATE Z
details.short_description: Build your own base, hunt , cook ,upgrade your equipment and your character , gather resources, farm, maintain vehicles, trade with communities, complete tasks in exchange for rewards. The choice is yours: join your friends, trust strangers, or be alone wolf. It's all in your hands.

details.title: Shmandala
details.short_description: Shmandala is a delirious arcade-style shoot'em up choreographed to a banging soundtrack!

details.title: Brewery Simulator
details.short_description: Run a medieval tavern in first person: plant 18 crops, brew beer and wine with the exact flavors your guests ask for, hire a crew, and turn a roadside alehouse into a legendary tavern. Play solo or in online co-op for up to 4 players.

name: Poor Samantha: An Agoraphobic Visual Novel

details.title: Poor Samantha: An Agoraphobic Visual Novel
details.short_description: "Noodles are the food of solitude." Trapped by agoraphobia and social anxiety, your only friend is Samantha. She is your courage to open the door. But in a room of broken mirrors, who is actually speaking? A short psychological visual novel about isolation and the lies we tell ourselves.

details.title: Cricket Manager 27
details.short_description: A deep cricket management simulation where you take charge of a club or national side, build squads, set tactics, handle transfers and board pressure, and chase glory across Test, ODI, and T20 seasons and major ICC events.

details.title: What Was Lost
details.short_description: A two-player online co-op puzzle game. One of you plays Ben in the family house as it was, the other plays Lily in the same house years later. You can only see your own timeline, so you solve it by talking. Chapters 1 to 4 in Early Access, with Chapters 5 to 7 coming in free updates.

details.title: Sketchy Warfare
details.short_description: A turn-based tactical war game where stick-figure armies from across history collide. Command 11 unique teams, master dozens of units and weapons, and fight through a campaign for every era—from cavemen and pirates to modern soldiers, fantasy warriors, and the armies of the future.

details.title: Luma Orb
details.short_description: Guide your orb through rotating planets and floating islands in this colorful 3D action platformer. Jump across gaps, dodge falling hazards, collect stars, and fight back with power-ups. From fiery worlds to slippery ice, every level brings a new challenge.

details.title: Cook & Sail
details.short_description: A 1-4 player co-op restaurant that happens to be a ship. Work the day as a crew, keep hungry customers from walking out, and spend what you make on a vessel that can actually handle the job. The tables want a good meal. The fleet wants its share.

details.title: PhotoLoop
details.short_description: Boot up the world's oldest PC to take photo editing commissions from a colourful cast of virtual strangers. In PhotoLoop, the only thing stopping you is your imagination... and probably your entire editing interface.

details.title: Dicebound
details.short_description: Dicebound is a single-player dice roguelike about pushing your luck. Roll, score, and bank points before a Farkle wipes the turn. Build powerful Charm synergies, survive escalating Blinds, and chase bigger scores with every throw.

details.title: After closing
details.short_description: After Closing is a 1–4 player co-op horror puzzle game. Explore an abandoned amusement park, solve puzzles, avoid the clown, and escape together.

details.title: Finares
details.short_description: Explore a world abandoned by humanity. Rescue lonely dogs and welcome them into your pack on a heartfelt journey of friendship, survival, and second chances.

details.title: STILL BOUND
details.short_description: A weekend trip ends on a mountain road. You wake in the wreck, alone, deep in a forest where every trail promises help. A story-driven, first-person psychological horror game about searching for rescue - and finding out what answers.

details.title: Haunted House Hellshift
details.short_description: Fight through a haunted house full of monsters and traps while a live TV audience watches. Collect eyeballs to open cursed doors, find the exit, and try to make it out alive—solo or with a friend in local 2-player co-op.

details.title: Sort of Paradise
details.short_description: Unwind in a sunlit seaside shop. Sort of Paradise is a relaxing first-person tidying game about putting scattered beach goods back where they belong. Complete satisfying displays, earn helpful upgrades, and enjoy a little order by the ocean.

details.title: Brand: Fracture
details.short_description: Pilot a sealing drone through fractured containment chambers. Cut territory, weld reinforced seams, and contain hostile rifts in a vivid arcade game set in the world of Imminence.

details.title: Pastry Pile Up
details.short_description: Drop and merge pastries to create bigger, more delicious treats! Serve your sweet creations to adorable cat customers to earn coins. Use your coins to fully customize your cozy bakery, and compete on the global leaderboard to achieve the highest score.

details.title: IRON EDEN
details.short_description: Iron Eden blends Roguelite progression, Loot Shooter mechanics, and deep Mech Customization into a unique experience where every run shapes your machine and your strategy.

details.title: Armory Chaos: Tidy Up
details.short_description: Clock in as a robot and bring order to a chaotic armory. Sort weapons, pack ammo, and haul crates solo or with up to 3 friends. Use magnets and air cannons to get the job done, and watch a stray explosion turn your tidy shift into a glorious mess.

details.title: Chess Mutator
details.short_description: Chess Mutator reinvents chess with game-changing mutations, strategic AI battles, and a 40+ level campaign. Master ever-changing rules, conquer unique challenges, and continue your progress across supported platforms with one account.

details.title: Rustlot
details.short_description: Drop junked cars onto belts. Watch the shredder chew them into scrap, the magnet pull iron from copper, the smelter pour glowing ingots, and the press stamp hubcaps for cash. A cozy, tactile 2D junkyard factory game with an honest finish line — sell the lot or keep optimizing.

details.title: Cindervale
details.short_description: A voxel-based sandbox game focused on survival, building, and engineering. Start in a large city, mine ore, smelt metal, wire up electricity, and assemble functional machines—ranging from wind turbines to computer-controlled factories. Play solo or with friends.

details.title: RoadHouse Manager
details.short_description: How did you get here? The forgetting fog, & an unreal roadhouse lost in it. You're serving customers, over endless nights -- until hyperspace broke down & it all starting warping. Now you phase through strange realities as you serve beer, craft cocktails, & battle shapes from the fifth dimension!

details.title: CCR - Cosmic Card Realm
details.short_description: CCR is a free-to-play online collection game where every draw brings a new discovery. Complete card sets, forge them into unique Relics, and build a museum that grows with you. With no battles or competitive pressure, you can relax, draw a few cards each day, and enjoy collecting for years.

details.title: Witch’s Tidy-Up
details.short_description: Witch's Tidy-Up is a calm first-person tidying game where you put 5,412 objects back in their places in a cluttered witch's house. With Lumi the cat, open the rooms one by one, learn spells, and send the flying things back where they belong.

details.title: Bit Universe
details.short_description: Grow a tiny voxel town into a solar-system economy. Build and upgrade neighborhoods, unlock districts, research technology and trade between worlds in a relaxed idle city builder. Includes desktop and optional PC VR, with shared Windows saves.

details.title: 52 Card Pickup
details.short_description: Fifty-two decks, one very messy table. Flip, find and slot every card back into its pack across 25 gloriously messier levels, chase the fleeting Gold Cards, and call up to 3 friends to help clean up... or race them to it.

details.title: KOBALT – Das Erbe der Spiegelmacher
details.short_description: Hamburg, 2027: art courier Hannes Vogt delivers a Venetian mirror and finds his client dead. To clear his name – and get his invoice paid – he follows a 340-year-old trail to Venice and beyond. A classic point-and-click adventure, fully voiced, with a dry sense of humour.

details.title: Schnuffels Hexa-World - You got schnuffeld
details.short_description: Seven fluffy Schnuffels, a mysterious hexagonal world, and plenty of puzzling challenges! Match colorful hex tiles, explore magical chambers, collect special fruits, and discover seven hidden keys. A charming puzzle adventure full of surprises!

name: ホワイトノウェイ（Stay on the white lines）

details.title: ホワイトノウェイ（Stay on the white lines）
details.short_description: One day after school, a boy walks home along a white line. His curfew is 5:00 p.m. The white line is filled with treasures that spark his imagination, turning the walk home into an adventure. Become that boy and journey through Hakusen, the childhood sanctuary where imagination comes to life.

name: The Myth of Might: A Lone Wolf

details.title: The Myth of Might: A Lone Wolf
details.short_description: A dungeon-crawler adventure where your mission is to rescue a kidnapped president.

details.title: Pulse Citadel
details.short_description: An incremental defense game where each run funds your next upgrade. The Citadel shoots automatically. Pick what to research, then time your abilities to keep it alive.

details.title: Horse Race
details.short_description: Start your journey in amateur races and climb your way to the top. Win races for prizes, open horse card packs, build your stable, manage your horses, and discover the perfect horse for every race. Rise through the ranks and become the ultimate champion. Do you have what it takes?

details.title: Poli City
details.short_description: Build a beautiful town, run its economy and services, win its votes and stay in power. Every train line, tax and law moves your voters, and they decide whether you keep the keys to Town Hall, or whether you refuse to hand them back.

details.title: Fractured Rift: Incremental
details.short_description: An incremental RPG auto-battler where you build and customize a team of allies to conquer increasingly difficult floors.

details.title: GOBLIN ELECTRIC LTD.
details.short_description: Run a goblin power company in a roguelite auto battler. Shop for squads across four races and 35 classes, merge matching recruits and build a formation. Break giant monsters’ armour, capture them alive and plug them into the grid to pay off your debt.

details.title: Gun Party
details.short_description: Roll for stars. Sabotage your friends. Gun Party packs 5 boards and 79 mini-games into one chaotic party night, from cart crashes to crew disasters and horror rounds. Play with 2–10 online or up to 4 in couch split-screen. Full controller support. Add bots to any match.

details.title: Realm Nine
details.short_description: On the land of Jiuzhou, there are fragments of your plundered Elf Wings hidden. You will play as five types of real-time shapeshifters and embark on a journey to find the lost fragments.

details.title: Devil inc.
details.short_description: Devil inc. is a strategy simulation of the conflict between good and evil. Explore the development of civilizations, society’s weaknesses and the consequences of your decisions. Watch how your choices change the world.

name: 缚于邪神低语的少女 TheWhisperingGodBoundGirl

details.title: 缚于邪神低语的少女 TheWhisperingGodBoundGirl
details.short_description: 这是一部关于爱与救赎的视觉小说。 被墟神选中的那一刻起，沈暮云就不再是人类了。 杀不死的身体、脑海中永不停歇的饥饿、随时可能失控伤及无辜的力量——这些足以压垮一个少女的东西，她独自背负了多年。 直到那个秋夜，在一条暗巷里，她遇到了那个隶属“第零部门”、嬉皮笑脸却深不可测的陆长明。 从互相戒备到彼此依靠，两个异类的生活就此交缠。然而平静之下，信徒的阴谋与墟神的苏醒正一步步逼近……

details.title: Soulcery: Deck of Shadows
details.short_description: A spell-slinging hack-and-slash action roguelite. Devour enemies and seal their abilities into cards. Draw cards to switch spells and chain them together to destroy everything in your path!

details.title: Fishing Tales: Neko's Journey
details.short_description: A relaxing idle fishing game focused on companionship, featuring over 40 fishing destinations and 260 fish to discover. Easy to enjoy without much effort. You can place the game anywhere on your screen while studying or working, without it intruding on your tasks.

details.title: Golden Town Card Shop
details.short_description: Run a fantasy card shop and venture into dungeons with a deck of your own. Bring sealed cards home to appraise, then choose what to collect, display, or sell. Turn your earnings into a better shop and prepare for your next adventure.

details.title: Robo Race
details.short_description: Build your own robot from blocks, let AI teach it to walk, and race it. Giraffe, snake, or a shape no one has seen before: the AI finds its own way to run. Take on 8 courses with obstacles, waves, and moving floors in local races or online with up to 4 players.

details.title: Mystery Blocks: Polyomino Puzzle
details.short_description: Master the grid in Mystery Blocks: Polyomino Puzzle! Drag and drop geometric polyomino shapes into boxes, solve relaxing tangram-style logic puzzles, and experience the ultimate satisfying fit. Play at your own pace!

details.title: Bleep Wildlife
details.short_description: Hunt dangerous animals, return to the tavern, and buy new guns and traps. Complete missions for a mysterious wizard and take on stronger prey.

details.title: Illusion Fight — Season 1
details.short_description: A dark fantasy tactical universe. Fight in hex-grid combat, collect cards, raise creatures, read the novel, and watch the webtoon — all free, all connected. Built over 23 years by a solo developer. Free to play. Season 1 is live now.

name: Save the Dateless Guy: Case.1 Sakura Hayase

details.title: Save the Dateless Guy: Case.1 Sakura Hayase
details.short_description: A "realistic" dating ADV that tests your "dating skills." As an Apprentice God, you must make the love of a man with no romantic experience come true. A one-of-a-kind, controversial game by an executive at a marriage agency.

details.title: CaTHaRSiS〜The last of atelier〜
details.short_description: Knowing nothing of who you are, you step into the worlds of iconic masterpieces. Walk through paintings, gather “memories,” and fill your empty vessel in this immersive art adventure. At the end of a journey through beautiful memories, what “world” will you paint?

details.title: The Winner 2 - The Reality Show
details.short_description: Experience what it's like to participate in a reality show in this casual, immersive, and fun simulator! Enter a medieval castle, compete for the title of ultimate winner, and enjoy a unique experience with an original soundtrack and fun 2D graphics.

details.title: Match & Magic
details.short_description: Match & Magic is a roguelike match-n adventure. Players defeat enemies and cast skills by matching tiles while climbing randomly generated towers. With cute cartoon visuals, it offers unique runs, loot, upgrades, strategy and high replayability.

details.title: SUPER-TYPE
details.short_description: SUPER-TYPE is a brutal keyboard-driven arcade score attack game. Use the entire range of keys to target multiple threats at once, and try to survive an invasion escalating faster than you can control.

details.title: Seat The Queen
details.short_description: A strategic tug-of-war card game where four Queens decide the crown. Push, pull, protect, and disrupt your way to four thrones. Plan each round carefully, outplay your rival, and play solo, locally, or online.

details.title: Head Miner
details.short_description: Head Miner is an idle mining game where your character spins and crashes into walls to move forward. Break rocks, collect valuable ore, and spend your earnings on character upgrades. Spin, smash, mine, and grow stronger!

details.title: mythorune
details.short_description: An endless co-op action-RPG dungeon crawl. Descend floors that never scale to you, slot runes that rewrite your skills into new weapons, mine the walls, and loot relics of world myth. Play couch, LAN and online in one six-hero party, or host your own server. No microtransactions.

details.title: Street Girls: Love Records
details.short_description: Work odd jobs, pay the rent, and fall in love in a small Chinese city. This 2D romance visual novel mixes light life-sim elements with three heroines and nine endings. Balance money, time, and energy as casual texts and budget dates grow into relationships that are harder to leave behind.

details.title: Flume
details.short_description: A pixel-art puzzle roguelike where every run is different. Flip tiles, swap cards from your hand and build a route to the finish before the flow catches up.

details.title: Slums: Hauler 2
details.short_description: Start with nothing and build a better life through delivery work, vehicle-based jobs, and high-risk contracts. Buy weapons, vehicles, and property while surviving the dangers of an urban sandbox where bigger rewards bring bigger risks.

details.title: The Lords' Game
details.short_description: Conquer a continent with your deck. The Lords’ Game is a turn-based strategy game with fully animated battlefield combat. Raise armies, break enemy morale, and rule through warfare, diplomacy, and subterfuge. Play solo, face friends in hotseat, or join an online campaign with up to eight players.

details.title: Hired Blade
details.short_description: Hired Blade is a tactical turn based RPG set in a medieval fantasy world. Become a warchief of your own mercenary band, recruit hired blades, take on contracts, fight bandits and monsters. Unwind in taverns to boost your squad's morale! Embrace the hard life of a true gritty sellsword!

details.title: NARNOK: Feed Grommy Candy
details.short_description: A push-your-luck roguelike sackbuilder where you feed candy to a worm called Grommy. Draw candies from your sack, chain their effects, and feed Gromintler BUT NOT TOO SWEET!

details.title: Guardian Demon
details.short_description: Protect the helpless peasant Myson from an army of angry orcs for as long as possible in this action arcade game. Defeat hordes of orcs with simple and easy to learn intuitive controls, earn gold to customize Myson's appearance and compete with others to see who can survive the longest!

details.title: AntiClimatic
details.short_description: A physics based weather simulator where you change the weather patterns throughout 30+ scenarios.

details.title: Fuji Flip
details.short_description: Flip two cards. Hear the word. Match the pair. Fuji Flip is a memory card game for language learners: every card shows a picture and a word and says it out loud, so you pick up real Japanese, Spanish and French words while you play.

details.title: Entre Sueños
details.short_description: Entre Sueños is a first-person psychological horror adventure where blinking changes reality. Explore unsettling environments, uncover hidden doors, solve mysterious puzzles and discover the truth behind a world trapped between life and death.

details.title: Streetball Legends
details.short_description: No rules. No fouls. Just baskets and beatdowns. Team up in co-op or go solo against increasingly tougher opponents in chaotic arcade basketball. Unleash devastating Power Shots, earn game-changing gear, and keep your run alive. Or go PvP and challenge a friend in Versus mode.

details.title: GEOMETRY NEXUS
details.short_description: Geometry Nexus is a neon action roguelike where your weapons fire automatically. Dodge enemy swarms, collect upgrades, trigger Overdrive, grow stronger between runs, and survive ten minutes to defeat the Nexus Guardian.

details.title: Playfolk Hockey 27
details.short_description: Run a hockey club in a league you design, then simulate, watch or play every game, from a top-down view or full 3D broadcast cameras. Set the lines and the rules, make trades, manage shifts and fatigue. Edit every league, team and player in-game, import your own or community rosters.

details.title: Relicbearer TD
details.short_description: Build your defences, unleash devastating abilities, and claim powerful Relics in this 2D Tower Defence Strategy game.

details.title: Hit the Fly
details.short_description: Let your instincts run wild! Take revenge on these pesky little bugs for everything! But remember they come in different colors and behave in different ways. To catch them off guard, don’t forget to use your "Super Hits".

details.title: Chiki Poki: Rush🎉
details.short_description: The cutest cleanup operation in the world. A fast, hands-on incremental game. Take down the copycat "Chippies", collect Star Candy, and keep your Ultimate going forever! Grow stronger with every material you gather — until the "Chippy King" falls!

details.title: Syncblade
details.short_description: A rhythm game where you can play any song thanks to our advanced music analysis system, or create and share custom levels with players around the world. Play as Akemi, a unique samurai girl, and slash through waves of Zombeats to the beat of the music you love.

details.title: The Adventures of Portos
details.short_description: "A 2D Platform hide and seek adventure"

details.title: Ninja Remix Resynced
details.short_description: Create your own ninja, use handsigns and perform jutsus, unlock skills across skill trees, and master techniques at different ranges. Team up in co-op or challenge other players in PvP.

details.title: Dead Bet
details.short_description: Dead Bet is a card-based roguelite set in a deadly show. Study fighters, uncover their secrets, and use cards to influence their chances. A wrong prediction can cost a family member their life. You decide who pays.

details.title: 奶瓦的归来
details.short_description: Short Description The bell falls silent and Naiwa becomes a fugitive. Wall-jump, double-jump, and air-dash through a 2D Metroidvania. Open shortcuts, knock foes back with a three-hit combo, and wipe out small foes with a belly laugh. Face four guardians and uncover why the bell stopped.

details.title: Tidy Up the Ark
details.short_description: Tidy Up the Ark is a cozy sorting simulator where 3120 animals from 156 species are waiting their turn to board the Ark. Gather them, sort them into the right pens, and unlock new abilities.

details.title: The Flying Feather Shotgun
details.short_description: There's tales told about a shootgun that can burst dreams into reality... Well, no, to be honest, it's just a single succubus that illegally entered MacDude's room that tell that. Let's believe her! And off we go to a 2d arena shooter with movement bound to the recoil of your weapons!

details.title: I Am Train
details.short_description: A cozy train track builder, I Am Train. Drive your train around the world picking up passengers from various platforms. Build houses and towns to connect passengers.

details.title: Your "Thing"
details.short_description: Finally, you can grow your own little thing. Water it, feed it, and experiment with your technique to shape how it grows. Every mushroom has its own size, patterns, and quirks. It lives right on your desktop, reacts to your touch, and sometimes gets up to mischief. How big will yours get?

details.title: Merchant Legends: The Founding
details.short_description: Build a new town in a Game Boy inspired fantasy world... Gather resources, recruit citizens, trade goods and grow your empire to push back the forces of evil! A love-letter to retro RPGs.

details.title: PW7A
details.short_description: You awaken from a long sleep as a robot. All you know is that this game is called PW7A. Turn your insights into the power to open new paths in this compact 2D pixel-art puzzle adventure.
developers: スイカ食べ食べうさぎ
publishers: スイカ食べ食べうさぎ

details.title: IAFT Fear Diagnosis
details.short_description: A new kind of horror game that builds a stage just for you from the results of a fear diagnosis. Scary, and a little funny. Heights, tight spaces, bugs, ghosts, even paperwork: your fears combine into over 2 million stages, so no two runs are alike. Too scary? Exclude any fear in the settings.

details.title: My Shitty Life
details.short_description: Life sucks. Make sure your friends' lives suck worse! My Shitty Life is a darkly comedic 3D board game where you work lousy jobs, pay rent, buy ridiculous items, and sabotage your friends while trying to avoid bankruptcy. Play solo, locally, or with friends through Steam Remote Play Together.

details.title: test
details.short_description: A classic side scrolling game level that combines platform jumping, action combat, and puzzle exploration. Players control their characters to move horizontally on a two-dimensional plane, gradually solving puzzles and defeating enemies through jumping, attacking, and obstacle avoidance operations.

details.title: Reversed
details.short_description: Build your defenses using 15 different types of blocks and survive fifteen waves. You'll earn XP for every wave you survive. Then switch sides and try to destroy your own base. The faster you are, the higher the XP multiplier. Use the XP you've earned to unlock new blocks and cards, and try again.

details.title: But in briefs
details.short_description: Reach the exit… until it runs away, everything collapses, and your pants catch fire. Six zones of chaos in a minimalist platformer.

details.title: Hanafuda Solitaire
details.short_description: Ever wished Hanafuda had a way to play alone? Capture pairs and form yaku in pure Hanafuda, with new rules that let you play it solo, solitaire-style.

details.title: The Lost Future
details.short_description: The Lost Future is a pixel art RPG blending fantasy and mechanical civilization. Follow Ark from peaceful Windmill Village through bustling harbors, mysterious elven forests, mechanical cities, and frozen northern lands. Explore seven chapters filled with adventure, companions, and hidden secrets.

details.title: Feed the Bloom
details.short_description: Drop food and watch a slime mould bloom towards it. Tendrils reach out, veins pulse with nutrients, and your hive grows against the clock. When time runs out, spend your spores on upgrades and go again. A calm, clicky incremental game set in a petri dish.

details.title: Hela: of Mice & Magic
details.short_description: See the world through the eyes of a brave little mouse in this enchanting 3D co-op adventure. Explore breathtaking landscapes inspired by Northern Sweden, solve puzzles, and be a force for good in a land where heartwarming storytelling and the beauty of nature intertwine.

details.title: Super Onslaught
details.short_description: A real time strategy, arcade, tower defense game where you repeat short runs in order to get more knowledge about the mechanics and turrets. With good knowledge and preparation, you will survive longer and even maybe reach the wave 100 milestone.

details.title: NIGHT SHIFT: HAUNTED MALL
details.short_description: The mall closed at midnight. The ghosts didn't. 1–6 friends. 5 lost items. 1 date with Mika… and only one of you gets it. Frying pans, bazookas, banana peels: anything goes. And don't scream: the ghosts can hear your mic.

details.title: Gateshock
details.short_description: Every map has a code. Build yours, paste it to a friend, beat theirs. A hex-grid tower defense with 14 towers across four upgrade tiers, a hand-crafted 16-mission campaign, and a run mode where 40 relics decide how far you get.

details.title: Dices golf
details.short_description: Turn-based golf where your choice of die balances reach and precision. Beat courses to welcome visitors, reinvest their earnings in your estate and skills, and take on ever tougher challenges, all the way to Hell.

details.title: Pirates Life
details.short_description: Build your own island, explore unique seas, uncover buried treasure, join or create crews, battle in naval PvP, and sink rival ships in an online pirate sandbox where every adventure shapes your legacy.

details.title: Up, Up! Neon Stairs
details.short_description: Same way? Climb. Other way? Turn. A two-button neon stair race where your brain must keep up with your fingers. Who's the fastest thinker? Find out in 1v1s, 4-player races with items and crumbling-stair Survival. 300+ outfits, Neon Pets, an idle world stroll. Free to play, with browser cross-play.

name: XX GAME: The Evolution Merge Puzzle

details.title: XX GAME: The Evolution Merge Puzzle
details.short_description: “XX GAME: The Evolution Merge Puzzle” is a physics-based merge puzzle game about evolution. Start as a tiny strawberry and evolve into insects, animals, humans, and beyond. Merge uniquely shaped characters and experience an evolutionary journey across 9 stages.

details.title: Boba Escape
details.short_description: Get ready for an adorable yet brutal climb! You play as a tiny boba pearl trying to escape a giant bubble tea. Aim, charge, and launch your way to the top in this cute but challenging precision platformer. Every jump matters, and one tiny mistake could send you tumbling all the way back down!

details.title: SCRAPFLUX
details.short_description: Turn scrap into ammo in a sci-fi top-down shooter. Pull metal in with your magnet, hurl it at enemies or deposit it for credits to upgrade your robot. Fight through 12 maps with bosses and face endless waves in Survival mode.

details.title: Padel Manager 27
details.short_description: A realistic padel management game: found your academy and take it from the bottom division to the world elite. Sign and pair players with real personalities, call every point from the bench or play it yourself, and live every shot on a truly simulated court. Early Access on December 1.

details.title: Sparrow Warfare
details.short_description: Play ever-crazier combinations of 3 tiles to free the birds in our synergy-rich deckbuilder. Let your mind take flight as you scheme and strategise. This… is Sparrow Warfare!

details.title: Mini Pond Farm: Frogs & Lilypads
details.short_description: Collect all the cute frogs! Shape your pond paradise, fill it with colorful hoppers, make them happy with reeds and lilies, and enjoy pure cozy serenity.

details.title: Cardelis
details.short_description: A competitive pixel art card collecting game. Open boosters, build your deck and face real players in PvP. Climb the leaderboard and prove you're the best!

details.title: LUNADUN: LUNATIC DUNGEON
details.short_description: You choose a favorite and walk beside them. But those you left behind — where do they go while you're gone? LUNADUN: LUNATIC DUNGEON is an emotional visual novel where choices shape four characters' fates. 'The ones you loved, the ones you ignored — you don't get to walk away from either of them.'

details.title: Own The Map
details.short_description: Build a fictional property empire on the real-world map in this Early Access online tycoon. Claim locations, earn game cash and grow with a shared community. Active development: features may change, bugs may occur and progress may be reset.

details.title: Antarctic Showdown
details.short_description: Kill your friend! Antarctic Showdown is a 1v1 roguelike shooter. Grow stronger with every defeat and claim victory!

details.title: Ashes of Macedonia
details.short_description: Survive the chaos of the Greek Macedonian Front in a brutal WW1 first-person shooter. Hold the line against overwhelming assaults, manage dwindling resources, and fight to stay alive. Death is permanent. One life. One soldier. One chance.

details.title: Harbourside
details.short_description: Build a busy little fishing harbour in this cosy management game. Send boats out, sell the day's catch, expand your pier and grow from a single rowboat to an automated fleet.

details.title: CRYMELIGHT
details.short_description: CRYMELIGHT is a roguelike action game set in the world of the afterlife, where girls confront their sins as they fight to gain their freedom.

details.title: fogpost
details.short_description: Guide a courier and a delayed echo through 250 turn-based puzzles. Collect the letter, plan around tides, bridges and shifting routes, and light both beacons on the same turn. Undo, use hints, then refine your route to earn gold stamps.

details.title: I just wanted a marshmallow.
details.short_description: 'I just wanted a marshmallow.' is a casual completely normal take on the arena shooter genre. Falling into the pits of despair over not having a marshmallow, you and your crew opt to take the matters into their own hands. There's not much else to say about this game.

details.title: DELVERS: Dragon's Hoard
details.short_description: A party autobattler incremental. Recruit heroes under their zodiac signs, gear them from a hoard of rolled loot, grow a skill tree that is the sky — then send four into the depths and watch them fight. Climb the cursed city of Greymarrow for gear no delve will ever drop. Every run reaches further.

details.title: ころコロ 2
details.short_description: corocoro 2! A gyro-exclusive casual game where you tilt the ground to guide 5 uniquely shaped balls to the goal. Overcome the obstacles across all 50 stages!

details.title: BallerZ
details.short_description: Fast, physics-based online football in the spirit of Haxball. Dribble, curl shots, dash and ghost past defenders in matches up to 6v6. Start a club, climb a league pyramid of real divisions, play cups and friendlies, and chat with your country's community. Free to play.

details.title: Myriad
details.short_description: Myriad is a star themed 2D falling blocks puzzle roguelite game. Every other round, enter a shop and strengthen your build. Gaze the stars in the night sky and score incredibly powerful line clears or just plain destroy the board as you see fit. Watch out for the constellations though...

details.title: Monstarium
details.short_description: Tiny pixel monsters live along the bottom of your screen, and climb on top of your windows. Hatch eggs, merge twins to evolve them, and collect over 1,000 looks across 95 forms while you work. Pet them, toss them a treat, and watch them make friends.

details.title: Last Spin: Survive
details.short_description: Your next spin could keep you alive. A dark first-person roguelite in a sealed bunker: collect artifacts, push payouts to the limit, and unlock permanent upgrades. Survive 12 days and hold out for evacuation.

details.title: Room Movers
details.short_description: Grab one end, I'll take the other. Room Movers is a cozy two-player game about unboxing and arranging tiny diorama workplaces. No grid, no score, no timer. Just you, your friend, and a room that slowly becomes a place.

details.title: Cheese Panic
details.short_description: An online 4v1 heist where four mice have 15 minutes to steal enough food while one cat hunts them down. Every mouse they fail to revive costs the team a life. Proximity voice chat included, so keep it down.

details.title: Bundoro
details.short_description: A Pomodoro timer, desktop companion, and Steam Inventory game.

details.title: Survival Of Runt
details.short_description: An open-world PvPvE survival shooter where cooperation and betrayal coexist. Choose between Chaos and Order to claim victory, and if you fall, revive as a formidable Mutant Player to hunt down the remaining survivors.

details.title: Going my way?
details.short_description: You're a train conductor in a world that doesn't sleep anymore. People are losing their minds, and Wanderers hide among them. Your job sounds simple: get the train to the City, watch the passengers, and never forget that the train demands sacrifices.

details.title: MAMA
details.short_description: Mama is a psychological horror game with a dark, unsettling atmosphere, set on the abandoned fifth floor of an old Soviet apartment building. As you explore, you will slowly uncover what happened there and why the entire floor was left behind.

details.title: Pistol Cat
details.short_description: Like Animal Crossing but really stupid and physics based. You are a heavily armed cat exploring a cozy yet chaotic open world island town. Discover items that give you abilities, get rich, collect custom costumes & accessories, farm, complete quests for your neighbors, unlock upgrades, and more!

details.title: Grid & Loot
details.short_description: Grid & Loot is a casual turn-based RPG with unique gameplay: one click resolves combat on a 3x3 grid. Pick your class, explore areas, collect loot, forge legendary gear and survive traps, elites and bosses.

details.title: Murder in the Arctic Circle
details.short_description: Murder in the Arctic Circle is a point-and-click exploration, photography and mystery adventure game in which the backgrounds are actual photos of real Norway - they were shot on location.

details.title: MyRummy® 2
details.short_description: The legendary tile-laying classic – combine cleverly, make smart moves, and add a little luck to be the first to play all your tiles.

details.title: Hi Sudoku
details.short_description: Sudoku should be pure logic—never guessing. Solve 10,000+ fair puzzles across five difficulties. Stuck? Step-by-step hints show the next move and why it works, so you can spot it yourself next time. Play comfortably with mouse, keyboard, or controller in calm themes.

details.title: Nukes on the Loose
details.short_description: Compete with up to 5 other players to see who can avoid getting blown up by the hidden dirty bombs in this thrilling card game. Play secrets, veto cards, cruise missiles and a lot more. Only 1 player can survive and save their city!

details.title: Bridgelands
details.short_description: Bridgelands is an action roguelite where you embark on expeditions with Flora across mysterious islands. Choose your routes, face dangerous creatures, and combine powerful perks to create a new build with every journey.

details.title: Keep Drawing: Webtoon Tycoon
details.short_description: Start as a solo webtoon artist and build a studio empire. Draw chapters readers love, grow hit series, hire specialists, and negotiate publishing deals across a 25-year career. A cozy creative journey with the depth of a management tycoon.

details.title: Crown & Banner
details.short_description: Crown & Banner™ is an MMORTS inspired by the browser games of the 2000s, where the roads and outposts your empire builds become the battleground of the endgame. Buy once, play anywhere, forever free-to-win, Crown & Banner is a game where strategy and diplomacy (not money!) determine the outcome.

details.title: EchoMon: Pack & Stack!
details.short_description: Transform a chaotic store into a pristine collector's haven. EchoMon is a cozy first-person shop simulator where you organize an incredible 3,600 elemental trading cards. Upgrade your skills, unleash magical sorting abilities, and experience the pure satisfaction of a perfect shelf.

details.title: IIIIIIlI
details.short_description: "Draw. Disguise. Kick the can." An asymmetric versus game of drawing and can-kicking, set on pixel-art stages. "Mimicry" by doodling on yourself and the stage to blend in, plus fast-paced mind games that end in minutes. Enjoy online matches for up to 16 players — casually, with AI bots or friends.

details.title: AREA 51: The Awakening
details.short_description: A dark, sci-fi, indie horror. The protagonist, Chris, wants to find his father, a scientist at Area 51 who has disappeared. He and his friends plan to infiltrate Area 51 and find his father. But the secrets and horrors of the place await them there...

details.title: AquaScape Desk
details.short_description: A planted aquarium sim that lives on your desktop. Build a hardscape from stones and driftwood, plant it, and let the fish swim. Plants grow in real time, so trimming matters. You can even scan real stones and driftwood and drop them straight in. Reef tanks with corals, too.

details.title: My Fart Adventure
details.short_description: My Fart Adventure — Cursed by a bad taco, you're now doomed to fart in public. The subtle art of cutting the cheese without getting busted: blend into the crowd, escape the DGREI Agents. Solo or up to 30 players online.

details.title: Broadside Bets
details.short_description: Your crew trusts you with their lives... Bad idea. You’re about to wager them on the cards! Collect rule-bending Booty and sail across the sea. Some routes lead to treasure, others lead to a merchant who will try to sell you a cursed map and you’ll probably buy it anyway.

details.title: Runaway Sleigh 84
details.short_description: Santa's sleigh is out of control! Dodge elves, stumps, and hazards, grab cookies to keep going, and race through 24 fast-paced arcade stages. Think you can survive the ride?

details.title: Echoes of Another Sky
details.short_description: A musical action RPG about a boy, a talking bell and thirteen skies that are being forgotten. Wield a tuning fork, chain combos, magic and reaction commands, and ring every silent world back to life before the last note fades.

details.title: VVV
details.short_description: Raise your Voltage in a Virtual world and seize Victory!!! Chain combos, master powerful Arts, and race against time. Roguelite × 3D Action Every cleared stage brings new upgrades, while the relentless countdown pushes your Voltage even higher.

details.title: Cranked
details.short_description: Explore, race, and freeride in Cranked and experience the raw thrill of downhill mountain biking. It’s fast, responsive, and grounded -- we're chasing what it really feels like to ride. Easy to pick up, impossible to put down, and packed with virtually endless skill depth.

name: Mystery Adventure The Maid Did It

details.title: Mystery Adventure The Maid Did It
details.short_description: The culprit is—the maid. And the protagonist. your mission is to strike down six unsuspecting guests, one by one. But beware—you must never be suspected before your plan is complete. To escape suspicion, engage in heated debates and refute your opponents. Hide your true identity at all costs.

details.title: Edenwound
details.short_description: A brutally difficult dungeon crawler rpg with elements inspired by the survival and roguelike genres. Face the horrors of Eden and discover what lies at the bottom of the abyss...

details.title: Solid Boat Adventure
details.short_description: Solid Boat Adventure is a co-op adventure game where you and your friends control an odd steamboat delivering curious cargo across treacherous waters.

name: G-MODE Archives+ THE LABYRINTH OF DRUAGA

details.title: G-MODE Archives+ THE LABYRINTH OF DRUAGA
details.short_description: Queen Ki has been captured once again. Take control of Gil and rescue Ki from the underground labyrinth!

details.title: Ember and Ash: The Cradle
details.short_description: A fantasy story game about a long road and the people who walk it with you. Choose your path, fight with timing and skill, grow close to your companions, and face an ending shaped by every choice you made.

details.title: Shear Debt
details.short_description: An active incremental game about shearing an increasingly odd flock, restoring the farm and building up upgrades that survive bankruptcy. Grandma’s farm is yours, debts and all. Even the Queen needs a trim.

details.title: JUNK//GOD
details.short_description: Steal weapons from the machines you destroy. JUNK//GOD is a 3D action roguelite where you build a robot from salvaged parts, combine its weapons and fight through five industrial districts. Lose a part in combat, pull it back in and keep fighting.

details.title: Figure Drawing Garden
details.short_description: Grab your sketchbook, relax, explore, and draw in your very own Figure Drawing Garden - an immersive virtual garden designed for you to practice and improve at figure drawing.

details.title: Still With Me
details.short_description: A short psychological horror experience about returning to a familiar place where something has been waiting for you.

details.title: Toadled: Eating Frenzy
details.short_description: Toadled: Eating Frenzy is an action roguelike with an appetite! Play as a toad and eat everything on your path to grow bigger and mutate into new, disgusting forms. Consuming human flesh? Fair game. Police cars, tanks, missiles? Mild indigestion. Try out hundreds of appetizing build combinations!

details.title: Skyrest
details.short_description: Skyrest is a first-person action roguelike where you summon procedural generated islands, gather resources, upgrade your boat, craft items and weapons and fight ghostly enemies using an arsenal of spiritual weapons and runic attacks.

details.title: Project Melvin
details.short_description: Project Melvin is a story driven 3rd person adventure game with main story quests and side quests to get excited about. Discover story lines you never thought were possible and humour you never wanted but got.

details.title: Muritura
details.short_description: A mouse wakes in a tiny community after a terrible storm brings more than just weather with it. Fight or flee monsters, mouse around puzzles, engage with locals, and uncover the source of the unnatural storm in this old-school, adventure game.

details.title: Short Circuit
details.short_description: It never stops raining in this abandoned world. Use your disc to turn the machines back on and find out what happened. A minimalist puzzle-platformer made with PICO-8.

name: 烽烟三国 Warfires of the Three Kingdoms

details.title: 烽烟三国 Warfires of the Three Kingdoms
details.short_description: Warfires of the Three Kingdoms is a turn-based strategy game set in the Three Kingdoms era. Build teams from Heroes, Skills, and Formations, exploit unit counters, climb the Tower with three parties, collect Equipment, and adapt your tactics to each enemy lineup.

details.title: Jibbers
details.short_description: Physics-driven ski game with fully simulated bodies and flexible skis. No trick buttons. Control, timing, and motion earn every move. Full customization, tunable physics, community maps, multiplayer.

details.title: Sorted by Christmas
details.short_description: It’s almost Christmas and there’s a mountain of 100,000 presents still to sort. Round up your Gonk Squad for first-person co-op chaos with vacuums, black holes and Festive Dynamite. Up to 8 players, or solo.

details.title: Build to Survive
details.short_description: Build a car, launch it down a mountain road and let physics decide. No steering, no second chances: pick the body, engine, suspension and tyres, then watch your machine fly, crash and fall apart. Beat gold times in Challenges or race two cars side by side in Free Drive.

details.title: SCRAPSCRAP
details.short_description: You're a lone robot that was left behind to clean up all of humanity's trash. Break down trash piece by piece and recycle them into tools, upgrades and a whole crew of helper bots. Stack up all the trash and restore the planet in this physics-driven incremental game.

details.title: Maple's Secret
details.short_description: Pet Maple at his own rhythm, earn upgrades to get away with more, and make it to 8:00 AM without getting caught.

details.title: ExoImperium: Space Tycoon
details.short_description: ExoImperium: Space Tycoon is a sci-fi strategy and factory management game. Colonize 70+ planets, automate production with worker drones, manage real-time interstellar logistics, research advanced technologies, and command powerful battle fleets across the galaxy.

details.title: KILLDOZER SIMULATOR
details.short_description: A top-down destruction roguelite. Bring down every building on your grudge list and turn the living town against itself: gas stations and propane tanks take out the vigilantes, police and soldiers sent to stop you. Between runs, build and customize your Killdozer with new armor, guns and mounts.

details.title: Gears & Glory
details.short_description: Build your battle machine in a steampunk autobattler of gears, steam, and strategy. Buy weapons and components, arrange them on your grid, and combine their effects. Put your engineering to the test as your machine fights automatically.

details.title: near the fear
details.short_description: Lost in an unknown world, alone and desperate, you're driving towards the light. On an ever-shifting road, turn inwards and face your ancient enemy to find the freedom you crave.

details.title: Cosminomy
details.short_description: The colorful universe of Cosminomy offers unique colony building challenges on nice little planets. Form thriving settlements, develop them step by step, turn a profit, and expand your colony across the cosmos.

details.title: Text Shelter
details.short_description: Text Shelter​ is a text-based post-apocalyptic idle game. Construct your shelter, plan production lines, and balance power and resources. Venture into the No-Man's Land, upgrade survivor stats, and invest in doomsday industries for greater profits. Expand your camp into a true Ark of the End Times.

details.title: Aita: The Dark Domain
details.short_description: Every card is both an attack and part of your survival in this 1–4 player co-op roguelite. Spend cards to strike, preserve enough to survive the counterattack, and combine sacred suit powers with 100+ Blessings.

details.title: Jackpot Poker Destruction
details.short_description: Poker meets slot machines in this roguelite deckbuilder! Hold and swap cards, build winning poker hands with special Jokers, upgrade your decks and defeat your enemies!

details.title: One Bard Move
details.short_description: You are a bard the size of a salt shaker, and the kitchen wants you dead. Any jump can end badly, and an exasperated narrator will tell everyone about it. A 3D precision platformer: funny, hard, but fair.

details.title: A Hundred Light Years
details.short_description: A text-based space survival game inspired by The Oregon Trail. Lead your family 100 light-years across deep space to a distant colony. Every choice matters. Not everyone makes it. Some things out there are worse than death.

details.title: Gang Birds
details.short_description: Gang Birds is a bluffing and deduction game around a table in a backroom. Your job and two hidden contacts decide whether you play for the Gang, the Cops or the Junkies. Play with friends, up to 10 at one table, in 1v1 duels or against bots.

details.title: HackMeNow
details.short_description: Investigate compromised systems through a fictional Linux-style terminal. Read logs, uncover hidden files, decode secrets and avoid traps across 15 story-driven puzzle levels. Every command brings you closer to the rogue intelligence watching from behind the screen..

details.title: Bakebound
details.short_description: Bakebound is a short, active incremental game about harvesting a magical field that fights back. Sweep through living crops, dodge their attacks, and bake what you gather into recipes that make every trip stronger.

details.title: Fetch()
