details.short_description: Join a team of food and wage war on a giant kitchen counter. Rev up, let go and splat your enemies with throws, or capture regions to take over the map. Pineapples, watermelons and more battle online in chaotic deathmatch and capture modes. Last team splatting wins!

details.title: Rail Rush Multiplayer
details.short_description: Dodge the trains. Ride the roofs. Never stop running. Race through a living city in a fast endless runner and go online with up to 50 players at once. Collect coins, upgrade your runner, complete challenges and see how far you can get before the next train hits.

details.title: Pimple Pop
details.short_description: Get up close. Really, really close. Squeeze pimples, scrape plaque, roll out earwax, pluck nose hairs and trim nails in 21 levels of ultra-detailed close-up work. Be gentle, be precise, and never touch the eardrum. Earn 3 stars on every level and unlock them all.

details.title: SUNSWORN
details.short_description: Awaken among the ruins of the Order of the Sun in a fantasy RPG with automatic combat and idle farming. Explore a hex-based world, develop your Exorcist and earn the trust of settlements to uncover the past. Begin again with your memories and the enduring power of the Phoenix Mark.

details.title: THROWAWAY
details.short_description: Five people posted about their night shifts on an anonymous forum. Every one of them stopped posting at 3:17 AM. Work their shifts yourself in this PS1-style horror anthology and keep to the rules they left behind. Then someone starts a thread about you.

details.title: Alice: Defense
details.short_description: Alice: Defense is a roguelike tower defense game where heroes fight on their own. Recruit them with gold, place them on the board, and hold back waves of monsters. Uncover why the World Tree has changed in Story Mode, then push your limits in Infinity Mode with Relics, Augments and Abyss Contracts.

details.title: HexStermination
details.short_description: Command one of four sci-fi armies on a hex board where every tile fires at once. Place, move and rotate your tiles, aim their guns and shields, and be the last one standing. Play against the computer, with friends on the same PC, or online with 2 to 4 players.

details.title: Hollow Galley
details.short_description: When deep-sea research vessel Thessaly goes silent, Rin Kessler docks alone to find her missing brother. Manage scarce ammunition against mutated crew members and unearth the Nocturne program in this story driven 3D cel-shaded third-person survival horror mystery with multiple endings.

details.title: Touhou Gomoku
details.short_description: In Touhou Gomoku, you're one stone from five in a row when Marisa's Last Spell, Final Spark, wipes out your line. 50 spell cards freeze points, steal stones and cut lines. Beat nine Kourindou regulars to win their cards, or play a friend locally or online. From the makers of Touhou Chess.

details.title: Clumsy Robot
details.short_description: A clumsy robot wants to prove he's useful. Walk him through 33 physics-based obstacle courses, from farms and offices to airports and banks. Carry fragile cargo, compete against ridiculous rivals, and fall in hilarious ways. Then challenge up to 7 friends in online races!

details.title: Mystical II: Forgotten Knowledge
details.short_description: Forgotten knowledge sleeps in five mystical realms. Buy the falling objects for a gold coin each, gather trios and pairs in your bag, then reveal them with the magnifier before a column overflows. 50 stages, 216 painted objects: a medieval puzzle game.

details.title: Stray Cloud: An Overcast Story
details.short_description: You are a cloud. A fairly small one, and the other clouds think that's hilarious. Swallow them, rain to buy upgrades and grow from one field to the whole Earth. Then drift on through the solar system, world by world, until you cover the Sun. A cozy, fully narrated incremental.

details.title: Holy Nest
details.short_description: Deep underground, where light has never been, live blind beetles. They know the world by sound, and by sound they know their god. A god game and colony sim with indirect control: the swarms live on their own, and you guide them with sound, touch and miracles. Your deeds decide what god you are.

details.title: Blindfold Bash
details.short_description: Don't make a sound! Blindfold Bash is a hide-and-seek party game where the seeker is blindfolded and hunts by ear. Every creaky floorboard, squeaky toy and badly timed fart lights up their screen. Stay quiet, fool the seeker, sacrifice a friend. Play with friends or in public matches, 2-20 players.

details.title: Hetero-Genesis
details.short_description: Build a living weapon in this deep-sea action roguelite. Choose your species, graft organs, and combine melee strikes, ranged fire, and strange synergies. Protect vital parts, survive waves and bosses, and evolve your body during each dive.

details.title: Defenders of Cinderkeep
details.short_description: Defenders of Cinderkeep is a dark fantasy incremental auto-battler. Battle endless waves of orcs, demons, dragons, and other mythic creatures in defense of the last bastion of humanity. Upgrade your heroes and equip them with a variety of spells and powers to unleash upon the demonic hordes.

details.title: Starforge Pirate
details.short_description: Starforge Pirate is a fast-paced arcade roguelite in which you will battle cosmic enemies, forge wild weapons, manage weapon heat, upgrade your ship, face deadly bosses, and chase the perfect run.

details.title: Crease
details.short_description: Fold the paper into shape. A cozy grid puzzler about creasing a sheet of paper until it matches the target exactly. 100+ levels, with fun mechanics.

details.title: Get-Out-Hoomanz
details.short_description: A chaotic 2-4 player dungeon crawler! Sabotage your friends' dungeons with deadly traps, loot everything in sight, and escape the show alive. Can you survive your friends' hazards or just another human snack?

details.title: Clanker Town
details.short_description: A first-person horde shooter with an incremental upgrade tree. Tens of thousands of smart-home robots want your trailer. Shoot them down, sell their scrap off Dale's tailgate, and grow one nail gun into hubcaps, Black Cats, a propane slingshot and a lawnmower minigun.

details.title: I Am Konrad Voss
details.short_description: 2171. Konrad Voss hid a six-dimensional bomb inside the maze of Alfa 47, and time is running out. Leave your family, cross the mountain, jump through the black hole and descend into the maze only you know. Shooting, racing, flight and a haunted house in one campaign, voiced in English and Spanish.

details.title: VOIDRUN: ASCENSION
details.short_description: Pilot an agile starfighter against relentless mechanical swarms in this fast-paced arcade shooter. Dodge bullet hells, unlock devastating weapons like the Nova Blast, and defeat massive bosses to survive the void. How long can you last?

details.title: KIRA: Composition for One Player
details.short_description: A 2D platformer where you explore an enchanted world, collect fragments of lost music, and piece them together into a composition. Help Kira bring music back to a city that has fallen silent.

details.title: Chief? About That File...
details.short_description: Step into an atmospheric 1990s police archive. Inspect, classify, and organize 3,360 unique criminal dossiers, crack safes, and uncover crime syndicates in this immersive first-person archival detective simulator.

details.title: Leave Them Outside
details.short_description: A life sim. Except you're in the real world. After the bombs fall, Shelter 38 beneath Kadıköy is yours to run. You decide who gets in, and you do whatever it takes to keep everyone inside alive. Multiple endings, shaped by your choices.

details.title: Polish Liquor Store Tidy Up
details.short_description: Turn a chaotic delivery into neatly stocked shelves in a cozy Polish liquor store. Sort bottles, snacks and Christmas trinkets, tune the radio, befriend a ginger cat and uncover the little stories behind the shop. Take your time. One item at a time.

details.title: Click Bait
details.short_description: Fight the internet’s worst monsters in a rhythm roguelite. Time your clicks on a spinning wheel to attack, block and survive chaotic minigames

details.title: Sort Cats Together
details.short_description: A toy store full of cats needs sorting! Play solo or team up with friends in this cozy 1–4 player co-op game. Find 200 different cat designs, sort 4,000 toys onto their matching shelves, and unlock upgrades to turn a mountain of cats into a tidy collection.

details.title: SOMBRAS: negative frames
details.short_description: ‘SOMBRAS: negative frames’ is a first person narrative game with a focus on photography and light horror elements. Follow Shiomi, a Japanese-Spanish photography student, as she is spirited away in a dark mirror of her 2000s Japanese town and must confront fragments of her own psyche.

details.title: SimFarm
details.short_description: A 3D farm management game where crops grow with the weather and the soil. Choose how tight money gets: play relaxed, or face real costs, loans and the risk of going broke. You give the orders; tractors and harvesters do the work. Rotate cows, sheep and horses through paddocks.

details.title: The Journey Home
details.short_description: Some answers can only be found by going within. In a world beyond the boundaries of time and space, your journey awaits. A stress-free atmospheric side-scrolling adventure.

details.title: Dumpster Gang
details.short_description: Play as a gang of mischievous raccoons in this chaotic co-op sandbox for 1-4 players. Complete ridiculous missions, steal everything you can carry, and outsmart a relentless Exterminator determined to throw your gang behind bars.

details.title: Titan Crew
details.short_description: Up to four players bring the MULE back into service: a 27-meter walking machine left in its depot for ten years. You cold-start it and fix it by hand, then walk it across an abandoned valley to move what its people cannot carry.

details.title: Ad Astra, Inc.
details.short_description: The hardest part about interstellar expansion isn't the technical cost, its the people. Exploit ecosystems, manipulate the masses, and conquer the intergalactic shadow market. Growth is mandatory -- ethics are not.

details.title: The Wrong Way Round
details.short_description: You’re trapped in a town where every way out brings you back from the other side. Explore with up to 5 friends, uncover the mystery and find a way home before the freezing fog takes over.

details.title: Dread of the Deep
details.short_description: Aim your beam, fire, and choose which side to leave in the dark. Fight overwhelming hordes and combine weapons into powerful builds. Shape your lighthouse with a sprawling talent tree, and uncover what waits beneath the waves.

details.title: Billiard Cat
details.short_description: Cats love knocking things off tables. What if it's a pool table? Missed a shot? A cat might just nudge the ball in for you. Then again, it might get in your way. Between turns, pet them, play with a cat teaser, or let one nap on your lap. 8-ball, 9-ball, and snooker for 1–4 players.

details.title: The Cup: Creature Card Battler
details.short_description: A free creature card battler and roguelike deckbuilder with the dice printed on the cards. Draft real North American animals and a few cryptids, take THE ROAD alone or with the House at your side, or fight live 1v1 while the booth calls every roll.

details.title: San Bernardino
details.short_description: Join the San Bernardino neighborhood watch as you try to save your overpriced house from zombies and dinosaurs.

details.title: Rastergeist
details.short_description: A scrolling shooter where you build your own ship from a grid of parts, and every part can be shot off. Collect salvage, research heavier weapons, and fly two branching campaigns of 53 stages, or grow a ship one drafted part at a time in Endless Run, a roguelite with a daily leaderboard.

details.title: INDOORS: Trespasser
details.short_description: May 7th, 1951. Five days after the Alston family vanished inside their manor. Local policeman Lucas Smith, never returned from his investigation. Now, his son breaks in to continue the investigation in this short horror and detective escape room.

details.title: While 1
details.short_description: Don't touch the walls. While 1 is a minimalist mouse-only action game centered around this simple concept. Create a loop around the level while avoiding obstacles synchronized to the music.

name: Lost Key - The Path of Illumination

details.title: Lost Key - The Path of Illumination
details.short_description: An ancient order that protects a secret, kept hidden for centuries. An unexpected crime that causes you to be accused of the murder of a friend. Solve the mysteries and puzzles of a story full of esotericism to prove the truth about your innocence and hold the real murderer responsible.

details.title: Minesweeper 2007
details.short_description: The future of minesweeper games we were promised. Minesweeper 2007 is a mine flagging puzzle game with new mechanics and a nostalgic 2000’s Frutiger Aero aesthetic. Flag your way through dozens of original puzzles, relax, and pretend it's still 2007…

details.title: One More Tower
details.short_description: This is a horde survival tower defense, I hope you'll like it! Expand the board, build towers, and hold out against the onslaught of enemies. How long can you survive? >:3

name: 第二公主的魔塔The magic tower of the second princess

details.title: 第二公主的魔塔The magic tower of the second princess
details.short_description: A minimalist portrait roguelike built for lightweight PC gaming. Build tag combos while enjoying mini-games like fishing, blind chess, and brawls. Play P2P duels with friends. Ultra-lightweight, code-drawn visuals, playable with just a mouse. Easy to learn, deeply strategic.

details.title: Thief: The Dark Project Remastered
details.short_description: The shadows are your ally. Return to the city as Garrett, master thief, in this remastered classic by Nightdive Studios. Pickpocket, prowl, and outsmart in a world where trust is a luxury and every stolen secret comes at a price.

name: Click the Stone: Active Incremental and Idler

details.title: Click the Stone: Active Incremental and Idler
details.short_description: Click the Stone is an incremental game about clicking a stone to receive rocks and coins that deliver incredible rewards. Build game-changing upgrade combos, and let your tribespeople join the fun. Improve your skills to become the strongest.

details.title: Debtrize
details.short_description: You're a debt collector tasked with tracking down everyone who owes a debt in the afterlife. Journey through grim lands full of dangerous creatures and old debts long overdue. Hunt. Kill. Negotiate. Not even death can save you from your debts.

details.title: Office TD
details.short_description: Foil your co-worker's attempts to make you as useless as they are by arranging hapless teammates and ordinary office equipment in devious cubicle layouts to engineer the ultimate defense.

details.title: Whispering Eclipsia
details.short_description: A first-person psychological horror detective thriller. Play as Inspector Keshav, investigate a mysterious murder, interrogate suspects, uncover disturbing evidence, and confront the terrifying secrets hidden within Woods Lane. But beware—some truths are better left buried.

details.title: Debauchery & Magic
details.short_description: In Haven, magic thrives and debauchery is strictly forbidden. Defy a ruthless new ruler as you and your friends quest, loot, party, and battle your way across the kingdom to bring freedom back to its people.

details.title: DeadPoly Desert
details.short_description: Use resources from the teleportation islands to build back in the desert, and attempt to reach even more distant worlds.

details.title: Amazing Slot Survivor (A.S.S.)
details.short_description: Spin the slot machine and see how powerful you'll become! Luck shapes your arsenal, but only skill keeps you alive in this high-stakes bullet heaven roguelite. Master unique weapons and destroy the Spawners summoning endless hordes, and push your luck to the limit.

details.title: Drift After Dark
details.short_description: Inspired by the golden era of Japanese street drifting and classic driving games, Drift After Dark is a laid-back, arcade-style downhill drifting experience built around one simple idea: enjoying the drive.

details.title: Jetski TD
details.short_description: Race against your friends in this PvP tower defense. Build and upgrade towers, ride your Monkey Jetski to haul gold from fish nodes, help other players defend — or quietly make things worse. First to clear a wave sets the pace for everyone.

details.title: Orbrix
details.short_description: Orbrix is a bullet heaven where you craft a unique build to defend against a swarm of bricks. Discover devastating synergies across 60+ upgrades. Survive 10 waves and bosses, then push your build to absurd limits in endless mode. Plus, there are alien pets!

name: Wanderer Wheels - A Road Trip Trading Game

details.title: Wanderer Wheels - A Road Trip Trading Game
details.short_description: Take a cozy road trip home in your van, turning it into a mobile shop to trade goods along the way. Explore scenic roads, discover charming small towns, eat, refuel, and camp as you travel. Trade and earn enough money to pay for your wife's treatment before you reach home.

details.title: Akashic Slingshot
details.short_description: One weapon. One health. One ███.

details.title: Contrail Blazer
details.short_description: A side-view airplane game. Circle items or enemy attacks with your contrail to make them yours. A planet slowly freezing over. Fly at a relaxed pace through rusted ruins and winter landscapes. Missions run about 3 minutes, controller only. Free to play.

details.title: Ex Death Game
details.short_description: 100 ex-boyfriends. One luxury cruise. A deadly reckoning at sea. Play as Su Wei, design lethal trials, and decide each ex’s punishment. As Chopin’s waltzes play, expose their lies, watch alliances crumble, and make every betrayal come due.

details.title: Cat Chaos Tidy Up
details.short_description: Cat Chaos Tidy Up is a cozy organizing game support 1-4 players coop! Pick up 4,800 adorable cat toys, sort them onto the right shelves, earn money, and unlock powerful abilities to tidy up the entire shop.

details.title: No Such Person
details.short_description: 一款以清末民初的上海为时代背景的社会派推理游戏。你在一台历史悬案核查终端前接手这项任务：为墙中无名遗骸重建家族谱系。翻阅泛黄的婚书、讣告与老照片，看清旧秩序崩塌之际每个人的选择与挣扎。

details.title: Diggems
details.short_description: Diggems is a first-person incremental mining game. Smash gems into chain reactions, turn the loot into better gear, and watch your Grand Hall fill up as your pets haul it all home.

details.title: Ad Iterum
details.short_description: Ad Iterum is a turn-based top-down 2D roguelike set in a decaying, ever-shifting world. Flesh is fragile, but you can hack it. Enhance your body, embrace mutations, or form ancient blood pacts. Descend into the depths, scavenge what’s left of humanity, and crawl back...if you can. Kill. Die. Repeat.

details.title: Hexa-Gone
details.short_description: Pieces are falling, and you need to do something about it! Match like colors together to clear them, and if you make a shape, you’ll earn some points. Points are your score in Singleplayer modes, and are used as a currency in Multiplayer modes. Use them to buy Power-Ups and make a comeback!

details.title: Sooooooooooo: Strike, Scream, Run!
details.short_description: Your microphone is your weapon! Play online with up to 8 players, scream to attack, kick your friends, dodge your rivals, and unleash chaos with ridiculous power-ups and unpredictable matches. Grab your mic and let out your best Sooooooooooo!

details.title: Dice Brawl
details.short_description: Dice Brawl is a dice customization roguelite map crawler game. Progress through different areas defeating enemies to unlock additional customization options. With different die face actions, rarities, and modifiers, dice customization has never been so rewarding. Roll for your destiny!

details.title: SearchBattle
details.short_description: Search, turned into a battle. SearchBattle is a word party game for 1–8 players on a real search engine. Everyone searches one word for the same topic; hit counts and results decide the winner. Across many rules, what's tested isn't knowledge but "search power." What would you search?

details.title: FallChess: Wizard's Chess
details.short_description: Mount, move, and command chess pieces in a fully 3D duel. Choose your character, ride your piece across the board, and face your opponents up close. Capture pieces, outmaneuver your enemies, and experience chess like never before, brought to life in first-person action.

details.title: Duck Duck Shoot!
details.short_description: A top-down 2D Survivors-like where you play as a chicken! Face hordes of menacing poultry and collect powerful upgrades in an attempt to get stronger. Fight bosses, choose your own upgrades, and bring a couple together? Get ready to Duck Duck Shoot!

details.title: Universe of the Damned
details.short_description: The Year is 2150 and Earth is on the brink of collapse. Humans have resorted to colonizing other planets to prevent their demise. The EFS received a distress call from one of their colonies on Mars. An elite unit is sent down to the surface to find out what has happened.

details.title: BONKABIND
details.short_description: Ever forgotten how to shoot in the middle of a gunfight? In BONKABIND, players can swap each other's keyboard and mouse controls! One round you're a sharpshooter. The next, you're running backward, crouching by accident, and wondering where your shoot button went.

details.title: Baked Blocks
details.short_description: 《Baked Blocks》 is a single-player grid-based puzzle game with an animal cookie theme. It features 210 puzzles across seven chapters, 30 of which have two or three different ways to solve them, allowing you to create different finished photos from the same box of cookies.

details.title: 桂冠之人 Laureate
details.short_description: “世间仅此一件的视觉小说，一件没什么用，却又独一无二的艺术品。”

details.title: Tilemancer
details.short_description: Build a deck of the dead, solve battles disguised as tactical board puzzles, and defeat an even more evil version of yourself, again and again.

details.title: 九州之士
details.short_description: 战国时代背景，剧情向 RPG 为主，融合大战略玩法。战国时代九州大地列国纷争，百姓流离，原本一介庶民的你，陷入了一场巨大的阴谋中，被亲情、友情与仇恨交织裹挟，踏上了拯救自己与万民苍生的旅途。

details.title: Prison Queen
details.short_description: In a world ruled by sharp tongues, one slip of the lip lands young Odette behind bars. Steal words from your fellow inmates, chain them into razor-sharp sentences, and talk your way up the prison food chain. Here, every sentence is a weapon.

details.title: Farmed & Dangerous
details.short_description: Not another farming game. Plant by night, then defend your crops from dawn to dusk in a first-person roguelite shooter, solo or in 3-player online co-op. Blast crop-hungry crows out of the sky with shotguns, turrets, air strikes and the occasional RPG. Miss the truck's order and the run is over.

details.title: Et le grain mourut
details.short_description: A visual novel set in 1920s Paris. As summer draws near, young students are revising their end-of-year exams. Olivier is one of them.

details.title: See Through Static: The Collection
details.short_description: SEE THROUGH STATIC: THE COLLECTION contains 4 First-Person Psychological Horror Games. Each showcasing new perspectives, mechanics, and insight into the overall story. Search through cryptic tapes and radio frequencies. Examine bodies and report your findings. Can you uncover the truth in time?

details.title: ODD HAUL
details.short_description: Pack your bag, discover powerful item synergies, and chase higher scores in a cozy, cat-filled strategy game. Arrange your loot, unlock clever combinations, shop for upgrades, and see how far your journey takes you!

details.title: PLANETOON
details.short_description: Grab planets, place them into orbit, and grow a galaxy in this space puzzle game. Watch life and civilizations emerge, encounter UFOs and black holes, and discover over 60 endings across 12 billion years of cosmic surprises.

details.title: Cultivation Realm: Card Survival
details.short_description: Cultivation Realm: Card Survival is a cultivation survival game built around card-based interactions. Trapped in a mysterious realm that drains your lifespan but brims with spirit power, you must cultivate, survive, fight, and find a way to escape.

details.title: The Aether Project TD
details.short_description: Place and upgrade towers to defend your objective. Use abilities and the terrain to hold back advancing enemies.

details.title: Sea Beast Odyssey
details.short_description: An incremental action adventure across the seas. Lead 5 Heroes into battle, upgrade your team and mounts, unlock 16 powerful skills, and build your Skill Tree across 35 levels of sea monsters. Defeat giant bosses and tame them as mounts!

details.title: Fishy Business
details.short_description: A story-driven adventure where you captain a fishing boat. Explore a strange island, catch fish, trade and collect records of classical music.

details.title: Board Kingdom
details.short_description: 24 board games in one kingdom. Play Chess, Go, Xiangqi, Shogi, Reversi, Mancala and more against computer opponents. Learn new rules, pick your challenger and build a record in every game.

details.title: The Last Opening
details.short_description: You are dead. To return, you must survive 40 nights in the woods, making brutal choices by day and playing chess against Death each night. The forest is cold. The nights are long. Win, and you may see the dawn. Lose… and the world forgets you.

details.title: Christmas TCG Tidy Up Together
details.short_description: Tidy up nearly 5,000 festive trading cards scattered across the floor of a Christmas TCG store, solo or with up to two friends online. Clean your finds and complete 15 festive sets in regular and holo finishes. Earn coins for boosters packs, hunt for exclusive rare cards.

details.title: My Cat Cafe Simulator
details.short_description: Build your dream cat café! Adopt adorable cats, care for them, and fill your café with love. Decorate your space, collect unique cats, play with your furry friends, and welcome happy customers. Grow your business and create the ultimate cozy paradise for CAT !!!

details.title: The Cave of Doubt
details.short_description: Lovecraftian horror game with elements of psychological and survival horror genres. Where Allen is lost in a cave and is forced to face horrors beyond his imagination. Survive the cave, solve mysteries, reveal the lore lost in time.

name: Statue Gallery: Back in One Piece

details.title: Statue Gallery: Back in One Piece
details.short_description: Explore a messy gallery filled with shattered sculptures inspired by real works from Ancient Greece, Rome, Egypt, and other cultures throughout history. Find where each piece belongs, restore the statues, improve your abilities, and put the gallery back together—one piece at a time.

name: Bleeding Nightmare | 血に染まる悪夢

details.title: Bleeding Nightmare | 血に染まる悪夢
details.short_description: Descend into the fever dreams of a traumatized young man in a first-person psychological horror game about grief, trauma, and fractured memories. Confront the horrors of your past and find a way back home from Hell. KNOCK, AND THEY WILL ANSWER.

details.title: SCP: Contain and Extract
details.short_description: A horror extraction shooter/creature collector unfolding in an overrun 1990s Site-19, built on rich SCP lore. Contain, extract and collect all the SCPs while surviving the evil that lurks throughout the site. Locate data, study ways to lure and trap, loot what you can and always be ready...

details.title: Brokie
details.short_description: You went all in with borrowed money and lost everything. Start over with $3,000 in a share house: work part-time jobs, gather clues from news, rumors and store shelves, trade 18 fictional stocks and keep your stress in check. How far can you climb in one year?

details.title: Stone Gambling Simulator
details.short_description: Start from a street stall. Pick stones, read them under a flashlight, haggle, cut, craft, and price your jade. One cut can make or break you — win it with an eye for stone and a tight ledger.

details.title: Maths Pals
details.short_description: Join six adorable animal friends on a journey to master math! From counting to multiplication, tackle fun challenges, earn stars, and watch your skills soar—all at your own pace!

name: Angelo and Deemon 2: Too Hell of a Quest

details.title: Angelo and Deemon 2: Too Hell of a Quest
details.short_description: Angelo and Deemon 2: Too Hell of a Quest is a classic point-and-click adventure packed with humor, puzzles, and unforgettable characters. It’s the sequel to Angelo and Deemon: One Hell of a Quest — and things are about to get heavenly chaotic.

details.title: Christmas VHS Store Tidy Up
details.short_description: Tidy a neon-lit ’90s VHS rental shop on a snowy Christmas night. Wipe down dirty sleeves, match each tape to its labelled slot, and unwind to Christmas lo-fi on your own or with a Steam friend.

details.title: Uncharted Lands
details.short_description: Will you be able to save shipwrecks from uncharted lands in medieval Europe? Get ready to survive, fight, explore and dominate

details.title: COLONY 2
details.short_description: Giri's search for his lost cricket ball opened a world of horror. He escaped that day but part of him never left. Eight years later, investigate the British colonial era asylum that broke him. But why does he keep coming back? What's his connection? Discover what's never meant to be discovered.

details.title: Star Claw
details.short_description: A claw-machine roguelite where you fling a cat's stretchy paw to grab treasure. Bounce off bumpers and reach each room's cash target before time runs out. Combine powerful upgrades, battle bosses, and unlock new cats and decorations between runs.

details.title: Cogwheel Quandary
details.short_description: A puzzle in pencil. Someone sketched a machine and left the meshing blank: the posts, the crank and the needle are there — which gears go where is yours to draw. Teeth decide who touches whom; the needle tells you whether you built the machine the sketch asked for.

details.title: Numpad Chef: Pizza Rush
details.short_description: Turn your numpad into a pizza kitchen. Type fast, cook faster. Master a unique number-based control system as you prepare, top, and bake pizzas under pressure in a cozy 3D farm kitchen, where every order counts and every mistake matters.

details.title: Frathouse Beerpong
details.short_description: 4 player beerpong. frathouse rules. public lobbies. proximity chat. beer(s).

details.title: Goblinfall: Defend Da Fort
details.short_description: Goblinfall: Defend Da Fort is a chaotic love letter to couch co-op games. Team up to protect the goblin fort from endless pig invasions! Manage ammo, extinguish fires, swap crystal upgrades, and survive the panic in a fantasy world!

details.title: KittenRush
details.short_description: A nonstop rush of bite-sized mini-games with an adorable pixel kitten! Run breathless and chase every trophy!

details.title: Scrapmiles
details.short_description: Explore an autumn valley in an old pickup. Collect and haul scrap, take jobs and secure your cargo. Spend your earnings on repairs, restoration and truck upgrades in an open-world driving and salvage simulator with changing weather and a day-and-night cycle.

details.title: Loot The World: Three Kings
details.short_description: An infinite procedural RPG. Explore a dangerous world, roll the dice in combat, loot everything, and hunt down the Three Kings.

name: A Game About Digging A Hole™ Together

details.title: A Game About Digging A Hole™ Together
details.short_description: A minimalist game about digging a hole at the beach, now with friends. Dig together, collect resources, sell them, upgrade your equipment and search for a promised treasure buried deep beneath the sand. Play solo or with friends (1 to 4 players), with crossplay.

details.title: INTERNET4
details.short_description: INTERNET4 lets up to 8 people control one browser together and turn the internet into a shared playground. Watch videos and livestreams, split the browser to explore the web, or draw together. Enjoy Wikipedia-based minigames or unwind with some fishing.

details.title: JIGSEUM: Assemble Jigsaws with Magic
details.short_description: JIGSEUM: Assemble Jigsaws with Magic is a single-player 3D jigsaw puzzle game set in an art museum. Collect 2,576 puzzle pieces scattered throughout the museum and complete colorful works of art. Use helpful magic skills to make puzzle-solving easier and more fun!

details.title: Tidy Up 9999 Numbers
details.short_description: Tidy Up 9999 Numbers is a first-person tidying game. Pick up golden plates numbered 1–9999 and fit them into matching slots on the wall. Solve number puzzles to earn coins, use them to get magic from a capsule toy machine, and upgrade your skills to put away all 9,999 plates!

details.title: Kitchen Tidy
details.short_description: Kitchen Tidy is a cozy organizing simulator where you sort over 2,000 kitchen items and return everything to its proper place. Enjoy the satisfying process of turning a messy kitchen into a perfectly organized space at your own pace.

details.title: REAL GO: Go Game (Baduk · Weiqi)
details.short_description: Light Go that opens straight to the board. Play Go against an AI that plays like a real person of your rank, from 20 kyu to 9 dan. Ask for advice and see live position analysis mid-game, solve 1,800+ classic tsumego, and pick from 13 boards and 39 stone sets in 3D or 2D. From beginner to pro.

details.title: Venture Pals
details.short_description: Choose your own Pal and venture out to grind skills and gather loot right from your desktop. Forge powerful gear, cook and brew invigorating meals and potions, and discover rare cosmetics. Manage energy, cleanliness, and training to grow. Or, just enjoy the company of your Pal

details.title: STARCULT Night Twisted Age
details.short_description: ...Everyone suspects you of murder. Become the Villainess everyone thinks you are. Create or join a cult. Manipulate people using the Emotion Palette. Enjoy power and peaceful moments... until bigger problems arise.

details.title: Trading Kingdom
details.short_description: Embark on a journey from a humble farmer to a powerful merchant in 15th century Venice. Compete against rival traders, expand your influence, and build your Trading Kingdom in a land where wealth is power.

details.title: Murder Sudoku: The Brinkhaven Cases
details.short_description: Place suspects instead of numbers. Use Sudoku-style logic, question witnesses and connect evidence as rookie officer Noor. Solve ten linked chapters and uncover the secrets of Brinkhaven, one deduction at a time.

details.title: Coloratis
details.short_description: Enjoy three color-themed puzzles! Connect and clear blocks in ColorDrop, draw a single path while changing colors in InkPath, and roll a die to paint the board in ColorDice. Plan what to clear, which route to take, and how to orient each face. Discover three different ways to put your mind to work!

details.title: Scourge Realms
details.short_description: Slay monsters in evil realms inflicted with scourge. Find Majestic Loot, Collect powerful enchanting materials and xp to survive the scourge and obtain god-like power.

details.title: Gemheart Valley
details.short_description: Grow crystals instead of crops. Crack geodes with the most satisfying tap in cozy games, fill a museum with one-of-a-kind gems, befriend a mountain village (and one very determined rival), and bring a sleeping valley back to life, season by season.

details.title: Heidi's Legacy: Mountains Calling
details.short_description: Heidi's Legacy is a cozy narrative sim where you care for goats, craft mountain goods, and help villagers rebuild their lives. Experience a peaceful pastoral life, inspired by the Heidi novels, celebrating nature, healing, community, and self-discovery.

details.title: Yukinite Depths
details.short_description: Send a team of autonomous goblin miners deep underground in search of the legendary Yukinite crystal in this relaxing pixel-art incremental strategy game with idle elements. Discover rare resources, unlock powerful upgrades, expand your mine, and face whatever is waiting below.

details.title: Football Story
details.short_description: Football Story is a cozy football RPG and life sim about growing up, friendship, and a dream. Develop your skills, explore the town of Lumen Bay, help its residents, and build your own street football team. Rise from your first neighborhood matches to victory over the pros!

details.title: 9 Layers of Hell
details.short_description: Carve through thousands of demons on your way down the nine layers of Hell. Combine your own spells, chase legendaries that rewrite your build and craft the perfect gear between waves. A horde survivor with the loot of an action RPG. How deep can you and your party go?

details.title: SiegeLine
details.short_description: SiegeLine is a four-way fantasy strategy battle. Your barracks send waves at your neighbors on their own. You decide where the gold goes: income, upgrades, heroes and base spells. No unit control: every choice is about timing. Inspired by the classic Survival Chaos custom map.

details.title: Hot Machine
details.short_description: Fill a felt table with hopping slot machines, hire Regulars to pull the levers, and climb from one penny slot to the Moon. Every pull costs money. Go broke, borrow from the Shark, or declare bankruptcy and walk back in with Ruin Chips.

details.title: Terminal Drift
details.short_description: Hold down the cargo bay! In Terminal Drift, automated defense systems handle the trigger, but survival is entirely in your hands. Adapt your load-out and survive 20 relentless waves, because when the Matriarch breaches the hull, firepower alone won’t save you.

details.title: BoxParty!
details.short_description: BoxParty brings multiple online party games together in one platform. Join friends or strangers, jump into quick matches, bluff, guess, trick your opponents, and discover reimagined game modes with events, jokers, and advanced rules.

details.title: GOAL2D
details.short_description: Three-minute top-down football where every shot, pass, and dribble is yours to control. Time-charged shots, beat defenders with skill moves, and call team tactics in 3v3 to 5v5 PvP or co-op. Climb six ranked leagues or play a career from amateur to national team. Try the free demo.

name: Caracol - Wars of Religion in the 17th Century

details.title: Caracol - Wars of Religion in the 17th Century
details.short_description: Simultaneous turn-based strategy (WeGo) set in the age of the Wars of Religion and pike-and-shot warfare.

details.title: Ocean Cargo Manager
details.short_description: A classic maritime business simulation about cargo ships, ports, commodity trading, and route planning. Build your shipping company, navigate markets inspired by real-world trade structures, and make long-term management decisions.

details.title: Lost Bitcoin
details.short_description: Lost Bitcoin is a digging and automation game set in a gigantic junkyard. Collect scrap, burn it for coins, buy upgrades and build a factory that works for you. Crack crates and safes, and check every USB stick to find your lost Bitcoin wallet.

details.title: Hook & Loot
details.short_description: Hook & Loot is a relaxing single-player magnet fishing game. Clear an autumn lake of 1,458 metal objects. Haul in scrap and rare finds, bring your catches to the scrapyard, and upgrade your gear.

name: Trash to Trees: Tidy up the forest!

details.title: Trash to Trees: Tidy up the forest!
details.short_description: Clean up, sort, recycle, and restore the forest in this cozy tidy-up simulator with over 10,000 trash items. Unlock abilities to improve your efficiency. Enjoy the satisfying experience of bringing the forest back to life at your own pace, alone or with friends.

details.title: Rogoz Fishing
details.short_description: A meditative fishing sim with deeply detailed fish behavior and habitats. Pick your spot on the depth map, choose how you fish — spinning, float or feeder — and land your trophies!

details.title: My Own Hero Party
details.short_description: My Own Hero Party is an incremental idle game. Build your own band of heroes, venture deep into dungeons and gather mountains of gold! Invest your earnings in a permanent talent tree, grow stronger with every expedition and fight your way to the boss.

details.title: Merry Nightmares
details.short_description: Merry Nightmares is a horror anthology featuring three chilling stories, all united by one theme: Christmas.

details.title: NOSTRIL ROYALE
details.short_description: You're a booger, and your life is hanging by a snot! Battle your friends in a chaotic multiplayer showdown inside a giant nose. Push, betray, dodge the finger, and try not to get picked first! Because here, it's not the strongest who survive - it's the slimiest.

details.title: FIND KITTENS 12: Cave Town
details.short_description: Light your lantern, traveler, for a journey into the depths of the earth awaits you! What are you waiting for?! Explore and find cute cats to fill this black-and-white world with different colors.

details.title: Hopperstride
details.short_description: Hopperstride is an endless 2D platformer where you jump, collect coins, dodge enemies and compete for the best score — solo or with friends in online multiplayer.

details.title: Chunk DAW
details.short_description: Build music out of blocks! Place, pitch, and sequence sounds in a 3D world, solo or with friends in real time. Jam over built-in voice chat, shape terrain and scenery around your songs, then publish your creations for the world to browse, remix, and play.

details.title: OVERCLOCK: Neon Survival Protocol
details.short_description: A top-down neon roguelite. Survive hordes for six minutes, pick 1 of 3 upgrades on every level-up, trigger Overdrive and bring down the Overseer Prime. Credits buy permanent upgrades and new cores.

details.title: Desperate City
details.short_description: The primary objective involves entering a battlefield where a toxic zone continuously shrinks, forcing you to contend with over a hundred other enemies—you must evade them and attempt to eliminate everyone else to secure victory.

details.title: It's Not a Bomb
details.short_description: Throw explosives, dodge chaos, and blow your friends sky-high in this frantic multiplayer party game! Battle across explosive arenas, unleash crazy power-ups, and prove who's the master of mayhem in modes like Battle Royale, Capture the Flag, Demolition, and Team Battles!

details.title: Dead Week
details.short_description: High schooler by day, Reaper by night! Deb hunts what hides in the dark and Marrowgate is full of it. Juggle classes and friends, fight demons and undead in this story-driven turn-based tactical RPG. Early Access opens with "Act One: Monsters and Coffee Runs", and 15 hours of gameplay!

details.title: Firebase
details.short_description: This is a First Person Shooter, "tower defense" style game that captures the intensity of the Tet Offensive. Offering unique game mechanics iconic of the Vietnam War, such as calling in Napalm strikes and M16 jamming. Firebase immerses you in the mud and grit of combat in South East Asia.

details.title: Cult Crasher
details.short_description: Twenty years ago, Val Thorne's family was taken from her by a sinister cult. Now armed with nothing but her dad's old pistol and a fresh bottle of whiskey, she's vowed to get her revenge...

details.title: Shunt & Haul: Rail Logistics
details.short_description: Shunt & Haul: Rail Logistics is a railway game focused on shunting, freight transport, and logistics work on the tracks. Take on the role of a train driver and railway operator, operate locomotives, assemble trains, transport freight wagons, and complete tasks on sidings, stations, and railway lines

name: Sort the Red Pandas: Tidy Up & Shelve

details.title: Sort the Red Pandas: Tidy Up & Shelve
details.short_description: Sort the Red Pandas: Tidy Up & Shelve is a single-player cozy organizing simulator where you sort 5,140 cute red pandas onto the correct shelves. Earn money, unlock powerful sorting abilities, and enjoy the satisfying transformation of a messy store from complete chaos into perfect order.

details.title: Tidy Teddy
details.short_description: Tidy Teddy is a cozy organizing game where you restock an animal-themed plushie shop. Bring the store back to its former glory by sorting thousands of animal plushies by species and color at your own pace.

details.title: Split Happens
details.short_description: Manage an old, rundown nuclear power plant with up to 5 friends in online co-op. Fix hazards before you put the reactor in critical condition, manage the chaos to avoid a meltdown, and try not to get in the way of your coworkers.

details.title: Death and Tactics
details.short_description: A post-apocalyptic turn-based strategy game where death is permanent and every decision counts. Experience unique events based on how you play, sell the organs of party members you don't like, transform your enemies into monsters, and much, much more!

details.title: Spectral Surplus
details.short_description: Run your own thrift shop and catch the ghosts haunting your stock. Pull in secondhand finds through an experimental receiver, set your prices, and serve customers. Upgrade your equipment, expand your shop, and use captured spirits to bring in better stock.

details.title: SlotsNStocks
details.short_description: Rig the market in this deckbuilding slot machine roguelite. Draft hundreds of bullish and bearish symbols, build money-making combinations, and manipulate the odds in your favor. Adapt to an ever-shifting market and make enough to survive your next margin call.

details.title: Stack Inspector
details.short_description: Stack objects in first person, defy gravity, and become the ultimate inspector at OddFrame Industries. Every piece matters, every mistake has a price, and every collapsing tower is the perfect excuse to try again.

details.title: Sneak & Snitch
details.short_description: Sneak & Snitch is a multiplayer social deduction heist. Thieves disguised as museum visitors forge paintings and swap them right under the guard's nose. The guard patrols on a Segway, spotting fakes and suspicious moves. Blend in, bluff your friends, and pull off the perfect art heist.

details.title: Signal Corruption
details.short_description: Pilot one of four experimental ships in Signal Corruption, a retro pixel art side-scrolling shoot 'em up. Battle enemy waves, face powerful bosses, complete challenging missions, and upgrade your ship to fight back against the spreading corruption!

details.title: Die Rich
details.short_description: Fight to clear the emperor’s debt in Die Rich, a gladiator action roguelite for solo play or online co-op with up to four players. Cut through swarms, draft weapon upgrades and win the crowd. Conquer four arenas, explore the Wilds and claim seals on your path to freedom.

details.title: Moorhouse
details.short_description: First-person horror for up to four players on a remote farm in the moors of northern Germany. Work together as survivors or play as the Moorfrau. Repair three pumps, drain the moor and burn her heart before the fifth night ends.

name: Dynasty Divided: A Three Kingdoms Saga

details.title: Dynasty Divided: A Three Kingdoms Saga
details.short_description: Unite a shattered Han China in 190, 194, 200 or 208 AD. Govern cities, raise spearmen, swordsmen, archers, cavalry and catapults, court allies and betray them. Every officer has a face, a history and a grudge. Turn-based grand strategy with tactical hex battles. Single player, no microtransactions.

details.title: SEE YOU ON THE ROOF
details.short_description: August 31. The lift is broken again, and your friends are on the roof waiting for the last sunset of summer. Tonight your neighbours are out on the landings, and each of them has something to say to you. Hurry. The sun won't wait.

details.title: Video Game Store: Tidy Up
details.short_description: Sort 3,000 scattered pieces in a cozy retro video game store. Clean discs and manuals, rebuild 1,000 games and stock the shelves. Serve customers, pack orders, unlock helpful upgrades and hire staff to turn complete chaos into a thriving shop.

details.title: Lets Bail
details.short_description: A relaxing first-person cleanup game, one bucket at a time. Scoop, carry and pour your way through flooded locations, upgrade your bucket, enlist a helpful drone and return each location to their former glory, with floating ducks for company.

details.title: Tank Them All
details.short_description: The ultimate tank party game! 2–6 players blast each other in quick one-hit rounds — on one screen, online or via Remote Play Together. Grab 16 wild power-ups, survive spike traps, tornadoes and air raids across 90+ arenas and 4 modes. Bots fill every empty seat.

details.title: Group Idlemen
details.short_description: Train Skills to 99, take on key bosses for RARE LOOT, Raids, & Expeditions. Control all 5 people in your group and climb the leaderboards!

details.title: Sigildeep
details.short_description: A deckbuilding dungeon crawler where every card is a spell on the front and a piece of the dungeon on the back. Lay cards down to build the way forward, fight with what you didn't spend, win packs and build better decks.

details.title: Apprentice Mage Gale
details.short_description: Apprentice Mage Gale is an Autobattler RPG where your entire party depends on you. You are their ONLY damage dealer, so master 16 spells, build your mage through 100+ skill nodes, overcome monsters and bosses, and fight across eight lands on the road to the Demon Lord.

details.title: Fish on the Floor
details.short_description: Rescue sea creatures from chaotic floors in a first-person cleanup game. Explore the seafood market and aquarium, toss creatures into matching tanks, and unlock upgrades.

details.title: University Architect
details.short_description: University Architect is a management game where you build and run your own university. Build the campus, design the courses, manage the professors, and decide whether to prioritize profits or your reputation.

details.title: Check Please!
details.short_description: Run chaotic restaurants in this fantasy medieval realm! Seat demanding magical creatures with your Demon Chef and serve over 100 unique dishes as you upgrade your taverns all across the kingdom! As the only human trapped in this fantasy medieval realm, your only way back to Earth is to wait tables.

details.title: Secret Shelf: Collectible Shop Simulator
details.short_description: Run a blind box figure shop: stock the shelves, set your prices, serve the queue. Then open a box from your own stock and cross your fingers for the secret. 290 figures, 32 series, a game hall across the street and up to 4 players in co-op.

details.title: Handwalk
details.short_description: Handwalk is a difficult physics-based rage game where you control each hand separately to climb a mountain on your hands.

details.title: King's Haven
details.short_description: A combo-driven roguelike, where every Citizen is a card in your deck. Draft a Knight, Vampire, Rat King, Chef or over 100 other unique Citizens to chain together powerful synergies. Construct landmarks, survive seasonal threats and defend your Haven in this quirky roguelike deckbuilder.

details.title: North Pole Workshop
details.short_description: Explore the magical North Pole Workshop in this festive co-op toy-making game for 1-4 players. Team up with your merry elves and lightly strategize how to complete various toy recipes. Craft, wrap, and deliver toys to Santa's sleigh for all the good boys and girls!

details.title: Scrappy Craft
details.short_description: A shop keeper game where you run a small forge. Scavenge trash and combine it to craft over 10,000 absurd weapons like banana swords or frisbee shields, buy upgrades, unlock new recipes, and sell your bizarre creations to quirky customers like tie-wearing otters or spaghetti monsters.

details.title: Planet No More
details.short_description: An arcade-incremental game where you DESTROY planets! Build a fleet, upgrade weapons, max out your skill tree and destroy your target slowly. You'll advance deep into the galaxy, strategically shattering planets to their cores to unlock the next celestial.

details.title: AetherCycle
details.short_description: AetherCycle is a first-person action RPG featuring fast-paced combat, character leveling, abilities, and loot-driven gear progression. Explore a vast world, conquer dungeons, and grow stronger solo or in co-op as the Cycle affects the world.

details.title: Horde of Distraction
details.short_description: An incremental game inspired by classic RPGs. Fight monsters, collect rare gear, progress through a vast skill tree, and defeat powerful bosses!

details.title: Dirt Town
details.short_description: Use incredible physics to create roads by pushing dirt, felling trees, moving rocks, hauling gravel. Dig a pit for resources, build a race track for the dirt bike! Get paid and buy more machines. Multiplayer for up to four players

details.title: Become an AI Company Boss
details.short_description: Run an AI company in the wildest race in tech. Survive a congressional grilling, chase your own runaway robot through Chinatown, smuggle chips under frozen fish, outfly helicopters in a flying sports car and ship three thousand robots to Mars. Every choice rewrites the ending.

details.title: ASCII Realms
details.short_description: A free-to-play online fantasy RPG drawn entirely in ASCII. Explore on horseback, battle monsters with real-time spells and steel, collect loot, and upgrade your equipment at the forge. Develop your character in a shared world.

details.title: Christmas Lot Simulator
details.short_description: Run your own Christmas tree lot in a snowy Montana town. Sell every tree, cut it fresh, net it and strap it to the car. Take on a new job each day, hire a crew, grow from a corner lot to a second lot across town, keep Santa happy and make it to Christmas Eve.

details.title: REFLEJASTES
details.short_description: Enter a futuristic world of light and logic in REFLEJASTES! Rotate mirrors, split beams and manipulate moving crystals to guide light toward its targets. Master 100 increasingly challenging puzzles, discover new mechanics, collect stars and unlock achievements. Can you solve them all?

details.title: Магический мир Константина Кадавра
details.short_description: Enter Konstantin Kadavr's absurd magical world through a refrigerator in the woods. Ask a video fortune orb, click for coins, catch flying bonuses, and test your patience to earn red chairs. The game is available in Russian only.

details.title: Bear in Super Action Adventure
details.short_description: A side-scrolling shoot 'em up game with an upgrade shop. Fly a bear with a jetpack through swarms of bees and flying eggs, dodge their bullets, grab the gold they drop and unleash Power Shot and Blast when it gets crowded. Then upgrade and go after the green rabbit who is behind it all.

details.title: Pirate Royalty
details.short_description: A free to play fantasy pirate MMORPG where you choose one of four classes, assign your own stats, learn skills, hunt rare loot, forge gems into gear and enter timed dungeons with other players. Every advantage is earned through play, with no power for sale.

details.title: Legacy: The Card Game
details.short_description: A free 1v1 card game with a twist: both players summon Foes onto one shared field, which either of you can kill for Legacy points. It's your Legend versus theirs to see who can leave behind the greatest Legacy. Use strategy to play cards that help you, hurt them, or add some chaos to the mix.

details.title: Town of Tinysville
details.short_description: Town of Tinysville is a deck building roguelike set on tiny maps with huge stakes. Strategically place buildings, grow your deck, and master powerful synergies. Enhance your run using unique chance cards, landmarks, and powerful laws that permanently affect your town.

details.title: Lunar Mining
details.short_description: Mine, melt, upgrade, repeat. Lunar Mining is a fast, casual incremental game built around tense 15-second mining runs. Smash lunar ore, smelt it into bars, and upgrade your drill between runs. Explore three biomes, battle bosses for rare artifacts, and chase Legendary ores across the Moon.

details.title: SnatchDeck
details.short_description: Steal, Adapt, Survive! SnatchDeck is a fast-paced and addicting card game that can be played both casually and strategically. Build a powerful deck on the fly by stealing cards from your opponents mid-round. You'll have to adapt your strategy round by round to avoid death.

details.title: Mythical Whalers
details.short_description: Set sail in the shrouded seas. A procedurally generated world where each voyage is unique. Captain a crew of mythical races to face monstrous leviathans and gain status with cunning factions.

details.title: A Tidy Konbini
details.short_description: Let's Tidy Up! Konbini is a cozy organizing simulator where you need to return over 1000 scattered products their proper place in a Japanese convenience store. No Skills, no time limits. Just a relaxing tidy up experience.

details.title: Pink Light
details.short_description: In this action RPG, play as a devoted Sister cursed by a demon and stripped of healing magic. Fight through a deadly dungeon with fast-paced sword combat, various gear choices, and relentless traps. Uncover dark secrets before Yarashina City falls.

details.title: Moonlight Cornelia
details.short_description: Akane Riho’s peaceful student life changes when she awakens as the magical girl Moonlight Cornelia. Switch between school exploration and real-time combo battles, customize skills and crests, bond with companions, and stop the Demon Queen’s revival.

details.title: Urban Echoes
details.short_description: Urban Echoes is a relaxing skateboarding game demo with stylish retro graphics that encourages exploration, individuality, and self-discovery.

details.title: Quality Control
details.short_description: Quality Control is 4–8 player party game where customizable robots compete in chaotic factory minigames, asymmetric challenges, and sudden-death showdowns.

details.title: My Otaku Girlfriend
details.short_description: Yuuichi’s anime club has finally joined the doujin event “Comiko.” To celebrate, the members hold a party. Yuuichi plans to confess his feelings to Maki, but when the “King’s Game” begins, the night takes a dark turn. Kaito, a newcomer, seems to have a hidden agenda, putting Maki in danger...

details.title: The Legend of Pepino
details.short_description: Level up your character, battle hordes of monsters, earn money to unlock items and spells for your class, and face powerful bosses along the way.

details.title: Final Remedy
details.short_description: You wake up in an unfamiliar, snowy place. You don't know how you got there or who you are. Solve the mystery, avoid or defeat enemies, and escape... An atmospheric, story-rich, post-apocalyptic walking simulator with puzzle elements and crafting mechanics

details.title: Nuria's Redemption
details.short_description: How many waves of rabid babies could you survive? Join your friends in Nuria's Redemption, a frantic co-op and PvP shooter. Choose from 4 classes, level up in combat, and defend your base from random events. Save the timeline!

details.title: Stock Den
details.short_description: Taipei, 1994. A stock den hides behind a corner store. Stocks × multiplayer × sabotage: phone in orders and race everyone to the same stock, up to 9 with friends or solo vs. AI. Jealous of their gains? Cut their line, spread fake news, bribe a pundit, drag them down!

details.title: ONE MILLION CUBES
details.short_description: A first-person arena shooter against one million cubes. They pour out of the sky, flock round you and build weapons out of themselves. One touch and you are dead. Every cube you break can be turned into upgrades on a skill cube for future runs. The goal is to break all one million cubes in one run.

details.title: Oomi’s Nook
details.short_description: Oomi’s Nook is a cozy and relaxing sticker decor game. Decorate a little room with hand-drawn style stickers according to the drawing or unleash your creativity! Follow the lighthearted everyday life of the adorable Oomi family and watch them live leisurely in the world you create!

details.title: THE WOLF OF TENGRI
details.short_description: A cinematic third-person Action RPG inspired by ancient Turkic mythology. Explore a vast semi-open world, master intense melee combat, uncover forgotten temples, battle mythical spirits, and become the legend who restores the balance.

details.title: Goblin Must Clean
details.short_description: An incremental cleaning game in first person. You are a goblin with one plate in your hands and a mountain of 500,000 to go. Wash them for Gold and spend the Gold at the hearth, until magic does the dishes for you.

details.title: RIGGED2EXPLODE
details.short_description: A tactical shooter where running out of bullets sets off a bomb strapped to your chest. Sneak through levels, take out enemies, and use the environment to your gain the advantage. Take your time and make every bullet count.

details.title: Crimson Banner: War of Liberation
details.short_description: Command the Chinese People's Liberation Army in Crimson Banner: War of Liberation. Fight through the campaigns of the Chinese Civil War in a turn-based wargame played on a hex grid.

details.title: Strawberry Flavor Sci-Fi
details.short_description: Like strawberries? If they went extinct, how would we find their taste again? This fundamentalist suspense & sci-fi visual novel lets you step into the shoes of an Ocular to unravel a series of conspiracies woven from tech ethics and human nature in a near-future world that could arrive anytime.

details.title: Revive! Onsen Town!
details.short_description: Revive! Onsen Town! is a cozy life simulation set in the Japanese countryside. Play as a girl on summer vacation or the mayor revitalizing the village. Catch bugs, fish, work part-time, cook, and help locals. Shape the town with your choices and bring this quiet hot spring town back to life.

details.title: Idle Puzzler
details.short_description: Puzzle shops don't run themselves. Yours will, eventually. Solve Sudoku, word locks and colour codes, hire staff who keep solving while you're away, and watch a market stall grow into something much bigger.

details.title: The Comyths
details.short_description: The Comyths is an action arcade and visual novel hybrid starring six Scholars with unique cosmic powers. Uncover their intertwined story, master their abilities, and chase the perfect S-Rank.

details.title: Become a Real Estate Tycoon
details.short_description: Buy property, collect rent, and negotiate with 20 anime-style female rivals. Grow your business across three towns, balance cash flow and fixed-rate loans, and climb the net worth rankings as property prices change every day.

details.title: Spot the Pet!
details.short_description: Find all 600 adorable pets 🐱🐶🐥🐰🐸🐷 hidden in two hand-drawn locations! Can you spot every one? 🔍

details.title: Dear Astronauts
details.short_description: You and up to three friends crew the world's worst space-tourism rocket. Launch it, fly it, feed the tourists, fix what breaks, go outside when you have to, and try to land with most of them still on board. Online co-op for 1-4 players.

details.title: Team Buddies
details.short_description: A fast-paced action and strategy game where you build teams, craft weapons, and destroy enemy bases in intense online and campaign battles.

details.title: First Bag
details.short_description: You are an invisible robber who steals valuables from the map, while the others — the police — hunt you down to catch you. But you're only invisible while standing still. Move, and you can be seen. Steal money and valuables, furnish your home and level up your skills.

details.title: FINAL CUT
details.short_description: A text-based horror interactive fiction about a cursed grindhouse actress returning to the studio lot that ruined her. Make choices through seven genre-bending wings, survive the damage, resist the corruption, and chase one of eight endings.

details.title: Riders Of The Nine Planes
details.short_description: A mounted cavalier rogue-like across the Multiverse. Charge at enemies with your stored potential energy from galloping in a straight line, but beware; you are vulnerable once stationary after charging! Later develops into a strategy game in the late stages as you rise in power and control areas.

details.title: Seek Shellter
details.short_description: Seek Shellter is an arcade-style pathfinder full of cute snails who must collect batteries and seek shelter before the timer runs out. Team up with a friend or go solo to clear levels, win minigames and unlock worlds steeped in retro-60s atomic charm. Do you have what it takes to beat the bomb?

name: Ancient Moves: Royal Game of Ur

details.title: Ancient Moves: Royal Game of Ur
details.short_description: Race seven pieces across ancient Mesopotamia in this classic game of dice and strategy. Capture rival pieces, claim safe rosettes, and time your moves to reach the finish. Challenge four AI difficulty levels or play a friend locally.

details.title: Idle Cultivator: Ascend Together
details.short_description: Idle Cultivator is a multiplayer idle loot RPG set in a world of Chinese fantasy. Auto-battle beasts and bosses, collect and upgrade gear, and grow stronger. Adventure solo or team up online with up to three friends to take on tougher challenges!

details.title: Little Kingdom Xiangqi
details.short_description: Xiangqi (Chinese Chess) with adorable characters! Learn the rules, battle an AI from beginner to master, solve 200 puzzles and dress up your pieces in 11 outfits (5 included, 6 in the Outfit Pack DLC). Offline, no ads.

details.title: Seperated!
details.short_description: You and your friends have been given a mission to retrieve a giant golden apple from the planet's World Tree! You must climb structures and dodge obstacles to reach the golden apple!

details.title: Dadi Kingdom
details.short_description: Action RPG: You're the king. Everyone wants something from you, and you've got a sword. Every morning you judge your people: release, gold fine or dungeon? Then you walk out the gate yourself and fight bandits, skeletons and worse. Father an heir before your time runs out.

details.title: Desktop Forge
details.short_description: A tiny forge in the corner of your desktop. Quirky smiths gather materials and hammer out blades on their own. Hand one to a passing adventurer, or deliver it to a nation at war — your blade decides whether they live, calms the monster dens, and can change who rules a town.

details.title: Ragdoll Ranch
details.short_description: Raise chickens, rabbits, pigs, and cows on the most chaotic ranch you’ve ever seen. Expand your operation solo or bring a friend in this challenging FPS farming simulator.

details.title: Retro Game Collector Simulator
details.short_description: Unbox second-hand game lots, sort your shelves, and bring old consoles back to life. Collect around 300 games across 17 fictional retro systems, connect them to a CRT, play built-in minigames, and turn a cluttered basement into your own collection.

details.title: The Edutainment Vortex Diner
details.short_description: It's time to make learning fun, with sandwiches and smalltalk at the Edutainment Vortex Diner, in retro PC game style! Meet ageless and immortal teachers. Get good grades or embrace your inner bratty problem child! Be not afraid. Let's inherit a terrible burden together. The vortex beckons...

details.title: Rope Untangle
details.short_description: Untangle colorful ropes, one move at a time! Drag the rope ends to free every strand. Simple controls meet clever puzzles: observe, plan, and enjoy the satisfaction of turning a tangled mess into order.

details.title: Sushi On Wheels
details.short_description: Sushi On Wheels is a cozy management game where you run your dream sushi truck business in a Japanese setting inspired by the real life Izu Peninsula. Prep ingredients, customize your truck, and serve handmade sushi to hungry locals as you travel around Japan and complete your grandmother’s dream!

details.title: Pantheon
details.short_description: A visual novel about a college graduate searching for a job, finding a way out at rock bottom, and rekindling hope.

details.title: Death by Taxes
details.short_description: A satirical incremental clicker about a billionaire facing the one thing money can’t fix: taxes. Spend every last dollar on increasingly stupid purchases before the bill kills you.

details.title: Dogfight Era: Origins
details.short_description: Wake up, Pilot! The war has just begun, and the enemy rules the skies. It's time to take the fight to them! Choose from 15 aircraft from the World War I era and soar above famous battlefields. Do you have what it takes to turn the tide of war?

details.title: The Regreening
details.short_description: Restore a deserted world in a cozy soilpunk simulation. Grow plants, rebuild wildlife habitats, and revive entire ecosystems. Upcycle abandoned junk into tools and decorations, befriend ancient nature spirits, and hug ALL the animals as you transform a forgotten world into a thriving paradise.

details.title: OverWorked: Santa's Workshop
details.short_description: Build, automate and expand Santa's workshop in a chaotic 1–4 player Christmas factory builder. Construct production lines, manage your elves and manufacture BILLIONS of presents to meet an impossible Christmas quota. Keep the elves happy, or start hiring replacements.

details.title: 牛马的涌现
details.short_description: A lightweight idle management game that lives along the bottom of your desktop. Hire quirky workers, pair them up to discover new offspring, collect breeds, traits and coats, decorate the office, and expand your company while you work.

details.title: Fary-Clary!
details.short_description: A brand-new arcade maze game imagined as a lost release from 1983. Guide Fary-Clary through Clee-Claa Forest, recover the scattered nectar, avoid the relentless Glaries, and chase the highest score!

details.title: The Cardian - Light the Shrines
details.short_description: The Cardian is a tactical roguelike deckbuilding card-defense game where positioning is everything. Predict enemy movements, plan your path, and set your cards in advance. See the future, outsmart the swarm, and defend the last Shrines of Light!

details.title: Roll N' Rage
details.short_description: A difficult physics-based platforming game about a golf ball's journey home. Roll, fall, rage, repeat... or quit. It's up to you.

details.title: Tidy Up the Cars Together
details.short_description: Rebuild 15 classic cars in a cozy first-person workshop, solo or in online co-op. Hammer rusty frames back into shape, hunt down 1,830 scattered parts and carry each one to the car it belongs to. Take your time. That last missing door is in here somewhere.

details.title: Muri: Wildwoods
details.short_description: Play as Pelle, a curious cleaner muri tasked with restoring an island back to life! Explore mysterious ruins, clean away corruption, befriend cute critters, collect sketches, and save the Wildwood’s forest spirit in this cozy cleaning-sim adventure!

details.title: TROLLHEIM: GNOMES
details.short_description: Explore an ancient, living forest as a tiny gnome in this co-op PVE survival crafting adventure inspired by Nordic folklore. Gather, craft and build a home for your gnome family amongst the treetops, and encounter the Väsen, mythical beings both friendly and dangerous. Play solo or up to 8 players

details.title: NEONOVA Puzzle: Pink
details.short_description: NEONOVA Puzzle: Pink is a relaxing anime jigsaw puzzle game blending Valentine-inspired cyberpunk, glowing pink neon art, and futuristic anime girls. Assemble 50 atmospheric picture puzzles, unlock vibrant illustrations, and unwind to soothing electronic music.

details.title: Satu GANG!
details.short_description: A 2D pixel-art fighting game with Indonesian neighborhood chaos. Pick one of four fighters, chain combos, and unleash cinematic supers. Play character stories, local 1 vs 1, Survival, and Training. In-game text is Indonesian.

details.title: Bee Space
details.short_description: Plant flowers and deploy tech from orbit in this roguelike deckbuilder! Terraform tiny hex grid islands as advanced space Bees. Contend with fickle weather, strange creatures, mysterious artifacts and meddling bosses as you reclaim Earth for all Bee-Kind!

details.title: Cozy Holiday 2
details.short_description: Cozy Holiday 2 is a chaotic party game for up to 10 players in a snowy town. Race cars, plow snow, deliver food, and slow rivals down with snowballs, shovels, or your bumper. Earn cash first, buy the Christmas tree, and survive the ambush before someone steals the win!

details.title: Desktop Drill
details.short_description: Every keypress fires up your drill! Desktop Drill turns your typing into a mining adventure that lives on your desktop. Blast through blocks, unearth rare resources, and unlock new drill parts as you dig deeper with every key you press.

details.title: Artificial Intrusion
details.short_description: A retro CRT tower defense where rogue AI pixels attack the internet. Place firewalls, CAPTCHAs and traps to survive 20 waves across 10 network nodes, then spend Packets on a huge radial skill tree to harden the web for the next run.

details.title: Compost Apocalypse Survivors
details.short_description: Survive the hordes and defeat the bosses in steam(ed)punk bullet heaven where the vegetables bite back. Wield ridiculous weapons, upgrade and evolve, and mulch monstrous bosses solo or in 2-player online or couch co-op. Gather Scrap, grow stronger, and fight your way up the compost heap.

details.title: NPC Simulator
details.short_description: NPC SIMULATOR is a game where you can finally become that boring NPC! No swords or spells. Your job is to give out quests, fix crooked textures, and do whatever it takes to keep players from reporting bugs. Hang in there!

details.title: Catacomb
details.short_description: Catacomb is a hardcore, melee-focused FPS roguelike inspired by the greats of the early 2000's. Using only your wits, your blade, and over 40 unique artifacts, hack and slash your way back to the surface and earn your freedom.

details.title: BetterAtGambling
details.short_description: Think you're the best gambler in your friend group? Prove it. Hit the tables, survive the minigames, and if luck runs out, just take the chips from whoever's in the lead. In the end, only one of you is better at gambling.

details.title: Psst!
details.short_description: Sit down with friends, give a few hints, and try not to give your secret away. In this party game, close guesses earn you points, but an exact answer knocks you out. Play as cats across five word-game modes, online with friends or solo with bots.

details.title: Tavern: Tidy Up
details.short_description: Warm, handcrafted-looking environments with a medieval atmosphere Barrels, bread, goblets, meat, pots, and many other diverse items Relaxing room-to-room gameplay An inn that expands and unlocks new areas as you clean Character upgrades Pressure-free and stress-free gaming experience

details.title: RETROPULSE Valentine
details.short_description: RETROPULSE Valentine is a relaxing neon puzzle game with romantic retrowave and retro-anime art. Connect matching colored dots with glowing lines, fill the grid, and reveal Valentine’s Day illustrations across 50 levels. Enjoy warm pink and red tones and atmospheric electronic music.

details.title: Meat Safari
details.short_description: Meat Safari is a multiplayer open-world restaurant simulator! Hunt ingredients, cook meat, stack cargo, and race across Meat World solo or in 4-player online co-op. Choose your driver and vehicle, and get out on the safarI!

details.title: Staircase 8
details.short_description: Find your way out of a repeating Victorian stairwell. Look for anything unusual, keep going if everything seems normal, and turn back if you spot an anomaly. A first-person anomaly-spotting game where one wrong choice sends you back to the start.

details.title: Abductables
details.short_description: An incremental roguelite in a vintage sci-fi comic. Pilot a flying saucer, beam up whole crowds of farmers, cows, cops and soldiers, stack them for huge combo payouts, and bank permanent upgrades before the army fills the sky. Every run sends a stronger saucer back to Earth.

details.title: Cardoom
details.short_description: Cardoom is a roguelite deckbuilder where you start with a basic deck. You collect new cards and items that affect your gameplay as you go.

details.title: Unharvest
details.short_description: Drain the life from everything around you in this reverse-farming incremental game. Infect all that grows, upgrade your plagues, and wither the world until nothing living remains.

details.title: Desktop Fighter
details.short_description: Turn your desktop into an idle RPG! Your stickman fights while you work, collecting chests and rare loot. Merge 9 identical items into stronger gear, choose from 4 specializations, and hunt for items eligible for the Steam Community Market.

details.title: Retro Football
details.short_description: Retro Fútbol is a football management game inspired by the classics of the 1990s. Manage your squad, transfers, tactics, stadium, and finances, and lead your club to the top season after season.

details.title: FFS: Football Freekick Simulator
details.short_description: This is a simple free-kick game in which you kick the ball by literally choosing the contact point, power, and direction between the foot and the ball. There are no hidden stats that magically assist the trajectory for you, so it's actually your skill that matters!

details.title: FrostBite
details.short_description: You buy your grandfathers house again after he died, but that was the biggest mistake you ever made. You listen to the tape the previous owner left behind and find the secrets of this old looking cabin.

details.title: Dig The World
details.short_description: There's a message buried beneath the Earth, and it was written for you. Dig through 10 regions in this incremental mining game: upgrade your laser, hire a crew, and uncover it cube by cube. Who left it there?

details.title: Rowan Needs Shinies!
