Wire the circuit, switch on, find out why it won't run: every current is computed, every fault has a cause.

name: Scary Land: The Potion Goes Wrong

details.title: Scary Land: The Potion Goes Wrong
details.short_description: Grandpa’s potion went horribly wrong, animals act like humans, and humans became animals. Explore the cursed island, gather ingredients for a cure, and bring Bonky, a skeleton who thinks you’re his dad.

details.title: Dendron 64
details.short_description: With the help of a custom emulator, a lost 90s puzzle platformer game has finally been restored. Explore the secrets of the dam, find out what happened to your friends, and save the valley from the monster lying in its depths.

details.title: EMPTYLAND
details.short_description: EMPTY LAND is a cinematic single-player survival horror game featuring atmospheric exploration, psychological horror, mystery, puzzles, and survival gameplay. The full game will contain additional levels, locations, story content, enemies, puzzles, and cinematic sequences.

details.title: Fire Crew Simulator
details.short_description: A co-op firefighting sim for up to 4 players. Fly helicopters with water buckets and drive the fire engine against a forest fire that spreads tree by tree, all on the same map. Or run the lookout tower campaign on your own.

details.title: TechRunners
details.short_description: TechRunners is an open-world 2.5D MMORPG set in the city of New Haven, where survival means climbing to the top. Start from nothing, build your empire, and take on rival TechRunners and Megacorporations. Form a crew to take control of the city or use your talents to climb the arena rankings.

details.title: Tower of Elyndium
details.short_description: Tower of Elyndium is a single-player action RPG featuring souls-like combat, where you ascend a mysterious tower. Face challenging enemies and bosses while exploring puzzle-filled floors and uncovering the secrets hidden at the tower’s peak.

name: Help! I'm Stuck In A Fractal!

details.title: Help! I'm Stuck In A Fractal!
details.short_description: (As seen on CodeTV S3 E7!) Thank you for calling the Higher Dimensional Manifold Escape Hotline. Your call is very important to us, and will be answered in the order in which it was received. In the meantime, please do not attempt to modify the fractals, or move through higher dimensions.

details.title: Rose Guns Days -Season 3-
details.short_description: In 1944, unprecedented disaster struck Japan, forcing it to accept an unconditional ceasefire from its enemy nations in World War 2. As a result, the Japanese have become a people without a nation, but they still come together and do whatever it takes to live without giving up...

details.title: Mongolian Wind Script 1: Chongzheng Academy
details.short_description: A historical visual novel set in early-20th-century Inner Mongolia. Make choices for Saran, a girl placed in the real Chongzheng Academy, and branch her story toward five true endings. Featuring native vertical Mongolian script rendering and reimagined period music.

name: The Echo of MeMe-For You Adrift in the Sea of Reveries

details.title: The Echo of MeMe-For You Adrift in the Sea of Reveries
details.short_description: Welcome to the Meme Space—a dream of scattered fragments. Cross the plains, descend to the deep-sea city, link time, and ride to the Silver River. A denpa-style roaming text adventure, made for you.

details.title: DRAMAtical Murder re:code NITRO ARCHIVE
details.short_description: NITRO CHiRAL's hit BL adventure game DRAMAtical Murder re:code is now available on Steam! Aoba, our protagonist, spends his days working part-time at Hum-Drum Junk. All he ever wanted was to live a peaceful life. However, strange events have begun transpiring in places beyond his fathoming.

name: I Refuse the Bad Ending for fear of Muscle Loss

details.title: I Refuse the Bad Ending for fear of Muscle Loss
details.short_description: A 530,000 combat SHSL personal trainer is reincarnated as a villainess?! “Guillotine in a year? I’ll tank it with my traps.”A chaotic gain-seeking survival comedy romance fantasy visual novel about a character who fears muscle loss more than death.

details.title: Caution! Platforming Ahead
details.short_description: Caution! Platforming Ahead is an abstract precision platformer starring Platformo. Run, jump, and blaze throughout the ether of a mysterious dimension utilizing incredible energy to defy gravity. Twenty scenes of classic platforming action await.

name: 新生：若能好好长大 Rebirth: If Only I Had Grown Up Right

details.title: 新生：若能好好长大 Rebirth: If Only I Had Grown Up Right
details.short_description: This is a simulation game that emphasizes the long-term impact of choices. Players take on the role of a Chinese woman born in the 2000s who has experienced trauma from her family of origin and must raise her newborn child until adulthood, ensuring the child's mental and physical well-being.

details.title: Caspian's Quest
details.short_description: The world of Caspian’s Quest is built around travel. Your wagon is more than transportation — it is your storage, shelter, lifeline, and symbol of progress. Preparation matters. The right meal, tool, potion, or crafted item can make the difference between a safe journey or an untimely end.

details.title: Cartomancy
details.short_description: Turn-based RPG style experience with emphasis on RNG and hints of team building strategy. Uncover a metaphysical mystery from an unlikely inheritance. Cipher the code and face the powers that may be. This isn't just a game, It's an initiation.

details.title: Pogo Together
details.short_description: Pogo Together is a multiplayer hardcore parkour game where you and your friends try to reach the top using pogo sticks. Your character never stops jumping, You just control the movement and timing. Kick your friends, laugh together and race to the finish line!

details.title: Revenge For Two
details.short_description: Revenge For Two is a narrative-driven 3D action-adventure game featuring platforming and puzzle elements, with two unique playable characters between whom the player can switch at almost any time.

details.title: Brass & Brine
details.short_description: Command a steam-driven ironclad across three legs of hostile sea. Fit your guns, take a refit after every wave, chart your route and sink the bosses that rule each ocean, alone or with up to four captains online or in split-screen co-op.

details.title: Shardfall
details.short_description: A classic real-time strategy war for the crystal that fell from the sky. Build a base, harvest Vitrium and command the Concordat, the Ascendancy or the alien Harrow through three campaigns, then wake the Mandate. Fight five levels of AI in skirmish, or battle your friends online.

details.title: Towers for Hire
details.short_description: A pixel-art roguelite tower defense game. Monsters are swarming toward the village, and you play as the captain of a band of mercenaries, building towers, sending out guards and holding the line with skills and traps. Mix and match over 100 cards and treasures to shape a company that's truly yours.

details.title: Crown & Claw
details.short_description: War looms over a world divided by five powerful factions. In Crown & Claw, an epic 8-bit fantasy RPG, follow a Holy Knight whose journey uncovers ancient secrets, challenges centuries of hatred, and reveals a dark truth that could change the fate of humans and monsters alike.

details.title: Love and Bread
details.short_description: Homeless, jobless, and buried in debt, rebuild your life in Moonville. Farm and cook custom meals, juggle your physical and mental needs, work jobs or launch your own business, and win over the town's people and cats along the way.

details.title: Asteroid Patrol
details.short_description: An incremental arena shooter where asteroids rain down and bounce back for more. Blast them apart, dash through creature swarms, protect the settlement’s houses and watch your numbers explode as you upgrade, beat bosses and push into new biomes.

details.title: Silent Hunt: Horror Escape
details.short_description: Investigate a house marked by a massacre, solve puzzles, and uncover what lurks in the darkness. But be careful… you're not alone.

details.title: Lumiere Express
details.short_description: Every conductor in Europe ate the bad mussels, so the railways send for you: 93, retired, and nearly blind. Drive a steam train through thirteen towns from France to Iceland, and at every junction pick the one clear line, even though you only see where it goes at the last second.

details.title: Take One Down
details.short_description: Ninety-nine bottles of beer on the wall. You know how it goes. Take one down, pass it around, and keep the Singer company at the bar. He's sung this song more times than he can count, and lately it's starting to sound a little strange.

details.title: NULL
details.short_description: A first-person psychological horror game about grief, obsession, and love. Sleep to enter dreams, take control of them, and descend into deeper layers where time moves slower. Explore, solve puzzles, and uncover the mystery of a grieving father who created a world frozen in time.

details.title: Saint Hallow
details.short_description: An nice little adventure game with a SPRINKLE of horror on top, this Cat and Mouse game is a steady paced, action oriented experience! Gather coins, find notes, and escape the claws of the Traeger Wolf. Be sure to utilize your powers, they may come in handy later.

details.title: Lawless Streets
details.short_description: Build your own criminal empire and dominate the city’s underworld. Command your soldiers, capture territories, expand your businesses, and make choices that will shape your future.

details.title: Alderun
details.short_description: A MOBA game with a hero at its heart and many different battlegrounds to choose from. Level your champion, gear it at the merchants and lead an army through sieges, tower defense, 5v5 lane battles and 10v10 valley wars, online against real players or solo against the AI.

name: 時渡りの論破屋 ～江戸城無血開城を死守せよ！～

details.title: 時渡りの論破屋 ～江戸城無血開城を死守せよ！～
details.short_description: Explore Edo, gather testimony and evidence, and expose lies that could rewrite history. Join high school student Ren and his time-repair companion Chrono in a historical mystery adventure. Connect clues and solve puzzles to protect the meeting between Katsu Kaishu and Saigo Takamori.

details.title: Train Keeper
details.short_description: A cozy first-person organizing simulator aboard a night train. Make beds, set tables and sort up to 2,443 objects across 22 cars before the train reaches the station. Unlock helpful skills, restore order at your own pace, or race the clock in Hardcore mode.

details.title: Xmas Squad
details.short_description: Physics co-op comedy for up to 4 players: deliver presents, steal cookies and save your friends from monsters. One more house and we're outta here. Promise.

details.title: Wishknot
details.short_description: Swing, saw and squash your way through a procedurally generated world in this medieval physics soulslike. You've fallen down an endless wishing well with nothing but a rope and far too much momentum.

details.title: BROKE.EXE
details.short_description: BROKE.EXE is a satirical trading simulator inside a fictional desktop OS. Earn cash in minigame jobs, then trade simulated stocks and crypto - long, short, leverage, stop-losses. Build passive income, run mining rigs and trading bots, and climb from $0 to $10,000,000. No real money involved.

details.title: VIZZA
details.short_description: Set particles dancing to your favorite songs. Infect your desktop with immortal mold. the waves of time at your fingertips. Your one way ticket to the trip dimension.

details.title: Regnum Last Sanctum
details.short_description: Regnum Last Sanctum begins with Saga I — Combat: Wrath of the Goblins. An dark epic, Action RPG, Regnum's Quest to defend its last sanctum against the invading goblins. Master skill-based combat, fight clever foes, and progress in the realm of Regnum where death has consequences. Will you survive?

details.title: Slice the Mountain
details.short_description: A relaxing incremental game about a red panda girl who wants to slice a mountain.

details.title: CURSECADE: Pachinko Roguelite
details.short_description: Build explosive chain reactions with balls, pegs, and cards inside a cursed arcade machine. Place and upgrade special pegs, master physics-driven bounces, and survive stages and bosses that keep rewriting the rules.

details.title: Oekaki Golf
details.short_description: Storybook-style physics golf: hit the ball and draw crayon lines to make platforms! Play the same hole with up to 12 players at once. Help friends with your lines or sabotage rivals with special crayons. Enjoy chaotic fun, solo or together!

details.title: Pixel defender
details.short_description: An idle tower defense you play in a corner of your desktop. Defend your castle from the oncoming enemy army!! Train your soldiers, grow your town, and build the mightiest army of all!!

details.title: NO.9 Supermarket Shelter
details.short_description: "No. 9 Supermarket Shelter" is an apocalyptic zombie shooter where you can switch between top-down and third-person views: rogue-like missions, base defense tower tasks, massive multiplayer PVP, complete freedom to customize your character and outfit. Play solo or team up online with friends.

details.title: Nonogram Kingdom
details.short_description: Turn numbers into pictures. Solve 1,400 color nonograms across 28 themes, choose a board you like, and watch each finished picture rise from the grid.

details.title: Paw Pop Breakout
details.short_description: Paw Pop Breakout is a fast-paced brick-breaking deckbuilding roguelike. Smash bricks and collect shards before time runs out. Your deck determines which bricks, power-ups, and obstacles appear. Build unique synergies, face random challenges, and break through the ever-increasing difficulty!

details.title: Senti Metrica
details.short_description: “If you are not loved, you won’t survive—” A girl slowly turning into a monster, and the “Metrica” who hunt her. A survival otome game where you waver between reason and instinct.

details.title: FishInc
details.short_description: A minimalist incremental fishing game about mastering the sea. Time your strikes, chain perfect hits, build your boat, and design powerful trophy loadouts to survive increasingly chaotic runs.

details.title: Tactical Tile Breaker Incremental
details.short_description: A synthwave neon space tile‑breaker. Hit the ball. Stack Power Ups at the right moments to clear the screen in the fastest time. Or just chill and space out to the synthwave soundtrack beats.

details.title: Plobania 47/B
details.short_description: Immortality is not a blessing, it is a burden. As Milton Clarke, you work at the 47/B Mandatory Sleep Hospital, review documents, surf the internet, and decide who will no longer exist. You don’t kill anyone. You only “put them to sleep.” The rules are clear. Every decision has consequences.

details.title: Void Strike
details.short_description: Shred endless waves of hostile spaceships in a 1-bit arcade survival roguelite. Build absurd weapon combos, unlock pilots, upgrade your fighter, and survive escalating dogfights against swarms, elite enemies, and colossal bosses.

details.title: Hexball
details.short_description: Six teams, one hex pitch, and metal balls everywhere. Hire warriors from across history, see the odds of every block, dodge and pass before you commit, then live with the roll. Your players level up, get hurt and can be lost for good. Up to six players on one PC, or against computer coaches.

details.title: Fire To Mine
details.short_description: You find yourself stranded alone on an island, and the first thing you see is a massive wall coming straight toward you. Blast your way through it, unlock upgrades, and try to make it farther every time.

details.title: Soul Of Sin
details.short_description: One spear. Seven Sins. A single hit ends each phase, for them and for you. Climb a ruined cathedral as the Penitent, face the Sins one by one, and watch your body change with every Sin you slay.

details.title: Bound By Fate - Cursed Soulmates
details.short_description: Break the cycle and find new love, or embrace your handsome (but creepy) Yandere soulmate in this horror romance visual novel.

details.title: LAST SLIME
details.short_description: When and where will you leave each slime behind? Guide a linked caravan of slimes, detach them to make paths, hold switches, and block hazards, then collect every LOVE on the board. Plan around each slime's color and your caravan's order in this turn-based grid puzzle.

details.title: Data Breach Inc.
details.short_description: Pilot a breach rig into hostile corporate infrastructure. Mine the firewall, crack daemon cores, extract your haul, and buy permanent upgrades between sorties.

details.title: DUSTBLOOM
details.short_description: Team up with up to 3 friends and turn a dead red planet green. Mine, build and automate, haul ore with your truck, push the green frontier into high-pressure lands, and hold your base against the husks that come at night, while you uncover what happened to the lost 14th team.

details.title: Delivery Survivors
details.short_description: Delivery Survivors is a survivor-like action roguelite game. Gather powerful relics and weapons, level up your character, create unique builds and slaughter your way through endless minions and bosses in the dungeon.

details.title: LATENT – Fragment 01
details.short_description: You wake up in a rotting clinic. No one is here. Almost no one. LATENT – Fragment 01 is an anime-style survival horror game.

details.title: Overbooked
details.short_description: In this Roguelike deckbuilder, arrange rooms for eccentric animal guests under overbooking pressure to meet KPIs. Upgrade rooms with furniture, and squeeze in your freeloading Panda Manager at peak capacity.

details.title: RecycleShopECO
details.short_description: 3-Match Puzzle × Human Observation × Horror Novel Recycle Shop ECO is a binary art style 3-match puzzle and horror novel game. Fulfill customers' requests, gather information about them, and explore a hidden world of horror.

details.title: Giant's Heart
details.short_description: A mysterious journey across a collapsing island. Reforge a lost blade, defeat ancient giants, and uncover the truth about your past. Save the island before it’s too late.

details.title: Tatakabu-Do: Hammer and Helmet
details.short_description: A simple, fast-paced versus party game starring Fang the bunny and friends. Bonk with a hammer or block with a helmet. One hit wins a round. First to five wins a match. Play side by side on one PC, or online. There's a story mode and CPU battles for solo players.

details.title: HolEvade
details.short_description: HolEvade is a challenging, physics-based 3D platformer where precision is everything. Tilt and control the platforms high above the clouds to guide your ball, navigate tight paths, and test your reflexes in a vibrant, stylized world!

details.title: Crimson Ark
details.short_description: Forge your own magic build in Crimson Ark, a single-player dark fantasy action RPG. Choose from three heroines, hunt for gear, and refine it through upgrades and reforging. Grow through auto-hunting, take direct control against bosses, and journey with Maria through a world of endless night.

details.title: Talescape: Write. Branch. Play.
details.short_description: Play well-crafted interactive stories shaped by mood and choice, or create your own branching story without coding.

details.title: Starship vs Everything
details.short_description: Start fragile. Earn every upgrade. Turn one battered starship into a storm of fire in this demanding bullet-hell roguelite. Dodge deliberate patterns, build devastating weapon combinations, and salvage permanent upgrades for the next run.

details.title: Escape From Worker
details.short_description: Escape From Worker is a third-person action shooter about a worker who refuses to clock in. Battle hordes of zombies, grow stronger, and evolve as you fight to escape the daily grind. Explore dangerous locations and face tougher enemies on your path to freedom. Clock out. Fight back. Evolve.

details.title: Tiara
details.short_description: Tiara is an exploration-focused narrative game where you play through days (and dream through nights) to uncover the story of Tiara's life.

details.title: Honel's Identification
details.short_description: A document inspection sim in a fantasy republic gripped by reform. Check papers from humans, elves, orcs, trolls, and beastfolk against rules that change every day. Follow the law, or your conscience? Every issuance has a cost.

details.title: REAVEN WOOD HOTEL : ROOM 207
details.short_description: A first-person psychological horror game set inside a mysterious mountain hotel. Explore the dark halls of Reaven Wood Hotel and uncover the terrifying secrets hidden behind Room 207.

details.title: Zombie Siege
details.short_description: Protect the last 10 survivors in a top-down tower defense game. Build defenses, hunt for gear with random affixes, and customize towers with skill cards. Pick one of three upgrades each level-up and turn a makeshift camp into a firing line against hordes and siege beasts.

details.title: Wander Her Way VR
details.short_description: Explore incredible interactive locations with your gorgeous companion. A sandbox VR experience with mini-games. Shoot enemies, destroy objects, drive a car, dance with an amazing girl, defend a tower, catch mischievous kittens, watch a fireworks show. Realistic female character, advanced physics

details.title: Rose in the Mist
details.short_description: A fantasy adventure visual novel featuring choices that shape the heroine's personality and the ultimate ending she will reach. Meet the residents of the Mist Witch's estate and grow closer to her mysterious guests. Love, friendship, and hatred in a captivating story.

details.title: BIRDS HUNTING
details.short_description: A chaotic 1–4 player first-person bird hunt. Blast incoming flocks, send your dogs to retrieve, earn cash for better gear, and chase golden ducks and a flying rainbow unicorn. Friendly fire is optional. Trusting your friends isn't.

details.title: Dragon Eggs: Survivors
details.short_description: Bullets that spawn more bullets! Collect dragons to fight with you. Level up and merge them. Create unique builds to survive hordes of enemies in this 3D roguelike bullet hell survival game!

details.title: Kit Keeper
details.short_description: Be the Kit Keeper of a football shirt shop. A truck dumps 540 shirts on the floor. Read the badge and number, find the player in the Kit Catalog, print the name and hang the shirt where it belongs. A cozy first-person sorting game.

name: Clean Those Carpets! - Carpet Cleaning Simulator

details.title: Clean Those Carpets! - Carpet Cleaning Simulator
details.short_description: Ever seen a video of someone cleaning a really filthy carpet? This game is exactly that! A satisfying process of cleaning a carpet from filthy to perfectly spotless.

details.title: Crown Control
details.short_description: RPG Roguelike Deckbuilder: play solo or in online co-op with up to 4 players. Choose your character, level up your class, collect and play cards to attack, defend, heal, summon allies, place traps, and alter the terrain in turn-based isometric battles to overthrow a tyrant king.

details.title: ARIA
details.short_description: An AI. A fly brain. An underwater facility. Wake alone in first-person survival horror: bring ARIA back online, rewire a flooding station and open the capsule yourself. Then lure the specimen hunting you into quarantine—if ARIA's memory can be trusted.

details.title: Juice Board
details.short_description: Add some juice to your typing with custom carets, satisfying effects, and reactive word combos that work across multiple desktop applications.

details.title: Chess of the Hidden Gates
details.short_description: A roguelike deckbuilder where every card is a Chinese chess move: the horse leaps, the cannon fires over a screen, the pawn crosses the river and never turns back. Every enemy strike marks its target square first. Step aside and it misses. Breach the Eight Gates. Play, or be taken.

details.title: Train Cargo: NightShift
details.short_description: October 21, 1998. You are the night clerk at Hollow Pine freight yard. Weigh the crates, check the seals, sign the manifests. Follow the rules on the board in the booth. When the signal is red, do not move. Do not look at the train that is not on the schedule.

details.title: Crystal Surge
details.short_description: Crystal Surge is a top-down extraction shooter with roguelite elements. Scavenge ruins, combine gear and random blessings, plan routes and deploy turrets. Fight with guns and powers, then extract to trade loot and grow stronger. Leave now or face a boss? Die and lose everything you carry.

details.title: 任意杂货铺
details.short_description: Stock up, arrange the trays, set your prices—make every hand reaching over the counter scramble to pay in Spirit Stones. Set out from the “Anywhere Door,” travel through a dozen-plus sects opening shops and doing business; Solve puzzles, rescue the elders, become a sect’s divine beast.

details.title: Tower of Sequence
details.short_description: Tower of Sequence is a beginner-friendly anime-style DBG developed by a solo developer.

details.title: Alice’s Archive
details.short_description: Alice's Archive is an atmospheric found-footage puzzle game. As a young archivist, uncover the dark secret of a psychiatric hospital where everyone vanished in 1984. Examine over 70 eerie, hand-drawn pictures by a patient, break the seals, and reveal the supernatural truth.

details.title: Cats And Pillows
details.short_description: Run a cozy cat shelter where every whiskered guest has their own needs! Place shy cats in quiet corners, sleepy cats on soft pillows, playful cats near fun spots, and stinky cats away from sensitive noses. Each level brings a new cozy setting and a fresh puzzle full of picky little paws.

details.title: AFK Throne
details.short_description: A chibi dark-fantasy squad idle looter that lives at the bottom of your desktop. Between work and study, spend your idle earnings to power up and push further, team up with other players against bosses, or duel them. With luck, you'll find rare tradable items to sell on the Steam Community Market.

details.title: Meka Gakuen
details.short_description: Run an independent military academy above the Shigure reservoir. Get to know 100 hand-written cadets through the years, and lead them in turn-based battles against flesh demons where every loss is permanent. Build the academy. Bring them home.

details.title: Computer Manufacturer
details.short_description: Develop your computer empire, control costs, and increase profits. Decide whether to develop hardware in-house or purchase it, and whether to prioritize cost-effectiveness or pursue higher profits. The choices are all up to you.

details.title: Seabreeze Atelier
details.short_description: Seabreeze Atelier is a cozy island-building game. Shape coastlines, carve rivers, and connect gardens and cottages with paths and bridges. Cast a line from your pier, then turn the island you built into a live Windows wallpaper and watch the boats drift by.

details.title: Operation Together VR
details.short_description: A 1–4 player co-op military VR simulation. Complete tactical operations, neutralize terrorist threats, and rescue civilians.

details.title: Infected Zone Survival
details.short_description: "Infected Zone Survival" is an open world zombie apocalypse survival game. The game is mainly based on third person action shooting, and can be searched, disguised, built, made, cultivated, fished,hunted, recruited NPCs, simulated management, etc.

details.title: Dimension Contortion Lover!!
details.short_description: 由CRYSTALiA开发的最新力作，一款近未来风格的战斗恋爱视觉小说。 你将扮演魔术师后代的男主人公“崩月槐”潜入“学园”，探寻真相。

details.title: Ayakashi Profile
details.short_description: One button per ally. Chain four fighters’ attacks, special attacks, and spells into launches, follow-ups, and devastating ultimates in this Japanese fantasy battle RPG. Meet a cast of nine, build a party of four, and try the free First Gate demo.

details.title: Unending Watch - Dead Man's Fingers
details.short_description: A steampunk extraction survival game built on brutal melee combat and constant tension. No guns—only heavy strikes, smart counters, and raw survival. Enemies hunt, adapt, and ambush. The world shifts mid-run. Extract with loot… or be claimed by the dark.

details.title: The American Dream: Past Due
details.short_description: The American Dream: Past Due is a realistic choice-driven sim. Play as a suddenly laid-off middle-aged man keeping up appearances. Balance family finances and emotions while facing mounting bills... Can you get your life back on track before your family falls apart?

details.title: Let's Drive - learn driving simulator
details.short_description: There are 1.3 billion cars in the world. But how many good drivers are there? Is every one of them trained and competent? Find out while playing Let's Drive, a driving school simulator that shows you hazardous situations on the road and puts you right in them.

details.title: Mossback
details.short_description: Tend a little farm on the mossy back of an ancient sea turtle as he drifts through the seasons. Fish, cook, raise animals and mend pottery with gold, then hop off to mine, dive, race and dodge bullets on a much grumpier turtle. Share what you grow with a very old friend and watch the island rise.

details.title: Cosminers
details.short_description: Cosminers is a 1-4 player co-op FPP sci-fi building and mining game with survival elements based on day/night cycle. As a space miner kill various aliens on procedurally-generated planet's undergrounds. Craft and upgrade your tools, weapons & base to get countless hours of thrilling gameplay.

details.title: RunMan Turbo
details.short_description: The Indie Legend Returns: Bounce, slide, and run fast as heck through high speed levels in five unique zones. Each time you run a level it will look and play different, requiring you to master your instincts to beat record times, earn medals, unlock secrets, and be the world's fastest! Wishlist Now!

details.title: Tri-Ger
details.short_description: TRI-GER is a top-down rouge-like SHMUP with technicolor vector based graphics. Fight endless waves of enemies, and be sure to match your color to get a high score!

details.title: The Mysterious Cat Tower
details.short_description: In this turn-based RPG, follow the story of a woman fighting off a terrible curse in order to save a loved one. Discover spells, choose talents, adjust attributes, recruit powerful allies, and reset your build to explore new strategies in order survive the treacherous world ahead.

details.title: TOCOViX
details.short_description: Place Crosses on the game board and complete "Shapes". Earn "Stops" to block your opponents and make your way to victory! Play with your friends on the same device or challenge other players Online.

details.title: Oasis the Great
details.short_description: Ever imagine you could play with your fellows in Online co-op , discover a tremendous world,find the treasures,build freely,do some farming,fight with others,party around ! also there are other mini games.And all these happen in a physics based oasis!! (￣▽￣)~❤

details.title: Cursed Night
details.short_description: Cursed Night is a multiplayer horror game for 1-5 players. Use your magic abilities to defeat the devil, or become the devil and seek revenge. Find talismans, collect power, release spirits, or choose the dark side and kill everyone.

details.title: Gobby Island
details.short_description: Gobbies, punches, and retrowave

details.title: For The Hive
details.short_description: Survive as a tiny insect in a big harsh world. Fight your way to the top of the food chain. Build a strong colony that stands the test of time and become the ruler of the insect world.

details.title: One More Wipe : Raid Night
details.short_description: One More Wipe : Raid Night — Lead a 25-player raid. Alone. Nobody's late, nobody's AFK, and you will still wipe. Recruit from 10 classes, draft a new build every run and call the shots through 8 dungeons and 16 bosses. Or hand the raid to your AI agent.

details.title: Pedro and Sofia's Nuclear Winter
details.short_description: A fantasy adventure across a nuclear-torn America! Play as Pedro and Sofia and set out on a quest in this open-world, 3D/2D role-playing game!

details.title: Motion Wulin
details.short_description: "Motion Wulin" is a fast-paced martial arts action game where you play as a time-traveling warrior fixing broken timelines.

details.title: Cardseer
details.short_description: Cardseer is a deckbuilding game combining roguelike elements with a sprawling campaign. Choose your hero and fight your way across diverse maps filled with fearsome enemies, all while crafting your deck and collecting powerful artifacts. Can you rise to the challenge?

details.title: Guns Undarkness
details.short_description: A command battle JRPG by Shoji Meguro, known for scoring and directing on the “Persona” and “Shin Megami Tensei” series. The adventure takes place in a near-future world on the brink of destruction. Become a member of the private military company BTI's Alpha Team, and carry out grueling missions.

details.title: Phantom Gear
details.short_description: Gear up in your battle armor and take on the sinister Ocular Force! Become Josephine and put a stop to the power-mad cult and the mysterious phantom force behind their spree of carnage!

details.title: ASCENDANT
details.short_description: High stakes, high chaos, and the most unpredictable twist on capture-the-flag yet. Outwit ruthless opponents, face mutant wildlife, and secure four biocores in this fast-paced FPS where wild events can turn the tables in an ever-shifting BioPunk arena. This is ASCENDANT - bring backup.

details.title: Evil Dreams
details.short_description: Travel through nightmares until you go insane. Evil Dreams is a dark adventure, telling the story of a boy living in the 19th century and forced to face ancient evil. Delve into the world of dreams to find out the truth.

details.title: Humankind in a nutshell
details.short_description: Spin the slot and decide the fate of your civilization. From seeds to kingdoms, from stone to steel. From the very first turn to a thousand years later, every choice becomes history. From the first spark of fire to a forest of skyscrapers. How long can your people survive?

details.title: MR.E
details.short_description: A turn-based sci-fi puzzle adventure where every move costs power. Navigate a failing spaceship, solve environmental systems, and uncover the truth behind a rogue AI and your stolen human past.

details.title: VOIDRUSH
details.short_description: An action roguelite, solo or co-op with up to 10 players. Face endless hordes, combine 52 weapons and 161 items into devastating evolutions, unions and synergies, and hold on until the end as the Void awakens beyond the map.

details.title: Bullet Maidens
details.short_description: Protect a school from demon soldiers. Battle followers of the occult. Discover a chilling revelation that just might lead to doom...or salvation? A turn-based tactical shooter that doesn't rely on luck about Taiwanese schoolgirls saving their refuge in a world at war.

details.title: Family Land - Farmer Simulator
details.short_description: Family Land - Farmer Simulator. Renew an old farm. Give new life to the farmland. Take care of the animals. Convince Old Bill that together you can do more. A humorous story about the struggles of a townie who decided to become a farmer.

details.title: Adventures of Steve the Cat
details.short_description: You are a cute cat Steve, who has to go through a lot of beautiful, exciting and dangerous locations. On the way you will meet a lot of enemies created by a crazy professor.

details.title: Pararecords
details.short_description: As a counselor in a mysterious facility, you are to examine children with strange powers and fill in their "Paranormal Records". In this story-based, choice-driven game, you will have to pry open your subjects' minds... but what you find inside them could prove dangerous.

details.title: DI: Debt is Inevitable
details.short_description: A wave-based arcade shooter where between waves you visit a shop with prices that increase with each purchase/rental. Keep your combo high and grab as many coins as you can, and you can delay the inevitable. Powered by GZDoom.

details.title: In Stone
details.short_description: A sculptor is confined in a monastery asylum.

details.title: Dawn of the Zombies: Survivors
details.short_description: Face the horde in a world of shifting light and rainy nights. Choose from 4 heroes and 3 weapons to survive 2 deadly maps. Customize your run with 100+ nodes. Play solo or split-screen across 3 difficulties. Start at 6 AM. When the colors fade to gray, the real fight begins.

details.title: Blood Peace
details.short_description: Blood Peace is a fast-paced rogue-lite dungeon crawler where you embody a cybernetic warrior with extraordinary abilities. Engage in epic battles against a diverse bestiary across 7 unique biomes. Each playthrough generates a procedurally created world, ensuring infinite replayability.

details.title: DESPA
details.short_description: DESPA is a fast-paced multiplayer arena shooter built for after-work warriors with more bills than free hours. Neon kill-boxes, railguns, and carbon katanas meet a five-second respawn loop, so every death flips into revenge before your coffee cools.

details.title: Evil Dungeon
details.short_description: ¡Fight the heroes trying to conquer your dungeon! Choose a class and fight along your comrades to stop invaders, level up, pick up loot, buy upgrades and become the greatest anti-hero

details.title: Unwound
details.short_description: Earthquakes are threatening idyllic Candy Island! Pull yourself together and get to the bottom of what’s troubling the island and its eccentric residents before your whole world breaks apart. UNWOUND is a rollicking yarn: a narrative RPG where people are objects and candy is currency.

details.title: Deaded
details.short_description: Build your defences, scavenge for loots and survive the zombie infested city saturated with a mysterious fog. Survivors will ask for help but its up to you to save them, or leave them for dead. How long will you survive before you become... Deaded...

details.title: Predatory Islands
details.short_description: After an emergency aboard their starship, groups of settlers were evacuated to an ocean planet. Lead an island outpost in an online RTS about survival, building, trade and wars for influence across a living archipelago.

details.title: 反击战
details.short_description: Enter Counterattack, and instantly travel back to the smoke-filled southern border battlefield of 1979. Every detail here echoes the historical authenticity, immersing you in the thick of battle.

details.title: Meritaton
details.short_description: The story of a pharaoh's daughter who decides to challenge her destiny. The mysterious and fragile world of Ancient Egypt hides more than meets the eye.

details.title: Skip Lake 2
details.short_description: “Solve beautiful puzzles and listen to the melody of crashing Pots going deeper into the story of Skip Lake!”

details.title: Game Cafe
details.short_description: Game Cafe is a casual game where you can play games like Spades, Okey, Backgammon and more with your friends or other cross platform players.

details.title: Merauders: Tides of Fate
details.short_description: Navigate family secrets and cultural divides as mysterious abilities awaken. Every choice ripples through relationships. Every conflict resolves through understanding, not violence. What you learn and the choices you make can change everything.

details.title: The Last Station
details.short_description: The Last Station is a visual novel. It's loneliness. This is the absence of a second attempt. It's the lack of happy endings.

details.title: Twin Jet Racer
details.short_description: Two jets. Two triggers. That’s all you need to swerve, drift, corkscrew, loop or even fly to reach the next checkpoint and top the leaderboard. Master the controls and the physics to progress to the next class of racer and unlock greater challenges. Compete against friends or against the clock.

details.title: Evergrind
details.short_description: Evergrind is an idle adventure like you've never experienced before! Discover unknown regions, face dangerous creatures, and create the ultimate loot loop. Master skills, process rare resources, and forge powerful gear on your journey to absolute perfection!

details.title: President Noir
details.short_description: The ultimate "President" card game app! Packed with tons of unique house rules and features cross-platform online multiplayer.

details.title: JUNK!
details.short_description: Do you have what it takes to be a Scrapper, or are you just another piece of JUNK? Battle with your friends, random opponents, or an AI trainer to unlock new robots, abilities, and customizations. JUNK! is a fast paced, arena 1v1 PVP brawler.

details.title: Hex Party
details.short_description: Hex Party is a chaotic multiplayer party game for up to 8 players online or 4 locally. Roll the dice, sabotage your friends, and compete in 14 action-packed minigames. Play solo with bots or bring your friends!

details.title: Vangaro Tactics
details.short_description: Command your cartoon army against pointy-nosed officers in this colorful turn-based strategy game with asymmetric factions, mining, and tactical Stealth Missions. Capture buildings, recruit exclusive troops, and use each commander's Power to advance through the Vangaro War.

details.title: Afterschool Adventurers Club
details.short_description: Oh no! An evil Game Master has taken over the school's tabletop role playing club and is terrorizing its members with twisted dungeons and strict rulings! As the new kid in town, do you have what it takes to stop the tyran and bring peace back to the Afterschool Adventurers Club?

details.title: Mental Salvo
details.short_description: Mental Salvo is a surreal top down art game with a procedural open world. A blank sandbox where you can explode your head, talk to weird entities, and perhaps find out if androids dream of electric sheep.

details.title: Abyss Delvers
details.short_description: Abyss Delvers is an Online Hack'n'Slash Action RPG. Adventure out alone or party up with your friends on an epic journey and fight the monstrous hordes of the Abyss. Featuring randomly generated campaigns, dungeons, items and more!

details.title: Tales of the Realm: Arisen
details.short_description: A story rich and action packed fantasy game, that takes place in the fictional kingdom of Mythuras. Defend the kingdom against the ruthless undead in this retro-styled adventure game.

details.title: DOLYA'
details.short_description: Atmospheric fantasy 2D-RPG. In a world where everything has a Plot, Fate, and a Name. Your role is to save Fate. To find that Name that was erased from reality.

details.title: TRYPAN
details.short_description: TRYPAN - A exploration based survival horror FPS. Return to Stagmon, the city where your father disappeared. Fight intelligent enemies. Improvise and use limited resources to defeat them.

details.title: The Doll Sitter
details.short_description: This is a psychological horror game where you play as a nanny taking care of dolls in a strange house. Watch over the dolls, complete tasks, gather clues, and uncover which one is the impostor.

details.title: Gus & Stella's Stellar Adventure
details.short_description: Help Gus find out where his family is, and who was behind the attack that left his ear bitten off. Craft, Climb, Solve Puzzles, Win Battles, and Get to know the Cats at the Kitten Intergalactic Taskforce station!

name: Captain Disaster and The Two Worlds of Riskara

details.title: Captain Disaster and The Two Worlds of Riskara
details.short_description: A new Captain Disaster adventure; this time he is more of a hero than a disaster! ... Or is he? A point and click adventure game with cartoony graphics, epic storyline and more bad jokes than you can possibly imagine. Wishlist this game. It is your destiny...

details.title: House spirit cat
details.short_description: House spirit cat is a visual novel with interactive features. It’s a story about a kind spirit of a house in the shape of a cat who is searching for a new owner. Will it find a new home or a place of despair? You are to choose.

details.title: Knightward
details.short_description: Build towers to safeguard your crystal while you loot treasure-filled rooms and grow stronger. Knightward is a tower defense action rogue-like for 1-4 players. Will your defenses hold off enemies long enough to discover the deepest levels of the dungeon?

details.title: GlitchStorm
details.short_description: Fight with style, hack enemies, and chase viral fame in a dying world. Earn credits, upgrade your ship, and reach new planets. Explore a city of broken Artificials—and save the only friend you have left before it’s too late.

details.title: Code5erpent
details.short_description: The game where numbers are a weapon. On a simulated Earth, add, multiply, or combine the numbers which comprise the matrix's code, and take advantage of a rich equipment system of weapons and scrolls in order to come up with devastating combos to annihilate your enemies.

details.title: Angry Mother Earth
details.short_description: Angry Mother Earth offers a one-of-a-kind strategy experience within an fully simulated world. Wield and merge a variety of abilities to release cataclysmic forces—ranging from hurricanes and earthquakes to blizzards—upon the world of humans. But be warned: humanity won't go down without a fight!

details.title: Lucky Dog Rise
details.short_description: Bring a lucky dog to your desktop! It stays in a screen corner, keeps you company while you work, and lets a little luck into your day. Take a break with a quick card game, win rewards, open blind boxes, collect outfits, and make your desktop a lucky nook for you and your pup!

details.title: Melt Away
details.short_description: People end up forgetting about the dead.

details.title: One with the Unicycleverse
details.short_description: A precision platformer where you maneuver and weave your unicycle through hundreds of dastardly obstacles across dozens of levels and side modes. Upon mastering the controls; the game becomes a meditative experience and you will discover what it means to be ‘One with the Unicycleverse.’

details.title: ユメザメの仮説
details.short_description: 『ユメザメの仮説』はあなたの力で過去を変える、マルチエンディング形式の恋愛アドベンチャーゲームです。 恋人とのデートをやり直し、振られてしまう未来を変えましょう。 デートの内容によっては恋人以外の女性との可能性も。 全てはあなたの”行動”次第。
developers: さめさめサメーション
publishers: さめさめサメーション

details.title: Special Case
details.short_description: Fight the Occupation Forces with Unique Super Powers! Destroy Helicopters, Drones, and Armored Vehicles. Explore "The Strip," protect its people, and rebuild a war-torn world. Welcome to Special Case

details.title: 帰宅 -kitaku-
details.short_description: I want to go home! Such a chilling experience awaits you.This is an exploration-based action horror game depicting the terrifying experience of a newly hired salaryman in an underground parking garage.

details.title: Ser Chub's Adventure
details.short_description: Join Ser Chubs as they adventure through an exciting world full of slimes, skeletons, and... robots? A fantasy, sci-fi action-adventure game the likes of which is rarely seen. The world of Ser Chubs is not as it seems on first glance. Fight enemies, solve puzzles, and most importantly have fun!

details.title: Echoes Below
details.short_description: Echoes Below is a tactical first-person shooter set in an unforgiving open-world survival environment. Build and fortify your base, craft essential gear, and recruit companions to fight alongside you. Explore a hostile archipelago, hunt for resources and engage in intense firefights.

details.title: THREE VERSES³
details.short_description: THREE VERSES is a first person dungeon crawler / typing game based on poetry. Having shed your corporeal form, you must now escape purgatory by completing the simple task of delivering verses from deities to struggling poets.

details.title: Echoes of Taihang
details.short_description: Run a gunsmith's workshop in a survivor camp hidden in the Taihang Mountains. Open supply crates, assemble and enhance weapons, fulfill commissions, and search the ruins for resources. A good gun can earn your keep or help bring you home.

details.title: DOCTRINEERS
details.short_description: DOCTRINEERS is a turn-based strategy game where no two games are ever alike. Strategize and plan with your unique doctrinal units and adapt to new battlefields in a single-player campaign and online multiplayer.

name: Lux Leonarii - A Mechanical Puzzle Adventure

details.title: Lux Leonarii - A Mechanical Puzzle Adventure
details.short_description: Lux Leonarii is a Puzzle game revolving around guiding beams of light throughout an ancient structure using a multitude of mirrors and devices, ranging from simple A to B connection to multiple colours and complex interactions.

name: 夜空色的魔法少女 - Nightsky Blue Magical Girl

details.title: 夜空色的魔法少女 - Nightsky Blue Magical Girl
details.short_description: You will play Wong YukChan, a high school student in Shenzhen. While enjoying campus life, you should investigate the monsters and seal them. In addition, you will act together with the cute girl Pak HoLing to defeat the monster, and develop a romantic relationship with her during this process.

details.title: Rebel Sector
details.short_description: RebelSector is a horizontally scrolling shoot-em-up inspired by HudsonSoft Caravan shooters.

details.title: Drakefall
details.short_description: Explore the World of Drakefall in this roguelike deckbuilder. Build your deck, piece together the broken world, and journey through swamps and mountain peaks with a familiar playstyle.

details.title: Bat Galaxy
details.short_description: Half on-rails shooter, half exploration-driven adventure. Zoom into a world where billions of bullets surround you and your handy punch feature can send enemies flying.

details.title: Spaceborne Fighters
details.short_description: Spaceborne Fighters is a dynamic action platformer featuring arena battles against hordes of enemies. Explore 10 diverse maps, develop your character through skill trees, and craft items to face challenges in the most spectacular way.

details.title: 孤行
details.short_description: 边地一座废村，金军扎着哨。 一个断了手的人走回来。刀出鞘，旧事也一层层被拽出来。 《孤行》用「今日」与「昔日」双线讲张四的故事。 人还在同一条回村路上往深处走，记忆却把他送回水缸、集市、军营，以及更远的地方。 战斗嵌在剧情里。你读他的失去，也替他点出这一刀该落在谁身上。

name: PhantomZone labyrinthos ファントムゾーン・ラビュリントス

details.title: PhantomZone labyrinthos ファントムゾーン・ラビュリントス
details.short_description: “There’s no escaping a nightmare that never ends.” When the protagonist wakes up, a young girl stands before him. She introduces herself as “Entropy (entourfe), the Management Support Android.” Spreading out before the protagonist is a confined underground facility.

details.title: FALSE SPIDER
details.short_description: The web woven by spiders is only for waiting for prey to bite.

details.title: Ocean in the Cold Sky
details.short_description: You can manually parry attacks, fly a little with your meagre wings, and die instantly.

details.title: Rise of the Bugs
details.short_description: RISE OF THE BUGS is a 2D pixel art adventure game about annoying bugs. Lead a colony in search of new food, discover the secrets of mutation and escape from the angry men on the kitchen. Will you be able to steal the mysterious sauce or you die crushed under a slipper?

details.title: DuckTape Inc.
details.short_description: Night shift for the notoriously stingy DuckTape Inc. In 1-5 player co-op, keep an offshore oil rig and a polar research station running: tape pipes, hunt hacked drones, drill ice and reach the helicopter before the thing in the dark finds you. The pilot waits for no one.

details.title: 遥岸灯海
details.short_description: 出身术士名门却没有天赋的人类少女，在机缘巧合之下得到了和城内最强大的猫妖签订契约的机会。直到某个期限——灯海节——到来前，她都为了成为出色的术士而不断努力。尽管她身边的猫妖，似乎并不理解她的心愿。

details.title: PSYCHExFUSE
details.short_description: CONQUER YOUR SELF and escape the nostalgia-fueled nightmare in PSYCHExFUSE, a brand new RPG horror filled with mystery, challenges and terror. Unite your past selves and save a troubled world in an interdimensional adventure into the deepest depths of your mind!

details.title: Pico Garden
details.short_description: On a cozy corner of your desktop, build a miniature world that is uniquely yours. Watch diverse creatures arrive and thrive, with the gentle rhythm of nature keeping you company as you study, work, and relax.

details.title: KAI
details.short_description: KAI is a game of Exploration and Adventure between the sidereal space and underwater depths. Skillfully lure and guide groups of fish to solve puzzles, access new areas and uncover the truth behind the mission entrusted to you, Akira, and the other crew members aboard the ship.

details.title: CYBRID: Survivor
details.short_description: CYBRID: Survivor - is a single-player shooter with survival elements. Use your entire arsenal, fight hordes of robots, mine resources and unlock powerful upgrades as you clean up the streets at night. You are alone, against everyone!

details.title: The M/S Cornelia II Incident
details.short_description: On a small, snowy skerry somewhere in the Nordic Archipelago a man wakes up with no memory of who he is, where he is or why he is there. A point-and-click mystery where atmosphere and unusual puzzles are at the heart of the game.

details.title: Backrooms Versus
details.short_description: Ever dreamt of chasing your friends in a backrooms style game? Ever wanted to be the entity in the backrooms? Ever had the thought "I wonder what fear looks like in VR"? Well, this is the game for you. Backrooms VS has all that and MORE. With plenty of game modes for a night's worth of fun.

details.title: Lefka 空垣
details.short_description: 《Lefka 空垣》是一款中式赛博灵异RPG。在位于阴阳两界之间的观测站，你将扮演新上任的部长曹麟，与部员列夫卡一起调查由「桃源抛尸案」引入的诸多灵异事件。在这人鬼混杂，乱象丛生的时代下，你们能否探清名为「空垣」的怪象？

details.title: Containcorp
details.short_description: An absurd Corporate Horror & Logistical Management Sim where you contain & milk anomalies for tremendous profit. Construct your facility across multiple floors, design containment areas, employ brilliant minds to study anomalies. Contain, Research, and build a machine of Profit.

details.title: Fabled Frontier
details.short_description: An open world survival action rpg set in a procedurally generated world inspired by fairy tales. Build your hero as well as a home!

details.title: The One Who Stands Behind
details.short_description: You are a God of Destruction. Realize your strength through powerfull card combos and burn your enemies from existence in the unique deckbuilder combined with hex-grid tactics.

details.title: Dwarf Legacy
details.short_description: A Bullet-Hell Precision Platformer. Climb up Vertical Dungeons of The Mountainhome, battling Swarms and navigating Traps. Uncover the secret of your Legacy hidden atop the highest peak and secure the future of your village.

details.title: Indie Game Farmer
details.short_description: Grow crops. Fund your game-making dream. Tend your pixel farm, sell the harvest, and upgrade your tools while dividing each day between farming, part-time work, and game development. Turn your first potato into your first release, and build a living from crops and games.

details.title: Steam Punks
details.short_description: inspired by SNES 90's classic like Mega Man X 1-3, Super Metroid & Link to the past, Steam Punks mixes elements from the classics into a lore rich adventure with some modern twists! Unlock items & power-ups and discover secrets & lore!

details.title: Heat Division: Rescue Team
details.short_description: Rescue civilians from natural and man-made disasters in this Speedrunning 2D Platformer. Featuring 4 playable characters: Jack Red, John Blue, Jane Orange & Chief Green

details.title: City Of Corals
details.short_description: Save the coral reef city in this cute tiny adventure game! Meet the colourful residents of this underwater city, explore the streets, befriend different species of fish and help them restore the corals to their former glory!

name: Levels of Fear: Voidwalker Act I- An Undying Devotion

details.title: Levels of Fear: Voidwalker Act I- An Undying Devotion
details.short_description: A Survival Horror game: Paranormal Investigator, Jonathan Hunter, awakens in an alternate realm finding himself fighting to survive. Forced to team up with a ghost girl named Angel trapped in a strange artifact, they must work together to escape an underground laboratory and evade dangerous enemies.

details.title: Pinbleton Park
details.short_description: Pinbleton Park is a small open world cosy adventure game where the whole world can transform into a giant pinball table. Help the villagers, rescue lost spirits, craft new pinball elements, and take down the corporation bent on destroying the forest!

details.title: Sever's Zone
details.short_description: "Sever's Zone" is a 3D first-person shooter about survival in the Anomalous Zone, full of artifacts, anomalies and dangerous inhabitants of the Zone - living and not so. The plot of the game is based on a series of books in the genre of science fiction.

details.title: Starforce Rangers
details.short_description: A small online Space RPG. Made to enter space! Fly around with others and level up. Battle against other ships or do other missions.

details.title: Mantle
details.short_description: Mantle is a multiplayer creation platform built on Unreal Engine 5. Publish playable worlds, then join instantly through one client with no per-place download. Explore worlds made by other creators, team up with friends, and build your own using the in-editor tools.

details.title: Deadly Deals
details.short_description: You're a merchant in an antique shop. Buy, sell, develop. Easy as that. Just don't die. One little detail of a profitable location that realtors don't usually tell you...

details.title: Absorber 2
details.short_description: Every monster you defeat leaves something behind. Absorb its skills and spells, build your loadout, and watch your hero fight on their own. Fuse pieces in the Merge Laboratory and grow into something no class could ever be. A lighthearted idle auto-battler RPG, the sequel to Absorber.

details.title: Digopolis
details.short_description: Explore, dig and gather treasures to fuel your evergrowing lust for wealth.

details.title: Through Hell and Back
details.short_description: Through Hell and Back is a timeline based roguelike deckbuilding game. Place your spells on the Timeline to outsmart your enemies. Choose your power ups carefully, trade spells and upgrade the Timeline to unleash devastating combos.

details.title: Brink of Broken
details.short_description: A turn-based RPG in a world already ruined! The weapons you pick up are plentiful but fragile, you must break your foes before your weapons shatter! Explore the land in search of permanent power-ups, or win your battles with strategy alone!

details.title: High Tide
details.short_description: A story-driven adventure where Doug accidentally unleashes an ancient curse across a tropical island. Explore, solve environmental puzzles, battle corrupted creatures, help strange locals, and uncover how to bring the missing people back.

details.title: Beyond Faded Voices
details.short_description: Experience moments in a third-person story about my passed away parents and my british cat Zeus. It's a mix of adventure, cat simulator and even Tower Defence and first person bodycam. Be the cat - sleep, sharp your claws, eat, be petted by parents and misbehave in a few hours!!

details.title: Kodas Nereus
details.short_description: Don your VR headset and descend into the abyss. Kodas Nereus combines true-to-life oceanographic data with hyper-realistic diving mechanics. Navigate pitch-black wrecks, monitor living reefs, and uncover history preserved on the seafloor. No fantasy monsters—just you, your rebreather, and the deep.

details.title: SatW Guesser
details.short_description: SatW Guesser is a geography-based quiz game that challenges your knowledge of world flags and country locations. You’ll be shown a flag or a highlighted country on a world map, and your task is to pick which country it belongs to.

name: Chronos Bound: How We Became Heroes

details.title: Chronos Bound: How We Became Heroes
details.short_description: Pilot a lone ship through a collapsing orbital station in a modern 2.5D shoot ’em up. Block bullets with a 360° directional shield, destroy grotesque wreck-born enemies, defeat colossal bosses, and build new upgrade paths with every run — a love letter to classic shoot ’em ups.

details.title: SiegeBorn
details.short_description: SiegeBorn is a top-down action RTS. Lead your troops, command powerful siege engines, and defeat the enemies!

details.title: Soul Catcher: The Moon Coliseum
details.short_description: Soul Catcher: The Moon Coliseum is a fast-paced Rogue-Like First Person Arena fighter. Battle through hordes of enemies. In this cruel coliseum, it's a free-for-all. You choose where to fight and who to fight at the right moment, with the aid of Magic Crystals that give single use weapons and tools.

details.title: B-Ricky High School
details.short_description: Meet Ricky in this exciting arcade game mixing flipper, brick smashing and fight. Get ready for the challenges of Arcade or Story mode and for the tough ones, settle the score in the double 2-player mode.

details.title: Do Crimes!
details.short_description: Hey, how'd you find this game?? Do Crimes is an upcoming chaotic competitive co-op extraction game where you and your friends drop onto randomized islands and cause criminal mayhem - then try to escape before you're squashed by the law...or just give each other the finger. Do Crimes! Or Don’t!

details.title: World In The Abyss
details.short_description: The aliens have caused the oceans to rise, plunging the world into the abyss. Survive, craft, and explore this mysterious underwater world. Build your base, defend it against relentless waves of enemies, and dive deep to uncover the secret that could stop the alien invasion once and for all!

details.title: JohnJohnson: Remnant
details.short_description: They were made to entertain. But now they want to smash and kill.

details.title: Temple of Glyphs
details.short_description: No text, no tutorials—only glyphs and puzzles. Decipher the true meaning behind every enigmatic symbol, connect tiles to reshape the world, and uncover the secrets of the ancient temple.

details.title: Hexora
details.short_description: Hexora is a unique and innovative strategy puzzle game that combines the classic mine-sweeping gameplay with a godly perspective and city-building elements. Embark on an exciting adventure to unveil the unknown and guide your people to prosperity.

details.title: GraviTech
details.short_description: In this 3D puzzle you will need to turn your perception of the world. After all, the actions of the game take place in the laboratory on the study of gravity changes. Forget about the attraction to the ground.

details.title: Death of a Dungslinger
details.short_description: Abruptly reincarnated as a dung beetle, you’ll battle a colorful cast of the neighborhood’s baddest bugs as you scoot, scuttle, and shoot your way through charming 3D worlds. Ball up whatever material you can find, then sling it at your foes—or hop on and ride it around to outmaneuver them!

details.title: Stuck In The Backrooms
details.short_description: Stuck In The Backrooms is a horror multiplayer (1-4) exploration game where players find themselves trapped in a different reality. Solve puzzles and investigate levels while avoiding (OR NOT...) entities. Some things were never meant to be found…

details.title: Creature Containment
details.short_description: Creature Containment is a hardcore base-building Action RPG. As a fresh Militia Commander, you've been tasked with infiltrating and wiping out an underground goblin infestation. Manage your base, equip your Operators, and fight hordes of creatures in the depths below...

details.title: Rebels of the Realm
details.short_description: Grab your friends, pick your class, and raid dungeons in this lighthearted co-op fantasy RPG, where chaotic spells and hilariously bad ragdoll deaths keep the realm unpredictable.

details.title: Blood Curse Legions
details.short_description: This is a RTS game where you primarily control cavalry units in battle. Utilize the vampire's abilities to command in battle, develop unique vampire heroes based on the game's evolving situation, and form a powerful Blood Curse Legion to dominate the world and establish a vampire nation.

details.title: Die Meeple
details.short_description: Die Meeple is a roguelite dice deckbuilder where classic board games have risen in revolt. Reclaim forgotten boards, battle their rebellious pieces, and unlock new dice, upgrades, and artifacts.

details.title: Leaforia
details.short_description: Run your own farm, craft unique items, and battle your way to success. Pay off your debt to the city, befriend the locals, and maybe even find true love. Raise animals, train your loyal dog, and ride across the land on horseback.

details.title: Sweets & Dragons
details.short_description: Sweets & Dragons is a simulation game of maid cafe management in another world. The player becomes the owner of a maid cafe, and while managing the shop and training beautiful maid androids, collects money and grows the shop.

details.title: Lumoryn: Whispering Worlds
details.short_description: Lumoryn: Whispering Worlds is an MMO of true rarity. Unique quests, permanent NPC deaths, unpredictable bosses, evolving worlds, and legendary items only one player can claim. Knowledge, not grind, shapes the world.

details.title: Stealer
details.short_description: Platformer with elements of metroidvania. Begin your adventure as a thief who is immersed in darkness. Use your lantern to explore eerie locations, search for clues, and interact with surrounding objects to uncover secrets and achieve your goals.

details.title: Memories Of Zattera
details.short_description: Memories of Zattera is a visual novel that merges fantasy and science fiction. Explore moral and political dilemmas from multiple viewpoints as tradition, progress and freedom collide. Will you see the world the same once all truths are revealed?

details.title: Kiki's Nightmare
details.short_description: An adventure RPG where you step in the shoes of a fearless hero. Navigate through unhospitable terrain, fierce enemies and save Kiki from her own terrifying dream!

details.title: DigSite: Archeology in Egypt
details.short_description: DigSite is open-world archeology sandbox game located in Egypt where you dig, clean and document artifacts you find. Donate rare artifacts to a museum and build your legacy as a legendary archeologist.

details.title: BattleSail
details.short_description: Fight pirate ships in turn-based naval battles during the Golden Age of Piracy. Earn gold, hunt hidden treasures, lead your fleet through a story campaign, and challenge friends in local and online multiplayer.

details.title: μ of the M World
details.short_description: 魔王としてこの世に生まれたのに、すでに世界は壊れていた。主人公の μ は何かを壊す事で、何もない世界の中から一つずつ大切な感情を手に入れていく。過去の正義を遡る3Dアドベンチャー『μ of the M World』は連載型のアクションゲーム。物語とアクションを同時に進めていくこのゲームは、無料アップデートで徐々に世界が広がっていきます。

details.title: Wiz Hunter
details.short_description: Wiz Hunter is a rogue-lite deckbuilding card game. Embark on a deadly quest to hunt down wizards through strategic, turn-based combat. Kill, die, learn, repeat.

details.title: Farol del Diablo (Devil's Lantern)
details.short_description: Our protagonist ventures into a dark, abandoned village in search of the treasures said to be guarded by the mysterious Luz Mala. Before long, what began as a quest for riches turns into a desperate fight for survival as she unravels a dark conspiracy that has remained hidden for years.

details.title: Imperial Bureaucracy Hero
details.short_description: IBH is a rich role playing game at the end of time. You're a mid-level official in a dying sci-fi regime, given the impossible task of fixing a faltering machine; explore a vast world, define your mind, flex your authority, and become a sinner or a savior in countless other stories.

details.title: Farming Service
details.short_description: Farming Service is a simulator of a working agency that performs assigned tasks on a farm. We start as a new owner of an agency based in Europe and our task will be to expand services worldwide. Develop skills, acquire orders and develop in three service departments: Farming, Buildings and Machines.

details.title: Service Dog
details.short_description: Unleash the chaos! Smash, bash, and crash through everything—and everyone—in sight. From wrecking houses to sabotaging dance-offs, Everyone has a favor to ask. Is he a good boy or a public menace? One thing’s for sure—this is Service Dog

details.title: Defiled West
details.short_description: A top-down Western Action RPG set in a desolate & mutated frontier. Discover and overpower furiously unstable foes that waver the rules of life and death. Collect and upgrade powerful weapons and wield a variety of otherworldly gadgets. Reclaim what was lost, one building at a time.

details.title: Aghori
details.short_description: Aghori is a psychological horror game set in the Himalayan foothills. Unravel dark rituals, cursed forests, and forgotten villages as Rudra searches for his missing friends in a narrative-rich journey through fear, mysticism, and the unknown

details.title: Polaria
details.short_description: Polarium is a relaxing idle game set in the serene world of Antarctica. Discover peaceful marine life, learn about polar ecosystems, and find comfort in nature. Inspired by real research, the game blends healing gameplay with subtle messages on climate and biodiversity.

details.title: Light&Claw
details.short_description: Light & Claw is a 3D top-down ARPG. In a godless era, White Mage Dboy runs a magic hospital using nature’s power. After a freak accident, he fuses with the White Tiger Brek. Now, Dboy can transform into Brek to fight! Join them and sister Luceria to find the lost God.

details.title: Low Battery
details.short_description: A puzzle game inspired by sokoban. Play the role of a power-recycling robot. Plan your route carefully to maneuvering other units and make your way out. Collcet power little by little, locate the source of Infinite Power and Leave this Factory.

details.title: FreedomBot
details.short_description: Turn-based roguelike where you play as a rogue bot surviving in procedurally generated cities. Features sophisticated character development and in depth combat using a detailed anatomical damage system .

details.title: Project Horizon
details.short_description: Project Horizon is a 1-4 player co-op first-person spaceship simulator where the entire crew needs to work together to carefully maintain the nuclear reactor, take up arms against enemy ships, and repair every leak and faulty electrical panel to survive.

details.title: Hellwire
details.short_description: A dueling deckbuilder game against other players. Learn the rules of the bizarre match unfolding before you, turn the tide with clever (and not so clever) abilities, don’t get tangled in the wires, and pray for the mercy of the Biomechanical Goat.

details.title: GAMING RAIDING
details.short_description: Third-person shooter games

details.title: Bugboy
details.short_description: Catch, train and battle creepy crawlies and uncover the secrets of Spider Town in this retro Gameboy-style RPG.

details.title: 约会普拉斯 Date Plus
details.short_description: A game born from memes, featuring the “World’s Richest Person” sending you $50, a chaotic skewer vendor, and a quirky dog-shaped backpack. Dive into a whimsical yet heartfelt dating adventure full of unexpected twists and pure hilarity!

details.title: INSTALLATION 19
details.short_description: Alex Carter, part of The Abducted UFO group, acts on a tip about nighttime sightings. Unknowingly, he wanders into a top-secret military base, triggering a suspenseful journey.

details.title: Library of Meialia
details.short_description: To uncover the secrets of Aethium Magic in the Library of Meialia, you’ve set out to prove your worth. Faced with doubts, pursuing forces, and sealed monsters, this journey is fraught with danger... Collect books, gather weapons, and explore the grand library alongside a diverse array of companions.

details.title: Weeny Wise
details.short_description: A Co-Op Adventure, Puzzle-Platformer game. Embark on your adventure with your companion in the magical world of Weeny Wise.Invite a friend to join for free with Friend’s Pass to solve puzzles together, cross platforms, and stand against creatures enchanted by Ragna.

details.title: Poop with Friends
details.short_description: Poop with friends is a desktop pet. Typing, pressing buttons or any input will cause a bowel movement. These inputs give you points which you can use to customize your stall with stickers, patterns and colors. Hang out with friends. play mini-games and support each other!

details.title: Retro Rail: Japan!
details.short_description: Drive nostalgic Japanese‑style trains through busy city lines and iconic routes. Follow timetables, signals, and station rules to become a master conductor. Choose between relaxed journeys or strict professional challenges in this retro 1990s console‑aesthetic simulator.

details.title: Tempus Triad
details.short_description: In Tempus Triad, dive into an ancient first-person horror scenario where a scientist is thrust into an era where huge predators dominate the land.

details.title: Venusville
details.short_description: Guide pioneering settlers among Venusian clouds in this space colonisation city builder. Grow food, collect energy, mine resources, balance buoyancy and weight to stay afloat in the treacherous Venusian atmosphere, and build a self-sufficient colony while navigating storms and acidic clouds.

name: Frame of Mind - A game of thoughts.

details.title: Frame of Mind - A game of thoughts.
details.short_description: Frame of Mind - A game of thoughts is a brief and cozy narrative game that lets you explore a character via thoughts and momentos you find in stages of their life. Its an introspective game, meant to share some experiences a peer-group of neurodivergent queers, including the dev, had growing up.

details.title: The Ump Show
details.short_description: The Ump Show is a baseball umpire simulator where you balance making accurate calls and enforcing your will on the game. Make accurate calls, cheat when you need to, and build your way up to the highest levels!

details.title: Nuclear Sub
details.short_description: A realistic nuclear submarine simulator will allow you to take command of your crew and battle your fiercest enemies. Arm yourself with missiles, dive into the ocean and fight for your country

details.title: Four Hundred Catapults
details.short_description: A large-scale survival strategy game with up to 3000 units on the battlefield. Build and manage your settlement, produce resources, research weapons and technologies, and recruit your army to survive in the war against the Half Dead Legions.

details.title: Kendo Warrior
details.short_description: Kendo Warrior is a realistic samurai sword fighting simulator. In the game, the player will take part in exciting duels in medieval Japan. Realistic animations of the most important moves of kendo warriors will introduce the player to the world of this martial art.

details.title: Toxic Crusaders
details.short_description: The Toxic Crusaders return for an all-new, all-action beat 'em up for one to four players! Grab your mop, tutu and attitude, and get ready to clean up the mean streets of Tromaville and beyond, one radioactive menace at a time!

details.title: VISK
details.short_description: Enter the bleak world of VISK, an online co-op horror game for 1-2 players. You and your friend are sent to a desolate village. Uncover the dark secrets of this place and cautiously explore your surroundings. After all, you might not be alone…

details.title: Pin City
details.short_description: Pin City is a VR bowling game with the spirit of mini-golf! Silly yet challenging, strive for a perfect game and explore the bowling alley!

details.title: You're a dad
details.short_description: A sleep-deprived text adventure about new parenthood, daydreaming, and the things left unsaid. Be a responsible adult, make dinner and take care of your child. You must do this. Nothing else.

details.title: Milkman
details.short_description: Explore the corrupted Kellsworth Hotel, crawling with twisted enemies. Slash your way through the nightmare, solve Puzzles, collect elevator buttons as you descend the hotel floors towards the ground floor.. Uncover the truth behind the disappearance of your husband

details.title: Monstrobus Quiz
details.short_description: Monstrobus Quiz is an online trivia game for 2-16 players! Answer questions and use tricks or boosts on yourself or others. Create custom question packs to keep each game session unique. Gather your friends and dive into the Monstrobus Quiz fun!

details.title: You Can't See Ghosts!
details.short_description: You Can't See Ghosts is a puzzle game about spatial awareness and deductive reasoning with a charming story where you play as an invisible ghost. Bump into walls, step on glass, and other clues to locate yourself and reach the exit. Perfect for both experienced players and newcomers alike.

details.title: Astra Sentinel
details.short_description: Astra Sentinel is a wave-based survival RTS where endless alien hordes relentlessly assault your planets. Build defenses, colonize planets and manage resources under constant pressure. Will you be able to recover the control of the galaxy?

details.title: The Backwars
details.short_description: The Backwars is a survival horror game where you gather resources, craft, and hide from lurking terrors. Play solo, co-op, or versus in a hauntingly realistic world where anything can interact with anything. Trust no one, and do whatever it takes to survive.

details.title: HOSTYLE
details.short_description: HOSTYLE follows agent Cryptic's job interview to become an assassin for the most corrupt company on earth. This fast-paced 3D platformer combines stylish movement options alongside a futuristic but nostalgic Y2K aesthetic.

details.title: Step into the Dark
details.short_description: Dive into the grim depths of the underworld, fight with its ferocious inhabitants, and determine your own fate in this classic first-person aRPG with immersive elements, created for fans of the genre.

details.title: TekRobot
