details.short_description: I am happy to present TekRobot, the game about a robot who lived and worked in his home factory, but once he was marked for disposal. Our goal is to escape from the factory, which no longer home but the deadliest place in the world.

details.title: Crooklock
details.short_description: You're in a stolen ship, your turret is stuck in one position, and you have the entire Galactic Federation breathing down your neck. An 80's styled shmup that has you shooting and running from the law across fifty nail-biting stages. Can you beat the odds... and your high score?

details.title: Arctis
details.short_description: Survive the hostile environment of Arctis on a unique rotating map and discover the fate of your group in this turn-based survival strategy game. Hunt the local wildlife, craft tools, build a community, and adapt to the foreigners who slowly populate the map.

details.title: Ritual Chamber
details.short_description: Mara Venn cleans the treatment rooms at a private clinic on the night shift. Tonight the register says Chamber Six is empty, but someone is sitting in the chair, and they know her name. Ritual Chamber is a first-person psychological horror game about a job she can't afford to lose.

details.title: Our Ephemeral Nights
details.short_description: As he enters his final semester of college, Kev continues to wonder if there’s something more to the future he’s carving out for himself. After a chance encounter with Vivi, an aspiring voice actor also in her final semester, he experiences the beautiful and fleeting days before his graduation.

details.title: Nocky el Armadillo
details.short_description: Nocky El Armadillo is a love letter to the 16-bit generation of challenging 2d platformers. Avoid traps and evade enemies while mastering the controls.

details.title: Plush Party
details.short_description: Get ready to challenge family and friends in PLUSH PARTY, the ultimate party game for all ages! Customize your cat, escape the claw, and be the last plushie standing!

details.title: Transit World
details.short_description: Lead your transport company to success: manage people, vehicles, and finances, take on jobs or drive yourself – Transit World combines management depth with freedom.

details.title: Roman Legacy: Speed Trials
details.short_description: Explore a reimagined ancient Rome in the industrial revolution in this fast-paced precision platformer. Master abilities like jetpacks and dashing, interact with the environment through wall running, and navigate interesting levels. Compete on leaderboards in 'Roman Legacy: Speed Trials'.

details.title: The Lightkeeper Is Gone
details.short_description: The Lightkeeper Is Gone is a retro-styled horror adventure set in the 1930's on a lone island. Take on the job of keeping the lighthouse while discovering the story of those that came before.

details.title: Abyss Lord
details.short_description: What awaits the young man in the future? A long and happy life next to loved ones? Losses and suffering leading to an inglorious death? The throne of the enemy of humanity? A harem of all sorts of races, from pretty goblins to graceful vampires? The one and only love until death?

details.title: GU Fighters
details.short_description: GU Fighters is an action roguelike where you unlock and upgrade new abilities after every round of combat. Play with up to 4 players locally or online to create your own unique build and be the first to win, or go solo/co-op to traverse varying environments and defeat hordes of enemies.

details.title: Snake in the Dark
details.short_description: Sure, you've played Snake. But this is Snake like you've never seen before? Snake in the Dark is a total re-imagination of the timeless arcade and puzzle game classics like Snake, Sokoban, and Boulder Dash. Fun gameplay you know delivered with more puzzling twists than you expect!

details.title: Everstorm
details.short_description: Classic MOBA combat meets battle royale PVP, with roguelite elements. Fight other players, customize your abilities and survive hordes of monsters long enough to face the final boss. The last team standing wins. Earn permanent upgrades in between matches, then dive back in for more.

details.title: Bedtime Horror Stories
details.short_description: Late night. A young man called Sam is home alone. He finds a mystical book that takes him into a world of horror stories that come alive. Start reading, but you must not break the most important rule. Once you have started the book, you must finish it!

details.title: Space Cleaners
details.short_description: You and your friends are building a space cleaning business. Navigate filthy and hostile space stations, clean everything up and work hard for your reputation.

details.title: The Barkeeper
details.short_description: Swap the espresso machine for a cocktail shaker! Mix, shake and serve drinks against the clock, master new recipes in bars across the city and keep your customers happy - solo or with a friend in 2-player co-op. One wrong ingredient and it's straight in the trash!

details.title: Broken & Loved
details.short_description: Broken & Loved is an interactive visual novel which tells the story of Evangeline and Rei, two university students entangling their lives in a love story fill with reflection, drama, sweetness and happiness.

details.title: Wire Throne
details.short_description: Upgrade your ride and unleash devastating firepower to take down Wire Throne! One life, one car in this roguelite top-down looter shooter!

details.title: Meteorder
details.short_description: Meteors are falling from the sky. Hurry up, your objective is to eliminate them by aligning same-colored blocks and launching them upward. Meteorder is an exciting tile-matching puzzle game where you can compete against opponents, explore various planets, and enjoy the beats.

details.title: Answer Campus: First Semester
details.short_description: Answer Campus: First Semester is a comic book style narrative adventure about identity, belonging, and the moments that define us. Make your way through the first semester of college as you make new connections, experience high stakes encounters, and settle in to your new life.

details.title: Flowering Void
details.short_description: Alone and newly awakened, uncover the secrets of this dark and unusual world by fighting and defending against the cruel environment.

details.title: Master Thief
details.short_description: Become the ultimate burglar in this witty 1-4 player co-op heist game. Craft your character, hone your skills, and pull off daring thefts as you rise from small-time crook to Master Thief!

details.title: Bilingual Crosswords
details.short_description: Learn languages by solving crosswords. Solve crosswords → encounter new words → review with spaced repetition → repeat → learn.

details.title: Dress the Duel
details.short_description: "Dress the Duel," is a roguelike deckbuilding game where your cards are your wardrobe and your outfit is your arsenal!Build a versatile wardrobe, disrobe strategically, layer outfits for powerful effects, and Dress the Duel!

name: HAOxSORA =THE SKY'S ABOUND= RIDE TO OUR FINAL

details.title: HAOxSORA =THE SKY'S ABOUND= RIDE TO OUR FINAL
details.short_description: CHANGE THE BOARD. CHASE THE WORLD.

details.title: Hydra Coil
details.short_description: Voyage amidst the stars in this relaxed turn-based Space Fantasy RPG.

details.title: echo//shredd
details.short_description: echo//shredd is a co-op survival horror game for 1-4 players in a dystopian future. Collect scrap, retrieve loot for upgrades and fight for your survival. Your life is a resource - and your commodification is part of the system.

details.title: Hot Dog Simulator
details.short_description: Start your own hot dog stand business, find the perfect spots in the city, upgrade your stands, attend festivals, and serve influencers. Expand your business by opening new branches and perfecting your hot dogs.

details.title: Fishing Shop Simulator
details.short_description: Catch fish, build your store, and sell your catches! Explore a mysterious world to find new areas, and new fish to catch. Decorate to get wealthier customers to buy your big catches. As you build up your store, a town will evolve around you!

details.title: FOREX GAMING FX
details.short_description: We offer a special program that allows you to improve your skills with just 10 minutes of training per day through high-speed training using currency charts. There are three courses to choose from: one for beginners, one for advanced traders, and one for AI automated trading.

details.title: Magical Girl Critical DELUXE
details.short_description: "If magic doesn't work,then you beat with stick!" Action game in which a magical girl is transferred to another world and struggles

details.title: Vibes TCG
details.short_description: A quirky Penguin-filled Trading Card Game.

details.title: Paddle Cats
details.short_description: Paddle Cats is a cozy two-player couch co-op fishing adventure where two cats share one boat. Paddle together, explore the waters, catch fish and bring your haul back to camp.

details.title: Neverending Check-in: The Hotel Stories
details.short_description: Immerse yourself in The Neverending Check-In, a pixel RPG filled with mystery, quests, cats, humor and life universe. Rebuild a once-glorious hotel and uncover its secret past in this captivating journey of deep plots, lively characters, and abundant quests.

details.title: Checkmate MAGIC
details.short_description: Lead your King into tactical 6v6 battles alongside five loyal companions. Recruit allies, customize Runes and Gambits, forge powerful gear, and unleash coordinated attacks to deliver CHECKMATE. Defeat seven rival Kings, collect their relics, and unlock the mysterious Corrupted Gate.

details.title: Dungeon Raiders
details.short_description: Dungeon Raiders is a roguelike dungeon crawler game with cards to acquire and loot to find! Make your way through perilous dungeons, battle monsters with cards, outfit your raiders with the best gear and sell any extra loot you find in your customizable shop for profit!

details.title: Geometry TD
details.short_description: Tower defense on a starship you build and fly yourself. Explore open space, mine asteroids, trade, and lead a crew of astronauts. When pirates board your ship, place geometric towers, merge them into stronger shapes, and stop every wave.

details.title: Hundred Battle
details.short_description: Grow like a roguelike, draft your party like an auto-battler, command like an RTS — a semi-auto-battler roguelike of a hundred battles.

details.title: Wizavior
details.short_description: 3D platformer that will pull you into a whirlwind of adventure! Step into the shoes of the powerful Zavior a retired wizard who, with humor and determination, sets out once again to save the world from evil.

details.title: Paver Simulator
details.short_description: Design and craft stunning pavements with precision and style. Choose from various materials, earn money, and build your reputation as a master paver. Are you ready to pave your way to the top? Test your creativity skills and create a masterpiece in Paver Simulator!

details.title: Kanun 1919
details.short_description: An action-adventure game set in a dieselpunk world. You are an imperial courier tasked with investigating the disappearance of a special cargo in the sealed-off city of Turov. Uncover its dark secrets and face the unknown. The fate of the city—and perhaps the entire world—rests on your shoulders!

details.title: Thalassophobia
details.short_description: Thalassophobia is a 4-player co-op horror diving game set in the crushing darkness of the deep ocean. Complete high-risk objectives and uncover long-forgotten secrets. The further you descend, the less safe you are.

details.title: The Mirror Dimension
details.short_description: The Mirror Dimension is a co-op psychological thriller and horror game for 1 to 4 players. Players investigate paranormal activities, solve mysteries across dimensions, and eliminate spiritual entities to find problems. Are you ready to explore different dimensions?

details.title: Hexoria
details.short_description: Harness the power of magical cards and become a master strategist in Hexoria, a turn-based roguelike deckbuilder game. Explore a dangerous world, build and expand your village, gather resources, and use your cards to gain obedience. Survive the unknown and lead your cult to glory!

details.title: Zeta Wolf Chronicles
details.short_description: "Date" one of four girls on the path to enlightenment. Prom awaits. Will you be led astray by an old crush? The realistic dating-sim that "teaches" through its gameplay. Follow Rayen, a young disillusioned teen who desires a girlfriend by year's end. Is there hope in his future or endless despair?

details.title: EXODUS: Sunflower on the Horizon
details.short_description: An original sci-fi RPG like you've never experienced before...

details.title: Enfilade
details.short_description: Enfilade is a fast paced low poly multiplayer fps game with 30 levels and 18 weapons If there are not enough players there is bot support. Level up and unlock new weapons

details.title: Qubica
details.short_description: A next-generation sandbox game heavily inspired by The Blockheads. All about exploring, building, and playing together. Mine resources, craft tools, build a cozy cabin or an entire city.

details.title: 大野逐龙
details.short_description: 欢迎游玩这个步步新奇的东方大陆。在这里玩家将扮演一名刀笔吏——萧辰，在天下倾颓、诸侯割据的时代，萧辰背上行囊，游历东南西北，探索山海秘境、见识无数宝物，结识众多神奇有趣的伙伴，当然，也会遭遇强大的敌人……游戏介绍【不一样的东方大世界】狐国、密库、衣锦城、驼母宫、博望馆、龙府、人鱼岛、冰夷渡、古战场、高耳山、北境村庄等等，游历不一样的山川河流、秘境洞窟带来的别样氛围。【沉浸式体验海量剧情】丰富世界观和故事细节，希望能有大量支线填充。领略当地的风土人情，并且完成他们的委托来增加代入感，以及世界观的可信度。同时，游戏文案的整体风格会朝部分写实的方向靠拢，给玩家带真实的体验。

details.title: Pandash
details.short_description: Pandash is a rogue-lite platformer with different perks to discover and balance their powers. On your search for peace for your world, you wander through different areas, which will change every run. You need to get strong enough and unlock everything to survive and reach your destination.

details.title: North Pole Defense
details.short_description: A blood-soaked horde shooter in a fully destructible voxel North Pole. Grab your guns, call in sleigh strikes and dig through the walls as you and up to three friends defend Christmas against endless waves of undead elves, Krampus, and worse.

details.title: Suiren
details.short_description: "Suiren" is a 2D platformer game in which you use the power of nature to perform various actions and progress through the stages. One day, a fire of unknown cause breaks out, and it is solved by utilizing the power of water and the natural forces of various regions.

details.title: The Man Who Walked
details.short_description: The Man Who Walked invites you to solve relaxing puzzles by switching between two worlds: in 2D you rearrange the environment, in 3D you explore it. Only by combining both perspectives will you uncover the end of the story.

details.title: Gridbound Tactics
details.short_description: Gridbound Tactics is an async PvP tactics auto-battler where TFT-style drafting meets Backpack Battles-style spatial buildcraft. Draft units, multiply local trait power with placement, and find the strongest shape for the pieces you hit.

details.title: ERROR:Ai.lien
details.short_description: "ERROR:Ai.lien" is a bishoujo horror adventure where she watches, learns, and slowly invades your everyday life— ordinary routines twist bit by bit, until the AI’s love transforms into madness.

details.title: Memories Of Tacticians
details.short_description: Memories of Tacticians is a turn-based tactics RPG about keeping your party alive. Move across the grid in chess-style patterns, roll dice to hit, and upgrade your heroes between fights. Each battle is built around who you have left, and the fallen stay dead. How far can your party go?

name: Fire & Crown: A Romantic Tale of the Hundred Years' War

details.title: Fire & Crown: A Romantic Tale of the Hundred Years' War
details.short_description: A historical visual novel about faith, power, and impossible love. Fire & Crown takes place during the Hundred Years’ War, where you must choose between duty and desire as France tears itself apart. Be the reason someone lives—or dies. History may have never loved anyone, but you still might.

name: Welcome To... Chichester 2 - Part I : DayRise

details.title: Welcome To... Chichester 2 - Part I : DayRise
details.short_description: Grendel Jinx, the megalomaniacal kleptomaniac has returned to Chichester, England for a secret mission. Can the protagonist stop her?

details.title: Backrooms: Eternals
details.short_description: Backrooms: Eternals is not a game. It's a relentless, ever-expanding simulation of the ultimate horror: an infinite reality, stripped of all meaning. There are no goals, only survival. No hope, only the decaying echo of what was once reality. Welcome to your forever home.

details.title: Fever Tilt
details.short_description: Fever Tilt is a fast 1v1 zero-G arena where you mine gems, weaponize drifting debris, and sabotage your opponent with lasers, forcefields, and explosives. Procedural arenas and physics-driven chaos make every 3–7 minute match a ruthless fight to score first.

details.title: Cosmic Cubicle
details.short_description: Cosmic Cubicle is a magical crafting puzzle game where you create the elements that make up the world. Watch the elements explode, splash, and crackle with simulated physics as you combine and hurl the elements at each other.

details.title: Brew & Dash
details.short_description: Jump, duck, accelerate, and run to test your reflexes by dodging obstacles and enemies, collecting ingredients along the way to brew potions, gaining new powers, and going even further. Face challenges on randomly selected maps in this new take on the genre.

details.title: Fairyland Journey
details.short_description: A Hall-of-Fame competitive turn-based RPG. Cultivate Eudemons (Mythical Beasts) exclusive to you, and utilize hundreds of skills to make every battle more intense and diverse. Unleash their true power and dominate the PvP arena!
developers: 雷爵網絡科技股份有限公司
publishers: 雷爵網絡科技股份有限公司

name: Mystic Rest Stop: Weekend at Stillpoint

details.title: Mystic Rest Stop: Weekend at Stillpoint
details.short_description: Leo Carter, a content creator, arrives at SteelPoint to investigate the local urban legends. What seemed like a peaceful getaway soon turns into a nightmare when he discovers that the forest hides a cult willing to do anything to keep its secret.

details.title: Her in the Abyss
details.short_description: You accidentally intercept a distress signal from space—a girl codenamed C804 is venturing alone into a forbidden zone. Game time runs in perfect real-time sync with reality; every response, every silence, shapes her actions and decisions.

details.title: REALM ARCANA
details.short_description: REALM ARCANA is a 1v1 online strategy card game. Take turns deploying units, combine abilities and positioning, and adapt to randomized battlefields that change the rules of combat. Read the field, outplay your opponent, and find a new path to victory each match.

details.title: Serenity Sketch
details.short_description: Relax and paint with water in Serenity Sketch, a guided mindfulness sandbox. Create ephemeral art, follow gentle voice prompts in atmospheric landscapes, and find stillness in letting go. A self-care ritual where each evaporating brushstroke brings freedom and reflection.

details.title: SILKRUN
details.short_description: SILKRUN is an arcade racing game! Master silky smooth powerslides around insane tracks, even on a keyboard — race against time, computer opponents, and online in different weather conditions and time of day. Super Cars 2 meets Slicks 'N Slide, Outrun, Stunts & The Need for Speed in modern 3D racing!

details.title: On the Rocks
details.short_description: Run a bar in a toxic wasteland, solo or in co-op with up to 4 players. Scavenge the wasteland, brew with what you find, and serve whoever comes through your doors. In a world gone to ruin, the last bar standing is yours to run together.

details.title: The Book of the Alchemist
details.short_description: 1980s America. A dying doctor follows the call of an ancient book to a fog-shrouded town of disappearances, unsolved murders, and secrets. Dark alchemy offers a cure—at a horrific price. Will you die human, or kill your humanity to survive?

details.title: Stuck in a Trench
details.short_description: You are the High Command. Guide generals as they send soldiers through wartime trenches, make agonizing strategic choices, learn from campaign outcomes, and build a lasting legacy across many fronts.

details.title: Ominous Room -不気味な部屋-
details.short_description: Destroy quantum spheres that record human deaths and escape together in this co-op exploration extraction horror game. Each sphere you destroy alters the space and materializes the deceased's experiences. Hostile entities born from their emotions emerge. Escape, or push the investigation deeper.

details.title: AUTOMA
details.short_description: A VR action-adventure with deep physics-based interactions, systemic gameplay, and a gripping near-future mystery as a rogue AI overruns a Southeast Asian city. In a near-future city seized by AI, you made a deal to save your family—but at what cost?

details.title: Right As Rain
details.short_description: Right as Rain is a weather themed head-to-head bullet-hell. Control the projectile deluge by means of a boss character, or be the one to dodge the oncoming raindrops, collect pun-ishing powerups and fight for the Right to Reign.

details.title: Astro Company
details.short_description: Build the path. Defend the Core. Combine towers, cards, and artifacts into broken synergies in an endless tower defense roguelike.

details.title: Izakaya Izakoza
details.short_description: “Izakaya Izakoza” is a deckbuilding roguelike that combines card battles with grid-based strategy. Fully animated, lively characters jump through the battlefield! Live a day that begins with a conversation, flows through food, and ends with a climactic fight.

details.title: The Bespoke Cards
details.short_description: A deck-builder RPG where you customize the attributes, abilities, and aesthetics of your cards and form unique strategies based on your deck's strengths and weaknesses.

details.title: CactusLamp
details.short_description: Take on the seven deadly sins in CactusLamp, an intense 2D action-platformer centered around unforgiving boss battles. Each sin is embodied as an epic boss inspired by Brazilian culture, requiring precision and fast reflexes to be victorious in this unique pixel art world.

details.title: Blind Dog
details.short_description: You are a detective who is slowly going blind. The only faces you can still see clearly belong to those who are about to die. A visual novel investigation where every choice affects the fate of Tokyo and leads you either closer to the truth or deeper into darkness.

details.title: Hold My Winch!
details.short_description: A co-op survival adventure about driving, climbing, and winching your way across a deadly island to reach & repair its antenna.

name: Magical Girl Mina ~Battle of the Twin Demons~

details.title: Magical Girl Mina ~Battle of the Twin Demons~
details.short_description: This is a stage-based 3D action game starring the cute magical girl Mina. Use various costumes with different skills to clear stages and defeat the boss at the very end!

details.title: Cell 413 : Mine & Survive
details.short_description: A survival game in the life of a prisoner digging a hole to escape. Explore the procedurally generated underground, outsmart the guards, build your base, craft tools and find a way out of there!

details.title: STACK'EM!
details.short_description: Stack cards together, create unique creatures, experiment with wild combos! Prove your creativity in this highly strategic, turn-based deckbuilder against toys.

details.title: Drone Soccer
details.short_description: Drone Soccer is a 5v5 full-contact aerial sport. Pilot a caged drone as the Striker to score through the goal hoop, or play Defender and smash opponents out of the sky to clear the lane. Compete in online multiplayer or sharpen your flying in solo practice.

details.title: Digging Out
details.short_description: Digging Out is a realistic co-op digging game for up to 8 players. Work together to dig a tunnel, upgrade your tools, and break into the bank. Every shovel counts plan smart, dig deep, and pull off the perfect underground heist.

details.title: The Chessboard Mystery:47 West Street,Highgate
details.short_description: Step into Highgate a fog-shrouded town in 1956, where a mysterious murder shatters the silence. As a private investigator, explore scenes, gather evidence, and question suspects. Use your evidence board to trace lies, face branching choices, and uncover the hidden truth behind the crime.

details.title: Backstage Football
details.short_description: Manage transfers, staff, and finances like a real sporting director. Backstage Football takes you behind the scenes of professional football. Football isn’t just a game — it’s an empire to build. Take control of the club and decide everything… except the score.

details.title: FOGBOUND
details.short_description: A retro psychological horror game set in a polluted city taken over by toxic fog that hollows out its inhabitants. Place air monitors, hold your breath, and get her out of here.

details.title: GREED
details.short_description: GREED - "roguelite" with "drag-drop" elements and item physics. Сhaos of constantly falling random items and advancing enemies. Create items from a variety of combinations, expand the tower in the upgrade tree, use magic to apply effects, and buy what you need to plan your steps ahead.

details.title: Geometrical
details.short_description: Geometrical is an addictive hybrid of a survivors-like and an incremental endless progression. Face waves of enemies, improve your stats after each round, and get ready to battle a final boss every 7 days. Will you be able to defeat the 5 great bosses?

details.title: Blast Off!
details.short_description: Blast Off is a cute space adventure game. You’ve crash-landed in a tiny, strange solar system with only your trusty magnet gun and a sarcastic robot drone at your side. Explore unique planets, solve magnetic puzzles, and collect the scattered parts of your ship so you can get home!

details.title: Sky Rush
details.short_description: Race as birds down colorful slopes, build speed by sliding smoothly, and compete for best times with friends across diverse worlds like Mushroom, Grass, and Ice. Fun, fast-paced, and all about improving your record.

details.title: 卡恩特村
details.short_description: As war erupts between the Dominion and the Kingdom Iori, from the borderlands, is drawn into the chaos This is a story-driven traditional turn-based RPG, where players embark on an adventure across a war-torn continent, and witness conflicts that will change the fate of the entire world

details.title: Please, Spin
details.short_description: The wheel of fate roguelike where you spin for your life. Customize your wheel, discover game-breaking relics, survive twisted side events, and outsmart rigged bosses to beat the lunatic host and escape the broadcast!

details.title: Dittomatic
details.short_description: A turn-based photocopier roguelike about copying the copy of a copy. Box up stamps, copy them and press them back onto the page. Copies grow stronger, matches fuse and mismatches misprint. Build a page worth printing, then watch the score cascade past quota.

details.title: Unknown Call: Ohio
details.short_description: You wake up in an empty forest in Ohio. A voice calls you. Says you're friends. Says you need to get out. But the signal keeps breaking, and so does your memory. Your friend will guide you from a distance, but he can't save you. Escape the creatures in the dark and find your friend.

details.title: Carouspell
details.short_description: Carouspell is a dark fantasy roguelite bullet heaven where you wield revolving magic to slay hordes of monsters. Spin your Spell Chamber, collect ancient relics and assemble god-slaying combinations to survive the deepest pits of despair.

details.title: Combo Smith
details.short_description: Combo-Smith is a Strategy FPS game where you combine your current weapons to create better ones. Defeat the Opposing team by Creating Crazy Combo's that wipe them all out, The limit is your imagination.

details.title: Phantom Lamb
details.short_description: Play a story-driven third-person psychological thriller set in a sinister early-20th-century asylum where reality bends under the weight of forgotten horrors. Phantom Lamb blends tense stealth gameplay with an immersive narrative of haunting secrets and psychological dread.

details.title: Refuel Together
details.short_description: Run a gas station with 1 to 6 player as Co-Op in Refuel Together. Build a large gas station from a single gas pump. Upgrade and expand your gas station as more cars arrive. Become popular as you meet your customers' demands.

details.title: [REDACTED]
details.short_description: You're a government officer. Documents hit your desk, you scrub out the secrets, and you hope nothing leaks. Miss a word? Maybe it's fine. Miss a few? Well, ██████████. You've got limited ink, limited time, and frankly, limited ████████████. Cheaper than a ████████████.

details.title: Woe Reigns Unending
details.short_description: Lead a cursed party through a ruined world in this grimdark side-scrolling RPG. Build your team, master tactical combat, and unleash forbidden powers to survive an endless parade of nightmares. Decide what, if anything, is worth salvaging from a world that has been reduced to ashes.

details.title: Safety Check YOSHI!
details.short_description: This is a game where you earn points by identifying hazards (near-miss incidents). If you successfully point them out, say, "Safety check, YOSHI!"

details.title: CAT-A-STROPHIC
details.short_description: CAT-A-STROPHIC is a goofy 3D rogue-like city destruction game where you play as Bluu, a colossal kaiju cat, rampaging through different cities to rescue your precious kittens! Embrace the purr-fect blend of chaos and relaxation as you level multiple towns and cities.

details.title: Kanji Grinder
details.short_description: Kanji Grinder is a spaced repetition flashcard system, purpose-built for Steam Deck. Designed for immersion learners who want a no-nonsense way to drill Kanji vocabulary, your daily reviews will be a breeze. Plus, for those who enjoy quiz games or flexing their skills, plenty of challenges await!

details.title: Ping Profit - Internet Tycoon
details.short_description: Run the internet your way. Build infrastructure, control traffic, stop outages, and grow a basement hosting startup into a global powerhouse.

name: Hyper Bun Buster: Rocket Hammer Action

details.title: Hyper Bun Buster: Rocket Hammer Action
details.short_description: Take control of Tess, a bunny girl who uses her huge hammer to send enemies flying into other enemies in this top-down bump combat action game! Dodge projectiles, control space and outmaneuver bosses in Arcade mode or explore dungeons, solve puzzles and unlock abilities in Adventure mode.

details.title: Ghost Merc: Frontlines
details.short_description: A fast-paced, team-based FPS. Engage in intense firefights, coordinate with your clan, and adapt your strategy to dominate the battlefield. Featuring a competitive clan system, objective-based modes, and deep customization, every match is a test of skill and teamwork.

details.title: Potat
details.short_description: Potat is a quirky, physics-based 3D adventure where you play as a sentient potato trying to escape a house before you get cooked alive. Roll, flip, and flop your way through a bizarre home filled with deadly traps, chaotic layouts, and unexpected obstacles.

details.title: Monster Pod Quest
details.short_description: Monster Pod Quest is an experimental creature collector with infinitely many procedurally generated monsters. Create completely unique creatures, build your party and battle through a huge variety of worlds to vanquish the bosses of the land.

details.title: UNDER WORLD
details.short_description: A deck-building roguelite game set in a devastated underground world after the war. Your choices will change your moral and soul, affecting your strategy and rewards. Venture deeper underground in search of the world's truth...

details.title: Vesper's Hunt
details.short_description: A turn-based deduction game where you play as a detective hunting vampires. Use a mirror to reveal hidden beasts and holy water to strike them down. But beware—the undead grow stronger with every attack. Outsmart the vampires… or become their next victim!

details.title: Absolute Cinema
details.short_description: Build your own movie empire! Create blockbusters by combining a huge variety of themes and genres, hire star actors at castings, and develop your studio and technologies. Crazy random events, references to real stars, and lots of humor. Prove that you are the best director! 🎬

details.title: Short Short Fictions
details.short_description: A short short mix tape of one story that connects three shorter stories. On the NewWave, a magical game console that is retro but new, enjoy DON'T SAY YES, TO:NORTH, and a secret tale nobody yet knows. Welcome to a slightly fantastical and nostalgic world of painful, toilful, and beautiful stories!

details.title: Aberrate Inc.
details.short_description: Guide N.T.R.N., a curious little maintenance robot, through cozy logic puzzles by splitting, moving, and combining red and blue boxes to power doors, platforms, and odd office machines. Winner of SXSW Sydney’s Best Student Game Award 2025.

details.title: Banned Together
details.short_description: A queer mystery game about book banning. Play as Ruby (they/them), a journalism major on a surreal, after-hours adventure to investigate the disappearance of books from their college library.

details.title: Ventory
details.short_description: A strange little command line puzzle game for Linux and Windows. Use the items in your inventory and outventory to solve each level and get to the exit.

details.title: 100 Cats Philippines
details.short_description: Find 100 Cats hidden in Philippines! Can you find them all? 😺

details.title: Burning House
details.short_description: This is a game about escape: escape from the inevitable that has caught up with you in a trap of wood and fire! Explore a house that randomly reconfigures itself every time, and with cold calculation, use everything you find in the rooms—but beware of the guests... or drive them out of this world!

details.title: Blemdeck
details.short_description: Ruin your deck to make money and avoid losing points. Start with a deck of playing cards and use stickers to change the value of your hand. Add effects to make more money or to mess with your opponents!

name: レビィのスライムファクトリー

details.title: レビィのスライムファクトリー
details.short_description: なぜかスライムになってしまったししょーを元に戻すため、みならい錬金術師レビィが日夜奮闘！スライムと錬金術の不思議な世界で繰り広げるカラフルで魅力的なパズルゲーム。

details.title: better.game
details.short_description: A game without lag or ping advantage. Client-side customizable. Players can see and hear different things. Moving spherical zone. Build, fight, or just go to zone. Jetpack, glide, grapple, ascend, teleport or drive across the map. Lose, view an instant replay, then reboot and get back in the fight.

details.title: Martian Elevator
details.short_description: Travel the world as a cute ufo and ruin everybody's day! Unlock new methods of mischief in over 30 levels, each with unique setting and objectives. This is an cartoonish UFO simulator!

details.title: Herbalist Roman
details.short_description: Step into the role of a medieval herbalist. Study your herbal book, craft macerations, and help your clients by easing their ailments. Christianity is reaching the Slavic village of Drebor, and your choices will determine whether these changes unfold in peace.

details.title: The Julian
details.short_description: Work at a supermarket, pack groceries into your inventory, and spend your wages on shopping and cooking to survive. Manage satiety and sanity while building friendships that set the story in motion. Your choices lead to multiple endings. A survival simulation fusing puzzle, daily life, and narrative

details.title: Anne & Mary's Hunt for Booty
details.short_description: Anne and Mary's Hunt for Booty is a fast-paced 2D beat 'em up. Play as historical pirates Anne Bonny and/or Mary Read, shoot and slash through the British fleet, and save the cowardly captain from a nasty privateer! Features swashbucklin' beats, local co-op, and art stylized by '90s cartoons.

details.title: Apogee
details.short_description: You wake up in a failing aircraft at 75,000 feet. No memory. No flight log. No rescue coming. Keep systems running and sweep for data to stay airborne. Explore a forgotten network of high-altitude stations and follow a signal that's been waiting forty-one years for someone to listen.

details.title: Type & Magic
details.short_description: Type words to shape your path, solve puzzles, and explore the ruins of a dead wizard’s castle. Find artifacts to uncover the castle’s dark mysteries. Report everything you saw to your master. Or… don’t.

details.title: Slopeside Kings
details.short_description: Slopeside Kings is a multiplayer snowboarding combat racer for up to four players, where you shred the slopes, catch big air, and pull off tricks to build boost. Pickup and use chaotic items along the slopes to battle your way to the finish line!

details.title: Cave Trek
details.short_description: Dig passages, build footholds, and find your way past monsters and traps in CaveTrek, a single-player roguelike platformer. Explore randomized pixel caves, gather treasure, and spend it on supplies. Every shovel use counts. How much will you risk on the way to the exit?

details.title: Blood Vow: Survive the Night
details.short_description: Defend the people of Sodermark from the hordes of darkness. Fight as an army of one, or online with up to four-player PvE multiplayer in this wave-based, action-survival game.

details.title: SANGRA
details.short_description: Classic survival horror with a modern feel. Solve puzzles, search for items, manage your inventory, and pray you'll return to the safe room alive in this decaying twisted facility consumed by a mysterious metallic corruption.

details.title: Cursed Bloodline
details.short_description: A narrative psychological horror where past and present slowly blur inside a remote house. The line between memory and reality is gone.

details.title: VoidWalker: Call of Insomnia
details.short_description: Immerse yourself in the world of dreams and discover its secrets, enjoying every moment thanks to photorealistic graphics

details.title: Break Shot Hero
details.short_description: Collect characters and roll them into billiards-style combat! Recruit conquered foes to build your party, customizing your skills and skins. Balls to the walls action for 1-4 players!

details.title: Hallow Maze
details.short_description: Hallow maze is a soulslike metroidvania set in a gothic world in 2D. Use transformations into different creatures to open your way, as well as incredible tools of energy. Discover the origin of the scourge that is infecting the lands of the Evernight Valley and venture into The Hallow Maze...

details.title: Sci Wars
details.short_description: Sci Wars is an exploration survival shooter set in a hostile alien desert. Use your jetpack, powerful weapons, and scavenged resources to survive deadly creatures and defeat powerful bosses.

details.title: The Grand Planto Heists
details.short_description: The neighborhood will never be the same! Play as a raccoon obsessed with the front gardens of The Grand Planto Heights in this 3D digging adventure, dodging Animal Control with your woodland critter friends and stealing whatever you can scamper away with in your paws & jaws!

details.title: Trick Eight
details.short_description: On a remote village shrouded in bloody tradition, a centuries-old ritual endures. You are a detective with unique skills, yet branded as a traitor. Will you surrender your limbs to ascend like an immortal? Or risk everything at the edge of science and plunge into the abyss of truth?

details.title: INNERWHY
details.short_description: You just dissociated from reality. Unfortunately, the imaginary world you've landed in is as disturbed as your mental state. Gather your courage and confront your darkest thoughts in this 8-bit psychological horror RPG.

details.title: Bloomcraft
details.short_description: Bloomcraft is a Garden Creation Simulator. The player's goal is to create a garden that pleases the Flower Queen. The more the Flower Queen likes the garden, the more money she pays for it every second.

details.title: Loot, Dungeons and Riches
details.short_description: Manage a party of adventurers and delve into the dungeon. As you progress, you will meet new enemies, new gear, a variety of dungeon systems.

details.title: Get It Up!
details.short_description: Can you make it to the top while balancing the stick on your head?ㅤㅤㅤㅤㅤㅤㅤㅤㅤㅤㅤㅤㅤㅤㅤㅤㅤㅤㅤㅤㅤㅤㅤㅤㅤㅤㅤㅤㅤㅤㅤㅤㅤㅤㅤㅤㅤㅤㅤㅤ ㅤㅤ...probably not. It's pretty hard.

details.title: Ramen Crisis
details.short_description: It’s a wacky ramen delivery action game! Hop on your scooter and deliver towering stacks of ramen without toppling them! Hurry up before the soup gets cold!

details.title: Waddle & Rescue
details.short_description: Waddle & Rescue is a sliding puzzle logic 3D game, where you'll take control of Teo the Penguin, a cute but brave adventurer, in his mission to rescue all the lost penguins around the world. Waddle your way across different biomes, sliding and solving puzzles in order to find his lost pals.

details.title: Too Big To Fail
details.short_description: Welcome to the firm. You and your friends get the worst desks in the building and one account between you. Trade, deal, cheat, invest, gamble. The market was made to be exploited. Do well and the firm will be yours, then the world, eventually.

details.title: PhantomZone SemiDeus
details.short_description: "A dragon survivor, a rarity in these times." That's what she called herself. Mysterious, bizarre biographical tales unfold in a retro-futuristic world.

details.title: Saintless
details.short_description: Explore the halls of the underground cult of The Open Hand. Experience the test rooms setup for your initiation in this psychological horror exploration game. Never forget....they are always watching.

details.title: Feodika
details.short_description: Live your own story in a world of the early Middle Ages! Lead a dynasty, expand your domain, help your subjects, and don’t forget to leave an heir! Thy Kingdom Come!

details.title: LIMINAL CAT
details.short_description: A cat wakes up in a beautiful yet eerie world. In search of an exit, it wanders, beginning its lonely adventure. This is an adventure game featuring a cat influenced by various liminal spaces.

details.title: Mini Gears: Mayhem
details.short_description: Mini Gears: Mayhem is a single player Rogue-like where you do the aiming. Take control of a little tank on a blueprint, fighting waves of supposedly evil slimes. Gain experience, level up, and upgrade your tank in each run.

details.title: Breezevale
details.short_description: Start a new life on a forgotten farm. Meet fantastical residents—elf, beastkin, demon, mermaid, ghost, and more! Restore the farm, find love, raise magical creatures, explore dungeons, and uncover the mystery behind the withering World Tree.

details.title: Mini Racer: Mini 4WD
details.short_description: Build, tune, and race Mini 4WD cars in this thrilling sim! Customize motors, tires, and more, design wild tracks, and manage your shop. Race in epic PVE and PVP battles. Inspired by 90s Japanese iconic hobby, it’s a gearhead’s dream. Add to your wishlist now and join the world of Mini 4WD racing!

details.title: Crystal Cub
details.short_description: Crystal Cub is a retro inspired cozy exploration game. Assume the role of Biggie the Bear who stumbles upon a magical library and discovers all of its secrets!

details.title: SIGMA COALESCE: Suika Game Roguelike
details.short_description: "SIGMA COALESCE" is a deck-building puzzle roguelike blending "Suika Game" and "Slay the Spire". Merge same-colored items to launch attacks and activate special effects that unlock powerful synergies to vanquish foes. Explore dungeons brimming with unique items, relics, events, and giant bosses.

details.title: Show Quiz
details.short_description: Show Quiz is a dynamic quiz game that tests your knowledge and reflexes! Chain together questions, climb levels and improve your rank to impress Jack Pot, your supercharged presenter.Over 5000 questions await you in this game!

name: Mech Assembler: Model Kit builder Simulator

details.title: Mech Assembler: Model Kit builder Simulator
details.short_description: Welcome to Mech Assembler, a relaxing puzzle game inspired by model kit (Gunpla) construction. You'll experience the relaxing process of building a model. Once assembled, you can paint it with Spry. Earn points based on your accuracy and unlock new elements.

details.title: Dream Walker
details.short_description: "Dream Walker" is an RPG game that combines survival, scavenging for extraction, and turn-based combat. Every time you explore within the dream, you might acquire valuable treasures, but you could also lose everything.

details.title: Coin War
details.short_description: A new twist on the StS-like genre: the cards you play transform into units on a grid-based board for several turns! Coin War delivers unique mechanics, tactical combat, endless synergies, and immense strategic depth. Craving a new challenge in the StS-like genre? Give this one a try.

details.title: Directive: Intercept
details.short_description: Protect Earth's last cities from an alien fleet in fast-paced aerial combat. Upgrade and customize your aircraft to dominate the skies.

details.title: SPIDER HOTEL
details.short_description: Misfit bugs vs. Giant Spider in an asymmetrical game of tag! Cooperate to survive, or become the spider and hunt! The spider crawls on walls to capture prey. The bugs must rescue friends using teamwork. Escape the trap-filled hotel in a thrilling, hilarious survival game!

details.title: PayGame
details.short_description: 💸《PayGame》is a black-and-white hand-drawn dungeon exploration game.You must race against time through randomly generated rooms, combining items and bills to pay massive amounts of money in order to stay alive.Each run offers a brand-new challenge and a completely different experience

details.title: Mimic Sleuth
details.short_description: No chest is safe in this logic puzzle roguelite! These mimic-filled dungeons are just waiting to be looted... but only the most observant and clever adventurers will make it out alive.

details.title: Pax Astralis
details.short_description: A real-time strategy game in retro vector graphics. Settle an eleven-world star system where no single world can feed an army, ship ore and troops along the orbits, and storm the Imperial Palace on Imperia, throne world of the Empire.

details.title: Inuyo High: Lesson 1
details.short_description: Welcome to Inuyo Academy, an all-ages school once filled with joy. Something terrible happened after the school’s mascot staff was revealed to the public, and it’s your job as an officer to investigate the abandoned building, in search of evidence to figure out the truth.

details.title: SPEEDING
details.short_description: An arcade-style racing game — experience the thrill of speeding on over 30 tracks! Drive over 30 cars and explore over 5 different game modes! Linear difficulty progression, from easy to hard — each stage brings a new challenge.

details.title: Akashic
details.short_description: Akashic is an AI-powered interactive storybook game that blends Roguelite elements with role-playing narrative. Every adventure is unique — driven by AI-generated dialogues and dynamic worldbuilding, where your choices, emotions, and conversations shape the unfolding story.

details.title: CubeMate
details.short_description: Chess meets the Rubik's Cube. Rotate a 3D cube until every face satisfies a chess challenge: check, checkmate, advantage, equality or a classic solve. A 34-level campaign tree from 2×2 to 7×7, Free Play, a Daily puzzle and shareable seeds.

details.title: Bet Shop Simulator
details.short_description: Run the neighborhood betting shop! Print bet slips, count out change and watch the match with your customers. A goal shakes the whole shop, a losing slip gets a TV smashed. Clean up, decorate, expand.

details.title: Salt and Spice
details.short_description: From Mogadishu to Calcutta, master the bustling trade networks of the Indian Ocean during the golden age of maritime commerce.

details.title: Island Core
details.short_description: The Otherworld invasion left one island base standing. You are the Core, a central AI with the personalities of fallen scientists. Mount lasers, saw guns, flamethrowers and drones, and hold the line through snowfield, desert and swamp. Single-player horde defense × character builds.

details.title: Pip sellfish
details.short_description: Catch fish by drawing circles around them, sell them in Pip's little beach shop, and reinvest everything. Fish, sell, upgrade, repeat. A cozy fishing incremental game.

details.title: UGOMEKU NOTE
details.short_description: A world more real than reality itself— It begins to wriggle into life.

details.title: Alt梦魇救赎
details.short_description: Psychiatrist Marine and her assistant Felix make an emergency visit to Egas Psychiatric Hospital for her important patient Edward on Christmas Eve, but they get caught up in a crisis...

details.title: Not My Floor
details.short_description: Not My Floor is a horror game set in the grim stairwell of a Soviet-era apartment block on the outskirts of Kyiv in the early 1990s. After a long shift at the factory, all you want is to get home—but the elevator and the entire building have their own sinister plans, driven by a mysterious entity.

details.title: Stick A Round
details.short_description: Relive the joy of your childhood in Stick A Round! Find uniquely generated sticks that transform into weapons based on their real-world shapes. Battle friends in combat, play action packed or relaxing minigames, and explore a changing world where your imagination sets the rules.

details.title: Mini Shopkeeper
details.short_description: Run your cozy little shop from the bottom of your screen, decorate to attract unique customers, hire assistants, and send adventurers for rare treasures - all in a lively, charming management sim!

details.title: Snatchems
details.short_description: Dive into the pixel-packed universe of 'Snatchems️,' a roguelike first-person shooter where you infiltrate the early internet as a "Snatchems️" megafan, bent on capturing as many goofy characters as possible.

details.title: The Last Waltz
details.short_description: The Last Waltz is a full-scale visual novel about an incredible niche sport; the first visual novel to be based on Dancesport. Featuring Over 30 stunning CGs, a soundtrack of more than 35 pieces of authentic Dancesport music, and integrating real footage of professional dancers and competitions.

details.title: Shadow Dwellers – Deliverance
details.short_description: Deliver, or take it back. An observation-based horror game where you process packages while watching for subtle irregularities in the same apartment building. No correct answers are given. What remains are your decisions—and the recorded “variations.”

details.title: Mr. Cloak
details.short_description: Be the first to explore the uncharted labyrinth beneath the city of Dravaneth as Mr. Cloak. Use stealth and wit to uncover its secrets, evade deadly traps, and chart your own escape route. Every level has multiple exits, unlocking new paths, areas, and dangers in your journey to survive.

details.title: GTL Schedule
details.short_description: In a post-apocalyptic world where food has become contraband and hope is on the brink of extinction, you quietly ignite a revolution to warm the world with a spatula and love.

details.title: COLDNIGHTS
details.short_description: Learn how to survive, craft and build the essentials, find source of food and construct necessary shelter before the snow starts falling. And may be someday, after building a bridge, you will find your way back home. Keep building bridges.

details.title: Vironics
details.short_description: Control a Nanite body from a space station to gather Nanite resources on Earth, seized by a rogue AI. Build and fortify your dropbase with turrets and defenses, fight waves of robotic enemies, and collect Nanites for extraction, balancing fast FPS combat with strategic tower placement.

details.title: Car Rental Simulator
details.short_description: Run your own car rental lot in this detailed simulator. Manage reservations, clean and service vehicles, and keep customers happy. With time-based tasks, strategy elements, and high replayability, every day brings a new challenge.

details.title: Die Robot
details.short_description: Build traps. Fight bots. Survive the waves. Die Robot is a stylized third-person tower defense game where you defend a mysterious Data Seed from waves of robots, the Carbonites. Mix real-time base building with fast-paced combat in a strategic fight for survival.

details.title: Hundredfold: Hero's Ascent
details.short_description: Hero, the hundred-floor abyss awaits. Keep jumping down, dodge enemy attacks, and use special platforms to fight back. No grand prophecy. No complicated mission. Just one hero, one adventure, and 100 floors of monsters to beat.

details.title: Magic Wands Workshop
details.short_description: A unique wand workshop simulator where you can create amazing combinations of wand elements and test their power! Immerse yourself in the world of magic and match wands to your demanding clients.

details.title: Tap Monster: Forest
details.short_description: Welcome to the world of monsters! Tap the screen, fight alongside your monsters, and conquer levels—easy to start, thrilling to master. Get stronger even while lying down!

details.title: Moonstone Resort
details.short_description: Find tranquility in a peaceful farming life while building a cozy hotel for guests. When you're ready for an adventure, explore the depths of the mines, encountering unique creatures and uncovering valuable resources.

details.title: Final Absolution
details.short_description: Final Absolution is an upcoming survival-horror first-person shooter with a focus on exploration, inspired by Super Metroid and Doom. A mysterious force has overtaken the N-Space rocket launch site and corrupted the artificial intelligence that manages the remote island spaceport.

details.title: Destiny Code
details.short_description: Beautiful girls and thrilling card battles, all in one RPG! As factions clash over the relics of a lost civilization, the fate of the world — and your companions — hangs on your choices. A dramatic tale where your strategy and decisions shape destiny!

details.title: Sadko
details.short_description: Monsters are closing in from all sides, and all you've got is a gusli… and the letter O? Dynamic combat with Slavic folk music, hero progression, and building a unique build to take on each location and its boss - so you can finally face Koschei himself.

details.title: The (mis)adventures of Magical Girl Luna
details.short_description: In another world, where magic and technology go hand in hand, lives Luna - a young but formidable magical girl. Raised by the powerful witch Solaire, Luna is about to embark on an incredible adventure, one that will put both her idealistic nature and her starry-eyed view of the world to the test.

details.title: Will O Wisp
details.short_description: This is a platform action game in which you control light in a world shrouded in complete darkness and rely on it to progress. Use the light to travel from place to place and illuminate the buried truth.

details.title: Don't Die, Dummy!
details.short_description: Who knew the secret to robot destruction was the perfect spin kick? Dance now, explain later!

details.title: Magic Cells
details.short_description: A life-or-death war between cells and germs! 20+ bosses lead 100+ minions to invade—cunning, multiplying, mutating, and parasitizing your turf! Summon 24+ magic cells, wield 100+ tech cards to fight back, and harness 9 divine powers to win!

details.title: Deliver Together
details.short_description: In Deliver Together, You control either (or both) of the two trucks attached to the same loooong trailer. And who's driving? Oh, just you. Or you and a friend. Or maybe eight of you, all screaming different directions at once. Your goal is to reach the finish line in chaotic tracks.

details.title: Dark Dungeon Feminized
details.short_description: This FPS game has dark and beautiful art style. A tragic accident turns the strict laboratory into a dark dungeon. You are trying to escape from here with wisdom and strategy, and discover its unknown dark secrets.（Has Customizable female villain with costume damage）

details.title: The Mirrion
details.short_description: Dive into a harsh open world where every choice can mean the difference between life and death. Explore untamed lands, build shelters, hunt, craft tools, and defend yourself from threats. Nature, weather, and unexpected events will test your will to survive.

details.title: SuperHookGirl Ultra Challenge!!
details.short_description: Soar through the skies with your mouse! Experience high-speed hook-swinging action in Super Hook Girl Ultra Challenge!! Simple controls — but tough to master! Hook onto anything to discover shortcuts and advanced movement techniques!

details.title: LATITUDE OF THE CULT
details.short_description: Christmas Eve, 1997. A Michigan town sells its Dogman legend to tourists. It never speaks of the cult , or the song beneath the frozen lake. This winter, all three came back. Seventeen walked into the fog and never returned. The sheriff has vanished. Survive the night. Find out what the town buried.

details.title: Kumori Village
details.short_description: Shine your flashlight into the darkness and navigate a survival horror experience where you must evade monsters. Use, equip, and combine randomly spawned items to uncover the village's mysteries and survive.

details.title: SEALAND 2124
details.short_description: Sealand 2124 is a story-driven adventure puzzle game that takes you to a utopian city on the ocean. Join Anja and her clever albino magpie, solve challenging puzzles, and uncover the secrets of a world that blends hope and danger.

details.title: Uagi-Saba 2
details.short_description: Uagi-Saba 2 is a creature care/breeder sim. Raise cute creatures called Faelings all with their own brain, genes and unique body parts. Guide them through beautiful hand drawn environments using speech and positive/negative reinforcement. Breed your favorites and create the perfect creature!

details.title: Terrestrial planet
details.short_description: On a planet with a biome climate similar to Earth, manage your residents from basic construction and planting, develop and research various cutting-edge technologies, recruit soldiers to form troops, resist foreign enemies or actively conquer other countries, and unify this distant planet.

details.title: Tank Core
details.short_description: "Tank Core" is a 2D top-down shooter game infused with Roguelike elements. Players will collect various random tank components in levels, including turrets, chassis, shells, modules, and cores, to assemble unique tanks that will protect base and defeat all enemies encountered.

details.title: Cyber Arena
details.short_description: You are being attacked by the virus. SURVIVE AS LONG AS POSSIBLE !!

details.title: Grotto Escape
details.short_description: You play as a SF character facing Heroic Fantasy creatures in this Dungeon Crawler with Platformer gameplay.

details.title: SWT: Survivor With Towers
details.short_description: Fusion of Vampire Survivors Like and Tower Defense! Survive with Towers against waves of enemies. Build towers by day, survive endless enemy waves by night. Expand your territory, gain experience, and grow stronger with each battle. How long can you survive?

details.title: Eclipsed Realms
details.short_description: Journey through fractured realms in a rich, immersive world. Solve intricate puzzles, battle deadly foes, and uncover lost lore. Teleport between parallel realities to alter environments, unlock secrets, and conquer challenges across shifting, surreal landscapes.

details.title: Celestial Lumina
details.short_description: Forge your own path by finding temporary tools or permanent abilities. Celestial Lumina is a 2D Pixel-Art Metroidvania where you ascend from the depths as the heir of a fallen underworld, to awaken radiant abilities & uncover the truth behind a heavenly world full of dystopian secrets.

details.title: Overland Journey
details.short_description: Drive cars or trucks across uncharted terrain, manage fuel and supplies, carry as many resources as possible to upgrade your vehicle, and explore deeper into the wild.

details.title: A Baby CEO?!
details.short_description: A struggling book company has decided to hire you, a baby, to be the new CEO? All you need to do is manage the budget, keep the company brand strong and make the employees happy. You can't talk? No problem! Give a thumbs up or down and try your best.

details.title: Moonlight Cradle
details.short_description: This is a traditional simulation management and raising game with multiple endings featuring beautiful girls.

name: Something is Wrong with the Library

details.title: Something is Wrong with the Library
details.short_description: Shelve hundreds of real books in a library haunted by blood and meat. A spooky narrative organizing simulator by the studio behind I Am Your Beast and Clickolding.

details.title: Shogi: AI’s Forbidden Move
details.short_description: A groundbreaking shogi game created entirely without a game engine. From rule design to thinking algorithms, everything has been conceived and built by AI. Experience a unique worldview and gameplay that sets it apart from any shogi game before.

details.title: Investment Fund Game
details.short_description: Investment Fund Game is a singleplayer sandbox simulation where you become the manager of an investment fund. Buy stocks, bonds, commodities. Test different investment strategies, track your performance, and compete with AI-driven funds using their own approaches.

details.title: Bar Master
details.short_description: Bar Master is a management game where you play as a bar owner and must develop your business. Start by serving beers in a simple bar, hire waiters, unlock new drinks, expand your bar, and buy new bars in the city!

details.title: 模拟修仙录
details.short_description: 《模拟修仙录》是一款修仙题材的策略构筑游戏。穿越获得无限模拟金手指的你，将利用系统随机提供的天材地宝、流派秘法及修仙百艺，一步步积累真元、修炼突破，构筑独属于自己的修炼法门，最终证道长生！

details.title: Midnight Dies Y2K
details.short_description: It’s December 31st, 1999. As the Devil’s daughter, you’ve been dared to stop your dad’s plan to take over the world before midnight. Solve wacky problems, collect bizarre items, and choose carefully—your decisions shape the ending!

details.title: Check My Papers
details.short_description: 2027. One year since the superpowers’ standoff came to a head. The nuclear winter has lifted, but people still hide in bunkers, afraid of the radiation. Who gets a new home—and who is cast out into the wastes? Lives are in your hands, Captain.

details.title: Paradise Beyond the Nightmare
details.short_description: "Paradise Beyond the Nightmare" is a 2D exploration horror game where you explore and solve puzzles in a 2D space with depth. You can experience moving both sideways and forwards through eerie paintings.

details.title: 和平东京
details.short_description: This is an anti-war themed destruction game. Our goal is world peace! To achieve this great mission, we must first establish peace in Tokyo!

details.title: Isometric House Builder
details.short_description: A cozy 2D isometric building game with pixel art style. Follow blueprints to place blocks and construct houses step by step. Balance accuracy and creativity as you complete foundations, walls, and roofs, turning simple plans into charming pixel-art homes.

details.title: Nitrania
details.short_description: Race. Boost. Unlock. A blazing-fast 90s-inspired arcade grip racer with 4-player split-screen. Master nitro to overtake 19 rivals, collect points, and unlock cars, upgrades, and vibrant track regions. Featuring an original soundtrack by the legendary retro racing composer BARRY LEITCH.

details.title: Emoji Guess Party
details.short_description: Think you can guess the answer from a few emojis? Emoji Guess Party is a lighthearted emoji puzzle game filled with idioms, wordplay, internet slang, and brain-teasing riddles. Play solo or guess together with friends.

details.title: Carte Blanche
details.short_description: Carte Blanche is an original adventure and card game in a fantastic world with the style of Japanese animes. Travel the world in search of the Cards. Collect them, develop them to participate in the Tournaments of the game. Discover the fabulous story of two children who love each other.

details.title: Deep Claims
details.short_description: Deep Claims is a space exploration game where you upgrade your ship and equipment in order to mine increasingly valuable and hazardous asteroids. Can you make it to the core?

details.title: 白銀のユークロニア
details.short_description: ”Silver Eucronia” is an exploration RPG where you wander through a post-apocalyptic world covered in white. Through interactions with allies, world exploration, and deadly battles against threats, you will witness the conclusion of your own world and carve out the future beyond.

details.title: Tokyo Supplier
details.short_description: As a post robot in a future Tokyo under lockdown, deliver packages under pressure. Dodge blockades and hostile bots, beat the clock, and unlock skins for your bot, dog companion, and delivery van.

details.title: Escape from Ruin: Greymart Simulator
details.short_description: A post-apocalyptic loot-fight-extract survival game with escape-style raids by day and black-market shop management by night. Fans of Tarkov-like gameplay — and players who love running management sims — will feel right at home.

details.title: Protocol Paradox
details.short_description: Protocol Paradox is a fast-paced roguelike shooter blending twin-stick combat, anomaly-based weapons and branching lore. Survive procedural sectors, customize builds with weapons and passives, face concept-driven bosses, and replay for new revelations.

details.title: Legal Beagll: Justice is Argued
details.short_description: Legal Beagll: Justice is Argued is a courtroom simulation RPG where every trial is a battle of wits. You’ll take on the role of Harold Beagll, a golden retriever attorney navigating a legal system filled with sharp-tongued rivals, eccentric clients, and unpredictable witnesses.

details.title: SPARK! -PHOTON BLAST-
details.short_description: "SPARK! -PHOTON BLAST-" is a sports action game where players face off in a futuristic stadium, rendered with stunningly beautiful photorealistic graphics. Your goal is to score by launching a sphere into your opponent's goal. Enjoy the heart-pounding, high-octane action where every second counts!

details.title: The Bone Dancer's Bane
details.short_description: A 700,000-word epic fantasy interactive novel.

details.title: Night Portable
details.short_description: Night Portable is a night-shift survival horror set in a used game store. Clean, restock, and hide from ■■■ until 6 AM. Play three retro handheld games and cash out for items—or risk losing them. Manage light, noise, and resources as a side-scrolling adventure uncovers the past behind the curse.

details.title: Trivia Fantasy
details.short_description: TRIVIA FANTASY is a trivia-based adventure with RPG progression. Crawl your way through a decayed tower filled with forgotten knowledge and defeat the dying deity that that awaits at the summit!

details.title: Frog Odyssey
details.short_description: A turn-based strategic auto-battler where you buy ingredients, craft special dishes, and feed them to your frog adventurers to unlock powerful bonuses! Embark on a heroic journey to confront those causing chaos across the realm.

details.title: TomaDO!
details.short_description: TomaDO! is a fast, quirky multiplayer platformer where tomato heroes race through floating obstacle courses, dodge hazards, and respawn at checkpoints. Jump, dash, and explore golf and other modes to reach the finish first.

details.title: Demondemon Demon Tamer
details.short_description: Demondemon Demon Tamer combines swarm-survivor and monster raising. Manage, take care, and train your demons during the day. Survive the swarm of attacking demons at night. Raise your reputation among three factions of demon tamers, and unravel their hidden motives in this doomed city, Laknakarta.

details.title: Devoid
details.short_description: Devoid is an immersive journey into the medieval world of vampires who feed on human souls. You will have to put an end to their power with the help of sword and magic. Use an arsenal of tools and magical abilities on your way to defeat the most ancient evil.

name: Rare Metal War: The sins of memory

details.title: Rare Metal War: The sins of memory
details.short_description: Iron beasts. Furry heroes. One last hope. In a world where humanity has fallen, unlikely saviors rise from the animal kingdom. Strap into your customized mech, unleash devastating firepower, and fight through endless waves of enemies in this action-packed survivor roguelike.

details.title: Project Damascus
details.short_description: A first person adventure platformer, focused on exploration with time based mechanics and puzzle elements. Enter the ruins of the Kingdom of Pharygia. Swiftly traverse its dillapidated, intricate infrastructure to delve further into the depths of iniquity, in order to cast light on hidden truths.

details.title: Bring Me Home
details.short_description: A small point and click game about helping a dog to get back home.

details.title: BONEMARROW
details.short_description: BoneMarrow is a short action survival horror in which you play a mutant creature created in a lab, destined to be used as a test subject. When the facility you were created in falls into disarray due to the meddling of a dark cult, you finally have your opportunity to escape.

details.title: ENTRY_13
details.short_description: ENTRY_13 is a psychological horror experience inspired by Backrooms lore. Explore its meta, multi-layered narrative, and its procedural, ever-changing maps. Track your way in, find your way out. Survive the encounters.

details.title: Spooky Lord
details.short_description: Become the Lord of Fear! Command a team of spooky spirits, each with unique powers, to haunt or outwit humans in this tactical ghost game. Choose your approach, master your minions, and control the world of the living!

details.title: Paccarat
details.short_description: The 10-rats-in-a-trenchcoat roguelike deckbuilder. Recruit a rag-tag team of rats, craft a curated deck for each, and discover devastating multi-deck combos. Build your team & masterfully pilot multiple unique decks to take down increasingly difficult enemies.

details.title: This Is Not A Dungeon
details.short_description: TINAD is a unique tower defense game where you defend your retirement home from overeager heroes. Play as the dungeon itself. Deploy traps, summon minions, and prove you’re just trying to enjoy your golden years in peace against heroes who can’t read the sign and assume every dungeon is evil.

details.title: Crime & Anomaly
details.short_description: Fight to keep your mind in the shadow of crime and the unknown. Crime & Anomaly is an indie psychological horror that drags you through the dark corridors of 1860s Saint Petersburg. Inspired by Dostoevsky’s Crime and Punishment, every creaking floorboard and flicker of light can shatter your sanity.

details.title: Warrior Is Just Going
details.short_description: There is no retreat. It is a game that tells the story of a mysterious journey of a warrior who only moves forward.

details.title: Multitales: Hood, Gun & Contraband
details.short_description: Red Riding Hood takes up a shotgun and explosive pies to find her missing father. Beneath the bright fairytale lies a dark story of fear, betrayal, and choices made when there’s nothing left to lose.

details.title: Pledged to a Princess
details.short_description: A cute and wholesome yuri visual about a young princess, Katarina Mikhailovna Vassilieva, who (finally!) gets to meet her online friend and fellow anime fan, Audrey McMahon. Is the power of cute girls enough to bring a princess and a pauper together?

details.title: Spheromania
details.short_description: Bounce, blast, and outlast in Spheromania. A fast-paced arena shooter where drones duel with blasters, mines, and mid-air hops. Manage your energy, dodge the shrinking arena, and be the last sphere hovering. Solo mode or online multiplayer.

details.title: A Service Call
details.short_description: Your first assignment alone. An island where no one has lived for thirty years. A lighthouse that stopped shining. The job was only supposed to take a few hours.

name: フリと忘れじの都 -FRI the Unforgettable City-

details.title: フリと忘れじの都 -FRI the Unforgettable City-
details.short_description: An adventure game where your choices change the world. Fri, a girl working at a coffee workshop, lives in a town that feels strangely mysterious. What will she encounter in this town while suffering from amnesia, and how will the world changing?

details.title: HOTLIME
details.short_description: Chaotic PvP party game for 2–4 players. Citrus fighters battle to the death in a hellish skyscraper — one hit decides everything. Escape, if the bartender lets you!

details.title: DIVINE CRAFTING WORKSHOP
details.short_description: Ancient China handcraft sim with shadow puppet art & multiple endings. As a craftsman, take orders, craft works, unlock dynasty stories. Full version: 7 dynasties, 28 categories, 110+ collectible handicrafts, 300+ event/40+ main endings, 50+ panda events & letters—immerse in traditional crafts.

details.title: Terrafarmer
details.short_description: A roguelite farming strategy game where every tile matters. Choose from randomly offered polyomino crop tiles, arrange them for powerful synergies, and terraform a dead planet before your debt catches up.

details.title: Chibi Engine
details.short_description: Make your desktop a lively place with cute chibi characters. Pet them, talk to them, give them gifts, and decorate your workspace with image or GIF stickers. Join our community on Steam Workshop to share your own characters and discover what others create

details.title: Wild Wordopia
details.short_description: Language x roguelike. The incarnations of an ancient language (Proto-Indo-European) that is said to have existed about 6,000 years ago are reborn as "Wild Words"!

details.title: Lushlands Adventure
details.short_description: Reach the finish without being seen in a cozy top-down stealth puzzle adventure. Sneak past guards, use distractions, push objects, and explore colorful pixel-art areas from farms and forests to caves and snowy villages.

details.title: ObeyE
details.short_description: In ObeyE, you will play the role of a [Fake] New-Order priest. Roguelike combat, build your fortifications while planting magical plants. Craft and shoot all the Enemy you see!

details.title: FalseGods Gambit
details.short_description: "FalseGod's Gambit" is a Roquelike deck-building game (DBG) infused with our unique ideas, set against a backdrop of Norsemytholoay, Plavers will step into the boots of veteran soldier Rod, embarking on his final mission before retirement!

details.title: 秋之轻语
details.short_description: VN.Your neighbor died in a fall — yet the very next day, she appeared inside your mind, as if an unseen hand were pulling every string. Everything feels dreamlike, unreal. You seem to have boarded a train that accelerates beyond control; in the chaos, you clutch at something — perhaps the truth.

details.title: HEMA. Humetal Era Morphose Arms
details.short_description: 《HEMA》is a Character Action Game Mixing with 2D Metroidvania. Beating the AI-Robot army – Humetal with Stylish Combo Combat !! Explore the Humetal Base and Discover Hidden Sub-Gadget And equipment !! Beat the Boss to Upgrade your Character to perform more Flashy Combat Skill !!

name: Ragnar’s Quest: Return of the Hero

details.title: Ragnar’s Quest: Return of the Hero
details.short_description: The game centered around Ragnar Lothbrok, a legendary Viking hero. Players assume the role of Ragnar, who has been reborn by Odin’s order to fulfill a divine quest. Ragnar embarks on a journey filled with discoveries, battles, and encounters with mythical creatures.

details.title: Adrenaline Overdrive
details.short_description: In this retro-styled FPS, tear through an alternate 1980s Brooklyn as a vengeful detective enhanced by experimental drugs. Master supernatural movement abilities, and uncover the truth behind your brother's murder - before the power that drives you becomes your doom.

details.title: Goblin Lair: Shards of Magic
details.short_description: Goblin Lair its a fast-paced strategic clicker! Smash your mouse like a maniac to gather crystals! Manage your resources wisely, recruit goblins, build your base and strengthen your warriors. Expand your base, enhance your clicks or automate your miners as you fend off relentless enemy raids!

details.title: Backframes: Escape Together
details.short_description: Backframes: Escape Together is a cooperative horror game for 1–4 players. Explore dark levels, solve dangerous puzzles, and escape from sinister entities. Use your voice to interact with objects, uncovering unexpected paths to survival.

details.title: Looters Inc.
details.short_description: Looters Inc is a physics-based co-op heist game. Break into houses, clinics and banks with your friends. And steal the most valuable items you can find. But be careful, the residents are violent, maybe even more violent than you.

details.title: Ember of Origins
details.short_description: Ember of Origins is a dark fantasy 2D side-scrolling pixel action shooter. Explore the ruins of a world consumed by infernal flames, scavenge resources, upgrade powerful weapons, and battle demonic hordes as you embark on a dangerous journey to rescue your missing companion.

details.title: Songs of the Shore
details.short_description: Explore a mysterious island full of musical shells and secrets to discover in this point-and-click 3D collectathon. Immerse yourself in an ambient and serene soundtrack which is remixed as you collect more shells.

details.title: Stone of Adventure
