details.short_description: Fuse CCGs, roguelikes, and hex-grid tactics. Scavenge cards & artifacts. Master the interactive battlefield: topple trees onto foes and shove them off cliffs. Your clashes bridge shattered worlds to avert catastrophe. Forge your path home!

details.title: Trauma Record
details.short_description: 夜を歩く、血だまりの上を走る、永遠を断ち切る。 復讐のための翼は折れない。

details.title: RitualRX
details.short_description: RitualRX is a brutally violent, blisteringly fast, adrenaline-filled shooter set within a pastel paradise ruled by cults. Control excommunicated sinners as you shoot, slash, and slaughter your way through a city where ritual is prescribed and the only treatment administered is an overdose of lead.

details.title: 02:17 AM
details.short_description: A remote forest lookout fell silent at 02:17 AM. Follow the missing keeper’s trail, restore the radio and piece together the clues in an atmospheric first-person mystery. No combat or jump scares.

details.title: Ponchorado
details.short_description: Ponchorado is a satirical Wild West survival-action game with roguelite elements in a 1930s cartoon style, set in the ruins of a never-finished western movie. Play as Poncho, a forgotten stuntman battling through chaos, clichés, and caricatures.

details.title: KAL
details.short_description: KAL is a first-person psychological horror game. Trapped in an old, abandoned Creole house, immerse yourself in a time loop and relive the story of a slave who became a true legend.

details.title: Buff Climbers
details.short_description: Physics-driven rogue-like platformer for you and your friends. Each run brings new hazards, fresh loot, and betrayal. Buff Climbers is in early development. Please excuse the lack of polish.

details.title: Homelander’s Valor
details.short_description: Become a hero of Eastern legend. Explore ancient secrets, plan your defenses, combine tower types and modifiers, and build an indestructible fortress in a tower-defence game with survival elements.

details.title: Cairns
details.short_description: Balance. Patience. Perfection. Cairns is the quintessential Stone Stacking game. Experience diverse and atmospheric environments, and master the art of building the freestanding stone towers know as Cairns.

details.title: Meow Recruit
details.short_description: Meow Recruit is a casual strategy game where you play as HR in an animal company. Recruit employees, arrange workstations, optimize your team, and build facilities to maximize company's profits. Are you the real HR master?

details.title: Versalis
details.short_description: A fast-paced, grid-based, card-flipping tactical CCG for up to 4 players! Archetypes and team Dynamics bring powerful abilities to move, defend, swap, or reorient cards. Capture the board and flip your way to victory!

details.title: Chain Corp
details.short_description: A roguelike deckbuilder about hunting for CEOs. Survive the endless hordes of CHAIN CORP. Collect the rarest cards and combos for future runs.

details.title: Cyberpunk Crafter
details.short_description: A cyberpunk open world crafting simulator, immerse yourself in a neon-lit city of your own design. Vibe out while unlocking your way to a spaceport and win your freedom on the interstellar stage.

details.title: WingWhiz
details.short_description: WingWhiz brings classic arcade shoot 'em ups into 3D with roguelite progression. Destroy everything in your path, level up, build your plane, unlock new weapons and planes, and try different playstyles as you fight through new worlds.

details.title: PanzenTD
details.short_description: A charming tower defense game where heroic panda warriors defend their homeland against waves of destructive robots. Build towers, deploy unique heroes, and outsmart your enemies across stylized jungle battlefields.

details.title: Built Brick by Brick
details.short_description: A life simulation and construction game set in rural Argentina. You start with a plot of land and the idea of your dream home. Work to earn money and achieve your goals.

details.title: GrappleBurger
details.short_description: GrappleBurger is a high-management cooking game where multitasking is the only way to get your orders out. Master the chaos of the kitchen as you fry, blend, grill, and craft your way up the leaderboards! Do you have what it takes to be a top chef?

details.title: Threshold 15
details.short_description: Threshold 15 is an atmospheric mix of anomaly hunting and escape-room puzzles set in a looping bunker hallway. Identify disturbances and piece together an unsettling story as each loop pulls you deeper into the mystery. You will sign the contract.

details.title: The Embassy
details.short_description: Uncover the secrets of a government building that mysteriously still has power weeks after total societal collapse. This short narrative-driven horror game is a prequel for a DayZ map mod.

details.title: 100 Astro Cats
details.short_description: 🐾 Join the cutest adventure in themed locations full of cats! 😻 Explore the charming hand-drawn artwork of special places and try to find 100 adorable cats hidden throughout the game. 🐈🕵️‍♂️ Can you find them all? 🕵️‍♂️🐈

details.title: 100 Barcelona Cats
details.short_description: 🐾 Join the cutest adventure in themed locations full of cats! 😻 Explore the charming hand-drawn artwork of special places and try to find 100 adorable cats hidden throughout the game. 🐈🕵️‍♂️ Can you find them all? 🕵️‍♂️🐈

details.title: 100 Lisbon Cats
details.short_description: 🐾 Join the cutest adventure in themed locations full of cats! 😻 Explore the charming hand-drawn artwork of special places and try to find 100 adorable cats hidden throughout the game. 🐈🕵️‍♂️ Can you find them all? 🕵️‍♂️🐈

details.title: 100 Amsterdam Cats
details.short_description: 🐾 Join the cutest adventure in themed locations full of cats! 😻 Explore the charming hand-drawn artwork of special places and try to find 100 adorable cats hidden throughout the game. 🐈🕵️‍♂️ Can you find them all? 🕵️‍♂️🐈

details.title: Varslo Tactics
details.short_description: Prove your worth as a commander in this turn-based tactical game with RPG elements! Level up your units to unlock traits and abilities to specialize their tactical usage. Fight to survive as war erupts across the continent!

details.title: Over the Radio
details.short_description: Local co-op game about flying a plane. One player is the pilot, the other the navigator. The pilot has no map. The navigator guides the pilot using only words. Work together to reach your goal in a remixable national park map.

details.title: Optix: Cinematography Masterclass
details.short_description: Optix is a virtual workshop and sandpit that teaches you key concepts and techniques in lighting, camera, and composition. Play through 29 interactive lessons, design shots for clients in endless procedurally-generated scenarios, or experiment freely by building your own scenes from scratch!

details.title: Rogue's Odyssey
details.short_description: Explore, Grind, Loot, Die, and repeat! Face hordes of monsters and challenging bosses in a 2.5D co-op roguelike ARPG. Combine skills across classes, creating thousands of unique builds, such as a potion-brewing Warrior or a wizardry Cat, the choice is yours!

name: The Last Tape: Before The Mine

details.title: The Last Tape: Before The Mine
details.short_description: Mia Jane disappeared in 1990 during a camping trip. Years later, Gabriel finds her recording while searching for a cure for her infection at the Lurmont facility. Explore two timelines, uncover the hidden truth, and survive the presence that lurks in the shadows of Black Wood.

details.title: MonsterGirl 3:Wukong
details.short_description: "Monster Girl 3: Wukong" is an interactive narrative game that combines strategic battles with branching storylines. Collect various mystic elixirs for trading, and unlock enchanting demoness characters to keep as desktop companions.

details.title: Cyan Breach
details.short_description: Cyan Breach is a 2D action RPG set in a post-apocalypse world with classic Castlevania-like combat and exploration. Explore the intersected game world map, defeat enemies, gain unique weapons, skills and items, increase character's power, and finally reveal the secret that caused the apocalypse.

details.title: The Legend of Simurgh
details.short_description: You are a small bird traveling through 7 valleys to find the Simurgh and bring life back to your village.

details.title: Dungeon Directive
details.short_description: You’ve taken over the guild hall in the center of town near a mysterious dungeon portal. With a small roster of heroes and limited resources, it’s your job to rebuild the guild, send parties into the depths, and shape a legacy that lasts for generations. What future will your choices create?

details.title: PONG EMOTIONAL
details.short_description: Legendary classic game "PONG" returns with stunning visuals and emotionally stirring sound! A high-performance AI precisely predicts the ball's trajectory and counters with calculated moves. If you can clear STAGE 30, you're a true super player!

details.title: Aerosurge
details.short_description: Perform daring aerial stunts, destroy your enemies and weave through hazardous environments to complete your missions before the time runs out! Upgrade your weapons and abilities between objectives, before taking out enemies across a variety of landscapes and planets

details.title: Finally a Florist
details.short_description: Finally a Florist is a cozy, slice-of-life game where you gather flowers to arrange beautiful bouquets. Explore peaceful landscapes, befriend animals, and fill heartfelt requests from the local villagers as you finally become a florist.

details.title: Phantom Containment
details.short_description: Survive the Planet, a massive open-world containment world filled with dangerous entities, anomaly outbreaks, hostile factions, and hidden secrets. Build, investigate, scavenge, and uncover the truth behind an experiment that never ended.

details.title: Runaway Rumble
details.short_description: Runaway Rumble is a fast-paced PvP action-sports game where players chase or escape using parkour and powerful abilities. Set in multiverse arenas, each character brings unique powers and style. Run. Chase. Rumble!

details.title: Kui & Chai: Evolution Survivors
details.short_description: Kui and Chai is a single human survivor game that collects various materials, strengthens itself, defeats evolving enemies, and perseveres until the last moment, perhaps knowing the truth of everything.

details.title: Dungeon Manager
details.short_description: This is a PVE auto Battler! Right after graduating from the management school but before getting degree certificate, you are snatched away by a red dragon and forced to be a dungeon manager. You need to fighting against the invaders of the evil empire together with the cute creatures in the dungeon.

details.title: Codename Sunday
details.short_description: A top-down, fast paced hero shooter. Kill tanks to upgrade yourself and become an undefeatable killing machine. Fight friends or foes in multiple engaging gamemodes and become the best of your kind.

details.title: Terragoat
details.short_description: Take up the responsibilities of terraforming an entire planet through a newfangled technological invention which could be roughly surmised as putting a goat inside of a pocket dimension to generate a potentially infinite amount of energy.

details.title: ASTROBURROW
details.short_description: Embark on an epic journey through uncharted galaxies. Build new space civilizations, and fight for the future of the species in this pixel art space strategy game.

details.title: Late Night Empire
details.short_description: Run your own late-night TV show in a living entertainment industry. Book guests, write monologues, manage staff and money, battle rival shows for ratings, and survive your network. Every night is a fight for attention. Build the show. Run the room. Become the empire.

details.title: Obitus
details.short_description: Obitus is a multiplayer survival game where players are thrown into a hostile wilderness. Scavenge weapons, avoid traps, and eliminate your rivals – only one survives. Inspired by The Hunger Games, with tactics, tension, and a fight to the death.

details.title: ChildStory 2: Say Cheese!
details.short_description: Say Cheese is a farmer simulator with roguelike elements, in which Sonya will not only develop her own cheese factory, but also find out the reason why everyone in the city has nightmares at night.

details.title: Drinking Medieval
details.short_description: You are a simple peasant living in medieval times, working for your feudal lord. One day, you discover the recipe for brewing beer. This changes your life - improve your brewing skills, unlock new sales channels, and expand your product across growing territories.

details.title: Atrum
details.short_description: Atrum is a dark fantasy, third-person roguelike where you play as a powerful mage descending into darkness. Fight challenging enemies and bosses across corrupted realms and collect magical items to shape your build before the darkness consumes you.

details.title: TheDowsing / ダウジング
details.short_description: You have entered a sealed gold mine, dreaming of a fortune. All you can rely on is your dowsing rod. Is it gold that lies beyond your reaction, or is it......?

details.title: TwinGrip
details.short_description: TwinGrip is a twin-stick physics-based puzzle-platformer video-game. That's a lot of hyphens. Control each leg of your vessel individually with a controller, or both at the same time with the mouse! Master this unique control scheme and find your way home!

details.title: The Great Hatch
details.short_description: Help goblins take down a giant floating egg

details.title: Space Revolver
details.short_description: SPACE REVOLVER is a puzzle adventure game that follows the journey of a protagonist caught in a catastrophic black hole accident. With your spaceship critically damaged, you must explore uncharted planets, solve puzzles, repair your ship, and find your way back home.

details.title: The Last Worlds : Crossed Souls
details.short_description: 3D Action Open World RPG set on the alien planet Ness-444. Explore this world on the brink of ruin with your inseparable companion Lupio. Fight or tame countless nessky, fantastic creatures now blinded by darkness. Survive to learn the truth of this world and find out where other like you have gone.

details.title: Bully Ball Brigade
details.short_description: Simple mini games for all, roguelike for the experienced.

details.title: Chibi Ninja Shino-kun 2
details.short_description: The Chibi Ninja is back! Use your ninja skills to run up walls and along ceilings, launch yourself around with your hookshot, and kick demon butts inspired by Japanese folklore!

details.title: Lode Builder
details.short_description: Lode Builder is the evolution of the classic Lode Runner. Collect all the gold using new tactical tools. Need to climb? Build a ladder. Pit ahead? Stretch a chain. Tired of Robots? Burn them ALL! Gather resources across the map and don't waste a single one.

name: ザワークラウトの中で自転車を漕ぐ

details.title: ザワークラウトの中で自転車を漕ぐ
details.short_description: Juvenile/Suspense Visual Novel Heading Towards Decadence

details.title: Star Life
details.short_description: Star Life is a space sandbox RPG where you start on a planet and carve your own path. Develop skills through "learn by doing," influence dynamic economies, schedule your life with the "Life Planner," and face the challenges of space. Balance risk and survival in a universe shaped by your choices.

details.title: ARES 2192
details.short_description: A sci-fi, open world racing adventure where you bond with your vehicle's AI while facing the extreme conditions of a planet Mars being violently reshaped by terraforming. Master physics-defying racing, build your reputation in illegal races, and explore to uncover the secrets of ARES 2192.

details.title: Alpa
details.short_description: Alpa is a narrative adventure game blending atmospheric exploration, emotional storytelling, and puzzle-solving across the journey of three intertwined souls.

details.title: Nightmare Diver
details.short_description: "Nightmare Diver" is a roguelite shooting game where a rubber duck dives into the world of nightmares to save a young girl from her bad dreams, defeating enemies along the way.

details.title: Project Leo
details.short_description: Advanced physics based rally racing game. Set in Englands' picturesque countryside, rally through highly detailed beautiful english rally stages and test your mettle on dirt, gravel and asphalt surfaces.

details.title: Clayground
details.short_description: Welcome to Clayground—the next-gen multiplayer VR experience where imagination knows no bounds! Whether you're a VR veteran or stepping into virtual reality for the first time, Clayground invites you to a playground like no other.

details.title: 五维介质：重生（Medium5: Rebirth）
details.short_description: "Medium5: Rebirth" is an AVG produced by Beichen, also the first MEDIUM5 fan game with a complete world view. Through QTE and other game-play interspersed in the plot, players will experience a journey on "Shulv Planet". This game will show you the charm and another possibility of MEDIUM5.

details.title: Last Survivor: Day on Earth
details.short_description: Blast through endless waves of enemies and evolve into an unstoppable force! This chaotic roguelike shooter lets you survive solo or in 2–4 player co-op, where every upgrade choice shapes your build in a battlefield swarming with monsters.

details.title: Riftveil
details.short_description: A dark fantasy rogue-lite action RPG with adaptive difficulty, dual parry combat, and structured runs full of brutal enemies and boss fights.

details.title: Supermarket Simulator Deluxe
details.short_description: Pizza Clicker is an Incremental Idle Game! Build the ultimate pizza empire! Click pizzas, earn slices, buy upgrades, automate production, and grow from a small pizzeria into a massive pizza making machine.

details.title: Leyline Chronicles 2
details.short_description: A JRPG with a dynamic, action-oriented tactical battle system and a diverse cast of unique characters, featuring a multi-world-spanning storyline that brings the epic saga of Leyline Chronicles to its grand conclusion.

details.title: Forestless
details.short_description: Forestless is an atmospheric, high-speed 3D action-adventure. Journey through a world of inner doubts armed with the Arrow of Hope: ignite lanterns in full stride to gain momentum, traverse procedural mazes of memory, and shatter the shackles of negative beliefs.

details.title: Console Dealer Simulator
details.short_description: A store simulator game where you manage your own game shop by buying and selling console games. Manage inventory, meet customer needs, and expand your shop. Playable in single-player or multiplayer mode.

details.title: Basefall
details.short_description: A competitive multiplayer strategy game blending lane combat and dynamic upgrades. Spawn units, unlock spells, and create insane build synergies to destroy the enemy castle.

details.title: Corpse Burger
details.short_description: Grind humans into “tofu” burgers, keep your customers hooked, and fight or avoid twisted mutants. Manage your secret meat supply, don't get caught, and deliver the most addictive meals in town.

details.title: Night Run Club
details.short_description: Feel the ultimate rush of overtaking 999 runners in a massive night marathon! Weave through dense colorful crowds, chain satisfying overtake combos, and upgrade your stats on the fly. Can you push your way from Rank #1000 all the way to #1 in this high-tempo casual runner?

details.title: Typeria
details.short_description: In Typeria, every keystroke is an attack. Watch your weapons and followers unleash dazzling assaults to harvest foes,collect and sell a wild arsenal of bizarre weapons scattered across diverse realms——all from a compact window on your desktop.

details.title: Plush Shop Simulator
details.short_description: Run your own cozy plushie shop in this management simulation game. Buy, price, and sell adorable plush toys, stationery, and mystery blind boxes!

details.title: Scrapborne
details.short_description: A Helldivers-inspired desktop overlay RPG where your actions shape the universe. Gear up in your bunker and join the galactic struggle from the corner of your screen. Impact the global economy, faction wars, and story. Adapt to World Events in a living, community-driven world.

details.title: Titanic: Honor & Glory
details.short_description: Explore the entire Titanic inside and out, from the hull and promenades to every saloon, boiler room, and cabin in a rich and detailed 3D environment with the highest level of accuracy possible, situated beneath our virtual Arrol Gantry in our digital shipyard.

details.title: Signal Station
details.short_description: Remote listening station. 1984. You're the operator decoding an impossible signal using oscilloscopes, tape machines, and analog equipment. Align satellites. Analyze waveforms. Make choices that determine humanity's response. Multiple endings. DISCOVER THE TRUTH!

details.title: REVOLVER
details.short_description: Tired of immortality, the Demoness has lured you into a trap and asks for a favor: remove the curse from her revolver, bet your life and rip the lost soul of suffering. This rendezvous will make you take full risks. But remember: once you sign the Act of Blood, no chance to turn it back.

details.title: Fallen Valkyries: Prologue
details.short_description: An Anime Wave-based Arena Shooter, Kill Goblin > Collect Bounty > Buy Upgrade > Survive

details.title: Lumber Plumber
details.short_description: Lumber Plumber is a game about tree felling, water plumbing, ore mining, rock crushing, metal bending, resource exploring, and wonder assembling. Transport lumber across long distances using steam locomotives and conveyor belts.

details.title: Ants Megapolis
details.short_description: Command a colony on the brink in Ants Megapolis. Survive an unforgiving world by forging your unique Pheromone, a weapon that dictates your evolution. Carve out an empire from the dirt as an interactive narrator chronicles your savage, epic story of survival.

details.title: Spellbroker
details.short_description: Become a master Spellbroker — wield magic and money in a fast-paced, isometric pixel art marketplace. Buy low, sell high, and bend the market to your will as you build your fortune in a world where profit is pure magic.

details.title: Cut the Strings
details.short_description: It's a battle to become a sacrifice. A TPS where the bride <sacrifice> girl shoots down abandoned synthetic soldiers on the battlefield. A fictional post-war world, a corrupt city, unreasonable fate and choices. Explore vast fields, enhance your body and weapons, and carve out her path.

details.title: Ominous Gift
details.short_description: Escape this dungeon that's like a prison! Embark on an adventure through the remnants of an ancient kingdom, using unique weapons that define how you traverse the world, fight your way through hostile inhabitants as you find the path out of this dungeon that was once a great kingdom.

details.title: The Final Hold
details.short_description: You and your teammates must survive as long as possible against relentless robots and deadly creatures. Your aim matters, but so does your strategy. Every enemy type fights differently, so stay ready. Fortify your base with turrets, healing stations, traps and a variety of upgrades.

details.title: FragFrame
details.short_description: FragFrame is a fast-paced Arena FPS with a modern take on classic shooters, set in a dark dystopian, neon sci-fi world. Battle friends in intense multiplayer matches fueled by high-energy electronic music and a rave-like atmosphere. Create and share custom arenas with the built-in level editor.

details.title: ATOMIC LANCE
details.short_description: Wield heavy weapons. Fly faster than a bullet. Nuke your enemies. You are a Black Project, an ATOMIC LANCE.

details.title: Boundless Evil: Awakening
details.short_description: A first-person horror experience set in a desolate highlands village. Track your missing archaeologist sister, unravel her clues through exploration and puzzles, scavange for loot and face the dark force she accidentally unleashed.

details.title: BOLD: Networked Newt Action
details.short_description: BOLD: Networked Newt Action redefines multiplayer stealth action for the modern day, with a return to classic Spies vs Mercs style 2v2 asymmetrical gameplay in a dark Sci-Fi world with anthropomorphic animals. 3rd person stealth is pitted against 1st person action in maps set across exotic locales!

details.title: Fluffy Fighters - Tactical
details.short_description: Fluffy Fighters - Tactical is a turn-based tactical RPG set in a medieval fantasy world populated by cats. Create your feline fighter, build your team, explore a free-roaming world and lead your cats through tactical battles full of choices, equipment and strategy.

details.title: Adeline's story
details.short_description: «Adeline’s Story» — a psychological-horror visual novel about a girl who moves from a bustling city to a godforsaken village, where the nighttime silence is ripped apart by inhuman screams and people vanish one by one.

details.title: Slammer Caps Xtreme
details.short_description: Slammer Caps Xtreme is a nostalgic RPG featuring physics-based battles, '90s wackiness playground energy and a dash of schoolyard. Blending impact simulation with collectibles and psychological duels, the game turns caps battles into rituals of power, identity and maybe something even crazier.

details.title: KaiKi
details.short_description: This is a walking simulator-style adventure game where you walk along the beach from a first-person perspective. Take photos along the beach and reminisce about the protagonist's precious memories. When you reach your destination, the ending will change depending on the number of memories you have.

name: Signal Lost: The Silence Between Words

details.title: Signal Lost: The Silence Between Words
details.short_description: Tune the radio. Silence the voices. Escape the dark. Signal Lost is a psychological horror experience where every sound matters. Lost in an abandoned underground relay station, your only link to reality is the static between transmissions.

details.title: Mainelander
details.short_description: Sandbox Mode: Manage trade, explore ten regions, complete various commissions, challenge the arena, recruit partners, develop your team in depth, and conquer various dungeons. Rookie Mode: Each game offers a different experience. Player Leaderboards: Challenge other players!
developers: MISTY MOUNTAINS NETWORK TECHNOLOGY CO LTD
publishers: MISTY MOUNTAINS NETWORK TECHNOLOGY CO LTD

details.title: COMANOMALY
details.short_description: COMANOMALY is a mix between a whodunnit mystery game & horror game, with different randomly selected culprit each playthrough. 🩺 It's 1985. You are Susi, a nurse working for Sudaritra Hospital, you have to protect your patient: a wealthy and powerful man with weird symptoms and peculiar conditions.

details.title: Plantverk: Perfectly Plantastic Plant Simulator
details.short_description: Create your perfect little Greenhouse with fantastic plants, fun decorations and more in this cozy idle game! Throw your harvests around and cause havoc, and then use the vacuum to clean up your mess (for profit of course). Use your well-earned money to buy decorations, unlock new plants and pots.

details.title: PLA-TOON 2
details.short_description: A chaotic, stylized, light-hearted, whimsical, cartoon party-style shooter.

details.title: Asteroid Boom Cosmic Courier
details.short_description: Work off your corporate debt as a low-tier space courier. Deliver antimatter devices to E.L.E. asteroids, recover classified data, and tackle hazardous space operations in a chaotic 4-player physics platformer. Drop the payload, share the oxygen, and survive the shift.

details.title: Cardbound Heroes
details.short_description: Cardbound Heroes is a Draw & Strike Roguelite where you combine cards to match numbers, cross out fields, fight enemies and unlock powerful combos. Build your deck, discover hidden combo cards, and master a campaign that changes every run.

details.title: The Rat Eater
details.short_description: Collect strange loot in this absurd world. Choose your simple rat and turn him into complex killing machine. Explore unique skill trees, craft items and eat rats. What more would one want?

details.title: Pawn City
details.short_description: From A Single Store To A Monopoly - Buy Sell And Trade Anything That Comes Through Your Door. Expand Your Business, Hire Employees, Bid For Storage Units, Don't Get Scammed, And Take Over The City !

details.title: Not Guilty!
details.short_description: Not Guilty! is a prison warden and executioner simulator. Become a scumbag: fabricate cases, spend the prison budget on your own whims, and EXECUTE PEOPLE IN DOZENS OF WAYS. Or try to stay human… if you can.

details.title: Argot's Laboratory
details.short_description: Argot's Laboratory is a 1-bit science simulator that puts you in charge of a high tech science lab! Modify, inspect, and evolve strange creatures, all while trying to not to lose your job... Can you complete the genetic tree before time runs out or will your boss finally snap?

details.title: southbound
details.short_description: A thousand years after collapse, the southern wilderness is the last frontier — and something is fracturing at its edge. Push deeper into a procedurally generated world of ruins, monsters, and growing strangeness. A survival roguelite where every run takes you further south, and further from normal.

details.title: Infinite Soul
details.short_description: Infinite Soul is a breath of fresh air for competitive fighters. Every battle will test your skill, cunning, and resolve. Attack and defend with Water, Earth, Fire, and Air; choose wisely because each one has a strength and a weakness.

details.title: The Sword Wizard - Part 1
details.short_description: A 2D action-adventure game through a fun and silly story. Use magic to launch swords at enemies. Explore maps to find more swords of various types and questionable designs. Magically combine swords into new powers to unleash even more swords at enemies.

details.title: Chronia: The Rotcore
details.short_description: Chronia: The Rotcore is a medieval themed turn-based RPG set in the fantasy land of Tinotella. You are a newbie mercenary, travelling across the land to find your origin. Part with teams, slaying monsters, achieving quests... It is your choice to shape your own journey.

details.title: 救済の日
details.short_description: "The Day of Salvation" is a horror game in which players must escape from giant humanoid creatures by hiding in the fog and discovering their true identities.

details.title: Kayotica
details.short_description: In Kayotica, you play as April—a clever but manipulative student caught in a web of friendship, rivalry, and dark crimes. What begins as ordinary campus life quickly turns into a mystery of betrayal, hidden truths, and a shocking murder. Can you solve the mystery, or will you become the next victim?

details.title: Ashen Vow
details.short_description: You are a knight sworn to God’s word, wielding only a sword against the darkness. But not all believers walk in good faith. The Black Maw has sunk its claws into the misguided, twisting their devotion into madness. Explore a once familiar castle now warped by evil, and cut down the corrupted horde

details.title: Cleanup Wizard
details.short_description: You, a wizard with a mop, fight against computer viruses to save the world! An incremental about cleaning up and collecting viruses to upgrade your mystic abilities to purge the world of this virus once and for all.

details.title: UNDELIVERED
details.short_description: UNDELIVERED is an exploration-based puzzle platformer in where PAR/Cel, a small, solar-powered robot must traverse an island in search of the parts required to repair the ruined boat of the islands residents.

details.title: Warwake
details.short_description: Take the helm of a WWII battleship in this naval combat game as you steer, manage your speed, and lay your main guns by hand, fighting ship-to-ship duels where turning broadside triples your guns and doubles the target you present.

details.title: PixelPainter 95
details.short_description: Fill the canvas. Then fill a bigger one. An incremental paint game on a 1995 desktop, from a single page toward a billion tiles. Widen your brush, hire painters that work while you are away, and print each page into a stronger start.

details.title: Qrack
details.short_description: Qruack turns your desktop into a relaxing duck pond. Work, meet, or space out while your new companions hang out at the bottom of your screen. over 60 ducks will keep you company either way.

details.title: Arithmeria
details.short_description: Arithmeria is a non-violent RPG for kids that replaces traditional combat with arithmetic questions and realm restoration. Enjoy a full adventure campaign followed by a robust endgame built for grinding and farming!

details.title: The Inconvenience Store
details.short_description: Explore an endless, procedurally generated furniture store where daylight gives you time to scavenge and build—but after dark, hostile employees begin to hunt. Gather supplies, craft tools, manage your needs, and survive each night.

details.title: Move The Freak Out!
details.short_description: In Move The Freak Out. You are a contracted mover who specializes in haunted homes. Your job is to move furniture out of homes that are claimed to be haunted by the people who left in a hurry! Get in, get out, and don't die in.... Move The Freak Out!

details.title: Wrong Landing: Reborn
details.short_description: Wrong Landing: Reborn is a new, improved open-world survival game. Explore a mysterious island full of surprises alone or with friends! Discover its rich story, fight hunger, extreme cold, and try to stay alive.

details.title: In Between
details.short_description: Three stories. An emotional game about the stories we live in between certain chapters of our lives and the chance to make new choices, reliving those moments.

details.title: Too Deep To Stop
details.short_description: Break dirt, drop treasure, and blow up whatever gets in the way. Too Deep To Stop is a physics-based incremental mining clicker where each haul pays for stronger hits, stranger tools, and a bigger mess on the next run.

details.title: RAT LUCK
details.short_description: Compete in precision timing rounds, choose which rat has to risk a hand, and survive a table full of dangerous cheese. Rat Luck is a chaotic 2–4 player online party game with proximity voice chat, bluffing, taunting, and terrible luck.

details.title: CLUELESS
details.short_description: Your friends secretly choose who you are. Everyone else can see it - you can’t. Ask yes/no questions, follow the clues, and figure out your character! Supports 2-8 players, and only the host needs to own the game.

details.title: SLAPPED SILLY
details.short_description: A game of tag with terrible manners. Chase, dodge, and slap your friends through a living 3D newspaper in this party game for up to 12 players. Get slapped and join the chase, dress to impress, and turn your finest moments—and worst falls—into front-page news.

details.title: Fridge Organizer
details.short_description: Unpack grocery deliveries and place everything into organized containers where it belongs. Watch for expired goods and be sure to follow First In First Out procedures.

details.title: Unreported Shift
details.short_description: Psychological indie-horror, simulation. In the 1990s, a small Balkan border town hides dangerous secrets. When Agent Bogomir is assigned to the checkpoint, he becomes an unwilling witness to the town’s darkest mysteries - and must uncover the monster behind the evil living within it.

details.title: Decksplorer
details.short_description: Decksplorer is a lite puzzle adventure where you explore dangerous decks, find unique items, manage limited energy, and complete contracts. Choose one of four classes and conquer tougher challenges.

details.title: TideBox
details.short_description: TideBox is a 2D physics sandbox where you can mess around with liquids and see what happens. Build stuff, dig tunnels, make rivers, flood entire areas, mix things together, or just dump a ton of liquid somewhere and watch the chaos unfold.

details.title: Pencil Shavings Soup
details.short_description: Pencil Shavings Soup is an incremental about running an underground factory that makes soup from pencil shavings! Collect, sharpen and upgrade your way to becoming the richest critter ever!

details.title: ねこっとラーメン
details.short_description: 異世界に転生したあなたが得たスキルは「カップラーメンを出す」！？猫の獣人たちが暮らす世界で出会った女の子・ユズと、成り行きで始めたお店を営業する調理シミュレーション。注文に合う商品を選び、かやくやスープを入れ、お湯の量と待ち時間を見極めて一杯を仕上げましょう。複数のお客さんを同時に迎え、それぞれの調理時間と待ち時間を管理。日ごとに変わる注文傾向や制限を乗り越えた先で、物語は複数の結末へ分岐します。

details.title: Keep The Circle Alive
details.short_description: An incremental game about protecting a tiny circle. Destroy endless waves of enemies, earn resources, stack upgrades, watch the numbers climb, and turn your circle into an unstoppable machine.

details.title: Mow The Planet
details.short_description: Start on Mum's back lawn and keep going: the street, the city, the planet, then the Moon, Mars and every world after that. Mow ground that stays mowed, bolt ridiculous kits onto one growing machine, and run a mowing company big enough to stripe the solar system.

details.title: Re+pray Signals: Echoes Still Wait
details.short_description: You are the only one connected to a child trapped in a closed-off world. Speaking becomes the key; listening becomes hope. A conversational adventure where the words you exchange help unravel its mysteries. #RepraySignals

details.title: Hist Maker: ReMake
details.short_description: A world history you can play. Combine people, events and ideas (Emperor Napoleon + Britain = Trafalgar) to rebuild 69 eras, from antiquity to the early 20th century. Every discovery fills in the era's panorama. Build your own levels with mods, history or not, and share them on the Workshop.

details.title: Edenfinity
details.short_description: Edenfinity is a relaxing incremental colony game where you guide Adam and Eve as they build a new civilization in Eden. Gather resources, sell your surplus, craft bricks, construct houses, and unlock upgrades.

details.title: Honey, Tidy the Basement
details.short_description: Honey, Tidy the Basement! is a cozy organization simulator where an earthquake has knocked over 2,880 console games all over your basement. Pick up each game case, sort them by console, and return them to their correct shelf as you unlock handy abilities to speed up your organizing.

details.title: M.A.M.M.O.N.
details.short_description: MAMMON is a co-op physics-based multiplayer action game where you and your fellow demons descend into Hell to find valuables, smash them to pieces, absorb the gold they leave behind, and bring your haul to the submission point before it's too late.

name: Ruiwen Three Kingkoms: Speakers of the Realm

details.title: Ruiwen Three Kingkoms: Speakers of the Realm
details.short_description: Powered by offline local AI, this Three Kingdoms dialogue simulator lets you roleplay as Liu Bei, Zhuge Liang and Guan Yu. Relive six classic scenes and reshape history through free, flexible conversations.

details.title: ROBOT DRAFT: LAST HUMAN
details.short_description: A first-person sci-fi escape adventure. Freeze robots, ignite fuel, and throw objects at enemies while solving escape-room puzzles. In the full game, build and playtest your own rooms, then share them as level files.

details.title: Aegis Vanguard
details.short_description: Lead humanity's last hope, a squad of desperate heroes, through a grim, corrupted realm in this dark fantasy strategy roguelite. Master squad combos and grid inventory management tactics. Create builds & synergies to outsmart dangerous threats in a bleak world where our fate rests on your survival.

details.title: Isle of Cards
details.short_description: Isle of Cards is a strategy deckbuilder where you build up your island by playing cards. Draw cards and place tiles to level up your island before time runs out. Create unique decks by unlocking new cards and completing challenges.

details.title: Stack & Spell
details.short_description: A cozy magical tidy-up game about collecting, identifying, and organizing enchanted cards. Learn their secrets, master the archive's classification system, and turn magical chaos into perfect order.

details.title: Offering Accepted
details.short_description: You signed her contract. Now you press the button, forever. Every press fills the bar, every full bar drops chests, every chest spills cursed relics, and every relic makes the next press worth more. Fair trade?

details.title: No Man's Idle
details.short_description: Endless stars, idle fingertips. Harvest planet resources, research exploration tech, and warp your ship across the galaxy — one step at a time toward the Galactic Center.

details.title: spin boom boom
details.short_description: Toggle pivot points via key presses, dodge collisions, and take on the ultimate test of timing and precision.

details.title: Peel Me
details.short_description: Peel wallpaper, dry each layer and rip it away in this strange first person peeling game. Earn Peelcoins, buy better tools and keep working your way through hundreds of layers. Just don’t peel too far. You might find something you weren’t meant to.

details.title: Kingdoms in Ink
details.short_description: A fantasy world's history unfolds on a single map. In this grand strategy game, kingdoms rise, borders shift, and kings and generals pass through the generations. Simply watch, or command a nation and unite the world. Follow towns, people, dragons, and adventurers through a history all your own.

details.title: Lane Siege
details.short_description: > Sack eight castles or die trying. Build your keep on a grid between battles, then > command the fight live — spending food to field archers, knights and siege engines down > one brutal lane. Every castle you take pays plunder. Every one after is tougher.

details.title: VELKOR
details.short_description: Survive a post-apocalyptic open world solo or in co-op for up to 3 players. Brave storms and emissions, build vehicles from scrap, establish your faction’s base and uncover the past. Make choices that shape lives and faction relations: every decision has consequences.

name: Defeat the Demon King with a Financed Bahamut

details.title: Defeat the Demon King with a Financed Bahamut
details.short_description: A fantasy adventure with Bahamut, a billion-gold dragon financed through a residual-value loan. Entrusted with the dragon by God, adventurer Leon takes on quests to make his monthly payments. Can he defeat the Demon King and reclaim his peaceful life…?

details.title: Hatter by Night
details.short_description: A first-person survival horror game inspired by horror films from the 1960s. As one of Jack Hatter’s victims, a former detective who turned to kidnapping women, your only chance of survival is to find a way to escape his house.

details.title: Cat Undead Island
details.short_description: Cat Undead Island is a co-op island survival game where cute cats fight the undead. Build defenses by day, survive zombie waves by night, craft weapon parts, recruit AI cat companions, and explore dungeons across an 8x8 island world - solo or with up to 4 players.

details.title: Desktop Arrow Defense
details.short_description: "Desktop Arrow Defense" is an idle tower defense mini-game that runs on your desktop. It lets you work while watching your tiny archer defend against incoming enemies. Upgrade your character's attributes, collect and enhance equipment, unlock skill combinations, and create your legendary archer!

details.title: GACHA MASH FIGHT
details.short_description: Mash away and your moves pop out of a gacha! A free-to-play slapstick 2D fighter. Every move is pure luck, with rarities N, R, SR and SSR. Pull an ultra-rare UR for a one-hit KO that flips any match! Three modes plus online battles: party with friends or climb the global leaderboard.

details.title: Driver Survivor
details.short_description: A driving survivors-like where your car is the weapon. Drift through zombie hordes, stack automatic weapons and upgrades, smash through a destructible city, and rescue survivors in a branching story—or push your build to its limit in endless mode.

details.title: PUYON
details.short_description: A fresh take on mouse action! PUYON is a level-based, top-down 2D action game where you use your mouse to reach the goal without bumping into walls or objects.

name: Lumi: A Cat in the Mist

details.title: Lumi: A Cat in the Mist
details.short_description: Lumi returns to find her village lost in mist. Ghosts linger where the villagers once lived. Creep through bushes, scramble over rooftops and let your magic amulet lead you into trouble. Solve puzzles to help lost spirits find peace. Keep out of reach of the rest.

details.title: Schooligans
details.short_description: A chaotic school party game for 1 to 8 players. Pull off the dumbest stunts, film everything on your phone, outsmart teachers who can hear your voice, sneak out at night and betray your friends to become the most popular kid at Coolischool. A stunt nobody filmed never happened.

2034 is a near-future dystopian narrative adventure set in a paper-crafted world. Players explore idyllic towns, solve puzzles, and uncover deep conspiracies. Its signature origami art blends bright visuals with a cold dystopian core, and your choices shape the story and characters’ fates.

details.title: Ɐ L∞P
details.short_description: A first-person observation horror game set in an apartment trapped in a ten-day loop. Find and correct every anomaly, survive the monster, and reach the door on Day 10. Miss one detail—or get caught—and you return to Day 0.

details.title: Circuit Manager
details.short_description: Manage your own racing circuit. Upgrade its facilities, increase its prestige, attract bigger and better racing series, and deal with everything that can go wrong during a race weekend

details.title: Montic
details.short_description: Assemble an army of time monkeys to defeat time-eating termites! Plan your moves around your enemies' known movements in this turn-based strategy game.

details.title: SpecterMancer
details.short_description: A multiplayer horror game for 1 to 6 players set in a dark Victorian era. As a ghost, you must terrify the others and prevent them from escaping alive; as a survivor, explore, solve puzzles, survive, and find a way to escape.

details.title: Tindalos
details.short_description: Fly through a vast fractal temple where ancient voices outlive their makers. Evade hunters, uncover lost memories, and seek a way out in this first-person cosmic horror flight game. Escape draws you onward. The mystery asks you to stay. PC and optional VR.

details.title: ULTIMATE将棋
details.short_description: This game currently supports Japanese only. ULTIMATE SHOGI combines authentic shogi with magic cards and AI assistance. Follow the AI, or play unaided to earn more mana. Build a 20-card deck, bend the rules of shogi, and turn losing positions into unexpected wins.

details.title: W勇者之剑
details.short_description: A red scarf. A hometown forgotten by the world. Follow Ryan from Windbell Village to mysteries in the capital. Explore hand-drawn-style scenes and fight fixed-position turn-based battles. Includes the prologue and Chapter 1; later chapters are unfinished. In-game text is Simplified Chinese.

details.title: Teeth Are Money
details.short_description: An incremental horror game about pulling teeth from a living monster. Grip, shake and yank each tooth free, then spend the money on research that turns one hard-won tooth into handfuls at a time. Keep pulling before the contamination fills, and watch the mouth grow.

details.title: MAYBE YOU!
details.short_description: Somewhere in that herd of 30 animals, one is a real person. Find them and shoot first. Your 29 NPC teammates move on your ping. Killed by an NPC? Possess an ally and keep hunting. You only lose to the real player. A 1v1 hide-and-seek FPS across a resort, sinking pirate ships and a Halloween castle.

details.title: Tactical Combat Simulator
details.short_description: *Tactical Combat System* is a realistic modern real-time tactics game set in the turbulent early 21st century. Command your own brigade through large-scale wars, configure every unit, and experience the responsibilities of a battlefield commander.

details.title: Hungry Dancing Wizards
details.short_description: Eat, dance, repeat! Get lost in a musical adventure where quick reactions meet rhythmic flow. Challenge your friends to ridiculous dance battles, chase high scores, and see who truly is the hungriest wizard!

name: Nook : The World’s First Real-Time, Real-Human Confidant

details.title: Nook : The World’s First Real-Time, Real-Human Confidant
details.short_description: A desktop AI companion who lives on your screen. Chat by text or voice, hear her answer in her own voice, call her face to face, and hand her errands she finishes while you're away. She remembers you and keeps her word.

details.title: Quick Quick Serve!
details.short_description: Turn a four-table diner into a bustling idle restaurant! Serve dishes, hire waiters, and upgrade your kitchen as every coin brings the next upgrade closer. A relaxed incremental game with patient customers and a satisfying journey from hands-on serving to automatic earnings.

details.title: Novus Deus
details.short_description: In a city controlled by a rising techno-religious cult called "The Church of Convergence", Kara fights her way through the corrupted districts to find her sister and save her from becoming a part of the mindless followers of Novus Deus.

details.title: Sandcastle Kingdom
details.short_description: A cozy sandbox for building sandcastles. Shape your island, castles and courtyards with dynamic sand. Dig canals, ponds and fill them with realistic water. Decorate your island. Share your home with cute animal friends, help them with their quests and gather around the campfire as the sun goes down.

details.title: Agoonis
details.short_description: Agoonis is a neon turn-based strategy game where you spend 300 gold to build a custom army, upgrade pieces into new movement patterns, fight over Soul Shrines, and capture the enemy Empress. Play Story Mode, challenge the bot, or take your questionable strategy online.

details.title: Fishing Town
details.short_description: This is a desktop idle fishing game. Collect rare fish, upgrade your gear, and build your own pond and aquarium.

details.title: Haeresis
details.short_description: Haeresis is a Roguelike Deckbuilder inspired by the classic solo card game, Scoundrel, where you purposely put enemies into your deck. Climb your way up a dark, ruined cathedral to discover what truly lies behind the doorway of your religious pilgrimage.

details.title: Genius Simulator
details.short_description: **Play a god-tier genius whose subtle glance is misread as the world's salvation formula!** In this deck-building Roguelike, turn fanatical overthinking into strategy: observe your opponent's mental flaws, shatter their logic chain, or strike their blind spots for an instant kill!

details.title: Sontaku Soul: Read the Boss
details.short_description: Fail and you're fired! SONTAKU SOUL is a collection of rapid-fire microgames about Japanese business etiquette. Play as Tamako, a brand-new employee, and find the right move in every situation—bowing, business cards, seating order, toasts and more—to survive the harsh world of work.
developers: ブラック企業サークル
publishers: 株式会社セブンコード

details.title: Paceweaver
details.short_description: Backstab for double damage. Every enemy move is telegraphed in advance. Paceweaver is a turn-based deckbuilding roguelike fought on a single lane, where distance and facing decide everything. Slip between telegraphed attacks and get behind your foe.

details.title: 露娜2：拾光之约
details.short_description: 《露娜2：拾光之约》是七龙游戏运营的3D-MMORPG游戏。以Q萌画风、奇幻故事、三大种族设定、三大职业等多元化的游戏内容深受玩家喜爱。农场种菜、河边钓鱼、小屋装扮等等那些年最纯粹的玩法，如今悉数回归。最经典的版本，最原始的感动，让我们一起重返蓝色大地，开启这场奇幻的冒险之旅吧！
developers: 江苏三九互娱网络科技有限公司
publishers: 江苏七龙网络科技有限公司

details.title: Die Asche von Dornhain
details.short_description: A fully voiced German narrative game where choices open different scenes, relationships, and endings. Levin and his friends can die, go missing, or survive profoundly changed. No single playthrough reveals the whole story.

details.title: Roll Brighter
details.short_description: Tether up and prove your teamwork in Roll Brighter, a physics-based driving game filled with chaotic traps and fun obstacles! Coordinate with friends via a physics rope, or relax in solo mode as you navigate a vibrant, atmospheric world designed for a satisfying casual driving simulation.

details.title: Set, Bounce, Cheese!
details.short_description: Guide Squeaky, a courageous little mouse, on a physics-based quest to save his village from tyrannical cats! Instead of controlling Squeaky directly, place an unlimited supply of bouncy gadgets along his path to guide him past traps and collect every last piece of cheese.

details.title: ProutoPulsion: Fart on your friends!
details.short_description: Have you ever dreamed of farting on your friends? ProutoPulsion is a fart-ass-tic couch game where up to 4 players fly and fight each other using their ultimate weapon: large, loud, unbreathable farts. Show your friends who is the true martial fart-ist!

details.title: Hand Stretched
details.short_description: Run a wood-fired pizzeria covering three key roles, Chef, Waiter or Manager, over frantic 6 minute shifts! Can you and up to two friends keep the customers fed and the accountants happy? Or see off a rival shop in a head-to-head, best of three/five battle with up to five other players?

details.title: Restock Master
details.short_description: The doors are locked, the parking lot is empty, and the aisles are in complete disarray. Restock Master is a first person supermarket organization game. Pick up scattered groceries, sort them out, and fill every empty shelf. No clocks, no customers, no stress.

details.title: The Wind from the East
details.short_description: A hand-drawn school visual novel. In 2004, five students handed in a blue-cloth folder; it came back with the last page cut out. Twenty-two years later you sift the archives - race sheets, carbon copies, loan dates - to find those five and decide whose ending gets put back. Nine endings.

details.title: Hood
details.short_description: England, 1216. Experience the true story behind the Robin Hood legend as you control Williken of the Weald in this 2D pixel art stealth platformer. Explore, sneak, and fight your way through the forests, villages, and fortresses of Kent to take down the ruthless Castellan and save your family.

details.title: Catadel: Slot Defense
details.short_description: Command an army of cats in this slot-defense roguelite. Pull the lever, chain cascading matches and hold the castle, then push your luck on the multiplier wheel for up to ×10 damage. Damage becomes Gold, and the royal tax always comes due. No real money, just risk and reward.

details.title: Deal Me In
details.short_description: Build wild upgrade combinations in a haunted casino. Fuse maxed cards into unstable bonuses, gamble across six games, and pay your growing debt while monsters hunt you. A first-person horror roguelike for solo play, 2–4 player online co-op or VS.

details.title: Curse Appraiser
details.short_description: Become the appraiser of a decaying old pawnshop. Uncover the true value of the items your customers bring in and the hidden curses they carry. Read through lies, negotiate the price, and follow the clues left behind by your father to unravel a dark secret in this dark fantasy simulation game.

details.title: Catomi: Suika Roguelike
details.short_description: Turn cute cat-fruit into huge combos! Collect powerful catalysts that twist the rules, boost your multipliers, and change how you play. Drop or slingshot fruit into place, trigger chain reactions, and build powerful combinations that send your score soaring in this Suika-style roguelike.

details.title: Grenade Party
details.short_description: A party game for up to 8 players where the crowd throws grenades, bombs and food onto the field. Catch grenades and throw them back to survive, and mix kart races, football, basketball, hockey, beach volleyball and obstacle courses into the same match.

details.title: WILD DECK
details.short_description: One friend with a shotgun, the other friends turn into random animals and try to survive. Asymmetrical action for up to 11 players, varied maps, funny animals, and absurd deaths

details.title: SCP: Rapture
details.short_description: The city has fallen. Multiple factions now race to secure the information buried in Facility 9's ruins. You're part of the backup team — one mission: get the information, and get out. The anomalies that were once contained now roam free, and they're unlike anything anyone's ever seen.

details.title: Bounced Out!
details.short_description: In Bounced Out! go it alone or team up with a friend to staff The Pound, a chaotic nightclub owned by "Mad Dog". As bouncers: check IDs, defuse situations, fight customers and make as much money as you can to avoid being fired by the boss!

details.title: The Frog Prince: Unfrogged
details.short_description: Once a prince, but accidentally turned into a frog. Lash your tongue to collect insects, feed the witch’s cauldron, and turn catches into magical essence. Upgrade your skills, survive nasty bugs to restore your prince status in this cozy incremental clicker.

details.title: Just Dots
details.short_description: The classic pen-and-paper game of Dots — place dots, close the loop around your opponent's, claim territory — now against a neural network that taught itself from scratch and beats its own creator. Grow from beginner to master. Any board size, local 2-player.

details.title: Money Grabber
details.short_description: GOLD Digger is a cute, lighthearted Vampire Survivors-like game. 2026, the Year of Big Results! Join Sensen and Liuliu as they frantically dig up money, items, and teammates in a resort hotel—and use the power of money to dig a way out of the zombie horde!

details.title: Castle Reborn
details.short_description: Castle Reborn is a 45-degree isometric voxel action roguelite. Enter an ever-changing cursed castle, cut through hordes of undead, collect weapons and relics, shape a new build each run, and push deeper into the endless night with every return.

details.title: Just Make Sense: Instinct Lab
details.short_description: A laboratory for your gut feeling, most rounds over in 15 seconds: eyeball distances, nail the timing, predict trajectories, count at a glance. 12 instincts, a main map that grows tile by tile, and 570+ everyday scenarios. No trivia, no math — just your instinct. It's sharper than you think.

details.title: Keyboard Companion
details.short_description: A tiny pixel monkey that types along with you. He sits at the bottom of your screen, hits the same keys you do, and when you take a break he snacks on bananas, yawns and dozes off. It never records what you type.

details.title: Scrapyard Survivors
details.short_description: A top-down mech survivors-like. Sixteen minutes of bullet heaven to survive and call yourself the Scraplord. Kill enemies, gather XP, gain more guns. Rinse and repeat.

details.title: Bharat Police
details.short_description: > Lead a police department in India where officers grow and react to how you use them. Develop their skills, shape your squad through perks, and manage the buffs and setbacks they pick up on duty. Choose your team, plan each response, and keep your officers ready for the next call.

details.title: TOWER KING
details.short_description: Building Management Simulation x Rogue-lite!You are a rookie hired CEO.Endure unreasonable demands from your boss and achieve your goals!However, the orders keep escalating…!?Overcome countless hardships and aim to become a tycoon!!

details.title: Misty Garden
details.short_description: Build the garden, fulfilling requests from the cute visitors, and even recruit them to create items! Decorate your misty garden to welcome cute little creatures, provide a place to help them relax!

details.title: CatLands
details.short_description: CatLands is a relaxing, cozy puzzle game. Move blocks to bring landscapes back together. Collect cats, build a village or just have fun with friends in online co-op.

details.title: GoopUpClassic
details.short_description: A vibrant and mysterious world filled with enchanted hats, oozing clumps of slime, hidden pathways, and a terrible king. Follow the trail of adventure to defeat the king and save the world from his tyrannical rule! Fight your companions after the trial is done!

details.title: Pirate Pillage and Plunder
details.short_description: PIRATE PILLAGE & PLUNDER is the unique blend of card game and auto battler, wrapped together in a neat roguelike package. Choose your faction, amass an army from thousands of "willing" participants, and lead them to greatness! (or agonizing defeat)

details.title: Tree's Love Crossing Above
details.short_description: This is a BL-themed FMV game where players will control the protagonist "Xiaoshu" make choices for him, and experience four completely different love stories. Will they lead to a sweet ending or end in regret? Every choice you make will determine the protagonist's ultimate romantic destination.

details.title: Charlie Spotlight
details.short_description: Meet Charlie, the next King of Comedy! Or at least its' Little Prince. It's a steady grind to get to the top, until on a night like any other, after one of his sets, Charlie is approached by a couple of rather unusual fans.

details.title: Vampires Die
details.short_description: Hired by the "Council" to take out a rogue coven, you must gather your clan and travel through the dark streets, graveyards, and crypts to battle for hierarchy against the deadliest of your own bloodline. Roll the dice in this "chill" turn-based board game, but remember, sometimes even Vampires Die!

details.title: Ripley [Remembered]
details.short_description: A surreal, story-driven puzzle game set on a train caught in a time loop. Solve narrative-driven puzzles, battle psychic bosses, and uncover the truth about memory, grief, and a girl named Ripley—before the day resets again.

details.title: Niverium
details.short_description: Niverium is a survival game in a harsh world where you have to take on the role of a man sent to the very bottom. You will have to do any dirty work for those who stand above you, under threat of death.

details.title: Gravitus
details.short_description: Enter a massive battlefield where two teams clash over resources, strategy, and firepower. Start as infantry, pilot hover tanks or flying pods, and unleash laser-based combat in a sci-fi warzone reminiscent of classic space battles.

name: The Town That Died In The Night

details.title: The Town That Died In The Night
details.short_description: You must escape the town, while trying to beat 2 clocks. An incoming nuke, and a viral infection. Can you make it out in time?

details.title: The Last Resourcer
details.short_description: Survive a hostile world with your droid. Build your base, automate with robots, and manage the energy that keeps you alive. Beware. The tech you rely on may save your life – or destroy it.

details.title: Shuttle Mining
details.short_description: Shuttle Mining is a Noita- and Terraria-inspired cozy & chaotic mining game. Craft your own unique lasers, burn, taze, and make things explode. The goal is to craft new batteries so you can use stronger lasers and dig deeper...

details.title: Critter Cosmos
details.short_description: A cozy 3D adventure where you play as a Capybara Astronaut, hopping from planet to planet, befriending cute animal pals, saving communities, and building a new home together.

details.title: Ultimate Gym Simulator
details.short_description: Build your dream gym with Ultimate Gym Simulator

details.title: Reviving An Angel
details.short_description: How do you revive an angel? Reviving An Angel is a turn-based RPG set in a world where Archangels, the greatest creations of the Almighty, are in a path of war. Wanting to revive his beloved, Harold, a young Fallen Hunter, saw himself facing an Archangel as he challenged the limits of his mortality.

details.title: SHOCK
details.short_description: With only a wheelchair for mobility, Jack, a disabled war veteran, must use stealth, solve puzzles, and crawl into tight spaces to escape a cybernetic creature. Explore a psychological survival horror experience in third person and uncover the truth behind this nightmare.

details.title: Sweep City
details.short_description: Keep your streets clean and discover hidden treasures in this relaxing street sweeper adventure. Drive through procedurally generated neighborhoods, uncover rare finds, and upgrade your sweeper with unique specializations. Cruise to your own tunes while keeping the city spotless.

details.title: Witchbound
details.short_description: Witchbound is a first-person reverse horror game where you play as Callisto Coven, a powerful witch defending her mansion from villagers and priests who seek to destroy the cursed relics binding her to it. Hunt them, terrify them, and become the horror they fear.

name: Hellspawn Trials: how many toddlers can you beat in a fight?

details.title: Hellspawn Trials: how many toddlers can you beat in a fight?
details.short_description: The Hellspawn Trials is an endless top down shooter where you choose from a variety of dynamic weapons and Faustian upgrades with unique side effects so you can become powerful enough to discover the answer to the ultimate question: How many toddlers can you beat in a fight?

details.title: MICROVERSE
details.short_description: MICROVERSE is a sci-fi action/adventure game. It includes weapons such as laser pistols, melee weapons and a 'merchant center' where you use in-game credits to buy new weapons and upgrades.

details.title: Bounce Rush 跟你爆了
details.short_description: A pinball-action × roguelike strategy game. Launch balls to smash enemies, equip turrets and skills, and craft your own build from hundreds of combinations. Three modes: turn-based tactics, real-time combat, and stage-based challenges.

details.title: Smash Them All
details.short_description: A highly dynamic top-down action game where the car serves as both a weapon and the primary tool for survival.

details.title: MUGENDUNGEON
details.short_description: “MUGENDUNGEON” is a top-down roguelike action game where players explore procedurally generated dungeons. Collect keys, reach the goal, clear each floor, upgrade gear in the shop, and dive deeper in this single-player adventure.

details.title: Eleven Legends
details.short_description: Eleven Legends blends football management, character growth, and strategic matches. You are not just a manager on the sidelines, nor just one player on the pitch. Plan each week, build bonds, find mentors, and lead your team to victory.

details.title: Beyond Orbit
details.short_description: A tab-target space MMO inspired by Earth & Beyond. Choose between three classes, Warrior, Explorer or Trader and make your way through the galaxy. Fight, mine, haul and craft with other pilots.

details.title: Jett Rider - Mini Hero
details.short_description: Jett Rider Mini H.E.R.O. is a classic Game Boy-style adventure set in the Jett Rider universe. A small mission. A big heart. A true handheld hero.

name: This is not just a farm

details.title: This is not just a farm
details.short_description: This Is Not Just a Farm is an idle farming simulator with horror elements where you can make progress while doing other things on your computer.

details.title: What Remains
details.short_description: A first-person psychological horror game set in a childhood home. Explore, uncover four days of missing memory, and survive something that has been listening since you arrived.

details.title: Sign It
details.short_description: Monteririo, a city steeped in violence and vice, welcomes a young examining magistrate. An appointment from the Crown has effectively exiled you to this southern outpost, a thousand leagues from home. Tell me—is there truly a way back to the North for you?

details.title: Chihuahua Racing
details.short_description: Arcade combat racing on planet Chihuahua! Twenty dogs race for the championship across 20 tracks with homing missiles, bombs, 18 wild supers and 26 random events. Build your own tracks, then race them alone or split screen with a friend, even tied together by a rope.

details.title: (Debt Feeds Debt
details.short_description: A turn-based bond card strategy game. Buy bonds, fulfill orders, build FEVER combos, and push progress to 100 before decay—and the demonic contract—catch up.

details.title: Factor Zoo
details.short_description: Factor Zoo is a strategy puzzle game blending Sudoku and betting. Pick 5 lucky cells before each round, then solve the board with Sudoku techniques. Revealed numbers form hands—pairs, straights, or five of a kind—to earn multiplier rewards.

details.title: Unregistered Scene
details.short_description: Unregistered Scene is a Minesweeper-style anomaly deduction game. As Agent 03, an insurance company agent, investigate scenes where records no longer match reality. Work with a mysterious assistant to identify anomalies and uncover hidden rules.

details.title: Misplaced
details.short_description: Misplaced is a historical detective puzzle game about sorting case files and uncovering hidden connections. Read letters, witness statements, and official records, figure out where each document belongs, and piece together the truth behind a murder case inspired by real events.

details.title: Chief Bubble Officer
details.short_description: Chief Bubble Officer is a Roll-and-Write strategy game. In every match, aim to score as many points as possible within limited actions. Each turn, draw random number cards and fill distinct charts. Every chart features unique rules, with a wild range of fill requirements and scoring systems.

details.title: Winter Hunts Us
details.short_description: Lead a prehistoric clan across a brutal hex map in a turn-based survival roguelite. Outrun the glacier, fight hunger, face strange events, and defy extinction.

details.title: ICU - Intensive Care Unit 8
details.short_description: ICU – Intensive Care Unit 8 is a single-player horror game where you’re trapped in a looping hospital corridor and must spot anomalies to find a way out.

details.title: Bounty Gunman
details.short_description: Control the line of fire. Take the shot. A retro pixel-art 1v1 western shooter focused on positioning and mind games.

details.title: Finding Cats In Green Street
details.short_description: Find cute cats in Green Street. Can you find them? Meow Meow...Kittens are calling you！

details.title: Remaining Kingdom
details.short_description: Remaining Kingdom combines deckbuilding, roguelike progression, and real-time tower defense into one dark fantasy experience where each Lord changes the way you fight.

details.title: On Time In Full
details.short_description: Manage dev teams. Hit deadlines. Deliver quality. OTIF is a kanban board simulation where every hire, every card, and every decision has a cost — and the client is watching.

details.title: War for Ylinthia
details.short_description: Based on the “Ylinthian Chronicles” novel series by M.J. Macourek, this easy to play PVE combination of Real Time Strategy and tabletop games allows for infinite replayability.

details.title: CRIKEYMAS
details.short_description: CRIKEYMAS is a chaotic platformer SUPER HAMMER ACTION GAME where everything is possible with your trusty hammer. Help Mr. SANTER's errand boy reindeer to smash through delightfully devilish levels!

details.title: IN:DARK RECALL
details.short_description: "I'm sure you'll find me." IN:DARK RECALL is a deep sea diving action game. You wake up at the bottom of the sea, as the target you'd been hired to eliminate.

details.title: Tax On Dice
details.short_description: Help Gibo to collect the King's taxes. Every season, roll dice to send Gibo in corresponding towns and collect their resources. In your downtime, buy dice and town upgrades to satisfy the ever-growing King's greed.

details.title: Synapse Idle
details.short_description: Grow a 3D neural network from a single neuron. Workers haul energy along radiant paths, buildings amplify every passing signal, and a 100-node skill tree reshapes how your synapse evolves. A calm, incremental idle game about watching complexity bloom — tinted in whatever colors you choose.

details.title: Victoria Kopernik: Monastery
details.short_description: Occult influencer Victoria Kopernik explores a cursed monastery in this short survival horror experience.

details.title: Greebly Gambit
details.short_description: Greebly Gambit is a chaotic fantasy smash-and-grab-style game where you play as a goblin trying to steal everything not nailed down in order to help revive the god of hope.

details.title: Game Show But Evil
details.short_description: A quiz show...but different!

details.title: Rune Tavern
details.short_description: This is an asynchronous PVP auto chess game. Arrange your runes and components, use energy transfer to activate as many rune skills as possible, and build a powerful lineup! In the face of randomly matched opponents, be the first to smash the enemy's elemental blocks and win more!

details.title: Stacko
details.short_description: In Stacko, remember your childhood while earning awesome prizes that change the way you play. Your goal is simple: stack the blocks as high as you can! Earn cards to modify the machine and plushies with powerful bonuses, all while playing this unique twist on the classic arcade experience.

details.title: JetBound
details.short_description: JetBound is a difficult game about flying. Stranded in space with a jetpack, upgrade your abilities and navigate deadly unique zones that constantly introduce new mechanics. No jumping. Pure physics-based flight with branching paths and high replayability.

details.title: Trouble in Potion High
details.short_description: Something went terribly wrong at Potion High. The school fell into the "Non-Dimension" and was placed under quarantine. If you don't break this lockdown, you'll be stuck here forever. Your wits are your weapon. Solve twisted environmental puzzles and get out of this place.

details.title: Nifland
details.short_description: Nifland is a surreal multiplayer horror game with social deduction, set inside a paranormal dream beneath the ocean. Maintain a decaying deep-sea station, survive the entities roaming its halls, and uncover the traitor hiding among your crew before the dream consumes you all.

details.title: Mana Reactor
details.short_description: From stone tools to modern weapons and giant mechs — survive, craft, and conquer another world.

details.title: Under Review
details.short_description: Welcome to the heart of a 1980s bureaucracy. Review applicant files, cross-check records, and make heavy moral decisions. Amidst strange rumors of an unidentified illness, will you uncover the dark truth or become an accomplice to the system?

details.title: The Havoc Channel
details.short_description: A mystery comedy visual novel game told strictly through the eyes of a news anchor. Learn about the city of Brookside, report the news as best you can, and guide the citizens toward a happy ending.

details.title: Monkey With A Gun
details.short_description: You're a monkey with a gun — but the gun is only for jumping. Shoot the floor to launch yourself up a wobbly, hilarious climb out of the zoo, where one bad shot sends you plummeting all the way back down. Rage-inducing by design. Easy mode included.

details.title: Drop Rate
details.short_description: A short incremental game about hunting monsters for rare loot by upgrading a resurrecting horde of unpaid interns. Warp the odds. Earn eternal retirement. All with zero labor cost.

details.title: WhiskersOS: Click and Survive
details.short_description: Your family computer has been infected! In this survivor-like roguelite, battle through hordes of viruses using your desktop applications as weapons. Recover corrupted data to level up, then upgrade your apps and drivers to purge the infection for good.

details.title: Bells Of Velmora
details.short_description: The bells of Velmora have cracked, and the dead are getting up. Pick a hero, alone or with a friend, and descend through crypts, swamp and frozen peaks. Stack elemental rituals on the same button until it becomes a war machine, fall, grow stronger, and go again.

name: All Pool Players Go To Hell

details.title: All Pool Players Go To Hell
details.short_description: All Pool Players Go to Hell is a physics-based combat roguelite where your pool balls are your weapons, your deck determines your options, and every shot can send a carefully laid plan completely off the rails. Build your deck, line up your shots, and use real-time physics to survive.

details.title: Doodle Academy
details.short_description: Doodle Academy is a card autobattler set in a school where students settle scores with card duels. Spend gold to recruit and upgrade cards, then arrange your team for automatic battles. Uncover the academy’s secrets in the solo campaign or test your lineup against other players’ teams.

details.title: Rap Or Die
details.short_description: Nobody knows your name. Your studio is small. Your ambition isn't. Create beats, write lyrics, record tracks, start beefs, and build your underground rap empire from the ground up.

details.title: Stockroom Syndrome
details.short_description: Build flatpack furniture and decorate showroom displays during the night shift in a giant Scandinavian furniture store, while demonic creatures hunt you through its ever-changing halls. HØLM. Build the room. Survive the store.

details.title: Observer Effect
details.short_description: As an unwilling contestant, take part in a twisted game show, a first-person psychological thriller where you solve puzzles, try your luck, test your aim & face unpredictable games. Uncover the secret objective, outsmart the host & race against the clock to survive the show... if you dare.

details.title: Dreams About Fireflies
details.short_description: A first-person dreamcore game of collection and exploration. Chase fireflies through dreamlike worlds, unlock and upgrade various tools to catch them. From infant to adult, experience life's challenges, rediscover forgotten memories, and find the strength to heal yourself.

details.title: Tide & Tails
