details.short_description: A cozy desktop idle fishing game made to keep you company. Fish, collect, and display your favorite fish while you work or study. Upgrade your gear, explore new waters, and let your journal record the journey.

details.title: SinEater
details.short_description: Climb and parkour through procedurally generated towers of memories in search of your own sins in this third-person exploration platformer. Survive in the world after the second great flood. Manage resources and needs, scavenge and trade with fellow sin-eaters.

details.title: The Gaslight
details.short_description: The Gaslight is a chaotic social deduction game where one player is the Murderer, one is the Detective, and everyone else is trying to survive. Talk, lie, complete missions, use your pepper spray, and figure out who you can trust before someone gets stabbed.

details.title: Claire: Operation Velvet
details.short_description: Play as Claire to battle the evil forces invading the world. Harness the power of souls to wield weapons and complete missions. Uncover Claire's story and discover what the malicious Velvet wants to achieve.

name: Mind Echoes: Broken Vow Collector's Edition

details.title: Mind Echoes: Broken Vow Collector's Edition
details.short_description: Forgotten memories haunt the old estate. Uncover a doomed love story and stop the servant hiding deadly secrets within Graven Manor. Follow the tragic fate of Count Graven and his vanished bride Lydia as restless spirits awaken inside this cursed hidden-object mystery.

details.title: UNSPELLED
details.short_description: Cut limbs. Cut names. Be the last one standing. In this chaotic multiplayer brawler, every letter of your name is a life. Lose them all, and you're UNSPELLED.

details.title: Marsheez
details.short_description: A candy-coated party brawler for 1–8 players. Shove, skewer and toast your friends across a dozen sugar-fueled modes, on the couch or online. Squishy marshmallows, silly hats, absolute chaos.

details.title: Sector Zero: Freedom
details.short_description: A sci-fi incremental simulation where you work as an Imperial slave, build your own business, survive inspections, join unions, and buy your freedom.

details.title: DwarVein
details.short_description: Welcome to DwarVein, a world where you a trusty dwarf venture forth into inhabited caves on the search for valuable Gems. Careful though, there are creatures lurking in the dark abyss. They have stolen your trusted companions and hid them within the caves! Will you achieve the highest score!?

details.title: Math Defense Protocol
details.short_description: Deploy characters across a fractured mind, combine numbers and operators into equations, and turn every result into firepower. Build your squad, trigger bonds, and defend the last memories through story battles and endless challenges.
developers: 日食网络 Solar Eclipse studio
publishers: 日食网络 Solar Eclipse studio

details.title: Touhou: Cirno's Snowball
details.short_description: Nobody's buying Cirno's bingsu because it's too small, so she's rolling a snowball around Gensokyo to fix it. Strawberries stick. So do crates, rocks and frogs. See what kind of bingsu you can make.

details.title: Spear Dive
details.short_description: Hunt 80+ fish species in a first-person freediving sim. Learn their habits and manage oxygen and body heat. Gear up with spears, fins and wetsuits to dive deeper. Explore seas with daily changes in temperature, murkiness and waves, fill your fish encyclopedia and unlock new fishing grounds.

details.title: Skele TONS
details.short_description: A short incremental realtime tactics game about stopping a massive skeleton army.

details.title: Arcade Together
details.short_description: Run the arcade. Play the arcade. Together. Team up with friends to run your very own arcade! From classic cabinets to extreme experiences, from a corner shop to a grand entertainment center — build your arcade empire, side by side!

details.title: Dungeon Typist
details.short_description: Dungeon Typist is a typing-driven dungeon roguelite where every word becomes an action. Type words to move, attack, and cast abilities while enemies act in real time. Dodge danger, collect gear, and build powerful combinations as you venture deeper into the dungeon.

details.title: Arcane Circuit
details.short_description: ARCANE CIRCUIT is a dark fantasy deck-building roguelite. Socket Core Cards into Emitters, chain Modules together, and create fully automated arcane circuits. Explore the wastelands, collect powerful Relics, and build your very own spell-slinging machine gun!

details.title: Re:Red
details.short_description: Stay on the path, Little Red. Spot anomalies in an uncanny, looping forest to reach Grandma’s house with your basket of goodies intact. If safe, press forward. If not, turn back immediately. Trust your paper map, explore strange new areas, and most of all, watch out for the Big Bad Wolf.

details.title: Me VS Demonking?Seriously?
details.short_description: This is a proper auto-battler game... right? Aside from the characters being a bit odd, the equipment a bit bizarre, and the skills a bit baffling... everything else seems pretty normal.

details.title: Pickup Point Chaos
details.short_description: Run your own pickup point! Receive, scan, sort, and shelve packages. Find customer pickups, then weigh and label outgoing shipments. Carry several boxes to save time, but customers may knock them down. Handle package rain, fragile items, and explosives—and don’t blow up the place!

details.title: Devour & Evolve
details.short_description: Born at the bottom of the food chain in a first-person labyrinth. Devour what you weaken and keep one of its skills or traits, or bind it and breed it at home: its egg is your next body. The blood remembers. Train what you eat, fuse it into new arts, and evolve into branches your line never had.

details.title: Fishing Spot
details.short_description: Fishing Spot is a relaxing fishing game about discovering unique fishing locations and the species that inhabit them. Generate new spots with their own ecosystems, fish populations, bite schedules and bait preferences, chase records, and build your collection — all at your own pace.

details.title: Over The Gnome!
details.short_description: Become a giant gnome-crushing boulder. Chase the treasure gnomes, shrink the giant yetis with your shrink ray, grow and improve until you crush them all. Travel through 5 unique worlds, prestige, and unlock permanent talents to become unstoppable.

details.title: Screen Nook
details.short_description: A book nook for your desktop. Tiny, lit 3D worlds that live at the edge of your screen and follow your real hours. Nothing to win, nothing to grind. Just somewhere lovely to glance at while you work or study.

details.title: MechInfection
details.short_description: Co-op survival horror for 2–4 players. By day, scavenge supplies across shifting locations; by night, defend your shelter from the things outside. Craft weapons, set traps, cook, survive together, and break out of a dead world before dawn.

details.title: Tokyo Shop Simulator
details.short_description: Run your second-hand shop under Tokyo’s neon lights! 🏮 Find, buy, and sell unique Japanese goods and grow your store! 💰🎎

name: Summer☆Dash: Our Track Team's Summer Training Trip

details.title: Summer☆Dash: Our Track Team's Summer Training Trip
details.short_description: As coach of the girls' track team, go on an exciting retreat in the countryside with the three best girls of your team, where you'll help them overcome their struggles and unlock their full potential!

details.title: Rustmire
details.short_description: In this side-view pixel-art world, you captain a landship—survive by combat and scavenging, and grow your modular vessel into your own city. Among roaming cities and underground enclaves, records and wreckage hint at why people live this way… or how you become wreckage.

details.title: Still Stars Echo
details.short_description: An atmospheric science-fiction journey across distant alien landscapes. Traverse monolithic structures, solve intricate puzzles, and uncover the story of a lost civilization written among the stars.

details.title: Stackatalbi
details.short_description: Stackatalbi is a survival game where you stack cards to collect resources and craft new items. Drag your hero over an open world, hunt, fish, farm and grow stronger to fight new foes. Play solo or online co-op with a friend.

details.title: Ruin and Rebirth
details.short_description: Ruin and Rebirth is a fantasy open-world factory building game with creature taming and breeding. In this playable creation myth, bring life back to a surreal, shattered, post-divine apocalyptic world where the gods have died.

details.title: The King's Bargain
details.short_description: Thirty years ago the King sold his wife to the devil. Now Hell's collections department wants its money. Team up with up to 3 friends in online co-op, build your King with a skill tree and devilish boons, raid dungeons and smash Hell's middle managers in a darkly funny ARPG.

details.title: RabbitHole Island : Turn-based Vtuber Battles
details.short_description: A vtuber-coded RPG with dynamic boss fights, curious exploration, and silly shenanigans. FREE to Play!!

details.title: War of Blobs
details.short_description: Massive multiplayer slasher combat, reduced to circles and sticks. Directional swings, real parries, two hits to die...and 60+ other blobs in the lobby trying to kill you first. Everything that doesn't sharpen the fight has been cut.

details.title: Falcon Fall™
details.short_description: Dropped deep in hostile territory with no backup and no way out but through. Every street is a kill zone, every shadow a threat. Built in UE5 by seasoned VR devs and combat vets, Falcon Fall™ delivers the most unforgiving tactical VR combat experience. Wishlist now - deployment scheduled for 2026.

details.title: SCP 1985
details.short_description: Welcome to Site 78 in 1985 where the foundation would experience one of its first major breaches. Escape the facility and survive the scps.

details.title: Goreticulture
details.short_description: Nurture a visceral garden as you clean up a bloody aftermath. Mop, water, and shear your way through retro levels. Use every drop to grow plants that earn piles of coins. Turn your green thumb red in Goreticulture, where doom meets bloom!

details.title: ByteCrawler
details.short_description: Pick a hero, build your swarm, and hold off enemy waves. Place units, watch your energy, and level up to survive in this lane-defense strategy game!

details.title: SUBSELF: Lies Deep
details.short_description: You are a prisoner offered a single chance at freedom. In exchange, you must descend into the depths of an alien ocean and recover lost data from a sunken research station, abandoned under mysterious circumstances by a powerful space mega-corporation.

details.title: Tasmon's Little Island ~ Cursed Mascot
details.short_description: Raise a mysterious creature "Tasmon" on your desktop!! No need to pay attention constantly, enjoy interacting with them in your free time. Once it has grown enough, you can challenge simple auto battles. The Tasmon's appearance upon birth will depend on what you do on your PC

details.title: The Quiet Days of Dorothy
details.short_description: During the 2020 lockdown, Dorothy spends her days caring for jars of sourdough starters. By sharing them with others, she builds unexpected connections and discovers small acts of kindness that bring warmth in difficult times.

details.title: Incremental Heaven
details.short_description: Start as a tiny mech, spread as a cosmic parasite, or rewrite reality as a living cursor. Destroy enemies, unlock hundreds of upgrades, evolve through massive transformations, and grow from scrapyard survivor to universe-shaping power.

details.title: Runic Tower
details.short_description: Stand as the last guardian of the god-bound Runic Tower in a groundbreaking 3rd-person roguelike tower defense experience. Command evolving powers, confront relentless invading factions, and utilize strategic planning to overcome your foes!

details.title: Tidy Tidy
details.short_description: A casual healing organizing game. No complex controls—just click and drag to logically sort and arrange items across scenes, turning clutter into order. With no time limits, savor the relaxation and healing of tidying up.

details.title: Slingbox
details.short_description: A minimalist physics platformer built on momentum. Dash, tether, and launch through a decaying simulation: zero gravity first, then gravity and corruption. Beat the clock, earn medals, perfect every route.

details.title: By The Orchid
details.short_description: 中式原生家庭环境下，少年找寻存在方式的故事。

details.title: Snack Shop Simulator
details.short_description: Run your own snack shop where eating snacks makes you stronger! Order 45+ treats online, stock shelves, feed employees, serve customers, or hire a team to help you. Build your business, boost your power, and create the ultimate snack heaven!

details.title: Desserted
details.short_description: Desserted is a 1-6 player co-op survival horror game. Explore procedurally generated map in your mobile food truck. Gather, cook, and defend your power grid from sabotaging monsters. Complete sacrifices and survive the deadly Blackout when the lights go out!

details.title: Omicrox
details.short_description: Stuck in an unusual game night. Break the contract and escape. In Omicrox, you are drawn into a twisted match of Ultimate Tic-Tac-Toe against an uncanny foe. Uncover the mysteries of this twisted game and escape.

details.title: Backrooms: Rogue 0
details.short_description: A routine expedition into the Backrooms goes silent. You are the last call. Now trapped in endless corridors that loop into themselves, you’ll soon realize you are not alone. Something moves heremany things—and none of them can be fought. Your only hope is to stay unseen. Never trust what you see.

details.title: 42 Space Mayhem
details.short_description: Fast-paced rogue-lite space shooter where every run brings new upgrades, enemy waves, and ship evolutions. Play solo or team up with a friend in co-op to survive, adapt, and dominate the galaxy.

details.title: Frontiers of the Realms
details.short_description: Build a realm and a deck to match. Grow villages into cities, shape production chains and play cards for supplies, expansion and tactical support. A turn-based strategy game where rivals act in the same round. Play against AI or challenge friends online.

details.title: Wheels Echo: The Winter Chronicle
details.short_description: Wheels Echo is a winter survival story where your thoughts shape the journey. As Fred Walker, explore a silent frozen world, write down clues in your notebook, uncover mysteries, survive the cold, and piece together what happened to everyone — and to you.

name: 挂机后花园.放置牧场AFK back garden.idlepasture

details.title: 挂机后花园.放置牧场AFK back garden.idlepasture
details.short_description: Create your personal oasis in the corner of your desktop.​ This is a laid-back idle simulation game where simple clicks allow you to grow plants and feed adorable animals. Watch them thrive and multiply, receive surprise letters and gifts, and let the serene ambiance of nature fill your screen.
developers: 她山之石Stones from Other Hills
publishers: 她山之石Stones from Other Hills

details.title: AENIGMA
details.short_description: Set in the year 4XXX, humanity lives disconnected inside underground megastructures to escape the threat of the ever-expanding silicon-based lifeforms.

details.title: Lounge Café
details.short_description: Lounge Café is an atmospheric coffee shop simulator where you play as Sara from Lucerne, running a small café in Binoville. Choose beans, craft drinks, and compete in the city’s major coffee tournament to become the best.

details.title: Cozy Craft
details.short_description: A relaxing soft crafting and resource gatherer game. Explore, collect materials, refine them, and restore a ruined castle to rescue the kingdom's princess. No rush. No danger. Just build, collect, and watch your cozy world come to life.

details.title: pyTexas
details.short_description: Completely free Texas Hold'em game, play with your friends, find public lobbies around the world, or play alone with bots. You can also add bots when your lobby doesn't have enough players.

details.title: Recalibration
details.short_description: Take down all your enemies using as few bullets as possible. Be both stylish and efficient – that’s what a true assassin is all about. Uncover the betrayal, track down the culprits, and bring them to justice in the name of global peace.

details.title: Jacaro: Looming Dread
details.short_description: A single session of Jacaro stands between you and a fate worse than death. Whilst something is lurking and waiting for a mistake.

details.title: SkyRen
details.short_description: Race, climb, and free-run through dynamic cityscapes! Build your character, master movement, compete with players, earn gear, level up, and climb the leaderboards to become the ultimate free-runner in this anime parkour MMO!

details.title: Kōyō
details.short_description: Fast, satisfying top-down combat meets cozy progression. Slay yokai, grab loot, craft upgrades, and explore an Edo-inspired valley in a stylized 2.5D action RPG.

details.title: VERDGE
details.short_description: VERDGE is a dynamic speedrun plaformer, where the player can decide which content is generated.

details.title: FatSheep Crisis:RE
details.short_description: Baa, baa, baa, baa, baa, baa, baa, baa, baa, baa, baa, baa, baa, baa, baa, baa, baa, baa, baa, baa, baa, baa, baa, baa, baa, baa, baa, baa, baa, baa, baa, baa, baa, baa, baa, baa, baa, baa, baa, baa, baa, baa, baa, baa, baa, baa, baa, baa, baa, baa, baa, baa, baa, baa, baa, baa, baa, baa. Baa.

details.title: Atlas Proxima: Tether
details.short_description: Stay in touch with earth as you travel the solar system, in this co-operative online multiplayer idler world filled with curated content to discover and play together.

details.title: The Fridge
details.short_description: THE FRIDGE is an action-roguelite with procedurally generated maps. Find or purchase weapons in each run and face increasingly challenging waves of enemies. Obtain magical catalysts to boost your weapons’ power and experiment with different combinations to adapt your combat style.

details.title: Age of Respair
details.short_description: Age of Respair is a medieval strategy castle-builder. Build massive castles with fortifications while managing resources and production chains. Assemble a large army and lay siege to enemy castles. Lead your people and bring respair to your kingdom🏰⚔️

details.title: Dream Bar Simulator
details.short_description: Become the Owner of Your Own Dream Bar! Create unique cocktails. Manage bar resources, buy alcohol and consumables. Expand and customize your bar, buy furniture and interior items, create the most comfortable atmosphere for your clients. Hire unique employees.Reach the top of the bar industry.

details.title: Ultimate Gym Simulator: Prologue
details.short_description: Build your dream gym with Ultimate Gym Simulator: Prologue

details.title: Dealer Shift
details.short_description: Get your hands dirty in an immersive open-world crime simulator. Mix, grind, dissolve, and package every product yourself, build hidden labs, outsmart the police, smuggle shipments through checkpoints, and grow from a small-time dealer into an underground kingpin.

details.title: Delta
details.short_description: Delta is a first-person movement-heavy platformer game focused on physics-based traversal, speedrunning, and mechanical mastery. And somewhere ahead, the one you lost is still waiting.

details.title: Hello Space
details.short_description: Dive into a 2D action game where you control a spaceship, defeat enemies and overcome deadly traps. Extend your arsenal by collecting new weapons and technologies for your ship that you will need to conquer four different dungeon-like worlds, all connected by an open space full of surprises.

details.title: Project SARA
details.short_description: A man who has lost his wife and seeks to escape loneliness and grief begins working as a firewatch in a forest. He meets a girl named Sarah and encounters strange occurrences while uncovering deep family secrets. He learns that not every voice is human and not every farewell signifies an end.

details.title: Bottom-Up Beatdown: Hostile Takeover
details.short_description: Bottom-Up Beatdown: Hostile Takeover is an intense 2D beat em' up set in a world dominated by corporations led by monsters! The only way out is up! Begin your freelance kaiju career in campaign mode, or play with friends in the traditional, challenging arcade mode!

details.title: Chronal Chain
details.short_description: "TIME CONTROL" bullet hell action. Overcome impossible odds by slowing, stopping and rewinding time!

details.title: Ta-Miu
details.short_description: Play as a cat chosen by the goddess Bastet. Solve ancient puzzles, unlock magical powers, and uncover the secrets of Egypt filled with myths, temples, and tombs. Embark on a mystical adventure and stop an ancient evil!

name: シェオルの森　- 黄昏の魔獣使い -

details.title: シェオルの森　- 黄昏の魔獣使い -
details.short_description: 古代中国から伝わる呪術「蟲毒」に着想を得た、「蟲毒×魔獣錬成×落ちものパズル」それが、「シェオルの森-黄昏の魔獣使い-」です。魔獣を使い魔にし、魔獣と戦わせ、使い魔同士を融合し巨大な魔獣を錬成しましょう！

details.title: Shrouded Siege
details.short_description: Design dastardly mazes in this co-op roguelike tower defense set in Irish mythology. Combine divine boons to make unstoppable towers and sculpt the terrain to make the ultimate death traps for your enemies.

details.title: Car-Nudge
details.short_description: Car-Nudge is a party game with cars. Play locally or online with up to 8 players, through different minigames and levels. Demolish your friends (or enemies) to win and unlock new customizations and cars to play with.

details.title: Chicken Jump, Puppy Jump
details.short_description: An online multiplayer party game for 4–8 players. Build your crew of robo-animal thieves, roam across insane locations to snatch treasures, or simply STEAL goodies from rival players — all to become the MOST WANTED crew on the Bounty Board!

details.title: The Calling
details.short_description: An anime-inspired free-to-play PvP arena shooter where every match is shaped by your build, strategy, and creativity. Customize your abilities, adapt to dynamic weather and day-night cycles, and outplay the competition in fast-paced battles.

details.title: Smash Simulator
details.short_description: Inherit a failing company and transform it into a destruction empire! Build and manage your own Rage Rooms, let clients smash objects to relieve stress… and turn it all into profit!

details.title: Aftershock
details.short_description: An earthquake has just struck the building you’re in — and caught off guard, you’ll have only moments to react. Every step could mean the difference between life and death.

details.title: The Friendliest Skunk
details.short_description: Skunk is the friendliest critter in the forest — but his natural scent makes making friends a bit… tricky. Help Skunk traverse a musical forest, in this charming rhythm-based platformer! Meet adorable forest friends, outwit hungry predators, and prove that kindness (+ good timing) conquers all!

details.title: Silentia
details.short_description: In Silentia, the monster is blind. It sees only what it hears. Hunt as Krav, a creature that grows stronger with every sound, or survive as one of the many, escaping in total silence. Make a sound, and it finds you.

name: The Man of Iron: Shadows of Haensburg

details.title: The Man of Iron: Shadows of Haensburg
details.short_description: Step into the boots of a guard in the dark megapolis of Haensburg. Master first-person combat and exploration in a striking 2D-in-3D stylized world. Caught between powerful factions, your decisions will shape the city's fate. Will you uphold the law or survive the shadows?

details.title: VeriData Inc.
details.short_description: Solve spreadsheet-based puzzles and handle crazy coworkers in a normal day's work at VeriData Inc.

details.title: Menhera Maiden
details.short_description: A ‘Landmine × Yuri’ Visual Novel. To complete your master's thesis, you are forced to interact with these landmine girls—a decision that may well prove to be the most disastrous of your life. Your dialogue and choices will not only shape your relationships with the heroines, but also your thesis.

name: A Game About Launching A Ball

details.title: A Game About Launching A Ball
details.short_description: A challenging game about launching a ball to collect stars. Collect the stars as fast as you can, discover the secrets, upgrade your ball, and unlock the awards. Grab a friend to play online or split screen!

details.title: Jingle Balls
details.short_description: Santa is injured and the gift list is gone. Jingle Balls is a first-person co-op horror game for 1–4 players. Search each house for clues, choose the right gift, and leave it without being seen. House layouts change between visits. Face different enemies and use a range of items.

details.title: Minesweeper: Next-Gen
details.short_description: This isn’t the Minesweeper you’re used to! In Minesweeper: Next-Gen, you’ll explore boards built from a variety of geometric tessellations. Boundaries can wrap around, tiles can split, and parts of the map can even contain the map itself. Rely on pure logic to gradually uncover all safe areas.

details.title: Fort Synergy Demo
details.short_description: A funny co-op tower defense game where you and your friends need to work together to defend yourselves against all the incoming waves of monsters! Decide whether to roam the map or stay near the towers!

details.title: Thieving Together
details.short_description: You and your crew have one goal: break in, grab everything, and get out before sunrise. Thieving Together is a chaotic physics PvP & co-op heist party game. Drag loot, dodge rivals, stack the van fast. Everything wobbles. Everyone steals. Biggest haul by sunrise wins.

details.title: GearGrave
details.short_description: 2D side-scrolling strategy game. Spawn units, fight, and destroy. Your choices decide victory or defeat.

details.title: Radical Tower Defense
details.short_description: In Radical Tower Defense, harness shifting core chips to forge a unique steel defense. Each choice reshapes your combat style. Unlock architectures, explore chip synergies, ignite tactical reactions. Don’t just defend—become a blade to break formations, strike the heartland, crush the enemy lair!

details.title: HOLER!
details.short_description: Dig, dig, and DIG! One meter deeper, one second longer. A relentless mining action game where you plunge into an endless underground world! Your only rival is your past self. The eternal challenge to shatter your own "Best Record" begins now!

details.title: Hidden Streets
details.short_description: Find cats and hidden objects in illustrated streets full of detail.

details.title: BLIGHTEN
details.short_description: BLIGHTEN is a survival horror fps set in an abandoned facility overrun by mindless creatures infected by the Blight. Scavenge for resources and do whatever it takes to survive the industrial hellscape you're isolated within.

details.title: 夏飢聲（なきごえ）
details.short_description: A first-person horror adventure game featuring a side story (spin-off) scenario based on “Kyoso Musebiya” by “Obaken.” Guided to Musebiya, the protagonist ventures into a mysterious underground space. What choices will they make, and what fate awaits them…?

details.title: Fantasy Mountains
details.short_description: Paper Mountain is the first chapter in Fantasy Mountains. A casual, friendly, single‑player VR climbing game. Enter a fantasy paper world. Meet and interact with the mountain creatures along the path. Collect useful and less useful items. Find your way to the mountaintop.

details.title: Tyrants Must Fall
details.short_description: In this turn-based tactical roguelike, build an army to triumph in fast-paced battles. Deploy your troops, plan your attack, and watch as the action plays out simultaneously. Unlock powerful formations and guide the Hero of Destiny as he topples the Tyrant King!

details.title: Basement Server Simulator
details.short_description: Build a basement hosting empire solo or in co-op. Buy and place servers, install server apps, set your prices, accept time-limited customer contracts, and balance power, internet, heat, and hardware failures as you expand your operation.

details.title: Sunny Hollow
details.short_description: Move to a magical city to live with your grandmother and make it your home. Explore vibrant districts, build relationships with 100+ villagers who remember how you treat them, help with errands and jobs, fish at the waterways, customize your home, and discover the stories throughout Sunny Hollow.

details.title: Astral Bloom
details.short_description: Grow a living alien world in this incremental base-builder. Cultivate strange plants, command loyal wisps, and reshape the sky with powerful wishes. Automate and expand your ecosystem as you uncover lost memories. As your sanctuary grows, will you stay... or leave in search of something more?

name: I Want To Be a Child

details.title: I Want To Be a Child
details.short_description: Family is the most precious thing you have. No matter what, right

details.title: Confessional: Reality TV Manager
details.short_description: A reality TV production management game. Cast, create or download contestants, design your season, and watch drama unfold in the most complex relationship sim ever created. Scout hidden talent, manage moods, watch challenges play out, and survive dramatic tribal councils. Build your franchise.

details.title: Min5 Min - Party Edition
details.short_description: "Fast, competitive, and sugar-coated! Min5 Min is designed for those looking for intense action in a short amount of time. Equipped with a variety of characters and powerful weapons, you have a minimum of 5 minutes to survive in this stylized world!"

details.title: EIDOL
details.short_description: Craft living statues from Oak, Stone, and Steel. Infiltrate a corrupt guild as you rise through the ranks in this hand-drawn dark fantasy card game set in an ancient world. Every eidol you build is a reflection of your mastery.

name: The Ghost Protocol: Echoes of Steel

details.title: The Ghost Protocol: Echoes of Steel
details.short_description: Command a squad of broken survivors on a planet that hunts you. A tactical mech-action game, you must build your base, defend against crystalline swarms, and manage the "Icarus Drift"—a neural link that grants god-like power but costs your humanity. Will you break the enemy, or become part of it?

details.title: Knut
details.short_description: SAVE THE PLANET, FIND YOUR FISH! In this epic 2D platformer, a simple rescue mission spirals into total planetary chaos. Knut, a one-eyed rodent with a nuclear-grade grudge, engages a robotic army to find his pet. Master twitchy physics and massive upgrades. Nothing stands between you and your fish!

details.title: The Observation Exit
details.short_description: A first-person psychological horror where you must identify anomalies, choose the correct elevator to progress, and escape an endless loop in a hospital corridor while avoiding deadly entities.

details.title: XiaoLuo's English War
details.short_description: The town is collapsing! A demonic legion is closing in, and its survival is in your hands. Words are your bullets, and typing speed is your life. Type accurately to unleash lethal skills against waves of enemies. Grab your keyboard and fight to master English and survive!

details.title: Dumb Dunks
details.short_description: Dumb Dunks! is a wildly creative, satirical twist on basketball where every level throws a ridiculous new object and target at you. Master tricky physics, perfect your timing, and embrace the chaos in this humorous physics-based dunking frenzy.

details.title: AI VS ARTISTS
details.short_description: Prove the power of human artists in this narrative-driven story game! Do you have what it takes to dethrone Scylla Corporation?

details.title: Apiary in Flow
details.short_description: Apiary in Flow is an incremental game with automation elements where you place bees inside a hive to build efficient honey-gathering chains. Unlock new bee types and spend your harvest on permanent skill tree upgrades!

details.title: Little Joe the Dodger
details.short_description: A high-difficulty puzzle action game featuring monochrome minimalist graphics and extremely simple controls — you can only jump.

details.title: Scarecrow Simulator
details.short_description: No swords. No dragons. No heroic destiny. Just you, a scarecrow, standing proudly in a medieval field while the world grows around you. Surprisingly relaxing. Surprisingly addictive.

details.title: S-Ranker
details.short_description: Fight through short dungeons in this action roguelite. Choose new powers in combat, equip runes between runs, and rise from F-Rank to S-Rank.

details.title: Clicker Tactics: Memorian
details.short_description: A clicker × auto-battle tactics game where you place your companions on a 3×3 grid. Link chains with a wide variety of skills and relics, and mow down the hordes surging toward you. An exhilarating incremental RPG where every adventure makes you stronger.

details.title: Kotoha’s Sealed Sword: Hiragana Deckbuilding
details.short_description: Learn and master Japanese with Kotoha! Join her as she goes on a mission to find her grandfather's sealed sword. Discover new creatures. Unlock and craft new words, add them to your hand to aid you in battle.

details.title: Funny Rummy
details.short_description: A Rummy roguelike set in a surreal, hand-drawn world that blends daydream and reality. Visit the Junk Drawer between rounds to bend the rules with wild cards and sub-suits that unlock new strategies. Experiment with new decks and trinkets to build power against ever-increasing scoring goals.

details.title: Vatan
details.short_description: Vatan is a narrative-focused historical drama set in Sivas in 1892. In young Ahmet's life, caught between family, love, and homeland, every decision you make changes relationships, atmosphere, and the path to the finale; every scene carries an emotional cost

details.title: Bad AI
details.short_description: Rapid advances in AI have sparked a wave of unemployment—and you are one of those left without a job. Your story begins at a black market, where you meet an outdated AI destined for destruction. Left behind by a changing world, humans and AIs find warmth in one another and slowly become a family.

details.title: Stellar Harvest
details.short_description: Harvest energy across the solar system. Build generators on alien worlds, prestige for Dark Energy, and construct a Dyson Sphere around the Sun. Ten planets. Infinite power. One way home.

details.title: Digital Druid
details.short_description: Build synergistic Gardens in this abstract roguelike deckbuilder. Push your luck and find the balance between growth and corruption. The Garden must Bloom.

details.title: Depth ReCharged!
details.short_description: Sink the subs before they sink you! A fast single-screen arcade shooter inspired by the 1970s classic Depth Charge. Dodge mines and torpedoes, grab power-ups, survive ever-harder waves and chase the high score. Built for Steam Deck, great on desktop too.

details.title: The Varitav
details.short_description: A top-down pixel art survivor roguelike. Play as a little fox, craft a powerful build against endless enemy waves, and survive across three distinct biomes. No permanent upgrades. You start from scratch every run. As the swarm grows stronger, surviving gets pretty hard.

details.title: The Buried Light
details.short_description: Cast into an abyss by a cosmic god, ancient forests have mutated into living botanical warships. In this mythic bullet-hell RPG, shift between four active combat modes, breed your skill tree, and craft modular ammunition across five slots to survive 150+ hand-authored phases and reclaim the sun.
publishers: Red Apple Swimming In The Green River Games

details.title: Raceway Sparks
details.short_description: Racing game in crazy world with futuristic cars and ai bots.

details.title: Treecension
details.short_description: Small Crow Man climbs big evil tree to save the world

details.title: Flightopedia: Legacy Wings
details.short_description: Master the skies in a mission-driven, third-person flight simulator. Take control across 12 structured levels featuring a diverse fleet from commercial airliners to military aircraft.
developers: Yash Future Tech Solutions Private Limited
publishers: Yash Future Tech Solutions Private Limited

details.title: DodgeBaller
details.short_description: Dodgeball is a martial art. Challenge your friends up to 4 players locally or online! Play as unique characters with varied styles and prove you are the ultimate Dodgeballer Artist.

details.title: Speed RPG
details.short_description: Play one card, discard one — both sides commit in secret, then everything resolves at once. Read your opponent on a 13x8 grid, build twin Move and Action decks, and climb the 100-Man Kumite, where turn timers shrink to 6 seconds. Short matches, fast decisions, one more run. Solo-dev alpha, JP/EN.

name: It's Just a Rescue, Bro! — Idle Hell RPG

details.title: It's Just a Rescue, Bro! — Idle Hell RPG
details.short_description: An idle ARPG for loot goblins. Slaughter monsters automatically, hunt build-changing gear, craft ridiculous builds, unlock new classes, then rebirth and do it all again—stronger.

details.title: AshSpire
details.short_description: A first-person roguelite horde-shooter. Shoot, slice, explode, trample and disco ball to death a metric ton of enemies. Also you get a grapple ability, so you're welcome!

details.title: The Last Lunch
details.short_description: A psychological cooking horror game set in a post-Soviet school. Cook meals, explore the school and its surroundings, and uncover the disturbing story hidden behind an ordinary cafeteria shift.

details.title: Midnight Haunting
details.short_description: The road home is never safe. Midnight Haunting is a 2D survival action game that demands the deliberate controls of a classic cinematic platformer. Survive a haunting, twisted midnight street riddled with deadly traps to reach the safety of your front door. Your next step could always be your last.

details.title: Holy Relic Shop Simulator
details.short_description: A medieval shopkeeping sim about appraising holy relics. Examine bone, metal, wood and documents in your pilgrim city, find the detail that doesn't fit, pass your verdict — then decide what to do with the truth. A mother begs for a miracle you know is fake. What do you sell?

details.title: Normal Human Jobs
details.short_description: A first-person incremental shooter about eight regular office jobs disguised as an evil robot experiment. Sweep, sort, shoot and buy upgrades until the job runs itself. Finish all eight and the CEO chair is yours.

details.title: KISI: The Deja Vu
details.short_description: 〈KISI: The Deja Vu〉 is a 3D anomaly-detection psychological horror adventure game based on the eerie sense of familiarity felt in a sanity-bending experimental facility—the phenomenon known as "Déjà Vu."

details.title: Across the Dark
details.short_description: A perilous quest to the Demon Lord's castle, where one mistake means death. Conquer foes using 4 heroes—Bloodslayer, IronGuard, GrandMage, SwiftHealer—and 8-slot card synergies. No fast reflexes required. Only your meticulous deck building and health management will save you.

details.title: Colosseum Infection
details.short_description: "Build your unique strategy stress-free, with zero time pressure! Combine synergies, augments, and items to form an unstoppable army. Step into immersive unit-view combat, taking direct control with manual movement and tactical potion throws to reverse the odds in this strategic auto-battler."

details.title: Towerburst
details.short_description: An incremental tower defense game where you fight enemies using unique tower combinations. Gather resources from fallen enemies, unlock and upgrade your towers, discover new tower synergies and defeat every enemy before your towers run out of shots.

details.title: Rewind Together
details.short_description: Join your brother on an epic time-travel adventure! Solve puzzles together across Ancient Egypt, the Middle Ages, and the Wild West to find your way back home. Don't forget to take photos!

details.title: SubQuest
details.short_description: SubQuest is a productivity game that grows with you, right on your desktop. Cute characters, endless adventures, and a diorama where your heroes rest between quests — decorate it however you like! Notes, to-dos, Time-Quests — get your work done side by side with your hero party!

details.title: VORA
details.short_description: Seeking shelter from the bitter cold after a car accident, you take refuge in an old cave. What seemed like salvation quickly turns into a nightmare.

details.title: Doodle Figure
details.short_description: Doodle Figure is a VR party game for one headset and a room full of phones.

details.title: Laurus
details.short_description: Rig the machine until it pays out wrong. Draw symbols from your bag across five reels, chain paylines, and slot circuit-board artifacts into combos the house never accounted for. A roguelike deckbuilder about the arithmetic of very bad odds.

details.title: Jin Ping Mei: Qinghe Reverie
details.short_description: In Qinghe County during the Northern Song, manage businesses and household affairs, build relationships, gather rumors and evidence, and set schemes in motion. As Ximen Qing, balance time, wealth, reputation and favors while your choices reshape lives, fortunes and endings.

details.title: Ribbit Robber
details.short_description: A challenging stealth game where every move matters. Sneak, trick, and outsmart enemy guards using creative abilities in a medieval world of frog people.

details.title: The 8 O'clock Block
details.short_description: A retro-inspired puzzle game featuring 11 unique game modes. Stack, match, chain, battle bosses, discover powerful items, and chase endless high scores across a variety of fast-paced block puzzle challenges.

details.title: AscendiA
details.short_description: For anyone who ever dreamed of being a shonen manga hero. You wake in a strange forest, left with only a tower and one word: “Climb.” Ascendia is a pixel action roguelike where the powers you choose awaken as new skills and hidden secrets as Astras. The path you walk becomes your own ending.

details.title: Barkyard Blitz
details.short_description: Herd sheep, steal points, and blast your rivals with weaponized barking! Gain unique abilities, defend your base, survive chaotic events, and play different roles in the ultimate farmyard battle.

details.title: Linked Wheels
details.short_description: Drive a cart through chaotic physics-based obstacle courses, alone or in online co-op. Coordinate both sides, jump, crouch, and survive deadly traps without destroying your friendship.

details.title: Job Burnout
details.short_description: Psychological horror game about your lovely work. Absurd humor, incompetent management, pointless tasks, weird coworkers, and monsters that show up in the office after the workday ends.

details.title: The Kingdom's Merchant
details.short_description: Build your fortune in a living medieval kingdom. Establish shops, manage caravans, master a dynamic economy, and outmaneuver rival merchant houses in single-player or competitive multiplayer as you build the realm's greatest trading empire.

details.title: Quantum Gomoku
details.short_description: A stone's color isn't decided until you "observe" it—a competitive five-in-a-row puzzle in flux. Black or white is drawn the instant you observe, and knowing when to spend your limited observations decides the match. A fresh take on strategy where luck meets mind games.

name: おやすみ冒険隊-ボクと最後の夏休み-

details.title: おやすみ冒険隊-ボクと最後の夏休み-
details.short_description: 懐かしくて温かくてちょっぴり切ない…… 少年少女たちによる、ひと夏のジュブナイルRPG！

details.title: Next Level: Tower Defense
details.short_description: Race-based tower defense. Build your army, defend your king, and send waves at your rivals. Up to 8-player FFA, 2v2 & 4v4 teams, and singleplayer. Crossplay on Windows, Linux, macOS & Steam Deck.

details.title: Groundwork
details.short_description: The humans are coming. Someone has to get the place ready. Scan what grows here, gather and mine. Repair the robots from crashed ships, and they'll teach you new recipes and take over jobs. Build a new home for the humans, and a home for the robots you found. No combat, no timer, no fail screen.

details.title: Absolute Sumo: Chonk Arena
details.short_description: A silly online party game where you play a chubby meme animal in a tiny sumo belt and shove everyone else out of the ring. Win rounds to grow from a cute little wobbler into a giant slab of muscle, dodge shifting arenas, and fight over who gets to push who.

details.title: Shrimp Method
details.short_description: Shrimp Method is a deliciously addictive shrimp-themed incremental game, where you can watch your shrimp slosh around into full grown crustaceans, vacuumed up by Shrimp Co.'s industrial vacuum network and turned into sweet sweet money!

details.title: Konbini Shift
details.short_description: A shop-sim puzzle game about running a Japanese convenience store. Drag runs of matching goods off the shelves to fill orders, then cook what you sell in the kitchen out back. VIPs and the panic clock force you to spend powerups wisely and clock out with the day banked and your manager's ask filled.

details.title: Kingdom's Destiny: Warlords
details.short_description: Defend the realms from tyrannical warlords, then recruit them! Command epic turn-based battles to defend the land from oppression. When pirates invade the small kingdom of Forestgrove they awaken military leaders who rise against cruelty and subjugation.

details.title: SALT SWEEPER
details.short_description: SALT SWEEPER is a roguelite twist on minesweeper. Sweep corrupted desert mines, fight enemies in turn-based combat, and grow more powerful with weapons and spells you find along the way.

details.title: Precinct 2099
details.short_description: NeoTokyo, 2099. The man who sold immortality is dead in a penthouse sealed from the inside. You are detective Kade Katano: scan the scene, read people, roll the dice and decide which truth closes the file. A noir visual novel — one complete case, three endings.

details.title: ODYSSEY: Wine-Dark Sea
details.short_description: Troy has fallen. Home is an angry sea away. Lead a crew of named men through the myths of the Odyssey — ration food, bargain with gods, decide who lives. In the myth he came home alone. Can you do better? A story-rich roguelite where every voyage ends in an epic Song about your choices.

details.title: Forgotten Possessions
details.short_description: Find and collect items that tell a dark story in an abandoned log cabin, but watch out for what lurks behind you. You sneak through dark rooms against a relentless, adaptive creature. Experience a dynamic world with randomized item locations and a reactive environment.

details.title: Carrot Count Sheep
details.short_description: Play as Carrot, a little bug who dives into The Dream of 100 Sheep in this cozy rpg puzzle adventure. Solve not-too-hard puzzles, meet interesting and unique characters, and uncover the mystery behind nightmares that are appearing across this once cozy dream. Whose dream is this, anyway?

details.title: Tin Coffins
details.short_description: You are Talon-22, a combat clone printed this shift, and twenty-one of you didn't come home. A cel-shaded mech roguelite shooter: short, lethal squad battles through procedurally generated war-torn cities, against enemy squads that flank, suppress and hold the line. Die, and the next you deploys.

details.title: Federal Cadet
details.short_description: Federal Cadet is a single-player police simulation and investigation game. Start as a cadet in Pinewood, patrol the town, question witnesses and suspects, analyze evidence, and rise through the department ranks.

details.title: Budget Defense
details.short_description: During the day, he personally drove the war vehicle to attack the enemy. At night, he extracted oil to sell and use the money to build defense towers, working together to protect the base.

details.title: Fast Charging Tycoon
details.short_description: Run an electric vehicle charging company. Choose your locations, design sites, schedule repairs, apply for loans and grants, vote on industry initiatives, hire executives, maintain reputation and site driver experience ratings, and claim one of four victories to build a fast charging tycoon.

details.title: Plague Doctor: Apothecary
details.short_description: Run your own plague doctor apothecary in this first-person shop simulator. Grind herbs, stir brews, bottle remedies and advise customers. Set prices, count change, hire staff and grow a humble remedy shop into Rookbridge's trusted apothecary.

details.title: JAPAN BUS SIMULATOR
details.short_description: Draw bus routes across a fictional Japan-inspired city, take the wheel yourself, and grow a tiny depot into a city-wide bus company. Stop precisely, stay on time, hire drivers and watch your network come alive.

details.title: Seven Relics
details.short_description: This is a card adventure game where you can choose 4 characters to form a team, select different routes to defeat enemies, and earn gold and experience points. Enemies will attack, and you can level up characters, purchase equipment, upgrade, enhance, and forge your cards to defeat powerful foes.

details.title: Hecatomb
details.short_description: Hecatomb is a mythic deckbuilding roguelike that tests how much you're willing to sacrifice. Every action produces Offerings, which can be relinquished to the Gods in exchange for powerful effects. But which Gods you worship and which you scorn have lasting effects on your journey to the Underworld.

details.title: Tide Fall
details.short_description: Explore dangerous islands, build and defend your base, sail the seas, and raid rival crews in this open-world pirate survival game.

details.title: Spinbot
details.short_description: A roguelite drenched in 00's competitive shooter vibes. In Spinbot, you trade your soul for cheats. Wipe out waves of bots and upgrade your "wordprocessor.exe" with some amazing features.

details.title: HAIGLA
details.short_description: Confined to a wheelchair, explore a hospital pulled into a distorted world beneath reality. A slow psychological horror focused on exploration, tension, and the unsettling atmosphere of this place.

details.title: Between Worlds: challenging puzzles
details.short_description: "Between Worlds" is a 2D puzzle game where you reshape the boundary between two intertwined worlds to reach the goal. Turn characters into terrain to create paths, but every change affects both sides of the world. Use logic, shifting gravity, and creative thinking to solve complex puzzles.

details.title: Monsters Awaiting Parcels
details.short_description: Parcels arrive every day — along with those who want to claim them. Find the parcels, make decisions, and don’t make mistakes, because if something goes wrong, the consequences can be… unpleasant.

details.title: Beeline
details.short_description: Slash and dash through tens of thousands of enemies per run in this base building horde-survival roguelite. Call in the hive for support, wield up to five weapons, evolve devastating builds, and combine powerful abilities. Rescue and hatch unique bees, build your Hive, and retake your bee empire.

details.title: Table of Fates
details.short_description: A roguelike deckbuilder set in a medieval tavern. Build your deck through tactical card play. Create powerful combos, make risky deals, and know when to walk away. Karma remembers every choice!

details.title: DeskFarm: Idle Garden
details.short_description: A desktop-optimized idle farm that stays by your side. Use built-in pin and hide features to grow your pixel garden without interrupting your workflow. Strategically secure rare seeds from the rotating shop and upgrade your way to discover increasingly valuable crop tiers.

details.title: Pocket Paradise Restaurant
details.short_description: Run your restaurant on the paradise island of Isla Sabor ! Dive in the ocean to get food, design and expand your restaurant, buy supplies and cook meals for your clients !

details.title: The Defective One
details.short_description: This is a visual novel set against the backdrop of a high school student band. It is a fierce collision between gender identity, the concept of freedom, and traditional views. You will play as the band's bassist, choose your answers to these issues, and experience the story of this special band.

details.title: PIGGO
details.short_description: A chaotic multiplayer party card game where players race to collect four matching cards, bluff their friends, and react at the perfect moment. Play with 2-4 players through fast unpredictable rounds. In PIGGO, it’s never just the cards.

details.title: Endless Harvest
details.short_description: Endless Harvest is relaxing yet strategic incremental farming game where every crop you place changes the efficiency of your growing plot of land. Grow crops, unlock upgrades, and optimize your farm as much as possible!

details.title: The Pyroxene Ages
details.short_description: This is a top-down, loot-based RogueLite game. You can build a town, craft weapons and socket them with various gems, then embark on adventures across maps you construct yourself.

details.title: New Game+ - Game Store Simulator
details.short_description: Run the game store you never wanted to leave, from the late ’90s to today. Buy, sell and repair games, haggle over trade-ins, and hunt for rare finds. Customize your shop and fill your shelves with parodies that make you laugh, cringe, or remember the games you grew up with.

details.title: Oath for Glory
details.short_description: Join the tournament as a lowly knight of a small village. A skill-based boss fighting game built around directional combat. Learn, adapt, and master precise melee mechanics where player skill determines victory.

details.title: Wanderfolk
details.short_description: A farming RPG where villagers remember everything. Grow crops, forage, and explore a procedurally generated world, then talk to AI-powered NPCs who form real opinions about you. Build friendships, pursue romance, fight monsters (or stay peaceful), and become part of a living village community.

details.title: Seal The Breach
details.short_description: A 3D survival experience set within a cramped one-man submarine exploring a hostile ocean trench.

details.title: Stardust Protocol
details.short_description: Blast through bullet hell in a sci-fi roguelite shooter. Chart a branching star map, combine scatter shots, missiles, homing fire and lasers, and build your arsenal with upgrades and items. Weigh risks at black markets and unknown events. Face colossal mechanical bosses. Play the free demo.

details.short_description: 🐾 Join the cutest adventure in themed locations full of cats! 😻 Explore the charming hand-drawn artwork of special places and try to find 100 adorable cats hidden throughout the game. 🐈🕵️‍♂️ Can you find them all? 🕵️‍♂️🐈

details.title: Vicelock - Tactical Roguelite RPG
details.short_description: Build a team, loot gear in turn-based tactical combat, then extract or push deeper and risk losing it all. Forge, craft and trade your haul on a real player-driven market. A tactical roguelite where your loot actually has value.

details.title: HER VOICE BEHIND
details.short_description: A magician wakes with no memory of the woman he loved... or how she died. Explore a circus that rearranges itself behind you, evade the witness in the rafters, and uncover what really happened during "The Final Show." An atmospheric first-person psychological horror game.

details.title: Atout
details.short_description: Classic Card Games & more: 23 card games in one, from Tarot to Hanafuda, plus Rummy, Belote, Poker and Solitaire. Three AI difficulty levels, local and online multiplayer, 24 variants, six languages. A warm pixel-art take on the classics — play solo or with friends.

details.title: Hypercube
details.short_description: An exhilarating FPS-style combat game featuring fully destructible arenas. The more you fight on, the less of the level you have left to fight in!

details.title: PuzzlePlants
details.short_description: In this post-apocalyptic gardening puzzle game players travel from island to island to help the inhabitants put food on the table. While placing plants, they have to consider their needs and avoid bad matches. Players face increasingly difficult puzzles due to sunlight, wind, rain or soil quality.

details.title: Cold Contours: Intake
details.short_description: You find yourself inside a frozen industrial megastructure. Its corridors are silent, its machinery locked in ice. Yet the pipes still breathe steam, and something at its very heart is waiting. The path to it is a puzzle of ice and metal, but all you have is a pair of magnets.

details.title: Turtles on Crocodiles
details.short_description: The world out there is full of wonders. Explore it at a turtle’s pace. Take your time. Along the pilgrimage, friendships may bloom. And sometimes, even sweet, sweet love.

name: Costella Maid Cafe♡ : The 5 Love Recipe for you

details.title: Costella Maid Cafe♡ : The 5 Love Recipe for you
details.short_description: 실존 코스튬 플레이어 5인이 직접 등장하는, 실사 비주얼 기반 연애 시뮬레이션. 옛날부터 알고 지내던 누나의 부탁으로 작은 메이드 카페 「코스텔라」의 임시 매니저가 된 당신. 라강, 아희, 보미, 아소, 린땅 — 다섯 명의 메이드와 함께하는 예상치 못한 일상 속에서, 다섯 가지 마음의 이야기가 시작됩니다.

details.title: Block Dash
details.short_description: A short, fast-paced action game where you move and dash your way through an abstract obstacle course. Encounter a wide variety of blocks that all pose different challenges. Will you be able to make your way through and see what lies at the end of it all?

name: Casa de Cuy: A Finca Full of Fluff

details.title: Casa de Cuy: A Finca Full of Fluff
details.short_description: Find 850+ mischievous guinea pigs across a cozy hand-drawn hidden-object adventure set in a Peruvian-inspired finca. Collect snackos, unlock secret rooms, solve tiny puzzles, and follow the crumbs toward the legendary Golden Corn.

details.title: A Moon Full of Money
details.short_description: Blast rocks, upgrade your base, and earn lots of money in this compact incremental game. Expand and automate your operation with powerful abilities like mining robots, drones, mines, supply drops, an orbital laser, and more.

details.title: Fairy Forge
details.short_description: Explore a spooky fantasy world, craft unique weapons, fight monsters, befriend magical fairies, fly an airship to visit sky islands, and build bases in this action sandbox adventure.

details.title: Pepo Sort Master
details.short_description: In Pepo Sort Master, take on high-speed sorting puzzles in a whimsical factory. Among the mysterious creatures called "Pepo" streaming down the line, "Pepo Imposters" are hiding in the mix. Master the art of Pepo inspection and earn your title as a certified Master Pepo!

details.title: Golden Bay: Desktop Aquarium
details.short_description: Golden Bay: Desktop Aquarium is a cozy ocean-themed desktop idle management game. Place a transparent bay at the bottom of your screen, raise fish and corals, welcome diving visitors, and care for a changing ecosystem. Earn income, upgrade your bay, and enjoy a peaceful companion while you work.

details.title: Utaburg
details.short_description: Utaburg is an open-world MMORPG. Join a world that puts a strong emphasis on immersion. Combat is dynamic. Choose one of four unique classes, then at level 40 choose a second class that complements your first. Fight, explore, create guilds, shape the economy - you decide.

name: 洪荒修仙界 Primordial Cultivation World

details.title: 洪荒修仙界 Primordial Cultivation World
details.short_description: At the dawn of creation, demons rule and humanity faces extinction. Seize sacred mountains, claim spirit veins, carve a path to immortality — win a homeland for humankind. *Primordial Cultivation World*: a top-down 2D open-world combat RPG. Explore, slay, seize, breakthrough — reshape Honghuang.

details.title: Project TITAN
details.short_description: You start with a tiny mech factory, a pile of scrap, and one goal: make money. Manufacture parts, assemble mechs, and take on questionable contracts for clients who don't ask about ethics, just excellent margins. Grow your factory, upgrade your tech tree, and build the ultimate mech: TITAN.

details.title: Romantic Leases
details.short_description: Unsure of where life will take him, he has four very different women enter his life: Sofia, the sharp and decisive CEO; Yeseul, a faded star; Emily, his long-lost first love; and Nina, who's like a little sister to him...

details.title: Final Bulwark: Zombie Tide Defense
details.short_description: Build your final stronghold on this overrun land. Plan your defenses, unlock deadly weapons, and face the ever-evolving tide of the undead—every decision you make determines life or death both inside and outside the walls.

details.title: Cry Wolf
details.short_description: Cry Wolf is a multiplayer social deduction game inspired by Werewolf, where secret alliances, risky bets, and new roles turn the classic rules upside down. Face 5 to 19 other players over voice chat across varied maps and unmask the wolves before it's too late.

details.title: Goblin Dodge
details.short_description: Play as a goblin who was displaced from its village, who must fight its way through a bullet gauntlet to earn freedom!

details.title: TapRacer
details.short_description: Two keys, strictly alternating, as fast as you can. TapRacer is a drag racer with real vehicle physics: torque curves, clutch slip, tire temperature, weight transfer. Burnout, launch, four shifts — and the quarter mile is over.

details.title: Ancient Duel
details.short_description: Ancient Duel is a free-to-play historical turn-based strategy card game. Build 40-card decks, combine ancient factions, position units and commanders, and outplay opponents in tactical 1v1 battles where timing, energy and formation matter.

details.title: Marble Mill
details.short_description: An idle game where every coin is a real collision. Build a marble mill, watch it grow into a roaring machine — and finish it in one satisfying evening. 100% achievements in ~3 hours, endless sandbox after. An idle game that ends.

details.title: Whisker Works
details.short_description: Whisker Works is a chaotic 1–4 player renovation game! Clean, repair, demolish and rebuild with your cat crew, because we clean, we fix, we PURRFECT!

details.title: Bullet Reign
details.short_description: Bullet Reign is a roguelike action shooter in a wasteland. Fight endless mutant waves as an armed survivor, choosing classes, weapons, and items to craft unique builds. Every run offers new progression choices—blast through the swarm and be the last one standing.

details.title: Africa Survival
details.short_description: As an explorer, you travel to Africa, hunt in the savanna, Avoid attacks from various ferocious beasts, gather resources, build shelter, and survive.

details.title: 9号台球馆：心动搭档
details.short_description: No. 9 Pool Hall blends playable eight-ball, character stories, roguelike builds, and Steam friend matches. Practice aiming and position play, meet distinctive partners, and survive nine strange nights. AI assisted art, audio, writing, code, and testing; no AI runs during play or sends player data.

details.title: Mapborn
details.short_description: Your map is the world. Mapborn is a real-time grand strategy sandbox played directly on your original artwork. Add cities and nations, choose one to rule, and shape its history through war, diplomacy, politics, and rebellion.

details.title: Mining Mike
details.short_description: Mikey Minerals owes the Shimigu Mining Corporation TRILLIONS in college debt. His sentence: the remote planet Dirt. Strap into a mech-themed roguelike mining tower defense survivor. Battle hordes, build a base, MINE and make money for the COMPANY.

details.title: Kito: Lost Trail
details.short_description: Kito: Lost Trail is a cozy 3D platforming adventure where you play as Kito, a young leopard searching for his missing mother. Explore wild environments, overcome platforming challenges, discover hidden collectibles, and grow your abilities along the way.

details.title: Solarise
details.short_description: A short and sweet game that aims to be a love letter to solar panel production and the crisis of the modern century for Europe as it grapples with reindustrialisation. Manage your factory, power needs, politics, and just ordinary people, in order to lower costs and outcompete your global rivals.

details.title: The City Knows
details.short_description: A story-driven deduction game set in Okayama, Japan, where everyone has an answer—but you need evidence. Examine evidence and records, cross-reference witness accounts, reconstruct timelines, and separate plausible theories from provable facts across six murder investigations.

details.title: 大收藏家
details.short_description: "The Collector" is a multiplayer auction game of sealed bids and hidden information. Face three players in five-round auctions for a container of unknown treasures. Use cards to uncover clues, place secret bids, and compete for the highest profit margin. Spend less, earn more.

details.title: Cats Out
details.short_description: The cats are out. They are everywhere, being a mess, stealing everything. Call your friends or if you're brave enough, take them on alone. Get your brooms ready, aim your slippers and go to War with those hungry little thieves!

details.title: Ashioto Kyōfu | Footsteps Terror
details.short_description: Touka Saeki, a former journalist and owner of the online video channel “Footsteps Terror”, travels to an abandoned mountain village where a school drama club mysteriously disappeared to cover that place in her next video. Her arrival awakens a long-buried curse...

details.title: Department 98
details.short_description: Your placement is confirmed. Report to District Intake, desk seven. The previous occupant's effects have been cleared. An idle game inside a fake 1990s office OS about paperwork, promotion, and a job going very well.

details.title: Can't Escape It
details.short_description: Can't Escape It is a first-person, found-footage, psychological horror game. You are trapped in a looping apartment. Search for clues to solve puzzles and find a way out, evade a clown that chases you, navigate the dark using your night vision, and manage your batteries. CAN YOU ESCAPE IT?

details.title: Ravenian Conquerors
details.short_description: A real-time sandbox strategy game across the vast archipelago of Ravenia, with a new island every play. Lead a faction, raise armies, and seize cities as you evolve through four ages. Prepare for a cosmic crisis that could end everything. Stand against it, or become the crisis itself.

details.title: Crooked Derby
details.short_description: Bet on one horse. Tell everyone you backed another. Crooked Derby is a party game of secret bets and public lies: rig the race with face-up cards, call your rivals’ bluffs, and get away with it. Play with friends online or solo against lying bots

details.title: Sewer Crawler
details.short_description: Survive horrific creatures and collect treasure in underground mazes, talk to eccentric characters, and manage your resources in a first-person survival horror experience.

details.title: Counterweight
details.short_description: A social deduction tower-builder for 4–8 players. Stack blocks, raise the tower, and figure out which of your friends is placing them badly on purpose. Grab chaotic items, vote people out, and forge the Saboteur Detector before every block hits the ground.

details.title: Celestial Sentinel
details.short_description: This is Xhono overwatch space station. Enemy forces are attacking. All kinds of turrets, space station supports and plugins at your disposal. Please use your resources wisely, build your defense, face against all kinds of enemies, and explore the unknown secrets of Xhono.
developers: 野象游戏工作室 Elephas Game Studio
publishers: 野象游戏工作室 Elephas Game Studio

details.title: Vanguard Monsters
details.short_description: Vanguard Monsters is a run-based creature raising roguelike autobattler. Hatch a team, evolve them to more powerful forms, and collect gear to defeat the endless forces of the encroaching void.

name: Spirit Companion: My AI Roommate Can't Be This Adorable

details.title: Spirit Companion: My AI Roommate Can't Be This Adorable
details.short_description: Bansing is a 3D healing-style companion game deeply integrated with AI. There are no fixed scripted characters; players can create a friend or family member who understands their preferences and habits, always by their side.
developers: 深圳市心翎科技有限公司
publishers: 深圳市心翎科技有限公司

details.title: Blame Echoes
details.short_description: Blame Echoes is a first-person psychological horror under a frozen planet in alien ruins. Playing as pilot Adam Lorn, you explore a forgotten complex for your missing wife while facing a presence that somehow already knows you.

name: 三国模拟器之我有一个妙计

details.title: 三国模拟器之我有一个妙计
details.short_description: In a parallel universe text-based dialogue adventure game, a brand-new Three Kingdoms era is constructed. Players can freely choose to play as classic warriors, and each dialogue choice will lead to distinct and surprising events.

details.title: Nexaris: Starweb Dominion
details.short_description: Lead a living star network in this real-time 3D sci-fi strategy game. Expand from one stellar core, link orbital nodes, secure resources, and launch coordinated assaults as every connection reshapes your economy, defenses, and territorial control.

details.title: Glooky: Cursors in the City
details.short_description: In this co-op adventure game, play as cursors able to take control of various hosts in the decrepit city of Glooky. Make your way through puzzles, discover picturesque neighbourhoods and their peculiar inhabitants, and uncover the secret behind the sprawling metropolis…

details.title: Hungry Hungry Human
details.short_description: A chaotic supermarket social deduction game where one player is secretly eating the products while everyone else works, watches, searches, and votes to catch them.

details.title: Nuts & Bolts
details.short_description: An action-horror game where you fight off against various robots as part of your job. Time your attacks properly, chain together combos, flee when necessary, and complete your mission.

details.title: Escape from Track 7
details.short_description: The last train is gone, and Track 7 won't let you leave. Watch for anomalies: if something is wrong, turn back; if not, keep walking. One mistake and you start over. A short spot-the-anomaly horror in an eerily real Japanese station, from a series with over 100,000 copies sold.

details.title: DON'T MAKE A SOUND
details.short_description: Don't Make a Sound is a first-person FMV interactive AVG survival horror game. Explore an infected city as Alex, search for your daughter, investigate clues, solve simple puzzles, and make critical choices. Eyeless creatures hunt by sound—one wrong move can lead to a deadly Bad Ending.
developers: HANG ZHOU SHUNYIN CULTURE  TECHNOLOGY CO.,LTD.
publishers: HANG ZHOU SHUNYIN CULTURE  TECHNOLOGY CO.,LTD.

details.title: Ember Camp Knight
details.short_description: Descend into a dungeon no one built for you. Fast, punchy pixel action in 5–10 minute bites — fight down through four themed floors, rest at a strange campfire, and meet the girl who tends it. Why does this dungeon exist? The answer waits at the bottom.

details.title: ACE Football
details.short_description: ACE Football is a football club management game featuring player development, squad building, tactical strategy, and 3D matches. Recruit talented players, train rising stars, build your dream team, compete in leagues and tournaments, and lead your club to championship glory.

details.title: Pouring Pints
details.short_description: Run your dream pub, solo or with up to 4 friends. Pour pints, sling snacks, and keep the customers happy as service descends into chaos. Dive bar, sports bar, or village pub. Build and decorate it your way with new ways to play every run. How long can you keep the doors open?

name: Nine Lives to Immortality: Did Kitty Break Through Today?

details.title: Nine Lives to Immortality: Did Kitty Break Through Today?
details.short_description: A cat cultivation, sect management, and ARPG loot game. Train feline disciples, send them into secluded cultivation, breed kittens that inherit stronger talents and looks, then enter dungeons to fight, loot gear, farm skill stones, build skills, and challenge higher-realm foes.

details.title: Liminull
details.short_description: Liminull is an atmospheric journey through liminal spaces. Explore, find secrets, solve puzzles, and interact with the world if you want - or simply keep moving forward, toward a place where everything feels so familiar, yet long forgotten.

details.title: Felzi
details.short_description: Felzi is a cozy retro 3D platformer. Roll through crates, stomp, climb and glide on a leaf across handcrafted worlds. Collect every gem and finish each level.

details.title: Settlers of Pineshore
details.short_description: On the edge of a new continent, you are responsible for connecting the wild region of Pineshore and its settlers to the rest of the world. Hire workers, gather resources, defend your venture from unknown dangers, and keep building the railway!

details.title: Riftmoor
details.short_description: A colony sim plus dungeon crawler where you build a thriving settlement, manage your citizens, create a powerful army, venture through mysterious rifts into dangerous dungeons, and return with the resources needed to grow your kingdom.

details.title: TDG: Tower Defense
details.short_description: TDG is a single-player military tower defense game. Hold a 30-wave campaign or an endless run on procedural maps, place and upgrade six tower types, meet Siege Carrier bosses, and adapt when new paths open. Sell or repair between fights. Early Access: full runs now, more content and polish ahead.

details.title: Three Kingdoms Story
details.short_description: Choose a faction, recruit officers, raise troops, and conquer rival strongholds across board-style maps in large-scale real-time battles.

details.title: Cozy Corner Cafe
details.short_description: Brew, upgrade, and relax! Build your dream coffee shop in Cozy Corner Cafe, a charming idle tycoon game. Automate prep stations, hire staff, handle in-store and online orders, and unlock upgrades through an extensive skill tree.

details.title: Plunderfall
details.short_description: Betrayed and stranded on a raft, fight back in this open-seas pirate survivors-like roguelite. Plunder resources, upgrade your hideout, unlock ships and weapons, rescue your crew, defeat traitor captains, and claim their relics to conquer new waters.

details.title: SagaCraft
details.short_description: Step into an untamed Slavic fantasy where no two tales are the same. SagaCraft is a dynamic action-RPG where you speak to fully adaptive characters to alter an unscripted storyline. Crush legendary beasts, scavenge for mythical loot, and explore procedural lands in a world that reacts to your words.

name: Zero Survivors: The Hero Must Die

details.title: Zero Survivors: The Hero Must Die
details.short_description: Create thousands of night creatures and ensure the Hero does not survive until dawn. Play as death in a reverse survivor-like where both sides level up as you raise armies of monsters, unlock dark powers and stop a lone Hero from becoming a legend.

details.title: VLCNP Story
details.short_description: A 2D metroidvania where you switch between Akim, a short-faced tiger, and his very long-faced friends. Punch through walls, slow foes with poison, float and fire will-o'-wisps. Recover memories to raise HP and grab rainbow seeds to power up, but hits power you down. Goofy looks, solid action!

name: Super Magic Ball ! Home Run Derby

details.title: Super Magic Ball ! Home Run Derby
details.short_description: Read the unpredictable breaking balls and hit a home run!!! You can create your own original breaking balls and compete against others in an online mode!!!

details.title: Midnight Scour
details.short_description: Escape a rural nightmare in this atmospheric first-person horror game. You are hunted by a cunning killer. He lives, sleeps, and actively hunts based on your actions . Use stealth to navigate the house, solve puzzles, and complete one of the exits.

details.title: Izaav:Darkness from Beyond
details.short_description: A 2D platform shooter ,where you fight against monsters and nature itself — everything standing between you and what you hold dear. A young boy, armed with weapons and determination, faces growing darkness. The deeper he goes, the harsher it becomes — but not impossible.

details.title: Feline Fury 3D
details.short_description: Hunt down the mouse invasion as a chunky cat with claws, bombs, and lightning. Feline Fury is a fast roguelite where every run reshapes the woods, the desert, the tundra, and the volcano around you. Build a deck of abilities, chase community milestones, climb the Furmament.

details.title: Formula 2027: Grand Prix Legends
details.short_description: Take the wheel in Formula 2027: Grand Prix Legends, a single-player open-wheel racing game. Master 18 track configurations, compete against AI rivals, and upgrade your car through a 22-event career. Chase faster laps, earn medals, and race your way to the top.

name: 灯台の見守り — Lighthouse's Vigil

details.title: 灯台の見守り — Lighthouse's Vigil
details.short_description: On a dreary night, a lighthouse keeper must sweep their beam to guide lost souls ashore, and burn back the dark creeping from within.

details.title: Farm Bang
details.short_description: Raise living ammo, blast monsters, haul massive loot, and survive the debt collectors in this chaotic top-down farming shooter.

details.title: NowLoading Forever
details.short_description: Can you actually “play” this game!? Before you can play "FINAL TALES QUEST", you must first load the game data.

details.title: AIRSKIPPER
details.short_description: Run through stages in this fast-paced action precision platformer. Rack up a combo and maintain it throughout the stage to score big at the end, or create your own stages and share them with others!

details.title: A Sweet Treat for Nona
details.short_description: Your Nona lost all the rolling pins, go find them! Explore levels full of crazy sweets, where each introduces into a new unexpected mechanic. Mix ingredients, discover abilities, and face challenges in this pixel-art puzzle platformer.

details.title: Penance
