details.short_description: A top-down action game about a crusader spending his final hours paying for the sins that ravaged everything he cherished. Fight through waves of powerful, high ranking imperial soldiers, with a Flame Meter that drains constantly and never refills.

details.title: Simulacre
details.short_description: Simulacre is a 1–4 player co-op psychological horror where familiar voices may not belong to your friends. Explore unsettling locations with unique objectives and threats, survive together, and never be certain who—or what—you can trust.

details.title: SEO or Die
details.short_description: Start with a single website and build a sprawling online empire. Grow traffic, manage clients, expand your team, and survive fifteen years of internet evolution in a life sim and business management RPG where every decision can lead to fortune or failure.

details.title: Hustle On High
details.short_description: A fast paced game where you play as Kaz and you enter human labs and defeat loads of strange creatures and creations, will you make it to the end only time will tell

details.title: Autobus - The Card Game
details.short_description: Race to empty your main pile in this fast-paced multiplayer card game for 2–4 players. Stack cards on shared build piles, outmaneuver your opponents, and be the first to go out. Play solo or online via Steam.

details.title: DANJIRI RAMPAGE
details.short_description: Ride the danjiri and carve every corner in this full-throttle Japanese festival action game. Master your balance atop traditional festival floats, nail razor-sharp drifts on steep slopes, and chase high scores with your festival spirit. All set to high-energy enka music.

details.title: Morpheus
details.short_description: Locked, loaded, on the beat — reclaim the boy's lost memories! Morpheus is a futuristic arcade rhythm game built around heavyweight impact.

details.title: Pinebrook Ski Resort
details.short_description: Run a ski resort as a real business. Shape trails on the mountain, string up lifts, and set prices against weather, snow and weekend crowds. Keep lifts running, skiers safe and the books in the black, from a gentle beginner hill to desert dunes and a volcano.

details.title: Beyond The Grey
details.short_description: Beyond the Grey is a cosy island life sim. Farm, mine, craft and keep bees at whatever pace suits you, trade at a market that opens once a week, and get to know some neighbours who notice when you come back. You left the city. Nothing here is in a hurry.

details.title: Don't Fear
details.short_description: Endure a recurring nightmare and search for scattered fragments of memory. Distinguish between the entities that approach you in different ways, and confront the traces of emotions long kept hidden in this first-person psychological horror game.

details.title: May, Be Dead
details.short_description: May, Be Dead is a first-person surrealist adventure game about walking through endless hexagonal rooms of memory and repeatedly killing May, a mysterious figure you shared an intimate yet ambiguous relationship with.

details.title: Sound & Shoal
details.short_description: A surreal first-person narrative adventure about memory, loss, and the stories we tell ourselves. Explore an ever-changing world where reality and fantasy blur in search of meaning.

details.title: Apocalypse Train
details.short_description: Command a heavily armed, constantly moving train through a hostile post-apocalyptic wasteland. Manage your crew's hunger, mine for resources, upgrade your mobile base, and defend relentless monster attacks.

details.title: No More Turtles
details.short_description: No More Turtles is a plastic-producing incremental game. Start cranking grandpa's machine, loot abandoned warehouses, and pollute your way to saving a world overrun by turtles!

details.title: Operation: Doomed Peter
details.short_description: OPERATION : Doomed Peter is a dungeon crawler heavily inspired by the 80's and 90's games like rogue. Weapons include guns, voodoo magic, melee, and even thrown weapons! Fight through hordes of monsters consisting of over 35 uniqe encounters and 3 bosses!

details.title: Review Responder
details.short_description: As a review responder for an e-commerce store, you face various customer complaints and must make critical decisions. Will you sincerely apologize, firmly refute, or skillfully defuse the situation? Every choice impacts your store's performance and determines the course of your career.

details.title: Lean Into The Swarm
details.short_description: Direct a growing swarm of harvesters as it consumes procedurally generated worlds tile by tile. Upgrade your operation, steer the frontier, use Scorch, and carry permanent Salvage perks into each larger world.

details.title: CampSight
details.short_description: CampSight is a co-op horror photography roguelike where you explore a haunted campground, photograph strange wildlife, and earn enough to meet your quota. Search abandoned camps, caves, cabins, and dark trails but beware: some creatures run, some stalk you, and some should never be watched too long

details.title: Aquaculture Simulator
details.short_description: Run your own fish farm in first person. Keep the water alive, raise trout, eels, sturgeon and koi, breed 25 koi varieties, and sell through customer orders, an online market, your farm shop and a show hall where you haggle face to face.

details.title: Shadows of Christmas Eve
details.short_description: Explore a house that gradually transforms as the nightmares become increasingly disturbing, while presences seem to watch you from the darkness. Discover the secrets hidden within its walls before it’s too late...

details.title: Break the Bank
details.short_description: Break the Bank is an incremental clicker game where you watch balls bounce through boards and break buildings for money. Upgrade, automate, unlock new zones, and defeat strange bosses.

details.title: HeroNet
details.short_description: Hire unique heroes, fight fearsome battles, and solve the inane problems of your clients in HeroNet!

details.title: Spook'd
details.short_description: Deep dive into Spook'd, a social deduction party game. Blend into a crowd of ghost NPCs to survive, or hunt down the players hiding among them. Cooperate or betray your friends, and share the laughs!

details.title: パラパラパズル
details.short_description: Your animations got scattered — piece them back together! The adorable pixel-art animations by asaha, a creator active mainly on Twitter and YouTube, have been scattered by someone's mischief!? Rearrange the frames and bring their cute movements back to life in this fresh animation puzzle game.

details.title: 木鱼敲敲有限公司
details.short_description: With just a tap of your fingers, you can raise small woodfish on your desktop Seven adorable and quirky little woodfish are at your beck and call. They'll become your work (slack-off) buddies, keeping you company through day and night. Happy or not, just give their little heads a knock!

details.title: A (tiny) Slime Quest
details.short_description: A short and cozy top-down adventure. Exiled to a hidden village after one final defeat, explore your surroundings and help fellow banished monsters by solving their unique troubles. Whether you long to return to combat or wish to discover a new path, it's your time to shine!

details.title: Chess Pit
details.short_description: Two teams. One giant chessboard. Every kill earns your team a move, then you climb inside a hundred-foot chess piece and drive it across the arena, crushing anyone where it lands. Real-time chess with no turns, no waiting, and a whole lot of gunfire. Take the enemy king to win.

details.title: HIT: Hold It Together
details.short_description: Break your rivals apart and hold yourself together in this voxel arena fighter. Battle in 4v4 matches with swords, bows and guns, where every lost block matters. Finish with more voxels than the other team, capture the central cube, or practise against bots.

details.title: Let 'er Ride
details.short_description: A Wild West roguelike based on casino Let It Ride. Post three bets, then pull them home or let ’em ride as the Board turns. Hire a posse of oddballs, beat crooked Proprietors at their own rules, and win Her back from the Baron.

details.title: Chaos Universalis
details.short_description: A grand strategy sandbox on a real globe. Start any day from c. 8700 BC to AD 1800 as a nation, a person or any entity, and just tell your friend Baibai what you want to do. Baibai plays out every side's reaction as you build your legend across 131 regions and 21,000+ individually drawn districts.

details.title: Minesweeper Survivors
details.short_description: Minesweeper meets roguelite survival! Reveal tiles and flag mines while your weapons tear through enemy hordes. Collect artifacts, create powerful builds, defeat bosses, and upgrade your arsenal between runs.

details.title: Mall Santa Mayhem
details.short_description: Christmas Eve, and Santa’s sleigh is empty. Race three other elves through a mall that’s new every run: hook, bounce, zipline and shopping-cart your way to every gift on the kid’s list, and get it to Santa before his patience runs out. 1-4 players, couch or online.

details.title: Caldera County
details.short_description: Your callsign is Air Attack 51. Circling overhead, your job is to call in aerial drops and direct ground crews against a fire that spreads with the wind, terrain and fuel. You must hold the line and protect every structure you can, but keeping people safe (including your units) is top priority.

details.title: Undercrown: Protect the Deadland
details.short_description: Dig a living dungeon, grow a hungry ecosystem of monsters and hide the Dungeon Lord from waves of human heroes. Thirty years after losing the throne, Albert returns - and this time the arena is underground.

details.title: From Cave to Shelf
details.short_description: Dig into the earth, explore mysterious caves, and collect crystals. Arrange your finds on the shelves of an abandoned magical mineral museum, upgrade your skills, and turn chaos into perfect order.

details.title: DataFactory
details.short_description: A top-down 2D pixel action RPG. Trapped in a six-floor factory run by a central AI, the only exit is at the top. Collect data coins, uncover the truth—every coin you spend rewrites the world outside. Four endings await.

details.title: Dragon Joust
details.short_description: Two riders. Four dragons. One sky to rule. Pick the Orc King or the Sorceress Queen, saddle up a fire, ice, poison, or magic dragon, and joust your rivals out of the clouds. Raid villages, summon storms, call a Titan, or just fly for high scores, solo, online or tournament with 8 players .

details.title: Sector Defense
details.short_description: Command the last line of defense in this single-player, turn-based sci-fi roguelite. Build two Defense Platforms, craft gear from salvage, and hold your home sector against three unknown invading factions, one run at a time.

details.title: KYORI ~ dream while awake ~
details.short_description: learn to keep your distance in this arcade survival horror game.

details.title: Speedway Team Manager
details.short_description: Take charge of a British speedway club in a detailed management simulation. Sign riders, negotiate contracts, tune bikes, manage finances and make tactical race-day decisions. Watch the action unfold in 2D or 2.8D as you chase league and cup glory across multiple seasons.

details.title: Sunday Socks
details.short_description: Sunday Socks is a cosy first-person tidying game. Socks are scattered all over the house: find each sock's twin, roll the pair into a ball and toss it into the Pair-O-Matic. Unlock upgrades, get help from the little Sock Bot and race for the fastest clear on the Steam leaderboards.

details.title: Twilight Park
details.short_description: Escape the amusement park before it's too late... You were invited to an amusement park, it was supposed to be fun. But soon, you realized you were trapped in the park. Can you escape the park? Investigate the environment, find useful items, solve puzzles, and escape the park before it's too late..

details.title: Jixo 7: Furry Friends Collector's Edition
details.short_description: Meet adorable animals through jigsaws, hidden-object scenes, logic challenges, and picture puzzles.

details.title: 英雄之责：烬海
details.short_description: You are the last hope. In a world swallowed by ash, build a final refuge, explore perilous islands, and lead your army against formidable foes. Every expedition forces you to weigh time, resources, and lives—until the Shoreless King arrives at your gates.

details.title: TRIANGLE: Geometric Exclusion Zone
details.short_description: TRIANGLE: Geometric Exclusion Zone is a neon top-down shooter. Customize your ship's left and right cannons, fight through branching rooms, collect gear, and build powerful weapon combos. Face geometric enemies, elite threats, and multi-phase bosses.

details.title: Caritas Nocturna
details.short_description: A quiet puzzle adventure with no combat. On a winter night of plague, the bell wakes you, the porter of a Spanish monastery. Until dawn, walk its rooms and perform the fourteen works of mercy for those still waiting.

details.title: Modular Synth Simulator
details.short_description: Build your own modular synthesizer and find your sound. Patch modules together, turn knobs, explore unexpected combinations, and make music. Jump in with ready-made patches or learn the basics with step-by-step tutorials.

details.title: They Seemed Normal
details.short_description: They Seemed Normal is a chaotic mix of inspection and tower defense where every stage affects the next. Work as a passport inspector and interrogate visitors. Let the right ones in and eliminate the "uncannies". Buy and upgrade birds, then use them as turrets to defend your base at night.

name: 防災 ― 史実の事故を、その場にいた一人として。

details.title: 防災 ― 史実の事故を、その場にいた一人として。
details.short_description: A documentary game where you walk through real accidents as one of the people who were there: an airliner that lost its controls, an airship in flames, a liner struck in the fog, a march into a blizzard, and a spacecraft far from Earth. Then read what really happened.

details.title: Deep Clean
details.short_description: A co-op horror comedy for up to 4 players. You're a crew of space janitors: scrub stations after "incidents" and find out what roams the halls and how to survive it. There are no instructions: try everything, log your discoveries in the glossary and piece together the truth.

details.title: Marble Hoarder
details.short_description: Sort thousands of glass marbles in a cozy, messy old marble shop. Pick them up, toss each one into the tray where it belongs, unlock skills like Spotlight, Gather and Auto-Place, and race your marbles on a wooden race machine. No timers, no pressure.

details.title: Tidy Up: Midnight Cleaner Simulator
details.short_description: Clean up spooky buildings at night as a caretaker. Sort the trash into the correct categories. Will you survive the nights?

name: Desktop Fantasy Packs: Idle Auto Battler

details.title: Desktop Fantasy Packs: Idle Auto Battler
details.short_description: Rip open packs, drop the tiles on your desktop and grow a tiny fantasy world one square at a time. Recruit knights, skeletons, orcs, vampires and dragonblood. They fight on their own while you work. Pull the rune slot for doubles, then hunt down three bosses.

details.title: Grounds Crew
details.short_description: Mow it. Blow it. Plow it. Take on 80 grounds-keeping jobs with a robot mower, a tractor and gang mower, a leaf blower and a snow blower. Lay perfect stripes, clear every leaf and push back the snow, from backyards and golf courses to castles and Christmas markets.

details.title: Plastic Noodles: Connector
details.short_description: Cursed and stuck in a time loop, reach one of the almost 30 different endings. Meet the wacky companions and adversaries that help or hinder your quest. Create powerful builds and dodge/parry bullets while managing the little time you have per loop. Can you reach your happily ever after?

details.title: Cozy Moka
details.short_description: A cozy pixel-art idle game about a neighborhood café. Serve your first espresso, hire baristas, decorate and grow across the city, from a tiny corner shop to a grand confectionery, one cup at a time.

details.title: Gnomes Garden: Fairy Kingdom
details.short_description: The Gnome Queen uncovers the history of the fairies, restores friendship, and fights an ancient darkness.

details.title: Node Wars
details.short_description: Node Wars is a short, neon-soaked incremental game. Smash glowing nodes, earn upgrades, and carve your path across a sprawling skill-tree grid. Easy to pick up, satisfying to optimize, and designed to be finished in a single sitting of a few hours.

details.title: NayBlades
details.short_description: Spin, bump and bounce through 20 hazard-packed levels with three friends. In NayBlades every player is a Naydo, a spinning tornado that sends anyone it touches flying. Work together to survive four worlds of obstacle courses, or knock each other out in the Arena.

details.title: Switchroom
details.short_description: You were naughty this year. Now you're stuck in Santa's warehouse with your friends. Every switch might drop a toy, kill the lights or let something in. Find the toys on the list, ship them, and survive each other.

details.title: Catnip Wars 2: Empires
details.short_description: Play your way in an infinite galaxy of cats!. Haggle at ports. Hack the yarn. Become a bounty hunter. Be an ace pilot in your own custom fighter! Compete in demolition style racing in the Nine-lives circuit! Create or join a house. Play with others on the official server or create your own.

details.title: The Park Keeper - First Days
details.short_description: Become a ranger in a national park where people have doubles. Check visitors, explore the forest, and help its strange inhabitants. A copy might be better than the original. But does that give it the right to take their place?

details.title: The Gloaming Hand
details.short_description: A free one-on-one card battler where the sky decides the fight. Plant units at Dawn, let them ripen through the Day, strike before Dusk and bluff through the Night. Five lanes, four phases, one sundial: every card is worth something different at every hour.

details.title: New Eldarian
details.short_description: A free-to-play 2D fantasy MMORPG with turn-based combat, exploration, character progression, dungeons, loot, crafting and cooperative online play. Explore a shared world, join other players and build your character.

details.title: Ambulante Simulator
details.short_description: From a cooler on your shoulder to a penthouse by the sea! Shout into a real mic, sell water, mate, popsicles, coconuts and açaí on Copacabana beach, and work your way up to your own stall and kiosk. Play solo, build a career with up to 4 friends, or compete with up to 6.

details.title: Treasury of Lies
details.short_description: Run a small country for ten years and survive the truth. Plant stories, turn spies, calm the bond market and outlast the fake feeds, before the voters, the lenders or a squirrel in the substation finish you off. A noir turn-based strategy game of money, spies and lies.

details.title: Real War: Not Fake
details.short_description: The fake-mobile incremental arcade game now made real! Shoot enemies, increase your army, gather coins, upgrade your gear, and defeat bosses to complete levels!

details.title: Midnight Brag: Before Poker
details.short_description: Before poker, there was Brag. Play Three Card Brag, the classic British card game of bluffing and nerve, in five late-night clubs run by bosses who never lose. Beat them in a voiced campaign, then sit down with real players at live tables with voice chat, in VR or on a flat screen.

details.title: 终端游戏：请审判我吧
details.short_description: 《终端游戏：请审判我吧》是一款带有meta元素的文字推理解密游戏。某一天，玩家在网络上下载到了游戏，在游戏内NPC的指引下，连接各个站点、探索并综合信息进行推理，拼凑时间线，了解整个故事，并最终对游戏内的NPC的选择进行审判……

details.title: Hyper Arcane Mage Battle
details.short_description: A mage platform battler for up to 8 players (Local multiplayer or Online). Earn spell cards and build between rounds until the winner is crowned at the match standings.

details.title: Amezida
details.short_description: Co-op survival horror for 1–5 players with card-driven actions and hidden objectives. Explore derelict ships, manage your hand, seal bulkheads and reach an escape pod. Play online, on one screen or solo with an AI crew. Trust is optional.

details.title: EscarGO
details.short_description: A hungry chef. Four nervous snails. Plenty of dark jokes. EscarGO is a typing party game: race up to 3 friends online, and if you get caught, write sentences to trip them up. Or go solo, outlast the bots and chase the top score on the global leaderboard.

details.title: Trisfera
details.short_description: A match-3 roguelite where you build your own bag of marbles. Line up numbered marbles, chain cascades, stack points × mult and shatter the glass bosses guarding every series. 100 artifacts, each hiding a secret + version to unlock.

details.title: Fruit Frenzy Clicker
details.short_description: Squeeze fruit, earn mountains of juice, and grow your tiny fruit stand into a thriving juice empire! Buy upgrades, automate production, discover rare fruits, brew recipes, explore orchards, and prestige for permanent rewards in this colorful incremental clicker.

details.title: Candy Diggers
details.short_description: Drill through candy planets, catch sweet critters and fuse upgrades into wild synergies in this cheerful digging roguelite. Every run brings candy home to your factory town, where belts and buildings turn it into coins for bigger, deeper runs. Save the candy universe from the Evil Veggie Council!

details.title: Nanomano
details.short_description: A nano-sized karate hero in a white gi and hinomaru headband. Punch, kick, and stomp through bacteria and parasites across 40 waves, push right toward the torii gate, earn a new belt every five waves, face the crowned boss at wave 40, and finish with a bow under fireworks.

details.title: Fishy Island
details.short_description: Fishy Island is a cozy collecting game you can enjoy solo or with friends. Catch, gather, and sort 2,804 fish, sea creatures, and ocean treasures into a sprawling seaside collection. Upgrade your tools, explore the island, and fill every display at your own pace.

details.title: Death to Demons
details.short_description: You are a Necromancer, use your powers to raise the dead in this dark fantasy roguelite auto-battler. Build an undead army, evolve minions, choose powerful upgrades, and fight through waves of demons to break the gates of Hell and free the lands of Vaelthorron.

details.title: Duck Duck Gone
details.short_description: Hide a rubber duck in plain sight, then hunt down everyone else’s in this chaotic online party game for up to 8 players. Paint it, resize it, fool your friends and pray the reveal camera is kind.

details.title: Cursor Survivors
details.short_description: Your friend's "harmless" prank virus mutated and hijacked your PC! Luckily, your AI assistant is ready. Command an evolving fleet of cursors in this bullet-heaven roguelite. Purge swarms of mutating malware, stack game-breaking upgrades, and reclaim your system!

details.title: Tama Pet
details.short_description: Raise your own desktop companion! Feed, decorate, collect cute accessories, open surprise packs, and watch your virtual pet grow while it keeps you company throughout the day.

details.title: ZERO//DECAY
details.short_description: ZERO//DECAY is a frantic roguelite action-platformer where you play as an unstable nucleus racing toward stability. Dash through bullet hell, collect epic mutations, build wild synergies — or die fast and try again.

details.title: Thock Roll
details.short_description: Roll a ball across a giant bowl of mechanical keyboard keys and press as many as you can before time runs out. Spend your Bits on a sprawling skill tree to unlock drones, shockwaves, meteorites and lightning, then prestige to new arenas in this satisfying, thocky incremental game.

details.title: Carpetorium: A Carpet-Cleaning Purgatory
details.short_description: A melancholic dark-fantasy idle/incremental game about cleaning carpets. You wake up in a strange guild hall with nothing to do but scrub - by hand or with magic brushes. Face rugs that smolder, ooze and worse, grow your workshop and guild, and explore a world where every rug hides something.

details.title: Fairy's Hero
details.short_description: Fairy's Hero is an auto-battler game with rogue-lite elements and incremental meta progression. While your hero is fighting enemies, you manage their inventory, skill tree, assist in boss fights, and collect rewards. Take your Hero on a quest across the kingdom, to fulfill their purpose!

details.title: MusicDamage
details.short_description: MusicDamage is a top-down multiplayer music shooter. Move, aim and fire to your weapon's rhythm in team battles and casual matches. Use cover and hazards, and enable optional fragment progression to collect rhythm fragments and upgrades that change how you play and build.

details.title: BoardboundHeroes
details.short_description: Recruit heroes, forge their gear, line them up—then watch them fight. A roguelike autobattler of deep dungeon dives: build parties around classes and trait synergies, draft reward cards to shape each run. Your army and gear persist as lasting assets. Play hands-on or let auto-farming grind for you.

details.title: AirGap
details.short_description: A first-person stealth roguelite about breaking into a floating AI datacenter and blasting it apart in every way imagineable. Learn the patrols, sabotage machines, steal keycards, cut the power, plant charges. Leave clean and the damage stays; get caught and the fortress heals and adapts.

details.title: MOTHERWARD
details.short_description: MOTHERWARD is a single-player psychological horror anomaly game. You are searching for your mother in an abandoned hospital. To find her, you must remember everything, uncover what you see...or don't see, and make a choice. But remember, every choice has consequences.

details.title: Lords: Ivory Tower Defence
details.short_description: Pioneering the bold new genre of "Ivory Tower Defence" Lords blends loot-based Tower Defence exploration, a unique quiz mechanic, and a painfully overwritten narrative about meaning in the age of AI.

details.title: Shape Shards
details.short_description: Shape Shards is a casual incremental game where you shoot bullets to destroy geometric enemies, collect shards to upgrade, and every upgrade brings a whole new experience!

details.title: AutomaticBox
details.short_description: A bunch of boxes move on their own. All you can do is watch them move and reset them. It's a box-pushing game without a main character. You need to use the order and direction of the boxes to guide them to stand on the destinations at the same time. Hope it gives you a relaxing brain massage.

details.title: Scale A Building
details.short_description: A game about scaling a building

details.title: Real Zombie Survivors
details.short_description: Real Zombie Survivors is a co-op top-down arena shooter where you fight relentless hordes of zombies on real-world maps generated from OpenStreetMap data. Choose unique classes, upgrade your arsenal, call in combat robots, and survive the apocalypse solo or with friends on Steam!

details.title: Digital Hunger
details.short_description: A true-crime investigation inside a killer's 1999 desktop. Dig through his files, crack his secrets, and answer a call that rings on your real phone. English subtitles, Hebrew voice. 3 endings.

details.title: Slacker Hero
details.short_description: A stay-resident RPG whose hero fights all by himself. He does the fighting — but when he gets bored he climbs out of the game window to wander around your desktop and take naps. Send him back, let him rest, or let him scavenge. A comedic little roguelite RPG.

details.title: I am the Dungeon Boss
details.short_description: Descend a cursed dungeon where every victory leaves a scar. Dethrone the boss, and your legend rises as the next guardian — an echo that waits in the dark. Roguelike permadeath, shifting floors, and optional ranked play against other players’ legacies.

details.title: Find All Things: Vacation
details.short_description: Find All Things: Vacation is a relaxing collection of puzzle games set in a world of travel and summer adventures. Search for hidden objects, solve puzzles, and spot differences across sunny beaches, water parks, and more. Escape the daily routine and enjoy a peaceful, relaxing atmosphere.

details.title: Beat Ten
details.short_description: Across the Rhythm Multiverse, anomalies are disrupting the Beat. Your mission: repair the Beat using YOUR music, one track at a time. Welcome to Beat Ten, where you can play to music you stream!

details.title: Neon Armada - Solar Storm
details.short_description: A top-down arena roguelite you can learn in one wave and spend a hundred hours mastering. Waves close in from every edge; the shop between them decides what you become. 32 ships, 28 weapons, 115 mods to combine — then endless mode, where the caps come off.

details.title: SheepFall
details.short_description: Build, fight and save the sheep in SheepFall, a strategy game with direct hero control. Face cunning enemies with distinct behaviors, outsmart them with your tactics, conquer dangerous biomes and climb the online leaderboard. Think you can handle it?

details.title: Aunt Hattie's Quilts
details.short_description: Grow your own cotton, gather natural materials, and craft beautiful quilts to delight your customers. Create lasting friendships within the community, and they might just reward you with new quilting templates! Expand your collection to unlock new designs and express your creativity.

details.title: Etched
details.short_description: A top-down action roguelite about a little mage who carves lightning itself. Etch engravings into your spells to reshape how they behave, weave engraving synergies into your own build, mow down monster packs, hunt buffed elites, and descend into ever-deeper arenas. What's carved cannot be undone.

details.title: ByteBuddies
details.short_description: Explore the depths of an abandoned world and figure out what is happening while you survive 5 nights fighting for your life.

details.title: Digging Up
details.short_description: Digging Up is a 1-4 player co-op digging adventure where you drill through a destructible alien planet, gather valuable resources, upgrade your gear, explore underground biomes, and dig your way back to the surface.

details.title: The Proxy
details.short_description: The Proxy is a narrative political simulation game set in a fictional nation, Leviah. The president is dead, and the office is yours. Sign papers that decide the fate of your nation, trade on secrets only you know, and juggle the ones who all want something. Protect the country, or protect yourself?

details.title: Golfever
details.short_description: Create, share and play endless unique 2D pixel-art minigolf courses. Powerful level editor, community maps, easy to learn controls but hard to master. The Steam launch includes multiplayer and expanded content!

details.title: 撕下你的伪装
details.short_description: A modern suspense game. Follow Lin Mo, undercover in a nightclub to find her missing brother. She uncovers organ trafficking—and his lookalike runs the crime group. 4 romanceable leads, multiple endings.

details.title: Skribline
details.short_description: Draw lines to help the skribman cross gaps and avoid neon hazards! Try Endless mode, or beat levels to unlock new skins, effects and backgrounds.

details.title: Figure It Out! Together
details.short_description: Your cat knocked over your Anime figure collection. Sort and tidy up over 2,875 mini, life-size and giant figures. Hunt for rare finds and unlock handy gadgets in this cozy Anime organizing game. Mechas, chibis, and maids… everyone belongs on a shelf. Your cat is “helping.” What could go wrong?

details.title: SYNTHALGIA: Retro Arcade Racing
details.short_description: No checkpoint timers — FUEL is your clock. Speed and danger keep you alive. Chase down tankers and cargo trucks to refuel and upgrade. Score big across miles of scenic highways and become #1 on the leaderboard!

details.title: Saveseeker
details.short_description: Embark on a quest to overwrite save points in Saveseeker, a turn-based RPG about a time-traveling girl who must save the world from her father.

name: The Swordfish: Knight of the Deep

details.title: The Swordfish: Knight of the Deep
details.short_description: Embark on an epic adventure as a sword-wielding fish and restore order to the kingdom's depths. Explore an ocean world full of adorable characters, menacing foes, and hidden wonders.

details.title: Arcane Treasures: Trading Card Game
details.short_description: Build a whimsical deck of cartoon animals to battle foes & uncover special treasures in this cute but competitive online Trading Card Game! Collect trading cards featuring indie artists' works, open booster packs, and complete challenges to expand your collection!

details.title: Sol Uknight
details.short_description: Delve deep into a mystical realm, from two distinct protagonist story perspectives! Communicating with your musical "Constellator" or uncovering cryptic symbols with "The Wheel of Life", solving mysterious puzzles, adventuring realms, or revealing key story elements will put you to the test of time!

details.title: Endless Anime Golf
details.short_description: Are you an anime lover with a passion for golf? This exciting game combines the best of both worlds, with stunning anime visuals and challenging golf gameplay. Best of all, Endless Anime Golf features procedural generation, which means every round is unique and unpredictable.

details.title: Rich Dad Simulator
details.short_description: Run your own chain of markets. Start from a small shop to the biggest business in town. Manage staff, control inventory, set prices, and keep customers happy. Build new locations and expand your retail empire. Can you succeed and become the king of retail?

details.title: CRETE
details.short_description: Fight against the Ancestors and other biopunk creatures. Use their DNA to build your own procedural weapons, find a friend and combine your skills to be even more powerful. The further you go, the better rewards you will get for the next run. It is up to you to reveal what is up there in the north.

details.title: Paper Play VR
details.short_description: Experience creative minigames as the world's biggest paper playground unfolds right in front of your eyes! We have crazy games, difficult challenges and a heartwarming story for you and your friends, so come and join the party!

details.title: Slotlander
details.short_description: A short incremental game about a gambling addict whose trip to rehab goes wrong. After a plane crash, you wake up alone on a tropical island with a broken slot machine on the beach. One wish brings it to life. Spins are free. No penalties. No one telling you to stop.

details.title: KADI: Ottoman Judge
details.short_description: You are a kadı in 1300s Ottoman Empire. Judge cases rooted in real history across ten provinces, from Gemlik to Damascus. Grow wise through knowledge or fall to bribery the balance is yours. Marry, raise a child, and choose between conscience and a never-ending purse. Every ruling shapes your fate.

details.title: The Gauntlet
details.short_description: Fight a diverse cast of characters each harder than the last! A boss rush game where you face many bosses back to back until you beat them all. Will you survive The Gauntlet?

name: Alone After Dark: A Short Drive

details.title: Alone After Dark: A Short Drive
details.short_description: Experience the chilling solitude of a nighttime drive through the woods. You are not the only person—or thing—on the road tonight. Drive carefully and try to stay calm behind the wheel. Can you make it to the sunrise?

details.title: Bullet Time Agent
details.short_description: Bullet Time Agent is a sci-fi action-adventure bullet hell. Slow time and dodge storms of bullets as you punch your way through robot-filled arenas. Leap past laser obstacles with super-powered jumps. Take down increasingly intense bosses as you rewind your own death...again.

details.title: Flywheel
details.short_description: Flywheel is a 2D action game where you dash through the skies using jumps and flight. Each run challenges you with ever-changing terrain. With retro pixel art, nostalgic sound, and simple controls, the game is easy to pick up and enjoy.

details.title: SheepHoundra
details.short_description: A sorting action game where you expose goats disguised as sheep with a blower and use stolen ink to dye sheep for shipment. Create "Rare Sheep" in specified colors within the time limit and aim for maximum profit!

details.title: Crime Empire Idle
details.short_description: Build your criminal dynasty in a deep idle/incremental game. Run crimes, launder dirty cash, upgrade your empire, use the black market, craft weapons & gear to fight criminal opponents while you balance heat and notoriety.

details.title: Pale Cure
details.short_description: A first-person survival horror game where you explore a mutating house, evade a delusional family, and live through the nightmare.

details.title: What the House Remembers
details.short_description: A narrative-driven psychological horror game where a secluded house twists memory into reality. As your sanity deteriorates, uncover a buried truth hidden within its walls before the house reveals what you've tried to forget.

details.title: Rayborne
details.short_description: Rayborne is a puzzle game built around lasers, physics, and real-time light simulation. Solve handcrafted challenges by shaping light itself while uncovering the mystery behind a questionable AI research facility.

details.title: DreeM Ascension
details.short_description: Explore the DreeMScape Darklands and uncover it's dark secrets in this story-driven survival horror boomer shooter.

details.title: SLENDYJAN
details.short_description: Slendyjan takes place on a planet devastated by a war that has been consuming all the races that inhabit it for years. The player controls Jan, an exceptionally powerful mercenary who fights on the side of the Nuggets, an advanced civilization from an unknown planet.

details.title: 夢酔のバーテンダー
details.short_description: A hazy, dreamlike visual novel with a touch of the surreal. Step behind the bar of a mysterious, ethereal space. Craft cocktails, share quiet conversations, and connect with your guests' hearts. Mix drinks as you please, and lose yourself in this gentle, dreamlike world.

details.title: Sea Pets: Match & Merge
details.short_description: Drop adorable sea creatures into the ocean and merge them into bigger ones in this relaxing yet addictive physics puzzle. How long can you keep the ocean under control?

details.title: Bad Tides
details.short_description: BAD TIDES is a chaotic 4 player co-op pirate adventure! Explore the seven seas, dive for treasure, upgrade your trustworthy vessel, and fight creatures of myth.

details.title: Delete The Hypercube
details.short_description: Delete The Hypercube is a chill active incremental which tasks you with destroying an extradimensional cube that feeds on Earth's core.

details.title: AntiMatcher
details.short_description: Merge, pop, burst and... annihilate?! Play with bubbles and antibubbles to discover their strange properties in this abstract puzzle game.

details.title: Amalu, Wells between worlds
details.short_description: Amalu: Wells Between Worlds is a pixel-art 2D platformer, and Metroidvania blending Atmospheric exploration, Spell-casting puzzle mechanics, Amazigh/North African mythology and an emotional storytelling

details.title: Rifles & Runes
details.short_description: A real-time strategy game blending extraction, cards, and fantasy exploration. Lead a modern army through a portal, scout unknown lands, build mines and radar, repel counterattacks, hold your outposts, and extract before the world’s attention overwhelms you.

details.title: Cardcraft
details.short_description: Make the card you wish you had. Choose its cost, stats and skills, build a 30-card deck, and test your combinations against AI or in online PvP. Explore the five-act Endless Workshop and share your cards and decks on Steam Workshop. No card packs required.

details.title: The Eye of Vala
details.short_description: Colonel Moorehead disappeared without a trace while searching for what he called “The Eye of Vala.” His desperate family hires MacNaughton, a treasure hunter, to look for clues to his whereabouts. The search for Moorehead will soon become a much greater challenge.

details.title: Dust
details.short_description: DUST is an online survival shooter. Gather, build and lock down your base, then raid your enemies with C4, RPGs and a rocket launch site. Talk with proximity voice, fight in x1000 and Battle Royale, survive the infected. Everything you build can be lost.

details.title: 政通人和
details.short_description: "Peace and Prosperity" is a independently developed ink-wash style historical strategy game set in an alternate pre-Qin period of China. Starting from a small village of just a few hundred people, and conquer all sides to gradually build their own vassal state with millions of people.

name: 八長調といにしえの楽譜

details.title: 八長調といにしえの楽譜
details.short_description: Shirabe Hatcho and Ancient Music Score is a puzzle-solving ADV game where you solve the puzzles by ear. Listen to audio, read music, and play an instrument. Use your sense of pitch to solve the mystery and prevent the phantom thief from committing his crimes as a member of the detective agency.

details.title: The Last Shot: Underworld
details.short_description: The Last Shot: Underworld casts players in the role of an aging scientist who, by a sinister twist of fate, finds himself deep in the dungeons of Metropolis. Build, explore and survive!

details.title: Tom Lander: The Exiled King
details.short_description: Pilot wacky aerial vehicles with silly key-based controls through an epic action packed campaign. Struggle to stay airborne while performing deliveries, rescues, firefighting missions, bombing runs, and chaotic dogfights. This game will remind you that flying is hard, but landing is harder.

details.title: HaCo
details.short_description: "Deliver or Destroy? The choice is yours!" High-speed jet action meets heist mechanics in this up to 4-player online co-op. Pilot rusty robots, master the inertia, and dodge missiles to steal packages. Can you meet the quota before time runs out?

details.title: Turbo Ziggurat
details.short_description: You are a tiny creature in a living human city. Talk to NPCs out loud to find clues, track down crystal balls, and steal them before the enemy team does. A chaotic team PvP game.

details.title: 蛊道The Reverend's Path
details.short_description: An innovative roguelite real-time combat game of one-handed, effortless spell programming. Wield arcane Gu, pick it up intuitively, and carve out your supreme Path of Gu across two layers: the Killer Move Board (build your skills) and the Condition Pool (set when they fire).

details.title: Loginnnnnn
details.short_description: Team up with up to 3 friends in online co-op to breach 10 ultra-realistic login screens with Physics-Driven Cursors! To unlock the final mini game, you must use fectly log into 10 fictional online services without a single mistake. Do you ready to get stuck at the login page???

details.title: Coffin Hunter
details.short_description: You owe the Helix a very specific soul. Hunt for coffins, harvest rare souls, and build the ultimate killing machine in this fast-paced roguelite. Survive faction wars, hunt bounty hunters, and find a way to reach the Kingpin in the lawless Marupto Rift.

details.title: Cube Sweeper
details.short_description: Cube Sweeper is a casual relaxing puzzle game. All you have to do is work out which cubes are red and which cubes are empty. Numbers show how many adjacent cubes are red and from that information you can solve all the levels in the game without guessing.

details.title: Pun Chan Pop
details.short_description: Think fast, match faster! Chain 5 pieces in any direction to win, or use the Square-Merge to turn 2x2 clusters into massive, high-scoring blocks before clearing them. Battle cute animals to a pulsing Bitpop soundtrack in this frantic puzzle showdown!

name: Find Bunny : A Little Hidden Journey

details.title: Find Bunny : A Little Hidden Journey
details.short_description: Find Bunny is a cozy hidden-object game where you peel stickers to find and collect hidden pictures. Join Coco and Matcha on a journey to uncover the secret of the misbehaving crops. Cross the sea, ride the train, fill your album with stickers, and help new friends bring peace back to the farm!

details.title: Sushi Sewers
details.short_description: A fast-paced cyberpunk bullet-heaven where neon chaos, dark power, and endless enemy swarms collide. Survive the waves, create the strongest builds, and become unstoppable.

details.title: Glamour Photographer
details.short_description: Fulfill your dream of becoming a glamour photographer, meet beautiful women from different cultures and backgrounds, and maybe even marry one of them!

details.title: 洛希极限 Roche Limit
details.short_description: ​Roche Limit​ is a 2D pixel sci-fi action roguelite, blending high-speed aerial combat with ARPG builds. Choose a mecha-girl, build her skills on the battle, and face the cosmic legion. Between runs, bond with the girls for more skill possibles and stories. Prevent cataclysm before the moon falls.

details.title: Reinvaders
details.short_description: Reinvaders is a short retro sci-fi shooter. Fight through four levels, dash past alien fire, and take down bosses in a tight arcade-style campaign.

details.title: Dreamsink
details.short_description: Awakening in a frigid room with an empty pill bottle, she’s forgotten something vital. Trapped between a monochrome bedroom and distorted dreams, she must face anxiety and depression... Break mental shackles and find the light in this psychological puzzle adventure！

details.title: City of Promotion
details.short_description: City of Promotion est un jeu qui combine les échecs et la construction de colonies, où les joueurs utilisent les règles de déplacement des pièces d'échecs pour collecter des ressources, développer des colonies et résister aux attaques de monstres en essaim.

details.title: Ravelle - Last Draw
details.short_description: What starts as casual matches in a humble café becomes a shared effort to protect a place that matters. Ravelle is a free-to-play turn-based strategy card game with visual novel elements, blending tactical card battles and personal character stories.

details.title: Gun Repair Shop
details.short_description: Become a master gunsmith. Repair, restore, customize, and test firearms in a detailed workshop simulator: buy parts, craft components, renovate classic weapons, and take them to the shooting range to prove your work

details.title: SECONDED
details.short_description: Seconded is a strategy-driven tavern management game about assigning the right companion to the right problem under pressure and uncertainty. Each request hides its true requirements, forcing you to read situations carefully rather than rely on explicit instructions.

details.title: Goldfish Gunner
details.short_description: Become the most wanted outlaw by taking on the role of Goldfish, a gunner robbing every bank in the Wild West. Escape across challenging, obstacle-filled landscapes where your only way to move is by firing your weapon and riding the recoil.

details.title: Dwarven Mining Company
details.short_description: Manage your own dwarven mine. Give orders to miners excavating ore and builders providing them with ladders to get deeper and deeper into the underground. Mine iron, copper and even mithrill to satisfy the needs of the dwarven kingdom for the price of a single coffee.

details.title: Lost Dude
details.short_description: Lost Dude is an atmospheric 2D platform-adventure game that follows a character who sets out on a journey to find their lost friend, experiences various events along the way, and embarks on new adventures together after reuniting.

details.title: Type The Rhythm
details.short_description: A rhythm typing trainer where you type real words to a variety of musical styles. Augmented proprioception lets you move the grooves between your brain and fingers for faster, cleaner typing. From hunt-and-peck to 150 WPM blindfolded, Type The Rhythm moves you forward.

details.title: Gunfort
details.short_description: Gunfort is a tower defense game where your army is competent and well-funded. The city is surrounded, and horrors are coming down every road. Build turrets, call in commanders, and hold the line. Watch your brilliant strategy unfold or discover exactly how much government money you can waste.

details.title: DepotDash
details.short_description: Fast-paced top-down construction yard simulator where you manage deliveries, move materials with heavy machines, and keep suppliers happy before your depot overflows.

details.title: 国gal笑笑传
details.short_description: 当国产galgame占领了整个世界。吃饭、睡觉、打工、购买，这个世界的一切都围绕国产galgame发生。你将在这里体验到超过50款“有趣”的galgame游戏。努力打工然后购买更多galgame吧！

details.title: KICK//LINE
details.short_description: Dribble, dodge and shoot your way through the city in KICK//LINE, a 3D football running action game. Chain feints, jumps and slides, wow the crowd with freestyle tricks, and challenge street rivals across five cities.

details.title: The Last Summer Holiday
details.short_description: A cozy story game about one summer with your grandparents on the Mongolian steppe. By day, learn the old ways with your own hands. By night, Grandpa tells a folktale and you dream your way into it: a fifteen-headed mangas, a serpent, seven burning suns. Six tales. Six dreams. One goodbye.

details.title: Wagerborn
details.short_description: A slot-machine roguelite where your RPG equipment becomes the reel. Equip weapons and relics, manipulate your symbol pool, complete powerful matches, merge gear, and build increasingly broken combinations across each run.

details.title: Programming Maze
details.short_description: A coding-focused dungeon puzzle game. Write real JavaScript or Python code to move your character through maze dungeons. Use loops, conditional logic and arrays to solve puzzles. Run your code and watch your character act. Beginners learn core programming logic gradually via trial and error.

details.title: Pyramid Solitaire
details.short_description: A free casual single-player pyramid solitaire game. Clear the pyramid, chain combos for power-ups, unlock skins, keep your daily streak alive and climb the leaderboards.

details.title: Orthodoxía
details.short_description: A first-person action game where you play as a witch infiltrating a cult-controlled town. Use black magic and telekinesis to fight your way through enemies and uncover the dark secrets of the place.

details.title: Skywatch
details.short_description: You work at a small observatory as scientist, studying the sky and making sure nothing unsual goes unnoticed. Explore worlds, launch satelites, receive signals from outer space, solve mystries and connect the dots. Welcome to Skywatch.

details.title: Thugs in Fantasy
details.short_description: You know nothing about magic. You don't know how to swing a sword. Fortunately, you know how to throw a punch.

details.title: DETRITUS
details.short_description: A roguelike deckbuilder inspired by the classic card game Trash. Arrange cards sequentially to open packs, discover game-changing modifiers, and build broken synergies to complete over 10 unique contracts.

details.title: Desktop Tower
details.short_description: Who says you have to stop gaming to be productive? Desktop Tower is an IDLE TOWER DEFENSE that takes up just a small corner of your screen. Leave it running while you work and enjoy a little dose of strategy throughout your day. Your desktop will never be the same again! 💀⌨️

details.title: The Caretaker: Block 9
details.short_description: "The Caretaker: Block 9" is a horror game set in 2000s Poland. You play as Janusz Nowakowski, former caretaker who returns to his initial occupation. At the beginning everything seems to be just a little scary but at the same moment ordinary...

details.title: Wuchang: Three Kingdoms Survivors
details.short_description: Wuchang: Three Kingdoms Survivors is a dark Three Kingdoms roguelite survivor game. Customize your background and destiny talents, ally with deities and summon reincarnated stellar generals. Build unique builds with randomized affix gear & divine bonds, fight through endless enemy hordes.

details.title: Border Pastoral Tale
details.short_description: A relaxing, wholesome cartoon-style herding simulation game. Become a sheepdog and guide scattered flocks back to their pens across vast grasslands while fending off wolf attacks. Supports local 2-player co-op with simple controls. Experience pure fun through agile movement and precise herding!

name: AI 位面旅者：无限世界

details.title: AI 位面旅者：无限世界
details.short_description: 《AI 位面旅者：无限世界》是一款由 AI 实时驱动的团队冒险 RPG。你带着队伍在位面之间穿梭：探索区域、完成任务、打怪、升级、招募同伴；也可以在信标塔手填世界观、区域、角色与部队，造一个完全属于自己的位面。剧情、敌人、事件全部由 AI 现场生成，没有两次冒险是一样的。每个角色都有自己的记忆与打算，会按自己的目标行动；你不在的时候，区域里的角色仍在自行流动。角色、装备、技能、血统分 D 到 SSS 品级，敌人与友军部队是成建制的单位；回合制战斗可手动指挥每一次出手。买断制，需自备 AI 服务商 API Key 驱动剧情。

name: Iron Offensive: Helmet Cam Extraction Shooter

details.title: Iron Offensive: Helmet Cam Extraction Shooter
details.short_description: You are not a scavenger on endless walks. You are a Soldier in a Tactical Shooter with a Helmet Cam perspective. Action from second zero, dodging artillery, drones, and the most tactical AI on the market in an intense field that wants you dead. Extract weapons, upgrades, currency, and killstreaks.

details.title: Acid Clashers
details.short_description: Acid Clashers is a single-player turn-based Autobattler game with a strong focus on incrementing stats.

details.title: 觀淵決:Abyss run
details.short_description: This is a Roguelike strategy game centered around "Dice-Building" and "Distance Control." 🔹 Customizable Dice: Ditching traditional deckbuilding, you can engrave skills directly onto your dice faces to create unique tactical builds.

details.title: MANDATUM
details.short_description: A Clay-Style online co-op game, with 4-player missions, about the maximum contribution of players to the boss's local elections. History is written by the winners, right? So we’re doing whatever it takes. MANDATUM.

details.title: Petricor: Tower Defense
details.short_description: Face off against hordes of shambling skeletons in this magical rogue-like tower defense! You're just cat-sitting for a shopkeeper, but an evil necromancer has other plans! Summon living statues to defend the shop and discover powerful spells to create devastating combos!

details.title: Sufficiently Advanced Witchcraft
details.short_description: "Any sufficiently advanced technology is indistinguishable from magic!" Practice witchcraft, summon daemons, harness crystal vibrations, and never EVER let the Magic Smoke escape as you help the villagers, protect the kingdom, and strive to unlock magic's deepest secrets in this cozy, witchy sim!

details.title: Alien Nature Rampage
details.short_description: A Topdown action game where you play an alien entity that must destroy all industry on earths major cities. Viewing the world from above the player selects a city to the help "save" from industry pollution.

details.title: Clock-out Denied
details.short_description: Clock-out Denied is an asymmetric multiplayer stealth game where Employees build shadowy office hideouts, complete tasks, and sprint for the clock-out machine while one Boss hunts them with light. Hide in the darkness you created, whisper with coworkers, and escape overtime before the final second.

details.title: Slammo
details.short_description: Conquer a charming woodland world in a grid-based strategy game where everyone moves at once. Expand your territory, predict rival plans, and fight dice-driven battles as adorable animal factions clash for control.

name: 红楼梦华录 Red Chamber Chronicle

details.title: 红楼梦华录 Red Chamber Chronicle
details.short_description: Red Chamber Chronicle is a classical Chinese life simulation and visual novel with multiple endings. You play as Jia Baoyu in the Grand View Garden, where daily life, relationships, and choices shape your branching story and different outcomes.

details.title: Wild East: The Straw Man
details.short_description: 1993, just after Czechoslovakia split in two. Play as reporter Marek and investigate the death of a company director in name only. In Prague, journalist Eva pursues a case of her own. Explore locations, read documents, and uncover where their cases meet in a classic 2D point-and-click mystery.

details.title: Mega Golf
details.short_description: Smash your friends into the ocean and bowl through buildings in your giant armored golf ball! Race through the chaos . Smash your way through buildings, navigate boosts and bounce pads, avoid landmines and oil slicks as you explore and devastate the courses.

details.title: 10000 BC
details.short_description: Build a civilization from the Stone Age to the distant future in this roguelike strategy game. Recruit unique residents, construct your settlement, survive enemy waves, and shape history through difficult choices.

details.title: Heroes Must Die
details.short_description: A cyber-theocracy RPG with bullet hell shooting. You are a resistance member. In a dark world of cyberpunk and theocratic rule, hunt down church-controlled heroes, rescue the goddess drained of her power, and uncover a 500-year-old lie.

details.title: Ravenhollow Hotel
details.short_description: A psychological horror game set in a mysterious hotel where every room hides a forgotten truth. Explore, survive, and uncover what really happened beneath Ravenhollow.

details.title: Plank Wars
details.short_description: Planks Wars is a fast, irreverent cross-platform PvP card battler where 200-foot-tall sorcerers use kidnapped adventurers as tournament pawns. Build your strategy with CCG-style deckbuilding, command your puppets... I mean, heroes, and climb the ranks.

details.title: Undervalued
details.short_description: You didn't want a real job. So here you are. Run an antique shop in Vienna with your friends or on your own. Buy low, sell high, pretend you know what you're doing. Oh, and keep your mood up. That last part is kind of the whole game.

details.title: 哥布林狂想曲
details.short_description: 化身获得人形变身药水的哥布林开启奇幻 2D 肉鸽冒险！深入随机生成的地牢副本斩杀魔物，拾取海量随机装备、技能词条搭建独属于你的战斗 Build；局外养成角色、解锁温柔羁绊剧情，拯救各族少女伙伴，反复挑战高难度地牢，同时感受肉鸽闯关的爽快随机乐趣与长线角色养成的治愈体验。

details.title: The Current Past
details.short_description: A fading seaside town, a dark secret lurking beneath the waves, and a plot that will test your powers of deduction... Use logic, observation and your trusty notebook to untangle your way to the truth in this puzzling mystery.

details.title: Worldrift: Unscripted Narrative RPG
details.short_description: Unscripted narrative RPG. Pick a world, meet its cast, and say anything — a live AI narrator writes the story around your choices while real game systems track wounds, skills and money underneath. Worlds remember what you did, and you can carry your story from one world into the next.

details.title: REDHOOD: CONTRACT ASSAULT ACTION
details.short_description: A desperate ex-soldier accepts deadly contracts from an anonymous employer. Hunt 4 random targets, fight through hostile locations, and reach a random extraction point in this fast-paced PS2-inspired and early 2000s PC Games shooter.

details.title: Turbowheels
details.short_description: Turbowheels is a dynamic car party game where you compete against your friends in a series of crazy game modes. Get behind the wheel, step on the gas, and prove your skills in a variety of challenges, ranging from frantic racing to total demolition chaos.

details.title: Kronopunk GP
details.short_description: Kronopunk GP is a VR motorcycle racing experience with a cyberpunk aesthetic, inspired by sim racing. Riding focuses on precision and flow rather than arcade-style handling. You control the bike using both head movement and hand positioning, while the heads up display provides information.

details.title: On the Green: Endless Golf
details.short_description: The golf roguelike. On the Green is a deckbuilder for the back nine. Your bag is the deck. Every swing rolls a die. Stack the deck, work the course, bury your rivals in the sand. One shot, one roll, one trophy at a time. Tee it up!

details.title: Finish Your Meatballs!
details.short_description: Finish Your Meatballs! is a galactic double stick shooter inspired in old classic arcade games. ¡Defeat multiple enemies and surpass your friends and THE WORLD with your best scores in various game modes!

details.title: Black Hole Idle
details.short_description: Start as a tiny black hole and grow by consuming asteroids, planets, and star systems. Automate your power, unlock upgrades, and devour the universe in this relaxing space idle incremental game.

details.title: Winds of Bounty
details.short_description: Winds of Bounty is a casual, fast-paced single and network multi player, competitive sailing exploration and treasure hunting game, featuring multiple game modes, including Treasure Hunt, Monster Hunt, Orb Hunt, Race, Arena, and Treasure Gallery!

details.title: Desktop Dice Ranch
details.short_description: Dice Ranch is a desktop idle game built around dice. Roll for coins, collect dice in all kinds of styles, breed their offspring on your ranch, unlock combos and talent skills, and go on expeditions to defeat powerful foes. Build the ultimate dice ranch of your own.

details.title: SUPERUSER
details.short_description: An ASCII bullet-heaven roguelite where you stack weapon modifiers, evolve your arsenal, and fight towering bosses. Turn bullets, blades, and fireballs into cascading destruction. Experiment with powerful combinations as enemies flood the arena.

details.title: SZKELETAL: Estrogen Dracul's Potato Hunger
details.short_description: Play as estrogen-fueled Dracul in this parodic roguelite 'yet another Vampire Survivors clone'. Fight off hordes of bums, haters, and similar ludolols, collect delicious potatoes, and upgrade your trashy arsenal. Survive this boring clunker, pee in the sink, and become the hobo of game scholarship!

name: ねこ巫女怪猫仕置ノ絵巻 -Neko Miko Kaibyo Shioki no Emaki-

details.title: ねこ巫女怪猫仕置ノ絵巻 -Neko Miko Kaibyo Shioki no Emaki-
details.short_description: "Neko Miko Kaibyo Shioki no Emaki" is an arcade-style action game where both allies and enemies are cats. Control the cat shrine maiden and her cat companions with the joystick, and run through the stages while defending against the fierce attacks of the monstrous cats with your feline companions.

name: 何以情堪·飞翔五十二里

details.title: 何以情堪·飞翔五十二里
details.short_description: 在一个本该平凡的周五，您与念白请假从西安前往广州参加婚礼，在前往高铁站的地铁上，似乎因为早上吃了不怎么干净的食物，导致有些腹泻，恰好站站有厕所，于是你们开启了“飞翔五十二里”的旅程。念白看似状态良好，但她似乎在隐瞒什么？当“从韦曲南8到北客站”真实上演，您能否掌控全局，带领念白平安抵达北客站呢？

details.title: Decks & Dashes
details.short_description: Step into the arena in Decks & Dashes, a fast-paced action-deckbuilder where strategy meets reflexes. Draft powerful elemental spells, dodge incoming attacks, and unleash devastating combos in real-time combat. Do you have the skills to become the ultimate arena champion?

name: There's Something Wrong with the Hero's Choices

details.title: There's Something Wrong with the Hero's Choices
details.short_description: 「その選択肢、正気か？」シンプルなノベルゲームのはずなのに、とにかく“選択肢”がおかしい！？ 予想を超える展開が待ち受ける、奇想天外なテキストアドベンチャーゲーム！

details.title: Endless War: Defense
details.short_description: Endless War: Defense returns with new missions, improved UI and modern resolutions support. Take command of fortified positions across WWII’s most iconic battlefields. Build defenses, deploy reinforcements, and let your army do the job or take direct control of any unit to turn the tide.

details.title: ACT LIKE TOYS! (A.L.T.)
details.short_description: Rescue abandoned toys and find your way back to your owner in this thrilling co-op action adventure! Evade those who seek to break or discard you by using the ultimate survival tactic: stop moving and 'Act Like Toys!' to blend in.

details.title: You Will Fall
details.short_description: A brutal vertical parkour game where every fall costs real progress. No checkpoints. And now the water is rising. Master momentum, learn the map, find faster routes, and climb before everything below you disappears.

details.title: ガッチャ！サバイバー
details.short_description: A roguelike action game where you absorb bullets to fight. Switch between Light and Dark, turn bullets into energy, and unleash powerful bursts! Build your skills and survive the overwhelming bullet storm.

details.title: Racetrack Tycoon
details.short_description: Build race tracks, expand your venue, attract racing series. Host everything from amateur club meets to world championship events in a true 1:1 scale simulation. Racetrack Tycoon challenges you to manage your budget, meet demanding series requirements, and entertain tens of thousands of fans.

details.title: Fieldwork
details.short_description: Your editor sent you to explore an abandoned ship graveyard. Photograph the evidence, stay quiet and get out alive.

details.title: Broken Masks
details.short_description: Enter an abandoned orphanage, solve unsettling puzzles, and uncover its terrible secrets. Living toys, dark presences, and haunted corridors will push your sanity to the limit. Can you survive the horror lurking within?

details.title: STORMY
details.short_description: Turn a sheet of paper into your controller using your webcam, or stick to standard controls. Journey across a vast planetary system to save your lost ally while piloting spaceships, exploring as a robot, fighting, trading, racing, mining, and cultivating life forms.

details.title: WHIPLASH
details.short_description: WHIPLASH is a speedrunning FPS where game-changing weapon mods turn ordinary guns into overpowered builds. Craft the perfect loadout, master each course, and chase the perfect run.

details.title: Beats & Brains
details.short_description: Beats & Brains is a co-op rhythm beat 'em up game. Fight zombies to the beat as Mona and Lu to rescue your bandmate in the apocalyptic Toronto subways. Play co-op, stay in sync, and jam against the living dead. Compatible with classic guitar and drum controllers!

details.title: Anomaly Sweepers
details.short_description: Join a starship cleanup crew and take on bizarre jobs across space. Memorize each site before anomalies appear, then spot what changed and hold to remove it before time runs out. From a salon where hair regrows as fast as you cut it to a tango hall that won't stop dancing, 20 strange sites await.

details.title: Just A Watermelon
details.short_description: Put aside all the responsibilities, bills, and stress that come with being human. You’re just a watermelon.

details.title: X Calibur
details.short_description: X Calibur is a top-down hack-and-slash roguelike! Every run starts with building your own dungeon-crawler path. Collect sword parts, forge powerful builds, and become unstoppable! No checkpoints to save you from the robots. Do you have what it takes to reach the end?

details.title: Kinbound
details.short_description: Kinbound is a survival roguelike where you combine familiars, trigger synergies, and build completely absurd teams to survive hordes of enemies and bosses. Collect XP, choose your upgrades, strengthen your build, and survive as long as you can.

details.title: Scraw's Blooms
details.short_description: Design sunflower fields, control cross-pollination, and scale your harvest with careful or chaotic management. As the field's scarecrow, Scraw awaits perfect blooms while scaring off those pesky crows. What new varieties will you grow?

details.title: Hostile Process
details.short_description: A fast-paced top-down shooter where aiming is controlled by rotating the camera. Use your character’s enhanced abilities to carve the fastest route through each level. Chase faster times, earn ranks, and unlock new challenges.

details.title: Long Carnage
details.short_description: Long Carnage is a first-person cooperative horror game for up to 4 players. Explore an isolated house, find resources, restore power, and survive unique killers with their own mechanics in dynamic and unpredictable matches.

details.title: Quilt
details.short_description: Create a beautiful quilt one patch at a time. Solve handcrafted puzzles inspired by picross, minesweeper, and jigsaw puzzles, and uncover the hidden rules of the world through logic and experimentation.

details.title: Neural Drift
details.short_description: Play as an emerging AI inside a motherboard grid. Buy, place, and combine programs to make money, build powerful synergies, and decide whether the AI becomes ethical or ruthless.

details.title: MSO FreeCell Arena
details.short_description: Real-time multiplayer FreeCell. Same deal, real rivals: everyone gets the same shuffle and races to solve it, every race timed to the millisecond. Race the nightly Arena Hour, take the worldwide Daily Challenge, and try to beat the dev. Free to download and play. No microtransactions.

details.title: Arcane Colosseum
details.short_description: Arcane Colosseum is a first-person PvP action game where you draw runes and cast spells with your voice to battle other wizards. Master a variety of spells, choose powerful augments, and forge your own strategy to become the last wizard standing!

details.title: Tavern & Tombs
details.short_description: Tavern & Tombs is an action roguelite looter set in a dark fantasy world. Explore procedural dungeons, blast hordes of monsters with powerful magic, and collect epic loot. Return to your tavern to brew potions and spend essence on permanent upgrades before your next run into the crypts!

details.title: Rescue Incoming
details.short_description: Survive escalating zombie attacks while scavenging supplies and upgrading your gear. Hold out until rescue arrives... if you can.

details.title: Karnage: The Legend Grows
details.short_description: A challenging, heavy metal–infused rogue-lite where you battle hordes, build powerful weapon synergies, and rise to challenge the great wyrms across a dark fantasy world.

details.title: Loreth
details.short_description: A Roguelike strategy game set in the Loreth Academy, where you play as a student god researching civilizations, ecosystems, heroes, demons, and the laws of the world through powerful symbol-building simulations.

details.title: Pebble'z
details.short_description: Pebble'z is an online FPS arena shooter set in a medieval fantasy universe. You play as one of Great Wizard Geoffrus' golems. Now freed from his evil reign, you can finally fight your stone-headed brothers and see which golem is the best!

details.title: Ruin Blade
details.short_description: “Ruin Blade” is a top‑down melee‑focused action RPG. You descend into ancient ruins long forgotten by the world. Face waves of relentless creatures and carve your path by steel, instinct, and the will to survive.

details.title: 中国棋牌博物馆
details.short_description: Welcome to Chinese Board & Card Games Museum. Step back into 1980s–90s China and play Dou Di Zhu, Guandan, Sichuan Mahjong, Ka Wu Xing, and more in 3D hometown scenes lit by your own clock. Practice against AI and rewind any move. Buy once, no ads.

details.title: F.A.G.E.N.
details.short_description: F.A.G.E.N. is a 2–4 player co-op comedy-horror game where every sound you make affects your nose. Run a bizarre restaurant by day, collect the F.A.G.E.N. resources demanded by your boss at night, and try to reach the goals they set before you get fired.

details.title: Degrowth
details.short_description: Unbuild various cities in order to convince citizens of the benefits of cloud based living! Perform demolition using our simple one-click interface, but be careful not to delete the homes of citizens who are still employed! Your work is complete when everyone's brain is uploaded to the cloud!

details.title: Trapper
details.short_description: An animal-catching game made both for and against the hardcore collectors.

details.title: 門 GATE
details.short_description: A Japanese psychological horror game set in 1980s Japan. Travel to the past after a nuclear war and prepare for the coming battle against AI machines using cursed powers, strange devices, and experimental technology.

details.title: Shootrix
details.short_description: Shootrix is a fast-paced strategic puzzle game where you shoot and place blocks to create explosive 2x2 combos. Master chain reactions, outsmart opponents, and compete in real-time arena battles against players worldwide.

details.title: Super Kickmen
details.short_description: A deck-building roguelike and turn-based soccer game that brings soccer to a 7×5 grid. Aim for the top of the world with the ultimate team you’ve built!

details.title: Don't Mention B3
details.short_description: Work the night shift in an underground parking garage. Verify drivers, credentials, surveillance footage, and internal records, then decide who gets through. Remember: There is no B3 level.

details.title: Lucifaria
details.short_description: After two other priests vanish, a retired exorcist is called upon to eradicate an ancient demon. Enter a thrilling single-room turn-based horror RPG requiring strategy, sacrifice, and perseverance.

details.title: 李商隐：青袍玉珂传
details.short_description: 这是一款古风恋爱文字冒险游戏，在晚唐历史的基础上进行了戏剧化改编。你将扮演李商隐这位才华横溢却命运多舛的贫寒少年，在恶劣的世道挣扎求存，在寒门与豪门的斗争中进行艰难抉择，一路上也会有红颜知己相伴。本作对于角色的塑造复杂立体，而非分出绝对的正邪。

details.title: Devour The Kingdom
details.short_description: Sell ​​your soul to a dark deity and reclaim what is rightfully yours. Gather the troops and devour the kingdom. A mix of incremental and auto-battler.

name: 豚の背に明日への金貨を

details.title: 豚の背に明日への金貨を
details.short_description: Is it hope you carry, or a heavy burden? Tomorrow’s Coins, Pig’s Back is a roguelike action RPG. Brave randomly generated maps that grow larger and deadlier as you ascend. Exchange loot for coins, upgrade your stats, and enhance unique weapons. Your choices forge your path in the abyss.

details.title: Eyes Wide Open
details.short_description: Work for a dystopian Inspection Bureau, Determine whether the subjects are humans or not, Uncover secrets, Endure psychological horrors and reach your work quota - or else.

details.title: Flippin Broke
details.short_description: Evicted, broke, and all you've got is a stupid bottle. Flip it, raid Crusty Carl's bin for weirder bottles, and build a team where every bottle has its own chaotic trait. Kick the curb and flip it till you’re rich!

details.title: Glaring Flaw
details.short_description: Glaring Flaw is a narrative puzzle adventure built around shifting perspectives. Unlock new camera angles, reveal hidden paths and clues, and explore a rural family estate threatened by both natural disaster and an approaching new era.

details.title: Elsewhere
details.short_description: “When humans dream, they visit actual universes.” Elsewhere is an atmospheric puzzle and magical combat game where you embark on a journey across a breathtaking dream universe. Work with a dragon named Wonder to restore the passage between worlds and figure out why the universe is decaying.

details.title: Mym's Sword
details.short_description: Defeat powerful foes and discover a colorful world full of mystery and wonder in this exploratory action platformer! A wandering beast discovers a magic sword, but can she uncover the truth of its origins, and resist the powers that created it?

details.title: Grim Dice
details.short_description: Dark medieval times. Face off in an online PvP Farkle-like duel where dice combos become damage and greed can cost you victory. Choose a hero, collect items, and defeat your opponent. Risk, strategy, and luck decide who survives.

details.title: Skillpoint Warrior
details.short_description: Slay, upgrade, conquer! In Skillpoint Warrior, every defeated enemy fuels your ascent to power. Harvest skill points to infinitely boost your stats, hunt for game-changing loot, and crush formidable bosses as you battle your way through diverse, unforgiving worlds.

details.title: Timberheim
details.short_description: Timberheim is a cozy Viking lumberjack game: swing your axe to chop down trees, carry the logs through the deep snow to feed the ever-burning fire, and watch the village rise one log at a time.

details.title: False Hope
details.short_description: One winter. Four survivors, and a wounded stranger who won't last the night without you. To the east lies a missile, the one chance left to end the war for good, if you can hold the camp together long enough to reach it. Every choice may costs someone.

details.title: SELF//FORK
details.short_description: A physics-driven cyberpunk incremental. Fork yourself into data packets, bounce through a hostile mainframe's defense matrix, and reunite the fragments to break free.

details.title: Severed Souls — Chapter I
details.short_description: Above, a floating golden city promises utopia. Below lies an abyss of poverty and despair. In this parallel narrative RPG, guide two brothers separated at birth: a royal heir and a slum orphan raised by a stray dog. Will you bridge their severed worlds, or doom them to a fatal collision?

details.title: Item TD
details.short_description: Every Tower Is a Backpack! Item TD combines Tower Defense and Inventory Management in a strategy game featuring 15 stages, 3 difficulty levels. Arrange weapons and support items in your character's and Towers' inventories to maximize their synergies and fend off waves of monsters.

details.title: meowtopia
details.short_description: See the world through a cat’s eyes and explore your home! From sunny balconies to cozy bedrooms, unlock new rooms, collect items, and solve light puzzles. Play mini-games and grow daily to turn this cozy house into a true "Meowtopia." Pure immersion and heartwarming companionship await.

details.title: Card Collector Battle
details.short_description: A 2D turn-based auto-battler about collecting gods. Summon 432 guardians from Korean, Chinese, Japanese, Egyptian, Norse and Greek mythology, then fuse duplicates into the copies you own to raise their borders from silver to celestial. Your deck decides the fight.

details.title: Diaper Wars
details.short_description: A chaotic multiplayer party game where unruly babies battle, compete, and unleash mayhem with ridiculous weapons, explosive combat, and wild obstacle courses.

details.title: Shrine Full of Anomalies
details.short_description: Play as Reimu Hakurei, Youmu Konpaku, Fujiwara no Mokou, and Marisa Kirisame in this Touhou Project fangame. Search four locations for anomalies, turn back if something is wrong, and escape by choosing the correct action.
