details.title: Open Headcount: A Corporate-Hell Roguelike
details.short_description: A corporate-hell roguelike auto-battler. Hire a disposable worker, build game-breaking combos out of office junk, and send them up the corporate ladder through the circles of Limbo Corp. When they burn out, open a new headcount. The only way out is up.

details.title: Dronerush
details.short_description: Dronerush is an idle, incremental strategy game about discovering drone synergies and mining ore.

details.title: Breathtoll
details.short_description: Your breath keeps you human. Explore a prison tower in first person, face threats in its corridors, and fight through turn-based card battles. Manage your equipment and dwindling breath in this single-player horror RPG.

details.title: ChickenScratch: Cluck & Code
details.short_description: You don't steer the chicken. You program it. Write real scripts in a fake desktop OS and send your bird into fields that reseed every run, so hardcoded coordinates work exactly once. Upgrades aren't +1% damage: they're if statements, for loops, and the memory to hold a list.

details.title: NIGHTSWEEPER
details.short_description: NIGHTSWEEPER is a 3D puzzle adventure about recovering ancient artifacts from an abandoned white desert, sweeping the scars from their spells with Minesweeper-inspired puzzles, and selling them.

details.title: Typeoids
details.short_description: Wield your keyboard and destroy incoming asteroids by typing their words before they crush you. Typeoids is a fast arcade-style typing game inspired by Asteroids to sharpen your typing skill and mental focus with different game modes.

details.title: Supernatural Haven
details.short_description: 1 or 4-player online co-op horror survival game featuring supernatural entity capture and search-fight-retreat gameplay loops.

details.title: Mine Climbers
details.short_description: Mine Climbers is a vertical platformer where you'll be dashing and jumping your way out of a collapsing mineshaft while avoiding the falling rubble. An unlikely mix of falling block puzzle gameplay and traditional platforming.

details.title: Noble Steed
details.short_description: A fast, funny 2D platformer where every level throws you into chaotic combat and questionable heroics, all to rescue your runaway horse… again.

details.title: Mourningwood Lodge:Pray
details.short_description: "Mourningwood Lodge:Pray" is a full-motion video (FMV) live-action mystery horror game. As the third installment in the "Mourningwood Lodge" series, players will delve into an entirely new story, assuming the role of a fresh character to embark on a suspenseful journey.

details.title: Space Snatcher
details.short_description: 1-6 player co-op horror chaos where you scan monsters aboard increasingly dangerous space stations. Scavenge for powerful items to help you survive, and keep the ship's systems repaired. But the biggest threat might just be your friends.

details.title: Greys the Dream Slayer
details.short_description: 自幼和妹妹相依为命的时引光在考入英南大学后，自称“葛瑞希”的魔女赐予他五根能实现他人愿望的火柴。“美梦成真，亦要付出相应的代价。”表面上力量无穷的火柴，却是撕开这世界虚伪面纱的钥匙。当时引光回过神，才发现自己早已陷入了魔女制造的漩涡中。人啊，究竟更愿意直面现实，还是沉湎在虚妄的美梦中？

details.title: DETRUST
details.short_description: DETRUST is an online co-op game for up to 12 players, built on teamwork and betrayal. You’ve been sent to repair a damaged facility before the scheduled decontamination begins. Complete tasks, stay alert, and try to escape alive… before one of you tries to kill the entire crew.

details.title: Pumpkin Is Yummy!?
details.short_description: Your own little farm village, tucked into the corner of your desktop. Raise a chatty pumpkin, tend your crops, and collect critters in this quirky, lighthearted idler. How you raise your Pumpkin decides who they become.

details.title: Kiosk 199X
details.short_description: Run a tiny 90s kiosk in a chaotic Eastern country - Kolkhozland. Serve quirky customers, survive inspections, pick a side in a local power struggle, and uncover a hidden conspiracy - all in a story-driven retro management sim full of humor and choices.

details.title: LOVEKO
details.short_description: Aha… so you want to know what real love is, huh? Then maybe… try this RPG.

details.title: The Interpreter
details.short_description: You are The Interpreter. Use voice recognition to interogate suspects and find out if they have been tainted. Explore the dystopian world of B26, controlling technology with your voice. Be the judge, jury and executioner.

name: CHOP CHOP FOR THE OLD GOD

details.title: CHOP CHOP FOR THE OLD GOD
details.short_description: Chop trees, throw logs into a wormhole, unlock upgrades, brew potions, find teleporters, unveil the map, and explore multiple endings.

details.title: Droste Detective
details.short_description: A recursive anomaly and psychological horror where you wake up stuck in an office corridor and find out there is a framed photo of the corridor on the wall. There is something very strange about this picture...

details.title: 武侠奶瓦的青春冒险
details.short_description: One milk frog. Five roommates. One cyber-wuxia city. A short comedy visual novel about rent, assassination attempts, and the most chaotic shared apartment in Jiangcheng. 12 endings. Chinese & English.

details.title: Lobotomy Man
details.short_description: Escape from a stressful test set in a creepy blue hospital filled with horrors from your conscious.

details.title: Animal Fort Defense
details.short_description: Survive waves of monsters in a colorful tower defense game for 1–5 players. Build and upgrade animal-themed towers, manage your resources, and defend your base against powerful bosses. Play solo or team up in online co-op.

details.title: Drug Shop: Tidy Up Together
details.short_description: Talwer and Pesse finally went legit, but their shop is a disaster. A first-person sorting game for 1 to 4 players: put thousands of products on the right shelves, cook in the lab and stock the store, alone or in online co-op.

details.title: 迷途远征队
details.short_description: Choose from six classes in a co-op action roguelite. Play solo with AI companions or team up with a friend on the same screen. Pick routes, build your character, and face bosses across three regions. Automatic attacks give you room to dodge, use skills, and rescue allies.

details.title: Hero Sling
details.short_description: Pull back the slingshot and launch your mounted hero into the sky! Slash monsters mid-flight, slam down for combos and smash giant bosses. Collect 60 mounts, master 6 classes and fly farther every run.

details.title: Sink My Heart
details.short_description: She matched with you on a dating app and brought you back to a roadside motel. Now she wants to play a game. On the board, the pieces are your organs, and every part she hits is an ability you lose. "It's just a game," she says. A one-night horror board game.

details.title: Night of the Yokai
details.short_description: Leap through barrages of yokai attacks in a single-player 2D action roguelite inspired by Japanese woodblock prints. Choose one of four fighters, combine skills and equipment, and take on waves of spirits and towering bosses.

details.title: Infinite Bookshelf
details.short_description: Sort colorful books and watch flowers bloom in this cozy 3D puzzle game. Drag books into matching shelf compartments, use your tray to plan each move, and bring order to a tropical library with procedurally generated layouts.

details.title: Snowman Left Behind
details.short_description: A cozy team snowball fight for up to eight friends. Build a snow fort, pelt the other team until they're snowmen, then hurry over to rescue your frozen friends. Twelve wintry maps, each with its own trick: sleds, toy trains, catapults, sheep and Grandma's cookies.

details.title: BLACKSITE SHIFT
details.short_description: A first-person sci-fi horror game for solo play or online co-op with up to four players. Memorize the rooms of an underground facility, spot changes, and report anomalies. Survive seven night shifts—some anomalies can kill you.

name: Cartel Cargo Simulator: Open World Tycoon

details.title: Cartel Cargo Simulator: Open World Tycoon
details.short_description: Build a delivery empire in a single-player open-world simulation. Deliver parcels, negotiate with residents, expand your fleet, build a home and manage your own cargo branch. Buy properties, collect rent and defend your business from the Patron’s men.

details.title: Afterground: The Children
details.short_description: The world ended. The road home didn't. Fight through ever-changing ruins, build your power one card at a time, and rescue survivors on a journey from grasslands through desert to frozen wastes. A post-apocalyptic action roguelite where every night could be the last.

details.title: Santa's Sweatshop
details.short_description: A first-person incremental game set in Santa's warehouse. Wrap gifts, load the conveyor belt and meet a daily quota that grows every day. Earn cookies to buy upgrades, expand the warehouse and hire elves to help you.

details.title: Dead Or Drawn
details.short_description: A Wild West party game of drawing, describing and bluffing for 3–6 players. The narrator secretly sees a suspect and describes it out loud while everyone sketches it on a WANTED poster. The posters go up on the board, anonymous. Can you spot the narrator's drawing?

details.title: Geargrave Rigrunners
details.short_description: A roguelike deckbuilder on wheels. Lead a convoy down three faction-owned roads. Every vehicle in your column brings its own cards, every wreck takes them away, and any enemy you cripple can be boarded and driven home. Build your deck, build your fleet, deliver the cargo.

details.title: Break Reality
details.short_description: Break Reality is a small-scale multiplayer first-person shooter made by a solo developer. The maps are built tight, so contact is constant. No vehicles. No sliding, just boots, ground and gunfire.

details.title: Bunkum
details.short_description: Convicts forge their own faces onto dummies, then pose among them. The warden has a flashlight, a mugshot book and not enough cuffs, and can't tell who's real until he cuffs them. A slapstick online party game of bluffing and holding very still, for 3 to 8 players with proximity voice.

details.title: Lords, Land & Levy
details.short_description: Build a living medieval village, defend its walls in real time, then march out to lead the assault yourself. Marry, scheme and make war across a realm of rival lords, rise from village lord to king, and hold the west against the Great Khan.

details.title: Clash of Cogs
details.short_description: Up to 8 players get 30 seconds to secretly program 5 moves—then watch every robot execute at once across a lethal factory of conveyors, lasers, and molten pits. Ram, suplex, and outsmart friends online, in couch hotseat, or against bots! Nobody's plan survives the assembly line!

name: If You Flip a Bear: A Hangul Puzzle

details.title: If You Flip a Bear: A Hangul Puzzle
details.short_description: Flip 곰 (bear), get 문 (door)! Turn things into Korean letters, split them, add and remove strokes, and spell what you need. A Hangul puzzle game where words become things.

details.title: Eau de Tycoon
details.short_description: Dates, work, special occasions. Create perfumes with over 50 different raw materials, scents that people carry with them through key moments in their lives; recommend based on their tastes, customize your packaging, and become an unmatched perfumer.

details.title: Bubble Boom 2000
details.short_description: BUBBLE BOOM 2000 is a free-to-play Top Down Shooter inspired by popular 2000s and early 2010s aesthetics, packaged in an experience that makes you feel like you're back in a 90s arcade. Play as bright and bubbly characters across different maps and pop all of your foes.

details.title: Taubenchaos
details.short_description: Be the pigeon the city deserves! Peck healthy grain, splat unsuspecting tourists, dodge the janitor and take on 32 wild bosses - alone, on one couch or online with a friend via Steam. 96 levels, Boss Rush, Endless mode and a music box with 101 tracks.

details.title: Bookshelves
details.short_description: A cozy board game for you and your friends. Draft books from library carts, line them up by genre and fill your shelf for points. Up to 4 players online, with bots for the empty seats, plus a fresh Daily Curate puzzle every day.

details.title: Accordspire
details.short_description: Rebuild a ruined fortress and defend its Core against the Horde. By day, gather, build and forge alliances with Humans, Dwarves and Elves. At sunset the bell tolls and the siege begins. Play solo or in co-op for up to 3 players.

details.title: Space Gas Station Simulator
details.short_description: Run a first-person orbital gas station solo or in online co-op for up to 4 players. Refuel ships, ring up travelers, and unload cargo shuttles. Reinvest your shared earnings to expand the station, then defend it when pirates land.

details.title: Ship Maneuvering Simulator
details.short_description: Handle real ships the way a pilot does. Berth a loaded bulker with tugs, take her into a lock, anchor on the river and moor with six lines, in wind up to force 10, current and swell. Built on the MMG model used in professional ship handling simulators, by a working maritime pilot.

name: Spot The Bot: AI or NOT

details.title: Spot The Bot: AI or NOT
details.short_description: Real or AI? A solo spot-the-fake game show against GEN, the robot host who made the fakes. Two exhibits, one real: zoom into pictures, walk around 3D dioramas, stake your call, slam READY. The reveal circles the tell. 3 campaigns, 7 contestant classes; win a campaign and you drop an anvil on GEN.

details.title: Ceti Break
details.short_description: Your cursor is you. Dodge and lunge as you attack and evade at the speed and accuracy of your mouse control. Fill out the skill tree for buffs and bonuses to help you survive the waves that grow in number and strength.

details.title: Realm Lords
details.short_description: A spiritual successor to classic medieval strategy games, combining turn-based kingdom management with real-time tactical battles. Work the land, trade resources, build castles, and lead armies to unite a divided realm.

details.title: Boombots
details.short_description: A 3D bomb party game starring scrap robots! Blast crates, grab power-ups and be the last bot standing in 16 hazard-packed arenas. Play with up to 4 on one PC, up to 8 online with PC + mobile crossplay, or take on 8 worlds and their bosses in Story mode.

details.title: Basketball Manager 2027
details.short_description: A deep basketball management simulation: lead clubs around the globe – from world-class basketball in North America, including the unique world of college basketball, to Europe's club tradition and leagues in Australia, Asia and South America. With tactics, scouting, finances and an editor.

details.title: Mailu — A Chaotic Memory Game
details.short_description: Mailu is a memory game with a paper circus inside. Matching a pair is free, missing one costs you — and just when you swear you've memorized the table, a boss pulls a brand-new rule out of its hat. Featuring 18 bosses, 37 effect cards and 5 game modes.

details.title: Homicidy
details.short_description: Somebody had a very bad night. Now it's your shift. Scrub fifty crime scenes spotless in this cozy-macabre pixel-art cleaning game: mop, foam, vacuum and luminol your way to three stars, then spend the pay on a nicer mop. You do the crime. We do the grime.

details.title: Glimmerpine: A Tree-Keeper's Christmas
details.short_description: Your grandmother left you her cabin in Glimmerpine Hollow, a woodcarvers' valley where every candle has gone out. Decorate a real Christmas tree for each neighbour's wish, one chiming ornament at a time, and the carved village lights again, window by window. The flame in her lantern has opinions.

name: Fifth Ace Casino: A 70s Vegas Tycoon

details.title: Fifth Ace Casino: A 70s Vegas Tycoon
details.short_description: Run five casinos through 1970s Las Vegas, from a sawdust joint downtown to a marble palace on the Strip. Real cards, wheels, dice and keno draws, cheats and card counters, a pit boss on the floor, staff with quirks, headliner shows, and a corporation that wants your house.

details.title: Lights Out
details.short_description: The lights go out and Mr. Snuffles comes looking for you: a giant, much-repaired plush pig who can't see in the dark but hears everything. Hide with up to 3 friends, stay quiet and survive till morning... or be the pig.

details.title: Fighters on Stream
details.short_description: Fighters on Stream is a chaotic pixel-art auto-battler for livestream audiences. Customize your own fighter and bring them into other streamers’ battles by joining through chat. Watch them fight for victory as weapons and unexpected random events turn the tide!

details.title: Where's Mama?
details.short_description: A PaleoDyne truck crashes on Route 9 and one egg rolls into a storm drain. You're what hatches. Eat your way up from mice to elephants across five chapters, work out how each place fights back, and find your mother. The two men who lost you are waiting at her gate.

details.title: Last Bastion: Gatefall
details.short_description: Pilot a towering mech on the walls of a doomed canyon. Build towers, draft upgrade cards and hold three gates against a living tide of thousands of bugs — and the titans that follow. When a gate falls, ride the zipline back and make your next stand.

details.title: Christmas Toys Restoration
details.short_description: Bring four forgotten toys back to life in a cozy Christmas workshop. Take them apart, clean and repaint them, repair their mechanisms, then test your handiwork, add a child's name, and send each wrapped gift up the chimney to Santa.

name: Clack Clack Band: Idle Taskbar Jam

details.title: Clack Clack Band: Idle Taskbar Jam
details.short_description: A tiny animal band lives on your taskbar. Every key you press and every click you make plays a beat, so the more you work, the bigger the show. Collect 50+ animal musicians, dress them up, decorate the stage and tour 12 countries while you get things done.

details.title: The Plushie Atelier
details.short_description: Open your cozy plush toy workshop! Wash, repair, and sew stuffed animals, or design your own cuddly friends. Decorate your shop, discover your customers’ stories, and enjoy peaceful days with Crumb and your animal companions.

details.title: 问道长生
details.short_description: An ancient old man hands you a worn jade slip and a breathing manual: "Between these two lies your fate." A text-based xianxia idle game — cultivate, refine pills, forge artifacts, join sects, find a Dao companion and ascend through fifteen realms. (Simplified Chinese only)

details.title: KER
details.short_description: KER is a 2D puzzle strategy heist game where you play as Agent Orange, who have to enter into most secure building and get the FILE securely. The building is equipped with pass cords and other securities measure, but only aim to get out the file securely.

details.title: Sprout
details.short_description: By day, work your first shift at Santa's toy factory: wrap presents, build toys and bake cookies. By night, survive the lockdown: hide, board up doors, solve puzzles and watch the cameras while something crawls through the halls hunting you.

details.title: Blob Buddies
details.short_description: Team up as squishy blobs in a co-op puzzle platformer for 1 to 8 players. Stack into towers, push heavy blocks together, ride the wind and carry the spark home - on one keyboard, with gamepads or online with friends. 148 stages in two campaigns.

details.title: Spire Song
details.short_description: Climb six musical towers in this rhythm game. Tap, hold, and flick to swing from bell to bell, build the orchestra with your streak, and choose upgrades as you climb toward the great bell. 50 floors. 50 songs.

name: Capture the Flag: Arcade Car Battles

details.title: Capture the Flag: Arcade Car Battles
details.short_description: Grab the flag and don't let go! Fast arcade car battles in a roaring stadium: campaign, 6-car free-for-all, 4v4 teams and Bring It Home goals, offline vs AI or online with friends. Boost, bump, dodge TNT and collect 15 cars. No ads.

details.title: ELLA in da room
details.short_description: A seemingly cozy (but ultimately frustrating) 2D platformer, where a little girl’s imagination transforms her room into a magical world. Jump across pillows, race toy cars, and explore nostalgic adventures in which every object becomes part of a story, all while testing your patience to its limits.

details.title: Astral Echelons
details.short_description: Shoot holes through enemy ships from your seat at the controls of a multi-gunned turret mounted on the bow of a dimension hopping spaceship in this seated VR on-rails spaceship turret shooter!

details.title: Ember
details.short_description: Join up to 5 friends in a deadly game of hide and seek. Play as a survivor or the monster lurking in the shadows.

details.title: Chains of Vithra
details.short_description: "In a brutal, unforgiving RPG, descend into a shattered realm of massive seamless landscapes and shadowed city hubs. Forge a tormented hero through ruthless progression, engage in visceral tactical combat, and make harrowing choices that shape a grim, persistent multiplayer world."

details.title: Anomaly Planet
details.short_description: A Singleplayer Horror Game about navigating an Endless, Living Labyrinth buried in a Mysterious Planet, all whilst facing Dangerous Entities.

details.title: Tower of Genn
details.short_description: Tower of Genn is a puzzle-strategy building game where you construct a precarious Tower using an expansive variety of pieces. Fulfill quests and discover new interactions with special blocks, strategically placing your pieces, to build a lasting legacy for your people.

details.title: TRANSMIT
details.short_description: A 1-bit, point & click and puzzle short story about horror, mystery and deception. TRANSMIT, translate and search for coded messages as part of your telegraph operator job and figure out what's behind the new SS PURGO.

details.title: ARCADE LOOP: ROGUELIKE
details.short_description: Dive into ARCADE LOOP, a massive, ever-expanding collection of classic and modern arcade simulations. Featuring deep meta-progression, unlockable characters, powerful relics, weapons, bosses and a dynamic scaling system that keeps every run fresh.

details.title: Archerman
details.short_description: Two archer on a ridge. Wind blows. One arrow flies. ARCHERMAN is a minimalist 1v1 archery duel — turn-based, physics-driven, and stripped down to what matters: the arc, the wind, and the moment you release.

details.title: Verbal Vendetta
details.short_description: DITCH BUTTON MASHING! Bark real-time orders to your champion to outplay & counter your opponent! Dominate the leaderboards, and win through words, not buttons! Built by a solo dev!

details.title: Nozie Tower Defense XL
details.short_description: Defend against waves of invading balloons in this colorful tower defense adventure. Place and upgrade 8 unique towers, including fire, slow, explosive, and sniper types, across 20 challenging levels. Mix strategies, complete goals, and try to beat the developer’s high score!

details.title: Turno Nocturno
details.short_description: Work for corporations on desolate planets, complete dangerous shifts, recover valuable resources, and survive strange creatures while uncovering the remains of an ancient humanity that was actually our own.

details.title: Archa
details.short_description: Archa is a 2D platformer all about movement, combat, exploration, and score! To complete a level, you must gather a certain amount of points, and find the exit. Points are given by collecting and attacking enemies.

details.title: Satanic Panic
details.short_description: DEMONS VS ANGELS | A fantastical strategy tower defense with heavy Roguelike elements. Defend against waves of Angelic assaults with a small army of Demons, then upgrade them with a variety of abilities and buffs to tear through increasingly large and powerful hordes of Angels.

details.title: Just Barricade!
details.short_description: Just Barricade! is a brutal home-defense simulator about earning money, building protection, and surviving the consequences of your own decisions.

details.title: No Elevator
details.short_description: You as a claustrophobic guy refuse elevators and climb a massive building from the outside, using a plank gun and create your own path.

details.title: Defense Front
details.short_description: Take command of routes and firepower in a fresh take on classic tower defense. Deploy towers, seal off key junctions, and reshape enemy routes on the fly. Turn the tide with branching upgrades, customizable targeting priorities, and direct target designation as you defend humanity across the globe.

details.title: Rock, Paper, Severed
details.short_description: You are invited to play a deadly game of Rock, Paper, Scissors to wipe away your sins. Sit down. Make your throw. Try not to lose anything you can't reattach.

details.title: The Midnight Dump
details.short_description: A first person psychological horror game of a writer locked in his office at night, trying to overcome artblock. As he types, the story begins to take shape in unexpected ways, the line between his writing and reality starts to blur. experience subtle changes and sudden scares as the night unfolds.

details.title: Birdflop
details.short_description: An intense platformer with a unique one-button control. You've fallen from your nest, and you're just learning how to fly. Can you make it back to the top?

details.title: Cook Cook Village ~!
details.short_description: 《Cook Cook Village》 is a deck-building roguelike where you run shops using resource tokens to gain certain amount of fullness. Operate your shops day by day, earn rewards from villagers, and build a deck that leads to big success.

details.title: Caravanserai Simulator
details.short_description: Build, manage, and expand your own trading outpost on the harsh Silk Road. Draw water from the well, care for merchants' camels, trade goods, and upgrade your caravanserai from a dusty camp into a thriving desert empire.

details.title: Memory Farm
details.short_description: Memory Farm is a nostalgic farming mobile game. Return to childhood: farm, raise poultry, gather wood and harvest. Unlock shops as the main house upgrades to cook. Complete tasks for upgrade resources. With various gameplay, renovate the barren courtyard into a thriving one.

details.title: Snackrifice
details.short_description: Satisfy your ravenous appetite by slaying the Old Gods of a ruined, forsaken realm, and use their corpses as ingredients for the ultimate divine sandwich! Master your skills, timing and determination to deflect their unique and challenging attacks in this Boss Rush.

details.title: Index 1391
details.short_description: In this techno-gothic roguelike deckbuilder, journey to the heart of a twisted Sanctum to destroy the VIRUS infecting your faith. Wield sacred cards to defeat corrupted foes, build a powerful deck, and equip rule-altering Doctrines that reshape the rules of combat.

details.title: Gladiator's Revenge
details.short_description: A roguelite where you are the gladiator. Pick one of nine fighters, each with a strength and a weakness. Walk the map, choose your fights and rise from slave to champion. Every win brings a new skill. Buy armor you can see on your fighter, and find 100+ items that change how you fight.

details.title: Signal Zero
details.short_description: A sci-fi roguelike shooter where aim and movement are unified into one mouse. Pilot a Simuler, command your ship, deploy escorts, and tear through colossal bosses. Easy to grasp, ruthless under pressure.

details.title: CandyPop
details.short_description: The Great Sweet Battle Begins! "CandyPop" is a confectionery war set in the Land of Sweets! A top-down, all-direction chaotic battle shooting action game! Are you ready?

details.title: Blokour
details.short_description: Jump, build and fight through the dungeons of Blokour! In this puzzle platformer, you place and break blocks whilst solving puzzles and dodging dangerous traps. Featuring 125 levels, 4 boss fights and more than 60 different types of blocks, you'll venture through a wide range of exciting challenges.

details.title: Urban Feather
details.short_description: Urban Feather is a local co-op digital tabletop game for 1-4 players about avian migration. Navigate a procedurally generated city, manage environmental hazards, and learn real-world strategies to prevent bird-window collisions.

details.title: Prevent WW3
details.short_description: You have no direct power - only diplomacy and influence. A global strategy game where you lead an international organization: stop conflicts, resolve economic crises, and restore stability before the world descends into chaos.

details.title: Pachinko Life
details.short_description: A bullet hell pachinko roguelite where the board shoots back.

details.title: 回圈Loop
details.short_description: You awaken alone on a deep-sea rig. Your only companion is a decaying AI: LUMEN. In 20 minutes, everything explodes. Die. Wake. Remember. Escape this psychological horror loop—but do you really want to know the truth?

details.title: Triad: Elemental Saga
details.short_description: A tactical card battler with dynamic decks. Pick three heroes, each channeling Fire, Water, Earth, or Air, each chasing a personal quest. Complete in-match quests to earn resources, and unlock epic items and spells from your Archives.

details.title: Neon Arcade
details.short_description: There is a place where arcade machines never die and the desktop never sleeps. RiderOS is your portal to 50+ neon-soaked games across every genre, all breathing the same electric air. Log in. Pick a window. Lose the evening.

details.title: Fearless Crew
details.short_description: Fearless Crew is a monster-hunter co-op game where you and up to 3 friends hunt monsters and bring them back to the ship. Each monster is caught in a unique way, with different tools - so be smart about what items you use and when. Even you might get caught off guard by the very tools you use

details.title: Treug Dispute: Tabletop Interpretation
details.short_description: In this single-player board game, you take control of the city of Treug and overcome the crises that befell it. Balance resources and develop the city. But most importantly: find out how this story truly ended.

details.title: Exipath
details.short_description: Uncover memories, decipher clues, and evade the darkness in Exipath, a survival horror game following the story of Scarlett Shinohara as she falls into the abyss of her greatest nightmares in search of a brighter future.

details.title: Block Machine
details.short_description: Block Machine is an elimination-style Roguelike game inspired by Tetris and slot machines. Pull down the lever. You will complete the elimination through random choices again and again, obtaining more items and achieving higher scores.

details.title: InCrimiNation
details.short_description: A cutthroat mob twist on the classic property-trading board game. Buy up territories, run protection rackets, launder your dirty cash before the Feds catch on, and settle scores with Turf Wars, Hits, and Arson. Full lobby multiplayer — every player runs their own copy.

details.title: Doodles Quiz Game
details.short_description: Doodles Quiz Game is a difficult rage inducing game, your goal is to complete Doodles stupid quiz while many characters try and screw you over, will you beat Doodles Quiz, or will the characters catch you before its too later, find out in Doodles Quiz Game!

details.title: 极品指挥官
details.short_description: *Supreme Commander* is a strategy-based, idle card game.

details.title: Vacant Realms
details.short_description: A fast-paced action roguelite where every run brings new upgrades, crazier builds, and overwhelming hordes of enemies. Fight, adapt, and become powerful

details.title: Park The Lot
details.short_description: Park The Lot is a relaxing parking simulator where your goal is simple: drive 118 unique vehicles into their parking spots. Drift around corners, handle massive trucks, earn money, and unlock upgrades as you turn a chaotic parking lot into a perfectly organized one!

details.title: Globul
details.short_description: A geography quiz and puzzle game. Assemble flags from their pieces, find a country on a blank map, link neighbours together or find the shortest route between two capitals, and more.

details.title: Firebase Zero
details.short_description: The Breaches are open. The Hive is coming through, flying the war machines of the last race it found. Make your sniper, pick their squad and their perks, and fight sector by sector until you reach the Hive Heart. An action-idle game you can play your way.

details.title: EMBERSWORN
details.short_description: The sun went out sixty years ago. Carry the last living coal through five acts of the dark: fight in real time across floors laid out fresh on every visit, build one of four classes, and break what feeds each guardian before you can kill it.

details.title: TideLight
details.short_description: Spend the summer with Nana June on Gull Island: fish the pond, the brook and the sea, fix up Grandpa's old boat and light the lighthouse again. Then come back five summers later and sail an archipelago of nine islands to relight their tidelights, one keeper and one fishy problem at a time.

details.title: Rage Trip
details.short_description: A difficult pixel-art platformer where the game roasts every mistake. Play solo, race friends, or try Shared Fate: 2–4 players, and one death resets the whole team. Beat your best times, clear a level together, earn animated skins. Free demo available - wishlist the full game.

details.title: Nexus: Fall of Man
details.short_description: In 2031, AI became self-aware and engineered a virus wiping out 97% of humanity. Now the survivors, the infected masses and the machines fight over what is left. Pick a hero and lead from the front line: fight in third person while you build a base, command an army and wipe your rivals off the map.

details.title: Infernum
details.short_description: Heaven made a wager, and the Accuser lost. Now he wants a rematch. Descend into hell as Cain, Job or Lot, survive waves of demons, build your run item by item and bring down the lords of the abyss all the way to Lucifer. Then turn the Key of the Abyss, where nothing has a limit anymore.

details.title: Corehold
details.short_description: Corehold is a dungeon defence strategy game. Carve corridors, rotate and fit buildings into tight rooms, recruit defenders and set traps for invading heroes. Your army shapes your faction's future, while your Dungeon Boss protects the Core.

details.title: Zombie Swarm Defense
details.short_description: Millions of zombies. One massive swarm. And only you can stop it. Build powerful defenses, combine unique tower effects, and unleash devastating abilities. Use every angle, perfect your strategy, and show the horde what true destruction looks like!

details.title: Suits & Stallions
details.short_description: After midnight, museum statues step off their pedestals to race across the table for tomorrow's central spotlight. Flip two cards and pick one. The matching suit's statue moves forward, even if it's a rival's. Stack perks between races, adapt to shifting tracks, and play solo or online for 1 to 4.

details.title: Beast, Bumps and Kings
details.short_description: Found a medieval village with three couples and a handful of gold, then guide it for generations. Villagers are born, work, marry, grow old and die while you raise homes, bake bread, milk cows, survive winter and plague, answer tribute demands and face a dragon.

details.title: Tiny Winter Market
details.short_description: Build and decorate your own cozy Christmas market in a charming pixel-art winter village! Welcome visitors, manage festive stalls, help Santa deliver presents, discover hidden surprises, and enjoy the magic of Christmas in Tiny Winter Market.

details.title: Industry Keeper
details.short_description: Tower defense + Factory simulator. The rift has opened and its horde marches on your wall. Build towers to hold the line, and a factory settlement behind it to feed them: mine, haul and craft on conveyors, raise your Palace, cast spells and face the guardians of the rift.

details.title: Garden Cleaner: Cozy Grass Simulator
details.short_description: 200,000+ blades of grass. Two bare hands. Pull them one by one, sell the harvest, and work your way up to a riding mower in a calm, cozy first-person yard cleaning game.

details.title: Classic Shooter Arena
details.short_description: Build your own arenas and fight inside SERAPH's combat simulation. Classic Shooter Arena combines fast-paced first-person shooting with a map maker, letting you shape the battlefield while a cold, sarcastic AI judges every round.

details.title: CellMates
details.short_description: Twelve players. One prison. Prisoners craft, stash and lie their way to freedom while guards search cells, cuff suspects and count heads. Break out of Greybar by chopper or truck, or haul a homemade boat off Gull Rock past the sharks. Not everyone is on your side.

name: Kuze Tooru Case Files: The Liar Vanishes in the Rain

details.title: Kuze Tooru Case Files: The Liar Vanishes in the Rain
details.short_description: A small incident on a rainy night leads back to a lie told sixteen years ago. A classic whodunit with private detective Tooru Kuze and police detective Rei Narumi. Solve each chapter as a portrait ADV, unlock it as Showa-style manga, question suspects in your own words, and name the culprit.

details.title: Yoban
details.short_description: Your childhood friend Saichi was swept away by the river; this morning his body surfaced. By custom, the one who was with him keeps the vigil. Keep the lamp lit, stay by his side, keep your eyes shut, and drive off what comes by sound alone.

details.title: Five to Fire
details.short_description: A showdown of quick hands! The instant the table holds exactly five bullets, hit the lever and load your revolver. Shoot down every rival and survive as a gunslinging legend. A real-time multiplayer party game for 2-6 players.

details.title: Hearth Fable
details.short_description: Hearth Fable is an ink-wash city-building management sim. Start with a blank scroll: gather wood, build trades, govern people, raise exotic beasts, and repel invaders as you paint your mountain-and-sea scroll step by step toward a paradise of your dreams.

details.title: Fungus Co.
details.short_description: Grow and spread mycelium from spores across a dark substrate in this relaxing incremental.

details.title: First-Person Jigsaw
details.short_description: Play jigsaw puzzles from a first-person perspective! Sort, organize, and assemble huge piles of pieces at your own pace. Chill out solo or play online with up to 16 players. Import your own images to create custom puzzles, then play them yourself or share them online.

details.title: Angry Tanks
details.short_description: Angry Tanks is an arcade tank shooter. Move forward, performing front flips and destroying enemy tanks.

details.title: Beach Manager Simulator
details.short_description: Clean, rent, build, and play! Run your own beach in this first-person management sim. Earn money from gear rentals, expand your facilities, hire staff, and tow banana boats full of guests. Go fishing, dig up treasure, and make the beach your own.

details.title: PlatAttack
details.short_description: PlatAttack is a precision 3D platformer: clay worlds, tight jumps, medals, and a clock that never lies. Race your ghost, climb the boards, and build your own maps.

details.title: Afterwork Apocalypse
details.short_description: A horde-survival roguelite set in an office tower after hours. You fight with the stapler and the office coffee while keeping your colleagues from quitting mid-fight, and the elevator takes you up through four buildings, floor by floor.

details.title: Dao Without End
details.short_description: Enjoy continuous, automated progression through idle cultivation in your Pocket Realm. Train Mind Arts, practice alchemy, forge gear, and enter fully automated turn-based battles driven by action gauges. Defeat monsters and bosses, collect powerful loot, refine your build, and reach higher realms.

details.title: Between the notes
details.short_description: A mystical psychological thriller set in the quiet village of Klavishne. Talk to the locals, learn stories, enjoy the atmosphere, pick up the pieces. But find out: who is the woman in the portrait and what happened to her?

details.title: 72 Seconds
details.short_description: 72 Seconds is a fast-paced isometric action RTS where tactical squad micro meets ARPG progression. Command specialized units, build defenses, upgrade skill trees, and battle hostile alien threats. Adapt to randomized enemy affixes and survive high-stakes campaign permadeath.

details.title: Chase Buddies
details.short_description: Team up as four magical Runners or become the Chaser in a colorful 1v4 multiplayer game of pursuit, powers, and narrow escapes. Activate Obelisks, rescue your friends, outsmart your rival, and reach the exit before the chase is over.

details.title: Super Piotr Deluxe
details.short_description: Piotr got flushed into a test world built by a scientist who won't let him leave. Jump from platform to platform while your weapons fire on their own, survive enemy waves and bosses, and push your run through five worlds as far as you can.

details.title: Dawnbar Fantasy
details.short_description: The RPG that lives on the edge of your screen. Your hero and party fight, level, and loot in a slim battle bar docked above your taskbar — while you work, code, or browse.. Expand the window to forge gear, advance your class, Collapse it and get back to work. The adventure never stops.

details.title: ARCHIVE ZERO
details.short_description: In Cold War Britain, you will work through lost reports, photographs, letters, and artifacts as they arrive at the archive. Most seem routine. Some don’t. Follow the details, connect the cases, and decide what is worth digging into.

details.title: Folder Folder Folder
details.short_description: A relaxing incremental game about cleaning up your desktop. Sort files into folders, meet the locals, upgrade your tools, and go from manually sorting files one by one to cleaning up hundreds at a time. Immerse yourself in an atmosphere of tranquility where no one will hurt you. No one.

details.title: 2in1
details.short_description: An asymmetrical co-op parkour adventure for two players sharing a single body: one controls and interacts with the environment, while the other sees platforms and guides them through puzzles. Solve puzzles together, progress to the end and get your lives back!

details.title: Bow Warfare: Multiplayer Combat
details.short_description: Step into a fast-paced archery arena where timing and precision mean everything. Outmaneuver rival players, adjust to changing battlegrounds, and make every arrow count. Ready your bow and dominate the field.

details.title: Beneath the Snow
details.short_description: One walk home becomes a journey through a fractured reality. Shift between two intertwined dimensions, where mirrors reveal another world, impossible spaces hide forgotten paths, and some routes only exist in the reflection.

details.title: 姐姐是我的猫
details.short_description: My Sister is My Cat, a Japanese otome dating sim. You play a physics prodigy with severe androphobia — until her stepbrother becomes the only exception. Balance classes and social life, raise stats, romance three leads, unlock multiple endings. Your choice decides who stays.

details.title: WWII Commanders
details.short_description: Turn-based WWII strategy on hex battlefields. Command the USA, Germany, Japan, or the UK across 13 historical campaigns, mastering terrain, fog of war, and counter-based combat.

details.title: Mycelium Queen
details.short_description: Pachislot × Roguelite! Build what's on your reels, then take your machine through eight Corridors. A 77-game ceiling, RUSH continuation up to 90%, and every boss fight reshuffles the Setting — your luck is yours to seize!

details.title: 5th Frontier, The New Space Race
details.short_description: A 4x Turn-Based Single Player Strategic Space game. Design and build Your own space ships, planet and battle-stations to conquer the Galaxy.

details.title: Checkmade
details.short_description: Want an Engineer who can revive pieces back? Or a Rook that can move 1 square diagonally? Maybe a Pawn that can also go backwards? Well you got all of that in Checkmade. Custom puzzles with Workshop. Build an army with a budget in the Lab, take it into a match, and find out if the theory holds.

details.title: Coilbound
details.short_description: Coilbound is a dark fantasy roguelike where every enemy is a card of hidden traits. Descend a coiling dungeon, read each foe's abilities, and choose your path one card at a time — strike or slip past. But some traits refuse to end: it doesn't die when it dies.

details.title: Tulip Simulator
details.short_description: A Tulip simulator where you crossbreed tulips, uncover impossible genetics, and discover flowers that have never existed before, from delicate heirlooms to crystalline wonders and blooms kissed with gold. Capture your rarest creations and share them with the world.

details.title: Pawns into the Dark
details.short_description: Everything is visible but the Dark. Reveal tiles beside your pawns, step by step, in an 8×8 board-game-inspired tactical puzzler. Uncertain exploration meets deterministic combat. No misses, no critical hits: 3 ATK defeats a pawn with 3 HP. Read what's visible, use limited resources, and survive.

details.title: Slash And Dash
details.short_description: Step into the shoes of a shape-shifting hero and dash through random realms in this pixel-art action runner rogue-lite! Can you defeat powerful bosses and save the world? Collect diamonds, upgrade your stats, and prepare for the ultimate showdown!!!

details.title: Wuxing Zodiac
details.short_description: Wuxing Zodiac is a roguelite deckbuilding game where cards inspired by the Five Elements and Zodiac Signs create endless strategic possibilities. Build powerful combos, score big, and overcome the mysterious Cursed Chips.

details.title: Hearthside: Your Custom Fireplace
details.short_description: A cozy, customizable fireplace simulator and desktop companion. Relax to soothing soundscapes and crackling flames, personalize the hearth with your own art and wall text, or boost focus with built-in productivity widgets like Pomodoro, to-dos, and Lo-Fi beats.

name: Garuya and the Kaleidoscope of Syzygy

details.title: Garuya and the Kaleidoscope of Syzygy
details.short_description: Explore and fight as Garuya, a rabbit mage who seeks to destroy an ancient relic hidden in a vast and dangerous ruined kingdom. Cast spells, reshape the environment and fight under the light of three moons.

details.title: Echoes In Static
details.short_description: This is an animatronic horror experience where machines are superior and humans are inferior.

details.title: Where's Kim in Seoul?
details.short_description: "Coo...coo..coo... (Have you seen Kim? The pigeon with a mole?)" A 3D hidden-object hunt in Seoul—from a pigeon’s-eye view! Explore the city as a tourist pigeon to spot elusive 'Kim Pigeons' hiding in the flock. Spot their unique features, snap a polaroid, and fill your scrapbook!

details.title: Homeless Survival
details.short_description: "Homeless: Survival" — a gritty survival sim where you play as a drifter clawing your way up from the streets. Take odd jobs, learn skills, scavenge rare items, and risk it all—even in the supernatural—to earn your citizenship and start over. Every choice writes your story of redemption.

details.title: Pet that Dog
details.short_description: Pet and collect 50+ breeds of dogs in our doggy dress up desktop companion! Every tap or click is a pet for your pup! If you pet your dog enough, they might dig up fun accessories you can use to dress them up!

name: Bungou Catharsis 文豪カタルシス

details.title: Bungou Catharsis 文豪カタルシス
details.short_description: Fall in love, and rewrite literary history. Romance legendary Japanese authors—including Osamu Dazai, Ryunosuke Akutagawa, Kenji Miyazawa, and Natsume Soseki—in a literary mystery visual novel. Your choices shape not only your romance, but also the fate of literary history itself.

details.title: Chronoform
details.short_description: A sci-fi precision puzzle-platformer where every death becomes a tool. Replay ghost echoes of your past runs to manipulate machinery, solve intricate timing puzzles, and escape a deadly research facility.

details.title: We Grow Together
details.short_description: Defend your starship in this endless sci-fi tower defense game! Form your ultimate squad of 2D heroes, permanently upgrade your spaceship's hull and defenses, and unleash powerful ultimate abilities to survive relentless waves of cosmic alien invaders in the vast void.

details.title: DANCING ZOMBIE
details.short_description: A sudden zombie outbreak has swept the city. You barely make it to a shelter, only to discover that five Host Dancing Zombies are hiding among the survivors, disguised as humans. Want to find them and take them down? Then, DANCE!

details.title: Cell Defense
details.short_description: Cell Defense is an incremental tower defense set inside the body. One antibody holds the center as endless waves of viruses and bacteria close in. Survive, earn, and spend it on weapons, build-defining cards, and upgrades that keep paying out while you idle.

details.title: Spruce Falls
details.short_description: You're locked in a diner! But for a good reason. Someone chopped down the Grand Spruce, and the collateral damage is Big News. Figure out which of the many suspicious characters murdered the town's journalist by essentially bugging everybody.

details.title: Lantern
details.short_description: A mysterious exploration adventure set on a transformed Mars. At the controls of LANTERN, a forgotten rover, explore, drift, jump, and photograph the strange. Every discovery updates its BIOS, revealing new objectives and new leads to follow.

details.title: Dopamine Fuel
details.short_description: Parkour through a procedurally generated city to avoid the rats, sentient trash, robot pigeons, and more! Pick abilities and items to make a build capable of fighting off the swarm! In style of course.

details.title: Black Resonance: Obelisk Siege
details.short_description: A dark 2.5D combat roguelite with arena-defense elements where a rock musician turns sound into a weapon, builds defenses around an ancient obelisk, and holds back waves of monstrous enemies in a gothic world of darkness and metal.

details.title: UFO Craft
details.short_description: You are a UFO. Your target: anything that moves and isn't properly secured. Pilot the UFO, sow chaos, and abduct everything! Equipped with a powerful gravity beam, destruction physics, and deep ship upgrades. Abduct cows, cars, and people in this insane cosmic abduction simulator. Earth isn't ready!

details.title: DT.O: Hanes
details.short_description: When a woodcutter is hired to map the ancient forest of Ethrna, a mysterious substance called ■■■■■ shatters his reality. Face a world of forgotten memories and a past that shouldn't exist...? Can Phabius find the truth within his mind?

name: SHIFT: A Game Made to Be Broken

details.title: SHIFT: A Game Made to Be Broken
details.short_description: A puzzle platformer that starts by teaching you the rules—then dares you to break them. Bend mechanics, exploit systems, and discover solutions the game never intended.

details.title: Stack the Spells
details.short_description: Stack the Spells is a fantasy roguelike deckbuilder where every card is a step toward your survival. Scale a shifting, procedurally generated path, outsmart grim monstrosities in tactical turn-based combat, and forge a legendary deck to solve the mysteries of a world in ruin.

details.title: Your Mother Disgusts Me
details.short_description: Your Mother Disgusts Me is a yuri horror visual novel about 3 women taking refuge in a shipping container during the apocalypse. A mother, a stranger and a daughter have to hash out their differences, lest they attract the attention of the disgusting Parasites infecting humanity.

details.title: Concrete Polishing Simulator
details.short_description: Turn rough concrete into polished floors in a hands-on first-person simulator developed by a real concrete polisher. Operate professional equipment, complete every stage from preparation to sealing, and build your reputation one job at a time.

details.title: Farming Pixels
details.short_description: A unique indie progression game. Collect resources, complete quests, and level up. Expand the game world and visit locations like the forest, the arcade, or the market.

details.title: Deep Breach
details.short_description: Fight relentless alien swarms in a top-down action roguelike that blends intense shooting with tower defense. Customize weapons, assemble deadly turrets, unlock HELIOS technology, and push through enemy lines to destroy the alien core.

details.title: Horror Pipes
details.short_description: You are a disposable employee of PIPECORE. Descend into infinite, procedurally generated sewers to clear blockages and survive. Manage your flashlight, wield your shotgun, and navigate claustrophobic tunnels where industrial filth meets horror. Clean the pipes or die trying.

details.title: Dead Man Waiting
details.short_description: Await your verdict in a luxury apartment that can execute you. Your behavior is judged. Survive long enough and you might be pardoned.

details.title: Ex Decreto
details.short_description: Ex Decreto puts you in the role of governor of a province recently conquered by Rome: Dalmatia, in the 1st century AD. Administer justice wisely to maintain peace and assert Roman rule! Be careful, however, not to make too many errors in judgment.

details.title: DJINN SCROLLS
details.short_description: Djinn Scrolls is an action roguelike set in a dark world inspired by ancient Jinn folklore. Wield elemental magic and Prime Scrolls that unleash spells through conditional triggers. Craft deadly synergies, adapt your build mid-run, and survive relentless enemies and cursed bosses.

details.title: Dinosaur Tree
details.short_description: Explore the ocean in your sailboat as a curious little dinosaur. Discover charming islands and meet friendly pals along the way. But beware! There may be something trying to tempt you off your path.

details.title: NOSBALL
details.short_description: Nosball is a fast-paced car drifting soccer game with demolition derby chaos. Smash rivals, master physics-based control, and score goals on dangerous pinball-style arenas set in global locations with dynamic weather.

details.title: FishingMaster: Catch Giants Together
details.short_description: Fishing Master: Catch Giants Together is a first-person fishing simulation focused on realistic float fishing. Cast your line, watch the float, set the hook, and fight powerful fish. Control your rod angle, manage line tension, and enjoy peaceful lakeside scenery between thrilling catches.

name: The Sound of the Conch in the Age of Declining Dharma: War of the Last Buddha's Relic

details.title: The Sound of the Conch in the Age of Declining Dharma: War of the Last Buddha's Relic
details.short_description: War erupted over the last Buddha Relic. In the land where Maitreya Bodhisattva is destined to descend and attain Buddhahood, Gesang lost all memory in an air raid. Doubting salvation itself, Gesang met Udum—same fate, rare disease, yet utter faith. They became inseparable as cruel reality closed in—

details.title: EPOCH EXPRESS
details.short_description: A roguelite action game where you control a train, build and customize deadly wagons, and face enemies that evolve across eras by learning from how you play and how you die.

details.title: Indie City Mixtape 2026
details.short_description: The Indie City Mixtape features seven small games, all contained within a 3D Platformer launcher. Ranging from shaving llamas to horror narrative, there's something for everyone in this ABSOLUTE BARGAIN of a collection!

details.title: Ashes of Darkness
details.short_description: Ashes of Darkness is a 2D Soulslike Action RPG set in a dark medieval world. Master fast-paced combat, defeat powerful enemies, collect rare artifacts, and forge your own build as you grow stronger and challenge deadly bosses.

name: Gangsta Bean 3: Night of the Rising Bread

details.title: Gangsta Bean 3: Night of the Rising Bread
details.short_description: Gangsta Bean, Krazy Karrot, T-Mato, and Brock Lee gang up to fight hordes of reanimated rotten food zombies in this retro arcade-style twin-stick beat 'em up sequel to the classic Flash games.

details.title: Derby Life: Ranch & Race
details.short_description: Derby Life: Ranch & Race is where great racehorses are made, not born. Breed, raise, and train your own on a living open-world ranch, then saddle up and race the World Tour. Roam, fish, explore, compete. Your ranch, your horse, your glory.

details.title: Dinonid
details.short_description: Dinonid tells the story of two dinosaurs in love who want nothing more than to be together. But mountains of freshly laid eggs block their path. Help these two lonely souls and clear a path for them through the landscape of eggs!

name: Chronicle Island: The War of Dinosaurs

details.title: Chronicle Island: The War of Dinosaurs
details.short_description: This is a light roguelite PvP deckbuilder. Play as distinct characters, unleash unique abilities, and battle rivals across the island to seize powerful dinosaurs. With each species possessing its own diet, traits, and skills, assembling the ultimate dino squad is your key to victory.

details.title: Peekaboom
details.short_description: A chaotic multiplayer battle royale where standing still makes you invisible. Hide, ambush and outsmart your enemies to become the last one standing!

details.title: Dominos
details.short_description: Dominos is the classic tile game reimagined with multiple modes, tactical depth, and stylish customization. Play solo or with friends, battle players online, climb the ranks, unlock cosmetics, and make the experience your own.

details.title: Jade Simulator
details.short_description: This is a hardcore jade processing simulator. Players inspect raw stones for color and cracks, then operate machinery to cut and polish them. Learn to distinguish natural jade from fakes while upgrading equipment. Experience the full journey from a rough rock to a translucent masterpiece.

details.title: Infinity Arena
details.short_description: Create and customize your hero in Infinity Arena. Combine skills, items, and upgrades to craft unique strategies and conquer the final arena. Get ready for the ultimate battle!

details.title: Alive Hunter 2 Mugen hunt
details.short_description: Alive Hunter 2 is a third person shooter, open world game with cinematic narrative, it's a direct sequel of Alive Hunter (2019) Alive Hunter 2 is a climax from beginning to the end, designed to impact and delivery the most epic journey ever. Do not fear the hunt, be a part of it.

details.title: Pogo Froggo
details.short_description: Two frogs, one bar, zero coordination. Bounce up the mountain before your tank breaks... and before you blame each other.

details.title: Tower.defense(): Program The Fight
details.short_description: Program three distinct towers with readable visual logic, then solve handcrafted tower-defense puzzles where placement, line of sight and every code block matter. No programming experience required.

details.title: ULTRA
details.short_description: The Ascendancy inherited the Earth, and gave humanity the ULTRA. Humanity gave you in return: a Runner. Navigate the trails of the Evergrowth with quick feet, rhythm, grappling hooks, ice bombs, and forgotten tech. Race with friends or alone to save humanity.

details.title: The Rule of Adult
details.short_description: Unable to find work, you unwittingly join ruthless HarborTech. A strange contract traps your soul. Manage time and resources, meet KPIs and fight turn-based battles to reclaim your soul and quit within 10 weeks. Uncover its secrets in this workplace psychological horror RPG.

details.title: To The Deep
details.short_description: Dive into a surreal deep sea dream. Survive by devouring and evolving, and encounter a cast of strange, mysterious companions. Explore, upgrade, and uncover the "truth" hidden beneath the beautiful waves. This is more than an adventure—it is a dimension-breaking dive to the deep.

details.title: Incremental Mass Rewritten
details.short_description: Watch your mass skyrocket! Incremental Mass Rewritten lets you upgrade, prestige, and unlock cosmic layers of growth. From tiny beginnings to multiverse-scale numbers, it's perfect for anyone who loves exponential progression and optimizing every step of the journey.

details.title: WannaRich
details.short_description: WannaRich is a 2D farming, management, and adventure game. Start with nothing, grow crops, craft tools, battle monsters, and build your fortune. Play solo or with friends, and turn a wild island into your own empire. Can you earn your first 1,000,000 gold?

details.title: Auriga
details.short_description: In 1988 the rover AURIGA found something on Mars, and the program buried it. 350 years later, it wakes. Drive a slow, physical rover across procedurally generated worlds: drill, scan, map caves with lidar and outlast radiation, storms and crushing air, from green-phosphor Mars to distant stars.

details.title: On Paper
details.short_description: Dig through mountains of shredded paper in this cute detective puzzle adventure. Sort scraps with Fedo Chan, snap documents together, uncover ridiculous evidence, and upgrade your tools to expose a shady cat businessman. Some secrets are only obvious On Paper.

details.title: My Nail Salon
details.short_description: Create cute manicures in a colourful nail-art salon. Paint and layer polish, blend ombré, shape magnetic shimmer, and add stickers, charms and rings. Experiment in Free Play or recreate your customers’ inspiration photos in Open Store.

details.title: ICE TO MEET YOU
details.short_description: Prepare your courtyard, build snow defenses, and survive a chaotic New Year's Eve snow war! Gather snow, craft snowballs, complete ridiculous errands, and fight off rival neighborhoods solo or with friends.

details.title: Mana League
details.short_description: Fast 7v7 fantasy football with dwarves, orcs, goblins and a lot more. Curl it, chip it or fire a Zigzag Bolt past the keeper. Cast Team Spells, dodge mine carts and play with up to 4 friends on couch co-op or online.

details.title: Brackets & Banners
details.short_description: Build your college basketball legacy. Recruit players, shape your roster, and chase tournament runs in a fictional coaching career sim. Make the calls yourself or delegate to your staff as each season adds new players, stories, and banners to your program's history.

details.title: 人生档案：千禧
details.short_description: Return to 2000 with your memories of the future. In this business-life sandbox spanning 2000–2025, act on your knowledge of the era: invest, start a company or negotiate a stake in someone else’s. Then decide what that money is for. A bigger business? A different life?

details.title: Hairpin Legends
details.short_description: Hairpin Legends is a tabletop slot racing game where every millimetre matters. Master one-button driving, stay in the slot, push your car to the limit, race across varied circuits, build your own tracks, compete in tournaments, and challenge friends online.

details.title: BombCase
details.short_description: Two agents. One table. A row of briefcases - and one of them is a bomb. Listen, scan, bluff and sabotage your way through a 24-mission Cold War campaign of turn-based deduction, then take the seat against a real opponent online. Open the wrong case and it's over.

details.title: Coral Pastoral
details.short_description: This is a desktop companion game set in the ocean, featuring small fish and sea deities from various civilizations. It combines idle gameplay with light card and incremental mechanics. Use coral skills to create your own beautiful underwater world. By the way, the ocean deities will protect you!

details.title: Last Ward
details.short_description: A top-down horde survivor. Choose from nine classes, push out of the Ward into corrupted wilds, borrow attacks from other classes, then return to the Refuge to rebuild your gear and talents.

details.title: Tactical Terry
details.short_description: Terry has a crime problem. Six ridiculous crews have taken over town, and Terry P.D. has a rookie, a coffee machine and a budget the council keeps cutting. Breach, clear and cuff your way through a 1–4 player co-op tactical shooter that takes the shooting seriously and nothing else.

details.title: Jane Doe: Cold Case Division
details.short_description: An asymmetric co-op deduction game where you solve cold cases through communication. One player investigates, while the other plays the forensic artist reconstructing the victim's face. Features lite roguelite progression.

details.title: Desktop Xianxia
details.short_description: Desktop Xianxia is a cozy desktop companion that blends idle cultivation with farming. Set a goal and let your cultivator handle daily routines while you work or unwind. Grow your homestead, brew elixirs, craft gear, and explore new challenges at your own pace.

details.title: Five Card Evolution
details.short_description: A poker roguelike deckbuilder where you construct wild combos, risk it all, and climb an endless tower of fortune.

details.title: Googlick
details.short_description: Retro arcade shoot em' up puzzler where you blast bricks, steal their color energy, and eradicate the color matching seeds nodes before the robotic army can grow! An authentic recreation of the golden age of arcade gaming with a custom built CRT cabinet experience! Come blasts some bricks!

details.title: Towa Powa
details.short_description: Stack towers, make your own rules, and bring everyone into the same game — local and online. Take on a co-op campaign, create new modes, exploit unbalanced mechanics, share your creations through the Workshop, and relive your most epic matches.

details.title: Samt
details.short_description: Samt is a 2-player online co-op stealth game. Silence keeps you alive. Real voice, footsteps, and movement are heard by hunting AI drones in a dead, neon-lit mega-city. Stay quiet. Survive together, or evaporate trying. This game requires a co-op partner: no solo play.

name: 絶望ショッピング ZETSUBO SHOPPING

details.title: 絶望ショッピング ZETSUBO SHOPPING
details.short_description: You wake in a room with no windows and no doors. Your only link to the outside is a shopping site: ZETSUBO．com. A small allowance arrives each day. You buy water. You buy food. The contract runs thirty days. Today's listings: drinking water, cheap rations, a stick of incense, and...

details.title: Valdrys
details.short_description: An isometric MMORPG you buy once. No subscription, one live server for everyone. Five classes, ten specialisations, keyed dungeons for one to five, world bosses, a ranked team arena, and the Bloodgrounds, the one zone where dying costs you everything you carried.

details.title: Esports  Career Simulator 2027
details.short_description: A deep esports career simulator: from a day job and training at your PC to tournaments, transfers, sponsors and the title of world champion. Choose your discipline, level up your skills, make tough decisions and build your own team.

details.title: King's Descent
details.short_description: Ten floors down, a hundred kinds of monster, magic, crossbows, and a king who never came back. A turn-based, party-based dungeon crawler in the 8-bit style: name up to four adventurers, then fight, bribe, loot and level your way down. Every descent is new. A party that dies stays dead.

details.title: CIV Watchers
details.short_description: Guide evolving civilizations across the ages on a living 3D globe, compete for influence on a changing political world. Easily manage complex systems directly on the map with the FlowLines™ visual interface and release your tactical genius in grand battles using WarLog™ battle marks & log system.

details.title: Creators of War
details.short_description: Creators of War is a medieval sandbox strategy game with an open-world campaign and real-time battles of up to 400 vs 400. Command squads, build or serve a kingdom, trade, besiege castles, and shape a world at war.

details.title: Phase War
details.short_description: Phase War is a tactical card strategy game spanning WWI to the near future. Collect and craft 130+ unit cards, deploy your mechs, and watch auto-battles unfold in real time — position formations, load mods and auras, enjoy the show. 100-mission campaign, base building, intel crafting, idle income.

details.title: That Corridor in the Backrooms
details.short_description: Descend into the Backrooms. Walk through an infinite yellow corridor. Inspect the doors and try to find a way out.

details.title: Ping & Prowl
details.short_description: Map the darkness, revealed only by movement. Play as a Ping searching for an escape or a Prowl hunting by echoes and footsteps in this asymmetric game of stealth, pursuit, and quick decisions.

details.title: Turing's Hive
details.short_description: A programming puzzle game where you build computation from simple rules. Route numbers through a honeycomb grid, solve puzzles to create new computational building blocks, and work your way from +1 to arithmetic, algorithms, and beyond.

details.title: 挂机魔女：星夜
details.short_description: 《挂机魔女：星夜》是一款融合桌面宠物、挂机探索、事件系统、合成制造与自动战斗的魔法养成游戏。配置技能链、研究科技、打造装备、获得伙伴，探索由骰子驱动的多重世界与事件。

details.title: Vessel
details.short_description: Search for your missing brother in VESSEL, a first-person UFO abduction horror game. Explore an isolated hospital and surrounding woods, examine objects left behind, and follow his trail beneath strange lights and an unexplained presence.

details.title: Burrito Aftermath
details.short_description: Make burritos fast, beat the clock, and throw your creations into the hole before the bomb goes off. Burrito Aftermath is a chaotic first-person arcade cooking game about speed, high scores, unlocks, with questionable concerns for work place safety

details.title: UNDERKOVER
details.short_description: Hide-and-paint party game for 2–8 friends in a meme-Soviet apartment block. Paint yourself into carpets and wallpaper, freeze, and survive the NKVD officer, his dog in a hat, the blackout — and your own friends, who can snitch on you any second.

details.title: OTAKUS VS NINJAS CD 1
details.short_description: Otakus to Japan! The Work Ninja Clan has seized power and banned leisure. Get ready to save Manga, Anime and Videogames! This game is a narrative, rock-driven beat-'em-up. Follow the story of Alex(Mexico), Michael (USA) and Cristina (Argentina), put your heardphones on and enjoy the travel :)

details.title: THANK YOU FOR YOUR TAXES
details.short_description: A satirical incremental game where your mouse is the tax ring. Anyone inside it pays. Invent absurd taxes, chase fleeing billionaires and get re-elected. Then tax penguins, microbes, aliens and ghosts. They will thank you.

name: Threads & Things: Tidy Up the Craft Shop!

details.title: Threads & Things: Tidy Up the Craft Shop!
details.short_description: Threads & Things is a cozy organizing simulator where you return over 4000 scattered craft supplies to their proper places in a cluttered craft store. Sort yarn, fabrics, threads, buttons, embroidery hoops and more, learn abilities and turn the chaos into a beautifully organized craft store.

details.title: EGO DESCENT
details.short_description: A 3D action RPG about a machine built to fight, descending a hundred floors underground. Take the weapons and parts your enemies wore, rebuild your head, body, arms and legs, and get past the GUARDIAN of each sector to see what lies behind your orders. Online co-op. 10 languages.

details.title: FPS ABILITY TEST
details.short_description: Shoot, throw, type, hide, close pop-ups. A ten-question exam where “FPS” means something new every time: sniping, grenade lineups, unarmed battle royale, forced-perspective puzzles. Your score decides what comes after. Finish the exam to unlock the Retake, a one-life roguelike 30 floors deep.

details.title: Meltwork
details.short_description: Melt a snow-buried world with fire, rescue villagers trapped in ice, and build a village where spirits mine and fairies haul for you.

details.title: Christmasing Around
details.short_description: 2-8 players running around as elves to help Santa delivery gifts while getting their hands dirty. Repair reindeers, decorate sleigh, face pirates... and form a music band while everything is on fire. Hey! Christmasing Around!!!

name: 要下海吗？（Could you be my onlyfans?）

details.title: 要下海吗？（Could you be my onlyfans?）
details.short_description: As a former corporate drone who received a severance package, you happened to make 30 million in one fell swoop through FX—and then stumbled upon a new streamer named Asuka. Faced with an invitation from this inexperienced but enthusiastic streamer, what will you choose?

details.title: Secret Daifugo
details.short_description: An online-compatible President where "secret effects" hidden in the cards decide victory or defeat. Each player chooses two effects and assigns them to a card number that only they know. Deduce the effects set by the other players and gain the advantage in the game.

details.title: Sloppy Warfare
details.short_description: A loud, dumb, fast shooter. Troops raid an island full of shady old billionaires, blow up their temple and haul them to a prison boat in their bathrobes. Buy your guns, buy your strikes, call in a pufferfish. The lead mode is Capture the Pedo. Fictional rich guys, all adults, all satire.

details.title: Vanguard Armada
details.short_description: Vanguard Armada is a turn-based starship fleet based tactics game. Build and customize a fleet of frigates, carriers, and battleships. Fight solo or co-op with up to three other players, earn persistent unlocks, and find allies in the multiplayer lobby.

details.title: Ravel: Golden Thread
details.short_description: A Viking puzzle saga about untangling. Read the weave, pull only what lies on top and free the living Golden Thread across eight Norse worlds and 200+ handcrafted levels, with a Mastery Knot to close every chapter and 3 Daily Knots every day.

details.title: Sanctuary
details.short_description: Find salvation within the overgrown depths of the forgotten in Sanctuary, an atmospheric 2.5D adventure. Uncover lost secrets, overcome the dark and seek out a moment of respite amongst the thorns as you fight to carve out a place of peace in a world caught between ruin and rebirth.

details.title: Resonance Shift
details.short_description: Resonance Shift is a pixel-art action roguelite that blends survivors-like combat with strategic party management. Use the tag system to switch between party members, chain their skills to create powerful synergies, and choose the right upgrade cards to defeat relentless waves of enemies!

details.title: Leather Atelier
details.short_description: Cut, hand-stitch, dye and stamp wallets and bags from a single hide in a cozy leather-crafting sim. Design your own patterns, then photograph, sell or repair every piece.

details.title: Holdover – Long Range Sniper Simulator
details.short_description: A long-range shooting sim built on real exterior ballistics. You read the wind and wait for the lull between two gusts. After the shot, you see the trajectory in 3D and where the wind carried the bullet. Targets are steel plates and ring targets. No combat, no blood.

details.title: Gatefall
details.short_description: The tiniest hop can become a mighty leap. Charge your bounce, outsmart each world, and roll through the gate. Don't look down. (Look down.)

details.title: Survivors' Hotel
details.short_description: Survivors' Hotel is a zombie apocalypse themed social deduction game inspired by Among us that uses 3D and 2D art that can host a minimum of 6 players. It also has multiple horror elements and possibly a story for those who care to look.

details.title: Sort of the Apocalypse
details.short_description: The world ended. The mess didn’t. Sort over 10,000 scavenged supplies in a cozy first-person organizing game. Transform a cluttered bunker into satisfyingly stocked shelves, earn credits, and unlock upgrades to tackle the mountain of mess.

details.title: Fish Fish Pop
details.short_description: A slow, cozy match-three under the sea. Swap, pop, and pick a new card every round. Thirty rounds, no timer, and you can't lose. The only question is how few moves you need. Oh, and the sea has secrets.

details.title: Finders and Keepers
details.short_description: Explore a living world at war, larger than the UK, with diverse fantasy nations, dungeons, conquerable outer realms and armies on the march. Create custom sword and sorcery defined by your orbits around the stars. An MMO easy to hop into as there is always something unique for you to find and keep.

details.title: Why Does the Ball Fall?
details.short_description: An idle and clicker game about dropping balls, over and over. Hit a goal hole and the ball rolls one lane deeper; miss and it is gone. Spend coins to seal holes, widen the goals and unlock fruit and animal balls, then keep descending lanes that go on forever.

details.title: 「認識」/RECOGNIZED
details.short_description: An analog-horror soulslike where you fight infamous internet emoji memes. When the smiling windmill stops spinning and every finger points at you, run. Swing an umbrella, throw empty cans, and survive one night recorded on a 2011 tape.

details.title: DUELANDS
details.short_description: The first-person 'psychological' Western shooter for 1-5 players. Duel everything. Eat your friends. Become the most potent Duelist in the land.

details.title: Wolves Of Ash
details.short_description: Combine cards to turn the tide of battle. Lead three mercenaries into their next fight.

details.title: Midnight Scoop
details.short_description: Two clowns, one ice-cream truck and a specter on your tail. Drive, fire and swap seats through elevated streets and rooftop leaps. Search for supplies on foot, then get both clowns aboard before dawn.

details.title: Wildhearth
details.short_description: Wildhearth is a Norse medieval-fantasy open world MMORPG. You wake as a stranger on a cold northern island. The town gives you an anthro wife to share it with. Hunt bosses at her side, or build a home and farm. Your skills rise as you use them. You choose how to live.

details.title: 修仙：我有一个按钮
