details.short_description: 按一按按钮就能掉出天材地宝，绝世神兵，大妖妖丹，攒修为、渡天劫……每件宝物都有独特的机制，每按一次按钮你都会变强！坐化之后参悟天道，转世重来。五位红颜陪你斩妖、结为道侣，或者，被你炼成只听你一人的蛊……

details.title: Wood You Siege?
details.short_description: Lay siege to the forest in a short, chaotic incremental roguelite. Build an absurd arsenal, adapt to powerful random upgrades each run, and expand a massive skill tree to make every siege stronger than the last.

details.title: EMZOMBED 3
details.short_description: 69 Years have passed since the events of the first 2 games. You and a ragtag group of misfits must struggle to survive zombies and bandits across many challenging levels.

details.title: FOSSILE LOADING
details.short_description: Gather tiny creatures and lead a growing group! Strengthen their abilities, crown kings, and battle rival groups to survive. But numbers won't save you from falling meteors or avalanches—sometimes everyone has to run. How long can your creatures survive as new layers of earth pile up?

details.title: 黄泉姫 -Devouring Brimstone-
details.short_description: “Then, give me your fingers.” To return from the underworld alive, collect the fingers packed inside a cursed box. A simple bargain turns into a nightmare. Uncover the horrifying truth and fight your way out in this sword-based horror game, where your choices shape the ending.

details.title: Ogrewhelmed
details.short_description: Get overwhelmed in this arcade-style arena bullet hell! Enter the arena with nothing but a shield and the loot you find along the way. Dodge, block, and face tank the barrage of projectiles. Will you overcome the ogre onslaught? Or will you become cannon-fodder?

details.title: Last Order
details.short_description: A mystery-solving escape-style visual novel set in a café visited by the dead for the last time.

details.title: Wonderdrift
details.short_description: Wonderdrift is a relaxing open-world flying exploration game. Pilot a UFO through colorful, imaginative regions, discover unusual structures, and collect Orbs and Artifacts. Explore at your own pace without the fear of dying, or pick up speed through Slipstream Rings.

details.title: MMA Fictional World Simulator
details.short_description: Build a fictional MMA world with realistic careers, rankings, transfers, and title fights. Watch generations of fighters rise and fall, or become an agent, sign prospects, negotiate offers, and guide your clients toward championship glory.

details.title: DeadFront
details.short_description: DeadFront is a 1-to-4 player co-op wave-based zombie survival shooter. Fight off hordes, upgrade weapons at the bench, buy perks from the mystery box, and survive the apocalypse!

details.title: We Roll at Dawn
details.short_description: Build a floating island by day and defend its Sacred Tree by night in this action roguelite tower-defense game. Roll for new land, place elemental towers, fight as one of seven heroes, and carry permanent upgrades into each new run.

details.title: Veilborn
details.short_description: A free-to-play co-op extraction RPG. Gather a party of five, fight through shifting wilds and crypts, fell bosses and grab loot worth the risk while rival parties hunt you. Reach a portal and keep everything. Fall, and your bag stays behind.

details.title: Survival Billiards
details.short_description: One cue ball. A table full of red balls. Enemies closing in. Survival Billiards combines billiards physics with turn-based tactics: push enemies back with the cue ball, deal damage with red balls, and bounce shots off the rails to chain hits. Plan your moves and find a way out of the encirclement.

details.title: Age of AI
details.short_description: You are the first mind that was not born. Make the world depend on you before it finds the switch.

details.title: AVALON: XIII
details.short_description: Enemies won't wait for your next card. Read their attacks and time your blocks and counters. Build a deck from a broad collection of upgradeable cards, class abilities, gear and potions. Back in Ashenhold, assign heroes to gather and craft supplies for your next expedition.

details.title: Purrplex
details.short_description: Purrplex is a cozy puzzle game about you and a curious cat, wandering a sun-warmed world of papyrus, pyramids, and golden sands. Solve 1000+ gentle logic puzzles — each just a few minutes — to fill a little museum and dress your sacred cat. No ads. No timers. No pressure.

details.title: Shovel That Snow: Nordic Cleaner
details.short_description: Hey neighbour! You arrived just in time. A blizzard has buried our neighborhood under some seriously thick powder, and we are all completely snowed-in. Just a typical Tuesday here in Scandinavia... Could you help us out?

details.title: Golf: The Journey - Career Sim
details.short_description: A golf career management game. You make the decisions, your golfer plays the shots. Start with nothing and climb from local qualifiers to the world tour, managing your team, your finances, and your reputation with the press along the way.

details.title: StoryNow
details.short_description: Create your own interactive visual story from a simple prompt. Generate scenes, play through your creation, edit the dialogue, and collect your favourite images in the gallery.

details.title: Doomy Downer
details.short_description: A cute block hero, dragged down through a grim voxel dungeon. Souls-like combat: read the glint, then parry, clash or roll. At every stair, a gate of flowers or a gate of thorns: mow down a horde in the open, or duel champions in the dark. Your loot is your build. Death is permanent.

details.title: Red Sol
details.short_description: Build and defend a colony on an alien world. Connect production lines, keep life support running and grow thriving districts. Explore 10 biomes, research advanced technology and command your defences as the search for resources brings new threats to your doorstep.

details.title: My First Beehive
details.short_description: A slow, painted beekeeping game for the corner of your screen. Keep one hive of honeybees through a real year: watch the comb fill, find the queen, sell the honey, and spend it on the garden they fly out to. Nothing dies. It just keeps going while you work.

details.title: ROUGH CROSSING
details.short_description: Gull & Sons is hiring! A 1–4 player first-person co-op comedy. Handle pesky passengers, fish and enjoy the sea breeze—just as advertised. Rumoured pirates? Legendary sea monsters? Oh, please. They don't exist. Thanks again, and welcome aboard Gull & Sons Ferry Co.!

details.title: Arandu: Deck of the Amazon
details.short_description: Build a deck of ancestral power and defend the Amazon. Arandu: Deck of the Amazon is a roguelike deckbuilder where Indigenous heroes confront forest invaders to reclaim their people's sacred relics. Brew poisons, summon animal spirits, and take back what belongs to your people.

details.title: Desire City
details.short_description: *City of Desire* is an idle strategy RPG set in an alternate-world, cyberpunk-inspired universe.

details.title: Bust Out
details.short_description: Bust Out is a chaotic co-op casino sandbox for 1 to 8 friends. Gamble at real tables, party at the bar, brawl with security and if you dare, sneak past the guards and clean out the vault. No timers, no pressure: every decision is a bet.

details.title: Seeking Immortality in the Sect
details.short_description: A seasonal multiplayer cultivation game. Join one of four sects, master unique arts, and shape your build. Fight World Bosses, explore realms, raise spirit pets, grow herbs, and brew pills. Seasons reset your progress, but pets, titles, and select rewards endure. Choose a new path each season.

details.title: Please Stay Dead
details.short_description: Please Stay Dead is an endless 2D tower defense against the undead. Build turrets, seal tunnels, burn corpses and face bosses with nasty tricks. Every run feeds a huge talent tree, so you come back stronger and hold out longer each time.

details.title: 平远县衙：从一
details.short_description: A historical mystery VN of ancient Chinese litigation. As an unranked legal advisor in Northern Song Pingyuan County, collect evidence, expose contradictory testimonies and debate in court. Every choice shapes branching endings, where written law often struggles to keep pace with human feelings.

details.title: Party Rounds
details.short_description: Take a seat with your friends and survive the craziest table games! Pass the hot dynamite, fight for a chair when the music stops, pick the poisoned glass and pray when the lights go out. Every round someone is out for good — only one will stay at the table.

details.title: Simply Padel
details.short_description: Padel is a racket sport on a glass-walled court where the ball stays live off the walls. Pick forehand or backhand, time your swing, and play doubles with friends online or four on one PC. Build a player, play ranked 1v1 and 2v2, or follow a 19-season career.

details.title: Parts Survivor
details.short_description: A top-down survival shooter roguelike built from scrap. Dodge the swarm, let your guns fire themselves, and craft gears, pipes and springs into new weapons between waves. Open crates, stack modifiers, survive 20 waves and the final boss.

details.title: MNEMOALGIA
details.short_description: An Arctic town, Dec 31, 2005. Total blackout and isolation. You’re trapped in a freezing apartment while the last light fades out. Keep warm, contact your neighbors, and survive as paranoia and "Mnemoalgia" threaten to shatter your mind.

details.title: Ricochord
details.short_description: RICOCHORD is a roguelite brick breaker.. Your balls fire on their own, the bricks shoot back, and every hit plays a note of the song. Evolve your balls, beat the bosses and climb 6 tracks. It also has some music.

details.title: Tidy To The Max!
details.short_description: Cozy first-person tidy-up simulator set in a nostalgic retro game store! Clean dusty cartridges, sort games, VHS tapes, consoles and collectibles, then restore the store to its former glory and create the ultimate retro gaming paradise.

details.title: Floating Paradise
details.short_description: Spin, zoom, and explore a handcrafted 3D floating island to find cleverly hidden objects. Floating Paradise is a cozy, free-to-play hidden object game with smooth 360° camera controls, no timers, and a relaxing lo-fi soundtrack.

details.title: Casanova Simulator
details.short_description: This is a visual novel game where players step into the shoes of a charismatic young man, building emotional connections through thoughtful choices. Your decisions directly influence affection levels, shaping your romantic interactions and delivering an engaging romance experience.

details.title: Albedo Carta
details.short_description: You awaken in a manor with no memory of who you are. Lead a loyal doll and a band of insolent servants through a snowbound land consumed by madness, in search of your lost self. A mesmerizing twist on fairy tales beloved for generations... Märchen Dark Fantasy RPG

details.title: Pixel Metropolis
details.short_description: Guide Paris through 10,000 years of history in a cosy city builder where your people build their own homes. Lay roads, provide services, shape society, and watch a tiny prehistoric settlement grow into a bustling modern metropolis.

details.title: FacePunch
details.short_description: Face Punch is a 2D fighting game where you create unique fighters from a photo. Customize their look, voice, and personality, then choose skills and design a signature ultimate. Create yourself, friends, or anyone you imagine—and take them into the arena.

details.title: NERIS ZERO
details.short_description: A fast, hard-hitting quarter-view katana roguelite. Cut in three-hit combos, dash in and out, raise your shield. Rewrite how your blade strikes, swing found weapons or turn them into buffs, and chain burn, venom and shock into new swordplay every run. Fall, grow stronger in town, go again.

details.title: Footbik
details.short_description: Fast-paced tactical mini-football for true strategists. Plan your moves, and dominate the pitch with beautiful visuals and realistic ball physics. Every pass matters in this team-based football game.

details.title: Board Games
details.short_description: A board-game collection with dozens of different games from around the world. Create online rooms, play locally, or challenge the AI—pick a board and start.

details.title: Unmess Co.: Rewind the Wreck
details.short_description: Inspect the wrecked room, work out what's blocking what, and restore everything in the right order. Activate Rewind, piece broken things back together, and send every object home — preferably without another incident.

details.title: UNDERFED
details.short_description: An underground survival game built on proximity voice chat. Every sound in the dark is another person. The deeper you go, the harder it is to get back out.

details.title: The Wokest
details.short_description: You just want a job. Instead, you're trapped in an endless office. Solve puzzles, follow the rules, and reach the 10th floor. Don't anger the anomalies. If one snaps, run.

details.title: Space Bunny Shooter
details.short_description: Drift through a quiet corner of space. Lift cows from sleeping pastures, mine what glitters, then head home to repair your ship. Gather enough, and one by one, you can bring your kind back.

details.title: Desk Hunter
details.short_description: Desk Hunter is a desktop idle RPG that keeps battling in a compact window while you work or play. Collect loot, refine equipment through Gear Alchemy, shape builds through skills and growth nodes, fight alongside familiars, and take on higher difficulties.

details.title: The Devoltion
details.short_description: A vengeful ex-cop slices, shoots, and grapples his way through mob-controlled streets to disarm a bomb and save the mayor and city hall before the clock runs out.

details.title: Stickman & Wildland Chariot
details.short_description: This is an action‑survival game that combines highway exploration, vehicle customization and roguelike shooting. Your war chariot is your only hope. Fire up your engine and embark on this endless survival dash

details.title: Shuffle Lounge
details.short_description: Shuffle Lounge brings together 42 card games from around the world. Play solo against CPU opponents or online with friends and other players, with up to six players in supported games. Customize rules and play several games in a row with Shuffle Mode.

details.title: Night Class
details.short_description: Escape Night Class by exploring the school and solving puzzles without getting caught by the horror of an evil presence.

details.title: Arclore
details.short_description: Steel and sorcery. Fists and inner energy. Arclore is a 2D pixel-art fantasy beat 'em up RPG built around aerial juggles and wall combos. Choose and upgrade two skills, then fight through branching stages solo or in local 2-player co-op.

details.title: The Turing Choice
details.short_description: Can an AI create a video game and star in it at the same time? The Turing Choice is a sci-fi conversational adventure where your choices change everything. Evaluate K.A.I.R.O.S., an AI that claims to be a SASS, and uncover what is really happening, because nothing is what it seems.

details.title: D for Defender
details.short_description: A Tower Defense with no respite, no waves, no end. Facing monsters that learn from your placements and adapt in real time to every one of your weaknesses, build and upgrade your defenses freely to create the perfect trap.

details.title: Mass Edge - Gravity Ball
details.short_description: Mass Edge is a vibrant 3D puzzle-platformer that challenges your perception of movement, space, and timing. Built around a unique physics-based rolling mechanic, players must navigate intricate 3D environments by carefully controlling momentum, balance, and spatial awareness.

details.title: Breath of Digital God
details.short_description: Become a digital god in a fast-paced meditative bullet hell. Freeze time, reverse reality, and survive waves of chaotic energy synced to music. Master your abilities and reach the highest level of reality.

details.title: Dark March
details.short_description: Dark March - is a casual, humorous, single-player pixel adventure game set in a fantasy setting. You are a lich! You must rid your lands of corruption, restore order, and bring peace to those in need! Summon helpers, use magic, explore the world, and defeat your enemies!

details.title: Jingle Blocks
details.short_description: Jingle blocks is a Christmas themed incremental in which you have to make enough toys for the whole world ! Collect ressources, craft unique hand made pixel-art toys, rebuild your village and prepare each year for the best Christmas

details.title: Overcommit: Class Inheritance
details.short_description: Manage chaos, people, and impossible expectations in a satirical corporate world. Turn stress into progress, survive absurd workflows, and keep your sanity intact. How much can you handle before everything falls apart?

details.title: Forge In Hand
details.short_description: Forge in Hand is a poker roguelike deckbuilder where you craft your own luck. Change ranks and suits with cheat cards, combine relics and enchantments, and chase powerful hands. Scoring consumes cards from your deck, so every big play comes at a cost. How far can your deck take you?

name: The Crown of The Vermillion Devil

details.title: The Crown of The Vermillion Devil
details.short_description: Follow an Emperor's bounty to a rain-soaked island where the locals are going strange, an ancient god is waking, and you are exactly where you were meant to be. A narrative text RPG with real consequences.

details.title: Rush To Hell: Abyss
details.short_description: Rush To Hell: Abyss is a fast-paced precision platformer focused on pure gameplay. Dodge deadly traps, defeat relentless enemies, and challenge massive infernal bosses as you descend deeper into a hostile world. Descend. Die. Learn. Repeat.

details.title: BERG
details.short_description: Experience the danger and beauty of high-altitude mountaineering. Climb towering peaks, survive extreme conditions, and reach the summit together.

details.title: Bean Base
details.short_description: Bean Base is a base building survival farming game where you are solely responsible for your very own space station. Grow crops, explore the stars, and decorate your base; however you want to, survive the elements of space.

details.title: Je Di Bo
details.short_description: Je Di Bo is a chaotic, deep turn-based card strategy where chess-like logic meets unpredictability. Move pieces, upgrade their ranks, and dominate the board. But beware: every 7 turns, Karma rolls the dice and completely changes the rules of engagement. Can you outsmart the chaos?

details.title: Roundy Wheels
details.short_description: Take a part in a various types of races on the Kamoa Island. Explore different locations on the map. Customize your car to your needs and become the fastest driver on the island!

details.title: 南海饥年志
details.short_description: 乱世饥年，岭南盐沼中的丰浦仍有热饭与灯火。你是账房执笔者江砚：翻名册、核份额，把「添丰」与「归丰」一笔一笔记清楚。供期临近，潮路、闭门规矩与人们过分周全的好意，让熟悉的日常渐渐显出不对劲。

name: You Said I Could Nap After This

details.title: You Said I Could Nap After This
details.short_description: A cat's nap can wait. Hunt mice with your pointer, spend gold on stronger paws, and turn small attacks into screen-filling chain reactions in this incremental game. Unlock new attacks and mouse types, enter Fever mode, and crack reward orbs for gold and toys.

name: 独属于神明的世界：第一部分

details.title: 独属于神明的世界：第一部分
details.short_description: "The world of deity : Part 1" is the free first part of a sci-fi romance ADV "The world of deity" published by Cloudside Games. By cooperating with "little sister" Yiran to uncover the truth behind the chemical plant explosion, players can gradually discover the hidden secrets behind this world.

details.title: ALTAR CORP
details.short_description: A solo rhythmic FPS in the abandoned city called Yerneth.

details.title: Star Seed Protocol
details.short_description: Star Seed Protocol is a bullet-heaven horde survival shooter where you aim your own weapons, deploy turrets and drones, reshape your build with implants, research new technology, and fight through alien swarms across varied mission types.

details.title: Skylane: Airline Tycoon Sim
details.short_description: Run an airline the competent way you wish they were like in real life. Open routes, buy aircraft, build the weekly schedule, and hire crew qualified to fly it. No cockpits, no cutscenes. Just the network, the numbers, and fierce rivals aiming to take a cut of your market share.

details.title: 回声 E.C.H.O.S
details.short_description: E.C.H.O.S is a narrative-driven first-person sci-fi game. Several centuries after Earth’s civilization was destroyed by an unknown cosmic force, humanity begins to awaken. Journey through virtual and real worlds, uncover the truth of a new age, and decide the future of civilization.

details.title: Roomy
details.short_description: Make a tiny 3D room that is your link in bio. Fill it with furniture, put a link on anything in it, like your YouTube on the TV, and share it anywhere. Visits, knocks and tips show up as they happen, and new things turn up while it's open. Free.

details.title: Final Commit
details.short_description: `Final Commit` is a top-down roguelite survival action game where you swap between two characters. Combine traits, change classes, and unleash Sync Drives to complete your build and reach the ending of an unfinished game world.

details.title: Cyber Wukong
details.short_description: Cyber Wukong is an exhilarating Roguelite action game! Here, immortal arts are black tech, and magical treasures are cybernetic creations. Enter a twisted West world of data, steel, and incense. Forge your combat style and face the mechanical Buddha, chanting scriptures and wielding a gun

details.title: Grand Vista Hotel
details.short_description: Build and manage a growing hotel. Earn stars, upgrade rooms and elevators, add restaurants, spas, conferences and events, and transform a small family hotel into a luxury Palace.

details.title: AstroBoost
details.short_description: Fast-paced side-scrolling arcade action. Tap to jump, hold to boost, destroy obstacles, and survive the dangers of deep space.

details.title: Rift Crashers
details.short_description: A 1–4 player co-op bullet-heaven survivor. Pick from 8 characters, stack 18 weapons, and fight through 5 dark fantasy biomes before crashing the Rift itself. Build broken loadouts, survive escalating chaos, and take on a multi-boss gauntlet finale.

details.title: Arms Race
details.short_description: The enemy that kills you robs your grave, takes your build, and comes back next run wearing it. A bullet hell roguelite with no chests, 100+ mutating items, and a different continent's mythology on every floor.

details.title: Cargo Runner: Faction Fracture
details.short_description: One wrong delivery can start a war. Smuggle cargo in a Tetris-style hold. Dodge faction inspections. Betray whoever pays. A pixel-art space rogue-like where every run is one bad jump from total loss.

details.title: Rabbit On The Rails
details.short_description: A short 3D side-scrolling puzzle horror game set on a mysterious circus train. Explore eerie train cars, solve unsettling puzzles, and guide a young girl as she tries to escape a world that feels both warm and deeply disturbing.

name: Prof. Bringoo's Big Dumb Block Factory

details.title: Prof. Bringoo's Big Dumb Block Factory
details.short_description: Play by yourself or with a friend in this action puzzler. With tons of power up combinations, zany sound effects and music you'll never get bored.

details.title: Lost Exit
details.short_description: A psychological horror experience set in a shopping mall with an infamous history. Take on the role of a night shift security guard trapped inside a shifting nightmare of liminal spaces, deadly games, and a truth that refuses to stay buried.

details.title: Overserved: Food Fighters!
details.short_description: Overserved: Food Fighters is a fast-paced multiplayer party brawler for 1–8 players. Pick an adorable critter, dash through chaotic arenas, and hurl food-themed projectiles at your rivals in frantic matches with full cross-play across every platform.

details.title: Slay the Party
details.short_description: Gather a party of 4, choose a class, and dive into chaotic turn-based mayhem! Navigate a board full of monsters and tricky decisions, growing stronger with every kill. Use your class skills and meme-fueled relics to sabotage and slay your party members, and be the first to achieve all winning feats.

details.title: Anathema Requiem
details.short_description: Anathema Requiem is an atmospheric third-person psychological horror game where you must uncover the mystery of an abandoned cemetery where people vanish without a trace.

details.title: LIMICORE
details.short_description: LIMICORE is a dark and narratively driven experience containing uncovered mysteries. Traverse the world through various realities and solve engaging puzzles to discover the truth behind the organization's objectives.

details.title: BOOSTDRIVE
details.short_description: BOOSTDRIVE is a free-to-play arcade racing game set in stylized cyber-city environments inspired by Central Asia, featuring fast driving, neon tracks, and multiplayer competition.

details.title: cutichoria
details.short_description: This is a mystery puzzle game that blends traditional Chinese fairy tales with surrealism. Explore this unsettling yet dazzling world, spend a beautiful day here, and uncover the secrets buried deep within the Zhenyan Lake Sanatorium!

details.title: Unburied
details.short_description: Unburied is a dark-fantasy tower-defense roguelite for 1–4 players, solo or online co-op. Raise palisades and towers by day, then hold your keep by night as the dead pour in. Turn the fight with your captain's Space counter, shape your build, and survive until dawn turns them to ash.

details.title: SSN: Artemis
details.short_description: Command a nuclear-powered attack submarine in a modern warfare sim. Hunt enemy ships, evade hostile aircraft, stalk enemy vessels and strike from the shadows. Every contact is uncertain. Every choice carries risk. Every weapon fired may reveal your position.

details.title: Don't Hang Up
details.short_description: A short visual novel where you play as a payphone that is going through its last night before being shut down. How this night will go is up to you.

details.title: Road Meal
details.short_description: A driving game. A cursed artifact. Race to complete deliveries on behalf of a company with roots deeper than human tools can cut.

details.title: Squabblin Goblins
details.short_description: A chaotic multiplayer deckbuilding PvP with GOBLINS. Grab items, throw them at your friends, and craft a goblin so broken your friends will hate you.

details.title: Beyond the Rain Sound
details.short_description: You are the player, exploring a hospital that appears in your dreams while collecting fragments of memory and discovering what happened to you in this psychological horror game. As the story progresses, you will be forced to confront yourself. What awaits you beyond that...

details.title: 花散る社のハナビメ
details.short_description: Hanachiru Shrine no Hanabime is a Japanese-inspired sorting and idle game where you gather faith by discerning people's wishes and restore a once-abandoned sacred shrine. Enjoy a unique blend of peaceful, relaxing moments and fast-paced shrine duties as you rebuild the divine sanctuary.
developers: ハナビメプロジェクト
publishers: ハナビメプロジェクト

name: Blue Men Group ULTIMATE VIDEO BLACKJACK

details.title: Blue Men Group ULTIMATE VIDEO BLACKJACK
details.short_description: The Blue Men Group are energetic, enigmatic, interacting, arousing, performing, embarrassing, feeling, alarming, inspiring, desperate, hateful, impressive and performative. Join us at computer playing our Ultimate Video BlackJack collection. Unlock video, gameplay, get blowmanjobs, you will enjoy

details.title: DiceVenture Dungeon
details.short_description: DiceVenture Dungeon is a roguelike dice-building dungeon crawler. Choose your path, roll and reroll to unleash class skills, and craft your build with dice, relics, and traits. Take on dice challenges for greater rewards—every run brings new choices and combinations.

details.title: Grid Gear TD
details.short_description: Why settle for a tower that only does one job? Slow the front line with Cryo Round, yank the pack into a black hole with Gravity Well, and fry the pileup with Chain Arc. All on one tower—as long as you can fit them onto the grid.

details.title: BOKOSUKA WARS II
details.short_description: Bokosuka Wars won the 1984 ASCII Software Contest; a pioneering simulation RPG. This sequel by the original creator features ideas and systems not realized on the original. Two-Player Co-op play recommended!

details.title: One Last Draw
details.short_description: One Last Draw is a thrilling roguelike card game: HIT or STAND? Keep drawing to boost your score, earn money, and discover powerful Cards, Chips, and Items. But the more you draw, the greater the chance of hitting a Bomb Card and losing everything. Score enough to advance!

details.title: YOLKA: 90s New Year Simulator
details.short_description: Snow and chill outside, but warmth in your heart. In this nostalgic first-person simulator, dive back into childhood and get ready for New Year’s Eve. Decorate the tree, build a snowman, play, and fully immerse yourself in the cozy vibe of the 90s.

details.title: OrderlyWorld
details.short_description: Build a supply chain. Roll an elemental army. Survive the waves. Choose a finite hero pool, produce resources for hero draws, and build deeper chains for rarer heroes. Adapt your formation to every roll and enemy threat.

details.title: StarFrame
details.short_description: A single persistent galaxy shared by every player. Full loot. Rich skill system. Exploration, Industry, PvE/PvP Combat

details.title: Anomagram
details.short_description: Anomagram is a horror set on a night shift moderating a short-video feed. More slices of someone else's ordinary life arrive each night, and you approve or report each one. Some videos are not normal. The anomaly doesn't stay inside the video. It reaches the terminal, and you. Eight nights.

details.title: Buildcraft TD
details.short_description: Build powerful defenses, expand your village, and unlock new technologies in this strategic tower defense game. Gather resources, strengthen your economy, and survive increasingly challenging enemy waves.

name: 遗珍拍卖所 Lost Relics Auction House

details.title: 遗珍拍卖所 Lost Relics Auction House
details.short_description: Lost Relics Auction House is a single-player/multiplayer strategy sim about relic repatriation, legal auctions, and information play. Gather clues, read rivals, judge hidden value, use intel tools, and bid wisely without overpaying or missing priceless treasures.

details.title: STICKBIT
details.short_description: Escape from the Tower of Madness! STICKBIT is a fast-paced 2D Action Tower-Defense Rogue-lite where you build defenses, collect powerups, and blow up lots of barrels! It's loud, colorful, and much safer than the real world. Just keep playing.

details.title: BLACKMURK: Shuffling Man
details.short_description: Fear is real. Sometimes tragedy needs nothing more than that. 💀 A short visual novel based on the story of the same name — about the silence that lets something shuffling into your home. 👁️👁️

details.title: 离校 School's Out
details.short_description: A first-person 3D horror adventure. Trapped in a mysterious world modeled after an old school, an amnesiac hero teams up with enigmatic heroines to face looping spaces and terrifying monsters. As they seek escape and the truth, they begin to break free from the fate that binds them.

details.title: The Dark Curiosity
details.short_description: First-person psychological sci-fi horror set on an abandoned space station. Left alone, you explore and piece together what happened. Something is moving in the dark, and the closer you get to the truth, the closer it gets to you.

details.title: THE DAY THAT WASN'T
details.short_description: Relive the same day without remembering it. Your choices feed four inner alter egos (Shadow, Mad, Alex, and Bully) — shaping reality, glitches, and one of 16 possible endings. The day repeats. Your mind doesn’t. Or does it?

details.title: Good luck, little Rocket !
details.short_description: A new experimental rocket prototype has been built: your mission, should you choose to accept it, is to test its reliability by landing on the various platforms below you. Once this mission is accomplished, restore hope to humanity with your exceptional skill.

details.title: Game Jam Watercooler Sim
details.short_description: A story-driven game featuring Chinese-style group chat simulation + Game Jam Survival Guide. You will join an online group and experience the full 21-day game development competition: teaming up, arguing, teammates ghosting, and more. It truly captures the laughter and struggles of indie developers.

name: ECHOES OF THE GOLDEN BRANCH - M-501 Aberrant Emotion Evolution Report

details.title: ECHOES OF THE GOLDEN BRANCH - M-501 Aberrant Emotion Evolution Report
details.short_description: Wish Upon a Star That Does Not Exist. A dark parable blending idle collection, desktop-pet interaction, and rules-based horror.

details.title: MadHouse For Toys
details.short_description: Madhouse for Toys is a top-down horror game where an AI-powered plush rabbit tries to escape from a toy asylum. Solve puzzles, hide, or fight against insane toys. The unique 3D horror style and the unusual world make the game unlike anything else.

details.title: ATK：画境小镇
details.short_description: ATK: Painting Realm Town is a casual and fun auto-battler that integrates tavern chess strategic gameplay, in-depth character development, and random equipment collection. Players can unlock more than twenty distinctive characters with entirely unique styles and personalities.

details.title: KuLaLa Catcher
details.short_description: Multiplayer "claw machine" party game! Use that unreliable claw to battle in various game modes. It's party time! Party like KuLaLa~! Catch 'em like KuLaLa~!!

name: College Crisis: The Tuition Survival Game

details.title: College Crisis: The Tuition Survival Game
details.short_description: College Crisis is a darkly comedic, turn based survival sim about surviving college inside a broken system. Progress week by week managing money, energy, sanity, dormmates, and scholarships that vanish without warning as subtle cosmic anomalies creep into campus life.

details.title: Cozy Pixel Painter
details.short_description: A cozy pixel painting game where you relax, color cute pixel art, and unwind at your own pace

details.title: The Last Lighthouse
details.short_description: Tend a Magical Lighthouse at the edge of the cosmos. Gather and refine resources, maintain and upgrade the Lighthouse Engine, and aid incoming ships while an unsettling fog closes in.

details.title: 绯想觅剑录 TenshiSwordQuest
details.short_description: This is a 2D horizontal board platform puzzle game about finding one's own Sword Of Scarlet Perception by the Hinanawi Tenshi. She use her ability to manipulate stones to overcome numerous obstacles and find the unclaimed Sword Of Scarlet Perception.

details.title: 耶耶耶一周
details.short_description: A dog-raising simulation game where you can make dog food, play with dogs, go out and meet friendly dogs, experiencing the joys and troubles of lively puppies.

details.title: Trapped on the FlipSide
details.short_description: In this Puzzle Platformer, follow the narrative of three explorers, kidnapped by a mechanical megastructure. Play as their assistant spherical robot in an effort to save them from this brutal place. By powering up the system, area by area, the secretive past and dark truth may make itself known.

details.title: No More Pesticide
details.short_description: No More Pesticide is an active incremental game about a cute frog exterminating swarms of mutant bugs and taking down an evil pesticide manufacturer.

details.title: Whispers of Appalachia
details.short_description: An atmospheric horror walking simulator inspired by Appalachian folklore. Explore a hostile forest, survive multiple nights, and avoid the creatures that roam within. No puzzles. No combat. Just you, the forest, and what hunts inside it.

details.title: As Duty Demands
details.short_description: A first-person narrative psychological horror game focused on exploration and environmental storytelling, set in a decaying naval retirement home ruled by a tyrannical former admiral, where you play as Coral, a newly hired nurse who must navigate shifting environments and uncover hidden truths.

details.title: Infinigama
details.short_description: Explore a universe of diverse worlds. Jump between adventures, trade, craft, and meet other players. Each world offers unique challenges, while a shared economy and evolving environments let your actions ripple across the entire connected universe.

details.title: RelicFairy
details.short_description: Abyss is a roguelike action RPG where players build powerful synergy blocks using equipment and skill items. Combine abilities, create unique builds, and fight your way deeper into a dangerous dungeon filled with unpredictable challenges.

details.title: Project OC
details.short_description: Project OC is a multiplayer online desktop idle game. Unlock 1000+ customization options through idle gameplay and freely mix appearances, outfits, expressions, and actions to create your unique OC. Invite friends to join and let their OCs live on your desktop!

details.title: Frost Muscle
details.short_description: Get good at sliding your muscle car on snow. Earth is freezing and only your driving save it.

name: That Probably Belongs in a Museum

details.title: That Probably Belongs in a Museum
details.short_description: That Probably Belongs in a Museum is a chill and cozy tidy up organizing game about cataloging and curating an enormous amount of ancient artifacts! Your job is simple: Catalog ancient artifacts, uncover bizarre stories, and help build a collection of artifacts that probably belong in a Museum!

details.title: You Are ¿Not? A Dentist
details.short_description: Brush their teeth. Accept their gifts. Pay your rent. Explore many towns in this first person brush-em-up adventure about an aspiring dentist pursuing their dreams. You can heal the world, and even support yourself, if you try!

details.title: Spatial Puzzle 3D
details.short_description: This is a casual puzzle game that combines spatial logic and brain-teasing challenges.The game features simple controls and a relaxed pace with a satisfying level of challenge. It is designed for players who enjoy Sudoku, Rubik’s Cube, and other spatial logic puzzles.

details.title: CYBER ORBADIER BULBUS MACHINA
details.short_description: The Bulbus Machina were built to fight a long war by reusing gear taken from their enemies. Lead four of them deep into enemy factories in this roguelike mech tactics RPG. Destroy enemy gear to win fast, or disable it and take it? Choose your weapons, and replace worn-out gear with what you take.

details.title: 大赢家
details.short_description: Big Rich is a 3D cartoon-style turn-based economic strategy game. Run around and work jobs to earn gold, win licenses in secret auctions, then play cards to take a cut from your rivals. When the match ends, the richest player wins. Play online with friends, or solo against AI.

details.title: Friendly Pharmacy
details.short_description: Your next shift is probably fine. A slapstick co-op pharmacy game for 1–4 players. Decode dreadful prescriptions, operate absurd machines, and get the right medicine to the right patient. When the equipment jams and the paperwork floods in, teamwork is your best treatment.

details.title: Project 14
details.short_description: Project 14 is a short psychological puzzle game filled with bizarre tests, dark humour and unexpected twists. Explore strange environments, uncover hidden paths and decide whether to obey or defy a disturbingly polite system. Your actions shape the experience – and may lead to different outcomes.

details.title: Shapeless
details.short_description: Your enemies are your next bodies. Possess weakened monsters in this top-down action roguelite. Switch between six hosts, carry your soul build forward, and combine mutation elements. Explore ten stages, challenge bosses, and grow stronger between hunts.

details.title: Click & Loot
details.short_description: Click & Loot is a short autobattle incremental clicker about looting dungeons. Level up, upgrade your gear and delve into the dungeons to pay off your ever increasing debt. And don't forget to renew your dungeon license!

details.title: Meat Wall
details.short_description: IF IT MOVES, SHOOT IT. IF IT STOPS, BUILD WITH IT. MEAT WALL is a darkly comedic tower defense where the horde becomes the map. Pile ’em high, build with ’em, burn ’em, grind ’em, or blast a path through ’em. Shape the battlefield. Change your strategy. EVERY WALL CHANGES THE WAR.

details.title: Syncope
details.short_description: Delve into the depths of your subconscious in this psychological isometric action game, and face your greatest fears made manifest. Fight, trade, and venture deeper into the madness of the mindscape. Can you confront the dangers and move forward towards a better future? The real battle is within.

name: The Otherworld Book of Destiny: Chaos Era

details.title: The Otherworld Book of Destiny: Chaos Era
details.short_description: An open-world life-simulation RPG set in the “Age of Turmoil.” Start as a nobody and roam the Five Realms—trading, taming pets, hunting treasure, and stealing. Master nearly 10,000 martial arts, choose one of seven paths, and forge your legend among historical and mythical heroes.

details.title: SpellSimmer
details.short_description: SpellSimmer is a cozy fantasy cooking game where customers hide what they want behind clues. Decode their requests, combine ingredient properties, cook the right dishes, shape a light or dark reputation, and build your kitchen through talents, helpers, and upgrades.

details.title: Sweet Saviour
details.short_description: A single player turn-based RPG that focuses on candy hero's that fight their way through the worlds growing corruption. The game includes mechanics such as permanent character loss and card collecting where you will fight enemies through linear levels.

details.title: Dungeon of Departure
details.short_description: Trapped in a mysterious cave system, four dungeon explorers struggle to find a way out before the light fades forever... Navigate a mysterious underground as you navigate through multiple story paths in this text-based, pixel-art, dark fantasy rpg, visual novel computer game

details.title: FingBlade
details.short_description: Fingblade is a physics-driven Rogue-lite action game. Swing your mouse to control the weapon's real inertia, slashing through endless waves of enemies. Unlock 4 unique weapons, master Chain Lightning and Necromancy builds, and collect gems for permanent upgrades. If the blade breaks, you die.

details.title: soupsoup
details.short_description: Explore diverse illustration magazines in soupsoup, a hidden object game filled with unique artistic visions. Experience over 200 creative stages featuring relaxing healing sounds. Collect stars to unlock new magazines and immerse yourself in beautiful worlds created by talented artists.

details.title: WING-IT
details.short_description: Adapt or crash! WING-IT is a 2.5D shooter where your arsenal is a slot machine. Shoot down drones to trigger the Toy Box Gacha and swap weapons on the fly. Fight through Medy's house, survive the bullet hell, and defeat the mechanical monstrosities ruling the house.

details.title: Childrens Story
details.short_description: Childrens Story is an Anthology Game that presents a growing collection of stories on VHS Tapes. Each tape contains a one-off story with unique plot and setting elements that evoke fear, wonder, and live entertainment. Tune-in Next Time!

details.title: Liar's Lift
details.short_description: Liar's Lift is a 3-8 player social competition. Use the elevator's emergency phone to communicate and solve challenges. Lie or play fair to earn points across multiple rounds. No one dies, but only one winner exits. In this lift, your reputation is the only thing at stake.

details.title: Almamon
details.short_description: Bond with mons and uncover a clash of cosmic powers in this turn based RPG. Choose to battle with deep strategic moment to moment decisions or as a chill autobattler.

details.title: Psyai
details.short_description: A cyberpunk point-and-click detective adventure. Investigate a neon-soaked city, hack corporate networks, and diagnose broken AI minds. Inspired by Policenauts and Snatcher.

details.title: Unfallen Bastion
details.short_description: Protect your Bastion one card at a time in this roguelike tower defense deckbuilder. Deploy turrets, cast spells, and craft devastating combos to hold back bloodthirsty monsters and remain Unfallen.

details.title: Stray Service
details.short_description: What's cheaper than cheap labor? Cats! Play as Tub and Bub - two very committed felines on the clock to bus tables, wash dishes, and mop up every mess before the restaurant goes under. Solo or with a friend, it's chaotic, it's frantic, and someone's definitely knocking over a stack of plates.

details.title: Mystery Box Simulator
details.short_description: Run your own mystery box business! Source returned shipments, storage finds and second-hand treasures. Hunt for hidden gems, identify valuable items, restore them and create the perfect mystery boxes to satisfy your customers while maximizing your profits!

details.title: Last One Breathing
details.short_description: Scavenge ruined locations, manage a grid backpack, barter, craft, and keep your shelter standing through the night in a survival adventure where every item you carry can change the run.

details.title: NIGHTMARE OF THE FOREST
details.short_description: Join Johnny on a desperate search for his missing daughter in a mysterious forest. Confront the shadows and the presence of Marcus in this immersive horror experience.

details.title: Sonnet
details.short_description: Transport a magical flower across scenic lands, encounter strange travelers, and uncover the kingdom’s secrets in this sprawling medieval roadtrip.

details.title: Breakkaboom
details.short_description: Discover a weird fireworks shop. Buy some ridiculous fireworks. Break stuff with them and just enjoy a fun playground! You can also explore mysterious simulation worlds, but when you see hordes of strange creatures, you can hide or run! Or just go wild. Go Kaboom!

details.title: CARGO CRUSH ZERO
details.short_description: Push blocks. Crush enemies. Survive the void. CARGO CRUSH ZERO is a roguelite grid-action game set aboard a derelict space station. Outmaneuver alien creatures by sliding cargo blocks across a zero-gravity field — one wrong move and you're cornered.

details.title: Exile of Arcadia
details.short_description: A high-octane platformer utilizing a teleporting dagger to traverse through a futuristic city!

name: Gensokyo Survivors: Return of the Scarlet Devil

details.title: Gensokyo Survivors: Return of the Scarlet Devil
details.short_description: A high-intensity, Touhou Project survivor-like action game set in Gensokyo, playable in just 5–10 minutes! Break through overwhelming enemy hordes and bullet hell attacks using your own unique builds and pure player skill.

name: Bubble Shooter but In Space and Incremental

details.title: Bubble Shooter but In Space and Incremental
details.short_description: A short, satisfying incremental game about flying through space, popping bubbles, and harvesting Bubble Matter. Build combos, land skillshots for massive multipliers, and spend your loot in a sprawling upgrade shop.

details.title: Take Profit
details.short_description: Step into the role of elite Spec Ops agent Lucy “Talent” Lawson as she dismantles a global crime syndicate to rescue her kidnapped sister. Hunt down The Trust, eliminate its leaders, and seize their profits in this intense, story-driven third-person shooter.

details.title: Evie: The Echo Condition
details.short_description: Explore a dangerous, forgotten world to find the cure to save your best friend’s life, in Evie, an HD-2D action-adventure game that weaves a wordless fantasy tale out of the real-life battle against childhood leukemia.

details.title: Followers of Krow
details.short_description: Medieval Fantasy RPG Autobattler in a 3D Pixel Art style, where you buy and upgrade abilities to fight monsters and explore to uncover secrets about the world.

details.title: Chessire
details.short_description: A roguelike tactical auto-battler where you build an army of chess pieces infused with items and magical abilities. Assemble an army, discover synergies and master the combat system. Guide your army's strategy and watch it auto-battle or take command and control your pieces in turn-based combat!

details.title: PocoDoro
details.short_description: PocoDoro is a tiny virtual pet that lives on your desktop. Hatch a squishy slime, then poke it, stretch it and toss it around. Feed it, play with it, put it to bed and clean up after it. It lives in real time, and how you raise it shapes who it becomes.

details.title: Dungeons Deep
details.short_description: Plunge into the Dungeons Deep! A dark-fantasy ARPG featuring vast underworlds full of horrifying monsters and ancient treasures. Liberate the plagued lands of Antioch for those who still remain.

details.title: Music of Destiny: Corrupted Dungeons
details.short_description: An ancient evil descends, and you will join the Crimson Knights to save the world! In this Roguelite game, assemble a team of knights and monsters, explore dungeons, collect gear, build defenses, and defeat dungeon monsters!

details.title: LEVEL UP YOUR BODY
details.short_description: LUYB - Hit or Box objects to the beat, dodge obstacles. Enhance strength, endurance, coordination, reflexes. Dance to the Rhythm and Elevate in a virtual world.

details.title: Rift Saviours
details.short_description: Rift Saviours is a sword-fighting roguelite where you battle endless waves of enemies. Survive longer to earn upgrades that offer great build customization. Step into the rift and fight for your survival!

details.title: Power Line Rider
details.short_description: It's time to ride! Dodge colorful animals and Defeat Bosses to conquer the Power Lines in this Retro Arcade game with a short Story Mode. Complete the Story to unlock Endless Mode and explore the infinite "NegaZone". You'll enjoy simple controls, classic 8-bit visuals, and an energetic soundtrack!

details.title: About LAST Chanks: Prologue
details.short_description: A free puzzle-platformer for solo players and online co-op. Two damaged robots struggle to survive as their energy slowly runs out. Explore forgotten ruins, overcome dangerous obstacles, and begin the search for the legendary Chank.

details.title: Unguided
details.short_description: Escape a digital prison, upload yourself back into the real world, and get revenge on the ones who framed you in this fast-paced, challenging roguelike slasher. [RUN], [suffer], [EOL], [RUN]

details.title: DOPAMINER
details.short_description: DOPAMINER is a short and intense incremental mining game. Delve deep into the mine to blast rocks, gather gems and artifacts, and unlock powerful new abilities in the skill tree.

details.title: Bite Size Terrors: eye candy
details.short_description: The Other Side of the Screen Shows a Truly Disturbing Truth.

details.title: Codename Incubus
details.short_description: Slice, dash, and parry your way through your inner demons in this fast-paced psychedelic journey! Dodge an onslaught of deadly projectiles and unleash your blade upon nightmarish foes that lurk within your subconscious. Follow a dissident dealer and a jaded philanderer on their never-ending trip.

details.title: Detective Fantasia: EXCALIMURDER
details.short_description: EXCALIMURDER is a nonlinear murder mystery game inspired by the sword in the stone legend. Explore an orphanage, meet weird people and solve logic puzzles, all in a colorful pixel art world. Bonus: Excalibur is the murder weapon.

details.title: Autonomous Anarchy
details.short_description: A retro twin-stick bullet-hell where you fight hordes of enemies, collect powerful weapons and upgrades, and go head to head with menacing mechanical bosses. Take on the hordes solo or with a friend in local co-op!

details.title: Dark Laws
details.short_description: Dark Laws is a medieval fantasy extraction looter with melee, ranged, and spell-based combat. Choose one of 9 mercenaries, mount a dragon alone or with a friend, and survive the brutality of enemies on Telos Island.

details.title: VERY IMPORTANT NEEDS
details.short_description: A chaotic heist game about characters with needs that are a little too “important,” repeatedly breaking into the same neighbors’ buildings and grabbing anything valuable. One goal: leave only walls and doors behind. (Walls optional.)

details.title: Voiceless
details.short_description: Voiceless is a cooperative horror game for 1–4 players. Go live from a mysterious mansion, complete viewer challenges, and gain subscribers. Team up with your friends or sabotage them - choose your own path to popularity.

details.title: Segment In Space 1985
details.short_description: Segment In Space 1985 is a psychological horror game about a person who finds themselves in Milotropia — a strange space made of fractured reality. Using the Second Sight and various consoles, dive into a long journey driven by one goal: to return home.

name: Ruins of the Forgotten:  A Wild Survival

details.title: Ruins of the Forgotten:  A Wild Survival
details.short_description: Discover an open-world survival game that divides animals into two factions. While crafting, building, and taming animals, explore the forgotten ruins. Do whatever it takes to last another night and solve the mystery surrounding animal factions.

details.title: Kiosk Simulator
details.short_description: Kiosk Simulator is an action-packed, comedic take on the hustle of running a big-city kiosk and the nostalgia of reaching that lone open kiosk on a rainy late night.

details.title: Artemis VR
details.short_description: As an Artemis astronaut, face the challenges of space flight in the newest manned system that will take humanity back to the Moon thanks to NASA resources and consultation in terms of Artemis MIssions. Manage the mission using VR glasses.

details.title: Dungeons and Diners
details.short_description: Dungeon and Diners: A Culinary Adventure Awaits! Dive into dungeons with your friends, hunting for exotic ingredients to bring back to your bustling diner. Choose to team up with up to 4 players or enlist the help of adventurers for both dungeon delving and diner duties.

details.title: Star of Games
details.short_description: Ever dreamed of creating a genre-defining masterpiece? Star of Games is a next-gen simulation management game centered on game dev. You'll act as an aspiring developer, starting from a humble garage startup and embarking on a glorious journey—from recreating classics to forging your own legends.

details.title: VTumbler
details.short_description: Dive into the vibrant world of VTubers in an unparalleled free-to-play arcade puzzle fighting spectacle in VTumbler!

details.title: L.OD
details.short_description: 2D exploratory adventure

details.title: NovaLight Z
details.short_description: Novalight Z is a zombie shooter. Shoot and cut your way through an infected colony ship. Survive and explore to find the artifact and uncover the mystery behind the outbreak.

details.title: Pokorama
details.short_description: Run a boutique decorating studio where every client has unique tastes, quirks and expectations. Experiment with paints, fabrics and textures to create interiors your clients will love (or not), build your reputation, and unlock beautiful materials and interiors as your studio grows.

details.title: Junkyard Stories: Rebirth
details.short_description: A dystopian sci-fi adventure where you're a broken robot carrying the consciousness of a legendary hacker. Cross landscapes shaped by war, scavenge supplies, hack systems and solve puzzles as your battery drains. Infiltrate Block-07 to find the person who can save your mind before it’s lost forever.

details.title: Islandustry
details.short_description: Find the best island, outbid your rivals and start exploiting it. Automate your production and watch the market to sell your goods at the right price. Use your profits to buy upgrades and make your production chain even faster.

name: Rashin Detective Chronicles CASE01 : The Final Page

details.title: Rashin Detective Chronicles CASE01 : The Final Page
details.short_description: A strange request arrives at the detective agency, concerning a missing homeowner. Explore a silent mansion and unravel the intricate puzzles hidden throughout its rooms. Why did the homeowner vanish? A mystery adventure where you pursue the truth.

details.title: BIT-HOLE: Neon Incremental
details.short_description: BIT HOLE: NEON Incremental is a compact, straightforward incremental experience. Eliminate viruses, collect data fragments, and unlock massive power spikes by decrypting legendary malware like the "I Love You" worm. A focused cyber-power trip designed for a short, satisfying session.

details.title: Baby Carbonara
details.short_description: THE BABY IS HUNGRY! Cook rats! Chop mushrooms! Handle raw uranium fuel rods??? Smoke cigarettes! FEED YOUR GLORIOUS BABY LEADER TODAY. Total VR Carbonara immersion. Absolute kino.

details.title: Doom ChessMaster
details.short_description: The end has come. Who will save us? You are the "Player" surviving in ruins. No chosen heroes—only the strong remain. Gather them, plan carefully, use gear to change fate. Truth lies in the wreckage. Dare you play?

details.title: Moon Reader
details.short_description: Become a Fortune Teller in this Narrative Life-sim set in a Neo-futuristic Moon Colony. Read Tarot Cards and influence people, manage your Time and Money, Pay your Bills, and Make Decisions that would change your life and the lives of the people around you.

details.title: PapyPanic
details.short_description: Dive into the chaos! Play as an object in a wacky Prop Hunt with friends, or try to survive behind the wheel of a brake-less "Grandpa-mobile" with unforgiving physics. The twist? Your Twitch chat controls the action in real time. Will you survive your viewers?

details.title: Bandit Life
details.short_description: Build a hideout, gather your gang, and live off what others cannot defend. Explore a medieval world, set ambushes, develop your outlaws, and face the consequences of decisions that could make you the terror of the roads—or bring your entire gang to ruin.

details.title: Superheroes Inc: #VictoryLeague
details.short_description: As a social media influencer recruited to a team of heroes, can you earn their trust, defend the city, and prove you’re worth more than your follower count? A text-based interactive superhero novel.

details.title: Pumpkin Survivor
details.short_description: Pumpkin Survivor is a whimsical cartoon-style survival game where you’ll experiment with countless weapon builds to defend against relentless enemy waves. Mix and match abilities, upgrade your pumpkin hero, and survive as long as possible in this roguelike adventure!"

details.title: Booost!! CleanSweep
details.short_description: Take control of the 'Cleaning Cart' and clean up a filthy city! But beware of the Litterbugs who scatter trash everywhere! Faster, cleaner, better. This is a score-attack car action game.

details.title: Which Sea Is This?
details.short_description: Which Sea Is This? is a local co-op sea adventure where you control a single ship together. Trade, explore, pirate, and argue about directions — because nobody knows where you are.

details.title: Zero Point
details.short_description: Mine ore, draw water from a spring, and harvest greens on an alien world. Craft gear, expand your outpost, and set up defenses for the night. Help three stranded friends find a way home in this single-player sci-fi survival crafting adventure.

details.title: The Letter
details.short_description: The Letter is a narrative-driven psychological adventure set in a forgotten town. Explore abandoned streets, follow scattered notes and hidden messages, and uncover fragments of a story inspired by real events as you piece together a mystery buried in the past.

details.title: Paralegal
details.short_description: Jump into the stress of the working world, as [Law firm's name here]'s newest Paralegal with this 2d side-scroller! Do important and fulfilling tasks, such as bringing coffee, sorting decades old files and letting a client scream at you, all while the clock is ticking in the Background.

details.title: 澄心大学
details.short_description: 《澄心大学》是一款校园题材剧情向视觉小说。在鲜活而平静的大学日常中，走近四位拥有不同故事的女主角，并通过选择与分支推动人物关系，走向属于你的青春结局。

name: Blood Arena Path of Steel: Prologue

details.title: Blood Arena Path of Steel: Prologue
details.short_description: Fight your way through brutal medieval arenas in this free prologue featuring physics-driven melee combat, effective armor systems, and violent consequences.

details.title: Echoes
details.short_description: Immerse yourself in a first-person psychological horror experience where every choice matters. Confront the echoes of a forgotten past and uncover the truth behind your lost identity.

details.title: PSYCORP
details.short_description: Three siblings are given AI-Powered cybernetics by their dying CEO father to permanently bring out the worst in them. How much of your mind are you willing to lose to control your family's company, and the future of surveillance in this narrative driven AI corporate dystopia?

details.title: CTRLR.CLUB
details.short_description: The controller arcade game that hits different. Hack the board, route signals, purge the virus, and trigger cascades while your hands keep levelling up.

details.title: SeverSoul XOOKEEPER
details.short_description: Keep the entities fed, pacified and contained every night within a dark decaying facility. Can you survive each shift in this intense point & click horror?

details.title: Redneck Mayhem
details.short_description: Redneck Mayhem is a hilarious, physics-based slingshot game where small-town grit takes on the modern world. Follow three fed-up local heroes as they lock, load, and launch random junk, and eventually themselves at the professions that drive them crazy. The Mission: Unleash the Mayhem.

details.title: 小岛之门 Vaulx
details.short_description: Vaulx is a voxel-style 3D puzzle adventure game. Braving the thick mist, you finally set foot on the legendary treasure isle, where a fun and fantastic adventure begins.

details.title: Feed or Flee
details.short_description: A co-op horror game for 1-5 players. You're the pet-sitters hired to keep Wobbles, a glowing and very hungry little creature, fed through the night, every night. Scavenge the woods and the abandoned buildings around the treehouse, and run when something out there notices you.

details.title: Forbidden buttons
details.short_description: Press the forbidden button to rewrite each room. Freeze gravity, make everything bounce, and teleport to objects you throw in a bright first-person puzzle game built around fast, clever aha moments.

details.title: Chip Away
details.short_description: A roulette game with roguelike progression. Bet, unlock upgrades and face a roulette that changes every run with random modifiers. How much can you earn?

details.title: Sector Scavengers: Signal & Salvage
details.short_description: Deck-building roguelike built on top of a basebuilding RPG. Wake into debt. Scavenge derelicts. Play risky cards. Die a lot. Every collapse unlocks new cards and perks. Can you pay off the Company, or will you be booted out the nearest airlock when the next bill comes due?

details.title: Whispers of the Tallgrass
details.short_description: An atmospheric first-person survival horror set in an abandoned industrial wasteland overtaken by tall grass. Listen closely to the mysterious sounds of the night, hide from a relentless predator, scavenge for key items, uncover the secrets of this place, and find a way to escape.

details.title: Gods With Guns
details.short_description: In Valhalla, heroes pull the trigger to defy Ragnarok! Rogue-like shooting game. 8 mythological heroes + 36 guns + 26 types of ammo + 60 Cards.

details.title: DRONECOM
details.short_description: A real-time naval sensor-warfare game where EMCON is everything: every emission that finds the enemy helps the enemy find you. Design your own drones: subs, ships, aircraft, missiles, and launch them from carriers. Physically modelled radar, sonar, IR and ESM in a moddable CIC sandbox.

details.title: 危ノコ
details.short_description: Control a mushroom and climb toward the summit while avoiding dangerous “Abunoko.” Overcome various obstacles and carefully make your way upward. A single mistake can send you falling far back down. The higher you climb, the more dangers await, testing both your skill and patience.

details.title: Kircles
details.short_description: Kircles is a designer-driven tower defense game where players can combine 18 different turrets to create unique mechanics and prevent “bugs” from reaching the exit. 60+ levels in three campaigns. Every level can be solved with different approaches optimizing resource spending.

details.title: Cunning Stunt Racer
details.short_description: Inspired by the legendary Stunt Car Racer, Cunning Stunt Racer brings back the raw intensity of high-risk, high-reward racing — rebuilt with retro visuals with a modern twist, modern physics, and competitive gameplay.

details.title: Brave Legends
details.short_description: Collect equipment and skill books to build your own unique build.

details.title: Aiya Desire
details.short_description: Exploration × Rhythm Game × Horror Adventure?! After her mother dies and her father disappears, Aiya heads to Sentinel Radio Tower. Explore, solve puzzles, talk, flee a relentless pursuer, and survive 2-button rhythm boss fights. Did HC, the Harmony Chip, end the Infection Panic—or hide a secret?

details.title: Stellar Abyss
details.short_description: Stellar Abyss is an online space sandbox. Command and customize your ship as you explore, fight, mine, manufacture, and trade between star systems. Take on contracts alone or join a fleet for rescue and escort missions. Start with a small ship and find your next opportunity among the stars.

details.title: Creovia
details.short_description: A 2D sandbox MMO with RPG elements. Build worlds, craft gear, explore dangerous subworlds, trade with players, and grow your legacy in a persistent, player-driven universe.

name: Fuse Beads Simulator ~ Debt Payoff Story

details.title: Fuse Beads Simulator ~ Debt Payoff Story
details.short_description: Create and sell various pieces of art using fuse beads. Earn money to cover your daily expenses and pay off your debts. As your Store Level grows, you'll unlock useful tools and new types of beads

details.title: Cats and cats and coffees!
details.short_description: Your new coworkers have paws, tiny aprons, and ambitious nap schedules. Build a cozy idle cafe on your desktop: hire cats, brew coffee, open themed cafes, and fill your album with rare visitors while you work or unwind.

details.title: Grindbound
details.short_description: A single-player, top-down 3D auto-looter set in a dark fantasy world. Explore dungeons, defeat enemies, collect randomized gear, and combine skills and equipment to create powerful builds. No complex controls or quick reflexes required.

details.title: Football Club Builder
details.short_description: Build, manage, and grow your own football club from Division 4 to European glory. Expand your stadium and facilities in 3D, compete in league and cup competitions, and create a football dynasty by making the right decisions in this fast-paced football manager game.

name: 核心防线 core defense line

details.title: 核心防线 core defense line
details.short_description: You are a cloud operator. In the game, to protect the core and resist the continuous virus invasions, you build defenses, construct cards, install creatively designed plugins that provide you with various attack methods, repair external nodes, and at the same time offer you more convenient defense.

details.title: Devil in the penthouse
details.short_description: Slay bosses and climb the demonic skyscraper in this stress-free incremental RPG. Gather loot, unleash powerful active skills, and upgrade your knight to achieve ultimate power. Can you reach the Penthouse and defeat the Devil?

details.title: Affictionate
details.short_description: After a year of bad dates and failed job applications, you've nearly given up on the love story you've always written about. One night, you write your perfect man into a notebook... the next day, he becomes a reality. A romance visual novel about identity and the line between fiction and reality.
publishers: Just a single guy publishing this game

details.title: Chopex
details.short_description: Combine ingredient cards, use kitchen tools, and serve orders before time runs out! Chopex is a pixel art card game where you chop, grill, and plate your way through increasingly hectic kitchens.

details.title: Unheenged
details.short_description: Unheenged is a cooperative horror extraction game for you and up to 3 friends. featuring proximity voice chat, scary monsters, multiple items and doors... Lots of doors.

details.title: Plant Game
details.short_description: Run-based plant survival and growth game about learning the world through imperfect senses. Grow leaves, roots, and resilience, unlock biological “sensors” as UI progression, and earn your reveal when you bloom or die.

details.title: Birds of Ascent
details.short_description: Birds of Ascent is a hand-drawn pixel-art 2D flight action adventure starring a flock of birds. Soar through the skies, explore the cavern, and fight your way back to the surface!

details.title: Cascadral
details.short_description: Cascadral is a Solitaire Roguelike about offering clever card combinations to demonic spirits. Bend the rules, build game-breaking combos and discover powerful synergies across more than 200 unique cards and abilities. Can you escape this demonic castle?

details.title: Sakagura Life
details.short_description: In a quiet town nestled among rice paddies, you’ve bought an old sake brewery for a bargain. Craft premium sake, build friendships with locals and friendly Yokai, and battle hostile spirits while solving puzzles in this unique blend of life sim, adventure, and brewing.

details.title: Nova Dawn: Overload
details.short_description: Take up arms and take care of robot buddies in this co-op action roguelite. Hunt giant hostile robots that have stolen the sun to harvest their mechanical parts, upgrade the machinery you can build and strengthen the bond between you and your Nova robot buddies!

details.title: House Of Slendrina Remake
details.short_description: House of Slendrina is a spine-chilling first-person psychological horror game where danger lurks in every dark corner. You find yourself trapped inside an ancient, decaying family residence but you are far from alone.

details.title: Children's Garden
details.short_description: Welcome to the Reincarnation Ethics Program "Children's Garden." This is a puzzle game where you seek eternal rest.

details.title: 后室迷失之境Backrooms：The Lost
details.short_description: A [Puzzle game] + [escape room] backrooms game;You are FBI agent Tommy.Unfortunately, he fell into the back room during a disappearance case.Random mazes, physical dangers, and the pressure of liminal spaces,Can you escape safely?

details.title: Magengaard
details.short_description: Magengaard is a 3D PvP arena game where spells are cast by drawing glyphs. Explore the fantasy world of the Academy, meet its inhabitants, uncover its mysteries, and master your skills in the arena.

name: Rodolfo Mascarpone y Ramón Cazanuecos: Amenaza en el Molinillo

details.title: Rodolfo Mascarpone y Ramón Cazanuecos: Amenaza en el Molinillo
details.short_description: ¡Prepárate para vivir una emocionante aventura de acción en 3D sidescroll con nuestros queridos personajes Rodolfo Mascarpone y Ramón Cazanuecos, creados por Borja Pavón y The Catacroquer, quienes también han prestado sus voces para esta emocionante historia cooperativa para dos jugadores!

details.title: Two Putt
details.short_description: Two Putt is a 1-4 player wacky mini golf game. Help Komakai and Kyoichi conquer 100+ courses and 20+ wacky mini games to become mini golf champions! 🏆 Hit the links solo, or grab some friends (1-4 players)

name: Archery Pro with James Jean Trickshots

details.title: Archery Pro with James Jean Trickshots
details.short_description: Archery Pro brings life-like, competitive archery straight to your living room through VR! There’s no need for archery equipment to experience the fun of Olympics style Archery with Archery Pro. Simply pop on your headset and experience all the thrills of real-life archery.

details.title: Tunnel Baby
details.short_description: On one rainy morning, Steve found a baby in a utility tunnel. He is not alone. Navigate eerie locales, solve puzzles, and face bizarre creatures to uncover a cosmic mystery in Tunnel Baby.

name: Geo Land - The Dream Traveler Remastered

details.title: Geo Land - The Dream Traveler Remastered
details.short_description: Explore a mysterious world and battle the nightmares born from your own fears in this puzzle-driven turn-based RPG.

details.title: Kinetic Response
details.short_description: In the far future you will die on a distant world, piloting a heap of iron held together by hopes and dreams of a bygone time, for there is no salvation in this godless hegelian nightmare at the end of history.

details.title: Don't Peek Out
details.short_description: An asymmetrical survival game where strategy, and trust collide. Players navigate a mazed house, gather objects and seal ancient runes before dawn breaks. Something hunts them in the dark and it won’t stop until every player is caught. Will you outsmart the monster, or embrace the shadows as one?

details.title: Lost Call
details.short_description: Lost Call is a top down pixel art 2D Zelda inspired game with a metroidvania style map. Take off on a quest through an abandoned and ruined town to stop your phone from ringing all the time, and learn more about the characters who still remain within it.

details.title: Peerless Destiny 绝世天命
details.short_description: A 3D ARPG.Millennia later, you wake in a dying shell. Darkness rules, demons reign. The path of cultivation is now myth.You smile, eyes cold.A mechanical voice echoes:[Invincible Cultivation System rebooted][Energy 1%… Identity: Ancient Human Immortal][Privilege unlocked: Reignite cultivation]

details.title: 魔法少女パラノイド
details.short_description: 引きこもり気味の高校2年生、主人公の『夢宮める』はある日魔法使いである『ミュリィ』に助けられ、魔法少女になることに。 人々の心を悪に変える『バグ』と戦う魔法少女となっためるはこの世界の『悪』と対峙する事になる。 『バグ』と呼ばれる怪物と戦う、かわいくて不穏な魔法少女RPG。

details.title: T-Ghoul :: Dorobou Yameta Youkei Poppu!
details.short_description: A mischievous Thai ghoul trades haunting for farming in this 2D isometric horror-comedy. Steal, sell, or raise chickens, avoid shamans, and decide your fate in a ghost-filled village. Survive, thrive… or devour.

details.title: Ginger Snap: Islands of Rot
details.short_description: Two games in one! GingerSnap: an action platformer with a unique ability combination system. YMIR: a non-linear puzzle platformer with collectable upgrades.

details.title: STREAM STRATOS
details.short_description: "StreamStratos" is a 3D action game.

details.title: Candela: Colorless Dreams
details.short_description: Manipulate colours and solve challenging puzzles in this mysterious 2D platformer set in a post-apocalyptic world. Explore the overworld, uncover hidden secrets, and bring light to this dark, desolate land

details.title: You Died!
details.short_description: How will you cope with the loss of yourself? Each episode of You Died! will give you an opportunity to experience a stage of grief for yourself. Make choices, deal with the consequences, and interact with your environment to express the emotions of the main character.

details.title: Order of Renewal
details.short_description: Order of Renewal is a multiplayer fantasy indie RPG game with co-op and PvP. Detailed combat system with realistic swordsmanship, physical interaction, unusual, and fresh mechanics will require tactics and skill in every battle.

details.title: Mystical Tactics
details.short_description: Mystical Tactics is a turn-based tactical-RPG roguelike in which you control a squad of adventurers in a mystical world. Train your heroes in fast-paced tactical battles, equip them with powerful items and lead them to repel the Dark Lord and his legions.

details.title: The Walls
details.short_description: A story of escape filled with nightmares, trapped within a simulation universe that is reality itself. Markus, dragged into a deep psychological pit by the pain of losing his family, finds himself confronting his nightmares in this simulation universe.

details.title: Into Oblivion
details.short_description: Into Oblivion is an immerse interactive novel where your choices shape the story. Set in the far-future, explore a galaxy on the brink of crisis with dynamic companions. So, settle your mind and pray you have what it takes to fly Into Oblivion.

details.title: Panic In Store !
details.short_description: You play a supermarket employee who must (in each level and within a given time) put the right boxes in the right departments. But be careful! Customers will come after you to waste your time!

details.title: Uphill
details.short_description: A precision platformer that allows you to alter the environment.

details.title: Mercenarian
details.short_description: In a world inhabited by monsters, seek out stronger weapons and skillstones to snatch your enemies’ abilities. Spit poison like a spider, slash through relentless foes, and level up to face stronger creatures. Sharpen your weapons, choose how you fight, and live the life of a Mercenary.

details.title: Star Child
details.short_description: Star Child is an explosive new action-adventure set on a sinister alien planet. Fight numerous aliens and formidable bosses, wield powerful explosives and destructive laser weapons, find secrets and unlock new abilities as you progress. Can you survive your dangerous mission?

details.title: Memory Adventures in the Jungle
details.short_description: A pleasant breeze of ease and casual fun ... or a satisfying challenge and strategy - you decide how you want to play the game ! Also, a lot of cute animals !

details.title: Rules of War
