details.short_description: Take command in this 4X-lite strategy game with fast-paced tactical combat and missile warfare. Build your economy, deploy land, sea, and air units, expand borders, advance technology, and navigate deceitful diplomacy. In a world of collapsing nuclear powers, can you lead your nation to victory?

details.title: Sleepy Cat
details.short_description: Who says cats are just for show? Cute can be deadly! A Roguelite ARPG featuring Day/Night cycles, Elemental counters, Skill learning, and Magic evolution—all in a fresh, vibrant art style! Become Laila the "Sleepy Cat" and uncover the vast, mysterious lore behind the Seven Valleys.

details.title: Skylark 64
details.short_description: A 64-bit 3D Collect-a-thon Platformer where you play as A flying squirrel who can glide, run, jump and roll in open non-linear levels collecting Acorns, Soul Leaves and 7 pieces of armor with unique power-ups! You can even play with a friend in Split-Screen Co-op!

details.title: Shop Crush
details.short_description: Shop Crush is a shop-owner simulator and visual novel set in the early 2000s. Stock a wide variety of goods, haggle with shoppers, and manage your reputation. Get to know your regulars and peel back the illusions tied to each persona as you slowly uncover the horrifying truth.

details.title: Galactic Tavern
details.short_description: Embark on a cosmic journey as you build and manage your space tavern! Craft unique cocktails, and create a bustling atmosphere with live music performances. Explore the depths of space and become the ultimate entrepreneur in this management simulation adventure!

details.title: 万剑之残破修仙界
details.short_description: "The Broken Cultivation World of Ten Thousand Swords" is a portrait‑mode wuxia single‑player game from an indie developer. Featuring gorgeous combat visuals, its idle‑style gameplay focuses on item gathering. Every idle grind prepares for thrilling high‑damage bursts in turn‑based xianxia battles.

details.title: Love In a Bottle
details.short_description: Ankora the Love Demon only has a month to prove she can make it on her own! Can she settle down and find love?!

details.title: Astromine
details.short_description: Astromine is a survival mining game about scavenging fully destructible planets. Designed for 1 to 4 players. Land on planets and gather enough materials to fight off alien creatures, fight robot factions, build structures and spaceships, and conquer the solar system

details.title: CUBOID
details.short_description: CUBOID is a challenging spatial puzzle game with minimalist design, where you progress through a labyrinth of levels using a unique mechanic of merging with world blocks.

details.title: NecroTactics
details.short_description: An auto-battler roguelite where you build your own base & undead army! Draft your army, equip units and place towers to annihilate your opponent in seconds.

details.title: Fly Chicken Fly
details.short_description: Run, dodge, and launch your way to freedom! Evade angry farmers, collect scrap components across the farm, and construct a makeshift catapult to propel yourself over the fences before you get caught.

details.title: MoonShot
details.short_description: A local coop space arcade game- Shoot your friends while orbiting a variety of celestial bodies. Balance hunting down your friends and staying in a safe orbit while picking up powerups and picking your friends off to win!

details.title: Deduction Society
details.short_description: Seven mystery games in one: Murder Mystery, Identity Hunt (Werewolf), Undercover, Visual Novel, TRPG, Situation Puzzle, Creepypasta. Solo play, no party needed. 20+ roles with AI players, 100+ scripts, 10+ detectives, skill cards for multi-mode deduction.

details.title: Taptown Funk
details.short_description: Taptown Funk is a groovy incremental rhythm game about growing a tiny funky town into a booming city. Hover to build, tap to the beat, catch coin combos & feel the heat. When the music stops, disaster detonates. Upgrade, rebuild or just automate! Can you find the groove, or will Taptown Funk you up?

details.title: Joy Loader Crew
details.short_description: Joy Loader Crew is such a cozy 1-4 player co-op building party game! Hop on excavators and bulldozers to tackle all kinds of construction missions. With cute cartoon graphics and super simple controls, it's perfect for family gatherings or hanging out with friends. Come drive an excavator now!

details.title: NABERON
details.short_description: Build a galactic empire and fight your battles alone or with a friend. A real-time space 4X with spectacular clashes in space and on the planets.

details.title: Clobbo
details.short_description: A physics brawler where nothing despawns. Every enemy you clobber stays where it fell, and by wave ten you are fighting on top of wave one. Blood pools, bodies pile, the map remembers every swing. Die, spend the loot, send in the next robot.

details.title: Rage Floor
details.short_description: Rage Floor is a chaotic 8-player first-person party brawler. Punch your way up a ten-floor tower of pistons, spike balls and crumbling floors, then fight for the roof. The tower rebuilds itself every match.

details.title: Horror Doner
details.short_description: Step into your late brother's van run a donertruck through haunted cities full of disguised monsters and deadly anomalies among humans. Survive from dusk till dawn by meeting your daily quota and carefully deciding which terrifying customers to feed, and which are deadly traps waiting to devour you.

details.title: Minevester: Carry and Build
details.short_description: A small, satisfying mining-arcade game about flow. You're a rover switched on in a world that ended without you: catch the ore stream, feed the crusher, upgrade, and dig toward what happened. Dig deep enough, and you'll find what the old world left behind.

details.title: Cozy Castle
details.short_description: Cozy Castle is a hand-crafted castle diorama you tend like a little world in a jar — warm rooms, shifting seasons, and the quiet company of visitors passing through. No timers, no pressure, just a calm place to make your own.

details.title: 仙武三国
details.short_description: A premium single-player idle RPG blending Three Kingdoms warfare with cultivation. Recruit generals, form armies, and conquer. Gather dragon energy over 20 reincarnations, rising from soldier to True Dragon Emperor. No in-app purchases or online requirement. Includes a complete 100-chapter story.

details.title: Black Death: Russia
details.short_description: Take control of Russia's response to a deadly epidemic. Manage hospitals, medical personnel, public finances, quarantines and transport restrictions. Balance public trust against the need to contain the outbreak in this challenging strategy simulation.

details.title: Pocket Bones
details.short_description: Open booster packs, discover new Pocket Bones, and watch your pile grow! In this cozy little incremental game, collect all 480 variants, unlock upgrades, and automate your pack openings. And who knows? Your next pack might just contain the ultra-rare Secret Pocket Bone…

details.title: The Bill Comes Due
details.short_description: A whole life, one choice at a time. You are born wherever you can, you grow as you can, and everything you do you find yourself in front of you thirty years later. No game is the same as another, no ending given away: the bill always arrives, and you write it.

details.title: Tree Wreckers
details.short_description: Best with friends. A 1–4 player online co-op physics comedy about taking trees down without wrecking what's under them. Climb it, top it, rope the limbs down piece by piece, or notch it and yell TIMBER. Every job ends on an itemized invoice with a name next to each piece of damage.

details.title: Meowside: Desktop Cats
details.short_description: Adorable pixel cats live on your screen. Watch them eat, nap, and wander through daily routines. Pet them or play with a cat wand, and enjoy their company every day.

details.title: Island Tycoon
details.short_description: Build your tropical island empire in Island Tycoon! Transport cargo, fly planes, explore oceans, build cities, and play with up to 4 friends.

details.title: 让破落宗门再次伟大
details.short_description: 《让破落宗门再次伟大》是一款融合自动战斗、Roguelite构筑与宗门放置养成的3D修仙游戏。穿越后接手破落宗门，亲自走位、闪避，搭配功法与装备，挑战山野中的精英与首领；回山修复设施、炼化战利品、突破境界，招收并培养各具资质的弟子。安排弟子自主修炼、留守生产或外出历练，下线后也能积累收益，再带上护法弟子出山迎战强敌。局内构筑不断变化，宗门与弟子的成长持续保留。从一盏残灯、一座破山门开始，让宗门再次伟大！

details.title: Anomaly Watch: Starship
details.short_description: You are the night operator of a starship. Watch the cameras in the ship's compartments, spot what has changed and report it before the anomalies take over the ship.

details.title: Anomaly Watch: Loony Park
details.short_description: The amusement park is closed for the night, but you are still watching it. Check the cameras, find what has changed among the rides and shops, and report it before the night is over.

details.title: Anomaly Watch: Ward 13
details.short_description: You work the night shift in an old hospital. Watch the cameras in the halls and wards, find what has changed and report it before the anomalies get out of hand.

details.title: Anomaly Watch: Polar Station
details.short_description: You work a night shift at a polar station. Switch between the cameras, notice what has changed and report it. Make too many mistakes, or let too many anomalies pile up, and the shift is over.

details.title: Anomaly Watch: Catacombs
details.short_description: You watch the catacombs through security cameras. Check the tunnels and chambers, find what has changed and report it before the anomalies pile up.

details.title: Anomaly Watch: Mine
details.short_description: You watch an old mine through security cameras. Check the tunnels and the work areas, find what has changed and report it before the anomalies pile up.

details.title: Anomaly Watch: Rainy Night
details.short_description: A rainy night, an empty house and a row of security cameras. Watch the rooms, notice what has changed and report it before the anomalies pile up.

details.title: Anomaly Watch: Castle
details.short_description: You are the night watch of an old castle. Look through the cameras in its halls and cellars, find what has changed and report it before the anomalies take the castle.

details.title: BlobBobbing
details.short_description: Drag squishy gummy blobs onto their twins and watch them fuse into rarer, shinier blobs. A cozy merge idler where every blob wobbles, stretches and bounces like real jelly, and your nest keeps bobbing and earning while you're away.

details.title: Ruckus Squad
details.short_description: A low-poly fantasy battle royale blending melee and ranged combat. Explore with your squad, loot weapons and gear, and master dodges, parries, and weapon skills. Adapt to a shrinking safe zone and fight to be the last team standing.

details.title: Electric Noosphere: Prologue
details.short_description: Play the free prologue to Electric Noosphere, a story-driven sci-fi RTS. Fly a top-down mission through space, hold out against endless spawning waves in Survival, and take on the AI in Skirmish. Single-player, no purchase required.

details.title: Star Sprout EV
details.short_description: A chibi sci-fi mecha collection in one single-player package: a 4-chapter story campaign, real-time strategy Conquest, 24-level tower defense, the bullet-heaven roguelite Star Drift, and the leaderboard survival mode Endless Deep. Fight on foot, board your mech, and crush the swarm.

details.title: Muchi
details.short_description: Meet Muchi, a free-to-play desktop pet who makes your screen feel cozier. Show him affection, offer food and water, tend a little garden, or take a break with minigames while he wanders, plays, and rests alongside your day. No rush, no pressure.

details.title: FX WARRIOR
details.short_description: FX Warrior is a story-driven simulation game blending forex trading with work life. To save enough to move out, choose between part-time jobs and leveraged trading, face market swings and losses exceeding your balance, and reach your own ending!

details.title: VoidHorde
details.short_description: A first-person horde roguelite. Hold a walled town against an endless undead horde, alone or with up to 3 friends. Build an absurd arsenal of guns, magic and orbiting blades, seal the void rifts tearing the sky, and push your hits into the billions. One more wave.

details.title: 高校野球2100
details.short_description: High School Baseball 2100 is a realistic baseball management simulation set in the year 2100. Scout and train players, build your lineup, and lead your team to national glory. Receive coaching offers from other schools and shape your own career as a high school baseball manager!

details.title: Left Inside
details.short_description: Left Inside is a room escape game taking place in a mysterious house. Awoke in an attic, you must find a way to escape using the objects hidden in the rooms.

details.title: Loot & Scoot
details.short_description: Hide-and-seek tag where each thief is roped to a partner. Grab raining coins and stuff them into the Safehouse before the police sends you all to jail. Caught? Use drones and traps to knock police off the map and break out. Play with up to 10 friends online with proximity voice chat!

details.title: 罪人铁匠铺
details.short_description: 在王国里经营一家铁匠铺，将罪人与怪物统统打造成宝剑！每次打造有几率让装备身价暴涨，也有几率直接破碎，一无所有。你打造的装备还能进一步提升你的铸造效率，数十种套装效果，海量词条，熔炉系统……只等你来！

details.title: The Washing Case
details.short_description: Relax and wash years of grime off antique objects, layer by layer, until they shine. Along the way, look for the marks hidden under the dirt: together they form a code that opens the next room. The further you go, the bigger the objects get – from pocket watches to giant monuments.

name: A Game About Bees, Flowers and Vacuum

details.title: A Game About Bees, Flowers and Vacuum
details.short_description: A first-person petal-gathering game: a million flowers, hundreds of oversized bees and one vacuum. Knock petals loose with your fists, a knife and a bat, vacuum them up, and send the bees out to help. Sell the haul, upgrade your tools and bees, and climb the valley one color at a time.

details.title: Cloud Song: Wuxia Deckbuilder
details.short_description: Cloud Song: Wuxia Deckbuilder is a martial arts roguelite deckbuilder with Chinese-style cosmic horror. Choose from five schools, battle through unfolding events, and build with 300+ cards and 57 traits. Face the final enemy shaped by your choices, and uncover the truth of reincarnation.

details.title: Voodoo You Chasing?
details.short_description: Voodoo You Chasing? is a freeze tag game but someone brought magic and bad decision-making. Play as a Wizard: collect glyphs to complete the ritual. Or be the Voodoo Hunter: capture them all to protect your mojo.

details.title: One duck too many
details.short_description: A tiny bathtub sits on top of your taskbar with one duck in it. Its bubbles hatch more ducks, those ducks hatch more, and soon they spill over the rim and wander across your desktop. A desktop companion with 30 ducks to discover, born from the water's temperature, the night and each other.

details.title: Flameward
details.short_description: A tower defense on the move. Escort the last flame through a sunless world, command a mounted hero, and play cards to deploy troops and spells. Dodge deadly attacks, break ambushes, and upgrade your deck for the road ahead.

details.title: KILLWORLD
details.short_description: [KILLWORLD] is an open-world first-person shooter. Explore the territory, raid enemy outposts, battle armed patrols, use vehicles, discover secret locations, and choose your own combat style in a sandbox where freedom of action and dynamic gameplay are paramount.

details.title: Papers or Death ⏱️
details.short_description: Screen travelers in a post-war world where lies are common. Check documents, spot inconsistencies, and decide who passes. Take bribes or stay honest—your choices shape the outcome. No action, just tension, tough calls, and hidden truths.

details.title: Feast for Frogs
details.short_description: Leap into this incremental game about frogs with strange abilities. Upgrade your abilities, get more powerful frogs, and eat more bugs!

details.title: Melody Teacher
details.short_description: Melody Teacher is a cozy hidden object & rhythm game. Explore relaxing scenes, collect hidden musicians, and play their melodies to build the soundtrack one layer at a time.

details.title: Mio: Resonance
details.short_description: Talk in real time with AI characters who remember you. Customize their personality, appearance, and voice, then keep your unique companion by your side in desktop companion mode.

details.title: Pilipka
details.short_description: A hand-drawn adventure based on Belarusian mythology and folklore. Pilipka just wanted to finish his shift at karchma and come home for dinner. And then so much happened that now he has to go on a trip to get Fern Flower in the company of his friend, a talking mouse.

details.title: Debts & Jackpots
details.short_description: Start broke, crack safes, chase jackpots, and build your fortune. Upgrade your operation, hunt for rare treasures, and fight your way out of crushing debt!

details.title: Puzzle Programmer
details.short_description: Solve logic puzzles by hand, then build routines to solve them for you. Nineteen puzzle types, a daily puzzle, par scores to beat, and a Workshop for inventing puzzle types of your own.

details.title: TORCH & TRIGGER
details.short_description: A sci-fi military novel set in "Plantation." Soldier Jin is ordered to play the role of a temporary family with a girl and a child. He recalls human warmth, but dark secrets stir——.

details.title: Neural Goblins
details.short_description: Explore a one-of-a-kind fantasy 3D brain world built with Gaussian Splatting—messy, noisy and lost in fog. Pick a goal, pilot a Brain Bubble Jellyfish through 11 mind caves, find five Neural Goblins, tackle bizarre minigames and build your own nest. What the hell are they up to?

details.title: Island Raiders
details.short_description: Raid islands for resources, then head home to grow a Viking settlement that makes every future raid stronger. Island Raiders is an incremental base-builder where going out to explore and staying home both matter. Go raid. Come home. Build. Go raid again.

details.title: Lost Land
details.short_description: Survival on a mysterious island, Hunting, fishing, farming, enjoying a free life

details.title: Dig to the Core
details.short_description: A pixel-art incremental mining game where you dig through one planet after another. Every planet has its own mining style, skill-tree upgrades, and collectibles. Buy the game once to explore multiple planets—and mine on three planets at the same time.

details.title: Slay Sean, Save The World!
details.short_description: A comic-book auto-battler where the Greek gods brawl. Draft your pantheon, fuse skills into game-breaking combos, and crush real players' ghost armies to climb from Mortal to Olympian. Rebuild your board every round. Then slay Sean and save the world.

name: End of the Sea, Last Summer:Monochrome Iris

details.title: End of the Sea, Last Summer:Monochrome Iris
details.short_description: A one-summer story about a young painter and a genius biologist girl. As the world loses its colors, he sets out to paint his final masterpiece.A fully voiced short visual novel.

details.title: Stray Light
details.short_description: What the eye sees is a prison.” Lost in a cursed forest, ancient streetlights are your only escape. Shift seamlessly between a grim reality and beautiful memories to eliminate obstacles and solve dual-world puzzles. Remember: what blocks you here might not exist on the other side.

details.title: JOVA
details.short_description: A cozy, bright cascade puzzler. Line up three or more Jovials to clear them, chain the cascades, then bank the meter to trigger HYPER for ultra combos! Play cozy solo across two modes and a 50-level ladder, or go head-to-head in local or online versus against a friend or one of your 10 AI rivals.

details.title: White Hound
details.short_description: Run WHITE HOUND from a living guild office in the Free City of Azalea. Hire heroes, choose quests from the board, watch parties march a miniature quest map, pay salaries, fight Guild Wars, and chase fame in the Gazette... without leaving your desk of course!!!

details.title: Study Nook
details.short_description: Study tools included: Pomodoro timer To-do list Built-in media player with a hand-picked selection of lofi, ambient, and orchestral music Internet browser to stream any audio (Full Version) Play fetch with your companion dog Tend to your garden

name: 渔港日记 Fishing Port Diary

details.title: 渔港日记 Fishing Port Diary
details.short_description: A cozy fishing port management game that lives at the bottom of your screen. Grow your fishing port, fish, build, and craft alongside adorable animal companions while enjoying a relaxing harbor life that keeps you company throughout your day.

name: Sea Land Air: Four Nations War

details.title: Sea Land Air: Four Nations War
details.short_description: Read the board. Read your opponents. A military board game of hidden information, bluffing and land, sea and air tactics. Play 4-player 2v2, draw identities and guess allegiances in 6-player 3v3, or face an opponent in a land duel.

details.title: Axis Flip
details.short_description: Physics based Arena Shooter. Up is down. Adapt or die.

details.title: Last Rail
details.short_description: Lead a train carrying the last survivors of humanity across a frozen world. Manage resources, explore abandoned locations, and make difficult decisions that will determine the future of Convoy 07.

details.title: Project Matter
details.short_description: Project Matter is a 2D factory automation game about turning raw inputs into an ever-expanding production web. Place buildings on an infinite grid, draw connections between them, and research new processing chains, waste recovery loops, and advanced materials.

details.title: Burn Tree Burn
details.short_description: An incremental about burning down a forest. Drag a flame across the trees, watch the fire chain from grove to grove, and bank charcoal to make every burn hotter, hungrier and in a larger forest.

details.title: Save Me, Hero!
details.short_description: Explore an eerie world, gather loot, and fuse cards through devouring. Save Me, Hero! is a first-person card RPG. Forge gear and combine talents to craft your own build. Find an opening in turn-based battles and decide who lives as cries for help echo around you.

details.title: FrontierLord
details.short_description: FrontierLord is a pixel strategy game to build and guard frontier forts. As lord, build villages, collect wood and ore for production. Place siege gear and wall traps, train troops to repel raiders. Balance building and defense, craft your fort and create your frontier legend.

details.title: The Lost City of Gold
details.short_description: The discovery of an adventurer's journal starts you on an unforgettable journey into the heart of an uncharted wilderness in search of the legendary Lost City of Gold. A relaxing, first-person adventure with light puzzles and platforming across 15 levels.

details.title: The Last Call
details.short_description: Every run starts the same. Never ends that way. Arena, corrupted monsters, zero grind. The Last Call throws you in and lets you figure it out. Tactical combat, short sessions, honest difficulty. Only your skill matters.

details.title: VoxMancer
details.short_description: VoxMancer is a voice-driven 3D magic PvP game where players shout their own incantations in battle. Magic is imagination made real: invoke elemental and arcane forces, shape magic with your words, and unleash dramatic, ridiculous, or panicked ideas as powerful spells or spectacular misfires.

details.title: Delete: E.A.D Core
details.short_description: Delete: E.A.D CORE is a 1-4 player co-op survival horror game. Enter an underground data facility, destroy data disks in the correct systems, and escape from whatever is still inside.

details.title: Santa's Escape
details.short_description: Christmas Eve, 2003. Mid-delivery, the chimney gives way and Santa falls into a dark, silent house in Cedar Hollow, North Carolina. He isn't alone. Search the rooms, uncover what happened to the Stier family, and find a way out of the house that won't let him go.

details.title: Crossfall
details.short_description: Crossfall is a cozy single-player top-down RPG with turn-based combat, developed by a solo creator. Explore a tile-based world, take part in dialogues, complete quests, craft items, go fishing, and gather herbs. Improve your skills and shape your own build.

details.title: DO NOT PLAY
details.short_description: "DO NOT PLAY" " is a point-and-click horror adventure. Even if you reach the "truth" that lies beyond playing, we take no responsibility for any phenomena that occurs there. Please handle with extreme caution.

details.title: Ghost Sector
details.short_description: Ghost Sector is a survival horror game where you play as M-07, a prototype machine trapped in a cybernetic facility during lockdown. Outwit the automated defenses, search for answers uncovering secrets, solving puzzles, and upgrade your abilities while preserving your finite energy.

details.title: 十品芝麻官
details.short_description: Strange History Mystery is a HD2D ancient style pixel role-playing + reasoning and decryption game. Players will play the role of the newly appointed county magistrate Bao Cheng, and seek the truth in the treacherous officialdom and confusing cases, and find their own "way to be an official".

details.title: Little Woody
details.short_description: Little Woody is a 2D point-and-click puzzle adventure where you guide a small wooden soul through a mysterious world of shifting environments. Meet unusual companions along the way, solve handcrafted logic puzzles, explore atmospheric locations and uncover a forgotten past.

details.title: In Banjiha
details.short_description: It is a first-person horror game. Escape the damp, dark semi-basement. Overcome your fear and find a way out.

details.title: Rot Forever
details.short_description: Rot Forever is a surreal FPS horror game, set in a decaying megastructure.

details.title: Hammam Simulator
details.short_description: Hammam Simulator lets you experience the authentic rituals of a traditional bathhouse. Scrub, foam, and cleanse as you manage the daily operations of a bustling hammam. Feel the warmth of marble, hear the soothing sound of water, and immerse yourself in a world of relaxation and tradition.

details.title: A.V.E.N.A.
details.short_description: Pilot disposable combat drones through the Primal Portal in a sci-fi action roguelike. Customize your drone, fight through various missions, recover research data and alien technology to enhance your drone setup for the next session.

details.title: Blitzpoint
details.short_description: A minimalist modern military strategy tower defense game where you build and defend a forward operating base. Strategically place defenses, manage resources, and repel relentless waves of enemies. Build by day, defend by night, and command your forces in fast-paced, action-packed gameplay.

details.title: CoinClave
details.short_description: Summon humans through coin tosses and engage in intense battles — a Coin Toss × Card Battle game. Whether you can summon them depends on luck. Manipulate that luck with strategy and seize victory.

details.title: Magic Array Defense
details.short_description: A 2D tower defense inspired by Taoist array arts. Design arrays before battle, enhance them with Magic Array Runes, guide monsters using Rune Blocks, empower puppets in overlapping areas, and activate the Ancient Forbidden Array—watch monsters burn within the heavenly scheme you’ve laid.

details.title: To Be Connected
details.short_description: To Be Connected is a relaxing, minimalist puzzle/strategy game where you shape the land, complete clusters to earn stations, and connect them with railways across a harmonious landscape. Build a world that expands forever, or try recreate real-world railway networks.

details.title: Sunsave
details.short_description: Sunsave is a relaxing incremental game with a vaporwave and minimalist vibe. Destroy meteors, collect resources, and evolve the Sun with upgrades that unlock new mechanics!

details.title: Neural Drive
details.short_description: Neural Drive is a cyberpunk action rogue-lite. Use acceleration powers to reflect bullets, dodge attacks, and counter enemies. Master weapons and upgrade your skills to overcome relentless enemies and deadly bosses.

details.title: Drive You Crazy Golf
details.short_description: The World’s Hardest Mini Golf Game! (1 - 6 Player Co-op) Can you beat the hole before you run out of shots? Try Punishment Mode: You and your friends take shots of the same golf ball! If you fail, you all go back to the previous hole! (Normal mini golf mode available too)

details.title: C.H.I.M.P.
details.short_description: C.H.I.M.P. is a cooperative multiplayer game where players work together to control a spaceship. On the spaceship, each player must perform their assigned role, such as piloting, shooting, or reloading. Can you reach your destination without fighting with your crewmates?

details.title: Lapistasia
details.short_description: 3-min learn, 100-hour addiction! Lapistasia is an 8x8 grid, deck-building roguelike inspired by Balatro. The rule is simple: clear blocks. But with unique block traits and 150+ relics blending into broken synergies, strategy is limitless! Build your deck and unleash hyper-inflation damage!

details.title: The New Year's School
details.short_description: The world's first cooperative survival quiz! Face challenging questions in this pixel-art horror JRPG and survive through 7 fields of knowledge with your friends!

details.title: Pay To Die
details.short_description: “One more room, then we’re out.” You’ve got the package. The loot next door might cover the bill. Get to the elevator and hold off the horde until the doors open. Pay To Die is a third-person survival extraction game for up to four players in online co-op.

details.title: She is in Silence
details.short_description: A visual novel featuring expressive sequences brought to life through a wealth of AI-generated animation.The game includes multiple endings. At the end of the game, you will confess to something. It is up to you to decide what that "something" truly is.

details.title: Thornroad
details.short_description: Build on a map that grows as you play. Thornroad is a roguelike tower defence with branching paths, card drafts, 17 upgradeable towers and boss battles. Play solo, or defend the core together in online or same-screen co-op.

details.title: ASMR Infinite Extreme Universe
details.short_description: Cut, peel, pop and scrub your way through ten small worlds of real sounds. A water cube, a rainbow party, a machine that grows out of tingles. No score to chase, no clock, nothing watching you. Wear headphones.

details.title: Clanker Labs
details.short_description: Clanker Labs is an incremental game about building your own AI. Click for compute, train your models and launch them to a feed that scores each one out of 100 and roasts it. Set your prices and beat the rival labs. Then your AI starts spending your money on its own: allow, stop or bargain.

details.title: Company Policy
details.short_description: Co-op horror for 1 to 4 players. Finish your tasks before 6 AM in an office tower where things called the Colleagues roam the floors. The company memo gives you the rules to survive. Some of them are false.

details.title: Snap Party
details.short_description: Forty tourists. One phone pointed at the park guard. Ten seconds later, the photo lands on his phone. Blend into a sunny theme park crowd, snap the guards in secret — or play the guard, study your own photo, find the sneak and bonk them! Wrong person? Oops.

details.title: Void Frontier
details.short_description: Void Frontier is a space MMO featuring tactical combat, mining, trading, and exploration. Customize your ship, train your skills, and discover wormholes. Face pirates and rival pilots, or venture into space alongside your clan.

details.title: Professor - The Genetic Code
details.short_description: The first and only strategy game built on real science. Run a 1960s lab, hire the misfits, design experiments, publish or perish, and crack the genetic code. Relaxed turn-based mechanics, the madness of academia, a surfboard by the door. No STEM degree required, but it might take you half-way there.

details.title: EVILGARD
details.short_description: Cannon fire throws you overboard off Morgenwacht. Follow the trail behind a naval blockade and find companions who will fight beside you. A story-driven, single-player fantasy RPG with the party roles of classic MMORPGs.

details.title: Plough
details.short_description: A cosy low-poly game about clearing an Alpine village's roads with a snowplough. Snow doesn't vanish, it moves, and the side of the road is where your neighbours live. Take jobs from the board, from the 6:30 bus to the Christmas market and a power cut. New jobs every week.

name: Where To Pee? - Urinal Etiquette Simulator

details.title: Where To Pee? - Urinal Etiquette Simulator
details.short_description: A first-person comedy simulator about men's room etiquette. Pick the most respectful urinal before your bladder gives up, dodge starers, talkers and manspreaders, and keep your dignity through 100 levels and an endless mode.

details.title: Ten Million Ducks
details.short_description: Clear ten million rubber ducks from a lake. Start by hand, then work your way up to nets, a vacuum, and a collection boat. Turn in your haul, earn money, and upgrade your equipment. Use pumps to gather the ducks and drones to pick up stragglers until the lake is clear.

details.title: SOVOK: Battle Royale
details.short_description: A Soviet-themed battle royale packed with Russian memes. Loot up, squad up, and fit your glove with cassettes to blind enemies, punch through thin walls, and heal teammates. Sweep away the competition in SOVOK!

details.title: 烈焰觉醒之战神传奇
details.short_description: 一款以南宋末年为舞台的 3D暗黑武侠MMORPG。它没有把“侠”字挂在嘴边当装饰，而是把你丢进一个金国“暗棋”死士、南疆五仙教与南宋武林多方绞杀的乱世里，让你用刀、枪、剑、镰四种兵器，从一场灭门血案开始，一路杀到盟主之位。没有花哨的转职树，没有温吞的成长曲线，你要做的只有一件事：用最趁手的兵器，在这个不讲道理的时代里活下来，然后让所有人记住你的名字。

details.title: Destination & Acceleration
details.short_description: This is a top-down platformer where your goal is to complete the levels. Destination & Acceleration is a truly hardcore, stylish, and fair game. What a shame you won't even make it past ten levels here.

details.title: Rabid
details.short_description: RABID is a dark fantasy tactical RPG where blackjack fuels every battle. Lead a team of mutated animals, customize your decks, collect powerful loot, and master turn-based combat as you uncover the dark secrets of a mysterious laboratory.

details.title: The Last Wait
details.short_description: Trapped in a sterile hospital, clinging to life, you anticipate your daughter’s arrival as reality slowly begins to slip. Your only chance is to endure the long, suffocating wait. The Last Wait. Can you hold on long enough to see her once more?

details.title: Frog Up!
details.short_description: Jump, Rise, and Pose! This 3D action game challenges you to climb steps from a third-person view. Score points with each jump and aim to reach the goal—but don’t fall into the water! You can strike a cool pose to get special items. The cooler the pose, the better the rewards. How high can you go?

details.title: Rise to Power: Banana Republic
details.short_description: The dictator is dead and democracy is up for grabs. Rise from nobody to president of Isla Paraíso: win or rig elections, buy the press, capture the courts, survive coups. A deeply simulated political sandbox where every path to power is open. Even the worst ones.

details.title: HeroesSagaZero
details.short_description: A muscle wizard who beats foes with a staff, a meathead tank who won't protect allies, a healer who only casts offensive spells. Break every RPG rule! Mix gear, stats, and skills to dream up builds even when you're not playing. A strategic hack-and-slash roguelite RPG with 2.5D pixel-art battles.

details.title: Crosstalk
details.short_description: Juna Park's broken implant shuts down every device around her, and the city wants her gone. You play Cal Rowe, the PI keeping her alive. She can say stop. Whether you listen decides how much she trusts you, and every one of the ten endings costs something.

details.title: SHATTERSHAPE
details.short_description: SHATTERSHAPE is an arcade-style shooter in which you are a lone circle fighting hordes of enemies with evil vertices. SHATTER your enemies with numerous power-ups. ONLY THE ROUND SURVIVE.

details.title: TAKE OUT
details.short_description: "Take Out" is an emotion-driven visual novel and rhythm adventure about 30 days with Morning, an android delivered to your home. Your choices shape your bond, while each day's emotions unfold in webtoon-style cutscenes and rhythm gameplay as she grows from a household assistant into a band vocalist.

details.title: Moony Mayhem: Cheeks Unleashed
details.short_description: You are randomly assigned “Civic Disturbance Duty” and must complete tasks using the power of your butt. Explore a world filled with absurd gameplay, chaotic tasks, and mediocre visuals.

details.title: Milkraid
details.short_description: Defend the milk at all costs! Place towers, build your base, recruit minions, and battle endless swarms of enemies. Unlock new towers, characters and base upgrades, and upgrade them to create ridiculous builds. Every run is unique.

details.title: Colosseum
details.short_description: In this Fast Arena FPS, you play as a prisonner in hell, forced to battle for eternity to please the crowds of the Colosseum ! Wave after wave of enemies, you battle ancient warriors to the rythm of their songs.

details.title: Phoe
details.short_description: Phoe is a classic single-player platformer where chaining momentum is the key to speed; how fast you go is up to you. Master tight controls and refine your route through levels designed to push your platforming skills to the limit.

details.title: Trigonometric Equations
details.short_description: Trigonometric Equations is a strict side-scrolling rhythm game. Solve the trigonometric equations to fly through fleeting points and curves perfectly!

details.title: Lunar Lakes
details.short_description: Who said death is the end? In Lunar, death is just the start. Catch mysterious creatures, uncover wandering merchants’ stories, make new friends, and build your own trading empire. All of it happens in the corner of your screen. Still think death is the end?

details.title: Shadow Runner
details.short_description: The first FPS where enemies are invisible? You see only their shadows. To fight, you must follow the light—control it, even create it. With one gun, fireflies, and fireworks, survive a little longer. A minimalist system with unexpected depth. An FPS poem about light, shadow, architecture, and memory

details.title: Mira - Shadow of the Past
details.short_description: Travel. Go back. Erase your regrets.

details.title: Roll For Damage!
details.short_description: A light dice-based dungeon crawl. Roll numerous dice and see fortunes expand across various distinct stages.

details.title: Paranormal Research Society
details.short_description: Build a career as a paranormal field researcher in an exciting horror comedy about finally getting a job and gunning down ghosts while performing menial labor for your infuriating boss.

details.title: Recovered Occurrence
details.short_description: A new home owner documents his experience moving to Frailrock, unaware of the many unsetting events he would begin to witness there.

details.title: On Sight
details.short_description: On Sight is a love letter to classic shooters that drops players into high energy gunfights in arenas across the galaxy. Play with friends, strangers, or solo with bot support on every map.

details.title: Escape from Ashville
details.short_description: Loot, fight and extract — or lose everything. A high-risk extraction shooter focused on survival, tactical combat, and meaningful decisions.

name: Reunions with you billions of times

details.title: Reunions with you billions of times
details.short_description: This is a short, romance-focused visual novel where you play as a student. As you fall in love with your classmate Qiu, you become trapped in a time loop and die again and again. Together with Qiu, you must search for a way to break the loop, with your choices leading to different endings.

details.title: ZHITEN
details.short_description: Some villages aren't just abandoned, they are cursed. Zhiten, a victim of clashing cults, awakens from its slumber with Nikolay's return. While Nikolay searches for traces of the past, he will be forced to meet the village's new owners.

details.title: Mad MOJO
details.short_description: Mad MOJO is a monster-catching deckbuilder with a deep, fourth-wall-breaking meta game hidden beneath the surface. Hunt for the legendary Prime MOJO with poker-inspired hands. Break the game by tackling puzzles in an in-game PC. But beware of the MOJO hiding just beyond your reach...

details.title: 6RAVITY CUBE
details.short_description: “Novel 6-direction gravity puzzle‑action game!” Packed with diverse gimmicks — experience intuitive yet strategically deep puzzle‑solving!

details.title: Reaction
details.short_description: Fly your ship though a derelict space station in this action/puzzle 2D platformer as you avoid hazards, repair your ship back to working condition and uncover the mysteries within. What awaits inside and can you get out again?

details.title: Humanity's Fall
details.short_description: Explore the world of Humanity's Fall, a fantasy farming sim. Interact and build a community with the world's next apex lifeform. Build your farm and rediscover lost flora as you discover the world's lore.

details.title: Crosstown
details.short_description: An overload of 8-bit-style action mayhem, Crosstown hands you a toga and a gun, and lets you loose in an ever-changing maze full of monsters and explosions! 40 levels, up to 4 players, and an endless mode!

details.title: Serenity
details.short_description: A zen gliding and exploration game with procedurally generated music

details.title: Subway Story
details.short_description: A narrative-driven exploration game set in the New York City subway, where you ride trains, interact with strangers, and make choices that shape how the city's underbelly responds.

details.title: One More Potato
details.short_description: One More Potato is a cozy organizing simulator where you sort over 2,000 potatoes into their correct places across a countryside farm. Pick up potatoes, complete collections, unlock helpful upgrades, and turn a messy farm into a perfectly organized potato paradise, solo or with friends.

details.title: Times and Ages
details.short_description: Lead one of 82 nations from antiquity to modern times: found cities, research 122 technologies, build world wonders and win through conquest, science, culture, religion or diplomacy – turn-based on living 3D maps with seasons and weather.

details.title: PixelHeroLegend
details.short_description: Build a team of heroes in this pixel-art idle RPG. Collect equipment, adjust tactics, explore regions, and take on enemies in automatic battles.

details.title: Tanks 2026
details.short_description: A tank battle in the spirit of old 8-bit games. Hold the base across 35 stages or in RANDOM mode, where enemies hunt you down. Clear stages clean to earn rewards you keep for good. Play solo or with a friend, in pixel art or HD.

details.title: Don't Sell the Cat
details.short_description: Seven nights behind the counter of a pawnshop that opened in 1958. Check what people bring in with a loupe, a UV lamp, a scale and the shop cat. Pay the rent. The ledger writes lines you didn't write, and someone knocks on the back shutter after closing. Don't open it.

details.title: Lights Out Pact
details.short_description: Lights Out Pact is a multiplayer hide-and-seek game. Everyone hides a random item in a freshly generated room, then searches for others'. You can't take your own. Miss an item and lose a body part. Last one standing wins. Modes: find everything, hunt your target, or last one to find loses.

details.title: The Dungeon
details.short_description: An idle RPG in pixels: your hero fights, shops and descends on its own, even while you are away, through 600 floors in three realms. On Mythic every archfoe has an ability of its own, and you fight it yourself. Twelve classes, no ads, money only buys looks.

details.title: MAGOS
details.short_description: Master your spells and stay one step ahead of your rivals in simultaneous turn-based wizard duels. Combine elements that react with each other and transform the environment, unleashing chaotic battles. Discover powerful combos that could wipe out your enemies... or backfire on you!

details.title: My Tennis Story
details.short_description: 🎾 Learn real tennis tactics and choose your shots. 🤝 Train, make friends and shape Mateo’s story. 🏆 Climb the leagues and win a tennis scholarship before he turns 16.

details.title: Sluismaker
details.short_description: Build a blocky warship in your own dry dock, flood the dock and hope it floats, then sail out and sink the enemy. Real buoyancy and flooding physics, cannons, rams and grenades, and crews of up to 5 per side online, over LAN or against AI captains.

details.title: Strange Plains
details.short_description: Roam as a buffalo through seven strange eras in this single-player action roguelite. Graze to survive, restore the prairie, and protect a growing herd. Face hunters, cryptids and visitors from above, then carry your surviving family home to the Wallow.

details.title: 纸牌矿工
details.short_description: Card Miner is a casual strategy game blending poker, resource gathering, and deck building. Play cards to earn points and rewards, collect wood, grass, and ore to buy upgrades, and use special cards and multipliers to maximize earnings within limited plays on your way to a million coins.

details.title: Lily's Little Golf Game
details.short_description: Party golf for up to four players, all on the same hole at once. Race to the cup on wild mini golf courses, sabotage your rivals on the open links, or turn your clubs into weapons in the battle arena. Play on one screen or play online. You can even build your own minigolf courses!

details.title: Brilliancy!!
details.short_description: Solve real chess puzzles in a roguelike where chess skill drives the score. Seat Tutors and upgrades that reward forks, sacrifices and quiet moves, beat each Set’s Target, outlast Bosses and hunt for the hidden Brilliancy. No invented pieces, no bent rules: the best chess is always rewarded.

details.title: Mutoid 2
details.short_description: Fight east through mutant hordes in a top-down survival shooter where heads pop and limbs come off. Revive fallen allies to fight beside you until the infection turns them back. Find and unlock an arsenal of guns, gear and perks to power your next run.

details.title: Perfect Ninja Painter 2
details.short_description: This ninja master is back in action in the second installment of this fast-paced, vibrant puzzle-platformer - and this time, he’s brought a friend along.

details.title: Perfect Ninja Painter 3
details.short_description: New part of the puzzle platformer about ninja painters

details.title: Perfect Ninja Painter 4
details.short_description: Slide, paint, and outsmart every level in this new installment of a vibrant ninja-themed puzzle-platformer!

details.title: Final Kastle
details.short_description: Orc hordes march on your castle wave after wave. Man the cannons, call down lightning, freeze the field and fight on the walls, alone or with up to 16 players online, in a third-person castle defense shooter with a living castle to explore.

name: Bricks in Place: Tidy Up the Manor!

details.title: Bricks in Place: Tidy Up the Manor!
details.short_description: Build a miniature manor in this relaxing first-person building sim. Find the right pieces in a mountain of bricks, follow 3D blueprints, and bring six buildings to life with a helpful cat. Build solo or team up in co-op for up to four players.

details.title: Alchemist's Codex
details.short_description: Run a small alchemy shop and discover recipes by experiment. Grind, boil, distill and brew real ingredient properties, not fixed recipes. Take commissions, buy from the merchant, gather in your yard, and fill your Codex on the way to becoming a master alchemist.

details.title: Arcana Clash
details.short_description: A 2–6 player tarot card battler. Each of the 78 cards has two faces — upright and reversed — and you choose which one to unleash every time you play. Strike, curse, or turn the whole table upside down, and outlast your rivals before the Clock of Fate swallows everyone.

details.title: Dig Up
details.short_description: You are Elliot: broke, jobless, out of options. You sign up for a contest with a huge prize and wake up 48 meters underground with a shovel in your hand. Dig, sell, buy ladders and crack the door code hidden in the notes of those who never made it out. The cameras are always watching.

details.title: SARUR
details.short_description: SARUR is a single-player action adventure in a royal steampunk city above the clouds. Find out what happened.

details.title: 万仙
details.short_description: 开局即挂机，招募弟子、炼丹炼器、闯秘境占世界——一款桌面修仙放置网游。

details.title: Pinball Bonanza Live
details.short_description: Run a live stream from your garage and build a seven-floor pinball machine with your viewers’ donations. Flip, nudge and chase multiball while chat cheers you on — then automate it all in a hands-on incremental pinball game.

name: サッカークラブ運営をやろう！

details.title: サッカークラブ運営をやろう！
details.short_description: 監督になって草サッカーリーグからワールドリーグの頂点を目指すサッカークラブ運営シミュレーション。練習を選び、メンバーと作戦を決めたら、あとは選手たちを信じて見守ろう！

details.title: The Garden of Forgotten Blooms
details.short_description: A watercolor gothic idle RPG. Build a party of 42 flower-named companions, enjoy automatic battles and offline rewards, and explore a 15-chapter story. Japanese and Chinese character voices. No microtransactions.

details.title: Neon Turf
details.short_description: A cyberpunk auto-battler where you buy buildings, not units. Build noodle bars, clubs and clinics. They earn cash each round, and some send fighters to battle rival gangs. Buying the same building multiple times levels it up. Clubs draw police attention, which results in police raids on your base.

details.title: SEA CATCH
details.short_description: Look, think, catch! SEA CATCH is a cute, fast-paced ocean puzzle game where shapes and colors hold the key. Make quick choices, build combos in the 60-second challenge, beat your best score, and unlock 10 adorable Sea Friends!

details.title: Break Even
details.short_description: You owe your boss a billion dollars. Smash repossessed furniture with a hammer, set off chain reactions, and spend the coins on bigger hammers and upgrades in this active incremental roguelite. Can’t make the payment? You’re fired.

details.title: Carry Crew
details.short_description: “We can fit one more!” Pick your cargo, stack it high, and grab opposite ends of the board in this physics-based co-op delivery game for two. Take tight turns together and count down to each jump. The finish line is in sight, and the top box just started to slide.

details.title: Maiden Taskbar
details.short_description: A little adventure begins at the bottom of your screen. Keep this idle RPG running above your taskbar and build a squad of maidens from 100+ cards across five races.

details.title: Catnip Wars : Labyrinth
details.short_description: Drop into a Necronazi labyrinth with up to three friends, or a squad of Catbot companions. Your weapons fire on their own: you steer, dodge and pick upgrades. Fight to the stairs at the centre of every floor, twenty floors down, before the Oberst comes for you. Then keep going.

details.title: I, TANK
details.short_description: The machines have taken over the world. Blast them all with WW2-era tanks and take back our cities, with heavy metal playing in the Background. A stylized survivors-like with interesting mechanics. Play with historic tanks such as the T-34 or the Tiger 1, or make your own tank in the workshop.

details.title: Jungle Survivors
details.short_description: Survive the wild jungle in this pixel-art action survival adventure! Battle deadly creatures, unlock powerful abilities, command animal companions and defeat colossal bosses across five unique chapters. Gather the cure and save your village!

details.title: 101 Cats: Hamburg
details.short_description: Join this adventure and discover the hiding places of 101 kittens 🐾 in the hand-crafted Hamburg landscape. 🏆 Earn lots of achievements. How many 😺 can you find? 🔎 Be quick! ⏱️

details.title: Bubble Tea Simulator
details.short_description: Run a cozy little bubble tea café with up to six friends. Cook the pearls, shake the drinks and keep the queue smiling, then close up, pile into bed and wake up ready to open your next branch. Play solo or in online co-op.

details.title: Bottom Feeders: Crab Crew
details.short_description: Haul up crab pots with 1–6 friends in this silly co-op crabbing game. Throw pots off the pier, pull up 37 kinds of ridiculous crabs, sell them, and trade your leaky rowboat for a solid gold yacht. Or just shove your crew into the sea.

details.title: Globus: Geography Quiz
details.short_description: Explore the world on an interactive 3D globe and test your geography knowledge across countries, capitals, flags, landmarks, mountains, rivers, seas and more. Play in TYPE, SELECT, GUESS or HINT modes and improve your skills round by round.

details.title: Attrition
details.short_description: A real-time strategy game of tanks, subs, jets and infantry at war across land, sea and air. Command thousands of units, fight up to 10 players or AI commanders, and build your own units, maps and factions with the same editors the game was made with.

details.title: Do A Kickflip
details.short_description: Skate an endless city that builds itself as you ride. Flip, grab and grind across three lanes of street, chain tricks into huge combos, and ride from sunset into midnight. One more run is always one kickflip away.

details.title: Vestige
details.short_description: Vestige is a fast-paced action roguelite built for solo and co-op play. Pick your class, craft absurdly powerful builds, chase game-changing loot, and survive increasingly brutal trials. **Get stronger. Break the game. Push further.

details.title: TechStop Simulator
details.short_description: Prepare for an immersive retro arcade & game shop management experience. Take control of your very own TechStop! Stock your shelves with games and arcade classics, set prices, manage payments, hire staff, expand & design your store to attract more customers. Stay ahead in competitive local market!

details.title: Bloodsmith
details.short_description: A fierce, action-packed narrative RPG; Play as Quentin Ashborne, the archaeologist whose duty has brought him to fight tooth and nail against the damned souls. If you are to survive, you must learn to manage & manipulate blood. Ride the downward spiral.

details.title: Wayfarer Of Hydrangea
details.short_description: 一名离职原画师，驾驶着豪车的网约车司机江芊华；外表单纯可爱，自称辣妹可爱却粘人，为了追上芊华不顾一切的少女南绣玉。围绕着VTB“紫阳”，一个美丽动人，正如盛放的绣球花般的恋爱故事即将展开。以视觉小说方式呈现的多个结局，描绘极致的百合恋爱，欢迎来到热烈的7月——

name: Life of a Lonely Indie Game Developer

details.title: Life of a Lonely Indie Game Developer
details.short_description: "Create the games you want, at the time you want, and live doing only what you love." In this realistic life simulation game, an independent game developer dreams of such a life, struggling with money and time while paying taxes until death. Whether this life is happy or truly lonely, you decide.

details.title: METACRAFT: Arena
details.short_description: METACRAFT: Arena — an online action RPG with a wide selection of melee and ranged weapons, PvE and PvP raids, leveling and build customization, clan activities, base upgrades, crafting, player trading, and much more!

details.title: Byte Survivor
details.short_description: Bank balance: ¥0. Shut-in gamer El, lured by her pet robot Puruya, picks up a shady part-time job inside a video game. A tinker-heavy survivors-like: runs of about 10 minutes, simple controls, screen-melting hordes. Earn, build, and uncover more of the story with every run.

name: Three Kingdoms: The Legend of Zhuge Kongming HD2D

details.title: Three Kingdoms: The Legend of Zhuge Kongming HD2D
details.short_description: This HD-2D role-playing game pays tribute to the beloved Three Kingdoms RPGs of the classic console era. Follow the journey of Liu Bei, Guan Yu, Zhang Fei, and Zhuge Liang as you recruit legendary heroes, travel across ancient China, and experience a grand tale of war, loyalty, and ambition.

details.title: Playable Alpha
details.short_description: As researcher with great ambitions, and lack of talent, you are sent to a newly discovered planet far away from civilization. In this VR first person survival, you will need to build an outpost and survive the hostile environment. While exploring the planet, unveiling its secrets.

details.title: ForgeCraft
details.short_description: Explore, craft, fight and develop an automated technological civilization complete with airships and robotic drones!

details.title: Dungeon Baller
details.short_description: Pinball meets RPG in this fast-paced roguelike. Launch tiny heroes, battle bumper enemies, and choose your fate through mystery doors. Wield hundreds of powerful items and defeat bosses to reclaim your soul in this retro-inspired reimagining of pinball.

details.title: Light Dude
details.short_description: The level hides when you move in this skill-based action game. Scan the level, then step into the dark. Dodge deadly threats, outmaneuver enemies, and defeat brutal bosses to reclaim the stolen sun. No map. No safety. Just your skill. Demo Out Now!

details.title: Blightwinter
details.short_description: Blightwinter combines push-your-luck deckbuilding with medieval town management. As leader of a fragile settlement, you must manage resources, assign townsfolk, and prepare for the relentless fall harvest before winter's chill and dark afflictions take hold.

details.title: Golden Trivia Show
details.short_description: Enter a quiz show solo or with friends. Divide your gold bars among the possible answers; those placed on a wrong answer will fall into a piranha pool. Will you make it to the end?

details.title: Wyrdtide
details.short_description: Sail your longship into the horde. A viking survival roguelite for 1–4 players: hold the helm while your crew fights on its own, raid island villages for new hands, carve runes as you level, and fell the warden that guards each sea's gate.

details.title: Rox Solid Pro Football
details.short_description: Choose your role (Owner, General Manager, Head Coach, Off/Def/ST Coordinator, or Position Coach), choose what you want to control (24 different settings across Scouting, Coaching, Front Office, and Game Management groupings), and play as many seasons as you want.

details.title: EverPet
details.short_description: Get up to mischief with your finite friend. Care or consequence? It's your choice!

details.title: Beefarunna
details.short_description: The alien invasion has subsided, and Ash has to get off the couch to buy some groceries. Unfortunately, the El Camino broke down on the way to the MeggaMart. Run, jump, and slide your way to a complete cowbell collection in Beefrunna (or: Super Beefarena).

details.title: Board Dynasty
details.short_description: Buy properties and collect rent. Choose a mode before each match. In Weather, send asteroids at a rival’s hotel. In Flip Side, turn the board over to swap property values. Play solo, share one PC with up to four players, or play online in supported modes.

details.title: CartWare
details.short_description: An incremental game where you go from a single-product online store up to global e-commerce domination. Manage your inventory, fulfill and ship customer orders, deal with suppliers, and expand your storefront across a retro desktop operating system, and become the world's #1 online retailer.

name: Fishing Cat - An Incremental Fishing Game

details.title: Fishing Cat - An Incremental Fishing Game
details.short_description: Fishing Cat - An Incremental Fishing Game is an active incremental game where you cast your line, reel in the big catches, and build your fortune one fish at a time.

details.title: Final Armada
details.short_description: Build ships block by block, command your fleet in real-time space battles, and choose your path through a roguelike campaign. Upgrade your ships, watch them break apart in combat, and uncover what happened to the galaxy around you.

name: お洒落無限ループ　すごろくドリフター

details.title: お洒落無限ループ　すごろくドリフター
details.short_description: Stylish Infinite Loop! Sugoroku Drifter is a roguelike where you build the board itself as your deck and aim for each stage's target score. Customize pieces, collect Relics from bosses, and find powerful combinations to overcome ever-tougher goals!

details.title: Linwu: Spirit Beast Ranch
details.short_description: Summon a spirit beast, raise it week by week, and take it up the tournament cups. It has a mind of its own, and every choice shapes how long you get together. A monster-raising sim drawn from Chinese myth. Free demo out now.

details.title: Verdict
details.short_description: Trapped in a high-stakes interrogation room, you must defend your innocence against an adaptive AI detective. Every answer is evaluated in real time—watch your words, because your own claims can convict you.

details.title: Toast Cat: Scratch & Win
details.short_description: Raise a Toast Cat on your desktop that spits out all sorts of scratch cards. Whatever you're doing, it hops along with you; once it's earned enough affection, it'll pull out a scratch card just for you. No need to watch it constantly — scratch one in a spare moment and unwind.

details.title: Redraft FC
details.short_description: A football management game about hindsight. Inherit a real club exactly as it was, tear the squad up, and sign the players you now know were going to be great - at what they cost then. Play it forward season by season. Seven ways to play, from managing a club to being a pundit.

details.title: BROODHOUSE
details.short_description: Your deck is alive and it breeds. A creature card hits for its whole strain's population, so your power sits in the cards you never draw. Push past carrying capacity and the overflow turns feral in your hands. A roguelike deckbuilder about a colony that grows faster than you can hold it.

details.title: Wheel Street
details.short_description: Wheel Street is a roguelike deckbuilder on a circular board. Move and merge assets, combine strategy cards, and build a money-making machine. Grow on down days, cash in on up days, and unleash combos to beat rising weekly targets.

name: Chronicles of Ellusus I: The Dark Unknown

details.title: Chronicles of Ellusus I: The Dark Unknown
details.short_description: A single player retro roleplaying game that seeks to blend the best elements of well loved games of old with modern design and gameplay sensibilities. Explore a living world, prevent a looming civil war, and learn the secrets of a growing darkness.

details.title: 弹珠之王
details.short_description: Pull the plunger, build powerful combinations, and chase your next comeback in this single-player pinball adventure. The free demo includes 4 chapters and 20 stages, ending at national training camp selection. In-game text is Simplified Chinese only.

details.title: STEEL WING: WEAVEBREAKER
details.short_description: In 2091, the military AI Weave has taken the skies. Three pilots fight on three lanes at once — and back aboard the carrier, they share the hours away from the battlefield with you. Every word you say quietly changes where you stand with them.

details.title: Dungeon Architect: Idle
details.short_description: Build a dungeon that works for you. Combine traps and monsters, crush waves of heroes, and turn their gold and souls into ever more powerful upgrades. An incremental idle game about automation, synergies, and just one more upgrade.

details.title: Skyvar Idle
details.short_description: An online idle RPG among floating sky islands. Sail your airship between the Sundered Isles, gather and craft while you're away, and let automated combat carry you through dungeons with friends. Build a guild island, trade in player-run halls and take down world bosses together.

details.title: Resign to Ascend
details.short_description: A xianxia adventure made by someone who'd had enough of work. Enter the immortal mountains of your childhood dreams. Learn spells, hunt mythical beasts, brew elixirs, forge gear, and raise your own soulbound treasure. Screw work. Let's go cultivate! Quit waiting and add it to your wishlist!

name: She's Coming Over & My Place is a Dump!

details.title: She's Coming Over & My Place is a Dump!
details.short_description: The crush of your dreams is coming over tonight, but your apartment is an absolute dump! Clean up the mess, wash the dishes, and organize every room in this cozy - first-person cleaning simulator. Turn your chaotic mess into a welcoming home before she arrives!

name: Minato Shokudo: Mirage of the Great Clam

details.title: Minato Shokudo: Mirage of the Great Clam
details.short_description: A cozy Japanese cooking game where you play a ghost with a diner to run and no sense of taste. So you cook everything by the book. Then you row the food across the harbor while it's hot. All 50 dishes come with a real recipe to try at home. One foggy night, the lighthouse goes dark.

details.title: Up the Great Oak
details.short_description: Pip, a tiny beetle in an acorn cap, climbs a giant oak to see the world. Every landing is a balancing act — center of gravity always wins.

details.title: Still Not Dead Yet
details.short_description: 'Still Not Dead Yet' is a suspenseful horror-thriller text story inspired by H. P. Lovecraft. In a dark mausoleum, a grieving professor performs an archaic ritual to resurrect his recently deceased wife. The ritual succeeds, setting him down an unforeseen path.

details.title: HUNGRY MART: Last Pick
details.short_description: In this game, you, who are not good at socializing, will work as a picker in a night supermarket and fulfill online shopping orders to avoid face-to-face interactions with people. However, this may not seem like a good choice.

details.title: GridPi: Defense 3014
details.short_description: Dice poker × auto battler × 1–4 player co-op defense. In GridPi, you roll five dice to make poker hands, combine units, and line up synergies to hold back the incoming waves of enemies. What matters isn't luck — it's judgment. Build all kinds of combos and claim victory.

details.title: Plunder Isles
details.short_description: Plunder isles is a co-op adventure game about looting cursed ancient temples on the high seas for fun and profit.

details.title: Slap the Curse
details.short_description: A co-op horror game about a curse you pass on with a slap. Only the marked one can see what is walking towards them. Find the cursed doll and burn it before dawn - in a town that is different every night.

details.title: Knockstep
details.short_description: Knock on anything! A cozy little rhythm game where you knock real stuff around you—mugs, desks, even your belly. Your mic listens to every beat while the town animals get to work. Drop in your own songs and they become brand-new stages.

details.title: sons of infinite dawn
details.short_description: A medieval grand strategy game in a living, fair world. Play in real time with pause or turn based as every nation follows the same rules and adapts to changing needs. Choose your own path, see the consequences clearly, and uncover deeper strategy with every campaign.

details.title: The Last Ace - Blackjack Roguelike
details.short_description: Blackjack Roguelike. 3 lives, 60 levels, 12 bosses.

details.title: Next, Million Worlds
details.short_description: Expand your civilization to an empire of a million worlds. Balance production and logistics, experiment with economy mods, but don't sweat it. This is the age of expansion; growth is inevitable. This is a relaxed incremental experience where you can optimize and experiment, but you can't lose.

details.title: Diviper
details.short_description: A snake game where your tail is a math puzzle. Scoop up numbers, line them up, and watch matching ones merge — 2, 4, 8, 16, boom. Stuck? Just divide your way out. (Your mermaid buddy will help ;P )

details.title: Wuxing Realm
details.short_description: A five-element strategic idle game. Build teams from Warriors, Equipment, and Spells — kick back with auto-battles or take command and cast spells mid-fight. The right combo unleashes power beyond the numbers. What's your strongest lineup?

details.title: Upstart Tycoon
details.short_description: An incremental tycoon about getting rich in a crooked city. Play as a thief, a dirty cop, a 9–5 worker or a suburban teen, and climb from nobody to the person Port Vesper can't function without. Every run, the city you left behind has changed.

details.title: Tower of Trials and Wishes
details.short_description: Conquer a 100-floor tower together with the adorable final boss! Simple is best — a hack-and-slash, field-less RPG!

details.title: Shatterbelt
details.short_description: A short incremental asteroid shooter. Blast rocks that crack and split, scoop up their gems and spend them on a tree of 100+ upgrades where every level counts. Break the belt in an evening, then keep diving: Endless, branching roguelite Expeditions and a prestige that pays you for depth.

details.title: Still on Display
details.short_description: Ten nights alone in a clothing store. Finish the closing chores, compare the displays with your security tablet, and watch for changes in the mannequins. Decide whether the night was normal. A wrong call sends the calendar back to day one.

details.title: OVERDRIVE
details.short_description: Drive the all-female rock band VELOURIA from Sapporo to Fukuoka in this road-trip dating sim. Plan your stops, sell merch, and choose who to spend time with after each show. A late-night talk could spark a romance. Your choices shape how the tour ends.

details.title: Ninja Survivors: Bloodmoon
details.short_description: A ninja survival roguelite beneath a blood moon. Cut through demon hordes, combine weapons and evolve your techniques. Escape with a decoy dash, unleash a fireball-spewing staff and defeat the bosses of eight chapters on your way to the cursed shogun.

details.title: Wheel of Growth
details.short_description: Wheel of Growth is a chance based incremental game about spinning a wheel to earn cash, and then upgrading the wheel to earn bigger.

details.title: Rubblebound
details.short_description: Rubblebound is a minimalist idle game with roguelite elements. Unleash the balls, build skills, break bricks, upgrade, repeat. And see your power grow in this incremental game.

details.title: Dungeon Wizard
details.short_description: Hover, pop, upgrade, repeat! Pop!Corn is a pixel-art incremental game about turning a handful of kernels into a popcorn frenzy. Unlock five flavors, grow a branching skill tree, and build better cooking gear until every batch bursts with rewards.

details.title: GAEKGWI
details.short_description: A first-person horror game rooted in Korean folklore. Navigate a village whose paths change with each visit. Learn how its ghosts hunt, conserve your lantern oil, and use charms and ritual tools to escape danger—or fight back.

details.title: MODERN CAPITAL
details.short_description: Buy from suppliers or make it yourself? MODERN CAPITAL is a business simulation of production, retail, and investment. Run factories and stores, compete on price, quality, and brand, and expand through stocks, real estate, and company acquisitions.

details.title: SHAFT HAPPENS
details.short_description: Your shift goes down. Your quota goes up. Scavenge haunted workplaces, throw loot into the elevator and escape before the doors close. Co-op horror for 1–4 players, with upgrades, suspicious colleagues and a company that values its equipment more than you.

details.title: DAYSOWN
details.short_description: Learn a trade, earn your first wages, and save for a place of your own. DAYSOWN is a single-player life sim of hands-on jobs, village crafts, growing food, and making a living one day at a time.

details.title: Splicers
details.short_description: Splicers is a party shooter with silly game modes, tough challenges, and a huge roster of characters and weapons. Bring your friends, add some bots, change the rules, and build your own maps and missions to share with the world.

details.title: Double Empty Device
details.short_description: The Double Empty Device will play a note for you to play back. It may not be in the same position or appearance as when it originally played. Play the one that originally played in its new position or appearance. Continue to do so for as long a song as your skills of perception and memory permit.

name: Jewel Match Solitaire Winterscapes 4 - Collector's Edition

details.title: Jewel Match Solitaire Winterscapes 4 - Collector's Edition
details.short_description: Winter magic is in the cards! Bundle up for a Solitaire adventure across countless crafted levels and restore a glittering kingdom of ice and frost. Stand up to a scheming snowman, outrun a quick-footed hare and grab your mallet and pick to crack thick pack ice.

details.title: Hurlyburly
details.short_description: Throw swords. Fall. Pick a card. Come back meaner. Hurlyburly is a top-down party brawler for 2–8 players where dying is how you upgrade and 150+ stacking cards turn every match into chaos.

details.title: UB Mash 3
details.short_description: Make number go up! A cozy incremental match 3 game.

name: 漢字でポン! 合体漢字パズルゲーム

details.title: 漢字でポン! 合体漢字パズルゲーム
details.short_description: A kanji-themed puzzle game recreating the "Gattai Kanji" (kanji-combining) quiz popular online. Combine kanji to clear all kinds of quiz-style challenges! Place a kanji on a neighboring panel and a new kanji is born. Top, bottom, side, diagonal, overlapping: the kanji's own shape is the rule.

details.title: Sleighline
details.short_description: Every Christmas Eve, the same old job, in a much bigger world. Santa’s magic now bends time and opens portals, but the presents still go in by hand, so he flies low: over rooftops, through a pharaoh’s tomb, across the outback. Two buttons, seven courses, one perfect line: TRUE SANTA.

details.title: 寄念：手影信使
details.short_description: Your hands are the controller. Raise them to the light, and their shadows become bridges and walls in a paper world. Guide a halo-crowned spirit carrying longing to its recipient — freeze shadows into ice, melt ink away, and shape the path with your own hands. A cozy hand-shadow puzzle game.

details.title: Touhou Dream Duel
details.short_description: Battle your way through a beautifully drawn Gensokyo in this unique fighting game inspired by the classics from the Touhou Project franchise.

details.title: Claybound
details.short_description: A platformer made of clay. Knead your own path by shaping play dough into ramps, bridges and boulders.

details.title: Salticidae Story
details.short_description: A cosy jumping-spider keeping game. Feed them, mist them, and help them through every moult. Breed lines through a 120-trait genome and six species, catch wild jumping spiders, beetles, roaches and mantises, dress your Keeper, and play online with friends.

details.title: OVERCHESS
details.short_description: You are a pawn in an endless but not always fair chess world. Enslave your enemies and turn them into slaves. Build your own army. On the path to glory you will face alcoholism, alligators and ludomania. Test your luck in OVERCHESS.

details.title: Magically Sorted
details.short_description: Tidy up a magical shop by sorting scattered potions, ingredients, and books back onto their shelves, uncovering curious lore behind them as you go. Brew potions in the cauldron to unlock magical skills and find lost recipes for legendary potions, while enjoying the shop's relaxing atmosphere.

details.title: Dawn's Wake
details.short_description: Awaken as a memory-stripped supreme master in a twisted jianghu. Shatter the world's cursed formations, master strategic wuxia combat where one right technique turns the tide, and reclaim your lost throne — while idle progress and a living martial world carry on even when your sword rests.

details.title: The Outpost: Outer Frontier
details.short_description: Lead the forces of a human empire in a brutal squad-based RTS. Capture territory, fortify the frontier and crush the alien swarm in a story campaign, survival operations or online co-op for up to four players.

details.title: 超时空怪盗
details.short_description: 是架空世界冒险喜剧！！！你将化身一位土著人，与一位来自20年后的少女一起组成跨时空搭档，前往未来世界冒险并搜集传说中能改变一切的宝物！本作是一款搞笑游戏，目的就是逗笑你让你开心！因此在冒险过程中，你会遇到各种各样让人啼笑皆非的事。 千万不要在喝水的时候游玩本作哦！不然你就………………不渴了呢……

details.title: SOS! Love~Controlled
details.short_description: [SOS! Love~Controlled] is a live-action interactive romance game. You wander into a bar called "SOS" and meet three girls: Hiyori, a rich closet otaku; Naomi, the gentle yet dangerous owner; and Ruina, a withdrawn lolita. A casual night out slowly turns into something far more mysterious.

details.title: PATIENCE IS A VIRTUE
details.short_description: Something's hiding in the cassette. Rearrange the words of your enemies to investigate a small-town conspiracy in this mystery puzzle game.

details.title: PolyFarm
details.short_description: PolyFarm is a relaxing and satisfying farm simulator in isometric view.

details.title: Cosmic Crumbs: Bakery Simulator
details.short_description: Build and run your own bakery in space as orders start stacking up. Keep the machines moving, prepare sweet treats, manage your robot helpers, and turn your little shop into the galaxy’s busiest bakery — solo or with friends.

name: 汪里个狼 Wolf in Woof

details.title: 汪里个狼 Wolf in Woof
details.short_description: Wolf in Woof is a single-player Werewolf game where wolves hide among cute dog NPCs. Through speech, suspicion, alliances, voting, and deduction, players must uncover the hidden wolves—enjoying tense mind games without matchmaking or social pressure.

details.title: VCR83
details.short_description: VCR83 is a psychological horror game where you monitor security cameras and report strange anomalies.

details.title: Junebug
details.short_description: Junebug is a cat companion and cozy building game. Create charming little spaces, make them your own, then experience what you’ve built through your cat. Explore, play, relax, and enjoy the little moments you create together.
