details.title: Magical Girl Taboo Village
details.short_description: The girls awaken in a mysterious village cursed by flowers. Every night at 8 PM, one girl is chosen as a sacrifice to the Kamibana—and hanged. Unravel the village’s tangled mysteries and sever the ritual’s endless cycle. A magical girl × folk-horror suspense visual novel from Acacia.

details.title: The Floral Princes
details.short_description: A dark fantasy otome RPG where cursed Floral Princes fight against the corruption consuming their kingdom. Build romantic bonds, make meaningful choices, collect powerful cards, and battle through a cinematic story-rich adventure.

details.title: Celestial Oath
details.short_description: Easy to Learn. Instantly Accessible. Simple Mechanics. Endless Possibilities. Epic Dungeons. Diverse Character Builds. Enter a world of ancient myths, legendary heroes, and timeless traditions. Join players from around the globe and discover the epic legends of the East.

details.title: Cthulhu Go Teaching
details.short_description: Go has never been so accessible! With Lord Cthulhu to guide you, playing Go becomes much more enjoyable. Whether you want to get started with Go, improve your skills, or tackle Life and death problems, Lord Cthulhu will keep you company forever!

details.title: BROKEN：Survivors  破界：幸存者
details.short_description: This is a fast-paced roguelike hack-and-slash game where weapons, characters, and skills can all be developed independently and freely combined to create your very own build!

details.title: Fairyland Online
details.short_description: Set in a beloved Fairyland universe, this charming MMORPG brings together iconic Fairyland characters, quests, and pets from around the world into a warm, whimsical fantasy adventure. The Global Edition is inviting players worldwide to join the adventure together!
developers: 雷爵網絡科技股份有限公司
publishers: 雷爵網絡科技股份有限公司

details.title: Tomboy: Muscle Inferno
details.short_description: Blast through thousands of biomechanical creatures and survive until extraction! Tomboy is a sci-fi casual rogue-lite where your choices shape devastating builds and overwhelming firepower against endless waves of horrors. Make bullet heaven real.

details.title: Five Laps at Freddy's
details.short_description: Welcome to Five Laps at Freddy's, The premier animatronic kart racing circuit featuring your favorite and lovable Fazbear friends! Sponsored by Fazbear Entertainment

details.title: Fate Trigger
details.short_description: Fate Trigger is a 3D Anime-style, hero-based tactical shooter powered by UE5, available across multiple platforms. Dive into a dynamic world of floating islands, become a sharpshooter with extraordinary special skills, and engage in thrilling, spectacular life-or-death showdowns!

details.title: Expedition: Into Darkness
details.short_description: Brave forbidden dungeons in a quest for knowledge and treasure in this medieval PvE co-op extraction looter. Craft weapons, customise gear and join forces with up to four allies. Survive the ruins together—or lose everything you carry.

details.title: Solaria
details.short_description: Collect various androids known as "Pvas" on the futuristic colony planet named "Solaria", deploy them for battles, construction, farming, crafting; pilot your own mobile base to explore the vast world. This is a brand-new, single player open-world survival and crafting game.

details.title: Verse Project
details.short_description: In this multiplayer game you have to explore the Solar System in real scale. Control spaceships of the near future, explore planets, moons and asteroids, mine resources, fight for space domination and build the future of the universe.

details.title: Descending Darkness
details.short_description: Descending Darkness is a co-op PvE shooter with up to 4 players. The world has been ravaged by solar flares. You wake up inside a bunker. While initially used for WWII, it is now a hideout against the mass infected. Your goal? To defend it at all costs.

details.title: Office Party
details.short_description: Office Party is a fully 3D edgy comedy adventure game inspired by classic comedies of the '90s, and also the long awaited sequel to House Party. Dive into the craziness and debauchery with all new characters, game mechanics and locations, and maybe a visit from some old party friends.

details.title: Orc Warchief: Prologue
details.short_description: Prologue version of Orc Warchief. Become an Orc warchief and fight for survival of your race. Rebuild your village and train your warriors. Gather resources and craft your weapons. Raise your warbanner and gather The Horde.

details.title: Glaciered
details.short_description: Soar the seas at the end of time. 65 million years in the future, the world has frozen over, and the oceans have been sealed under a thick layer of ice. Become a Tuai—a species that evolved from birds—and protect the Everwinter in this futuristic underwater action game.

details.title: GOMAN -stuck in the avici hell-
details.short_description: "Die fast, retry faster. GOMAN is a hardcore side-scrolling action game where memory and reflexes are your only weapons. Beat who you were 3 seconds ago!"

details.title: Nevrosa: Rescape
details.short_description: Nevrosa 2025 is a meticulously crafted VR puzzle/escape room game where players must solve numerous puzzles, battle mysterious creatures, and uncover a new Misty World.

details.title: Haunted House
details.short_description: You wake up in an eerie mansion, beside the one you love. To take her home, you face six lost souls — not enemies, but tragedies to understand. Each room hides a love never spoken. But when you think you've finally escaped, some truths only appear once you walk out the door.

details.title: Purble Place 3D
details.short_description: This is Purble Place 3D! - three exciting adventures in an updated classic! Create and win, just like in the good old days!

name: The Magic World 2: Curse of the Ancients

details.title: The Magic World 2: Curse of the Ancients
details.short_description: Party role-playing game. You control a squad of characters moving through an open game world. Collect items, complete quests, communicate with NPCs, try to survive, destroy enemies with various magic and weapons.

details.title: Arisen Force: Vonimir
details.short_description: Gather allies, fight the shadows, and uncover the secrets of Vonimir. In a land of pixel beauty and epic battles, your legend begins.

details.title: Whispers of the Luminaries Part 1
details.short_description: Uncover the truth behind an idol's disappearance, weeks before her debut. Whispers of the Luminaries is a narrative-driven game that blends a classic detective story with the dark side of the idol entertainment industry.

details.title: World of Anterra
details.short_description: The prophecy foretold your coming, Traveller, but are you here to save Anterra or yourself? Explore an expansive living world, with thriving towns, wild animals, and monster filled dungeons. Discover secrets, lore and mysteries, and uncover the truth about the Eye to become Anterra's Champion.

details.title: HARUKA: Beyond the Stars
details.short_description: HARUKA: Beyond the Stars is a juvenile sci-fi RPG about the intergalactic adventures of the protagonist, Yuuki, and a mysterious girl named Miiya. Set out on a spaceship and explore unique planets. Enjoy a thrilling adventure in the latest 3D anime art style.

name: Witchmarsh: Tea Party of the Damned

details.title: Witchmarsh: Tea Party of the Damned
details.short_description: Create and lead a team of four investigators in this action RPG set below Jazz Age New England.

name: Bamboo Spring: A Story Cast in Bronze

details.title: Bamboo Spring: A Story Cast in Bronze
details.short_description: After saving an exiled prince of the fallen State of Wei, you are granted an abandoned homestead. Farm the land, raise livestock, fish and hunt, forge bonds with the townsfolk, build a militia, and defend your home against invading forces.

details.title: Mainland
details.short_description: Enter a cooperative medieval realm, forge alliances, lead armies, and engage in epic battles. Shape history with dynamic politics, or test your mettle against others in fierce player-vs-player combat.

details.title: Rotoball
details.short_description: Rotoball is a challenging mouse-controlled action pinball game with a moving paddle and twin flippers. Rotate between four pinball tables, collect resources, complete orders and trigger weapons against waves of alien pests.

details.title: Mars Base Alley
details.short_description: Mars Base Alley is a cozy city-builder about creating the perfect little corner of humanity on the red planet—one alley at a time.

details.title: Cobblekin
details.short_description: Chop back the forest and grow a cozy village where every log, loaf and bucket is carried by busy little villagers. Raise families from tents to brick houses, catch the rain for the dry season, and hold your walls against orc raids.

details.title: One Billion Ducks
details.short_description: An incremental journey about duck hunting with your canine companions. Shoot rare ducks, sell them, upgrade your abilities, and collect one billion ducks to combat world hunger!

details.title: 你离开之后
details.short_description: 《你离开之后》是一款文字互动类乙女向游戏，再次醒来时你发现自已似乎已经是一缕魂魄了，你的爱人在你离开后变得敏感脆弱，而你的行为将会或直接或间接的影响到他，最终走向不同的结局。 一款美味的鳏夫文学，你的冷漠与无视会让向来冷静矜持的爱人在你面前发疯变得歇斯底里，你的捉弄会让他在梦里情难自已，你的一举一动都会让他改变，你离开之后，他活成了你的样子，或是你想要的样子。

details.title: KILL BREACH
details.short_description: KILL BREACH is a brutal, fast-paced roguelite FPS where relentless horde shooting meets infinite weapon upgrades. Break into a randomly generated facility where no two runs are the same. Turn yourself into a machine of mass destruction, and RIP apart anything that moves.

details.title: Skatebound
details.short_description: An action-packed 2.5D skateboarding RPG with stats, progression, and skate spots galore

details.title: Marmorea
details.short_description: Venture into the Tuscan village of Pietralba to solve the mystery of your brother’s disappearance. Uncover the dark secrets buried within the marble quarries and your own family's past.

details.title: D-Extinction
details.short_description: D-Extinction is a first-person investigative horror game. A secret experiment went too far. Now the pre-historic predators are loose. Explore, investigate, and survive in a immersive horror experience where one mistake can kill.

details.title: Bus Terminal Simulator
details.short_description: Experience an immersive terminal management simulator. Manage passengers, organize schedules, inspect luggage, catch smugglers, and prevent illegal activities. Not every passenger is innocent — some will try to trick you or smuggle illegal items. Stay alert and run your terminal efficiently.

details.title: LUBA
details.short_description: LUBA is a walking simulator with platforming elements. Explore a mysterious place and find your way using light and shadow.

details.title: Beyond Yardwork Simulator
details.short_description: Gardening has never been this rewarding! Use a full arsenal of tools – from lawnmowers to pressure washers – to transform properties and earn money to renovate your own home. With intuitive mechanics and beautiful visuals, it’s the perfect stress-free relaxation for everyone.

details.title: Curse Of The Abandoned Floor
details.short_description: Curse Of The Abandoned Floor is a first-person Chinese horror game. It starts with a paranormal video about an urban legend: "Beware the non-existent elevator mezzanine. If you enter it, you will be trapped forever."

details.title: 中等生
details.short_description: 这是一部中式校园（高三）为背景的百合向视觉小说。 只要考上大学，一切都会好起来吗？手牵着手，心跳扑通扑通，我们只是朋友吗？大家说只是开个玩笑，感到不舒服是正常的吗？想要挣脱母亲的期待，这是不孝吗？您将跟随主角周语桐，探索青春期的疑惑，帮她作出选择。

details.title: VoidHue
details.short_description: VoidHue is a top-down puzzle game that fuses classic sokoban mechanics with colorful light mechanics. Mix and match colors to phase through gates, activate light-based mechanisms and solve vibrant puzzles to bring back the color to the world.

details.title: Tactical Commanders R
details.short_description: Tactical Commanders R revives the classic large-scale sci-fi strategy warfare of the original Tactical Commanders. Command your forces, control the battlefield, and experience intense real-time strategic combat once again.

details.title: Farm Renovator
details.short_description: Buy a ruined farm and give it its full glory back. Clean, repair, restore, improve. Repair machines, manage the work on your farm, take care of your animals, and choose your development strategy. We're sure you'll have many satisfied customers.

details.title: Life After End
details.short_description: Dive into the harsh world of post-apocalyptic Siberia. Extreme climate, limited resources, wild animals, and other players - all this is part of the daily struggle, where only the strongest survive. Are you ready to find out what life is like after the end?

details.title: Autobahn Racing
details.short_description: No limits, no rules: 300 km/h on German autobahns and through authentic cities. Brutal street races, dense traffic, cops on your tail – pure adrenaline rush from Munich to Berlin.

details.title: Bunker Builder Simulator
details.short_description: Plan your work, dig a hole and build a bunker, that will survive anything! Manage safety, needs and moods of your clients, so you can become the best architect and earn a fortune. Will you be able to meet the expectations?

details.title: Jianghu Simulator
details.short_description: Simulated Jianghu is a role-playing game that blends sect-management mechanics with multiple playthroughs, high player freedom, and a gritty street-level wuxia style. A mobile-first launch is planned for 2025.

details.title: Island of Winds
details.short_description: Journey through a mystical 17th century Iceland inspired by authentic folklore and mythology. Play as Brynhildur, a young Balance Keeper who uses magic, empathy, and puzzle-solving to uncover ancient secrets and restore harmony to a fractured world.

details.title: Cube Party
details.short_description: Cube Party is a 2-8 player co-op puzzle and adventure game! Team up with friends, stack your box characters into walls, solve puzzles, overcome obstacles, and find the key to clear 40+ unique levels!

details.title: CRANE GAME QUEST
details.short_description: A simulation game that recreates the Japanese crane game experience. Feel the frustration of the arcade right at home. Use a variety of techniques to win prizes. Unlock prizes and stages as you master the crane game.

details.title: BB ADVENTURE
details.short_description: “BB ADVENTURE” is an immersive action game where you ride a real balance ball and clear athletic stages. Using a controller with an accelerometer, your balance ball’s movements control the in-game character, making you feel as if you’re inside the game.

details.title: Crack the Stone
details.short_description: Minimalist desktop idle game that lives in the corner of your screen. Upgrade the water flow from a single drop to a steady stream and keep wearing the stone down. Someday it will crack. Patience always wins.

details.title: Tidy Bakery
details.short_description: Your cozy bakery is a little… messy 🍰 Sort, organize, and put away about 3,000 freshly baked treats. Take your time, enjoy the cozy atmosphere, and turn bakery chaos into perfect order.

details.title: Magical Angel Princess Lynn
details.short_description: Flashy action with the adorable Princess Lynn! Fight against the mysterious invaders threatening the city.

details.title: 逃离蔡徐村
details.short_description: This is a kun-terrifying game developed by a Heizi. You play as an Ikun named Su Shan, trying to escape from Caixu Village, which is overrun by Kun Kun.

details.title: Cozymancer: Wizard Tower Restoration
details.short_description: Cozymancer is a chill organizing game where you restore a Wizard Tower. Learn spells, sort artifacts, clean up slime, restore furniture and bring the Tower back to its former glory!

details.title: That Damn Grass
details.short_description: A co-op lawn game where you start with a nail cutter. Play as a budget robot, cut an enormous lawn, collect the clippings and earn better tools while searching for a lost wedding ring. Work alone or with up to three friends. Yes, scissors are an upgrade.

details.title: Climbing Gym Manager
details.short_description: Build, set and run the climbing gym of your dreams. Shape every wall, reset routes zone by zone, and watch a cosy community grow, where every climber queues, projects, falls, cheers their friends on and tries again.

details.title: Crashborn
details.short_description: Lost and with no memories, cross a solar system to get back home. Tear through each planet's hordes to recharge your ship's energy and take off before the world turns lethal. Combine weapons, implants and anomalies until nothing can stop you. Every death rewrites your reality and your memory.

details.title: pieces/渡り鳥のソムニウム
details.short_description: 不愿入睡的少女，渴望长眠的少年。 当两人的梦重叠之时，传说将再度流转。 最终，与你一同坠入浅眠之国。

details.title: Buckaroo
details.short_description: A creature-breeding sim where you catch wild critters in an open world and breed them into absurd creations, with over 60 million combinations. Then take your critter down to the rodeo or the racetrack and climb the ranked circuit.

details.title: 文字生存守则
details.short_description: Amid info nodes, you’re a codebreaker—each choice shifts the story. Click nodes for clues, pull key details from text, crack codes, link logic. When all light up, truth emerges: unravel with reason, or get stuck in a thought labyrinth? It depends on your calls.

details.title: The Last Summons
details.short_description: A co-op dungeon action game. A calamity has woken beneath a village, and the last summons brought you here. In parties of up to 10, descend into ever deadlier depths, slay the bosses below, and bring back stronger weapons and lost powers — if you survive.

details.title: Casual Sokoban Pack
details.short_description: Casual Sokoban Pack is classic puzzle game where player is tasked to move pieces into their respective places. The game offers 300 levels with 5 difficulty levels divided into push only, pull only and mixed levels.

details.title: Multi Miner Madness
details.short_description: A mining party game for up to four players. Drill for ore, haul it up and sell it, then spend the money on bigger drills, bombs and rams. Play on one screen with friends on the couch, or online through Steam.

details.title: Galvanize Simulator
details.short_description: Manage a hot-dip galvanizing plant. Bid steel contracts, staff the pickle line and kettle, and run overhead cranes—auto or by hand. Upgrade plant equipment, optimize racks, expand your line, and ship coated loads on time without burning zinc or customers.

details.title: Santa's Workshop: Tidy Up Together!
details.short_description: A cozy first-person organizing game for 1-4 elves. The party wrecked Santa's workshop on Christmas Eve: sort thousands of toys, baubles and presents back onto the right shelves, solo or in online co-op. No timer, no way to lose, and when a room is spotless, every Christmas light comes on.

details.title: Auto Forge: Idle RPG Craft
details.short_description: Idle blacksmith RPG. Forge weapons from a wooden club to a plasma rifle across dozens of eras, gear up your hero and duel real players in the PvP arena. Your hero keeps battling while you're away — come back, collect the loot and forge something stronger.

details.title: Astral Wizards
details.short_description: Pick a wizard, walk into the swarm and let your spells fire on their own. A neon pixel-art bullet heaven with 30 worlds across 3 galaxies, laws that bend the rules, ENDLESS boss marathons and 13 wizards to master. Evolve 24 weapons into screen-filling light shows. No ads, no microtransactions.

name: 渊海群星：深海文明建设

details.title: 渊海群星：深海文明建设
details.short_description: Start with kelp and a settler in an icebound abyss. Gather, build, assign jobs, and survive the seasons. Research through ten eras, shape society, grow in faith, build wonders. Break the ice, explore stars, build megastructures. Grow a deep-sea civilization with idle play, challenges, and Prestige.

details.title: Deep Shaft
details.short_description: Sink your own mine shaft from bare land to the Earth's core. Dig by hand, then bring in excavators, dozers, haul trucks, hoists, rail and a tunnel boring machine. Every layer - sand, clay, granite, basalt, magma - fights back. Co-op for 1-8 players.

details.title: Not So Crazy Water World
details.short_description: Yes — we used 100% AI + Unreal Engine 5 to turn those fake 'Crazy Water World' ads into a real open-world survival RPG! Freely lay deck planks across the sea and build 2-storey structures on your ship, fish up 20 legendary companions, run a Urine Recycler, steer into 35° naval ramming & boarding battles, and raid 28 grand dungeons!

details.title: Dungeon Tavern
details.short_description: Mix drinks by day, explore the dungeon by night. A retro pixel-art tavern game for monsters: guests name a flavor and you mix it yourself, then take your lamp down floor by floor to gather ingredients, befriend monsters and turn a dusty dungeon tavern into a home for 68 regulars.

details.title: MOONWRIGHT
details.short_description: A lunar mining sim where the time lag is part of the game. A new Gold Rush has begun, and you are one of the first prospectors on the Moon. Drive a rover, find and mine lunar ores, and sell what you mine. Use money to upgrade the rover and Moon base. Receive new missions and try your luck there.

details.title: Can We Cook?
details.short_description: Get ready to run a chaotic restaurant with your friends! Three friends: one blind, one deaf, and one mute. One restaurant, endless misunderstandings! The one taking orders can't speak, the one who speaks can't hear, and the cook can't see! Work together to get the meals right!

details.title: Dokimon Frontier
details.short_description: The first FREE Dokimon experience: A Monster-Tamer Roguelike! Collect monsters, discover rare items, and battle to your heart's content.

details.title: Hose to Mars
details.short_description: Your mission is to terraform Mars. However, a crash landing destroyed all your gear leaving you with just a spoon! Start watering the soil with your spoon, earn MarsCoin, and upgrade your equipment. Turn the Red Planet green solo or with friends!

details.title: WHO'S LIVE?
details.short_description: Hide among NPCs and stream live! WHO'S LIVE? is an online stealth and deduction game for up to 4 players. Streamers earn donations while staying hidden, while Enforcers use livestream footage delayed by about 2 seconds to track them down. Play solo or with friends!

details.title: Grain Master
details.short_description: Enjoy a relaxing ASMR sorting experience in Grain Master! Sort grains one by one using chopsticks, upgrade your tools, improve your speed, and immerse yourself in a world of relaxation and enjoyment.

details.title: 검 강화하기
details.short_description: Hammer a rusty dagger into a legendary blade. Every press of the forge can succeed, fail or shatter your sword. Evolve 119 swords across elemental lines, sell high and reinvest, then take your blade into real-time 1v1 duels and race tournaments against other players.

name: We Can Get Stronger Without All the Hassle!

details.title: We Can Get Stronger Without All the Hassle!
details.short_description: After being cast out of your sect, you decide to grow stronger your own way. This idle cultivation game combines automatic combat, equipment progression, and combat skill builds. Train in twelve classes, refine it to higher tiers as you face hordes of monsters and powerful bosses.

details.title: Sort & Sorcery
details.short_description: Run a tiny magic shop at the edge of the woods. Every night a portal tips a mountain of potions, tomes, keys and curios onto the floor. Sort it all onto the right shelves before morning, chase off the thieving imp, and grow your little shop into the finest in the land.

details.title: Pixel Platoons
details.short_description: Lead your squad through explosive pixel-art missions across desert, tundra and jungle battlefields. Recruit, train and promote soldiers, compete for medals and global records, and live with every loss. Every soldier matters. Every death is permanent.

details.title: Dart Career Manager
details.short_description: Rise from a pub amateur to darts world champion. Train your trebles and doubles, throw every dart yourself or simulate, earn your tour card at Q-School and battle the stars on the Pro Tour. Manage money, staff, sponsors and rivals in a deep darts career manager.

details.title: Three Kingdoms: Chronicles of Generals
details.short_description: Rise as a warlord in the chaos of the late Han and unite the realm. Recruit from over 1,100 officers, build your strength through domestic affairs and espionage, then win turn-based battles on 3D hex battlefields with tactics and schemes. Duels and debates let a single officer turn the tide.

details.title: Kisaragi
details.short_description: A third-person shooter horror game inspired by the unsettling Japanese legend of the non-existent Kisaragi Station.

details.title: Corbaci: A Cozy Cinematic Horror
details.short_description: Run a cozy little soup shop haunted by unsettling stories. In Corbaci: A Cozy Cinematic Horror, uncover hidden mysteries and unlock every secret recipe. Serve the right soup from the Super Soup 2000.

details.title: Catgirl Rage: Claws of Fury
details.short_description: Demon invasion has shattered the dimensions, filling the world with corrupted souls. Cat girls with unique stories unite through friendship to restore balance by purifying souls and facing fierce bosses. An exciting and adorable side-scrolling action adventure!

details.title: NO STRAIGHT ROADS 2
details.short_description: Metronomik and Shueisha Games are thrilled to announce NSR2 – the explosive sequel to the hit action-music adventure NO STRAIGHT ROADS – coming to Steam in 2026.

details.title: Late Night Chats
details.short_description: In this game you play through a series of late night conversations within a dysfunctional friend group, while the narrator awkwardly judges every decision you make. It’s intense, suffocating, and a little unhinged. "I need to go back, I need to change my choices." - My Mom

details.title: Aliya: Timelink2 Dawn
details.short_description: A truth spanning time—connect with Aliya and meet diverse characters from 1,000 years later. In this real-time synchronized adventure, help her escape the Courtyard and team up to uncover the massive corporation’s hidden secrets...

details.title: Akina
details.short_description: Akina is an arcade drift game set in early-90s Japan. Drift down mountain passes, race friends online, and explore a peaceful summer countryside shaped by the golden age of Japanese street-racing culture.🗾🎌

details.title: Disquieted
details.short_description: Disquieted is a hand-drawn action platformer set between a dreamlike Naples and an underground world distorted by anxiety. As Connie, fight, dodge, choose power-ups, and face the demons hiding beneath the city.

details.title: Shadowstone
details.short_description: Play solo or with up to 4 players. Plan your turns together, chain your heroes’ skills into combinations that break the run open, and fight your way out of a labyrinth that changes every time. A turn-based tactical roguelite about what your party can do together.

details.title: Too Deep To Quit
details.short_description: Grab your gear and your friends for a hilarious, golden-age co-op adventure! Dive into cursed temples, hunt for the ultimate treasure, and work together to stay alive. Beware of everything and everyone... after all, only the survivors get to split the gold!

details.title: Gothic Steel
details.short_description: Gothic Steel is a grimdark, retro, survivor-like, wave shooter. Command a heavily armed tank against the horde, assemble your crew, and forge an unstoppable war machine.

details.title: Autobahn Police Simulator 4
details.short_description: Experience daily police duty on Germany's Autobahn like never before and keep the peace in a living open world. From traffic stops to high-speed pursuits: every call is yours to answer.

details.title: Liv
details.short_description: You are accused of the disappearance of a young woman. To prove your innocence, you must solve the case. Use the computer, the victim's diary, and her videos from the last months. You can use specialized software and the police datas. Make deductions, solve puzzles and find out what happened to Liv.

details.title: Flip & Shop Simulator
details.short_description: All simulators in one game! A cooperative city simulator where you and your friends manage businesses in a single large world. Open stores, earn money, and develop the shared city - together or separately.

details.title: Misguided Remastered
details.short_description: Misguided Remastered: Third-person action-horror. Silvia, high school girl trapped in otherworld nightmare. Desperately search for missing best friend & mom's cherished letter her only memory. Survive Indonesian folklore horrors with axe/knife combat, solve puzzles, uncover dark secrets!

details.title: Mosaic of Life
details.short_description: Mosaic of Life is a picross/minesweeper hybrid featuring an ENORMOUS single puzzle that retells the history of life on Earth.

details.title: Doctrine Strike
details.short_description: Modern real-time strategy in real cities. Pick a place on Earth, generate its real landmarks in 3D, shape the terrain, design your own units and factions, then fight combined-arms wars with superweapons on the map you built. Free to play.

details.title: Live on, Until we can't
details.short_description: Between a child's first cry and someone's final breath, a tribe's history takes shape. Place its people in buildings, answer unexpected events, and lead the tribe for as long as it can endure in this turn-based tribal survival rogue-lite.

details.title: 虞州的罪羊
details.short_description: A multi ending narrative AVG.When nightmares and hallucinations alternate,you have to find the only truth among the many possible endings.

details.title: TBF: Task Bar Fishing
details.short_description: A story of a girl fishing and exploring in a submerged world. Let her fish automatically in the corner of your desktop, and step in only for key events. Gather money and gear through fishing to continue your journey and uncover the truth of this world!

details.title: Good Night
details.short_description: A good night's sleep is for one person only. Roll, squirm, and shove your friends off the bed in this 2-4 player ragdoll party game.

details.title: Barista Dream - Prologue
details.short_description: Open your own cozy cafe for free. Brew every drink by hand, pour your own latte art, and read what customers post about you on an in-game social network.

details.title: RE:CHAINED ~Links of Redemption~
details.short_description: Bill climbed the Abyss Tower for cash. Freeing minds in red chains became a rescue he never meant. A comic SRPG of grid tactics and decks. Eight companions seek resurrection. What will they choose?

details.title: The Final Witness
details.short_description: The Final Witness is a first-person psychological horror detective game where every case tells a different story. Explore a haunted family mansion, uncover hidden truths, analyze conflicting evidence, and identify the true killer before the darkness consumes your sanity.

details.title: Chill Boats: Sailing & Boat Simulator
details.short_description: A physics-based boat game, from sailboats to powerboats. Take the helm of foilers, catamarans or RIBs on a sea that really decides your speed. Race against opponents, or just sail wherever you want.

details.title: Siege of Incrementalia
details.short_description: Command an undead army and lay siege to a continent in this incremental strategy game. Build war machines, sacrifice minions and automate hellish magic in your quest to unite the lands of Incrementalia by force.

details.title: 罐头成长计划
details.short_description: 一款养成游戏，在游戏中，你将扮演妈妈，收养一只来自孤儿院的小罐头生物，前往罐头小镇抚养它，通过各种方式的培养来引导小罐成长为不同性格和职业，形成不同的人际关系 9名有感情线路的角色，游戏内包含钓鱼，换装，喂食，打工，战斗，抽卡机，五子棋，阵营选择，npc小任务等游玩方式 ·养成游戏 ·自由选择多结局

details.title: Elixir of Immortality
details.short_description: A cultivation incremental game where alchemy is the key to survival. Recruit minions, manage your alchemy room, seek elixirs to extend your lifespan, and reincarnate when your time runs out. Reincarnate again and again on your path to immortality.

details.title: 履歴死ョ
details.short_description: "Anyone will do. As long as they're human." Late at night in an empty office, your job is simple: stamp resumes. Hire or reject. But not every applicant is human. Spot the anomalies, hire ten people, and you can go home. Who — or what — you hire decides how your night ends.

details.title: Champion Trainer
details.short_description: The next level of horse racing sims. Genuine Thoroughbred lineages spanning over 300 years, 30 real UK/IRE courses featuring full race calendars, online head to heads, Mendelian and polygenic inheritance, Chef-de-Race dosage, Bruce Lowe families, nicks built from real-world race records... and more.

details.title: Zone Rush: Floating Medieval Hamlet
details.short_description: A knight robbed of her floating home, left with only a sword. Capture Zones for more time, combo through Vikings, and topple the Fire Golems guarding them. Fall, and you lose score and drop to level 1. A fast-paced single-player action game: race across a multi-level village and beat your best.

details.title: XBPlayer
details.short_description: Stream games from your own Xbox console or from Xbox Cloud Gaming to your Steam Deck or Linux PC, at home or away. Play with a controller or a keyboard and mouse. Pay once, no ads. Games and Game Pass are not included.

name: Cats Must Be Petted! - An Incremental Game About Petting Cats

details.title: Cats Must Be Petted! - An Incremental Game About Petting Cats
details.short_description: Cats have one simple demand. They must be petted. Step onto a little patch of grass, find a cat, and give it some attention. Tap to get a cat's attention, then keep petting when it rolls over and reveals its belly. Fill its satisfaction meter and watch it happily run off...

details.title: Rally Together
details.short_description: The whole rally, with your friends. Fix the car in the service park, jump in with your co-driver and race it on the stage. What you left loose you feel in the next corner, and what you break comes back to your bay. Online co-op for 1 to 6.

details.title: Meme Exam: Cats
details.short_description: MEME EXAM: CATS challenges memeologists from all over the world! Test your knowledge of the most famous meme cats and prove you’re a true memeologist!

details.title: Take Care of Her Frog
details.short_description: The most relaxing and delicious idle on your screen. Choose whose frog you’re going to take care of. She starts stressed and nervous… your mission is to pamper, relax and fully satisfy her. While you live your life, she stays in the corner of the screen. Simple, tasty and addictive.

details.title: Who Killed Mr X
details.short_description: You wake up locked up in an unknown place with 8 strangers. Who are these people ? Why are you here ? You have a bad feeling. But suddenly, the phone rings, and it's up to you : Will you dare answer and go deeper in this mysterious plot ? Will you reveal the horrible truth... and survive it ?

details.title: 終末メイドロイド
details.short_description: A choice-type adventure novel game in which the ending is determined by the percentage of parts recovered from the “receive,” “don't receive,” and “take” options.

details.title: Ritual Tides
details.short_description: Ritual Tides is a story rich, psychological horror game set on the dark, atmospheric, isolated British island of Hortus. Explore the island, uncover its dark past, loot food, ammunition and supplies, evade the cult of the Fallow Parish, as you fight for survival against Lovecraftian horrors.

details.title: Billy the Hero
details.short_description: Billy woke up on Hell Island as a bear. No memories. No regrets. Apparently, this is just who he is now. A Dark Fantasy Turn-Based RPG where math kills, heroines are unhinged, and the truth about Billy is the one thing the game won't hand you easily.

details.title: UnGodly
details.short_description: Ungodly is a dark fantasy RPG where visceral real-time combat meets collectible hero strategy. Build your roster, chain elemental powers through seamless team swapping, and forge bonds that unlock devastating synergies in a world on the edge of ruin.

details.title: Isekai HKV
details.short_description: Enter another world with a VTuber ally. Move, dodge, collect magic and items, and survive the monster waves. Your VTuber ally can protect, break you out, revive you, and change how each fight plays.

details.title: GOGOGO!pomal!
details.short_description: Your roguelike monster adventure begins here — explore a vast 2D open world, capture and fuse creatures, and create the one-of-a-kind team that carries you through every challenge.

details.title: Tornado Hunter
details.short_description: Become a Tornado Hunter! Join the thrilling race across the American plains to predict, track, and document the deadliest storms of the century. Risk everything in pursuit of perfect data, but be careful: one wrong move and you'll become a storm victim.

details.title: Eggspedition
details.short_description: ENTER THE EGGSPEDITION - A TERRIFYING SURVIVAL HORROR WITH DINOSAURS! Play solo or team up with up to 4 players to explore unknown planets, abandoned facilities, complete missions, and make daring extractions. It’s inhabited by… dinosaurs. Furious, massive, and very much alive.

name: Brave Old World: Tower of Cards

details.title: Brave Old World: Tower of Cards
details.short_description: A text-based RPG adventure. Uncover an epic story of decay and rebirth in a new world, 200 years after humanity's arrival. Guide multiple protagonists through an immersive narrative, diverse gameplay, and a dynamic art style. An unforgettable experience awaits!

details.title: Depth Loop
details.short_description: A werewolf game set in a deep-sea lab, where the survival of humanity is at stake—does justice lie with humankind or the werewolves?

name: Car Rental Simulator: Prologue - Early Days

details.title: Car Rental Simulator: Prologue - Early Days
details.short_description: Free introduction to the full Car Rental Simulator game puts you behind the desk of a small-town rental office in Winston Springs. Manage customers, grow your fleet, and deal with surprises along the way

details.title: Loss Prevention
details.short_description: Loss Prevention is a social deduction game where you can shoplift your local grocery store with up to five friends. Experience the joy of petty crime as a shoplifter, or keep your eyes peeled for suspicious activity as the shopkeeper. Can you grab all the items on the shopping list?

details.title: Oblivion 2666
details.short_description: A slipstream magical realist visual novella about an outsider, a borrowed camera, and a city that no longer matches its own photographs—told through literary prose and ever-shifting, textured cinematic presentation.

details.title: GILDEN
details.short_description: A fast-paced dark fantasy action RPG with retro pixel art. Fight through dense hordes of enemies, discover powerful weapons, defeat deadly bosses, and descend 50 floors into the depths.

details.title: CAREFUL WITH THAT!
details.short_description: CAREFUL WITH THAT! is a hilariously chaotic physics co-op delivery game for 1-4 players. Balance unstable cargo through difficult Terrain and differend Biomes. Coordinate every single step or drag your entire crew into the abyss!

details.title: Columbiad: To The Moon
details.short_description: Build a retro-industrial space program, manage your launch base, assemble and upgrade the Columbiad, then guide each mission from atmospheric ascent to Earth orbit and lunar transfer in a low-poly spaceflight management adventure.

details.title: 宗门经理人 - Sect Master
details.short_description: <Sect Manager> is a single-player cultivation sect management sim. Build and upgrade your sect, craft equipment, and train disciples. Send them into the Spirit Abyss to gather materials, then prepare your team with equipment, techniques, and formations to battle monsters and bosses.

details.title: 无法同意的用户协议
details.short_description: A point-and-click puzzle game set on your desktop. Uncover hidden rules in absurd user agreements, pop-ups, webpages, and minigames. Outsmart the traps, investigate Clause Inc., and uncover the truth behind the installation wizard.

details.title: Coming Through!
details.short_description: You're a little penguin plotting world domination. First things first: get out of the zoo. And cause a little trouble for the humans while you're at it.

details.title: Sherlock Mysteries: Victorian Investigations
details.short_description: Book-style murder investigation game set in Victorian London. Logic, Deduction and Attention to Details - use this to solve game mysteries. Unfold story chapters, investigate clues, visit London historical locations - and help to get murder into jail.

details.title: Astrovein
details.short_description: Ready to blast a path to riches in Astrovein? A full hold draws alien warships! Fight beside your captain or man the turret and defend your loot with raw firepower. Upgrade ship, weapons and modules; push into deadlier sectors for rarer ore. Busy? Your captain keeps fighting and mining.

name: Cinephile: Tidy Up The Movie Store

details.title: Cinephile: Tidy Up The Movie Store
details.short_description: A hilarious cozy first-person tidying game for movie lovers! Hand crafted movie posters parodying real movies. No Generative AI! Plus, a level editor to create your own packs and the same familiar game loop you’re familiar with in the genre.

details.title: Weirdoku: The Files
details.short_description: Weirdoku: the Files is a horror puzzle game. You play as a new recruit at the Anomaly Bureau, reconstructing the scene from the clues and identifying the Anomaly hidden among the people.

details.title: Yes, Your Majesty!
details.short_description: Outrageous! A century on the throne—peace and prosperity across the realm—yet my flag covers but a speck on the map? I keep an elite army, and all they do is parade for me! Guards! A grand campaign begins! — Yes! Your Majesty!

details.title: Revengeful dwell
details.short_description: This is a first-person horror adventure game. From horror game developer Akumu Yuko comes the third installment, “Revengeful dwell.”

details.title: Mightmancer
details.short_description: An old-school first-person action RPG set across a vast open world. Explore dungeons, fight hordes of enemies, master four mixable classes, recruit companions. Relive the iconic blend of 2D and 3D art unique to late-90s RPGs.

details.title: Nectar Spines
details.short_description: You encounter your handsome model neighbor in the story, but he harbors dark intentions toward you… A stormy night approaches. Evade his pursuit and struggle desperately. Yet the second you launch the game, escape is impossible.

details.title: Doomsday tidy up
details.short_description: Every inch of space matters in the apocalypse. Organize firearms and survival supplies inside your shelter, find a place for every item, and turn cluttered storage into orderly reserves for the days ahead.

details.title: Sort The Mart
details.short_description: Sort The Mart is a cozy organizing simulator where you sort hundreds of toys, food, cars, plushies, sports items, and more onto the correct shelves. Enjoy the satisfying process of turning a messy mart into a perfectly organized store, one shelf at a time, at your own pace.

name: Bulb Keeper: Tidy up the Night

details.title: Bulb Keeper: Tidy up the Night
details.short_description: BulbKeeper: Tidy Up the Night is a cozy single-player organizing game. Return scattered bulbs to their original places along the Bulb Street and light up the night. Complete sets of Lights to grow stronger, and use your abilities and strategy to return over 1,000 bulbs as quickly as you can.

details.title: Desktop Farm
details.short_description: Desktop Farm is a farm management game that lives on your desktop. Plant crops, raise animals, fish, mine, and run a little stall. Tuck it away when you're busy, and press Alt+W to return when you're free. It stays out of your way and quietly keeps you company.

details.title: Runemoor
details.short_description: 10v10 PvP capture the flag. Pick one of 31 champions, steal the enemy Rune Banner and carry it home in fast-paced team battles where any fight can turn in seconds.

details.title: Lantern Hearth
details.short_description: A cozy 2D MMORPG in the spirit of the classics. Build your hero stat by stat, party up against bosses, raise loyal pets, and keep your World's lantern burning when the shadows come.

details.title: Corner Cutters
details.short_description: Top-down racing for people who love a good fight for a corner. AI drivers defend and make mistakes. Tyres wear and grip best when warm. Rubber builds up on the line, and in changing weather the track dries where the cars drive. Best played with a controller. Race a season or go online.

details.title: 信息素留白
details.short_description: Alpha？Beta？又或是Omega，他们的性别会因为你的选择而改变…… 升学后，青春期的大家陆续开始性别分化，你的行为与选择会让在意你的两位男主分化成不同的性别……当然，你也在被很多目光注视着，在影响他们的同时也在被他们影响，你又会分化成什么性别？ 在信息素的影响下，温柔的人会嫉妒到发狂，高傲的人甘愿跪在你的脚边，当爱意染上信息素的颜色，一切都会变得微妙起来……

details.title: Jet Combat Sim
details.short_description: A low-altitude jet combat game. Fly mouse-aim jets based on the real aircraft's public technical data over an endless procedural world, score low passes and streaks, break through SAM belts and enemy fighters to the core, and climb a ladder of 38 aircraft from the MiG-15 to the F-35.

name: Chroma: Tidy Up The Paint Store!

details.title: Chroma: Tidy Up The Paint Store!
details.short_description: A cozy organizing simulator where you sort 4,096 paint cans by color. Dig them out of a mountain of mixed-up paint, shelve each one in its row and watch the store turn into one giant rainbow.

details.title: Sort The Plushie Store
details.short_description: Welcome to your new job at the coziest, most chaotic plushie store! Sort 4000 adorable plushies, unlock quirky vending-machine buffs, and sort alt-universe variants in this satisfying, physics-based organization game.

details.title: Anomaly Watch: House 01
details.short_description: You work a night shift as a camera operator in an ordinary house. Switch between the cameras, notice what has changed and report it. Make too many mistakes, or let too many anomalies pile up, and the shift is over.

details.title: Anomaly Watch: Backrooms
details.short_description: You watch the Backrooms through security cameras. Move between the levels, notice what has changed in each place and report it before the anomalies pile up.

details.title: Gold Below
details.short_description: A pixel-art loot roguelike. Start every run with junk gear, buy and merge pieces into rarer ones, stack a set until the numbers get silly, then fight thirty floors down to the dragon at the bottom. Everyone who dies leaves their gold to his hoard.

details.title: Grey Staithe
details.short_description: Grey Staithe is a retro point-and-click puzzle game with cult-themed flair. Explore the environments, use the items you find, uncover the secrets buried here, and complete the commissioned task.

details.title: Doomsday: M.A.D.
details.short_description: Nuclear strategy on a living planet. Nations are born, build their towns, economies and railways, trade, rebel and go to war, century after century, all the way to nuclear fire. Watch the world live, or take control of one nation.

details.title: 孤城守将：放置射击
details.short_description: Defend a Chinese frontier fortress in this first-person shooter with idle allies and incremental upgrades. Turn a crossbow into a rapid-fire weapon, recruit defenders, command volleys, and farm behind the walls. Build up your firepower to face four legendary beasts.

details.title: Tiny Trouble
details.short_description: Race toy cars across breakfast tables, bathtubs, pool tables and sandboxes. Shove rivals into the cereal, squash the peas and fly off the toast. 18 cups, a sticker album to fill, party modes for the couch, online races and a track editor. Small cars. Big trouble.

name: Clean the Snow Off My Car, Please!

details.title: Clean the Snow Off My Car, Please!
details.short_description: Winter came overnight. Grab a brush. Clear powder, scrape stubborn ice and push snow off a buried car in a cosy first-person cleaning game. Work your way around each panel and watch the car emerge, one satisfying stroke at a time.

details.title: Thousands Will Fall
details.short_description: 50,000 enemies on screen at once. One castle. You have a minigun. Orc warbands and a swarm that thinks are coming for your walls. Build a tower maze, then drop in and mow them down with miniguns, black holes and nukes. Solo or co-op for up to 4, and every friend brings another horde.

details.title: Dropnauts
details.short_description: Command a battered megaship across a war-torn galaxy, then zoom straight down to the ground and lead your Dropnauts through brutal squad firefights. Build firebases, grow colonies, call in bombers and orbital fire, and carve out a faction of your own.

details.title: Greenbound
details.short_description: Green sahara desert with your friends in online co-op. Get paid for every square meter, buy upgrades, drones and vehicles, and automate the job. No big company wanted this job. Now it’s yours.

details.title: Road To Zero
details.short_description: Embark on a long journey through a war-torn world. Discover abandoned vehicles, swap engines, repair and restore cars, and explore forgotten places. Hit the road with friends, build your perfect ride, and make your way toward the mysterious Site Zero.

details.title: Dungeon Dealer
details.short_description: Heroes bleed. You profit. Send squads into deadly dungeons, crack open chests of glowing loot and sell every find at the perfect moment. Arm your best heroes, conquer it all, then retire rich and start a bigger era in this pixel-art incremental game.

details.title: Blood Rails
details.short_description: An armored train, a straight track across a dead continent, and a horde that never stops chasing you. Turn your train into a fortress, loot abandoned villages and decide whether the next kilometer is worth the risk.

details.title: Horror Mahjong
details.short_description: Expect the unexpected! Play mahjong and stay alive in a haunted tea house. Pretend you can't see them—good thing you're well armed. Stock up, shoot, throw tiles, revive friends, and win your hand to get up and cover them. Survive until dawn and escape together, or keep watch with paper tablemates.

details.title: Desktop Elf: Raising Story
details.short_description: Raise spirits on your desktop! Hatch 100+ species, give gifts, breed rare variants, and build a cozy home. Combine elements, skills, and runes to challenge stages and towers, or send companions to explore and gather resources. Enjoy idle growth and everyday companionship.

details.title: SEVEN DAYS: Strange Locked-Room Life
details.short_description: "SEVEN DAYS: Strange Locked-Room Life" is a suspenseful escape-room visual novel. You are a reporter trapped with a drug company heiress for seven days. Can you survive the mastermind’s orders, uncover the truth, and escape before you lose your mind?

details.title: Dead Extraction
details.short_description: Explore zombie-infested Tokyo, scavenge resources, and make it out alive. Expand your shelter, manage survivors, and face dynamic threats and deadly bosses in a top-down extraction survival roguelite.

details.title: CHAINSPIRE
details.short_description: CHAINSPIRE is a soul-like platformer for 1–4 players connected by a real physical chain. Your friend will become your enemy the very moment they stop listening to you.

details.title: Respawn | 2020
details.short_description: Come join us at Respawn where you can play with friends, make friends, create whole worlds, become a content creator, become an artist and so much more all at Respawn!

details.title: CACTBOY
details.short_description: Put on your sheriff hat and load your revolver! CACTBOY is a hilarious and chaotic Western multiplayer party game for up to 4 players. From split-second quick-draw duels to absurd brawls, master a variety of minigames and prove who the true CACTBOY is!

details.title: Red Ball 4
details.short_description: The legendary physics platformer with more than 350 million downloads comes to Steam! Roll, jump and bounce through 75 levels packed with traps, puzzles and boss battles — and unlock 80 Steam Achievements along the way.

details.title: Denpa Virus
details.short_description: A "Dark x Engineering" visual novel. A story of brain-docking with four girls infected by "Denpa Virus".

details.title: Dumb Ways to Party
details.short_description: The world’s dumbest party game is here! Play as your favorite Bean, and go head-to-head with up to three other players to become the Dumbest of the Dumb. Will you use skill, sabotage or sheer dumb luck to win?

details.title: BUS: Bro u Survived
details.short_description: Ride through the apocalypse with your friends! BUS: Bro U Survived is a co-op story-driven adventure featuring your very own bus! Fight zombies, gather resources, help other survivors, and solve puzzles. Can you uncover the truth about the beginning of the epidemic and decide the fate of the island?

details.title: MUDANG: Two Hearts
details.short_description: In a unified Korea, masked terrorists strike at the heart of Seoul. Ji Jeongtae, a soldier sent in to stop the attacks, stumbles upon a K-Pop star named Gavi at the center of the unfolding crisis. As their stories intertwine, a chilling truth begins to take shape.

name: The Infectious Madness of Doctor Dekker 2

details.title: The Infectious Madness of Doctor Dekker 2
details.short_description: An FMV game where YOU are a psychiatrist trying to solve a double murder whilst treating the unusual patients of the recently deceased Doctor Dekker. Ask questions and link answers to determine their fates, and your own!

details.title: Revelation of Decay
details.short_description: Revelation of Decay is a zombie survival game that’s less “scary” and even a bit lively. Explore this pixelated world full of bizarre anomalies, awaken supernatural powers, and, amid endless zombie hordes and mutated monsters, gradually uncover the truth behind the invasion.

details.title: Ether Void
details.short_description: New York, the 90s. Detective Frank Miller investigates a murder in a grim metropolis. Your window to the truth is an old terminal. Analyze data, crack codes, uncover digital trails. Remember: not everyone here wants you to succeed.

details.title: Spellatro
details.short_description: A roguelike word game that combines Balatro with Scrabble. Power up letters and use 100+ passive abilities to defeat bosses and rack up high scores!

details.title: Var Game Simulator
details.short_description: Var Game Simulator allows you to manage critical moments of football like a VAR referee. Carefully examine offside, penalty and card decisions and make the right decision. Experience the excitement of football through the eyes of a referee with realistic scenarios!

details.title: Rabona
details.short_description: Rabona is an online multiplayer soccer game with physics-based gameplay. Take total ball control with precise touches. Join the real football action with your friends. Feel the game.

details.title: Chest & Blade
details.short_description: A dark fantasy idle RPG where the fighting happens on its own. The deciding doesn't: open chests, compare gear, salvage the rest, then spend it on skills, runes and three-card augments until the wall you were stuck on breaks. Offline progress keeps it moving.

details.title: 永恒少女和天使
details.short_description: A cute shota game that heals both your body and mind

details.title: 687 Days on Mars
details.short_description: 687 Days on Mars is a survival game where you are stranded alone on Mars - your task is to manage resources, build a base from scratch, grow food, and explore the red planet in search of supplies and other hidden challenges. Every breath and decision counts - can you survive on the Red Planet?

details.title: Interwoven Dream
details.short_description: 《Interwoven Dream》 is a Victorian-era visual novel with multiple POVs. In 1884 London, four friends reunite after a string of disappearances, each with their own motives. Together, they dive into the city's darkest secrets, where dreams and reality blur.

details.title: About Fishing
details.short_description: Cast your line into calm waters and feel the quiet pull beneath the surface. Each cast brings rewards, but some things you reel in were never meant to be found.

details.title: Furniture Restoration Simulator: Garage Edition
details.short_description: Step into your own garage workshop and breathe new life into forgotten furniture. In this immersive first-person simulation, sand away decades of wear, apply vibrant paints, and polish each piece to a showroom finish—one satisfying restoration at a time.

details.title: Watamari Part2 - A Fake Marriage?
details.short_description: This is a yuri game where you as an angel of love must help guide the heroines. Do your best, little angel (you) and take care of your mistress's wellbeing!

details.title: FLINT
details.short_description: Multiplayer survival in an open world. Build your base, farm, hunt different creatures, survive in a harsh world, fight or team up with other players and evolve through the ages.

details.title: Bifröst: Prelude to the Storm
details.short_description: Bifröst: Prelude to the Storm is a BL visual novel set in an epic fantasy world — told through 8 POV characters, 30+ fully illustrated cast members, accompanied with 40+ soundtracks and 50+ event CG's. The story branches based on your decisions, shaping relationships, loyalties, and personal fates.

details.title: RUST MOON
details.short_description: RUST MOON is a cyberpunk pixel side-scrolling action game. Play as ALPHA-7, whose memory has been rewritten, and cut through blockades with firearms, blades, and cyberware abilities — from the neon city all the way to a lunar base. Someone wrote your past for you. What comes next is up to you.

name: 港警成雙：來自城寨 Dual Fire Walled City

details.title: 港警成雙：來自城寨 Dual Fire Walled City
details.short_description: Dual Fire Walled City is a story-driven co-op game for two players. Featuring close friends who grew up together in the Kowloon Walled City, only to be pulled onto vastly different life paths by a twist of fate. Get ready to immerse yourself in a classic Hong Kong-style movie.

details.title: Sumalia
details.short_description: Foreign trawlers are emptying your sea and dumping their waste on your shore. Nobody is coming to help. Grab three friends, a skiff and whatever fuel you can scrape together, and go reclaim what once was yours, and then some. 4-player co-op piracy with proximity voice.

name: Sweet Order: Candy Shop Tidy Up!

details.title: Sweet Order: Candy Shop Tidy Up!
details.short_description: A magical candy shop is a sticky mess! Play as an adorable marshmallow in this cozy first-person cleaning and organizing sim. Vacuum up gummies, scrape away syrup, and sort colorful candies to perfection. No timers, no stress, just pure satisfaction!

details.title: Acts of Blood
details.short_description: Master the art of hand-to-hand combat in Acts of Blood, a gritty and fast-paced third-person brawler with brutal combo chains and blood-soaked revenge.

name: 我喜欢的白毛美少女不可能是凶手

details.title: 我喜欢的白毛美少女不可能是凶手
details.short_description: “为什么我什么都做不到!这样的现实，由我亲手撕烂!这一次我不会再让任何人伤害你!” —— 本游戏为单女主剧情作 属于悬疑恋爱类文字冒险游戏，主角将通过一个个选项来了解一场凶杀案背后的真相，其中有很多线索和不一样的结局来提供游戏趣味性。 『没有人能拒绝白毛异瞳的杀伤力!』 这是如梦幻般的故事。 无法忘怀，也不能忘怀的爱与回忆!!!

details.title: Send In The Vampires
details.short_description: Maniacs have taken over the asylum. Restore order with your fists in the ultimate gothic arcade beat em up. Supports up to 4 players in couch coop/remote play.

details.title: SHORE
details.short_description: Stuck in the middle of the ocean, survive together on a fragile physics-based raft. Fight storms, tsunamis, sharks, and starvation as you find your way back home in SHORE, a 1-4-player co-op survival adventure.

details.title: Date the Difference
details.short_description: Date the Difference is a casual puzzle game where you spot differences between images while enjoying a light dating-themed atmosphere. Explore stylish scenes, find hidden details, earn rewards, and unlock charming characters through relaxing, attention-based gameplay.

details.title: Little Lilicia
details.short_description: A full-fledged farm life sim where you live as a rancher, socialize, and find love with heroines in the town of Kokotan, home of the Forest Goddess. Step into the shoes of the protagonist, Philo, who becomes a rancher by chance, and revitalize the run-down farm.

details.title: City of Hunger
details.short_description: Survive a deadly parasite outbreak in immersive virtual reality. Fight for your life, uncover the truth behind Dr. Summers' experiments, and escape before it's too late.

details.title: Doomsday Defense Line
details.short_description: This is an innovative game that combines strategy, action and character development. David to the frontlines of the plant-animal alliance. Engage in fierce defensive battles against the powerful zombie horde, and uncover the fascinating stories behind every precious character in this world.
developers: 上海齐格飞网络科技有限公司
publishers: 辰炎翎网络科技（上海）有限公司

details.title: 99 NIGHTS IN THE APOCALYPSE
details.short_description: A 1-5 player co-op survival game. Team up with friends to survive 99 nights in a post-apocalyptic world. Gather resources, build your camp, craft weapons, explore different biomes, and fight off waves of enemies and powerful bosses.

details.title: 键盘农场 Keyboard Farm
details.short_description: "Keyboard Farm" is a desktop idle farming game. Place it on your desktop and focus on your work. Every key is a plot of land—each keystroke helps plants grow. Harvest crops to collect coins, unlock various keycaps, and create your own keyboard world.

details.title: Virtual Driving School: Trucks
details.short_description: Train like a professional HGV driver. Master trucks and buses, manage blind spots and long loads, avoid bridge strikes, navigate level crossings, and operate vehicle-mounted cranes. Real rules, real risks — zero real-world consequences.

details.title: Smart Train Simulator
details.short_description: Take the controls of the classic 81-717 and modern 81-765 on Moscow Metro Line 7. Master authentic cab controls, braking and safety systems, and explore stations and depots on foot. Built on professional train simulator technology.

details.title: Tutsak
details.short_description: Tutsak is a 1–4 player co-op horror game where you complete objectives and escape before the creature catches you. Caught? You're locked in a cell until your friends break you out. Sometimes, you can sell out a teammate instead.

details.title: Quackoban
details.short_description: In Quackoban you will push blocks that fuse into shapes, teleport and move in groups. A new and challenging twist on the Sokoban block-pushing classic, bringing it to new dimensions where you have to think in shapes.

details.title: Mike goes on hike
details.short_description: Leave the city behind in a first-person hiking adventure. Explore mountain trails, take photographs, and fill Mike’s travel journal with memories — from a thrilling zipline ride to a quiet evening by the campfire.

details.title: Dear Passengers
details.short_description: Play in co-op as the crew of the world’s worst airline. Your plane is falling apart, your cargo is illegal, and passenger safety barely makes the list.

details.title: Whimpact!
details.short_description: Collect, care for, and adventure alongside your Whims, who grant you incredible powers. Then dive into the fast-paced, cooperative arena to find and reclaim the world’s missing Starcane energy.

details.title: Lagrange Front
details.short_description: Lagrange Front is a team-based sci-fi FPS. Fight on foot, in zero gravity and in vehicles for a moving hill, haul a payload into the enemy flagship, or storm a ground map with tanks and walkers. Up to 48 players per match, with AI bots filling empty slots.

details.title: PixelRift
details.short_description: A 2D side-scroller platformer game with level creation features.

details.title: Slip Angle
details.short_description: Arcade drift racing where being sideways is almost mandatory! Find the perfect balance between speed and angle to clear objectives and slide your way through multiple game modes - enjoy the drift flow state or challenge yourself to be one of the best, the choice is yours.

details.title: Sector 73
details.short_description: Top-down coop shooter. Fight down through nanite-infested research labs and uncover what the executive found in the Oram ruins. Flip on the flash light and keep firing until nothing is left standing.

details.title: Steal de Janeiro
details.short_description: A first-person incremental game about petty theft in a made-up corner of early-2000s Rio de Janeiro. Pick pockets, strip parked cars at night, shake off the guards and flip the loot online at Tico's lan house. Every heist pays for the next upgrade.

details.title: TIDE OR HIDE
details.short_description: Three minutes of daylight. Ninety seconds of night. TIDE OR HIDE is a 1-4 player co-op survival game where the deep water guarding your camp drains away every night - zone by zone - and armed hunters come for what you stockpiled. Gather, arm up, and hold until dawn.

details.title: Ore Express
details.short_description: Build chaotic, physics-powered factories. Chop trees and mine ore, then catch the avalanche with belts, ramps, fans, pistons and cranes, smelt and craft it into goods, and fill the trucks. Every item is a real physical object, so every contraption is gloriously unpredictable.

details.title: Aurora: Firebreak
details.short_description: Break through self-replicating warforms in fast neon expeditions, evolve a new ship build every flight, recover lost technology, and rebuild humanity's last uncorrupted fleet across a branching campaign for survival.

details.title: Lily's Little Dart Game
details.short_description: Couch party darts for up to four players. Race from 301 down to zero, cause mayhem in a three-minute Chaos match, or steer your dart in slow motion through an obstacle course in The Gauntlet. Play on one screen or online with friends.

details.title: Let It Snow
details.short_description: Grab a shovel and dig into real, deformable snow. Clear your yard scoop by scoop, sell every load to the Snow-O-Matic, upgrade your tools and uncover what winter has buried. A cozy, satisfying snow-clearing sim.

details.title: Cat Fight
details.short_description: Scrap with other cats in a fast, chaotic multiplayer arena brawler. Swat, pounce, and use items across five competitive modes, with local, LAN, and online play plus optional bots. Cat Fight is in active development.

details.title: ASHEN SEA
details.short_description: Ashen Sea is a first-person narrative experience for AXISRAY. Play as BASH, a party robot repairing arcades and tuning jukeboxes via terminal on a derelict spaceship. No combat, no time limits—explore freely. When a shuttle is the only way down, the party’s meaning blurs.

details.title: Better Together
details.short_description: A 2 to 6 player co-op psychological horror. Become neighbors with your friends in an underground experiment. Complete the studies, get paid by doing tasks, while the Institute notes your routine. Betray your friends before they do. In the end you'll know exactly who your friends really are.

details.title: The Six Dragons
details.short_description: Welcome to The Six Dragons Discover 256km2 of Open-World full of surprises, escape 1 billion dungeons, craft and enchant items

details.title: Copter Besieged
details.short_description: Copter Besieged is a multi-copter survival arena shooter. Realistic multi-copter flight with arcade style weapons, items, powerups and escalating monster waves. Dodge incoming attacks, shoot monsters, collect coins, level up your copter. Or race against your friends ghosts on the flight courses.

details.title: Deslot
details.short_description: A realistic miniature racing game featuring Die-Cast, Slot, and Mini RC cars. Master momentum, throttle, and precision driving across handcrafted and procedurally generated diorama tracks. Build your own circuits, customize your cars, and race through Career, Challenges, and Multiplayer.

details.title: Cartoon Craft: Rise of Mutation
details.short_description: A story-driven real-time strategy game inspired by classic RTS. Experience a mission campaign filled with memorable characters, unexpected alliances, and humor. Build your kingdom, command Humans and Orcs, create custom maps, and share your battles with the world.

details.title: Mamma Mia
details.short_description: Play in co-op as the staff of Italy’s worst restaurant. Your kitchen is falling apart, customers’ safety barely makes the list, and weird things happen in the back alley.

name: IRON RAIL GIRLS : Last Train Draisine

details.title: IRON RAIL GIRLS : Last Train Draisine
details.short_description: While converting the armored train (or is it a trolley?) “Draisine” into the “world's mightiest moving fortress,” they embark on a one-way journey (a breakthrough battle) back to their hometown. A 2D side-scrolling, top-down train shooting game.

details.title: Split Drive
details.short_description: Split Drive is a roguelite arena shooter where you have to find your way home through a hostile galaxy, numerous locations and a variety of bosses, all generated procedurally.

details.title: Hide The Corpse
details.short_description: Hide Gus before the cops arrive in this chaotic VR physics sandbox. Drag, throw, and cram a fully simulated body into absurd hiding spots across unique environments while the clock ticks down. Includes the Gusimir Mansion DLC.

details.title: FortressCraft : Phoenix
details.short_description: The third iteration of the game that invented the Factory genre, FortressCraft :Phoenix takes the over-the-top base building and survival gameplay and cranks it up a hundred times. Build your mining base with hundreds of thousands of machines in it, explore alien landscape, heading deep underground.

details.title: Carpet Forge
details.short_description: Build your deck, deploy wooden toy vehicles, and bolt on a variety of weapons and utility modules in this roguelike top-down turn-based tactics and deckbuilding game. Draft units, weapons or effects and outsmart the creepy, broken plastic nightmare toys!

details.title: Cross Reverie
details.short_description: Follow the story of Eight of the land of Xylera’s bravest combatants and their descent into the madness known only as The Trial of Nightmare in this JRPG-inspired title featuring turn-based combat and a character-focused narrative.

details.title: Banneret
details.short_description: Roguelike deckbuilding meets tactical auto-battling in this party building strategy game! Recruit and upgrade fighters, customize your deck, explore treacherous lands and battle fierce enemies.

details.title: Adventures of Ruby Rabbit
details.short_description: "The Adventure of Ruby Rabbit" is a light action shooter adventure game. In the game, you can control Ruby the cute bunny, fight the bunny balls, and grow as she grows.

details.title: Glitchphobia
details.short_description: Immerse yourself into unstable reality. In order to get out you must exploit glitch in a world around you. You can be sure of one thing, any rules you known no longer exist!! Do you have a courage to dip in it?

details.title: Elevator
details.short_description: Embark on a journey through The Elevator. This is not a simple trip to the top. Each stop will open your eyes to the mysteries of the Elevator. What floor will it stop on? What will it show? The Elevator decides your fate now!!! From the makers of Elevator: Source comes Elevator, the sequel.

details.title: Evil Among Shadows: Hollow Creek
details.short_description: After Kevin's disappearance, Sam stays with her aunt and uncle to support them after the loss of their son. She and her friend Anthony soon stumble down the same rabbit hole as her cousin did, growing increasingly obsessed with proving there is a serial killer lurking in Hollow Creek.

details.title: Jupiter Moons: Mecha🦾
details.short_description: Choose your mech, customize your loadout, and build your perfect deck. Experiment with cards to find powerful combinations as you enjoy the tactical combat and deckbuilding in this roguelike adventure!

name: CrocApoca!! Crocodile maiden at the End of the World

details.title: CrocApoca!! Crocodile maiden at the End of the World
details.short_description: Take care of a cute crocodile girl and make it through the Apocalypse while your bossy step-sister and some mysterious organizations are getting in your way!

name: Be My Mom - maternity simulator, take care of your child

details.title: Be My Mom - maternity simulator, take care of your child
details.short_description: Become a mother and experience the best of maternity. The game is for future mothers, so they know what to expect, and also for their partners, so they can experience things their women do. The adventure begins just as you see the pregnancy test is positive.

details.title: Still Rooms
details.short_description: A cozy, pixel-art decorating game where you design and furnish unique homes across 7 themed locations — from modern apartments and rustic houses to retro 80’s interiors, student rooms, rooftops, and even a spaceship.

details.title: Quarantine Cutz
details.short_description: A hilarious cartoon simulation where you're absolutely terrible at cutting hair. Can you overcome your nerves and total pop culture ignorance to give your family a haircut that won't crush their dreams? Probably not, but you're gonna give it your best shot!

details.title: IPredictedYouPredictedMe
details.short_description: A unique two-player fighting game where you must predict your opponent’s moves before they act, while preventing them from predicting yours. Plan five actions each round and outsmart your opponent in a fair battle of wits. Enjoy the thrill of mind games!

details.title: Daisy la Fleur
details.short_description: A PS1-esque art nouveau action-adventure game inspired by classic 90s games. Something strange has arrived in early 1900's France! It looks like Daisy is the one to stop it! Uncover the mystery behind these, tentacle monsters, jelly fish creatures, and even escaped brains! Welcome to Daisy la Fleur!

details.title: Aposis: Infinity Hero
details.short_description: A sci-fi roguelike RPG about an agent from the past awakened deep inside the Cradle, a colossal AI-controlled megacity.

details.title: Script Strike
details.short_description: Script Strike is a strategy game where you fight with code. Command your knight and solve levels in your favorite language, from variables and loops to algorithms, debugging, and concurrency. Collect weapons, unlock skills, and face the challenges of a medieval fantasy battlefield.

details.title: 白日梦Daydream
details.short_description: "Daydream" is a light puzzle game that is based on the connection between real life and dreams. The inspirations gained by the player in the dream give them strength, which makes them more powerful in reality.

details.title: Isolation Dolphin Tank
details.short_description: You fall asleep on the train home and wake at an unfamiliar station: Cetacea City, a town lost in endless night beneath two hazy moons. Your only clue is a dolphin hymn heard in a faint dream. Talk with its curious residents and gather fragments of lost memories in this dreamy, hypnotic adventure.

details.title: Annie's DineInn
details.short_description: A cooking game with cozy themed days and horror themed nights. You and your daughter are now owners of an abandoned motel and diner. Start cooking, renting rooms, and do other work to pay off the loan. But beware of the choices you make as they might come back to haunt you. (Solo developer project)

details.title: KUMANO
details.short_description: KUMANO: Third District, Last Service is a 3D exploration narrative adventure. As a protagonist who has lost his memory, walk among the residents of an abandoned city, meet them, and choose. Experience a world you've never known, yet somehow remember.

name: The Child Who Serves the Hanul

details.title: The Child Who Serves the Hanul
details.short_description: A linear, story-driven 2D adventure set in Korea's Donghak era. Deliver secret letters, evade soldiers, and talk with villagers as the story unfolds through illustrated cutscenes blended with live-action footage, in one boy's coming-of-age journey.

details.title: Weekend at Ease
details.short_description: Weekend at Ease is a casual puzzle game centered on interacting with objects, set against the backdrop of a relaxing weekend shared by two girls. Solve puzzles by dragging, arranging, rotating, and swapping objects, and experience new interaction rules across different chapters.

details.title: Oops, No Floor!
details.short_description: Bring your own floor in a chaotic co-op platformer for 1–4 players. Carry, throw and place floor panels, spring over gaps, dodge factory machinery and a claw-armed robot, and pull your friends out of trouble before the clock runs out.

details.title: Stickers, please
details.short_description: Decorate a fantasy location with sticker packs. Place or rearrange anything however you want, there are no rules.

details.title: One man's junk
details.short_description: Hassle the unsuspecting residents of Chislington in order to barter your way up from a paperclip to a car, so you can go visit your family for the holidays.

details.title: Beatcore
details.short_description: A simple rhythm game where you hit beats as they come down the lanes. Level editor included.

details.title: Beatcore zero
details.short_description: Try Beatcore for free! A simple rhythm game where you hit beats as they come down the lanes. This version does not permit access to the workshop.

details.title: Farming with lasers
details.short_description: Incinerate various pests with your giant laser, as you grow your farm. Purchase incremental upgrades to expedite the process.

details.title: Deck paper scissors
details.short_description: It's rock paper scissors, but as an incremental roguelike deck builder.

details.title: Mommy Dies
details.short_description: 100 mommies. 100 ways to die. Only one survives. A psychological horror visual novel where your choices determine who lives and who dies in a twisted underground facility.

details.title: Cook Together
