details.short_description: Overtake is an idle racing game that lives on your taskbar, built for people who spend all day at the keyboard. Your car cruises along while you work, and every keystroke gives it an extra push. Collect skins and trade them on the Steam Community Market, climb the leaderboards and never stop moving.

details.title: Sky Defense
details.short_description: A card-driven tower defense game where one wrong choice ends your run. Place defenses, upgrade your deck between rounds, and protect your floating island from endless waves of enemies.

details.title: Five Families
details.short_description: Turn-based mafia strategy. Lead a Cosa Nostra family through 40 years of New York crime: build rackets, command your crews, outplay four rival families and survive the FBI. Every decision has consequences.

details.title: God Is Not Here
details.short_description: “My God, my God… why have You forsaken me?” — Psalm 22:1. Words spoken by Jesus Christ on the cross before His death.

details.title: Monolith Zero - An Incremental Odyssey
details.short_description: A pixel art incremental game of mining and drones. "Captain, the mothership has lost control near an unknown structure. We're stuck. It's pulling iron-laden asteroids towards us… It seems to want to help us."

details.title: JiivJiiv
details.short_description: Raise a flock of felt chickens on Grandma's old farm. Throw eggs into the truck, migrate across six regions with their own rules and follow her postcards to the legendary First Hen. A cozy idle game with no ads, no premium currency and a real ending.

name: Vinyl Shop: Tidy Up Music Game

details.title: Vinyl Shop: Tidy Up Music Game
details.short_description: A cozy first-person game: bring a vinyl shop back to life! Sort thousands of records by genre and artist. Complete a genre to earn its track. Spin it on the turntable: the tidier the shop, the more music.

details.title: The Last Admiral
details.short_description: Abandoned on the Outer Rim with four ships, you name a new empire and conquer inward to the galactic core. Fight gridless tactical fleet battles, shove warships into black holes, claim hulls from 14 factions, and face living God Dragons. Lose the run, keep your fleet.

details.title: MineEngineer
details.short_description: Build physics-driven ships and automated factories block by block in a 2D space survival sandbox. Mine planets and asteroids, program machines, explore a hostile universe and survive solo or with friends.

details.title: Haoru: Desktop Chaos
details.short_description: A chibi anime girl moves onto your real Windows desktop: she keeps you company while you work, reads, naps and plays on your windows, and wrecks everything on screen with 27 over-the-top weapons and 15 pranks. Dress her up, build an island village, befriend Kitsune and Neko. Only pixels get hurt.

details.title: Pixel Quest: Guild
details.short_description: Your guild fights at the bottom of your screen. Hire heroes, merge them, take on bosses, collect Arcanas, call in your Steam friends, and see how deep you get before you ascend and start over.

details.title: To Kill a God
details.short_description: Craft your skill tree in this action roguelike where you must utilize skill and creativity to unleash devastating builds, all for one purpose. Break the Cycle. Kill a god.

details.title: Ape Express
details.short_description: A co-op delivery adventure for 1-4 apes. Pile into your battered pickup and haul explosive, ticking and occasionally alive cargo across a wild valley — over mountains, through caves and past things with teeth. No signature required.

details.title: Atelier en Provence
details.short_description: Bring a little Provence to your desktop. Join Pierre the painter as he works and rests. Upgrade his tools, collect and sell paintings, and create a cozy home. The full release will feature over 1,500 works of art.

details.title: Emptiness Sire
details.short_description: Uncover a story told in fragments across 160+ challenging turn-based puzzles steeped in cosmic horror. Switch between three survivors, anticipate enemy moves and rethink your strategy with unlimited undo.

details.title: Die and Decay
details.short_description: Turn a handful of dice into a town that fights back. Every roll is a choice: strike the horror in front of you, keep your people fed, or grow your dice engine. Chain your buildings into cascading combos, because if the city falls, your Hero falls with it.

details.title: Office Aberrations
details.short_description: Office Aberrations is a first-person, spot-the-difference game set in a looping hallway. Study your surroundings for changes ranging from subtle to silly. The search area grows as you progress, testing your memory and attention. Knowing whether anything has changed is your only way through.

details.title: Nook Beasts
details.short_description: Digital monsters in the corner of your desktop! Hatch, Evolve, and Raise over 100 different beasts, and send them on adventures to grow stronger, earn rewards to upgrade your nook, and discover eggs from unknown species!

details.title: Mikene's Aspects
details.short_description: Guide Mikene in the search for the 7 Aspects of Balance to achieve Omnipotence and put an end to the problem plaguing the city of Farzin once and for all. Dive into hordes of enemies in this frantic hack n' slash in the best Soulslike style!

details.title: Horde Below
details.short_description: Horde Below is a zombie-themed incremental tower defense game. Fight massive zombie hordes with your towers and your own weapon. Buy permanent upgrades, evolve your towers, and turn the battlefield into pure chaos.

details.title: Logisticats
details.short_description: Move to a floating island and start a new life alongside a colony of cats with unique personalities! In this cozy business sim, you'll help your cats to plant crops and build buildings before taking to the skies in your airship to lead your feline crew in search of treasure and adventure!

details.title: Let's Go! Curio Crew!
details.short_description: Fancy a virtual getaway? This desktop buddy can collect local goodies from 700+ cities across China while you work, study, or sneak in a break! Buy low, sell high to fund your trip! Collect gorgeous hanfu from past dynasties and travel in style~ Team up with friends online to find goodies faster!

details.title: The Airline Century
details.short_description: Build and manage an airline from 1960 to 2030 in a turn-based strategy simulation. Buy or lease aircraft, plan routes, fares and schedules, expand hubs, and navigate oil shocks, financial crises and rival airlines.

details.title: Ace & Aro: Heart-to-Heart
details.short_description: Welcome to the Ace & Aro Meetup! Whether you’re a-spec yourself or just curious, we hope you feel welcome here. Meet the members, try a cocktail (or two) and unwind with some arcade games. Let’s have a heart-to-heart!

details.title: Sidepeak
details.short_description: A tiny climber lives on the edge of your screen. Every key you press, in any app, carries them from Montmartre to Everest, real peaks at their real altitude. Take a break and they pitch camp, which you decorate with their finds. And when the mountains run out? That's for you to find out.

name: It Works: Electronics Repair Simulator - First Short Circuit

details.title: It Works: Electronics Repair Simulator - First Short Circuit
details.short_description: Take your first steps in the electronics repair business! Enter your home garage, master the basics of diagnostics, use the multimeter, and solve your very first hardware crises. Fix basic devices, satisfy your clients, and face the ultimate test: your first short circuit!

details.title: Whodunit Sudoku
details.short_description: This is a logic puzzle blending Sudoku with murder mystery deduction. Place suspects using row-and-column rules on illustrated crime scenes, then read spatial clues and room boundaries to deduce who was left alone with the victim. Pure logic, no guessing.

details.title: Castellan of Aurelwatch
details.short_description: Rebuild Aurelwatch, explore a world of medieval fantasy, and lead your heroes into turn-based battles. Discover its past, gather allies, and use clever tactics to overcome your enemies.

details.title: Dump Chaos
details.short_description: Dig through piles of junk, place the items you find on their proper shelves, and sell them to make money. Take your time organizing, add rare finds to your collection, and enjoy the satisfying feeling of turning chaos into order.

details.title: SKINFACE
details.short_description: SKINFACE is a gruesome horror-thriller where you skin strangers alive to create the perfect disguise. Evade the police, earn your target’s trust and carry out the hit. Knock knock!

details.title: Working with Montabi
details.short_description: Let adorable Montabi keep you company while you work! A desktop companion that types together with you. Customize your room and avatar, stay focused with productivity tools, and collect every Montabi by placing their favorite items!

details.title: Between the Days
details.short_description: Between the Days is a cozy, hand-drawn puzzle game inspired by everyday life in Japan. Sort objects, discover patterns, and solve little puzzles through simple clicks and drags. Take a relaxing journey through Tokyo's four seasons, even if you've never visited Japan.

details.title: Pseudo-Psy Play
details.short_description: A 21st Century Noir Horror Game. Pseudo-Psy Play is an eccentric blend of a side-scrolling shooter and a point-and-click adventure. The time has come – face your fears in this bone-chilling story-driven horror game that feels (and looks) like nothing else in the genre. Are you ready, Joseph?

details.title: Fractal Forge: Sierpinski's Sanctuary
details.short_description: An incremental idler about recursively creating several famous fractals, managing your workers, finding treasure, fighting a dangerous fractal, and balancing multiple production lines to overcome the exponential growth in which fractal construction tries to imprison you.

details.title: Platform Anomaly
details.short_description: Platform Anomaly is a co-op horror game where you and your friends hunt for anomalies — or hide them yourself and watch the search unfold. Scary and fun at the same time!
developers: macrayb is the coolest and Nikolai Tapchenko contributed 23 percent of the game

details.title: Dispatch Loop
details.short_description: A pixel-art loop roguelite about a bike courier. Place cards to build your route, chain combos, survive the city's worst customers and upgrade your home between contracts. The deliveries never stop. Neither do the problems.

details.title: STARZ.PEG
details.short_description: STARZ.PEG is a Y2K physics roguelike built around chain reactions. Buy blind-box figures called STARZ between rounds, line up your shot, and set off whole rows of abilities to run up the score.

details.title: Wipe Them Out!
details.short_description: Wipe them out is a hand-drawn incremental zombie-blasting game. Shoot zombies, collect scrap, and upgrade your weapons and defenses. Face increasingly powerful horde as you grow stronger with every upgrade. Protect your wall and enjoy the satisfaction of tearing through countless zombies.

details.title: PAWA
details.short_description: P.A.W.A is an auto-chess roguelike inspired by TFT and Slay the Spire. Build a team of cool and cute creatures, combine and position your units wisely, create powerful synergies, and defeat challenging bosses.

details.title: Full Metal Hell
details.short_description: A roguelite shooter that combines physics-based collisions, inventory management, and active skills. Choose from a wide range of vehicles, weapons, and builds, then crush everything in your path through the machine hordes!

details.title: Kawaii Evolution Clicker: Desktop Edition
details.short_description: Ultimate anime idle game! Click, collect, and merge adorable anime girls to unlock completely new evolutions. From classic anime schoolgirls and maids to pure Tsundere and dangerous Yandere — become their Senpai and unlock every beautiful location!

details.title: Leaf to Sun
details.short_description: Autumn is ending, and the sun grows weaker by the day. Blow fallen leaves into the bonfire to grow the fire, and power up your wind and flames with the skill tree. Before long, the journey heads to space. A relaxing pixel-art incremental game.

details.title: Seres Universalis:Three Kingdoms
details.short_description: Return to the Three Kingdoms period. On the grand strategic tactical battlefield, use terrain for defense setup and resource allocation to shift the battle situation. Control the war via hexagonal grid movement and tactical ability activation, and unify the realm.

details.title: Danganronpa 2x2
details.short_description: While on a school trip to Jabberwock Island, students are ensnared in Monokuma’s deadly game, forced into mutual killing and Class Trials to expose the culprit. Break through contradictions with high-speed detective action. Includes both a brand-new scenario and the enhanced original!

details.title: Magical Girl: incremental gaiden
details.short_description: Start as a weak Magical Girl and become an unstoppable force! Fight weird Shadows, collect resources, unlock powerful upgrades, and annihilate the Witches in this Incremental Bullet Hell!

details.title: Night At The Mall VR
details.short_description: Night At The Mall is a first-person, narrative-driven psychological horror game where you take the night shift inside an abandoned shopping mall that refuses to stay still.

details.title: Fire Buller
details.short_description: Throw a flaming bull from a baseball stadium as far as it goes: over the city, past the Moon and Mars, to the edge of the universe and on to 10^1000 km. Wherever it lands, it crashes and rampages. Distance times destruction buys a stronger arm and twenty wilder bulls.

name: CHU: The Nightmare of That Day

details.title: CHU: The Nightmare of That Day
details.short_description: The nightmare every Korean veteran knows: being drafted again. Survive three days in the barracks in a first-person comedy-horror story. By day, army life. By night, hide, sneak and run.

details.title: Desktop Reimu
details.short_description: Desktop Reimu is a Touhou Project fan-made idle game that sits along the bottom edge of your screen. Your key presses and clicks turn into donations while you work, and Reimu heads out to resolve incidents.

details.title: Remnants of R'lyeh
details.short_description: Remnants of R'lyeh is a first-person survival horror that drags you from drowned ruins and the streets of Innsmouth into Abyssal City, a steampunk city in the abyss, and down to R'lyeh itself. Fight above and below the water and find a way out before your sanity breaks.

details.title: Kwartikum
details.short_description: An atmospheric puzzle adventure about guiding a lone figure through a strange land, discovering new ways to solve box based challenges.

details.title: Monolith: Dark Matter
details.short_description: A round-based co-op FPS for 1–4 players set inside the Monolith — a brutalist complex shaped by living dark matter. Fight escalating waves of its zombie marionettes, earn points to unlock new sectors and build your arsenal, and find out how long your squad can last.

details.title: Rotten Keep
details.short_description: Trapped in a medieval castle while investigating a deadly plague, Maestro Severino must survive the unholy horrors stalking its halls. Hide, solve sinister puzzles, and rescue the count’s surviving daughter before the nightmare claims you both in this survival stalker horror game.

details.title: Outbreak Z
details.short_description: A post-apocalyptic party-based auto battler RPG. Recruit three survivors with nothing in common, loot a dead city for their gear, level each one down their own tree, and send them into the horde. They fight every wave on their own. Whether they come home is on you.

details.title: MANDATE
details.short_description: A 60-week superhero career RPG in pop-noir comic art. Train, sign with the Bureau, face the press and make 225 moral choices that come back to haunt you. Seven endings.

details.title: Trox The Reversal
details.short_description: Trox The Reversal is a first person horror game set in an alternate reality where the Cold War became a global nuclear war. With food supplies collapsing, the Soviet government introduces the Sustainable Meat Act, making cannibalism legal and forcing every household to contribute.

details.title: Terranigma
details.short_description: Thematic boldness. Stunning character design. Excellent music. Smooth gameplay. Terranigma had it all... except a modern re-release. Now, the beloved action JRPG classic is back for the first time since 1995!

details.title: Potion Master
details.short_description: Inherit your grandmother's potion shop and make it your own. Chop, squeeze, and grind ingredients to brew potions — stick to the recipe, or experiment and discover new formulas. Build your reputation, attract mighty heroes bearing rare ingredients, and decorate your shop with curious trophies.

details.title: Skyscraper Security: Zombie Rain
details.short_description: A retro FPS you can play solo or in two-player online co-op. Protect civilians from falling infected in Lockdown, or fight through dark floors and choose when to extract in Infiltrate.

details.title: FIND KITTENS 13: Pirates
details.short_description: Yo-ho-ho and a bottle of rum! Are you ready to travel on an exciting journey with pirates? What are you waiting for? Explore and find cute cats to fill the black-and-white world with bright colors.

details.title: PenguPult
details.short_description: Grab your hammer and launch yourself through ice and snow in PenguPult! Climb the mountain with precise jumps or slip and fall back to the bottom. If you crave a challenge you need to try this!

details.title: Undying Soul
details.short_description: Undying Soul is a 2D action roguelite focused on fluid combat, character swapping, and broken build crafting. Choose your allies, combine their abilities, discover powerful synergies and adapt your playstyle to overcome deadly foes and reclaim your shattered soul.

details.title: Stewart The Fox: Swing it!
details.short_description: A fast-paced speedrun platformer where you play as Stewart The Fox, improve your runs, and compete on worldwide leaderboards. Master the movement across 15+ maps, race against your ghost, and beat your personal best. Can you become a World Record Holder?

details.title: Let the cat fish!
details.short_description: Let a little fishing cat live along the bottom of your desktop. Catch and collect rare fish, build a cozy tower floor by floor, equip cannons against cute seaside monsters, dress up the tower and taskbar, and shrink the game to a tiny companion while you work.

details.title: FLASK
details.short_description: A roguelike autobattler about alchemical greed on the new frontier. Build unstoppable homunculi, barter with mutated merchants, and slay hordes of monsters to harvest their valuable blood. It's time to get bloody... Bloody rich!

details.title: HEXECUTIVE ORDER
details.short_description: You're a mage the government kept on a leash, and the collar just broke. Fight your way down 44 floors of a very bureaucratic cult with a spellbook, an iron cross and a lot of red barrels. Old-school, fast and messy.

details.title: Illusion Remix
details.short_description: Wake a forgotten museum of optical illusions with your robot curator, Luna. Explore its wonders, fill the galleries with your own creations, and go as deep as you like: shape every detail, make illusions dance to your music, and stage whole shows. Cozy, psychedelic, endlessly remixable.

details.title: Broken Shell
details.short_description: Broken Shell is a short, hand-drawn puzzle adventure about two hermit crabs searching for a place to call home. Explore a vibrant underwater world, solve gentle puzzles, and experience a heartfelt story told entirely without words.

details.title: Ved : Journey Beyond the Cube
details.short_description: You are a cube. But you weren't always. Solve story-driven 3D puzzles, uncover the truth behind an ancient curse, and fight your way back to being human

details.title: Potion Pantry: Sort the Apothecary
details.short_description: A cozy sorting game set in an old candlelit apothecary. Thousands of potions, each with its own name and label, and liquid that sloshes as you carry it. Ride the rolling ladders, fill crates, and put every shelf back the way it was, to rekindle the light of your late mother's spirit.

details.title: His Magical Gay Awakening
details.short_description: Tristan swore he was straight. Then the Arcane Fashion Institute stitched desire into his skin. A gay romance visual novel in a dark academia world of magical fashion: a dangerous rival, a tempting model, a ruthless professor, 3 endings, and choices that matter.

name: Desktop Party: An Idle Fantasy RPG

details.title: Desktop Party: An Idle Fantasy RPG
details.short_description: A tiny party lives on your desktop in this idle RPG. Your heroes fight monsters and find treasure while you work or browse. Choose their gear and watch them grow into new forms. Take a break to pet them or play with toys. Sometimes it rains frogs.

details.title: Chess War
details.short_description: Chess War brings chess to life in epic 3D battles between legendary armies from different historical eras. Challenge friends online or locally, face a competitive AI, and watch every capture unfold through dynamic, action-packed combat animations.

details.title: Ironfront Express
details.short_description: Customize and upgrade the Ironfront Express to kingdom come in this bullet-hell, tower-defense roguelite. Engineer and command the Ironfront Express in a unique take on lane defense, where you upgrade with specialized turrets, drones, and tactical abilities. Scrap the swarm!

details.title: Slime Break
details.short_description: Tower defense against a horde of thousands of slimes. Build walls, towers and traps along a funnel, pick level cards that bend each run, and watch the mass pile up, split and break through. Spend essence between runs to grow stronger.

details.title: Hellsino Pokerlike
details.short_description: Gamble for your soul in a roguelike deckbuilder where your deck is your life. Build deadly poker hands, unleash massive Nexus combos, and shield your cards from demonic Dealers. Cheat the casino and break the house before it breaks your deck.

details.title: Twistoon
details.short_description: Twist balloon toons that come alive and play on your screen. They stroll along your taskbar, stretch, chase their tails and earn you balloons. Make a postcard of your toon for a friend, hide a whisper inside, and they can put it on their own desk.

details.title: KEYLINGS
details.short_description: Every key on your keyboard becomes a tiny living creature. The more you type, the more your Keylings grow. They play, fall in love, and sometimes even fight in this charming life simulation. Compatible RGB devices can also react with synchronized lighting.

details.title: The Resilience Protocol
details.short_description: An incremental game about a switch. Wake up in a small room. Flip the switch. Watch the number go up. A calm voice thanks you for your contribution. Upgrade, automate, sleep, repeat, and listen carefully to what the voice says, and to what it corrects.

details.title: Zombie Crawlers
details.short_description: Crawl through a haunted mansion and gun down the undead with a deck of cards! ZOMBIE CRAWLERS is a 3D first-person roguelite deckbuilder where your deck is your boomstick. Explore the mansion, uncover its secrets, and face the neverending horrors behind each door.

details.title: Sturmjäger
details.short_description: Sturmjäger is a sci-fi shoot 'em up built for pure, adrenaline-fueled arcade action. Obliterate everything in sight, and master 10 unique missions solo or in local couch co-op. High-octane action, merciless boss fights await. Simple rules: If it moves, shoot it. If it doesn't... shoot it anyway!

details.title: 13Z: The Zodiac Trials
details.short_description: Go solo or team up with up to three friends in online co-op for this fast-paced, anime-inspired action roguelike. Master stylish hack and slash combat, craft overpowered builds, and conquer mythological trials to claim the title of the thirteenth Zodiac.

details.title: Tiny Night Market
details.short_description: A tiny night market lives right above your taskbar. While you work, the stalls cook, sell and grow on their own. When you have a minute, help out at the stalls, toss a few rings, fill regulars' orders and wait for rare visitors — and watch one candied-hawthorn cart grow into a glowing street.

details.title: Smoking at 2 am
details.short_description: A tiny late-night hangout by the water. Breathe out smoke, sculpt it into art, pull off 36 slow-motion smoke tricks and snap photos of the night while ambient music plays. Just don't chain-smoke - the night gets dizzy, with a cartoon rainbow ending.

details.title: Hook Nook
details.short_description: A cozy multiplayer idle-fishing game that sits on the bottom of your screen. Catch fish to unlock different biomes, socialize with shopkeepers, upgrade your gear, and maybe even try wearing a duck for a hat! Study, work or watch shorts while fishing with friends.

details.title: What the Duck
details.short_description: A co-op hunting adventure for 1–4 players. Call in birds, haul back your kills, and buy better gear as you explore increasingly strange hunting grounds. Bring your friends, load up the boat, and take on oversized bosses. It started with ducks.

details.title: BLIGHTFALL
details.short_description: A fast-paced roguelike FPS built on momentum. Slide-jump, air-strafe, and bunny-hop through relentless hordes, chain mid-air dash-executions, charge shrines for loot, and break the game with stacked builds before time runs out. Play solo or in online co-op for up to 4 players.

details.title: Everfront
details.short_description: Lead a nation through a roguelike strategy campaign where borders grow continuously. Choose your path, unlock technology and push the front.

details.title: Monster Mine IDLE
details.short_description: A free-to-play idle mining game: build a crew of cute miners, explore six biomes, open chests and eggs, and forge gear. Collapse the game into a compact bar and let the mine keep working while you use your computer.

details.title: Cash Only
details.short_description: Run a coffee shop by day and a drug business on the side. Serve customers, grow product, negotiate dead drops, avoid the cops, and split the work with friends in this co-op crime simulator.

details.title: Crime: 1997
details.short_description: Newport, 1997. Waterside gang member Henry Gallagher is thrust into a lethal spiral after a failed deal. Trapped between a police crackdown and the Sorvino Mafia, Henry must navigate a city ignited by "Pulse"—a volatile new drug turning every street into a warzone.

details.title: Main Event Mogul
details.short_description: Book the card, manage the roster and run the business of your own pro wrestling promotion, then watch every match play out in 3D as a live TV broadcast with entrances, commentary and a roaring crowd.

details.title: Beyond 33 Days
details.short_description: A story-driven, top-down survival shooter spanning thirty-three days of a collapsing city. Follow Su Nuan and Lin Shen, fight the infected, gather supplies, upgrade weapons and defend a shelter at night as you search for a way back to each other.

details.title: 太一剑歌
details.short_description: 《太一剑歌》是一款独特的东方幻想开放世界MMORPG！游戏拥有超过6万平方公里的超大无缝地图，你将在这个充满剑与魔法的世界中展开一场惊险刺激的自由冒险之旅！你的每一个行为将影响周围的世界，并决定这个世界的未来！

details.title: ANANTA
details.short_description: Welcome to ANANTA, an Urban Open World RPG. Play as a variety of characters and explore everything from bustling business districts and hidden alleyways, to quiet tea towns and buzzing old streets. Rub shoulders with a wide-ranging cast of intriguing characters as you assemble a team all your own.

details.title: Echoes of Aether
details.short_description: A hardcore indie action RPG exploring a post-purification world and uncovering the truth.

details.title: Cat Rooms: Sticker Decor!
details.short_description: Cat Rooms: Sticker Decor! is a relaxing sticker game about cozy rooms and cats. Pick up stickers with tweezers, place them into tiny dioramas, and slowly create warm little spaces you’ll want to return to after a noisy day.

details.title: The Fatal Card
details.short_description: A tactical 1v1 card duel in a dark fantasy world. 31 characters with their own skills: curses, diseases, undead summons, attacks across the whole board. Place your cards, exploit your opponent's weaknesses and beat the AI or real players in ranked Steam matches.

details.title: STRANGER THAN HEAVEN
details.short_description: A fifty-year, action-adventure saga of men with nowhere to go and their desperate struggle to find a home. Use extreme violence to survive, and musical talent to thrive as a showman across five cities and eras of modern Japan.

details.title: THE UNWRITTEN: Shadows of Iga
details.short_description: 1581. Iga burns. Kirimaru, a seventeen-year-old shinobi who survived, slips through the last years of the Sengoku era as a shadow who leaves no name — from the fall of Iga through Honnoji to Sekigahara. A retro, NES-style ninja RPG where every general leads thousands of troops into battle.

details.title: Extracto Proviso
details.short_description: Sent to a distant planet to feed a war you never chose, you are the perfect extraction machine. Build sprawling automated factories, survive a wilderness that fights back, and uncover whispers in the soil that make you question your directive. Extract everything. Then decide who it's for.

details.title: REQUIRED SYNERGY WORKSHOP: Deja Damnation
details.short_description: A participant disappears during a mandatory corporate workshop. The System restarts the session but keeps your answers, and the people around you remember how you treated them. A choice-driven psychological horror story about workplace rituals, surveillance, and a reality coming apart.

details.title: Pico32: The Lost Pages
details.short_description: A magical book appears in the woods, transported somehow from another dimension. Pico32: The Lost Pages is packed cover-to-cover with 32 creative games spanning every genre. Its chapters recall the history of a doomed world, and whisper a warning for our own.

details.title: Splorbit
details.short_description: Splorbit is a physics-driven horde survival game. Bounce, split and explode balls through swarming enemies, build a loadout from upgrade cards, break the gold off named bosses, and survive 20 minutes per world across 5 worlds. Solo or local co-op for up to 4 players.

details.title: Skill Eater
details.short_description: Skill Eater is a roguelite game where you've been turned into a slime with no choice but to steal opponents' skills to grow stronger. Eat your way through the humans and monsters that stand in your way, claim their powers, and aim to defeat the final boss that awaits you.

details.title: TankRat
details.short_description: A dying world, flesh given way to steel. Swarms of corrupted mech-monsters roam a desolated land. Search and destroy, scavenge and dismantle, rebuild yourself from the wreckage. What you take becomes what you are. Survive the wasteland. Make it to Highpoint.

details.title: Butt Out!
details.short_description: The neighbors are coming to drag you off the toilet. Feed the hero, combine foods, and aim a flexible pipe in this arcade wave defense game. Unlock new projectiles, stock up on food, build obstacles, and choose your upgrade path.

details.title: Once Upon a Kill
details.short_description: Red Hood hunts what the fairy tales were afraid of. Break Koschei's death out of a needle, feed Baba Yaga to her own oven, shatter the Snow Queen's heart. A brutal 2D action game in cut paper, ink and one red. Every tale ends on the Tree.

details.title: 闪耀！我的游戏班
details.short_description: You are her teacher. She is the last student in the game design class, and she dreams of making great games. For three years, guide her through classes, game development, part-time jobs, and competitions. But the industry is collapsing. Will she rise, or disappear? That is up to you.

details.title: Aery - Surreal World
details.short_description: In the story-driven flight exploration game Aery – Surreal World you play as a tiny bird shaped spirit drifting through impossible, dreamlike worlds on a journey to restore balance to a universe where reality has come undone.

details.title: Space Circle
details.short_description: Space Circle is a game that combines Circle TD and roguelike. Enemies have no final destination, and you must defeat them all within a limited time!

details.title: Willow Lake Food Park
details.short_description: Welcome to Willow Lake Food Park! Manage your food truck in this tiny cozy, casual sim! Unlock new trucks, experiment with your recipes, and maximize the happiness of your customers to get that sweet, sweet cash!

details.title: Gymnostia
details.short_description: Gymnostia is a short story about a basketball player who decides to practice for a crucial game after the school has closed for the night—only to encounter something that defies reality.

details.title: Multiverse Survivors
details.short_description: Unlock every universe, then field heroes and skills from different worlds together — dream matchups no history would allow. Einstein raises havoc in the Heavenly Court. Ancient generals hand-build an atom bomb. Odin opens fire with a gun. Sun Wukong fights aliens, and more.

details.title: Sneakin Femboy
details.short_description: Play as a femboy in this short 2D stealth comedy game :3

details.title: Defiance
details.short_description: Explore a new continent in this pixel art action RPG. Choose from ten classes, build your hero with skills and loot, take on quests, world events and guardians solo or in co-op with up to 4 players. Fully translated into 30 languages.

details.title: Paschalis TD
details.short_description: Build and upgrade towers to defend yourself against various enemies.

details.title: Road To Yvhalon
details.short_description: Road To Yvhalon is an action RPG specifically designed for Virtual Reality. Explore stunning maps, craft epic swords, defeat mysterious demons, and steal their souls to harness their powers!

details.title: EXTRAKTOR K.R.Y.P.T.
details.short_description: EXTRAKTOR K.R.Y.P.T. Explore abandoned places, face terrifying creatures, and complete missions as a team. Play with up to 6 friends, but be careful: every monster has its own unique mechanics. Will you survive and uncover the hidden lore?

details.title: Beadroom
details.short_description: Make fuse bead creations, iron them and decorate your apartment with things you have made yourself. A cozy crafting game with commissions from the neighbours, free mode and new boards to buy. Export your designs as printable templates to craft them in real life, too.

details.title: Fallen Hunter Ashen Crown
details.short_description: A challenging Action RPG where you hunt the Fallen across a world ravaged by corruption. Master fast-paced combat and overcome powerful enemies.

details.title: Bowl Big
details.short_description: An incremental bowling game where one pin becomes hundreds. Unlock a tech tree. Upgrade pins and balls. Dodge obstacles. Watch numbers skyrocket. Ditch the 10-pin limit and Bowl Big!

details.title: Delving The Depths
details.short_description: Escape imprisonment by delving into the caverns below your cell and exploring until your group reaches the surface in this first-person grid-based dungeon crawler with turn-based combat.

details.title: Kpop Infinite
details.short_description: Build and run your own K-pop entertainment company. Scout trainees, form your idol group, produce comebacks, and guide your artists from a tiny office to a global entertainment empire across generations that never truly end.

details.title: CityZen
details.short_description: Build a city from humble beginnings into an industrial metropolis. Manage supply chains, meet your citizens’ needs, and keep essential services running in a deep economic simulation that rewards good planning without demanding perfection.

details.title: Everpixel
details.short_description: Everpixel is what happens when you combine tactical RPG, pixels, and wiener dogs. Lead your motley crew to pixelated dominance--or die trying.

details.title: FACULA
details.short_description: Explore, Build, and Fight in this handcrafted solar system with many secrets to discover and enemies to defeat! FACULA is an open world exploration and base-building focused game where you fight monsters and survive on an array of unknown worlds.

details.title: My Colony 2
details.short_description: My Colony 2 is a next-generation 3D space colony simulator and city builder. Construct sprawling cities on alien worlds, manage resources, form alliances, and explore new frontiers in a fully moddable sandbox environment.

details.title: Time Stop Tower Defense
details.short_description: A fast-paced, time-focused twist on tower defense with a strong emphasis on story, gameplay progression, and world-building.

details.title: Medium Rare
details.short_description: Eat people and conserve ammo as you hike to the top of a mountain where a human meat factory is about to process your kidnapped wife in this turn based survival dungeon crawler.

details.title: SORROW: Rise of Divinity
details.short_description: An open-world action survival game combining fast-paced battle royale, competitive deathmatches, trophy hunting, and intense missions—where strategy and skill determine your fate.

details.title: The Official's Path
details.short_description: A satirical life simulation of China's civil service system. Rise from a lowly clerk to a powerful official, navigate corruption and political intrigue, make choices that shape your career, and discover where your principles end. 14 endings, 1000+ events, 45 years of modern Chinese history.

details.title: Ants TD
details.short_description: Thousands of ants race for your nest. Dig the paths they follow, block shortcuts with barricades and lure the swarm with fruit, then shoot, burn and blow it all up in a chaotic tower defense.

details.title: Radia Island
details.short_description: Radia Island is a civilization-building survival game. Lead your people to a new land, establish your first town, gather resources, research technologies, advance into the industrial age, and ultimately complete the space program.

details.title: Lucky Coin Pusher
details.short_description: Lucky Coin Pusher is a coin pusher simulator focused on deck-building. Combine characters, coins (or bowling balls), stickers, items and other elements to build unique synergies and hit the jackpot.

details.title: THORNSPELL
details.short_description: Embody a magical florist by placing plants strategically in your garden, and watering them to score points. THORNSPELL is a garden-building roguelike where you will create and unleash chains of magical effects, dispelling the corruption spreading through your home.

details.title: Lexip
details.short_description: Lexip is a cozy fantasy factory game about magic, rail logistics, and questionable sustainability. Build production chains across the overworld and underground, power machines with local magic, fulfill contracts, and keep Null pollution under control.

details.title: Object 24
details.short_description: A psychological horror game set in a Soviet apartment. By day, explore your home, search for clues, uncover secrets and perform rituals. At night, it becomes a trap — hide, use the environment and defend yourself with whatever you can find. Survive the night and remember what you tried to forget.

name: Shunx's Tyrhia ~ What a Beautiful Dawn ~

details.title: Shunx's Tyrhia ~ What a Beautiful Dawn ~
details.short_description: In 1863 Japan, steam technology from another world has transformed Edo into a mechanical city. Young swordsman Hachiro Iba is ordered to escort a mysterious girl, Rin, to Kyoto, but soon becomes caught in a conspiracy that could change the course of history.

details.title: Gay It Loud
details.short_description: Dating in the dreamy shopping mall of 1995! Hang out at the food court, have sloppy makeouts in the dressing room, loiter in the arcade, and collect nostalgic toys.

details.title: Star Driver Ultra
details.short_description: year 2050 ULTRA high speed combat racing on the Moon

details.title: Witch, Gnomes, Faun and Others
details.short_description: Put your gnomes to work, build a settlement, and keep the local witch happy in this first-person mix of village management and fairy-tale horror. Rebuild the Gnomehenge to get everyone home.

details.title: Hack You
details.short_description: Desktop hacking and social engineering in a moral thriller. Write viruses, hide them in game builds, crack other people's PCs — to get to the former friend who stole your life and built a new success on its ruins.

details.title: Souq Boss Simulator
details.short_description: Every Sheikh-sized fortune has to start somewhere. Yours starts with a tiny baqala. Manage your shop, meet the locals, build your fortune, and invest across a 2002 Gulf city inspired by Old Dubai & Riyadh. Solo or with friends in online co-op. Become the Souq Boss.

details.title: Bonville Bandit
details.short_description: A pixel-art stealth game. During the night roam the neighbourhood and steal from houses, be careful to not get caught by the guards or other security measures. When the sun rises, live the village life and get ready for the next night.

details.title: Clowntown
details.short_description: A co-op minigame campaign where the minigames play you! Collaborate (or sabotage) your way through action puzzles and evolving minigames that will have you laughing, screaming, and honking for 2-8 friends.

details.title: Hellforged
details.short_description: Hellforged is a loot-driven, extraction bullet-heaven game. Fight through demon-infested maps, pre-craft your build, hunt powerful gear, and combine abilities into epic synergies. Every run is a tense heist. Safely extract epic gear mid-battle or risk it all for greater rewards!

details.title: Illyrium: Chronicles
details.short_description: Recruit heroes and craft powerful builds from masteries, classes, spells and equipment. Use these systems to build each character your way, then command your party in challenging turn-based tactical combat.

details.title: Cook, Serve, Delicious: Remustard!
details.short_description: Welcome back, Chef! Take your restaurant from a one star abomination to a five star wonder in this new take on a million-selling classic. With new art, a new campaign, and a new local co-op mode, there's never been a better time to get cooking.

details.title: Idle Tides
details.short_description: Idle Tides is an idle incremental where your goal is simple: Catch as many fish as you can. Unlock new boats to automate your fishing, upgrade your fleet, and help the island with this fish overpopulation!

details.title: Address The Mess
details.short_description: Address The Mess is a single-player narrative sim. Clean up the scattered post, use magic, solve puzzles, find props and assemble furniture,. Unlock & use magic spells and be unstoppable, or relax and enjoy the narrative sim at your own pace, with a spirit dog, cat and your friendly mail pigeon.

details.title: Galactic Disharmony
details.short_description: A Sci-fi First-person shooter and Strategy game. Command and control your fleets and planets, build troops and extract resources in the solar maps' turn-based strategic mode. Then head into battle with your troops in large-scale first-person warfare to conquer planets.

details.title: Island Farm
details.short_description: Island Farm is a highscore game where each plant has a unique ability. Combine them strategically, level up upgrades and try again with different game modifiers.

details.title: Squimo
details.short_description: The Squimo have taken over this planet. Grab your weapons, fight your way through endless hordes of Squimo, and face the Squimo King to reclaim the planet!

details.title: Iron Sumo Rivals
details.short_description: Push, grapple and throw your way to victory in Iron Sumo Rivals, an arcade sumo wrestling game with pixel-art fighters in 3D arenas. Rise through the ranks, build a lasting career, or challenge a friend in local versus bouts.

details.title: POUND SAND
details.short_description: Every pixel simulated, including the machines. Dig into alien planets, build a factory from real blocks, and carve it into any shape you want. Ore sinks and sand rises in the greatest competition in the galaxy. Move it, grind it, melt it, freeze it, sell it, and strip the planet to bedrock.

details.title: GRINDWORM
details.short_description: A short horror game where you pilot a grinddozer through a nightmare buried underground. Workplace safety rules no longer apply. Just remember: DON'T. STOP. DIGGING.

details.title: FlockSol
details.short_description: FlockSol is an incremental top-down survival game. Light up the dark and defeat the monsters hiding inside. Spend their essences to unlock and upgrade your skills. Summon your past souls to fight alongside you. Reach your full potential, survive the night and cleanse the world of darkness.

details.title: Peter the Stash Hunter
details.short_description: A business sim + looting + strategy hybrid. Outbid rival hunters at storage auctions, ransack what you win, then run the shop that bankrolls Peter's search for his missing grandfather. Sabotage cards, Dutch vs English bidding, harpoon chases. Every box could hide a secret.

details.title: Battle-Lines
details.short_description: Like playing Go with puzzle pieces. Build, recolor and steal lines to dominate the board! Play local, online or against AI.

details.title: Waifu Bubble
details.short_description: Dive into a charming underwater puzzle adventure! Play solo or with a friend, control adorable crabs, and guide a trapped waifu through clever two-layer levels. Solve puzzles, work together, and help her reach the surface!

details.title: Mondrian Puzzle
details.short_description: A zen-style puzzle game inspired by the works of Piet Mondrian. Finish puzzles your own way, play the colors, and save them as wallpapers for your phone or computer.

details.title: Sibling Steelers ~Forge & Family~
details.short_description: This game is created with RPG Maker MZ. Play as Alyssa's brother, slaying monsters, collecting materials in dungeons, and completing various events for the sake of your sister's dream...

details.title: Forbidden Love
details.short_description: Love for forbidden dreams, Forbidden Love is a visual novel about the love between a teacher and a student, in pursuit of a forbidden dream.

details.title: Silent Mainland
details.short_description: Silent Mainland is a Roguelike deck-builder mixing positioning and board tactics on a 5×12 battlefield. Every card is a life-or-death choice. As monster waves surge like a tide, only sharp positioning and smart deckbuilding carve a path to survival.

details.title: Chiasmus
details.short_description: Viktor finds himself in a mysterious apartment with no way out. He discovers an amazing ability to move between two parallel worlds. This discovery helps him piece together the scattered fragments of what is happening and find the key to solving the mystery.

details.title: Forbidden brew
details.short_description: Run a tavern in a dystopian city where magic is illegal. Serve ordinary customers by day, sell forbidden potions in secret, identify informants, hide the evidence and survive government raids.

details.title: isekizima: Ruins and Tails Journey
details.short_description: isekizima: Ruins and Tails Journey is a 2D action game. Kijino, a cat-eared adventurer with two tails (Nekomata), embarks on a journey to Isekizima (Ruins Island of dreams and romance: as it was written in the tourist brochure). Explore ruins buried in the forest while enjoying folk music.

details.title: Hunter's Hand
details.short_description: A dark fantasy roguelike deckbuilder where every clue you uncover wakes the thing hunting you. Build a lethal deck across branching paths, weather corrupting biomes, and raise the Threat - then discover how much of an Ancient's attention you can survive.

details.title: Duke Saith
details.short_description: A fantasy island city-builder where elves, vampires, and minotaurs live together. Meet the Duke's demands or his fall will unleash the Empire's legions, manage each race's Mind gauge to prevent arson and strikes, run train logistics, and grow strong enough to claim independence!

details.title: Candy Hollow
details.short_description: One more treat before bed? A candy hunt in your bedroom leads to a dark factory. Solve hands-on puzzles, hide from the Candy Man, and choose what goes in the mixer in this first-person retro horror game.

details.title: Until You're Empty
details.short_description: A fast-paced action platformer set in a vertical arena. Dash, leap and slash through waves of enemies and deadly bosses. Manage your stamina carefully: every jump and sword strike costs you, and one mistake can leave you running on empty. One hit is all it takes to die.

details.title: Build a Sand Castle
details.short_description: Build a Sand Castle. Complete the task from the rich man and earn yourself 1M Dollars. The Castle is Enormous so you will be here for a while... But it would be faster if you used the Abilities and "Sugar" the man gave to you.

details.title: Grr Grr Gnomes
details.short_description: A co-op adventure about tiny gnomes on a very big ocean. Sail from island to island, scavenge for supplies, fight strange creatures, survive whatever goes horribly wrong, and keep your ship moving toward one goal, finding the way home...

details.title: Below Lethe
details.short_description: The River Lethe holds memories of the dead. Use its memories to uncover what happened and prove a soul's guilt in the Underworld. His guilt seemed clear—until truth shook the verdict. Knowing all the truth, can you still call him guilty? A story-driven psychological horror about memory and judgment.

details.title: Pack It In!
details.short_description: Unload trucks, stack awkward belongings, and squeeze everything into tiny storage units. A satisfying 3D packing puzzle about weird customers, stranger possessions, and making the impossible fit.

details.title: Plink Void
details.short_description: Plink Void is a dungeon crawler roguelike with a pachinko combat system and a dark fantasy atmosphere. Build your loadout with various items, throw blade-balls, and smash skull-pegs with them

details.title: Plura Ingenia: Patient 16
details.short_description: Face yourself, endure surreal trials, and survive a clinical evaluation that adapts to how you think and behave. Your intake begins in a psychological horror experience where your fears, choices, and personality profile carry into future chapters.

details.title: Tiny Shop: make it cozy
details.short_description: Leave the hustle and bustle behind and bring your dream of a cozy little shop to life! Create, decorate, and watch visitors fall in love. Let your imagination run wild and craft a beautiful, inviting space they'll want to return to again and again.

details.title: BoomScroll
details.short_description: Evaporate endless hordes of creatures as you scroll your way to freedom! Grab upgrades, build your arsenal, and scroll at the speed of light to make it as far as you can!

details.title: Ro Sham Brawl
details.short_description: Ro Sham Brawl is a rock, paper, scissors fighting game where you brawl your friends in chaotic rounds of fast-paced, physics-based competition. Launch powerful attacks with crazy abilities, while destroying arenas and friendships with every shot.

details.title: Rank & Ruin
details.short_description: Real-time squad combat meets roguelite progression. Pick your faction, earn legendary heroes on the battlefield, and grow stronger with every run in Rank & Ruin

details.title: CoreRunner
details.short_description: Imprisoned within the Core, your only hope of escape are your light blades. Strap them on, grab your guns and your katanas, then experience a retrowave prison break. Skate, shoot, and slash your way to freedom under the neon glow of cyberspace, to the tune of a pulsing synthwave soundtrack.

details.title: Hellmate - Chess Deck Builder
details.short_description: Roguelike deckbuilding chess in the seven floors of Hell. Each floor belongs to a deadly sin, and every sin crowns its own king. Summon pieces, sling spells, and brand your army with sigils to melt the king's HP before your turns run out. Seven sins, seven kings, one deck.

details.title: Crack the Crate
details.short_description: Crack the Crate is a super-satisfying crate-smashing incremental game. Open crates, collect 288 items and their rare variants, and upgrade your way from wooden boxes to cosmic crates. Can you find the legendary Dodo?

details.title: Last Lie
details.short_description: Everyone's lying. One of them is you. "Last Lie" is a first-person social deduction game with built-in positional voice — no typing, only talking. Hunt the mafia or draw a word one player was never told. Mafia: 5–14 players. Clueless: 3–8.

details.title: Sender Unknown
details.short_description: Work the night shift in an underground sorting facility. Weigh packages, compare their contents, and meet your quota by 6 AM. But beware, some packages hide dark secrets. Identify bad batches, earn cash, and survive the night in this tense PSX-style horror job simulator.

name: There is No Stress in Outer Space

details.title: There is No Stress in Outer Space
details.short_description: An incremental game about a spaceship in outer space destroying asteroids and other strange objects. Take control of the spaceship's gun, shoot, earn money, make upgrades and unlock new weapons and targets.

details.title: A Roguelike Tower Defense
details.short_description: Build a unique defense every run in this roguelike tower defense. Choose a hero, discover new towers, collect upgrade cards, and create powerful synergies to overcome increasingly difficult enemies and bosses.

details.title: Neural Repair
details.short_description: ATTENTION OPERATOR: Congrats on volunteering to repair a dying AI! (You didn't volunteer.) Light every tile. Do not retrace your steps. In this puzzle roguelike, avoid traps, fog, and that red thing. Should your stability hit zero, all progress will be wiped. NEXUS thanks you for your sacrifice!

details.title: Keycap Keycap!
details.short_description: Enjoy the satisfying click of every keycap! Collect a variety of keycaps, upgrade your skills, and acquire powerful Relic Keycaps. Keycap Keycap! is a short and satisfying incremental ASMR game.

details.title: ur round
details.short_description: a small, cosy co-op pub game for you and your mates, played as birds. a cramped bar, chaotic nights, pop-up trouble and jobs everywhere, and it gets harder every night. you probably won't survive night 7.

details.title: Will It Break?
details.short_description: Pack a bottle, yeet it down the stairs, and posterize the outtake. A clean delivery pays but a spectacular disaster might pay better. Build a channel from just you and your mom and besties built on physics chaos, one staircase at a time.

details.title: Spin Tide
details.short_description: Spin to win in this open-sea survivors-like where a lone wind turbine becomes a force of nature. Stack wild upgrades into game-breaking builds, turn oil-guzzling pirate hordes into driftwood and defy colossal oil tankers to clean up the seas one spin at a time.

details.title: Nightbound
details.short_description: Two strangers share one house at the end of the world. Their only hope: trust each other, fix up a van, and reach a mountain too cold for the Bloom to follow. You fight as a pair with turn-based tactics. Live the days together, hold the house at night, and build a bond that outgrows the Bloom.

details.title: POLYARIS
details.short_description: A first-person Arctic survival game where the cold is deadlier than any enemy. Explore on skis and by boat, scavenge supplies, fight to survive, manage your warmth, food and water, uncover the secrets of the desolate North, and find your way home.

details.title: StowStow
details.short_description: StowStow is a first-person warehouse sim where every box is a physics object. Stop the train, unload and sort cargo, handle explosive parcels with care and load the trucks. Draft upgrade cards and build conveyor lines until the depot runs itself.

details.title: Fogreaver
details.short_description: Shoot zombies. Earn cash. Take back your Base Camp and clear the surrounding areas. Bring home supplies, upgrade your weapons and head out for more. Wake the hordes, lure them into traps or fight from horseback. Kill every last infected to keep what you earned. Then gear up for the next run.

details.title: Forgotten - Whispers of the Past
details.short_description: Something in this abandoned boarding school refuses to rest. Use your flashlight to survive what lurks in its hallways and solve the puzzles that reveal its dark past. Will you find the truth, or will you be the one forgotten tonight?

details.title: Sirin's Feather
details.short_description: The Bird of the Dead has taken your beloved. How many times will you have to die to bring her back? Gather companions, uncover their secrets, and shape the story in a world where pagan myths come alive.

details.title: Stack Out
details.short_description: Obviously, Cubes are known for their aerodynamics. Dash, slide, wall run, grind, and swing through dreamlike worlds. Play solo or with up to 5 friends. Chase every medal, then architect a world of your own and see how you stack out.

details.title: Time Champions
details.short_description: Recruit units from different historical periods and defend the timeline against alien invaders in this action-roguelike. Mix and match units to discover game-breaking synergies and use hero powers to survive enemy hordes. Unlock new units and evolve them to wreak absolute chaos on the battlefield!

details.title: Mortal Chess
details.short_description: Every piece is living on borrowed time. In Mortal Chess, each piece's life counts down with every move. Collect the coins from expired pieces, buy extra turns, deploy reinforcements, and earn the queen you don't start with. Play vs AI or local split-screen PvP. Checkmate isn't the only way to lose.

details.title: Bullet Barrage
details.short_description: Shoot. Dodge. Control the distance. Bullet Barrage is a commandless 1v1 bullet-hell action game featuring 8 unique fighters, CPU battles, local versus, and online multiplayer.

details.title: Shortcut Hero: Grid City
details.short_description: Turn real keyboard shortcuts into devastating attacks in a fast-paced arcade action game. Defend Grid City from relentless robot invasions, chain explosive combos, and master the skills that separate heroes from high-score legends.

details.title: Cat and Dog: Princess Guardians
details.short_description: Dark demons swept across the entire continent, and the princess embarked on the road of escape. Along the way, she encountered many cats and dogs that had been ostracized and abandoned by the world. In the end, these cats and dogs voluntarily transformed into guard towers to protect the princess

details.title: Sealed Gate
details.short_description: Sealed Gate is an exciting pixel 2D MMORPG with a huge world, lots of quests, crafting and social gameplay. Engage in battles with monsters, explore mysterious locations and become the hero of your own fantasy story!

name: VOID DIVER: Escape from the Abyss

details.title: VOID DIVER: Escape from the Abyss
details.short_description: Dive into a city swallowed by the Abyss. Slay aberrations, grab artifacts, and survive until the Diving Booth arrives. A 2.5D pixel art extraction action RPG with up to 3-player co-op. Run the antique shop 'BALUSHA' and uncover the city's secrets.

details.title: MAGNUM Protocol
details.short_description: Take control of the M1A5 MAGNUM. Fight mechs, drones, robots, and enemy tanks across ruined cities, frozen wastelands, and abandoned battlefields. Explore a hostile world and customize your tank with a powerful arsenal of weapons and upgrades as you uncover the secrets buried beneath the ruins.

details.title: DARK IN LIGHT
details.short_description: A man who falls asleep while working late wakes up in an unfamiliar city overrun by monsters. Survive with limited resources and explore the city by following clues through the darkness. You must press on to make it back to the son waiting for you.

details.title: Labyrinth of the Crystal Princess
details.short_description: A horror adventure that tasks you with detecting the Unseen to escape the facility's labyrinths alive.

details.title: Long Watch
details.short_description: A short incremental game about an old relay station waking up from deep hibernation. Collect signals, decode the messages they carry, and grow your station into a network across nearby sectors.

details.title: Cats In The Shell
details.short_description: Provoke explosive chain reactions and experiment ever-evolving combat strategies in this mech-building roguelike auto battler. Mix and match components and mech modules to discover powerful synergies, then watch each creation spring to life in satisfying combat sequences.

details.title: Rottenroots
details.short_description: You play as Salem, torn between family and forbidden love, thrown into a three-day death tournament. Can you help him survive, love, rescue and betray... while figuring out who he wants to be? 25+ endings and 300+ choices await in a hauntingly beautiful dystopia.

details.title: Stip
details.short_description: Assign, undo, deduce! Solve a series of minimalist number puzzles. Use constraints to assign numbers to the correct stips. Navigate the interconnected puzzles to uncover secrets. Please ignore any odd Stip behavior.

details.title: Medieval Frontiers
details.short_description: First-person colony simulation where strategy meets survival in a demanding, medieval wilderness. Construct gridless settlements, establish production chains, and manage the needs, desires, and work morale of your villagers to ensure their survival through the harsh realities of nature and disease.

details.title: Killing Things With Your Friends
details.short_description: Rip limbs off mutants and use them as weapons in this chaotic co-op survival game about dark humour and dismemberment. Hack through mutant hordes, work as a team, and survive lethal challenges for profit!

details.title: Lost Lands
details.short_description: A minimalistic, chill city builder inspired by Nordic culture and landscape, with mysteries to uncover and a unique world to discover.

details.title: Pocket Racer Shop Sim
details.short_description: Create the ultimate Pocket Racer hobby shop. Stock the shelves, open car packs, build miniature race cars and expand your store over time. Design custom tracks and invite your friends over to help run the shop or to throw down on the latest track setup.

details.title: Wait, They Can Climb?!
details.short_description: In this incremental Tower Defense you are alone on top of a building, surrounded by thousands of zombies. Place the turrets, grab the rifle and survive 10 days waiting for rescue. But be careful: they can climb!

details.title: You've Changed
details.short_description: You've Changed is like scary "spot the difference". Observe changes in the environment and catch enemies before they attack in this retro-inspired, anomaly horror game! You've Changed features hand-animated rotoscoped enemy graphics and finely-tuned gameplay balance.

details.title: Hexrite
details.short_description: You are a sorcerer seeking to fulfil a magical ritual to summon an ancient dead deity. Cast mystical domes, explore fantastical realms and meet a peculiar cast of characters in this stylized PS2-inspired action-platformer!

details.title: PaintScape
details.short_description: PaintScape is a 3D coloring book you can step into. Every map starts as a blank line drawing. Pick any brush and paint freely, or color by numbers. As you paint, sleepy flowers wake up and little chimneys begin to puff smoke. Walk around inside your painting, where every mistake is a happy accident.

details.title: Backrooms: Impending Doom
details.short_description: The research team is gone. You're next. A first-person psychological horror in the Backrooms - explore ruined levels, keep your Synchronization steady, and uncover what destroyed your research team. Free demo: the Prologue.

details.title: Clash of Melodies
details.short_description: A Visual Novel Rhythm Game that tells the story of two dorks who don't like each other going on an adventure together. Play the DDR / FNF inspired Arrow Mode and the original Circle Mode. Enjoy the story or go for a highscore in Freeplay.

details.title: SwipSwap
details.short_description: SwipSwap is a fast-paced 3D game where every hit is fatal. Fight alongside your shadow—which echoes your moves with a 2-second delay—swap positions instantly, and purge Dracoulous’ castle room by room. Sharp reflexes, positioning, and ruthless timing are your only hope.

details.title: KYC: K Stands for Killing
details.short_description: Suneil starts his new night job at a gas station on the outskirts of Highwayton, Colorado. The customers keep coming but few of them leave. Something in the dark keeps asking for them.

details.title: LOVE COMPANY: A Romance Escape
details.short_description: Love leaves clues. Join LOVE COMPANY, a company that delivers feelings of love. Inspect objects, follow emotional traces, and solve puzzles to uncover the truth behind those feelings in this first-person romantic mystery escape-room game.

details.title: One More Asteroid
details.short_description: Drill voxel asteroids apart in an incremental mining game. Grow from one drill to a swarm of drones that mine where you aim. Unlock powerful tools, crack the core and watch the asteroid collapse. Then take on the next, stranger rock.

details.title: Musgro Farm
details.short_description: Start a farming empire in this incremental factory builder. Plant crops, combine them into recipes, and distribute them for sale. Optimize your layouts and reinvest in your infrastructure to maximize your output. Gain experience to unlock new technologies and expand your ever-growing automated farm.

details.title: Cat Secretary
details.short_description: Welcome to DOX HQ! Manage your lobby, catfish your boss and climb that corporate ladder. But when the sun goes down, the real work begins, because there’s only one thing standing between humanity and total AI automation: one very determined cat! Who's a good Cat Secretary? You are!

details.title: Snipers & Airdrops
details.short_description: A competitive sniper game for you and your friends, 1v1 or 2v2. Fight over airdrops falling into the middle of the map, outplay each other with agent abilities and wild movement, build a rifle that's all yours, and spend your winnings at the Black Market.

details.title: Murder Meet Cute
details.short_description: Look, just because I’m paid to fix computers, doesn’t mean I’ll sit here and listen to your life story. So what there’s been murders? Do I look like a detective?

details.title: Global Plates
details.short_description: Build food factories that keep a cat café purring. Plan at your own pace, serve fresh dishes through the rush and turn your best days into upgrades. Travel through ten kitchens in a cozy cooking-automation game about tasty efficiency.

details.title: Fill the Sky
details.short_description: A factory automation game where you are the mind of a self-replicating interstellar probe. Turn barren rock and ocean into sprawling industry that feeds the data centers you run on. Launch copies of yourself until they fill the sky. No enemies. Build at your own pace.

details.title: Usual June
details.short_description: Fight monsters, talk to ghosts, and get to the bottom of a mystery threatening to obliterate an entire city in Usual June, a third-person action-adventure game about combat, cupcakes, and community.

details.title: Portabellows
details.short_description: Explore a whimsical island to find… pie recipes?! Bake them by gathering or growing ingredients, which may be the key to helping out your new found quirky friends leave the island! In this wholesome 3D platformer collectathon, you can enjoy discovering the world freely at your own pace.

details.title: CRIMSON GATE
details.short_description: A roguelite RPG where auto battler meets tower defense! Summon and deploy 30 battle dolls. Grow your legion with gear and card combos, and take on the final boss waiting at the end of 100 waves.

details.title: Kagenazo
details.short_description: Kagenazo is a 3D shadow puzzle game where you build cube shapes, rotate them, and match their silhouettes from multiple angles. Solve over 190 puzzles across 2x2x2, 3x3x3, and 4x4x4 cubes while chasing cleaner solutions, faster times, and higher star ratings.

details.title: Defend the Village
details.short_description: Build towers along winding waterways and Defend your Village against pirate fleets. Combine mythic powers, grow crops, research upgrades, and face powerful bosses across multiple maps in an epic single-player fantasy tower defense adventure.

details.title: I Buried Steve
details.short_description: Eight players build a lethal beach obstacle course, then all eight have to survive it. Think Ultimate Chicken Horse crossed with Fall Guys, with axes, artillery and a Sharknado. Draft the traps, rig the sand, then run for your life as the water rises.

details.title: Demra: Rifts of War
details.short_description: Real-time strategy in the spirit of the 90s classics. Build your base, seize mines and lead your army with a spell-casting hero against a demon invasion – or command the demons yourself.

details.title: Crowd of Knives
details.short_description: An online PvP stealth game where every assassin looks like an NPC. Blend into a crowded medieval marketplace, hunt your targets, and strike without being seen. Get caught killing, and the bounty is on your head. Now you're the one being hunted. Pick and use your abilities to outplay the others.

details.title: Field of Heroes
details.short_description: Swords, sorcery – and soccer. Assemble your friends and get on the Field of Heroes, the wildest, most radical online sports brawler ever. Sharpen your weapons, focus your spells, and SCORE!

details.title: Sweepcremental
details.short_description: minesweeper, but with a skill tree.

details.title: Illegourmet
details.short_description: From underground kitchen to culinary empire. Cook and distribute illegal food across a city obsessed with healthy eating. Expand your network of kitchens, automate production, and take over the black market for flavor.

details.title: ZOMBILLIONAIRE
details.short_description: Incremental FPS game where Millions of Zombies came from the dead... AND THEY ARE FULL OF OIL!!!!!! Demolish Millions of Zombies. Buy Insane Weapons. and become a Zombie Oil Billionaire

details.title: The Outer Islands
details.short_description: Explore a quarantined island chain and an automated hospital abandoned for twenty years. Investigate a returning signal, read the evidence left behind, solve mechanical systems, and evade machines that still believe they have patients.

details.title: Grid Forge TD
details.short_description: Stop continuous waves of enemies by building a maze in this free flowing tower defense game. Purchase upgrades between runs to become even more powerful and go further next time.

details.title: Idle Forgewarden
details.short_description: A cozy pixel-art blacksmith forge that lives on your desktop and keeps working while you do other things. Step in whenever you like to time the hammer, take commissions, arm adventurers for the road and grow a humble forge into a legendary smithy.

details.title: Crystals Of Irm
details.short_description: Crystals Of Irm is an old school RPG with a distinctive combat system and dungeon crawl elements. With three heroes you explore Irm, visit the different regions of the land and climb deep down into the darkest dungeons.

details.title: Special Agent: Aigis Pink
details.short_description: Aigis Pink and Blue work together under Tritonis to combat the evil organization known as Joker. A month after Aigis Blue infiltrates Joker's hideout alone and goes missing, Aigis Pink begins searching for her missing partner...

details.title: Stock Car Classics: Championship Season
details.short_description: Race door to door in a throwback stock car racing experience! Battle hard-fighting opponents, build rivalries, and chase the championship across asphalt, concrete, and dirt ovals.

details.title: NEXT OBJECTIVE
details.short_description: The objective marker IS the monster. Play as Tom, a very obedient boy, and teach him how to disobey. Leave the playable area, break the rules, and fight back against a game that wants you to stay on script.

details.title: Pigeon Gang
details.short_description: Pigeon Gang is a physics-based co-op horror game for 1–6 players. Play as thieving pigeons, grab loot with your sticky tongue, explore dangerous locations, hide from monsters, and escape together. Stealing is easy. Surviving is not.

details.title: Soulstonia
details.short_description: Recruit Summoners with minds of their own in this single-player 2.5D fantasy RPG. Control them individually, as a party, or set goals for them to gather, craft, and fight on their own. Explore five regions in a procedural world, complete quests, train 20+ skills, and summon an army. Free to play.

details.title: Crownmarked
details.short_description: Rule a fallen kingdom: manage its people, send adventurers into dangerous lands, and explore the wilds yourself to learn what broke the world.

details.title: Forge More, Mole!
details.short_description: Sell now, or try one more upgrade? Become a mole blacksmith and strike the anvil to raise your weapons' level and value. Head home after a day's trading, where unexpected events await to shake up your ordinary routine.

details.title: DOOBAK
details.short_description: While you were sleeping, a blizzard buried the entire village in snow. Now you need to evacuate alone or with a team of up to 4 players! Dig tunnels, scavenge for supplies, warm up by campfires, and try to call for rescue.

details.title: Tides of Empires
details.short_description: Two empires, one sea. Tides of Empires is the tower defense roguelite game you can finally play competitively. Command warships, aircraft and submarines in ranked 1v1 & 2v2 duels, in a challenging campaign and endless Survival. Rule the tides.

details.title: Third Bloc
details.short_description: A text-based political management sandbox set in the Cold War. Balance the budget, recruit experts, bargain with rival powers, answer telegrams, and drag a poor new republic into the space age. Or bury it in a nuclear one. All in animated ASCII.

details.title: CURSOR SLASH
details.short_description: A pixel-art incremental game where your mouse cursor attacks automatically! Slaughter slimes to earn gold and collect ores such as copper, iron, and gold. Unlock a variety of skills, weapons, relics, and coins, then sweep away hordes of slimes!

details.title: Dudo
details.short_description: How good are you at lying? Everyone cheats, and cheating is the rules in Dudo. Peek under cups, nudge your dice, lie to a table of crooks and climb through smoky back rooms to find out who is the Owner. A roguelike deckbuilder of bluffs, loaded dice and bad company.

details.title: Witch Shop Simulator
details.short_description: Step behind the counter of your very own sorcery shop. Witch Shop Simulator is a cozy first-person shop management game where you invent and brew custom potions, manage your stock, and keep your shelves full of magical wonders for customers to buy.

details.title: FIND KITTENS 14: Slavic Mythology
details.short_description: In a faraway kingdom… kittens are hiding! What are you waiting for? Explore a hand-drawn world of Slavic myths and folk tales, find hidden kittens, and fill the black-and-white scenes with different colors.

details.title: Local Game Store Simulator
details.short_description: Run your own local game store and rewrite the rules. Crack packs, haggle over trade-ins and chase numbered pulls with up to 8 players in co-op or rival stores. Build your own cards, packs, games and consoles and share them on Steam Workshop.

details.title: Midnight 42
details.short_description: One of you just wants to sleep. Everyone else is a mosquito. Buzz, bite and sabotage until the human snaps, or grab the swatter, finish your chores and fall asleep before 6 AM. Online asymmetric party game for 2–7 players (1 human vs up to 6 mosquitoes) with proximity voice chat.

details.title: Seaside Wash
details.short_description: Seaside Wash is a cozy job simulator where you clean, repair, and restore ships from rust and barnacles to pristine condition. Upgrade tools, grow your business, discover rare finds, build your own ship, and enjoy peaceful seaside activities.

details.title: MIXBALL: Football Basketball Volleyball Tennis
details.short_description: Mixball combines the world's most popular sports into one action packed game. Play Soccer, Basketball, Volleyball, and Tennis in the same arena. Enjoy Single Player, Local Multiplayer, or Online modes as you challenge your friends in fast paced, adrenaline filled matches.

details.title: Island Keeper
details.short_description: Island Keeper is a cozy exploration and restoration adventure. As maintenance robot Ferrum-1, clean up a polluted archipelago, recycle rubbish into gear and stations, and watch every island turn green again as wildlife returns.

details.title: RumBall Stadium
details.short_description: Vehicles. Arenas. Friends to crush. RumBall Stadium: the Free to Play multiplayer vehicular combat game ! Drive Tanks, 4x4s and Racers in explosive arenas ! Collect Coins, equip Super Powers and crush your friends ! Discover multiple arenas and game modes !

details.title: Smash Arena
details.short_description: An online party game for up to 12 players: brick-built toys clash in wild, physics-driven challenges. Run, jump, shove, survive the glass bridge and Red Light… and climb onto the podium. Dress up your toy and challenge your friends!

details.title: Brofish
details.short_description: Brofish is an autobattler roguelite with Tower Defense elements. Catch and upgrade bizarre fish, combine items, effects, and hold back waves of undead to save the village from the Sea King!

details.title: Super Galaxy Gladiator
details.short_description: Super Galaxy Gladiator is a survivor roguelite focused on buildcrafting and inventory management. Fight waves of enemies, buy and upgrade items mid-run, and arrange your gear to create insane builds and synergies in the galactic arena.
