Venture into hazardous zones consumed by a biological catastrophe, battle mutated creatures of all shapes and sizes with firearms and melee weapons, and gradually uncover the truth behind the disaster as you advance through tense, tightly paced linear levels.

details.title: Tongyou Town
details.short_description: A town that runs itself. You decide who ventures out, where they go, and what the town sells. Recruit, form squads, farm regions, craft gear, and run the market — the rest happens without you.

details.title: Idle Caravan
details.short_description: A cozy idle adventure you can play in a small desktop window. Ride your giant bison across a magical world, deliver packages, discover creatures, and let your journey continue while you do other things.

details.title: SPEARHEAD
details.short_description: Eastern Front, 1944. Command the entire battle as a commander — then climb into your ace tank and fight it out yourself. real penetration physics where armor thickness, impact angle, and ammunition decide everything. WW2 RTS and tank simulation collide in a single battle.

details.title: Joseon Delivery
details.short_description: Walk and run across the eight provinces of Joseon-era Korea as a courier. From the stone-wall lanes of Jeju to the foothills of Geumgangsan, carry parcels and letters, hear the story behind each one, and collect a song from every town. A cozy journey on foot, with no combat and no failure.

details.title: Brawliens
details.short_description: Punch your friends off a flying saucer. Sneak snacks past a sleeping cat. Race karts across a giant kitchen. Brawliens is a first-person party game for 2–8 players online: 43 minigames, sneaky gadgets and one FINAL BRAWL where even the leader can lose.

name: 深夜閲覧 Midnight Reading：Showa Echoes

details.title: 深夜閲覧 Midnight Reading：Showa Echoes
details.short_description: Midnight Reading is a short horror adventure set in a Showa-era Japanese school. As a library committee member, search for overdue books. Read, return, and make choices as the story branches into three routes and a True Route.

details.title: Hearts Gone Black
details.short_description: Hearts Gone Black is a top-down zombie survival game set in a post-apocalyptic open world. Manage your base and survivors, scavenge, gather resources, craft equipment, and defend against infected while endure a broken world where weather, hunger, sanity, and moral choices can slowly wear you down.

details.title: Dust & Dig
details.short_description: Dig anywhere for buried treasure, wrestle rattlesnakes with fully physics-driven hands, and haul the loot back to town to sell. Buy bigger shovels, follow legendary treasure maps and take on three desert bosses: alone, or in online co-op with up to 3 friends.

details.title: OCULUM
details.short_description: OCULUM is a challenging first-person platformer set within a strange and unsettling world. Every step is a gamble, and every mistake is brutal. Climb toward the summit, uncover its secrets, and face whatever is waiting above. Will you endure?

details.title: One Step Higher
details.short_description: This is a 3D platformer where you must utilize the unique traits of two distinct spheres. Switch between them on the fly in 3D scenes to overcome challenging obstacles. There are currently 21 playable levels.

details.title: Portopia Serial Murder Case
details.short_description: The legendary "THE PORTOPIA SERIAL MURDER CASE" is reborn! Under the executive direction of Yuji Horii comes an all-new entry featuring five brand-new investigation files. Set in 1980s Kobe, conduct your investigation alongside a new cast of characters and uncover the secrets hidden behind the case.

details.title: ONE MAN'S DECEIT
details.short_description: One Man's Deceit is a survival horror first-person game where you are on a mission to find a missing friend. Explore a world filled with secrets, search for clues, follow your instincts, survive deadly encounters, and fight different creatures on your journey.

details.title: MMA Career Simulator
details.short_description: Create your MMA fighter, develop their skills, build winning game plans, and promote yourself to a global MMA superstar. Every fight is simulated based on your preparation and in-fight decisions, where smart choices can mean the difference between victory and defeat.

details.title: Videogame Automation Engineer
details.short_description: In this visual programming game, you become a video game tester for different clients. Using intuitive image sensors and logic wiring, you automate a vast collection of minigames to make your circuit press the right virtual gamepad buttons at the right time.

details.title: MOM SAID DON'T OPEN
details.short_description: The whole night lies ahead! Lock the door. Don't open it to strangers. Some have come to help. Some simply knocked on the wrong door. And some... have come for you. Remember — a locked door won't always save you.

details.title: Tiny Takedowns
details.short_description: The Rebels thought they had their shrinking weapon under control, until the Spies turned it against them! Uncover the Spies or cause chaos as a Rebel in Tiny Takedowns! With unique skills and chaotic rounds, every match offers a fresh and thrilling experience.

details.title: Game Over: Spring
details.short_description: Explore, solve environmental puzzles, and step into the future your choices create. In this first-person narrative adventure spanning 1963 to 2087, a thriving greenhouse can become a lifeless room. Return to pivotal decisions and discover what could have been.

details.title: Broke2Blocks: Crypto Mining Simulator
details.short_description: Start in your parents' basement with a single USB stick miner. Plug in every cable yourself and sell your coins. Move into an old gym, then into a huge warehouse full of racks. Buy broken miners on the black market, fix them screw by screw and keep the heat under control.

details.title: Nonogram Classics
details.short_description: Classical nonogram puzzles: 1000+ puzzles, 50+ distinct themes. Solve puzzles and unlock unique images. Newcomer in nonograms? Start with tutorial and small puzzles. Expert? Challenge large and complex nonograms. Complete 'em all!

details.title: MINSK: APOCALYPSE
details.short_description: Survive apocalyptic Minsk. Manage health, food and water: search for resources or complete missions to stay alive. Fight demons, Templars and criminal factions as you investigate the apocalypse and those responsible. A survival adventure in development.

details.title: Keep the night
details.short_description: Build your fortress by day and defend it by night. Construct walls, recruit troops, draw powerful cards, and lead your hero into battle against ever-growing enemy armies.

details.title: Uncover Space
details.short_description: An incremental idle game where you fling asteroids and comets into the dust that hides planets, moons and suns. Every broken stone pays for more projectiles and upgrades, and your shots keep breaking dust while you are away.

details.title: Railtown
details.short_description: Every great city starts with a station. In Railtown, trains bring tourists and money while you grow a tiny town into a bustling city: build homes, shops and tram lines, upgrade your train from steam to high-speed, and keep your citizens happy through every season.

details.title: MATCHO
details.short_description: MATCHO is a narrative first-person action adventure. Tag targets, build chains, and execute combos with an innovative real-time Match-3 combat. Join Max as he fights through an alien invasion, uncovers the truth behind his illness, and races to find a cure before Earth falls under alien control.

details.title: Nessi
details.short_description: Explore Loch Ness alone or with up to three friends in a first-person horror investigation. Gather evidence, photograph sightings and upgrade your boat and equipment. Try your best to prove the existance of the Loche Ness Monster.

details.title: SWIFTNESS
details.short_description: This game is all about speed and not getting eaten by the spreading corruption.

name: Ganja Ricochet: Cut Kush. Make Cash.

details.title: Ganja Ricochet: Cut Kush. Make Cash.
details.short_description: A chaotic 3D pinball-pachinko game: cut Kush, build combos, unlock 12 scissors, 12 plants, 12 pots, tons of upgrades, and defeat 4 Boss Plants.

details.title: Sushi Bar Manager
details.short_description: Run a conveyor-belt sushi shop in Japan. Buy fish, keep the plates moving, wash every dish and pay the bills each night. Hire staff, decorate, survive bad weather and clumsy customers, and see how many days your shop can last. 🍣🥢

name: Two Demon Catgirls: A Nocturne of Evil

details.title: Two Demon Catgirls: A Nocturne of Evil
details.short_description: 🍂🍷A mystical and devilish visual novel about two demonic catgirls, a lonely author, and the nature of Evil — with music, philosophy, dark humor, and hand-painted gouache artwork.

details.title: The Window Across
details.short_description: Three days before her childhood home is demolished, Emi relearns the secret language she once spoke through a window with a boy across the courtyard: lamp light and cardboard shadows. A pixel-art story about the things we never said. Demo coming soon.

details.title: Duelike
details.short_description: Duelike is a poker roguelike where you play cards across three zones, build poker hands, and use card abilities to bend the rules. Win 2 of 3 zones, upgrade your deck between battles, and later test your build in online PvP.

details.title: Eternal Anima
details.short_description: Embark on an adventure across eras in this love letter to JRPGs. Journey between the past and present to uncover the truth behind a lost history. Control your fate in turn-based combat by using Future Sight to foresee enemy actions and strategically rewrite the future.

details.title: Scrapman Simulator
details.short_description: Start by collecting cardboard from the streets, turn scrap metal into cash, upgrade your home and vehicle, and grow your business. Build your own recycling empire by playing solo or with your friends in a living city inspired by Istanbul.

details.title: Barty's Adventure
details.short_description: The world resets every three days, but not everything has to be forgotten. Choose what carries into the next loop as you uncover secrets in a cozy metroidvania set in a world of children's toys.

details.title: Wo Long 2: Wings of Ember
details.short_description: Born from war's flames, a Phoenix ascends. A dark fantasy Three Kingdoms action RPG from Team NINJA. Wield acrobatic Chinese martial arts and conquer the vast battlefields of the Three Kingdoms, where mighty generals and demons stand in your way.

name: Unity Sanctuary: Rampage of the Void

details.title: Unity Sanctuary: Rampage of the Void
details.short_description: This is a roguelike tower defense action strategy game where you must protect Unity-chan as she is forced to march toward “initialization.” Players use weapons and skills to fend off the hordes targeting Unity-chan as she charges forward on her own.

details.title: Shitty Shift: Toilet Sim
details.short_description: Even a public toilet has a probation period! Collect entrance fees, deal with bizarre visitors, clean up disgusting messes, or just relax on the couch and let the chaos unfold. Will you become employee of the month or the laziest toilet attendant in town? It's your shift. Your rules.

details.title: Code Grid
details.short_description: Place instructions on a grid, plan the path, and let the machine follow your logic. CodeGrid is a programming puzzle game with no traditional coding required—use simple commands to build loops, conditions, and data processing, then create increasingly complex programs within a limited space.

details.title: Building to the Sky
details.short_description: A tower-building management sim you can read like an architect's drawing. Build a classic side-on 2D tower or a 3D landmark you can slice open floor by floor, run it for thousands of tenants, and switch any time between rendered, blueprint and CAD views.

details.title: SRD: Slightly Random Dungeons
details.short_description: A tabletop roleplaying game (TTRPG) simulator. Gather a company of quarrelsome mercenaries and set forth through the adventures of the Guilds and Gutters Campaign setting, or use the intuitive adventure building tools to craft your own campaign to challenge your friends or unleash upon the world.

details.title: Dwarven King
details.short_description: Build a dwarven kingdom inside a mountain. Dig tunnels, hire miners to gather resources, and expand your settlement. Explore hidden halls, collect relics, and rally soldiers and sorcerers against the goblins and trolls you uncover.

details.title: Desk Fantasy
details.short_description: Desk Fantasy is an anime idle companion that lives in a transparent window on your desktop. While you work, Noa auto-battles mischievous yokai on a tropical island. Grow her on a 75-node Evolution Grid, roll dice in a 10-chapter visual novel and find one of 4 endings.

details.title: Lonely Dung Beetle
details.short_description: You are the only dung beetle for miles. Roll your ball, crack open treasures, and explore a big little world full of neighbours who need your help. A cosy game about rolling, collecting and never being lonely again.

details.title: CRUCIBLE OF THE ABYSS
details.short_description: Slot, fuse, and discover. A dark fantasy first-person dungeon crawler where you build every action from parts, melt them together into new powers, and descend fifty floors into the abyss.

details.title: Trine 6: Together in Time
details.short_description: Trine 6: Together in Time is a co-op puzzle platformer for 1–4 players. Wit, timing, and teamwork collide as you solve perplexing puzzles, engage cunning creatures, and traverse perilous paths in the next adventure through Trine’s iconic fairytale world.

details.title: Breaker League
details.short_description: Puzzle-battle mayhem on one shared board. Drop pieces, chain combos, and invade your rivals' turf in frantic 1–4 player matches online or on the couch. 37 ridiculous fighters, 12 game-changing specials, and a 32-level story campaign.

details.title: Megabait
details.short_description: A brutal top-down obstacle course where every second counts. Master precise movement to survive deadly hazard rooms, leave a bloody trail of your past mistakes, and uncover every secret on your path to 100% completion.

details.title: Necro Heist
details.short_description: Turn the casualties of war into an undead looting empire. Raise your skeleton army from battlefield corpses, steal fallen riches, and grow your necromantic power through a vast skill tree. In Necro Heist, every battle fuels your incremental rise.

details.title: FSPunch
details.short_description: A physics party brawler for the living room and LAN party. Animals in boxing gloves punch, kick and carry each other off crumbling platforms. Play brawler, scooter, dodgeball, scooterball or soccer, build your own maps, and settle it in splitscreen or over LAN.

details.title: Folders On The Run
details.short_description: Escape the factory reset! Control two adorable folders in a failing OS. Play solo or coordinate your movements with a friend. Master shifting mechanics to survive. Perfect for testing your skills and friendships!

details.title: BreakFree
details.short_description: A first-person block breaker from 1995: you are the paddle. Keep your fireballs alive and break the walls of 72 levels. Chase medals and the Daily Challenge, or build levels for Steam Workshop. Runs natively on modern PCs, with the original DOS game included.

details.title: Dungelo
details.short_description: One dungeon a day, the same for everyone. Dungelo is a turn-based pixel roguelike you can finish in 15 minutes: read what each monster is about to do, answer it, and beat the floor 5 boss. Your first run counts on the daily board. Yesterday's best set today's challenge. Difficulty shifts with you.

details.title: RoboSquare: Recharged
details.short_description: A 16-player online party game where hovering robots dash, jump and slam each other off the map across five chaotic minigames. Your friends are worse than you remember, and the platform is smaller than you think.

details.title: I Launch
details.short_description: This is a game that lets you relive the experience of what it was like before you were born, alongside your goofy friends.

details.title: Spinvestor
details.short_description: Spinvestor is a fun, risk-free alternative to winning millions while gambling in a casino where the house doesn't have the edge for once. Win big, invest in stocks, and run your own businesses while becoming the highest ranking VIP at Steak, the best casino where the house always loses.

details.title: Wobblebound
details.short_description: A physics stacking roguelite where every toy has a face. Draft toys and lucky charms at every bell, spend coins at the toy shop and beat six bosses as one of six toymakers. Then race friends or robots, or build one tower together, with up to four players on one PC or online.

details.title: Radical Centrists
details.short_description: A deckbuilder where your cards are real politicians with questionably historical abilities. Discover new combos and accumulate wealth and influence. Push your luck with volatile politicians and make sure your party doesn't go off the deep end!

details.title: Towerworks
details.short_description: Build your tower floor by floor and watch tenants move in. Grab a mop, fix what’s broken and keep the lifts moving. Hire staff when you can afford it, a manager when you can’t keep up, another tower when you’re ready. It looks cozy but the sim is unforgiving if you overborrow or disaster strikes.

details.title: Wispward
details.short_description: The cloaked spirits on your road aren't attacking. They're fleeing. Hold the road for 120 levels of tower defense: lumberjacks and miners earn the Smoke that builds towers, masons lay free tower foundations, barricaders trap the road. 21 fully voiced story videos ask what they're fleeing.

details.title: Touhou: Don't Spill It!
details.short_description: One jar of water, two friends, and all of Gensokyo trying to make you spill it. Cirno dashes across the road, fairies throw stars, barrels roll in. Stop short and the water surges over the rim; a hard knock cracks the jar. What's left at the finish is your score. A Touhou Project fan game.

details.title: Moltenfall
details.short_description: Moltenfall is a fast-paced survival roguelite set in a world where every pixel is simulated. Fight increasingly dangerous swarms of enemies, collect experience and grow stronger with every upgrade. Watch your step as collapsing terrain, acid, lava and other materials reshape the world around you.

name: FYOF: I Swear I Didn't Download That

details.title: FYOF: I Swear I Didn't Download That
details.short_description: Your files are coming for you! Become a weaponized Recycle Bin, blast endless waves of hostile data, collect powerful perks, and survive the ultimate digital apocalypse in this chaotic bullet heaven roguelite!

details.title: Rus: source
details.short_description: Historical novel with RPG-elements about the Origins of the Rus’ state. Four knyazes. Four lives. The only mystery. Your decisions influence on who you are going to become, and who you are in the new circle.

details.title: Nocta
details.short_description: "Before the beginning, Time and Nothingness danced..." Become Nocta, the Embodiment of Time, and safeguard Creation from the abyssal hands of the Void in an original cosmic creation myth. Hand-drawn stained-glass art by 花凛. Wishlist now!

details.title: Zero Distance
details.short_description: Fight overwhelming zombie hordes in a 3D bullet heaven where packing your case shapes your firepower. Arrange weapons, gear and supplies to unleash fire, lightning and explosive combinations. Survive 20 minutes, defeat the boss and earn your extraction.

details.title: TOX-17
details.short_description: Analyze real video footage to solve a poisoning case. Discover the country, city, neighborhood and final location. Every detail may be a clue.

details.title: Barbe-Yeux
details.short_description: A comedy narrative adventure in 6 chapters. Explore islands, lead your crew into battle, go fishing, play dice at the tavern and lose all your gold again. You play a captain convinced he's a legend, flanked by two companions whose entire vocabulary is almost "Gloubi".

details.title: Eddie on Fire
details.short_description: Rescued at birth from a life of bondage, Eddie resolves to win his mother’s freedom from the tyranny of his father by defeating him when they meet in the arena. Join Eddie as he fights for his life in this non-combat adventure to dethrone a champion and rescue a slave.

details.title: GUNDAM ROGUE ORBIT
details.short_description: Become the pilot you were born to be. Change humanity’s fate in GUNDAM ROGUE ORBIT, a high-mobility action game that delivers a bold new take on Gundam, blending a fast-paced cinematic story with intense, hard-hitting combat in an all-new universe.

details.title: sportsbook
details.short_description: The sports betting roguelike. sportsbook is a high-stakes sports betting simulator where you stake your bankroll on a variety of props, swing for the fences on parlays, discover game-changing perks to juice the odds in your favor, and turn small bets into outrageous payouts through strategic combos.

details.title: Souls for Relics
details.short_description: An incremental roguelite auto-battler where you choose random relics, create powerful synergies, earn souls, and unlock new possibilities between runs.

details.title: Orb Immortal
details.short_description: Roll your god's crystal orb through 150+ hand-built stages across the heavens, into the cosmos, and beyond the halls of the divine. Tilt the world to chase medals and leaderboards and shatter the statues of your rivals. Race your friends and compete to be the first to reach the secret levels.

details.title: MORS
details.short_description: Every evening the note said tomorrow, for fifty years, and every morning the tree was still there. So Vladimir and Estragon cut it down, built a rocket from it, an oil drum and a painted can, and flew to Mars to build a factory: mining, belts, machines. Godot, presumably, is late.

details.title: MORTISCRIPT: Undead Auto Battler
details.short_description: Raise the dead and write the rules they fight by. In MORTISCRIPT, a gothic auto battler, you program your undead army with simple logic blocks, watch every instruction play out, find out why the plan broke, and fix it, until the kingdom that betrayed you falls.

details.title: Screw You Party
details.short_description: "Screw You Party" is a 1-4 player online or local multiplayer party board game. Roll dice across the map of the United States, earn coins in mini-games, and win medals by sabotaging other players and stealing their coins. Become the President of the United States!

details.title: SNATCH & BETRAY
details.short_description: SNATCH & BETRAY is a living tabletop treasure hunt. Explore the jungle, find gold, deal with traps, and decide when to cooperate with other adventurers — and when to take the treasure for yourself.

details.title: Maid Mech : Backpack TD
details.short_description: Maid Mech: Backpack TD – A grid tower defense game. Lead the last Dragoon maid mecha against mutant hordes. Collect shape modules after each wave, build defenses on a 14×7 grid, and deploy mecha to fight automatically. Backpack management meets tactical TD.

details.title: Three Kingdoms Heroic Tales
details.short_description: Choose your protagonist from over 450 officers and freely assemble your party in this Three Kingdoms RPG × conquest strategy game. Develop your officers, combine gear, sub-commanders, and formations, and conquer all 88 castles in an ever-changing age of war. Who becomes a hero is up to you.

details.title: ARTEMIS' Miscalculation
details.short_description: This is the one case the police must never know about. A murder at a Japanese inn, where every guest has secrets. AI Thriller × Logic-Driven Mystery in a world policed and judged by AI. A linear visual novel with no choices. Includes Episode 1, a self-contained case lasting about two hours.

details.title: Touhou Hikouroku ~ Flight Risk
details.short_description: Marisa fires her Master Spark and the recoil sends her flying. Blast your way around the great library, steal the books, and watch Patchouli's bill grow.

details.title: Goblin Problem
details.short_description: Goblin Problem is an RPG, co-op, tower defense game where you build and expand your fortress by day and defend it from waves of goblins by night. Control your hero, build powerful defenses, recruit troops, and reclaim the kingdom piece by piece.

details.title: Io Resort MMO
details.short_description: A classic real-time text MMO sandbox reborn in full 3D. Pilot your hovercart through the luxury hotels of Io Resort under the looming presence of Jupiter. Run missions, build drone fleets, fight alien invaders, and trade your way up — in a persistent world that runs whether you're there or not.

details.title: The Hero's Road
details.short_description: A node-based adventure with semi-automatic combat and a deckbuilding roguelite core. Choose your route, relics, identity, and combat style — the build is the decision. 140 relics, 100 foes, 40 origins.

details.title: Nameless Fate
details.short_description: Follow a bamboo path into a shared temple. Sweep leaves, meditate, strike a wooden fish, or count prayer beads. Earn incense and wish slips through practice, then light a stick or write a wish by hand as other players pass through the courtyard.

details.title: Paladin HC
details.short_description: Command a 3D Paladin self-propelled howitzer in this tactical artillery simulator game. Join historical military operations. Calculate firing ranges, manage resources, and support allies. Add Paladin HC to your Steam wishlist and support our indie team!

details.title: Rise Immortal
details.short_description: A xianxia deckbuilding roguelite where every card grows with you. Temper techniques through Essence, choose from five cultivation paths, and battle through four realms and their Tribulation bosses on the rise to immortality.

details.title: SYNCOPE
details.short_description: Jump through surreal worlds, collect glowing notes, and experience unique soundtracks for each level. SYNCOPE is a rhythmic first-person 3D speedrunnable platformer game. Uncover the mystery of the giant eye, speedrun levels, and race friends to top the global leaderboards.

details.title: Kicked Out
details.short_description: The bailiffs are at the door and you have only one minute. Throw what you can out of the window, then jump after it. Beg, dig through the trash, survive the nights and save $100 before the street breaks you.

details.title: 末日序列：诡域求生
details.short_description: ELDRITCH SEQUENCE is a Lovecraftian survival RPG that fuses rule-based horror with dungeon crawling. Uncover deadly rules, explore nightmarish dungeons, and fight to survive. Customize your attributes, develop unique builds, and combine powerful skills to forge your own path to survival.

details.title: Fantasy Guild Manager
details.short_description: The fantasy guild management sim. Price the jobs clients bring you, hire adventurers who choose their own work, and watch the valley change with every job you take or turn away.

details.title: Ten Kingdoms Courier
details.short_description: One courier. A land torn by war. Every letter could be your last. A historical visual novel set in 10th-century China, where the Five Dynasties rise and fall and one wrong choice can kill you. Thirty ways to die, four endings. No voice acting.

details.title: Tales of Eldoria
details.short_description: The sun is gone. In a world trapped in eternal moonlight, guide Liora and her companions through the Arcadia dungeons in a story driven JRPG about sacrifice and the bonds formed when the world is already broken.

details.title: Byte Bistro
details.short_description: Program a little robot crew and bring a neighborhood café to life. Cook, serve, restock, and refine your routines across 24 services. Mix visual programming with hands-on minigames, then keep your kitchen humming in Desktop Companion mode.

details.title: JazzWitch
details.short_description: A fast-paced 2D platformer about building speed through movement combos — chain jumps, dashes, and saxophone blasts to increase your combos. Outrun various hazards across hand-drawn dimensions to the beat of an original jazz score.

details.title: Pantheon Wars: Auto Battler
details.short_description: Command 198 gods and legends from 18 pantheons in a mythology auto battler. Draft from a shared pool, merge copies into 3 star legends, stack pantheon bonuses and outlast 7 rivals.

details.title: Astra Genesis
details.short_description: A colony that starts from almost nothing, in a galaxy of 5,000 planets shared by everyone on the server. Production chains, workers with names, expeditions, a player Exchange and alliances, and PvP you set yourself, from solo mode to Hardcore. The colony runs even without you.

details.title: Love Letter to a Vampyr
details.short_description: Love bites … especially when you’re in love with a Vampyr. In this survival horror game, travel to the ominous ruins of Castle Helenox in order to deliver your personal love letter to the monster who stole your heart. After all, who said that love has to be a pain in the neck?

details.title: Draft Eleven
details.short_description: Draft Eleven is a football auto-battler roguelite where you build your perfect XI, scout the transfer market, create powerful synergies, adapt your tactics, and compete in asynchronous PvP against squads built by real players from around the world.

details.title: GNOME REDUCTION
details.short_description: Co-op for 1 to 4 grumpy grandpas. Sneak into a gnome village at night, grab the little pests with your bare hands, stuff them in a sack and sell them on the black market. The gnomes fight back, and the forest guardian is always watching.

details.title: Deepfold: One Day Deep
details.short_description: Deepfold is a papercraft mining story about letters from your grandmother, trapped 66 million years in the past since a 2019 accident. She lived there 20 years. Plant ore in the past, fast-forward millions of years, and dig it up by hand. Each upgrade brings up her next letter. Take your time.

details.title: DWARFS AND? SKELETONS
details.short_description: Slay gods and their onslaught of mystical minions in this fast-paced dark fantasy FPS. Slowly unlock an arsenal of guns, abilities, and equipment to make ridiculously devastating builds that obliterate your enemies as you make your way to The Dark Lord and uncover what is really going on...

details.title: Kazfall
details.short_description: Kazfall is a single-player roguelite dungeon crawler built on 25-minute runs. Fight with stamina and timed blocks, discover NPCs who sell upgrades and gear, and reach the boss before time runs out. Even failed runs make you stronger for the next descent.

details.title: Friday at Ours
details.short_description: Friday at Ours is a time management-adventure game about overcoming your anxiety and visiting a party you weren't invited to.

details.title: Classified Chaos
details.short_description: Classified Chaos is a multiplayer horror, action title, where you fight through creatures of various sizes, and danger. Use whatever equipment you can to fight, defend, run, or die for your team so someone gets out alive.

name: The Odds Are Stacked Against Us

details.title: The Odds Are Stacked Against Us
details.short_description: PULL THE LEVER! In this tower defense roguelite, a slot machine deals your towers and thousands of tiny walking coins are coming for your base. Hit lines, merge towers, rain rockets and lightning, and watch the horde explode into gold. Jackpot or bust!

details.title: Phylactery Slayer
details.short_description: A soulslike roguelike where every pixel of the world is destructible. Play solo, with your team, or face invading enemy squads. Four online modes, from solo runs to PvP arena. Each death leaves a phylactery that remembers your power.

details.title: Star Replica
details.short_description: Mine, build, and replicate. Pilot a modular spacecraft through an unexplored universe, then put your replicas to work with autonomous mining and crafting. Transfer your consciousness between ships, grow your fleet, and follow mysterious signals into deep space.

details.title: Minya in the Sky
details.short_description: You’ll control Minya as she takes on the graduation exam at Sky Magic Academy, aiming to pass the exam and graduate. If you defeat a host of enemies and take down the final boss, Minya will graduate successfully. This game focuses primarily on third-person combat and treasure hunting.

details.title: Tidy Slot Cars
details.short_description: Tidy a slot car club and take your favourites to the track! Sort 1,497 cars by model and colour in this cozy first-person organising game. Unlock cars as you tidy, build your own circuits, and race your cat or a friend in local split-screen.

details.title: Sanctuary of Small Things
details.short_description: A wholesome creature-collecting game, solo or co-op for up to four. Wander enchanting biomes, gather ingredients, brew gentle remedies, and heal the small things you find to grow your Sanctuary. Cosy, calm, and quietly addictive.

details.title: MORTGATE
details.short_description: You are an explorer of an abandoned manor that once belonged to a renowned occultist. You came to steal ancient artifacts and walked into a trial where the stake is your life.

details.title: AEX: AFK EXOS HEROES
details.short_description: The tiniest adventure in the world begins! Place it anywhere on your desktop and watch your heroes battle automatically. Effortlessly enjoy a flood of loot and the thrill of progression.

details.title: Set Adventures
details.short_description: Set Adventures - platformmer story based game join set the strongest warrior of all time to bring justice to the universe

details.title: Give or Take: Pawn Shop
details.short_description: Step behind the counter and run a small-town pawn shop. Inspect items to reveal hidden traits, make deals with quirky locals, clean, repair, and sell secondhand finds for profit while helping a town recover. All it takes is old junk and a good deal.

details.title: Pigeonhole Principle
details.short_description: Meet a pigeon who dreams of flying to the Galápagos. That flight needs one thing — the legendary golden sunflower seed. But right now that pigeon has fallen into a stranger's storage room, and is in real trouble. Cook the things around you, wear them, and climb a little higher.

details.title: Angler 2003
details.short_description: A regional television programme from 2003 that you fish inside of. Cast into ponds, storm drains, sofa cushions, and the internet. 135 "Fish" species. Hosted by everyone's favourite Pineapple Cat.

details.title: Flowline
details.short_description: Don't build more — make it flow. An idle factory game where one station always limits your line. Find it, feed it, and watch the bottleneck jump somewhere new. Secretly a real manufacturing simulation — with none of the math in your face.

details.title: Number Bound
details.short_description: Explore, battle, build, and collect in Number Bound, a family-friendly adventure where math and trivia unlock rewards. Play solo or with up to three friends, collect plushies, go fishing, build with nearly fully editable world objects. 3 Mini games including Fox Quest a game in a game!

details.title: Balls to the Walls
details.short_description: A short incremental physics game about upgrading and annihilating your balls. Equip chaotic special balls and buy physics-altering upgrades to break the simulation and get rich.

details.title: I Wanna Be a Supernova
details.short_description: Devour celestial bodies, grow from red dwarf to supernova, and build your own sky. Forge worlds, choose zodiac relics, and dodge incoming threats. A chill space adventure in pixel art: Normal is relaxed and flowing, Hard is there if you want a challenge.

details.title: Deadhold
details.short_description: Deadhold is a roguelite zombie survival/strategy game where your choices impact who lives and who dies. Rescue survivors, scavenge resources, fortify your base, and protect your community against stress, infection, and zombies! Can you find a sense of normalcy in this cruel new world?

details.title: Petal Runner
details.short_description: Hop on your bike and join Cali and Kira as they ride across the sun-soaked city of Sapphire Valley and become Petal Runners! Make deliveries, meet new friends, play minigames, and discover a solarpunk, pixel art-powered open-world RPG about life, loss, and what we carry with us.

details.title: Frieda is Changing
details.short_description: A fun-horror point & click adventure following Frieda, a 14-year-old girl, determined to uncover the mystery of her sister's disappearance. Explore an expansive village, solve puzzles, unlock memories, and discover monsters where you least expect them.

details.title: Cursor Kingdom
details.short_description: Create an army of cursor clones by recording your actions. Automate resource gathering, production, and defense while your kingdom grows on its own.

details.title: The Gentleman's Rise
details.short_description: Descend into a corrupted 1930s asylum in a 2D eldritch action Souls-like. Master scythe combat, dodge, block and parry deadly attacks, recover lost Sanity, replay completed levels, and rise stronger with every descent.

details.title: MEGAMINE
details.short_description: Dig up, not down. Pilot a mining pod through an endless shaft, six biomes and the boss guarding each one. Eighteen weapons that fire themselves, twenty-nine items to find, six miners to choose from, and one loaf of bread a biome for when your hearts run low

details.title: Lone Sands
details.short_description: Lone Sands is an exploration/atmospheric/trick game with wind-sail and kite riding across desert dunes, ocean waves, snow and ice. Its procedural world has huge weather systems, ancient ruins and places to discover, and no quest chain to follow.

details.title: Chair Chase
details.short_description: Chase the chair before someone steals your seat! Chair Chase is a chaotic 2-8 player party game where living chairs run away from you. Jump, dash and push friends aside, then hold on tight to score. Most points after 7 rounds wins! Supports public matches and streaming.

details.title: Ragdoll Fighting Simulator
details.short_description: Ragdoll Fighting Simulator is a physics-based 3D active ragdoll fighting game featuring multiple martial arts and weapons. Battle your way through levels or fight for survival in a Battle Royale mode.

details.title: Backrooms: Savior
details.short_description: That's a co-op horror exploration shooter set in the Backrooms. This time, you won’t just hide—grab your weapon and fight back against the entities. Explore classic and original levels, scavenge supplies, rescue survivors, and survive. Ammo is scarce. Noise is deadly. This time, fear goes both ways.

details.title: SIGNOS: IMPETUS
details.short_description: Design your own autonomous combat mech and its AI in this roguelite auto battler. Salvage parts, patch one line of AI in battle, and use replays to improve your design.

details.title: Arena
details.short_description: Directional, team-focused medieval PvP. Fight 1v1, 2v2 or 3v3 with sword, bow and staff, choose your abilities from a wide selection, and outplay your opponents with timing, reads and teamwork. Climb the ranked ladder. Now in open alpha.

details.title: Just One More Catch
details.short_description: Catch creatures, build your team, and decide how far to push your luck. Explore a 99-floor realm in this single-player roguelike, master turn-based battles, and return safely with new companions—or lose the rewards you have yet to secure.

name: Tower of Annihilation: Welcome to Hell

details.title: Tower of Annihilation: Welcome to Hell
details.short_description: Tower of Annihilation: Welcome to Hell is a roguelite dungeon-crawler where the only way to escape eternal damnation is to climb a seemingly endless, interdimensional tower filled with monsters and temptation. Reforge your soul and climb ever-higher, or become corrupted by the evils lurking within.

details.title: Spirit of Midnight
details.short_description: Play as a house cat who gains the ability to leave home and embark on a supernatural adventure after encountering a strange spirit. Befriend a badger and meet other adorable creatures along the way, all in an effort to restore balance to the forest and uncover the truth behind its mysteries.

details.title: Dodgeball Rush
details.short_description: Fast third-person arcade dodgeball. Charge it, throw it, catch it, knock them out. Every catch can flip the match. Play solo against bots or with friends: up to 4 players on local split screen, co-op or versus. Free playtest opens in November.

details.title: Never Wood Enough
details.short_description: You've been hired to chop trees, and Bob the beaver has plenty of requests and very little patience. Chop trees, gather wood, and fulfill his orders before time runs out. The tasks start simple, but soon Bob will be asking for increasingly absurd things. Don't disappoint him!

details.title: She Doesn't Speak My Language
details.short_description: A real dating sim and real English conversation practice in one game. No dialogue choices: win her over in your own English, by voice or keyboard. The in-game AI runs on your PC. No subscription.

details.title: What's the color?
details.short_description: Read the color name, find the matching tube before the clock runs out. 30,000 names, a gallery that fills as you play, and shades that get harder to tell apart.

details.title: Ashes of Animara
details.short_description: A fast-paced, challenging top-down sci-fi combat campaign. Your world is gone. Fly with Lia, the AI at your side, against the Nihilus Order's escorts and capital ships, then upgrade your weapons, abilities, and relics in the hangar between missions.

details.title: Time Loop Nibiru
details.short_description: Your death is your greatest weapon. A sci-fi Metroidvania shooter where you are trapped in a time loop on the war-torn planet Nibiru. Explore a vast interconnected world, solve puzzles, and cooperate with the ghosts of your past lives to survive and escape.

details.title: Crown of Heartbeats
details.short_description: A rhythm roguelike love story in three acts. First, a hero fights through four cursed realms to reach the Elf Queen, who is sure he's coming to kill her. Then comes happily ever after, which turns out to be scarier than any dragon. And then it's her turn to pick up the sword.

details.title: Flurry Fray
details.short_description: A chaotic snowball party game for up to 4 on one couch or more online. Pelt rivals, sneak up with a shovel, bury their campfire with a snowblower, torch their snowman with a molotov and steal the toys off their Christmas tree. Bots fill empty spots.

details.title: Beam Them All
details.short_description: Abduct animals with your UFO, upgrade your saucer, and return for bigger hauls. Dodge defenses and escape in time, or lose the resources collected on your expedition.

details.title: Sandkeeper
details.short_description: A cozy sand art game. Pour colored sand into glass bottles one grain at a time: lean the glass to slope the layers, tap it to settle, press in a shell. Pour a bottle for each of the 48 places in your grandfather's book and keep them in his seaside cottage. No score, nothing can fail.

details.title: Dead Copies
details.short_description: Management is pleased to confirm your placement at the facility. Continued employment is contingent on satisfactory performance. On contract conclusion, a successor is assigned to ensure there is no interruption to operations.

name: Put the Ball in the Hole

details.title: Put the Ball in the Hole
details.short_description: The instructions are in the title. A physics trickshot game with 70 levels and 10 ways to shoot: basketball, golf, pool, bowling, baseball, soccer, ping pong, marbles, slingshots and cannons. Every shot is one motion with your mouse.

details.title: Grave Seasons
details.short_description: Grave Seasons is a narrative farming sim with a terrifying twist – someone in the town is a supernatural serial killer. Farm, romance, and investigate your way through the unsettling town of Ashenridge.

details.title: Feed the Front
details.short_description: Build the factories that supply a planetary war. In this sci-fi RTS, mines, warehouses and guns launch cargo to one another across a small world. Manufacture shells, reroute deliveries and keep your artillery firing as rival commanders and alien swarms close in.

details.title: Match 2 3D
details.short_description: Match II 3D is a relaxing 3D hidden pair puzzle where physics scatters dozens of colorful objects across detailed environments. Rotate the camera, find matching pairs, unlock new waves, and challenge your observation skills in a cozy casual experience.

details.title: MicroMayhem
details.short_description: The party game that doesn't give you time to think: 100+ five-second micro-games, faster and faster. 4 players on one screen, up to 8 online, or solo, with RICO and ZIP calling it live. Remote Play Together: only one copy needed!

details.title: Keep Evading
details.short_description: Keep Evading is a top-down arcade car chase where your ride never stops and one hit ends the run. Dodge growing police pressure, turn cruisers against each other, collect power-ups, unlock new cars, and chase a place in the Steam Top 10.

details.title: Hungry Cataway
details.short_description: Chomp your way through levels, dodge enemies and escape! Hungry Cataway is a charming grid-based pixel-art arcade game. Blast through walls with bombs, outmaneuver hazards, and unleash your ultimate vomit attack to clear the path.

details.title: Frankenship
details.short_description: A co-op space mining game for 1-4 players, on one couch or online. Drill through hostile moons, blast crystal seams open and haul the ore home to your patched-together ship while the hive closes in. Then run for the pod.

details.title: Cryptborn
details.short_description: Choose your unique spirit and descend into an endless procedural dungeon solo or with friends. Loot items, explore, and battle through hordes of enemies before they evolve and destroy you. Try the demo now!

details.title: MONOMANIA
details.short_description: Obsessive 3D games in one package. Journey through a world of magic, keep insects that move like the real thing, catch and evolve monsters, build robots from gacha parts, and let a bullied boy's rage explode. One game. Many worlds. More arriving in Early Access.

details.title: Rimfarers
details.short_description: A classic turn-based space RPG. Trade between the worlds of five races, take on jobs, hunt pirates, rise in the fleet reserves and play dozens of text quests — while the Silence creeps in from the edge of the galaxy.

details.title: SQUISH N POPS
details.short_description: Fire a moonbeam straight up and split every bouncing bubble into two smaller ones until the sky is empty. A 200-level campaign in five acts, each ending in a boss, with 19 bubble traits and eight powerups, then all 200 again with the camera in close. Chain pops into FEVER and earn new looks.

details.title: Pongzi Scheme
details.short_description: Pong for funds that never existed. Bat capital with a stock candle, pay old investors with new money and buy time against the SEC. A finite incremental: 4 acts, offshore prestige, 5 endings. When The Case hits 100%, the raid comes. What you keep offshore is up to you.

details.title: Roomcopter
details.short_description: Roomcopter is a sandbox room-building game about creating your dream space. Shape your room however you like and furnish it with thousands of props, from furniture and lights to plants and decor. Find your favorite angle and capture the moment with realistic graphics.

details.title: Uncatalogued
details.short_description: Take one oil lamp into an underground library that rearranges itself every night. Your items are reclaimed when the light goes out — only what you catalogue stays. A first-person roguelite of reading, deduction, and burning oil, in handheld-sized retro 3D.

details.title: Skewered Up!
details.short_description: Stack absurd combos onto a skewer. Fill your inventory with unique ingredients and skewer them to discover deliciously broken synergies. Grill, cash out, upgrade your skewer, and serve customers with unique demands in this fast, physical roguelike deckbuilder. Easy to learn. Hard to Master.

details.title: Shadow of the Road
details.short_description: Shadow of the Road is a story-driven, turn-based RPG where feudal Japan meets magic and machine. Assemble your team from a diverse set of characters and test your skills against yōkai and steampunk contraptions. Carve your own path through an immersive story and change the fate of the Empire.

details.title: Carts & Coins
details.short_description: Your father left you a cart and 1,000 coins of debt. Haggle with elves, dwarves and giants, pack your cart like a puzzle, and trade your way across a hand-drawn fantasy world that is new every run. Buy low, sell high, survive the road.

details.title: The Fog & Flask
details.short_description: Run a cozy potion bar on a misty swamp. Pour layered potions that settle by density, grind, chop and heat ingredients, and serve curious guests with secrets of their own. By night, hold back the creeping fog with your lantern and follow the trail of your vanished mentor.

details.title: The Hollowing
details.short_description: An incremental first-person voxel mining game about tearing an entire mountain apart, one layer at a time. Cut rock with a laser drill, sell the ore, and upgrade everything — wider drills, longer batteries, a fleet of drones that keep digging while you're away.

details.title: Globecide
details.short_description: Fly a warship around a living planet and take it apart. Steer nukes into capitals, drop its moon on it, crack its crust, flood its coasts. Every crater stays, and the planet fires back. 72 worlds, a roguelite Rampage mode, and a Forge that turns any picture into a planet.

details.title: MATRYBALL
details.short_description: Matryoshka meets football in a roguelike cup. Every hit can crack a shell off your players. Pick a fantasy club, unleash its special power and climb the ranks of Matry Champions, where every win upgrades your build. Or play local matches with friends.

details.title: The Golden Seam
details.short_description: A quiet game about mending what's broken and learning to wear the seams. Turn each fracture, slide the pieces home and seal the crack in gold. No timers, no score, no way to fail. Break and mend. The gold remembers.

details.title: Pinfinity - Incremental Pinball
details.short_description: Combine classic pinball physics with addictive incremental progression! Place bumpers, unlock massive skill trees, and watch your score skyrocket into the millions!

details.title: TRAINCORE
details.short_description: Command a fusion-powered war train through a cyberpunk world. Build specialized wagons, consume resources, salvage enemy wreckage, upgrade your convoy, and survive until the next station.

details.title: TIC.EXE
details.short_description: Three in a row is not a win — it is a discharge. A tactical grid roguelite: fight hostile processes on a shifting board, build an engine out of 30 modules, and clear eight sectors before the machine answers its own launch request. Duel a friend online or on one screen.

details.title: Save Us, Doctor Faust!
details.short_description: Save Us, Doctor Faust! is an immersive medieval doctor simulator where you diagnose diseases, study medicine, and craft remedies from raw ingredients. Examine your patients, grind and distill ingredients, experiment with recipes — and remember: one mistake could cost a life.

details.title: Trainwatch
details.short_description: A time-management psychological horror set in a fogbound railway crossing. What seems like a simple 1-month job as a gatekeeper operating a crossing turns into an exploration of occult grounds, meeting unsettling folk, and trying to fix your own life.

details.title: The Black Shift
details.short_description: In this AI-powered thriller, your phone is the gateway to a dark past. As a mine chief, you receive messages from a mysterious stranger demanding you put your workers in danger in exchange for uncovering forgotten historical secrets. Who will pay the price for the truth?

details.title: Call Me BlackJack
details.short_description: Build your own blackjack run in a roguelike deckbuilder built from a six-deck shoe. Play hands, buy cards, break the rules, and beat BlackJack to solve a casino mystery. Every run plays differently with new risks.

details.title: Hellmet: Seven Circles Down
details.short_description: Your helmet is your weapon. Plunge through the seven circles of hell, swap cursed Hellmets for absurd new powers, headbutt demons into paste, and shred the hordes with bullets and blades. A boss guards every circle on the way down to the Ultimate Lord of the Underworld.

details.title: Asteroid Lanes
details.short_description: Draw trade lanes across a single seamless universe drawn in symbols and lines, and let your ships mine, haul and sell on their own. Chase the materials you lack and the regions you want, push your network outward, and hold the lanes against pirates.

details.title: Arena Bot Manager
details.short_description: Manage a scrapyard bot-fighting team on the Lunar Ring World and prove your worth in brutal, high-stakes arena matches. Build machines from scrap, hire a team of engineers and programmers to give you an advantage, and wreck your opponents as you rise the ranks. Wreck - Rebuild - Repeat 'til you win.

details.title: Power Up!
details.short_description: Your first office job has one rule: move up by beating your manager at the company’s card game. Explore a strange corporate tower, solve workplace problems through observation and choice, build your deck, and climb floor by floor.

details.title: Godyssey
details.short_description: A modern take on the god game. Cast down by the other gods, all you have is your faithful creature, two bickering advisors and a world of people who have never heard of you. Win them over with miracles or terror, spread your influence, and find out what kind of god you are. Then take your revenge.

details.title: Smokeward: Seven Year Promise
details.short_description: Seven years ago your village signed its valley away. Now you're back with the deed. Light the first hearth, rebuild homes and give fifteen families a reason to return. Each family that comes home brings back some of the valley's colour. A story-rich cozy farming sim, solo or 1–4 co-op.

details.title: Project Vanquisher
details.short_description: Fight out of a corporate prison with a gun that rewrites itself: nine forms, eight power levels, and a card after every boss that reshapes the next one. Fifteen sectors, fifteen guardians, 180 rooms arranged fresh every run. Then find out the escape was part of the show.

details.title: Touhou Rumble Banquet
details.short_description: Touhou Rumble Banquet is an unofficial Touhou Project platform fighter for up to 4 players. Choose from 11 fighters from the Embodiment of Scarlet Devil, play locally or against CPUs, or go one-on-one online with rollback netcode.

details.title: Escape With Friends
details.short_description: Investigate with your friends in this hilarious hand drawn game. Draw your own skin and go on a journey filled with minigames: darts, mini car races, electrical panels... From 2 to 8 players.

details.title: ESCAPE MY FAMILY
details.short_description: ESCAPE MY FAMILY is a retro PSX stealth survival horror. Every run, one of 4 crazy relatives (Dad, Uncle, Granny, or Grandpa) stalks you with unique behavior. Explore rooms, hide, collect randomized loot, and escape before you get caught!

name: Lootbox Inc.: The TCG Card Battler

details.title: Lootbox Inc.: The TCG Card Battler
details.short_description: The TCG autobattler. Lootbox Inc. is the ultimate number-go-up deckbuilder. Collect powerful loot, build crazy decks, discover unexpected synergies, and stack insane combos. Easy to learn, hard to master. Play at your own pace, solo or against other players!

details.title: Heist of Fools
details.short_description: Team up for chaotic fantasy heists with 1–4 players. Use four thieves’ unique abilities, outsmart guards and traps, haul enchanted loot, and escape before your mistakes bring the owner home.

details.title: Roly-Poly Panda: Desktop Pet
details.short_description: A desktop pet panda who lives on your screen. Pat it, squish it, pick it up and toss it, or offer bamboo and watch it react. While you work, it munches, naps, climbs windows, and peeks in from the screen edge, quietly keeping you company.

details.title: PHASE ZERO
details.short_description: A grotesque illness binds the town of Flint Peak. Several survivors try to escape with their lives as mysterious creatures roam the streets. Face horrific monsters, solve puzzles and uncover the truth in this classic survival horror. Can you escape the nightmare?

details.title: Russian Village Business
details.short_description: Become a young entrepreneur who arrives in the Russian countryside and opens a village shop. Buy and sell goods, upgrade your store, and make this village great again — just like in the good old days!

details.title: Blood of Rations
details.short_description: A first-person PvPvE WW2 extraction looter shooter. Slip alone into a war-torn Europe to scavenge what the dead left behind. Hunt loot. Fight deserters and strangers. Extract alive — or lose it all. Every raid begins in your warm, safe bunker. If you're lucky, it ends there too.

details.title: Not in Order
details.short_description: You report for duty on a train that never stops. A name, a date, a seat, a carriage: everything must match. Check the tickets, report what is wrong. And work out what really happened aboard.

details.title: Road Kings
details.short_description: Drive a 40-ton semi hauling cargo across the coastal plains of the American South, managing multiple jobs, trailers, and routes. Grow reputation from rookie to veteran owner-operator, dodging disasters and rivals to become the hero of the open road.

details.title: Bloodpact
details.short_description: Cut down endless demon hordes, unlock new abilities as you level and grow stronger by forging bloodpacts with archdemons.

details.title: Nebulon Colony
details.short_description: Nebulon Colony is a 3D colony sim. You take command of the first crew of astronauts, tasked with building the first colony on a distant planet. Dig, craft, build, trade, automate, level up, grow plants, herd animals, drive rovers and more.

details.title: Veils of the Past
details.short_description: A cinematic mystery visual novel about a vanished woman. You're the detective on the case. Twelve years ago, your sister disappeared the same way. Four investigations lead to four different answers about what really happened — and none of them is the wrong one. The truth is whichever one you find.

details.title: Ruinhand
details.short_description: Turn the room into your weapon in this tactical roguelike deckbuilder. Ignite oil, chain lightning and shove guards into mines. Climb ten Ruin levels per hero, uncover each hero's story, chase the Daily Ruin, race up to four friends live, or bring one into co-op.

details.title: Inkblot: The Art Restorer
details.short_description: A painterly puzzle about restoring masterpieces. A living ink blot has stolen the figures from 128 famous paintings and heaped their shadows on your workbench. Untangle the overlapping silhouettes, paint each one whole and send it home before the museum opens.

details.title: OVERDRILL
details.short_description: A pixel art incremental mining roguelite. Drill through destructible caves, collect ore and build a stronger rig with drones, automated bores and a branching upgrade tree.

details.title: Coven of Thorns
details.short_description: Five witches. Five familiars. One Root. A dark-fantasy roguelike deckbuilder: pick a witch and her familiar, build a deck and climb the Thorn Road through a cursed wood, a bridge of briars and a candle-lit chapel to the Gardener. Every run is a new map.

details.title: Excuse My Bullets
details.short_description: Think bad aim and an empty magazine mean it's over? Wrong! Right-click and your bullets fly back along their trails to hit enemies again. Steal enemies' bodies, or race along a trail as light. Everyone is called a "shareholder", but only the Central Board has a say. Fight from 13th Street to their door!

details.title: OmniMart Tycoon
details.short_description: Design and manage the ultimate retail empire in OmniMart Tycoon! Build complex store layouts, optimize daily supply chains, and set prices. Hire staff and watch hundreds of simulated shoppers navigate your aisles as you balance profits with ultimate customer satisfaction.

details.title: Back For Loot
details.short_description: Smack bosses for gold, buy permanent upgrades, and push further with every run in this incremental roguelite. Lead four unlikely heroes through a fantasy kingdom that can't let anything end. Your party wants out. Your next upgrade says otherwise.

details.title: Royal Verdict
details.short_description: A medieval court simulation where every verdict matters. Hear cases, uncover lies, and balance the King, the People, and the Church as your reputation shapes the fate of the kingdom.

details.title: That Caveman Theme Park Game
details.short_description: Build a tribe. Run a prehistoric theme park. Keep the fire alive. Train cavemen, gather resources and create wild timber attractions. Entertain visitors, defend them from dinosaurs and expand your park's warmth while balancing fuel, construction and stone income.

details.title: HELLEVATOR
details.short_description: A freight elevator descends the hundreds of floors of hell. Every time it stops, the doors open and demons pile in. KILL. THEM. ALL. Pixel-art carnage, bosses that come apart, and no way back up.

details.title: Panzertanken
details.short_description: Turn-based tank artillery on fully destructible pixel terrain. Command about 200 tanks from WWI to today, dig in with shovels and steel plates, and blow up enemy bunkers in five campaigns, 3 vs 3 battles against bots, hot-seat duels and online matches.

details.title: Stock Escape
details.short_description: Trade 50 stocks, dodge loan sharks and con men, and blow your fortune on mansions, yachts and private jets. A funny stock market life sim where every hot tip comes with a catch, a kidnapping or a shark. Escape to your dreams.

details.title: Incremon
details.short_description: Build a thriving farm powered by Incremons! Capture roaming pets, evolve them, and keep them well-fed. Harvest, stockpile, and manage resources to unlock upgrades and expand your farm in this cozy incremental game.

details.title: Carve!
details.short_description: Feel the adrenaline in this easy-to-learn, hard-to-master, fast-paced ski racing game. Make every turn count and become a skiing legend. But be warned: once you’re hooked, one more run is never enough.

details.title: Iron Curtain Call
details.short_description: A fast cartoon noir FPS and retro boomer shooter set in an absurd alternate 1965. Dash, grapple and parry through a wind up robot army, punch enemies for health and ammo, and bring down theatrical bosses with very undiplomatic weapons. WW3: Third time's the charm!

details.title: Snowdrop Lane
details.short_description: Snow. Parcels. Neighbors. A cozy winter week as the new mail carrier on a buried street. Shovel, chip ice, fire up the snowblower, and let Dougie the dog sniff out what's under the drifts. Everyone on the lane needs a favor. Some will even say please.

details.title: The Last Liftboy
details.short_description: Being a liftboy is easy… until it’s not. After thirty years, a letter brings Ted Grady back to the Hôtel Grand Valmont. The hotel is barely breathing. Carry luggage, run the elevator, restore the rooms — and save the place that made him.

details.title: Seagrid Nightfall
details.short_description: Shove skeletons overboard and into the Storm King's lightning in this turn-based pirate tactics roguelite. Every enemy attack is shown before it lands. Lead three pirates through the night, keep your battered ship afloat, and fight to see the dawn.

details.title: My Arms Are Longer Now
details.short_description: You are a yucky long-armed thief. Snake through levels, retract like a vacuum cord, or put on a sock to seduce a lonely guard - whatever it takes to pull off the perfect heist!

details.title: Dear My Son
details.short_description: Raise a family, carry on through generations, and fight demons to break a curse passed down through your bloodline in this family legacy simulation game.

details.title: The Horror Quest
details.short_description: The Horror Quest is a project of a secret organization that creates bloody shows under the guise of games. There are no scripts and safe zones here - only real danger, primal fear and the fight for life. Will you be able to get out of the game alive?

details.title: HINEKURE QUEST
details.short_description: It's Daifugo, but run out of cards and you die. Fight enemies with Daifugo rules: the mighty 2, the 3 that beats it, 8 Cut, 7 Give, 10 Discard, J Back and Revolution. But an empty hand can't attack, 7 Give can corner you, and Luck may self-destruct. Daifugo alone won't win. Break the rules.

name: 在りし日のわたし達へ

details.title: 在りし日のわたし達へ
details.short_description: A juvenile visual novel leaving proof that we truly lived. Collect ancient relics known as "Traces" and update your journal to unravel hidden emotions and the mysteries of the world. A dream-chasing girl's fateful step forward—one that ultimately leads to a cruel destiny with a steep price.

details.title: Ballpark Days
details.short_description: A story-driven baseball game where you play as the catcher. Steady your pitcher through how you receive, mound visits and pitch calling, and frame borderline pitches into strikes. Read batters who each have their own approach, and at the plate, read real-speed pitches and drive them back.

name: Stop The Fire: Apprentice Water Wizard

details.title: Stop The Fire: Apprentice Water Wizard
details.short_description: Everything is on fire. Learn water magic and restore a world consumed by flames... all on your own.

details.title: Leif's Garden Tower
details.short_description: Grow plants, tend the greenhouse, and fall in love with the customers of Leif's Garden Tower. Leif's Garden Tower is a cozy 2D tower-builder about a lonely leaf spirit rebuilding an abandoned greenhouse, help him restore the tower and learn its secrets.

details.title: One More Shake
details.short_description: Shake a vending machine, collect cans, earn money, and build the ultimate idle vending empire through satisfying upgrades, automation, and endless progression.

details.title: Posted Missing
details.short_description: A detective game at a London newspaper's shipping desk in 1876, where owners sink their own ships for the insurance. Work out what became of each ship, choose what the morning paper prints and get your family to America alive.

details.title: My Cozi Shop: Craft & Sell
details.short_description: A cozy first-person toy shop sim. Cast rubber ducks, sew plush toys by hand, then box, tape, ribbon and ship each order out the window. Customers review every parcel, and they notice a crooked eye. Spend what you earn on new toys, a helper and decor.

details.title: Murdok
details.short_description: A dark action RPG of ash and betrayal. Master 45 skills, socket runes to forge your build, and fight through five acts of horror to the Abyss Throne. Claim the Crown or shatter it, then survive a level 100 endgame.

details.title: Luna Plena
details.short_description: "Read your enemy. Count every turn." A Short RPG Beneath the Full Moon.

details.title: Rune Runners
details.short_description: A colorful 3D action platformer for one or two players, on one couch or online. Mix water, fire, thunder and wind into combos, take on twenty bosses and come home to a cozy village between the worlds.

details.title: NISKALA: Survivors
details.short_description: Ghosts from Indonesian folklore, and two ways to deal with them. ARENA is 20 waves of pure survivors-like chaos. SURVIVAL is ten days in a haunted kampung: farm, fish and dig by day, shop at Ibu's warung, fuse silly weapons into Mythics, and hold the line every night.

details.title: Fireteam Breach
details.short_description: Fireteam Breach is a competitive 5v5 PvPvE tactical shooter built on destruction. Every round plays like an operation gone wrong. Civilians panic and get in the way. Get reckless, and they call the police, who can turn the round. Play by day, at dusk, or in a night storm where the power fails.

details.title: Flank
details.short_description: A tactical roguelite deckbuilder on a hex battlefield. Build your deck and find the cards that work together. Then take them into battle, where what you play matters as much as where you play it — your own position, and your enemies'. Read the battlefield, choose your ground, and survive the run.

details.title: Castles & Castellans
details.short_description: Castles & Castellans is a hybrid of real-time strategy and third-person action. Rule from the castle-building RTS view - construct, manage, and fortify against looming threats. Then step into the castellan’s boots in TPP, fighting side by side with your soldiers atop the very walls you built.

details.title: Swornhand
details.short_description: A dark fantasy tactical card game with a story campaign, deckbuilding and online duels planned for launch. Discover 480 cards, fight for control of 3×3 and 4×4 boards, and challenge another player on the same computer.

details.title: Sum & Steel
details.short_description: Build a factory that makes numbers. Mine deposits across a large map, connect arithmetic machines with conveyor belts, and deliver the results to your hub. Reuse old production lines, unlock faster machines, or tackle 42 campaign missions and 25 puzzles.

name: がむしゃらギルド-Scrappy Guild-

details.title: がむしゃらギルド-Scrappy Guild-
details.short_description: Team up with your friends, pool your wisdom, and take on the Demon King with the ultimate deck. Gamashira Guild is a cooperative deck-building roguelike where discussing strategies with friends is the key to victory. Let’s all team up and take down the Demon King!

details.title: Glitch Front
details.short_description: Glitch Front is a tactical cyberpunk card battler where team chemistry matters as much as the cards you draw. Build your crew, combine powerful faction synergies, master separate Play and Combat decks, and fight for control of a shared Warzone.

details.title: StarCat
details.short_description: StarCat is a bullet heaven roguelite with the soul of an arcade shoot 'em up. Space cats, betrayal and a thousand ways to die. Build your loadout, crush the Sili and cross four worlds packed with enemies and bosses. For hardcore gamers only.

details.title: Mowed Down
details.short_description: Prop hunt, but the hunter drives a lawnmower. Disguise yourself as anything from a hay bale to a giant toilet, hold still, and hope they don't look twice. Get caught and come back as a mower or a ghost. Up to 40 players online, or solo against AI props.

details.title: Pawnbroke
details.short_description: A darkly funny pawnshop roguelike. Your late uncle left you his shop and his debt to Mr. Grin. Buy strange stock, arrange the shelf so every item boosts its neighbours, and pay up every five days. Come up short and he takes a finger. Play solo or with a Steam friend.

details.title: Sort the Bazaar
details.short_description: Sort The Bazaar is a cozy organizing simulator where you sort a variety of items and bring life and color back to a faded roadside market. Unlock new skills, automate tasks, and enjoy the satisfying process of turning a dull, messy bazaar into a vibrant, organized marketplace at your own pace.

details.title: Altiros
details.short_description: Build! Craft! Destroy! Jump on clouds and fight cute monsters in skill-based battles of steel, magic and spirit in this online sandbox adventure set in a fantastical world of sky islands!

details.title: Nexus Storm
details.short_description: A fast-paced arcade shoot 'em up inspired by 90s classics! Blast through waves of alien enemies, unleash devastating weapons, and destroy your surroundings. Play solo or team up with a friend in local co-op as you fight to save Earth!

details.title: Shield-Bearer Ben
details.short_description: A short incremental game where you play the TANK in a dungeon-finder party. Hold up your Big Shield, call out the red circles, and keep three teammates alive. Upgrade 120+ skills in a giant skill tree and take down the Demon Lord before tonight's patch deletes his dungeon.

details.title: Just a simulation
details.short_description: Just a Simulation is a futuristic strategy game where you master a vast arsenal of weapons, upgrade your tools, and dismantle enemy systems. Go in guns blazing or hack your way to victory.

details.title: Pyramid Scheme
details.short_description: Hop across pyramids, paint every cube, and mix drugs for wild synergies in this procedurally generated arcade roguelike. Befriend a depressed clown, call in air support, and survive the comedown. One more run. One more… hit.

details.title: POK
details.short_description: Step into the arena where the Sun and Moon were born. POK is a 3D arcade sports game that blends competitive gameplay with fighting mechanics, inspired by the ancient Mesoamerican ball game. Compete in 1v1 and 2v2 matches where timing, positioning, and teamwork define victory. Every hit matters.

details.title: Invasion Of Britannia
details.short_description: Lead Rome’s conquest of Britain in a third-person strategy RPG. Fight, craft, trade, lead armies, and manage settlements in a living world where towns grow, caravans travel, people gain experience, shortages spread, and conquest reshapes the land, even when you are elsewhere.

details.title: ClusterForce
details.short_description: ClusterForce is a fast arcade 3D flying sports game for up to 8 players online, a unique combination that demands many of your skills at once. Carry energy balls from magnetic ramps to the goal without getting caught by your rivals and their glider weapons!

details.title: Chute Happens
details.short_description: Deliver precious cargo. Drop explosive surprises. Try to keep your plane in one piece. Chute Happens is an arcade game of parachute drops, daring deliveries, and demolition. Dodge incoming fire, chase bonuses, and make every drop count.

details.title: Entangled Logic
details.short_description: Survive a failing research facility in Entangled Logic, a top-down action game with programmable quantum devices. Battle swarms, upgrade your build, and defeat six bosses. Use preset circuits or design your own. No quantum physics knowledge required.

details.title: Ballochet
details.short_description: Five balls, one cannon, a city of rooftop contraptions. Bank shots off beams, springs, rubber and swinging boards to ring the bell in 60 hand-built ricochet puzzles. Each ball scores less than the last, so make the first shot count.

details.title: Grave Benders
details.short_description: A co-op horror heist for 1 to 4 players. Rob the graves of the rich after curfew. Dig with your friends, which is loud, in a cemetery that listens... It's 1947 and the plague never ended. Keep your voices down. The watchman can hear you, and not every grave is as quiet as it looks.

name: Modan's Book of Myths: The Nameless Knight

details.title: Modan's Book of Myths: The Nameless Knight
details.short_description: Control a party of up to four unique heroes in this turn-based RPG to rid the nation of Haven from evil forces both supernatural and humanoid in nature!

details.title: Tremble of Towers
details.short_description: Co-op tower defense for 1-4 players where you fight alongside your towers! Build any structure from any mineral: ice slows, magma burns, lead extends range. Mix traits into countless combos and hold the Golden Vein across ever-changing, randomly generated maps.

details.title: REELS of the DAMNED
details.short_description: A slot machine deckbuilding roguelike dungeon crawl. Choose a class, grow your symbol deck, unlock spells and relics, and fight your way to the bottom of the Dungeon!

details.title: SANDSTRIKE
details.short_description: A free top-down shooter set in a world that ran out of humans. Blow robots apart in PvP, a 16-robot battle royale and a night-time co-op convoy run. 28 guns, 7 gadgets, 22 implants. Pay-to-win not included.

name: IT MOVES! - Build Your Own Robot

details.title: IT MOVES! - Build Your Own Robot
details.short_description: Build working robots by wiring visual signal graphs, then watch, diagnose, and tune them in deterministic simulations. Grow a repair shop from its first piston to PID control, autonomous navigation, robot arms, and a walking humanoid.

details.title: The Last Curator
details.short_description: A first-person jigsaw puzzle game set in a museum that has been closed for thirty years. Find the scattered pieces of 39 real paintings and fit them back into their frames. Each finished painting brings light and music back to its room.

details.title: Ash and Flame
details.short_description: Ash and Flame is an interactive cinematic thriller set in the dark fantasy world of Erwintal. You are Raynar, a war veteran who takes up his sword once more to face an ancient evil. Your choices shape the kingdom’s fate: ashes… or the flame of hope.

details.title: Panning Out
details.short_description: Pan a sleepy creek for gold, melt it down at your forge and craft rings, coins and crowns for your village. Panning Out is a cozy gold rush: no hurry, no stress, just the joy of a nugget glinting in your pan.

details.title: Neon Bastion
details.short_description: You build the road the invaders walk. Lay their path piece by piece, then line it with towers, traps and fused war machines. A roguelite tower defense with a new build every run, 18 hand-made missions, co-op for up to 4 players online, on one couch or with bots, and head-to-head Versus.

name: The Apothecary Diaries: The False Imperial Brother

details.title: The Apothecary Diaries: The False Imperial Brother
details.short_description: Investigate mysteries, craft medicine, and uncover the truth in this brand-new story from The Apothecary Diaries. Explore the rear palace and capital to gather evidence and question witnesses, then assemble what you've learned into theories and deductions to solve thrilling mysteries in this sprawling adventure game.
