details.title: Wheelchair Together
details.short_description: 1-2 player physics based platformer. Play solo or with a friend in chaotic mini levels, master wheelchair movement, and learn to work together.

details.title: Awakewood
details.short_description: Will returns to bury his mother and leave right away, but everything changes when he finds a stranger in the woods. As the house decays and roots swallow everything, saving her comes with an irreversible cost: uncovering a truth hidden in Awakewood for ten years.

details.title: Dead Descent
details.short_description: Dead Descent is a 4-player, online co-op, psychological horror game. You and your team of urban explorers will enter a secret underground lab filled with failed experiments and try to gather as much evidence against the company as you can. Use your survival skills to make it out alive... If you can.

details.title: Tea Runners: Turkish Teahouse Simulator
details.short_description: Run a traditional Turkish tea house with up to five friends online. Brew cay, grill toasties and race trays out to the shopkeepers next door. Keep the okey tables from turning into a brawl, take bets on match night, dodge the tea inspector and settle with the tax man - however you have to.

details.title: Wildball League
details.short_description: Open booster packs, collect 87 monsters, and build the football team that makes them work together. Every creature has an element and a family: the right tactic is the one where your cards answer each other. From a graveyard club to the Full Moon League.

details.title: Throneforged
details.short_description: Forge your empire. Claim the throne. A competitive 4X strategy game where every tile matters, every decision counts, ZERO RNG, and one win condition exists. Claim the central Throne and hold it for 10 turns.

details.title: SuLing: Echoes of Souls
details.short_description: "SuLing: Echoes of Souls" is a casual exploration game. Players will step into the dreamlike and picturesque continent of Spirit Tracing, explore the optimal resonance value of spirits, and unleash their full potential.

details.title: Marked Deck
details.short_description: Blackjack where the numbers explode. Build your own deck, play up to three seats against one dealer, palm cards past the pit and turn every winning hand into a Chips × Mult jackpot. Climb eight casino floors, outplay the Pit Bosses and beat The House.

details.title: Where Is Your Bathroom?
details.short_description: You need to pee. Every door between you and the bathroom is lying to you. They run away, fall on your head, and get weirder with every room. A first-person troll puzzle game about outsmarting doors. Yes, doors.

details.title: Boom or Bloom
details.short_description: Run a fireworks workshop with up to 3 friends. Every extra scoop makes the shell bigger and worth more - and brings the workshop closer to blowing up. One listens with the stethoscope, one steadies the shell, one holds the bucket. Light the fuses at night: a sky full of fireworks, or a crater.

details.title: Camino Ghosts
details.short_description: Enter a world overtaken by ghostly beings. Choose your companion, survive alone or in a team, restore infrastructure like power and water, build your home, and hold back the ghostly hordes. Explore the vast open world and uncover the cause of the change.

details.title: BATTLEFRONTS: GRIMDARK
details.short_description: BATTLEFRONTS: GRIMDARK delivers big battles experiences. The battles will face teams composed of Humans and BOTs one against other on battlefields filled with troops, monsters, vehicles and immersive landscape elements.

details.title: Echoes of Fire
details.short_description: Survive the relentless cold in a stylized, post-apocalyptic wilderness. Gather wood, build fires, and fight to stay alive against the wind, snow, and the wild.

details.title: False Fortune
details.short_description: False Fortune is a modern crime RPG where you investigate the conspiracy that framed you, rebuild your fortune, buy businesses and homes, find love, marry, take honeymoons and vacations in a living, breathing world, and shape Adrian Vale’s future through evidence, leverage, redemption, or revenge.

details.title: 9 Box
details.short_description: Ten players. Nine boxes. Grab a box, pick one of two abilities, take aim — then every ability fires at the same moment. Fast, chaotic online battles for up to 10 toys in a giant kid's bedroom. Matches last under 5 minutes.

details.title: OutSpin
details.short_description: Ram, bump and launch enemy spinners out of the arena! OUTSPIN is a physics arena brawler roguelite with living arenas, epic boss fights and 10 Heat levels. Pick your spinner, build your run and master the ring-out – on PC and Steam Deck.

details.title: Desktop Cozy Sheep
details.short_description: Meet your new office companions! Watch your sheep and goats sleep, eat, and frolic while you work or relax. Unlock new animals and decorate the little pasture at the bottom of your screen!

details.title: Chef Pinball
details.short_description: Flip after flip, Chef Pinball serves pure dopamine! Explore powerful synergies in this chaotic cooking pinball roguelike aboard a moving train. Recruit chefs, cook delicious meals and transform your train into the ultimate restaurant on rails.

details.title: Path Of Fear: Allia's Nightmares
details.short_description: Path Of Fear is a first-person psychological horror game. Explore dark environments, solve puzzles, and survive a stalking threat while uncovering the dark secrets around you. Will you escape, or become another victim of fear?

details.title: The Useless Game
details.short_description: A completely useless videogame that politely asks you not to download it.

name: Blue Hawaii Aniki's Small Celebration vol.5

details.title: Blue Hawaii Aniki's Small Celebration vol.5
details.short_description: "Blue Hawaii Aniki's Small Celebration" is a radio show that Blue Hawaii Aniki appears on to make a little extra cash. If you enjoy that unique radio atmosphere, I highly recommend giving it a listen. It runs for about two hours. Feel free to start from Vol. 5.

details.title: Velthos
details.short_description: Survive overwhelming hordes in a magical action roguelite! Discover spellbooks, transform into a giant, turn enemies into chickens, combine devastating spells, and outsmart powerful bosses. Every disaster has a spell. Can you find it?

details.title: TORION:Escape
details.short_description: TORION:Escape is a fast-paced parkour game where nothing stops you from going forward and Escaping the simulation in record time. Run, jump, and control the environment alongside a variety of relaxing drum and bass tracks playing in the background.

details.title: LADR
details.short_description: Gather your team and step into LADR: a fast-paced 5v5 arena brawler blending the depth of MMORPG combat with the intensity of a fighting game. Challenge friends and rivals alike.

details.title: SCP Tower
details.short_description: You were hired as a ranger into National park. Your job? Taking care of Suntop Lookout. However once you get there, ceiling trapdoor is blasted open, showing continuation of Suntop Lookout. Will you enter?

details.title: Bookmark Hero
details.short_description: Bookmark Hero is a fantasy, peripheral-idle RPG. Play from a bookmark-sized window on the side of your screen and instruct your hero with queued tasks. Watch as they explore lands, conquer monsters, hone skills, craft gear, and embark on quests. Even as you work, their legend unfolds.

details.title: Rex Summons a Meteor
details.short_description: A short game about a large rock. You helped a wizard wish on a shooting star, and got a meteor instead. Every dinosaur talks in emoji: work out what each one wants, find it, and play absurd mini-games like skateboarding and rhythm duets. No timer, no game over. Now go save the dinosaurs.

details.title: OVERREACH 2126
details.short_description: Hotseat · game night · pass & play on one PC — one screen, one mouse. Other strategy games hand you a 280-page manual; OVERREACH 2126 hands you one page. Then 1–6 of you fight for the world. Grimdark strategy: recruit, dig in, counter-attack. One evening. One game. One winner.

details.title: Warden's Descent
details.short_description: Four-player co-op dungeon crawling with an extraction problem: what you find is only yours once you climb back out. Descend through realms of stone, ice, salt and bone, learn each guardian’s tells, and decide on every floor whether to push on or bank the run.

details.title: Anomaly Core: Incident
details.short_description: Your first task is to investigate an incident in one of the "Anomaly Core" laboratories and retrieve the important documents. Explore the laboratory and complete the task.

details.title: Sleepwalkers
details.short_description: Bloodthirsty creatures are destroying your life and the lives of your loved ones. Grab your weapon, fight them, and uncover the secrets of a mysterious experiment that brings all your deepest fears to the surface.

details.title: Dice After Dark
details.short_description: DICE AFTER DARK is a dice poker roguelike. Rig the dice, stack relics, build ridiculous damage, and break the House.

details.title: Weiß Schwarz Online
details.short_description: Battle with cards from your favorite titles! Weiss Schwarz, the world’s No. 1 card game by number of participating titles, is now a video game! With a full tutorial and online battles, players of all skill levels, from beginners to experts, can enjoy the game.

details.title: Loop Tower
details.short_description: Loop Tower tells the story of adventurers climbing an endless tower. Place it on a corner of your desktop and help them continue their ascent. Experience a fresh blend of desktop idle gameplay + roguelike + RPG right now!

details.title: Denari
details.short_description: Denari is a narrative action game about a boy with telekinetic powers who must fight to save his people from the invasion of an empire. Master fast-paced hack and slash combat, take down epic bosses and follow a young warrior's coming-of-age journey as he becomes the protector of his people.

details.title: Eye of the Giant
details.short_description: Put history on trial in a cosmic courtroom. Manipulate Sanity, Guilt, and Arrogance to psychologically dismantle legendary figures, uncover the truth, and deliver your verdict in this roguelike deckbuilder.

details.title: Living With Dad - Family Party
details.short_description: Take on the Championn’Appart challenge with Dad’s Girls in this colourful party game! Who will take the top spot on the podium?

details.title: Desert Diggers
details.short_description: Dig out a lost Egyptian city with up to 7 friends! Shovel deformable sand, haul fragile treasures together, survive cave-ins, snakes and sandstorms, and bury your friends alive when they least expect it. Dynamite is cheap. Friendships are not.

details.title: MINAGOROSHI : THE RISEN AVENGER
details.short_description: Sneak up and brutally assassinate enemies from behind. A hardcore stealth action game where the tension of instant death upon a single glance intersects with the exhilaration of transforming into an Asura and slashing through everything.

details.title: TrackBlitz
details.short_description: Three minutes, one track, your best lap counts. Compete against the world on 60 unique tracks with incredible variation. Race your friends and beat their times, climb regional leaderboards and become number one. Customize your car with endless options and show off your awesome ride to the world!

details.title: ReVamp
details.short_description: A Tower Defensevania where you rule as Dracula. Shape your fortress room by room, command an army of monsters, and step into battle yourself to protect your throne from relentless mortal invaders. A war waged for eternity, for the love you couldn’t save.

details.title: Russian Survivors
details.short_description: Fight versus unlimited hordes of lizards and italian brainrot animals in post-soviet environment.

details.title: Slide or Fry
details.short_description: A chaotic 1–4 player co-op rage game about chained polar bears, slippery ice, deadly lava, and friendships under pressure. Master brutal precision routes, fight enemies, survive with limited hearts, and try not to take everyone down with you.

details.title: VANADEN
details.short_description: Vanaden is a first-person survival horror game set in a cursed, fortress-like labyrinth. Hide from monsters, solve puzzles, and navigate shifting corridors where stealth and every decision determine your survival.

details.title: Eggnob
details.short_description: Eggnob is a precision platformer about a flatulent egg. Guide it through multiple traps dressed up as levels. Or don't. Let it die, see if I care. Floors vanish, spikes appear, the exit lies. Drag that Egg through hell. It won't thank you. It can't. It's a stupid Egg.

details.title: Poutamelo
details.short_description: Create your own music and share your finished sheet music with the townspeople. Then, visit the local live music bar to hear them perform your songs. Help out with farming, get to know your neighbors, and create your own story in a peaceful little town in this life simulation game.

details.title: Salvo Spire
details.short_description: Build upward. Defend in 360 degrees. SALVO SPIRE is a sci-fi tower defense game where weapon combinations and construction order shape distinct defensive builds. Expand your tower, upgrade its firepower, and direct focused fire against enemies closing in from every side.

name: それでも僕らは廻っている。

details.title: それでも僕らは廻っている。
details.short_description: Stars revolve around you. Stars are both weapons and shields. Create, strengthen, and advance in the strongest star system in this hack-and-slash game.

details.title: Craterlands
details.short_description: Craterlands is a 2D sandbox adventure set in a post-apocalyptic world filled with danger, mystery, and endless possibilities! Mine, build, craft, and fight your way through diverse environments as you uncover the secrets of a shattered civilization.

details.title: Zap Rat
details.short_description: Zap Rat is a 3D Multiplayer Game, where you and your friends must survive against hordes of aliens.

details.title: Ostinato
details.short_description: The musical roguelike deckbuilder. Duel champions in song, collect notes and marks that change the rules, and play chords and runs until one blow scores millions.

details.title: Seal of Confession
details.short_description: A man confesses he'll kill tomorrow, but the hardest part isn't deciding what's right. It's deciding what you're willing to betray. Work with the Gravekeeper, unaware of the tragedy unfolding around you.

details.title: Bartend With Your Friends
details.short_description: Online 1-4 player co-op robot-bartender roguelike full of physics-driven chaos. Work together to mix drinks, manage demanding customers, and pick upgrades to hit the bar's daily quota before your shift ends - or the bar shuts down for good.

details.title: Kingsreach
details.short_description: Kingsreach is a open world bullet-hell action RPG set in a colorful kingdom under a tyrant's rule. Dodge deadly patterns, unleash powerful abilities, and combine weapons, armor, and charms. Explore hidden paths, battle through dungeons, and take on fearsome bosses on your way to unseat a tyrant.

details.title: Jesus Christ: Necromancer
details.short_description: This is a fast, brutal gothic metroidvania: reap the damned with the scythe, raise their bones to fight beside you, grow stronger at every shrine, and carve your way through a dead [un]holy city to the Four Horsemen. Jesus is back... and he's back for Blood.

details.title: Nightbound Ledger
details.short_description: Chinese folk horror × idle turn-based. Lead mercenaries through ten eerie regions in Nightbound: recruit from the roster, assign skills, farm affix gear, then watch auto-battles unfold line by line in the combat log. Gear sets your ceiling; formation decides how the fight plays out.

details.title: Timberlord Clicker
details.short_description: An idle clicker about cutting down trees. As a newly appointed noble, tame the wilderness, build your domain, and unlock new technologies. Recruit unique characters, uncover their secrets, and fight the corruption spreading through the forest.

details.title: Hopwood
details.short_description: A cozy 2D metroidvania about memory. Explore five connected regions, gain a new ability in every act, use the Whisper to hear what creatures think, win back the Old Cherry's five blossoms from bosses who forgot who they are, and uncover the valley's lost story.

details.title: Little Battlefield
details.short_description: Little Battlefield is a top-down tactical shooter with a blue-ink art style. Capture control points and blast through walls in a solo campaign or co-op for up to four players. In Zombie Battlefield, scavenge by flashlight and fight off the horde until you can extract.

details.title: 66: Dinosaur Survival
details.short_description: 66 is a brutal multiplayer dinosaur survival game where you hunt, grow, hide, migrate, and fight your way through a prehistoric ecosystem where every mistake can be fatal.

details.title: Neostalker
details.short_description: NEOSTALKER is a tense turn-based first-person puzzle experience that combines grappling-hook movement, lethal machinery, and tactical planning in a series of dangerous spatial challenges on the way to the heart of a factory that has become a threat to everything around it.

details.title: Fold'Em
details.short_description: Join the table for a surreal high stakes poker card game experience. Discover creepy characters and survive each round with whatever you can. There is something sinister at play...

details.title: Sushi Gacha: Auto Battler
details.short_description: Gacha-powered auto battler, ten minutes a run. Spin for sushi figures, line up four on the counter, and watch them fight lineups other players left behind. Stack copies for stars, blend two into a new kind, beat a chef boss every fourth round. No paid gacha, no timers.

details.title: ChillTank
details.short_description: Collect, care for, breed and trade colorful fish in a cozy aquarium game. Build your own 2.5D habitats: shape the landscape, add water and decorate. Play offline, at your own pace. But even the calmest waters hide hungry shadows...

details.title: Bermuda Bastion
details.short_description: Survive 33 days in the heart of the Bermuda Triangle! Build triangular structures to defend against malevolent squares, pentagons, and other geometric monsters. In this chaotic city-builder roguelike, every mistake pulls your Bastion closer to the depths.

details.title: Bar of Betrayal
details.short_description: A social deduction party game for 4-10 friends in a 1927 speakeasy. Regulars play the bar's games, find the body and vote out the killer. The killer stabs in secret, hides the body, mops the blood and blames someone else.

details.title: Mailed It!
details.short_description: You're the new night-shift intern at a postal sorting facility. Hit your quota and survive the shift, or build machines to do the work for you. Sorters, fans, conveyors, bizarre contraptions… whatever keeps the mail moving. Because the mail never stops!

details.title: Rift Fighter
details.short_description: Auto-attacks keep the pressure on; you control four equipped arts. Find manuals, evolve arts through use, and combine elements and gear across four chapters. Upgrade your equipment and permanent talents between expeditions. Play solo or team up in two-player local co-op.

details.title: Crop Guardian
details.short_description: Farm by day. Fight by night. Grow your farm, explore dungeons in search of rare seeds, ore, and equipment, and strengthen your defenses to protect your harvest from the creatures of darkness. A pixel art adventure where every seed counts and every night is a challenge.

details.title: Randventure
details.short_description: Randventure is a 1-bit, turn-based roguelite played in a single swipe: slide your heroes left or right to make your choices. Build your team of three heroes, journey through three acts, evolve them along the way, and overcome every obstacle on your road.

details.title: FrogPop
details.short_description: Pop bubbles with your tongue and dodge what they split into. Eat Power Bugs, combine relics, and face strange bosses in a pixel-art arcade roguelite. Try the free Windows demo: 10 waves, 2 bosses. Can you clear the pond?

details.title: How To Goblin
details.short_description: How To Goblin is a cozy desktop idle game where a tiny goblin crafts weapons on a dungeon platform while you do other things. Collect rare loot, sell items, purchase upgrades, and complete your collection!

details.title: Ticker Panic: Stock Market Simulator
details.short_description: Trade in a chaotic stock market sim where absurd headlines, hype cycles, crashes, and liquidity traps can make or break your portfolio. Start small, survive the chaos, and take over the market.

details.title: Keep Making Games
details.short_description: Tycoon for a one-person game studio, starting in 1976. Your only staff: a talking cassette, a bonsai and a chick with a megaphone. Unrealistic, I know. So is taking on the whole games industry alone for 50 years, and that's the plan. Build games from features, beat rivals to the shelves.

details.title: Little Colony
details.short_description: A little ant farm, alive at the edge of your screen. Paint a line and the ants dig it. Paint a room and they build it. Glance back later and they've been farming, foraging, and surviving the seasons. Every spring the Queens fly and the trees grow.

details.title: WARONOMY
details.short_description: Waronomy is a turn-based fantasy strategy conquest wargame set in a medieval magic world, where strategy is everything: raise armies, empower heroes, forge elite stacks, and annihilate rival warlords until every castle on the map is yours.

details.title: Ring Craft
details.short_description: In "Ring Craft," you will play as a ring forging master, using various materials to add useful or useless attributes to the rings. You will explore the secrets of nutrition, oop, I mean, enchantment. Whether it's miracles-craft or disaster-craft, it's all up to you!

details.title: Tallawa Game Nights
details.short_description: A Caribbean Tabletop Game Collection. Slam dominoes, throw 3D dice around the room, team up as allies or betray them and challenge 10 different AI personalities with hidden grudges in Arcade and Story. No copy? No problem! Play together using your phones!

details.title: Psychonesis
details.short_description: Psychonesis is a survival extraction pursuit co-op game where you play as patients imprisoned by an evil billion dollar corporation. Betrayed by those you trusted most, you must outsmart and outmaneuver their private security in this ultimate prison break/police chase game!

name: Suburban Manager:From Corner Store to Regional Price Cartel & Supply Chain Trust

details.title: Suburban Manager:From Corner Store to Regional Price Cartel & Supply Chain Trust
details.short_description: Suburban Manager is a hardcore supermarket sim based on Chinese business logic. Scout locations in a 3D sandbox and build a gridless store. Procure goods via App, manage logistics, and handle realistic payrolls including net salary and social security. Experience a pure retail journey.

details.title: Situation Normal
details.short_description: You're a secret agent. Get in. Destroy the boss. Get the hell out. An action platformer where the faster you move, the more chaos you unleash at once.

details.title: Tiny Planet Protectors
details.short_description: Welcome to the TPPA! The galaxy is yours to explore. Unfortunately, you owe the company that owns it. Take strange jobs across alien worlds, discover bizarre anomalies, and rebuild a bar on a tiny asteroid.

details.title: 光影の塔
details.short_description: An online 3D shooting game where players divided into 2 teams, "Light" and "Shadow" and buttles 4 vs 4 in max. Players ride on a machine which moves automatically and occupy "Tower" which are placed in stages. It is important for players to get power up items and weapons in the stage.

details.title: Echoes of the Stars
details.short_description: Confront fate and the gods themselves in Echoes of the Stars, a 2D Handpainted Action RPG. Explore diverse biomes, gain new skills, fight challenging foes, unlock new abilities, play mini-games, and unfold the epic journey of Eldric and Rin.

details.title: Dream Loop
details.short_description: A first-person music-puzzle adventure. Wander surreal dreamscapes, record the world around you, and mix what you find into original tracks. Turn up your headphones and drop out.
developers: The Mad Men of Oopsy Daisy, Inc
publishers: The Mad Men of Oopsy Daisy, Inc

details.title: Binary Golf
details.short_description: 3D sci-fi mini-golf where you hit targets until the last target becomes the hole. Every target grants a unique ability; chain abilities mid-flight and curve your shots. Compete for stars in 4-player Battle Mode or explore a story full of bosses and secrets.

details.title: My Cozy Home
details.short_description: My Cozy Home is a relaxing house building game where you get to build the house you always dreamed of. The game offers a huge library of items to create a bedroom or a kitchen or a gaming room or anything you can dream of. Choice is yours. Add to Wishlist now!

details.title: SkyCruise
details.short_description: Race a solar-powered ship from the mines to orbit before the sun goes down. Steer, jump and burn through 35 zones of drop hammers, traffic and open gaps, then chase Gold and Ace medals against the ghost of your best run.

details.title: Titan: The Ascension
details.short_description: Titan: The Ascension is a colony management strategy game on Saturn’s moon Titan. Build and expand an off-world industrial colony, extract ice to produce water for Earth, trade resources, and defend against ancient automated systems that react to technology growth. Will you prevail?

details.title: Dark Tidings Online
details.short_description: A classic, Tiny-MMORPG experience. From a penniless nobody dropped with no memories into an unknown world, to a hero ... or a villain? Join a faction of your choice and learn a wide array of skills. Help out villagers in need, battle in the wilds and explore dungeons. Alone or with friends!

details.title: Vampire Rancher
details.short_description: Rancher by day, Vampire by night. Manage your time and resources to restore your sleepy little town to its former glory, all while satisfying your vampire needs for blood. Oversee shops and saloons, farm crops and humans, and explore ancient vampiric ruins in the Weird Wild West!

details.title: Divided Land
details.short_description: Explore a vast medieval world haunted by the undead. Craft gear, build a settlement, farm, and tame animals as you develop your skills. Adventure alone or join other players to reclaim cursed lands, restore life to the wilderness, and defend what you've built.

details.title: DOPASPIN
details.short_description: Air hockey with a twist! Rotate your paddle to fire pucks that warp across the arena edges, and smash them into your opponent's Core. Match events fill the arena with pucks! Play 1v1, 2v2 or 3-player battle royale, locally, online or against the CPU.

details.title: Fire and Brim Co.
details.short_description: Embark on a wild and wacky adventure in this top-down action RPG! Take on the role of Ned, a disgruntled demon employee seeking to restore Hell's former glory. Fight your way through the corporate ladder of Fire and Brim Co., to confront its leaders and its evil CEO Satan!

details.title: Fantasy Boy
details.short_description: Fantasy Boy is a 2D platformer that follows the adventures of Boy. Explore a fantasy world, battle numerous enemies, and most importantly, have FUN!

details.title: Toxic Frontier
details.short_description: The world ended a long time ago. Unlock powerful cards and build a safe haven for your people within its ruins. In this roguelike city-builder, deploy cards across a hex grid to expand your colony and purify the land, buying another day of survival in the noxious wastes.

details.title: The Button Effect
details.short_description: Every button has a purpose. In this short, minimalist first-person puzzler you explore a dense, interwoven architecture – a museum, full of hidden connections and spatial insights.

name: Grand Arms: March of the Red Dragon

details.title: Grand Arms: March of the Red Dragon
details.short_description: Squad-based tactical RPG, with auto turn-based combat and real-time-with-pause map movement. Build your army, defend your territory, and unite Wales against the English invaders. Inspired by classic JRPGs including Ogre Battle and Ogre Battle 64.

details.title: Crimson Deluge
details.short_description: Command a besieged camp from its walls. Top-down zombie horde defense: survive seven brutal days, pick new weapons as the waves speed up, fortify your camp from scrap barricades to a military fortress - and keep your survivors alive.

details.title: Neebota: 99 Fails
details.short_description: Neebota: 99 Fails is a 3D action adventure with impossibly difficult platforming challenges in 2D. It takes place in Zeebo's surreal nightmare wherein his body painfully transforms, set to music by legendary David Wise.

details.title: Helmscape
details.short_description: Lead a party of fantasy heroes in action-packed battles...in SNAKE formation! Choose your party and venture forth into an ever-changing world as you discover new heroes and find better loot to keep gearing up.

details.title: Mad Chess
details.short_description: Mad Chess is a turn-based strategy game that vastly expands on the classic game of chess. Explore a colorful fantasy world, recruit up to 20 unique factions, fight-off an alien invasion in a single-player story mode or battle your friends online!

details.title: Whispers of West Grove
details.short_description: You're trapped in a psychiatric hospital. Your dreams are turning into nightmares. And your flashlight can change reality. Explore the twisted worlds of West Grove, solve puzzles that defy expectations, and use your strange new power to escape. Just remember: every world plays by different rules.

details.title: Holy Ocean
details.short_description: Ride your bike through the ocean of meat, alone or with friends. Raiders on your tail. They built a tower on that head island. Sneak in. Take down their leader. Destroy the whole island if needed. It is all for the love of Rose

details.title: Car Rental Simulator
details.short_description: Car Rental Simulator tests your skills in management, marketing, and fulfilling customers' unexpected needs. Solo or in co-op! Grow a small rental company into a true empire in Winston Springs.

details.title: HexLands
details.short_description: Forge an island kingdom one card at a time. Each card you play raises a farm, mill, or harbor on procedural hex islands. Crack the challenge each new shore gives you before setting sail, carrying your relics and upgrades onward. No combat. The land, the weather, and your own draw are the challenge.

details.title: Compicactus
details.short_description: Compi is a little cactus on your windowsill, and it wants to keep a diary. Help it write about your days with a few taps: the people you love, what you did and how you felt. Watch it grow and bloom, dress it up, and read your days as Compi saw them.

details.title: Everything Bites
details.short_description: The whole wild wants you gone. Defend the Barnes family farm in a top-down pixel-art horde survivor. Fight off waves of hostile wildlife with pitchforks, shotguns, leaf blowers, and traps. Earn coins, upgrade your arsenal, and keep the harvest alive!

details.title: Dungeon Roll
details.short_description: Descend beneath your family estate to uncover the truth about the crusader heroes of your bloodline, re-rolling your path floor by floor through a labyrinth built on real Crusades history. The souls of legendary crusaders grant you boons and the seven deadly sins guard the way down.

details.title: The Bakerville Case
details.short_description: Get ready for a first-person horror, adventure and survival experience, enter the darkness in this adventure inspired by true events and enjoy incredible graphics generated in real time with Unity engine. Play as Thomas Baker and explore a remote town to discover the terrible evil that awaits there.

details.title: RoomRun
details.short_description: Roomrun is a simple yet action-packed local multiplayer retro-style running game for one to four players. Run through trap-filled rooms, use the environment to your advantage, play safe and slow or fast and risky and try to reach the finish line before your friends do!

details.title: Eternal Mist
details.short_description: A real-time tactical game about making the right decisions with incomplete information. Choose your battles, prepare your squads, and adapt on the fly when enemy waves unfold in unexpected ways.

details.title: Feed Your T-Rex: Desktop Companion
details.short_description: A tiny T-Rex lives at the bottom of your screen while you work. Feed it rabbits, chickens and other critters. Once it's big enough, you can even feed it... humans! Decorate its Containment, keep it happy, and when it dies, use its DNA to breed an even better one.

details.title: Phenomena Embattled
details.short_description: From the far reaching void of space. To the very cores of planets. This is where Phenomena Embattled takes place. Pilot your alien trans-medium craft through aerial battles, underground caverns and deep sea trenches.

details.title: Alpha Spectrum
details.short_description: Alpha Spectrum is a cyberpunk RPG set in a dystopian 2030, where humanity is dangerously dependent on technology and social media. You are a CIA agent with psionic powers sent to investigate a devastating cyberattack that throws the world into chaos. But the system you trust may crack from within...

details.title: SHATTERFARMS
details.short_description: Farm. Forage. Fight. SHATTERFARMS is a first-person farmcore roguelike where you'll scavenge and fight through the Calamity, while cultivating a mysterious farm to survive and grow stronger. Creatures are untamed, magic unstable, and horrors unimaginable. Welcome to SHATTERFARMS.

details.title: Dino Cleanup
details.short_description: Clean giant dinosaurs and save cute prehistoric friends in a world flooded with goop! Unlock vacuum overdrive abilities for new ways to play and collect tons of hats in this nostalgic 3D platformer.

details.title: Loot Goblin Inc.
details.short_description: Break into homes, steal valuables, and sell them online to make big cash money! Join the corporate goblin world in this very cool Loot Goblin Simulation!

details.title: Rebel Roar
details.short_description: Build two decks at once in REBEL ROAR, a tactical deckbuilding roguelike where each rebel unlocks a different way to play. Combine an animal deck with a class deck to create Ninja Cats, Hacker Opossums, and hundreds of unique builds as you lead the rebellion through a cyberpunk animal world.

details.title: Water Walls
details.short_description: Enlist the help of UFOs to collect and evaporate water! Use the falling blocks to contain the water for collection by building Water Walls. Can you create a solution to bring you to the top of the leader boards in this easy-to-play hard-to-master block stacking game?

details.title: Barbarization
details.short_description: Barbarization is a roguelite dungeon crawler with elements of bullet hell and horde survival. Experiment with complex progression systems to create unique and powerful characters. Defeat enemy hordes and face challenging bosses to reclaim your lands and restore civilization.

details.title: Frontier Ferris For Adventurers
details.short_description: This is a stage-based, real-time battle action game with survival elements. You can gather resources and craft equipment and food. Defeating the boss of each stage unlocks new stages. Let’s continue to develop the frontier of Felis.

details.title: THE BACKWORLDS
details.short_description: RUN, JUMP, ESCAPE. Endlessly high buildings of dead ruins are towering over a giant chasm of green mist. But the reality of our world is seeping in, and some familiar places are now stuck there. This is how you are invited there - against your will. Enter the hostile realm of the BACKWORLDS.

details.title: Crimson Skyline
details.short_description: Set the skies ablaze in this aerial combat bullet hell! Target enemy carriers to cripple fleets, dodge relentless anti-air battleships, and outmaneuver fighter jet squadrons. As a Phoenix Squadron pilot, you are the final rampart against tyranny and your nation’s last hope to rise from the ashes.

details.title: Catena
details.short_description: Catena is a deck-building roguelite where the freedom to customize your allies feels as powerful as programming. Dive into strategic, grid-based battles and create tactics uniquely your own to conquer the mysterious island and defeat the formidable enemies that await.

details.title: Crystal Rail
details.short_description: All aboard the Crystal Rail - a train game set in a crystalpunk fantasy world of extinct animals, hand-painted environments, and political revolution!

details.title: Cappy & Tappy: Temples of Peril
details.short_description: Follow Cappy & Tappy through their block-stacking, platforming, worldwide adventure! Stack massive blocks as Tappy to help Cappy explore, survive and escape. Play with a friend or juggle both roles solo to escape crumbling temples packed with devious traps, colossal bosses, and mysterious idols.

details.title: SHUNYA
details.short_description: One moves, one draws—you control both at once. In this pixel-art puzzle game, draw Earth, Water, Fire, and Wind magic cubes to reshape the environment. Bound by a magical chain, a girl and a floating cat must escape the mysterious Otherworld and find their way home.

details.title: Ninkyo Dantai
details.short_description: Ninkyo Dantai is a 3D top-down, role-playing video game developed by TeamCS1. It is the first mainline title in the Ninkyo Dantai franchise developed as a turn-based RPG.

details.title: Highreach
details.short_description: When calamity struck, the world of Highreach was shattered. In this open-world survival game, build encampments, rescue survivors, and soar across the skies on your airship to explore a lost world and uncover the truth.

details.title: Instar Ecdysis: Protocol Limos
details.short_description: Protocol Limos is a tense psychological survival-horror game in which your cat is your only anomaly detector. As a homeless woman searching for food in a militarized school, you must rely on stealth, resource management, and absolute silence. But be careful, something in the darkness is watching you.

details.title: Who Wants To Be King?!
details.short_description: The year is 865. Vikings are sailing to avenge Ragnar Lothbrok. Build your city and defend it—alone or with friends.

details.title: Hyper Fin
details.short_description: Hyper Fin is a High-Speed Arena Fighter where you Out-Maneuver your enemies and Bash into their weak points.

details.title: Dunderbeck
details.short_description: Cincinatti: The Queen City, the Paris of America, Porkopolis. This city is a mess, Dunderbeck. Your job is to fight that mess, build with that mess and - I'm sorry to say - eat that mess. It's a dirty job, but that's how the sausage is made.

details.title: Card To Conquer
details.short_description: Conquer your enemies in this roguelike deckbuilder. Win by upgrading your deck, purchasing powerful items and combining your cards in battle to find overpowered synergies.

details.title: Food Magician
details.short_description: Food Magician is an fantasy action-adventure game that filled with hidden treasures, dangerous creatures, and ancient ruins. With stunning graphics and beautiful music, Food Magician features various gameplay mechanics, including real-time combat, traps, and puzzle-solving.

details.title: BaulaQuest
details.short_description: Local middle school teacher fights angry orange bald man army with marbles and furry creatures. Baula. Quest. BaulaQuest.

details.title: r:STRIKE
details.short_description: Get ready for a thrilling shooter racing experience. Feel the immense power and speed from your tank as you liberate a stunning city from it's deadly drone invaders.

details.title: 304 Seconds
details.short_description: As Kuroya, you wake up in an unfamiliar place together with your trusty partner, Nicole, and soon learn that your memories have been tampered with. Can you overcome the trials in this mystery visual novel?

details.title: RANGER COMMANDO
details.short_description: Nostalgic '80s-inspired isometric tactical shooter. Explore randomly generated missions, assassinate officers, free hostages, blow stuff up. No handholding, but easy to pick up!

details.title: Hexforger
details.short_description: Craft your spells in ONLINE CO-OP with your friends in this SURVIVORS-LIKE! Slaughter monsters, gain gold, upgrade your spells to infinite heights. Crush challenges and unlock new spells, upgrades, pickups, realms. Up to 4 players in this unique twist on the survivors-like formula!

details.title: Elemdian
details.short_description: A mystical action-adventure where you shift between human and wolf, combining elemental powers to cast powerful spells. Explore islands alongside a fairy survivor, and uncover the connection between a mysterious attack and a spreading Dark Mist.

details.title: VICE Undercover
details.short_description: VICE Undercover is a point & click narco-thriller set in an alternate 1980s Miami - where every choice matters. You play as undercover agent Vida, and for one hour per day, you're taking control over a cartel-run computer using Amigo OS, a fully-functional 1980-inspired operating system.

details.title: Galaxy Gang
details.short_description: JUMP into the Ultimate Universe as Danny, a ten‑year‑old kid who suddenly finds himself wrapped up in a cosmic adventure way bigger than he ever expected. Galaxy Gang gives you a fast, colorful introduction to the worlds, characters, and movement that define the game.

details.title: Nowhere Manor
details.short_description: House of stolen devil bargains and indolent angelic aristocracy: Nowhere Manor is doomed to disappear. You can leave if you’ve got a soul … but that’s not an option for an artificially created servant such as Liber. Just how far are you willing to go escape?

details.title: Ants in Space!
details.short_description: A roguelike strategy game where you evolve and mutate your space ants to repel an invasion of asteroid termites! Combine fast-paced exploration of tiny planets with spaceship travel across the galaxy. Find the ultimate ant DNA combination to withstand the unstoppable force.

details.title: Unnatural Worlds
details.short_description: Innovative yet familiar real-time strategy game in development. Grand-scale RTS game played on maps/planets of any 3D shape. It emphasizes strategy, base building, logistics, and reduces micro-management of individual units.

details.title: End Of World - Story
details.short_description: Colony Sim meets 2D Sci-fi Action RPG in End Of World - Story. Manage your space farm and recruit colonists among Space Apes, Sentient Penguins, Humans or Cyborg Beasts. Go on missions to exotic locations armed with quantum bombs, find the relic and triumph. Inspired by Among Us, Cult of the Lamb.

details.title: Into The Deep
details.short_description: Into the Deep is a tactical adventure RPG where you lead a troop of dwarves through a lost city. Plan turn-based battles, recruit survivors, explore catacombs, solve puzzles, and defeat dark forces to save the city.

name: Path of Ambition: The Sun Rise

details.title: Path of Ambition: The Sun Rise
details.short_description: 《異麒麟：初入江湖》是一款以東漢末年為背景的高自由度武俠 CRPG。 你將扮演一位與妹妹相依為命的流民少年，在黃巾之亂尚未爆發的邊境安身立命。從一無所有開始，學武、謀生、遊歷城鎮與荒野，結交形形色色的江湖人物，也在一次次對話、事件、檢定與抉擇中，決定自己要如何在這個時代活下去！

details.title: Red Dust Colony
details.short_description: The spirit of the space race lives on in this Mars based colony sim. Mine, craft and research in order to build up your initial lander into a self sustaining colony. Keep oxygen levels high and CO₂ levels low. Discover and grow a variety of plants to balance out colonist nutrition.

details.title: Farmion
details.short_description: Build your dream farm and grow a village around it in this cozy voxel farming and life sim, solo or with friends. Grow crops, raise animals, and turn your harvest into meals, bouquets and cheese for your own café, grocery store and flower shop. Your farm keeps growing while you’re away.

details.title: Glintland
details.short_description: Glintland is a magical factory-building card puzzler. Place tiles from a deck to build enchanting production chains, light up the land, and discover a cozy world full of secrets. Each Glint is a short, satisfying journey of automation and alchemy.

details.title: B.R.E.A.C.H.
details.short_description: B.R.E.A.C.H. is a cooperative exploration survival horror game. Join the Sharashka Complex and uncover what took place before the Incident. Hunt artifacts, explore the unknown, survive the unheard. Scavenge and craft to expand Sharashka Complex and help you rescue those lost in the void.

details.title: The InBetween
details.short_description: The InBetween is a hand-drawn Metroidvania with challenging platforming where you explore a dying and Infested land, gain new abilities, fight epic bosses, and decide whether to spare or kill the Infected, shaping both your conscience and your story.

details.title: Re:Connect
details.short_description: Re:Connect is a programming puzzle adventure set in a digital world, where you connect code to change the rules! Become a Debug AI, solve electronic circuit puzzles, and set off on a grand adventure to repair the “Heart Bugs” of the AIs!

details.title: Sapphobos
details.short_description: Sapphobos is a mystery and horror VR game. Explore, find clues, make deductions, choose the right conclusions, and maybe you will understand what happened to your missing colleague...

details.title: Lemonade Apocalypse
details.short_description: Make money selling lemonade. Optimise your product. Build your workforce. Sell, sell, sell. But money is not enough. Become president! Fuel climate change! Manipulate geopolitical events! Lemonade Apocalypse is an incremental game about business decisions that are technically legal.

details.title: Kindred Ills
details.short_description: Kindred Ills is a dark, loot-focused tile-based dungeon crawler. Build a party of mercenaries, discover powerful spells and items, and fight your way through dangerous biomes where death is permanent. Find rare loot, and push your party further with increasingly brutal difficulties and modifiers.

details.title: Roadside Egg Stand
details.short_description: Bring the residents of Reine the freshest, finest eggs! Raise cute chickens, collect their eggs, and sell them at roadside egg stands scattered throughout the village. Decorate your egg stand, collect your daily earnings, restock with fresh eggs, and read the heartfelt letters from the villagers.

details.title: Easy Drive Together
details.short_description: An easy and fun drive with a friend.

details.title: Supreme Heroes
details.short_description: Highschool sophomore Jacob suddenly discovers he has super powers and must team up with his best friends to become the 'Elect Few', but convincing them to embrace their powers and save the world is all but easy. Events bring Jacob to battle villainous factions in order to bring peace to the nation.

details.title: SAGE
details.short_description: SAGE is a multiplayer adventure game about frog wizards. Play solo or with friends on a journey to master elemental magic, explore a corrupted world, rebuild mushroom villages, and share tea with other frogs.

details.title: Multi Deck Hero
details.short_description: Multi Deck Hero is a roguelike deckbuilder where you command three unique decks to create powerful synergies. Strategically combine cards, unlock game-changing charms, and battle against increasingly powerful enemies. Will you master the perfect deck or fall to the challenge?

details.title: Untitled 2D Isometric RPG
details.short_description: Explore a dynamic 2D isometric fantasy RPG with procedurally generated worlds, adaptive AI, deep crafting, and story-driven quests. Shape your destiny through choices, combat intelligent foes, and forge legendary gear in an ever-evolving, immersive adventure.

details.title: Ayre Battles: Heritage Academy
details.short_description: A tactical card fighter where reactions, timing, prediction, and momentum matter. Build a 30-card deck, outplay your opponent with fighting game-inspired mechanics, and master strategic battles against an adaptive CPU or other players.

details.title: Hopfall
details.short_description: Build your team in this froguelite autobattler. Tame corrupted frogs, equip them with powerful items, and discover team synergies to overcome mysterious enemies.

details.title: Mermeows: Chill Cat Mermaids
details.short_description: Welcome to Mermeows: Chill Cat Mermaids – where every splash brings a smile! In this enchanting idle clicker creature collection game, traverse hand-drawn lakes, hatch unique Mermeows, and upgrade serene habitats. Collect pearls and let magical currents carry you into a world of calm strategy.

details.title: Maze Maou
details.short_description: A game about the struggles of an office worker in an anachronistic medieval fantasy setting. Strategically employ monsters and cursed items to keep adventurers away from your dungeon.

details.title: Pinewater
details.short_description: Pinewater is a cozy first-person fishing game about restoring a run-down lakeside cabin. Catch rare and legendary fish, restore and decorate your lakeside home, plant trees, and shape the surroundings to your liking — all at your own pace.

details.title: Story of Leaves
details.short_description: Start your new life! Build your dream farm, grow crops, craft, mine, fish, and forge heartfelt connections with charming townsfolk. Explore a vibrant world, uncover mysteries, and shape your own unforgettable story in this cozy farming / life sim RPG.

details.title: 财神模拟器
details.short_description: Become a novice God of Wealth! Grant fortunes or ruin fates with a touch. Your choices build "Virtue" for ascension or lead to轮回. Uncover the truth behind your divine power.

details.title: BOILED
details.short_description: America, 1925. A simple errand for an old friend pulls ex-gang leader Dan into a violent smuggler war on the border. A narrative-driven, adrenaline-pumping top-down shooter, set in the 1920s Old West.

details.title: Firewheels Shop Simulator
details.short_description: Co-Op Firewheels Shop Simulator lets you manage a diecast model store. Organize shelves, assist customers, and expand your shop in a detailed, realistic world. Hunt for rare and chase cars, trade with customers, and grow your diecast empire.

details.title: Spin Power
details.short_description: A short incremental building game where everything functions with your Spin Power. Build structures, mine resources, unlock new lands, upgrade yourself inside the big skill tree, automate resource mining to increase your income and awake the mysterious water tank from eternal slumber!

name: Escape from Planet Pan: Scam Center

details.title: Escape from Planet Pan: Scam Center
details.short_description: A fake job offer traps you inside the notorious Planet Pan Scam Center. Enduring daily abuse from guards, you are forced to scam strangers into fake investments while secretly planning an escape. A unique Butterfly Effect system brings past characters into future runs so you can change their fate.

details.title: Addie Shen
details.short_description: Addie Shen is a math based puzzle shooter. Play solo, team up in co-op, or practice your skills to stop the evil PEMDAS minions. Can you save the world with math?

details.title: Kosmosis
details.short_description: Two xenobiologists find themselves stranded on a mysterious planet that appears intent on their anihilation.

details.title: Luminest
details.short_description: Luminest is a hand-drawn 2D puzzle-platformer. As Lumi the light spirit, you traverse mutated woods gathering crystal shards. Solve light-themed puzzles with light, color and rhythm. Uncover hidden lore amid exploration to reignite the tiny world, featuring whimsical and soothing aesthetics.

details.title: Hell and Back
details.short_description: Step through the gates of hell and descend into darkness. Use blades and magic against dangerous enemies and challenging bosses, collect better loot, grow stronger, and fight your way out of hell. See how far you can survive into hell.

details.title: Eisenkiefer
details.short_description: Eisenkiefer is an asymmetrical horror multiplayer game for quick sessions with friends. Play as a Pig, hide, sabotage a giant meat grinder, and rescue your teammates – or become the Butcher and process the Pigs before they destroy your machine.

details.title: Mochi Conquest
details.short_description: A roguelike JRPG dungeon crawler set in mythical Japan. Lead Mochi squads across 9 unique classes in dynamic turn-based combat with timeline tactics 👺 Meet 300+ Kami, loot weapons, power up, and shape your strategy. Conquer 100 corrupted floors to uncover forgotten fates ⛩️ A full JRPG - Every Run!

details.title: Grid Gladiators
details.short_description: A pixel art roguelike deckbuilder battler on a 2D grid. Multiple biomes, randomly generated terrain, and a push-your luck system of battle modifiers keep battles feeling fresh. Characters, cards, stickers, relics, and more create many paths to victory. Join the community's fight to conquer the Grid!

details.title: Dwarven Village
details.short_description: Place your dwarves directly on the enemy paths. Keep them alive, level them up, equip them with powerful items, and build towers around them to create your perfect defense.

details.title: MECHBORN
details.short_description: A fresh roguelike deckbuilder where YOUR MECH IS YOUR DECK – With 7 cards always in play on a conveyor belt victory is down to skill and not luck. Master pilot skills and unlock Mech parts to reveal powerful cards, as you carve your path across 3 ever-changing continents to repel the Kaiju invasion.

details.title: Dealicious
details.short_description: Dealicious is a cooking-themed kitchen management deck-builder card game. Discover and stack cards together to cook meals, manage your kitchen space and expand eventually hiring staff as you grow your empire. Discover unique cards which offer special abilities/bonuses! Can you collect them all?

details.title: Dug Out
details.short_description: "Dug Out" is an exciting multiplayer PvP game for 2-4 players, where you dive into an underground arena and engage in intense battles. Armed with guns, you'll dig through the environment to uncover hidden opponents and outsmart your rivals.

details.title: Back of Beyond
details.short_description: Eldritch cult meets roguelite deckbuilding. Something stirs in a misty town... Recruit cute animal townsfolk, build your cult's deck, and grow your secret cult. Place buildings, pair them with townsfolk, and turn faith and devotion into forbidden power. Can you resist the Eldritch Gods' corruption?

details.title: Echoes of Agony
details.short_description: A dark turn-based roguelite where you are hunted by your own inner demons. Master the dynamic turn economy, collect loot and push your limits. The more you suffer, the greater the rewards. How much are you willing to endure in the pursuit of power?

details.title: Roof by Roof
details.short_description: Climb up, lay clay tiles row by row and watch the light change over the village. Roof by Roof is a cozy first-person roofing game: lay patterns for rewards, take on roofing orders and grow from apprentice to roofing legend, all at your own pace.

details.title: KAPICI
details.short_description: Cover your friend’s night shift as the caretaker of an old apartment building. Take out the trash, clean the halls, and handle the usual complaints. It’s only one night—until one complaint leads you inside an apartment you can’t leave.

details.title: Zorezdra
details.short_description: Zorezdra is a sci-fi platformer/metroidvania with a retro graphical aesthetic. Run, jump, fight and glide your way through a vast starport as you search for the truth about your protagonist's complex origins.

details.title: King's Escape
details.short_description: The old war game of the North, brought to life. Lead the king's last guard to freedom, or close the ring and take his crown, across seven historic rule sets of Tafl. Battle a cunning computer, a friend at your PC, or anyone online.

details.title: Carhem
details.short_description: Chaotic car brawler where you collect items, spam unique abilities, and trash talk your friends. Knock opponents off the platform or keep them out of the circle to win!

details.title: Greedspire
details.short_description: Build powerful gear combos in a push-your-luck roguelike auto-battler. Enchant your gear to +20 or watch it shatter. Move to the next floor, or risk your entire run for richer loot in deadlier rooms. 100 floors. One life. How greedy will you get?

details.title: H.A.I.N
details.short_description: H.A.I.N: Heir of the Ancient Immortal Necromancer is an asymmetrical co-op horror/thriller game for 1–4 players. Explore hostile regions, collect ancient artifacts, and begin the final ritual. But one of you will become H.A.I.N, the betrayer, and trust will collapse.

details.title: Dino Citadel
details.short_description: Command a castle-on-a-dino through a corrupted world. Rescue fallen allies, lead them in battle, and build your deck. Manage your economy to draw cards and confront the Voidrift in this tactical roguelike deckbuilder.

details.title: AVROPOLIS
details.short_description: VR action-adventure with fully physics-based movement. Climb ruins, fight mysterious creatures and enemies, survive deadly traps, solve ancient puzzles, and manage your gear as Leonardo uncovers the lost civilization of AVROPOLIS. Story-driven campaign with strong accessibility options.

details.title: Kardaviik
details.short_description: Kardaviik is a 3D factory automation game set in a voxel asteroid belt. Your mission: harness energy, ascend the Kardashev Scale, and save Earth. Conquer the expansive procedurally generated belt by harvesting resources and extracting fuel, and build your ultimate space factory!

details.title: Last Life
details.short_description: Last Life is a breathtaking adventure game set in NeoNova, a cyberpunk city where high technology and dark secrets intertwine. Our protagonist, a cute cat controlled by players, will embark on a mysterious journey to find their lost lover.

details.title: Legends of Castile
details.short_description: To fulfill her dream of becoming a nun, María de Salazar must outsmart the creatures of Castilian folklore using her wit and a mysterious bestiary in this comic fantasy point‑and‑click adventure set in 19th‑century Spain.

details.title: Snap Quest
details.short_description: A Photo Collection Adventure Game. Complete your research notebook, solve creature puzzles, earn research grant money. Buy upgrades for your camera, rebuild the town, bond with the locals, and reveal the paranormal mystery of Star Island.

details.title: Arctic Unrest
details.short_description: Arctic Unrest is an intense experience of survival set in a hand-crafted frozen arctic world. Hunting, fishing, building, crafting & fighting are required to survive. Vehicles & Parkour & Traversal system enable you to explore the vast frigid world. Wishlist it Today. Keep frosty & Keep Alive

details.title: Galactic Diner
details.short_description: Galactic Diner is a cooking-themed RPG full of minigame mayhem. Explore a planet full of friends, food, and mysteries, and cook your way to the top of the galaxy!

details.title: Lady Hunt
details.short_description: Lady Hunt is a pixel art action platformer, set in a dark gothic world, where blood has been infected. You play as a huntress, who must find a way to purify this world, inhabited by monsters and beasts.

details.title: VoidMania
details.short_description: A neon arcade territory game. Carve lines through the void and seal them to the wall to claim space, but if an enemy touches your open line, it burns. Trap the sector bosses, chain your cuts and reveal every sector across 48 levels.

details.title: Guesslings
details.short_description: Guesslings is a silly, cozy 2-8 player party game. Everyone gets a name on their forehead that only they can't see. Ask your friends yes/no questions until you guess who you are. Or cheat at chess, lose at darts or just goof around. PS. Remember to pet the cat.

details.title: PaceBreak
details.short_description: Pacebreak is a first-person parkour speedrunning game. Compete against yourself, your friends or the top of the leaderboard. Play official levels, community maps, or create and share your own courses using the in-game level editor.

details.title: Edge of Madness
details.short_description: Edge of Madness is a Lovecraftian RPG with tactical card-based combat. Explore the grounds around the Marsh Estate, find equipment, combat cards, and combine them with character skills. Find a way to defeat your enemies without losing your sanity.

details.title: TailofScorpios
details.short_description: "Scorpion's Tail" is a AVG set in an alternate historical timeline. In the war-born nation of SouthXi, a conspiracy involving girls begins to surface.Investigator Zhang Cheng meets a mysterious girl. After accepting request, he is drawn into a web of secrets.

details.title: Nono & Soso
details.short_description: Nono & Soso is a puzzle game built around magnets. Switch between N and S poles to push and pull your way through blocked paths and reach the goal.

details.title: Clan fantasy adventures
details.short_description: Clan fantasy adventures is a turn-based 2D RPG. Play Marco, a young boy who wants to become a swordsman, through various adventures that will plunge him into the heart of a major conflict.

details.title: Cubic Blitz
details.short_description: Cubic Blitz is an isometric puzzle game where you control a cube and solve loads of hand-crafted levels. With the power of paint, sponges, and much more, your task is simple: PAINT THE WORLD.

details.title: Sunyata CCG
details.short_description: Sunyata is a tactical, action‑packed card game where you command fantastical creatures in Earth's magical future. Ride dragons, summon the undead, and evolve magical beasts in duels that reward creative deckbuilding and adaptive strategy.

details.title: Ultimate Lemon Basket
details.short_description: 🍋 A Speed-Running platformer where you can’t drop any lemons.🍋 Between you and the goal are Ghosts, Cows, Acid Rain Clouds, Monster Trucks, Hopes, Dreams and other things AS WELL!! There are leaderboards.

details.title: Spinning My Wheel
details.short_description: Build a physics‑powered hamster‑wheel, master rocket‑boosted moves, to lead a brain chipped enhanced hamster through puzzles, mining, and laboratory‑runner mayhem.

details.title: Meat Market
details.short_description: Outside the last human city, you keep a butcher shop. Your customers shamble in at dusk. Stock comes from the city beyond. Village is home - they tolerate you because you keep the dead calm. And somewhere in that city is the one who took your daughter.

details.title: Phatastrophe
details.short_description: Turn the pond into a warzone in this chaotic action roguelike! Dual-wield outrageous weapons, unleash devastating back-mounted firepower and create wild builds as a Phrog, Chrab or Phlai. Survive solo, team up in co-op or blast your friends in online battles.

details.title: Pepper the Giant Purple Dog
details.short_description: In this twist on a harmless pet simulator, take care of Pepper, who happens to be a giant purple dog. But when things go awry, you will have to decide: how many lives is one good boy worth?

details.title: Star Pulse:The War
details.short_description: Star Pulse: The War is an independent real-time strategy game that merges science fiction with fantasy. Players will command a sci-fi faction, harnessing the power of star pulse to gather resources, construct buildings, train troops, and nurture heroes in the fight against invading magical forces.

details.title: Kung Fu Addiction
details.short_description: An auto-battler RPG where anticipation is everything. Predict your enemies' moves, shape your hero's progression, and channel the souls of ancient warriors to resurrect with a new fighting style as you overcome escalating challenges across multiple combat modes.

details.title: Apprentice of Darkness
details.short_description: Play as a dark magician, gather your party of all sorts of evil, unspeakable creatures and spread darkness! A hand-drawn, turn-based rogue-like experience! Sacrifice your enemies to Evil Gods, unlock new powers and recruits, build your Tower of Darkness to spread corruption throughout the continent.

details.title: Ruff Day at the Office
details.short_description: Ruff Day at the Office is a cozy office dog simulator where you help the whole office succeed through pure dog logic. Make friends with your coworkers, solve problems you probably started and level up your office skills. Will you become the office dog of the year?

details.title: 追逃 Chase&Escape
details.short_description: "Chase & Escape" is a single-player horror game about Chen Lin, a construction worker. After his night shift, his girlfriend Jiayi vanishes, strange dolls appear, and he’s chased by her. What’s behind these eerie events? Discover the truth!

details.title: Obgob
details.short_description: Build overpowered combos! Obgob is a autobattler roguelike with a focus on allowing the player to experiment and create wacky combos with item combinations, traits, and artifacts. Select a character and recruit units carefully positioning them while utilizing your resources to make broken builds.

details.title: Summoner's Cookbook
details.short_description: An active incremental, creature collector about summoning creatures and giving them tasks. Craft them using ingredients and fill out your Cookbook with your discoveries. Take on requests, build, expand and manage your creatures to work for you while you discover new recipes!

details.title: Vale's Echo
details.short_description: Death isn’t the end - it’s your last chance. Solve haunting puzzles and make choices that matter as you guide Vale across the underworld. Will regret follow her into eternity?

details.title: Prohibition Panic!
details.short_description: Run a dusty speakeasy, alone or with 3 other players, determined to become the next underground sensation! Serve your patrons the booze and carry their drunk butts out of the parlor, all while hiding from the law, ready to take you in… or take some “gifts” from you.

details.title: Valerie
details.short_description: Follow Valerie on a charming 2D adventure where you'll jump, slide, bounce and boost your way through dense forests and dreamscapes using her bubble powers.

details.title: LAG KILLS
details.short_description: Desperate and out of options, you break into what you thought was an empty house, but little do you know the owner is home, and you're his prey. LOOT, HIDE, SURVIVE and ESCAPE alone or with a friend.

details.title: Drop Dead Party
details.short_description: Drop Dead Party is a 2–4 PvP multiplayer bomb tag party game that you can only play with your Steam friends. Pass the ticking bomb, sabotage everyone with power-ups, and be the last one standing. No public lobbies, so every betrayal is personal. Invite your friends, ruin the friendship!

details.title: Knight life tavern
details.short_description: Cook and brew endlessly, desperately trying to serve a never ending stream of customers with a temper. The medieval knight is hard to please and very vocal about his disdain for goblins and the like. Make sure everyone enjoys eachother's company, and kick the trouble makers through the front door!

details.title: Merchant Miles
details.short_description: A good merchant knows what to sell. A great one knows where, when, how, and to whom. Fill your cart with wares, haggle your way through towns, and keep an eye on the shifting market in this travelling merchant strategy game. Just be wary that today’s bargain could be tomorrow’s loss.

details.title: Ruling Horsestown
details.short_description: Be a horse mayor! Make the best choices in this casual comedy management game, try not to lose, and govern the chaotic city of Horsestown where new absurd decisions and eccentric characters await you.

details.title: Cuzuco
details.short_description: Challenge yourself and demonstrate your precise high-speed hand control to help our little armadillo get back home as fast as possible in this fair but unforgiving platformer game.

details.title: COLIVING
details.short_description: COLIVING is an interactive narrative adventure where you play as a hard-boiled detective and a relentless journalist on two distinct paths. As their cases converge on a shared apartment, your choices shape a complex, branching story. Trust no one—the real danger lives right behind the wall.
developers: Taiwan Computer Graphics Manufacturing Co., Ltd.
publishers: Taiwan Computer Graphics Manufacturing Co., Ltd.

details.title: 玫昙 She From TheFuture
details.short_description: Mei can see hidden memories. Two years ago, Her lovers Tan died in a fire, ruled suicide. She became a detective. Then she discovered she can travel through time. She must return to the night Tan died—can she change it or just watch it burn again?

details.title: KACHIN!
details.short_description: Din Dino, the mob's top ex-hitman, runs away from their past to pursue their true passion: selling custom t-shirts. Design T-shirts, get to know your clients and confront your past!

details.title: Stop the Crawl
details.short_description: Stop the Crawl is a roguelike autobattler where you assemble a deck of monsters to defeat the invading heroes. Discover which monsters work well together, strengthen them with items, and create an unstoppable team.

details.title: Sa[meow]rai: Silverwing Stray
details.short_description: "Sa[meow]rai" is a top down action role-playing game centered around one-hit kills and rich interactivity.You play as a law-enforcer with an implant called "Gyakugawa Emergency Reboot Device," fighting for every second of your remaining time in a morally ambiguous cyberpunk city.

details.title: Impious
details.short_description: Impious is a dark turn-based RPG set in a world where human imperfection is no longer tolerated, those deemed impious are captured and dragged underground. You wake inside a system designed to break you and your only way is forward:fight, negotiate, gear up and find your way out.

details.title: Chaos Bringer
details.short_description: Outsmart foes in fast-paced tactical dungeons, then become a raid leader who stops time to command your party. Explore, craft, and conquer giant bosses single-handedly for the ultimate MMORPG-level satisfaction.

details.title: Blood Dice
details.short_description: Roll or hold dice to get patterns and reach blood quotas. Modify dice, buy items and sign some suspicious pacts to escape. Craft your build, and test it against the odds or lose it all.

details.title: Bread & Bravery
details.short_description: Return to the era of knights and castles in a uniquely satisfying mix of Settlement Building, RTS and Castle Simulation genres. Manage complex and realistic medieval production chains, build your army and defences, satisfy the King and lead your people to prosperity. Will you succeed as a new lord?

details.title: Falafel King
details.short_description: Take orders, fry falafel and fill pitas, solo or with up to three friends, at a quiet stand in Tel Aviv's Carmel Market. Do it well and word gets around: more customers, more dishes, and a lunch rush you'll need every hand for.

details.title: Duel Paean
details.short_description: Experience the most exhilarating third-person, free-form combat! Players can use uniquely designed characters and a combat system that is easy to learn but hard to master. This allows you to effortlessly grasp combat techniques while engaging in exciting and diverse battles with other players!

details.title: Tower of Creation
details.short_description: Immortality became a curse, so humans chose to return their souls to the Creator. You are the last one left. As you take the same Path as your lost love, you discover that paradise is a lie and that the real mystery has only just begun.

details.title: 大学物语
details.short_description: "University Story" is a college simulation game where you play as a freshman. Experience family, friendship, and love over four years in university. How will you balance studying, socializing, and daily life? What kind of person will you become ? Every choice you make shapes your future!

details.title: Revertices
details.short_description: Directed by one of Cuphead's developers, Revertices is an action combat sidescroller where you will be forced to fight the corrupted remains of your friends: your duty is to reset the cycle at all costs, but in doing so you doom yourself and your companions to repeat the same horrors.

details.title: Everforge Legacy
details.short_description: Single-player action RPG inspired by Final Fantasy XI. Six Jobs, weapon skills, skillchains, elemental days, and Named hunts, rebuilt for one hero, with up to two Trusts at your side. Three origin stories through a complete Chapter 1 storyline.

details.title: Bones will Fly: Tower Defense
details.short_description: A cozy 3D tower defense where every hit makes the bones fly! Build and upgrade towers, give them specializations and blast marching skeletons into bouncing, physics-driven bones. Watch the skies for flying skulls and defend 25 levels across meadow, snow, desert, lava and graveyard.

details.title: Treble-Basie
details.short_description: A throwback to retro collect-a-thon platformers! Treble-Basie features a comprehensive moveset, old-school graphics, nostalgic soundtrack, and much more!

details.title: Blood of the North
details.short_description: A survival game with roguelite elements where you build, fight, and explore the northern islands to reclaim what was lost.

details.title: Epic Idlenture
details.short_description: Epic Idlenture is a pixel-art idle dungeon crawler. You play as a bear taking on endless depths. Let the fast-paced combat handle itself while you focus on building the ultimate hero: equip rare loot, level up your attributes, and unleash devastating skills to clear every floor.

details.title: Like Me
details.short_description: Turn your shut-in childhood friend into a VTuber and aim for 10 billion followers! Click SNS "Like" buttons in this clicker x idle x Adventure game. When growth slows, use "reincarnation" to boost SNS power and unlock new "Tsukimin" forms. A fresh take on modern SNS society with cute visuals.

details.title: Less Miserables
details.short_description: A historical comedy adventure game, loosely based on Les Misérables, with classic point-and-click puzzles, hand drawn art and an amazing voice cast.

details.title: BUZZ QUIZ
details.short_description: Buzz Quiz is the best way to liven up any gathering: play alone or with friends, create your own quizzes with photos and videos, share them in the workshop, and turn them into cool videos or offline parties. Fast, fun, and always your way!

details.title: SHALTER-03
details.short_description: Time is ticking. In this co-op first-person puzzle-adventure game where the senses of sight, hearing, and speech are disabled, each level introduces new mechanics. Think fast, balance buffs and debuffs, and find the most efficient path to victory. Adaptability is your greatest weapon.

details.title: Sunderborn
details.short_description: This is a multiplayer asynchronous sandbox with elements of puzzles, logic games, world exploration, and strategy. Take on the role of the Creator, shaping your own reality out of the surrounding Chaos. Manage your created world and compete with other Gods!

details.title: Blight Doctors
details.short_description: DISCOVER, DIAGNOSE, EXORCISE. You are a plague doctor paranormal investigator living in a rotten, gothic city at the end of an apocalypse. Banish ghosts, cure plagues, treat with monsters... all in co-op and proximity chat!

details.title: PECADO
details.short_description: PECADO is a first-person folkloric horror experience set in the “España profunda”. Listen to the word of God.

details.title: Dice Slinger
details.short_description: Become a dice slinging legend in the weird west world. Carefully craft your deck of dice and stratagems to hunt ever more dangerous bounties. Who knows, maybe even the Death itself shall fall to your ingenuity. Become the one true Diceslinger.

details.title: Bedrotting Simulator
details.short_description: Lock the doors. Reply to her texts. Don't stumble onto the wrong account. Track down your missing friend, salvage your relationship, and survive the nights alone—assuming your mind doesn't break first.

details.title: The Immolation Apartment
details.short_description: An ancient cult lurks in an old apartment; a mother sacrifices her daughter. A decade later, her son enters the Netherworld to save his family from a deity’s torment, evading spirits to reach "Penglai Island" and destroy the Soul-Refining Furnace. Uncanny Abode blends 1990s Taiwan with cult horror.

details.title: Celestial Golf
details.short_description: It’s 2D golf on an astronomical scale. Bite-sized missions will teach you the techniques of real space flight, without having to worry about fuel or crew. Precisely plan orbital trajectories over the moons of Mars, through the rings of Saturn, and boldly go where no golf ball has gone before.

details.title: Gunfetti
details.short_description: Pick a hero, jump in and start shooting. Fast multiplayer action in pixel art.

details.title: Knight Paths
details.short_description: A free, chess-inspired strategy duel where every square can be used only once. Control a single knight, outmaneuver your opponent in online PvP, or challenge five AI difficulty levels offline. Simple rules. Every move matters.

details.title: Zombies Hate to Die
details.short_description: Precise character slashing, scavenge resources along the way, and upgrade absurd gear. In this Roguelite loop, every escape is a brand-new journey.

details.title: Shifting Chambers
details.short_description: Shifting Chambers is a solo / co-op survival horror game where you need to escape from a mansion where rooms shift when the bell rings. Explore the rooms, reorient yourself, solve puzzles and survive the unpredictably intelligent guardians.

name: Super Egg & TCG Card Shop Simulator

details.title: Super Egg & TCG Card Shop Simulator
