details.short_description: Run your own TCG Card Shop! Crack open surprise eggs, collect rare cards and toy parts, and raise birds to produce eggs on your farm. Stock shelves, set prices, and serve customers as you grow your store in this shop simulator.

details.title: Everything Store
details.short_description: Everything Store is a game where you can manage your own thrift shop! Buy items, fit them into your store and sell them by negotiating with customers!

details.title: Punch Lunch: Foodtruck Fighter
details.short_description: Beat up punks in fast isometric combat, then win them over with burgers from your food truck. Brawl through the city, upgrade your kitchen, learn combat moves, and unlock new neighbourhoods. Grab your spatula and take back the streets!

details.title: Warp Bound
details.short_description: In this roguelite auto battler, you've been thrust into an uncharted sector of the Galaxy, discovering friends and foes alike. Traverse different environments, seek out and deal with traders, equip unique parts for your ship, form varied strategies, and fend off a variety of hostile factions.

details.title: OVERCRASH
details.short_description: Devastate the roads with your vehicle, wreck objects, explode traffic, take down helicopters, boost everywhere and chain combos to unlock new rides and challenges.

details.title: Imprinted
details.short_description: An audio restoration job becomes an investigation into the occult, as an elusive musician’s damaged cassette tapes are exhumed in northern Italy. Use a fully-operational desktop to sift through files, descending into the artist’s world in this slow-burning ghost tale of creativity and obsession.

details.title: Mewts
details.short_description: Handcrafted party Clayhem! A PvP game full of chaos and innocent violence. Fight your friends or challenge bots. Play as Mewts, cute, wiggly creatures. Use your body as a slingshot and hit each other! Play a variety of game modes in handcrafted clay arenas!

details.title: Midnight Video Store
details.short_description: Midnight Video Store is an idle game where you play as Jeff, the sole employee of a retro video store. One night, the video store is attacked by a horde of monsters. Make Jeff more powerful with the help of a gigantic and monstrous talent tree !

details.title: Woodland Werewolf
details.short_description: The mist came without warning. One morning, the residents of the village woke to find their lakeside settlement wrapped in an impenetrable fog—thick, cold, and utterly wrong. Within hours, people began to vanish. No screams. No signs of struggle. Just empty spaces where lives used to be.

details.title: Pip & Bones
details.short_description: Pip & Bones is a score-based deckbuilder roguelike with domino rules. Connect really long chains, score a lot of points, forge your perfect deck, enchant tiles, unlock new strategies with powerful idols and win the title of Tavern Champion!

details.title: Fireworks Incremental
details.short_description: Bad Wizard covered the land with a Magical Dome and the only way to destroy it is with fireworks! Hire units, unlock buildings, buy upgrades, discover powerful synergies, turn a few tiny explosions into a ridiculous spectacle and ultimately defeat The Bad Wizard himself!

details.title: Shadowbound
details.short_description: Shadowbound is a minimalist 3D platforming and puzzle journey where light is your enemy and shadow your only ally. Overcome short challenges, manipulate light, and recover lost colors to rebuild the memories of a lifetime.

details.title: FEARSFROMARS
details.short_description: You are a space hunter from Mars. Hunt with friends, capture bizarre aliens alive, and sell them to the highest bidder. In this galaxy, alien or not, they all share one fear... FEARSFROMARS.

details.title: Neo Bananas
details.short_description: In this sci-fi speedrun-platformer, destroy every neo bananas, get the S+ ranks, and uncover why you're the last gorilla on Earth. Go fast. Go wild. Go bananas!

details.title: A Day with Wuki
details.short_description: Wuki is a real cat, and today the whole neighborhood is his. Slip through open windows, push mugs off tables, hunt mice, complete little cat mischief in every house and collect polaroids of the real Wuki. Or just nap in the sun.

details.title: Oiran Survival: Edo Yokai Rush
details.short_description: Defeat, choose, grow, and break the battlefield. A Japanese dark fantasy survivor-style roguelite where you Limit Break 14 skills and cut down hordes of yokai. Defeat bosses, forge gear from their rewards, and face even stronger foes.

details.title: Gargoyle Garden
details.short_description: Grow magical plants, open enchanted seed packs, hire cute critters, and upgrade your greenhouses. Visit the local gargoyle shopkeeper and complete your plant collection in this cozy incremental gardening game.

details.title: Bloomino
details.short_description: A cozy game about running your own little flower shop 💐 Place flower tiles, create charming bouquets and brighten your customers’ day. Decorate your shop, unlock new flowers and discover a variety of beautiful combinations.

details.title: Bono
details.short_description: A calm first-person village life and survival game. Chop wood, catch fish and collect scrap, do daily jobs for the shopkeepers to win their friendship and secrets, drive the mountain road, and get through four seasons in a small village below the mountains.

details.title: Layang Atma
details.short_description: An isometric survival horror about grief and loss. Fight terrifying manifestations, search through distorted memories, and uncover the truth behind the person Yus cannot let go.

details.title: Occult Office: Lofi Rituals
details.short_description: Occult Office: Lofi Rituals is a cozy desktop companion that blends witchy aesthetics and real productivity tools. Plan your day, care for plants, read fortunes, pet magical familiars, customize your desk and avatar, and play minigames during your breaks.

details.title: Rift Tavern
details.short_description: Gather materials, cook meals, serve patrons, and defeat foes! Welcome to your new life as the owner of the 'Rift Tavern'. Restore the former glory of your run-down tavern by night, and explore the depths of dangerous portal zones by day!

details.title: White Noise: Ghost Signal
details.short_description: You are the new caretaker of a polar station. The assignment came unexpectedly, but you accepted it without hesitation. A lonely outpost in the middle of an endless frozen wasteland — a place where you must simply survive, follow the instructions… and keep your mind from breaking.

details.title: SYDI
details.short_description: SYDI is a turn-based JRPG inspired by tabletop RPGs like by D&D, where every battle comes down to the roll of a die. Explore a silent, colorless world and find your friends again, and face the question waiting for you at the end.

details.title: Elemency Island
details.short_description: Elemency Island is a cozy farm and automation game in coop multiplayer. Plant, raise animals, sell your ressources to unlock technologies and automate your entire farm. Alone, or with your friends, come discover this island full of surprises and unknown creatures.

details.title: Shrine Raider
details.short_description: Help Regina recover an important relic that was stolen from her shrine, while saving her sister and stopping a secret organization from creating the ultimate weapon in this unique danmaku adventure!

details.title: The Beginner Investor
details.short_description: Start from scratch, learn the market, and build your fortune in this accessible stock market tycoon game. Buy, sell, and diversify your way to wealth!

details.title: Redline District
details.short_description: A turn-based tactical strategy about evacuation coordination. As the voice on the radio, guide survivors through real-world city streets, manage squad roles, and calculate every move in deterministic combat before the expanding hazard zone engulfs the district.

details.title: Turbo 16
details.short_description: Turbo 16 depicts a coming-of-age narrative through combining arcade racing and storytelling. Turbo 16 is a racing game and provides players with racing challenges (3 modes), the game is equally an environmental narrative experience.

details.title: Hero's Unison
details.short_description: Hero’s Unison is a 2D pixel action RPG where you are summoned as a hero to a mysterious new world. Form a 3-hero party, link souls with your allies, and unleash unique powers to stand against the darkness threatening all realms.

details.title: Infinity Rising
details.short_description: Infinity Rising is an open‑world sandbox set between Cornucopias—the Nation in the Sky—and Earth Below. Players traverse both worlds to explore, gather, craft, build bases and land plots, trade in a player‑driven economy, and respond to rift‑related events and Terra through PvE.

details.title: Undertaker
details.short_description: Hunt eldritch horrors in the cursed lands of Transylvania. Stalk your prey with blades and bullets, craft your ideal loadout, and conduct unnatural rituals in this gothic shooter.

details.title: Vicky The Fox
details.short_description: Where did the lost days go? Join Vicky on a magical and relaxing journey! Befriend nature spirits to learn new abilities, discover sweet fun facts about animals, and collect magical grapes to restore harmony in the forest. 🦊🍄

name: おばけなんて怖くないJK　VS　学校迷宮

details.title: おばけなんて怖くないJK　VS　学校迷宮
details.short_description: Curious about horror but bad with scary things? This is a not-so-scary horror game made by a developer who feels the same way, created for players who want to enjoy horror without being truly frightened. A pixel-art side-scrolling action adventure with puzzles and light action elements.

details.title: Mars Incremental
details.short_description: A short incremental game about terraforming Mars. Build, automate, and deploy drones to harvest power, gas and water, then watch a quiet, red planet wake into a living world, one horizon at a time. Just follow the instructions: step one, change the entire planet.

details.title: Monarchs at Play
details.short_description: Turn-based 4X strategy in just one hour. Place buildings, chain adjacency bonuses, optimize resources, and outsmart rival monarchs through trade or war to earn the most Glory - solo or multiplayer.

details.title: Wares & Wonders: Fantasy Shop Simulator
details.short_description: A cozy first-person fantasy shop simulator. Every customer has a profession, a budget, and a reason to stop by today. Choose what to stock, arrange your displays, take on quests, and run the shop solo or with friends. Everything is physical. Everything can be broken.

details.title: Taiyi Saga
details.short_description: Taiyi Saga is a deck-building roguelike set in Chinese mythology. Pulled into a god's private realm, you build your deck, battle rival gods' invaders, and collect relics forged from ancient beasts — fighting your way toward the truth, and a way home.

details.title: Little Frontier
details.short_description: A story-rich Western tactical RPG set in 1836. Lead three mountain men across the vast, untamed American frontier. Explore the wilderness, engage in tactical turn-based combat, and navigate dangerous encounters where your decisions shape the story and the fate of your companions.

details.title: DORM
details.short_description: First-person horror. An old student dormitory in a provincial Eastern European town, strange residents, brutal encounters, blood, dark humor, and explicit scenes.

details.title: Breaking News Live
details.short_description: When the truth and business are at odds, money prevails. Shape the reality of others by curating which news are worth telling and which are worth altering.

details.title: Karusel
details.short_description: 1984. Denis is trapped in a never-ending summer day in a Soviet village. The sun is frozen at its zenith, and familiar paths lead to dark secrets. Uncover the nature of this anomaly and discover: what price must you pay to finally reach tomorrow?

details.title: Breaking News
details.short_description: A chaotic comedy adventure where you hit a glitchy CRT TV to change reality. Shake up the broadcast and twist the story to make your uncle’s crazy conspiracies come true.

details.title: Slacker
details.short_description: Collect shopping carts, ignore customers, and complete To-Do lists that encourage mischief and mayhem. Fight a chicken mascot, prevent an alien invasion, learn to breakdance, crash a forklift, and more. How much can you get away with and still keep your job?

details.title: Shrine Protectors
details.short_description: Deckbuilder Tower Defense meets rogue-lite RTS strategy. Lead your army, crush waves of enemies, and unlock powerful upgrades and passive spells. Combine deckbuilding strategy with tactical army management in this relentless bullet heaven.

details.title: Bonds of the Zodiac
details.short_description: Rei, a grieving girl, is drawn into a mystical realm where the Zodiac spirits are bound by the Jade Emperor. Mediate their inner struggles and guide them toward freedom in a first-person journey steeped in myth, conflict, and emotion.

details.title: Rookie Taoist
details.short_description: A co-op survival horror game rooted in Chinese folk traditions. Team up with 1–4 players to survive haunted locations, use ritual tools, uncover hidden truths, and escape the grip of evil. But beware—your arrival may only be the beginning of a greater nightmare...

details.title: Reng Azure Requiem
details.short_description: No jumping. Only 4-way teleportation. Travel through eras, collect Skill Gravestones, defeat bosses, explore armor sets, and choose your final act in search of resurrection in this 2D pixel art Metroidvania.

details.title: PC Versus
details.short_description: The first ever competitive PC building game. Go head to head with another player on the same task and budget, pick from 800+ real components and overclock for an edge. Push too hard and your build crashes. Free to play.

details.title: Ultra Damage
details.short_description: Ultra Damage is a hand-drawn Boomer Shooter packed with humor and action, featuring hand-crafted visuals and a story blending gritty detective work with absurd comedy. Each level is a wild ride. Unravel the mystery, find hidden clues, and deal ultra damage to save humanity!

details.title: Sven Rescues a Princess
details.short_description: Sven Rescues a Princess is a 3D co-op horde brawler for 1–10 players. Hack and slash through 30–45 minute runs to save six princesses, then live with whatever you brought home. Hordes keep time with the music. Unlock everything by playing. No microtransactions or loot boxes.

details.title: Mega Hasan 2: Wallet Detective
details.short_description: Mega Hasan is back! Last time he had to find his own wallet. This time he's here to find other people's crap! Run and jump through 56 levels across 7 worlds. Battle bosses, unlock characters and team up with a friend in local co-op!

details.title: Desktop Legends
details.short_description: Desktop Legends is an idle desktop action game featuring fantasy character progression, incremental resource management, and visual customization. Help your hero take their legendary stand against the forces of darkness right on your desktop!

details.title: Immortal Coil
details.short_description: Build powerful decks to confront the Gods in this lane-based, strategy card game. Play the Roguelike Adventure Mode or ascend the Tower of Battle in Gauntlet Mode. Discover wild deckbuilding synergies to unleash spectacular combos against formidable foes.

details.title: SCP: Scavenger Project
details.short_description: Asymmetric co-op horror set in the SCP universe. 1-12 survivors trapped in a collapsing Foundation site, and one of you is infected. They know it, and they're hiding it. Complete objectives, trust no one, and try to escape.

details.title: Crow's Requiem
details.short_description: A narrative-heavy, comic-infused survival visual novel & puzzle game where you are a licensed body collector navigating a dystopian world of moral dilemmas and resource management; where belief, rebellion, or control will prevail through your choices.

details.title: 骤雨终日
details.short_description: "Endless Rain"is a pixel plot game driven by dialogue that incorporates elements of suspense, crime, humor, and more. Players will explore the truth behind a murder case in two different time and space, gradually uncovering the true face of a small town shrouded in the haze of the past.

details.title: Humanity Echo: Cyberpunk Tactical RPG
details.short_description: Humanity Echo is a turn-based tactical RPG set in cyberpunk Odesa, 2044. Lead a squad as an engineer: prepare for every contract, fight from cover, overload transformers, set off explosive barrels, loot better gear, and make choices the people around you will remember.

details.title: Auto Grind: Dungeons
details.short_description: AUTO GRIND: DUNGEONS is a singleplayer auto-attack dungeon crawler that fuses party management with snap decisions. Build your party, synergize skills and masteries, discover unique relics, craft items and adapt your allies' combat tactics in real time as you fight your way through enemy hordes!

details.title: VOIMA
details.short_description: VOIMA is a sandbox where you build freely - no grids, no limits. Draw shapes, place blocks, and defend your creations from monsters. Mod the game in real time - no coding needed. Play it. Then make it yours.

details.title: Ascend and Fall
details.short_description: Ascend and Fall is a dark-fantasy multiplayer autobattler where the order of your spells decides the outcome. Build your spell loadout, fight monsters for loot, and unleash powerful arcane combos against rival players. Sequence your magic right to rise while they fall.

details.title: Codebreakers VR
details.short_description: Codebreakers is a chaotic VR Action Shooter that takes place in a dystopian future where various organizations are fighting for control of the world order.As a breaker, you will have to infiltrate, defeat enemies and avoid security systems to extract data.

details.title: Crop and Claw 2
details.short_description: Crop and Claw 2 is an Adventure-RPG about dragons, plants, memories, and more. Delve into a whole new continent of secrets and unearth the roots of the strange events going on.

details.title: Extinction Force
details.short_description: Battle across time to save humanity from giant arachnids in this multiplayer third-person action shooter.

details.title: Wilds - Night Zookeeper
details.short_description: Let your imagination run Wilds! From the BAFTA nominated team at Night Zookeeper, Wilds is an online adventure bound only by the limits of your creativity. Create characters, bring them to life, and embark on your own adventure in fast paced multiplayer action.

details.title: Reply All
details.short_description: A single player roguelite deckbuilder where emails are turn-based combat and you build a deck of devastating responses that will bring even your most passive-aggressive coworker to their knees.

details.title: Droning On
details.short_description: Write code that looks and feels just like Python to guide Gizmo through hazardous mazes, devious puzzles, and procedurally generated runs that push you, and your code, to the limit. Learn to code, climb the leaderboards, and customize your robo-homie.

details.title: Astro
details.short_description: Astro is a team-based multiplayer FPS that explores the exhilarating feeling of combat in zero gravity. Master a roster of innovative weapons and abilities that make strategy and speed just as deadly as your aim.

details.title: Foederatus
details.short_description: In this kingdom management RPG, you assume your father’s throne in Dalmatia to lead the kingdom, build alliances, fight rivalries and hear the pleas of your people. On the brink of change, you will define the political order. By your decisions, the future of Dalmatia is in your hands.

details.title: BEATVISTA
details.short_description: For little ones and hardcore players alike. BEATVISTA is a rhythm game where every track, with music and video from AI video creators, gets a stage of its own. Play one-button mini-games or hammer through HELL charts on four keys, and rewind any tricky passage to practice.

details.title: Little Cheese Works
details.short_description: [Co-op Action × Voice Chat] Work together to carry cheese without waking the cat! Use voice chat—but be careful, even small sounds can alert it. As overworked mice in a shady company, can you overcome traps and escape to a peaceful life?

details.title: Hell Games
details.short_description: Get ready for Hell Games: In this action packed player vs player arena brawler 4 fallen athletes, once cheaters and dopers, battle it out in the depths of hell. Knock out opponents with sports gear, power up, and strive to be the last one standing.

details.title: Fantastic Haven
details.short_description: Restore the equilibrium of magic by saving endangered fantasy creatures. Build your shelter to welcome and protect them, explore unique regions, rally neighboring populations to your cause and rehabilitate creatures in their natural environment.

details.title: Protocol Non-Human
details.short_description: A realistic first-person horror deduction game. Identify NON-HUMAN entities and navigate critical decisions within the Zone. Earn your survival, upgrade your booth, and-above all-don't let the NON-HUMANS in.

details.title: Dark Queen of Samobor
details.short_description: Experience a thrilling adventure through the dark and atmospheric world of medieval Croatia where an evil queen rules from the shadows and her haunted guardians await you. Venture into a dark fantasy tale wrapped in a cinematic action side-scroller with a unique 2.5D style.

details.title: Belatoris
details.short_description: Lead your legion in an open-world RPG with tactical combat, settlement management, and meaningful choices.

details.title: Danger World
details.short_description: Explore an epic fantasy world alongside three heroes on a quest to recover a stolen jewel. Guide your party to victory in turn-based battles, make decisions that will determine the events of the story, and uncover the ancient secrets of Eldora as you race to catch the mechanical thief.

details.title: D.A.D.S.
details.short_description: Use your special ops units to construct base facilities and towers to protect them from the ever-increasing threat of alien invaders in this Tower Defense game with a city-building element! Research their weaknesses and develop defenses before mankind runs out of time.

details.title: The Disappearance of Emily Crowe
details.short_description: A first-person psychological horror built on stealth and dread. Raise your real phone to reveal what your screen can't — hidden threats, impossible paths, and the truth about a sister who vanished 15 years ago. What took Emily never left, and it remembers you.

details.title: Grav My Balls
details.short_description: Grav your balls and let them fly! You are trapped and must escape with the help of the strange tech built into your hands. Launch your balls to change gravity on objects blocking your path. Use your mind and your new powers to solve gravity and mind bending puzzles.

details.title: Drudgemark
details.short_description: The dark marches on the King's Realm and you stand at its border. Forge steel, build up your keep and command your soldiers in formation. Then draw your own blade and fight beside them in first person, alone or with your friends in co-op.

details.title: The Mirage Project
details.short_description: A first-person sci-fi horror game where you explore an abandoned research facility, travel through different timelines using a broken time machine, and uncover shifting, liminal spaces created by the Mirage. Survive evolving shadow-like entities and uncover the facility’s dark secrets.

details.title: Troop vs Troop
details.short_description: Tactical turn-based combat in WW2. Lead U.S. infantry, tanks, and artillery through procedurally generated battlefields. Use cover and clever tactics to outmaneuver German forces.

details.title: TEKNOKRAT
details.short_description: Enter the city of Nu-Vika as a cyborg repairman in TEKNOKRAT, a thriller romance visual novel. There's a conspiracy brewing beneath this techno-metropolis, and you find yourself an unwilling participant. You will meet three clients, cyborgs with secrets and aspirations of their own.

details.title: WorldWasGray
details.short_description: A relaxing game about painting a gray world back to life.

details.title: Kwad
details.short_description: Kwad is a snappy, grid-based puzzle game where you play as a square. Jump, snap, and merge with other Kwads to morph your way through clever spatial challenges.

details.title: No Gods, Only Ducks
details.short_description: No Gods, Only Ducks is a chaotic mix of boomer shooter, wave survival, and extraction shooter gameplay. Fight through increasingly dangerous waves of corrupted creatures, collect powerful weapons and equipment, and do whatever it takes to survive long enough to escape.

details.title: SPACE WALK
details.short_description: SPACE WALK is a hands-on first-person astronaut simulation where you operate an orbital station and conduct surface expeditions across the Moon.

details.title: Marsbound
details.short_description: MARSBOUND is a survival game in sci-fi setting which combines elements of economic strategy and psychological thriller. The player assumes the role of an AI manager who must create the first Martian colony from scratch with Earth's brightest minds under their command.

details.title: AKEGARASU: Journey to the Underworld
details.short_description: Cut Down Enemies to Keep the Clock Running! Race through deadly trials and reach the end of the Underworld in this ultimate-speed hardcore runner.
publishers: Pujia8 Studio (Mainland China, Hong Kong, Macau, and Taiwan)

details.title: The Gambit Lost to Time
details.short_description: Become a time-travelling goddess entrusted with saving the world in this tactical RPG! With powers capable of altering time and terrain - serve one of three distinct, warring factions, and unite them over many timelines to break free from a time loop of doom.

details.title: Bit by Bit
details.short_description: Build a ridiculous game with your friends in minutes, then jump in and play it together. Draw the weapons & items, record the sound effects, draw the world, modify the rules and see what kind of cursed game your group creates.

details.title: Action & Automation
details.short_description: Action or automation? In this asymmetric, side-scrolling action-RTS, fight on the front line yourself, let your machines do the work, or do both at once. Each of the three species plays by its own rules.

details.title: Valley of Stability
details.short_description: Crash-land on a dying alien world and bring it back to life. Build automated factories, master real chemistry and nuclear physics, and terraform the atmosphere one gas at a time — while sandworms hunt the power signature of everything you build.

name: Ask Mom: Find Objects, Learn Words

details.title: Ask Mom: Find Objects, Learn Words
details.short_description: Learn a language by finding hidden objects 🔎 in a cozy, funny family game where everyone keeps losing things — except super‑mom, who can find anything. Search for items, learn words in context, and enjoy short family scenes. Free demo coming soon — wishlist the game.

details.title: Decommission Protocol
details.short_description: Edith station has been abandoned for a year - an unusually long time to sit derelict. You are a space station engineer sent up to decommission the station in a manual service elevator with the ability to stop between floors. Will you discover the truth or simply follow protocol?

details.title: Gamarra - Street Vendor Simulator
details.short_description: Your family is desperate for money. All you have is a stand in Gamarra, Peru's busiest market. Start small, haggle hard, dodge corrupt police, and survive gang extortion. But every coin you earn is a choice: send it home, or bet it on your business, nothing comes free.

details.title: Pax Astra
details.short_description: A political sim RPG space opera with 4X elements, inspired by Suzerain and Stellaris. Become the first president of a fallen empire, choose any ideology, and expand into the stars. Your decisions shape the nation and the galaxy. Follow any ideology, be the leader you want in Pax Astra!

details.title: Last Draft
details.short_description: Complete your last draft before sunrise while enduring increasing paranormal activities and relentless monster stalks. Use your typing skills to progress and your instincts to hide, surviving 7 days of pure psychological horror.

details.title: Wilderness Strike: Survivor
details.short_description: Players take on the role of a survivor trapped in an endless battlefield. Face massive waves of enemies swarming from all directions, gain experience by defeating foes, level up and select skills to build your unique combat build, then break through the siege and claim victory!

details.title: Tomo Cafe
details.short_description: Tomo Cafe is a Pomodoro Timer and cafe simulator game. Run a study cafe, work through your actual to-do list beside the regulars, decorate the place, and unlock the next chapter of heartwarming stories.

details.title: Train 404
details.short_description: A first-person co-op horror game where you collect coins, find the Golden Ticket, and race back to the train while monsters close in.

details.title: SpellFast
details.short_description: A fast-paced multiplayer word game. Chain letters across a shared board, bank coins, and spend them on abilities that swap, change, or shuffle tiles. Race the clock in Bullet, take your time in Rapid, or host a private lobby with friends. In English and Spanish.

details.title: EREBUS: The Northwest Passage
details.short_description: Lead the doomed 1845 Franklin Expedition through the Arctic in a survival strategy game where every month, order, resource, officer, and event can decide the fate of HMS Erebus and her crew.

details.title: Czar Ry
details.short_description: Physically interactive adventure where you must escape a strange abyssal structure inside a batholith by learning its secrets. Use fully interactive physical hands: reach, grab, drag, hold. No action buttons, no clicks, no hotkeys. Every door, lever, and chain requires your hands to move further.

details.title: COOKBOT
details.short_description: You've been placed as a standard model COOKBOT on the transit ship ZIMA. Cook, bake, pour, freeze, cut and mix food while following recipes. Complete orders from crew members and listen to their stories. But remember - you're not human. The cake is there for company morale.

details.title: True Confession
details.short_description: Henry, a religious young man, witnesses violent shootouts and fragments of his past at night in his dreams. In reality, he’s just an ordinary man, visiting his pastor while struggling with anger and guilt. Fight inside his dreams in this isometric pixel-art shooter to experience his True Confession.

name: Backrooms Dream with Tung Tung Tung Sahur

details.title: Backrooms Dream with Tung Tung Tung Sahur
details.short_description: Backrooms Dream with Tung Tung Tung Sahur is a first-person psychological horror game about a lonely man trapped in a surreal dream loop. Explore strange levels, solve eerie puzzles, survive terrifying chases, and uncover why Sahur keeps appearing in your nightmare.

details.title: DeckDEX - TCG Live Simulator
details.short_description: Buy low, read the room, flip it. DeckDEX is a card-flipping market tycoon: hunt underpriced cards on a live player economy, rip packs, forge duplicates into rarities, complete sets, and build a cardboard empire.

details.title: Unclaimed: Loot or Junk
details.short_description: Unbox. Sort. Collect. Become a master of discovery by exploring unclaimed packages. Complete every set, from vintage gadgets to "Golden Junk". Sell piles of everyday items to buy new shipments and hunt for truly rare treasures. What will you find in the next box?

details.title: Sainthood Relics
details.short_description: Excavate layered blocks to uncover hidden relics. Carefully balance power and precision to clear each surface efficiently in this relaxing, satisfying puzzle experience. Each discovery reveals the true (and sometimes strange) histories of the saints.

details.title: SolTarot
details.short_description: Turn low cards into big scores in SolTarot, a tarot-inspired solitaire roguelike. Combine Tarot powers, modify your cards, and bend the rules to overcome bosses that challenge your strongest combinations.

details.title: Beencremental
details.short_description: Beencremental is a colorful incremental game where you guide the Queen Bee, forage pollen and turn every drop into honey. Upgrade your hive, grow an unstoppable swarm, and conquer four changing seasons as your production climbs from a few bees to a buzzing empire.

details.title: Remain At Your Desk
details.short_description: Incremental hacker about faking productivity while stealing from your employer. Sell intel for credits or keep it and raise suspicion. One bad audit and you’re back to Intern.

details.title: The Great Hebrew Rescue
details.short_description: The Great Hebrew Rescue is a 2D action platformer with puzzle elements, hack and slash your way through ancient forces as Abram the Hebrew. Solve Riddles, answer questions, complete quests, level up! Craft your supplies and master movement as you navigate your way through ancient Canaan.

details.title: Afterschool Brawl Club
details.short_description: After school, clubs clash for supremacy! Afterschool Brawl Club is an AutoBattle card game set in a vibrant academy city. Easy to play, hard to master. Each round choose your allies, decide which cards to keep or cut, and adapt to survive. Step into their stories and claim the top in your own way.

details.title: Her Name Was April
details.short_description: Her Name Was April is a 3D platform game developed by a single developer. It aims to stand out with its story and visuals, while also not being overly difficult.

details.title: Animal Clicking
details.short_description: Animal Clicking is a cute, cozy island builder that blends farming, automation, and resource management with the addictive gameplay loop of clicker games into a completely new sandbox experience.

details.title: MeowRig
details.short_description: MeowRig is a mining-themed incremental game. Follow Me(ow) and search for Meow God's great treasure.

details.title: Mafia Boss Simulator
details.short_description: They shot you on your own driveway. Now dig your way back. MAFIA BOSS SIMULATOR is a cinematic crime saga from 1920s Sicily to 1950s New York — stealth, driving, shootouts, and a story of loyalty, betrayal, and the price of the crown. Welcome to the Family.

details.title: Train Set Code
details.short_description: Aim for a high score by creating complex train set layouts. Program points and signals to direct trains and keep them moving. Run more and more trains… but don’t let them crash!

details.title: Just a Clicker Game
details.short_description: Acquire energy. Build a city. Consume the universe. Just a Clicker Game is a darkly humorous incremental experience where your quest for efficiency might just break reality. Manage simulation instability, unlock the massive Neural Tree, and remember: the Ducky Council is always watching.

details.title: DAIMIENS TOWN OF WITCHES
details.short_description: Open a cursed book and awaken as a witch in a dark 18th-century world. Fight with sword and magic, brew potions, complete rituals, collect cards, transform your body and summon mystical animal companions while uncovering a story that crosses time.

details.title: Destroy The Moon
details.short_description: A cosmic survivors-like where every upgrade brings you closer to becoming a living superweapon. Burn through alien hordes, rupture pocket dimensions, escape black holes, and survive the cosmic war for the Moon.

details.title: Dwarven Shift 98
details.short_description: Dwarven Shift 98 is an incremental mining game in short timed shifts. Break rock walls layer by layer, each richer than the last, and fill the screen with an explosion of ore and gems.

details.title: DANCE DANCE INCREMENTAL
details.short_description: Hit incoming notes to collect bytes. Spend them to upgrade your device, build your army, and download new tracks! Dance Dance Incremental is a rhythm incremental game inside your own Y2K mp3 player.

details.title: SALMON
details.short_description: You are a salmon, performing platforming that feels satisfying and ridiculous. Jump off walls, race against your friends, explore the strange world. Most people don't realise how athletic salmon can be.

details.title: Spasiba!
details.short_description: Build a scrappy deck, chain actions, and outscore your rivals in Spasiba!, a courtyard deck-building card game. Choose your kingdom, find card combinations, and turn a modest starting hand into a winning engine.

details.title: Landers
details.short_description: Pilot a nimble combat ship through hazardous terrain, complete high-speed objectives, destroy ground threats, collect hidden rewards, and master precision flying in a single-player action campaign built around skill, momentum, and replayability.

details.title: Island Wolves
details.short_description: You are a wolf. Hunt prey and gather materials to build your camp, decorate your den and grow your pack. Fight off rival wolves or avoid combat altogether by using the environment to your advantage. Explore the islands and discover the truth behind the lost packs.

details.title: Larva
details.short_description: LARVA is a tactical co-op horror FPS for up to 4 players. Explore environments, collect valuable loot, face deadly anomalies, and extract before it's too late. Coordinate, survive, and don't go alone.

details.title: Order of Beast
details.short_description: A horde-survival roguelite with deep builds, stunning painterly art, and compelling fragmented storytelling. Shape each skill through randomized upgrades with Path of Exile–style build depth. Explore a beautiful, decaying dark fantasy world and uncover the buried past of the Order of Beast.

details.title: Sail On
details.short_description: A stylized pirate roguelite with asynchronous run-based PVP, where you combine projectile properties to create devastating combos and dominate the seas even after your run ends. Die loud, rebuild louder and "Sail On"!

details.title: Coldline: Disconnect
details.short_description: It's not who you are, it's what you do that matters! As an agent inside the enemy base, repair devices by solving puzzles! Plant your bug in the correct device! Listen on the radio at night and transmit critical intel. You are entirely alone in every decision, but your choices will affect everyone.

details.title: Time To Waste
details.short_description: Drive your little trash compacting robot across a ruined world, collect mountains of trash, and upgrade everything — until your one small bot becomes an unstoppable cleaning fleet. An active incremental about quiet, endless purpose.

details.title: Groove Core
details.short_description: Groove Core is a rhythm-based bullet heaven roguelike shooter where you arrange your weapons on a sequencer. Mix and match 200+ items, build your ship, and flood the cosmos with bullet storms as deadly as they are beautiful.

details.title: Earth Atlantis Abyss
details.short_description: A shoot 'em up roguelike where light, space and safety are things you trade away. Descend as Pypher, a lone captain chasing her grandfather's lost legacy into a drowned world. Anyone who seeks answers knows that the deeper you go, the darker it gets...

details.title: Mini Sushi Factory
details.short_description: Manage your very own sushi factory in this cozy automation game. Deliver batches of Bento Boxes during shifts, then upgrade your production lines, receive emails from customers, and get new recipes in the management room.

name: The Prime Minister's Crest: Path to Power

details.title: The Prime Minister's Crest: Path to Power
details.short_description: A political simulation visual novel set in a severe post-bubble economic crisis. As newly elected governor Kazuma Oriki, allocate tight budgets to resolve economic, security, and welfare issues. Navigate complex factional politics and ultimately forge your path to the Prime Minister's seat.

details.title: Ember Folks
details.short_description: The incremental city builder about forcing BIG numbers to go BIGGER! Gather, build, automate and expand your frozen kingdom. Assemble an army of workers and put them to work reigniting a fading star!

details.title: Recoup 'n' Roll: Music Industry Simulator
details.short_description: Build or join a record label across seven distinct music markets, each with its own charts, economy, contracts, royalties, and audience behavior. Sign artists, fund releases, manage debt, survive rivals, and turn local acts into global stars.

details.title: MNOZ - My Nuclear Octopus 2
details.short_description: Everyone's favourite nuclear octopus is back to save the world again in MNOZ, the explosive sequel to the hit game My Nuclear Octopus. MNOZ is a psychedelic retro arcade game for fans of pure out-and-out arcade blasters. Chase those online high scores! And if you have a VR headset, play in VR!

details.title: ai.ai
details.short_description: The CEO of ai.ai has passed away, and his final word was "bubble." Uncover the meaning of his final word in this comedy mystery satirizing Silicon Valley.

details.title: the moon is a gun
details.short_description: A planet-defense roguelite where the moon is your gun. Use the planet’s gravity to bend your shots and defend its cities from waves of enemies. Between nights, build your arsenal with new weapons, upgrades and abilities to take down bosses.

details.title: FOXFIRE
details.short_description: Full Thrust, Full Inertia, Full Auto! FOXFIRE is a top-down sci-fi survivors-like with space physics and a devastating arsenal of evolving weaponry. Customize your ship and tear through alien swarms as routine recon missions descend into bullet hellscapes.

details.title: Color War
details.short_description: A simple, relaxing real-time strategy game. Play as the blue human race, summon troops mid-battle and take the continent from the Red, Yellow and Green nations.

details.title: Welcome Back to Work
details.short_description: Revive and team up with your past selves in a single-player survivors-like. Each rescue adds a full loadout to the fight, with up to 6 weapons per self. Arm a whole line of past selves, discover weapon fusions for stronger builds, and blast through a twisted office.

details.title: Murder at Monty's Mansion
details.short_description: Step into a goofy murder mystery where you play as a detective who cannot speak. Use your notepad to interrogate guests, explore Monty’s mansion, and discover who murdered the butler.

details.title: Fantasy to Kill
details.short_description: PARRY enemy attacks in a Turn-Based RPG with Real-Time Mechanics. You spawn in an end game zone where monsters are powercrept beyond what is possible to win using traditional turn based combat. If you want to survive, you have to be equally as unfair.

details.title: Neutrophils Rush
details.short_description: Neutrophils Rush is an incremental game where you control a group of white blood cells to defend against various infections. Process the DNA collected to evolve your cells and jump back in the fight!

details.title: Pathogen
details.short_description: The Specter has kidnapped the doctors who once experimented on it and ordered them to extract essence from pathogens. You are one of those doctors. To survive the Specter's deadly experiments, you must extract enough essence before it's too late. Will you make it out alive?

details.title: 透明罪 - Blue Tears
details.short_description: A novel, a game, a judgment document, a self-confession letter. On an ordinary summer morning, the arrival of an unexpected visitor awakened the dormant memories of a small island. You will play the role of Lynn Chan, and face your "Invisible Sin" by searching for a "Non-existent friend".

details.title: Divine Sin: Death Duel
details.short_description: A dark fantasy deckbuilding roguelike featuring a unique Clash combat system, where every duel becomes an exchange of calculated moves and deadly counters.

details.title: Explosive Exchange
details.short_description: A fast-paced multiplayer arena party game where up to 8 players create absurd builds, outplay their friends, and turn every match into explosive chaos. Play locally or online.

details.title: Eternal Fall
details.short_description: Eternal Fall is a Medieval Dark Fantasy Horror game. You wake up in a dungeon. Everyone is gone. Have your premonitions finally come true? You must use what you can find around you to survive.

details.title: ZeroEco
details.short_description: A psychological horror narrative game in pixel art about routine, memory, and the fear of change. Explore, interpret, and uncover what lies hidden within yourself.

details.title: DIGSITE ZERO
details.short_description: Destroy meteorites, collect crystals, uncover secrets, and upgrade your tools to dig even deeper beneath the surface of the cosmic rock. In DIGSITE ZERO, a simple mining loop leads to a mystery that’s out of this world.

details.title: DEAD UNIT
details.short_description: A titanic complex. An insignificant man. In this grim horror, you are a prisoner classified as a DEAD UNIT. Explore your prison, bypass security systems, evade escaped Entities, and piece together material traces for a single chance to make it out alive.

details.title: ZENITH
details.short_description: ZENITH is a score-attack puzzler fusing Tetris with roguelike deckbuilding. Assemble a build all your own from 100+ enhancements. The higher you stack, the more your multiplier climbs — and when synergies click, one clear can erupt for tens of thousands of points. Chase an absurdly high score.

details.title: Runic Dungeon
details.short_description: Runic Dungeon is a challenging fantasy rogue-lite bullet-hell dungeon crawler with RPG elements. Level up and assemble arcane runes to craft unique, ultimate builds. Gear up your character and clear dungeons infested with deadly monsters!

details.title: Duelists
details.short_description: A 2D arena brawler for two to four players, on the couch or online, where losing is the fastest way to become dangerous. Between rounds the shop reads the scoreboard and arms whoever is behind. The cat running it is not sorry.

details.title: New Science
details.short_description: Combine illustrated cards in an open-ended world of discovery. Follow Targets through 16 Ages or experiment freely with every card you find. Build your collection, trade with other players and make discoveries nobody has found before.

details.title: Exiled Ark
details.short_description: Fight, build, and survive aboard a ruined interstellar colony ship. Scavenge resources, forge powerful weapons, establish strongholds, and reclaim humanity's last Ark. Master six attribute paths, unlock four technology trees, and shape your own ending through roguelike and relentless combat.

name: One Percent - Game About Taxing Billionaires

details.title: One Percent - Game About Taxing Billionaires
details.short_description: Comrade! Filthy billionaires are buying political influence again! Shoot their flying bribes from the sky in this fast incremental class struggle. Help the common people rise, don’t get corrupted, win the people’s votes, unlock powerful upgrades, and tax the billionaires out of power!

details.title: Pilgrimage of the Fallen
details.short_description: Pilgrimage of the Fallen is a 3D top-down Zelda-like ARPG focused on non-linear exploration. Navigate intricate labyrinths, gather hidden loot for alchemy, and slay ancient tyrants in unforgiving blade combat.

details.title: ClickCrafter
details.short_description: A dark cozy incremental crafting game about reclaiming yourself while marooned on a mysterious island. Click, craft, collect, construct and restore your way back to humanity while uncovering the island’s secret history. But beware — is the island guiding you home, or does it have other plans?

details.title: Orbsorber
details.short_description: Orbsorber is a single-player, action-adventure RPG focused around collecting Orbs. You play as a cosmic ball of energy exploring uniquely themed zones, smashing obstacles, defeating bosses, and gaining new abilities. Absorb Orbs to upgrade your powers and awaken your true potential.

details.title: Hwaseo
details.short_description: A Korean folk dark fantasy deck-building roguelike. Three souls. One bound fate. Three companions are bound to one shared deck — every draw is a party question, not a single hero's. Journey through layered shrines drawn from Korean folklore.

details.title: Rock From Home
details.short_description: Type emails in the 90s to buy tiny hats for your pet rock! Handle strange workplace situations, and choose how you respond. Spend your hard-earned money on silly stuff like your weekly bills, and things that truly matter: ridiculous accessories for your rock.

details.title: Rush Tower
details.short_description: Rush Tower is a Tower Defense game where new paths are procedurally added over the course of the game. Can you keep up as the enemy builds more paths in this ever more hectic war?

details.title: Alchemist
details.short_description: A magic-focused action battle* RPG where research and alchemy shape your path through combat encounters, puzzles, and challenges across diverse locations.

details.title: Sekigahara
details.short_description: The fate of Japan is in your hands! Sekigahara is a digital adaptation of the acclaimed two-player strategy board game set in 1600, during the epic campaign that unified Japan. Command hidden armies, manage loyalties, and outmaneuver your rival!

details.title: Be Positive!
details.short_description: Move Mr Positve around the arena by converting the cubes around him to reach his goal, Ms. Negative. Play on desktop or in VR.

details.title: Your Maid
details.short_description: A desktop companion simulation featuring a charming 3D character living on your screen. Drag, rotate, and pose your companion. Collect poses across rarity tiers, unlock costumes, play 7 mini-games, and set alarms while your fantasy friend keeps you company throughout your workday.

details.title: Stellar Frontline
details.short_description: A unique tower defense game where you build and upgrade defenses by placing hex tiles. Protect your rocket from hostile spaceships to unlock new tiles after each defeated wave.

details.title: Slay the Slime
details.short_description: An incremental game where you slay thousands of slimes in an epic power fantasy. Stack upgrades, master unique classes, equip powerful relics and defeat mighty bosses on your way from rookie to the guild's top adventurer.

details.title: Gee, Tea, Eh, Seven?
details.short_description: In a single night, your family's boba tea empire AND family were taken out by rivals. Take revenge as Seven, the tragic sole survivor. Build up your power base by brewing the best drinks and retaking the town... or, you know, by *fixing* the competition through sabotage, subterfuge and violence.

details.title: STAY ON AIR
details.short_description: Keep talking. Keep broadcasting. Know when to shut up. A 2–4 player co-op horror game where your microphone keeps you alive: the Listener hunts silence, the station must stay on air until 6 AM — and when it's close, it hears you.

details.title: Pixel Xanxia
details.short_description: A pixel art cultivation RPG inspired by Idle Xanxia. Hunt spirit beasts, master techniques, rebuild your shattered Dantian, and uncover the mystery behind the attack that destroyed your cultivation.

details.title: The Bakery
details.short_description: Create your own bakery on your own or with up to 3 of your friends. Unlock new recepies, kitchen furniture, Decoration and more. Keep your bakery running as long as you can, the more reputation your bakery gains the more popular it becomes, will you be able to handle the demand?

details.title: Floor 13: Onryo
details.short_description: You are trapped in a hotel with an Onryo. You must keep an eye out for anomalies she uses to delude you to find a way to escape.

details.title: Rehang: A Museum Sorting Game
details.short_description: Rehang is a cozy first-person organizing game. The museum owns 1,279 real paintings, and every one of them is on the floor: work out who painted each canvas by its brushwork, hang it on that painter's wall, and unlock abilities that speed up the search.

details.title: Escape From Argos 7
details.short_description: A retro computer incremental game about escaping a hostile alien planet. Explore an old desktop, gather resources, install programs, unlock upgrades, automate your progress, and find a way off Argos 7.

details.title: Greediest Landlord
details.short_description: Become a Dark Landlord in this Incremental game to purge human settlements in your domain. Convert trespassers into fuel for your dark arts. Cast plagues, drain souls, raise legions of minions, and expand your corrupted land to unleash chaos. Invoke the Dark God to reclaim your solitude once more

details.title: Keylings
details.short_description: You start with one key. You end up with an entire keyboard covered in keylings hopping across it. Buy keys, hire critters, unleash storms and watch the numbers climb to absurd heights in this laid-back incremental with mechanical keyboard sounds.

details.title: Inbox Duel
details.short_description: You're the new intern, and the only weapon you have is email. Duel your coworkers with passive-aggressive cards until they get fired, then come for your boss's job. Inbox Duel is a roguelike deckbuilder about climbing the office one promotion at a time.

details.title: Bloomery
details.short_description: A first-person horde survival game where every fight helps revive an underground city. Wield powerful fantasy weapons and spells, protect a growing plant, build defenses, and turn a dangerous ruin into a living city.

details.title: Idle Digger Bots Deluxe
details.short_description: A sci-fi idle and automation game where you manage mining bots to dig deep and sell resources.

details.title: Flat Earth Runner
details.short_description: Endless runner. Sentient Yowie. Antarctic ice wall. The New World Order really does not want you finishing the lap. A PS1-style comedy about the dumbest possible way to prove the earth is flat.

details.title: GraveFeast
details.short_description: The curse drains your life with every passing second. The only cure is blood. Charge into the horde, gather them, and tear them apart to drink deep. In GraveFeast, low health isn't a reason to run. It's a reason to go deeper.

details.title: Your Usual
details.short_description: A small bar, one bartender, and a conversation that picks up where you left it. Mara runs the place, pours what you ask for, and remembers you between visits — all of it running on your own machine. No account, no cloud, no one else listening in.

details.title: Desmarchon
details.short_description: Drag a chain through drifting Anomalies and let go to burst them. Build around longer chains, drones, or automatic weapons in this sci-fi survivor-like. Fly 16 Campaign operations, then take your ship into 30 Deep Space destinations, including endless Shardwake.

details.title: Robots To Scrap
details.short_description: Design the paths your enemies take in this loot-focused tower defense game. Your paths and defenses stay in place between waves. Pull enemies in, push them back, and concentrate your firepower. Combine upgrades, gear, and specializations to keep building your defenses.

details.title: K17 ARACHNE
details.short_description: You came to K17 looking for answers. Now you need to escape. Explore an abandoned military facility, uncover the truth behind Project ARACHNE, and hide from the creatures lurking in its corridors in this atmospheric first-person survival horror game.

details.title: Honey or Else
details.short_description: Honey or Else is an incremental game about bees forced to make honey for their bear captors - while secretly plotting to free their Queen. Plant flowers, hire bees and upgrade the hive. Sweet, sticky, cute and quietly rebellious.

details.title: Symloquy
details.short_description: Meet Xuanxuan in Symloquy, a sound novel with AI dialogue. The Fading slowly erodes her memories and sense of self, while your conversations bring an Echo that helps her stay lucid. As you grow closer, discover her past and perhaps hear what she usually keeps to herself.

details.title: Take That Shot
details.short_description: You're a basketball. Roll, charge-jump and dash up a tower of floating junk, squash your friends on the way, and try to sink a shot at the top. Up to 8 players with voice chat.

details.title: Magic Crystal TD
details.short_description: Magic Crystal TD mixes tower defense with resource management. Build roads to resource points, send familiars to haul red, yellow, blue crystals, refine advanced ones, and swap them on Magic Crystal Bases for varied defenses. Face shifting nature, wield Blessings, destroy nests to win!

details.title: Tinker's Nook
details.short_description: Own and run a workshop in a steampunk fantasy world! Craft, fix and sell items to make a living while meeting countless townsfolk and listen to their stories.

details.title: Wink Mafia
details.short_description: Pet the cat, bluff your friends, and pray your drink isn't poisoned. Wink Mafia is a chaotic 3D social deduction party tournament. Kill with a lethal wink, execute rivals with the golden gun, or brawl in the streets—where innocent card games turn into deadly mob chaos. Play with friends or smart AI!

details.title: FLATBED
details.short_description: Seven years ago the Void opened over the Rim and the gates appeared. You are a pilot with a debt, a worn-out ship and a signal that repeats every 402 seconds using your hull number. Fly, trade, fight, rebuild your ship piece by piece and decide who gets left behind. A single-player space action RPG.

details.title: Slime on Top
details.short_description: An epic auto-battling RPG unveils right in the corner of your desktop! Watch your slime push through endless floors and crush giant bosses, or team up for thrilling 4-player co-op! Combine deep star charts, class trees, and loyal buddies to craft your ultimate build.

details.title: Splitter
details.short_description: Shoot or slice through swarms of shapes, bank the pieces and build a stronger weapon. A pixel arcade incremental: short charge-limited runs, one connected upgrade board, and a Boss fight at the end of every chapter.

details.title: Mono Tape
details.short_description: REMEMBER! You can't escape the guilt, can you? You must remember and face the truth. Are you the one to blame? There is one way to untangle your mind: collect lost tapes, repair corrupted recordings, and watch your past. But be careful who you trust. Even yourself.

details.title: The Duke of Werlington
details.short_description: A mysterious noble invites you to his estate. You have little reason to trust him, but the promise of wealth is impossible to refuse. As a traveling merchant, explore this PSX-inspired interactive fiction set in an 18th-century gothic fantasy.

details.title: Miner Issue
details.short_description: Miner issue is a short active 3D first person incremental where you mine asteroid with your feet because your Boss told you to.

details.title: Murim Sect Leader
details.short_description: Lead a struggling martial sect in a Murim roguelike. Recruit and train disciples, assign them to missions and sect buildings, equip them with crafted gear, discover martial manuals, develop mastery, and guide your sect through dangerous events, rival factions, and turn-based auto-battles.

details.title: Melonpan Survivors
details.short_description: Fight slime hordes and heal with melon bread in this roguelite survival action game. Combine weapons, magic, and cards with auto-attacks and unique character skills to survive. Choose from 20 characters and brave stage hazards, from encroaching lava to slippery ice!

details.title: Nectarbound
details.short_description: A short, active incremental game about a bee with a vacuum. Collect nectar, turn it into coins, and buy upgrades. Hire ladybugs to plant flowers and worker bees to carry your haul. Day brings flowers. Night brings trouble.

name: Ramen Shop in the Floating Slums

details.title: Ramen Shop in the Floating Slums
details.short_description: Start penniless in a floating slum. Scavenge for supplies, choose from dozens of ingredients to create your own ramen, and grow your shop in this first-person ramen shop and life sim. Earn money and build your reputation, go fishing, and explore a city created just for this game.

details.title: Siege of Spellspire
details.short_description: A short incremental siege game about a mage defending his tower from hordes of enemies. Cast spells, perish, upgrade, and come back stronger to face tougher waves and fearsome bosses.

details.title: Only Winks!
details.short_description: Deal with the problems of being too pretty. First people... then robots... then aliens and gods! You might get stalked by cultists or straight-up kidnapped — no promises! Whatever happens, keep winking. A pixel-art incremental game.

details.title: Rise of the Pirates
details.short_description: A free to play 2D pirate MMORPG. Sail a living archipelago, master your class, hunt bounties, raise a crew, and carve your name into the sea. Old school pixel soul, modern online heart.

details.title: Open Boat: Charter Fishing Simulator
details.short_description: You're the captain now. Take paying customers out on simulated real-world waters, find the bite with real fishing knowledge, cast a few yourself if you want, and turn the small skiff into the best charter boat on the dock. Fill the bucket, rain or shine.

details.title: CROST : Crown, Coin & Steel
details.short_description: 권력은 왕관에, 살림은 금화에, 힘은 강철에 있다. 왕관 없는 왕국 아르덴의 지휘관이 되어 부대를 이끌고 곳간을 채워라. 마법 없는 사실적인 후기 중세 전쟁 전략 게임.

details.title: DeepSteep
details.short_description: DeepSteep is a fast-paced action arcade shooter set in the Void, in which world yet not exist, break Chaos and bring back Order.

details.title: One More Candle
details.short_description: A cozy candle shop simulator where you take customer orders, melt and mix wax with colors and herbs, pour candles into unique molds, decorate each creation, and grow your little business one warm glow at a time.

details.title: Undertow
details.short_description: Scavenge the island for anything that floats, build a raft with your team, and battle other players in casual online PvP to be the last raft floating.

details.title: Orbital  Sweeper
details.short_description: Become an Orbital Sweeper: explore the orbit, clear the debris, return to run your factory and upgrade your ship, challenge each layer's boss, then play a round of Space Mahjong in your downtime.

details.title: Minds & Myths
details.short_description: Human-authored adventures, made interactive by AI. A story map keeps the plot on track while every character thinks for itself. Bring your own AI key: buy once, no subscription, your stories stay on your PC.

details.title: Knights Of Four Kingdoms
details.short_description: Defend a besieged kingdom in a real-time tactical strategy game. Build walls, towers and traps, command heroes and specialized troops, manage scarce resources, and adapt your defenses against raiders, monsters and siege engines across handcrafted battlefields.

details.title: Bonaparte 1789 AD
details.short_description: The game of power, intrigue and freedom. Europe, 1789: lead France, Prussia, Austria, Russia or Great Britain through revolution and war. Rule month by month, keep your estates and rival courts in check, forge alliances and fight hex battles – all the way to an imperial crown or your downfall.

details.title: Feste Feiern: German Festival Tycoon
details.short_description: Funfair, Christmas market, festival of lights, Halloween, wine festival, flea market and more: run the festivals of a German town – each with its own stalls, visitors, season and way of making money. Steer the crowds and turn an empty meadow into the best festival in town.

details.title: Brek
details.short_description: Take on the role of a homeless person without a penny to his name, your main goal is to buy your dream apartment. However, you have no intention of tainting yourself with a regular job, so you rely on whatever comes your way, regardless of whether the owner gives permission.

details.title: Million Gems: Sorting Wizard
details.short_description: A cozy magic game about a wizard trapped in a magical castle. The only way out? Sort one million gems.

details.title: No Light at Sea
details.short_description: Turn an abandoned lighthouse into your last refuge. Salvage, fish and craft alone or in online co-op for up to 4 players. Brave the storms, rebuild floor by floor and uncover what lurks behind the legends of Brittany. Bring back the light. Before you lose your bearings.

details.title: Crown Me Again
details.short_description: Defend against waves of adventurers, collect tons of loot, create powerful builds and climb your way back to the top of the ladder as the fallen Skull King. Incremental Clicker meets Loot-Driven Action RPG.

details.title: Tabletop Tycoon
details.short_description: In Tabletop Tycoon you start your own board game company from a single desk and grow it into the biggest name in the industry. Design games that sell, design your own box and make every piece fit inside. Research new genres and mechanics. Build and decorate your office as you outgrow your rivals.

details.title: God Codex
details.short_description: A cinematic 2D pixel-art action adventure. Slay the Demon King, then awaken within her memories as two girls struggle against fate in a collapsing world. Heavy combat, environmental storytelling, and immersive cinematic presentation with almost no UI.

details.title: Dungeon Trader
details.short_description: Become a Dungeon Trader and climb from Beginner to Legendary Trader! Buy, Sell, Negotiate risky deals, Play unique Mini-Games, Unlock strange visitors, customize your appearance, and uncover hidden secrets lurking beneath the Dungeon.

details.title: Auspicious Clouds
details.short_description: A unique turn-based game featuring Auspicious Cloud Cards. Wield the power of the Five Elements to unleash skills and vanquish foes. Unlock a vast roster of character skills, collect Cultivation Orbs, and devise your own one-of-a-kind tactics to conquer every opponent.

details.title: Dungeon Potato
details.short_description: Dungeon Potato is a fast-paced, top-down action roguelike where your loadout shapes the story. Survive unpredictable encounters, forge unique builds, and battle through a perilous labyrinth. Will you rise as a servant of the Potato God or rebel against it?

details.title: Friendgeist
details.short_description: An online co-op horror comedy for up to 5 players. You wake up trapped in a house haunted by the Friendgeist, a spirit that takes the shape of a friend to deceive and possess you. Find the way out. If one of you gets possessed, exorcise them before it's too late. Or escape, if they let you.

details.title: I can offer you Flowers
details.short_description: ‘To propose to my boyfriend... what flowers would you recommend?’ Arrange bouquets in this cozy puzzly game! Discover flowers, meet new people, and become the Atrium Botanique community center florist!

details.title: Pearls of Wisdom
details.short_description: A relaxing card game with real-world side quests. Match inspiring and reflective quotes, combine special effect emblems, do out of game side quests and build your deck to get high scores. Reflect, relax, and walk away feeling good after you've finished playing.

details.title: Picasho
details.short_description: Become a rich and famous artist with your friends by painting wild creations, completing commissions, and exhibiting your art. Unlock all kinds of unusual tools, turn everyday objects into art, expand your gallery, and rise to riches in 1–4 player co-op!

details.title: Timberflow: Sawmill Simulator
details.short_description: From a single tree to an entire industry! Manage and automate your lumber business in this relaxing, yet challenging Sawmill Simulator. Start small, grow rich, dominate the market.

details.title: Infant God
details.short_description: You are the guardian of an infant god. Guide Aistalt through the toxic ruins of the internet. Debate with random users, harvest their ideologies, and sculpt her personality matrix. Will you raise a benevolent savior or a tyrant who deletes humanity?

details.title: Lone Tower
details.short_description: Defend one tower. Face endless waves. Build synergies, unlock permanent upgrades, and survive the chaos.

details.title: Pinball Realm
details.short_description: A pinball Roguelite where the board is yours to build. Fortify your defenses, stack outrageous synergies, and unleash game-breaking combos as you save the kingdom from endless waves of monsters!

details.title: Terrafactory: Idle Planet
details.short_description: The idle planet creation game that sits anywhere on your desktop. Watch the birth of a planet, upgrade the Catalyst, discover new biomes, and shape your own solar system while you work or relax.

details.title: Son Of A Dealer
details.short_description: Turn forgotten treasures into a thriving business in this narrative-driven second-hand shop simulator. Haggle for the best prices, uncover the stories behind every item, and build deep relationships with the townsfolk. Your choices shape not just your shop, but your life.

details.title: Curse of Cards
details.short_description: Battle through a shifting cosmic library in this roguelike card-crawler. Combine satisfying card strategy with first-person exploration. Unleash ancient creatures of British folklore, gather relics, collect powerful cards, and fight to shape your own story escaping the cursed library’s grasp.

details.title: Biryado
details.short_description: Biryado is a billiards roguelike deckbuilder where rules are made to be broken. Collect Billy’s bizarre artefacts, customize your balls with wild abilities and combine their effects into absurd combos. Master shifting tables, overcome eccentric bosses, and send your score into another dimension!

details.title: Void Nebula
details.short_description: Create, customize and fuse every card in this sci-fi roguelite deckbuilder where you battle foes, stack absurd items, and drag your handmade deck to the heart of the Nebula.

details.title: Midnight Manhunt
details.short_description: Hunt down a hidden target through a cyberpunk city in this turn-based game of cat and mouse. Coordinate four Grid Runners to eliminate his escape routes one by one, deduce his position and close the net before he completes his mission. Or become the Ghost, laying false trails to survive the night.

details.title: Tiny Desk Pot
details.short_description: Grow and nourish your own vegetables in a tiny desk pot! Let your leafy companion grow idle in a corner of your desktop while you do your things. Discover new soils, unlock new types of vegetables, and customize your pot with cute stickers. Relaxing music included!

details.title: Quack Ball!
details.short_description: Defend your goal as a rubber ducky in chaotic 4-player 3D pong! Battle friends in local multiplayer across wacky arenas. Lose a round? Draw a power-up card. Stack synergizing cards into wild builds and quack your way back to victory.

details.title: Fatemender
details.short_description: A Tarot puzzle adventure where you collect cards, cast spells, and place paths to reshape an ever-shifting Labyrinth. Outsmart the Fates, collect powerful Artifacts, and attempt the impossible—escape Purgatory.

details.title: Miscreant
details.short_description: You're a rogue-in-training trying to break into a legendary vault under your school. Explore the danger-filled academy after curfew to find 100 keys hidden behind puzzles and traps, and even trapped puzzles.

details.title: Mannequin: Echoes of Their Minds
details.short_description: Work the night shift at a clothing store, dressing mannequins according to instructions. Your job lasts 30 days. With every mistake, the store grows stranger. Unexplained anomalies keep appearing. Can you make it through all 30 days? A job simulator horror game where quiet work meets creeping dread.

details.title: MODULE:BERSERK (모듈 버서크)
details.short_description: MODULE:BERSERK is a 2D pixel "hard-boiled" action game with steampunk-inspired world of endless desertification and corruption. Play as a butler-styled automaton. Track down the suspect that caused terrifying event to the family you serve. And protect the only survivor, 'lady' from upcoming dangers.

details.title: Neighborhood Video
details.short_description: Crack the case of the missing video store employee in this 3D point and click mystery game by solving escape room puzzles, combing the computer database, and scouring shelves as an undercover detective posing as a cashier during your first weekend at the suspiciously understaffed Neighborhood Video.

details.title: True Nightmare - Diner Loop
details.short_description: You're a rookie FBI agent trapped in an endless loop inside a roadside diner. Spot anomalies, follow the rules, and survive the entity hunting you. Every mistake brings it closer, and every loop reveals something more terrifying. A psychological horror with a haunting VHS aesthetic.

details.title: Only Booze: Liquor Store Simulator
details.short_description: When an alcoholic opens a liquor store… what could go wrong? Run, manage, and grow your own liquor empire in a dynamic market where prices change daily, trends shift overnight, and your reputation lives or dies on social media. This isn’t just another shop simulator. Welcome to OnlyBooze.

details.title: Fragments
details.short_description: Your mind is shattered. Step into a first-person psychological horror where you must relive your deepest trauma, uncover fragments of your past, piece them back together and face the tormentors that haunt your mind.

details.title: Anomaly Hours: Forest Cabin
details.short_description: Anomaly Hour: Forest Cabin is a tense observation horror game where you monitor rooms through security cameras to spot strange and shifting anomalies. Each replay reveals new, unpredictable events as you uncover the haunting mystery behind the Kinley family’s forest cabin.

details.title: Crime Scene Clean: Paranormal
details.short_description: Crime Scene Clean is about Sector 7 hides the supernatural from the world. You’re their cleaner—erasing cursed symbols, demonic traces, and forbidden rituals. No fame, no questions. Just silence, speed and survival. Clean haunted scenes, contain threats, and bury the truth before it spreads.

details.title: EpiDexa Racing
details.short_description: EpiDexa Racing is an arcade racing game focused on time trials and online multiplayer. Play with keyboard or controller, climb the leaderboards, and prove your skills against friends or players from around the world.

details.title: You are fired
details.short_description: A fast and chaotic roguelike deckbuilder set in the absurd Hell’s Office. Build a powerful deck, collect twisted artifacts, and outplay your demonic coworkers as you claw your way up the corporate ladder. Face bizarre encounters, slay vicious foes, and crush your boss to earn your freedom.

details.title: Drowned in the Light：Gloom
details.short_description: Drowned in the Light: Gloom is a high-difficulty, real-time turn-based, story-driven character development game. Players will explore the unknown world.

details.title: Teddy Won't Help
details.short_description: One night, your plushies whisper a warning: Three monsters from under the bed will come for you before dawn. The only way to survive is to play their games… and win. Fail, and you won’t live to see the morning.

details.title: Necromancer's Workshop
details.short_description: Necromancer’s Workshop is a fantasy tycoon game. Craft zombies, work the land. Build a cozy countryside business, worth waking the dead for.

details.title: Luminids
details.short_description: A cozy colony-building adventure with two ways to play: experience the story campaign or create your own colony. Shape the land, build homes and grow food for little creatures with lives of their own. Plan from above, then switch to first person to explore your settlement and the world beyond.

details.title: HABAP
details.short_description: A cozy reseller sim where you haggle with grannies, buy mystery bags, and turn flea-market junk into profit. Grow your little shop, hunt rare finds, and buy a plane to escape a country where reselling for profit is a crime.

details.title: Little Devil
details.short_description: Little Devil is a top-down horror-comedy roguelike. Combine primary and secondary weapons, fuel a soul-powered ability, and stack Boons as you go. Survive permadeath, beat three random Deadly Sins, and face Lucifer at the end of every run.

details.title: Metamorph Clicker
details.short_description: An evolution clicker where you guide a larva from simple forms to incredible creatures. Click, collect resources, unlock upgrades and progress through stages. At the end of each stage, a spectacular metamorphosis awaits - a complete transformation into a new species!

details.title: The Bed Above My Head
details.short_description: You’re playing a game in the dark. Something in your room is not. In this Sit & Survive type psychological horror game, you're a child playing on your console, while something roams your room. Observe your surroundings, listen carefully and manage your stress to survive this nightmarish night.

details.title: Fig and Totems™
details.short_description: Capture-the-flag meets hide-and-seek in this online party game (2-4 players). In 2min30, everyone hides a totem then hunts everyone else's. Listen closely to find them, or ambush and steal from your friends before they score. Win by throwing the most totems in the box, the fastest! Bonus if unfound.

details.title: 园区物语
details.short_description: You play as a tourist trapped in a scam compound. fight to survive, sneak around and seize escape chances. Gather hidden clues, master scam skills reluctantly to survive, meet captives stuck here for various reasons, dig out its dark secrets, and choose between escaping the den or ruling it.

details.title: AGX GP
details.short_description: AGX is a heart thumpingly fast, Anti-Gravity racing game. It's lightning‑fast action and Xtreme ability‑based gameplay, will push your reactions and skills to the limit! Welcome To AGX!

details.title: Maledictum
