details.short_description: In Maledictum (1–4 co-op), you’re not a ghost hunter you’re an Investigator of Guilt. Identify the entity, uncover the victim/culprit/cause, and decide a final ritual to free or condemn a spirit that reacts to your voice.

details.title: Scrapfall
details.short_description: Classic falling-block gameplay pushed to the edge in a fast-paced action roguelite of escalating gravity, unstable physics, and cascading systems.

details.title: Economic Biathlon
details.short_description: Test your wits in an arcade quiz. React quickly and overcome tricky challenges. You can set new records and compete in Economic Biathlon.

details.title: Hollow Faces
details.short_description: Hollow Faces is an atmospheric narrative horror where you step into the role of creators documenting paranormal phenomena. The game blends an intense walking simulator with environmental observation, careful listening, and reacting to threats.

details.title: Voxel Throne
details.short_description: Voxel Throne is a voxel-based action adventure RPG. Explore a beautiful world, alone or with friends! Help townsfolk, defeat enemies, loot powerful items and create your ultimate build!

details.title: Buildmaxxing
details.short_description: Build together on floating islands in this 1-4 player co-op building game. Each player has a unique role. Memorize blueprints, communicate with your team, and build from memory before time runs out!

details.title: Trickstir
details.short_description: Solve puzzles by rotating the environment to drop ingredients in your cauldron. Discover blocks and ingredients with special twists across six different worlds. Collect the ingredients to help the witch create the ultimate potion!

details.title: Arborist
details.short_description: Build a garden, survive the forecast, and follow a trail of birds through wild habitats in this cozy roguelike card game. Discover new cards, tools, and enchantments as you shape unique builds that keep every run feeling fresh.

details.title: Relic Spire: The Barrel Reborn
details.short_description: “Relic Spire: The Barrel Reborn” is a Tower of the Sorcerer-like strategy game.You start out as just a barrel,explore a monster-infested magic tower.Collect relics,assemble the body.Choose the best route,and conquer the magic tower!No manual input during battles — strategy is everything!

details.title: Castlefolk
details.short_description: Build a medieval kingdom from a small settlement, gather resources, recruit an army, battle dangerous creatures, and expand your realm across a charming pixel-art world.

details.title: Prison Chef Simulator
details.short_description: Step behind the counter of a high-security prison cafeteria. Prepare daily meals, manage scarce ingredients, and survive volatile inmates who throw trays at your face. Keep the dining hall from rioting and guard your cutlery, or your shift might be your last in this tense kitchen sim.

details.title: Strikemania
details.short_description: You are the missile. Launch. Strike. Repeat. Kamikaze your way through defenses, master each route, and use previous missiles to help clear the path in this fast-paced retro arcade time-attack game.

details.title: Boomfish
details.short_description: Captain, open fire! Blast swarms of monster fish! Combine special ammo, secondary weapons and crew support. Boost your firepower with salvage upgrades and return with a hold full of loot. Unlock 50+ armaments, recruit and train 100+ crew, earn deep-sea blessings and brave deadlier waters!

details.title: Just One More Season
details.short_description: A roguelike esports management sim: take charge of a team and climb from Iron league to Diamond. Recruit and train players, manage finances and fans across seasons that play out differently every run. Lost the final? Just one more season.

details.title: Blueshift Breakdown
details.short_description: Bring destructibility to the extreme in this Asteroids-inspired shoot 'em up. Travel the galaxy and encounter a wide variety of fully destructible asteroids and enemies. Upgrade your ship and annihilate everything in your path, pixel by pixel.

details.title: Break the Planet
details.short_description: A satisfying, meditative incremental game about shooting balls to destroy planets. Find the white voxel hidden in each world, unlock more balls, and uncover the secrets to destroy a 10-billion-voxel planet.

details.title: NOEMA
details.short_description: Take your place at the terminal. Follow the procedures, process the records, and read messages never meant for you. NOEMA is a quiet, unsettling narrative experience about work, obedience, human connection, and what routine teaches us not to see.

details.title: Gideon Unleashed
details.short_description: The last wizard. The world's greatest mistake. Every hunter in the kingdom wants him dead, and all he wants is to get home. Walk the road through four lands, build a ring of spells that feed each other, then hold Ravenhold against an army that never stops coming.

details.title: Shunt
details.short_description: The Devil has scattered Rex's bones all over his house. One press slides Rex, the clay dog, until he hits something, and shoves everything in his path. Line the bones up in a row or column to win them back. 338 hand-built puzzles, 16 worlds, no timer, level editor.

details.title: Warbuddies
details.short_description: WarBuddies blends team building, skirmish wargaming, and card-based combat. Lead your friendly buddies creatures in a hex-based battlefield, capture objectives, and outwit your rival in tactical clashes.

details.title: Gamblemon
details.short_description: Gamblemon is a roguelike deckbuilder built around a slot machine. Place your Gamblemon and items in the lanes, spin the machine, and trigger synergies by matching elements across the lanes. Buy items, evolve your Gamblemon, and reach the target score before you run out of spins.

details.title: Forsythia
details.short_description: 1592, the Imjin War. Lead Yi Sun-sin, Gwon Yul, and other real commanders through seven years of war between Joseon, Ming, and Japan. Fight real-time encounter battles, command a fleet of panokseon warships, and craft your own equipment. A single-player campaign drawn from the historical record.

details.title: Go & Bust
details.short_description: Go-Stop, the classic Korean card game, meets poker and roguelike deckbuilding. Match cards, push your luck with GO or cash out with STOP, rig the table with 28 shady items, and bankrupt three ghost dealers, from a back-alley den to a luxury casino cruise.

details.title: NULL.REF EXODUS
details.short_description: A frenetic 1-4 player co-op roguelite TPS. Inside the ship carrying humanity's last backup, create your own weapon, scale it to absurd levels, and defend every sector from relentless swarms and colossal bosses.

details.title: Chartward
details.short_description: Rise from the slums to your own ship in an open-world pirate RPG distilled into incremental play. Sail uncharted seas, board vessels and plunder their riches. Choose your quests, dive for treasure and earn permanent keepsake upgrades across repeated lives.

details.title: Tollmire
details.short_description: A dice roguelike in the bog. The witch demands eight tolls, each steeper than the last — you pay in rolls: points times mult. Between tolls you forge special faces onto your dice and gather talismans.

details.title: Massively Singleplayer
details.short_description: A predatorily monetized MMO turned singleplayer action roguelite. Choose your class and face six biomes filled with hordes of monsters. You have 20 minutes before the servers shut down, survive the onslaught or get banned. Gamble your way to glory and pay some guy in a bush to bless you.

details.title: Abduct & Destroy
details.short_description: Pilot a UFO in a chaotic VR arcade game. Abduct humans, blast buildings apart, and take on ridiculous missions with your ship’s destruction and abduction cannons. Earth is having a very bad day.

details.title: Knitwork
details.short_description: A cozy casual puzzle woven with endless fun. Every button is held by its threads: label each one with how tightly it's knit into the network. Pull the loose threads first, work inward, and find the tight-knit core.

details.title: The Stable
details.short_description: The Stable is a sports management sim set in the world of professional boxing. Start up a gym, hire and train professional fighters across 6 different weight divisions, and watch them fight as you work towards the coveted title of world champion.

details.title: Just to Survive
details.short_description: A wasteland tactics game: explore a weathered desert, salvage what remains, and build a squad for precise, turn-based firefights.

details.title: NightGlow : Aquarium Shop Simulator
details.short_description: Light up a quiet, dimly lit shop with the glow of your aquariums. Raise and breed fish, discover new varieties, and build your own aquarium shop. Manage your tanks, sell fish, fulfill customer requests, decorate your space, and slowly grow your little shop in this cozy aquarium management sim.

details.title: Calorie Pinball
details.short_description: When can you lose weight with just a flick of a finger? Right now! Calorie Pinball turns your weight-loss plan into a pinball game. Will you bounce into a workout, a bizarre event, or that 2,000-calorie slice of cake? It all comes down to skill and luck!

details.title: Slavlands: Tribes at War
details.short_description: Build a Slavic stronghold from a few huts, feed your people and lead your warband across a great map of the early medieval Slavic lands. A 90s-style real-time strategy with a deep simulation, where wars are won with granaries, supply trains, weather and faith long before the first blow.

details.title: Skate N Chill
details.short_description: Build your own skatepark, find your line, and take it easy. Skate N Chill is a relaxed single-player skateboarding sandbox: shape bowls and rails, customize your crew, learn new tricks, or kick back and watch the park come to life.

details.title: Gridways
details.short_description: Traffic is your problem now. Draw roads, paint arrows, time the lights and stack overpasses so every vehicle reaches the right hub. Congestion costs you points - gridlock ends the round. Over 100 handmade puzzles, three difficulties, a level editor and Workshop support.

details.title: Dream Island Simulator
details.short_description: A desert-island survival sim played live by AI: every survivor is a large language model — they chat, dream, hold grudges, and get on with life while you're away. Start from firewood and thatch, and rebuild the knowledge the end of the world turned back into legend.

details.title: LUMENKEEP
details.short_description: A dark hex board. Shadow-crystal creatures march on your last lantern. Build no towers, build light. Aim emitters, bend beams with mirrors, and cross colors to unleash new effects. Every placement re-traces the whole board. A roguelite tower defense made of pure light.

details.title: Cyber Ninja: Tokyo Rumble
details.short_description: Cyber Ninja: Tokyo Rumble is a high-speed VR ninja action game set across multiple eras of Japan. Wield blades, unleash devastating energy techniques, and battle robotic armies in immersive arenas.

details.title: Pack Party
details.short_description: The drawing party game where you and your friends make a deck of absurd cards to answer ridiculous prompts. 4 to 10 players.

details.title: Grid Mage
details.short_description: A puzzle game about battling demons with magic. Figure out the rules behind enemy actions and exploit them with an expanding set of spells.

details.title: IT'S NOT A DEER
details.short_description: First-person horror game where mimicking creatures hide among ordinary wildlife. Study animal behavior and spot anomalies before you shoot. Sell meat and hides, upgrade your gear, and retreat to your cabin when you become the prey.

details.title: Type for Speed
details.short_description: Your keyboard is the gas pedal. Type to accelerate, chain clean words into combos and nitro, and race friends or bots on 10 tracks. Survive the endless highway or just cruise in Free Drive. 129 cars to collect, 10 languages, each typed in its own script.

details.title: Airport Land: Air Traffic Control
details.short_description: An air traffic control game in the tower: sequence takeoffs and landings, call the go-around, and hear pilots answer in real ATC radio. Grow a one-runway island into a hub, then work Haneda, Heathrow, Kai Tak and Lukla by their real rules.

details.title: Plinko Squad
details.short_description: Drop balls down a plinko board to recruit your squad, arrange them on a hex grid, and send them auto-battling up a 25-floor tower. Stack augments into explosive synergies, but every unit that falls is gone for good.

details.title: Tidy Up Bukkos!
details.short_description: Hope you had fun making a mess by throwing all the Bukkos around because you're not going anywhere before putting everything back to its place! Tidy up this eccentric library and its puzzle shelves in this comedy oriented organizing game.

details.title: The Playtester
details.short_description: A first-person roguelite about being the aliens' playtester. Wake up in a cell, slot cartridges into a PC and survive their homemade minigames. Spend your pay on furniture that changes how the games play. Perform badly and you're eliminated. The next human wakes up in the room you furnished.

details.title: Sayara's Path
details.short_description: Join Sayara on a journey through the snow-covered Vad-Hidek to find a way to bring her brother back to the world of the living. Here everyone’s fate depends on the will of the Spirits, and the path to resurrection becomes a trial the result of which is unknown.

details.title: The Core: Protocol
details.short_description: A dark co-op horde shooter blending tower defense with trap building. Fight through a procedural maze whose biomes, cabins and weather are reshuffled every run. Survive the waves, collect permanent upgrades for the hub and discover what waits beyond the walls.

details.title: Shattersong
details.short_description: A story-driven tactical RPG in the spirit of the 16-bit classics. Raise a found-family army of 60 heroes, recover the lost Words that sang the world into being, and stand against the Hollow Cantor — a grieving priest unsaying the world one note at a time.

details.title: Idle Smith: Forge, Craft, Battle!
details.short_description: An Idle cozy blacksmith that sits on your desktop. Craft & customize swords, bows, axes for your companions. Collect loot, upgrade your workshop and prepare for the Bosses. While you attend to your own affairs, your companions will keep fighting for you.

details.title: Tiny Vessel
details.short_description: A companion idle ARPG that lives beside whatever you are doing. A tiny crew of crash-landed survivors fights along an alien walkway while you work: real loot, a Relay to grow the vessel, depths that demand better gear. Progress keeps going while you are away.

details.title: Roguelette
details.short_description: Build your own luck in a roulette roguelike. Choose three bets, lock useful results, and reroll the rest. Upgrade your table, change number colors with tricks, and stack charms to beat rising score targets.

details.title: HOOKLINGS
details.short_description: Hook. Swing. Boom. A fast 2.5D arena shooter about tiny round critters with grappling hooks. Swing through 3D arenas that fight back, yank rivals under the press and pop them into confetti. Play online, on the couch or against bots, and earn outfits, hook skins and rare finishes.

details.title: Dirty Dispatch
details.short_description: Dirty Dispatch is a management game where you dispatch emergency teams across an isometric city while pulling the strings of its criminal underworld. Respond to calls, expand your operation, and face the consequences of the risks you create.

details.title: Horror Club: Grandpa's House
details.short_description: A first-person psychological horror game where you stay with your grandfather for a few days after he starts acting strangely. Help him with everyday tasks, follow his unusual rules, and experience unsettling events around the house as the story unfolds.

details.title: Labyrinth: The Descent
details.short_description: The maze is alive. The gold is bait. You're the meal. A permadeath dungeon crawler where the dungeon is keeping score: ten floors, one rogue, turn-based tactics on a grid. When you die that's it for the run — but your grave heals the next hero who finds it.

details.title: Carry On
details.short_description: Carry On is a chaotic 1-4 player local co-op baggage handling game. Grab, wash, wrap and hurl colour-coded luggage down the conveyors to fill every departing flight's manifest before the clock runs out. Miss the plane and the whole terminal pays for it.

details.title: Dungeonhand
details.short_description: A single-player horror game about being hunted while you work. The contractors have given you ten nights to dig your debt out of an ancient dungeon. Everything you are carrying is lost when you die, and every death costs you one of the nights.

details.title: Wunderfront
details.short_description: In this brutal roguelite survival shooter, death is only the beginning of your evolution. Master a unique mix of historical firearms, experimental gadgets, and secret wonder weapons to execute the monstrosities ruling a ruined WW2 frontline.

details.title: Dear. My Marionette
details.short_description: A narrative-driven, turn-based RPG set in a cold, Nordic-inspired world. Master strategic card combat and make choices that will shape the fate of this frozen land.

details.title: FRANKED!
details.short_description: A roguelite about weaponising your mistakes. It happens to be pinball. Night shift at a sorting office. Flip parcels into the right chute, or misroute them onto the Backlog Rail, where they gain value while they wait. Fill the rail and everything crashes back at once, worth far more than before.

details.title: The Villages That Cave
details.short_description: With just three decisions before each battle, build a defence against creatures emerging from caves that turn your villages into more. In this turn-based strategy, exploit terrain, grant villages special powers, use wildcards to wipe out chunks, and upgrade your units and structures.

details.title: + SHORTCIRCUIT -
details.short_description: You've accidentally installed a virus on your old 90's computer! Run through your PC's folders and kill the virus before it deletes precious pictures of your dog!

details.title: ASTRA LIMES: Belt Operations
details.short_description: Command fleets in this indirect control RTS game set within treacherous asteroid belts. Easily design your own skirmishes for a quick 15-minute battle or dive into a campaign of high-risk surgical strikes and systematic border advancement.

details.title: Pew Pew Magic Wizard Fighter
details.short_description: It's Wizard VS Wizard in this isometric arcade battle blaster! Dominate a gauntlet of Best-of-5 duels across unique, destructible arenas that change with every match. Out-maneuver rivals with your chosen fighter's special moves to an eclectic electronic score by inflexi0n.

details.title: Bank Life Simulator
details.short_description: Build, manage, and grow your own bank branch! Handle teller transactions, spot fake IDs, and offer loans and deposits to a living population. Hire and train staff, trade on the stock and black markets, survive strict audits, and rise from a small branch to a financial empire.

details.title: Beep Beep Until You're Rich!
details.short_description: A cozy incremental treasure-hunting game about digging up buried loot with your metal detector, unlocking upgrades, and building a pirate fortune. Help Bia buy her very own pirate ship!

details.title: Banners of the Galaxy
details.short_description: Recruit, scheme, explore, and fight. Build your fleet, choose your allegiances, and command your ships in real-time space battle in this open-world space RPG.

details.title: Final Signal
details.short_description: A signal has been detected deep inside the Backrooms. Go on your first mission with PATROL, explore levels, avoid entities, and work together to find John B., before all that's left of him is his Final Signal.

details.title: ROADS: Tangled in Traffic
details.short_description: The city is strangled by its own explosive growth. Identify the chokepoints, invest in infrastructure, and redesign the network. One well-placed roundabout could nurse it back to life. Can you relieve the pressure and let prosperity flow as freely as the traffic?

details.title: Shadows Over Fog City
details.short_description: Shadows Over the Fog City is a Republican-era spy visual novel. As an undercover clerk inside an enemy puppet bureau, hide behind files and seals, mislead your enemies, pass intelligence, and survive audits, blame games, and purges. One mistake means death—but you have no choice.

details.title: Volcano Watch
details.short_description: Discover an open-world volcano-monitoring game grounded in accurate volcanology and authentic phenomena. Step into the role of a lone scientist facing an active volcano, and lead the adventure at your own pace, free to follow the story or carve your own path.

details.title: A Mountain Called Hope
details.short_description: Explore a hauntingly abandoned late 1800s mountain coal mining town afflicted by a violent winter storm.

details.title: The Bank
details.short_description: a finance mmo with the goal to compete in a virtual economy

details.title: Skill Issue
details.short_description: Skill Issue is a collection of competitive minigames where you can outplay the competition through pure mechanical skill-master.

details.title: SCREW IT
details.short_description: Co-op space mercenary simulator. Take on high-risk contracts, upgrade your gear, and turn a profit.

details.title: Masc, Mask & Masked
details.short_description: Masc, Mask & Masked is a game that combines mini-games with a visual novel in a terrifyingly cute 2D style. Search through your mobile, chat to your potential dates and recover the powerful mask of Niarlatoted.

details.title: Drag and Conquer
details.short_description: A fast-paced, easy-to-learn grand strategy game. Drag your orders across the map and conquer enemy territory. Manage your economy to keep your armies supplied with troops and equipment. Play historical 20th-century scenarios or create your own in an advanced editor.

details.title: Iteration Protocol
details.short_description: Escape deadly mazes, recover fragmented memories, and restore a forgotten archive. Every run brings you closer to uncovering the truth behind the Iteration Protocol.

details.title: Steal This Station
details.short_description: Build your station. Defend it. Invade theirs. A sci-fi action RPG where you design a deadly space station filled with traps and enemies, then fight through what other players built to steal their loot. Every station is a target, including yours.

details.title: Milling Machine Simulator 2: Machine Shop
details.short_description: Step into your own machine shop. Operate manual mills and lathes, write CNC G-code, and turn raw stock into finished parts with real-time material removal. Experiment in Free Play or put your machining skills to work in Career mode.

details.title: Circuitra
details.short_description: Circuitra is a challenging visual logic puzzle game about building increasingly complex circuit boards. Limited inputs, tight board space and changing contract constraints force you to debug and rethink your designs in order to grow your circuit-design business.

details.title: Forklift Logistics Simulator
details.short_description: Take control of a physics-based forklift as you move pallets, stack cargo and load trucks through increasingly challenging warehouse missions. Precision, balance and careful handling are at the heart of the experience.

details.title: Operation Blackwaste
details.short_description: Scavenge, fight, and survive in a zombie-ravaged wasteland. Build your safe house, take quests, manage hunger and thirst, craft your build with gear and ability trees, clear wave-based Purge stages — or let auto-combat grind for you. Every sortie and extraction makes you stronger.

details.title: Warcaste TCG
details.short_description: The Warcaste TCG is a tactical sci-fi digital trading card game where battlefield positioning matters. Choose a Doctrine, command your fleet, and outmaneuver your enemy across a 3 zone battlefield. Play in story mode, solo play, or online PvP.

details.title: Potion Drifter
details.short_description: A cozy first-person alchemy game with hands-on physics. Cast out of the city of alchemists, travel from village to village with a fold-out cart. Throw herbs into your cauldron, pour water, and grind ingredients to brew potions for people you meet. Discover recipes, explore, and grow as an alchemist.

details.title: Hex & Tonic
details.short_description: A poker-hand roguelike deckbuilder about brewing potions. Draw reagents, brew reactions, stack catalysts until the numbers get silly — then break the Hex. Six covens, fifty hidden recipes, a Daily Brew and an Endless cauldron. Fair odds, shown to you. No hidden RNG.

details.title: Can Collector Simulator
details.short_description: Pick up piles of scattered cans in a casual first-person collecting sim. Recycle your haul at reverse vending machines, cash out printed receipts, upgrade your pickup speed and capacity, and look for oversized prize pull tabs hidden in the mess.

details.title: Wilds of Lumithra
details.short_description: Explore the hand-crafted open-world of Wilds of Lumithra, where every cliff, chasm, and hidden path is yours to discover. Turn natural obstacles into shortcuts as you gather, craft, build, and fight your way to survival - solo or online with friends.

details.title: My Beautiful Aquarium
details.short_description: A fish tank that lives on your screen. Real species, and every fish is an individual you can name. In Cozy mode nothing can die, so you can leave it running all day. Challenge mode is proper fishkeeping: water types, breeding, sickness, mistakes. Play it, or just let it swim.

details.title: Steps To The Stars
details.short_description: A single player puzzle game following the journey of two stars as they climb to return to the constellation from which they have fallen.

details.title: War Table Arena
details.short_description: War Table Arena is a real-time collectible card battler.[/h2] Energy pours in continuously and both commanders deploy onto a three-lane tabletop, where units march, clash and lay siege to the enemy citadel while you are still deciding what to play next.

details.title: Sarco
details.short_description: Sarco is a first-person horror game built around constant tension instead of jump scares. Maintain visual contact with the sarcophagus to keep it closed and the primordial being contained. But beware: it will adapt. Explore an abandoned complex and find a way to stop the being before it breaks free.

details.title: Anispo
details.short_description: Anispo is a fast paced 2D real time strategy game set inside a digital warzone. Command streams of bytes of data, capture network nodes, reinforce your defenses, and outmaneuver computer controlled or online rivals across customizable cyber battlefields.

details.title: Bamboo Beat
details.short_description: Embark on a journey through the world of Bamboo Beat. Attack, block, and counter to the beat, and take down one formidable foe after another.

details.title: Arcanum Solitarius
details.short_description: Poker solitaire with an arcane twist. Each row and column of the 5x5 grid is a poker hand, scoring as it fills. Repeat a hand and it's worth half. Purify the cursed Arcana, corrupted tarot cards that penalize your play. Draft Jokers for unique powers and power up your deck and board for bonus chips.

details.title: My Mom Says I’m Fine
details.short_description: A creepy survivors-like played on a child's tabletop. Fight swarms as a tiny toy while a giant Kid looms over the battle. Pick level-up cards, merge your powers and build a ridiculous arsenal. Mom says he's fine. You'll see.

details.title: Eatery At Ridge Station
details.short_description: A short, cozy, and heartful narrative experience with cooking elements. Play as Felix Cook, the elderly owner of an eatery, on his last week in town sponsoring the restoration of his favorite park. Cook up a new menu, say farewell to regular customers, and attend the grand reopening of Mabel’s Park.

details.title: A Trans-Siberian Tea
details.short_description: Snowbound for decades, a Trans-Siberian train holds its passengers exactly as they died. Talk to the frozen dead, uncover the identity of a legendary thief, and decide how far you're willing to go for the truth.

details.title: Eldritch Boyfriend
details.short_description: Eldritch Boyfriend is the only skill-based visual novel dating sim where your sanity—or lack thereof—turns the very act of choosing the right dialogue options into a series of challenging mini-games.

details.title: Amelia
details.short_description: In this first-person narrative experience, you step into the shoes of a young girl. Explore a rural farmhouse and witness everyday family life through her eyes. Across 13 consecutive days, you'll realize that your family is not what it seems. Will you notice what everyone else leaves unsaid?

details.title: Space Annihilator
details.short_description: Command a powerful space warship and fight your way through relentless waves of enemy ships and bases to achieve the ultimate victory!

details.title: Turtle Up
details.short_description: Only up — with the turtle and skateboard!

details.title: On Break
details.short_description: Fresnel Labs needs a Box Stacking Technician. Press the button, drop the box, build a tower that won't topple. Chain colors, earn your pay and spend it on strange office decorations that rewrite the rules of the job. Your robot supervisor, B.A.S.I.L., thinks you'll do great. Probably.

details.title: Edge of Power
details.short_description: A political sandbox where you become the architect of your state. Change the laws, manage the economy, and change the lives of citizens! Here you write your own history of your own country and the whole world. See how your decisions will affect the course of history!

details.title: Fast & Fractured
details.short_description: Step into typical Spanish sun-baked places and prepare for Fast & Fractured experience, a frenetic physics-based driving shooter for up to 8 contenders— in a chaotic multiplayer battle royale. Choose from 4 colorful elderly characters and battle in stereotypical Spanish maps

details.title: Beyond Lost Planets
details.short_description: Beyond Lost Planets is an intense Roguelike Dungeon Crawler Bullet Hell. Fight through enemies and bosses across procedural worlds. Everything from weapons and bullets to powerup and companions is represented with cards. Grow absurdly powerful and create wild, unique synergies every run!

details.title: Veiled Shadows
details.short_description: Live a month in a rural mountain town, build bonds, and hunt a mystery across two worlds. Manage your days, explore dungeons, and fight turn-based battles to recover what's been lost.

details.title: Cosmic Plague
details.short_description: A plague is silencing the galaxy one world at a time. Command a small ship and a frightened crew in this roguelike about outrunning it. Trade, fight and keep your ship alive as systems go dark behind you. Reach the Ark before it leaves, and pray you pass the scan. It only takes clean ships.

details.title: One Wrong Step
details.short_description: One wrong move can change everything... Explore trapped rooms in this tactical roguelite inspired by Minesweeper. Every square is a risk. Every exit, a choice. Think carefully... or start again.

details.title: Unwilling Executioner
details.short_description: A sadistic killer is forcing you to choose who lives and dies. Investigate and find clues scattered around The Bunker to save your family. Double check every detail before time runs out, because one wrong pick and you’ve killed someone you love.

details.title: Berrus
details.short_description: Berrus is an old-school online RPG. Explore, fight in real time, gather, craft and farm.

details.title: Car World
details.short_description: Car World is a realistic 2D driving and life simulator focused on true car ownership and maintenance. Drive, repair, and tune your vehicles, take jobs or trade them for profit. Every car system is simulated down to the smallest detail. Can you prove yourself as a true car enthusiast?

details.title: RoboFarm
details.short_description: Build, automate, and decorate your dream farm! Deploy robot workers, unlock powerful upgrades, and watch your crops thrive while you relax, raising profits to your satisfaction. Save and share your creations, tune in with the music, and experience the world of RoboFarm.

details.title: Zoomalia
details.short_description: In a world conquered by Zealotory harvesters, Zoomalia’s survival rests in your hands. Build a team of over 100 unique creatures, then fuse, evolve, and mutate them into powerful forms. Adapt your strategy, destroy obelisks, and reclaim the planet in this strategic roguelite.

details.title: Dice chess
details.short_description: A new-age chess game combined with math. Free to play with your bro offline, your friends or any players online.

details.title: Anna's Bakery Shop
details.short_description: You’re Anna, a young woman who ditches the boring city life to open a cozy bakery in a small town. Along with your animate mannequin friend Can Doe, you will embark on a delicious journey, decorate your beautiful shop and meet locals who are curious about the new bakery in their town.

details.title: Life Balance
details.short_description: A physics ragdoll climber where life choices become literal baggage. Climb a tower in the sky alone or in 2-player split-screen co-op: give each other a leg-up, grab each other, and share the load. Can you reach the top, or will your responsibilities drag you down?

details.title: The Final Like
details.short_description: THE FINAL LIKE. A fruit machine with a mind of its own. An authentic UK AWP simulator built around the world of social media - where the machine’s AI is watching, and has no intention of letting you walk away a winner.

details.title: As We Planned
details.short_description: Stealth PVE heist with friends. Steal valuables, solve puzzles, use tools, upgrade your base, and complete quests. You can go quiet or loud — the choice is yours. Up to 4 players. Every raid is unique!

details.title: Project Lighthouse
details.short_description: Trapped inside a scientific anomaly, solve puzzles with evolving teleportation tech and uncover the fate of the vanished “keepers”. Built alongside our community, props we made for Project Lighthouse are free for other game developers.

details.title: Kill to Zero
details.short_description: Seek revenge in a frantic top-down hack and slash! Cut enemies in half, master the Parry, and take down a cyberpunk megacorporation!

details.title: Shape Wars
details.short_description: A fast-paced auto-battler where Squares, Triangles, and Circles clash in an endless lane war. Build your army, manage your economy, and destroy the enemy Nexus before they destroy yours.

details.title: Star Talent
details.short_description: Run a Hollywood talent agency from a one-room office to the top of the industry. Scout unknowns, sign stars, negotiate the deals and fight rival agencies for every role, in a living, deeply simulated film world where every career is yours to make or break.

details.title: Billionaire Life Simulator
details.short_description: Wake up in a penthouse. Sleep on a yacht. The alarm clock is a helicopter. BILLIONAIRE LIFE SIMULATOR is the ultimate "what if I had everything" sandbox — pilot private jets, host yacht parties, customize mansions, and live the Instagram fantasy in cinematic Unreal Engine detail.

details.title: Vanguard Tides
details.short_description: Fight in massive-scale battles where armies paint the battlefield in their color. Captured territory affects both your health and your abilities. Level up your vanguard and your army, defend your castles, and survive the shifting tides of battle to claim ultimate victory!

details.title: Farmdustry
details.short_description: Cozy farm automation game: lay roads, send out cute cargo bots and turn wheat into bread, then bigger recipes. No timers, no fail states. Play solo or co-op with up to 4 friends.

details.title: SpellMart: Monster Girl Shop Simulator
details.short_description: Build your dream magical shop in SpellMart! Stock modern potions, set competitive prices, and manage a quirky team of Monster Girls in a vibrant neon world. A stylish tycoon simulator where retail strategy meets anime charm. Can you turn magic into big business?

details.title: Ravenous Greed
details.short_description: Trapped in the body of a raven, Pacer begins his quest to restore his human form. He must collect all of the treasures to fill his vault with coins! Only with enough wealth can he finally overcome the curse.

details.title: Whispers
details.short_description: Whispers is a psychological horror game where you explore an abandoned hospital, investigate its dark secrets, and follow the final footage of a missing vlogger. Listen for unsettling whispers, uncover clues, and navigate a reality where you can no longer trust what you see or hear.

details.title: Nullwatch
details.short_description: Hold your base against waves of geometric nodes in this stationary shooter. Aim, choose what gets deleted first and time every reload. Between nights, upgrade your base, sell salvage, buy better guns and spend skill points before the field fills again.

details.title: 6 VIEWS MYSTERY
details.short_description: 6 VIEWS MYSTERY is a mystery adventure where you explore closed spaces from six fixed viewpoints—north, east, south, west, ceiling, and floor. Find clues and items, operate mechanisms, and uncover new details by changing your point of view. Currently includes the short episode “Cell 214.”

details.title: The Wuslers
details.short_description: Build a cozy settlement where Wuslers keep your economy running, carrying all your goods on foot along the roads you lay. Feed your mines, expand your territory with Barracks and play solo, against the AI or with up to eight players on PC and Android.

details.title: Purification: Idle Defense
details.short_description: Purification merges Tower Defense with the exponential growth of an Incremental Idler. Harvest souls for talents and ancient relics to fortify your wall—and switch to a silent Desktop Companion bar to keep defending while you work or study.

details.title: Hungry Hoist
details.short_description: Hungry Hoist is a co-op dungeon-crawler sandbox about gathering and selling as much loot as possible. Dig deeper into the mine to discover darker, more twisted dungeons containing new enemies and puzzles, as well as shinier loot to sell or craft with. Mine, fight, and cook to evolve your panda!

details.title: CraBro 蟹霸
details.short_description: Fight through an underwater arena with two independent claws. Build weapons from scrap, learn martial techniques, parry deep-sea bosses, and unlock an online asynchronous ladder against other players' saved builds.

details.title: Island Escape
details.short_description: A single-player 3D survival crafting game. Shipwrecked in 1907 on a nameless island, you gather, build, and push your civilization from stone to electricity — then build a boat and gamble on the open sea. Even a raft can leave; arriving alive is another matter. Sink, and the island is still yours.

details.title: The Goodnight Potion
details.short_description: The Goodnight Potion! is a pixel-art fantasy puzzle game in which you help an old mage with a troubling potion addiction. Choose which potion to drink first, combine elemental reactions, and use spells and transformations to survive until the next night.

details.title: Bottled Gleams
details.short_description: A cozy incremental idle game for your desktop. In the Cat Squeeze bottle, scoop up and pet a cat hunting for dried fish. In the Deck of Harvest bottle, moles mine and ship their haul for coins. Tap keys or click to boost output. Spend idle earnings on capsules for skins, weather and décor.

details.title: Before Dawn Bakery
details.short_description: Flour, heat, and bake away the hours before sunrise. A cozy solo baking sim where every stage — ferment, proof, bake, cool — has its own feel and timing, and one pair of hands to meet them all. Fill the morning's orders and close out before the town wakes.

details.title: Packlore
details.short_description: Packlore is a cozy incremental TCG where you open magical booster packs! Earn money from cards, upgrade, and hire helpers. Can you complete the collection and uncover the mystery of the secret page?

details.title: COILBREAKER
details.short_description: A survivor roguelite where you steer a scrap-metal snake through hordes of machines. Its weapons fire on their own, and where they sit on the head, body or tail changes how they fire.

details.title: Folder Escape
details.short_description: "Wait, this is a game?" A puzzle game played inside a file explorer. Rename files, change extensions, show hidden items and switch view modes to escape each folder your own way. 30 stages, and every fifth one is a .zip that demands all of it at once.

details.title: Leila's Adventure
details.short_description: Join Leila on a colourful 3D platforming adventure inspired by collectathons of the 90s. Explore vibrant levels, collect treasures, overcome obstacles and uncover secrets as you journey across unique worlds.

details.title: Incremental Dungeoncrawler
details.short_description: An Incremental Party-Based RPG inside an endless ASCII dungeon. Command a squad of 4 unique heroes, crawl through procedurally generated grids, and strategically unlock massive, custom skill trees. No mindless backtracking! Only forward progression, permanent prestige, and numbers going up!

details.title: Temporal Minesweeper
details.short_description: Reason across time: a cell that is safe now may be a mine the next moment. With only the clues and rules, solve the puzzle step by step — without ever guessing. Combined rules build on one another for a pure brain-teaser.

details.title: Archemyst: Alchemy Shop
details.short_description: An incremental game of spell-driven gathering and alchemy shopkeeping. Summon skeletons and goblins, gather materials, craft goods and run your shop. Unlock recipes, expand the shop and follow the talent tree to relearn elemental magic and regain your powers as an archmage.

details.title: Desk Sushi Idle
details.short_description: Desk Sushi Idle is a cozy animal sushi shop at the bottom of your screen. Keep working while guests grab plates, check out, and your restaurant grows. Build belts and stations, unlock dishes, and expand at your own pace—an idle desktop companion with real conveyor-sushi charm.

details.title: CRUMBKINS
details.short_description: A 1–4 player physics-based co-op heist comedy about tiny, hungry thieves. Climb giant furniture, steal food for picky clients, and decide: deliver the loot, throw it to a friend, or eat a pepper and shoot fireballs.

details.title: Dear Maid
details.short_description: I spent every penny I had and signed up for 60 monthly payments on a maid robot. Then the world ended.

details.title: Roll Call: Hero League Manager
details.short_description: Build your superhero dream team from 888 playable characters and take on 35 bosses. Negotiate transfers, brave dangerous missions, and keep clashing egos and the payroll under control. Outthink 49 rival clubs in a turn-based management game where every roll can change your season.

details.title: SLASHER NIGHT
details.short_description: A single-player VR slasher simulator. Stalk targets through Redcastle, strike with hands-on weapons and face physical NPC reactions. Choose your approach and survive escalating resistance as witnesses flee and authorities respond.

details.title: Roadworn
details.short_description: Roadworn is a dark fantasy sandbox RPG. Lead a squad across a new world of rival states, wild factions and bandits, get drawn into intrigue around the thrones, fight turn-based hex battles and rise from nobody to legend

details.title: Deadline Detective
details.short_description: An offbeat retrofuturistic deduction game: build your career across hundreds of investigations. For each, you have 48 hours and one accusation. Question and confront suspects, rise through the ranks, and unlock new tools. The same mysterious signature keeps appearing: the Archivist’s.

details.title: Tiny Club Manager
details.short_description: Lead a tiny club from the Sunday League to the top of the world. Watch every match in a living pixel-art stadium, shout orders from the touchline, train your squad with cards earned from what went wrong, and grow your ground from a roped-off pitch into a roaring arena.

details.title: Boomside
details.short_description: A roguelike twist on Minesweeper. Dig up houses, signal towers and parks for points, chain power plants into huge multipliers, and read every hint to steer clear of the gas mains. Hire helpers, build your combo, and secure all eight key sites to redevelop the district.

details.title: Mini Hotel Simulator
details.short_description: Build and run your own hotel in a charming miniature world. Design rooms, arrange furniture, hire staff and care for your guests. Grow at your own pace, from your first hotel to new properties.

details.title: MALMORT
details.short_description: A first-person tower defense set in the Louisiana bayou, 1850. The dead are rising from the black water. Choose one of four heroes, build traps and turrets on stilted walkways, and fight the horde yourself to protect the last totem holding back the evil. Solo or 2-player co-op.

details.title: OUTIS
details.short_description: A 1–10 player PvE/PvP rules-horror game. Follow the rules of the urban legend—or deceive them—to survive and escape. The objects you bring back from inside the legend will be used to advance technology for humanity's survival.

details.title: Pack Goblin
details.short_description: A cozy desktop companion and card collector. A little goblin lives above your taskbar. Your typing and clicks fill its meter, then it sneaks off and brings back booster packs. Rip them open, chase foil legendaries, fill your binder and decorate its yard

details.title: Hide and Freak
details.short_description: A goofy online ghost hunt, a seeker with a magic lantern, and a whole room of ghosts hiding in plain sight, posing, dancing and sneaking up behind you. Rainy graveyard, PS1 look, up to 16 players with room codes.

name: Iz and Auggie: Escape from Dimension Q

details.title: Iz and Auggie: Escape from Dimension Q
details.short_description: Bandmates Iz and her robot Auggie wrote a killer song. Cosmo LaRue stole it. Recover the song from Dimension Q in this animated point-and-click puzzle adventure from 1996: descramble codes, outrun the Q cops, crack a musical lock, and rescue missing secret agents.

details.title: Carbon Conservatory
details.short_description: A psychedelic botanical bullet hell with the bones of a Souls-like. Parry the overgrowth's fire back into it, seed husks until they rupture, and chain their deaths into blooms. Dash, graze and run your living gun hot through a dying glasshouse refuge, and take on bosses that punish every mistake.

details.title: Jack & Snag
details.short_description: Grapple into a new angle and turn robot fights in your favour. Jack & Snag is an arena FPS for 1–6 participants, with one- and two-handed weapons, colourful arenas and bots to practise against on your own.

details.title: Room on Earth
details.short_description: A room. Probably on Earth. Somehow, it is always night, with no bearings beyond the window. Room on Earth is a 3D sandbox for building, decorating and collecting. Arrange your space, gather things you love, and make a corner into an animated wallpaper. Outside can wait.

details.title: AfterShift
details.short_description: Change the past, rewrite the present. Shift through three moments of a catastrophic accident, solve time-bending puzzles, escape a secret facility, and decide which of your coworkers you can save.

details.title: NoroiStation
details.short_description: This console is cursed. Play the cartridges one by one on an old CRT. If something is wrong, reset at once.

details.title: Crown Without a King
details.short_description: Your abilities evolve. Build a fantasy party, develop and modify its abilities, and master your weapons. Forge and enchant gear, choose where to strike in turn-based battles, and prepare Emberwatch for the coming invasion.

details.title: Velma's Costume Closet
details.short_description: Velma and Rapu are off on a twenty-country dress-up tour, and you pick the outfits. Mix and match traditional costumes and have fun with the fully animated skits. Put on a show and print your own paper dolls. A fully restored 1997 Headbone Interactive classic.

details.title: 江湖藏锋
details.short_description: Jianghu: Hidden Edge is a hardcore turn-based Roguelike RPG blending deckbuilding and inventory management. Lead your martial artists through the perilous grid map—will you risk all for legendary gear or retreat with your haul? Uncover the conspiracy brewing in Songhe Town.

details.title: content moderator.
details.short_description: Eidopathy is a disease in which hallucinations spread through photographs. To pay for your mother's surgery, you apply for a suspicious part-time job as a Content Moderator, deleting photos containing hallucinations. Make it out of the anomalous office alive.

details.title: Meow Mart
details.short_description: Experience the immersive fun of first-person restocking and cashiering. Launching with 6 distinct cat breeds—breed them freely, sell them for a profit, or keep them as collectibles in your store to boost customer traffic.

details.title: 404 Survivor
details.short_description: The horde is coming. 404 Survivor is a top-down post-apocalyptic survival game focused on scavenging, crafting, and base building. Gather resources and fortify your base by day, then defend against growing zombie hordes by night. Every night could be your last.

name: When the Moon Falls, We Speak

details.title: When the Moon Falls, We Speak
details.short_description: The moon is falling, and the world nears its end. You play as Hill, a museum curator who chooses to stay on Earth. There, you meet 12, a mysterious red-haired woman who keeps you company as the world fades. Through your final conversations, you uncover her secret—and perhaps, the reason you stayed.

name: 幻霓绮岛 Phantasmal Neon Island

details.title: 幻霓绮岛 Phantasmal Neon Island
details.short_description: Welcome to Phantasmal Neon Island! In this sleepless city, you inherit your father’s legendary host club after his accident. Manage debts, recruit new hosts, and survive rent hikes and rival clubs. Will you build a nightlife empire—or fall in love and lose it all?

details.title: Ghost Justice
details.short_description: Lead elite operatives against ruthless cartels in a brutal narco conflict. Coordinate multiple tactical teams, plan ambushes, gather intelligence, and eliminate high-value targets through stealth-driven turn-based combat.

details.title: Horns
details.short_description: Horns is an evolving dark fantasy RPG inspired by retro ARPG adventures of the late ‘90s. Join Lyssandra on her search for the king in a collapsed, magical world as she grows more grotesque on her trek for truth. Fight the darkness — or become it — and watch the world react accordingly.

details.title: Static Between Stations
details.short_description: Static Between Stations is a narrative-driven RPG in the dying city of Patchwater. Explore, negotiate, scavenge, craft or try your best to avoid conflict. In a fight for survival adaptability is your only advantage.

details.title: interViolence
details.short_description: Help a teenage supervillain move out of his one and only home. Mop spills, pack clothes and disarm lethal machines. Think about your past, and his uncertain future. A short RPGMaker visual novel about nostalgia, grief, and the things you miss when they're gone forever.

details.title: Charming Blood: Twelve days
details.short_description: Embrace darkness as an unwitting vampire in this choice-driven romance. Navigate ancient powers, brewing conflicts, and passionate relationships with four captivating vampires who could become your greatest allies – or something more. When night falls, will you surrender to its dangers?

details.title: DreadHaven: The Last Colony
details.short_description: Build by day. Survive by night. Each day, use a limited number of actions to expand your city, manage resources, reinforce defenses, and prepare for what’s coming. Each night, unleash the power of your towers against the ever-growing zombie hordes.

details.title: Minutes to Meltdown
details.short_description: Everything breaks on your 6 minute shift in this 1960s nuclear power plant. You and up to 3 colleagues keep the power flowing, the town lit, and the reactor from melting down. Push for one more shift, or clock out while you're ahead?

details.title: The Apartment
details.short_description: A new apartment. A polite neighbor who knows every package you get. He wants his share. Every day, a little more. Keep him fed or become the meal. A first-person psychological horror.

details.title: Late Night Manifest
details.short_description: As Marco, you wake up to a reality where the world is shrouded in darkness, forcing you to fight for survival while seeking answers in abandoned darkness.

details.title: MonsTile
details.short_description: A groundbreaking roguelike deck-building defense game on an 8x8 board! Strategically place monsters and trigger synergies to fend off adventurers. Having fled across dimensions from an unbeatable hero, you arrive in worlds of fantasy, apocalypse, wuxia, and cyberpunk to battle their heroes.

details.title: Scaredy Cats
details.short_description: Where resource management meets dungeon crawler. Collect rare loot, strategize monster encounters, and push your luck to descend to the bottom of the dungeon!

details.title: Band Stage
details.short_description: Step onto a vibrant, colorful stage and unleash your musical magic with a variety of instruments. Featuring a curated collection of classic hits, our soundtrack spans Pop, Rock, Classical, Electronic, and beyond—guaranteed to hit every note of your musical imagination.

details.title: Whisk
details.short_description: Whisk is a two-player platformer about shared movement and communication. Coordinate jumps, climbs and throws with a partner to get every Dreamcat home.

details.title: Evolution Of The Ancients
details.short_description: Survive as a vulnerable hatchling, grow into a fierce predator and lead your own herd. Craft armour from the bones of your prey, recruit NPC companions and join other players to defend your nesting grounds. In a world where dinosaurs never went extinct, build a future worth fighting for.

details.title: Study Abroad Simulator
details.short_description: Four years abroad. A whole new life. Take on college in near-future America! Ace your classes, earn your keep, fall in love, and play your cards right. Then start again to uncover a hidden conspiracy. Your next big decision could change more than your future—it could change the world.

details.title: Dreadmark Outlaws
details.short_description: The West is dead. You’re not. Yet. Enter a grim Wild West overrun by the undead, build deadly defenses and turn every last stand into glorious chaos — alone or with your friends. Survive the night. Become an outlaw legend.

details.title: I Like Trains
details.short_description: I Like Trains is an incremental game about growing a single train line into a sprawling network full of trains, upgrades, and strange anomalies. Build, expand, and watch the map come to life while deciphering anomalies and revealing the story within.

details.title: Infinite R: Idle Racing
details.short_description: "An idle racing management game tailor-made for second screens. Perfect for 'desktop slacking,' watch your car auto-race while you work. No driving required—step behind the scenes as the boss to tune cars, manage drivers, and experience the pure joy of motorsport management!"

details.title: GnomeBoozled
details.short_description: Run an illegal gnome disposal business from your backyard. Build absurd traps and conveyor systems to maximize profit, and stop gnomes from sabotaging your shady operation before the whole neighborhood falls into chaos.

details.title: Toypact
details.short_description: Welcome to the world of Toypact. Step into a miniature world, collect unique toys and grow together! Think through strategy, mix and match equipment, and build your own ever-changing combat style. Every choice may spark new surprises—and the strongest doll will be cultivated by your own hands!

details.title: KAGERO
details.short_description: Fight solo or in up to 4-player co-op to destroy the houses that tried to erase you. Harvest the souls of the fallen, grow stronger with every battle, and fuel the ritual to awaken an ancient spirit.

details.title: Sprout's Meadow
details.short_description: Manage a team of adorable Sproutlings in this cozy farming adventure! Assign tasks, automate chores, and turn forgotten land into a lively home. Grow crops, raise animals, and craft goods, then take to the skies in your hot air balloon to trade. Watch your little farm come alive!

details.title: Magical Girl
details.short_description: A pixel-art magical-girl action adventure. Transform, chain attacks, time Perfect Guards, and master new fighting styles. Explore a haunted city and collect forbidden books, then return to school life, phone chats, and a place to call home.

details.title: Rogue Reigns
details.short_description: Rogue Reigns is a dark fantasy roguelike deckbuilder about trust and sacrifice. Lead selfish antiheroes through a world where death is no more, and something still hunts them. Build synergies that bind them or rivalries that break them. Nobody dies, some are sacrificed, but everybody is condemned.

details.title: Diatonic
details.short_description: Diatonic is a piano roguelike that sharpens your sight-reading. Learn songs one run at a time, no matter your skill level. Best played with a MIDI keyboard.

details.title: Low Level Hunters
details.short_description: Low Level Hunters is a low-poly, cold war era helicopter combat flight simulator. Pilot Cobra attack helicopter, Huey II utility helicopter, or MD-500 Defender by directly interacting with switches and control devices using mouse, joysticks, and VR controllers to defeat ruthless rebels!

details.title: Deserter
details.short_description: An immersive isometric stealth RPG about a thief surviving in a decaying totalitarian city. Plan every move, evade traps, and pull off daring heists right under the Party's nose.

details.title: Tesera
details.short_description: Beyond the familiar lies a world of uncharted lands, strange creatures, and the remnants of a lost civilization. Explore, gather, craft, build, and fight - make this alien world your own, solo or with friends.

details.title: Roguebound Pirates
details.short_description: Loot, upgrade & dominate! Your inventory IS your ship in this action roguelike. Customize weapons, create game-breaking synergies, and claim your place as the most overpowered pirate across the seas!

details.title: Five More Minutes
details.short_description: Build your deck and strategize to defeat foes as you traverse videogame worlds. Choose between 3 unique starting genres, and combine them to create unstoppable combos! Five more minutes is a love letter to growing up with the emotional support of our best friend: videogames.

details.title: Fields of Aaru
details.short_description: A cozy life sim set in the mystical afterlife of Ancient Egypt. Farm along the Nile, befriend the locals, and decorate your eternal home. Venture into the desert and discover oases, pyramids, and tombs. Unlock magical powers by restoring ancient obelisks and making offerings to the gods.

details.title: polymorphite
details.short_description: Rhythm-dodging adventure game about a mysterious set of murders. Come then; decide the past, so that we may glimpse at a better future.

details.title: Kopernicus: Incremental Suffering
details.short_description: Burn. Build. Survive. Escape. Incinerate nightmares with the MATEJKO flamethrower, expand your ever-growing base, and unlock devastating new weapons. Every night the planet grows stronger. So do you. Recover forgotten memories and fight your way back home (with your chihuahua's help).

details.title: Army of the Potomac
details.short_description: A digital version of the grand tactical wargame published by GMT Games and designed by Mark Herman. Second in the Civil War Heritage Series, this game includes scenarios for five individual battles covering the period of 1862 to 1864, and two campaign scenarios using eight maps from the boardgame.

details.title: Raging Blasters 2
details.short_description: The sequel to the "Raging Blasters" is here! It's called "Raging Blasters 2". This is an arcade-style vertical scrolling shmup. Players choose from three pilots to control, and head into battle. The graphics are pixel-perfect, and the music includes chiptune versions.

details.title: Sirius the Stargazer : Furry Idle
details.short_description: Awooo—! Follow Sirius into the starry lands! Sirius the Stargazer is a cozy desktop idle game. Start with a simple branch, defeat monsters, collect gear with random abilities, and help Sirius grow stronger. When he’s tired, let him rest by the campfire and keep you company.

name: Error: Love - Human Bug Eradication Project

details.title: Error: Love - Human Bug Eradication Project
details.short_description: If love is an error you can’t fix… will you delete me—or choose to keep me? Step into the role of a censor and dive into a story of order, freedom, and love.

details.title: Cardmare: Descent
details.short_description: A push-your-luck roguelike deckbuilder. Ten deadly floors, ten-minute runs, nine classes, one question every turn: Will you gain enough gold to buy powerful new cards, or become too greedy and push your luck too far?

details.title: Serenity In Surrender
details.short_description: Daisy's the brilliant and beautiful girl-next-door. You haven't gone outside in a week. Still, you're determined to win her heart and if you make the right choices, you might learn to fall in love along the way.

details.title: SHIFU: Traffic Masters
details.short_description: Drive slow cars fast. Haul cargo that shifts and spills, keep taxi passengers comfortable and chase suspects through the packed streets of 1990s China, all in forgotten workhorse cars with more character than horsepower. Inspired by ’90s games like Midtown Madness and Driver.

details.title: LOVE WMC
details.short_description: "Love wmc" is a visual novel game based on music games. It tells a series of stories about the protagonist who came to a small county town to study alone due to family conflicts, and accidentally got involved with four female protagonists because of an arcade music game.

details.title: Wheel Wills
details.short_description: A roguelike where every attack is a gamble. Spin the Wheel to decide what each day throws at you, fill your grid with Gambits that either hit or miss, and repaint the Wheel itself to bend the odds your way

details.title: 时漏界限-edge-
details.short_description: 一场神秘的“梦”，打破了你平静的生活。横贯两个世界的旅程，却总是遭遇同一场危机。你遇到了意味不明的茶味男，看起来很好说话的异瞳少年，突然出现的神秘妹妹头，呆傻的美丽学长，好久不见突然变成金色的幼驯染。你们的故事打破了两个世界，人们的命运就此交织…… 《时漏界限-edge-》是一款文字avg乙女冒险游戏，正式版包含4位可攻略男主角，一位隐藏可攻略男主角。正式版游戏文本量在50w字以上，拥有50张以上精美cg。 在游戏中，你将扮演一名即将毕业的大学生，在穿越两个世界的旅途中寻找世界的真相，并作出自己的选择。游戏拥有多个分支结局，等待你在游玩过程中逐步解锁。

details.title: Large Language Mercenaries
details.short_description: A roguelite turn-based strategy RPG where you command an AI mercenary, defend your caravan, and parry enemy attacks in real time. Play as the *original characters* Sam the Scout, Elon the Envoker, or Dario the Duelist and face down waves of AI-enabled nightmares to save humanity.

details.title: Train Kingdom
details.short_description: This is a railway history simulation game.Set in the United States of the 19th century. Get a railroad network that connects cities in the pioneering America. Use locomotives to carry supplies, passengers, and get money through trade. Complete various quests and gain fame.

details.title: Taste Of Heaven
details.short_description: Taste of heaven is a 2D cooking RPG with a pinch of roguelite ! Master the art of crafting dishes for celestial gourmets while forging bonds with a cast of unforgettable characters. Discover hidden recipes and explore a vibrant, ever-changing world brimming with charm and mystery.

details.title: Dimakerus
details.short_description: Dimakerus is a social deduction combat game for up to 4 players. Disguise as anyone. Mimic their ways. Ambush your friends. Discover cursed Roman relics in procedural catacombs and wield their might to obliterate those who stand in your way.

details.title: Speechbound - A language RPG
details.short_description: In Speechbound: a Language Learning RPG you'll step in the role of Zero to save the planet! Engage in a captivating narrative, battle formidable foes, tackle exciting language exercises, and discover the beauty of Babyl Moon. Learn a language, save the world!

details.title: Glitch Core
details.short_description: In the far future where AI has been deemed too dangerous and sent to the moon, you play as a rogue AI agent fighting through battle simulations to unravel the true purpose of your design in this tactical, immersive, procedural FPS rogue lite with split screen co-op where the code FIGHTS BACK!

details.title: Crafted Legends
details.short_description: Build awesome racing tracks, challenge other players' ghosts, and discover what happens when realistic physics meets questionable driving skills. Create, race, crash, repeat. Roads are optional. Gravity isn't. Welcome to Crafted Legends, where even your worst ideas deserve a test drive.

details.title: World War 2 Agenda
details.short_description: An old-style PC game to honor the British, American and Russian soldiers who fought and defeated the Nazi Socialist party. Go behind enemy lines and destroy the Nazi Globalist agenda during World War 2.

name: This Place at the End: An Apocalyptic RPG

details.title: This Place at the End: An Apocalyptic RPG
details.short_description: This Place at the End is a tactical, turn-based RPG about moving forward at the end of the world. 30 in-game days, 30 real-time hours, and 12 ways to reach the end.

details.title: A Little Less Desperation
details.short_description: When a peaceful farmer is abducted by an alien, he cannot imagine how this experience will turn him into a hero that needs to save the galaxy. Suddenly, alien abduction is funny again.

details.title: My Paper Plane Is Better
details.short_description: Throw a paper plane into a city built for flight. Every run you finish becomes a track, and other players race your ghost on it. Skim rooftops, thread alleys, pop balloons and chase the longest glide.

details.title: Notoris 2: Warlords
details.short_description: A dark meets high fantasy strategy RPG. Play as ruler, administrator, or officer. Wield influence to sway allies and rivals alike. Command vast armies in tense tactical turn-based battles. Inspired by the Romance of the Three Kingdoms.

details.title: Wishbound
details.short_description: An ancient djinn has awakened but some bonds are stronger than magic! Help Erika and her friends face the supernatural together in this story-driven turn-based RPG. Explore the city, customise your party and uncover mysteries. Every moment brings you closer to saving the city - and each other.

details.title: INFINITE CHUMP
details.short_description: INFINITE CHUMP is an ultra-fast, boomer shooter roguelite tripfest where you graft spell-casting arms to your body. Put rings on your new fingers to create spells on the fly. Inspired by 90's FPS games with a trippy twist.

details.title: BURN IT ALL DOWN
details.short_description: Sneak around and BURN IT ALL DOWN! Use everything at your disposal to target key political figures and structures as you fight to free the people of New London from the oppressive grip of the Puppet Master in this Orwellian-inspired VR immersive sim.

details.title: Head Chef
details.short_description: Head Chef is a restaurant management game. Supply the kitchen, select your staff, overcome challenges, create a delicious menu and… cook! Make your guests happy and find your way to the stars. Keep control of your team and finances, because the higher you climb, the harder you fall.

details.title: ecoSYSTEMS
details.short_description: Shape a living planet, study its shifting seasons, and build a resilient society across a world defined by climate, resources, and risk. Every civilization begins with understanding the world beneath it. Make thoughtful compromises and build a world that can withstand the scope of human impact.

details.title: Wick & Slate
details.short_description: Descend into a malice-soaked underworld in this intensely oppressive single-player "loot, fight, extract" roguelite deckbuilder. Play as a Stone Folk hero, battling monsters in a grotesque gamble. Build your deck mid-run, scavenge eyeballs and skulls, dissect bosses for mystery rewards.

details.title: 仙侠涤尘箓
details.short_description: 《Xian Xia Di Chen Lu》is an open world ARPG game that includes real-time combat, dating development, and multiple plot side options. Its unique feature is that the combat system adopts a rare move mode in RPG genre, hoping to bring players a different experience.
developers: 常州市华蓝德软件科技有限公司
publishers: 常州市华蓝德软件科技有限公司

details.title: Folder Dungeon
details.short_description: What if your desktop was a dungeon? Explore folders, slay bugs, collect relics, modify them and create broken combos in this OS-themed roguelike dungeon crawler!

name: How Many Cockroaches Can You Kill?

details.title: How Many Cockroaches Can You Kill?
details.short_description: How many cockroaches can you kill before your stamina runs out? Before the Queen crawls out? Before the whole city is infested? Squash 50 roach species, grab the coins, upgrade, unlock bombs, lightning, meteors and a giant slipper, and find out in this fast incremental clicker.

details.title: Ten Ten
details.short_description: Ten Ten is a unique game that combines shooting, puzzles, and bullet-dodging.

details.title: Lord Skeleton
details.short_description: Night lies upon history. Beneath your blows the stone gives way, the towers fall, and the flames die in the dust. Then comes the silence of the last light quenched, and the vast shadow of the one who kept watch over the ruins.

details.title: Debts of Power
details.short_description: Northern Song China, 1057. You passed the exams and were posted to a county as registrar. You are not the magistrate. You draft his papers. Each month brings more files than you can clear, and someone remembers every one. After three years, rising takes a patron willing to stake his career on you.

details.title: Card Shards
details.short_description: Your cards, your rules! Create your own cards and immerse yourself in a world of limitless creativity. Challenge opponents, discover new strategies and become the architect of your own legend. Ready for your adventure?

details.title: 遥遥领先
details.short_description: You transmigrated back to the 1980s, you decided to start a business and accurately seized every opportunity for success. You hired legendary managers to work for you, allowing your products to dominate both the national and global markets. Eventually, you became a "far ahead" business legend.

details.title: CONFINED: Leaving OKB-134
details.short_description: CONFINED: Leaving OKB-134 is an intense horror/puzzle adventure game for PC and VR, set in an abandoned Soviet bunker. Seek safety by restoring power, lights, and machinery. Learn about the long-gone personnel, solve sinister riddles, and find a way to escape. But stay quiet... You’re not alone.

details.title: Project Polygon
details.short_description: 32 players. 5 rounds. Nobody is ever eliminated. Race, dive and tumble through a chaotic TV game show armed with Goat Launchers, Chicken Rays and Black Hole Bombs. Get knocked over, bounce back up and climb the scoreboard – the Final counts double!

details.title: Dungeon Man
details.short_description: A bullet-hell dungeon game where you use colored gems to match the enemy in order to deal damage. Each enemy type has a unique attack style. Shoot and Dodge as you search for the evil toilet snake which lies deep within the dungeon.

details.title: Hot Seat Manager
details.short_description: One PC, one couch, up to four managers. Build your club, hijack your mates' top transfer targets, and pin secret sticky notes to the market. On matchday, everything plays out live in the round-up—and by the penalty shootout, cushions will fly.

details.title: CatCat Panic
details.short_description: CatCat Panic is a chaotic online party game for 3–4 players! Pick your cat and battle your friends in 14 crazy mini-games: rob Nazif’s house, escape the vacuum monster, hop on your skateboard and race. Only one cat takes the crown!

details.title: Royal Escort: Idle Battles
details.short_description: Escort your king on an epic journey to reclaim his kingdom! Upgrade and strengthen your army in this idle auto-battler. Recruit soldiers, discover powerful skills, collect valuable loot, and craft powerful equipment as you battle your way through a realm filled with danger.

details.title: Pay Up, Piggy
details.short_description: You're the kid who owes Finn the loan shark. Smash piggy banks, stack the coins and pay the Boss's weekly cut, or you're done. Upgrade your hammer, call in Favors, survive the Showdowns and climb Port Penny's mob.

details.title: Shaft Nine
details.short_description: Work the shift. Meet the quota. Go a little deeper. A 2D pixel art mining game about a job that gets stranger the further down you go: less automation, more discovery, and secrets that don't stay underground.

details.title: Mad Racer
details.short_description: Hit the gas and tear through the wasteland in this top-down incremental roguelite about a rusty car, a tiny fuel tank and a growing horde of raiders. Wreck, loot, upgrade your ride and climb all 18 wanted levels!

details.title: Necrowake: Bone Legion
details.short_description: Lead an undead army through waves of enemies in this action roguelite. Recruit elite minions, choose your formation, and combine equipment skills to build your legion. Pick your next battle through portals, defeat bosses, and spend your shards to grow stronger.

details.title: Doomsbell
details.short_description: An auto battler where every protocol plays by its own rules and your Commander fights beside your army. Choose your road through wagers, stories and bosses, merge and fit out your machines, then outbuild other players' armies, one turn at a time.

details.title: Ium Idle Companions Odyssey
details.short_description: Monster-collecting auto-battler desktop companion. Assemble, customize, strategize elemental synergies, craft powerful skill loadouts, and conquer regions as your squad fights autonomously in fast-paced real-time combat at the edge of your screen while you work, study, or play.

details.title: Aquarium Naturalist
details.short_description: An aquarium sim built in Unreal Engine 5 where equipment, feeding, and water chemistry interact like they do in real life. Hardy fish are as forgiving as the real thing; delicate ones demand real care. Crossbreed new morphs, or selectively breed delicate lines to handle tougher water.

details.title: FOCOM: Forward Operations Commander
details.short_description: Command your forces from a forward operating base in a land held by an insurgency. Order every soldier yourself, push patrol bases out, win over the towns and hunt down the camps the insurgents fight from. A real-time commander game on one living map that remembers what you do.

details.title: Apartment Empire
details.short_description: Build your own apartment empire, one floor at a time. Design flats, collect rent, manage tenants with very different needs, and try to keep everyone happy. Meet colourful characters, uncover their stories, and discover that some residents are not entirely from around here.
developers: I Was Supposed to Be Studying for My Exams and find an intern but Somehow I make a game and became a Game Developer and Accidentally Started My Own Studio Despite Having Absolutely No Experience, No Employees, No Budget, and No Idea How My Life Works, but Now I've Already Paid Steam $100 So I Guess I Have No Choice but to Finish This Game Before My Parents Find Out That I've Been Spending More Time Debugging Unity Than Studying for My Degree, and Even Though I Promised Myself I'd Go to Bed After Fixing Just One More Bug, It's Already 5 AM and the Bug Has Somehow Become a Feature.™
publishers: I Was Supposed to Be Studying for My Exams and find an intern but Somehow I make a game and became a Game Developer and Accidentally Started My Own Studio Despite Having Absolutely No Experience, No Employees, No Budget, and No Idea How My Life Works, but Now I've Already Paid Steam $100 So I Guess I Have No Choice but to Finish This Game Before My Parents Find Out That I've Been Spending More Time Debugging Unity Than Studying for My Degree, and Even Though I Promised Myself I'd Go to Bed After Fixing Just One More Bug, It's Already 5 AM and the Bug Has Somehow Become a Feature.™

details.title: Cursed Luck
details.short_description: The Devil owns your debt. The reels hold your fate. Cursed Luck is a dark fantasy roguelite where you build powerful symbol combinations, unleash explosive chain reactions, and bend luck in your favor. Chase massive wins, survive rising demands, and pay your debt before the Devil claims your soul.

details.title: Kixball
details.short_description: Kixball is top-down physics football where you are one player on the pitch. No animations, no auto-aim: just you, the ball and the walls. Train, earn transfer offers and rise from the lowest division in your career, or play with up to 3 friends on one screen.

details.title: Deep Rescue
details.short_description: Pilot a small rescue sub through a dark, glowing ocean. Gather schools of glowfish in your beam, outwit poachers, lead rare animals home and stay clear of the Gloam, the huge thing in the deep that hunts anything that glows.

details.title: Lost Subject
details.short_description: You are the result of a mysterious experiment, trapped in a dark underground facility. Solve puzzles, explore dangerous locations, unlock new characters, battle bosses, and find your way to freedom!

details.title: NOSTRA: Crystalbound
