details.short_description: An action roguelite from the world of NOSTRA. It is the year 860 of the Charter: crystal grows everywhere and no kingdom guards the roads. Take the merchants' coin as the Rune Warrior, etch runes into your abilities on every run and fight through three regions of a broken land.

details.title: Proviantmeister 1756
details.short_description: His Majesty’s army shall march – provided you keep it supplied! Manage depots, organize wagon trains, procure provisions, fodder and ammunition, and contend with weather and war. A historical military logistics simulation set during the Seven Years’ War, 1756–1763.

details.title: The Forgotten Workshop
details.short_description: A cozy alchemy idle game: brew potions, serve customers and hire little clay homunculi who keep the shop running, even while you're away. Explore the Grimoire, risk strange mixtures in the cauldron and bring three workshops full of surprises back to life.

details.title: One More Wave: Tower Defense
details.short_description: A tower defense game where you build towers along a road and hold off one wave after another. There are 9 towers with two upgrade paths each, 17 enemy types, 5 final bosses, 7 hand-made maps plus random ones, and an Endless mode.

details.title: Frog Express
details.short_description: Collect frogs and upgrade your express in an active incremental game! Power up manual collection, install automated modules, or combine both. Merge hats, fill your frog album, and unlock permanent upgrades to travel further with every run.

details.title: StarRanger
details.short_description: Lead a field team in a story-driven sci-fi RPG with turn-based squad combat. Build your squad's skills, choose its equipment, and make difficult calls on assignments with the Star Rangers - all while searching for your missing brother.

details.title: Grief the Server
details.short_description: The admins are away. Grief a voxel server in this single-player incremental: sabotage builds, unlock outrageous cheats and become everyone's problem. Simulated players repair, fight back and unite against you. Play in first person or send a bot in Idle Mode.

details.title: Battle Winds
details.short_description: A galaxy of over 7,000 stars lives on without you: trading, waging war, and falling back before the Reapers. Take the helm, jump to any star, set your ship down on a planet, and step outside, rifle in hand. Every battle, deal, and sortie you make reshapes the map everyone sees.

details.title: Dopamine Cube
details.short_description: A fast-paced roguelite shooter where every level-up is a slot machine spin. Dodge bullet storms, stack wild upgrades, fuse synergies into your own abilities and merge your guns to see how far your build can go.

details.title: Fantasy Guild Manager
details.short_description: Your heroes handle the fighting. Everything else is your problem. Recruit and level up adventurers, send them into auto-battles before quest timers run out, and grow your Guild Town in real time while Chaos creeps across the land.

details.title: Just Like the Photo
details.short_description: Someone turned these homes upside down. Now it’s your job to put them back together. Play solo or with friends and use photos taken before the mess to return every item to its original spot.

name: Kiel & Kontor – Vom Stamm zum Stapellauf

details.title: Kiel & Kontor – Vom Stamm zum Stapellauf
details.short_description: Manage a historical shipyard: design ships for customers, organise materials and skilled workers, negotiate contracts and expand your business. From simple rowing boats to great sailing ships, craftsmanship, quality and smart business decisions determine your success.

name: Skeletal Heroes: Attack of the Slimes

details.title: Skeletal Heroes: Attack of the Slimes
details.short_description: Six skeleton heroes, one bony adventure. Slash, shoot, smash and cast through 16 story chapters overrun by slimes. Swap heroes mid-fight to hit each monster’s weakness, unleash a super for every hero and topple giant bosses in this colorful third-person action RPG.

details.title: Blobbardment
details.short_description: Blobbardment is a turn-based artillery party game where every fighter is a blob of jelly. Swallow a bomb and spit it back, split in two, freeze the sea into a bridge, then knock your friends off the map. Play online, on one screen, against bots or in a story campaign.

details.title: Pocket Post.
details.short_description: Deliver the mail. Pocket Post is a minimal strategy game about managing post routes.

details.title: Jarlfall: Strandhögg
details.short_description: Strike the shore before the tide turns. Lead Viking raiders through tafl-style battles on sinking boards, grab loot village by village, and sail home to grow your Great Hall before luck runs out.

details.title: Cityterium
details.short_description: Cityterium is a multiplayer voxel sandbox where the real world becomes your canvas. Choose a city, build freely, tear things down, and reshape it with others, one block at a time.

details.title: Not Your Keys
details.short_description: Not Your Keys is a Bitcoin roguelike deckbuilder. Draft NFT cards, evolve them into stronger forms, and fight junk coins, frozen exchanges, and the Federal Reserve itself across a 21-block run to The Final Block.

details.title: Hidden Layer
details.short_description: See how AI really works by building it. Buffalo, 1958: the Navy has paid for a machine that learns. Write the Python that teaches it, from the first perceptron through backpropagation and deep learning to attention, the idea inside today's chatbots. A programming puzzle game about machine learning.

details.title: It's a Montage
details.short_description: A pixel-art training game with no opponents, where every level you gain shows on your character and the world around you. Once you outgrow the dojo, you train at a waterfall, on the open sea, on the moon, on a star and at the edge of a black hole.

details.title: Warband Incremental
details.short_description: Start with two footmen and build a warband of humans, orcs, elves, and undead in this voxel incremental auto-battler. Shape your formation, equip heroes, and unlock a vast tech tree. Battle through four chapters and giant bosses, then rebirth with your gear and unlocked factions intact.

details.title: Waterscape Atlas
details.short_description: Not a lake, not a river: the sea, fished the Japanese way. Surf, breakwaters, island rocks and boats on one life-size coast. 40 ways to fish from sabiki to squid jigging, 40+ species, real tackle logic, and every bite through a vibrating controller. Five dioramas included.

details.title: Saw Down
details.short_description: Turn a tiny robot with a saw into a machine that grinds through mountains of scrap. Gather resources, choose your upgrades, and unleash explosions, flying sawblades, and chain lightning. Grow stronger with every haul and cut your way deeper.

details.title: 三国：群英演义
details.short_description: You are no famed general or warlord. A nameless commoner, you enter a broken land with five villagers. Recruit and arm them; farmers become veterans beside you. These are no mere numbers. Old heroes are gone. Your story is unwritten. March on: legend, or footnote?

details.title: Kesselgrid
details.short_description: Turn-based grand strategy on a hex map, set in the First and Second World Wars. Run a nation's industry, politics and diplomacy, command its armies, fleets and air force, and break the enemy front. Play alone against the AI, in co-op or online against your friends.

details.title: Clash Pandemic: Forest Hell
details.short_description: You’re stuck in a gigantic forest. Chop wood, explore lost buildings, upgrade your swinging weapons, and spin your way through waves of zombies to a boss. Play alone or bring friends. Lots of blood. Much gore. Try not to die.

details.title: Foilage TCG : Collectors Edition
details.short_description: Foilage TCG: Collectors Edition is a single player fantasy trading card game. Build your ultimate deck, open booster packs, trade on the market, and hunt for rare Foil Refractors to take on your opponents. Collect and build your ultimate collection to load your binder and hard cases.

details.title: MimiCreate
details.short_description: Even aliens have exams! In MimiCreate, Mimics must learn to hide among humans before earning a license to visit Earth. Build disguises, blend in, and dodge the Inspectors in chaotic multiplayer hide-and-seek.

details.title: SPATHA
details.short_description: A side-scrolling shooter flown from the cockpit. Read what's ahead through the canopy, the terrain in the side view and the lanes in the top view — all three on screen at once. Harvest magic stones from alien beasts, buy the weapons you want, and dive into seven worlds the Ordo turned into nests.

details.title: Circuit Valley
details.short_description: Grow a thriving valley with a crew of little robots. Play as Pip to tend crops and build workshops, then put your helpers to work hauling harvests and keeping production moving. Turn a handful of apples into a place that hums with life.

details.title: DUNSPIN
details.short_description: Pull the lever. Recruit whatever heroes the reels hand you. Then watch them fight. DUNSPIN is a slot-machine auto-battler roguelike with deckbuilding, where one lucky spin can turn a losing run into a winning one.

details.title: Soul Crypt
details.short_description: Explore cursed crypts in Soul Crypt, a dark fantasy adventure filled with intense combat and terrifying creatures. Face deadly enemies, uncover the secrets of the depths, and fight to survive the darkness.

details.title: The Gigglebone Gang: AlphaBonk Farm
details.short_description: A is for AlphaBonk! Join Farmer Bonk and the Gigglebone Gang for a trip through the alphabet down on the farm — letters, rhymes, real farm photos and a barnyard full of silly games. A fully restored 1995 Headbone Interactive classic.

details.title: Idle Laps
details.short_description: An incremental racing game where you actually drive. Beat your best lap and turn it into ghosts that loop it endlessly, earning coins for you. Upgrade your ride, ascend, and master every circuit of an island racing festival.

details.title: Voyage of the Damned
details.short_description: A turn-based narrative survival voyage, 1904–05. Pile coal on the decks and you'll reach Dakar even if the colliers don't come. But the ships get slower and the men suffer for it. Decisions like this fill 224 days, from the Baltic to Tsushima.

details.title: ACE – Tennis is Life
details.short_description: Victoria von Arndt has it all: a villa, champagne, a world ranking. Then the tax investigators ring the doorbell. Arcade tennis with diving saves and special shots, 36 wild tournaments from Monte Carlo to a motorway services, and a fully voiced comic story from riches to Germany's rust belt.

details.title: Cloudwright
details.short_description: A cozy factory game for 1-8 players across a vast sky of floating islands. Every island holds something new, and it all connects: belts, ropeways and airships tie your islands into one ever-growing factory. Explore, meet the islanders, friend and foe, and brave the caves below.

details.title: Rooklite
details.short_description: A minimalist chess roguelite played on 4×4 boards, with the classic pieces and all the beauty of chess. Build your board and fight for checkmate.

details.title: Alandys
details.short_description: You don't catch creatures here: you are one. In this co-op action roguelite, every guardian plays like a raid boss: read the telegraphs, solve the mechanics, raise your kin and climb to the Summit. Solo, with AI teammates or up to 3 players online. Free to play.

details.title: Art Monolith
details.short_description: Discover art, one brick at a time. A relaxing clicking game where you break a giant cube. Painting masterpieces hide under every layer. Collect hundreds of them to hang in your own gallery, or join the world to break one massive cube in multiplayer mode.

details.title: The Last Warden
details.short_description: You are the last guardian of a city in a medieval post-apocalyptic world. An unknown plague has spread across the world, and every day is now a struggle for survival. Decide who may pass through the gates — and who must face the final sentence.

details.title: Unextinct
details.short_description: A post-apocalyptic online evolution game. Wake up as a cloned microbe at the bottom of a drowned world and evolve into a virus, a predator or something new. 180+ evolution paths, 90+ locations, riddle quests and real-time PvP with other players.

details.title: Arcana Autonoma: Fourteen Races
details.short_description: Twenty years after the War of Unification, Setsuna, daughter of the sky battleship's captain, descends to a land of fourteen races torn by blockades. Recruit the foes you beat, raise five cards and send them into auto battles - then decide where, and for whom, to spend your few skip tickets.

details.title: Flight Deck: Pacific 1942
details.short_description: Command a WWII carrier task force in real time. Find the enemy first, arm and launch your squadrons, plot their attack runs and survive the counterstrike. Fight six battles of 1942 by day and by night, design warships in the shipyard, share maps on the Steam Workshop and battle friends online.

details.title: Throw Weight: Fleet Doctrine
details.short_description: Hard sci-fi fleet command. No shields, no lasers — just missiles, point defense and electronic warfare.

details.title: ASHENSHIFT: Desktop RPG
details.short_description: ASHENSHIFT is a pixel-art RPG that lives on your desktop. Three heroes fight in a slim transparent window above the taskbar while you work. Talents, gear, the forge and a rule for every ability are yours to set. Enemies wind up in plain sight: break the cast or raise a shield.

details.title: Usogui:Contradiction Game
details.short_description: Come on, bid for weapons and items with limited gold coins. Offense? Or defense? Perhaps it will be revealed after the bell rings. Your sole purpose is to use your wisdom to win this gamble.

details.title: Reapercussions
details.short_description: Death is now your day job. Roll your bones, build poker hand variants and reap each Soul before your rolls run out. Stack cursed Relics and Hex Potions into absurd combos as you try and impress in your new role as a Reaper. It looks easy but looks are very deceiving.

details.title: Castle Back
details.short_description: Twelve years after the land collapsed, people live in fortresses on the backs of giant beasts. Stack yours block by block and send it into battle. Hit the right support and a whole tower comes down. Theirs, or yours. A cute voxel auto-battler roguelite.

details.title: Desktop Space Battles
details.short_description: Your desktop is the battlefield. Build and customise a fleet of 25 ships, command towering Capital Ships and unleash spectacular online space battles across your screen. Watch fighters clash, missiles hunt and hulls shatter as you challenge rival commanders on Steam.

details.title: Ludus Magna
details.short_description: Ludus Magna combines auto-battler combat, gladiator management, and strategic quick-time events in a dark, run-based strategy game set in ancient Rome. Lead your gladiator school as a Lanista, develop unique fighters, manage gold and risk, and keep your House from bankruptcy.

details.title: Cursor's Tale
details.short_description: An incremental game where your cursor becomes a hero. You battle monsters and collect their loot. Upgrade your skill tree, from basic upgrades to game-changing abilities. Craft gear from monster materials you collected to go even further beyond. Get back before night falls.

details.title: Clanker Buster
details.short_description: Build an armed truck, wire your weapons and command your crew in this action roguelike. Raid machine-controlled ruins for supplies and survivors, bring them back to humanity’s last settlement, and unlock permanent abilities for your next expedition.

details.title: Tinymon Tactics
details.short_description: A cozy roguelite autobattler. Set sail for Verdantia, an archipelago where curious little creatures called Tinymon roam every island. Befriend them, help them evolve, and shape them into a team strong enough to challenge the arena leaders waiting at the end of each island.

details.title: Drop Dead Lucky
details.short_description: Every bounce is a gamble. Make yours count. Drop Dead Lucky is a Plinko roguelite where you aim your drops, nudge fate in your favor, and combine charms, runes, and spirits to build huge scores and survive eight escalating antes.

details.title: EconoCity
details.short_description: A shared-world city builder and economy game. Buy land, lay roads, build block by block, sell power and water, and set your rent. Every rival is a real player, every price was set by one, and the city keeps running when you log off.

details.title: Quiet Hours
details.short_description: It's 2AM, the truck is loud, your friends are louder, and everybody on this street is a light sleeper. Quiet Hours is online co-op for 1–4 players on a night garbage route, where your real voice is noise the street can hear. Microphone strongly recommended.#

details.title: Zombie Mall Defense
details.short_description: Zombie Mall Defense is a game in which you defend your malls from ever-bigger zombie hoard waves that come from every direction. Expand the map, build and discover new turrets, find new zombie types and destroy their houses...

details.title: The Last Shop Before Kingsfall
details.short_description: Run the last shop on the road to Kingsfall in this cozy first-person medieval shop sim. Stock your shelves, set your prices and outfit the heroes who pass through. They have names. Out there, they can die for good. What you sell them decides who comes back.

details.title: Meet The LeaderSheep
details.short_description: Thousands of sheep. One pen. Grab up to 3 friends who are no help at all and get the flock home before dark. They’ll panic over nothing and happily follow each other off a cliff. So will the sheep. Bring in the most and you’re the LeaderSheep. Nobody said you’d be a good one.

details.title: Klocky
details.short_description: The world moves too fast. Fit gears under the lamp and hear your machine’s first tick. Klocky is a calm clockwork-building game where every tooth drives the next. Follow hand-drawn plans and discover mechanical history and ingenuity through engraving-style illustrated books.

details.title: RIP-OFF
details.short_description: Buy booster packs from Panda, a shady raccoon dealer, and slice them open with one swipe of a knife. Collect, stack, sell and archive 280 pixel-art cards across four series, then upgrade your table until the packs open themselves.

name: Desktop Smash! - Idle Loot & Colony Sim

details.title: Desktop Smash! - Idle Loot & Colony Sim
details.short_description: A tiny guild base keeps running on your taskbar. Your adventurers push the monster horde back and bring home wood, stone and iron. Grow your facilities, set rules for crafting and selling, and the loot sorts itself. Desktop Smash! is base building and automation at the bottom of your screen.

name: Deep Space Dapper Squad: Guiding Stars

details.title: Deep Space Dapper Squad: Guiding Stars
details.short_description: General L. has vanished, Agent, and only YOU can find him. A dapper 1-bit roguelite shmup. Pick from 20+ ships, keep your energy in check, mod your ship mid-run and dive through black holes into ever-deeper space.

details.title: Undead Showdown
details.short_description: 4v4v4v4 zombie survival. Hold your stronghold through ten rounds, gear up from a shared bank, and risk it at the casino. Your first eligible survival death gives you one chance in Limbo. Then the gates open: last squad standing wins.

details.title: Ink Left
details.short_description: You are a stick figure on an unfinished page, abandoned mid-stroke. Draw bridges, ropes, springs and mirrors with the ink the artist left behind — every line obeys real physics. Slip past crossed-out beasts across fading paper. Ink runs out. In the end, you will have to erase part of yourself.

details.title: I, Hurricane
details.short_description: You are the hurricane. Spawn storms across five seas, steer them toward the coast and push them toward 300 mph while humanity promises to act “by 2050.” Or switch sides and defend it: run the hurricane hunters’ base, fly into the eye, forecast the track and issue the warnings.

name: The Last Interview: Into the Furnace

details.title: The Last Interview: Into the Furnace
details.short_description: Read the case files, interrogate the robots, and decide their fate: back to society, or into the furnace. Your verdicts genuinely shape how the city develops — and watch out for the robots who refuse to jump.

details.title: Web Scaping
details.short_description: You are a cursor loose on WikiNet, a living encyclopedia. Crawler bots are hunting you. Click from article to article to reach your target before the swarm indexes you.

details.title: Dread Bids
details.short_description: A first-person horror auction. Bid against three desperate rivals on cursed relics, read their nerves and snipe before the hammer falls, then survive whatever you bought. Every night, the poorest guest does not go home.

details.title: Drift Goblin
details.short_description: Drift a pickup truck through thousands of goblins while the voxel city around you breaks apart. Bolt on a new build every run from a goblin dealer's hundreds of parts: flamethrowers, rocket pods, wrecking balls. Also, one of the goblins stole your cow, Betsy. Get her back.

details.title: Sigilbound
details.short_description: A dark fantasy auto battler RPG you buy once. Collect champions from six factions, build your team of five, then sit back and watch it fight. No energy, no shop, no paid summons: every champion is earned in play.

details.title: Roof UP!
details.short_description: Build a cozy floating hex island where every building grows as tall as it is happy. Cottages love trees, windmills love fields, lighthouses love the sea. Place each piece where its neighbors lift it up, and watch your skyline climb through the seasons.

details.title: Ring Hunt
details.short_description: Ring Hunt: an original 2-8 player online movement-driven social deduction — trapped together, you may only kill your next number, then inherit their target until only you remain. Kill wrong and YOU die instead. 10-min matches — bring all your mind games against your frenemies to outlast all watching

details.title: Gnome Acres
details.short_description: A cozy farming game where a village of gnomes does the work. Draw fields, pick what grows, and watch your gnomes plant, water, harvest and haul every crop through spring, summer, autumn and winter.

name: Epokborn: From Stone to the Stars

details.title: Epokborn: From Stone to the Stars
details.short_description: An open-world survival crafting game where every era changes how you fight. Storm castles, board pirate ships, ride through the Wild West, and drive WWII tanks into battle. Craft weapons, build towns, and grow an industrial empire through the ages, solo or with friends.

details.title: $1 Pizza Slice
details.short_description: Run a cozy New York pizza shop where every slice costs $1. Roll dough, prepare toppings, bake and cut pizzas, then serve hungry neighbors. Shop for ingredients, upgrade your kitchen, share leftovers, and chip away at your debt one slice at a time.

details.title: Hopworth the Wizard
details.short_description: Hopworth the Wizard is a challenging, colourful 2.5D platformer. A Gargoyle King has taken over Hopworth's Wizard tower while he was off questing. Journey home through forests, hills and mountain passes, leap the King's enchanted boulders and climb the tower to serve its eviction notice.

details.title: Quest For Stoken
details.short_description: A gloriously weird skateboarding sword platformer. Grind rails through ancient Greece, outer space and the depths of Atlantis, slash your way past frogs, aliens and killer bees, and battle bosses that make no sense at all, all to collect the mysterious Stoken.

details.title: Pegoda
details.short_description: Climb a haunted Japanese Pagoda in this pachinko roguelite. Build a bag of enchanted balls, fuse powerful evolutions, and place pegs mid-shot to turn a falling ball into a huge combo. Unlock new characters and defeat the guardians standing between you and the Emperor.

details.title: Crack & Stack
details.short_description: Race up to six friends to stack dice and crack puzzles in this chaotic party game! Based on the 2025 board game, Crack & Stack, you can now play online, split-screen, or solo against the commentary team, and turn on Chaos Mode for rounds that bend all the rules!

name: Order Filled: A Trading Desk Story

details.title: Order Filled: A Trading Desk Story
details.short_description: A stock trading sim with a story mode and a free mode. Story mode: you start as a new trader on a US desk in 2010, with a tutorial week, client orders and an evening review of your fills. Free mode: open an account, pick your stake and trade a generated market, with margin and short selling.

details.title: GHOSTGRID
details.short_description: Take freelance hacking jobs in a port city. Break into fictional networks with real commands, investigate breaches, write the report, then go out and pay the rent. Everything you do leaves a record, and investigators read them. 153 real techniques, and the game checks that you did them.

details.title: Round One, Fight!
details.short_description: A laid-back incremental auto battler straight off a '90s video-store shelf. Build your fighter, let him throw the punches, and come back stronger after a beating. 25 opponents, 5 acts, a skill tree, and a little romance.

details.title: Liquidation Inc.
details.short_description: A co-op physics horror for 1-4 friends: buy out the contents of haunted, foreclosed homes and haul everything to your van before the timer runs out. Every scratch costs money - and something still lives there.

details.title: Cave Saga
details.short_description: Explore the caves in this action-adventure platformer. Jump, dash, pick up, and throw objects or creatures to help escape the various complex cave systems. Each biome you explore contains unique mechanics and aesthetics. Play solo or with up to 4 players in local co-op!

details.title: Fishly: Desktop Aquarium
details.short_description: A tiny pixel-art aquarium that lives on your desktop. Your fish swim, eat, sleep at night and earn gold while you work. Breed rare colours, fill your album, decorate your tank or let them swim across your whole wallpaper

details.title: Sharktooth Bay
details.short_description: Dig for shark teeth, sift through the sand, and stock a seaside fossil shop with what you find. Set your prices, arrange your displays, and sell to visiting beachgoers. Keep your favorite finds for your own collection.

details.title: Seoul Night Bites
details.short_description: Run a tiny Korean street-food stall after midnight. Pick ingredient cards, cook 64 real Korean dishes and chain recipes into huge combos in this cozy roguelite deckbuilder. Pay the rent, then see how long you last in Endless Nights.

details.title: SkyAceBlitz
details.short_description: Top-down roguelike aerial shooter. Engage in realistic inertia dogfights, shoot down foes with machine guns and homing missiles. Gather random upgrades every run for distinct builds. Play with friends via Remote Play Together!

name: Drink Cola. Get a Fighter Jet!

details.title: Drink Cola. Get a Fighter Jet!
details.short_description: The fighter jet prize is no joke. This cola company actually delivers. Crack open colas, rack up points, and fight with powerful prizes. The ultimate goal: a fighter jet. A top-down shooter incremental where you grow endlessly stronger and collect dangerous prizes.

details.title: Rainfed
details.short_description: Build and run your own farm in a pixel-art management sim. Grow crops, breed livestock and turn your harvest into products to sell. Buy land and machinery, hire workers and set plans to keep the work moving. Expand the business, shape the farm and try not to go broke.

details.title: Breaking Protocol
details.short_description: Dodge bullets in a fast bullet hell boss rush against parodies of AI models. Every attack is telegraphed and you build your own playstyle from 64 exploits. Singleplayer, two players locally or online, plus 2 to 8 player raids.

details.title: Clickbait Arcade
details.short_description: You've seen the ads. Pull the pin, pick the door, run through the x3 gate. The games never existed... until now. Clickbait Arcade is 12 fake mobile-ad games made real, in a neon arcade, with no ads, no energy timers and no pay-to-win.

details.title: Captain's Wake
details.short_description: Loot, level, legend! Captain's Wake is a pirate action RPG on a cutthroat sea, where rival captains level up, loot and hunt just like you. Every ship has a captain with a fortune to chase and a long memory. Will you be friend or foe? Chart your own course and become a legendary pirate.

details.title: UNHOLY PEPPERONI
details.short_description: A tiny pizzeria. A sister you love. A tragedy you can't escape. Run a pizzeria where the nights are unsettling, and every slice comes with a side of something sinister. But no matter how hard you try to keep the business, some things refuse to stay buried.

details.title: Monsters & Banknotes
details.short_description: Open a backstreet monster shop on borrowed money. Buy, breed, raise and sell 141 species, build valuable bloodlines, prove them in the arena and trade at the grand auction. Pay the underworld tribute or defend your shop in this pixel-art management sim.

details.title: MAGICA☆REVERSI!
details.short_description: Reversi, but magical girls fire rocket launchers. Shuffle the board, flip every disc, warp in for a one-hit win. Fall behind and your comeback magic charges up. Lose the disc your character stands on and you lose on the spot. Every disc you're ahead is in-game prize money. 50 3D boards.

details.title: Bayani: Auto Ascent
details.short_description: A naked hero. A ten-floor tower. A Rival who drafts from the same cards you do. Build your hero piece by piece - gear, spells and fighting techniques - and watch the fights play out automatically. Take the card they need, or the card you need? At the top, you duel to the death.

details.title: Little Brigade: Desktop Battler
details.short_description: A relaxing (because apparently you're not involved) idle auto-battler that sits in the corner of your screen while you go about your day.

details.title: Moji Snake
details.short_description: Fight to survive this snake roguelike with quick adventures or endless runs.

details.title: Earn Your Stripes
details.short_description: A single-player WWII shooter where you start as a Private, rank up, and gain command of an entire army. Fight in battles of hundreds of soldiers on procedurally generated battlefields, from the Normandy beaches to the Rhine. Lead a squad, plan attacks on the map, crew tanks and call in bombers.

details.title: Realmwake
details.short_description: Recruit and merge an everchanging roster of combatants in this roguelike autobattler. Arrange your squad, discover powerful synergies, and venture through a world shattered by the four colliding realms.

details.title: Fever
details.short_description: Experience the beautiful horror of a hostile alien planet in this co-op survival FPS. Explore, mine resources, craft weapons, and fortify outposts with turrets and traps. When the sky rains blood, fight hundreds of creatures and survive the Fever.

details.title: NEON DESCENT
details.short_description: Half human, half machine, D dives into a neon cyberspace with J, the AI who refuses to leave his side. Fuse together, outsmart 12 bosses that each demand a different strategy, and descend to the Core to learn why the children vanished.

details.title: Kill the AI
details.short_description: An action roguelike set in a dystopian future where the tech titans who built the AI are sent to kill it. Gun down swarms of glitching machines, level up, hack terminals, build your loadout and transform your weapon mid-run. No permanent upgrades: every win is pure skill.

details.title: Folkwyrd
details.short_description: A fantasy colony sim and city builder where every villager has a life of their own. Build and customize a floating island settlement, manage a living population, shape generations, and explore a persistent multiplayer world where every choice leaves a mark.

details.title: They Are Zombies
details.short_description: Gather by day. Survive by night. Team up with friends, collect resources, and craft what you need before the zombies come. Survive 15 nights of attacks—and find out whether your brilliant plan can actually get you through to morning.

details.title: Math Combo Chain
details.short_description: A tower defense where ammo is limited and math is your reload.

details.title: Bukchon Anomaly
details.short_description: A first-person anomaly horror game on a looping street inspired by Seoul's Bukchon Hanok Village. You get one photo per passage. At the gate, report whether anything changed. Three wrong reports end your run, and some anomalies come for you before you get there.

details.title: Monster Hunting Supplies
details.short_description: A supernatural mystery game where customers bring disturbing rumors and strange encounters to your workshop. Ask questions, study your field guide, and prepare the right ammunition. Every story holds a clue, and some are connected.

details.title: Second On Ice
details.short_description: Fast, top-down ice hockey with a story-driven single-player career. Skate, pass, check, and score from snowy neighborhood rinks to pro arenas as you step out of your brother's shadow. Play quick matches, league seasons, and international tournaments in a pixel-art hockey world.

details.title: XenoTrax
details.short_description: Race powerful alien off-road vehicles across five extraordinary worlds. Choose your driver, tackle rugged tracks, compete in championships, and chase your own ghost. Take on computer rivals or race with friends in up to four-player local split-screen.

details.title: Ocean Dredgers
details.short_description: Dive solo or with up to 3 friends, dredge sunken wrecks for lost treasures, brush and rinse your finds, and display them in your shipboard museum to earn upgrades and explore deeper waters in first or third person.

details.title: Secret of Nox
details.short_description: Immerse yourself in this action roguelike game, turn defeated enemies into your minions. Explore 12+ unique classes, endless playstyles, battle through 50+ maps, epic bosses and discover the Secret of Nox.

details.title: I Missed the Apocalypse 2
details.short_description: You missed the apocalypse. Now it’s up to you to take back the Earth. Gather, craft and build your base with your flying companion Eddy, survive Alien attacks every night, free mind controlled humans and smash every Alien Heart, from Scandinavia to the whole world.

details.title: Heartwood TD
details.short_description: A maze tower defense roguelite where every tower is also a wall. Plant Wardens to shape the path the nightmares walk, combine their powers into chain reactions, and grow a stronger maze with every run.

details.title: Full Bleed
details.short_description: A knight doodled in the margin of a cursed bestiary wakes unarmed in a plague abbey overrun by its monsters. Cleave, shoot and bleed through four episodes of fast, gory boomer-shooter carnage, drawn in heavy stylized comic ink and dither, where blood is the reddest thing on the page.

details.title: Death Draft
details.short_description: A team FPS where every round adds a new bad idea. Draft cards that give enemies huge heads, turn you into a giant or bend the fight in your favor. Everyone gets the same weapons. The cards are up to you. Play with friends or bots in matches up to 5v5.

details.title: Secret Shelter
details.short_description: Once a corporate tycoon, you now run a shelter in a nuclear wasteland. Use cards at your corporate terminal to oversee production and research. Decide who you can spare for expeditions, fight with skill cards, and choose which survivors to trust as you piece together the truth behind the war.

details.title: NEW COLD WAR
details.short_description: Lead the United States or China in a turn-based strategy board game. Play cards, expand your influence, and compete across six regions while managing the technology race and a global crisis that could end the game.

details.title: Planet Defender
details.short_description: An incremental shooter about protecting Earth from meteor storms. Upgrade your rockets, build an orbital arsenal of lasers, railguns and moons, and get strong enough to face the Titan.

details.title: PAEBACTORY
details.short_description: A 3D automation game in an asteroid belt for 1 to 4 players. Mine and crack open asteroids, automate production with belts and drones, and keep your turrets supplied when announced raids hit, even while you work in another sector.

details.title: Mine a Little
details.short_description: Mine a Little is a fun and relaxing mining game! Control your pickaxe with your mouse, smash rocks, and collect valuable ores! Upgrade your pickaxe, break tougher rocks, and unlock new mining areas as you work your way toward becoming the ultimate miner!

details.title: Super Empire
details.short_description: Build a supermarket from a corner store to a hypermarket. Stock shelves that really empty, staff real shifts, price against rival stores, and keep every shopper happy, from dawn delivery to closing time, through every season.

details.title: Cleared for Profit: Airline Management
details.short_description: Run an airline in one evening. Open routes across North America, set every fare and buy or lease every aircraft, then watch the month play out. Every number explains itself, Corvane Air fights back, and you can go broke. Buy once, no timers.

details.title: RUGGED
details.short_description: RUGGED is first-person survival for one to four players. Fell trees, haul logs back to camp, craft tools, and hunt for food. Build a cabin on your own or host your existing world for friends through online or LAN co-op.

details.title: Matter of State
details.short_description: Boil, freeze, melt and condense matter on its way across small island boards, in as few parts as you can. 184 puzzles, a new one every day, and a level editor with Workshop sharing.

details.title: Revive The Beast
details.short_description: A short story-based active incremental game where you reanimate animals by drawing inscription patterns. Learn about the tragic past of the necromancer and become powerful once again.

details.title: The Iliad - Wrath of Achilles
details.short_description: A roguelike deckbuilder of Greek myth that faithfully follows Homer's Iliad. Achilles' wrath is your weapon: the angrier he grows, the harder he strikes and the more Troy fears him. But to win the last fight, he must master it. Told in real engravings and paintings from the 17th to the 19th century.

details.title: Bordertide
details.short_description: Grow a small banner into an empire, one tile at a time — alone against cunning computer nations, or online with up to 7 friends. Expand, build, sail, strike and make pacts in quick 10-minute matches, on fresh maps or a real map of the Earth.

details.title: SAIJAN: Dice Mahjong
details.short_description: A dice mahjong roguelite for riichi players. Roll tile dice, place Melds, stack Charms and send Fu × Han soaring. 22 Yaku from Riichi to Big Three Dragons, plus 10 SAIJAN Yaku for columns, diagonals and Pip totals. Beat every Boss to complete a 15–20 minute run. 2–4 player co-op with Steam friends.

details.title: Ash Company
details.short_description: A command-and-management game about running a mercenary company. Hire mercs, fit their gear, mark routes on the op map and send them into the ruins. During an op, the only way to intervene is by radio. Loot carried out by the squad pays wages and grows the base.

details.title: Bricked
details.short_description: Bricked is a city-building sandbox set on a tabletop above the clouds. Build a toy-brick city piece by piece, set kaiju, mechs and armies against each other, and watch every strike tear it apart. Put every brick back with one click, then fly, drive and ride through the city you made.

details.title: YellowJacket
details.short_description: This is a 2D platformer adventure game set in a world that has lost its color, where you retrieve scattered jackets to color the world again. Discover the rules of color and begin your journey to restore the lost colors.

details.title: Whisker Tinkers
details.short_description: Dig through boxes filled with junk, organize them in your warehouse and fulfill client orders by crafting their desired items from your gathered materials. Protect your shiny treasures from sneaky raccoons and prepare your store for inspections. Don't forget to hide what you don't want to be seen...

details.title: Coindrop Dungeon
details.short_description: Coindrop Dungeon is a Pachinko inspired dungeon crawler. Your coins and pegs from the board are your inventory. Explore builds, create synergies and break the curse that keeps you in the ever changing dungeon.

details.title: Sails of Salt
details.short_description: Set sail and become a pirate legend in this roguelite sandbox. Every voyage, a new sea: plunder, capture ships, lead your fleet and shape your crew. Greed makes you rich. Or dead. How much will you risk?

details.title: Hendichen
details.short_description: Chaotic co-op cooking for 2 or 3 players, with real recipes and a real kitchen. THE CHEF knows every recipe but has one working hand. MUFFLES barely hears you. WOBBLES reads every order as a different dish. Talk to each other, or the kitchen burns.

details.title: Touhou: Marisa! Cook It!
details.short_description: Reimu praised Sakuya's cooking one time too many, so Marisa announced she would handle the next banquet herself. Build a deck of ingredients, pour it into her magic cauldron, and watch the collisions and danmaku chain out of control. A physics-based deckbuilding roguelike.

details.title: Anthill Wars: Ant Colony Sim
details.short_description: Grow an ant colony from a single queen into a thriving empire. Raid rival anthills, steal their brood, and strengthen your colony with captured ants. Defend your territory from giant insects and expand your nest. When the time comes, release a swarm of winged queens and begin again in distant lands.

details.title: Pupmancer
details.short_description: Pupmancer is a top-down 3D action roguelite where you fight through dangerous dungeons as a magic-wielding pup. Discover powerful spells, loot, craft potions, and build your pup’s abilities to survive each run. Adventure solo or team up online with friends to take on enemies or fight in PvP battles.

details.title: Genome Fracture
details.short_description: A fast-paced bullet heaven roguelite where reality fractures every 2 minutes. Evolve powerful mutation families, unleash devastating synergies, and create game-breaking builds as the battlefield transforms around you. Can you survive the Convergence?

details.title: Forgotten Grounds
details.short_description: Survive alone in a pixel-art wilderness where daylight can kill you. Scavenge abandoned shelters, craft essential tools, and face predators. Plan your expeditions around the sun and weather, because staying indoors won't keep you alive forever.

details.title: Blek and the Endless Keep
details.short_description: Guide Blek through the twisting grey halls of the Endless Keep as they work to get their memories back! Fight back the Keep's monstrous spawn, meet it's unique denizens, and make thorough use of the art of cat necromancy to find your way back home! The Keep can't truly be Endless, can it?

details.title: Puppet's Trial
details.short_description: Puppet's Trial is a horror game where you incarnate a Puppet. With decaying life and the desire to find a purpose, You will face multiple trials to try to prove your worth to your maker. And eventually meet him.

details.title: After Green
details.short_description: A survivors-like where you build towers. Suit up in ridiculous outfits, gun down cute zombie hordes, drop turrets in their path, and stack absurd relic-and-tower synergies. Pick your route across a branching map to the Horde King, solo or online co-op. Die, and your Last Wish carries you back.

details.title: Grim Gambit
details.short_description: A card-puzzle roguelite where every card you place on a dungeon grid is a higher-or-lower bet. Guess wrong and part of your board explodes. Poker hands heal you, counting cards is encouraged, and the Grim Reaper runs the table. One standard 52-card deck. Fill the grid. Cheat death.

details.title: Dawn Of The Realm
details.short_description: Dawn Of The Realm is a medieval real-time strategy game. Build cities, manage resources and raise armies. Zoom straight out to a strategy map of the whole continent and back down to the battlefield, with no loading and no separate mode. Up to 10 players.

details.title: Obolisk
details.short_description: COSMIC COMBAT DECIDED ONE COIN AT A TIME... Obolisk is a turn-based tactical roguelike where your party of Obols use coin flips to attack, defend, and unleash unique abilities. Plan ahead, survive each encounter, and see if you can make it to the OBOLISK.

details.title: Tales of Twin Souls
details.short_description: "Tales of Two Souls" is a 2D open-world xianxia RPG. Explore, fight, and cultivate with the soul bound to you. Uncover your family's fall, rebuild your ancestral home, meet allies and rivals, and forge your own path.

details.title: Don't duck with me
details.short_description: Cook with the fruit you kill in a cozy fantasy incremental. Cut down fruit monsters, blend them into delicious smoothies and grow your beach bar! Your goal: a boss with 1.5 billion HP.

details.title: No Neutral Ground
details.short_description: Master magnetic polarity in a fast-paced, physics-driven robot party game for 1-8 players. Attract, repel, dash, and outmaneuver rivals across 20+ Mini Games, Magnetic Football, and a sprawling Scrap Raid. Customize your machine and claim the arena.

details.title: Deeper
details.short_description: Your mission is to recover lost and forgotten artifacts. Set out with your crew on underwater expeditions ever more hostile, ever darker, ever deeper...

details.title: Bulgasari: Blocks & Bullets
details.short_description: Bulgasari: Blocks & Bullets is a multitasking action roguelike where combat and block puzzle happen at the same time. Devour scrap to grow stronger, create your own build, and survive against endless machine hordes.

details.title: Lightbound : A Rolling Ball Game
details.short_description: A racing platformer. Take control of a ball and set off on a wildly dangerous adventure. Master your momentum, chain power-ups, outwit the enemies on your tail, and whatever you do — don't fall. Solo or split-screen for up to 4 players.

details.title: Whale Life Simulator
details.short_description: Experience the life of a whale. Hit the streets, earn cash, and pour massive amounts of money into an online game. Use your maxed-out account to crush other players!

details.title: The Facility
details.short_description: You look different today. Yesterday, you looked different too. Which one is really you? A psychological horror game about paranoia, identity, and the fear of trusting the wrong person.

details.title: Lots at Stake
details.short_description: Build a property development company from the ground up. Find undervalued land, negotiate acquisitions, design profitable estates, navigate planning and construction, finance your projects and sell into a changing property market where every decision affects your return.

details.title: First Age
details.short_description: A turn-based strategy card game set in the Neolithic Age. Sacrifice villagers, tame mammoths, and build powerful card synergies to lead your tribe through the threat of the Dark Ages. Will your people stand the test of time?

details.title: Battlecaster 2
details.short_description: Battlecaster 2 is an intense top-down action roguelite. Descend to the center of a hostile world where control, precision, and aggression decide every fight. Push forward and dismantle enemy pressure through skillful play. Shape powerful, expressive builds as danger rises.

details.title: Rustborn - Outland Threat
details.short_description: You’re a cowboy abducted by aliens who accidentally ends up with a biomechanical arm. Run, climb, and shoot like crazy to survive hordes of deadly robots in this third-person bullet-hell shooter. Conquer the mothership and find your way back home!

details.title: Burnknowe Golf Club
details.short_description: A cosy golf club tycoon in a painted Scottish landscape. Design the course, sculpt the ground, keep the greens perfect and your members happy, and grow your club from a handful of holes into a destination worth the trip.

details.title: Frostmason
details.short_description: Hunt monsters for their body parts. Assemble them into a full specimen as part of a Cold War project

details.title: Phantom of Orion
details.short_description: A WW2 submarine sim in space. Alone in an unfinished stealth prototype, run cold and dark through alien convoy lanes, strike from cloak, then vanish before the swarm sweeps back. The cloak that hides you also blinds you.

details.title: How Much For It?
details.short_description: Run a second-hand shop. Hear out your customers, value strange items, and make your offer. Some lie, some hide important details, and some deals may bring more into your shop than you bargained for.

details.title: TrueClash
details.short_description: An emotional visual novel following the journeys of several fighters. Your choices shape their lives and dictate how the story unfolds. These characters have souls of their own—will you bring yours into the mix?

details.title: Parcel Point Simulator
details.short_description: Sort, Scan, Deliver and Grow — Turn a corner parcel point into a fully-automized money machine, and build your logistic empire.

details.title: CatBall
details.short_description: CatBall is a physics-based roguelite builder: arm your cat, toss it into battle, watch it roll, crash, and swing on its own, and switch weapons at the right moment to send enemies flying.

details.title: Nightmare Delivery
details.short_description: Enter distorted minds and deliver packages to the darkness within. Play alone or in online co-op for up to 4 players, explore nightmarish locations, solve environmental puzzles, outsmart dangerous entities, and escape alive.

details.title: INFAZ
details.short_description: Fight your way through tense tactical firefights. Plant or defuse the bomb, take on the opposing team, or test your aim in solo matches. Use your weapons, grenades, sound awareness, and the minimap to gain the advantage

details.title: Dead Sector: Rogue
details.short_description: Pick a core, rewrite how you fight. Reload and meteors fall. Ice spikes rise, dash to shatter them. Sprint and lightning strikes. Fight in style to climb from D to S rank and make it all strike more often. A fast FPS roguelite with two guns, a combat dog and a station stuck in a time loop

details.title: Farm Hand
details.short_description: A brain-bending deckbuilder about setting up huge harvest combos! Enhance your deck, discover game-changing synergies, and plan your harvests to maximize your score. Every crop has a timer. Every harvest is a puzzle. Every combo feels incredible.

details.title: Blindstep
details.short_description: A robot with no forward vision. You can only walk backwards and the moment you turn to look where you're going, the screen goes black. Ten sectors of collapsing floors, hydraulic presses and things that patrol the dark. Every jump is taken blind.

details.title: Delphyr: The Deep Whispers
details.short_description: Dig to the last living core of a dead world. Delphyr is a 2D action roguelite where every death sends you home to the family whose bond the Deep cannot break — upgrade with them, then dig deeper. Hand-crafted spells, a grapnel, telekinetic mining magic, and titan bosses await below.

details.title: LockLine
details.short_description: LockLine is a tense turn-based tactics game. Think 3-in-a-row, but lining up your units calls down an orbital strike. Outthink an enemy trying to do the same to you. Grab jetpacks and shields, pin enemies, drop barriers and smoke screens, and face boss commanders who change the rules.

details.title: Saving San Martino
details.short_description: A stealth adventure where you spray graffiti to reclaim Sicily from the mafia. Pick locks, tag turf, and build your base on the Mediterranean coast.

details.title: Plasma Sky
details.short_description: This week, every pilot on Earth flies the same new seeded run: identical enemies, identical drops, pure skill. Flow through alien formations, arm your wingmen, and power up when you can. Out-score your friends in Plasma Sky, an arcade shmup with over 100 handcrafted levels. Blast into the neon sky!

details.title: Astral Bounty
details.short_description: Astral Bounty is a demanding 2D arcade side-scroller straight out of the ’90s. Blast through hand-built enemy waves, hunt four bounties, earn credits and blow them on beefy upgrades in the shop. You’re going to need them. 3 difficulty levels, 4 ships, mercy optional.

details.title: Roma Eterna Sons of Mars
details.short_description: Gather your legions, build defenses, and conquer territory for ROME! Explore a doomed world, research new technologies, and uncover the legacy of Mars. "Roma Eterna: Sons of Mars" is a strategy and tower defense game. ROME WILL NEVER FALL!

details.title: Third Surveillance Bureau
details.short_description: Watch the monitors, spot anomalies, and protect citizens in the dead of night. The Third Surveillance Bureau is a 2D horror game centered on surveillance. Cycle through camera feeds, report irregularities in time, and uncover a reality far more terrifying than monsters.

details.title: Fifth Tier
details.short_description: Fast, readable football management. You don't just pick the XI — you own the club. Take a small side from the fourth tier of a five-tier pyramid towards the top: tactics, wages, stands, academy, shares. Then sell up and buy a bigger club. A whole season can be played in an evening.

details.title: Space Industry
details.short_description: Build and automate your own modular space fleet in this sandbox base-building game. Mine asteroids, expand your ship, fight enemies, explore new star systems, and uncover the deepest secrets of the universe.

details.title: Porcelain
details.short_description: Porcelain is a first-person stealth extraction game set in a dark steampunk city. Infiltrate guarded districts, stay hidden, recover mysterious Reveries, and escape before you are caught. No guns. No easy way out.

details.title: Mombasa Conspiracy
details.short_description: Join Connor O'Ryan and his inseparable friend Brian Moloney in a classic Point & Click thriller that will take them from the gloomy streets of Dublin to the sweltering heat of Kenya, where they will become embroiled in a conspiracy hidden in time.

name: GRUBSTAKE: A Post Apocalyptic Pawn Shop

details.title: GRUBSTAKE: A Post Apocalyptic Pawn Shop
details.short_description: GRUBSTAKE is a single-player, first-person, post-apocalyptic pawn shop sim. Run a barter shop in the wasteland... if you can out-haggle the survivors at your counter. No money. No price tags. Trade, craft, restock, repeat. Be on the caravan by day 30.

details.title: The Deep Calls
details.short_description: Build every hero your way in The Deep Calls, a turn based Lovecraftian roguelite dungeon crawler. Choose distinct Disciplines, mix unlocked Skills , embrace dangerous Traits, and equip hard won relics. Forge powerful party synergies, then risk those builds in branching dungeons with no retreat.

details.title: Age of Crowns
details.short_description: Captain a free company across a medieval kingdom of four crowns. Hire swords, keep them fed and paid, and climb seven rungs from sellsword to king. Your veterans earn names, the captain who beats you may come back with one, and every fight is decided by orders you read before you commit.

details.title: Apawcalypse: Corrupted Brain
details.short_description: Lead a team of three animal survivors in a roguelike deckbuilder where every character has their own deck. Coordinate a shared Action Point pool, Intercept attacks to protect allies, and build powerful team synergies to survive the corruption.

details.title: Woks & Works
details.short_description: Build and automate your restaurant empire. Manage chefs, customers, supplies, and production chains in a living food economy.

details.title: BlackHole Collapse
details.short_description: You are a stationary black hole, growing more powerful with every run. Devour crystals, fend off relentless swarms and volatile anomalies, and unleash devastating gravitational blasts to survive the void in this fast-paced action roguelite.

details.title: Nest Rivals
details.short_description: Lead a slime colony through a living pixel world. Take direct control of individual creatures, grow new nests, face rival species and guide your colony through a campaign of changing worlds. Explore unfamiliar biomes and fill your illustrated bestiary with discoveries.

details.title: Hollow Orbits 4x
details.short_description: Hollow Orbits is a turn-based space 4X with the tension of a board game. Roll a die for every weapon, then choose which enemy ship takes each hit. Expand, trade, negotiate or conquer your way across a galaxy of ancient ruins and rival powers. Play solo, against AI or online with friends.

details.title: Bottopia
details.short_description: A cozy idle collecting and decorating game that lives on your desktop. Make progress while using your computer, fish up new decorations, and turn your bottle into a tiny world that's uniquely yours.

details.title: Archive of Fate
details.short_description: A single-player card RPG blending Tarot mysticism, roguelike deckbuilding, and lasting progression. Use a wide variety of cards alongside all 56 Minor Arcana, brew potions, explore randomized regions, and unleash rule-breaking Sequence skills to reshape battles, events, and fate itself.

details.title: Memory Cyphers
details.short_description: Online co-op Survivors-like for 1-4 players. Take on the memory-drained hordes with your friends. Memory chips, weapon upgrades, rule-breaking relics. Nobody clears a swarm this big alone! Fast roguelite action.

details.title: ZUNKS
details.short_description: ZUNKS is a top-down action game where you wipe out swarms of monsters and battle against powerful bosses in a ruined world. Save the world with ZUNKS, with all your might and a cheerful spirit!

details.title: Nookmaker
details.short_description: You're the new interior designer in a small town. Read your clients' letters, decorate their rooms and discover hidden furniture combos along the way. Then spend what you earn on your own little home, where nobody asks for anything.

details.title: Wreck & Profit
details.short_description: Swing a wrecking ball, knock down buildings, and get paid for every brick. Buy machines that do the swinging for you, sell the company, and take on a bigger city. A short incremental game with real physics & some automation with an actual ending.

details.title: Spell Fist
details.short_description: Unleash fists of arcane fury in this boss-rush brawler. Punch, parry, and steal spells as a broke wizard fighting rival mages to escape crushing debt.

details.title: COREDUMP: 口口口口
details.short_description: COREDUMP: 口口口口 is a Metroidvania inspired puzzle platformer where you recover lost colliders, switch between phasing through walls and charged bouncing, and uncover hidden paths across an interconnected world.

details.title: Koimori
details.short_description: Turn your desktop into a living pond with this peaceful idle overlay. Let koi drift around while you work or relax, drop snacks to see them gather, and unlock rare koi patterns as you spend more time with your little friends.

details.title: VIRUS_31.EXE
details.short_description: Minimalist survivors-like built for short, snack-sized sessions. Pop enemies, earn bits, get stronger.

details.title: The Rules Kaidan: Night Watch
details.short_description: In this side-scrolling horror adventure game, explore multiple eerie spaces rooted in Rules Kaidan. Every adventure, you will encounter all kinds of terrifying beings born from kaidan legends. Follow and memorize every rule — however conflicting or bizarre — to survive each trial.

details.title: Donjon: The Dark Fantasy
details.short_description: Can the Hero reach the donjon of the dark castle looming over the village he once called home? An immersive first-person RPG with old-school graphics.

details.title: Freshly Folded: Laundry Shop
details.short_description: Run your own dry cleaning shop in a charming, cozy small town. Wash, dry, and press clothes to perfection, serve quirky customers, invest in new machines and upgrades for faster service, and stay organized to carefully complete each order. Mend rips, remove stains, and more.

details.title: Call Of Resistance
details.short_description: Call of Resistance is a real-time tactics game where you lead a group of resistance fighters in occupied France during World War II. Step into the shoes of shadowy heroes and discover the sacrifices and strategies needed to stand against the enemy

details.title: Crafters Heaven
details.short_description: Crafters Heaven is a lowpoly RPG sandbox where you design and build your own items piece by piece. Create unique weapons, tools and equipment, build your base, fight wild creatures, and explore an open world full of secrets! Demo coming soon!

details.title: Bygoner
details.short_description: A medieval road-movie parable blending rogue-lite action and journey management, wrapped in vintage cinema aesthetics. Follow a nameless knight through the southern lands of the Grand Duchy of Lithuania (modern-day Ukraine) at the beginning of the 16th century.

details.title: Pay Your Space Debt
details.short_description: An incremental survivor-lite where you must earn your way out of debt by mining entire asteroid fields, upgrading your spaceship and surviving the debt collectors.

details.title: THE FORMIO PROGRAM
details.short_description: Terraform the moon Io from an isolated, fully simulated outpost as an operator for the F.O.R.M.I.O program. Master interconnected devices, take your (MANDATORY) daily dose of RADOX, and ignore the robot :)

details.title: My Cozy BookShop
details.short_description: Run your own magical bookshop in a cozy fantasy world! Stock your shelves, decorate your shop, meet curious customers, and venture beyond town in search of rare books, magical ingredients, and secrets. Build the bookshop of your dreams ~one adventure at a time~

details.title: Undead Night Crew
details.short_description: Run an undead cleaning crew in this online co-op bullet heaven roguelite. Recruit auto attacking followers, team up with friends, and build wild synergies to wipe out zombie hordes. Sign contracts, complete missions, earn cash, get stronger, and do it again!

details.title: WotaBeats
details.short_description: 《WotaBeats: Code Aria》 is a VR rhythm experience fusing music, idols, and energy. Swing your glowsticks, fight BUGs, and keep the stage alive—feel the beat, live the light. 「Feel the rhythm. Recode the idol.」

details.title: Grim Path
details.short_description: A roguelike card crawler where every step is a choice. Descend into dark dungeons, battle monsters, and face various encounters. Choose your gear wisely to survive and go even deeper.

details.title: Open Land
details.short_description: Transform barren land into a thriving ecosystem in this relaxing building game. Recycle trash, grow plants, and reintroduce wildlife to create a self-sustaining world.

details.title: VILLAIN – Path of the Necromancer
details.short_description: You are an Osteurgo, a lesser necromancer risen from the ashes of the Dark Lord. Raise your empire among desolate mountains, subjugate savage tribes, and spread corruption. Build, conquer, withstand enemy hordes, and claim the empty throne of evil.

details.title: Chess Club Manager
details.short_description: Tycoon game to build and manage your own chess club from the ground up. Balance training, sponsors, tournaments and turn a tiny local club into a global success.

details.title: Magnet Agent
details.short_description: Magnet Agent is a puzzle adventure game based on “magnetic power”. Magnet Agent N-52 and his robot vacuum, Dustino, use their shockingly cool magnetic spy kit to explore the world and thwart Magnet Empress's evil plan before it's too late. They are drawn to danger, are you?

details.title: SUS!
details.short_description: One of them is a thief. Blend into the crowd, steal, knock out your targets and escape, but you have to cough now and then. Spies watch the streets through CCTV, scan the crowd and get one clean stun shot. Stun an innocent and it costs you. Online PvP for 2 to 10 players, or play against bots.

details.title: Rondo's Romp
details.short_description: Join Rondo, a cheerful Akita pup, as he explores 6 whimsical worlds, digging up coins, items, and throwable objects to solve puzzles, battle enemies, and uncover secrets... all with the charm and challenge of a classic 2D platformer!

details.title: Po10tions: Silver Path
details.short_description: Po10tions: Silver Path is a deck-building business simulation game. Start your business in a magic world in the 18th-century. Produce 3 types of goods and sell them. Play cards to produce more, trade for better prices, or stop your opponents. Make money faster to win!

details.title: Frank and Stein
details.short_description: Trapped in one stitched body, Frank & Stein must swap heads to survive this gloomy Metroidvania. Wield light and psychic powers to explore a castle shrouded in darkness, solve puzzles and reveal the unseen. Discover abilities and secrets, but beware of threats lurking in these twisted corridors...

details.title: Witchland: Trinity Blight
details.short_description: Lead an Inquisition expedition into a land consumed by corruption. Choose your missions, manage precious time, build your company, and survive brutal turn-based tactical battles as the world grows more dangerous around you.

details.title: Khinkills
details.short_description: As a cute khinkali dumpling, fight over the last piece of cake through fast paced and chaotic arenas. Smash your frenemies, steal their candies and kick everyone’s butt in this cute’n gore world.

details.title: Thothic
details.short_description: Thothic is a logic puzzle game where you land stones on their glowing targets. But all stones move together, in the same direction — so you'll need to find the one path that brings every stone home at once.

details.title: WOLFOUT
details.short_description: A Wild West social deduction game. You and your gang of outlaw coyotes have one goal: crack safes, rob the bank, and loot the saloon before time runs out. But some of you are secretly sheriffs. Same look, same gang - opposite mission.

details.title: Paradox Tower
details.short_description: Explore Paradox Tower and save your future. Only your wits and your loyal demon cat are able to throw down the Coven. Grow stronger, pick your battles, and make smart moves. And if you don't? Travel back in time!

details.title: Atomic Blastman
details.short_description: Remember those epic LAN afternoons with your dad or friends? Atomic Blastman brings them back. Pick a color, suit up, and blast your way through huge arenas. Power-ups, sudden death, chaos, and laughs guaranteed. Just... please... don’t blow yourself up! Chaos and madness, guaranteed.

details.title: Ramen://protocol
details.short_description: 🍜🃏 Ramen://protocol is a cyberpunk ramen-stall roguelite deckbuilder. Push your toppings to their limits, then rev them up even further with skills. Master countless synergies and serve bowls so good they're synapse-frying. Chase the one bowl that will cut you free from your past.

details.title: Picatso
details.short_description: Play as Picatso, a calico cat painter searching for a creative spark. Navigate through underground ruins with his ability to paint the environment which allow him to advance in this platforming adventure!

details.title: The Grant Grover Anthology
details.short_description: In Neo Naarm in the 22nd century, augmentation technology has run amok. Combining deduction, visual novel and point and click gameplay, play as Grant Grover, private detective, one of the only remaining citizens without augmentations, as he solves crimes across the city.

details.title: KLITTER
details.short_description: KLITTER fuses the precision of arena combat with the chaos of glitchcore and the flow of a movement-driven brawler. Every dash, every shot, every kill defines your rhythm - stop moving and you die, flow perfectly and the system collapses. PURE FLOW. ZERO MERCY.

details.title: Infini Orbis
details.short_description: A sci-fi automation game with deep RPG progression and RTS fleet combat. Command humanity's last ark, Mothership, on a desperate mission back in time to build a fleet powerful enough to change the destiny of the galaxy. Automate local and interstellar supply networks to purge cosmic threats.

details.title: Gonzalo the Chicken
details.short_description: This chicken is crossing the road... to blow up everything on the other side! Throw Gonzalo's loud-mouthed explosive sidekick Azzar at the Crocogator horde, and then use a magic glove to retrieve him. He holds on tight while you flutter through mountains and beaches and forests, oh my!

details.title: Mentiss Werewolf: Human vs AI
details.short_description: Play Werewolf with AI players that argue, bluff and vote on their own. Hunt the wolves with the village or lie your way to a wolf win, solo or with friends while AI fills the empty seats. Watch Mode, Parallel Mode, replays and post-game Review. Free Games every day.

details.title: Yokai Mart
details.short_description: Yokai Mart is a cozy shop simulation game full of mysterious stories. Help your grandmother run her konbini. The supernatural visitors who come at night and the customers from the village need your help. Little by little, you’ll get to know the place and improve the lives of your guests.

details.title: MEATBALL THE MITE
details.short_description: MEATBALL THE MITE is a Metroid-inspired platforming game where you explore the colossal, labyrinthian remains of a decaying creature. Collect upgrades, go toe-to-toe with gnarly threats, and claim victory over the rot on your quest to grow stronger. Do you got the guts to survive in these guts?

details.title: Coming Forth by Day
details.short_description: Journey through the Egyptian afterlife in this roguelike deck builder. Use the rules to your advantage, or break them, to outwit supernatural foes in an ancient Egyptian board game. Prepare yourself, pharaoh: the Duat awaits.

details.title: Vertepnyky: Prologue
details.short_description: Travel to a remote snowy island where everything is not what it seems! Interact with the locals, unravel the prophecy, and prepare for a "holiday" with Helga Burevis in an action-packed visual novel where every choice matters. The only rule: trust no one. ESPECIALLY mirrors, masks, and musicians.

details.title: Trap Side
details.short_description: Jump into the arena in Trap Side, a fast-paced multiplayer party game where cute faces meet brutal chaos! Dodge deadly saws, grab spears, outsmart your friends, and survive the pixel-blood-soaked mayhem. Trust no one, not even the ground you stand on!

details.title: Soul Savior
details.short_description: Blast monster hordes with elemental spells, lay traps between waves and protect your gold in this action roguelite tower defense. Save the villagers' souls or sacrifice them for power, solo or in online co-op.

details.title: InCyanSpace
details.short_description: IncyanSpace follows the story of Li, an artificial human, who sets out to find his long-lost original human brother Yuan. Together with surviving New Humans, they stand against Xystem, a dominant force of mechanical lifeforms that controls the surface world.

details.title: Dear Polder
details.short_description: The sea took half your fields. Dear Polder is a cozy farming life sim in a Dutch polder village, solo or in 4-player online co-op. Mend the dike, let your windmill pump the land dry, then befriend 40 villagers and dance under the lanterns on festival nights.

details.title: TappyCat
details.short_description: TappyCat is a cute pixel kitty who settles onto your desktop and turns work and study into a warm, cozy ritual. It's a desktop pet, a Pomodoro timer, and a smart productivity tracker all at once - all in one little cat.

details.title: FREEWAVE
details.short_description: FREEWAVE is an epic spaceship action-adventure. Explore a vast, tattered city in search of answers. Fly between crumbling buildings and become a master pilot. Fight against the oppressive tech regime ULTRASOFT and defend yourself against rotten monsters. All hand drawn with pen and watercolor.

details.title: Global Parity
details.short_description: Lead one of 15 nations from 1999 to 2019. Balance the budget, pass laws through parliament, win elections, sign treaties and fight on a moving front line, while AI nations build, trade and go to war around you.

details.title: HALFLIGHT
details.short_description: A survival horror roguelite about a house that erases itself behind you. Learn to read doors, solve puzzles, and survive things you cannot fight. Every step is permanent, there is no way back. Find the way out.

details.title: Bonsai Island
details.short_description: Grow, shape, and sell your own fully simulated bonsai trees to adorable animal customers! Turn your humble little bonsai cart into a thriving business on a cozy island.

details.title: Mereni
details.short_description: A casual Hexcells-like puzzle game where you reveal hidden drawings among the stars.

details.title: Not Monsters
details.short_description: A medieval themed party game for 4-15 players where social deduction becomes ragdoll combat and monsters hide in plain sight.

details.title: IVORY
details.short_description: IVORY is a story-rich, cold weather survival game with cosmic-horror elements. Enjoy the twists and turns of its gripping, dark narrative and rich lore as you explore two open-world locations dripping with psychological terror. Play as a man driven toward his grim fate by cowardice and greed.

details.title: Idle Dig
details.short_description: Idle Dig is an idle mining game that sits on your desktop and plays on its own. Collect 125 unique gems and items, unlock 15 skins, complete quests, and uncover the mystery at the heart of the planet.

details.title: Mayhematic
details.short_description: Mayhematic is a bullet heaven where the next door is always worth the trouble behind it. Blast through cartoon hordes solo or in 4-player online co-op, spend your kills on doors that go deeper, build something ridiculous and put your name on the leaderboard.

details.title: Mercenary Guild Manager
details.short_description: Raise a banner and run a mercenary guild in a grim medieval fantasy realm. Recruit and read your blades, negotiate contracts, send them into procedural missions, and survive a living political web where every payday bites and nothing is ever certain.

details.title: DuoFall
details.short_description: Pieces fall from the top and rise from the bottom - and you play both fields at once. Can you do it? Longer than your friends? Challenge them: same seed, live duel or leaderboard - every run is proven by replay. One mind. Two fields. Many blocks.

details.title: MixUp!
details.short_description: MixUp! is a CO-OP focused, fast-paced color mixing and management roguelite. Enter the unique, black and white world of "Malben." As a Visionary Painter, your life mission is to restore color to this monochrome reality, one customer, one day, one city at a time, friends may join you on your journey.

details.title: My Army Getting Stronger
details.short_description: A short relaxing incremental auto-battler where you grow an unstoppable war machine and grind your way forward through enemy territory. No stress, no micromanagement — just growth, upgrades, and glorious mass battles.

details.title: Tiny Street: Taskbar Tycoon
details.short_description: Tiny Street: Taskbar Tycoon is a taskbar idle game where a tiny street sits right on the taskbar while you work, relax, or simply watch the people come and go. Passerbys will randomly shop in your colorful, hand-drawn stores, and slowly help grow your little economy.

details.title: Buddington
details.short_description: Buddington is a 2D life sim blending restaurant management, light action combat, and story adventure. Battle pests for ingredients by day, then plan the menu and run the canteen with friends come sundown.

details.title: MSP Mayhem
details.short_description: Run a chaotic IT service company with your friends! Answer the phones, fix the servers, calm the customers and land that big enterprise deal — all before the SLA clock runs out. Inspired by Overcooked-style couch co-op mayhem, set in the world's most stressful open-plan office.

details.title: Court of Karma: Soul Check
details.short_description: Every soul has a past. Every sin demands a price. As an underworld judge, uncover the truth behind each soul's life and decide their fate. Will you deliver justice, or condemn the innocent?

details.title: PARRUITS!
details.short_description: Swallow a watermelon, become a watermelon. A 2–6 player party brawler where parrots turn into whatever fruit they eat, then use one ridiculous ability each to knock each other into the sea. Last parrot on the island wins. Couch or online. A minute to learn, ten minutes to lose a friend.

details.title: The Pineapple Conspiracy
details.short_description: An impostor survival reality show for 4 to 10 players. Craft a raft in twenty minutes while impostors work against you in secret. Survive, betray, and find the Golden pineapple!

details.title: Harvesters
details.short_description: A short incremental management game where every harvester has a name and a story. Upgrade your favorites, your spaceship, buildings and explore different planets. Optimize your production to meet the Council's requirements. It's all about watching the lil people do their thing.

details.title: Hedra
details.short_description: A scientific blunder tears open a portal, and the Hedra pour through. Build a shifting collider from six tile shapes, grow monster dice, complete patterns, battle rival Overlords, and devour physicists in this solo digital board game.

details.title: Fleeting Requests: Freya and Ray
