details.short_description: Caught using magic to steal a game, Raymond Wong En is spared from arrest and recruited by Cheng Li Fang Freya into the Spell Casting Crusaders. Engage in a point and click, character driven narrative using magic to fulfill requests, each revealing deeper layers of the group’s story.

details.title: NAND²
details.short_description: Build a computer from a single NAND gate, together: online co-op for up to 4 players on one board. Wire relays into logic, memory and a 16-bit CPU with a pipeline and a cache, then program it. Robots in mazes, Nim, even a shooter on your own CPU. Level editor and Steam Workshop.

details.title: OneThought
details.short_description: One thought to ascend, one thought to fall. A cultivation roguelike deckbuilder where six disciplines light up like auto-battler synergies: stack 3/6/10/15 cards of one school and become what you build. Join a sect, collect the lore, survive the Tribulation, then reincarnate and run again.

details.title: CoreVore
details.short_description: CoreVore is a first-person voxel mining sandbox. Explore a persistent atlas of destructible planets, scan for rare ore, shape tunnels, deploy machines, and evacuate your cargo before instability turns your route into a trap. Return later—the planet remembers what you changed.

details.title: Wirehawk
details.short_description: Wirehawk is a neon vector shmup in the spirit of 80s arcade classics. Play it your way: razor-sharp mouse control, or a dedicated controller mode rebalanced for the stick. Blast asteroids and alien waves, dodge bullet storms, slow time with stasis. Autofire always on.

details.title: Sunset Painter
details.short_description: Have you ever wanted to spray an entire can of whipped cream into the sky and watch the sun's golden rays dance through your masterpiece as day melts into dusk? Craft the perfect sky - spray, sculpt, and swirl volumetric clouds with delightfully tactile tools. No pressure, just you and the sky.

details.title: Hop Slasher
details.short_description: A fast-paced arcade battler where you slice your enemies from any angle. Once you start moving your momentum never stops, use quick reflexes to dodge attacks and perform trick shots to score more points! Slash through waves of unique enemies and bosses!

details.title: BumpFlip
details.short_description: Choose and place bumpers to build your perfect pinball setup. Hit the target score before the 90-second timer runs out.

details.title: L'Eternel Retour, Death Gamble
details.short_description: A bullet heaven roguelite. Caught in a loop of death and return, hold back a surging horde, draft a build, and find a way to save what's left of civilization. Die, come back, unlock new items and weapons. Solo or online co-op.

details.title: Melodan
details.short_description: Command mythical legions to victory in a fantasy auto-battler where every placement matters. Draft your troops, unlock magical upgrades, set your formations, and let the battle begin. Pure strategy, no clickfest. Prove your brilliance in 1v1 and 2v2 matches, or survive the escalating Co-op Horde.

details.title: Touge: JDM Dealership Simulator
details.short_description: An economic simulator set in an alternative Japan. See a car that everyone has written off, read it with your bare eye, haggle with a salesman who remembers every deal, and grow from a single parking space to a corporation to keep it when the country runs out of money in 1990.

details.title: Pongcremental
details.short_description: Pongcremental is an incremental game where you play as the ball of Pong. Eliminate enemies, get stronger, unlock game changing abilities. Hit, destroy, earn, get good. And repeat.

details.title: Kingdom TD: Draft Your Demise
details.short_description: Choose the enemies. Risk a deadlier wave for more gold. Build winding defenses, upgrade your towers, and ride between them to boost their power. How much danger will you draft to defend your campfire?

details.title: Marzu
details.short_description: Something ancient lives in these ruins, and it already knows you're here. Flee through shifting halls, tunnels, and forests as unseen entities hunt your every move. Solve environmental puzzles, evade ancient horrors, and uncover a truth that unravels reality itself.

details.title: Fusil
details.short_description: An action-adventure set in a weird fantasy world. Face levels where every shot counts: move silently to backstab enemies, use spells to unlock paths, and explore non-linear environments with multiple solutions. Choose your path, manage your ammo, and survive.

details.title: Bureaucromancer
details.short_description: Bureaucromancer is a turn-based tactical shooter set in a floating records office in the sky. A medieval fantasy where rather than magic, they discovered the awesome power of bureaucracy.

details.title: Runemoria - Blades of Memory
details.short_description: Flip cards, uncover pairs, and command your squad in a tactical memory RPG. Equip weapons, unlock powerful skills, and battle enemies or other players in strategic single-player and PvP combat.

details.title: Cursed Carts
details.short_description: A PvPvE horror game playable with 2–6 players. Compete against each other with your alien team split into two groups. In a massive mansion filled with creatures, the team that collects the most loot within the time limit wins.

details.title: Smash Hit
details.short_description: Smash Hit is an online party brawler for up to 12 players. Grab a random loadout of ridiculous weapons, knock your friends off the stage and play to the crowd. Climb to the top of the scoreboard and become TV's next SMASH HIT!

details.title: PERKS
details.short_description: A chaotic 1-6 player physics brawler where you battle your friends with game-breaking perk synergies. Stack wild abilities to fire homing multishots, bounce rapid-fire lasers off walls, or summon an orbital cannon inside a swirling twister. Steal the best perks and turn the tide!

details.title: Watch Out: Shark!
details.short_description: Survive in the ocean by feeding on smaller fish, dodging predators, and facing various dangers in this relaxing, challenging, and super fun retro arcade game—all hand-drawn in pixel art style. Dive into this adventure solo or in multiplayer mode. But remember: watch out for the shark!

details.title: They're Gonna Get In
details.short_description: "They're Gonna Get In" is an RTS/Roguelite where you play as an advisor to the ruler of a failing kingdom. Your enemy mirrors you. A wall will fall. The only question is whose breaks first.

details.title: Cryotank Rogue
details.short_description: Cryotank Rogue is a fast-paced 2D sideview twin-stick roguelike shooter set in a brutal cyberpunk apocalypse. Fight through procedurally generated levels, loot weapons and augments, and evolve into a deadly machine to survive permadeath runs.

details.title: Static Maw
details.short_description: You take the night shift at StaticCore, an antenna station built over a sealed mine. The old mining machines never left. Keep the station running, track them on radar, drive them back with radio waves, and find out what the antennas are really listening for.

details.title: Gobelinus: The Cursed Deck
details.short_description: Gobelinus: The Cursed Deck is a dark fantasy roguelike deckbuilder where a debt‑ridden goblin builds cursed card hands to survive. Equip bizarre relics and trigger outrageous score combos to defeat relentless monsters in each run.

details.title: Hidden Shore
details.short_description: After many years, you have finally reached this mysterious place. Now, will you be able to uncover all its secrets and finally find what you have been seeking for so long? Explore a secret island, solve puzzles and riddles to uncover the truth.

name: Interactive Language-Learning Novel: Interview with Emma

details.title: Interactive Language-Learning Novel: Interview with Emma
details.short_description: Emma starts journalism school: new friends, awkward first meetings and maybe her first love. Listen to voiced dialogue, click any word and learn English, Spanish, French, Italian, German, Portuguese or Turkish inside a living story. The free demo is out now.

name: 戚继光 Qi Jiguang: Art of War

details.title: 戚继光 Qi Jiguang: Art of War
details.short_description: Gunpowder vs Samurai: A Tower Defense + Auto Battler. Wield the Ming dynasty's cluster bombs, rockets, drones, and cannons against pirate fleets from the sea. Build formations, set up artillery, can you replicate Qi Jiguang's legendary 0:2000 kill-to-loss ratio?

details.title: Applied Shamanism
details.short_description: A cozy 3D game about a rookie rabbit shaman. Diagnose quirky illnesses with X-ray spirit vision, gather and grow elemental ingredients, and brew always-useful potions. Each patient is a bite-size mystery of folk ailments and guardian spirits, with no combat, damage, or timers.

details.title: The Old Parish
details.short_description: A cozy top-down farming and life sim in a rural Irish parish. Sow and harvest the family farm, mow and bale the hay, raise cattle and sheep and fish the lake. Then head into a town where every door opens, for Sunday Mass, a pint at O'Brien's and a hand of Twenty-Five.

details.title: Don't Wake the Queen
details.short_description: Protect the peaceful sleep of Your Meowness in this infinite incremental tower defense. Place fierce warriors, build your own path, unlock a ton of new skills and infinitely upgrade EVERYTHING.

details.title: Thousands of Chroma
details.short_description: A layered logic puzzle game, where thousands of colors come to life using only □(0) and ■(1).

details.title: THE WITCH'S GRIMOIRE
details.short_description: An atmospheric experience in the dark and eerie world of classic fairy tales, progressing solely through your choices. No complex mechanics; just sit back and focus on the story. Make the right decisions to avoid danger and try to survive the twisted endings of these tales.

details.title: Ram Fights
details.short_description: Get ready to headbutt your way to glory in this hilarious physics-based brawler! Customize your ultimate animal gladiator, master the art of the perfect charge, and send your rivals flying with epic ragdoll physics.

details.title: Moonlight Apothecary
details.short_description: Brew concoctions, befriend Ravensport's many fantasy inhabitants, and unravel the mystery of the Evernight as the newest apprentice of the Moonlight Apothecary.

details.title: Tsuki Journey
details.short_description: A relaxing slice of life adventure game where Tsuki travels between beautiful cities, meets new friends, uncovers stories, and fills out collection logs at his own pace, combining cozy idle activities with short, meaningful bursts of progression.

details.title: Where Giants Fall
details.short_description: Fight your way from desperate survival to overwhelming power in a 3D fantasy bullet-heaven roguelite. Combine weapons and active abilities into devastating builds, outmaneuver swarms and bring down towering giants. Take on greater danger for richer rewards.

details.title: Rise Under the Warstorm
details.short_description: Build the production lines that power your defense. An automated economy supports your army as you command it against enemy waves. Upgrade cards and the technologies shape your strategy for the battles ahead.

details.title: Necromancer’s Domain
details.short_description: A dark fantasy dungeon management game where you rule as a necromancer. Build and defend your dungeon, resurrect fallen enemies as undead soldiers and workers, research forbidden magic, and expand your domain across the world.

details.title: Trials of Liberation
details.short_description: Imprisoned by the king, you must earn your freedom by completing his puzzle trials. A top-down 2D puzzle game focused on logic, planning, limited items, and clever solutions.

details.title: Reverie Eclipse
details.short_description: You are the president of the student council at a high school. Six lovely girls are ready to help you! Spending time with them... is it as easy as it seems?

details.title: Spin, Baby, Spin!
details.short_description: Spin, Baby, Spin! is a short incremental game about slot machines. Spin the reels, upgrade your income and drop chances, craft new slot machines, and collect powerful artifacts. Choose your talent cards and earn enough chips to buy back your soul from a demonic clown!

details.title: Dont Stop Walking
details.short_description: A co-op survival extraction game for 1 to 6 players. A purple storm is coming down the canyon and it never stops. Walk, scavenge, craft from grass to iron, fight what lives in five abandoned places, and get your haul home to your floating outpost before the storm takes it all.

details.title: Cafe Life Simulator
details.short_description: Manage your dream cafe, but don't stop there. In this comprehensive simulation, explore a living city! Drive cars, build relationships, work side jobs, and build your empire. From brewing coffee to becoming the most famous name in town—how will you live your cafe life?

details.title: Magic Moon
details.short_description: Welcome to Magic Moon, a cozy mystery life sim set on a peaceful island where the air is fresh, the waters sparkle, and the ground hums with forgotten magic. You play as Hana, a magical girl starting over on a remote island full of charm, curiosity, and just a little mystery.

details.title: BugoPhobia
details.short_description: BugoPhobia is an indie survival horror game where you explore haunted places, avoid ghosts during ghost hunts, collect clues, and correctly identify the type of ghost

details.title: The Endemic : Best Mates
details.short_description: Endemic: GONGWAN is a cozy farming game inspired by a CCC comic. Taiwanese foods like Gongwan and dumplings come to life as cute creatures called Endemics. Play as a researcher, rebuild the park, farm the land, and befriend unique companions.

details.title: Reflectory
details.short_description: An idle incremental game about bouncing balls that lives in the corner of your screen.

details.title: Depono
details.short_description: Play against your friends in this fast paced, competitive card game. Bet, scheme and bluff your way to victory. Craft your deck with secret cards, change the playing field with items and become unstoppable.

details.title: DeckWrecking Pirates
details.short_description: A tactical roguelike deckbuilder where you roll dice, command your pirate crew, and even control your enemies. Build your deck… and wreck theirs!

details.title: FENDERSHOT
details.short_description: A lawless street racing league with the fiercest rivals and the latest Race Tech™. Can you and your crew handle the heat? Included in the box: Wild sense of speed. Split-Screen local multiplayer. Underglow Neons. 60+ FPS on Steam Deck.

details.title: War Tactics
details.short_description: 《War Tactics》is a turn-based tactical game inspired by "Advance Wars". Command military units on square grids in modern warfare scenarios. Features deep tactics, intuitive controls, rich unit variety, complex terrain interactions, and single-player campaigns. Plan and conquer with your intellect.

details.title: DJ till Dawn
details.short_description: Be a cool DJ and battle crowds in a rhythm roguelite where every beat is a weapon. Build your DJ loadout, unlock new tracks and keep the party alive till dawn to win!

details.title: Pripyat 0
details.short_description: Chernobyl has broken down. As radiation rains down upon you, the world starts rapidly mutating. You've gotten stuck in a nightmarish loop. Can you correctly spot the anomalies on time and get to safety? Or will you become one with the zone?

name: Top of That Thing Called Mountain

details.title: Top of That Thing Called Mountain
details.short_description: Who would you go with on the toughest adventure? Team up with a friend in this 2-player, 2D co-op platformer and guide two dolphins up an impossible mountain. Shoot harpoons, blast air cannons, and swing your way up. Every climb demands perfect teamwork, and one wrong move sends you both tumbling.

details.title: Monkeys Don't Fear Hell
details.short_description: A cozy farming and building sim by day, a demon-slaying gauntlet by night - grow crops, raise a town and then descend to battle waves of demons and towering bosses. DOOM & Vampire Survivors meets Stardew Valley.

details.title: BREAKOUT BABY
details.short_description: BREAKOUT BABY is a blood-pumping, Pac-Man–infused, first-person horror roguelike where you must help a poor baby escape to the surface. Run from creatures, scoop up pellets, and shake your baby to survive.

details.title: Fruit Slicer
details.short_description: Slice fruit with precision - using your mouse or real hand! Dodge bombs, master combos, and push your reflexes to the limit in this fast-paced arcade slicer.

details.title: ABISMO
details.short_description: ABISMO is a co-op deep-sea horror game set on the abyssal floor of an alien planet. Descend alone or with up to 4 players into shifting trenches, explore derelict facilities, and recover what you need to survive while uncovering an analog-horror mystery hidden in corrupted VHS tapes.

details.title: Red Nox
details.short_description: Red Nox is a horror roguelike deckbuilder with realistic graphics and a liminal space aesthetic. Gamble, explore, and create your own synergy of cards and relics to survive against the uncanny abominations within the Forbidden Lands.

details.title: Augment Protocol
details.short_description: Enter a retro-futuristic nightmare of failed human augmentation. Fight relentless hordes, earn Bio-Credits, unlock quarantined facility sectors, and eradicate the grotesque experiments NeuraCorp left behind.

details.title: Possums
details.short_description: Possums is an NPC-driven co-op heist game for 2-6 players where every character reacts to your actions. Distract them, use them, or stay out of their way — loot their city to pay the forest taxes.

details.title: Interstitial
details.short_description: Interstitial is a first-person psychological horror game that dives into the unease of liminal spaces, blending environmental storytelling, exploration-driven gameplay, and slow-burning dread to create an experience where the world itself becomes the threat.

details.title: The Missing Threads
details.short_description: [DEMO available now!] Erased memories, scattered clues. What will you uncover, and what will you leave buried?As an amnesiac detective, investigate crime scenes with limited focus. You can't analyze everything. Strategically choose your leads to shape the case and reclaim your lost past.

details.title: Crooked Cooks
details.short_description: Crooked Cooks is a chaotic co-op game where you and your crew run a restaurant as a front for the Boss’ criminal jobs, mixing fast-paced cooking with shady business.

details.title: Chronicles Meteorfall
details.short_description: A semi-open world turn based RPG with detailed class-based and skill building mechanics, deep worldbuilding and lore, and genuine LGBT+ representation.

details.title: Dragonhaul
details.short_description: Dragonhaul is a retro roguelite autobattler where every step matters. Explore a hand-pixelled overworld, arrange powerful items in an expanding inventory and construct devastating synergies before the boss arrives, no two runs are the same.

details.title: Cadence_Blade
details.short_description: Hold the castle sword-in-hand in this co-op action defense game for 1-3 players. Time your strikes to the Flow, manage where you invest your coins, and see how long you last against the waves... or just let a friend take the dragon.

details.title: Astral Trace
details.short_description: Astral Trace is a fast paced arcade word game where every word keeps you alive. Trace through moving hex clusters, earn precious time, and chase high scores while the field grows faster, denser, and more demanding. Survive the pressure and keep the run alive.

details.title: Eat the Sky
details.short_description: An arcade space roguelike where you are a star and everything smaller is food. Swallow the planets to grow, while rival stars hunt you for the same reason. Outgrow them or be eaten. At the center of it all something far larger is already feeding, so hurry up, the clock is ticking.

details.title: OddXI
details.short_description: The football sticker roguelike. OddXI is a gloriously daft deckbuilder where you rip open packs of deeply odd footballers, stack their traits into ridiculous combos, and drag your XI through three nerve-shredding seasons against absurd bosses: vegan pirates, a goth band and ancient philosophers.

details.title: Ogro Buchón: Barrio Multiversal
details.short_description: Ogro Buchón: Barrio Multiversal is a 2D beat ’em up inspired by classic arcades, with street combat, Mexican humor, outrageous enemies, bosses, and minigames. And just when you think you know where the story is going… you’re probably wrong.

details.title: Crank'N'Gun
details.short_description: The ultimate cranking roguelike you will ever play. Survive waves of enemies, get upgrades, defeat bosses, and unlock new scenarios. The only requirement is to keep CRANKING and never stop. I hope your hand can handle it.

details.title: Panda Rails: Desktop Journeys
details.short_description: Panda Rails: Desktop Journeys is a cozy desktop idle game where every click and keystroke boosts your high-speed train. Travel through scenic countryside with adorable animal passengers, enjoy local dishes, and receive beautiful postcards along the way!

details.title: Misfortune
details.short_description: Fight monsters with a slot machine. Spin, hold and reroll to land deadly combinations. Build your reels with powerful symbols, collect relics and unlock extra paylines. Shape your luck—and survive long enough to cash out.

details.title: CleanUp OS
details.short_description: A cozy desktop-cleaning sim. Sit down at someone else's messy computer, delete the junk, kill the CPU hogs, and fight off popups and files that keep respawning, until there's finally enough free space for that big system update and the whole machine breathes again.

details.title: Winds of Discovery
details.short_description: Set sail across a living Age of Sail. Trade goods between distant ports, build your fleet, hire your crew, and forge your own path to fortune in a vast world of exploration and commerce.

details.title: Deepworks
details.short_description: Earth is gone. The fleet is hungry. Drop a Hub on a generated claim, find the seam, and let the robots dig. Every machine you build makes noise — and noise is how the machines that took the planet find you. Hold the line, launch with the take, sell it, and go deeper.

details.title: Mushrooooooom
details.short_description: A numerical incremental game about spreading spores. There are mushrooms aplenty here, giving you countless ways to take root and spread across procedurally generated planets. Cross the seas, burrow underground, climb into the clouds, and turn the entire map into your own color.

details.title: Tamagong
details.short_description: A monster-raising autobattler where you hatch, feed, and train your monsters, shape their builds, and discover powerful team synergies.

details.title: Weathard
details.short_description: In this cosy puzzle game, control the weather and clear your path. Switch between rainy, sunny and snowy weather to transform the environment and solve each puzzle.

details.title: Brumel: Fantasy Presidential Race
details.short_description: In this fantasy political simulation, you are the Hero Party’s presidential candidate, with 60 days to win an election. Defeat rivals from the Demon Party, the Spirit Party, and beyond to become president. The fate of your nation—and the world—rests on your choices.

details.title: TURACIN
details.short_description: Beautiful tunnel racing game.

details.title: Letters from the Springs
details.short_description: Run a cozy hot spring inn in a mountain valley. Read guest letters, plan menus, prepare tea and baths, and grow your own ingredients. Get to know your travelers, balance the books, and help your little inn flourish, one thoughtful stay at a time.

details.title: Boomerang Survivor Technoverses
details.short_description: An exhilarating action game where you defeat enemies with a boomerang! Enjoy a variety of wondrous experiences across numerous pixel-art "Technoverses"!

details.title: Deckwork
details.short_description: Build a six-card deck that fights for you. Draft, reorder and sacrifice cards to forge synergies, bend the rules with relics and lead three heroes through dungeons and fearsome bosses in this pixel-art fantasy auto-battler roguelite.

details.title: Strive Card
details.short_description: Strive Card is a deckbuilding roguelike won with Niu Niu poker hands. Build a five-card Niu Niu, line your Strive Cards up so additive bonuses feed the multipliers, reshape your deck with Tech Cards, and clear 24 solar terms and 8 stage bosses to push one hand into the billions.

details.title: No Pose, No Mercy
details.short_description: Paint, survive, and create your own character poses in a fast-paced multiplayer game with runtime Control Rig customization.

details.title: Clean 'Em Ocean
details.short_description: An incremental game about cleaning the ocean with a speedboat, unlocking upgrades, and cleaning more trash. Will you save the ocean?

details.title: Omenweald : Les Erres
details.short_description: An ARPG where you build the adventure you fight through. Spin a crazy one-armed bandit, roguelite style, to win better pieces of your adventure, room after room, until the final one.

details.title: Arctic Shop Simulator
details.short_description: Run a small shop at the edge of the Arctic wilderness. Ride your snowmobile into frozen regions, track and sedate wildlife, fish, survive brutal weather, and return home to sell your finds. Negotiate with customers, expand your shop, and build a thriving business in the far north.

details.title: Liquidity
details.short_description: It's 1995 and the bank is yours. Set rates, approve loans, take deposits, deal in stocks, satisfy the regulator, and try not to break too many rules. A deep banking and finance management sim wrapped in a mid-1990’s desktop.

details.title: Ball Game
details.short_description: Ball Game is a game about making weaponified balls face each other using physics. Choose between many powerful cards, go through the rounds and watch slowly as the destruction rises!

details.title: Dour Tower
details.short_description: Stomp your way through floor after floor of a monster infested tower to reach the vampire king who stole all your blood and get it back.

details.title: Behind Room 102
details.short_description: In a dark nation of crime and corruption, you're more than just a hotel worker. Inspect the people in front of you, catch their lies, and make decisions. Your boss expects the best. To survive in this ruthless world, doing what you're told is a MUST! But will you follow every order?

details.title: 隐迹囚笼 Mind Jack
details.short_description: Mindjack is a plot-progression Visual novels and investigation game about social violence. Hijack instructors' vision terminals, eavesdrop on conspiracies, and capture violent acts. You must uncover dark secrets, and decide whether to save your friends trapped within the time limit.

details.title: Break the Witch
details.short_description: Manage the duality of defending while using the enemy projectiles in your favor to face challenges an progress through the game. To improve collect boons along the way. Try different builds and find the one that best suits your play style.

details.title: Helltower
details.short_description: A Roguelike RPG mixing spectacular action and rhythmic combat, in a dystopic hell where each soul has to accept their death, and the regrets that come with it.

details.title: UpBRELLA
details.short_description: A witch's adventure with nothing but an umbrella. Upbrella is a puzzle platformer where every trick you discover reopens the world in a new way, wrapped in cozy pixel art and a wordless friendship between a girl and a strange little creature.

details.title: Guild of Elemental Quests
details.short_description: Welcome to the Elemental Adventure Guild! Pick your adventurer, clear elemental blocks to strike enemies, gather diverse elemental gems, and craft your personalized battle style. Survive each mission's battles and complete every challenge that comes your way.

details.title: Welcome Back to Aeris
details.short_description: Welcome back to Aeris! A point-and-click psychological horror about reviving a Frutiger Aero minigame console shutting down in 7 days. Restore its dead channels with your guide Mora — and follow the strange traces appearing beyond the screen.

details.title: Sportvida Foodimals
details.short_description: Half food. Half animal. All adventure. Team up with friends in this VR co-op adventure where you'll hunt ingredients, collect adorable Foodimals, and cook up a world of fun.

details.title: When Stars Rest
details.short_description: Stars are out of energy. The black hole is hungry! Charge stars that fall on your island to earn coins. Will you upgrade weapons, unlock powerful items, and put Tesla coils and UFOs to work—or feed that black hole's growing appetite? It's all up to you!

details.title: SOULLOOP
details.short_description: A steampunk roguelite FPS with deckbuilding. Draft a card after every floor: your revolver chains lightning, your saw thrower freezes enemies. Combine powerful builds, bank your souls when you die, and spend them to make your next descent stronger. Free demo out now.

details.title: BattleSpinners
details.short_description: A fast-paced, spinning-tops versus game. Build your spinner, launch it into the arena, and defeat your opponents by knocking them out of the ring, or by tearing them apart. Brawl against or alongside your friends, use your skills and unleash powerful abilities to dominate the arena (1-4 players)

details.title: RAPIDS
details.short_description: Dare to Deliver in RAPIDS, a frantic co-op roguelike. Either solo or as a group of friends, navigate a hazardous river while delivering packages. Master magic, charm cute critters, and upgrade your boat, one fast-paced run at a time

details.title: OVER SAND
details.short_description: Take to the steampunk skies! Defend your flying ship over endless sands from mechanical hordes. Master turret firepower, switch weapons, and craft synergistic perk builds mid-wave. No movement — pure skill!

details.title: Evergrowing
details.short_description: Play as a squirrel in a cozy adventure about growing your tree home. Help woodland neighbors, build along the branches, and travel by balloon to other trees. Venture beneath the roots and discover what’s waiting below.

details.title: Pirate & Darkmage
details.short_description: A life simulation RPG set in a world of pirates and magic. Farm, fish, build friendships, and set out on adventures at your own pace. Complete goals without feeling restricted, and shape your own story through the choices you make.

details.title: Totally Normal Ramen
details.short_description: Cook ramen across the galaxy as a rogue robot chef! Explore planets, trigger wild events, battle dangerous customers, and build your ultimate space food truck.

details.title: Cubalance
details.short_description: In this physics-based puzzler, color matching is only half the battle. Balance scales or launch cubes across the screen with weight-shifting chain reactions. Do you think you’re a master of logic? Meet Gravity. Let’s see how you handle the pressure when the floor starts tipping.

details.title: God of Stocks
details.short_description: Trade stocks with divine powers in this incremental game. Copy winning trades and trigger Blessing combos with one click to manipulate stock prices. Sell at the right time and watch your profits snowball. Unlock new stock markets and diversify your portfolio as you progress.

details.title: Dough it Yourself
details.short_description: Run a cozy bakery where every ingredient comes from your own farm. Grow crops, raise animals, and turn your harvest into flour, butter and jam. Bake fresh bread, serve hungry customers, get to know the regulars, and grow your bakery one step at a time.

details.title: Parry the Bullet
details.short_description: Parry the Bullet is a fast-paced one-hit-kill top-down action. Parry, slash and shoot your way through an army of gunslinger crows as a chicken knight seeking revenge.

details.title: Build To The Moon
details.short_description: A relaxing incremental tower builder—until hundreds of tiny workers turn it into complete chaos.

details.title: Construcubes
details.short_description: Grab, move, rotate and connect bricks to build many cute objects ! Follow instructions to build things such as a flower, a robot or a well-known building, or make your own models and share them with others ! Available for PC, and for VR with Oculus Quest 2 and 3.

details.title: Hantu and Hunted
details.short_description: Morph into props to survive as a human or hunt as the legendary ghosts of Southeast Asian folklore. Asymmetric horror prop hunt with proximity voice chat. Hide, hunt and escape.

details.title: Kindred Pieces
details.short_description: Kindred Pieces is a relaxing world-builder where you shape beautiful landscapes one hex tile at a time. Discover 6 unique biomes, unlock cute characters, and master a subtle layer of strategy to build the biggest world imaginable.

details.title: Mother ZERO
details.short_description: In Mother ZERO, a cyberpunk action-adventure game, fight your way through a decaying world full of mysteries and threats. Explore deep underground bunkers, battle corrupted creatures, and encounter bizarre characters.

details.title: Abyss Chamber
details.short_description: Maintain an underground research facility full of abyss entities. Fulfill their needs and survive long enough to solve all of the mysteries. Abyss Chamber is a lore-rich, first-person psychological Horror game.

details.title: Bumpers & Dragons
details.short_description: Drop balls. Slay dragons. Bumpers & Dragons is a pachinko roguelite where physics meets strategy. Engineer your luck, create wild combos, and crawl deeper into procedurally generated dungeons.

details.title: 鱼干集团那些事：征途
details.short_description: 《Furry Journey in Other World》 IP Furry Anime 2D Role-Playing Visual Novel GameYou will take control of the protagonist — HuiYuan — and continue writing the story of Yugan Group in this sci-fi world. Embark on an epic journey together with your friends and comrades-in-arms.

details.title: KUBIKA
details.short_description: KUBIKA is a Sokoban-like puzzle adventure. Manipulate gravity and guide charming little cubes across three-dimensional, perspective-twisting puzzles. Master each world’s unique mechanics, build and share your own puzzles using the built-in Level Editor. Free Demo available today !

details.title: WarSlice
details.short_description: Take command of your army in WarSlice! Fight for the glory of your favorite faction, choose your commander, and rally your troops to victory in strategic turn-based battles. With intuitive controls and simple mechanics, even newcomers can engage in intense matches!

details.title: Melody Flow
details.short_description: Catch the notes. Save the melody. Fly through procedurally generated musical worlds, dodge shifting obstacles, and compete for high scores in fast-paced arcade gameplay. Play solo or challenge a friend in split-screen multiplayer.

details.title: Fuel Needed
details.short_description: Race against time or other players through difficult levels full of obstacles.

details.title: STEEL CORE
details.short_description: STEEL CORE is a tactical turn-based strategy about giant mechs defending mining outposts on hostile worlds. Build each mech from parts, fortify your base, and survive an escalating roguelite campaign against an overwhelming alien enemy. Frontier work pays well, for those who survive it.

details.title: Knights v Zombies
details.short_description: Knights. Zombies. Pirate ships. Giant robots. A chaotic 1-4 player couch co-op hack and slash that starts medieval and ends in maximum carnage. If that sounds like the ravings of a six-year-old, that's because it is! It was designed by a kid with crayons and built by his dad in Unreal Engine.

details.title: The Heretic's Seal
details.short_description: Two heretics. Sixty-six ways to break a seal. A dark party RPG where your equipment, gold, and levels carry forward — only the dungeon resets. Pick your pair. Descend. Survive. Or come back stronger.

details.title: The Deconsecration Initiative
details.short_description: A short incremental game about building a machine to kill a god. Fire your laser, collect the shards and grow your base. The god will corrupt your workers into slugs, crystal trees and worse. Put them to work anyway.

details.title: The Singular Ones
details.short_description: Help a group of teenagers with unique powers uncover the mystery of the Soul Mirror in this cozy logic mystery puzzle game. Place characters and objects in the right rooms at Corvane Academy by following a set of coexistence rules.

details.title: Snapshot Survivor
details.short_description: Snapshot Survivor is an action-focused take on Snapshot, inspired by games like Vampire Survivors with an extra dose of naughty story telling. Roam around in an outskirt of Tokyo trying to survive taking upskirt pictures for profit to unlock new weapons and cutscenes!

name: They Stop for Gas at Night

details.title: They Stop for Gas at Night
details.short_description: A first-person horror simulation game. You owe money. So you work nights at a gas station in the middle of nowhere. Serve whoever shows up, and try not to think about what's watching from the dark. Something ancient is watching, and it isn't planning to leave.

details.title: The Blinking Room
details.short_description: One night, young Lily wakes from a nightmare — unaware that her real nightmares are only just beginning. Uncover the secrets hidden behind closed eyes.

details.title: Zoti's Train Workshop
details.short_description: Rotate pipes, restore steam flow, and repair stubborn old trains in this cozy hand-drawn puzzle game from the world of Sly Crow.

details.title: Pollex
details.short_description: Enter the pit. Bet your fingers. Survive the thumb war. Pollex is a first-person horror game set in an underground thumb war fight pit. You owe a debt you can’t pay. The only way out is through the ring ,where every match is played for keeps, and the house always takes a cut.

details.title: Desktop Planet
details.short_description: Desktop Planet is a sci-fi building game centered on automated production lines. Start with mining, smelting and manufacturing, plan your logistics and power supply, then assemble a fleet to explore new planets.

details.title: Still Breathing
details.short_description: Keep your family alive in an underground bunker after the world collapses. Manage scarce resources, explore the ruined city, and make brutal decisions when desperate strangers start knocking on your door.

details.title: Castle Wars: Legacy
details.short_description: A fast-paced card strategy game with deck building, PvP, tournaments, and a campaign, inspired by the classic Castle Wars flash game

details.title: Homunculeye: Seer’s Ascent
details.short_description: Climb a merciless ascent where every mistake sends you falling. In this brutal rage-platformer, claim the power of those who stand in your way to discover the truth.

details.title: 落樱
details.short_description: 落樱是一款将AI聊天与Galgame结合的聊天恋爱模拟游戏。你可以自由与落樱对话、与落樱一起游玩各种小游戏。在游玩中你可以体验到落樱的多种性格，并触发随机事件。

name: WE DIDN’T KNOW WHAT TO CALL THIS GAME [So... we just left it like this!]

details.title: WE DIDN’T KNOW WHAT TO CALL THIS GAME [So... we just left it like this!]
details.short_description: A comedic meta Visual Novel with a cinematic presentation and an interactive world where everything responds to your clicks, while you and the characters constantly blur the boundaries between the story, the creative process, and reality itself.

details.title: My Demon Academia
details.short_description: Raise a runt into the King of Demons, battle its siblings and overthrow the Demon King. Power is earned. Family is optional.

details.title: Farming & Defense - Farmfence
details.short_description: Supermarket Simulator meets Farming Simulator—with zombies. Build your store, grow crops, and survive nightly undead attacks in this fast-paced farming defence game. Harvest, sell, and fight to keep your business and farm alive.

details.title: Not My Base!
details.short_description: Build, defend, adapt… or just watch your base burn. Not My Base! is a Tower Defense game where you build up your defenses and fight through various levels. Strengthen your fortifications, choose your upgrades, and craft new strategies to withstand the chaos and havoc unleashed by angry armies.

details.title: Feed The Lone Bastion
details.short_description: An Incremental-Ish game about evolving The Bastion.

details.title: The Saga of Three Realms
details.short_description: A classic sandbox MMORPG. Tame animals and monsters to fight at your side. Plant your house right in the open world, no instances. Master any skill by using it, craft gear that matters, trade across the realm and carve your own legend. No pay to win, no cash shop.

details.title: Talero
details.short_description: Roll the dice, build your combo, and push your limits! Modify your dice, combine powerful Jokers, and create wildly overpowered builds in this roguelike where every roll can change everything.

details.title: The King Must Grow
details.short_description: A physics-based co-op incremental about overly loyal jesters, each with one very important job: Feed cute, entirely innocent slimes to the ever-hungry Slime King. Throw them by hand, then see if you can build systems that do it for you. Play solo, or be lazy and make a friend do the work.

details.title: Bloomtop
details.short_description: A cozy idle gardening game that lives at the bottom of your desktop. Water, harvest and cross-pollinate pixel-art plants while you work, discover 58 hybrids, and grow a flowering vine up your monitor's edges until it frames your whole screen.

details.title: Hoverwick: Village in the Sky
details.short_description: A cozy medieval village floating in the corner of your desktop. Peek in between emails, put up a new house, plant flowers or paint a river, then get back to work. The villagers take care of the rest: they bake bread, go fishing and build snowmen, even when the game is closed.

details.title: Photoncytosis
details.short_description: Photoncytosis is an idle desktop life simulation. A tiny organism feeds on the light of your screen, stores energy in its cells, and grows while you work. Shape its evolution, inspect it under the microscope, and help it survive a changing desktop ecosystem.

details.title: The Debt of Chronos
details.short_description: Travel into the past to build a fortune, save your father from the mob, and prevent a catastrophe in the future. Invest, borrow, and bend the rules of time—but every choice can fracture the timeline and turn the future against you in this narrative strategy thriller.

details.title: Incremental Boss
details.short_description: Play as a dungeon boss in this relaxing incremental game! Gather resources, defend yourself against glory-seeking adventurers, and pursue your ultimate goal: getting promoted to an S-Rank Dungeon Boss!

details.title: Warcamp Rivals: Async Autobattler
details.short_description: Recruit and equip a fantasy warband in this asynchronous PvP auto battler. Cook, brew, train, and forge gear between battles. Combine traits and powerful Edicts, then test your squad against other players’ saved armies. Climb the ladder to become the best Camp Manager.

details.title: Sword for Hire
details.short_description: Hire your blade out to a dying city. Cut through the horrors in its streets, grab every valuable you can carry, and trust your eyes while you still can, the longer you stay, the less of what you see is real. When the bell rings, run.

details.title: Fieldworks
details.short_description: Start with a hoe and four tiles of dirt. End with an agricultural empire. Farm, breed, and chain 179 recipes across four tiers — with no rot, no bankruptcy, and nothing that can ever die. Quality only goes up. The only enemy is your own floor plan.

details.title: Mimic Hunt
details.short_description: Mimic Hunt is a multiplayer stealth game where you blend into crowds of NPCs, pretend to be one of them, and outsmart your opponents across different game modes. Play as a Hider or Hunter, team up with friends in co-op or compete against other players.

details.title: Too Slow Again
details.short_description: A first-person shooter where every level is a race against the clock. Clear the enemies, reach the finish, then do it again, faster. Every hit costs two seconds and restarts are instant. 100+ tracks across four weapon circuits, from assault rifle to sniper.

details.title: Roswell: Redacted
details.short_description: On a summer night in 1947, an unexplained light lit up the sky outside Roswell. That same night, the younger sister of a teenager named Tom Wilson disappeared from their home. Where exactly was the mysterious voice guiding him trying to lead him?

details.title: Gamble Cats
details.short_description: A top-down survivor game where you guide an addicted gambling cat through enemy hordes, dodge danger, collect XP, and grow stronger with auto attacking weapons, stat upgrades, and chest rewards.

details.title: Rise of the Seraphyn
details.short_description: An old-school 3D isometric MMORPG. Roam 100+ tiered zones, shape a character on a sprawling skill web, tame beasts, craft in 20 professions, run trade wagons for your guild, bet on arena duels, and choose a side: fight for one of four cities and let your karma decide what your wings become.

details.title: Starship! Starship!
details.short_description: Blast through asteroids and enemy ships in Starship! Starship!, an arcade space shooter inspired by Asteroids. Fly solo or team up in local co-op, upgrade your ship, and grab power-ups to survive the chaos—or challenge your friends in PvP.

details.title: Gemtide
details.short_description: A short and satisfying incremental game about collecting gems underwater. Break rocks, get gems, go deeper, repeat.

details.title: Click through Earth
details.short_description: Click Through Earth is a short, relaxing incremental game. Gain diamond and coins. Use them to unlock items and upgrade a versatile upgrade tree. Use your own combination of items to make super powerful attacks.

details.title: Cubuild
details.short_description: A puzzle-platformer where you can't jump. Use limited blocks, sprints, and resets to complete the experiment.

details.title: Cue Knight
details.short_description: Cue Knight is a physics roguelite inspired by billiards. Slingshot yourself through dungeons, smashing monsters with precision shots. Collect powerful weapons and items, upgrade your stats, and clear an endless series of rooms in as few moves as possible.

details.title: Professional Money Relocator
details.short_description: So much wealth is cluttering up this place! Enjoy a relaxing, satisfying collectathon where you clear out a massive vault. Pack loot into your bag and upgrade your gear to claim every valuable. There is nothing quite like the sound of crisp bills filling your pockets.

details.title: Hidden Lines - Family mysteries
details.short_description: Find your unknown parent. Follow clues, meet eccentric characters, analyze DNA results, and search archives to solve the mystery of your own life. Secrets, false leads, and unexpected allies await. Every discovery could change your life.

details.title: Novis
details.short_description: You are an Umbra Corporation operator connected to an Avatar on Earth-01 as part of an inter-reality experiment. Build a unique character by combining abilities with dozens of items and spells, interact with the inhabitants of Earth-01, and discover why you ended up in this particular universe.

details.title: Doctor Plague
details.short_description: It tells the legendary story of Doctor Plague, who slays demons and cures diseases. Medical skills are honed through battles, and knife skills are refined through treating patients. The combat part adopts Metroidvania, while the healing part uses rhythm game.

details.title: 3 AM Delivery
details.short_description: In 3 AM Delivery, you play as a sailor tasked with delivering a cursed shipment across a decaying maritime world, navigating shifting environments and uncovering multiple endings shaped by your choices.

name: Crazy Farm: Roguelike Idle Building Game

details.title: Crazy Farm: Roguelike Idle Building Game
details.short_description: A relaxing yet chaotic farming roguelike. Combine quirky animals, items, and strategic layouts to create explosive, poop-powered chain reactions!

details.title: Cats and Hats
details.short_description: Stack Hats on adorable Cats! A cozy roguelike memory deckbuilder where you match tiles, build multis, and stack Hats on a variety of oddly compliant Cats.

details.title: H3xatr0n
details.short_description: Your trail is your weapon... and your biggest danger. Trap endless enemies, escape an ever-changing maze and trigger bullet time to survive. Unlock 13 powerups and discover 30 deadly Quantum Link combos as you grow stronger and chase higher scores in a retro-futuristic neon arcade roguelite.

details.title: The Last Stand
details.short_description: The Last Stand is an endless medieval wave-based survival game where you hold the line while your people escape. Fight off relentless attackers, explore the abandoned castle, upgrade weapons and gather supplies. Every decision will matter, how long can you last?

details.title: Desktop Cat Clicker
details.short_description: What if a cozy desktop game met an idle clicker? In Desktop Cat Clicker, cats wander across your taskbar, earn points from every click as you work, play, or relax. Collect new cats to unlock unique bonuses and grow your peaceful cat empire over time.

details.title: The Curse of Stuzhiy
details.short_description: A short trip through the winter taiga to check on a comrade who's gone quiet turns into a story that should never have begun. Atmospheric first-person horror: explore the empty snowbound forest, follow the tracks, uncover the secrets these places keep. And yes - you're not alone out here...

details.title: Oxygen Frontier
details.short_description: Explore the oxygen-ravaged frontier, battle mutated creatures, recruit bio-companions, and lead your squad to survival in a turn-based tactical adventure.

details.title: Amadea
details.short_description: Run, jump, and climb your way to the summit of an ancient world in this freerunning Metroidvania adventure! Solve the mysteries of the land to correct the course of fate and save the Mountain from eternal winter.

details.title: Saving Yellow Ox
details.short_description: A chaotic co-op climbing race for 2–4 players! Scramble through a floating countryside full of traps, moving platforms, and wild obstacles. A UFO stole your yellow ox — climb higher, shove your rivals, rewind and fast-forward time to carve new paths, and survive to save it.

details.title: Dungeon Convenience Store
details.short_description: Take on the role of a slime part-timer in a convenience store hidden deep within a dungeon! In this 2D top-down logistics simulation, organize chaotic items from portals, manage unpredictable customers and weather, and survive a 7-day shift by optimizing your workflow.

details.title: Jigsaw Panic
details.short_description: Put together giant jigsaw puzzles online with your friends while dealing with chaotic curses, environments, hazards, time limits, and rising difficulty. Also you play as rotund monkeys and you can customize their fur color, butt cheek color, and accessories.

details.title: METAMORPH PROTOCOL
details.short_description: Online co-op horror for up to 5 players. Descend into Army Facility 7, a buried military lab where sample M-7 copies the shapes, voices and faces of whatever it touches. Carry your fallen friends, survive every floor and get out together, or not at all.

details.title: Ashen Blade
details.short_description: Step into a dark, atmospheric world where every descent brings you closer to doom or glory. Ashen Blade is a high-stakes, fast-paced action game set in a shattered realm overcome by darkness. Explore a cursed, vertical land where danger lurks at every level.

details.title: The Waking Grove
details.short_description: A cozy incremental idle about restoring a dead garden, one tile at a time. Spread life across the seasons and let the soil remember everything you grew.

details.title: City of Tales
details.short_description: Reach the City of Tales, uncover the truth about the Big Bad Wolf, and choose Red's fate, one card at a time. A narrative card game set in a fairy tale world turned upside down. Will you restore the power of the Plot, or lead it into chaos?

details.title: Hot Pot Pizza Edition
details.short_description: Slice, bake, box and serve under pressure in a fast-paced first-person pizza game. Survive chaotic shifts, unlock kitchens and truck cosmetics, and go from a messy garage to your own restaurant.

details.title: Mirage - Idle RPG
details.short_description: An idle incremental bullet heaven where you fight waves of enemies, collect loot, and grow stronger every run. Play four different classes, craft items, run a shop, tend a garden, raise pets and keep progressing even while you're away.

details.title: Supermarketeer
details.short_description: Build and run your supermarket solo or in online co-op. Hire employees, assign jobs to suit their strengths and train their skills. Bake goods, handle parcels, pack online orders and tase shoplifters. Customize and expand your store, and react to in-game news and supplier offers.

details.title: W.A.M
details.short_description: Command a bunker’s remote surveillance network to cull an infestation of Molemen from a dark, foggy forest. Upgrade your tactical hardware and pilot scout drones to survive, and keep your guard up; the threat behind you is constant.

details.title: INURE
details.short_description: Wrong man, in the wrong place, at the wrong time. Explore a hostile Dreamscape, manage scarce resources, and use whatever weapons you can find to survive a world shaped by cosmic dread.

details.title: Vem, Exu
details.short_description: A short narrative experience where you solve simple puzzles and explore a world where emotions become interaction. Build a kite, connect constellations, and face a storm born from your own anger.

details.title: Aurenv - Audio Reactive 3D Environments
details.short_description: Aurenv is a music visualizer that takes it one step further by translating both stems and real-time audio into physical motion, dynamic lighting, and responsive elements within 3D environments.

details.title: Synapse
details.short_description: A cyberpunk point-and-click thriller where your emotional score determines everything. Explore a city under constant surveillance, hack its systems, build dangerous connections, and make choices that decide your access - and whether you survive the night.

details.title: Galactic Kebab
details.short_description: A dark survival strategy game about a celebrated chef stranded on a hostile alien world. With Nekobot, your service robot, turn the wreck of your ship into a restaurant, keep the Empire's tax paid, and decide what you are willing to serve. Survive if you can, but can you stay human?

details.title: Between the Shelves
details.short_description: A cozy bookshop management game where customers step out of classic literature. Curate your shelves, recommend the perfect book, and unlock new items and mechanics as your shop grows into a living collection of stories.

details.title: Deceptive Shadows: Final Case
details.short_description: A paranormal detective in Sin City. A missing girl, a chained demon, and a city full of lies. Sounds like a normal investigation. It isn't. Question the demon, fight with guns and magic, solve occult puzzles, and survive its tricks.

name: A Farm About Digging A Tunnel To Escape Totalitarianism

details.title: A Farm About Digging A Tunnel To Escape Totalitarianism
details.short_description: A first-person co-op farming sim in a dictatorship you design yourselves. By day, your family grows the Party's weekly quota under the guards' watch. By night, you dig a secret tunnel under the border wall. Play solo or online with up to 4 players.

details.title: Forgotten Station
details.short_description: Forgotten Station is a knowledge-based narrative game, where you travel aboard trains to find your way out of a time loop. Your curiosity and observation skills will be put to the test in this relaxing game, filled with atmospheric places to uncover, characters to meet, and real human stories.

details.title: TION: Hero Awakening — Idle RPG
details.short_description: Build your hero, collect gear, upgrade your stats and watch your character fight automatically. Push through harder enemies, bosses and new stages in this 2D incremental RPG.

details.title: Tillandsia
details.short_description: Venture through the shifting dungeons of Akirume in a mystery dungeon roguelike featuring a unique real-time / turn-based combat system and over 1900 spells. Gather threads of mana, uncover powerful magic, and carve your path across a continent shaped by ancient forces.

details.title: 众星入海
details.short_description: 大学毕业正在苦于找工作的平凡男生时寻，在奔波中遇到了一位穿着战术服的少女陈枫实。 陈枫实声称自己是末日时期的搜救人员，目的就是拯救世界上最后的幸存者。 时寻望着周围熙熙攘攘的街道，陈枫实望着周围残破的废墟，同时发觉了对方已经疯了的事实。两人抱着对对方的同情，开启了独属于他们的故事。
developers: 失业者联盟游戏制作组

details.title: Cursed Gas Station
details.short_description: At an isolated gas station in the 1990s, Cole takes a night-shift job that comes with a room to stay in. As you serve customers, unexplained events begin to unfold in this psychological horror game.

details.title: PERFECT SNAP: Ultimate Jigsaw Puzzles
details.short_description: Turn any image into a 3D jigsaw puzzle! Solve solo or with friends (co-op & PvP), display your masterpieces in a customizable 3D museum, and visit everyone else's. Personalize your character and take on the 100-level campaign, from easy puzzles all the way to 1000 pieces.

details.title: MILES 27: Look Like You
details.short_description: MILES27 is a psychological horror game told through self-contained stories inspired by disturbing real-life cases. Each episode presents a short but intense experience focused on atmosphere and tension. The game is designed to make players feel watched, unsafe, and uncertain about what is real.

details.title: Mine or Burn
details.short_description: Start with a basic mining ship and snowball into an asteroid-crushing powerhouse in this incremental bullet hell roguelite. Mine asteroids, battle rival miners, stack upgrades, create powerful builds, and survive escalating threats across dangerous star systems.

details.title: 搭搭大战（DaDa Wars）
details.short_description: Dada Dazhan is a casual real-time strategy game. No frantic micromanagement—just focus on your troop formations and city management. Grab a cup of coffee and watch these little cartoon soldiers charge into battle for you.

details.title: 26 Moves: The Queen's Plot
details.short_description: A point-and-click mystery game. Search for the truth in 26 days, playing as two different characters, in a town during 1907.

details.title: Starting a Village from Zero
details.short_description: “This is your own little village.”You are a familiar summoned by the apprentice witch Lily. In her place, build houses and create a thriving village.A new kind of “garden world × roguelite × turn-based strategy” game.

details.title: Inertial
details.short_description: Inertial is a 2D arcade space racer. Race against the clock or against your friends in this reality-adjacent racing experience. No speed ceilings, no warped physics, just realistic gravity, thrust and skill.

details.title: Criterion
details.short_description: Criterion is a space optimisation puzzle game about designing efficient solutions under constraint. Process the color fluxes. Control their strength. Solve increasingly complex networks where every tile matters. There is always a solution, the question is how elegant yours will be.

details.title: Crystal Siege
details.short_description: Explore, build turrets, and prepare your defenses. When night falls, face relentless waves of enemies to protect your crystal. Inspired by Kingdom Two Crowns and Terraria, Crystal Siege blends strategic Tower Defense with 2D action combat, where you must fight alongside your defenses to survive.

details.title: Roll Dice no Die
details.short_description: Choose your pawn and build a dead man's deck! Challenge yourself in a deadly reimagining of the famous tabletop game where every dice roll can save or kill you! Manipulate the board, make fateful decisions, outsmart the Master, and win this ultimate game of survival!

details.title: Wands & Whiskers
details.short_description: Rescue cats, discover rare coats, and grow a cozy network of shelters in this idle cat collector. Wave a wand for a roomful of playful chaos, decorate their favorite spots, or relax while the donations roll in, even while you're away.

details.title: MÁG
details.short_description: Be a mage, a God of control. Learn to to solve combat situations with a wide variety of spells. Summon minions, paralyze enemies, wall them off, burn them, poison them, and more. If you die, you lose all that you carry. Some enemies are dumb and easy to fight, some will make you cry.

details.title: Dig to Mole Dorado
details.short_description: Burrow deep into the earth in this short incremental digging game. Hunt for treasure, upgrade your powers and experience the low-key story of a mole and his dad on a grand adventure.

details.title: Cyberwars
details.short_description: A turn-based tactics roguelike where you run a mercenary company. Draft and deploy a deck of soldiers and vehicles, hire new mercenaries in the field, take territory against an AI opponent or your friends on hand-built maps, and clear contracts before the week timer ticks to zero and the run ends.

details.title: Syntherion
details.short_description: Syntherion is a top-down space shooter in which each level is built around a single song. The weapons, enemies, environment, and objectives are all derived from that licensed track. The library spans 20+ artists that have signed on, and is still growing.

details.title: Hop Slash
details.short_description: Jump, slash and collect with Hop, the non-stop hopping Bunny Knight in this 3D platformer in the spirit of the N64 and PS1 classics, with a twist: he won't stand still, so chain your moves across the floating islands of Celestina.

details.title: Manafinder II
details.short_description: The world does not need saving; you do. Mankind has ended, yet the world moved on. Take the role of Rey in this turn-based RPG and fight ferocious beasts and other existential threats alongside a disparate cast of allies as you seek purpose in a world that no longer welcomes you.

details.title: Dream Ocean
details.short_description: Journey across an ocean of strange worlds in a story-driven JRPG. Follow your companions’ stories, combine skills across classes, and lead your party through ATB battles and tactical encounters. Discover hidden dungeons and abilities that change how you fight and explore.

details.title: Shroomanoid: breakout action roguelike
details.short_description: Forget classic breakout games. In Shroomanoid, you are the projectile. Control the frantic flight of a giant mushroom, smash enemies into a bloody pulp with precise ricochets, and stack insane combinations of abilities.

details.title: The Sievert Scale
details.short_description: A surveillance horror based inside a nuclear power plant. Monitor CCTV, Identify hazards, document incidents and keep operations running. Report too much and you fail the weekly audit, too little and danger spreads. What’s happening deeper inside the plant was never meant to be monitored.

details.title: Crown & Spores
details.short_description: Medieval CO-OP simulator where you grow magical plants, brew potions, create illegal products, trade with customers, and build your own underground empire in a fantasy world.

details.title: Subclidean
details.short_description: Subclidean is a puzzle based single-player where you traverse and navigate infinite worlds, solving non-euclidean based puzzles and uncover the truths about the secrets of why you are here and how to escape.

details.title: Retire in the Fairy Mountains
details.short_description: Retire in the Fairy Mountains is a Chinese-style farming game that integrates planting, fishing,cooking, mining and free building. Players take on the role of a farmer at the foot of the Immortal Mountain, unlock various interesting items and build their own world.

details.title: Devils on the Moon Pinball
details.short_description: A classic-style Creature Collecting Pinball game based on old school masterpieces with modernized gameplay. Pixel-crafted in full monochromatic glory.

details.title: Hotel Simulator
details.short_description: Take control of a motel in Winston Springs! Design unique interiors, care for guests, earn and invest in a hotel network. Plan room layouts and furnishings, and hire staff. Transform outdated spaces into luxurious apartments with attention to every detail. Will you create the hotel of your dreams?

details.title: Deep Space Survivor: Endless Starfield
details.short_description: "Deep Space Survivor: Endless Starfield" is a survivor-style game. Your interstellar battleship accidentally enters an unknown universe, fighting its way through endless enemies, roaming multiple star systems, and collecting meteor resources to forge your ultimate orbital weapon.

details.title: Blunderball
details.short_description: Arcade football where the ball sticks to whoever touches it. Dash to steal it, shoot it along the line you push it, and throw your character's magic: a hat that becomes a hole, a slowed-down world, two decoys. 1v1 or 3v3 with friends or bots. Three minutes, at least one blunder.

details.title: Glimtide
details.short_description: A tiny island of jelly creatures that lives on its own, for everyone at once. Glims eat, sleep, fall in love, build villages and pass their skills to their babies. Watch them, bring a treat, adopt a favourite, design your own species, or drop a banana peel.

details.title: Smoothie Chaos
details.short_description: A co-op slime restaurant game for 1 to 6 players. Raise slimes in your garden, feed them strange things to see what they evolve into, then blend them into smoothies for a dining room full of hungry humans and robots.

details.title: Arrowhead
details.short_description: ArrowHead is a single-player bullet hell game… where getting hit is the only way to hit back. Rotate around the battlefield to ensure that you get your fill of arrows to shoot back. Slo-mo dash to squash your way through enemies!

details.title: Jin Gambit
details.short_description: Your formation shapes the battle. JIN GAMBIT is a single-player roguelite auto battler where you position and merge units, then watch your strategy play out in automatic combat. Build on your formation with heroes, artifacts, training, and awakening as your expedition progresses.

details.title: LFG Battles
details.short_description: Async PVP auto battler where you build a party of heroes and gear them up to fight other players. Craft synergizing combinations as you try to break the game with your build! Dominate the ranked leaderboard or explore absurd combos at your own pace in casual mode.

details.title: Heidentor
details.short_description: Fantasy PvE/PvP MMORPG build around classic player based economy and gear based progression systems

details.title: Blind & Seek
details.short_description: The seeker is blind — they hunt by sound. Every footstep, every thrown stone and every word you say on the mic lights up their world for a moment. Stay quiet, sabotage your friends, and make sure you're not the one wearing the blindfold when time runs out.

details.title: Mini Market Tidy Up
details.short_description: A cozy pixel-art organizing game about tidying up messy supermarkets. Sort products, stock the right shelves, earn money, unlock upgrades, and take on bigger stores as you turn every chaotic market into a perfectly organized space.

details.title: SpartanBit
details.short_description: SpartanBit is a voxel arena FPS for competitive battles and custom game nights. Fight over flags and control points, survive 50-wave BitHorde with up to 8 players, or build your own levels in Creator Mode. Multiplayer battles support up to 24 players.

details.title: Oh Sheep! It's UFO
details.short_description: Hop aboard your UFO, abduct sheep from Earth and bring them back to your home planet! Collect upgrades along the way, and don’t forget to get some help from your trusty dog friends!

details.title: Crown of Ages
details.short_description: A turn-based 4X strategy game set in an organically crafted fantasy antiquity. Build cities, advance through new ages, wage wars, and unleash magic. Roguelite choices shape every city and every run anew — until the world ends and your empire is reborn from the ruins.

details.title: Fly-Fishing
details.short_description: Fly-Fishing is a casual "fishing" game with a unique twist! In this game, you and up to 3 friends will be able to take to the skies, playing as fish themed characters. Where you will be able to utilize your array of upgradable equipment to fish for a large variety of real and fantastical birds!

details.title: DEMON JACKPOT
details.short_description: A roguelite auto battler where slots summon your minions. Shape your army through evolution and runes, rewrite each run with the Demon's Revelation, and turn the tide with Demon Skills as you reclaim the lands seized by humanity.

details.title: Three Kingdoms: Art of Command
details.short_description: Three Kingdoms: Art of Command is a turn-based strategy game on a hanji paper map. Command paper armies, use your officers' tactics, and fight duels. Receive envoys and negotiate pacts in your audience hall. Govern cities and fight for the realm with 610 officers across 7 scenarios.

details.title: STEADY STATE
details.short_description: Is your factory any good? STEADY STATE tells you. Mine mixed ore, sort it, smelt it and move it by belt, rail and drone. Then prove your site works: every order you have taken, delivered at its rate, all at once, for thirty seconds. Certify to unlock new machines, better grades unlock them sooner.

details.title: The Last Homecoming
details.short_description: A top-down mystery horror game rooted in Korean folk beliefs. Return to your childhood village after twenty years. Explore by lantern light, solve puzzles, and escape pursuit as buried memories surface. This homecoming may be your last.

details.title: Blitz: Last Stand
details.short_description: A top-down roguelite horde shooter. Hold one perimeter for 100 waves as one of six operators, evolve 11 weapons into Mythics and break ten bosses. A new upgrade every second level, a commander every tenth wave. Black Site ECHO-7 fell in eleven minutes. Nobody mentioned extraction.

details.title: Terminal Depth
details.short_description: An incremental digging game where buried salvage fuels a growing excavation to unearth ancient artifacts and piece together a lost history with every layer you uncover. Upgrade your tools, unlock automated helpers, and blast through tougher layers with powerful abilities.

name: Take Your Time - A Relaxing Collection of Minigames

details.title: Take Your Time - A Relaxing Collection of Minigames
details.short_description: The most hectic relaxing game you'll ever play

details.title: Arena Shooter
details.short_description: Hop in a tank. Call in a nuke. Flatten the fortress. Battle your friends and bots in a top-down arena shooter with 20 unique maps and modes, 60+ vehicle types, 40+ perks, zombie hordes and a classic Zombie Boss, in a fully destructible world where everything goes.

details.title: Taco Truck Simulator
details.short_description: You will run your own food truck: take orders, cook fresh ingredients, and quickly assemble delicious tacos while hungry customers wait in line. But running a food truck is about more than speed: source supplies wisely, maintain steady cash flow, and win over diners with every satisfying bite

details.title: Overdepth
details.short_description: An idle loot RPG that lives in a strip above your taskbar. Your character fights somewhere deep and dark while you get on with your day. You decide how far down to send them — then glance at the bottom of your screen to see what came back up.

details.title: AXIDENT
details.short_description: Battle your friends in a series of mini games to win the golden axe. May the BEST jack win!

details.title: GearTopia
details.short_description: Supply a war you don't fight. A steampunk factory with no wires anywhere: water, steam, shafts and gears. When flat ground runs out, build downward. Fill the orders of dwarven fortresses — they hold only as long as you keep shipping.

details.title: Get Stronger! Auto‑Chess
details.short_description: This is an auto-chess game. By combining units' skills, passive abilities, and synergies, units can grow infinitely stronger.

details.title: Xenon Protocol
details.short_description: Xenon Protocol is an online co-op roguelite card game (2-6 players) based on synchronization and trust. Travel to real-world nuclear sites, coordinate card plays through a decaying temporal signal, defeat bosses and try to undo an apocalypse. Without saying a word.

name: The Tidy TeaShop: Tidy Up the Tea Collection

details.title: The Tidy TeaShop: Tidy Up the Tea Collection
details.short_description: Tidy Up 2130 tea boxes with no time limits in this cosy organising game. Read the labels and study the packaging to return every blend to its proper shelf. Organise the shop and help the occasional customer find the tea they want, always at your own peaceful pace.

details.title: Zero Day
details.short_description: Zero Day is a short incremental typing game. Type words to destroy enemies, push through twenty stages, beat unique bosses, and unlock a huge perk tree!

details.title: Disaster City: Magical Girl Dispatch
details.short_description: Disaster City: Magical Girl Dispatch is an anime RPG combining urban wasteland exploration, companion collection, paper-doll progression, and ATB turn-based combat. Explore the high-pressure city of Tianyuan, collect perks, awaken magical transformations, and craft stories in the built-in editor!

details.title: Stepwell
details.short_description: Stepwell is a puzzle game about building impossible paths. Arrange and overlap tiles to create surprising connections, discover new ways to use each piece, and guide little inhabitants as you rebuild their shattered world.

details.title: Conquer
details.short_description: Build, trade, and fight in this competitive multiplayer shooter played on a board. Build settlements and roads across a shared island, trade resources with your rivals, and gun down anyone who stands between you and the victory point goal. You can Conquer the world!

details.title: Crittermancy
details.short_description: Become a Crittermancer in this roguelike deckbuilder with real-time combat. Master the art of critter alchemy: combine, transform, and mutate critters to discover new cards and build your deck. Venture deep into the dark forest and unleash your creations against the monsters lurking within.

details.title: Chobisuke's Weird Farm
details.short_description: Protect the farm by any means necessary. Grandpa’s secrets, the mysterious villagers, and the yokai that emerge at night... Every mystery and a thrilling battle await you!

details.title: Get Up, Man!
details.short_description: Get Up, Man! is a ragdoll comedy about Kolya, an engineer taking part in the first public experiment in crossing between universes. Four limbs, three actions, one voice off-screen and a very long way home.

details.title: Mad Cafe
details.short_description: Serve coffee, pastries, and smiles to increasingly disturbing customers in this atmospheric psychological horror game. Keep the café running, master the perfect brew, and try not to lose yourself as each shift becomes more unsettling than the last.

details.title: Another One
details.short_description: Flip 7 cards without a repeat and you'll hit like a truck. Draw a double? Bust, your whole hand is gone. A push-your-luck roguelike deckbuilder with silly boosters, bosses that cheat, a Daily Challenge leaderboard and a mode where you build your deck from scratch.

details.title: Recruiting Against Rodents
details.short_description: View resumes, hire employees, train them into roles, and defeat the rodents! Recruiting Against Rodents is a small indie roguelike auto-battler where you, a hiring manager, must build a team to fight 15 waves of rats from a nearby cave.

details.title: Beetle Island
details.short_description: Beetle Island is a relaxing idle game for beetle lovers. Buy beetles, raise them and sell them to grow your fortune! Turn an empty patch of land to a buzzing oasis filled with exotic beetles, wacky decorations, and love!

details.title: Jellscape
details.short_description: Jellscape is an arcade-style fast paced race against doom. Control your gloopy ball to navigate daunting trails and obstacles. Each death is just another chance to prove you have what it takes to beat the next level!

details.title: Primal Tactica
details.short_description: Recruit a team of Primals, then equip and evolve them to survive deadly encounters! Loot powerful Relics and Augments and stack synergies to create wild gamebreaking teams. Primal Tactica is a roguelike autobattler where TFT meets Slay the Spire, with thousands of possible builds.

details.title: Blightsilver
details.short_description: Join a paranormal investigation where card battles are the key that uncovers the conspiracy beneath the city. Duel on a secret 5×5 grid. Reveal your opponent’s hidden information—while they hunt for yours.

details.title: Silas' Speakeasy
details.short_description: The local speakeasy has been closed down for quite some time due to an undisclosed incident involving the local mob. You've been given the job of finding your way inside, locating, and destroying any and all incriminating evidence that you can get your hands on before it can be used against you.

details.title: Harrowgate Asylum
details.short_description: HARROWGATE ASYLUM is a first-person survival horror where fighting back is not an option. Study patrol routes, slip between hiding spots, and hold your breath while something walks past you in the dark. If you are seen, running is all you have left.

name: Dragon's Chronicles~双星のレギンレイヴ~

details.title: Dragon's Chronicles~双星のレギンレイヴ~
