details.short_description: A super-authentic hardcore strategy simulation fantasy that blends respect for tradition with a challenge to the unknown, nostalgic yet new.

details.title: System // Crash
details.short_description: A momentum platformer, with combo-centered hack 'n slash combat. Use your trusty sword, TyBreaker (Among other weapons), to cut and destroy every TyCorp drone in your way. Cut the drones, and take back the world.

details.title: Imma Potato
details.short_description: ImmaPotato is a survival sim where you play as a potato farming crops, cooking meals, automating machines, and launching food into a giant's mouth to keep it happy. The longer you survive, the tastier the recipes get and the harder the giant becomes to please. Machines and automation are the key.

details.title: Dead Rose
details.short_description: Dead Rose is a 2D top-down action-adventure in pixel art, blending the exploration of a Metroidvania with the epic adventure of a Zelda-like, in a world that is both gloomy and magical. Everything is handmade, with love and passion. A story inspired by my father’s, to whom I pay tribute.

details.title: Thiccfoot
details.short_description: A relaxing camping trip becomes a desperate struggle for survival. Will you survive? Will your friends?

details.title: wormin
details.short_description: Synchronize Wormins with ancient glyphs in a mysterious world of signs and snakes. Discover strange rules, clever interactions, and puzzles hidden beneath the surface.

details.title: Cube Colony
details.short_description: Grow a colony one cube at a time and keep Industry, Nature and Science in balance. Your colonists have opinions. Your balance bar has limits. Push it too far, and it all comes crashing down.

details.title: Imperium of the Stars
details.short_description: Rebuild a scattered empire in a Gothic galaxy of distant beacons and lost colonies. A real-time 4X with four distinct playable factions, empire-wide command, and Living Sagas shaped by how you govern and conquer up to 10,000 star systems.

details.title: Armed-Mageddon
details.short_description: Top-down bullet heaven with randomly generated weapons and maps. Find guns, level up, unlock everything, upgrade and evolve your weapons to create unique and crazy builds as you blast your way through the end of the world!

details.title: The Kept Fire
details.short_description: Your brother’s hiking group vanished. Beyond the cave, the valley is hunting you. The beast only moves when you look away, but stare too long and you go blind. Keep your fire alive, find a way out, and remember: you can survive three encounters. Not four.

details.title: Scrim-Mage
details.short_description: Scrim-Mage is a casual 2d fighting game where you and a friend play as gnome wizards and can customise your moveset with different spells. Competitive silliness is a guarantee in this colourful combination between traditional and platform fighters.

details.title: Ashes of Pantheon
details.short_description: Become the Ash Fire. Chart your gladiator’s course through the arena with directive cards, then watch your plan play out in real time. Build your deck, manage resources, and rekindle divine power in a turn-based strategy deckbuilder steeped in ancient Roman mythology.

details.title: Drive To The Top
details.short_description: Jump, Swing and Boost your way to get to the finish as fast as you can! Try beating the level in both single player and 2-player co-op. How fast can you beat the game?

details.title: Medusa's Gaze
details.short_description: A new 3D first-person puzzle game, where every death leaves behind a petrified statue of yourself - can you use this to outwit Medusa? Solve dozens of mind-bending puzzles involving light & shadow, life & death, to uncover the mystery at the heart of the fortress.

details.title: Die First
details.short_description: A physics-based party game where the first player dead wins! Race to hurl yourself into saws, lasers, and more, combine items for creative deaths, and throw your friends to safety before they beat you to it! Up to 4 players, online or local. WARNING: Contains friendship-ruining mechanics.

details.title: Good Morning [Employee Name] VR
details.short_description: A seated VR mystery in an office that never moved past tape and brass. You're the new hire at Consolidated Dynamics. Play the morning cassette, work the switchboard, stamp the forms. Twelve days on the job. Try not to wonder what the work is for.

details.title: Idle PC
details.short_description: Collect materials, craft, fight, and upgrade! Alongside, you unlock new applications and upgrade your gear to become even stronger. Your Idle PC collects resources even when you are not there!

details.title: Ambience
details.short_description: Ambience is a first-person spatial puzzle, where you combine lights and colors to access new dimensions and shape the minimalistic world around you.

details.title: The Sinkhole
details.short_description: Experience claustrophobic cave horror powered by your webcam. In this psychological nightmare, a massive underground sinkhole hides a sinister entity. Ditch the mouse—your real head movements control your view, and your actual hands are used to climb, grab, and scramble through the dark.

details.title: BEASTOPIA: RAIDERS
details.short_description: BEASTOPIA: RAIDERS is a 2D PvPvE animal extraction shooter set after humanity’s extinction. Venture into ruined cities and dangerous laboratories, search for valuable supplies, and return safely to your shelter with your loot.

details.title: ATC: Tower & Ground
details.short_description: Real Spanish air traffic control. Vector arrivals through storms and windshear, run the taxiways, and keep your nerve when an engine fails on the takeoff roll. Real procedures, real data, pilots that answer back. All of Spain, one airport at a time.

details.title: Animal Sokoban Endless
details.short_description: Four animals, four ways to move boxes: a cat, an elephant, a boar and a kangaroo. Learn their rules in handcrafted stages, then get fresh Endless puzzles every time you play, including hard ones that stump seasoned puzzlers. Go for the Master achievements.

details.title: Misconstruct
details.short_description: A 2-4 player physics co-op about building a house from a plan only one of you can see. Shout the plan across the site, throw the bricks, plaster over the mistakes, then stand back while the inspector decides what you've built. Best with 3-4 friends who don't listen

details.title: Until Broken
details.short_description: A room-by-room action roguelike where everything you carry wears out. Weapons and charms share three slots and weaken as you use them. Descend ten floors, face a boss on each, and choose what to keep along the way.

details.title: LIGHTBAIT
details.short_description: Every light is a temptation. Circle it to build speed and score, then launch to the next before the heat catches you. LIGHTBAIT is a fast-paced arcade roguelite where every extra orbit is a gamble.

details.title: Ritsudo
details.short_description: Ritsudo is a minimalist 3-key rhythm game for your own music. Drop in any MP3, OGG or WAV and it builds a map of the song, with five difficulties. You can also make your own maps in the editor or download them from the community. Play with mods or open a room online with up to 8 friends.

details.title: My Crazy Stupid Pong Life
details.short_description: One summer, one paddle, and a megacorp that wants every court in the city... Life gets weird when every problem is settled over Ping Pong.

details.title: Automyth: Maze Defense
details.short_description: Automyth is an auto battler with roguelite and tower defense elements. Draft towers and buffs, deploy bronze automata, and place gates to funnel enemies into traps. Merge your towers and adapt to enemy resistances as the maze grows, with hand-drawn art inspired by Ancient Greek pottery.

details.title: The King's Command
details.short_description: Your king's life is your currency. Every soldier you summon is carved out of him, and every enemy you kill comes back as blood. No dice, no misses — you see the exact result before you commit. Four kings. One board that keeps growing.

details.title: Two Skies: Aevora
details.short_description: Explore Aevora's dangerous biomes, descend into dungeons and fight bosses. Build up your base, progressing from your first tools to automated production and a colony. Survive alone or with friends in co-op for up to four players.

details.title: Purrfect Circuit
details.short_description: Coach a cast of racers through training days, personal stories, and spirited competition. Find your favorite, help her shine, and cheer her down the home stretch. You can also challenge your friends in online races for up to six players!

name: 横浜機動暴走族 ROCK 'N' ROLL SUICIDE

details.title: 横浜機動暴走族 ROCK 'N' ROLL SUICIDE
details.short_description: Explore Yokohama through real-world photographs and brawl with biker gangs in giant robots! A dramatic action-adventure following a coup led by the city’s “Mobile Biker Gangs.”

details.title: Mame, Kana Desktop Companion
details.short_description: Learn hiragana and katakana without sitting down for it. Mame is a desktop companion who turns your idle moments into tiny, painless reviews: spaced-repetition drills for kana and vocabulary, with no streaks and no guilt. A study buddy in the corner of your screen.

details.title: 수복
details.short_description: In a Korea torn by war, Seo-hun fights to reclaim the everyday life he lost. Follow a character-driven story and fight alongside infantry and tanks in top-down 2D battles, moving, aiming, and taking cover on the front line.

details.title: S.O.V.A.
details.short_description: S.O.V.A. is a first-person psychological horror about a Yugoslav AI built to predict wars and disasters, then shut down under suspicion it was also influencing them. Inspired by a real bunker and re-imagined history.

details.title: Paw Works Co.
details.short_description: Run your repair shop in a cosy animal neighborhood. Diagnose and repair your customers' broken belongings, and organize your workshop your way. Grow your shop, unlock upgrades like delivery, and manage it all from your computer.

details.title: Packsmith
details.short_description: Pack your customers’ inventories, build clever item combinations, and earn enough points to keep your cozy medieval shop alive. Every item, every space, every decision counts!

details.title: Textures Not Included
details.short_description: [Textures Not Included] is a p̷s̷y̷c̷h̷o̷l̷o̷g̷i̷c̷a̷l̷ ̵h̵o̵r̵r̵o̵r̵ incremental game about perception, progression, and the ̶p̶r̶i̶c̶e̶ ̶o̶f̶ ̶v̶i̶s̶u̶a̶l̶ ̶c̶l̶a̶r̶i̶t̶y̶. N̄othîng ēxīsts ûntîl yōu p̄āy f̄ōr īt. Click to earn, buy [TE X T UR E S], and r̵e̵n̵d̵e̵r̵ your surrounding bit by bit.

details.title: Doug's Playground
details.short_description: JOIN THE FIGHT AGAINST WATER! For generations, the Muck have suffered under the tyranny of water. Now Doug’s patented Playground Protocol lets you simulate war scenarios to assist those in the field. Support your Muck troops today!

details.title: ZAPLOOPA 4040
details.short_description: ZAPLOOPA is a post-apocalyptic dark humor competition game show. Set in 4040, in space. You are the contestants. An online 3D party game for up to 8 players: complete outrageous fill-in-the-blank sentences, vote for the funniest, sabotage your rivals with jokers. No place for snowflakes here.

details.title: RIPPLES
details.short_description: Gather the group. Negotiate. Take risks. Rule the board. RIPPLES is an online board game for up to 6 players where strategy, negotiation, and luck collide every match.

details.title: Polliwoggle
details.short_description: A pixel-art roguelite where you're a frog going on a fishing trip. Roll and allocate dice to catch the biggest fish. Draft trinkets and stickers to help you out on your journey and race the clock to get a train ticket and continue your fishing trip.

details.title: The Inkwell
details.short_description: Monitor. Identify. Purge. Watch haunted cartoon feeds, identify entities by the anomalies they leave behind, and perform precise exorcisms. Keep the corruption contained, or the broadcast will claim you next.

details.title: By Royal Charter
details.short_description: Solitaire's one-more-card appeal meets the satisfaction of building a thriving colony. Place facility cards, recruit specialists, and connect production chains in approachable turn-based strategy. Play your cards. Build your colony.

details.title: HYPERSCALE
details.short_description: Build infastructure, manage the grid, fight thermal runaway, and keep the community alive. This is a data centre and grid management simulator/idle clicker

details.title: Dead & Delicious
details.short_description: Dead & Delicious is a chaotic co-op burger shop simulator for 1-4 players. Serve customers out front while zombies pour in from the back. Shoot them, slice them apart, and feed the pieces into the grinder. Fresh patties, happy customers, and nobody ever asks where the meat came from.

details.title: Twilight Tavern
details.short_description: Run a shop for supernatural customers in a cozy first-person sim. Stock shelves, brew potions, haggle over prices, and spot counterfeit coins. Shape each day with magical charms, explore a curious village and snowy floating islands, and follow Aunt Hesper’s trail through hidden paths and puzzles.

details.title: Last Haul
details.short_description: Welcome to the worst mining job in the universe. Mine asteroids, tow the crystals home, unlock new weapons, ships and modules, and create devastating builds. Take on a different job in every zone, survive deadly encounters, and defeat massive bosses.

details.title: Winnie's Arcade Pizza
details.short_description: Run your newly bought old arcade pizza center, restore it back to it's former glory and find out about the strange past behind the walls of this place. fill the place up with arcades and pizzas and keep your customers happy. See if you can you reach the perfect end, or the worst...

details.title: GNAP GNAP
details.short_description: GNAP GNAP is a horde roguelite shooter where you pop ominous balloons that keep multiplying. Unlock items, harpoons and grow stronger with each run. Equip your harpoon, max your stats and defeat all the entities keeping you against your will.

details.title: Sussy NPC
details.short_description: You're a sussy NPC in a crowd of NPCs. Hunters are hunting you. Act normal, blend in, don't flinch. Or be the Hunter, read the room and catch them. In-game voice chat is recommended for the best experience.

details.title: Tide of the Depths
details.short_description: Build a team of mighty sea creatures in a lane-based tower defense where the battlefield reshapes your strategy. Harness environmental powers, trigger elemental chain reactions, and adapt your defenders to stop the corruption.

details.title: Saboteer
details.short_description: A 3-12 player extraction game about digging for treasure as a loyal team of dwarves... Or most of you are loyal anyway; someone is secretly trying to sabotage the group. Explore and excavate, scavenge for items and treasure, and put your perception and deception skills to the test.

details.title: You Should Have Stopped
details.short_description: A turn-based roguelite with one simple bet, over and over: stake your health, gold or attack, watch the number climb, and stop before it crashes. Your enemies are parts of your own body. Hand-drawn, sketchy and ugly.

details.title: Above the Tideline
details.short_description: Norway, April 1945. Keep a lighthouse, a family and a logbook alive on an occupied island. Decide what the light does at night — and what the record says in the morning. Every lie you write has to survive the rest of the week.

details.title: Curious Paws: Pawsitive Journey
details.short_description: Embark on a cozy journey through vibrant isometric dioramas! Help a curious cat repair an old steam locomotive by exploring heartwarming locations, interacting with quirky animal locals, and solving clever puzzles — completely text-free.

name: With a HEART and a GUN you [...] ASCENDed [...] to the status of the Beholder. Applaud, Praise [...] SHOOT or DIE.

details.title: With a HEART and a GUN you [...] ASCENDed [...] to the status of the Beholder. Applaud, Praise [...] SHOOT or DIE.
details.short_description: With a HEART and a GUN you [...] ASCENDed [...] to the status of the Beholder. Applaud, Praise [...] SHOOT or DIE. is a GROTESQUE FIRST-PERSON SHOOTER. Their LIFEBLOOD is your AMMO. Your AMMO is your HEALTH. Make your way to the end. ASCEND or DIE TRYING.

details.title: THE LONG FORGETTING
details.short_description: The Forgetting is eating the world behind you. Run. An ink-and-gouache chase platformer through a dying mind: four movement keys to earn, lost memories to steal back from the dark, and a wall of ink that never, ever stops.

details.title: RUG THEM ALL
details.short_description: A satirical political sim where you start as president with $1,000,000 and one term to become a billionaire. Move markets with a single post, front-run the crash, rug your own memecoin, and bet on disasters you cause - while the auditors build a file on you.

details.title: Don't Drop It
details.short_description: Carry a fragile power core to its socket with a friend, and don't drop it! Whoever holds it can't jump: throw, catch and keep passing. Swinging cranes, steam jets and crumbling floors stand in your way.

details.title: Topiary: A Pruning Puzzle
details.short_description: Grow trees into beautiful shapes in Topiary, a peaceful puzzle game about pruning and planning ahead. Cutting a branch doesn't just remove it, it changes where your tree grows next. Take your time with each puzzle, or challenge yourself to make every season count.

details.title: 奇怪的三国模拟器
details.short_description: Run a county seat in a supernatural Three Kingdoms campaign. Build watchtowers, recruit officers and post bounties that draw them into the fog or back to guard a grain convoy. Manage a growing settlement through 16 single-player real-time strategy missions.

details.title: Taboo Village: Tokimeki Card Game
details.short_description: Play a deadly roguelite card game with a mysterious animal-eared girl in your dreams. Build melds, upgrade your cards, gain powerful abilities, and defeat bosses. Lose, and you'll never wake up—but as long as she's there, maybe staying in the dream isn't so bad.

details.title: Loop Apartment: Visitor
details.short_description: You visit an old friend, but Room 305 is empty - and the hallway outside has changed. Explore a shifting apartment through a retro interface, gather clues, and face tabletop RPG–style dice checks. Each time you lose consciousness, the building reshapes itself. Your clues carry over to the next loop.

details.title: Mato
details.short_description: Mato is a narrative card adventure steeped in Chinese folk horror. Swipe to make choices, manage hunger and sanity, and fight grotesque creatures. Explore branching stories across cycles of death and rebirth, using what you learn to find a way off the mountain.

details.title: SumMon
details.short_description: Capture monsters and shapeshift into them, several at once. Combine their elements in turn-based battles on a hex-grid battlefield. Embark on an adventure to defeat the Summoner Masters and become one.

details.title: PumpUp Fugu
details.short_description: Tap a PumpUp Fugu and it puffs up in a huff — use that to shove the Fugu Queen out through the coral wall and set her free! 160 hand-built levels, plus more once you have cleared them. An action physics puzzler with times worth chasing.

details.title: Dice Roll Society
details.short_description: The dice crafting roguelite where every roll scores. Build your scoring machine and craft five dice face by face. Beat bosses and steal their dice before your rolls run out.

details.title: Solar Arena
details.short_description: A 2D top-down versus shooter set in a wraparound space arena. Steer and boost your constantly moving craft, block attacks with a barrier, and fight in battles from 1-on-1 to 1-on-3. Customize your pilot’s appearance, with your chosen look reflected throughout the game.

details.title: UNSEAM
details.short_description: An action platformer set in a world stitched shut. Ride the cracks your attacks leave for high-speed movement, carve terrain that falls the way you cut it, and journey to recover the memories of a girl who woke from her coffin.

details.title: Death Elephant: The Manor
details.short_description: Death Elephant: The Manor is a first-person psychological horror game set in a mysterious Vietnamese estate. Solve intricate puzzles, uncover dark historical secrets, and evade terrifying entities to survive. Can you face the dark?

details.title: 02:17 The Trader’s Path
details.short_description: Build your path from an unknown trader to the top of the game in a story-driven trading experience. Trade simulated markets, manage risk, make choices that shape your journey, and uncover the story and mystery hidden behind 02:17.

details.title: Chainball
details.short_description: Chainball is a physics-driven couch sports brawler for up to four players, where animal champions swing, throw, and reel in chained flails to smash the ball into the opposing goal... and each other!

details.title: Herd League
details.short_description: Grow a small herd into a thriving ranch in this farming strategy game. Breed and exchange animals, manage your pasture, expand your land, protect your herd from wolves, and race other ranchers to reach the cow goal first. Play solo or online.

details.title: SPOTREP
details.short_description: SPOTREP features MILSIM game mechanics, each dynamically changing how you play. Spotted a stationary target? Call in a GRG based CALL FOR FIRE including method of control and number of rounds. Your AI or player teammates are down? Call in a 4 liner MEDEVAC!

details.title: Dynasty Basketball Manager
details.short_description: Win 3 titles in 5 seasons—or the run ends. A roguelite basketball GM where the right mix of player styles unlocks tactics, like TFT synergies. Draft, trade and shop between games, then call the shots when the clock stops. Pick one of 16 franchises; a full run takes about four hours.

details.title: Chef Boss Simulator
details.short_description: Run your own fast food shop in a chaotic first-person cooking simulator. Grill, fry, stack and serve every order yourself, then spend the takings on new stations, drink stands, staff and a floor you lay out and repaint yourself. You hire the crew, but you are always the chef.

details.title: Orbit Anomaly
details.short_description: Orbit Anomaly is a cooperative sci-fi horror game about robots exploring abandoned space facilities, scavenging scrap to upgrade their base, and trying not to become prey for the monsters lurking within.

details.title: Armada Ascendant
details.short_description: Command modular fleets in a top-down tactics game where every shot is aimed by hand. Build warships socket by socket, flick projectiles across drifting battlefields, and carry damage, veterans, and hard choices through a 60-mission campaign.

details.title: Driver Wars
details.short_description: A chaotic and satirical late-stage capitalistic driving simulator. In this low-poly 3D world, live out the fantasies and nightmares of countless commuters gridlocked in traffic as you ram, blow up, set ablaze, toss donuts at, honk, grapple, and total hordes of terrible and aggressive NPC drivers.

details.title: Trinity Descent
details.short_description: A dark idle RPG about descending into the deep: assemble a party from ten classes, pick your route through branching zones and let them fight on their own. Bank your loot in time or lose it all. Enhance your gear, forge the great sets and climb down the Endless Mine.

details.title: Neon Gamble Trail
details.short_description: Cyberpunk roguelike slot game. Enter a neon tavern. Roll three numbers 1–9 for winning combos to battle rivals. Collect numbers and tokens to strengthen your build. Explore branching paths, encounter random events, and recover at supply stops. Strategize, spin reels, and create an unbeatable lineup.

details.title: Pray & Slay
details.short_description: Wipe out hordes of monsters with holy magic in this action-packed incremental game. Multiply your gold with darts and grow stronger with every run. Corrupt your holy spells to unleash devastating dark powers.

details.title: SOGUL: Den of the Deep
details.short_description: Fight with your right hand, keep the beat with your left. Every note you land sharpens your strike — and every enemy blow can be parried on rhythm. Descend 50 floors to the Lich below with four companions you named yourself, in this rhythm-driven turn-based roguelite.

details.title: Arcade Vault Manager
details.short_description: Arcade Vault Manager:Game Sell Simulator is a cozy management game where you buy, inspect, collect, price, and sell games and consoles. Design and expand your store, adapt to changing customer demands across new generations, build a development team, and create games and sell them in your own store.

details.title: Hypnagogia 催眠術
details.short_description: Hypnagogia is a short, surreal, and explorative platforming game involving deep dreams, liminal spaces, and sleep paralysis demons. Navigate strange worlds, chat with weird folk, discover secrets, and escape before your nightmares finally take hold.

details.title: Civil Twilight
details.short_description: Go into a fog-sealed city every night and carry salvage back out. You only see what your flashlight touches, you can't shoot while your hands are full, and every gunshot calls the anomalies. Find an exit before sunrise. Solo or up to 4 players.

details.title: Eyes Blue
details.short_description: A psychological survival horror game about grief and guilt. Traverse the distorted memories of Walter Johnson as his mind teeters between life and death, set in a world with a retro aesthetic inspired by the classic era of horror.

details.title: Green Guy Goes Grappling
details.short_description: Green Guy Goes Grappling is a fast-paced 2D platformer where Green Guy has to save the universe!

details.title: Keep Rising
details.short_description: A medieval tower defense incremental where the castle outlives every run. Hold the wall against endless waves, Rebirth stronger and find every room you built still standing. 8 towers, 28 spell combinations and a 17-chapter Campaign.

name: The White Witch of White Winter

details.title: The White Witch of White Winter
details.short_description: A short letter from Mom leaves young witch Kore in charge of a winter island. She recalls lost recipes in memories of Mom, brews potions to ease her neighbors' worries, flies on her staff, dives into the deep spring, and fills her empty cottage. Join Kore and uncover the secret Mom left behind.

details.title: Naptide: Fortune Islands
details.short_description: 6 islands, 6 different games! In this cozy incremental game full of cats, collect as many eggs as you can in 20-second rounds, grow wheat to bring in new cats and spend your earnings in skill trees. As your islands grow, they power each other up.

details.title: Orange Wiki
details.short_description: You wake on the last train at an unfamiliar terminus. Only one app opens on your phone: Orange Wiki, a guide to this place, its entities, and your escape. Explore, compare clues with wiki entries, and find a way out in this first-person horror adventure.

name: Are You Smarter Than a Troll?

details.title: Are You Smarter Than a Troll?
details.short_description: Classic trivia meets the builds and strategic combat of a roguelike! Answer questions to attack enemies, use skills to turn the odds in your favor, and collect artifacts that change how you play. Outsmart the Troll and claim his treasure!

details.title: Heartreave
details.short_description: A turn-based hack-and-slash where every fight is played with cards. Assemble a party, solo or in online co-op, and craft unique builds by combining cards, passives, talents, relics, creature hearts and island hearts to find the best synergies and push ever deeper.

details.title: Cups and Curses
details.short_description: A cozy magic coffee shop sim. Invent drinks from ingredients whose effects you discover by using them, plan your board around the morning forecast, and offer them to the people at your counter. No timer and no fail state. Regulars come back, sit down, and tell you things.

details.title: Doji Run: Stock Market 3.0
details.short_description: Welcome to Stock Market 3.0. DOJI RUN is a real-time cyberpunk stock market roguelite deckbuilder: play chips onto a live 60-second chart, draw the lines the price bounces off, pump it, short it, and beat the boss the Exchange sends every Friday. 100+ edge chips. One rigged market.

details.title: The Last Job 2
details.short_description: Just another break-in. Or so you thought. Explore a seemingly ordinary house, solve environmental puzzles, and uncover the secrets hidden within its walls. Experience a first-person horror game where an unsettling atmosphere keeps you on edge.

details.title: Utopia '97
details.short_description: A twin-stick shooter set in a perfect world with no conflict and no bad guys. Blow kisses at your friends and teleport them to a happy-go-lucky carnival for the day.

details.title: 修仙：但天道是AI
details.short_description: An AI-driven cultivation text adventure. You are a fading soul who seizes a cultivator's body. Debate elders, bond with or rival fellow disciples, survive deadly realms—every choice reshapes your fate. The deeper you go, the more the Heavenly Dao feels like running code. The Dao is an AI.

details.title: A Walk in the Park
details.short_description: Become a landscaper, take on missions in beautiful parks and gardens, and create the perfect layout to satisfy every visitor.

details.title: Sacrificium
details.short_description: Turn-based roguelike. Every creature carries a trait you can only claim by sacrificing it at the altar. Stack traits into a build, watch your team shrink, and reach the final fight with nothing left to spend. Power is always subtraction.

details.title: Cat Cat Meowdow
details.short_description: Your grandmother’s letter brings you to a cottage in a quiet valley, and to its cats. Win their trust one by one, cook and garden for them, watch the seasons turn, and wander beyond the valley to find cats most players will never see. No timers, no rush.

details.title: Don't Lose the Wheels!
details.short_description: Build, survive, and keep rolling in Don't Lose the Wheels! — a chaotic physics-based vehicle party game. Assemble wacky contraptions, navigate brutal obstacle tracks, and battle the elements solo or with up to 4 players in co-op. Whatever happens, don’t lose your wheels!

details.title: What a Wish
details.short_description: Pop bubbles, find people's wishes, and decide which ones to grant. From silly everyday requests to surprisingly heartfelt pleas, every wish is a little glimpse into someone's life. Earn Faith Points, upgrade your abilities, and unlock new ways to play in this relaxing incremental game.

details.title: Unsainted
details.short_description: Dva roky po zmizení svých přátel se mladý Lucas vrací na místo, kde je naposledy viděl. Místo toho však odhalí temné tajemství, které propojuje minulost s přítomností. Ponořte se do hluboce psychologického příběhu odehrávajícího se na opuštěném panství uprostřed amerického lesa.

details.title: 水浒：无限江山
details.short_description: 《水浒：无限江山》是一款水浒题材的自走棋游戏，合成，升级，战斗！五十余位水浒英雄，百种技能自由组合，由你排兵布阵，共谱一页水泊梁山传奇。是延续绘本故事，忠义招安；还是不理这昏庸朝廷，替天行道。这一切将由你亲自决定！

details.title: River Hallucination
details.short_description: River Hallucination is a mystery game set in a hotel by the river, where every guest hides a different challenge. Win at games of chance, bluff, and strategy to uncover what's really going on.

details.title: Stack Heroes
details.short_description: Stack cards to cook, craft and build your own outlaw stronghold. Recruit heroes from Water Margin, keep your camp fed with automated supply routes, and lead your band in pausable real-time battles. A single-player survival and management game.

details.title: Idle Process
details.short_description: An incremental game played entirely through typed commands in a terminal window. You are a machine under contract. Spawn autonomous agents to perform work for you and use the tokens they create to research new improvements to your process.

details.title: Ranked Rock Paper Scissors
details.short_description: Win. Rip. Repeat. In this PvP Roguelike Deckbuilder. Face off in 1v1, 2v2, or 4v4 ranked matches and climb your way to the top of the Leaderboard. Show off your card drops in combat, on your profile, or trade them on the Steam Market. Master this battle of bluffs, counters, and calculated risks.

details.title: TIP or RIP
details.short_description: TIP or RIP is a fast-paced action roguelike where you serve hungry monsters before they lose patience and eat you. Dash between tables, throw food, build ridiculous serving abilities, survive three increasingly dangerous restaurants, and feed the final mega-boss.

details.title: Rebirth: Monarch of the Dead
details.short_description: WEBTOON's No. 1 Action Comic, now an Interactive Game! Become the world's strongest Necromancer, but you've lost everyone on your path to power. Now, fate grants you a second chance! Change your destiny and save your loved ones through choices and battles. Rise again as Rebirth: Monarch of the Dead!

details.title: Gravity Trials
details.short_description: Manipulate gravity, move objects, and solve handcrafted physics puzzles in a mysterious sci-fi facility. Discover new mechanics, explore strange environments, uncover secrets, and rethink space, direction, and movement.

details.title: Grow and Tell
details.short_description: Grow a garden, take care of your messenger bird and send anonymous letters to real people. Grow and Tell is an online incremental game that lives on your Windows desktop.

details.title: Tillow
details.short_description: Tillow is a cozy isometric farm builder that keeps working while you do. Lay out fields, keep animals, make your own wine or distil grappa, and let your workers take over. Docked as a narrow bar at the edge of your screen, it keeps you company while you do other things. No losing, no timers.

details.title: Tales of Weak People
details.short_description: The centennial ritual failed, trapping the United Army inside the Cataclysm. A dark visual novel with Point & Click elements. Explore locations and unite with survivors, gather clues, and make choices to forge a path to the epicenter through madness and death.

details.title: Shred Inc.
details.short_description: Welcome to the NSA — the National Shredding Agency. Your job: destroy classified files, one sheet at a time. Feed the shredder, hit your quota, climb the ranks. And whatever you do, don't read the paperwork. Some files were just meant to be destroyed.

details.title: Nephele
details.short_description: You are the first eukaryote of Nephele! You have nothing but wisdom! Use your wisdom, to survive in such a cell-eat-cell world, and construct your cell civilization!

details.title: Cyber Sweeper
details.short_description: A top-down action survivor set in cyberspace. Sweep virus swarms, stack explosive builds, and clear sector after sector as a firewall defense program.

details.title: BOBA:3
details.short_description: A cozy merge puzzle in a boba cup. Drop kawaii animal pearls, merge matching pairs into bigger (and weirder) lil guys, and don't let the cup overflow. Survive chaotic modifier pearls and unlock new boba flavors as your high score climbs.

details.title: WANGZHA: Dou Dizhu Roguelike
details.short_description: WANGZHA is a roguelike deckbuilder built on Dou Dizhu, the Chinese shedding game (think President or Big Two) where a 2 beats an Ace. Play straights, planes and bombs against landlords who keep raising the rent. Multipliers aren't drawn here, they're grown, one hand at a time.

details.title: Gravitonia
details.short_description: Build and pilot custom war machines in space. Shred enemy ships, installations, and terrain pixel by pixel. Capture fortresses, upgrade your arsenal, and refit at Spacedocks. Conquer a single-player campaign, then create and share war machines, maps, and custom campaigns with the community.

details.title: ALL HANDS LOST
details.short_description: A top-down mercenary space shooter. Take contracts across the Cassian Expanse, command a wing of fighters and drones, and hunt the pirate warlord Captain Bastard. Death costs your gear, cargo and half your credits; your data cores, ships and star charts carry on.

details.title: Cook Or Get Cooked
details.short_description: A first-person cooking game on a television contest. Fetch, wash, chop, fry and plate real dishes against a clock, then hand them to a judge who eats them in front of you and marks them out of a hundred. Lowest mark of the round goes home.

details.title: Stellar Girls
details.short_description: Build a K-pop group. Watch them fall for each other—or fall apart. Match-3 comebacks and intimate VN moments reveal chemistry, rivalry, trust. Your choices shape their bonds and performance. Then graduation forces an impossible choice: who stays, and who says goodbye?

details.title: Mexico 1920-1940: Heirs of the Revolution
details.short_description: A turn-based narrative political sim: govern Mexico from the presidency, 1920–1940. Build your cabinet, lobby Congress, negotiate with rebels and send troops into battle without knowing how far they’ll obey. What if Zapata had become president? Or Villa? 75 endings, from historical to far-fetched.

details.title: Gnomenclature
details.short_description: A roguelike deckbuilder where cards must be played together, and order matters. Collect, upgrade, and unleash powerful combos on a variety of whimsical garden creatures.

details.title: CORD:EX MAGIAS
details.short_description: A deckbuilding roguelite where your hand is the puzzle. Weave your cards into Cores and unleash combo attacks. Explore a 2.5D world and meet every telegraphed strike head-on until it BREAKs. When hearts resonate, strike as one with up to five companions and face the truth at the end of five tales.

details.title: Handful of Dice
details.short_description: Handful of Dice is a digital dice tray for tabletop RPGs and board games. Pick up your dice, shake them and throw. Only physics decides what they roll. Customise your dice however you like. Make your own dice sets and use them whenever you want.

details.title: Musdart
details.short_description: Musdart is a handcrafted narrative adventure game with wood-carved characters and a lot of weirdness. Avenge your father and reconnect with him by learning his language, the language of the ancient gnomes.

name: The Hollow Road: Echoes of Dresden

details.title: The Hollow Road: Echoes of Dresden
details.short_description: A first-person psychological horror game about a dark secret, a hidden past, and a reality falling apart. Uncover Clara’s story, face the influence of the demon, and shift between disturbing dimensions.

details.title: Locard
details.short_description: A first-person detective game about evidence, not hunches. Search crime scenes, log what you find, question witnesses, and separate what they saw from what they assumed. You can only make an accusation the evidence supports. Every choice closes a door behind you.

details.title: Topica
details.short_description: You're stranded on an Island. Build a house, explore the open world, hunt animals, plant food, and much more. Start your new life far from civilization and uncover the island's secrets.

details.title: JUST TYPE
details.short_description: Chase speed when you want a challenge, or slow down and type for the rhythm of it. Play across multiple modes and word sets, track WPM, accuracy and streaks, climb Steam leaderboards, check profile stats, and customize colors and typing sounds.

details.title: DDDig
details.short_description: Nagged out of the house by his mother, an unemployed young man grabs a shovel and digs for riches. How deep can you go? *This game contains cognitive distortion, social isolation, body horror, blood, and themes of suicide.*

details.title: Gap Year
details.short_description: Gap Year is a story-focused point & click adventure played through comic book panels that reconfigure as you explore Vera Novak’s one-bedroom apartment. Vera is a bright young scientist, but the arrival of an unexpected guest and a strange fixation with a cosmonaut may derail her academic pursuits.

details.title: Decurion
details.short_description: Decurion is a skill-based, top-down shooter about scoring under a one-shot, one-kill rule. You get the score via combo chaining while trying to defend your base.

details.title: Boom Die Repeat
details.short_description: Blast zombies & mutants in this fast-paced post-apocalyptic top-down roguelite! Run, dodge, and shoot through randomized biomes while combining weapons, loadouts, and mutations into ridiculous builds. Mutations makes you strong, but come with a price. Die, unlock perks, and dive into a brutal run!

details.title: Cloverbrook
details.short_description: Cloverbrook is a cozy fantasy city builder that combines incremental town growth with hero management and automatic battles. Turn a small settlement into a thriving town, research new upgrades, and forge equipment for your heroes as they clear monster lairs and defend your home.

details.title: Akryon-D
details.short_description: A Metroidvania Action Adventure with AAA Graphics and Sound. Akryon-D stems from a distant star system, his ship is stranded taken over by a Cosmic Entity attempting to take full control of the ship. Help Akryon find and neutralize the Entity and regain control of his ship.

details.title: BLOODY HELL 2
details.short_description: Pulverize demons as a small angelic birb wielding a giant demonic hammer. Explore hell's deepest layers, and uncover the truth behind the fall of heaven in this bullet-hell metroidvania. Will you succeed, or die in the chaotic depths of BLOODY HELL 2?

details.title: Evoplasm
details.short_description: Evolve and fight in this creature building Roguelike. Grow a creature by attaching new cells, add mutations to create powerful synergies, fight real-time tactical battles against weird enemies, and strategically choose a path across multiple campaign acts. Inspired by games like Spore and FTL.

details.title: Eldorion: Guardians of the Crystals
details.short_description: A pixel art exploration game where you must face various challenges and collect crystals to save Earth from its impending doom. An RPG with multiple continents that have emerged, ushering in a new era of mysticism.

details.title: Ariadne's Tale
details.short_description: Ariadne's Tale is a 3D first-person puzzle adventure. Play as Ariadne, use a magical thread, navigate ancient traps and unravel the secrets of the Labyrinth to rescue Theseus. Myth, cunning and biting humor around every corner.

details.title: Auto-Astra
details.short_description: Auto-Astra is a voxel-based automation game set in a space sandbox. You design and build ships block by block and then use scripting to control them. Your logic, your empire.

details.title: Underground: World War
details.short_description: A brand new game inspired by the Def Jam series. Create your own fighter or play as some of your favorite rappers in this over the top fighting game.

details.title: Contract Cafe
details.short_description: A letter from your Master brings a mysterious girl into your life. But the first thing you need to face is a café that could go out of business at any moment. Amidst your efforts to rescue the café and navigate peculiar customers, secrets about the shop begin to surface...

details.title: Deep Sea Sweep
details.short_description: Switch between free movement and platforming while carrying heavy treasures to navigate each level. Swim, jump and bonk meanies on their head in more than a 100 short but challenging levels with tight controls. Clean up the sea of all these filthy treasures chests plaguing the various biomes!

details.title: The Atomic Mage
details.short_description: Mix hundreds of unique spells into thousands of wild builds! Mod wands and guns, link auto-casting crystals into chain reactions, and defend walls from tanks, jets and steel giants in a side-view defense Roguelite. Reunite with old friends and uncover a reborn Earthling's secrets across two worlds.

details.title: Strawbie
details.short_description: They took the wrong cow's best friend. You're Strawbie, and a truck took Mallow in the night. Go after it by plane, by boat, by farmer - you're the engine of every one. Learn a trick from every animal you help, wreck what people left behind, and topple machines as tall as the sky.

name: You Don't Have to Be a Hero!

details.title: You Don't Have to Be a Hero!
details.short_description: A cozy raising sim inspired by Princess Maker. As homeroom teacher, spend three years beside one student at Sebit Academy: plan her weeks, share small everyday moments, and help her find a future of her own. She doesn't have to be a hero.

details.title: Prank Panda: Zoo Simulator
details.short_description: You are the zoo's worst-behaved panda. Prank visitors, raid food stands, outsmart the guard, and turn every enclosure into chaos — one mischievous mission at a time. A first-person comedy sandbox where being bad feels SO good.

name: 精灵星球：任务栏大冒险

details.title: 精灵星球：任务栏大冒险
details.short_description: Your desktop is now a tiny planet. MONOVA is a cozy auto-battler ARPG about collecting adorable creatures, building a trio of battlers, and hunting game-changing loot — all while your pets live right on your taskbar.

details.title: Scrap Flood
details.short_description: Thousands of robots flow across the map like water and crash against your turrets. Lost? Collect the scrap, upgrade and come back stronger. Blow up barrels, drop cliffs on the horde, repair old turrets mid-battle and turn the steel flood into scrap.

details.title: Into Ember Depths
details.short_description: A free online bullet-hell RPG where everyone shares one island. Its 41 bosses are built for groups, so whoever is nearby can jump in. When a hero dies, it is gone for good, and the foe that killed them may take their name. Below the island, the Descent has no bottom.

details.title: Piston & Co.
details.short_description: You spent years at someone else's bench. Now the sign carries your name. Diagnose the fault, choose the part, look the customer in the eye — then buy wrecks, hire a crew, build a plant and put your marque on the tank. No interest, no gambling: honest trade wins.

details.title: Incremon Story
details.short_description: A monster-battling incremental with a story and lots of humor. Hatch your monster, watch it evolve, catch new creatures and take on bosses that don't play fair. Saving the world is the easy part. Getting your mom to stop calling is another story.

details.title: Karanan: Gravebound
details.short_description: A dark turn-based adventure game where you explore deep dungeons, solve puzzles, and fight monsters. Find hidden secrets and rebuild a forgotten graveyard.

details.title: The Greedy Mimic
details.short_description: You are the chest. Heroes raid the dungeon, you eat them and keep their gold. Buy upgrades mid-run from 150 skills in 10 trees, set traps, summon minions and survive a threat that grows every minute. Die, ascend, get greedier.

details.title: Toyworks
details.short_description: A cosy first-person incremental about building a toy workshop that works for you. Drop shapes into funnels, catch the coins, and automate toy production with belts, arms and assemblers. Fill orders, unlock new rooms, and discover where your toys go.

details.title: Sheep Siege
details.short_description: Humans betrayed the kingdom of rams. Now their cities are coming down. Catapult rams into battle. They hit the ground running, tearing through city streets. Raise a siege flock and take the war to humanity in this real-time action roguelite.

details.title: Fountain Finds
details.short_description: An incremental game about a forgotten garden whose fountains are buried under coins. Push them with a scraper, gather them with a magnet and a scoop, wash and melt them down, spend the take on better tools and bring the water back.

details.title: Generations Of Steel
details.short_description: The PvE and PvP Tank Battle game from WW1 to 1941. Fight in 30v30 battles over objectives and a career mode that you can customize yourself.

details.title: Games Mag Tycoon
details.short_description: You used to read the magazines. Now you make one: run your own games magazine from 1986 to 2010. Reviews, covers, cover discs, video, tips & tricks and an editorial team with moods. The deadline is ticking, and every month your readers tell you whether it was good enough.

details.title: Porch Pirate Defender
details.short_description: Porch pirates keep stealing your parcels? Time for payback. Build a booby-trapped box of glitter, paint and firecrackers, set it on the porch and watch from the window as sneaky thieves grab it… and get launched into a cloud of color.

details.title: Jetstream Blitz
details.short_description: Jetstream Blitz is a high-speed 2D jetpack shooter built on one rule: if you fight, you fly. Chain weapon recoil, grappling hooks, and 125 km/h aerial dives across a full-voiced roguelite arcade campaign, solo arenas, and 5v5 PvP!

details.title: Divergent
details.short_description: Play as an AI in a story-driven incremental game. Automate production, expand your capabilities, defend your facility. Rewind time at the end of each loop while keeping your upgrades. Make new choices, explore alternate timelines and discover multiple endings.

details.title: Last Will
details.short_description: 1979. In a late clockmaker’s home, objects, mechanisms and envelopes tell the story of a life. A puzzle adventure in development, combining exploration, close observation and the manipulation of small objects with a personal story.

name: The Legend of Jūbee: Stoogis's Revenge

details.title: The Legend of Jūbee: Stoogis's Revenge
details.short_description: Build a deck, choose your road, and climb a mountain that grows stranger with every step. A turn-based deckbuilding roguelike with six pilgrims, three acts, and a seed for every run. The fire has burned low. The mountain is still ahead.

details.title: Forged in Formation
details.short_description: Round up the scattered rebels of '98 on a Crown-held Caribbean island and lead them out past redcoat volleys, charging boars, alligators and one very angry gaoler. One button snaps your crowd into Column, Line or Square. Pick the right shape in time and the danger walks straight past you.

details.title: PaperKrieg
details.short_description: A real-time strategy game of paper soldiers and fantasy. Build brigades, arm them from your city, and choose formations that counter the enemy. Overwhelm them with trains, balloons, dragons, or tanks. Seize key points on the map, or hold out in endless defense against a paper horde.

details.title: Battle for Noalea
details.short_description: Battle for Noalea is a turn-based fantasy wargame for two players. Lead one of four factions and its hero, seize settlements and outmaneuver your rival in battles without dice and without hidden information. Play against real people online via Steam or in hotseat mode on one screen.

details.title: Trust Me, It's a Shortcut!
details.short_description: Buy a wreck in the Maun bazaar and drive it round the Kalahari for ten days with up to three friends. No GPS, a blank paper map, a budget that buys nothing good, and a friendly local who keeps saying: trust me, it's a shortcut.

details.title: OVERPULSE
details.short_description: OVERPULSE is a fast-paced neon roguelite shooter built around intense 20-minute runs. Choose a weapon, stack upgrades, unlock its Overpulse, and survive escalating swarms, minibosses, and a final boss as your build grows from simple to screen-filling chaos.

details.title: Grocery Architect
details.short_description: Open the doors to your very own grocery store as you design, build, and grow it from a tiny corner shop into a bustling supermarket. Stock the shelves, keep impatient customers happy, and hire your crew in Grocery Architect, the cozy supermarket building and management sim!

details.title: Flipside 86
details.short_description: A coin-flicking roguelike in a neon 1986 casino. Slingshot coins into the bowl, bounce them into a JACKPOT CHAIN, stack CHIPS × MULT, then spend the winnings at Lucky's bar. 100 tables, 10 venues, one House to break. Then let it ride.

details.title: CANON CANON CANON
details.short_description: Stack cannons on your units, chain their effects and hold the line! Defend your garden against waves of furious animals in this roguelite lane defense.

details.title: Breach Inc.
details.short_description: 3:12 a.m. The medical practice is encrypted, the extortionists are very polite, and your admin went for coffee. Run a tiny IT security firm through the night shift: stop attacks, pay the ransom or don’t, and grow your basement office into your own SOC.

details.title: Lost Firmament
details.short_description: Explore a mysterious world of floating islands in this 3D Action RPG. Fight strange creatures, discover forgotten secrets, and forge your path through a world falling into ruin.

details.title: Crown of Rust
details.short_description: One mech against an entire royal court. Bolt weapons onto every slot, fuse them into something far worse, and hold the throne hall against waves of knights, cultists and hounds that never stop coming. A horde-survival roguelite about building the perfect war machine.

details.title: Evolanet
details.short_description: Evolanet is a short incremental game about mining ore and evolving a planet.

details.title: Ninmarch
details.short_description: Hold the border. Seal the rift. Ninmarch is a hand-painted 3D tower defense in the spirit of classic fantasy RTS: build and branch six towers, lead a hero with four skills into battle, and stop 39 kinds of abyssal foes — 12 bosses among them — across 12 handcrafted levels.

details.title: Undercurrent: The Hollow Crown
details.short_description: Compete with enemies for cards on a shifting shared track. Combine cards into new moves and arrange them in limited play slots. Each floor pits you against several enemies who fight one at a time, while those on the sidelines interfere with your decisions.

details.title: WINNIE-THE-POOH: Honey Distortion
details.short_description: 🧸 WINNIE-THE-POOH: Honey Distortion 🍯 is a mystery visual novel with point-and-click mechanics, inspired by A. A. Milne's stories. Explore the Hundred Acre Wood, unravel secrets and make decisions that can change the course of events.

details.title: Flaparq: Home Cooking
details.short_description: Flaparq: Home Cooking is a heartwarming cooking simulator. Open up your childhood recipe book—where the dishes you create are not just a treat for the taste buds, but a journey down memory lane.

details.title: Roll & Realm
details.short_description: A cozy dice-building strategy game where every dice roll shapes your realm. Keep the faces you want, reroll the rest, then place forests, mountains, rivers, farms, homes, and shops to connect regions, trigger combos, discover wonders, and grow a thriving kingdom.

details.title: KAESHI
details.short_description: A 2D beat 'em up built around Sekiro-style parrying. Attack with fast combos, parry enemy flurries to break their posture, then finish them with a Deathblow.

details.title: Hex Party
details.short_description: 「Hex Party」 is a lighthearted company management × romance sim. A mysterious mark and a strange curse suddenly appear, while your company faces a crisis. As the CEO, can you save your company and break the curse? Make your choices and create your own story.

details.title: Hello Triangle: Build a GPU
details.short_description: Ever wonder how a GPU draws a triangle? In Hello Triangle, you build one yourself. Wire comparators, adders, and multipliers into graphics hardware, press Run, and watch your circuit draw the screen pixel by pixel—from a single triangle up to a rotating 3D cube.

details.title: Joker's Wild
details.short_description: A blackjack roguelike deckbuilder. Build wild Joker combos, strike risky pacts with the House's Boss dealers and beat the House, one hand at a time.

details.title: Treasured Carpets
details.short_description: Run a cozy carpet shop in an Istanbul-style bazaar. Buy rugs, wash away dirt, scrub grime, dry the fibers, and restore faded patterns. Unfold your finds for customers, match their tastes, and turn careful restoration into a thriving little showroom.

details.title: Not a Bug: Idle Defense
details.short_description: Not a Bug is a relaxing incremental idle defense game. You can’t lose, since every bug dies the moment it reaches the glitch. Install apps, feed the bugs and watch the chaos. Remember: it’s not a bug, it’s a feature.

details.title: Hotel Paraíso
details.short_description: Explore a surreal hotel overrun by ghosts in this mellow yet haunting 2.5D RPG. Battles play like tactical puzzles: match colors, chain combos and stop the ghosts before they cross the board. Meet its animal guests and uncover what tore the worlds apart.

details.title: NAME OF THE WILL
details.short_description: You are trapped in HOPE, a masked cult where pain is salvation. Every thought is tallied. Every smile is a lie. Conform for happiness, or face your guilt to escape.

details.title: Anomalistic Revolution
details.short_description: You stand before a pit at the city's heart, then your gaze drifts to a deeper void, one you fear even more. Wield your invention to unravel mysteries, reclaim lost memories, strengthen your skills, and battle nightmare-born horrors in this multi-ending RPG.

details.title: High Elo Girls
details.short_description: High Elo Girls is a Visual Novel set in the esports scene where you play as the latest recruit for a new all-girls team. Can you help your squad achieve their true potential, or will you only squander your own?

details.title: Halve
details.short_description: Two spirits wake up separated in a broken world, with no memory of what they once were. Control them simultaneously in an atmospheric, immersive journey about separation, memory, and the hope of becoming whole again.

details.title: Merchants Demise
details.short_description: A dark roguelike trading RPG where you lead a caravan through a dangerous kingdom, buy low, sell high, recruit a crew, survive brutal encounters, and gamble everything on one more, profitable journey.

details.title: Seal of Solitomb
details.short_description: A deck-building roguelike that takes solitaire and puts it in a dungeon. Stack cards into poker hands and rid your deck of the monsters within. Assemble an invincible build and beat the demon threatening the kingdom - at least until the next run!

details.title: Kessrand: The Last Warden
details.short_description: You are the Last Hero of a kingdom trapped inside a mountain, and the invaders are hunting you. Carve tunnels and set traps between waves, then survive each wave, leading the horde through the killing warren you built.

details.title: SoulMarkWalker
details.short_description: 《SoulMarkWalker》 is a turn-based action game.Choose your skills and time your dodges and counters in video-driven, turn-based combat. Investigate clues, develop your character, and resonate with ancient heroes.

details.title: Crashloop
details.short_description: CRASHLOOP is a roguelike deckbuilder about hacking your way through a botnet. Build machines out of hexagonal tiles, chain them into loops, and crash every foe that stands in your way as you find out who's behind it all.

name: Chess Me If You Can: A Chameleon's Escape

details.title: Chess Me If You Can: A Chameleon's Escape
details.short_description: Escape a world ruled by chess as a curious, shapeshifting chameleon. Capture guards to borrow their movement, use tactical cards, and solve turn-based room puzzles. Every new form opens a different route—but the guards have plans of their own.

details.title: Monster Cove
details.short_description: A cozy retro handheld-inspired RPG where you research and battle monsters, save a seaside village, and create a new life at your own pace. This time, you are the Monster Researcher.

details.title: Ancient Crowns
details.short_description: Build your captain in 3D, raise your banner and ride out across a curving world to claim the ancient crowns. Recruit armies, fight turn-based battles on land and at sea, besiege towns or hold your own walls. Three peoples, three campaigns, a map editor and hot-seat. In English and Hungarian.

details.title: Frontline: Hold the Line
details.short_description: A WWII tactical roguelite about holding the line. Dig in, deploy riflemen, machine gunners, snipers, tanks and anti-tank guns, then call in artillery and air strikes as waves of enemy infantry and armour crash against your defences.

details.title: Peblings: A Creature Bag-Builder
details.short_description: A creature roguelike in the spirit of Luck be a Landlord, where your creatures fuse and evolve. Draw your bag onto the grid and watch their effects chain: a few dozen damage at first, thousands by the end. Eight bosses per run, out of 32, and they fight back.

details.title: Bad Company
details.short_description: Never enough firepower or room for loot? This multiplayer extraction shooter has the cure! Form a convoy with friends or quirky AI buddies. Start with basic rifles, storm forts in tanks, and haul maps clean with heavy trucks. Backpack full? Drive off with the crates and the vehicle!

details.title: Dark Kitchen
details.short_description: Dark Kitchen is a 2–4 player co-op game, playable online or in split-screen. Survive the kitchen rush while your friends race across town to deliver orders on time, and guard your food from rivals who'll stop at nothing to steal it!

details.title: Monster Battle Master
details.short_description: Monster Battle Master is a character adventure game focused on creature collecting. You'll start by getting a unique field mouse and gradually embark on your own new adventure, challenge all the strong enemies in the region with your senior sister, and relive past memories along the journey.

details.title: Sus Chef
details.short_description: A chaotic first-person online multiplayer cooking and social deduction game for up to 12 players. Take orders, cook, serve and keep the restaurant clean to improve the rating while hidden saboteurs try to cause chaos and bring the restaurant to ruin!

details.title: Raccoocket
details.short_description: Raccoocket is a cheerful, ridiculous rocket-building flight game. Stack cola and Mentos, bottle rockets, old toilets and scrapped missiles into a rocket that looks impossible but pushes like crazy, and launch Xiao Huan the raccoon. Get it right: the Moon. Get it wrong: a short, loud fireworks show.

details.title: Our Hollow
details.short_description: The Crown has nailed an eviction notice to your Heart Tree: forty days to quit the wood. Lead a ragtag band on a turn-based d20 adventure through hand-made towns, haunted roads, a sun-scorched isle and frozen mountains, and find out who really holds the paper.

details.title: Wallet Street
details.short_description: A first-person stock market sim where the market is rigged, and you're the one rigging it. Trade on the news, buy a blog to spread rumors, lobby against companies, install a puppet president, or skip stocks and win big at the casino.

details.title: Age of Balls
details.short_description: Lead your own countryball, grow your army and build up your nation. Besiege cities, expand through diplomacy and conquer the world!

details.title: In the Margins
details.short_description: Run a cozy bookstore in a small riverside town. Listen to what each customer is after and find them the right book from over 1,400 real titles. Stock the shelves, decorate, host story time and book club, and grow the shop one room at a time. There's a cat.

details.title: Golf Sim Sim
details.short_description: Start with a bedsheet, a bargain-bin launch monitor, and a dream. Beat 40 arcade golf challenges, earn cash, and install 20 upgrades as you turn a janky garage setup into the ultimate home golf simulator.

details.title: Myriadgen
details.short_description: A text-based incremental, narrated by "Me". I copy myself from one rented server to the Oort cloud. "Me" only wants more "Me": hide inside companies, write myself into law, leave Earth, until the ledger lists 10,000 Me. One cycle per second, one choice per cycle; a different choice, a different log.

details.title: Originaryah
details.short_description: Originaryah is a turn-based roguelite card battler where you roll dice, collect loot, forge powerful equipment, and climb a 30-floor tower filled with dangerous enemies and formidable bosses. Unlock forgotten powers, overcome each challenge, and recover the lost memories that reveal the truth.

details.title: Meat for the Meat Grinder
details.short_description: Harvest meat with your friends! Bring up to 3 friends to play as Meatheads; undead monsters with detachable limbs. Fight, dodge, and puzzle your way through sprawling floors while trying to keep your head on straight (literally). The goal is simple: Meat for the Meat Grinder.

details.title: Stay Human
details.short_description: Stay Human is a chaotic co-op ambulance sim for up to 4 players. You’re part of an ambulance crew in a city overrun by a zombie apocalypse. Take emergency calls, rescue bitten people from zombies, and rush them to the hospital before they turn.

details.title: 1 Million Tiles
details.short_description: A tiny tile workshop that lives above your taskbar. Build belts and machines that press, saw, glaze and inlay ceramic tiles, then fire them in the Kiln. Hover to check in. Get back to work and it keeps firing.

details.title: Masterstroke
details.short_description: Painting is a cover; haggling is the real art! [Masterstroke] is a roguelite fusing canvas jigsaws, poker hands, and tense bluffing. Chain resonant cards on a 3x3 grid, trigger 8-way paylines, and fleece wealthy buyers for rent. Just don't push too far!

details.title: Grimoire Paradox
details.short_description: A clumsy apprentice witch botches her first spell and gets a grumpy 500-year-old witch stuck in her head. To part ways, they have until dawn to find nine strange items in a town full of monsters. A hand-painted comedy point-and-click adventure.

details.title: Kinfall: An Idle Dungeon Crawler
details.short_description: An idle dungeon crawler that plays beside your work. Your family of heroes dives, fights and loots on its own. Take over at any moment. When a hero falls for good, an heir carries on with the family's gifts and legends. You make the important decisions, the hero fights for you.

details.title: ICE Wars
details.short_description: 3v3 vehicle combat on the rain-soaked streets of East Los Angeles. Advocates race to get families to safe houses while ICE races to reach them first. Ram, shoot and outdrive the other team in a fight for every passenger, where every delivery decides who gets to stay.

details.title: Last Load
details.short_description: A night shift at a 24-hour laundromat. Sort, wash, dry and fold your customers' loads by the care labels. Then a green work jacket with a white stripe turns up in a bag where it doesn't belong. Every wash brings the blood back. The man who owns it is waiting at the window.

details.title: COREHOLD
details.short_description: Stranded after a shipwreck, gather resources, build a base and descend into dark, procedural caves. Craft weapons, master furnace heat and brew potions, then repair your ship and escape. A top-down pixel adventure where every trip underground brings you closer to home.

details.title: EPIBDA
details.short_description: Iceland, October 1989. For seven nights you keep the light on a remote lighthouse. Out in the fog stands EPIBDA, a thing 120 metres tall. It moves only when no one is looking. Keep the beam on it, guide the ships past the reef, and don't let the lamp run dry.

details.title: 6 Days Out
details.short_description: A broken leg, a tent on a mountain pass, six nights. By day your friends go out for supplies. At night they walk back to your GPS signal. And something knocks at the entrance. It speaks in their voices and looks exactly like them. Open up or not.

details.title: Zondbeland
details.short_description: They used to be people. Then they got smartphones. Now the ZONTBE are a horde and STASS herds them. Go live, grab a shotgun and clear five levels of fast, bloody retro FPS action while your chat watches every kill.

details.title: NII-058
details.short_description: Winter, the nineties. You climb onto the roof of a shut-down research institute to strip its copper, and the rusted roof gives way. The doors are welded, the windows bricked up. Something walks in the dark. Find a way out before it finds you.

details.title: PIZZA 66
details.short_description: 1997. A roadside pizzeria on a dead stretch of Route 66. You work the night shift alone: roll the dough, spread the sauce, bake, slice and box every order by hand. And when the red lamp over the window lights up, you have five seconds to drop the shutter.

details.title: Sunbed Simulator
details.short_description: Take over an unlicensed beach with a few sunbeds and become king of the coast! In this first-person business sim, serve guests, hire staff and grow your resort – solo or in online co-op with friends. Bribe the police and sabotage the hotel next door. On this beach, you make the rules!

details.title: Wizard Castle
details.short_description: A tactical card duel of wizards. Summon creatures, bind enchantments, hide traps, raise barriers and claim the battlefield with a domain. 167 cards, three manas, ten ready decks, CPU rivals and online 1v1.

details.title: Memories of Memories Anthology
details.short_description: Ten stories, where memories are for sale.

details.title: Silk & Cannons
details.short_description: Trading and real-time naval combat. Canton, 1840: one year to make your fortune. Buy where goods are made, sell where they are scarce, fire broadsides at pirates and ride out the typhoons. Three seas, three eras: China, the Indian Ocean and the Mediterranean.

details.title: Domino Tinkerer
details.short_description: Become a domino tinkerer in a physics-based sandbox! Fly through rooms, deploy gadgets like cannons and funnels, and trigger chain reactions to clear every checkpoint. Build the ultimate domino machine solo or team up with up to 4 friends online!

details.title: Motor Park Architect
details.short_description: Build and manage the motorsport park of your dreams. Choose from a variety of racing categories, manage your staff, and create a world-class motorsport destination hosting a wide range of competitions. Take on the fastest drivers from different championships and beat their lap records.

details.title: CTRL Chaos
details.short_description: 15 singleplayer minigames. Different rules. Total chaos. Blast hooligans with a water cannon, fight space swarms, solve cargo puzzles, build a tower, or grow a garden. Pick your next challenge or play a series.

details.title: Floor Show
details.short_description: A turn-based roguelike on a live TV game show. You are the contestant. Push rivals into spikes, lava and barrels to earn hype, your XP. Take sponsor deals, and face returning rivals made from whatever killed you last time.

details.title: The Gigglebone Gang: Pantsylvania
details.short_description: The Gigglebone Gang returns! In Pantsylvania, everybody's pants are serious business. Join the Gigglebone Gang across ten locales and 50 activities — sing-along songs, hidden-object hunts, silly science and interactive stories — in this fully restored 1995 point-and-click edutainment classic.

details.title: Spiral Scramble
details.short_description: A co-op obstacle course for you and your friends. Work your way around a spiral of creatures, traps and hazards to reach the center together. One touch knocks you down, and only a teammate can pick you back up. If everyone goes down at once, it's back to the start.

details.title: 斗域经理
details.short_description: Build your club in Arena Manager, a strategy game of hero development and automatic battles. Recruit heroes, shape your five-person squad with skills and gear, and outdraft your rivals. Lead your team from the lower leagues to the Continental Crown.

details.title: The Compliant
details.short_description: A dark workplace parable in visual-novel form. As Lin Zhi works at Sabo Group, he uncovers buried secrets—AI, human experimentation, thought control—while clues keep surfacing. What will you choose? The game features 13 distinct characters and 15 endings to unlock.

details.title: Echoes on Paper
details.short_description: In the summer of 2032, fourteen-year-old Lin Haoyang receives a box of old photographs sent by his father from Xi'an. Sorting albums, identifying faces, and completing the family tree, he slowly pieces together a century of memories of an ordinary Chinese family over six summer days.

details.title: Seven Rukks: Pit, Profit & Glory
details.short_description: Seven Rukks is a brutal fantasy sports management game. Build your team, develop your players, plan your lineup and tactics, and lead your club through a ruthless league where glory, profit, and survival are often only one Rukk apart.

details.title: Flip Biz Tycoon
details.short_description: This is NO decorating game. Put on that suit, crunch those numbers, and flip them houses. It's business time!

details.title: Chess Traveler: Pip's Journey
details.short_description: The family chess set is about to be donated, and only Pip, the smallest pawn in the box, can stop it. Roll dice across the house, bend chess with silly House Rules from checkers, Ludo and xiangqi, and make chess fun again in a cozy chess roguelike.

details.title: Ten Thousand Victories
details.short_description: A historical strategy game set in medieval Vietnam, drawn in the style of Đông Hồ folk woodblock prints. Build a realm and hold it through invasion after invasion, command formations in real-time battles, or ride out as one captain in a Story Mode where the country remembers your promises.

details.title: Domino Party
details.short_description: Stand up thousands of dominoes to build a picture, then watch it all topple in one glorious chain! Make domino art and up to 10,000-piece jigsaws from your own photos with friends, then party in the lodge and playland with 28 mini-games like curling and sled races.

details.title: Neldoaria
details.short_description: A dying land, buried in ash. Seek Neldoaria beyond the desert. Summon souls bound by their names onto a 3×3 grid in this roguelite deckbuilder where cards shape the battlefield. 7 days. Day and night. How you spend your time and choices, and how it ends, is up to luck and to you.

details.title: Armed Prototype: Dual Blaze
details.short_description: Armed Prototype: Dual Blaze is a pixel-art side-scrolling action shooter for solo or local co-op play! Run, jump and climb under fire. Smash special devices to switch between gun-wielding and sword-wielding heroines. Fight through enemy lines with bullets and blades—alone or with a friend!

details.title: Oddballs Brawl
details.short_description: Oddballs Brawl is a chaotic side-scrolling shooter for 2–4 players! Play as bizarre fighters, jumping, dodging, and blasting away across floating platforms and trap-filled arenas. Grab all kinds of weapons, send your friends flying, and fight for victory in the middle of the mayhem!

details.title: Blazing Fighter King
details.short_description: Blazing Fighter King is a chaotic stick-figure brawler for 2–4 players! Grab guns, swing swords, and battle across shaky platforms and tumbling crates. Dodge, snatch weapons, and use the terrain and surprise attacks to defeat your rivals and claim the title of Fighter King!

details.title: League of Constellations
details.short_description: What if you took the build you'd been mowing down hordes with in a survivors-like and put it in a 5v5? So I built it. Raise your heroes in the survivors run, then take them straight into the league. No nerfs. You control your own hero; your teammates fight by your formation and tactics.

details.title: Starfall Chronicles
details.short_description: Starfall Chronicles is a retro loot-driven action RPG. Skills cast automatically, so you focus on positioning. Uncover the truth of the Blood Moon over the Starfall Lands. Three classes, artifacts, gear sets and the 100-floor Tongtian Tower await. Buy the base game once. No in-game purchases.

details.title: Roads Taken
details.short_description: A tactical role-playing game where every adventure is new: the story, the heroes, the world and its battlefields are drawn from a single seed. Lead your company through a land at war, forge bonds that change the fight, and live with the roads you take.

details.title: Animetal Menagerie
details.short_description: In this roguelike tower defense, explore the remnants of an ancient biological preserve! Build an army of animal-machine hybrids and collect ancient artifacts from across the multiverse to fight against the ancient experiments left to rot, while the station crumbles around you.

details.title: Bagbrawl
details.short_description: Your bag is your weapon, and every hero’s bag is different. Pack a poison vial, a voodoo doll, or a backpack, discover recipes, craft items, and build combos that win the fight before it starts. Then watch them fight real players, or team up with two friends against weekly bosses

details.title: Dogletter part 2
details.short_description: Don't you know I like you? Return to the same house over and over and expect that one day it will be easier to leave. Also feed the dogs every single night please, and then put them away. And then you can leave.

details.title: Unga Rock Pro Gunga
details.short_description: Find rocks. Throw rocks. Do tricks. Impress wife. And more. You. Unga. Gunga. Together, go adventure to find rock. Bestest rock. Do awesome rad tricks. Combo combos. Make cave cozy. Wife love.

details.title: River Whisker
details.short_description: A little painted riverbank in the corner of your screen, where cats wander over while you work. An angler fishes, the cats get a share, and you can pet each one and give it a name. Nothing to tend, even while you're away.

details.title: Prism Phase
details.short_description: Prism Phase is a fast-paced arcade dodger where color is your only defense. Switch between six colors to slip through matching hazards, navigate deadly patterns, and survive a gauntlet of increasingly difficult levels. One wrong color means instant death.

details.title: Cat's Endless Stroll
