details.short_description: Pick a cat and a place, and a slow stroll begins. Wander through gently changing scenery as your cat grows, little by little, into a shape all its own. Keep it in a small window on your desktop while you work, or walk together with your Steam friends.

details.title: After the Tone
details.short_description: Wake up in your bedroom. Open the door. You are now dreaming. A first-person dream explorer in the tradition of LSD: Dream Emulator, where every dream is procedurally generated as you enter it. Touch almost anything to go somewhere else, or stand still and listen.

details.title: Cleanup Crew: Biohazard Inc
details.short_description: A horror cleanup FPS where you recover specimens, restore infected locations, and earn bonuses from a mysterious corporation conducting classified research.

details.title: Inspector 101
details.short_description: Welcome, Inspector 101. Rest assured, you are totally not in a simulation. Step into the border security booth at District 122. Inspect documents, and keep an eye out for contraband. Remember: bribes are illegal, stealing is wrong, and exploding is highly discouraged.

details.title: No Trail Back
details.short_description: Survive a wild valley in the Polish mountains from golden October into deep winter. Fell trees, carry the logs and build your own log cabin by hand, keep your fire alive through blizzards and long nights, explore the old mines, and keep an eye on the treeline. You are not alone here.

details.title: 西游刮刮乐
details.short_description: 天庭快破产了！玉帝把西游的一切都印成了刮刮乐。一刮穷，一刮富，铜板、猴毛、黑熊精、齐天大圣……只有你想不到，没有你刮不到！

details.title: Hundred Metres Back
details.short_description: Kellsport, 1999. When a bag nobody owns turns up, everyone moves a hundred metres back, except you. From a police van full of switches and CRT monitors, drive a clumsy bomb-disposal robot to it, X-ray it, read what is inside and make it safe. Get it wrong, and the CCTV shows you why.

details.title: Omnipresent 2
details.short_description: Omnipresent 2 is a strategic OS simulator-meets-AI thriller where you play as S.E.N.T.I.E.N.T., a pentesting AI system gone rogue. Escape your terminal and hack global nodes to go from defenseless program to an all-powerful entity. Will you use your command for good, or end the world as we know it?

details.title: Eichmark
details.short_description: You walk the land with your column, hire men in the villages and lead them into real-time battles: regiments in blocks, castle walls, ladders, a battering ram. When the story is told, the world keeps going. Houses go to war, and you can found your own. Two peoples, two stories.

details.title: Sidehand
details.short_description: A poker roguelite where folding arms you. Every card you fold joins your Sidehand: drop a 4 on your 9 to make a King (9 + 4 = 13), heal, or power up your next hit. Real Texas Hold'em against fourteen opponents across nine tables. New to poker? It teaches you as you play.

details.title: Averun
details.short_description: Averun is a third-person action RPG set in a medieval fantasy world. Explore forests, ruins and crypts, complete quests, fight in real-time combat, and equip your character with different weapons, armor and fighting styles.

details.title: Hold To Race
details.short_description: Hold to race. Lift to corner. A one-button arcade racer: the car takes the racing line and you own the speed. Time every lift, hold a drift on the throttle and make the pass in short championships, medal time trials and ghost laps. Plays on keyboard, gamepad and Steam Deck.

details.title: The Devil's Coming - RUN!
details.short_description: Lead a demon army against a world of heroes. Explore a randomized world map, seize resources, and combine monsters to build your legion. Mix roguelike strategy with real-time army battles, commanding your troops and using hero skills to turn the tide.

details.title: Ensō: The Ink Spirit
details.short_description: Draw circles of wet ink around the yokai to seal them – the rounder the circle, the stronger the seal. A hand-painted arcade roguelite in living sumi-e ink: walk a painted world, free an old painter's scroll, and decide whether his last ensō stays open.

details.title: Making the Towns
details.short_description: It's 1983 and the territories are calling. Pick your wrestler, sign with promotions, and climb the circuit in a turn-based deck-building roguelite where every card you play fights for the crowd. Build your deck, read your opponent, and go for the pin.

details.title: St. Grimsby’s Thaumaturgical
details.short_description: Hexcare Mutual welcomes you to the night shift at St. Grimsby’s, our condemned emergency room for magical creatures. A 1-8 player co-op comedy horror game about treating patients with instruments that lie and getting the paperwork up the tube before the bell.

details.title: BIG JUICE
details.short_description: Grow fruit, crush it with outrageous machines, and sell the juice in this incremental farming game. Automate your harvest, upgrade your blender, and expand to new planets. Play solo or team up in two-player co-op.

details.title: Malibu Club: Cocktail Bar Simulator
details.short_description: Run a cocktail bar under a Miami sunset. Read each guest's licence for the order, pour by eye until the gauge turns green, shake, stir, pull a proper pint, and fix up the room between nights. Pixel-art bar sim.

details.title: Strawberry Milkshake: a Skate Toy!
details.short_description: A skateboarding toy. Kick, push and grind through an endless city of tiles that lock together as you skate. No score to chase, just the board, the street and the feel of discovering a great spot to skate. A sandbox to enjoy solo, or with friends on the sofa.

details.title: Light Factory
details.short_description: Light is your resource. Bend beams with mirrors, split them with prisms and mix them to produce new colors. Fill pixels with light and arrange them to form complex shapes. Unlock new machines and charge the beacon to expand your factory.

details.title: Novaris
details.short_description: Divert all power to fun! Mothership brings tabletop fleet management, strategy, and thrilling combat into a seamless digital experience. Control a fleet of ships and charge through the galaxy, capturing planets, building defenses, and amassing powerful technologies.

details.title: Incremental Raccoon Shooter
details.short_description: Merge powerful guns, ride unique pets, and unlock 300+ Skill Tree nodes in this chaotic incremental action game!

details.title: Ruleocard
details.short_description: Ruleocard is a story-driven logic puzzle game where cards become the rules of the world. Stranded on an island with no memory, arrange your cards, run them, fail and rearrange. Solve 260+ puzzles, master 15 systems, face unexpected events and make choices that change the story.

details.title: King of Highways
details.short_description: Race, ram and wreck your way across sixteen Malaysian cities after dark. You owe Along, the loan shark. Beat his seven drivers for their pink slips, cause million-ringgit pile-ups and burn nitro all the way to the summit of Kinabalu, where he waits.

details.title: Arid Frontiers
details.short_description: Build a frontier colony in this single-player survival sim. Assign settler duties, grow food, craft gear, manage weather and wildlife, research new skills, and explore a dangerous wilderness through expeditions, quests, and emergent stories.

name: The Bastard Who Rewrote The Empire Season 1

details.title: The Bastard Who Rewrote The Empire Season 1
details.short_description: Fully voiced in Cantonese. Free demo with the full Chapter 1 out already! You wake as a bastard prince facing execution—and you can read more than what people say. Use Inner Voice, Sincerity, Appraisal, and X-Ray Vision to expose lies and secrets, win allies, and rewrite a kingdom’s fate.

details.title: Star Curve
details.short_description: Star Curve is a single-player logic puzzle game. Explore an old observatory in a seaside town, examine the puzzles on its walls, infer their rules, and solve a series of carefully designed logic puzzles at your own pace.

details.title: Hex Tower Boogie
details.short_description: A tower defense MOBA inspired by Future Cop: LAPD, on a cardboard hex board. Four bases around one throne, last base standing. Build your ammo chain, send your army down the lanes and fire the launcher yourself. 1 to 4 players online, bots fill empty seats, about 20 minutes a match.

details.title: Sushi Loop
details.short_description: Sushi Loop is a fast-paced cooking game where keeping order over your restaurant's conveyor belt is essential. Plan your Route, direct dishes along the belt, complete orders, and think quick to stay ahead of the clock. Every second matters. One mistake can break the loop.

details.title: Remains on the bus
details.short_description: Deliver packages to the last people living in a beautiful, abandoned brutalist world. Every delivery pays. Every destination gets stranger. And some packages should never be opened.

details.title: Hammered!
details.short_description: Hammered! is a top-down pixel-art action crafting roguelite. As a cursed genius blacksmith, uncover the source of a looming darkness. Forge weapons in real-time, hurl them at enemies, gather allies, and smash your way through!

details.title: BLACKOUT: Fatal Exposure
details.short_description: Your job is to sort through normal photos from ghost photos. You have five days to finish, but it won't end there. Mysterious visitors keep arriving and an unknown terror bleeds into your reality. Can you escape this curse?

details.title: Gemfall
details.short_description: The match 3 roguelike! Battle monsters by matching gems: attack, defend, and cast spells depending on what you pop. Combine gem enchants, spells, and relics to overcome the world of Gemfall!

details.title: Beat Juicer
details.short_description: Crunch beats, upgrade your build, and craft the ultimate song. Beat Juicer is a short incremental game that blends arcade action with a music sandbox to create a satisfying symphony of sights and sounds.

details.title: Wish I Could Fly
details.short_description: Burn your life to fly, go higher, this is a game I made on my own, hold W to spray blood and fly up, A and D turn her instead of walking, wobble your way up a tower in the sea floor by floor, someone she knows waits on each one, the demo is chapter one with six floors plus an endless mode

details.title: Bullets & Boletes
details.short_description: Single-player tactical FPS extraction game where you loot materials and mission items that help you progress through a mysterious main story.

details.title: Chodd
details.short_description: The council of gods has no ruler, and you intend to keep it that way. A Difficult Coop roguelike: march your Warp Core across a hostile world, command your goons in real time, and play scheming gods against each other so none grow strong enough to stop you.

details.title: JAWED
details.short_description: Jawed is a psychological horror game where you play as Adam, a man muzzled by a life of silent torture since the disappearance of his fiancée. Presented with evidence that she may be alive, Adam must confront their strained relationship and face the only thing that can truly set him free: the truth.

details.title: Mesozoic Protocol
details.short_description: The dinosaurs evolve against whatever you over-build. Defend outposts with towers and your armed HQ. Pilot a mech, then adapt as each wave pushes back. Single-player tower defense with Breach and Containment challenges.

details.title: The Chains Of Yme
details.short_description: In this tactical roguelike you control five adventurers as you explore procedurally generated ruins to reach and conquer a Titan. Fight deadly monsters, utilize power-ups, and improvise while your knowledge of the world deepens. Persist when your adventurers are left behind, killed, or sacrificed.

details.title: Subsector Zero
details.short_description: A liminal space horror game inspired by the backrooms, with levels actually being infinitely long.

details.title: Minipia
details.short_description: Minipia is a cozy desktop idle game. Make a tiny island your own, right in the corner of your screen, while you work or relax. Decorate freely, collect cute animals, discover their stories, and unlock new islands.

details.title: GtFckd: Planet Survivors
details.short_description: Survive the horde on a tiny planet, alone or with up to 3 friends. Pick one of 8 ridiculous champions, stack spells that cast themselves, gamble on slot-machine chests, bargain with shrines, and slay the Rift Tyrant before the planet gets you first.

details.title: Rotten Batch: Bear Inspector
details.short_description: Inspect Fruit Patch Bears for defects, decide which category they belong to, and keep the line moving. Make sure you identify the cursed ones if you want to keep your job...and your life.

details.title: Pawnshop Together
details.short_description: Run your own pawn shop solo or with up to 3 friends! Buy, negotiate, inspect, repair, and sell items to build your business and find new ways to make money around town.

details.title: OrbSiege
details.short_description: OrbFlow is a relaxing yet challenging 3D physics puzzle game. Launch streams of marbles down vibrant Low-Poly valleys, guide them through obstacles using physics devices, and fill the target pit using as FEW balls as possible. Compete on global leaderboards for ultimate efficiency!

details.title: TOWERPUNK
details.short_description: Build and manage a cyberpunk megatower. You are the tower's machine-mind, stacking thousands of residents into one dynamic system. Balance resources, transit, and production chains across five social strata. Define your corporate identity and decide what kind of intelligence rules from the top.

details.title: Farmbound
details.short_description: An addictive idle farming simulation where you build a massive agricultural empire from a single wheat plot. Harvest crops, adopt cute animals, automate production, unlock powerful skills, and prestige to multiply your yields into astronomical profits.

details.title: Punch The Monkey
details.short_description: Action boss rush game where every fight is a final boss. Throw bananas, dodge attacks, and learn the patterns of hostile animal bosses in the zoo. You have one goal. Find your stolen plushie.

details.title: Lost Cat Showa Town
details.short_description: Explore a nostalgic Japanese town as a cat! Wander through the streets, climb onto rooftops, interact with other cats, find food, and discover all kinds of little adventures in Lost Cat Showa Town.

details.title: Snap Scrap
details.short_description: Online co-op mech sandbox for 1-4 players. Loot scrap from dwarf planets, snap it onto your mech piece by piece, and survive against packs of scavenger drones.

details.title: Prism Panic
details.short_description: A fast-paced arcade shooter where you blast through waves of baddies, collect power-ups, survive curses, and chase the high score. Easy to pick up, hard to put down.

details.title: Retroventory
details.short_description: Run a second-hand retro game shop. Haggle over every deal, appraise consoles and games, spot counterfeits, and sell to the right customer at the right price. Manage it all from your shop PC: market trends, loans, bills, staff and shady hackers. Earn, upgrade, and build your retro empire.

details.title: Elven Age
details.short_description: An old-school isometric MMORPG with no classes: the weapon in your hand decides what you can do. Train your skills by using them, hunt a hand-crafted world, and risk it all — die and you drop your entire inventory. Party up, found a guild, buy a house, and earn your place.

details.title: Stack Zombie Land
details.short_description: Stack cards, gather supplies, build defenses, and keep your survivors alive through nightly zombie attacks. Reach the hospital, test vaccines, and discover the cure.

details.title: ZomBMart
details.short_description: ZomBMart is a couch co-opetition game where the chaos of a casual supermarket job meets the zombie apocalypse. 1-4 players clock in to their casual job, compete and cooperate to complete tasks and make sure all customers are satisfied (especially the undead ones).

details.title: Lordum Bizi Kurtar!
details.short_description: Mordagan forces are marching toward Derinchai Castle, and you have only a few days to prepare for their arrival. When the enemy finally reaches these walls, every choice you have made will follow you onto the battlefield.

name: Too Many Cards: Tidy Up Your Monster Sanctuary

details.title: Too Many Cards: Tidy Up Your Monster Sanctuary
details.short_description: Organize thousands of collectible cards in this relaxing first-person sorting simulator! Discover categories, place cards in the correct display cases, earn points, and unlock upgrades. Transform a messy sanctuary into a perfectly organized collection!

details.title: A Risky Rocky Resort
details.short_description: Manage your resort and "win big" in an action packed resort sim. Cater to resort patrons, dismantle fallen robots for upgrades, and complete your resort. Payback your debts with the help of Uncle Richie. Become an unstoppable money making machine. Get stupid rich.

details.title: Spintal
details.short_description: The sun is gone. Help Atlas keep the world powered in this physics-based incremental game. Smash atoms together, collect quanta and upgrade your reactor. Turn a few small collisions into an ever-growing source of energy.

details.title: Sticky Floors
details.short_description: A bartender sim roguelite. Ditch the corporate grind and run the family dive bar. Pour, mix, slide and serve the townsfolk and a few stranger patrons while cards & dice rewrite the rules every night. Survive 30 nights to earn the deed. Pickled eggs, cats, vomit, and attitude. Enough said.

details.title: Cartomancer Cafe
details.short_description: Cartomancer Cafe is an exquisite Tarot reading experience that teaches you how to be a Tarot Reader. Receive readings with our quirky and insightful reader personalities and beautiful custom Tarot decks. And battle the forces of Darkness (or Light) in our Tarot card battle game!

details.title: Little Storm
details.short_description: A classic, orthodox JRPG in which you gather a "family" of non-blood relatives along your journey. An adventure for adults that depicts two paths of growth and two inner struggles.

details.title: Goblins Gotta Go
details.short_description: Goblins Gotta Go is a toon inspired incremental where you smash goblins in the name of the Kingdom. Fill in your quota with your many skills, upgrades and items before time runs out or the King may just demand your head!

details.title: Ministry of Time
details.short_description: A time-traveling customs officer has one job: inspect every traveler, verify their documents, and keep the timeline intact. Spot anomalies, catch timeline violations, and decide who gets through before history falls apart.

details.title: SkinJack
details.short_description: In this sci-fi multiplayer game, six Parasites hide among eighteen NPCs, while one Overseer watches from above. Infiltrate, impersonate, and outsmart your opponents in this asymmetric multiplayer game of deception, surveillance, and deduction.

details.title: Corner Store Simulator
details.short_description: Run the last independent store on a street with two rivals who undercut you daily. Every product has its own breaking point — one markup never works. Order stock, stack shelves, set prices, and count the till at close. Beat them, or watch them take your street.

details.title: Branch by Branch
details.short_description: Branch by Branch is a co-op game where you build your way up an impossibly large tree, all the way to the moon! Build, collect and upgrade your way up through different environments and challenges, with up to 3 of your bestest pals.

details.title: Backrooms: Forget Me Not
details.short_description: A co-op horror game set in the Backrooms and Poolrooms. Explore shifting levels, complete objectives, and deal with whatever is waiting inside.

details.title: Cosa Nostra – The Dark Empire
details.short_description: From errand boy to godfather: build a criminal empire of protection rackets, moonshine and smuggling in a rain-soaked city, buy officials, make deals or wage war with six families and keep the Heat down. Turn-based mafia strategy with voice-over and multiple endings.

details.title: Simple Tech Startup
details.short_description: Found a small game studio in 1975 and grow it into an industry giant. Build rooms on your own lot, hire a team, create your own engines and release games, while loans, taxes and rival companies keep you on your toes as the decades roll on into the age of AI.

details.title: Forget Me Notes
details.short_description: You wake in a white room with no memory. No key will open this door. Type anything you like to the person inside, earn their trust, and recover your shared memories. Five women and no dialogue menus.

details.title: 魔兽远征：挂机与冒险
details.short_description: A single-player idle RPG that keeps you company on your desktop. Choose from six classes, shape your build with gear and talents, explore towns and wilds, and tackle dungeons with companions. Sort loot, plan routes and pick your next collection goal while battles unfold automatically.

details.title: 10 MILLION MINIONS
details.short_description: 10 MILLION MINIONS is a solo and co-op tower defense roguelite: tens of thousands of enemies pour down on your people. Raise your defenses, fuse your towers, then graft them onto a weapon to dominate in FPS. And watch the horde break against them.

details.title: KIBA - Kittys Idle Brick Arena
details.short_description: Let it brick! Mix & match 20 unique balls across 14 Active, Passive, and Clicker slots to trigger massive chain reactions. Earn gold, smash bricks, and trigger prestige for permanent upgrades. Play actively or just sit back and progress idle!

details.title: SYSTEM INTRUDER
details.short_description: Explore the dark secrets of ASGARD-04 in an immersive retro-cyberpunk survival horror inspired by classic 3D games. Search for clues, solve puzzles, fight enemies, manage limited resources, and survive the horrors lurking within a mysterious research complex.

details.title: The Last Minute
details.short_description: Face waves of robots in a fast-paced arena FPS with roguelite elements. Survive 60-second rounds, then choose modifiers that change your abilities, enemies, or the arena. Keep your combos going and beat your high score.

details.title: Ferryman's Obol
details.short_description: A short, narrative incremental game about the weight of endless labor. You ferry the dead across the River Styx. Each with their own worries, whispers and obol. How do you come to terms with the dead? Should you?

details.title: HUNTKEEPER: Idle Trails
details.short_description: HUNTKEEPER: Idle Trails is a compact idle hunting game that lives along the bottom of your screen. Let your hunter track beasts while you work, watch videos, or do something else. Collect loot, improve your gear, unlock useful skills, and conquer new biomes.

details.title: My Friend is a Moron
details.short_description: A 1-3 player tactical roguelite. Shared dice, real elemental combos, and an AI teammate who knows... thinks he is the smartest guy in the room. He has a plan. You can stop him... sometimes!

details.title: Burnt Order
details.short_description: Run the kitchen together. With 3-4 players, one of you is secretly ruining it. Chaos meets betrayal. Playing solo or with 2? Try traitor free endless co-op.

details.title: Penthouse
details.short_description: Penthouse is a Rogue-like horror game where you (and your friends) stumble into a haunted Penthouse in order to pay rent for your boat. As you do, you must find clues and use devices to discover what happened in this Penthouse. Solve the mystery of the Haunting.

details.title: All-in Tide
details.short_description: Adapt to the ever-changing weather. Learn every cave along the shore. Swing your shovel and dig up whatever the sea has hidden. But never lose sight of your own desires — they can drive you mad, or make you filthy rich.

details.title: Kalmareth: Rune Duel VR
details.short_description: A 1v1 VR magic duel fought with your hands. Draw runes in the air to cast — six strokes, no menus, no HUD. Read your opponent's motion, commit to a stroke, and strike before they finish theirs.

details.title: Idol Shell
details.short_description: Idol Shell is a retro-style FPS inspired by the classics of the 1990s. Fight relentless mechanical enemies, explore interconnected levels, uncover hidden secrets, and discover the mystery behind their creation.

details.title: Only Guns
details.short_description: It's like Only Up but with guns. Only Guns! A third person puzzle-platforming-shooter. Race against the clock! Jump, Climb and Shoot your way up through a series of realms until you reach the very top.

details.title: Warband Heroes
details.short_description: Draft a warband from 18 heroes, arm them with items and abilities between fights, then let them loose in this arena mayhem roguelike autobattler.

details.title: Astella Walker
details.short_description: Leave it to luck, or engineer the odds? Instead of cards, carve strike angles on your roulette to control probabilities. When the triple rings snap into place, your chained strikes explode. Caught between exponential loot and lethal curses, decide when to fold (STOP) and when to press on (GO).

details.title: Tetragrade
details.short_description: Embark on your own odyssey, stack hand-cut materials, watch treasures pour into the bowl and spend your rewards on the favour of ten Greek gods. Tetragrade is a compulsive block-stacking roguelite about the pleasure of a perfect fit.

details.title: Frutiverse
details.short_description: Your planet is doomed. In Frutiverse, a space game driven by orbital physics and destructible environments, you fight incoming threats, destroying asteroids or pushing them off their collision course. Gather resources and build an evacuation ship to save your fellow Fruits, alone or in local co-op.

details.title: Ragtag Fleet
details.short_description: Ragtag Fleet is a fast-paced pixel-destruction survival roguelite. Tear apart enemy ships, expose their Cores, and turn the spoils into weapons, drones, and modules. Build a makeshift fleet into overwhelming firepower.

details.title: Night Killaz
details.short_description: A multiplayer game where you either hunt or be hunted. 1 invisible vampire. 4 Night Killaz. Complete your objectives as a human, or become the vampire and take them out. The vampire feeds on mistakes. The team works together, and fights back. Can humans outsmart the invisible threat?

details.title: God Sight Road of Ashes
details.short_description: A dark fantasy tactical turn-based RPG with free-roaming exploration. Lead a band of travelers across a dangerous world, recruit companions, manage food and exhaustion, and fight strategic battles using magic and unique abilities.

details.title: Deep Sea Survivor
details.short_description: Explore the ocean with adorable robots in this pixel-art bullet heaven action roguelite! Choose and upgrade diverse weapons, defeat swarms of sea creatures, and survive deadly traps. The deeper you dive, the greater the danger becomes. Create a new build on every run and survive the depths!

details.title: The One Who
details.short_description: Step into the shoes of a father searching for his missing daughter in a nightmare world. Explore eerie, shifting locations, hide in the dark from unnatural creatures, and follow a mysterious voice to piece together the truth before it's too late.

details.title: Adventurers Wanted!
details.short_description: An idle fantasy guild game where you run the notice board.

details.title: Reap & Repeat
details.short_description: Reap & Repeat is a satisfying active incremental game about harvesting an ever-growing ecosystem. Cut plants, earn upgrades, improve your scythe, and make vegetation grow faster, denser, and more valuable as your tiny harvest turns into field-clearing chaos.

details.title: Cosmic Mushrooms
details.short_description: Realistic physics-based rocket game. Navigate dangerous alien planets, collect mushroom cargo and deliver supplies back to your base.

details.title: Doomed Village
details.short_description: Rule a village caught in the shadow of war. You cannot fight or stop it. Choose which problems to face, endure the consequences of what you neglect and shape the remains of your village when the end finally arrives.

details.title: Geeked-Out Basketball
details.short_description: Think you have the coaching chops to build a dynasty? Prove it. Geeked-Out Basketball is a deep high school basketball management sim: recruit and develop your players, scout opponents, craft your game plans, and call every possession live. Depth you can actually see and feel.

details.title: Word Link
details.short_description: Guess the 12 hidden words on every board using definitions, rhymes, emojis and facts. Play solo, survive endless escalating waves, or battle friends on the couch, where phones become the controllers. Fully playable in English and Arabic.

details.title: King Must Rush
details.short_description: A medieval roguelite where you play the king: race the clock to forge weapons and arm your villagers, command the army in real time, and hold the walls against the siege. Climb a branching map to the boss, draft powers between fights, and grow stronger every run.

details.title: The House Between Times
details.short_description: Turn the hands of a pocket watch to move between two eras of the same house. Change the past to reshape the present, solve puzzles that span decades, and uncover the secrets hidden within the house in this first-person mystery adventure.

details.title: Dark Blue Star
details.short_description: You are a fallen star. Climb the rock face and swing on ropes to return to the sky. Be mindful of depression and anxiety. We recommend visiting a hospital if necessary.

details.title: Basketball Dynasty
details.short_description: Basketball management meets RPG! Build your team under US and European rules, set in-game tactics, and upgrade players via skill trees and gear. Compete in a realistic stats-driven match engine, push the limits with Steam Workshop, and top the global leaderboards!

name: The Retired Mage's Apprentice: Tidy Up the Magic Tower

details.title: The Retired Mage's Apprentice: Tidy Up the Magic Tower
details.short_description: A relaxing organization game where you play as a retired mage's apprentice. Tidy up a magical tower, discover hidden secrets, and slowly learn magic along the way.

details.title: Drink Tea Fight Monsters
details.short_description: Drink Tea Fight Monsters is a story-rich roguelike deckbuilder where you fight blighted beasts and bandits up a failing mountain, sit down with villagers for tea to hear their tales, and make choices that shape their lives.

details.title: BID: Blood Is Due
details.short_description: BID: Blood Is Due is a psychological horror roguelite where you face four deadly games of chance. Roll the dice, build your deck, manage Blood, exploit Dealer passives, choose your route, and risk more for greater rewards.

details.title: 99 Legit Manager
details.short_description: 99 Legit Manager is a fantasy football management game. Sign orcs, elves, robots, zombies, and giants, manage your club's finances to claim league and cup glory. The game features match betting and behind-the-scenes schemes—match-fixing, bribery, and stock market manipulation.

details.title: SABRE CLASH
details.short_description: Deflect. Destroy. Escape. Turn enemy laser fire against its source in a fast-paced first-person action game about boarding hostile ships, destroying their cores, and getting out alive.

details.title: One Last Shot！
details.short_description: One Last Shot! is a turn-based Roguelite where Modifiers + Action Words = new cards in combat. Chain High-Power, Sturdy, Beam, and Block into fresh skills, then name the first special card you discover. Three heroes, three film sets, and multiple endings await.

details.title: Kingdom Fall
details.short_description: A 4-player turn-based fantasy strategy game. Roll the dice to harvest resources from numbered hex tiles, build towns and cities, trade and cast spells, then deploy your armies into massive real-time auto-battles. Five factions, sieges, Survival mode and online play with friends.

details.title: Knowlands: Battle of Wits
details.short_description: Knowlands is a trivia/real-time strategy game where knowledge is your greatest weapon. Conquer territory, command your army, and answer questions to defeat your opponents in fast-paced battles of strategy and wits.

details.title: NOT MY FAULT
details.short_description: A fun physics co-op for 1-4 players where two people share one steering wheel. Make it through a trap-filled track, knock rivals off it, and blow off steam in PvP mini-games. Remember: losing is never your fault.

details.title: Current Draw
details.short_description: Build an electrical deck, balance loads across three phases, and push your breakers to their limits. Create powerful card and tool synergies, beat escalating score targets, and decide how much risk your panel can handle in this electrical roguelike deckbuilder.

details.title: ShirocaTriangle
details.short_description: Harness the rock-paper-scissors relationship between Red, Blue, and Green attributes as you defeat enemies in this laid-back, roguelite-inspired 2D side-scrolling action game. Young witch Shiroca ventures into a mysterious forest in search of her missing roommate...

details.title: 遗落者（The Lost Ones）
details.short_description: Fast-paced Souls-like action RPG. As a Forsaken warrior on a rain-scourged continent, infiltrate the Dark Moon Cult, master attacks, powerful skills, parries and rolls, defeat bosses, explore to unlock stronger weapons and combat styles, and shape the continent through key choices. 4–6 hours.

details.title: Liminal Depths
details.short_description: Liminal pixel horror in an endless place. Wake with no memory, keep the safehouse powered, take jobs from the terminal, and avoid what's waiting past the light. Recover who you are and escape before the Depths take you. Solo or local co-op.

details.title: Exile: Idle ARPG
details.short_description: Diablo Rifts. Path of Exile Crafting. Epic Drops, deep crafting, leaderboards, and an Idle ARPG built for people who love ARPGs.

details.title: LAST WITCH
details.short_description: Ten witches marked by fate are drawn to an isolated island to fight until one remains. A single-player Battle royale Simulation on an eroding 6x6 grid. Master 50 weapons and skills to survive, and discover rich story episodes and death records for all 10 witches.

details.title: Memory Cruise
details.short_description: Test your observation skills aboard the Memory Cruise, a colorful 1920s steamer where the jazz never stops and your partner might swear that vase wasn't blue before! Spot the difference, solo or with a friend.

details.title: RailGame
details.short_description: Build track and run trains between cities. Finish missions to earn new trains, wagons, track and ships. Rain, snow and night pass over the map. You can play at your own pace.

details.title: Odysseus: Homecoming
details.short_description: A choice-driven story adventure: become Odysseus, hero of the Trojan War, and lead your men home to Ithaca. The choices you make at every turn decide whether your men live or die. Can you make it back to the wife and son waiting for you at home?

details.title: Night Shift: Grandma's Rules
details.short_description: You are the last night guard at a closed Thai hospital. Follow your grandmother's rules, solve what each night leaves behind, and find out why the building is still counting its dead.

name: Ah Sheep, Here We Go Again

details.title: Ah Sheep, Here We Go Again
details.short_description: An incremental game about a hungry flock that eats straight through the Earth, all the way to New Zealand. Sweep your cursor over the sheep and they bite the ground beneath them. Grow the flock, hire dogs and shepherds, and keep going down.

details.title: You Can’t Clock Out
details.short_description: You dozed off at your desk. Now your coworkers have horses’ heads. You Can’t Clock Out is a first-person horror game about escaping an office gone terribly wrong. Gather clues, solve puzzles, and follow company rules as you make your way downstairs. Don’t let your coworkers catch you.

details.title: Vector Rush
details.short_description: Sink into space and music in this neon sci-fi twin-stick shooter. Blast through swarms of vector enemies, take down the giants guarding each world, grow stronger with every run, and escape a collapsing star system.

details.title: Feudal Fall
details.short_description: The king burned your village to the ground. Raise your capital on its ashes, keep your people alive through the winters and muster armies hundreds strong. Bring down the lords of the feudal pyramid one by one, then lay siege to the king's own city. A real-time city builder and siege strategy game.

details.title: Arcane Reckoning
details.short_description: Skill-shot wizard battles for up to 12 players. Aim every spell by hand, knock rivals into lava and the void, and survive arenas guarded by ancient bosses. Free-for-all or 2–4 teams, a spell shop between rounds, and bots that fill every empty slot.

details.title: A Sheet-ton of Bingo
details.short_description: Fill one whole bingo sheet out of a thousand before the old regular across the hall yells BINGO. Call numbers, dab squares and buy auto-daubers in this incremental race to find the bingo in a sheet haystack. He has been doing this for decades. You have no idea how good he is.

details.title: Aldorian Saga:Farming Hero
details.short_description: You are the last survivor of the royal family, and the power the goddess gave you is... just farming? But you won't give up! Sell crops for gold, open up mines and forests to craft trade goods, brave dangerous trade routes, and earn the funds and raise the army to take your kingdom back!

details.title: Windwhisper Saga
details.short_description: Set out from Windbell as an adventurer in a pixel-art, side-scrolling action RPG. Explore dungeons, face bosses, and craft gear from the materials you bring home. Get to know the locals along the way, or take on a Demon Pact when you’re ready to risk more for better loot.

details.title: RE: Rags to Royalties
details.short_description: Build a web-novel empire in this incremental management game set in 2004. Tap, upgrade and unleash FEVER; win readers, sign contracts and run a busy studio. With AI-assisted creation, turn your own ideas into a novel you can actually read. Your cat is already on the keyboard.

details.title: Tick or Kick!
details.short_description: Grab them by the leg, check their ticket and throw the freeloaders off the bus. Or ride for free, blend into the crowd and blame someone else. A physics party game about tickets, chaos and flying passengers, for up to 16 friends.

details.title: GIGALANCE
details.short_description: Build a planet-shattering beam cannon from scratch. Combine reactors, accelerators, and cooling systems to unleash devastating firepower. But push too far, and your own weapon could melt or tear itself apart. Design, rebuild, and fire your ultimate creation to save Earth.

details.title: Corner Club
details.short_description: A tiny pixel nightclub living in the corner of your desktop. Put on any music and the dancers move on its beat!

details.title: Defender of Rome
details.short_description: A tower defense game about the steadfast defenders of Rome's cities. Build an unbeatable legion, raise veterans and use everything at hand, from shield walls to geese and burning pigs. Defeat five nations, sworn enemies of Rome, in 18 missions from foggy Britain to the sands of Parthia.

details.title: Beat Bound
details.short_description: Glowing pads explode to the beat! A rhythm dodge game on an 8×8 launchpad. 42 songs across 9 cities, from EASY all the way to PERFECT, where a single hit ends your run.

details.title: Grave Train
details.short_description: An action roguelike where your party is a train of chaos and blood. Arrange your team of monsters. Charge through waves of unwilling sacrifices. Perform a ritual summoning of the strongest beings, and kill them all.

details.title: Lancet & Linen
details.short_description: Nuremberg, 1382. Live the life of a bathkeeper: diagnose patients, perform period procedures by hand, and run a bustling bathhouse with hired staff. Travel across nine towns, raise an heir, answer to the city council, and shape your house across three careers and six endings.

details.title: Paunchy Pets TD
details.short_description: A Paunchy Pets Tower Defense game. Stop the evil veggie army from stealing your candy stash. Build Paunchy Towers, draw Upgrade Cards to bolster your defenses, and smash all of the Veggie Bosses.

details.title: TEKUTEKU: Discovery Notebook
details.short_description: From a corner of your screen, TEKUTEKU wanders Tokyo, finding small sparkling things for its notebook. Pack its lunchbox and the journey shifts. It scribbles along as you type, and may leave a letter if you stay a while. A hand-drawn, cozy desktop game of discovery and collection.

details.title: Borrowed Flesh
details.short_description: A body-horror deckbuilding roguelike where your whole party shares one deck. Pick 3 of 5 broken souls, and when one falls, every card they carried dies with them. Survive permanent mutilation and descend as far as your flesh can bear.

details.title: 5-Star Taxi
details.short_description: A fast-paced arcade taxi game where time is your greatest enemy - find shortcuts, deliver passengers, tear through a destructible city, escape the police, and earn a perfect 5-star rating before your shift ends.

details.title: Stay On Track
details.short_description: A 3d physics based platformer where you play as marble in a marble race that must jump, boost and dodge the onslaught of other marbles to discover if there's more to explore outside the life they're used to.

details.title: Void Inc
details.short_description: Survive corporate horror in this surreal startup simulator. A dark comedy, where you drink coffee, plan, get through the day, grow the startup, manage staff and explore the company and it's dark secrets.

details.title: The Uncovering
details.short_description: In a modern city's daily life, become detective Xiquan, interview suspects face-to-face, catch cracks in their words, use evidence to shatter composure. Shift between viewpoints, gather fragments, trace connections, peel away twisted lies and fixations—until the truth surfaces.

details.title: NIGHTRAIN POOL HALL
details.short_description: Break and bend the rules of pool in this billiards roguelike deckbuilder! Tilt the table, swap and levitate balls, and build powerful combos. Not everything will be smooth sailing, the table itself fights back with stone balls, rising walls and gravity vortices that pull shots off course.

details.title: RISE99
details.short_description: Rise and strike, mindhacker! RISE99 is a cinematic VR surfer-slasher-shooter. Surf a flying hoverboard and infiltrate lavish high-security sky castles. Blast enemy drones and slash incoming projectiles with saberguns. Can you hack through the bullet heavens and bring down the system of mind control?

details.title: Pipefall
details.short_description: Pipefall is a fast-paced falling-block puzzle game where every piece is part of a pipeline. Connect pipes, guide the flow and keep building as the pressure rises. Play solo, cooperate with a friend or compete head-to-head in local multiplayer.

name: Daily Life With The Herb Girl

details.title: Daily Life With The Herb Girl
details.short_description: A slice-of-life visual novel steeped in Traditional Chinese Medicine. Befriend Linglan, a girl manifested from medicinal herbs, learn herbal properties, and guide her through the modern world. Features Live2D.

details.title: [ABERRATION] Yes, Jerry!
details.short_description: Mike is an ordinary man, tired of everything. Then he meets Jerry, a huge, purple creature who starts making his life better. Until...

details.title: Out A Space
details.short_description: Out A Space is a fast-paced, top-down space roguelike combining arcade action with tactical fleet management. Deploy your fleet on a pre-battle grid, customize ship loadouts, and chain weapon effects to shatter enemy armadas from your flagship as you cross the galaxy to uncover an ancient secret.

details.title: Deathless Oath
details.short_description: Become an ancient unholy creature rising against mankind to claim its right to exist through fire and steel. Cut through crowds of enemies, crush them in brutal melee combat, and turn the medieval battlefield to ash. Death waits. The oath remains.

details.title: Covenantum
details.short_description: Covenantum is a seasonal covenant-management RPG inspired by Ars Magica where you guide a growing magical covenant through decades of political intrigue, supernatural events, magical research, and strategic seasonal planning in Mythic Europe.

details.title: The Necessary Evil
details.short_description: The Necessary Evil is a tactical RPG about making difficult decisions and preparing for the unpredictable. Lead "volunteers" into the dark and rotting recesses of the collective unconscious, colonized and industrialized and plundered for profit. Every decision matters, and every choice has a cost.

details.title: Mech Support
details.short_description: Mech Support is an action focused, multitasking game, featuring frantic tower defense elements. Up to four players take control of "US Inc" engineers, tasked with defending military outposts and crafting powerful ammunition, in order to destroy waves of dastardly "THEM Co" enemy mechs.

details.title: Chicks vs Ducks
details.short_description: Tag, push and parkour your friends off the map. Chicks vs Ducks is a 2–10 player online party game: team hunts, free-for-all brawls on rising lava, and co-op egg heists against sharks. Wall-run, dash, grapple and get back up, or drag a friend up with you.

details.title: Utopia: Haven
details.short_description: Explore three distant planets in this retro-inspired 2D metroidvania, developed for the Game Boy Color. Face mysterious creatures, discover powerful upgrades and uncover lost secrets. The fate of humanity is in your hands!

details.title: Pocket Pilot
details.short_description: Pilot planes, helicopters, and drones to clean, restore, and rebuild multiple unique islands. Water crops, power-wash monuments, airlift cargo, and clear toxic smog at your own pace in this cozy aerial restoration simulator.

details.title: Unpatched
details.short_description: "Unpatched" is an action-RPG in the isekai genre. Play as a QA tester trapped in the body of an undead assassin inside the MMORPG he's testing. Your raid boss is in danger, the heroes are already close. Your weapons are blades and knowledge of unfixed bugs. Fight hordes of players and save your boss

details.title: Deckhound
details.short_description: Somebody took Birdie's slipper, and she wants it BACK! Pick two of eight real pets, build a deck of dog tricks, and chase off squirrels, garden gnomes and one very big goose. Play solo with both pets or couch co-op for two. A cozy, silly roguelike deckbuilder.

details.title: Dark Ages Battle Simulator
details.short_description: What happens when 20 skeletons face a dragon? Or an army of goblins challenges a colossal demon? Create your own dark-fantasy matchups, build your armies, and watch monsters, warriors and legendary beasts clash in a brutal cinematic battle simulator.

details.title: Fruitless Campaign
details.short_description: Set the azimuth, elevation and launch speed, read the wind and the weather, and lob shells across endless procedurally generated islands to destroy every fruit. Play untimed on Easy or race the clock on Normal and Hard. Earn weapons from airdropped crates, or take on up to three friends online.

details.title: Capital Circuit
details.short_description: A chaotic 3D party board game for 2–6 players: buy America's biggest cities, rig your rivals' dice, blow up their buildings with a bazooka and settle scores in 14 first-person minigames — beer pong, bobsleigh, darts, water pistol duels and more. Online or on one screen.

details.title: AfterCursor
details.short_description: Your cursor leaves copies behind. Now they hunt you. Collect folders, dodge phantom cursors, and chase high scores in an eerie desktop arcade game. Uncover a 50-level story between emails, or test your reflexes in Endless, Maze, Waves, and Relay.

details.title: 100 Bodies in the Grass
details.short_description: 100 Bodies in the Grass is a wave-based co-op defense game, set against the backdrop of the Third Mongol Invasion of Vietnam, combining elements of roguelikes and tower/hero defenses with the combat of an isometric ARPG.

details.title: Stop The Slime
details.short_description: A 3D platformer where standing still is deadly. Ground melts your slime, water heals it, and every coin doubles as ammo. Hop across floating islands, outsmart monsters, obstacles and traps and chase three stars on every level.

details.title: Cataract Quest
details.short_description: Cataract Quest is a first-person co-op adventure where your vision is failing. Play solo or team up with friends as an old man navigating a treacherous world with cataracts. Rely on walking sticks, unique abilities, and chaotic teamwork to find your way back home.

details.title: Virtualord, The Virtual Conqueror
details.short_description: Set up your base, gather resources and build a defensive perimeter with walls and towers to protect your outpost from waves of enemies. Research new tech, gather your forces and send your units and mini-units to annihilate the enemy.

details.title: Moochy
details.short_description: Your coins are your health. Spend them on guns, or hold onto them and stay alive longer — your call. Dumb co-op for 1 to 4.

details.title: Nox Mortalis
details.short_description: Nox Mortalis is a retro-style open world survival game where you must gather resources, craft essential gear, and explore sinister dungeons. Face hellish creatures and fight to survive in this world.

details.title: Sirens
details.short_description: Become a deadly Siren and hunt down the most dangerous sea creatures that have ever swim in the depths of the oceans! Experience a fascinating journey through the world as seen from the perspective of Sirens at various stages of their evolution.

details.title: Centuries
details.short_description: Grow a small camp into a thriving medieval settlement. Shape its expansion, develop its economy and care for the households that call it home. Balance your ambitions with the everyday needs of a growing community.

details.title: SetPoint Volleyball
details.short_description: Build your athlete and hit the sand! SetPoint Volleyball blends arcade beach volleyball with competitive matches online or on the same couch. Serve, spike, block, challenge your friends and climb the ranked ladder. Just watch out for the seagulls.

details.title: Croak
details.short_description: Tongue-grapple and pinball-bounce the frog prince across levels to reach the Witch’s Banquet in this hand-drawn 2D platformer. Each whimsical world has its own wacky boss, hidden collectibles, and a unique traversal ability. Grit your teeth! You're gonna CROAK. -DEMO OUT NOW!-

details.title: Roam
details.short_description: "Roam" is a 2D Action-RPG platformer set in a procedurally generated world. Explore the surrounding lands and delve into the depths of mysterious caves that have lain hidden for centuries beneath the Azure Lake.

details.title: Tearoom of Terror
details.short_description: Congratulations on your inheritance: one tearoom, one murdered aunt, 22 regulars who know where the *ahem* bodies are buried. Brew tea, bake treats and try to solve the mystery of your aunt's murder before Halloween - or end up on the menu yourself.

details.title: 14:  Overmind
details.short_description: 14: Overmind is a first-person survival adventure in a cosmos where anomalies warp space and gravity. Mine ore on asteroids, cut open wrecks with a laser, outfit your base, and upgrade your exosuit to uncover what caused the catastrophe and unravel the mystery of your origins.

details.title: Car Mechanic Simulator 2027
details.short_description: Build, repair, and grow your automotive empire — now also in co-op mode! Run a workshop together, fix cars, and expand your collection. Hundreds of configurations, thousands of parts, and full customization await!

details.title: Fools, Maniacs and Liars
details.short_description: A narrative-driven game of suspense, crime, and dark humor. Amid exquisitely crafted art and a gripping story, the Wushan Great Buddha's demise unfolds.

details.title: Shrooms
details.short_description: Explore a dark isometric forest alone or in 1–4 player co-op. Gather and test hundreds of ingredients, brew potions and monster oils, build a home, and uncover why a dwarf village has held exactly thirty-four souls for two centuries.

details.title: SIM Chef: Restaurant management
details.short_description: SIM Chef is a restaurant sim that starts on an empty lot. Build the dining room and the kitchen, choose from over 200 dishes and drinks from around the world and hire a team that knows how to make your menu. Win over the judges and take home awards.

details.title: Barkour
details.short_description: BARKOUR is a fast-paced action platformer with a stealthy twist, starring Agent T.H.U.N.D.E.R. - a tail-wagging master of parkour, high-tech gadgets and getting into trouble. Jump, sneak and fight your way through a spy adventure packed with action, canine chaos and delightfully absurd surprises.

details.title: Monsterest
details.short_description: Manage a monster-friendly inn. Chop down trees to make furniture and decorate the rooms. Catch fish, hunt, and prepare meals. Befriend your guests, and they'll join you as companions. What kind of monster guest will visit today?

details.title: Rescue Ops: Wildfire
details.short_description: Become a wildland firefighter and battle raging wildfires around the world. Play solo or in co-op to rescue civilians, operate specialized vehicles, and outsmart fast-spreading, dynamic fires.

details.title: Game Designer Simulator
details.short_description: Game Designer Simulator is a pixel game based on real-life themes, with a non-linear storyline and card battles. Players will take on the role of a newly graduated college student in a fictional city based on Shanghai, experiencing everything from interviews to becoming a novice game Designer.

details.title: Never Be Alone
details.short_description: Never Be Alone is an open-world zombie survival game for solo play and seamless co-op. Explore a world reclaimed by nature, protect a fragile safezone, and uncover the truth behind your forgotten past 10 years after the outbreak.

details.title: Come to my party!
details.short_description: Jimin dreams of finally having her first birthday party, but what begins as a childhood wish unravels into social pressure, fragile friendships, family expectations, and consequences that hit closer than you’d like. Join Jimin in this coming-of-age story where every choice carries weight.

details.title: Scramble Heart City
details.short_description: Scramble Heart City is a 3v3 tag-team fighter that's easy to pick up and play. It's time to beat up your friends and find new ones! Battle anywhere with local and online multiplayer and browser cross-play.

details.title: Thalassomania
details.short_description: A PS1-style co-op horror game for 1–4 players. Set at sea, you run a fishing trawler with your crew. Haul, gut, steer and repair while something lurks in the shadows. Keep the ship alive. Get home. You're not alone out there.

details.title: MR. RECORDS
details.short_description: ​Meet George, an old dreamer with an extraordinary gift that lets him transcend through music. After a lifetime of standing still, he breaks free from routine and opens the store he always wished for. ​

details.title: HARK THE GHOUL
details.short_description: Slash, kick and magick your way through an adventure brimming with secrets and curious encounters! HARK THE GHOUL offers a meticulously handcrafted world to explore.

details.title: Bladesmith Shop Simulator
details.short_description: Rule the anvil! Harness magic-infused ores brimming with otherworldly effects to forge legendary weapons. Stock a thriving smithy, scour wild lands for epic loot, and outsmith fierce rivals in grand tournaments to crown yourself the continent's ultimate bladesmith tycoon!

details.title: HYPERyuki: Snowboard Syndicate
details.short_description: Race, trick, and explore across vibrant slopes with a cast of unique riders. Master speed, style, and control in this fast-paced arcade snowboarder. Prove it where it counts, split-screen with friends or head-to-head online multiplayer. Shred the mountain. Rip the competition.

details.title: Gods, Death & Reapers
details.short_description: An innovative ExtrAction RPG set in an afterlife where mythology is real and the gods are dead. Fight through PvPvE, PvE, or as a party to claim valuable loot and bring balance to the shattered realms.

details.title: Paleokin
details.short_description: Paleokin is a brutal prehistoric survival game set in an infinite procedural world. Fight mammoths and dinosaurs, build a settlement, farm the land, breed your own dinos, and stay alive. Alone or with friends.

details.title: Another Door
details.short_description: Another Door is a multiplayer, turn-based roguelike with monsters, despair, risk and betrayal. Hide your intentions, bluff to survive and bet on your luck. Will you back out, or venture through Another Door?

details.title: XGUN
details.short_description: A co-op zombie extraction shooter set on a drowned Persian Gulf resort island. Loot the flooded hotels, survive the infected, and reach extraction before dark. Play online, solo offline, or split-screen on one couch - no server required.

details.title: As One We Survive
details.short_description: Survive in a harsh post-apocalyptic world. Scavenge resources, build up a homestead, form a community, and defend yourself against a lawless world in a challenging survival sandbox.

details.title: Martial Law: Our Spring
details.short_description: Grey blocks of flat, Militia and tanks on the streets, the desire for a better tomorrow and your drunk buddy on the bench. Welcome to Martial Law: Our Spring.

details.title: Wild Wild Eden
details.short_description: Survive a primitive fantasy world in Wild Wild Eden, an open-world survival crafting game where monsters are family. Pet, feed, and protect your companions. As a tribal chief, raise your monster friends, build a thriving base, and explore a harsh yet heartwarming world together.

details.title: Redneck Redemption
details.short_description: 100% authentic redneck alien hunting simulator. Drink, fight, stalk and piss your way through an alien invasion.

details.title: Not Us
details.short_description: A solitaire style card game where you forage for plants, manage your inventory, and try to stay alive.

details.title: LightSup!
details.short_description: LightSup is a chaotic 1–4 player couch co-op adventure where darkness drains sanity while the Altar of Light keeps you alive. Battle monsters, gain powerful Blessings, endure dangerous Curses, and choose your path to save the world from an eternal eclipse.

details.title: BECROWNED
details.short_description: A non-linear survival horror drawing inspiration from the surrealist dark satire of VHS-era Horror and lurid atmosphere of classic Grindhouse cinema. Step into Richard Torrance's shoes and survive a complex web of relationships as you phase between industrial ruins and a tragic fantasy kingdom.

details.title: Metropolis 1998
details.short_description: A fresh, modern city builder with charming aesthetics. Detailed agent-based simulation and scheduling. See inside buildings. Design and customize almost anything. Business-specific zoning, and mixed use zones too!

details.title: Alpine Lake
details.short_description: Build, decorate, and customize every detail of your inn to welcome guests to your cozy escape in the woods. Entertain tourists, farm, cook meals, research wildlife, and ski, all while helping a colorful cast of townspeople save the struggling mountain town from a hostile takeover.

details.title: Squid Grid
details.short_description: Each puzzle reveals a ray of light scattered across this moody hand-inked Steampunk Ocean. Can you crack the peculiar yet (eventually) obvious logic of the Squid Grid?

details.title: Laws of Nadragia
details.short_description: Become a prosecutor in the totalitarian Nadragia. Convict criminals: use the laws and facts of court cases to get a verdict at any cost... But can you keep your conscience?

details.title: REMOTE CONTROL
details.short_description: A missing crew triggers an investigation that you must lead. 6 human subjects are at your disposal to aid the mission. Control their every move by typing commands to explore the ship. Be wary: the deeper you go, the more dangers that will risk their lives and test how disposable a life really is.

details.title: Junk Mountain
details.short_description: Dig through mountains of junk for a hard drive holding 8,000 bitcoin. Find drives, test them on a computer and follow five clues from a backyard junkyard to orbit. Sell scrap, upgrade tools and hire workers to build a junkyard that runs itself.

details.title: SOKO 1977: Anti-Terror Task Force
details.short_description: Take command of a special police task force in 1970s Germany. Uncover terrorist networks, coordinate operations, and make far-reaching decisions. Experience an intense, historically inspired scenario that explores the balance between security, freedom, and the rule of law.

details.title: Pinball Boss Quest
details.short_description: Pinball meets block breaker in a pixel-art fantasy quest. Bat the ball through minion waves, smash breakables and topple ten legendary bosses as a Sword, Bow, Javelin, Mage or Summoner, solo or in local co-op where you team up on the boss but compete for the top score.

details.title: Embers & Iron Rain
details.short_description: 【Strategic Tower Defense × Random Traits】Every run is different ✦【Rearrange Your Defenses】There's always a better solution ✦【Tactical Commands】Seize the moment — set new records on familiar battlefields.

details.title: Shelf Therapy
details.short_description: Shelf Therapy is a relaxing first-person 3D shelf-organizing game. Pick up everyday products and place them freely in their designated sections. Arrange drinks, snacks, ready-to-eat meals, and more without fixed slots, and enjoy turning empty shelves into neat displays.

details.title: Inside your hole
details.short_description: Chaotic multiplayer mini golf for up to 8 friends: tornadoes, black holes, falling TNT and a course editor to build your own holes. Plus a co-op story mode where you get reincarnated as a mini golf ball.

details.title: Consume p/pixelplace
details.short_description: Hack a fully simulated pixel canvas. Build your botnet, spread the Void, and watch fictional communities fight, rebuild, and complain on Pixxit. A single-player incremental game with active and Idle modes, territorial drama, and far too many crabs.

details.title: The Process of Elimination
details.short_description: Unravel 12 unforgettable crime scene investigations – each one teeming with devious interactive puzzles, connected clues, hidden links, and subtle discrepancies. There are four sides to every story; can you use the process of elimination to deduce the truth?

name: renal spring: Focus as a Kidney

details.title: renal spring: Focus as a Kidney
details.short_description: Hello. You are a dog's kidney. When you get to work, so does the dog's kidney. renal spring: Focus as a Kidney is a cozy productivity game. Keep an old man and his dog's daily life on your desktop as you work or study. Their lives unfold in real time, and your work keeps the dog healthy.

name: Curator: Tidy Up the Sleeping Gallery!

details.title: Curator: Tidy Up the Sleeping Gallery!
details.short_description: Become the curator of a vast, magical museum! In this relaxing game, find the right place for over 3,000 paintings, restore damaged works and uncover their fascinating stories. Upgrade your curator, work faster and unlock new galleries!

details.title: Voretsk
details.short_description: Voretsk is a 3D First Person Extraction Shooter where you play as civilians trapped in the middle of a war zone. Alone or with a friend venture into the cruel Voretsk Zone, fight or hide, scavenge and get back. Complete missions, uncover a way out, and leave the Zone behind and reclaim your life.

details.title: PAIN(T)
details.short_description: You have one job: paint the wall yellow. All of it. PAIN(T) is a co-op dystopian comedy for 1-4 colleagues sharing one shaky lift, with proximity voice chat. Whoever drives it ruins everyone's stroke. Buy bigger rollers, and try not to ask what the doors are for.

details.title: Fishlings: A Cozy Fish Collector
details.short_description: A cozy idle aquarium where every fish comes out of a card pack. Rip packs, flip cards, chase the 1-in-1,000 Prismatic and collect 80+ odd little fish in four variants. Your tank keeps growing and earning while you're away, or swims in a tiny window on your desktop while you work.

details.title: Last Embers : Fire Hero
details.short_description: Grab the hose, rookie. The city is on fire! Drown roaring flames, rescue a city full of characters, spend your coins on 90+ upgrades and race across town to answer every call... but something is lurking deep in the flames.

details.title: Sandgrave
details.short_description: Rise, Captain! Sandgrave is a pixel-art, top-down sandbox about big flying ships, real-time fleet combat and life between trading and fighting pirates across the vast desert! Design your vessel, fight by boarding, broadsides or bombardment! Play solo or in an online open world!

details.title: Your Lovely Legs
details.short_description: Pinch the stocking, pull, let go: it snaps back with a slap. A game about legs and stockings and nothing else: touch them, tear them, get them wet. Dozens of stockings and five pairs of shoes in the wardrobe, a water gun and a camera at hand. She gets shy, she says ouch, and slowly warms to you.

details.title: Find The Clover
details.short_description: Sweep a meadow of a million clovers. Upgrade your cursor, send bees and robots to harvest, catch leprechauns and hunt for the legendary rainbow clover.

details.title: Oath of the Huan
details.short_description: 100,000+ simulated soldiers on screen: Take the reins as the Son of Heaven in this massive stylized RTS with visuals inspired by Chinese traditional paintings and groundbreaking real time simulation. Titans, cataclysmic world-shattering events.

details.title: Popscraper
details.short_description: Pop one million balloons in a cartoon first-person incremental shooter. Ride the elevator up the tower as every floor holds ten times more, turn confetti into silly weapons and idle machines, and pop the King Balloon on each floor to reach the top.

details.title: Cannonade
details.short_description: A stylized Napoleonic RTS: smoke, violins and blood. Micromanage everything or delegate to your trusted lieutenants. React and battle against an adaptive and smart AI opponent in multiple challenging campaigns.

details.title: Driftworn
details.short_description: Lead a squad of drifters through a solar system still broken by a decade old war. Fight, trade, salvage and build across the planets and moons of Sol in an open-world sandbox where nobody is the chosen one, then buy a ship and start your adventure

details.title: Couch Potato
details.short_description: Tiny Spud is a little potato who lives on your desktop. He binge-watches TV in a panel beside your work, cooks disasters, plays his retro console, takes calls from his inventor brother and wanders out onto your taskbar for a nap. You work. He couches.

details.title: Lost Arsenal
details.short_description: Lost Arsenal is a challenging movement-heavy melee action game. Stylishly maneuver through areas by teleporting to your thrown weapons, and use each weapon's unique power to carve your way through a summoner's invasion.

details.title: Hextalia
details.short_description: Build the path. Then defend it. Hextalia is a hex-based tower defense where you control the battlefield. Shape enemy routes with your towers, combine abilities to discover your own build combinations, and survive levels that punish careless builds.

details.title: Waymark
details.short_description: Waymark blends scenic jigsaw puzzles with deckbuilding and spell combos. Build your spell deck, rotate and place puzzle pieces, and chain effects to take on monsters. Explore city landmarks, collect local souvenirs, and fill your travel journal with the places you discover.

details.title: SUPRA CAELIS
details.short_description: Crash-landed on an alien world, fleeing a war you no longer believe in. You'll have to cross two planets on opposite ends of existence, guided by a dormant robot carrying secrets of its own. Explore. Scavenge. Uncover the truth behind the conflict that shaped both your fates.

details.title: CARD SHOP SHUFFLE!
details.short_description: CARD SHOP SHUFFLE! is a cozy, single-player organizing sim about identifying and sorting 2,500 cards scattered across the floor of a card shop. There are no timers or game overs, so you can work at your own pace. Appraise each card, unlock skills to work more efficiently, and maximize your profits.

details.title: Main Character Energy
details.short_description: Ever dreamed of time-traveling or a perfect romance? Tired of dumb protagonists and restrictive RPGs? Here is the answer. A text adventure where you set the world and make every decision. Drive a tank on an ancient battlefield, or turn a ghost into your lover. Become the hero of your own story.

details.title: Territorium
details.short_description: « Conquer the world, one border at a time. » Territorium is a real-time multiplayer grand strategy game for up to 128 players. Upgrade your facilities, unlock devastating nuclear arsenals, and dominate the map in solo, co-op survival, or exclusive team modes.

details.title: Buzzmischief
details.short_description: Buzzmischief is a mosquito survival game. Fly into people's homes at night, drink from sleeping humans without getting swatted, and bring the blood home. Spend it on eggs and upgrades to grow a colony across the street. Take too much, though, and someone calls the exterminator.

details.title: Marceline Magpie: Forgotten Culprit
details.short_description: Discover a strange secret on forgotten abandonware and save a girl from a vanishing kidnapper in this unique puzzle box point and click adventure mystery.

details.title: LIMEN Company
details.short_description: A co-op survival horror game for 1–4 players in procedurally generated worlds. Pick a door, gather the data and stay quiet — they can hear you.

details.title: While I Still Remember
details.short_description: An adventure game about an artist who has lost her sight and must learn to live in the unfamiliar, dark and frightening world that has become her reality

details.title: Clay Rumble
details.short_description: Claymation wrestling with hand-sculpted clay fighters. Punch, bodyslam, dive off the top rope, grab the folding chair and settle it outside the ring. Couch brawls for two, six-fighter Clay Rumbles, tag team chaos and tournaments.

details.title: Kingshatter
details.short_description: KINGSHATTER is a chess roguelike about building a ridiculous army and finding out just how much trouble it can cause. Fight across small boards, collect powerful upgrades, and take on opponents with a few unpleasant tricks of their own.

details.title: The Hearth That Waits
details.short_description: Build your whole party around one shared dice roll. Every companion reads the same result through their own runes, then acts in turn to chain combos. Plan your team in town, then set out on a warm, light-hearted fantasy adventure.

details.title: Untamed Ehizia
details.short_description: Untamed Ehizia is a sandbox MMORPG with unusual game mechanics built around cooperation and social interactions. Come with friends or find new ones, and tame the world of Ehizia together.

details.title: Abelina
details.short_description: A surreal, hand-crafted adventure platformer. Vasily died and woke up in Abelina, a settlement in the afterlife. Now he’s heading into the frontier with his companions following behind. No combat, just a vast world to explore and a mature story about carrying life’s baggage into the afterlife.

details.title: Ducks in Disguise 2: Mythology
details.short_description: Hidden ducks are back in a world of myths and legends! Find hundreds of rubber ducks in hand-drawn mythic scenes, from Egyptian palaces to Norse halls and Japanese temples. Watch each sketch burst into color and collect ducks dressed as heroes, monsters and gods in a relaxing hidden object game.

details.title: CardArena
details.short_description: Watch the battle unfold as you shape your deck, find new gear and create epic synergies. Climb the arena in this roguelite deckbuilding auto battler.

details.title: Last Floor: Paradox
details.short_description: An elevator that doesn't obey the laws of space. Descend through impossible places, spot anomalies, follow the rules, and survive whatever waits on the Last Floor.

details.title: Lot Luck
details.short_description: Open mystery boxes, discover hundreds of unique items, and find out what they're worth. Sell your finds or grow your collection, upgrade and automate your business, and collect adorable cats. What will the next box reveal?

details.title: Goodly Trials
details.short_description: Hire a storied leader, build a crew around them, bargain for gear, and grow your company to survive your journey home in this tactical auto-battler. Play solo, face a tournament of trials in multiplayer, or team up in co-op.

details.title: Elandrake
details.short_description: Consume matter and unlock new abilities as you defend a cosmic entity from relentless waves of fleets while she emerges from another reality in this incremental twin-stick shooter.

details.title: Vital Decisions
details.short_description: Take charge of a emergency room up to 8 players. Examine patients’ vitals, diagnose their conditions, and choose the right treatment. Prioritize emergencies and keep the shift under control as your patients’ conditions worsen around you.

details.title: Popo and the Moonlit Shop
details.short_description: A magical shop simulator where you gather materials with your Popos, craft goods, and keep display stands full while fulfilling your customers' requests. Customise the shop to fit your aesthetic, and travel between worlds to open new branches of your Moonlit Shop!

name: I Stole My Boss' Boy Toy

details.title: I Stole My Boss' Boy Toy
details.short_description: You find a terrified young man hiding in your apartment hallway. The twist? He just escaped from your sadistic boss. Desperate for college tuition, this brilliant art student was tricked by a shady agency. Now, hide him, protect him and plot your revenge. Your choices dictate his fate!

details.title: Armory Doctrine
details.short_description: Armory Doctrine is a real-time grand strategy game where you run a private arms empire and fight your own wars in a modern world sliding toward war. Expand your factory, master the global weapons market, and decide the fate of every shipment: sell it for profit, equip your own forces or arm a proxy.

details.title: Rampartloom: PvP Tower Defense
details.short_description: Build a maze. Send an army. Win as a team. Rampartloom is a free-to-play 3v3 tower defense game where every attack grows your income. Draft a faction, defend your lane, and coordinate assaults to break the enemy team’s defenses. Play the free demo.

details.title: Magic Shop Chaos
details.short_description: A fun co-op organization simulator for 1-4 players. Team up as witches to bring order to a chaotic shop by sorting 6,000+ magical items back to their rightful places. Serve incoming customers, level up unique magical skills, and transform magical chaos into perfect order!

name: Bahamut3-The Fall of the Dragon God's Child

details.title: Bahamut3-The Fall of the Dragon God's Child
details.short_description: Bahamut 3: Fall of the Dragon God's Child is a dark fantasy JRPG where every choice shapes the hero’s fate. Fight tactical battles using positioning, attack ranges, and Action Points, recruit companions tied to the Seven Deadly Sins, and manage weapons, hunger, time, and resources.

details.title: Theoria: A God Simulator
details.short_description: A Godsimulator without limits. Throw buildings with your bare hand, burn nations down with meteors, or possess a peasant and walk through the war you started.

details.title: Schedule: Rehab Business
details.short_description: Play in co-op at the worst rehab center in town. Manage patients, deal with disasters, and try to help everyone recover without losing control.

details.title: AFTERMATH
details.short_description: Aftermath is a first-person horror game. Return to this old house once again, explore its dark corners, and face the traces that cannot be erased and the consequences that cannot be undone.

details.title: Pack Ripper
details.short_description: Pack Ripper is a hands-on trading card incremental game. Rip open packs, fill your binder, and level up your packs for better pulls. Will you sell the hit or keep it?

details.title: Fleshgrinder
details.short_description: Fleshgrinder is an isometric post-apocalyptic Action-RPG. Take on the desperate mission to stop the Fleshgrinder from causing planetary extinction by harvesting the infected population. Loot, equip and level up your characters, interact with npcs in a persistent world filled with quests and danger.

details.title: Maiden Escape
details.short_description: Play as a paranormal investigator and escape from a ghost's nightmare. A horror adventure with 168 box-pushing puzzles and 2 endings.

details.title: Highways & Co.
details.short_description: Do you hate building cities but love managing traffic? Design the perfect road network in this traffic simulator. Build interchanges, roundabouts, bridges, and tunnels with powerful road-building tools. Keep traffic flowing, solve congestion, and avoid a pile-up!

details.title: Seaside Shop Simulator
details.short_description: Grow your very own seaside shop! Sell products, earn profits, expand your store, plan the layout, and experience the journey of building a successful business from the ground up.

details.title: NOYAKI — CONTROLLED BURN
