details.short_description: A casual puzzle game about controlled burning! Fire obeys the land and wind: racing uphill, fading downhill, stopping at cliffs and rivers. You choose only when and where to light it. Read the slopes, read the wind, cut firebreaks, move the livestock, and burn the grassland exactly as you meant to.

name: A Normal Quiz Game where you try to solve questions but the questions have tricks and gimmicks and if you get them wrong you have to beat a wacky punishment but they are kinda fun so you lowkey wanna do them even if it means getting the question wrong.

details.title: A Normal Quiz Game where you try to solve questions but the questions have tricks and gimmicks and if you get them wrong you have to beat a wacky punishment but they are kinda fun so you lowkey wanna do them even if it means getting the question wrong.
details.short_description: Solve puzzles, test your reflexes, and do your taxes in this normal quiz game that is actually quite unusual.

details.title: Dude, Trust Me
details.short_description: Get hopelessly misunderstood by your two best friends. One of you goes blind, one goes deaf, one loses their voice, and no puzzle here can be solved by one person. Can the three of you work out how to understand each other?

details.title: Mecha Wars: Kitbash Rebuilt
details.short_description: One day, young Lumina accidentally witnesses a shady incident and gets dragged straight into the crossfire. From that moment on, she’s forced into a desperate war against the evil organization “Tenfold Piercing Arrow”. To crush her enemies, she must scavenge parts and forge an even stronger mecha.

details.title: Wretched Tales:Cinderella
details.short_description: A familiar Cinderella fairy tale is twisted into a grotesque puzzle adventure. Observe static 2D scenes, interpret the hidden reactions of objects, and complete the cruel procedure that leads to the ball.

details.title: Brain Bomb
details.short_description: Concepts are bombs. Association is death. An cult-like anti-utopian psychological horror puzzle game. The subject has a concept bomb implanted in brain. If a subject thinks of the [Fuse Word], their head detonates. You, as the "cognitive bomb defuser", dismantling the deadly "brain bomb".

details.title: Kingdoms Assemble
details.short_description: Kingdoms Assemble is a fantasy async PvP auto-battler. Start from a small plot: buy tiles, plan your layout, expand territory, and conquer kingdoms on the world map. Your pre-arranged lineup automatically produces and strengthens your army. Forge a unique war kingdom and conquer the continent!

details.title: Desert Sweepers
details.short_description: In this relaxing first-person cleaning sim, the Bureau has declared the desert too sandy. Start with a spoon, get paid by the kilo, and earn your way to sweeper trucks and hauling robots. Leave a clean trail through the dunes at your own pace. Play solo or in online co-op from launch.

details.title: Heroll: IF
details.short_description: Roll the dice, survive the chaos, and rebuild a broken world in this roguelite board-game RPG. Battle through unpredictable loops, recruit adorable pets, face wild events, and grow stronger with every roll.

details.title: Sound Agent
details.short_description: Sound Agent is a narrative puzzle game where you solve cold cases by listening. Use the sound device to rewind to crime scenes, listen to the sounds at the scene, and uncover truths hidden in plain sound.

details.title: Marriage in Withdrawal
details.short_description: A dark otome VN where you will walk a perilous tightrope between desire and morality. Will you melt the ice of your frozen husband, or fall into the gentle trap of the boy next door? Will you sink into a tangled, three-way descent, or break free from everything to claim your ultimate freedom?

details.title: Anomaly Cafe
details.short_description: Manage a quaint coffee shop hidden deep in an unknown forest. Brew daily cups for ordinary travelers, but be prepared to adapt your service when unusual and anomalous entities start lining up for their caffeine fix.

details.title: Gökbörü
details.short_description: Draw a line, close the loop, crush every demon caught inside. A 3D arcade action roguelite born from Turkic mythology — every open line is a gamble. Power up with divine Boons, face 10 mythic bosses and chase the high score.

details.title: Midnight Moving Crew
details.short_description: Midnight Moving Crew is a 1-4 player co-op horror sim. Clock in, pack the house, and survive the shift. Buy EMF detectors and defensive wards to repel any entities in the house before you become the next permanent resident.

name: Day by day：东京留子生存日记

details.title: Day by day：东京留子生存日记
details.short_description: A pixel-art life simulation about studying, surviving, and chasing your dreams as an international student in Tokyo. Every day, every choice, shapes your future.

details.title: SCP Idle: SECURE. CONTAIN. PROGRESS.
details.short_description: In this incremental game you are in charge of managing a SCP facility site. Construct and upgrade new containment chambers, prevent devastating breaches and complete the Thaumiel Containment Engine.

details.title: Log Drop
details.short_description: A physics sandbox with one noble goal: get more logs into the core than physically reasonable. Chop the trees, build the contraption, then unleash a wave of logs for combo-fueled cash. Kick back and let it flow, or engineer the perfect cascade. Your sandbox, your rules.

details.title: Tiny Cultivation
details.short_description: Raise a tiny cultivator on your desktop. Watch them train, nap, fail, reincarnate, and build a unique cultivation story while you work, study, or play. Every life is different. Every reincarnation leaves a legacy.

details.title: Gamercury World Engine
details.short_description: Turn one idea into a playable AI world. Gamercury World Engine helps creators build detective mysteries, dress-up dramas, simulation games, and cinematic interactive stories with AI-generated plots, quests, character dialogue, voice, cutscenes, and 3D scenes.

details.title: Mars Inc 98
details.short_description: Mars Inc 98 is a retro Windows 98 styled incremental game about terraforming Mars. Mine ore, craft parts, build machines and launch rockets to turn the Red Planet from a dusty wasteland into a habitable world.

details.title: Cardboard Conquest
details.short_description: Every card is an army in a beautiful papercraft world full of surprises. Choose from slimes, ghosts, a bug hivemind, giants, and more, across 22 distinct packs with unique playstyles. Earn the cardboard crown solo or online with up to three friends.

details.title: Cold Case: Unfinished Sentences
details.short_description: Enter the burned crime scene and restore 8 cases from the past. The crime scene photos and records have been charred black, but as a cold case investigator, your deduction and forensic skills can reveal what happened. Search by keyword, reconstruct the sequence of events, and uncover the truth.

details.title: CRIMSON PANDEMIC
details.short_description: CRIMSON PANDEMIC: A tale of the 'Rubrum'—a crimson light that mutates living beings into entities driven by resentment—and 'Belle,' a girl who has lost her dreams, embarking on a journey of promise aboard a Ark.

details.title: 时装工坊
details.short_description: You are a fashion designer and run your own fashion design room. An ordinary template can be made into anything you imagine. You can also design clothes for pets and put on your own clothes to wear after the design is completed. Match the scenes and actions and take a photo of your work.

details.title: UNCUT
details.short_description: UNCUT is a tactical police raid shooter seen through a bodycam. Shout real orders into your mic and suspects react: some comply, some run, some open fire. Clear houses solo with two NPC officers or in co-op with up to 4 players. No raid plays out the same.

name: Lomiya: Do LLMs Dream of Modern Poetry?

details.title: Lomiya: Do LLMs Dream of Modern Poetry?
details.short_description: A near-future visual novel — No androids. No cyberware. Only an LLM girl, the world, and you.

details.title: Road Truckers: New Beginning
details.short_description: Be a TRUCKER, not a truck. Haul cargo, restore a forgotten town, and grow your trucking business in the first true trucking RPG. Get on foot to forge relationships, then jump back into your fully customizable rig to rule the road.

details.title: Shadows of Chroma Tower
details.short_description: Choose your faction and fight for control of the Tower! Shadows of Chroma Tower mixes together the best features of Dungeon Crawlers and ARPGs. Choose between steel, wit and magic to face hordes of enemies and huge bosses in PvE dungeons while participating in Asynchronous PvP modes.

details.title: She'll Be Home Soon
details.short_description: Your wife will be home soon. Clean the house, feed the dog, finish the chores and keep everything under control before she arrives, while something that looks like her stalks the house and starts undoing your work.

details.title: 5th ERA
details.short_description: A techno-fantasy JRPG inspired by 16-bit classics. Explore Helgon, the city on the comet, and build your ideal team from a roster of 9 distinct characters, each with their own classes. Engage in strategic turn-based combat against the deadly Brightlings to uncover the truth behind the white portals.

details.title: Rescue Drone Simulator: Second Chance
details.short_description: Pilot drones into burning buildings, frozen landmarks, and collapsing tunnels. Rescue survivors, build and customize your fleet, and lead a team of specialists who never got a second chance - until now.

details.title: Young Suns
details.short_description: Build a home on your own spaceship and take it adventuring across a newly liberated Jupiter. A cozy 1-4 player narrative life sim where you explore, salvage, and repair to help a huge cast of lovable characters make society better.

details.title: COVR
details.short_description: COVR is a high-stakes tactical VR shooter built around next-gen visuals, grounded realism, and tense CQB. Deploy solo or in co-op, complete classic tactical objectives, adapt to unpredictable missions, and make every decision count. Coming in 2026.

details.title: SpaceDeck
details.short_description: SpaceDeck is a roguelike shoot-em-up deckbuilder. Build a deck under fire - dodge bullets, blast enemies and grab cards as you fly. Survive the action, then use your deck to fight a boss in a turn-based card battle. Get blown up, start again and keep fighting until you get your dog back!

details.title: Plushie Party
details.short_description: Win mini-games, survive the show, and watch your friends turn into stuffing as you crush their hopes and dreams in this collection of slightly violent party games!

name: Smoke Em If You Got Em (SEIYGE)

details.title: Smoke Em If You Got Em (SEIYGE)
details.short_description: Smoke Em If You Got Em (SEIYGE) is a PvPvE tactical VR FPS shooter with vehicles, to include a functioning C130 Gunship. Up to 3 teams battle over different maps to hold a trophy for 3 minutes to win the match. SEIYGE includes weapon attachments, revives and a Zombie mode for each map.

details.title: Wizards
details.short_description: Four wizards. One arena. One furious ball. Protect your library & spellbook, sling five arena-warping spells, and outlast everyone. Local AI and Steam multiplayer.

details.title: Hellsplit: Labyrinth
details.short_description: A rogue-like VR action RPG with brutal, physics-driven medieval combat. Collect seven crystal shards across procedural dungeons. You get one life. No second chances.

details.title: Drone Operations
details.short_description: Pilot combat drones through diverse missions with realistic FPV flight simulation. Scout targets, drop grenades, launch explosive strikes and fire mounted weapons against enemies who flee, seek shelter or escape in vehicles. Earn stars to unlock new operations, drones and upgrades.

details.title: Idle Fish: Aquarium Legends
details.short_description: Build your own pixel aquarium! Open chests, collect rare fish, feed them to grow, and combine three into a higher rarity. Sell fish for pearls, decorate your tank, and assemble a team of three for automatic battles. Your next legendary discovery awaits.

details.title: Überlauf
details.short_description: Build a mine with cards on a freshly rolled voxel island: place mines, lay belts, smelt ore into ingots. You get 75 seconds per round. Then your jokers multiply the takings until the number catches fire. A roguelike blend of factory building and cards.

name: Space Novel: Echoes of the Divide

details.title: Space Novel: Echoes of the Divide
details.short_description: An ordinary factory worker becomes a fugitive in a galactic war. Choose whom to trust, uncover the purpose of an experimental crystal, and decide what freedom is worth in a branching science-fiction visual novel.

name: Fishing Company Tycoon: Harbor to Market

details.title: Fishing Company Tycoon: Harbor to Market
details.short_description: Build a fishing company from a single boat. Send your ships to the fishing grounds, truck the catch to the markets that pay the most, research better gear, and grow a fleet that works by itself. A relaxed management game on a living island.

details.title: Luminescence
details.short_description: Illuminate the path in this Parkour experience across the constellations of Space

details.title: Timothy: Wasteland Janitor
details.short_description: This is an incremental game in which you help Timothy, a discarded droid, defend himself against hordes of aggressive Wasteland creatures. Upgrade Timmy, pick the best builds, and enjoy the fireworks of the battlefield.

details.title: 8 More Lives
details.short_description: A challenging turn-based tactical RPG. Lead a mercenary company of outcast cats through a gritty procedural open world. Take contracts, count coin, bury the dead. Battle rival warbands and night horrors. You have 8 more lives - try not to waste them all.

details.title: DEADLINE: Afterlife Processing
details.short_description: The dead wait in line. You run the press. Read each soul, judge it, seal it and get paid for it. Tired of doing it yourself? The catalog has machines that'll do the work for you. Management recommends it. Management appreciates your cooperation.

details.title: ChameleonCraft MMO: Hide Your Piñatas!
details.short_description: An incremental idler MMO: Paint & hide your gold-generating piñatas while hunting & stealing others’ poorly hidden treasures in a massive persistent world! Build wealth, spend on upgrades, hide & protect your passive-income empire, customize your character, get revenge, find rare items & show off!

details.title: Trank Reborn
details.short_description: Trank Reborn is a top-down arcade shooter: take command of a tank, blast through fields with armored enemies, and take down massive multi-phase bosses. Collect Tokens, unlock upgrades in the Garage, and roll back into battle stronger.

details.title: Castle Against the Dark
details.short_description: Defend your castle in this third-person action-strategy. Cut through the horde, command your army, level up your hero and castle, build defenses, protect your king, hire the heroes you've trained — and break the time loop by slaying the Dark Lord himself. Every dawn, you come back stronger.

details.title: Slime Mine Survivor
details.short_description: Mine 2D blocks in this Survivors-like roguelite action game! Play as a slime, dig deeper underground, stay ahead of the poison gas, hunt for treasure chests. Collect ores to upgrade and evolve your weapons and pickaxe, then unleash powerful synergies to smash through enemies and blocks alike!

details.title: What the K-Drama?!
details.short_description: You were a successful CEO... until you woke up inside the makjang K-drama you once dismissed! Become chaebol heir ‘Lee Segye,’ win both love and the chairman’s seat, and turn this 14-episode whirlwind of birth secrets and conspiracies into the perfect happy ending!

details.title: CRUMB Advanced
details.short_description: The follow-up to the hit circuit simulator. Build anything from an LED to an 8-bit CPU, code microcontrollers, play guitar live through your circuits and drive robot arms with real physics. Make any part in the component editor and share it on Steam Workshop. If you can build it, CRUMB can run it.

details.title: Echoes From Beyond
details.short_description: This is a desktop companion game centered around everyday companionship and time management.

details.title: Winds of Viridia
details.short_description: Explore the valley of the towering Grantree, battle grand beasts, and find out what’s driving the creatures in these forgotten lands mad. Discover secrets, make new friends, and find powerful lost relics. Take on fearsome bosses, and uncover the truth of the wild frenzy.

name: 八部寛のホームページ

details.title: 八部寛のホームページ
details.short_description: A night shift job paying 88,888 yen a day. Your task is to monitor 'Hiroshi Hachibe's Homepage' on the office PC. If you spot an anomaly, destroy the PC; if everything looks normal, just clock out. Survive all 8 days without missing a single anomaly.

details.title: Graveheart
details.short_description: A retro FPS where William Wallace is back from the dead, Scotland is invading England, and your cursed weapons keep switching themselves at the worst possible moment.

details.title: There Is Eternal War
details.short_description: An RTS game set in a dark sci-fi fantasy universe where you command thousands of units on a huge map without breaking your PC. Dystopian humans, evil elves, greedy dwarves, or relentless undead are all playable factions in a game that has a grand campaign and two story campaigns.

details.title: The Infinite Shift: Backrooms
details.short_description: The Infinite Shift is a psychological horror exploration game. Trapped in an endless shift, explore liminal spaces from the Poolrooms to Level 0, solve puzzles, evade unknown entities, and find a way out before it’s too late.

details.title: TidyUp 2000
details.short_description: A cozy desktop organizing simulator where you sort thousands of scattered files into their correct folders. Upgrade your computer as you organize more files and turn a messy desktop into a perfectly sorted one.

details.title: Little Chefs
details.short_description: Little Chefs is an incremental cooking game where you forage, chop food and recruit little animal chefs from around the world that help you sell soup and buy back the deeds to their forests.

details.title: Othercrown
details.short_description: A deck-building auto-battler roguelite where you build your own slot machine to deploy monsters and cast spells against the human kingdoms. Mutate your creatures, and maximize your slots to deploy as many creatures and spells as you can during your fights against the human kingdoms.

details.title: Sarmatian Heroes
details.short_description: Sarmatian Heroes is a turn-based strategy RPG where you explore the ancient world, develop heroes with unique skills, command armies, and build fortified cities your way. Fight tactical hex-based battles in the open field and defend your custom-built cities during sieges.

details.title: One Hit Hero
details.short_description: One Hit Hero is a boss-rush action game where any hit is fatal, for you and your foes alike. Read attack patterns, block, parry, and dodge to build the power to slay each boss with one decisive strike. Trapped in a sealed dungeon, you must prove yourself by defeating every boss to earn your escape.

details.title: Houston, We Have a Spungus
details.short_description: A living space fungus is eating our colonies, and it grows back faster than you can shoot it. Build turrets, call in orbital strikes, combine flamethrowers, tiny suns and lightning, and hold the line until HQ nukes the source.

details.title: Whisperborne
details.short_description: Turn-based collection JRPG on a continent the gods walked away from. Gather the lost heirs of the Sword-King, build a ten-slot weapon board for each of six elements, and raid alongside up to 30 players against the things still walking through Mira.
developers: Liufenyu Games 六分鱼游戏工作室

details.title: THE IRON GAMES
details.short_description: The Iron Games is a medieval battle royale where 24 players fight to the death. Loot armor and weapons, build unique combinations to become as strong as possible, and fight to be the last team alive.

details.title: Oscilloscopia
details.short_description: Oscilloscopia is a puzzle game built around an authentically simulated oscilloscope. Build signals, patch modules and tune the instrument until the phosphor trace matches the target. Experiment with signal processing and find your own solutions.

details.title: RenewCity
details.short_description: Small budget. Hard choices. No perfect fixes. Revitalize real neighborhoods in Detroit, Seoul, and Leipzig, and find out whether you helped the people who live there or replaced them.

details.title: Wheel You Drive?
details.short_description: Grab a friend and take control of the same RC car in this chaotic 2-player co-op game! Each player controls a different part of the car, so you'll need to communicate, coordinate your movement, and somehow make it through every obstacle together.

details.title: TOKUGI ARENA
details.short_description: Generate energy by typing, solving Tsume Shogi and completing other challenges, then spend it on projectiles, blades and barriers. A team-based action game with CPU practice, solo challenges, Score Attack and compatible VRM avatars.

details.title: Hit the Anvil
details.short_description: Hammer the anvil, forge gear, sell it for gold and grow your forge. Advance to Swordmaster, Mage, Necromancer or Shadow Rogue and unleash class skills that fill the screen and reinforce all your loot at once. A pixel-art incremental crafting game with masteries, gems, charms and puzzles. Free demo.

details.title: Pixel Sorter Factory
details.short_description: First day at the factory: extract pixels, sort them, sell them. Then let the machines take over, until the factory runs itself. A blend of clicker, incremental gameplay, and pixel art… with a touch of mystery: where do all those pixels go?

name: What Da Font: Tidy Up the Print Shop

details.title: What Da Font: Tidy Up the Print Shop
details.short_description: A cozy first person organizing game. Thieves turned over every case in a 1920s print shop: gather 5,000 pieces of lead type from two floors, tell one typeface from another, and put them back. Every case you finish opens a job to print, and the ten printed posters keep the combination to a safe.

details.title: Railminer
details.short_description: Turn a tiny drill into a massive mining machine. Extract resources, sell your haul, and expand your train with cutters, lasers, rockets, and drones. Every run pays for your next upgrade in this incremental mining game.

details.title: Valken
details.short_description: VALKEN is a realistic tactical solo shooter where you play as a lone agent infiltrating a secretive military organization. Explore varied environments, make hard choices, and face the brutal consequences in an intense, unforgiving campaign.

details.title: Dungeonery
details.short_description: Crawl your way through the dungeon in this roguelike autobattler. Equip your heroes with epic loot and test their might in battle! Your team might uncover game-breaking synergies and conquer the dungeon… or get wiped out. Probably will, actually. No biggie, there’s always more where they came from.

details.title: Green Mist over Portland
details.short_description: A detective noir puzzle deduction game. Explore a non-linear timeline during the cold war on a globe-trotting adventure following a trail of spies from a quiet English harbour town to a frozen Finnish fishing village and the corridors of an intelligence service rotten at its core.

details.title: Wuxia Life
details.short_description: You never truly knew your father. Wuxia Life is a single-player wuxia RPG set on Yingzhou. Investigate his death and your origins, expose the Blacktide Gang's betrayal of Yingzhou, and shape your ending through ATB combat, Five Inner Voices, inner demons, and the Heavenly Storyteller.

details.title: Blooming Canvas
details.short_description: This is a visual novel game themed around "painting" and "romance." The story begins with a mysterious girl and her damaged painting. As the art exhibition approaches, you will build a bond with the girl, complete her commission, and uncover the truth behind the painting.

details.title: Underking
details.short_description: A first-person mining incremental game. Enter the cave to mine and extract valuable ores. Convert ores into coins and spend them on upgrades to extend your runs to reach deeper into the mountain.

details.title: Oh, For Bugs' Sake!
details.short_description: Team up with a cute spider family in this cartoonish asymmetric co-op platformer where communication and coordination are crucial. Avoid electrified cables and dodge one extremely angry giant finger who really, really wants to squash you.

details.title: Disaster Crew
details.short_description: Disaster Crew is a co-op action-adventure for up to four players. Take on unusual contracts, explore locations packed with traps and obstacles, and share an adventure filled with unexpected dangers and spectacular events..

details.title: Quadfort
details.short_description: Build a ring. Break theirs. QUADFORT is an arcade strategy party game for 1–4 players: snap walls around your fortress, arm it with cannons and aim every shot yourself. Play with friends on one screen or online, or climb the 15-stage solo campaign. A new island every match.

details.title: Nuclear Engineer Tycoon
details.short_description: Build a nuclear power plant and manage reactors, generators, and turbines, producing energy to keep the city lit and prevent reactor explosions. Earn resources, research nuclear technologies, build larger and more modern reactors, refine uranium, and create a nuclear energy empire.

details.title: QUIET
details.short_description: Your ship crashed, your crew is stranded, and this house is somehow your best chance of survival. Search for ship parts while every movement and real-world sound risks alerting whatever lurks nearby. Stay QUIET, keep your flock together, and try not to quack under pressure.

details.title: Dithered
details.short_description: DĪȾĦɆꞦɆĐ invites you to a realm forsaken by the clock—a surreal nightmare where you must platform through the jagged shards of a protagonist's trauma. Guided by two bickering birds and hunted by a ticking horror, you must fight your way through a glitching reality…

details.title: Idle Transporter
details.short_description: Idle Transporter is a fun incremental game to have running while you work on something else. Build your own little company and watch the cars zoom around the screen while you are in a zoom call.

details.title: The Granny Detective Society
details.short_description: Play as Madeleine, a retired granny recruited by the Granny Detective Society (basically the FBI… but add dentures). Investigate your neighbors, figure out their names and professions, and uncover all their secrets in this no-murder detective game full of white hair and mugs of tea.

details.title: Leafborn
details.short_description: Leafborn is a fast-paced action game where you command a being made of thousands of leaves. Explore a universe of floating islands, discover new abilities, shapeshift, and mercilessly tear apart Nulls robots draining this world's life energy!

details.title: We Are So Cooked
details.short_description: You and your friends are in trouble. Big trouble. You’ve accidentally killed someone, and now you have to get rid of the evidence. "We Are So Cooked" is a 1-4 player co-op physics-stealth game where the objective is simple: Get the body to the exit. The execution? That’s the hard part.

details.title: Fronts of Steel
details.short_description: Fronts of Steel is a pausable real-time operational wargame on WWII's Eastern Front. Draw battle plans on a staff map and command divisions to break enemy lines, cut supply routes and close encirclements. Exploit terrain, keep troops supplied and choose when to advance or withdraw.

details.title: Deathand
details.short_description: Burn your cards for light. Fight with what remains. A first-person dungeon crawler with turn-based deckbuilding combat. Sacrifice cards to reveal enemy intentions, hold attacks to charge stronger hits, and build your deck as you descend through procedural dungeons.

details.title: One Million Bolts
details.short_description: Take industrial machines apart as a robot worker, solo or with up to 3 friends. Unscrew bolts, cut welds and recover valuable parts. Upgrade your tools, deploy robot helpers and bring heavy loads to dispatch in a first-person dismantling simulator with progress you can see.

details.title: Eternal Xiuzhen
details.short_description: This is a cultivation game! Play as a cultivator, hunt demon beasts, collect resources, and roam the cultivation world! With a unique battlefield size-changing mechanic, from small demons to colossal beasts, feel the thrill of hunting!

details.title: Odd Rock Out
details.short_description: You're locked out, and your spare key is inside a fake pebble somewhere among 5,000 real ones. Pick them up, shake them by your ear and listen for the one that rattles. A short, quiet game about patience: no upgrades, no countdown. Solo or with up to four friends.

details.title: PATROL
details.short_description: Hunt insurgent leaders across procedurally generated warzones inspired by Mogadishu, Afghanistan and Iraq. Raid compounds quietly or loud, call in gunships and airstrikes, take your target alive, and bring every wounded soldier home. Solo or in two-player co-op.

details.title: NEEDLEFALL
details.short_description: Equip your mechs, drop them from orbit and hold the line. NEEDLEFALL is a horde defense RTS for 1–4 players. Build pipes to carry Flux to the Core and your turrets, raise walls, command your mechs against swarms of hundreds of creatures and destroy the twelve hives.

details.title: Prisoner Amber
details.short_description: [BL Visual Novel] Amber’s career as an agent ends in an explosion. Arrested and interrogated, he discovers a huge chunk of his memory is missing. Recover the memories, find the true culprit, and face—the final truth!

details.title: Zero G Nova Adventure
details.short_description: Zero G Nova Adventure is a free-to-play online space sandbox. Fly through galaxies of real stars, black holes and nebulae, mine and craft, build bases, trade with other pilots and fight in PvP. Host your own server or join friends with a code.

name: 亲吻那片花瓣：米迦勒的少女们

details.title: 亲吻那片花瓣：米迦勒的少女们
details.short_description: 承接著名的《亲吻那片花瓣》系列作品，《米迦勒的少女们》在原有剧情基础上拓展了各位少女们的故事——这些情节跨越了数月时光，描绘了她们生活中的种种磨难。在少女们不断成长并相互扶持的过程中，百合终将绽放。

details.title: WorldOS
details.short_description: Rule a superpower in 2026, command armies in World War II, unite China in the Three Kingdoms or seize Rome after Caesar. Type any order and an AI game master plays out the consequences: borders move, rivals scheme, allies betray. 200+ hand-picked worlds, plus an editor to build your own.

details.title: Thank you,  Next please!
details.short_description: Run a local shop in an eastern totalitarian state. Provide rations, alcohol and medicine, but watch out for fake ration cards. Deny them goods or give them what they need to survive, knowing the Ministry is watching. Help the revolution, reunite families, and bring peace to the neighborhood.

details.title: Foldvalley
details.short_description: A cozy pop-up storybook village builder. Lay paper tiles that pop up off the page, welcome villagers home and make their wishes come true. Read your village's story in its own storybook, then build without end on a map that keeps unfolding.

details.title: The Silent Wild
details.short_description: A realistic first-person open-world survival game for one player, or two in split-screen co-op on one PC. Build with physics-based blocks, hunt, craft and cook, then hold out as creatures break through your walls, tornadoes tear homes apart and the cold freezes every drop of water.

details.title: The Beaten Track
details.short_description: Off-road across an endless land in an old 4x4. No roads, no markers: just forests, deserts, glaciers, caves and sea. Find hidden campsites, haul planks and stone, build shops that earn for you, and share it all with every driver in one world where many tires make a track.

details.title: Gladren
details.short_description: A physics-driven medieval melee arena for up to 8 players. Aim every swing with your mouse, block, kick and dodge, buy your weapons and armor each round, and settle it with friends in brutal duels and team battles where steel bites and limbs fly.

details.title: Planet Sim
details.short_description: Land on an untouched planet and build a factory colony that reaches the stars. Harvest, haul and produce without conveyor belts, launch rockets to orbit and the Moon, wake your colonists, defend against what lives here, and rebuild the broken colony Ark to finish the journey.

details.title: HAZPIT
details.short_description: A top-down survival game where you work your way down zombie-infested high-rises, floor by floor from the roof. Lower floors mean more radiation and zombies, but better loot. Stay undetected when you can, and use what you bring back to repair your bunker and recruit survivors. Single-player only.

details.title: FIGHT-QUEST
details.short_description: Punch, slash, and blast through hordes of fairy-tale creatures in this first-person action roguelite. Stack absurd abilities, conquer deadly arenas, and bank your hard-earned gold for new unlocks.

details.title: Sefton Asylum
details.short_description: Care. Investigate. Survive. Play as a night nurse in a secluded asylum. Every night is a choice: find your missing brother, secretly gather evidence of forbidden experiments or keep your patients alive before they come back to haunt Sefton’s wards.

details.title: Pact, Passion, Puchimon!
details.short_description: Journey across a continent teeming with diverse monsters! Capture them through intense bullet-hell battles and grow stronger together. With an in-depth nurturing system, you can build bonds with your "Puchimon" to unlock exclusive storylines and turn them into your ultimate battle partners!

details.title: Rain of Lead
details.short_description: Every hit is lethal, with no room for error. Switch between sword and pistol to tear through soldiers, artillery pieces, tanks — and even destroy an entire army. You awaken without memories. A queen claiming to be your wife asks you to fight for her. Will you stand with her to the end?

details.title: Company Coal
details.short_description: Have you ever yearned for the mines? No? Too bad. Welcome to the Consolidated Coal & Iron Company family! Dig coal, meet your quotas, and try to pay down a debt that grows by the day. Solo or online co-op, for your convenience.

details.title: My Cat Is a Maid!
details.short_description: A short, slice-of-life romance visual novel. As an anime merch shop clerk, you meet a cat-eared maid "cosplayer" while running an errand for your manager. Her request? Adopt her! Wait—she’s a real catgirl?! Your cozy life with an adorable catgirl begins!

details.title: Harmony Strike
details.short_description: A party-based survivors-like where you lead a whole party of heroes instead of a single character. Each boss you defeat adds a new hero to your team, heroes fighting side by side combine their elements, and dozens of runes and relics shape every run.

details.title: Retro Empire
details.short_description: Buy filthy retro consoles from strangers, bring them back to life on your workbench and sell them in your own second-hand game shop. Haggle for stock, take on repair jobs, fix up arcade machines and grow the shop level by level. Free one-hour demo.

details.title: Elancia Replay Online
details.short_description: A free-to-play 2D MMORPG in development, with combat, gathering, crafting, and trading planned. Early Access is targeted for mid-to-late March 2027. Follow development and help shape the game through your feedback.

details.title: Smash & Settle
details.short_description: A cozy idle game about smashing and settling. Break open trees, rocks and ore, build huts and kitchens, give every villager a job and let your islands run themselves. When the purple corruption creeps in, gather your soldiers and clear its dungeon.

details.title: Learn Abroad: Japanese
details.short_description: Learn Japanese through a cozy study-abroad simulation. Attend guided classes, practice with interactive activities, and complete homework to earn money. Explore Shibuya, recharge at cafés and ramen shops, and build a daily routine around learning something new.

details.title: The Last Inn
details.short_description: Welcome to The Last Inn — become the innkeeper! Build a refuge on the Radiated Continent. By day, serve guests, farm and raise livestock; by night, hunt, scavenge and gather ingredients. Recruit companions as helpers or lovers. Build an oasis and unravel the mystery over three great shelters…

details.title: Dragon's Tear
details.short_description: Slay monsters, harvest their Tears and power-up your party in this idle dungeon crawler RPG. Farm cleared floors while AFK, then leap back into action to lead your party down 100 handcrafted floors. Can you find the legendary Dragon's Tear?

details.title: Deadgate
details.short_description: Bir sözleşme al ve zombilerin istila ettiği karantina altındaki adaya gir. Ganimet topla, rakip takımlara karşı hayatta kal ve gece yarısından önce tahliye noktasına ulaş. Aksi takdirde yanında getirdiğin her şeyi kaybedersin. 32 oyunculu bir extraction shooter. Sözleşme yoksa çıkış da yok.

details.title: Bondoq: Desktop Gunners
details.short_description: Collect, trade, and build your team of Gunners! Discover heroes with unique weapons and effects, and hunt for rare items. Watch the battles unfold automatically on your desktop!

name: Dragon's Keep: Tidy Up the Treasure!

details.title: Dragon's Keep: Tidy Up the Treasure!
details.short_description: Dragon’s Keep is a relaxing first-person treasure sorting game. Organize over 4,000 treasures, repair ancient artifacts, and unlock magical abilities to make sorting faster and more satisfying. Discover the secrets hidden within the dungeon, and find your way out.

details.title: One More Siege
details.short_description: One More Siege is an Incremental Strategy game with massive auto-battling armies. Plan your building placement to counter the enemy, break their ranks and destroy their castle. Every battle earns you Honor, which you can spend to upgrade your army.

details.title: EDGE-FI
details.short_description: Don’t rush to figure out what’s going on in a place the world has discarded, where dim neon flickers through the haze. Discover how the devices around you work, and lose yourself in atmospheric music as you bring the city back to life. So, when progress moves on without us, where do we belong?

details.title: Horizon of Steel
details.short_description: Horizon of Steel is an idle ARPG. Instead of controlling the fights, you build your character's skills, equipment and strategies, then send it into combat to farm or level. The fights are drawn in ASCII with dynamic lighting, and a replay shows one exactly as it happened.

details.title: Chip Factory Simulator
details.short_description: Build and run your own semiconductor factory in first person. Process wafers, operate machines, connect conveyor lines, automate production, and ship advanced chips as your factory grows.

details.title: Totally Legal Logging
details.short_description: A co-op physics comedy about a crew of dwarves running a totally legal logging business. Fell trees with real physics, feed them to questionable machines, load the truck and get out before the forester arrives. Your friends are also a resource.

details.title: GEARSMITH
details.short_description: GEARSMITH is a pixel-art action roguelite for 1–4 players. Fight from the cellars to the desert with 14+ weapons, each with its own way to fight. Take the gear you find to the forge, socket runes into it and upgrade it into an artifact.

details.title: Forsakia
details.short_description: You're a bounty hunter working off a depot's job board: fly into zones held by armed contractors, slip past or break their patrols, loot what you can carry, and hold an extraction zone until the helicopter takes you home.

details.title: Moonlit Vigil
details.short_description: Moonlit Vigil is a first-person narrative horror game where you are the cemetery's new caretaker. Explore the grounds and uncover what really happens to bodies once they're buried in this atmospheric nightmare filled with jumpscares.

details.title: Legio Impera
details.short_description: Found a Roman colony, run its economy and pay your legions. Legio Impera is a city-building RTS set in Marian Rome: govern a province during the Cimbrian War, subdue Gauls and Germanic tribes, and stop the horde before it reaches Italy.

details.title: Bottled Ambition
details.short_description: A Prohibition-era moonshine sim, solo or in co-op with up to three friends. Grow corn, mix your own blends and run them through a copper still. Smuggle the jugs past the sheriff and rival bootleggers by truck or on horseback. Hire workers and build your empire.

details.title: Resortful
details.short_description: Resortful is a cozy island management sim. Start with a harbour and a beach, then build bungalows, cafés, hotels and water parks for the guests who sail in each day. Balance prices, upkeep and reputation as your relaxing resort grows.

details.title: Coal Rush 1990
details.short_description: Eastern Europe, 1990s. Janusz is 21,370,000 PLN in debt, and an inherited coal mine might be his only way out! Dig for resources, hire workers, build machines, and automate production. Start with a shovel, build a mining empire, and pay off your debt before the creditors come knocking!

details.title: Demon Balls: A Bowling Roguelike
details.short_description: A bowling roguelike deckbuilder. Recruit demons, deal with devils, cast spells and feed worms to your ball. Roll up through the heavens and kill God.

details.title: Ember Citadel
details.short_description: Build a colony on the ruins of a lost machine age, master black powder and hold the walls. Somewhere out there, the Citadel is looking for you. Hold out alone or with friends in online co-op.

details.title: Ex Simulacris
details.short_description: Challenge the Simulation in this sci-fi autobattler. Recruit a growing roster of unique Operators, design fireteams, deploy them into increasingly difficult battle sims, gather data, upgrade, and try again. Log in, Administrator – the Simulation awaits.

details.title: BENEATH PARADISE
details.short_description: Fight for Nambara in a first-person open-world action adventure. Liberate outposts, rescue civilians, and expose the Council that controls the islands.

details.title: Brad Dracula
details.short_description: A wobbly physics game at a vampire accountant's house. That's me. I'm Brad. Come alone, or bring a friend to your couch, and steal the fruit of immortality off my tree. Behind my doors are seven worlds, and there's a whole 16-bit RPG on my TV. Stay off the lawn. ...Have a great day.

details.title: Pastel Squad
details.short_description: Hold back the enemy horde swarming the city with a squad of cute girls! Build your team from 30+ unique members and fight with terrain and skills in real-time squad tactics. Includes three modes: Story, Missions and Roguelite.

details.title: Echo Walker: Tactics
details.short_description: Lead the last survivors across a broken Earth - and turn the train that carries them into a home that grows after every battle. Every attack shows its odds first, on a grid you can read in a glance. A full 5-chapter campaign; Chapter 1 is a free demo with a save that carries over.

details.title: Sundered Reach
details.short_description: Rise from cadet to commander in a living star system. Build your warband, fight real-time fleet battles, board enemy flagships and lead sieges with up to 1,500 soldiers per side, while something stirs at the edge of the Reach.

details.title: Pickfall
details.short_description: Swing your pickaxe at the rock. Every cell you break charges a bar, and a full bar births a thrown pickaxe that digs beside you until it shatters. Collect what the rock dropped, buy the upgrade you can see, and dig a deeper shaft next round. A short mining incremental in ink on paper.

details.title: Just Another Soldier
details.short_description: Die, and rise again as just another soldier in this Trojan War action roguelite tower defense. Hold Troy's walls against thousands of Greeks and mythic monsters. Pick level-up cards, call on the gods, fire siege engines yourself, then upgrade your fortress for good with Soul Gems.

details.title: CRUSHMINO
details.short_description: Crushmino combines roguelite and falling-block gameplay. Drop blocks to crush your enemies, then claim rewards to craft your own build. Keep your balance so the stack never reaches the top. Tricky enemies and trials await.

details.title: Kick Rocks
details.short_description: Kick a rock until it's round. That's the game. Then sell it, buy better shoes and kick a harder one.

details.title: Spexl
details.short_description: Spexl is an incremental game where you destroy planets made of pixels and collect every particle they’re made of to upgrade your ship. Fly, shoot, and get back to base before you run out of fuel. The challenge is to push farther and farther out.

details.title: Booster Beast
details.short_description: Booster Beasts is an incremental pack-smashing game. Equip up to six mythical beasts, and unleash all their skills with every strike. Combine elemental bonuses, evolve your beasts, and build the firepower to crack tougher packs and take on bosses.

details.title: Ironclads 3
details.short_description: A hardcore historical naval combat sim set in the Age of Iron & Steam, built around meticulous historical detail. Command a warship and its specialist crew as they man guns, operate steam propulsion and shipboard machinery, keep the vessel battle-ready, and fight fires and flooding under enemy fire.

details.title: The Endless Museum
details.short_description: Wikipedia turned into a museum you can walk around, where every article is a room and every link is a doorway. You can wander wherever the links take you and read about each room as you go, race friends between articles, or look for the secret passages, puzzles and hidden rooms behind the bookcases.

details.title: Alt-Tab Legend
details.short_description: An incremental multiboxing game where you run every game at once on one PC. Pull games from blind boxes, pack hardware into a grid case, place plugins on your keyboard, and raise Keysprites to hit keys for you. No game over, just more games every night.

details.title: 坠于浮华的赤色神女
details.short_description: 世人只知神女可召神，却不知神女每晚都能闯入神使的梦里，甜蜜与执念，旖旎情愫在此交织。穿越到架空神话里，和只属于你的神使们开启一段浪漫缱绻的故事。

details.title: PaleBlueRose
details.short_description: A free-to-play online medieval city builder. Start with a founding wagon and a little grain. Grow a town, build production chains, trade with thousands of players and go to war, all in one shared world. Win by holding 90% of the world's yearly economy.

details.title: Choo Choo Kingdom
details.short_description: The Rift has swallowed the kingdom. Grow one archer’s carriage into a 16-carriage war-train that auto-battles endless hordes. Place troops beside supports for synergy, upgrade a deep skill tree, chase each boss through town and free the kingdom village by village.

details.title: DEEPWARD
details.short_description: Choose three heroes from a roster of six and switch between them instantly during combat. Each has their own health, weapon and ability. DEEPWARD is a fast horror FPS roguelite set in an alternate 1920s, where keeping your squad alive means fighting through the madness. Hero death is permanent.

details.title: Dice of Braves
details.short_description: Dice of Braves is a streamlined turn-based roguelike strategy game. Recruit, roll dice, decide, fight, level up, change class! Squad-building + strategy + luck! Assemble your team, destroy the undead legion, defeat the Dark Lord, and restore order to the world!

name: Before the Tee: A Golf Course Tycoon

details.title: Before the Tee: A Golf Course Tycoon
details.short_description: Before the Tee is a top-down golf course management sim. Build a course hole by hole and run it sunrise to sunset. Shape fairways and greens, hire a crew, keep the tee sheet moving, and handle whatever the day throws at you. Win the right to host tournaments and climb the rankings of local critics.

details.title: Select Kiss +Plus
details.short_description: Select Kiss +Plus is a lighthearted visual novel where you choose two people from a colorful cast of six and lock them inside “The Room You Can’t Leave Until You Kiss.”

details.title: Eightfold
details.short_description: Eightfold is a hand-drawn roguelike deckbuilder set in a cursed carnival. Play poker hands, build your deck, and sign Pacts you might regret. Face ancient Gods who break the rules your deck relies on. Take their souls and pay your debt.

details.title: Butcher hero: hook'n'chew RPG
details.short_description: Survival RPG: fight monsters & aliens, upgrade gear, defeat bosses for survival

details.title: Your Momo
details.short_description: Shortstack, Interaction, Desktop Companion. Your Momo is a narrative, cozy desktop game. Talk with Momo through playful spanks on her butt and build a deeper bond. Unlock new items through conversation and watch her draw freely on your desktop as time passes.

details.title: 7Komada
details.short_description: A GAME TO BE PLAYED WITH ONE'S WHOLE LIFE. A killing game based on Werewolf and Mafia, set in an alternate-universe Europe. Your graduation trip is cut short with your entire class kidnapped and locked in an abandoned mansion. Figure out who's behind it, and who you can trust.

details.title: Heartbeat Under One Roof
details.short_description: Sakura, the protagonist’s childhood friend, gets scouted by a talent agency and begins her journey as an idol. She moves in with the protagonist, who works in Tokyo. With his support, can Sakura rise to become a top idol with one million fans?

details.title: Nock Nock Loose
details.short_description: An active incremental tower defense game where you defend your city from enemy armies. Aim for the biggest crowds to boost your archers' accuracy, unlock powerful abilities in a massive skill tree, and crush every warlord who dares besiege your walls.

details.title: CATACOMBOS
details.short_description: CATACOMBOS is a physics-driven roguelite combo-builder where you throw and merge cats, build absurd synergies with cards and cat hats, and crush armies of dogs in the depths of the catacombs.

name: Game About Botting in an MMORPG

details.title: Game About Botting in an MMORPG
details.short_description: Why grind when you can cheat? Start as a novice grinder and work your way towards total automation. Unlock Bot Modules, configure combat behavior, optimize farming routes and build the ultimate grinding machine in this incremental MMORPG simulator.

name: Bus Station Simulator: Prologue - Early Days

details.title: Bus Station Simulator: Prologue - Early Days
details.short_description: Bus Station Simulator Prologue: Early Day is a free prologue where you take over a neglected bus station in Winston Springs. Manage passengers, vehicles, and infrastructure as you transform a run-down facility into the thriving heart of the town.

details.title: 明末：甲申年
details.short_description: Set during the fall of the Ming dynasty in 1644, this historical grand-strategy narrative game lets you rule as the Chongzhen Emperor, fight for the Shun regime, lead another faction, or survive as a commoner. Govern, wage war, manage resources, and reshape history through AI-assisted court debates.

details.title: PROTOCOL BOUND
details.short_description: BOUND is a psychological thriller where you search through private conversations, hidden files, and recordings on devices that aren't your own. Manipulate others, uncover dark secrets, and shape the outcome through the choices you make.

details.title: Rogue Striker
details.short_description: Draft. Play. Upgrade. Win. Combine fast-paced football action with roguelite drafting strategy to build the perfect team and reach the World Finals.

details.title: Grass Cutting Incremental
details.short_description: Cut grass. Build power. Reset for permanent progression. Automate production, unlock new worlds and mechanics, and push further through layer after layer of an ever-growing incremental adventure where the grass is only the beginning.

details.title: WyrmGate
details.short_description: A turn-based online RPG in the dark-fantasy Wyrmlands, where abilities decide the fight: 39 abilities, spells and cantrips across three classes, 31 combat effects, 11 damage types. Loot with 100+ affixes, +10 enhancement, enchanting orbs. Async PvP and a co-op dragon lair for 2-5 heroes.

details.title: Idlecraft
details.short_description: A mining incremental game where you dig by day and survive the night. Break blocks, fight the mobs that climb onto the board after dark, and spend every run's haul on skill trees, enchants, gear and prestige. Every run makes the next one stronger.

details.title: Concerto on White: Bass Hero
details.short_description: Pick up your keyboard and play it like a real bass! Take on the role of Ostinata, the leader and bassist of the all-girl band Tutti Nova. Strengthen the bonds among the five band members while staying ever ready to fend off bassist jokes, and grow your fan base to perform in larger venues!

details.title: Zombie Hospital : Abandoned
details.short_description: [Zombie Hospital : Abandoned] is a survival horror game that combines exploration, puzzle-solving, and crafting. You set out alone to investigate a disappearance that occurred in an abandoned hospital. Craft tools and medicine from limited resources and fight to survive against zombies.

details.title: I Don't Do Quests Anymore...
details.short_description: Be the quest giver in this casual guild management game! Tired of doing all these quests for random NPCs? This time, you can be this NPC! Take your place in your very own adventurers guild and distribute quests to heroes. brew potions, craft gear and make smart choices to help them survive!

details.title: Dfiance: Dominance
details.short_description: Three worlds at war. Grind ranked, crush enemies, or go for tournament glory. Build your deck, trade skins, play solo or with friends. Three factions, endless strategies. Free to play. Your dominance starts now.

details.title: ScareZone: Haunted Attraction Tycoon
details.short_description: Build the haunted attraction of your nightmares! Design chilling walkthroughs, fill them with animatronics and actors, then watch your victims - er, guests - scream their way through your twisted creation. Grow your empire season after season and prove you have the guts to be a world-class haunter.

details.title: Pizzapoly
details.short_description: PIZZAPOLY is a chaotic co-op pizza restaurant game where you cook, serve, make deliveries, and survive the rush in a lively city. Run your pizzeria with friends, keep your customers happy, and grow your small shop into a local favorite.

details.title: False Echo
details.short_description: False Echo is a narrative cryptography thriller set in the darkest depths of the Stelantic, aboard a secret military submarine. Operate the Obscura machine, decode messages, and decide what gets through in a regime where even the smallest mistake means a huge death toll.

details.title: Lost Floor — Not My World
details.short_description: An auto-battler dungeon crawler with visual novel elements. A tired office worker got off on the wrong floor and ended up in another world. The locals look suspiciously like his coworkers, and to get out, he'll have to do some work.

details.title: The Incentive Program
details.short_description: A dopamine-fuelled match-3 roguelite set within a surreal corporate nightmare. Rig the odds, exploit the system, and unleash impossible combos as you fight to escape the program.

details.title: Super Chasm Hunter
details.short_description: An unforgiving extraction-roguelite adventure. Gear up and descend alone into the Chasm, fighting enemies and searching for loot. Take risks for better rewards, or extract and return home with what you've earned to sell, craft, decorate, and farm.

details.title: Barely Developers
details.short_description: Build a gaming empire in this first-person, co-op game development simulator! Start in Mom's garage, create hit games, hire chaotic employees, design your own consoles, and grow into a AAA studio. Play solo or with up to 3 friends.

details.title: The Long Mine
details.short_description: An incremental mining game with fully destructible caves. Every pickaxe strike removes an actual piece of rock. Mine ores, sell them, and buy upgrades. Upgrades are not just +10% damage. Equipment and Curses change how you mine, move and explore. Combine them to create your own build.

details.title: Worst Airline Ever
details.short_description: Build an airline from scratch in this multiplayer co-op airline management game. Fly airplanes inspired by real aircraft, design and upgrade your plane, serve passengers, and grow your airline from a small regional carrier into a world-class airline.

details.title: KAGE
details.short_description: Anime MEGABONK with friends. Unleash anime-style techniques — shout them to activate their true power! Fight hordes of enemies, hunt massive bosses, gather rare loot, and craft insane builds in a fast co-op action game for up to 4 players. Upgrade your village. Become a legend 👹

details.title: Void Hunters
details.short_description: Lead fearless rebels in a dark fantasy, turn-based RPG where tactical decisions and strategic squad-building shape every battle against the world-devouring Void.

name: Master of Chaos: Beat or Break the Game

details.title: Master of Chaos: Beat or Break the Game
details.short_description: Pulverize your enemies for underestimating this cute little wizard by counter attacks, deflecting projectiles, unleashing face-melting ultimate abilities and building insane combos boosting your power until you are strong enough to beat the boss or break the game - Either way you win.

details.title: Project SEVER
details.short_description: Project Sever is an adventure submarine simulator with a touch of horror. Master the controls of an old Project "Sever" submarine and learn to maintain it in working order to escape a deadly underwater trap and solve the mystery of the Anomalous Zone.

details.title: HellPunk: Purgatorium
details.short_description: HellPunk: Purgatorium is a roguelite that combines stylish action with inventory management. Equip gears, manage your grid, and conquer the tower.

details.title: ON ANY JOURNEY
details.short_description: Designed exclusively for two players, < On Any Journey > is a co-op adventure packed with varied gameplay challenges that call for teamwork, coordination and a healthy dose of sabotage. Play locally or online with a friend!

details.title: Nonolith
details.short_description: The NONOLITH consumes you. Copy and paste the world around you to discover the secrets of this ancient, enigmatic structure. You are very powerful, you just don't know it yet.

details.title: BRAINSHELL
details.short_description: Have you ever wondered what it would be like to become an Intercontinental Ballistic Missile? A psychological horror experience focusing on immersion, storytelling and audiovisual torment.

details.title: Die Deep
details.short_description: Die Deep is an action game focused purely on the confrontation with your enemies. No exploration, no puzzles, The only core is Combat. One reckless move or greedy strike, and it’s all over. Answer the silent call of the abyss. Descend into the depths to find your forgotten desires.

details.title: Starfinder: Afterlight
details.short_description: Starfinder: Afterlight is a party-based RPG that brings Paizo's beloved science-fantasy universe to life. Battle across the Pact Worlds, lead a legendary crew where your choices shape their destiny, and well, save the galaxy while you're at it!

details.title: Uncanny Valley: Checkpoint
details.short_description: Pass. Quarantine. Kill. Run a Soviet checkpoint together in co-op after a nuclear meltdown unleashes a viral mutagen. Inspect papers, spot lies, and judge twisted bodies while battling radiation, paranoia, and the deadly cost of every mistake.

details.title: ANTARIUM 2
details.short_description: Long ago, the Old Colony filled these depths. Now your queen begins to dig. Grow a living ant colony in a cross-section of the earth, automate it with belts and machines, survive storms and raids, wake the ancient Engine, then fly to found a stronger colony.

details.title: Remothered: Tormented Fathers Remastered
details.short_description: The first chapter of the modern old school survival horror saga, rebuilt in Unreal Engine 5. Same ruthless tension, sharper everything.

details.title: Remothered: Broken Porcelain Remastered
details.short_description: The second chapter of the iconic modern old school survival horror saga. Remastered in Unreal Engine 5 to deliver a dramatically improved experience, while keeping every mechanic, every scare, and every secret exactly as they were.

details.title: Scream Operator: Haunted House Manager
details.short_description: Run a haunted dark ride from the control booth in this spooky horror management sim. Load guests, trigger scares, route carts, and keep the power alive as the queue surges. Earn cash and prestige to rebuild the mansion, automate the ride, and survive every shift.

details.title: Spreadsheets & Dungeons
details.short_description: A grid-based turn-based roguelike where you manage a party across a dungeon which is a spreadsheet. Explore each dungeon, level up your heroes, build synergies, scale absurd stats, and survive escalating dungeon pressure through tactical positioning and resource management.

details.title: Lurking
details.short_description: Lurking is a first-person survival horror game set in a building infested by giant spiders. Search for tools and weapons to fight back and survive. Find a way out before you're eaten alive.

details.title: Green Inferno
details.short_description: A new kind of horror deduction game that allows you to investigate freely. Examine detailed scenes, collect evidence in the form of clips, and use them to reconstruct events. Connect the clues, build your own theory, and unmask the macabre truth behind a doomed expedition.

name: Hypnagogia 壊れた夢 Broken Dreams

details.title: Hypnagogia 壊れた夢 Broken Dreams
details.short_description: A protector submerged, a mirror shattered, and a dreamscape left severed. Unravel a new, surreal dream mystery as you platform, solve puzzles, meet unique characters, and much more in this first-person exploration prequel to Hypnagogia: Boundless Dreams.

details.title: The Polar Darkness
details.short_description: A Lovecraftian folk horror mystery set during the polar night of 1980s northern Finland. When a child preacher disappears during a revival sermon, a journalist becomes trapped in an isolated village where something ancient is beginning to awaken.

details.title: The Refuge
details.short_description: Build and upgrade your refuge, gear up, and take on dangerous missions alone or with up to 3 players. Recover valuable resources, expand your camp, and choose your contracts wisely: the greater the reward, the greater the risk.

details.title: MARBLE SOULS
details.short_description: Prepare to roll through the dense, interconnected world of MARBLE SOULS. Collect lost souls and level up your marble in the new genre-defying game from the creators of Mosa Lina & FALLSTRUKTUR.

details.title: Orblins
details.short_description: Orblins is a Marble-Matching Roguelike inspired by classic marble shooters like Zuma and Luxor. Create game-breaking builds with endless marbles and upgrades to defeat a host of Orblins and bosses. Choose from a large cast of characters or create your own custom class to personalize your run.

details.title: WOYO!! 2
details.short_description: The second installment of the WOYO!! Saga— a French turn-based JRPG set in the heart of the Parisian suburbs. Rediscover Montreuil with your team of misfits and take on your terrifying enemies: pigeons, mobsters, barflies, and other shmucks.

details.title: Snow Panic
details.short_description: An online ski race for up to 8 players armed to the teeth. Blast your friends into the trees with bazookas, call in airstrikes, unleash exploding goats and beat them all to the bottom.

details.title: Sword & Banner
details.short_description: Mount & Blade's campaign meets classic RTS battles, in pixel art. Lead a warband across a fantasy continent at war, raise peasants into knights, trade, and carve out your own faction. Command every soldier in fast, brutal real-time battles and sieges.

details.title: Caravan Bazar
details.short_description: Caravan Bazar is a chaotic co-op physics adventure in a procedurally generated world. Find precious loot, load it into your cart, punch gnomes, fight trolls, repair broken wheels. Try to survive and reach the end. Complete missions, fly on gliders and live the life of a goblin.

details.title: Perplexicube
details.short_description: Perplexicube is a challenging isometric puzzler where you must work together with your past and future selves. You'll have to think ahead as you create loops backwards in time to set your futures selves up for success.

details.title: Irondrive
details.short_description: A vehicular roguelite where you manage a crew inside a moving fortress. Your base is on the move, your crew is at the breaking point: automate repairs, manage priorities, and survive relentless attacks as you cross a hostile, post-apocalyptic wasteland. Keep moving.

details.title: The Ninth Legion
details.short_description: The Ninth Legion is an RTS narrative strategy game, set during the fateful final campaign of the LEGIO IX HISPANA, Rome's famous missing legion.

details.title: Feather Rogue
details.short_description: A tactical grid combo builder where each turn is a full combo.. not one move. Chain your hand across the grid, trigger 16 elemental reactions that cascade with no limit and wipe the board in a single turn. Plan smart, combo harder and talk trash. Every run is a new puzzle of destruction.

details.title: Bouncery
details.short_description: Bouncery is an incremental bouncing game where you smash grumpy geometric shapes. Start by clicking and fill the board with balls, saws, lasers, black holes and many other weapons. Ascend and break it all again, faster.

details.title: HELLCARD II
details.short_description: Hellcard II is a unique co-op deck-builder roguelike game. Descend into the paper dungeons on your own or invite friends to fast-paced tactical card battles against hordes of evil and dragons. Lots of dragons!

details.title: ForMind
details.short_description: A horror shooter set in the ZiroTech underwater complex, where every sector is a fight for life. Battle the infected, use the environment, hack terminals, and learn from mistakes. A time anomaly gives you a second chance — don't waste it.

details.title: Shutter Story
details.short_description: Examine a family's photo album to reveal signs of the paranormal, as the horror unfolds in the house around you. Their fate is in your hands.

details.title: Banana Airways
details.short_description: Feed your passengers. Or they'll eat each other. Run an airline with cannibal chickens, radioactive passengers and screaming babies you can throw off the plane. Fly, serve, repair and try to land. Play solo or with up to five friends.

details.title: Cartastrophe
details.short_description: CARTASTROPHE is a party game for 1–4 players, streamed live as the internet's most exciting death game. Crash, shoot and stab your way through minigames for likes, and survive the Final Showdown to walk out famous.

details.title: Nightholme
details.short_description: Nightholme is a 12-player, third-person PvEvP extraction horror game. Hunt solo or in duos through an ever-changing city where one encounter can set off a chain reaction. Fight with abilities, not guns. Transform into a monster for devastating power, at the cost of your sanity. How far will you go?

details.title: Too Angry to Clean
details.short_description: A co-op destruction game for 1-4 players where the best weapon against the undead is a falling house. Tear down walls, towers and castles with magic and bury undead hordes under the rubble. Level up and unlock new spells. Set records and find out who’s strongest in an arena you can wreck too.

details.title: Pineview Drive 2 - Rising Storm
details.short_description: For years, Lisa has been haunted by dreams of a burning mansion. When she recognizes the place from a late-night television documentary, she decides to uncover the truth behind the nightmare in this story-driven first-person horror adventure.

details.title: Parkour Bot
details.short_description: Parkour Bot is a fast paced, rhythm based, physics platform game, with an unique movement set of main character. Show your skills and get a lot of achievements in 100 dynamic levels.

details.title: We Are Bodies
details.short_description: Drag a sinner to Hell, where he belongs! In this physics-based co-op puzzle platformer for 1-2 players, you play as rookie devils who can only control one leg each. Stumble, dodge and solve your way through the chaos to drop him into the pit of Hell.

details.title: Drift
details.short_description: Drift is a narrative sci-fi horror adventure set on a desolate deep-space outpost. With your mission gone horrifically wrong, you face an unspeakable, monstrous foe. Explore the station's dark recesses, restore failing systems, survive terrifying encounters, and confront your own tormented past.

details.title: Solar Core
details.short_description: Survive to the end of each track in fast, rhythm-driven combat in this top down twin-stick roguelike.

details.title: Village vs Rock
details.short_description: Village vs Rock is a physics based incremental game about crushing mountains. Raise your village of orcs to wage war against the rock that keeps popping up in your backyard. Hurl mammoths, unleash spells, and upgrade everything to DESTROY THE ROCK!

details.title: Toque: Restaurant Tycoon
details.short_description: A restaurant tycoon where you are part of the crew. Work wherever you want, in the kitchen, at the register or on the floor, build your place yourself and pick one of four restaurant types. Grow your menu with cooks who know the dishes and rise above the city's rival restaurants.

details.title: Age of Space
details.short_description: Evolve from being a nobody to being the center of power! Age of space combines real time resource management with tactical combat. Work as a mercenary for clients in our solar system as you gradually get dragged into a liberation war between the Martians and the UEA. Who will you side with?

details.title: VoltHaven
details.short_description: Build electric grid in small settlement. Advance from outdated generators to modern powerplants, use fossils and renewables. Accomodate growing customer base and weather changes. Farms or mines provide extra income. Map-free layout with drag-and-drop simplicity. Simulation based on european data.

details.title: Tattered Banners
details.short_description: Lead a mercenary company in a turn-based tactics RPG set in a dynamic, simulated world shaped by your actions. Recruit, equip, and evolve your warband to survive a medieval-fantasy realm where cities rise and fall, noble houses pursue personal agendas, and the land bears the scars of your decisions.

details.title: Huni Kuin: Beya Xinã Bena
details.short_description: A 2D platform game that comes to life through the myths of the Huni Kuin people. Overcome challenges in the Amazon, use the knowledge of the shamans and explore the world of spirits in this adventure illustrated by indigenous artists.

details.title: Definitely a Unicorn
details.short_description: Startup chaos for 1–4 players, solo or online co-op. Everyone is a co-founder and everyone thinks they're the CEO. Ship it half-baked, bluff investors, fight over the last dollars. Become a unicorn — or a meme.

details.title: Project Sundive
details.short_description: Project Sundive is wave-based arena auto-shooter roguelite, focusing on ship customization and ridiculously overpowered builds

details.title: Pillow Punk
details.short_description: Fight waves of enemies and towering bosses in a third-person action roguelite. Spend the points you earn on the Patch Board to build your own fighting style. Play solo or bring up to three friends into online co-op.

details.title: Civlands
details.short_description: Rule a medieval fantasy kingdom in this pixel-art real-time strategy game. Your people build, farm and haul on their own while you decide what matters. Trade with rivals or march on them, bind spells to your armies, and build a wonder worth defending. Reign well, or not for long.

details.title: Struggle of Empires
details.short_description: Write your orders, wait for the turn, then open your realm's newspaper to find out who betrayed whom. A play-by-email empire game in the old style: rule a fantasy realm, a steampunk power (1750 to 1914) or a real people from 5000 BC to today, against friends, strangers or the computer.

details.title: Zodiac Legion
details.short_description: Zodiac Legion is a turn-based tactical RPG where you take command of an arcane chivalric order. Launch daring raids through ancient ruins and treacherous dungeons. Advance in steadfast formations to disrupt enemy ranks with cunning stratagems. Hold your ground in a world of reawakening cosmic magic.

details.title: Midnight Horde
details.short_description: Leap, slash, and soar through gothic ruins in Midnight Horde, a high-mobility auto shooter where parkour meets reverse bullet hell. Battle through swarms of monstrosities, upgrade deadly weapons, and build strongholds to push back the creeping dark.

details.title: The Night Janitor
details.short_description: You were hired to clean. Nobody mentioned the ghosts. Craven & Moor Associates needs their offices spotless before the morning shift. What their employees can't know won't hurt them. Mop up the mess, take out the trash, and don't let anything catch you doing it. Five nights. One mop. Don't die.

details.title: Family Time
details.short_description: Build a family of thousands of wolf children with your own wolf partner!

details.title: LEXICON: Lingua Obscura
details.short_description: An old terminal in an abandoned office is still on, long after everyone has left. Why is ECHO-7, a cryptic AI, still running? Why does it want you to play? Twist strange rules and chain letter combos in a word roguelite where every run feels one step away from revealing something bigger.

details.title: Demon Spore
details.short_description: Blast your way out of tentacle hell as a failed lab experiment gives birth to a rapidly growing viral horror in this intense action rogue-lite inspired by 80s Monster movies. Use the lab to your advantage and improvise an escape plan before this constantly evolving life form spreads out of control.

details.title: Kakurenbo Neko
details.short_description: Kakurenbo Neko, a cozy hide & seek kitty collecting game.

details.title: Unwalkable
details.short_description: Unwalkable is a silly physics based open-ended puzzle platformer where you control a wobbly character. Without just one way to solve puzzles, you must use your imagination and ingenuity to create solutions to unthinkable problems.

details.title: Pinata
details.short_description: Hit a giant piñata with up to 3 friends in first-person co-op. Coins fall out, roll down a spiral funnel into your vault and buy you bigger weapons: a bow, a machine gun, a hwacha, archers. When it bursts, a bigger one comes down from the clouds.

details.title: Unexpected Tasks
details.short_description: Relax with a cozy Time Management adventure. Clear obstacles, gather resources, rebuild the kingdom, and enjoy satisfying progress at your own pace - with or without a timer.

details.title: Skyclimbers
details.short_description: Build your kingdom, choose your class, and tame monsters in this Multiplayer City-Building RPG that takes place in a procedurally generated anime-themed universe.

details.title: TREAD: Arcade Tank Combat
details.short_description: Fast-paced top-down online tank battles where skill, teamwork, and strategy decide every fight. Customize your tank with specialized hulls and turrets, each with unique stats and abilities.

details.title: Homeplanet
details.short_description: Homeplanet is a space combat simulator with Newtonian physics and a story-driven campaign. Step into the boots of a combat pilot of the Troiden clan! Take part in the saga of exile from your home world—and the struggle to conquer a new one.

details.title: Pry Into The Void
details.short_description: Delve into the hearts of monsters and people in this bleak monster-taming RPG. Exploit enemy weaknesses, confront difficult moral choices, and recruit surreal creatures by uncovering the truths hidden within their souls.

details.title: NIA
details.short_description: Drill, smash, leap and slide through this 2d puzzle platformer mashing retro graphics & icepunk aesthetics. Explore dozens of hand crafted worlds in well over 100 different levels.

details.title: Hack The Stars
details.short_description: Earth, 2040. The powerful are quietly preparing to leave for the stars. Fly a drone into their facilities, plant access, then command AI agents from your illicit Shadow Cloud to breach layered networks, train stolen models and expose who gets to go.

details.title: Solaria Moon Remake
details.short_description: A 3D space adventure aboard the Taranis, a huge cargo ship, full of puzzles to solve and secrets to uncover. Already own Solaria Moon? The remake is free for you.

details.title: Pirates Republic
details.short_description: Build your pirate republic from nothing. Survive, cook, trade, and plunder your way through a procedurally generated Caribbean in this open-world survival sandbox. No fantasy - just history, grit, and freedom. Play solo or with friends in co-op.

details.title: From Misfortune Comes
details.short_description: A broke high-school senior tries to rebuild his life, while secretly exploiting a supernatural second world to acquire money, power and opportunities that transform his ordinary existence.

details.title: The Last Iron Sentinel
details.short_description: A first-person zombie roguelike shooter. Humanity is down to one last shelter, and you are its last sentinel robot.
