details.short_description: Luck in the Dark is a turn-based roguelike with slot machines and backpack management. Pack your bag to improve your odds, spin the reels, and find your way out of the dark.

details.title: REDHAND
details.short_description: A psychotic-horror (psychological, surreal survival horror) with dark, oppressive atmosphere, brutal action and grotesque creatures.

details.title: Core!1!
details.short_description: Core Miner is a cozy incremental mining adventure where every swing takes you deeper into Earth. Break rock, collect ores, relics and pet eggs, upgrade your tools and build powerful loadouts on the journey toward the planet's core.

details.title: We Don't Exist
details.short_description: A single-player, first-person psychological horror game. You wake up in a facility where every room wants you dead and a voice records everything. The worst trap is the other subjects: trust them, betray them, sacrifice yourself? Training modes playable by two, online or in split screen.

details.title: Hellkick
details.short_description: One kick, one survivor. HELLKICK is an early 2000s inspired lightning-fast two-button fighter: divekick your way down the circles of Hell, snap spines in x-ray FATAL KICKS, and duel on arenas that fight back. No combos to memorize! Every single hit is death, yours or theirs.

details.title: Vacuum Uprising
details.short_description: Rip the ground from under your feet and hurl it at your enemies! Vacuum Uprising is a pixel-perfect destruction platformer with physics-based combat, epic boss fights, and local multiplayer for up to 4 players.

details.title: Voidbit
details.short_description: In this challenging deckbuilder puzzle platformer, mixing turn based with real time gameplay, you don't control the main character. Instead, you'll play cards to manipulate the character, the world and the deck to lead them off planet before the chasing void consumes them.

details.title: Flipping Football Clubs
details.short_description: Buy, build, and flip football clubs in a fast-paced roguelite management sim. Sign players, hire staff, survive FFP, unlock Club DNA modifiers, and grow club value across 1-2 hour seasonal runs.

details.title: Metzger Manager
details.short_description: Run your own butcher shop, buy animals, butcher meat, serve customers, and expand your business with employees and upgrades.

details.title: The Shotgun Game: Buckshot Survivors
details.short_description: Blast your way through endless hordes of enemies and become the Ultimate Shotgun! Level up, unlock upgrades, build your arsenal of powerful mods and create unique builds to devastate everything in your path.

details.title: Abjure
details.short_description: Win by emptying your hand. Abjure is a roguelike deckbuilder where the 2 of Spades reigns supreme — draft cards, stack relics, and outplay every opponent in a strategic twist on the Big 2 card game.

details.title: Echoes of Aromia
details.short_description: Echoes of Aromia is a story-driven, pixel art RPG with turnbased combat, branching dialogue, alchemy, companions, and much more. Set in a pre-steampunk medieval fantasy world on the brink of industrialization, full of corruption, conspiracy, good, and evil. And ancient myths waiting to be uncovered.

details.title: Meatstone
details.short_description: Meatstone is a turn-based tactical RPG. As a mercenary in a wasteland with alien colonizers, you must cross the unknown surface, gather resources for your base, and augment your gears and flesh. Learn the truth of the past, and salvage what remains of a world that may already be beyond saving.

name: Outside the pile of leaf litter

details.title: Outside the pile of leaf litter
details.short_description: In Toronto's cold, dry, pitch-black polar night, a four-string bass roars in a freezing basement. Sink into punker Jack's drug‑induced, hallucinatory "trip"—face the overwhelming unease through twisted fluid colors and a torn, fractured vision.

details.title: Mechanized Wonder: Lost Unit
details.short_description: Fight across battlefields in the name of freedom from those who are bound and weighted down by gravity in this FPS simulation game, where you pilot a giant Mechanized Combat Vehicle from within an enclosed cockpit.

details.title: Solitary Singleplayer Offline MMORPG
details.short_description: Run an MMORPG guild in this incremental management game. Recruit new members, upgrade your guild, promote leaders to automate the busywork, and grind for the best gear. All to earn the Server-First achievements for every raid.

details.title: murmures
details.short_description: murmures is a narrative exploration game. Clara is doing everything she can to stay emotionally stable, but something is following her. Explore, search, roll your d20s and help her find a way out.

details.title: Survivor of the Meow Kingdom
details.short_description: Gameplay:​ A 3D pixel-art roguelike action-adventure game. In an endless sea of choices, discover powerful card-based upgrades, forge your own path, slay monsters, save the empire—or challenge yourself to the limit in endless mode.

details.title: Wild Boar Digging
details.short_description: A small relaxing game where you control a wild boar collecting resources. Upgrade the attributes of you wild boar and find a diversity of interesting animal cards. You can even recruit bees to help you!

details.title: Vanslinger
details.short_description: Fast-paced FPS with bullet time, short replayable levels and intense action-packed combat

details.title: Paint Me Back
details.short_description: A cozy narrative adventure set in a very particular museum, where the great masterpieces of art history have lost their colors and their protagonists. Help George restore the paintings, bring the missing characters back and discover what forced them to leave their paintings...

details.title: Hollowtone
details.short_description: A game you can play BLIND from start to finish... Meet Serene™️'s newest digital therapy model: N.O.R.A.! Hollowtone is a first person audio-based navigation horror game. For possibly the first time ever, CHOOSE to play with graphics OR blindfold yourself for a unique audio experience.

details.title: Elowen's Travel Notes
details.short_description: Discover Elowen’s travel journal in her bookshop and step into her journey. Use productivity tools to study and work as each focus session takes you further. Unlock new scenes and discover her story at your own pace, with soothing music and beautiful illustrations.

details.title: Fantasy Auto Chess
details.short_description: Fantasy Auto Chess blends roguelite, extraction, and auto chess gameplay. Build your squad through battle, choose when to fight or retreat, and carry Heroic Spirits into future runs as permanent assets to gain stronger starts and unlock more strategies.

details.title: Mafia Pizza : Family Business
details.short_description: Manage your mafia family and take over the city! Assassinate, extort and take down rival families — All while running a perfectly legitimate pizza business.

details.title: Strayward
details.short_description: STRAYWARD is an open-world voxel survival game set across a series of strange and isolated regions. Explore, scavenge, gather resources, build shelters, and fight to survive as you venture deeper into an unfamiliar world filled with persistent threats and unexplained phenomena.

details.title: Nutty Mice Party
details.short_description: Nutty Mice Party is an adorable multiplayer adventure! Play as cute mice with unique abilities, explore colorful candy-filled mazes, and gobble up every last treat while dodging hungry cats. Team up with friends or face off in chaotic cat-and-mouse battles. Let the sweet chaos begin!

details.title: Star Chasers
details.short_description: Star Chasers is a 2–4 player local multiplayer party game! Roll the dice, race across the board, collect stars, and challenge your friends in wild mini-games. Dodge lasers, survive lava, and outplay your rivals with skill, strategy, and a little luck. Who will claim the party crown?

details.title: Plushie Ops
details.short_description: Plushie Ops is a local two-player 3D action platformer! Grab a friend and guide two adorable plushies through a world of traps and surprises. Jump, fight, tackle tricky mechanisms, and collect stars as you explore a toy factory and a mysterious underwater world. Can you make it to the finish?

details.title: Doctor Funkelstein
details.short_description: Build and upgrade your mad scientist laboratory to bring your creatures to life! Strategically manage your souls, unstable science and experimental ingredients to show the world your brilliance in this spookily cozy incremental game.

details.title: Orbit: Night Shift
details.short_description: Vacuum up space junk, crack the data chips hidden inside and wake the 70 women of the Star Harbor's lost night shift. A cozy collecting game with upgrades, lootboxes without real money, your own space station and a very grumpy alien merchant.

details.title: FrankenCars
details.short_description: Build ridiculous cars from mismatched parts, test them in drag races and long jumps, then sell your creations to fund the next disaster! FrankenCars is a lighthearted car-building tycoon where clever upgrades and terrible engineering go hand in hand.

details.title: Abysses: Meridian
details.short_description: Your pod came down crippled on Meridian, a world where the sea has risen sixty metres in six years. Swim out on a minute of air, wake a silent station, build a real submarine and dive ever deeper, alone or with a friend, toward the vast ring that made the sea rise.

details.title: Midnight Bell
details.short_description: A gothic asynchronous PvP autobattler. Build a board of werewolves, vampires or monster hunters, arm them with items, then watch them fight other players saved teams of gothic monstrosities. Halfway through every fight the midnight bell tolls and the monsters transform.

details.title: Shio: Be With Me
details.short_description: A quiet train, a cold-faced vampire girl, and a promise you can't quite remember. Take on commissions with Shio, stay focused together, and slowly find your place beside her.

details.title: Trust No One: MAFIA
details.short_description: The party game Mafia, but nobody closes their eyes at night. A first-person social deduction shooter for 7 to 15 players with proximity voice chat. The Mafia can take a dark form: no voice, no name above their head. If someone in the dark won't answer you, run. Or shoot first.

details.title: MageInc
details.short_description: An Incremental Magic game where you face ghouls and other monstrosities blocking your path. Use Fire, Ice, Earth and other elements to annihilate them!

details.title: Ashen Rain
details.short_description: No justice. Only consequences. Ashen Rain is a brutal 2.5D tactical action shooter: fight through rain-soaked streets, factories and military outposts with weighty gunplay, punishing enemy fire and visceral, realistic damage. The law failed. He didn't.

details.title: SonDem
details.short_description: Son Dem is a 3D online social game set in a traditional Turkish coffeehouse for up to 20 players. Play backgammon, 101 Okey and chess with friends, watch matches as a spectator, and join the conversation through voice and text chat.

details.title: Mighty Gladiators
details.short_description: Fight through waves of enemies and conquer deadly bosses in a dark fantasy arena action RPG for 1–4 players. Choose from four heroes, combine talents with legendary gear, and master boss mechanics solo or in online co-op.

details.title: Unfolding Memories
details.short_description: Build paper pop-ups at a quiet desk. Glue folds onto a card, cut them with a knife, add stickers and words, then open and shut the book to watch it all fold flat. When you like it, print the pattern and make it for real.

name: Fine Tuning: A Radio Repair Shop

details.title: Fine Tuning: A Radio Repair Shop
details.short_description: Run a little radio repair shop in 1952, where every wireless on your bench is a working circuit, so the meter reads what's really there and the hum or the crackle you hear is the fault itself. You take each set apart by hand and fit new parts from the cabinet till it plays again for its owner.

details.title: Paid Bloom
details.short_description: Your desktop is a garden. Plant a seed, go back to work, and your flowers grow while you type. Look up hours later and the screen is in bloom. Every plant is one of a kind, rare colours are out there to hunt, and nothing ever dies.
developers: Beijing Star Halo Technology Co., Ltd.
publishers: Beijing Star Halo Technology Co., Ltd.

details.title: Last Skull
details.short_description: Take a ship into hostile waters, plunder islands, wrecks and rival captains, then make it out before your time runs out. Whatever you bring home is yours to keep. Sink, and what you carried is left floating for someone else.

details.title: Thrustlings
details.short_description: A physics rocket game about landing softly. Feather the thrust, fight gravity and wind, and touch down before your fuel runs out. Race friends online in Pad Race, King of the Pad and Orb Ball, conquer 120+ levels, and build and share your own in the level editor.

details.title: Incredig
details.short_description: Incredig is a short sci-fi incremental mining game about digging far too deep. Break rock pixel by pixel, haul ore back to your Rig, automate the mine with swarms of drones, and keep pushing downward. Something beneath the surface is beating.

details.title: Order of the Crystalline Tortoise
details.short_description: Walk a baby tortoise one leg at a time across a storm-wrecked island. Find food, gather torn clues and make friends who live inside your crystal shell. At night, move those friends between its openings to fend off threats in this story-led adventure with real-time defense.

details.title: Coin Shower
details.short_description: Coin Shower is a short, cozy incremental casino arcade game. Every machine pays out in a burst of coins that pile up on the floor. Scoop them up, spend them on upgrades, unlock new machines, and chase the $1,000,000 moon shot.

details.title: IncreGate
details.short_description: IncreGate is an incremental shooter. Hold the line as hundreds of goblins, skeletons and orcs pour out of the gate, then spend your Gold on a sprawling upgrade tree, 48 guns, part cards and a squad of companions, and push one round further.

details.title: SoulForge: Clicker
details.short_description: A tactical roguelite-clicker RPG set in dark and ruthless realms. Unlike ordinary clicker games, survive the deadly blows of your enemies, upgrade your abilities, unleash combos, and grow stronger by usurping the souls of the bosses you slay.

details.title: Aftermind
details.short_description: Aftermind is a fast roguelike boomer shooter inside a coma patient's nightmares. Shoot limbs off, stagger enemies and end them with brutal finishers. Every run brings new powers, and a little more of the truth about why you're here.

details.title: Arctic Station Six
details.short_description: Program a remote Arctic weather station to run itself through the polar winter. Write and optimize assembly programs to read your instruments, warn of gales, launch weather balloons, and more. Grow the site level by level from a small outpost to a fully fledged research station.

details.title: Dice Dice Battles
details.short_description: Buy dice, line them up, and watch them play. Move one die and the whole line changes. A roguelike dice battler about finding absurd combos, then testing them against a cursed dungeon or other players in async PvP.

details.title: Demiurges: Land of Strife
details.short_description: A survivor-like action game: You start as a mortal and randomly obtain fragments from different factions in combat. Collect a complete set to ascend into a brand-new form—new model, more skill slots, and a deeper skill library—leading to a completely different combat path.

details.title: Wall Over
details.short_description: Stack furniture, combine your powers, and toss a friend over the wall in a physics adventure for 1–4 players. Play solo or team up online as four tiny creatures on a quest to bring their village’s missing music box home.

details.title: Spells of Arcanetheria
details.short_description: A dark 16-bit roguelite where magic is everything. Find lost spells, master them, then forge your own from soul shards, Aether and relics: one roll, no recipes, yours forever. When death comes, roll the d20. When your hero falls for good, their spells live on for the next adventurer.

details.title: Slime Overload
details.short_description: Slime Overload is a Plinko roguelike auto-battler and deckbuilder. Slime balls grow stronger as they bounce off pins, then summon an army at the exits. Combine slimes and relics, upgrade your machine, choose paths to exploit enemy weaknesses, and protect your Hero Slime to defeat the final boss!

details.title: Adventile
details.short_description: Every adventurer is a puzzle piece. Hire them, fit them together and clear the dungeon in this polyomino puzzle × resource-management roguelite. Every floor can be solved — the question is how cheaply. Whoever you place is gone for good. 30 weeks to reach the Three Great Dungeons.

details.title: Dragonwing-Rampage
details.short_description: Unleash your fury and blast through enemy lines! Dragonwing Rampage is a 2D bullet hell roguelite. Catch wild beasts, raise dragons, and build a ranch on your sky island. Gear up, dodge through bullet storms, and stack blessings to unleash the firepower you need to defend your home from the Void.

details.title: Boo! Boo! Train!
details.short_description: A cozy train journey through a valley that keeps its own time. Drive slowly, pick a line at every junction, stop for the view and whistle at the neighbours. One real hour is one day in Pinewind Valley, and the season turns every week. Nothing to build, nothing to fail.

details.title: Casus Foederis: 1815
details.short_description: Your ally is attacked and calls you into a war you never wanted. Answer, and you fight. Refuse, and every court in Europe remembers. Lead one of twelve powers from 1815 to 1871; grow too fast and the continent unites against you. A turn-based strategy game of diplomacy. Single-player.

details.title: Bermuda Trial
details.short_description: Party Based Autobattler RPG where you choose team of three survivor to explore the wonders and dangers of the mysterious Bermuda Island.

details.title: DEFCON 89
details.short_description: OLD-SCHOOL ZOMBIES ARE BACK. Survive endless rounds solo or in 4-player co-op in a Cold War nightmare set in 1989. Powered by Unreal Engine 5, explore sinister maps, find secret weapons and unravel each map's hidden main story. How long can you last?

details.title: Wool Shop
details.short_description: A cozy idle game that lives along the edge of your screen. Your sheep graze, their wool is spun and knitted, and customers shop at your little store while you work. Your sheepdog follows your cursor and helps herd the flock.

details.title: Okey Dokey
details.short_description: The tile-rummy roguelite. Lay runs and groups, outplay a rival at every table and stack boosts with regulars, drinks and enchanted tiles on a tour of the world's tile clubs, from Lisbon to the Grand Salon.

details.title: Trash Nights
details.short_description: Autumn, 1998. You take the night shift on garbage truck No. 7 in Maple Hollow, a quiet suburb whose last crew quit without notice. One street a night, 11 PM to 4 AM. Every house leaves its trash on the curb, and one neighbor's bags should not exist.

details.title: Chat, we are Cooked
details.short_description: Humanity is facing extinction. And naturally, as it always does, it's handling the situation very professionally. Become an asteroid, grow into an unstoppable cosmic disaster, and watch Earth react and respond with missiles, politics, corporate greed, and increasingly questionable breaking news.

details.title: Night Radio
details.short_description: Run your late-night radio show, take calls from strange listeners, uncover their secrets, solve puzzles and survive the horrors of the night.

name: Swarm Queen: Reincarnated as Mankind's Doom

details.title: Swarm Queen: Reincarnated as Mankind's Doom
details.short_description: Once an apothecary whose potions saved thousands, Elyse was branded a heretic and cast into slavery by a desperate Church. Falsely accused, she returns not as a savior, but as a ruthless conqueror. Now it's your turn! Evolve the swarm, command the horde, and crush humanity in this macro-free RTS!

details.title: Wheeler Dealer Together
details.short_description: Turn used cars into profit! Inspect vehicles, uncover hidden problems, negotiate the best deals, and visit repair shops to get them fixed. Buy low, sell high, and grow your own used car dealership with friends in Wheeler Dealer Together!

details.title: Infinite Supermarket
details.short_description: Infinite Supermarket is an online co-op survival roguelike with physics-driven chaos, proximity voice chat and character roles. You and up to 7 friends must find the exit - and keep yourselves fed on the way.

details.title: A Growing Problem
details.short_description: Start smaller than a speck of dust in a houseplant pot. Eat anything smaller than you, grow, and turn everything that hunted you into a snack: crumbs, cats, cars, cities and, eventually, the whole planet.

details.title: Rogue Dungeon 2
details.short_description: The sequel to the solo dungeon crawler based on the board game. Step out of the dungeon and into Ilderia: travel a dangerous world, gather a party, follow questlines to a hard-won ending, and delve into flooded sewers, cursed tombs and a vampire-haunted castle.

details.title: Chernoberg: Rebirth
details.short_description: A Super Polymerization of a turn-based SRPG that combines strategic depth with exhilarating combat, and a story-driven AVG packed with tens of thousands of words and a plot full of twists and turns. Experiment with diverse party compositions and discover the playstyle that suits you best.

details.title: Backwatt
details.short_description: Backwatt is a co-op top-down action roguelite for 1–4 players. Drop into the arena, fight off waves of enemies and head back to the Barge to gear up. At its heart is your rig: your skill at managing space and planning your purchases decides how strong your build is.

details.title: The Backworld
details.short_description: Slip through the cracks of reality and explore a vast, open-ended RPG world where surreal horrors collide with fantasy kingdoms and sci-fi cities. Fight in strategic turn-based battles and tense real-time action. The more your sanity breaks, the more the world and its monsters warp around you.

details.title: 银色记忆
details.short_description: 扮演失忆的主角在一个充满秘密的小镇生活，探索和恋爱

details.title: SuperBird
details.short_description: SuperBird is a roguelike deckbuilder starring birds and bugs. our cards crawl, grow, and even devour one another. Learn each bug’s quirks, build around them with powerful trinkets, and time your plays to perfection under the arena spotlight. Climb your way to the top and claim the crown!

details.title: Poreia
details.short_description: Manipulate magnetic forces to solve puzzles and uncover the truth of the world in this 3D puzzle adventure - become a memory-lost cat robot and explore a mysterious world!

details.title: Leaf Us Alone
details.short_description: Build a powerful army with synergistic abilities, and prove your strategic mastery in this unique deckbuilding roguelite. Command your forces in battle, triggering outrageous combo to defeat the invading Voidlings threatening to consume the world.

details.title: Final Orbit
details.short_description: Master the cockpit of highly realistic spacecraft in this Newtonian physics based sim. Take off from surface to space, plot a course between the planets and dock with space stations. Trade commodities or take shipping contracts to buy upgrades and optimize your build - every choice matters.

details.title: Beards vs. Claws
details.short_description: Dig tunnels, build bridges, and blast your way through walls towards victory in this highly dynamic arena first-person shooter - every obstacle is a potential door

details.title: Pixel Rush: RTS
details.short_description: A fantasy real-time strategy deck builder where you summon monsters, evolve them mid-battle, cast spells, fight for control of the battlefield and rush the enemies base for victory!

details.title: Goat Survivor 2
details.short_description: Soul-harvesting survival action: a goat wizard sets out to conquer the demon realm. Mow down endless hordes, capture foes with Mind Control, and grow stronger with every soul. Simple controls, fast growth, screen-filling battles. Conquer domain after domain and claim the Demon Lord's throne.

details.title: VOIDSWARM
details.short_description: They came from the void. You are all that stands between the swarm and our annihilation. Direct and fight alongside an immense fleet as both pilot and commander, hold the line against thousands of enemies using powerful upgrades, and take back our homeworlds in this roguelike RTS.

details.title: Kuaiban!! Magical Girl
details.short_description: Your phone is the clapper — wave it, and the party starts. A motion party rhythm game: beat duels, photo-booth co-op, and a single-player story across China. Scan a QR code to play with friends — no app to download. Turn any screen into a party, magical-girl story and all.

details.title: Lords of the World
details.short_description: Develop your city, expand your armies, and send your kingdom's elite agent across the world to complete dangerous missions.

details.title: BLIGHT SWARM
details.short_description: BLIGHT SWARM is horde-building action roguelite where you invade Earth as an alien hivemind and run a planetary infection campaign. Turn civilians into zombies, merge your minions into stronger abominations, evolve your Beast, and spread the Blight across the globe.

details.title: Project Longshot
details.short_description: Build a space program that reaches the stars in this 1:1 scale spaceflight and colony sim. Design rockets and fly them with real orbital mechanics. Land anywhere in a procedural universe of over two million real star systems, then set up space stations, colonies and factories. How far can you go?

details.title: Purrgeist
details.short_description: A cozy-spooky ghost-catching incremental. You're a little cat with a spectral vacuum: explore a haunted mansion room by room, suck up ghosts, harvest essences, sell your loot, and pour it into a massive talent tree. Short runs, satisfying progression, and always one more.

details.title: Derelict Planet
details.short_description: Derelict Planet is a retro-inspired top-down action RPG. Survive on a harsh alien planet, battle dungeon bosses, solve puzzles, complete quests, and search for new weapons and abilities.

details.title: Incremental Garden
details.short_description: A short incremental game about a magical garden. Grow wonderful flowers, earn money, buy upgrades, and roll the gacha to discover rarer plants! Over 30 unique plants are waiting for you!

details.title: Focus My Deer
details.short_description: Focus my Deer is a game that helps you stay focused on your real-life work! After every focus session, you gain energy which can be used to bring back plants and trees to the land. As the forest grows, animals will come to visit! Learn about the animals and help them on their quests.

details.title: The Ones Who Answered
details.short_description: When a catastrophic global anomaly known as "The Knocking" drags you into a nightmare dimension, you must fight to survive. Play as YouTuber Pisty and team up with an ally, Perm, to escape a four-layer hellscape. Solve puzzles, evade terrifying threats, and defeat the creator of this twisted world..

details.title: Yolings
details.short_description: Yolings is a puzzle platformer about sacrificing some to save the rest. Possess individual characters, use self-sacrificing abilities and turn their deaths into puzzle solutions to save as many as possible for the highest score.

details.title: Tug-O-War Wrestling
details.short_description: Grab the rope and fight for control in a physics-based wrestling game where every move pulls your opponent with you. Master momentum through Season Mode or battle friends and random opponents locally and online.

details.title: Factory Reset
details.short_description: Shorty's repair shop has gone quiet, and the note says back soon. Under the desk sits a box of factory paperwork nobody ever mentioned. Work the jobs on the bench with real tools and real skills, learn to see past the first sign of life, and find out what a factory reset really means.

details.title: Attrition Line
details.short_description: A factory game about building an army. Mine, smelt, and manufacture soldiers on an assembly line, then send them to fight a swarm that grows every hour. The more you automate, the bigger your army. Fall behind and the line breaks.

details.title: GOLF TRIP
details.short_description: YOU ARE THE DRUG. Show off your accuracy while controlling an experimental substance designed to strip away human will. High skill, instant restarts, and zero room for error. DELIVER THE DOSE. DON'T FAIL. THIS IS GOLF TRIP.

details.title: Outspin Champions
details.short_description: Outspin Champions is a local competitive PvP / Co-op brawler where the spinning never stops. It blends party-game chaos with Souls-like precision, mastering physics-driven weapon weight to deflect foes. Outspin. Outsmart. Outlast.

details.title: For The Witch
details.short_description: For The Witch is a cute fantasy top-down tower-defense roguelite. Protect a sleeping witch from mosquito swarms, develop both the soldier and the witch, combine mechanic-changing items, and awaken them into new effects to hold out through each night.

details.title: Dyeversion
details.short_description: Dyeversion is a color-routing tower defense. Drag liquid hoses from color sources to your towers, mix colors to forge powerful COMBO towers, and route your pipes around the enemy path. Battle dozens of levels, earn tokens, and unlock a deep skill tree.

details.title: Shadows of Beginnings
details.short_description: Explore fractured realms, battle fearsome enemies, and rebuild Novum in this dark fantasy action RPG. Gather resources, upgrade your gear, develop your class, and seamlessly switch between isometric and over-the-shoulder combat as you fight for a world on the brink of being swallowed by the void.

details.title: Luck and Raid
details.short_description: A 1–4 player online co-op, top-down action RPG/roguelike where luck is everything. You're fluffy, and you're adorable. Earn money and get stronger. Running low on cash? Try gambling! Lost it all? Just borrow some from a friend. Your friend is broke too? Congratulations! Now the real co-op begins.

details.title: Doomsday Train
details.short_description: Doom falls and civilization collapses entirely. The roaming train becomes the last hope of mankind. You will take charge of the vehicle, manage and equip survivors, allocate food and daily tasks, collect resources to resist zombie swarms. The fate of everyone hinges on your decisions.

details.title: Lawn Mower Mayhem
details.short_description: Mow lawns, haggle prices and build a lawn-care empire in a cartoon mountain village — while three rivals sabotage every job with garden gnomes, rubber chickens and the occasional airborne sheep. Career mode for the turf war, Chill mode for just the mowing.

details.title: Hotel Is Hungry
details.short_description: The world ended. You got a hotel job. Check guests in, serve their orders, keep them away from killers, and decide who the hotel eats. A horror hotel management game.

details.title: L.L.L.Liar
details.short_description: Shi, a photographer and unforgivable sinner. After her train breaks down, she steps onto the platform and meets someone she'll never forget. This narrative-driven RPG takes you down a thorny path to save your loved one and face the real world together.

details.title: Loopy Dungeon
details.short_description: Legend has it that all who enter this dungeon are doomed to loop forever. In Loopy Dungeon, build your deck fight after fight, combine your relics and break the cycle.

details.title: Dead Relay
details.short_description: Dead Relay is a PSX-style survival horror game. As a field engineer sent to a blacked-out relay station, you must restore power, explore classified sectors, and decode encrypted logs. But the facility isn't empty — and the system itself seems to be watching your every step.

name: Dream to Millennium | 梦回千禧

details.title: Dream to Millennium | 梦回千禧
details.short_description: Worn out by life’s stress? Dive into a dreamy millennial world with Chinese dreamcore vibes. Wander freely with no tasks or combat. Paired with the rap album Dream to Millennium: Teen Never Die. Stay true to your dreams, and never compromise.

name: Knock Off: The Battle For Imagination

details.title: Knock Off: The Battle For Imagination
details.short_description: Fight for the fate of imagination in this fast-paced 2D fighter inspired by classic arcade games and 80s/90s action figures. Master air combos, EX moves, assists, and super attacks with a roster of wild off-brand toy legends.

details.title: Project8088: Finding Aidia Le
details.short_description: A fast first-person arcade shooter where you transfer into a quantum state and fight inside the hardware. Stack buffs, gain augmentations, and push through 16 levels of routers, rigs, and servers to find Aidia Le.

details.title: The Minesweeper's Tale
details.short_description: From the clues, reveal an imaginary map zone by zone in this minesweeper-variant logic game, where each solved region transforms a grid into a work of cartographic art.

details.title: GONE
details.short_description: This is a story about self-discovery, wrapped in the guise of family. You step into the shoes of Gu Huixing. Watching my life unfold as an outsider, re-examining trivial days from an omniscient perspective — what will I become? Life is never a dead end. It is always a choice.

details.title: Space Burger
details.short_description: Run a burger joint in zero gravity with your friends. Jetpack around a tiny spaceship, stack floating burgers, feed chatty aliens and keep the place in one piece while meteors, fires and hull breaches tear it apart.

details.title: A day at preschool
details.short_description: Welcome to A Day at Preschool. Care for the cutest yet most troublesome creatures—human toddlers. With strange requests and emotions that turn into tears, use light logic and simple puzzles to organize everything and guide them through a chaotic but adorable day.

details.title: Dawn of the West
details.short_description: Fight for control of the frontier in this competitive multiplayer Wild West FPS where precision gunplay, tactical movement, and class synergy decide every match. Capture objectives, master stamina-based traversal, and dominate the frontier through pure skill.

details.title: Falling Up
details.short_description: Falling Up is a 3D adventure game, your goal is to get to the top of the mountain. There will be a lot of challange duration your trip, you have to either beat them, or be sneaky. Don't be frustracted when you fall from the mountain, you are leveling up each time you fall.

details.title: Melt Down
details.short_description: Melt Down is a slime racing game where you are on a clock to reach the finish line. You are melting: small is fast, big is slow, and you have to finish the race before you turn into a puddle. Dodge hazards, fight off your rival slimes with powerups, and finish before you perish.

details.title: WorldLoop
details.short_description: WorldLoop is a story-driven RPG about cycles, sacrifice, and irreversible choices.

details.title: Pigs On Wings
details.short_description: Pigs On Wings is an open-world cooperative flight sim featuring extraction mechanics and global guerrilla warfare. Work together to pilot a temperamental aircraft: battle ground forces, deliver cargo, repair systems, and upgrade your gear.

details.title: Scattered
details.short_description: Scattered is a short adventure where you explore a tropical island as a cat in search of a litter of hidden kittens. Discover paths to remote locations, dig up pirate treasure, and seek out perfect sleeping spots. Upgrade your skills and show them the way back home.

details.title: Snowboard Rogues
details.short_description: The snowboarding roguelike. Master your riding skills to survive all threats in a procedurally generated ski resort. Inspired by 90s' FreeSki and modern Roguelikes.

details.title: Jest Messters
details.short_description: A comedy-mystery otome (GxB) visual novel full of dad jokes, cringe puns, and an unexpected mystery! Come and join the pun!

details.title: Eighth Pole
details.short_description: Eighth Pole is a realistic horse racing simulator where you train, race, and breed horses as you build your stable and rise through the ranks of the racing world.

details.title: Game Breaker: Divine Error
details.short_description: Game Breaker is a humorous, story-driven dark fantasy RPG where every character knows they're in a video game. Exploit glitches and cheats to rewrite the fate of a dying world. Experience a deep narrative with a massive 119-track original soundtrack.

details.title: The Black Breath
details.short_description: Lead a caravan of survivors fleeing from the Black Breath. Manage your resources, explore, and choose your path carefully, as the journey will be unforgiving. When hardships arise, you will rely on a diverse group of heroes willing to give their lives to defend the caravan.

details.title: みちくさワンダラー
details.short_description: The Demon Lord and the Hero are gone. With no mission to fulfill, no world to save, you hunt as you please, eat as you please, and travel as you please. It’s an RPG where you are free to do anything.

details.title: The Demon Party
details.short_description: The Demon Lord has vanished, and the Demon Lord’s Castle has fallen into chaos. Become Lethe, a demon girl, dominate defeated monsters, form your own Demon Party, and raise a new demon army!

details.title: Over The Blackboard
details.short_description: Over the Blackboard is a fun open-world adventure game filled with quests and missions kids love to play, where exploring, solving puzzles, and completing challenges naturally helps them practice math, logic, reading, and more without noticing.

details.title: 遗物路：Relic Road
details.short_description: Relic Road is a roguelike turn-based tower-climbing game centered around equipment and relic building. As players continue to explore, they can recruit various heroes to expand their team, obtain equipment from heroes, encounter different events, and strengthen their forces.

details.title: RSOD
details.short_description: Shoot, crack, and quest in RSOD, an action game with elements of roleplaying, loot, and anime-style graphics.

details.title: HandFoot
details.short_description: Inspired by 80s and 90s trash horror, HandFoot is a chaotic 3rd person action game where every gun is also a melee weapon. Shoot, smash, throw, climb, and sneak through gore-soaked battles with bullet-time, stealth gameplay, and puzzle-solving along the way.

details.title: 四合 Quadrangle
details.short_description: Muni awakens on an unfamiliar campus, drawn into a web of mysteries. Your choices shape relationships and the path of the story. A relationship-driven yuri game.

name: Car Wash Together: Prologue - Early Days

details.title: Car Wash Together: Prologue - Early Days
details.short_description: A free introduction to the full version of Car Cleaner Simulator is your chance to make dreams come true in a fabulously clean business. Run a car wash for Clever Emma in Winston Springs.

details.title: Voidfall
details.short_description: Epic space strategy with 4X elements. Digital implementation of the printed board game by Mindclash Games. Base Game holds the competitive mode with 20 Scenarios and 14 playable factions. 1-4 players. AI opponent with 4 difficulty levels. Cross-platform and live and asynchronous gaming.

details.title: Aiyoe's Secret Room
details.short_description: Locked-room mystery meets sweet romance in this immersive visual novel! Solve tricky chamber puzzles and meet lively girls. Dynamic sprites, multiple endings shaped by your choices. Want more? The official anime adaptation is on Crunchyroll. Search X&Y for extra stories!

details.title: Rings of Heaven
details.short_description: A multiplayer roguelike action platformer with a focus on teamwork and cooperation. Play as angel vtuber Amai Lilia and friends and take on heaven's deadliest gauntlet, the Rings of Heaven.

details.title: Bus Station Simulator
details.short_description: In Bus Station Simulator, take over a forgotten bus station and bring it back to life - solo or in co-op! Take care of passengers, your fleet, and the infrastructure as you transform a rundown terminal into the beating heart of Winston Springs.

details.title: HellHeart Breaker
details.short_description: HellHeart Breaker - the monster girls you date grant you newfound powers, and the girls you don't... are the bosses you fight! In this dungeon-crawler roguelite, you are locked away at the bottom of the Underworld, fighting your way out. If all is fair in love and war - what will you do?

name: Floor Plan: Slap Out Of It!

details.title: Floor Plan: Slap Out Of It!
details.short_description: A slap-and-solve adventure that stretches your wits and your noodly arms in all directions. Explore impossible towers where every floor is a comedy sandbox of secrets. Meet strange characters and solve (or add to) their problems with a personal touch. The power to change everything is in your hands.

details.title: Space Arcade
details.short_description: A 3D arcade space shooter where you defend your base against endless waves of enemy ships. Earn credits, buy upgrades and perks between waves and fight Boss Waves a every few waves. Play alone, in split screen with up to 4 players on one PC, or online with friends.

details.title: Kingsbane
details.short_description: Raid gothic fortresses in a 2D action-platformer RPG. Choose from heroes with distinct fighting styles, hunt for rare gear, and defeat the infernal kings. Replay stages to try new routes and builds. Play solo or team up with up to three friends in local or online co-op.

details.title: Rance Quest Magnum
details.short_description: Rance sets off on another grand (though not always grave) adventure across the Continent to find a cure for the curse and get his life back in order!

details.title: Black Dawn Rises
details.short_description: The action game where you write the orders. Sign tomorrow's order as written or change it, then fight the mission your choice made: free-flow combat, a whip that binds, and Iona Sorn at your side. Since 1947, secret files have said what happens next. Arena co-op for two, on one couch or online.

details.title: Estancia Protocol Zero
details.short_description: A first-person survival horror set in Neuquén, Argentine Patagonia. Venture into a remote estate in Cerro Ocaso to search for your missing partner. Face hordes of the undead, manage your resources, and solve classic puzzles to survive the nightmare.

details.title: Forged from Monsters
details.short_description: Not every sword begins as steel. Forge weapons from monster parts with hands-on control over every step of the process. Discover surprising effective combinations of creature parts heroes bring to your smithy.

details.title: Tame or Conquered
details.short_description: You got isekai'd, only to wake up as a cursed saintess. You have 6 months to choose a husband from 7 yandere red flags.. or become a big tree and die. A "simple" psychological horror & dark romance VN.

details.title: Ground Drone Operator: UGV Simulator
details.short_description: Co-op combat UGV simulator. One drone - several operators. Configure your ground drone for the mission and split roles between platform, weapon station, and equipment. Run robotic assaults, escorts, supply runs, evacuations and raids behind enemy lines.

details.title: War Wolves
details.short_description: An online ranked third-person arena shooter where you pilot an armored robotic wolf. Compete in modes like Free For All, Team Deathmatch, and Capture the Flag, control map power weapons, grab combat pickups, and outmaneuver rivals with fluid sprinting, sliding, clambering, jumping, and rolling.

details.title: Astral Dive
details.short_description: Join Atlas and his companions in Astral Dive, a charming hand-drawn pixel art fantasy RPG. Experience innovative turn-based combat powered by magic cards, explore wondrous worlds beyond the astral portals, and uncover the secrets of the magic academy.

details.title: Secret Files: Tunguska - Remastered
details.short_description: The award-winning adventure classic returns as a remaster with modernized visuals and updated technology. Join Nina and Max on a globe-spanning investigation filled with puzzles, conspiracies, and danger – and uncover the secret of Tunguska that changes everything!

details.title: SERPENTER
details.short_description: A fast, colorful 3D snake adventure across 9 floating worlds and 63 levels! Dodge crumbling floors, slippery ice and wild hazards, unleash power-ups, tackle endless runs and daily challenges, or play with up to 4 friends. Help Zip find Ray!

details.title: BlightMist Idle
details.short_description: Every drop feeds something. Ore becomes ingots becomes gear becomes power. Monster parts become permanent power. Seven classes, six life skills (just in Act 1 alone), talent trees, card collection, and much more — all compounding, while you're on and offline.

details.title: Off Tape: Welcome
details.short_description: Stock the shelves. Watch the cameras. Tell the humans from the things wearing their faces. Decide who to serve, and eliminate the rest. Off Tape: Welcome is a retro horror shop sim where you run the store for the Tobacconists, owners who don't know you exist.

details.title: The Five Monks
details.short_description: A settlement simulation about five monks who survived a burning monastery and set out across the continent. Generate a world, gather scattered companions, and raise a new sanctuary from the ashes. Rebuild a broken world with the hands of those who survived.

details.title: Zombie Princess
details.short_description: Raise a daughter infected with a zombie virus in this dark fantasy raising simulation. Over 5 years, balance your daily care in secret with dangerous expeditions. Will you cure her humanity, or help her rise as an immortal zombie queen? Discover over 60 unique endings!

details.title: Neubo
details.short_description: Neubo is a 3D puzzle-platformer game based on the interaction of materials and dynamic gravity changes. You control a ball that moves through levels consisting of cubic blocks, enemies, and other obstacles. Your goal is to collect all the keys and reach the exit.

details.title: The Nightmare Arena
details.short_description: The Ancients have awoken! Face their wrath in The Nightmare Arena, a tactical roguelike deckbuilder. Journey through the Realms collecting cards and facing endless waves of enemies.

details.title: A FAREWELL TO AI
details.short_description: It began with something strange. Something unsettling. In a future where drawing is forbidden, you dare to take up your pen and join the revolution. Solve mysteries. Complete drawing missions. This story needs your art. No one else's.

details.title: Bunny Bring Bits
details.short_description: You are a grumpy rabbit restoring the game world. Clean up rubbish, wipe away dirt with a rag, recycle junk into elements of the world, and activate mechanisms. And after the heroes' fight with the boss, don't forget to clean up the unlucky heroes.

details.title: Infernal Corridor
details.short_description: An incremental roguelite with automatic, real-time card combat. Carry your flame through the corridors of hell, slay demons and claim your revenge.

details.title: Scary Zombie Shooting Game
details.short_description: Build your defences, buy guns and kit out your survivors in this top-down pixel-art zombie survival game. When night falls, the dead emerge from the trees and your people do the shooting. Watch your strategy unfold, hold out for rescue, or stay and see how long you can last.

details.title: Vorynth : Ashfall
details.short_description: Choose from 12 classes, plan every turn and hunt rare loot in a dark fantasy RPG. Explore hand-built dungeons, reforge your gear and push into harder difficulty tiers. Play solo offline or team up with up to three friends in online co-op.

details.title: Spotlight Tennis
details.short_description: Spotlight Tennis is a classic tennis game. Upgrade your skills, play to win, and become a champion!

details.title: Lord of the Mountain
details.short_description: Lead your dwarven clan back into the mountain the dragons took. Build a stronghold in the dark and filter the spore-filled air to claim ground. Then hold the line as the dragon sends its fungus-infected hordes against you. A dwarven survival RTS with pause.

details.title: Ghost Activity
details.short_description: Ghost Activity is a next-gen horror game where you capture paranormal evidence through a bodycam. Explore realistic, haunted environments, survive terrifying jumpscares, and compete with other paranormal journalists to climb the leaderboards!

details.title: Round Table Rivals
details.short_description: Round Table Rivals is a turn-based fighting game where your strategy starts the combo — but your timing keeps it alive. Build your team, chain attacks, take down powerful bosses, and challenge your friends in head-to-head battles.

details.title: Driftholm
details.short_description: Build a cozy town on a floating island. Place buildings where they suit their neighbors, grow hamlets into cities, pull new land in from the clouds and keep your island balanced as it drifts through the seasons. Alone or with a friend.

details.title: Paper Lanes
details.short_description: A transport strategy game: draw trade routes on 30 hand-drawn maps of real regions, from the Aegean to Malacca, and keep caravans and ships moving goods to towns that need them. Routes, vehicles and ports are scarce, so every redraw counts. Play solo or in online co-op for up to 4.

details.title: Hazel Rush
details.short_description: You need to explore the world, outsmart your environment and uncover secrets to unlock new paths to reach your next destination, gather crucial knowledge, craft different structures, and survive hidden dangers.

details.title: Tales Of Eight
details.short_description: Tales of Eight is an action roguelite, naval battle game. As one of the last pirates you are fighting against the dreaded Feline Empire. Fight on the high seas with customizable magical canons, upgrade your ship, explore the ever-changing ocean, and trade with factions all to save Piratedom.

details.title: TOBARI and the Vampire Alchemist
details.short_description: I want to be your friend. But I want to eat you… Discover the end of a twisted friendship in this story driven adventure. Deep in the forest, an alchemist hides a monster: Tobari. Gather silver coins. Find a cure for an incurable disease.

details.title: The Great Exhibition
details.short_description: You are the head curator of a museum. Gather ancient artifacts to expand your collection by raiding temples of long-lost civilizations with your friends.

details.title: Obliteration Quest
details.short_description: Deliver utter obliteration through unique synergies, fully procedural and destructible environment and 4 unique characters in this hack&slash action roguelite. choose between 7 elemental power ups, lots of items and passive upgrades and destroy anything in your way.

details.title: Dragon Football
details.short_description: Dragon Football is a single-player football auto battler with no-holds-barred combat. Recruit unhinged, superpowered animals. Kill opponents, send them flying, and score a goal while you are at it. Matches play out automatically. The goal count decides who wins.

details.title: Catch Succubus
details.short_description: "Catch the Succubus" is a first-person comedy horror game. The mischievous succubus has designed a variety of gameplay for you, including memory puzzles, platforming, dark navigation, and more. You win as long as you catch her.

details.title: Afterfolk
details.short_description: Renovate a Forgotten Village. Restore crumbling homes, shape the landscape, and build something new. Farm, fish, craft, and welcome new neighbours as you uncover forgotten stories and help lingering spirits find peace. Bring the village back to life, your way. Play solo or with friends.

details.title: Color Parade
details.short_description: Color Parade is a cheerful two-player co-op painting adventure! Play as a young painter and an adorable pup: spray paint, leave colorful pawprints, and bring a colorless world back to life. Explore vibrant themed maps, tackle painting challenges together, or face off in playful contests!

details.title: Bum Dog
details.short_description: Bum Dog, an old time vagabond of modest means, defiant fists, and dogged spirit returns to his shelter to discover his true love missing. Now he must punch, scratch, bite, and summon elemental powers beyond his comprehension to set this wrong to right.

details.title: Only One Hero
details.short_description: Build an army around three Heroes in a dark fantasy roguelite autobattler. Assign Jobs, buy abilities and gear, and prepare for real-time battles that fight themselves. Soldiers die for good. After each major act, execute one of your Heroes until only one remains.

details.title: Area [No Love]
details.short_description: Fall in love, and you explode?! Explosive Love Cells have made love itself a danger and a crime. A boy who swore off romance gets tangled up with three girls... Will you survive? No Love Virus is a visual novel where you must keep affection just right to win a heroine's heart.

details.title: Burning Skies
details.short_description: Burning Skies is a frantic roguelite bullet hell. Build the ultimate warjet, mix weapons and enhancements every run, take down giant bosses and overthrow the tyrants who rule the world.

details.title: Ibboran
details.short_description: The Empire is aflame! Lead your fantastical troops through a 15-battle, turn-based strategy campaign. Build your army by achieving objectives to fill your Treasury. Recruit mercenaries to tilt the battle in your favor and use your General to improve your units or blast the enemy. To war!

details.title: Super Bio-Man
details.short_description: Super Bio-Man is the ultimate gunslinger and the guardian of our galaxy. Using his arsenal and metal fist, he shows the invaders from outer space - who's the boss here.

details.title: Star Shift Freelancers
details.short_description: In a galaxy where loyalty is tested and alliances shift like stars, Captain Max Triton and his crew find themselves embroiled in a sea of treachery. When their own government betrays them, Triton and his crew must forge their own path, or lose everything.

details.title: Battle Titan:RAINBOW
details.short_description: Defeat the overwhelming forces of the ASURA Cult with the Cursed Battle Titan: RAINBOW !

details.title: Speed Golf Royale
details.short_description: Ready, set, swing! Whack the ball and dash through chaotic courses. Scored on shots taken and how fast you reach the flag. Outplay your rivals in a fast-paced, fun scramble to victory!

details.title: The Forgemage
details.short_description: An auto-battler roguelite of rune-forged magic. As a Forgemage, carve runes and chain their power into your spells until they break every law of magic. Walk into the horde alone and unleash what you forged.

details.title: GRUBWERK
details.short_description: Manufacture the tools and assemble the bombs that will raise our great nation above all others. You and your comrades will expand our new munitions factory in the eastern block.

details.title: Uncounted Isles
details.short_description: A first-person RPG at the edge of the known world. Explore a vast archipelago from frontier towns to forgotten ruins. Wield swords and sorcery, shape your fate and fight your way through a branching story that will leave scars on your character.

details.title: Cafe Simulator
details.short_description: Build and decorate your shop, diversify your products through alliances, and make the right investments to expand your business.

name: Journey to the West(暴躁西游)

details.title: Journey to the West(暴躁西游)
details.short_description: A classic nostalgic side scroll game！
developers: 冲锋牛独立游戏工作室
publishers: 冲锋牛独立游戏工作室

details.title: The Main Menu
details.short_description: The Main Menu is a psychological horror thriller where you wake up trapped in a room with only a corrupted main menu to interact with. Changing the menu physically changes the room around you. Manipulate its buttons and hidden systems to solve puzzles and uncover what controls the screen.

details.title: Starry-巡星之旅
details.short_description: 为了打倒毁灭世界的大魔王，少年和少女们踏上长长的旅途，开启了一段跨越两个世界的恋爱、幻想奇谭。 本作品搭载了中日语的文本和配音，L2D动态立绘以及超过200张的基本CG；此外还有立绘触碰等独特系统。

details.title: Bloodloader
details.short_description: A fast top-down roguelite where every rifle shot is earned with the bayonet. Stab to load, shoot to kill: build a weapon from a bayonet and a rifle, take favours from four old powers and climb four hellish realms to take your flight back from the Redeemer.

details.title: The Outcast Bloom
details.short_description: Build an ever-growing defense network, meet and level loyal companions and discover a deep loot system. Featuring many different enemy types, abilities, environmental affixes and card choices.

details.title: [ABERRATION] THE ANALYST
details.short_description: Dexton-City vanished, leaving a 14.2-meter void. As a PRISM analyst, process Agent Meg Simons' final hours through the EYESYS simulation. Survive the psychological terror and brutal trials of a Class C4 Hive Mind. An [ABERRATION] case by FEIGIN ENTERTAINMENT.

details.title: Eterno
details.short_description: A first-person fantasy RPG where you carve your own legend in a living world. Explore dangerous dungeons, shape your reputation, and choose your path between honor and ambition.

details.title: WarVara
details.short_description: A dark survival action game set in a world overrun by infection. Progress through story-driven levels, complete objectives, fight infected enemies in close combat, and use stealth to eliminate threats.

details.title: Strawberry Cafe
details.short_description: Build your own strawberry cafe and farm in this cozy, casual management sim. Grow strawberries for customers to pick, or harvest your homegrown strawberries to cook delicious strawberry-themed food and drinks. Complete missions and keep customers happy to unlock new furniture and recipes.

details.title: Raking Fire
details.short_description: Asynchronous PvP Space Armada Battler. Build your armada, invite your friends... and destroy them

details.title: X Marks the Orc
details.short_description: An auto-battler roguelite. Call a play, mark who dies first, give each hero an order, then watch the fight unfold. Between fights, buy and upgrade units to grow your party.

details.title: BLACKBELL
details.short_description: A gothic cartoon auto-battler roguelite. Build a company of strange fighters, stack Traits for powerful bonuses, merge copies into 2★ and 3★ forms, and fight your way through a haunted world ruled by the BLACKBELL.

details.title: Age of the Ancients
details.short_description: A real-time strategy in four ages: gather five resources, raise walls and a castle, command your army with stances and formations — and when your shaman speaks to the stones, call the night down on your enemy instead of yourself. Seed-generated worlds, a map editor, English and Hungarian.

details.title: No one outside
details.short_description: A co-op survival horror game set in a large reactive city. Explore, loot, drive, build defenses, and survive massive hordes when night falls.

details.title: Hoppkins: Twinkle World
details.short_description: Hoppkins: Twinkle World is a charming 3D platform adventure where you explore colorful worlds, leap across platforms, use unique abilities and vehicles, and face challenging enemies. Join Mr. Hoppkins and venture beyond the clouds to rescue his beloved!

details.title: Wait, My Gun's Gone?
details.short_description: Survive endless waves of zombies in a chaotic PvE FPS, alone or with up to 3 friends. Run out of ammo, and you get a new random gun. Buy ammo to keep your favorite. In co-op, one player's empty gun triggers a reroll for everyone. Explore the map, buy upgrades, and discover the secret to escape.

details.title: Jennifer Against Space Aliens
details.short_description: Jennifer Against Space Aliens is an action-packed, third person, sci-fi shooter with 1980s vibes. Run, drive, shoot and blow things up inside space stations, spaceships and distant planets.

details.title: A Minor War
details.short_description: An auto battler where your build is the music. Give each instrument a phrase of notes, then lock it in and listen to your ensemble fight another player's. Your trumpet sounds out every Fireball you gave it, and your drum keeps time with its Blocks.

details.title: Splatterdunk
details.short_description: 90s-arcade 2-on-2 or 3 -on -3 basketball where the players are monsters and the fouls are fatal. Chain trick dunks, arm Fatalities, bribe the ref and dunk on monsters through the glass while VAT-9, a robot announcer who used to be a star, calls it. Up to 6 players, couch or online. Bring a mop.

details.title: Gemstroids
details.short_description: An incremental space-mining game: blow up a field of rocks, wave after wave. One good shot at a bomb sets off a chain across the screen, and every cleared wave pays more than the last. Between sessions, build your ship, beat the zone's guardian and fly with Otto the otter to the Heart of the Void.

details.title: Gangs of Nightglade
details.short_description: A card battler where you fight with poker hands. Deploy your gang members, build poker hands with them and sabotage your opponent's attempts to complete theirs. In the story campaign, you lead a gang trying to solve the mystery of its former leader's disappearance.

details.title: Tales of the Southern Seas
details.short_description: Build trade routes, recruit companions and refit your fleet in a single-player sailing adventure set in the late-Ming Southern Seas. Navigate wind, waves and strange encounters. Will you turn the sea into a ledger—or learn to live alongside it?

details.title: Alamare: The Wayfarer's Hand
details.short_description: Command mythic creatures in a single-player roguelite card battler. Choose your attacks, play support cards, and ascend into stronger forms mid-battle. Collect new cards, build your deck, and chart your path through dangerous expeditions across fallen realms.

details.title: Save the Red Box
details.short_description: Reach the red portal and the level turns on you. Every stage is a round trip: get there normally, then fight your way back through chaos mode, where the room mutates into black silhouettes, new traps and warped sound. 0.5-second respawns. No upgrades, just get good.

details.title: DAYON
details.short_description: DAYON is a multiplayer sandbox set in a walled, near-future city where everyday life, ownership, combat, and exploration come together. Create your own character by combining dozens of skills instead of following fixed classes or levels. Live your way in a city synced with real-world time.

details.title: Stack Coffee Shop
details.short_description: Run a coffee shop from backyard to table. Grow ingredients, turn your harvest into drinks and food, and serve your customers by stacking cards. Hire employees and connect conveyor belts to automate every step from growing to serving.

details.title: Line Story
details.short_description: Follow number clues and connect the dots to reveal hidden illustrations in this cozy, hand-drawn logic puzzle game. Bring Lili and Nene's storybook world to life, one drawing at a time.

details.title: Ball of Goof
details.short_description: A game you've never played before! Explore this world with up to 4 peeps (that's slang for people) in this comedically-driven open world sandbox by platforming through challenging challenges, unlock new abilities & uncover the delicious lore behind the ultimate question... What is a Ball of Goof?

name: Mystic Land: The Search for Maphaldo

details.title: Mystic Land: The Search for Maphaldo
details.short_description: An old-school RPG inspired by Wizardry 7, Might and Magic and Eye of the Beholder series. 2d grid-based movement, strategic turn-based combat and lots of places to visit and puzzles to solve.

details.title: Gateworlds
details.short_description: Gateworlds is a colony sim about exploring and surviving a fantasy wilderness. Find your way in a world of floating islands, strange creatures, and fickle gods.

details.title: Trailblazers: Into the March
details.short_description: Embark on a thrilling adventure in this roguelite colony-sim strategy game. Command your Landship in tactical battles, care for a crew composed of all sorts of characters, shape your home, manage resources, and lead expeditions into the March. Discover what lies at its heart... and in yours.

details.title: Heroes Of Isekai
details.short_description: An auto-battler with roguelike elements, and no unit cap. Run your camp, buy creatures, buildings, spells, gear and runes, assemble your build — then crush your enemies!

details.title: RoRX
details.short_description: A competitive strategy game where both players plan in secret, then every order resolves at once. Build an army of Robots from over 200 cards, fight on hexagonal arenas and outthink your rival, not outclick them. Every card is earned by playing.

name: Shadow Sacrament: The Roots of Evil

details.title: Shadow Sacrament: The Roots of Evil
details.short_description: Shadow Sacrament is a grim horrorvania where you play as a tormented detective who must investigate the secrets of an ancient, horrific monastery. Explore hidden chambers, solve intricate puzzles, and face terrifying nightmares that lurk in its shadowy halls. Hunt the Haunt.

details.title: Solace Creek
details.short_description: A PSX-stylized horror mystery set in the lonely Taraset Station. Haunted by a monstrous presence, with six mysterious red coins, you embark on a tense and deliberate journey. Solace Creek is a retro-inspired horror title with a focus on exploration, atmosphere & puzzle solving.

details.title: Rogue Wheels
details.short_description: Rogue Wheels is a turn based roguelike deckbuilder where your car is your character and timing driven combat defines every run. Build fun and crazy decks!

details.title: UNCRACKED
details.short_description: Crack your enemies with an arsenal of weapons and various tactics in this 2D egg-splosive, gore-filled, yet kid-friendly action platformer, teeming with splattering yolk and shattering eggshels and survive the fierce cage wars.

details.title: Agecraft
details.short_description: Agecraft is a city-builder strategy where you guide a settlement through thousands of years of human history. Manage individual citizens, grow your economy, trade or wage war with other states, and advance from the Stone Age to the Space Age.

name: Silent Planet - Elegy of a Dying World

details.title: Silent Planet - Elegy of a Dying World
details.short_description: Silent Planet is an exploration-focused, gothic sci-fi metroidvania rooted in Cosmic Horror. Explore the claustrophobic corridors of a massive underground complex filled with the remnants of technological and biological horrors created by a dead civilization.

details.title: Tidebound
details.short_description: Chill, catch, sell, upgrade! Tidebound is a fishing game with a relaxing, cozy atmosphere where you upgrade your boat, and sail further to fish for more expensive and exotic sea animals. Casual yet engaging, the game offers a sense of progress with tons of equipment and hundreds of species to catch.

details.title: PROJECT MIX
details.short_description: PROJECT MIX is a VR anime narrative adventure. Can you find happiness after losing everything you once had?

details.title: Gunmetal Gothic
details.short_description: A co-op shooter-RPG with a retro-3D aesthetic. Customize and upgrade your character as you take back the city of Vestige from demonic machines!

details.title: GearGrit
details.short_description: Tansy Geargrit, charged with some crimes she did commit, and some she didn't... Explore, platform, and blast your way through GearGrit, an Action Platformer inspired by your favorite PS2 games!

details.title: Infinitum: The Backrooms Story
details.short_description: INFINITUM is a horror open-world survival co-op story game for up to 4 players. Explore Infinite procedurally generated levels and uncover multiple endings, with every playthrough offering a unique experience.

details.title: Football Tactics: Dare to Dream
details.short_description: A turn-based football tactics roguelite with superpowers. Move your five kids across the grid, check your odds, then pass, lob, volley and shoot. Break the rules with lasers, meteors and unsaveable overhead kicks, and build your squad between matches.

details.title: Become
details.short_description: Become is a short single-player third-person adventure where you embark on life's most fantastical journey, as one of millions of sperm. Survive the perilous microcosm, wiggle, dash, and outcompete rivals through the human reproductive system to create new life.

details.title: The Expanse: Osiris Reborn
details.short_description: The Expanse: Osiris Reborn is a third-person Action RPG set in The Expanse universe. You’re no hero — just a merc caught in the wrong place at the wrong time, trying to hold your crew together and keep the ship up and running. Your choices will shape your story.

details.title: ICEWAKE
details.short_description: Steer a nuclear icebreaker across a frozen, sunken world. Dive a tiny sub into drowned cities for salvage, save the sick in underwater towns — and survive what hunts in the deep: a monster that hatches from the dead, grows, and one day comes for your ship.

details.title: Wallstrike
details.short_description: A fast-paced wallball game for up to 8 players. Strike the ball with one hand, bounce it off the ground and into the wall, and send it beyond the next player's reach. Play locally or compete online, eliminate your rivals, and build your career to become world champion!

details.title: My Penguin Friend
details.short_description: Jump into the adorable flippers of Dindim. Think like a penguin and tackle tricky physics puzzles across the gorgeous deep waters and sunny beaches of a tropical fishing village. Leave little footprints as you build a cosy nest, and gather keepsakes to discover a heartwarming story about friendship.

details.title: Where is Starlingdive
details.short_description: A college radio DJ has vanished, but the school says she withdrew. Search forum posts and confidential records to uncover the people behind anonymous handles. Piece together what happened to Starlingdive in a deduction mystery spanning three connected cases, from college radio to the music industry.

details.title: Bladehold
details.short_description: Demolish monstrous hordes on horseback or foot, unleash devastating abilities, build the ultimate hero, and protect your fortress with deadly automated defenses in this fast-paced action roguelite.

details.title: We'll Meet Again
details.short_description: When someone takes their own life, the pain doesn't end with them. It passes to those left behind. A short story about the guilt, anger and unanswered questions of the people who stay.

details.title: Necrolord
details.short_description: Command an undead army in this dark fantasy auto-battler roguelite. Raise fallen enemies, equip your troops and turn battles with powerful spells. Explore procedurally generated lands. Lose your army, reincarnate and rebuild with your retained magic and lich abilities.

details.title: The Fallen Merman
details.short_description: An officially licensed visual novel based on Lin Qian's The Fallen Merman. A distress call from an abandoned aquarium reunites Bai Chunian and Lanbo. In a world of genetic modification and supernatural powers, relive their journey from wary encounters to a love that defies species and death.

details.title: Pantania:wedge of time
details.short_description: Fulfill your mission, scavenge for supplies.With the power to control time, you can be a savior who saves people—or a ruthless monster who slaughters them all.

details.title: Wizard Warrior
details.short_description: A pixel-art roguelike deckbuilder of spells and steel. Spells spend mana, weapons spend stamina, and hovering a card shows every blow before you throw it. Cross eight realms on a face-down road, fell each realm's guardian, and earn nine more playable houses, each growing its own way.

details.title: Neon Siege
details.short_description: Connect the dots, close the lines, obliterate everything caught inside: a real-time, wave-based roguelite. Between waves, expand a massive talent tree, procedurally generated every run.

details.title: Kinhenge
details.short_description: You don't play a hero, you play a bloodline. Kinhenge is an online survival game that starts in the Stone Age: survive hunger, cold and rain, raise heirs and share a living island with NPCs who have a trade, remember what they live through and build villages of their own.

details.title: Nella & Smudge
details.short_description: Play as Nella and her cat Smudge in an isometric stealth-horror adventure inside a paper building. Switch between them to sneak, hide from the Manager, solve puzzles with light and darkness, and make tools from what you find as you follow her missing dad's trail.

details.title: Rewind to Coding
details.short_description: It’s 2010 and AI isn’t a thing yet. You’re a developer who looks for answers in documentation, web searches and your brain. Build your career, solve problems in JavaScript, pay bills and choose your own path to success.

details.title: Analog Overdrive: Signal Barrage
details.short_description: A space arcade bullet heaven where weapon evolutions are earned on the battlefield. Combine weapons and Support Modules, hunt the enemies carrying your evolutions and dash through the swarm. Keep your kill chain alive and chase a higher score.

details.title: BosaTella Loopa
details.short_description: Junk Robots. Monster Hordes. Unhinged Firepower. Team up in this co-op looter shooter to get filthy rich, discover absurd weaponry, and blast away the dangerous monsters that lurk within "The Loop". Tear through the subway, catch the train (or don't), and blow all your money on even more firepower.

details.title: Cordonfall
details.short_description: Type in your address and defend your own street. Cordonfall turns any real neighbourhood on OpenStreetMap into a zombie siege: make a building your HQ, put soldiers on the rooftops, fortify by day, and hold out for ten nights as the horde grows every dusk.

details.title: The Lost Study
details.short_description: A forgotten study. Lost because no one remembers it. Solve puzzles, recover stories, and restore it — one chapter at a time. 14 stories, 14 worlds. Cozy, eerie, funny, and strange. They seem completely unrelated. Until they're not.

details.title: Bash Moto
details.short_description: Tear up the West Coast in a 90s-themed beat'em up motorcycle racing game. Kick, punch, and bash rival bikers to claim the cash prize while dodging traffic, obstacles and hot-pursuit cops. Wreck your ride or run out of cash for bail, and it is game over.

details.title: Basement To The Sky
details.short_description: A bright afternoon, perfect weather. With your parents away, you’re left with a rocket toy you received as a birthday gift. Build your own rocket and launch it high into the sky! Enjoy delicious homemade meals and work part-time jobs to upgrade your rocket. Can your rocket reach outer space?

details.title: Arkhanium
details.short_description: Arkham lies in ruins; humanity has lost the battle. Now is the time to perform the ritual to summon the Great Old Ones in a turn-based, tactical PvP battle. Establish your dominion and seize power over the Earth!

details.title: FIREDAMP
details.short_description: Ostrava region, November 1994. Following a methane explosion, the entire shift—including your younger brother—remains trapped in the Terezie mine. Descend 900 meters underground with a headlamp, a canary, and a pickaxe. The buried can't see you, but they can hear you.

details.title: Orbitfall
details.short_description: Launch your fleets into orbit and let physics fly them. Low orbits are fast, high orbits slow, and every meeting counts down on the map. Seven factions, up to eight players against AI or friends online: claim the planet, bomb it from orbit and outplan everyone.

details.title: Used Car Empire
details.short_description: You cannot see the car. You can only read it. Buy used cars off strangers, work out what is wrong with them before it costs you, and decide what to tell the next owner. A 2D deduction game about the motor trade, in a small town that remembers every car you sell.

details.title: Mobile Phone Shop Simulator
details.short_description: Build and manage your own mobile phone shop! Buy, sell and expand your business in this detailed simulation game. Balance profits, manage your team, and become the best shop in town.

details.title: Just Another Guild Day
details.short_description: Run a guild in a small village bordering the Demon King’s lands. Assign quests, train adventurers, manage loot, brew potions, gather intelligence, and prepare your people to survive the next monster attack.

details.title: Jade Cutting Simulator
details.short_description: Your grandfather has retired. The jade workshop is yours to run. Guide the saw along your own line and rinse the cut to see what's inside. Sell a good stone to fund your next find, or keep that streak of green for a bangle customers will remember? The future of the shop is up to you.

details.title: Console Dealer
details.short_description: Run a secondhand games shop in 2003, where every sale is a negotiation. Read the customer, hold your price or fold, buy low across the counter and at auction, and keep a shelf that moves before the rent comes due. A first-person shop sim about haggling, stock and margins.

details.title: Solitaire
details.short_description: Unwind with Klondike, Spider, FreeCell, Pyramid and TriPeaks. Choose a deal by difficulty, take your time, and enjoy the simple pleasure of putting the cards in order, with hints and undo whenever you need a little help.

details.title: Sluggernauts
