details.short_description: Arcade roguelike baseball. Lead the Hickory Creek Squirrels, a small town minor league team and Earth's last hope. Take a randomized road trip and upgrade your team with powerful gear combinations. Hit, pitch, and field to beat otherworldly teams with unfair advantages.

details.title: Pennants Of Glory: Condottiere
details.short_description: Run a medieval mercenary company with Battle Brothers-style management in a living world. Command up to 600 soldiers in Total War-style real-time 3D formation battles as factions wage wars, besiege towns, and reshape campaign. Break formations with unique stance mechanics.

name: Five Hearts Under One Roof season3

details.title: Five Hearts Under One Roof season3
details.short_description: Mal-sook and Gran return for the finale, feelings deeper than ever! After a work disaster, Yuman heads to Jeju with Gran, only for Mal-sook to appear and reignite their love triangle. New faces enter the mix as old bonds change. This time, choose where your heart belongs.

details.title: Trust me, Officer
details.short_description: Scissors, Stamps, and Signatures. You're a brilliant (possibly) forger who creates passports, visas, and official documents for people the system has turned away. Cut out stamps, forge signatures, retouch photos, and put every document to the test before handing it over.

details.title: TwinLock
details.short_description: TwinLock is a two-player cooperative puzzle adventure set in an abandoned gothic castle. Separated inside its halls, you and your partner have nothing but a walkie-talkie each. Every puzzle hides half its answer on the other side of the wall.

details.title: The Witch Simulator
details.short_description: Experience the life of a witch in a medieval village, co-op or solo! Gather ingredients, hunt monsters, brew potions to solve villagers' problems while keeping your magic hidden from the Inquisition. Build your reputation, earn passage into the kingdom, and overthrow the Grand Inquisitor.

details.title: Pinetrail
details.short_description: Deliver packages across Pinetrail in an overloaded rusty rickshaw truck! Meet the locals, uncover mysteries, and explore beautiful hidden spots. Use your vehicle's unique abilities to cross rivers, glide over trees, and battle cargo-stealing boars!

details.title: When Two Roses Collide
details.short_description: A BL visual novel set during the War of the Roses. Will love prevail over honour?

details.title: HopScout
details.short_description: HopScout is a cozy logic puzzle game about arranging cute, picky rabbits to keep everyone happy. Take your time solving puzzles, help the rabbit burrow overcome a looming crisis, and discover the heartwarming stories of its adorable residents.

details.title: 徘徊之碑 - Lingering Stele
details.short_description: "Haven't seen you in forever." A narrative-driven RPG about the heart. In a peaceful world where all conflict has come to an end, is there still a chance to make up for the words left unspoken?

details.title: Mountkin
details.short_description: Climbing meets Roguelike: climb a corrupted mountain, restore its nature, and build a character powerful enough to reach the summit. Each run brings new synergies to exploit, and new challenges the mountain throws your way. Fall, learn, grow stronger, and climb again.

details.title: Salvebringer Ninjas
details.short_description: As the outbreak spreads and civilization crumbles, humanity's last hope rests with an order of mysterious ninjas that have been hiding from the world for decades—the Salvebringer Ninjas!

details.title: Squadron 42
details.short_description: Enlist in the UEE Navy in a cinematic, single-player space adventure. Pilot combat ships, fight on foot, and explore capital ships, space stations, and frontier outposts. Live and work alongside your crew as you battle on the front lines of a galactic war.

details.title: Harvest Skies: Crop Dusting Simulator
details.short_description: Job sim? Flight sim? Co-op for 1–4 players? YES. Take farm jobs with friends, upgrade your hangar and grow a fleet. Mostly chill, with the occasional power-line PANIC.

details.title: Total Incremental Battle
details.short_description: Start with a single soldier, end up with a massive army. Strategize and command your units, or let them grind on their own. Progress through many unique progression systems and conquer all the stages.

details.title: After ICEY
details.short_description: After ICEY is a 2D side-scrolling action meta sequel in the ICEY universe. After countless cycles, ICEY defeated Judas and left the world, yet cycles remain. Three bound souls await. Follow the arrows, defeat them, and take their soul crystal masks — this is your mission.

details.title: Elegy of St. Godhrkar
details.short_description: Elegy of St. Godhrkar is an narrative-driven game with a multi-perspective POV system. By uncovering lies hidden within the tale, you gain the power to rewrite characters’ fates and shape the story’s outcome. Where stories LIE, the answer waits for your EYE.

details.title: Midnight Souls
details.short_description: Dive into the secrets of the quiet hamlet of Camomile Peaks! A romantic trip to meet your online crush spirals into a mystical adventure: epic battles, bizarre allies, and dark humor. Win her heart, solve the mysteries, and protect your cat, Charlie!

details.title: Vega Chronicle
details.short_description: Lead your civilization to galactic glory in this bite-sized 4X strategy game. Build, colonize, trade, and, by tact or might, overcome all who oppose you.

details.title: ASUKA x Redline Reverie
details.short_description: Play as Asuka Sakai and take on the mountain roads of Japan. Tune your car, challenge rival racers, climb the rankings, and earn your place at GRACE. A pure touge racing experience.

details.title: Warfactory: Automation RTS
details.short_description: Warfactory is an automation RTS where production defines the war effort. Build assembly lines to forge an army of machines, then feed thousands of units into massive real-time battles where every loss must be replaced by your factory.

details.title: Wingsuit Simulator
details.short_description: The most realistic wingsuit and parachute physics on PC and in VR. Discover perfect lines across a 256 km² island built for proximity flying. Skim cliffs, thread tight gaps, and attempt stunts you’d never risk in real life. Master the community’s lines or surprise them with your own way down.

details.title: GigaTroubleS
details.short_description: A unique giantess girl-themed exploration and puzzle work which integrating the depth of the plot and the diversity of gameplay. the past and present of the protagonist are pieced together. Three character storylines with completely different gameplay and multiple endings.

details.title: Skies of Valoria
details.short_description: "Skies of Valoria" is a fantasy action Roguelite with dynamic builds and fast combat. Soar the clouds on "Aethelwhale", team up with 4 Valkyries across Valoria, and strike the Demon King's Castle! Harness War Souls for endless combos and summon monsters to sweep away all foes.

details.title: Tower Tanks
details.short_description: TEAM UP! BUILD UP! BLOW UP! Tower Tanks is a chaotic co-op vehicle combat roguelike where you and your friends build and crew giant war machines. Work together to customize your tank, power up the engines, put out fires, and man the guns as you blast apart anything in your way!

details.title: Make GAL together!
details.short_description: Make GAL together! is a visual novel where you play as Xiao Lu, an unemployed copywriter. Move in with an energetic producer, a sharp-tongued tsundere artist, and a quiet programmer. Amid the daily chaos, can you create an unforgettable game together?

details.title: Railsiege
details.short_description: You drive an armed war train through a ravaged Wild West, all the way to Fort Alamo. Fit the wagons with turrets, then choose as you go: floor it to outrun the monsters and risk blowing the boiler, or slow down to cut them down and pick up their loot.

details.title: Car Crime Simulator
details.short_description: Steal cars, set up secret stashes, sell vehicles for big profits on demand, or strip them for parts. Build your criminal empire solo or team up with others in co-op mode.

details.title: RAIN HEART
details.short_description: Psychological horror about Alex Bow, who struggles with himself and his traumas.

details.title: Sker: The Bleeding Veil
details.short_description: Evade Sister Gwenllian and her ritual-bound orphans as you use sound to explore, solve harmonic puzzles and survive blind stalkers that hunt by hearing. Sker: The Bleeding Veil is a first-person, stealth-focused survival horror set in the Sker universe.

details.title: RAD: Ascension
details.short_description: Some runs you race the clock. Some you just flow. RAD is a movement game built around speed and experimentation. Pump, jump, swing and glide through neon courses, race leaderboard ghosts, shave milliseconds off every run, and play it all to your own music. Instant restarts; one more run, every time.

details.title: Tessera
details.short_description: Tessera is an open-world sandbox fantasy RPG. Create your own character, explore a seamless hand-crafted continent, gather and craft, delve into ever-changing dungeons, and build a home of your own. Play solo or invite friends into your world.

details.title: PuppetOFF
details.short_description: PuppetOFF — a co-op (1–4 players) survivors-roguelite where the puppet theater stage turns into a battlefield. Play as heroes inspired by classic tales, upgrade your abilities, and mow down thousands of crazed puppets. Collect buttons and spare parts to make it through the show alive.

details.title: I Can Never Love Another
details.short_description: A realistic visual novel based on a true story. As a lawyer trying to save a rock singer from her toxic family, you uncover the suffocating truth of "Codependency." Will you leave, sink into the abyss, or g◼︎ai◻︎n the c#our%ag◼︎e to f◼︎ac◻︎e the p#ai%n? Your choices decide.

details.title: Wild World: Online
details.short_description: A multiplayer third-person werewolf action game. Be the tank who guards and soaks up the damage, pull rivals in with Gravity, or vanish and strike from the shadows. Alone or with your pack, forge your own playstyle. So, how will you hunt?

details.title: SubDuctis
details.short_description: Traverse a puzzling metallic landscape by folding away space itself. Bypass obstacles, form conductive paths, and discover new areas by folding, unfolding, and folding again.

details.title: Hack Fate
details.short_description: Hack Fate is a fast-paced hack-and-slash game with Chinese cyberpunk pixel art. Manipulate the timeline, switch identities, and kill enemies in one hit. Turn traps and foes into weapons and find multiple routes through every level. Ancient myth meets cyberpunk, each choice defying fate.

details.title: Adventurers Guild Inc.
details.short_description: Run the business behind the heroics by managing your own Adventurers Guild! Turn the world's problems into appealing quest and take your cut. Support your adventurers by selling them the services they don't even know they need. Then reinvest your earnings and grow the greatest guild of them all!

details.title: Guns 'n Goblins
details.short_description: Face a deluge of monsters in this incremental horde survivor FPS. Build your Bastion, level up your character, and upgrade your arsenal to rise from Apprentice Bell Ringer to Master Dragon Hunter.

details.title: Prospera
details.short_description: Prospera is a first- & third person citybuilder set in the Victorian era, blending survival, crafting, strategy, management. Rise to an industrial tycoon as you build, manage, and explore your city. Plan production chains, optimize logistics, and ensure prosperity.

details.title: Arcane Ligature
details.short_description: Arcane Ligature is a dark fantasy roguelite deckbuilder where you create your own spells by combining runes. Experiment with powerful fusions, master strategic turn-based combat, collect magical relics and battle through an ever-changing world where every run brings new possibilities.

details.title: Greyskin
details.short_description: Crawl through countless dungeons, fighting hordes of monsters in this unique, fast-paced Action RPG. Class-up, mutate, and survive as you loot, shoot, upgrade, and repeat. Descend into the depths of a strange and dark world filled with mysteries and uncover its secrets.

details.title: Crazy Lemmings
details.short_description: Control entire horde of lemmings and solve puzzles!

details.title: Isles of Krom
details.short_description: Isles of Krom is a dark fantasy top-down roguelike where progression is carved into the world itself. Master challenging, Souls-inspired combat as your Wards push back the Pestilence, claim each isle's lasting power, and reclaim the Krom Archipelago run after run.

details.title: Superstore Rush
details.short_description: Build, expand, and manage your dream store in Superstore Rush! Unlock groceries, electronics, clothing, and more while serving customers and tackling challenges like spills and power outages. Grow your shop, stock shelves, and rise to the top as the ultimate store manager!

details.title: Poopnauts
details.short_description: Four astronauts teamed up to fix spaceships using... poop? 1-4 players co-op. Every ship is different, so you never know what you will find inside. Finish the job, sell the scrap, and stay away from whatever else is on board. Get to work, poopnaut!

details.title: Oddsmaxxing
details.short_description: The odds manipulating roguelike. Oddsmaxxing lets you flip loaded coins and try to achieve specific outcomes and combos while chasing increasingly egregious targets. Unlock and use special coins to increase your chances in this satisfying gambling roguelike. May the odds be ever in your favor.

details.title: Overdrive: New Earth
details.short_description: OVERDRIVE is a retro 3D combat racing ARPG. Build and weaponize your car, battle rivals who remember your every move, and conquer procedurally generated tracks across five deadly biomes. Every race is a fight for survival. Every victory makes you stronger.

name: There's no way that tsundere girl I met in the infirmary will be my girlfriend

details.title: There's no way that tsundere girl I met in the infirmary will be my girlfriend
details.short_description: "B-baka! Who said you could get in!? I'm not prepared yet!" "Oh well... since you're already here, why not stay for a while?" "D-don't misunderstand, okay? It's not like I asked you to stay because I like you or anything..."

details.title: Ship of Theseus
details.short_description: Steal your ship back from other realities, even from yourself. The Theseus is stranded, and every part it needs is held by a crew who needs it too. Rebuild it piece by piece and ask if it is still the same ship. A sci-fi roguelite FPS, solo or online co-op.

details.title: CAT Interstellar: Episode II
details.short_description: A short story inspired by Robert Heinlein's: Starship Trooper

details.title: Project Life
details.short_description: 一款剧情丰富的roguelike互动小说游戏，也是一款拥有无限可能的构史引擎。假如人生可以重来，你将如何选择？主推故事集《中国式人生》，模拟90后/00后/10后的人生，在无数选择中体验一代人的共同记忆！游戏本体故事专为90后00后10后、互联网深度用户、喜欢搞笑抽象风格的玩家打造！

details.title: Rustown
details.short_description: Five years after the “idiot virus” pandemic, a letter arrives from the father you thought was dead. Rustown is a story-driven stealth adventure about finding him in a slum where the infected live. Evade watchful eyes, follow clues, and discover the stories of those caught up in the city's troubles.

name: 气运之子The One of Fortune

details.title: 气运之子The One of Fortune
details.short_description: Step into the mysterious and boundless world of Chinese-style fantasy. Gather the mysterious power of destiny. You can either assume the role of the revered leader of the righteous path, or transform into the powerful Demon Lord of the evil path.

details.title: FOMO
details.short_description: A 1x waste or a 100x investment. Whether you buy or not, you're already playing.

details.title: Smile Run
details.short_description: An endless runner with adorable characters. Run through multiple environments with different play styles. Play two modes of either limited time Gift Delivery or endless Ice Cream mode. Multiple levels of increasing difficulty.

details.title: Mote
details.short_description: Mote is a hard sci-fi, squad-based, turn-based tactical roguelike played on a hexes. Create an species with unique abilities, senses, and combat styles. Command a squad as you explore distant systems, encounter new societies, and choose which factions to help, and which to betray.

name: World of Magic: Rise of Magic

details.title: World of Magic: Rise of Magic
details.short_description: An open-world Medieval Punk Action RPG. Combine and modify spells in real time while enemies adapt to your combat tactics. Choices shape a living fantasy world filled with cities, monsters, and escalating conflict.

details.title: Whispers of Primwood
details.short_description: Escape into art, music, and choice in this spicy romantasy otome. Whispers of Primwood is a seductive tale of trust, betrayal, and shifting morals. A simple delivery leads you into a forest both beautiful and deadly, and toward two dangerously alluring men.. Could a nightmare turn into a dream?

details.title: The Crown
details.short_description: From humble beginnings, rise up to take your place in the city's underworld! Your choices will decide how the story plays out in this Visual Novel about crime in the 2000s East Coast. Choose-Your-Own-Adventure, Stat-driven, Deep Meta-progression.

details.title: Astro Fighters 3
details.short_description: The aliens have returned. Fight through relentless waves of enemies, dodge impossible bullet patterns, unleash devastating special weapons, and unlock 70 powerful cards that reshape future runs in this action-packed arcade shoot 'em up.

details.title: The Last Swordmaster
details.short_description: 《The Last Swordmaster》 is a Chinese wuxia action Roguelite loot game. Set in a world shaped by the Huajian Workshop, you play the final disciple of the Last Swordmaster, wield ancient weapons, build your own martial style, and fight through a blood-ink-corrupted jianghu.

details.title: Kwun Tong: The Origin
details.short_description: My friend is starting a new model shop located in Kwun Tong. But he disappeared since the second day of opening...

details.title: Chechelevo Mainland
details.short_description: Chechelevo Mainland is a procedurally generated sandbox game focused on resource gathering. Carve your path through the landscape, upgrade your robot, uncover hidden stashes, and build your own underground world, progress is saved locally, and every world is unique thanks to seed-based generation.

details.title: Pixel Piracy Online
details.short_description: Pirate MMORPG with zero microtransactions. Set sail alone or with friends, and build your pirate empire using force or trade. In this pirate simulator game, you write your own RPG story.

details.title: Age of Legacy
details.short_description: A turn-based roguelike RPG where every enemy has a plan and you only get one life. Read their tricks, counter them with your abilities and runestones, and fight through a broken kingdom to the general who murdered the King.

details.title: STRAY BULLET
details.short_description: Free-to-play cartoon shooter where YOU are the bullet. Hop, blast off with gunpowder, fly on flames and go kamikaze in online matches for up to 20 players. Earn killstreaks like UAV, helicopter or nuke. Bots and split screen. No pay-to-win.

details.title: REaffraid
details.short_description: REAFFRAID is a THIRD person SURVIVAL HORROR game where you FIGHT Soldiers, Robots, Zombies and SEXY demon girls with powerful weapons and hand to hand fighting techniques.

details.title: Nereus
details.short_description: Set out aboard an old bathyscaphe to find a missing underwater station. Descend into the depths, keep your equipment running, and watch what lurks beyond the portholes. Explore the station and uncover what happened to its crew.

details.title: Stingray Sanctuary
details.short_description: Stingray Sanctuary is a cozy idle management game. Raise stingrays in real time, then stack creatures, plants, and curios into systems that earn and collect money for you. Start small, get rich, and let the island run while you're away, or keep it docked on your desktop as you work.

details.title: Zero Gumbit
details.short_description: A cyberpunk roguelike deckbuilder. Play poker-style hands, stack Chips and Mult with 145 wild Jokers and break eight Antes of Boss Blinds. Swear risky vows in the Gambit, fuse Jokers at the altar. No gambling, no betting, no real money. Just combos.

details.title: Doomsday Sector
details.short_description: Survive relentless waves of U.M.F. cyber-zombies in this gritty, retro-futuristic survival FPS. Play as an elite Vindex soldier, explore a non-linear desert bunker, unlock 18+ weapons including a devastating Microwave Gun, and multi-upgrade your arsenal at the Proto-Max station!

details.title: BrickHub
details.short_description: Build, fight and compete in BrickHub, an online sandbox shooter where players create maps, battle in PvP matches and shape their own arenas.

details.title: StarshipFighter
details.short_description: Build and customize your own starship, then survive escalating waves of enemies and intense boss fights. Unlock new parts, upgrade your loadout, choose your difficulty, and climb the leaderboard in this fast-paced 2D top-down space shooter.

name: Sound of the Night - Nightclub Building & Management Sim

details.title: Sound of the Night - Nightclub Building & Management Sim
details.short_description: Build, design, and manage your own nightclub in a cyberpunk city. Shape your space, grow your business, and turn your club into a thriving nightlife destination.

name: Sonucido: Dreams of the Gray God by Daniel da Silva

details.title: Sonucido: Dreams of the Gray God by Daniel da Silva
details.short_description: Sonucido: Dreams of the Gray God is a dark fantasy turn-based, party-based Horror RPG. As you descend into the gruesome depths of Sonucido, it's becoming clear as sin that it was a mistake to even set one foot into this twisted place.

details.title: Crossarium
details.short_description: Dive into a story-driven game about a newspaper editor at a small American publishing house in the 1980s.

details.title: Rush Hollow
details.short_description: Rush Hollow is a movement shooter with a big heart and a lot of guts! Uncover the secrets of Rush Hollow as you fight your way through it's many dungeons.

details.title: Cosmic Composer
details.short_description: Casual puzzle game on a cosmic scale. Build stars, planets and other cosmic objects. Evolve your cosmos using abilities of the stars from stellar winds to supernova.

details.title: Custom Hero vs Epic Boss
details.short_description: A dark fantasy 2D platformer with RPG elements. Lead expeditions, level up your entourage, and loot rare gear from monsters. Master challenging platforming levels, defeat epic bosses, and uncover the secrets of the ancient Pact.

details.title: Rey: Shattered Darkness
details.short_description: A dark pixel-art action platformer set in a world shattered across time. Block, parry and cut your way through broken eras, cleanse the corruption spreading through them, and find your way home.

details.title: Splitcard
details.short_description: Every card is a choice. Swipe left or right to unleash one of two powers, build broken combinations, and fight your way through a challenging roguelite deckbuilder.

details.title: Evolution Survival
details.short_description: Evolution Survival is a survival game where the universe evolves around you. The plants and animals you saw at the beginning will be different at the end, They may not even be there, the star may have gone supernova or shrunk into a white dwarf. Use the time you have to ensure your survival.

details.title: Steps
details.short_description: Embark on a narrative puzzle-adventure in a world made of blocks. Play as a block on a quest to find your place, meet other blocks on their journeys, and help them shape their stories. Explore hidden areas, discover treasures, and unlock abilities that open new paths in every level!

details.title: Arsenic & Absinthe
details.short_description: A Bartender point-and-click simulator game mixed with visual novel-style storytelling set in a noir-fabled world. As you have only 7 days to live, to save yourself from a collapsing life, it’s time to investigate, mix the drink and discover the secret recipe of success you deserve all along.

details.title: Die Fighter
details.short_description: A sci-fi dice roguelike where every die you spend is handed to your enemy. Build a machine of 80+ tiles that turns one roll into a chain reaction, and fight your way up a fleet fleeing a black hole.

details.title: A Cut Above: Mow & Grow
details.short_description: Build your lawn-care business from the mower seat. Take on contracts, cut generated properties, upgrade your equipment, manage fuel and clippings, and expand into new service areas as the jobs get bigger.

details.title: HAECHE_Ism
details.short_description: HAECHE_Ism is a pixel-art roguelike SRPG - a tactics game where you command the "Crows," the special task force of "Headquarters," to clear each stage.

details.title: Konomondo
details.short_description: Konomondo is a cozy game learning adventure where math becomes part of exploration, puzzles, and quests. Care for plants in the math-magical garden with daily exercises, solve challenges, and discover the secrets of mathematics step by step.

details.title: One More Case, Naomi Ishigura!
details.short_description: In this bizarre, darkly comedic murder mystery set in 1990s Japan, you play as private investigator Naomi Ishigura. Investigate a murder, get to know an eccentric cast of characters, and take on a series of increasingly absurd challenges.

details.title: Fernwick
details.short_description: Fernwick is a hand-drawn narrative point-and-click game about exploring a keepsake book left to Jude by her late grandmother, Junie. Look through illustrated scenes, inspect objects, and collect keepsakes to learn about the town and people that meant so much to her.

details.title: College Architect
details.short_description: Design, build, and manage a college campus. Become an architect of a prestigious university that only accepts the most elite students, or a community college that allows for normal everyday folks to pursue an education regardless of their academic background. What will you build, Architect?

details.title: Bramblewick: Guild Management Simulator
details.short_description: The heroes get the songs. You get the ledger. Run a fantasy guild hall, recruit adventurers with lives and personalities of their own, and send them on dangerous journeys shaped by combat, chance, and your decisions. Manage the hall they call home—and live with the stories they bring back.

details.title: Grimtrace
details.short_description: A monster-themed deduction game focused on solving brutal murders. Investigate crime scenes by uncovering hidden evidence, analyzing fingerprints, and testing blood samples. Identify the killer, determine the creature responsible, and solve seven thrilling cases

details.title: 迷途猫StrayCat
details.short_description: Stray Cat is a platform jumping game featuring exquisitely polished control feel, stylized pixel art and a lighthearted, cheerful narrative. The game is relatively accessible in terms of difficulty, yet it also offers a more challenging gameplay mode.

details.title: Key Lingo
details.short_description: A typing-based language learning game with WarioWare-style quick mini-games, spaced repetition, and built-in mnemonics — fun even if you already know the language, with secret advanced modes for dedicated learners.

details.title: Hackflesh
details.short_description: A Cookie Clicker-style idle game in a cyberpunk world. Click the terminal to siphon Data, grow a network of 20 generators from Script Kiddie to The Architect, catch Glitch Signals and Reboot for permanent Exploits. 719 upgrades, 100 Exploits, 602 in-game achievements.

details.title: Sanity City
details.short_description: Start your new life in a futuristic cyber world. Team up with your friends and go on a raid. Acquire money, equipment and fame.

details.title: School Dream
details.short_description: Start ninth grade with AI-driven classmates who answer anything you say and remember it. After school, go wherever you make plans to go. At night, play the dreams your day leaves behind, from a murder mystery to a flight to Mars.

details.title: SHAHED
details.short_description: A realistic single-player FPS set in a war-torn Middle Eastern city. Fight as a resistance fighter, ambush enemy forces, target military vehicles, and survive brutal urban combat.

details.title: The Shadow Brokers
details.short_description: A mysterious hacker has stolen the NSA's cyber arsenal and is threatening to sell it to the highest bidder. You have been pulled from your day job and assigned to hunt the hacker. Triage alerts, search through logs, piece together the clues, and find The Shadow Brokers before they leak everything.

details.title: Beast Snap
details.short_description: Build a deck from 500+ monster cards across nine planets, pick a Boss, and battle on a living board. Outsmart rival Bosses with spells, traps and Places, then open booster packs and upgrade your favorite cards to shiny Holo and Prism.

details.title: Ruin Upon Ruin
details.short_description: Roguelike deck-builder where equipment decide your card pool and attack range is here! Make your own loadout from various equipment and conquer the arena.

details.title: Stone & Throne
details.short_description: Dig beneath the mountain, march against its walls. Hook ore from the depths to fund your army, line your units across the hex battlefield, fuse the ones that stand together, and break fifteen fortress gates in a rogue-lite siege where what you mine below decides the war above.

details.title: Russ, Fight The Power!
details.short_description: After getting knocked out by his bully, Russ is stuck in a fever dream set in his school, where anything and everything is against him. Survive multiple waves of enemies and the dangerous school environment by leveling up Russ and making him an unstoppable force!

details.title: Branchout
details.short_description: You're a squirrel, and the clock is running. Sprint along branches, scramble up trunks, swing from ropes and glide through towering treetops. Perfect your moves, keep your momentum and shave off every millisecond. Can you beat the record?

details.title: Doubloon: Pirate Dice Roguelike
details.short_description: Doubloon is a pirate deckbuilding roguelike played with dice. Keep the dice you need and reroll the rest to build hands and pay each captain's ransom. Hire crew and carve dice in port to grow both your stake and multiplier.

details.title: Task Bar Dungeons
details.short_description: A new dark-fantasy Task Bar idle RPG. Six heroes, twelve specializations and hordes that fight back — right above your taskbar while you work. Loot, upgrade, rebirth. Free to play, with Steam Community Market trading planned after launch.

details.title: Stork Effect
details.short_description: A storm tore a time-travelling apartment apart and threw a family of storks across three eras of Uzbekistan: the Silk Road, a Soviet winter and modern Tashkent. Gather the pieces of home, find each other, and bring everyone back for dinner.

details.title: The Sirius Device
details.short_description: Your battleship is the last line of defense against a mysterious fleet attacking the solar system. Powered by the mysterious Sirius Device, you will gain levels in your own custom class, craft and equip new ship modules, and fight against numerous enemies in this new Action RPG- Space Sim hybrid.

details.title: Mortuus
details.short_description: A round-based co-op zombies FPS for 1 to 4 players. Survive endless hordes in brutalist procedurally generated map. Buy doors, hit the mystery box, upgrade your guns, and uncover the hidden ritual that wakes the Mother.

details.title: Root Of Evil
details.short_description: Survive and destroy the devastating Root that is growing and crawling around the cracks and crevasses of the Hotel. Using whatever tools you have to keep your self alive. Find the antidote that will destroy it or die trying.

details.title: Guildmaster’s Quest
details.short_description: A turn-based isekai guild management strategy game. Summoned to another world by a goddess, you found a guild, send adventurers into dungeons and win over or blackmail the courts of seven great kingdoms, while every death in the world brings the Demon Lord closer.

details.title: Cataclysmic
details.short_description: A explosive and dynamic top down shooter where you collect time energy from strongholds that represent cultures and mythologies from history in an effort to restore order.

details.title: The Voynich Project
details.short_description: A choice-driven romance visual novel where every decision shapes your relationships and the story. Meet unique characters, explore multiple routes, and unlock different endings. Featuring high-quality anime-style art, an immersive soundtrack, and deep storytelling. Your journey begins now!

details.title: The Snake Catcher
details.short_description: The Snake Catcher is an investigation horror game set in the rural South, with no ghosts, only snakes. Track them through people’s clutter, tell venomous from harmless, and bag them before they bite. You think there’s just one. Under the burlap sacks, there’s a whole nest.

details.title: Run Away
details.short_description: A first-person story horror. The hospital has sealed itself shut: steel over the windows, doors that won't open. Inside are you, a few survivors and a creature that can't be killed. It remembers where you run and where you hide, and next time that's where it looks.

details.title: Defense Of Village
details.short_description: This is a roguelike tower defense game focused on builds and decision-making. In every run, map layouts, enemy compositions, shop offerings, and rune rules are procedurally altered. There are no fixed solutions you can rely on—only choices made under constantly changing conditions.

details.title: Newtone's Gospel
details.short_description: Newtone's Gospel is a top-down roguelike shooter. Unlike typical Survivors-likes, it is more about exploring huge procedurally generated maps, planning your route, turning limited resources into more resources and finally into increasingly powerful builds.

details.title: Voidshift
details.short_description: A psychological horror game about working the night shift in a store that reacts to your mistakes. Follow procedure. Avoid irregularities.

details.title: PANDECROWN
details.short_description: KILLOMINA collapsed in 2019 after the virus escaped from the Medical Hospital in LAUCTHI City, which held the corporation liable for compensation in the LAUCTHI City Incident in 2019. The verdict led to bankruptcy, causing them and their subsidiaries to close for the year Following.

details.title: Doughjo
details.short_description: Recruit battling pastries, build your perfect team, and master fast-paced tactical grid combat in a turn-based RPG where every fighter has their own skills, strengths, and flavor.

details.title: Heng Rover Mission
details.short_description: Build, launch, and survive. Design your own rover and automated robot workforce to conquer the harsh Martian climate, fulfill Mission Control directives, and uncover the secrets of the red planet in Heng Mar Mission.

details.title: First Kingdom
details.short_description: Build your kingdom, develop your city, and defend it against waves of giants! Empower towers with elements, fuse defenses, create powerful building synergies, and use limited space wisely to shape your own strategic defense.

details.title: Within Time
details.short_description: Six months remain before the end of the world. With the power of the Scions, Yunis, Estella, Angie and Rictor cross into Iolade to stop it, in a turn-based RPG about grief, friendship and fate. Fate changes for no one.

details.title: Origin of Storms
details.short_description: Dive into Origin of Storms, a visually striking fighting game where elemental warriors clash in epic one-on-one battles. Unleash primal transformations, master distinct elemental powers, and compete globally for supremacy in this electrifying arena. Are you ready for the storm?

details.title: RAGINGSTRIKE
details.short_description: Master the three weapons that change according to the humanoid robot form and fighter form, destroy the scattered enemy attack targets, and finally defeat the boss standing in your way!

details.title: Age of Sail
details.short_description: A co-op pirate adventure where you trade goods between islands, fish for resources, upgrade your ship and fight hostile pirate NPCs with friends.

details.title: Ctrl+Z
details.short_description: A unique puzzle game driven by the time-rewinding "Ctrl+Z" button! Fill every tile while navigating sliding floors and deadly bug tiles. With limited Undos, you won't just fix mistakes—deliberately trigger traps and reverse time to solve these mind-bending one-stroke puzzles!

details.title: Zombie Dog
details.short_description: Zombie Dog is a zombie herding sheepdog game set in Yorkshire. It combines strategic coordination and timing with puzzle solving and comedic physics-based mayhem through its unique zombie herding mechanic.

details.title: Dragon Defense
details.short_description: Dragon Defense is an action-packed, wave-based defense strategy game where you must build, craft, and protect your island from relentless monster invasions.

details.title: Black Stars - The M87 Conflict
details.short_description: Command a rising interstellar empire in the M87 cluster. Explore and colonize distant worlds, build powerful economies, terraform hostile planets, deploy specialized fleets, and wage war against rival factions in a VR-exclusive galactic 4X strategy game where every decision shapes the conflict.

details.title: Lurking In Fear
details.short_description: Enjoy the love of zombie games without the feeling of being locked down to a story mode! Enjoy a open world zombie era, loot, and explore! OR if you want a change in pace, Play a new round based zombies mode that will keep you loving or Re Loving Round based zolmbies!

details.title: The Universe of Death
details.short_description: Hand-drawn isometric Diablo style rogue like with Elden Ring style controls, and it's also a tower defense. Level up in run to try new skills and builds, level up between runs to increase your stats to begin each run stronger. Acquire loot and give old loot to your towers and mercenaries.

details.title: The Masked Vengeance: Chapter 1
details.short_description: A dark survival horror game of intense chases, terrifying enemies, and deadly mystery. Run, hide, solve puzzles, and survive against the Purple Rabbit’s masked followers with supernatural abilities as you uncover the horrifying truth behind the mysterious entity known as the Purple Rabbit.

details.title: Project Zarya
details.short_description: Project Zarya is an open-world adventure set in post-apocalyptic Russia, where every day is a fight for survival. Explore, gather resources, build shelters, craft equipment, and battle the infected alone or with friends.

details.title: Tithe
details.short_description: Build a deathtrap arena. Raid someone else’s. Tithe is a dark-fantasy action raider where you design trap-filled gauntlets for other players to survive, then fight through theirs, and through the vaults, hideouts and ruins of Pheran, where everyone owes someone.

details.title: Dicebloom
details.short_description: Roll the die and wake a twilight garden. Every hit sets off a chain of blooming: plants grow their neighbours, bees fly, seeds sprout and multipliers climb. Build a garden engine that pays a rising debt every week in this cozy dice roguelite.

details.title: The Primus's Party
details.short_description: Solve the murder of the intergalactic deity and birthday boy by clicking your way through this visual novel adventure before everyone is winked out of reality by the neighbouring black hole - death closes in with each search of a wardrobe or awkward conversation... Enjoy the party!

details.title: Spirits and Secrets
details.short_description: Spirits and Secrets is a Bartender Simulator Murder Mystery game set in a medieval fantasy world. Talk to patrons, make their orders, and solve their mysteries by piecing together clues.

details.title: northern mythology
details.short_description: Northern mythology is a northern-myth themed hardcore action fantasy game. Traverse frozen wilderness and ancient ruins. Fight mythical creatures with skillful parry and dodge. Gather relics, customize your warrior and face epic bosses to reveal the secrets of the old gods.

details.title: Haiju
details.short_description: Gather the 36 Heavenly Wind Bells from across otherworldly landscapes drawn from Japanese mythology. Charge through enemies and glide over vast gaps in a high-speed action platformer charged with electric energy.

details.title: 流転のジェミニ
details.short_description: The other half of your soul—never let go. Walk the Afterworld with a same-sex partner in this turn-based dark fantasy RPG. Joy, anger, sadness: every emotion the story stirs becomes power in battle. Your smallest choices shape your bond and lead to one of four endings. Hope, or sweet, cruel ruin?

details.title: Softscape
details.short_description: Restore barren spaces into peaceful gardens in a relaxing first-person sandbox. Route water, shape terrain, place plants and decorations, then watch your world slowly return to life beneath the Grand Tree.

details.title: 地府模拟器
details.short_description: 你死了，但真正的人生才刚刚开始。作为一名初入地府的孤魂野鬼，在酆都谋生、赚钱、修炼、置业、结交鬼神，也可以加入阴司，从普通阴兵一路晋升为判官、阎罗，甚至掌管整个地府。

details.title: Altera Historia
details.short_description: A top-down action shooter where you fight by aiming in **eight directions**! Don’t just read the bullet patterns and dodge— choose the right attack for the situation, take risks, and fire your way through the chaos to turn the tide.

details.title: Sanctuary: Shattered Sun
details.short_description: Command vast armies across the surface of a star-encompassing Dyson Sphere in this next-gen RTS. Shatter the map itself with superweapons, freeze oceans to create new invasion routes, and control hundreds of units in your quest to dominate humanity's greatest megastructure.

details.title: FROG RAIN
details.short_description: A sudden downpour turns everyone caught in the rain into frogs. Now I’m surrounded by frogs, and I can’t tell my teachers from my classmates. But that’s beside the point. It’s a new school, after all. I’d better make some friends soon.

name: Miracle Warrior of Mountains and Seas

details.title: Miracle Warrior of Mountains and Seas
details.short_description: A puzzle, monster-fighting game blending time-travel wuxia and The Classic of Mountains and Seas. A righteous modern youth falls into an ancient well, opens a time portal to ancient times, Defeat monsters, collect items to boost stats; weapons grow with abilities. Solve puzzles.

details.title: Proximity Effect
details.short_description: When Earth falls to a viral collapse, the last hope hovers above it. Drop from orbit to stop a rogue scientist building an army underground Robben Island before he unleashes havoc unto the world.

details.title: SHAPE & SHADE
details.short_description: SHAPE & SHADE is a multiplayer game that combines Prop Hunt and Social deduction mechanics, draw your own disguise and survive until de train reach the Station. Watch your friends slowly go crazy trying to figure out what's real and what’s not !

details.title: Alienhead
details.short_description: Alienhead is a linear narrative zelda-like dungeon adventure, inspired by Binding of Isaac & dripping with nerd references & 90s nostalgia.

details.title: Collector's Edition
details.short_description: Hunt treasures at garage sales, inspect every flaw, and haggle with eccentric sellers. Photograph your finds, choose the right headline and list them online to flip for a profit. Keep the best for your private collection. It's the Collect Everything Game!

details.title: August Star | Sao tháng Tám
details.short_description: Sao Tháng Tám - August Star video game demo is a First person survival horror game about the Famine that killed nearly 2 million people in Viet Nam in 1945.

details.title: September 3rd
details.short_description: September 3rd is an iconic day. It's one of those days when the decisions made the day before completely change a person's fate. Feel the atmosphere of life’s drama and immerse yourself in the midst of events from a time when the turning of the calendar marks the beginning of a new era.

details.title: The Beresford family
details.short_description: What happened on the night of July 20, 1824? The Beresford family was sleeping unaware that an ancient evil was about to resurface. An ancient evil that brought upon them a curse whose echoes resonate to this day.

details.title: GunJong
details.short_description: Aim. Shoot. Match. Mahjong Solitaire with guns: shoot matching pairs to clear the board. Relax in Zen mode or chase the leaderboards. Import own art and make game yours

details.title: WHITE : ANASTASIS
details.short_description: Explore a striking black-and-white psychedelic open world. Harness elemental tools, restore energy facilities, and battle strange entities inside the simulation that powers reality.

details.title: KOI-KOI!
details.short_description: A stylish roguelite anime card game about luck, strategy, and risk. Build card combinations, bet your chips, and face three dealers in high-stakes games where your fate is at stake.

details.title: Angels Die
details.short_description: Play as a group of female intelligence agents in this turn-based tactical espionage RPG set in 1976 during the Cold War. Build your own characters, get them more and more skills until they become a modern day Leonardo Da Vinci. Unless they die first.

details.title: The Concrete Sutra #1
details.short_description: A post-apocalyptic world. Two friends haven't seen each other for 5 years are heading back home on a bike. The first episode of an epic action jrpg by yeo.

details.title: Death Infection
details.short_description: In a zombie-filled post-apocalyptic MMO, each city can host up to 10,000 players online at once. Take control of your character’s body and sexual interactions. No cash shop, no premium currency—all currency and equipment are earned in the game world.

details.title: Psychological Hacker 2044
details.short_description: 「Psychological Hacker」is a turn-based combat game featuring HD-2D pixel visual style. Explore the inner worlds of others, gain their cognitive experiences and secrets, and uncover the hidden mysteries in this city.

details.title: PathoBLASTA RK
details.short_description: Immerse yourself in this Vertical Shoot 'Em Up 80's Style Arcade, with unique Graphics & Sound. The game includes Ships, Missiles, and Special Weapons upgrades. Shoot enless waves of Viruses, Amoebas, Spores and Bosses. Protect the Containment Wall, do not let the Exuoa virus through.

details.title: The Nightmare Chronicles - Devil's Drive
details.short_description: When Jason’s dad leaves him home alone to go on a business trip, sinister things start happening in the usually quiet ‘Devil’s Drive’. Can you survive playing as young Jason while uncovering the secrets of Devil’s Drive?

details.title: Breath of the Pasture
details.short_description: A heartfelt life-sim about love, land, and the magic of the countryside. Compose your very own pastoral symphony— Listen to the rain as it falls. Chase the breeze on sunny days. Watch crops reach for the sky. Let your cows and sheep rest in peace. Fall in love. Grow a farm. That is THE GAME!

details.title: Stardust Rain
details.short_description: A momentum-driven 2.5D anime fighting game. Build velocity, adapt on the fly, and always be on the move! Easy to pick up, hard to master, with rollback netcode.

details.title: Sick Samurai
details.short_description: It's 1972 on Furikyu Island. A jazz-hop record spins up. Your deranged mentor lights his cigarette. Slash every enemy before it burns out. One-hit-kills, no mistakes... well, maybe a few.

details.title: Longjuice Squeeze
details.short_description: Shoot, parry, and slash your way to self-awareness in Longjuice Squeeze, a roguelite fighting game where the winner steals gear from the loser. Featuring billions of possible builds, tons of collectible gear, and single-player, local, or online duels with rollback netcode.

details.title: Not Only Nine
details.short_description: A cat soul journeys through The Afterlife to save their human. An ancient being (helps?) defeat the Reapers in this narrative RPG adventure.

details.title: Libi
details.short_description: A survival horror where you peek into the mind of a hero saving her kidnapped lover while making excuses for her crimes. fight an undying jestress ruling an uncivilized world, scavenge for limited resources, avoid enemies, trick them with food and lay traps. for you are the hero... right? ​

details.title: Olaf and the Crowning Hangover
details.short_description: Olaf wakes up with a legendary hangover and a missing royal crown. Retrace your drunken rampage across the kingdom to save your head! In this comedic puzzle adventure, fixing the mess creates the maze: every object you repair becomes an obstacle blocking your path.

details.title: Decor Quest
details.short_description: 👩‍🎨✨🏰 A cozy decor sim. Design dream homes for whimsical clients, with help from a sassy cat critic. Enjoy solo or with friends in 2-4 player co-op.

details.title: Drachenquell
details.short_description: Willkommen in der Welt von Drachenquell, einem epischen Abenteuer, das dich in eine Ära voller Mythen und Legenden entführt. Erkunde die weitläufigen Länder von Drachenquell, wo jede Ecke der Karte mit Leben gefüllt ist.

details.title: Feral Scape
details.short_description: Feral Scape is a single-player open-world dark fantasy RPG set in a strange wilderness inspired by Australia. Explore as a feral animal, gather resources, craft tools, build a place in the world and form relationships with three rival factions as your choices affect the story.

details.title: Aledorn
details.short_description: Spiritual successor to many old school hard-core RPG/Dungeon masterpieces, that combines tactical combat system, exploration in the first person view and intriguing travelling system between main map locations.

details.title: Divine Gambit
details.short_description: Rally your friends and defend your village in a chaotic blend of action and strategy. Stock up on resources, build wacky defenses and lay deadly traps by day. Come night, grab your weapons, unleash powerful spells and fight back against invading armies. Team up, embrace the chaos and defy the gods!

details.title: Wall Dodging 3D
details.short_description: A casual game where you make it to the end of each level without hitting a wall.

details.title: Emocre
details.short_description: Emocre is a retro-inspired monster-taming adventure where you explore dreamlike worlds, tame living emotions, and discover a story about self-discovery and inner peace.

details.title: 12 nights
details.short_description: A survival-horror game about a detective searching for his sister in a mysterious victorian mansion that shifts its shape. The mansion is their family home - and their family curse. Fight monsters, solve puzzles, explore the mysterious estate!

name: Lost viking somewhere in Byzantine Empire.

details.title: Lost viking somewhere in Byzantine Empire.
details.short_description: Enter an alternate history where Vikings rule the Byzantine Empire. In this retro hero simulator, master sword & magic, manage hunger, and use the Valknut artifact to cheat death. Fight through a world torn apart by warring gods to prove your destiny.

details.title: Sinner's Grimoire
details.short_description: Descend through the Nine Circles of Hell as a forsaken spellcaster bound to a cursed grimoire. Unleash chaotic magic, dodge relentless hordes, and craft devastating spell combinations in this infernal bullet-hell survivor. Only the damned survive.

details.title: In The Liminality
details.short_description: A cosmic-psychological horror experience, unique in story, art, and heart. Face "The Master" in this tale of girl's love and terror. Only you can bring it an end. Only you can bring World Revolution.

details.title: Dracanea: The Ragtag Regalia
details.short_description: Dracanea: The Ragtag Regalia is a comedy adventure RPG featuring a washed-up hero who's turning 30, with talking dogs and hamburger monsters! Solve puzzles in the overworld to collect items, engage in turn-based battles with fighting-game button inputs, and even learn 150+ cooking recipes!

details.title: Dungeon Killer
details.short_description: Dungeon Killer is a fast-paced boss rush shoot ’em up where you play as Astrid, a woman determined to bargain with the goddess of death herself to resurrect her husband. Armed with a minigun, you’ll descend into a hellish dungeon and face deadly, disturbing female enemies.

details.title: Change Dynasties
details.short_description: Lead a militia through a realm in turmoil. Build your settlement, manage resources, recruit troops, and defend your people when night falls. This single-player game combines settlement management with real-time strategy combat.

details.title: Fish Fights Back
details.short_description: A fishing game where the fish fights back — properly. Rod, drag, line stretch and the fish's own stamina are all simulated, so every hook-pull and snapped line is something you did. Fish matches on one lake against friends, and find out who can actually read the water.

name: 灰暗日常下的星航家们 GreySky&StarNavigator

details.title: 灰暗日常下的星航家们 GreySky&StarNavigator
details.short_description: GreySky&StarNavigator is a text-based adventure game. In the game, you will learn about the story of a young girl trapped in a one-day world. You will follow her perspective to experience the joyous daily life of her alien companions, and eventually find a way to escape from this world.

details.title: Sketchbook
details.short_description: Familiar places hide mysteries, the laws of reality no longer apply, and childhood fears lurk in everyday objects. Embark on a journey through distorted memories of the past in a first-person horror game.

details.title: Eavad
details.short_description: A VR roguelite dungeon-crawler where you dive into Dragonian cultist lairs—mine resources, gather intel, and settle vendettas with axes, bows, and more—then return to your cozy village to forge gear and plan your next descent.

details.title: EVAC
details.short_description: EVAC is the Worlds Greatest Helicopter Game. Fly explosive combat missions, high-speed races, rescue missions, and a variety of utility operations.

details.title: Pixel Clicker
details.short_description: A pixel art-style clicker game where you tap to blast pixels and bosses, upgrade, automate, and travel through diverse biomes, from lush jungles to the far reaches of space, all wrapped in an immersive soundscape. Climb the leaderboard and become the ultimate pixel boss.

details.title: Happy Door
details.short_description: Magic, Horror, Co-op Survive together in Happy Door, a mysterious space with fellow wizards. Gather resources through co-op play and purchase powerful spells to endure the horror.

details.title: Rescue Heli
details.short_description: In this arcade style simulation game, be the pilot of a life saving helicopter and a member of a life saving crew. Whenever lives are in danger you will make a difference by ensuring that the help is there.

details.title: Impact Trial: Hyperchaos
details.short_description: Survive endless waves and let yourself be swept away by the chaos. Impact Trial: Hyperchaos is an arcade bullet hell with adaptive difficulty, where every second counts and your reflexes determine how long you survive. The longer you hold out, the harder it gets. Can you survive the Hyperchaos?

details.title: Haparoot
details.short_description: Step into a dream world. Become the sole source of light in the darkness and Explore an authentic handcrafted landscape in third-person. Solve layered environmental puzzles, discuss some familiar issues and uncover secrets shaping the journey toward balance.

details.title: Pigeon Guild
details.short_description: Pigeon Guild is an adventure RPG with no combat. You play as Jules Corso, a rookie cadet in an airborne postal service. Pilot your flying cargo boat through Cassandria - a world of floating islands where every delivery tells a story.

details.title: Provener
details.short_description: Build your own mercenary company in a world where the Golden Age is gone. Build, explore, survive, and carve your own path through a land filled with forgotten mysteries.

details.title: Moment of Decision: WW1
details.short_description: Command squads, dig and occupy trenches, call devastating artillery barrages, and battle across a destructible WWI battlefield. Moment of Decision: WWI is a tactical RTS where positioning, cover, attrition, and battlefield control determine who holds the line. Every decision has a price.

details.title: The Frutiger Utopia
details.short_description: An exciting puzzle-platformer based on the Frutiger Aero artstyle of the 2000s!

details.title: Monsterful Tavern
details.short_description: Become the owner of a tavern for monsters where knights are on the menu and the menu is your deck. Monsterful Tavern combines roguelite deck-building and resource management mechanics with ridiculously dark humor. Bon appétit, kek!

details.title: No Crown Eternal
details.short_description: Apparently the Romans with Dynamite are really broken. Grow a village into an empire in this turn-based Roguelike. Explore, build buildings and wonders, adopt civilizations and research technologies in 30-minute runs.

details.title: Drift Wars
details.short_description: A new style of RTS that focuses heavily on terraforming and changing terrain to different types to overcome your opponent ! Inspired by old-school RTSes but with next-generation RTS ideas !

details.title: GUNDIG
details.short_description: GUNDIG is a roguelike twin-stick shooter where your gun is also a pickaxe. Mine your way through massive fully destructible planets, fight off hordes of aliens, and stack increasingly ridiculous upgrades.

details.title: For My Darling
details.short_description: Based on a True Story, "For My Darling" is NOT fiction! Lili’s ordinary life was fractured in 2023 after meeting someone strangely familiar. Her reality twists as something begins to follow her. It is tied to lost memories and a past that won’t stay buried. To understand, she must uncover the truth.

details.title: SCHMEKEL
details.short_description: SCHMEKEL is a chaotic roguelike where you're a coin, fighting an Arcade machine from within. Every bullet you fire bounces back. The build you choose will shape your bullet-hell experience.

details.title: Football Career Mode 28
details.short_description: Football Career Mode 28 is a straightforward football manager game. Choose a club, pick a sponsor and start your football management career! Lead your club to the top through transfers, scouting, infrastructure upgrades and much more, and win as many titles as you possibly can!

details.title: Terra-7
details.short_description: A Colony Sim where you build your company in an hostile alien world. Keep your employees happy and bring profits to your investors while you try not to go bankrupt.

details.title: Chef of Sherwood
details.short_description: Will you take from the poor to feed the rich? A satirical cooking & management game where choices matter. As Prince John’s new cook, scrounge ingredients from the population by day, serve lavish feasts to a spoiled royal family by night, and decide who pays the price: the people, the crown… or you.

details.title: Dirge of the Scarlet Star
details.short_description: A JRPG and Survival Horror, featuring turn based combat and 12 different playable characters. 3 days under the Scarlet Star, to end the insanity ,or join it. Dirge of the Scarlet Star is a descent into isolation, madness, and a slow death under the heat of the Scarlet Star.

details.title: Gierki's Pirates!
details.short_description: Gierki's Pirates! is an open-world pirate adventure inspired by the classic Sid Meier’s Pirates! As a free captain, you explore a seamless open-world filled with rival nations, pirates, and trade routes. Capture ships, raid towns, trade goods. Shape the course of your story.

details.title: Rule the Dungeon
details.short_description: A chaotic dungeon adventure RPG where every choice leads to a solution, somehow! As a city investigator, tackle dungeon complaints with a troublesome crew of hunters. Kick that suspicious vending machine, or drop in a coin? Give it a try. There's more than one way!

details.title: Lemony Fresh
details.short_description: You are a tiny lemon who cleans filthy spaces. Explore and restore a home with a warm, beating heart.

details.title: Vord
details.short_description: Vord is an evolving sandbox adventure where players shape the world through iterative mechanics and collaborative discovery. Navigate a shifting landscape, build unique structures, and experiment with expanding gameplay systems that grow alongside the community’s imagination.

details.title: The Nightwal Legacy
details.short_description: A first-person supernatural thriller where you explore a manor overtaken by darkness. Wield a mysterious power to confront an ancient evil, unravel the truth, and save your brother.

details.title: Faded Cove
details.short_description: A cozy, witchy game where you must lift the curse on your woods and appease the Goddess while doing so. Collect ingredients around the Cove by growing crops, tending to animals, foraging, online shopping and trading with locals in pursuit of growing your ingredient inventory to cook new foods!

details.title: Frozen Extinction
details.short_description: A cinematic RTS where a forgotten failure awakens Earth's original apex predators. Build, fortify, and lead humanity's counteroffensive to reclaim the planet before extinction claims us all.

details.title: DoomBus
details.short_description: DoomBus offers high-speed fun in a post-apocalyptic world. Drive modified vehicles, drift fiercely on tricky ruined tracks, and enjoy dramatic physical collisions. You can traverse wastelands, defeat zombies, rescue survivors or go head-to-head with alien UFOs.

details.title: Illi-A
details.short_description: Embark on an emotional journey - from calm to despair, from serenity to rage - where story and struggle merge into one climb to the top.

details.title: 玄灵尘缘录
details.short_description: 《玄灵尘缘录》是一款玄幻题材开放世界RPG游戏。你将扮演一名小村少年，踏入名为“灵洲”的浩瀚大陆，展开一段自由无拘的冒险之旅。你可以随心探索广阔天地，体验快节奏的自动战斗，清关刷宝；也能结识好友，组建队伍。在非线性无限制开放式剧情中，亲手书写属于你的命运篇章。

details.title: Bound Together
details.short_description: Explore the world, gather resources, produce ammunition, build turrets, and defend against relentless waves of monsters in a 2.5D fantasy adventure that blends base building with tower defense.

name: Hotel Hilbert and the Divergence Ruler

details.title: Hotel Hilbert and the Divergence Ruler
details.short_description: Move from each room to the next in the paradoxical Hotel Hilbert, with its rooms infinitely many, yet all occupied. Shift Entropy, meet other Guests, find lost Belongings and advance ever forward in Hotel Hilbert, where the laws of physics are mere suggestions.

details.title: Tommy Gun Marionettes
details.short_description: The witches are killing again, harvesting organs from the dead. Special Agent Bram works the backstreets, chasing the witches as the bodies fall. Tommy Gun Marionettes is a point and click noir adventure in a world of witches, squidfolk, pigfolk, and people who'd rather he stopped asking questions.

details.title: Magic Kitchen
details.short_description: A casual restaurant game about perfection, not pressure. Team up with a friend in local co-op, listen to your customers' demands, and master the perfect ingredient combinations on your way to a 5-star restaurant.

details.title: LastWitness: Mero
details.short_description: Guide Mero through a dark 2.5D action-adventure, battling twisted memories, solving portal-based puzzles, and uncovering the truth behind a forgotten childhood.

details.title: Starcrest
details.short_description: Build, pilot, and crew custom physics-driven spacecraft in a persistent online universe. Explore distant worlds, mine and trade for resources, and band together in factions to fight for territorial control. Carve out your empire in an ever evolving infinite online galaxy.

details.title: BONEWOOD
details.short_description: Cut through waves of orcs, undead and other wretched enemies of the realm! Gather your units and equip them with powerful gear, place your traps, level up your hero and unlock new talents. Discover mad builds and insane synergies that will help you defend endlessly! Play solo or co-op!

details.title: Pass Thru Fire
details.short_description: A story-driven puzzle and mystery RPG with a unique art style. Players take on the role of an unemployed police officer, wandering through the corrupt city streets to find the killer behind the serial murders at Qingjiang University dorms, and uncover the truth about their missing brother...

details.title: Sworn to the Depths
details.short_description: A text-driven dungeon crawler inspired by Ironsworn: Delve. Travel to a forbidden site full of treasure, roll dice, make choices, face danger, and find out the hard way why the site was forbidden in the first place! Or maybe you'll find the treasure. It could happen!

details.title: Wendtale
details.short_description: A brilliant breakthrough in turn-based strategy! Just as the enemy attacks, your turn is only beginning—Preemptive Strike, Defense, or Counterattack. Anticipate enemy targeting, manage your resources, and take them out by surprise between turns!

details.title: Iridium Bones
details.short_description: Dive into a thrilling space roguelike where survival demands tactical brilliance. Upgrade your starship, loot devastating weapons, and master intense strategic combat across the galaxy. Every run is a new battle; every choice shapes your legacy.

details.title: War In The Dark
details.short_description: War In The Dark is a 1-bit turn-based wiretapping simulation. Track enemy radio frequencies and decipher incoming Morse code to pinpoint unseen enemies. Use the spacebar to manually tap Morse commands to direct your allies and control the flow of intense information warfare.

details.title: AVIK
details.short_description: AVIK is an atmospheric space sandbox where you explore space. Following a recent tragedy, you must begin your story from scratch, unraveling mysteries of the past while upgrading your spaceship, mining resources, crafting new parts, and fighting for survival.

details.title: Wild Myth
details.short_description: An online co-op adventure where you and your friends hunt for proof of the world’s most dangerous myths. All for the views. Go live. Capture the chaos. Run. Cut it into viral content. Stay live. Stay alive.

name: Best Viewed Up Close: Oil on Canvas

details.title: Best Viewed Up Close: Oil on Canvas
details.short_description: A game made entirely from oil paintings. You were tearing out the meadow to pave a parking spot. Then you shrank to bug scale. Climb flowers, ride bees, and fill a field journal before the world beneath your boots disappears under concrete.

details.title: God of creation
details.short_description: An action Roguelike featuring a unique Spell Programming System. Forge powerful weapons, program your own spells, combine hundreds of abilities, and create limitless builds with your own combat style.

details.title: Celestial Temple
details.short_description: Celestial Temple is a narrative action-adventure game from Ursa Majeur. Become Curiosity, uncover who and where you are, and journey through a dreamlike mythic odyssey across ages, facing enemies with your own face while seeking a sliver of light in self-made darkness.

details.title: Burning Bridges
details.short_description: You discover a suspicious box on your parents attic. Uncover a long hidden family secret by rummaging through old homevideo and letters.

details.title: Cat Cat Cat Factory
details.short_description: Run a factory with cats! Put them to work, optimize production, and make magic tools and medicines to fulfill requests in a fantasy world. Expand your factory, unlock new products, and venture into action stages to gather materials. Grow your factory together with your cats!

details.title: VEXA
details.short_description: The rift tore two worlds together, and it's dragging you through. VEXA is a fast-paced, dark anime shooter where you step into a Vessel each one built around their own weapons, abilities, and style, so how you fight is entirely yours. Become an Apostle and strike fast against those who oppose you.

details.title: BLACKWELL
details.short_description: You are a Mech plague doctor treating a family infected by a disease that spreads through emotions, and mutates them into monsters. Your choices decide their fate.

details.title: Emberholme
details.short_description: Emberholme is an old-school open-world RPG inhabited by 100 simulated adventurers who learn and progress by the same rules as you. Train skills, craft, trade, build a home, fight bosses, play alone or with up to three friends, and grow stronger across ten Ember Cycles.

details.title: Koi Oasis
details.short_description: Breed lifelike koi and build your calm backyard pond or grow a breeding empire. Sculpt 3D voxel landscapes, design multi-tiered water gardens, and breed stunning, lifelike koi.

details.title: Touhou Eternal Frontier 2
details.short_description: Join Reimu and Marisa on a train journey through 20XX! Explore a future Outside World shaped by superintelligence (SI), space expansion, and nuclear war. A Touhou Project fan-made 3D action game with first- and third-person views.

name: Kira the Fox: Crystals of Harmony

details.title: Kira the Fox: Crystals of Harmony
details.short_description: Free demo out now: all of World 1. A pixel-art 2D platformer where you earn your speed: the cleaner you chain, the faster Kira gets. Ten worlds, ten Crystals of Harmony to take back from King Crystus, bosses, a grapple, a rhythm mode. Made by one person in Quebec.

details.title: Gang Crime Simulator
details.short_description: Take on the role of a criminal determined to build an underground syndicate from the ground up. Start small, earn street respect, money, and expand your operations through shady ventures, risky jobs, and smart management of your growing gang.

details.title: JANISSARY: ECLIPSE
details.short_description: A first-person survival RPG set in a sealed-off Crimea, overrun by the Stained: zombies that run on sunlight. They sprint in daylight. After dark they go blind and hunt by sound. You wake up bandaged, memory gone, stuck between two armies. Pick a side or burn it all down.

details.title: BLOKSTAR HERO
details.short_description: A voxel arcade shooter set in the real solar system. Every world you reach is its own arcade game - fly some, land on others and walk in on foot. Mine belts, run warp lanes, dock at stations, sell your haul and refit. Your ship, your gear and your dents all carry with you.

details.title: Songs of Vireluna
details.short_description: Songs of Vireluna is the ultimate visual novel experience, where choices matter and combat shapes the story as much as dialogue choices do. Meet the characters, uncover the story of the city, and become its salvation… or its doom.

details.title: Shivaliva
details.short_description: Set sail on a space puzzle adventure to stop the Blue Throat, the God of Destruction, before he destroys the universe! Gather your crew, voyage your ship from island to island, conquer the eight Ordeals and find the last island, where he waits for you. Every job, game and battle is a puzzle.

details.title: Scoped Assassin
details.short_description: Twelve hundred people in the town below, going about their day. One of them is your contract. No markers, no arrows, no objective ping — just a scope, a rifle, and the patience to find the right face in the crowd.

details.title: Survive the Shift
details.short_description: workplace survival card decision game. Starting as an intern, you must balance boss trust, team popularity, business output, and personal savings. Slacking rules, dinner culture, and bizarre blame-shifting communications turn into choice cards. Swipe once a day to see how many days you can survive.

details.title: Cascade Fault
details.short_description: This is an adventure game where the main character, Shinobu Mayuzumi—a shut-in PC geek—uses her cutting edge AI, Cherubim, to unravel the truth behind urban legends lurking in daily life alongside her childhood friend Nanoha and her collaborator KD.

details.title: Lilith's Curse
details.short_description: Welcome to Lilith's Curse. In this game, you're trapped in an asylum: your goal is to find items, solve puzzles, and escape. Watch out for the enemy: Lilith. Lilith will do everything she can to stop you. If she succeeds, there will be very serious consequences.

details.title: The Grooming
details.short_description: The Grooming is a 2.5D psychological horror adventure where a girl follows a cat through familiar streets that slowly distort. Explore unsettling spaces, investigate strange phenomena with your phone and camera, and make choices that can change what you experience—and whether you survive.

details.title: The Seven Hunters
details.short_description: December 1900. Three keepers of the Flannan Isles lighthouse vanished without a trace. As Donald MacArthur, keep the light burning until the last watch, obey the island's ancient rules and face what history never explained. Pixel art psychological horror inspired by a true story, 1.5 to 2 hours.

details.title: The Elder Jade
details.short_description: The Elder Jade is a hand-drawn, side-scrolling action roguelite inspired by Chinese fantasy. In the Great Wilderness, where spiritual energy is running dry, the ruins of the Xuan Dynasty suddenly reappear after a thousand years, engulfing much of the Liyun Sect.

details.title: Bird Sense
details.short_description: Go to different scenes, wait for birds to appear, and take their photos. Use the in-game encyclopedia to compare and identify each bird. Raise your birdwatching level, discover more real bird species, and become a birdwatching enthusiast.

details.title: Go! Super Awesome Monkey!
details.short_description: Play as SAM in Go! Super Awesome Monkey and save the world from AI Tech Overlords in this cute 3D Platformer! Collect pizza slices, coins, & floppy discs by spinning, dashing, and slamming (and more!) in 100+ levels. Play at your own pace: casually explore or speedrun to rise up the leaderboards!

details.title: Catacrypt
details.short_description: Catacrypt is an online co-op roguelite dungeon crawler. Enter procedurally generated dungeons to obtain powerful upgrades and craft unique weapons. Descend floors and fight increasingly harder enemies and bosses, all to reach the bottom.

details.title: Aestia: The Engineer's Odyssey
details.short_description: Explore an open-world pixel action RPG where you play an engineering student lost in an unfamiliar land. Win the trust of local villagers to recruit them into your party, level up specialized combat abilities, tackle bosses, and find a way back to Earth.

details.title: Echoes of Eras
details.short_description: A creature-collecting RPG where you don't catch, you bond. Travel through time from the Stone Age to the dinosaurs, win turn-based battles and let the Echoes choose to follow you. What you change in the past reshapes the eras that come after.

details.title: Speed Up Memories
details.short_description: SpeedUP goes back to the roots of arcade racing. You’ll feel right at home behind the wheel by the first corner, but you’ll have to fight for the win all the way to the finish line. Just like the arcade racers you remember from the turn of the millennium.

details.title: FrostHaul
details.short_description: The Great Frost has swallowed the south. Build a camp in the snow, mend the last train out, and grow both into a home that holds: heat every room and car, keep your people alive, raid frozen outposts for coal and iron, and stay ahead of the White Wall, the storm that never stops.

details.title: Coldfront – The Escalation Corridor
details.short_description: Command NATO through eight decades of the Cold War. Arm too heavily and you provoke nuclear war – arm too little and the East overruns you. Balance deterrence, diplomacy, espionage and proxy wars on a knife's edge, from the Berlin Blockade to today and beyond.

details.title: Founders: The Cost of Growth
details.short_description: Start in a garage in 1970 and build a corporation through more than a century of change. A realistic business tycoon sim where cash flow isn't profit, every strategy has a price, and there's no winning build — only the trade-offs you can survive.

details.title: Halmfall
details.short_description: Zombie survival in a small German town that has been empty for twenty years. Search houses and wrecked cars, stay fed, warm and healthy, set up somewhere safe to sleep and find out what happened here. Solo, co-op or on a server.

details.title: Xanrean Tides
details.short_description: Build your kingdom, raise armies, and command powerful heroes in a fantasy RTS inspired by Warcraft III and Majesty. Recruit autonomous adventurers who explore, fight, and make their own decisions while rival factions and monsters threaten everything you've built.

details.title: Out of Office!
details.short_description: A 2-6 player co-op camping game with proximity voice chat. Your behind-the-times tech employer has sent you on a “mandatory-fun” nature retreat in Atlantic Canada. Manage ticks, hunger, a full bladder, and whatever else lurks behind the treeline! Underperform and risk being terminated... ⛺

details.title: The Forgotten Ones
details.short_description: Leidy dreamed of the city, she never imagined violence would force her there. In this 90s narrative adventure, explore streets and interiors, inspect traces people left behind, hear conflicting family memories, and reconstruct meaningful objects by hand while restoring what violence left unfinished.

details.title: Iron Pilgrim
details.short_description: Noah's Ark returns as a war train. Leave the rails behind in a horde survival rogue-lite where you smash through fully destructible worlds, rescue survivors, and forge devastating wagon synergies.

details.title: AMINA-MAL-GUM
