details.short_description: A surreal metamorphic turn-based RPG where you assemble new bodies from acquired anatomy, recruit strange lifeforms, and explore a time-driven world alongside autonomous companions whose decisions you can increasingly influence, interrupt and override.

details.title: DES: Hyperspace Racer
details.short_description: A 6DOF space racing game built around pure piloting skill. Race through procedurally generated tracks, master extreme turns, beat your best times, and compete against other pilots in multiplayer.

name: You Have No Friends But You Still Want to Play Tabletop RPGs

details.title: You Have No Friends But You Still Want to Play Tabletop RPGs
details.short_description: A comedy horror story about five tabletop RPG fans. Roll the dice, argue with the game master, and try to survive a story that very quickly stops going according to plan.

details.title: Enrooted
details.short_description: Enrooted is a bullet hell rhythm RPG. Fight to the beat in turn-based battles, collect the six petals of ARCADIA, and set out on an amazing journey to face the Rat President in a final symphony.

details.title: BREACHPOINT
details.short_description: Frag out like you're a teenager again. BREACHPOINT is a fast arena FPS: Deathmatch, Team Deathmatch, the stage-by-stage push of Breachpoint, and Endless co-op against hordes and bosses. Every mode plays split screen for up to 4, and you can build your own maps for the Workshop.

details.title: Paracity
details.short_description: Paracity is a character-driven, party-based heist RPG. You are the leader of a small cadre of cut-throats and ne'er-do-wells. Run your crew through heists in a 15th-century city, issuing orders and juggling the personalities of your henchmen. But be wary: your crew may have their own ideas.

details.title: PooDaddy
details.short_description: PooDaddy is a fast paced auto battler where you build ridiculously overpowered attacks. PooDaddy combines ridiculous cartoon humor, a story driven world and unpredictable events that can supercharge your run or turn the entire level against you. Every run becomes chaotic and different.

details.title: Azalea
details.short_description: A real-time strategy game set in the Joseon Dynasty, rendered in ink-wash art. Cultivate rice fields, raise fortress walls, and train armies to seize the battlefield. When multiple forces collide, who you strike first and how you commit your troops decides the victor.

details.title: CrudWay: Star Employee
details.short_description: You, are a lowly sandwich maker. Coming from beyond the fog to run Sylvecchia's very first CrudWay. There is nothing more to your story. Stay, Serve, and Do Not Listen to the Dross...

details.title: Call Into Chaos
details.short_description: Collect and summon creatures then make them fight. Call Into Chaos is an auto-battler game with pixel graphics. In this world you survive against great creatures called Masters, evil popes and cruel kings.

name: Tales of Acilain : Bound by Shadow

details.title: Tales of Acilain : Bound by Shadow
details.short_description: Explore the lands of Acilain and uncover their secrets. Solve dynamic puzzles, defeat relentless foes, and slay challenging bosses to unlock new abilities. No weapon is stronger than that of your spirit.

details.title: Burn all out
details.short_description: Fired for missing the trash bin and dumped in the basement, channel your burnout into pure rage in this chaotic roguelike. Fight your way up the corporate ladder, crush middle management with office supplies, craft insane builds, and uncover this shady corporation's dark secrets.

details.title: Buddy System
details.short_description: Buddy System is a 1-8 player co-op camping horror game about a pack of Marshfellows who made some bad decisions. Keep the fire lit, survive four increasingly cursed campsites, and if your buddy stops being useful, roast them. The last Marshfellow standing wins.

details.title: Telluris
details.short_description: Become a waymaker on the frontier of Antaris. Fly a second-hand ship past the edge of the charted stars, dive from orbit through the clouds of a world nobody has named and land anywhere. Chart its rivers and species, name it, claim it… or go too far to ever come back.

details.title: shanghai ghost pawnshop
details.short_description: Run a pawnshop in Republican-era Shanghai, trading with the living and the dead. Appraise goods, read customers, and bargain with incomplete information. As night deepens, strange deals promise riches—or death. Prove yourself, repay your debts, and uncover how deep they truly run.

details.title: Irkalla
details.short_description: Conquer Irkalla, a world of mortals torn apart by a war between eight civilizations! Command heroes, forge and break alliances, journey through five eras of history, and choose one of the Seven Truths to change the face of reality forever. A turn-based 4X strategy game.

details.title: Currents of Vaultmere
details.short_description: Play as a young sailor in a 3D underground sea adventure. Sail seas hidden inside a vast cavern. Explore islands, stalactite cities, and underwater villages. Conquer dungeons, acquire gear, and collect items in your quest to stop Vorrakh, the Lightless Maw, whose darkness would devour the Vaultmere.

details.title: Waterfall Dreams
details.short_description: Waterfall Dreams is an expressive diorama-builder with realistic water behavior. Build your own cozy waterfalls and watch water find its path among the nature scenery. Relax without any goal and paint in a 3D world full of procedural helpers. Imagine a new place - or recreate the one you saw before.

details.title: It's Okay
details.short_description: A first-person deduction and mystery game set in an old mansion in Istanbul. Wander through the frozen final moments of those who died in the mansion you inherited. Read, listen, observe; record the secret of each death in your register and uncover the truth behind this century-old curse.

details.title: Robo Dream Party
details.short_description: Robo Dream Party is a multiplayer party brawler for 2–8 players where you send your opponents flying off the map in a robot’s wacky dreams. Jump into chaotic brawls with simple, intuitive controls! Enjoy satisfying hits and send your worries flying!

details.title: Horizon Ascension
details.short_description: Horizon Ascension is a precision FPS parkour game. Every map is a demanding challenge that calls for mastery, sharp observation, and perseverance. Ascension isn't handed out: it has to be earned.

details.title: Dirtbike Simulator
details.short_description: Hardcore motocross sim with realistic physics, real-time procedural generated engine sound and dozens of tuning options. The track deforms with every lap, replays feature an FPV drone and augmented reality, and community tracks, bikes and gear expand the game through the free SDK.

details.title: Keepsies: It's All Mine!
details.short_description: Win a fight, take something from your opponent's bag. Lose, and they take from yours. An auto-battler roguelike about packing items into a grid backpack, where the dungeon studies your build and comes prepared with counters. Swap in gear from your Sub Bag, outsmart it, and claim it all!

details.title: 锯刃之心 Sawheart
details.short_description: SAWHEART is a third-person survival action game. You play as Xi, who wakes in an unfamiliar room to find the streets outside packed with the infected — and all you have to do is survive what is left of Tidewatch.

details.title: Realm
details.short_description: Experience the next evolution of UGC maps in Realm, an open-source tactical arcade engine. Deploy armies in high-speed, large-scale auto-battler clashes, or build the next generation of multiplayer games in our editor using intuitive sculpting tools, AI-assisted map creation, and self-hosted lobbies

details.title: Catechesis
details.short_description: Embrace the darkness as a demon-possessed altar boy in this Horror RPG. Explore the city, battle demons, upgrade your weapons, and embark on an unforgettable journey with unique characters and anime-style cutscenes.

details.title: Tokatonton: One-Armed Blacksmith
details.short_description: "Tokatonton: One-Armed Blacksmith" is a medieval forge management sim. Craft unique weapons, satisfy demanding customers, or take risky deals for profit. Rebuild a crumbling forge with two struggling blacksmiths.

details.title: Tickets, Please!
details.short_description: Become a train conductor and run your own train in a relaxed cozy simulation! Check tickets, keep everything clean, repair defects, and upgrade your train. Experience humorous chaos on rails in a relaxed yet hectic single-player experience.

details.title: Rhythm of Resistance
details.short_description: In a future ruled by silence, your playlist is your weapon. In this Rhythm Metroidvania you fight to the beat, explore a dark interconnected world, and use forgotten songs to ignite the resistance. Every beat, a rebellion. Every song, a revolution.

details.title: Cold Sweat
details.short_description: Cold Sweat is a PvE single player extraction shooter set in a post-apocalyptic world. Collect loot, complete missions for traders, upgrade your base, customize your firearms, and shoot your way through other survivors and the undead.

details.title: Dark Island: Faded Memories
details.short_description: Ride dragons across forgotten islands. Explore the ruins of a world that fell long ago. Battle monsters and fallen soldiers lurking in the dark. Play solo, or team up with friends in co-op. Nostalgic graphics and style that bring back the magic of childhood.

details.title: Drill Keeper
details.short_description: Build impenetrable fortresses of mining to defend against relentless hordes of aliens and make a name for yourself as a famed Drill Keeper! Roguelike deckbuilding meets siege defense as you travel the galaxy and dig through fully destructible worlds to strip them of their riches.

details.title: NINE ROUNDS RAPID
details.short_description: Blast your way to freedom through a possessed, fragmenting space station. Upgrade abilities, mod your weapon builds, and manipulate time to defeat the station's nine gatekeepers. Power up, progress, and learn the ugly truth with every escape attempt.

details.title: Six Bullets
details.short_description: Six Bullets is a spaghetti-western CRPG. You're a drifter with no name. Meet folk barely scraping by in a husk of a town & its canyon. Choose what kind of a man you'll be. Lend a hand or antagonize. Just remember: folk never forget and six bullets are all you're ever gonna get.

details.title: EVE Vanguard
details.short_description: EVE Vanguard is an extraction-adventure FPS set on the ruthless planets of New Eden. Raid crash sites, assault forward bases and seize exotic tech before colossal Nemesis Drones hunt you down. Every mission is a race against time. Every extraction shapes a larger war. This is only the beginning.

details.title: Pawned Souls
details.short_description: Soulslike combat meets Chess. Step onto the board as a pawn: move forward, strike diagonally, and battle enemy pieces that attack using their real Chess movements. Clear the board to claim your promotion

details.title: GHOSTPUNCH
details.short_description: GHOSTPUNCH is the horror game where the monster is you. Get stronger every run with unique items, discover powerful abilities, master an expressive combat system and take back your house!

details.title: Plantlife: Market Garden Simulator
details.short_description: A botanical farming sim featuring 100 crops, each with unique care requirements to master. Plan your sowing schedule, manage your workforce and process harvests into premium goods. Transform a wild plot into a thriving market garden and craft kitchen. What will you grow?

details.title: The Landlord's Legacy
details.short_description: Restore a derelict East Village building in our cozy management sim. Scrub, paint, repair flat by flat, choose who moves in, win their trust and track the rumours that circulate. Most odd goings-on have a normal explanation. Not all. You have one year to save it from the property developer.

details.title: Server Cleanup: Night Shift
details.short_description: Turn a cluttered server room into a satisfying job well done. Collect and sort 2,000 drives across 20 cabinets, reconnect the cables and bring the network back online in this cozy first-person organizing game. Take your time, find your rhythm and enjoy the cleanup.

details.title: Tsumamigui 3
details.short_description: A romantic adventure story developed by the popular Japanese studio ALICESOFT! That bittersweet memory in his heart, never fading away— Akihito Natsuki, forced by company circumstances to take a long leave, decides to return to his hometown.

details.title: Magic Island New Era
details.short_description: Following the guidance of the goddess Gaia, elf Lumina arrived at the island country of demons - Mogapo. The Demon Lord Nora helped and took her in. After living in Mogapo for some time, Lumina gradually fell in love with this place and Nora, who led her to start this new life...

details.title: Black Autumn: 1438
details.short_description: A realistic medieval pixel art RPG set in the Hron valley in the autumn of 1438. Fight in armour you put on piece by piece, ride horses into battle, pick locks and purses, and gamble with cards or dice. No magic and no monsters, only the real Hron valley as it was in 1438.

details.title: Cursebreakers
details.short_description: Cursebreakers is an exclusively co-op first-person dungeon crawler. Invite a friend to join for free with Friend's Pass and master sword & sorcery together. Explore a lost castle and delve into a rich dark fantasy world full of monsters, traps and magic. Defeat the fallen queen and BREAK THE CURSE!

details.title: Dawnstead
details.short_description: Lead survivors to build a new home in an unknown wilderness. Develop your settlement, defend against threats, and explore the world alongside a lord who truly lives among your people. Let your lord act independently, or take direct control and write your own frontier legend.

details.title: Dearest Darling Dragon
details.short_description: Raise your own baby dragon and date a hot dragon "daddy" in this silly and fantastical stat-raiser dating sim! 🥚🐉

details.title: Mowties
details.short_description: Mowties is a combo-crafting roguelite taking place on weird boards! Build unique properties and arrange them into combo cascades to beat an ever-growing payment. Manipulate dice rolls, break the game rules with legendary items, gain a tactical advantage with secret cards - and win another run!

details.title: PINBOMB
details.short_description: The Pinball Roguelike! PINBOMB traps you in a room with a pinball machine hungry for higher and higher scores. Buy new parts to upgrade it, build wild synergies to feed the machine, and send your score through the roof. Oh, and there's a bomb strapped to it, so score big or go boom!

details.title: Waste Force
details.short_description: <Waste Force> is a post-apocalyptic PvE extraction shooter. Drive a garbage truck with your crew and survive oncoming mutants and scavengers. Repair the vehicle during chases and collect resources. Connect special trailers to complete your own vehicle. Cleanse the surface as part of Waste Force!

details.title: ShatterRush
details.short_description: ShatterRush is a multiplayer parkour FPS where fluid movement meets massive mechs in fully destructible levels. Wallrun, grapple, and smash through cover to outplay your foes in kinetic, high-speed combat as the map changes with every fight. Join the rush in our free Open Pre-Alpha & wishlist now!

details.title: Economika
details.short_description: Build a company from the ground up and scale it into a global economic empire. Manage production, logistics, real estate, stocks, commodities, and finance in a deep, open-ended sandbox where every decision shapes your growth.

details.title: Tower of Wizard
details.short_description: Tower of Wizard is a survival rogue-lite where you ascend a cursed tower filled with monstrous foes and fallen wizards. Collect powerful relics, craft broken builds, and uncover the mystery that waits at the top floor.

details.title: Relicfall
details.short_description: Forge your own class in this Bullet Heaven Action Roguelite. Combine 3 professions to shape a unique skill tree, hunt for powerful loot, and socket relics to create game-breaking synergies. Slay endless hordes and push your build to its limits.

details.title: Hunter: The Reckoning – Deathwish
details.short_description: In the bustling streets of New York, passersby are unaware of the evil lurking in the shadows. You, however, know. Hunt the creatures of the World of Darkness in this action RPG, where your choices determine whether you live another day.

details.title: Warpflux
details.short_description: Warpflux is a top-down action based resource management game. As the commander of Earth's colony ship and a fleet of autonomous drones, collect supplies and defend against hostile forces during a thousand year voyage to save humanity.

details.title: Azzy Battles the Darkness
details.short_description: Unleash elemental powers through your bionic arm in a story-driven 3D action-platformer inspired by the PS2 era. Explore 5 sprawling elemental realms, master explosive mobility upgrades, battle chaotic bosses, and search for your missing father before the Darkness consumes everything

details.title: Torment in Tartarus
details.short_description: A 2.5D side-scrolling romance adventure blending dual perspectives, puzzles, survival horror and psychological horror. Awaken with no memory in an underground experimental prison. Evade modified test subjects and seek a way out, forging a bond with a mysterious woman along the way.

details.title: Detonation Sauce University
details.short_description: An ordinary new student faces monsters after dark. With no superpowers, they use ketchup to blind monsters, creating escape gaps.​Gameplay: Evade, find ketchup, escape via hidden routes. Clear levels by escaping monsters, unlocking new campus dangers to uncover the monster secret.

details.title: Hereditas
details.short_description: Found your house or lead one of eight noble families in a medieval realm. Raise a castle stone by stone, furnish its halls, command companions and armies, and win the crown through war, trade and diplomacy – or hold what you built against every siege.

details.title: Secrets of Moon Island
details.short_description: An indie (solo dev) Action Adventure RPG with Swordplay. Fight monsters in the game's own, non target based combat system. Become stronger by leveling up and collecting / looting items and equipment. Explore and discover the islands mysteries and secrets. What will you find?

details.title: Gray space
details.short_description: A level-based game blending action, adventure and role-playing. Set in a crime city, players (from police academy) infiltrate enemies for intel, hide actions, earn stars to upgrade, and write undercover legends.

details.title: Lurk And Rouse
details.short_description: A story-rich wartime spy game. Players pick an undercover role, move the protagonist across the map to do code-breaking, steal secrets, rescue captives or assassinate leaders. Find clues via talks, swap info with comrades using signals. Sneak to eliminate enemies or take their clothes to blend in.

details.title: Beautiful Light
details.short_description: Beautiful Light, a PvPvPvE tactical first-person extraction shooter where 6 squads of 3 operators are tasked with entering, securing, and extracting an artifact in a hostile, horrific environment. Face other operators and player-controlled anomalies, but beware: mistakes can risk your life and gear.

details.title: VUP-Simulator
details.short_description: The VUP-Simulator is a game that allows you to experience the career of a virtual anchor. Here you can make videos and get fans' attention, or interact with the audience in live. Upgrade your device (PC/microphone/camera, etc.) and you (technology/sketch/L2D, etc.) to improve the audience experience

details.title: Convergent Chrono
details.short_description: A 2D action roguelike where time is your health and deadline. Freeze the world and mark foes for certain death — when time resumes, every kill executes at once. Lose control of that power, and the world accelerates against you. Sell time to grow stronger, earn time to survive. How much is left?

details.title: GORTH
details.short_description: GORTH is a fast-paced open-world aerial combat game. Fly low across hostile territory, hunt enemy convoys, destroy radar sites, ships and military bases, dodge missiles, and survive with limited fuel and ammunition.

details.title: RIFTW ARDEN
details.short_description: Side-scrolling mech action game. Three guardian mechs, three ways to play, with fighting moves designed by a world fighting champion. Protect the core and survive thirty waves of monsters.

details.title: SILENT REALM
details.short_description: Free To Play Game, An atmospheric action horror experience set in a non-human realm governed by rules unlike our own. A world of skeletal entities and shifting remains, where forms assemble and decay endlessly, and death exists as an active, hostile force rather than an outcome.

details.title: Deckrage
details.short_description: A grim single-player card-based tactical RPG where you assemble a party of four heroes, chart dangerous expeditions, and survive brutal battles by managing formation, stress, and resources.

details.title: Tomathen's Blunder
details.short_description: A 2D action-RPG dungeon crawler. Choose one of six animal heroes, wield swords, flails and bows, and master nine schools of risky magic with finite mana. Find keys, unlock gated halls, and loot your way to the temple terrace.

details.title: The Coldest Winter
details.short_description: Making decisions has never been harder. Guide Jovanna through a psychological horror adventure in a freezing New York City. Navigate unstable characters, uncover the truth behind the unnatural weather, and struggle to make choices as her emotions fight your every move.

details.title: Gun Wizard
details.short_description: Fight as the Gun Wizard, a veteran war-mage who bends space & time to battle an overwhelming goblin horde. Master magic, melee, stealth and the explosive firepower of the future. Dangerous quests, dynamic destruction, and hard-earned loot await in an ever-escalating arms race of magic and machinery.

details.title: Libra Apocrypha
details.short_description: A dark-fantasy deckbuilder with strategic turn-based combat and a haunting narrative of gods, fate, and rebellion.

details.title: Dark School
details.short_description: Dark School is an adventure with FUN Boss Battles! ..And Unspeakable Horrors. Face the dark alone, or with a friend..

details.title: Defender of Grids
details.short_description: A pixel-perfect Tower Defense game where defeat is just the beginning. Master the rock-paper-scissors balance of combat, speed up the action with 4x speed, and use your hard-earned XP to unlock powerful permanent skills. Can you hold the line?

details.title: Nightclub Life
details.short_description: Turn a small neighbourhood bar into a packed nightclub in an isometric management sim. Design your venue, hire staff, set prices, and book DJs. Keep the night running when queues grow and the unexpected happens.

details.title: Showa American Story
details.short_description: Showa American Story is an RPG steeped in retro pop culture. In the late 1980s, a dominant Japan culturally colonized America. Resurrected from the grave, Chigusa Choko embarks on a road trip of combat, exploration, and growth across a world both absurd and strangely familiar.

details.title: Aequorea Victoria: The Museum
details.short_description: A first-person journey through a world made of art. Wander a gallery of paintings, music and film, step into surreal rooms of fear, climb a tower where every floor is a different story, and leave your dreams for strangers to find.

details.title: Pulse of the Neon Soul
details.short_description: Upgrade your Neon Soul and free the world from the Red Virus in this relaxing neon-themed incremental game.

details.title: Mission Nuts
details.short_description: More than a colorful 2D action-adventure platformer, Mission Nuts is a personal artistic vision blending exploration, humor, original poetry, hidden lore and philosophical reflection. Follow Wiewiu on a heartfelt journey about friendship, hope and finding light in life's darkest moments.

details.title: Not Your Eyes
details.short_description: Your eyes cannot be trusted. A girl finds herself questioned by a twisted psychiatrist, helping a fallen angel, and followed by a bizarre stalker, descending to a beautiful, terrible world where nothing is as it seems.

details.title: Voodoo Dolls
details.short_description: The only way to save his beloved Jill from her death, is for Jack to shoot through hordes of Voodoo Dolls at the Witch's Halloween Party. Voodoo Dolls is an original FPS Video Game packed with fast paced action and non-linear 90s style dungeons.

details.title: Roguelike Story
details.short_description: A Strategy JRPG Story Driven Roguelike

details.title: Badass Brad
details.short_description: They killed your wife. They killed your dog. Now it's your turn to kill them in this fast paced roguelike!

details.title: Peppermint Academy
details.short_description: A cute western bara visual novel with RPG combat, where you can build a party, collect monsters, and have a romance with hot guys. Peppermint Academy is a strange school that brings together humans, demons, and angels from many different worlds.

details.title: Famine
details.short_description: Play as the new candidate chosen to participate in a deadly game. If you succeed, humanity will survive a few more days. If you lose, you die.

details.title: TacBrain
details.short_description: TacBrain is a tactical strategy game focused on small-scale battles, an innovative command system, and realistically paced combat. Issue orders, coordinate your units, and use positioning, timing, and careful planning to outmaneuver your opponent.

details.title: Bad Heroes
details.short_description: Save the world and romance misfit heroes in the first-ever dating sim and beat-em-up! When a crime wave grips Gloom City, you and your ragtag band of heroes-for-hire uncover shocking truths about the A-list supers at the top. Fight crime, punch mimes, and kiss six superheroes with supernatural abs!

details.title: Auctus
details.short_description: Auctus is a deep sci-fi RPG where your body is a cybernetically enhanced tool of destruction. Talk your way out of danger, sneak past enemies, or shoot your way through. Soar above danger with jet-augmented legs and blast enemies with arm-integrated rockets. Level up, gear up, and solve quests.

details.title: Hotel Espir
details.short_description: Trapped overnight in a grand Alabama hotel built on plantation soil, you must outsmart the echo of a century-old killer. Use sound, stealth, and your instincts to survive the night and uncover the secret beneath Hotel Espir.

details.title: Ugly Jack: The Halloween Curse
details.short_description: A painterly folk-horror game set on a colonial frontier, 1666. Something below the fields has begun taking the people who work them. By day, tend the harvest and set your scarecrows. By night, walk as Stingy Jack, lantern in hand, and keep what comes out of the dark from reaching the village

details.title: Hollow Covenant
details.short_description: A grim dark-fantasy MMORPG in a world kept alive by corrupted gods. You are nobody: your father is buried and his killer is still walking. Level, craft, guild up, and decide how each fallen deity ends - purify, slay, or bind. No one chose you. You chose to cross.

details.title: Load Path: Engineering Office Manager
details.short_description: Run your own engineering firm in this cozy office builder/automation game. You'll get to build your office floor by floor, automate the flow of projects, and play engineering themed mini-games, all whilst trying to not get buried in paperwork.

details.title: Damned Dwellers
details.short_description: Play out your misery as entertainment for the all-seeing Dungeon that brought you to life in this hack-n'-slash rogue-lite. Delve uncharted rooms, puzzles, and fight monsters like yourself to learn what makes it tick, but DON'T let it grow bored...

details.title: Song of Horror: Enhanced Edition
details.short_description: The Presence is watching. Enter this third-person psychological horror adventure and survive a paranormal entity you cannot fight, one that strikes when you least expect it. Uncover the story through multiple characters in an experience unique to every player.

details.title: Clown House: Lunacy
details.short_description: A narrative horror experience where violence is a trap. Unravel the secrets of a derelict mansion and its uncanny clown residents. Solve puzzles. Observe the clowns, deduct their needs and what angers them to survive. And never harm the residents of the Clown House. It has eyes.

details.title: Backlight War
details.short_description: A 3D top-down, level-based post-apocalyptic survival delivery game. Players control a debt-ridden character, take "Crisis Emergency System" tasks to enter ruined cities, fight oncoming zombies and mutants, pick up items via buttons to boost abilities, finish deliveries for debt repayment.

details.title: Flee
details.short_description: The leading role is a group of treasure adventure lovers, each to a place to find treasure will be booked in advance a dwelling to rest, but they have no awareness of hidden in the dark a pair of eyes are staring at them, waiting for the opportunity to kill!

details.title: Den
details.short_description: Together you explore, together you survive. Lead siblings with unique abilities through a co-op survival Metroidvania. Scavenge diverse biomes, coordinate every move, and master interdependent powers. Uncover a nostalgic story of family as you fight to build a new home, a new Den.

details.title: LIMINOUS
details.short_description: An exploratory first-person survival horror story about travelling the gaps in our reality. Risking everything to keep the lab funded and the board members happy.

details.title: Hallow's Eve
details.short_description: Welcome to Hallow's Eve We follow Stingy Jack, on his adventure to possible redemption. Come and follow Jack to see where he will go.

details.title: Faceless Residence
details.short_description: Explore an abandoned mansion shrouded in mystery and danger. Face eerie creatures, solve challenging puzzles, and uncover hidden secrets that could be your key to escape – or something far darker.

details.title: ECHO_
details.short_description: ECHO is a stylized role-playing game. Play as a young woman returning from deep space, exploring a silent Earth,solving puzzles, and following a mysterious signal to find the people and memories she left behind.

details.title: Trillionaire Mercenaries of 21XX
details.short_description: In 21XX, humanity clings to the remains of a cyberpunk world consumed by the ocean. As corporations fight for what's left, you'll work as a mercenary for the ultra-rich, carrying out covert operations in a third-person stealth adventure that tips the balance of global power.

details.title: WORLDS: Anthropos
details.short_description: Embark on the only story ever told. You are Maya, marooned on a hostile world with no memory of the fall that put you there. Ammunition, healing and life share one meter — you replenish it only by surviving. Seven worlds stand between you and the truth. Anthropos is the first.

details.title: For God and For Profit
details.short_description: For God and For Profit is a Renaissance investigation game. Audit the ledgers, question the merchants, and uphold the truth...for God and for profit.

details.title: Liminality: Chapter 1
details.short_description: Liminality is a Singleplayer Liminal Horror Game That focuses on Liminal Environments, and has a bunch of lore that you have to uncover - Based on the web-series and movie created by Kane Parsons (The Backrooms) CAN YOU ESCAPE THE LIMINAL COMPLEX

details.title: Nav Singh's Poohopia
details.short_description: An open-world RPG adventure. More details coming soon.

details.title: Mars Era
details.short_description: Mars Era is a turn-based strategy game about Mars colonization. Build your base, welcome settlers, gather resources, research technologies, and overcome the harsh conditions of the Red Planet. Manage your settlers, develop infrastructure, and turn Mars into a new home for humanity! 🚀

details.title: 持镣铐者#735
details.short_description: 《The Shackles Holder #735》 is a female-oriented text-based game set in a steampunk world. On November 30, 1875, Police Chief Temis, known for his 100% case clearance rate, was transferred to the crime-ridden city of Nineveh.

details.title: The Long Freeze
details.short_description: The world froze. Humanity changed. Explore the snow-buried remains of civilization, scavenge for food, fuel and supplies, fight those transformed by a failed vaccine, and do whatever it takes to stay warm. The storm never stopped. Will you?

details.title: Tidal Forces
details.short_description: Explore a galaxy of 300 systems as you control your fleet in a top-down 3D style, navigating through Star-lanes, Warp gates, and Black holes. Customize and upgrade your fleet, complete missions, trade, hire your crew, wage war and determine the fate of the galaxy in this grand sim saga.

details.title: Battle Scars Eternal Stars
details.short_description: This is a simulation game, made by an independent game developer, individual developers have limited energy, please don't have too high expectations. You play as a robot exploring a planet. You can freely drive vehicles, use weapons to attack, and more advanced weapons such as controllable missiles

details.title: Boundless world
details.short_description: Enter the vast forest of Boundless World , no traditional map boundaries, procedural random details/buildings make battles variable; battlefield has differentiated destruction (explodable procedural buildings as key variables); agile AI feels like real players, single-player has multiplayer tension.

details.title: Fantasy Cartographer
details.short_description: Fantasy Cartographer is a relaxing game about creating maps with hand‑drawn graphics. Build lands filled with seas, mountains, and forests, gather resources, develop cities and kingdoms, discover new drawings, complete quests, gain experience, and become a master of cartography.

details.title: Settle or Sweep
details.short_description: Settle or Sweep is a single-player Durak roguelike deckbuilder. Attack, defend, take tables into your hand, upgrade cards, and collect Rigs that change the rules. Chain multi-card combos and multipliers to push your score as high as possible.

details.title: Magic Animal TD
details.short_description: A cozy, tower defense adventure. Command two unique heroes and deploy a quirky squad of magical animals—like a pig, butterfly, and snail! Customize your defenders with powerful magic crystals to maximize their combat potential and repel enemies across vibrant worlds.

details.title: Farming Mushroom
details.short_description: "Let's run a mushroom farm!" The story of novice farmers growing mushrooms begins.

details.title: Unsound
details.short_description: Unsound is a first-person psychological horror game. Explore unsettling environments, solve puzzles, and uncover a dark mystery. Things are not always as they seem, and the deeper you go, the stranger things become. Pay attention to your surroundings and piece together the clues.

details.title: Yeommae
details.short_description: Yeommae is a point-and-click game about traditional Korean shamanism. Investigate objects, witness past memories, and solve puzzles. Uncover the truth through the four senses and untangle the twins' twisted fate at the hands of the Mudang.

details.title: The Other Ear of Sock
details.short_description: An experience for little - and big - people who could use a bit of tenderness. Help the little bunny Sock find a place to hide from the cold winter night. What kinds of characters might he run into?

details.title: The LastShard
details.short_description: Make a life in the last world still lit. In this high-fantasy sandbox MMO, learn skills by using them, craft and trade with players, and build a home. Beyond guarded towns, open PvP puts everything you carry at risk.

details.title: Canyons
details.short_description: Canyons is a third-person action shooter set in a procedurally generated world. Fight mysterious Awakened alone or in co-op for up to 4 players, command giant Crawlers, build your haven, and survive a brutal living world.

details.title: Oathwood Realms
details.short_description: Oathwood Realms is a dark fantasy strategy card game focused on careful planning, tactical decisions, and calculated risk. Luck plays a role, but victory favors players who read the board and commit to their choices.

details.title: St. Nicholas Night
details.short_description: The Night of St. Nicholas is a night that rekindles the belief in miracles. Brave the snowstorm, wander through snow-covered streets, uncover hidden presents in a city fast asleep, and restore the magic of this heartwarming winter adventure.

details.title: Mama
details.short_description: An emotional narrative point-and-click about a daughter caring for her mother as dementia reshapes their bond. Explore heartfelt conversations, fragmented memories, and story-driven puzzles on a journey of caregiving and learning to let go.

details.title: Hopeless
details.short_description: HOPELESS is a first-person psychological horror game where players explore looping, distorted environments, observe subtle changes in reality, and survive an ever-shifting space.

name: KREIS AREN ashes of the uprising

details.title: KREIS AREN ashes of the uprising
details.short_description: A 2.5D action RPG where you play as an inventor-hero, battling invaders, crafting unique gear, and exploring a mysterious world. Your decisions determine the fate of your people and the outcome of the uprising.

details.title: The Great Tribes
details.short_description: Blending the best of classic and modern 4X strategy! Lead humanity from nomadic tribes to space conquest. Shape the land, mix cultures, and forge your own laws. Face a fair AI system, which learns and explores the world just as you do.

details.title: Punching a Dirty Wizard
details.short_description: The Dirty Wizard wants you to punch him, he wants you to kill him. One strike at a time.

name: Nexus of the Dead God: The Microcosm

details.title: Nexus of the Dead God: The Microcosm
details.short_description: You will lead a squad—formed solely for the sake of survival—as you continuously push forward across a vast hexagonal map. Recruit companions, adjust your formation, devise tactics, and carve your way out of the Bone-strewn Continent through a series of automatically unfolding battles.

details.title: Skinscribing
details.short_description: SKINSCRIBING is a 2D hand-drawn and dual-handed cosmic folk horror game wherein you explore environments, grief, and bodies alike to interpret and tattoo the history of a dying world as the foundation for the Era to come.

details.title: O.T.B.R.O.S.: Haze of Kazantip
details.short_description: O.T.B.R.O.S.: Haze of Kazantip is a shooter about the Crimean Exclusion Zone in the style of OLR, Anomaly, and Lost Alpha mods, black humor and harsh social satire. Collect anomalies in jars, treat hemorrhoids, and fight evil spirits. Absurdity, hardcore, and complete freedom in the world await you.

details.title: Power of Desert (Quvvat ul-Sahro)
details.short_description: Immerse yourself in the world of medieval Central Asia during the golden age of science, culture, and Islamic revival. Power of Desert is a story-driven, single-player RPG inspired by Uzbek folklore, Turkic legends, and the spirit of ancient warriors. A cinematic journey awaits!

details.title: Major Hoof
details.short_description: Check it out ! it’s pure action and chaos. Major Hoof is a fast-paced 2D shooter inspired by Metal Slug, combining intense bullet hell with environmental destruction and action-packed levels. Fight through hordes of enemies and uncover a dark story.

name: The World of Enemies with You

details.title: The World of Enemies with You
details.short_description: A Novel × Turn-Based RPG told through seven perspectives. Join Mahoru, a new Hunter of αh, and enter Outrealm, a world threatened by Enemies. Experience strategic battles and a story where each perspective reveals a different truth. Uncover the secrets of this world. これで約260〜280文字程度です。

details.title: Shatterlight
details.short_description: Shatterlight — survival horror platformer. Play as Agnes as you enter a Victorian mansion swallowed by the Dark World, where fears take physical form. Use light and a mirror shard to survive living darkness, uncover a family’s nightmare, and find your missing brother.

name: War of Light: Liberation of Aetherquill

details.title: War of Light: Liberation of Aetherquill
details.short_description: A 2.5D dark-fantasy action RPG with roguelike builds and a multi-ending story. Choose your hero, face unpredictable battles, draft items and equipment, and summon Roundtable allies. Shape Aetherquill’s fate through your decisions. Play solo or in two-player local co-op.

details.title: Atahion - Tower Defense
details.short_description: Build your defense base to repel alien invaders. Atahion is a strategy and tactical defense game in which you have to extract resources, build defense towers and use bonuses to complete the mission.

details.title: Unoffensible
details.short_description: A VR strategy game where you are big, powerful and in control. Command your forces to build, defend, and destroy.

details.title: MAHOU SHOJO REVENGE!
details.short_description: MAHOU SHOJO REVENGE! is a visual novel where you follow an ex-magical girl on a quest of revenge against her former squad mates that betrayed her.

details.title: Potion Pals
details.short_description: A co-op witches’ shop game for up to 6 players where you brew potions for woodland critters and turn your friends into frogs. Chop, grind, and stir witchy ingredients, fill orders, and try not to blow up the shop. Drink your own stock to explore the woods and uncover forbidden recipes.

details.title: Dark Lessons
details.short_description: Trapped in your teacher's home, your only defense against the dark is a flickering candle. Unearth a family’s twisted history and solve puzzles in this Lovecraftian nightmare to find a way out. But be warned: Something else is lurking in the shadows ... and a voice is pleading for your help.

details.title: Teo Dove Am Skater 2
details.short_description: Skateboarding game in the spirit of THPS. Perform flip tricks, grabs, grinds. Insane lines. Level up your character and learn new tricks. Find hidden secrets. And challenge your rival to a classic game of skate HORSE!

details.title: Choppy Waters
details.short_description: A roguelike deckbuilder where you build your cards, not just your deck. Combine ingredients, each with its own effect, into sushi, then serve it to hungry pirates in turn-based battles. Spend gold to grow stronger, but run out and your voyage is over.

details.title: Foosball Manager
details.short_description: Foosball Manager is a table football management sim. Scout, sign, and train your squad. Set your tactics, then call the shots from the sideline as your players act on their own across a physics-driven table. Climb the divisions and become a foosball legend.

details.title: Phantasist
details.short_description: Phantasist is a game about a boy living with social anxiety!

details.title: Convenient: Fiend
details.short_description: Quickly dig graves and run for your life while solving puzzles to solve the mystery of the Wendigo

details.title: Club House on Haunted Hill
details.short_description: A story driven golf game, challenge friends locally or online or experience the cinematic story. Customize your golfer with the right set of clubs and delve into a haunted golfing adventure!

details.title: The Hydra Experiment
details.short_description: Solve puzzles and fling flasks as a member of a mad scientist collective in this action-adventure RPG. Unlock prototypes and discover new mechanics, using them to explore deeper into 0-Laboratories. Build or burn bridges as you sculpt your persona with branching dialogue and consequences.

details.title: ノウ
details.short_description: "Know" is a cute, eerie, and slightly melancholic adventure game. Explore, evade "Kaibutsu" (monsters), and uncover the secrets of this world!

details.title: Bato Battō
details.short_description: Bato Battō is a 3D platformer-fighter set in classic arena-style multiplayer. Fight with unique direction based melee combat, athletic movement, and multi-chain combos using stylized physics. Compete a variety of game modes - Deathmatch, CTF, King of the Hill, Multi-Team and more!

details.title: This Is Land of Mysterious
details.short_description: Fate throws you into an mysterious island adventure! Try to survive a perilous voyage across the Island! Build your own home, solve a puzzles and gets more trophy but be wary! You will need a lot of effort to survive.

details.title: Timepunk
details.short_description: Retrofuturistic bullet-hell roguelike where you play as a rogue time traveler, fighting through hundreds of historical foes! Every run reshapes history itself— Shoot weapons from different eras, use time-manipulating skills, and create unique builds to survive until you reach the end of all time!

details.title: Sanguinite
details.short_description: Sanguinite is a lunar-lander-meets-twin-stick-shooter action game with elements of resource management and exploration. Equip your remote drones and explore the dangerous surface of distant worlds. Bring resources and artifacts back to your ship. Investigate the origin of the aliens you encounter.

details.title: Last Patrol
details.short_description: You are an Orderlord — a mutating meatball cop battling cultists in a surreal post-human dystopia. Evolve your form, investigate an intergalactic conspiracy, and prevent cosmic annihilation in this top-down horror shooter.

details.title: Beyond the Pier
details.short_description: Set sail for an uncharted New World. Explore unknown islands, build thriving colonies and compete with rival factions in a living world where every voyage, battle and decision spreads rumors that shape your reputation, economy and diplomacy.

details.title: Death Ring
details.short_description: Death Ring is a casual action roguelike in which you will have to force your way through hordes of undead in search of the human world’s main artefact. Numerous scenarios of each character’s development based on random dropping items will make your runs unique.

details.title: Dig Dig Boom
details.short_description: Dig Dig Boom is a strategic mining roguelite set in a fully destructible world where time moves only when you move. Dig, blast, explore and fight your way through procedurally generated caves using a wide selection of mining tools with unique effects.

details.title: Ending Tau
details.short_description: Ending Tau is an action roguelike where you morph your body parts with curses that completely change the game. Walk, fly, teleport, or dig your way across the jungle. Explore unique mechanics with endless mix-and-match upgrades, unravel a beautiful pixel art land, rebuild your village, and End Tau.

details.title: Diode Arena
details.short_description: Design, build, and pilot bots with wildly varying movement abilities and weapons, then use them in online cross-platform PvP matches. Earn cash and advance through the tiers of the tech tree to unlock new parts and build better, faster, stronger bots.

details.title: The Mangust
details.short_description: The Mangust is a high octane action platformer. You play as the Mangust, a lone drifter with a loose grip on reality. Blitz through enemies with an arsenal of customizable guns and special abilities. Explore different environments, defeat iconic bosses, and stop the plans of the Evil Dr. Cassowary.

details.title: Little Monster
details.short_description: Little Monster is a hand-painted side scroller beat ‘em up where you play as Stormy, a monster under the bed who protects us from our nightmares. Protect the dream! Explore the realms! Rescue your friends!

details.title: Arcane Arena
details.short_description: Arcane Arena is a fast-paced multiplayer action game where spellcasters clash in team-based combat. Choose your class, master powerful abilities, and dominate the arena. Manipulate time, summon creatures, wield the elements, and combine magic with your team to claim victory.

details.title: Specters of the Sun
details.short_description: Specters of the Sun is a challenging 2D action platformer with action-packed levels. Take on the role of an elusive specter to reclaim your old corpse, now possessed at the heights of your former kingdom.

details.title: Eternal Summer
details.short_description: unmixing reality

details.title: Psychotic Bathtub
details.short_description: Have a psychotic episode in your bathtub. Argue with a rubber duck, flood your bathroom and drown Jesus. Find your very own ending – or all of them.

details.title: Ecosphere
details.short_description: A Fantasy / Steampunk Visual Novel in which you'll make hearts skip a beat! You are Arane Kross, a talented engineer capable of controlling nature with a machine: the Ecosphere! What will be your impact?

details.title: Jeller Fellers
details.short_description: Bounce, squish, and launch through a vibrant, stylized world in Jeller Fellers, where you *attempt* to control a wobbly jelly cube. Solve puzzles, overcome obstacles, and explore diverse environments in this challenging, physics-based precision platformer

details.title: Creej's Corruption
details.short_description: Creej's Corruption is a Combat Based First-Person Action RPG set in a pre-apocalyptic suburban town. When reuniting with your family, an ominous building in the distance suddenly collapses causing a massive chain of events. Your brother has been taken. You're the only one who can save him.

details.title: Devil Apartment
details.short_description: Hello, Jake. Welcome to the game.

details.title: Just in Crime
details.short_description: Just in Crime is a detective video game in which you play a detective dog and a wizard cat. With a twist; you are able to travel back in time and examine the crime scene a few seconds before it happened.

details.title: Dōbumon
details.short_description: Dōbumon is an RPG monster collecting/battling game. Experience tactical battles as you choose 4 Dōbumon to fight with on the battlefield. Grow, evolve, and customize your attacks while developing different strategies in order to win, as you fight and explore your way to become the Dōbumon champion.

details.title: Gravity Shift
details.short_description: Trapped in a space station, your only way out is to solve puzzles by manipulating gravity. In this game you will destroy destructible surfaces and go through non euclidean impossible spaces.

details.title: Legend of Hidden Flows
details.short_description: 《Legend of Hidden Flows》It is a sandbox Immortal cultivation game that combines strategy card construction, open world ,and role-playing.You can experience a different life in this world.

details.title: April '86
details.short_description: April ’86 is an atmospheric first-person psychological horror about returning to Pripyat, where the past never truly died. Explore the abandoned city, uncover the mystery behind the disappearance of children, and confront what was hidden behind the Chernobyl disaster.

details.title: Zehlar
details.short_description: Explore a world full of secrets and magic, inhabited by creatures with unique elemental abilities. Ally with them to embark on your adventure, and train alongside your creature companions to become stronger and conquer the challenges of the world.

details.title: Elite Rogue
details.short_description: Elite Rogue – BOUNTIES. CHAOS. BETRAYAL. Every contract is a high-stakes gamble in this unpredictable roguelike! Hunt alone or with up to 10 players, earn Darkmatter to unlock game-breaking powers, manipulate reality, and outsmart rivals. Adapt or be erased. WISHLIST NOW!

details.title: Bloody Horror Plant
details.short_description: Bloody Horror Plant – probably the bloodiest casual point and click adventure game ever! Help Horror Plant solve interesting and funny point and click puzzles, kill evil dwarfs, save the forest and its creatures!

details.title: Limbo Control
details.short_description: Limbo Control is a 1v4 asymmetric horror game where a supernatural creature takes over the area in an attempt to anchor itself in our world, while four hunters fight to reclaim control before it’s too late.

details.title: VICCP 2 Core
details.short_description: The Very Important Central Control Panel is back. Keeping the mysterious atmosphere and with even more mysteries. Control the omnipotence remote, experiment, and find many endings. Brainstorming in retro sci-fi style / Puzzle / Quest / Point Click.

details.title: Isolation One
details.short_description: Exciting action with puzzle elements and an interesting plot, which takes place on the huge spaceship Transporter P18. In this game, players will encounter an incredible mixture of science fiction and horror. Immerse yourself in a dark world where you need to survive at any cost.

details.title: Operation Excision
details.short_description: Operation Excision is a retro styled first person shooter with visuals inspired by 1980’s vector graphic arcade games, and a setting and story influenced by 1970’s and 1980’s science-fiction movies, books, and comics.

details.title: Born from the Soil
details.short_description: Conquer the apocalypse using gritty dirt bikes and explosive ordnances in Born from the Soil, a blend of classic turn-based tactics, modern gameplay polish, and 16-bit retro charm.

details.title: C.C.C.: Special Cleaning
details.short_description: C.C.C.: Special Cleaning is a third-person bullet hell shooter. Join Cosmo Clean Co.'s Special Cleaning Division, drop onto high-risk planets, and recover the planet cores a former operative stole. Absorb incoming fire, slow the field with Time Dilation, and hit glowing weak points.

details.title: Unheeded Influences
details.short_description: A spiritual journey in the life of an elemental soul in our mythologies and legends. A unique adventure infused with 12 elements: fire, time, shadow, water... Unlock powerful spells and influence the game of other players. Fast travel through spirit realms, and try to survive in physical ones.

details.title: Wieldo
details.short_description: Wield your sword and your creativity to survive in this procedural world. Fight to build. Build to fight. Bring some friends and make it home 🏠

details.title: Poker Warlords
details.short_description: Poker but your cards fight to win the pot. Turn cards into armies, complete combos for more power, and claim victory on the battlefield and at the betting table! From the creators of a top-10 StarCraft II custom game, this is poker like you've never played before.

details.title: Dead Detective: Zombie Conspiracy
details.short_description: Step into the shoes of Margh, an undead private detective, in this hilarious and bizarre adventure that combines classic point-and-click gameplay with an elaborate “deaduction” system. Use your brain (or what’s left of it) to solve strange and unconventional mysteries in a world ruled by zombies.

details.title: Heroes of Abyss
details.short_description: Heroes of Abyss - a rogue-like tactics army battler. Guide the heroes through rooms full of different creatures. Equip and sacrifice your heroes in procedural dungeons as you fight your enemies!

details.title: Agent Simulator
details.short_description: If you are a sharpshooter, you would be a great fit for us. Within a short period of time, select 3 options from the list and deal with your enemies. Do not forget that the ability of using time efficiently and aiming your targets are crucial. Complete each mission and earn an agent certification.

name: 東方霊守祀 ~ Consciousness' Unity of Opposites

details.title: 東方霊守祀 ~ Consciousness' Unity of Opposites
details.short_description: Gensokyo, the sacred land of the forgotten, mysterious spirits whisper silently from every corner. Burning torii lintels, an uncanny full moon—where do these visions of the present world lead? Become a maiden within the barrier and uncover the truth behind the strange tale of the world of stillness.

details.title: My wife is a princess
details.short_description: A traitor appeared in the kingdom, and the seal of the demon king was lifted. In order to save the kingdom~the beautiful queen sent a rescue request to the brave...The price was to become the wife of the brave!

details.title: Myrne 6313
details.short_description: Myrne 6313 is a mix between the extraction shooter genre and corporate life. Survive an hostile office space where each step can be your last. Help HR find their stapler, get chased by security dogs, clear your inbox, fight cultists in the parking lot, learn magic… And more!

details.title: Hanoi Puzzles: Spin Match
details.short_description: Inspired by the classic Tower of Hanoi, Assemble towers by spinning pieces to get the right pattern on a hexagonal board with a mysterious and relaxing atmosphere.

details.title: Wonderland Quest
details.short_description: Wonderland Quest is a casual point & click adventure game. Travel across Wonderland teeming with colorful challenges, surprises and creatures, brought to life with beautiful artwork.

details.title: Moonbriar
details.short_description: Delve into a dark fantasy visual novel where evil isn't always as it seems. Make your choices and grow your skills to help determine who survives the Great Culling. Featuring the voice talents of Ralph Ineson, Simon Callow, Savannah Steyn, and more.

details.title: Forgotten house
details.short_description: Be QUIET, otherwise he will notice you. You want to find a way out of this house? Game inspired by Gnarled Hag and Granny.

details.title: KVLT
details.short_description: Fight your way through armies of Nazi occultists, religious zealots, and unspeakable cosmic horrors to unveil the Eldritch secrets behind the war theatre in this 2000s-era-inspired grimdark singleplayer FPS where WW2 meets Cthulhu Mythos.

details.title: Red Rebellion
details.short_description: A sapphic fairy tale mashup as Robin Hood teams up with Red Riding Hood to save their town set in a historically accurate medieval England.

details.title: THE SONG OF THE NIGHTRIDER
details.short_description: Unravel the secrets of evil love with sword and song. Become a sound witch and break the Nightrider's curse!

details.title: Not Waste Wood
details.short_description: Forge your path in True Men Ascend, a dark fantasy action RPG with cultivation-inspired progression. Choose from 20 classes, hunt loot, master relics and Inner Arts, and challenge dungeons and bosses solo or in online co-op for up to 4 players.

details.title: Slum Dweller
details.short_description: Slum Dweller is a physics-based fighting game about typical situations that slum dwellers encounters on a daily basis. Try on the role of a slum dweller trying to survive in a harsh criminal environment or a street fighter taking part in underground tournaments.

details.title: Neko's Rage
details.short_description: Neko's Rage is a pixel art rogue-lite platformer set in a post apocalyptic future overrun with dangerous biomechanical robots. Play as the cyber Neko-01 unit and collect always more loots to upgrade your Hub and character.

details.title: Charon - Zhetan Chronicles
details.short_description: A turn-based pixel-art 2D Queer Magitech Fantasy (J)RPG where you overcome the chasm ordained by divine fate! An epic story with diverse characters, strategic battles and handmade artworks awaits you!

details.title: Goblin's Journey
details.short_description: Goblin's Journey is a humorous adventure game with a stupid plot and even more idiotic characters. You play as a greedy bastard goblin named Alastar. You are about to save you king's life - in exchange for gold of course! An adventure full of gold, mischief and innapropriate content.

details.title: The Last Exam
details.short_description: Dylan hasn't left his home since the pandemic. As he struggles to move forward, his dreams pull him back to one day from his youth: the day of his final exam. Explore his memories in a hand-painted watercolor point-and-click adventure, solve puzzles, and uncover why he can’t let that day go.

details.title: BLIGHTWRECK
details.short_description: Stuck at the bottom of the sea floor, escape a sunken ocean liner in this handcrafted 2D METROIDvania! Find powerful upgrades, and fight strange bosses. You may be isolated from your shipmates, but you're not alone...

details.title: DAO
details.short_description: DAO is a platform action adventure game. You travel back to a dark era. As the last Daoer of your sect, you set off on a journey of vengeance. Combine diverse weapons and talismans to fight numerous foes, and piece together the kingdom's lost memories from fragments.

details.title: Starship Colony
details.short_description: A deep starship colony sim. Build your starship, manage air, water, food, fuel, energy, temperature and psychology to keep your crew alive across vast distances. Closed-loop system in space. Mining, wiring, plumbing, in-ship factory, (alien?) radio signals & translation, diplomacy, combat, and more.

details.title: Battle for the Void
details.short_description: You will annihilate your opponents with an arsenal of over 40 types of weapons across multiple online game modes. Strange creatures and the destructible environment will make each gaming session unique! Level up and obliterate everything around you! are you ready to survive in the void?

details.title: Mountain Resort Manager
details.short_description: Build a cozy alpine resort where gondolas glide, guests explore, and your mountain evolves through seasons. Place trails and buildings, manage staff and finances, and watch the resort come alive at your pace.

details.title: PROJECT NULL
details.short_description: You wake up in a dark forest and you don't know how you got here, and you don't remember anything. But somehow everything changed. You meet strange creatures, and no one is very friendly in this world. Soldiers, monsters and basically everything in this place is trying to end your journey quickly.

details.title: Old School RPG II
details.short_description: Old School RPG II: Dawn of the Orc is a party-based RPG. Create a group of adventurers whose destiny is forged by the actions they take and their choices will matter and impact the game world. Featuring advanced class customization options, strategic turn-based combat, and trap filled dungeons.

details.title: Life Souls
details.short_description: Life Souls is a cooperative roguelike for 1–6 players featuring dynamic arena combat, free-form skill combinations, epic bosses, and permanent progression.

details.title: Ham's Game Store Simulator
details.short_description: Run your own retro game shop! Stock shelves, manage customers, collect rare games, and even play the ones you sell. Upgrade your store, host launch events, and build the ultimate gaming destination in this cozy simulation game.

details.title: TOKENS: Rogue Club
details.short_description: Launch explosive combos and master your luck in TOKENS: Rogue Club, a tic-tac-toe deckbuilder roguelike. Every flip counts while you forge synergies with Arcanes, Effigies, and Harmonies. Paris's nightlife in the 1920s with its artists, magicians, and exciting challenges awaits! Welcome to the club!

details.title: OEDO DEVELOPER
details.short_description: “Oedo Developer” is a city builder featuring Ieyasu Tokugawa's Edo. Story and free play modes are available, the first offering a history based city building experience, and the second allowing you to freely develop the lands. Plan, build, distribute, and learn as you make the Edo of your dreams!
developers: 株式会社ドリームスレッド
publishers: 株式会社ドリームスレッド

details.title: CatchMaker
details.short_description: Embark on a cozy, 3D adventure where you catch bugs... and match them for perfect romance! Explore a world abuzz with cute critters and help them find their perfect date through playful minigames. Befriend the locals, uncover your past and embrace your destiny as steward of a magical island.

details.title: Gourmet Steak Odyssey
details.short_description: A resource management platformer where you play as Sweet Baby Jesus on a quest to make the perfect steak. Use your gun to propel yourself through levels and use your feet viciously to crush your foes.

details.title: KARATE ROGUE
details.short_description: A stance-driven, turn-based combo roguelike—turn defense into offense and fight your way out of the abyss.

details.title: Decay of Worlds
details.short_description: A tactical fantasy defense game with RPG elements: Deploy powerful units, wield magic, and lead a band of heroes through dark missions filled with meaningful choices.

details.title: The Darkness Delivers
details.short_description: A haunting horror story set in an isolated abbey. Jeanne, a naïve young nun, struggles to save her lover, the angelic Sister Séraphine, from a wasting disease which has ravaged their home - but what is Jeanne prepared to sacrifice for Séraphine's sake?

details.title: Stella: into the Shadow
details.short_description: Stella comes to Blackwood for a few days to write about an old case: in 1988, four teenagers drove out to the lake and never came back. Then a murder happens in town, and leaving is no longer an option. A detective visual novel about an investigation and feelings that arrive at the wrong time.

details.title: As We Unite
details.short_description: As We Unite is a political strategy simulation game where you play as a high-ranking Consul of a secretive cult aiming to unite the world before an impending global calamity. Instead of controlling a country, you manage agents across different nations, each run has a crisis you have to resolve!

details.title: Aetherfall
details.short_description: Aetherfall is an elemental post-apocalypse extraction RPG set on a modern Earth where technology has failed and elemental power rules. Master fire, earth, air, and water, combine them into new elements, and risk everything as you fight to survive and grow stronger.

details.title: Bearskull 2
details.short_description: A vast open world, ruthless Vikings, powerful bosses, and an epic co-op mode – rise to the challenge! ⚔🔥🐻💀

details.title: End the Endless
details.short_description: End the Endless is a dark fantasy Monster Collector set in the Purgatorial Realms. Harness every resource at your disposal, including your own party members to slay a variety of horrors. Explore the Afterlife, meet the ones who call this land home and seek to conquer the Seven Terraces.

details.title: Vox Manipuli
details.short_description: The king is dead! Tame chaos in this unconventional strategy with autobattler and puzzle elements, set in a fantasy setting. As the King's Regent, manage your Councilors so that they vote accordingly to your will. Manipulate, trigger synergies and win debates!

details.title: Dawn Watcher
details.short_description: Lead your army

details.title: Voyage Router
details.short_description: The further you go, the more the universe turns against you. Voyage Router is a navigation-driven roguelite strategy game where you explore dimensional oceans, chart optimal paths, and risk everything for a greater haul.

name: The Haunting of the Chea-Wilson Family

details.title: The Haunting of the Chea-Wilson Family
details.short_description: A Cambodian-American family becomes haunted by a ghost. Enjoy this story-driven narrative as the haunting unfolds. Inspired by horror movies in the late 2000s-2010s.

name: Mystic Academy: Escape Room VR Edition

details.title: Mystic Academy: Escape Room VR Edition
details.short_description: The VR version of your wizarding exam is here! Within this enchanting escape room, you'll navigate a wizardry school, unravel puzzles, master new spells, and put your magical skills to the ultimate test. Will you emerge triumphant?

details.title: Contagion Protocol
details.short_description: Survive an endless undead horde in this brutal auto-battling roguelike. Slash, upgrade, and evolve your arsenal as chaos unfolds to the pulse of an industrial metal soundtrack. Contagion Protocol is fast, bloody, and built for replayability.

details.title: Saw Counter
details.short_description: The killer is here, and now he's coming for you!!He will put you through trials, play with your emotions, your mind, and your body. Are you ready?

details.title: Fizz Flow: Factory Management
details.short_description: Fizz Flow is a strategy and management game that takes place in a setting without competition regulations. In old America, where the beverage industry is on the rise, build your own factory, make your own unique recipes, weaken your opponents and maintain your hard earned success at the market!

details.title: Tramp: Become President
details.short_description: Start from picking through trash, collecting, crafting, and trading hundreds of items. Explore sewers, hire workers, run businesses, withhold wages, dodge taxes, and buy votes on the black market. Turn trash into assets, and assets into power. One day, you too will sit atop the President's desk.

details.title: Death By Pixel
details.short_description: Death By Pixel is an action RPG shooter with exploration elements. Experiment with elemental weapon combinations, exploit enemy weaknesses and trade your defenses for devastating abilities.

details.title: Talas
details.short_description: Shoot your way across deep space. Shred through waves of enemies, unravel the secrets hiding beneath the surface, and explore the endless synergies in this retro-inspired action roguelike.

details.title: serverBound
details.short_description: Corporate AI broke the internet, so people rebuilt it by hand. Now something is eating it. Walk their paper-and-ink web islands, read each one like a crime scene and work out the rule of whatever's attacking it. Then fight it in a turn-based duel with no dice, no levels and no excuses.

details.title: Cutting Edge: Roots Of Mutation
details.short_description: Perform life-saving operations in this fast-paced surgery sim. As lizard surgeon Dr. Peri Maddock, you'll treat injuries, excise tumors, and hack corporate organs with speedy, surgical precision. The patient's life is in your claws!

details.title: CHTHON
details.short_description: CHTHON is a visual novel about pain, memory, and the darkness within us.

details.title: Age of Amelorn
details.short_description: Recruit unique units, cast powerful spells, and conquer your enemies in a 2D fantasy strategy adventure. Tackle a challenging campaign or dive into Skirmish Mode to create and customize your own battles.

details.title: Rasna
details.short_description: "Rasna" is an historically accurate Etruscan tale: a legend as it might have been told in ancient times when people gathered around the fire. A single-player, story-driven historical open-world game to jump 2500 years in the past.

details.title: FEAR BOUNDS: Amelia story
details.short_description: Through phobias to the truth. Embark on the chilling journey of the girl, Amelia. Monsters and horrors born of a child's imagination rise up, revealing the deepest secrets of her family's past. Fight or flee, hide or jump! Learn, solve puzzles, and explore these terrifying, twisted worlds.

details.title: Fear of Horror
details.short_description: In 1944, you take on the role of Jason Miles. On behalf of the OSS, you are sent to a waterworks near the Schneiden in the heart of Germany, because according to reports, a Nazi scientist is researching how to resurrect fallen soldiers as ghosts.

details.title: Arcadice
details.short_description: Play a top-down shooter on an arcade machine you’re handcuffed to. Buy vices between levels and abuse them to power up your run. Load dice like bullets and shoot dice-headed enemies. This is not a dice game.

name: Echoes of Shadows: The Last Jinyiwei

details.title: Echoes of Shadows: The Last Jinyiwei
details.short_description: A third-person stealth adventure set in the late Ming dynasty. Play as Jinyiwei agent Xie Guxian and travel with a mysterious girl. Observe patrols and connections between people. Use Threadweaving together to create openings for infiltration and rescue, and find a way through danger.

details.title: Battles For Glory
details.short_description: Battles for Glory is a free MMORPG where opposition of parties and control of the world map are combined.

details.title: AFTER 9PM
details.short_description: AFTER 9PM — a game where reality and nightmare merge into one. Your parents left you home alone. It’s already late. Every time they left you like this, you had strange nightmares. Each time, they became more and more real. And now you’re not sure… if it’s just a dream anymore.

details.title: Sunset Suckerpunch
details.short_description: Meet K8E: a talking, transforming motorcycle-greatsword-gauntlet-pistol. Drive her to meet your enemies, and wield her to crater them into the asphalt. Turn the bodies of your enemies into supersonic projectiles in fast-paced, power-tripping combat. Don't let them take her voice.

details.title: No One Leaves the Field
details.short_description: A first-person folk horror game set on a cursed farm where the wheat shifts each time you enter. Search for your car keys, uncover the family’s dark ritual, and beware—something ancient walks between the stalks.

details.title: SPRKLS.exe
details.short_description: ˚ ̴̡̢̛̼̬̠̰̀͟҉̢C͊͊ ༘⋆ ⟡̷͛ SPRKLS.exe is a cute, melancholic story-driven puzzle-platformer visual novel about friendship and apocalypse that unfolds entirely on YOUR desktop 𓂃˗ˏˋ⟢ 𓂅 ⋆. ˖𓏲ּ𝄢 ⟡̵̂ ִֶָ 𓂃⊹

details.title: Software CEO
details.short_description: Build your own software empire from scratch. Manage projects, recruit staff, design components, and grow from a garage startup to a tech giant. Create SaaS platforms, sell software, or fulfill contracts. Balance quality, deadlines, and innovation in this relaxing yet deep business simulation game.

details.title: BioRogue
details.short_description: Grab a living cybernetic fish. Fire it. Mutate it. BioRogue is a 3D twin-stick roguelite bullet hell where 100+ mutagens let you splice together a build that's yours alone. Die, adapt, and go again, until the regime that built this island out of genetic exploitation finally falls.

details.title: Infinite Alliance
details.short_description: Heroes and villains from 17 Indie JRPGs collide, in this story rich Crossover Event! Chained Echoes, Jack Move, CrossCode, 8-Bit Adventures 2, Beloved Rapture, Quartet, and more unite for a totally FREE adventure!

details.title: Parasensor
details.short_description: When Marisol accepts a job as a telecom technician, she finds herself in a quarantine zone where civilians are mutating into insects. Connect with strangers, confront grotesque creatures, and unravel a conspiracy at the heart of the metamorphosis.

details.title: FoldLoop
details.short_description: FoldLoop is a detective game that emphasizes logical reasoning. To escape the curse of endless cycles, you'll observe the sandbox from a higher dimension, analyze the rulebook, and deduce the secrets of the real world.

details.title: Regions
details.short_description: Build a living region, from the first street to a network of towns and cities. Shape the land, grow neighborhoods, plan public transport, and guide the economy. Follow residents through their daily lives in a deeply simulated city builder where every connection matters.

details.title: The Fish
details.short_description: Escape the corporation's laboratory and save the ocean poisoned by mutagen. Cleanse biomes, build and develop your base, use a variety of vehicles, communicate with civilizations through gestures and gifts, fight mutants, and explore the interactive world solo or in online co-op.

details.title: Pickle Panic
details.short_description: Steer the jar with your pickles inside. Roll through trap-filled courses! A 1–4 player physics-based co-op chaos: clear obstacles without shattering the jar, return to checkpoints, and try wild tactics with friends. Easy to learn, hard to master.

details.title: Greta Sees Ghosts!
details.short_description: Greta Sees Ghosts! is a lovingly crafted cozy adventure filled with quirky ghosts, witty dialogue, and clever shape-based puzzles. Explore remote islands, help the dead move on, and uncover Greta’s quietly touching story. One odd encounter at a time.

details.title: Chakravyuh
details.short_description: A compact Indian mythological action game where you play as Abhimanyu and face three challenging handcrafted boss duels. Learn attack patterns, dodge bullet-hell barrages, break enemy poise, and master melee strikes, parries, ranged attacks, and Astra abilities to survive.

details.title: QUADREMOR
details.short_description: A first-person shooter where you play as one of the last human mercenaries, driven by vengeance for the annihilation of humanity. Dive deep into a dark and unforgiving realm fueled by cruelty.

details.title: TouHou Legend of Fairy Souls
details.short_description: “TouHou Legend of Fairy Souls” is a TouHou fan game.In the game, because of someone's conspiracy, Reimu turned into Kedama and caused her power to weaken.Reimu then had to embark on an adventure to recover herself and finally uncover who was behind the scenes.

details.title: Onslaught Rift
details.short_description: An arcade hack and slash where you rapidly switch between three heroes to decimate waves of enemies! Master each of the heroes' abilities as you fight your way through dangerous areas, each with unique monsters and bosses.

details.title: Elidriel
details.short_description: Elidriel is a story-driven pixel-art RPG that combines reactive turn-based combat with character customisation, a range of non-combat activities and a mystery surrounding a lost love. Explore a world of wonders, crafting, cooking, fishing, playing songs and mining gems to upgrade your weapons.

details.title: Rocket Penguin
details.short_description: A challenging flying game controlled with just two buttons. How high you can fly is another story. Now join Peeo and dive into the world of penguins, soaring to space. Push your limits and become a true flying legend!

details.title: Reinforced Machine
details.short_description: A fast-paced mech arena shooter mixing arcade intensity with skill-based unlocks. Unleash powerful ultimate forms, mix and match skills to define your playstyle, and master each unique combat machine to unlock their signature abilities.

details.title: DollHouse: survive  or death
