details.short_description: A stately, huge, beautiful mansion... Where is this?Opened the door of the mansion with a nervous heart, and the moment , I knew there was no turning back.

details.title: Bite Size Terrors: Speechless
details.short_description: Find what was taken from you at any cost in this Minimalistic Survival Horror.

details.title: Self Simulated
details.short_description: Self Simulated is a fast-paced precision platformer about a robotic copy of yourself, waking up with no memory of a severe accident. Dash, dodge, and double jump through 100+ handcrafted levels, reboot instantly on every fail, and uncover the truth behind your past.

details.title: Paris Transylvania
details.short_description: A vampire-slaying pachinko roguelike deckbuilder. Collect a powerful deck of cards, strategize, aim, and pop pegs to power up and deal massive damage with relic synergies. Play as one of the unlikely heroes, conquer Transylvania, and free the people in this turn-based RPG.

details.title: Dice Captain
details.short_description: Dice Captain is pirate roguelike about managing luck. Roll dice, adapt and outsmart bad luck to win battles at sea. Build wild artifact combos and upgrade your dice faces between runs to turn pure chance into a strategy you control.

details.title: AirBoost Airship Knight
details.short_description: the blonde Airship Knight Dorota, during a battle in the ruins, accidentally discovers an amnesiac girl, Agate. This also draws the attention of sky pirates, leading to fierce battles. The game offers rich levels and exciting battles, with many companions who will fight alongside you!

details.title: THE SUSPENSE
details.short_description: Discover the story of a man tortured by the hardships of life among “endless rusty walls”. Explore the world of a terrifying alternative future, overcome challenges, and maybe you'll be saved (or at least learn a hint of the truth).

details.title: NANOVOID
details.short_description: NANOVOID is a 2D tactical space shooter that puts you in command of your own modular spaceship. Engage in intense, physics-driven battles, strategize with ship customization, and outsmart your enemies

details.title: XWarShooterVR
details.short_description: Dive into "XWarShooterVR": an amazing VR world that combines dynamic shooter, techno-magic and base-building strategy. Make your way to victory in tactical battles and attacks on other players' bases. Add to wishlist now and become a legend in the VR world.

details.title: Project Cradle
details.short_description: Save humanity in the blink of an eye! Project Cradle is a fast-paced action platformer. Pilot a nimble HelperBody drone, a robo kangaroo capable of all sorts of acrobatics! Zoom, burst, and grind through a maze of mysterious underground facilities as you search for the last remnants of humanity!

details.title: GameChanger - Episode 1
details.short_description: Take on the challenge to close the Great Five Portals in this varied 2D-Action-Adventure with Twin-Stick-Shooter Gameplay! Explore the vast Interworld, solve tricky puzzles in complex dungeons, shoot your way through hordes of mysterious entities and stop the dragon!

details.title: Bagsy
details.short_description: Dive into the colorful and captivating world of Bagsy, an infiltration game where cunning and strategy are your best weapons! Take on the role of a daring thief whose goal is to steal carefully guarded treasures from a variety of shops and banks.

details.title: Neon Rush
details.short_description: Speed through a neon city in this 2D retro racing game. Outsmart cops and rivals with skillful maneuvers. Immerse yourself in illegal racing, fueled by synthwave beats, and dominate as the underworld's top racer!

details.title: Chikaro
details.short_description: A boy and an android girl wake up without their memories in a world where deadly robots roam the streets. With the boy's powers, they can leave their bodies to walk through walls or possess enemies. The two follow the trail of the intentions left behind by those who once perished above the ground.

details.title: Greenfeet Haven
details.short_description: A friendly fantasy colony sim where you manage halflings. Start with nothing, launch expeditions into the wilds, experiment with crafting to discover new items, and evolve your settlement into a thriving, self-sufficient town! Inspired by the genre of RimWorld and the ambience of Stardew Valley.

details.title: CountDown
details.short_description: CountDown is a casual, semi-idle, 2D tower-defense. Waves of enemies are advancing, it's your job to bolster your city, or rather, ammunition, and wipe them out. Will you rise to the challenge, or let your city crumble?

details.title: Icebreaker
details.short_description: Icebreaker is a co-op action roguelike for 1-3 players. Keep a watchful eye on the actions of your PROWLER units, as they deploy to complete endless missions in ever-changing and very hostile facilities.

details.title: Incline ~Railway of devil's valley~
details.short_description: An action adventure with a quirky battle system that uses an inclined railway to carry and seal devils to a sacred boundary. Robbed of his weapons, the unarmed hero must keep dodging devil attacks in the cargo bed of an inclined railway until he reaches the sacred boundary at top floor of village!

details.title: Wildforge Hero
details.short_description: Defend against waves of enemies in this minimalistic roguelite game with base building and RPG elements. Collect resources and Craft new gear! Build structures to gain bonuses and new perks!

details.title: Autofahrt
details.short_description: A storm is gathering and devouring everything. Drive for your life alone or with friends and escape the deadly storm. Repair and keep your vehicle intact, it's the only way to reach the bunker and survive.

details.title: A Short Odyssey
details.short_description: Discover a mysterious 17th century Caribbean island. Perfect your swordplay, take on giant bosses, cook tasty dishes, or take in the scenery, it's your choice in this 3rd Person RPG. Investigate the secrets of the island while you freely explore a detailed simulated world.

details.title: The Telwynium
details.short_description: A 90s fantasy adventure epic from the creator of The Drifter- It's your first night away from Willows Dene, and you have first watch.

details.title: Floatineer
details.short_description: The game is set in a world where lands have vanished beneath the waves. Players experience life as floating engineers, using modular architectural blocks to rebuild shelters that can withstand various disasters and fulfill villagers' aesthetic requirements within a given time limit.

details.title: Mithrall
details.short_description: Mithrall: Realm of the Dwarves is a massive survival-sandbox MMO. Dig into the mountains, build kingdoms above and below ground, claim and tax the land, and fight from skirmish to siege in a vast realm shared by up to 15,000 players.

name: Reggie & his Cousin: Two Scientists and Most Likely the End of the World

details.title: Reggie & his Cousin: Two Scientists and Most Likely the End of the World
details.short_description: Reggie's peaceful life is interrupted by a wild time-travel mission! Step into a playable hand-drawn animated story where you'll break physics to master the flow of gravity. Meet an absurd cast and uncover deep mysteries to fix (or screw) the universe’s future.

name: Mops & Mobs: A Sweeping Dungeon Adventure

details.title: Mops & Mobs: A Sweeping Dungeon Adventure
details.short_description: Mops & Mobs is a humorous dungeon adventure, spicing up storytelling with decoration quests and card-based battles. Befriend eccentric monsters and solve problems as the dungeon’s janitor. Clean, decorate, investigate, and eventually uncover dangers threatening the dungeon.

details.title: Headlice
details.short_description: Headlice is a reverse horror game where you play as an escaped biological abomination fleeing an inept corporation. Embrace your parasitic nature and become the monster you were meant to be.

details.title: OCRPG
details.short_description: An Arcade Styled RPG with surprises, laughs and horrors at every turn.

details.title: Free Stars: Children of Infinity
details.short_description: Experience a stellar space adventure and the sequel to The Ur-Quan Masters. Travel through hyperspace, engage in fast-paced combat, discover weird worlds, and meet a unique cast of truly alien aliens as you uncover a mystery that threatens the galaxy.

details.title: Alonecats
details.short_description: Colorful mischief-makers have settled in this valley. Solve puzzles to find them all in a new unique game in the genre of animal search.

details.title: Enemy Metal
details.short_description: 2.5D Roguelite Shooter with Unique Gameplay, Powerful Weapons and a Killer Soundtrack. Battle the dangerous enemies and defend the planets of the Sunstar System! Gather crystals and destroy turrets to level up and unlock exciting new Starships on each planet!

name: Steel Runner - VR Block Craft Sandbox

details.title: Steel Runner - VR Block Craft Sandbox
details.short_description: Steel Runner is a VR vehicle crafting sandbox game using physics. Create your own unique vehicle by combining various types of blocks, then ride it to enjoy free exploration, adventure, and combat in an open-world environment. Shape your ideal vehicle and explore this vast world!

details.title: Escape From The Past
details.short_description: A scientist is stranded in the Bronze Age with a dead time machine and a pocket knife. Raid the valley for materials, survive Scythian warriors and wild animals, and work through the history of technology, from a sharpened stick to the first battery, to get back home.

details.title: Work In Progress
details.short_description: It’s your first day in office and half of the staff is already on burnout... Here is your gun, your contract. Now go fire some people.

details.title: 9Cat Saga
details.short_description: 9Cat is a Co-op shooter/action game. Gather your friends to forage and extract in the procedurally-generated landscape. Nourish and furnish your collection of 9Cat, refine your combat styles and overcome various missions and defeat great enemies.

details.title: Piece Quest Idle
details.short_description: Shape a party that keeps growing while you’re away. Gather resources, upgrade your base, craft gear, customize hero skill trees, and tune auto-battle strategies to conquer powerful bosses

details.title: Locus Equation
details.short_description: You are an anthropod, a synthetically crafted life form. Your objective is to save the ones who are stuck on an uninhabited planet. Persuade, charm, manipulate: use your ultimate power—freedom of choice—in sci-fi role playing hyper variative game LOCUS EQUATION.

details.title: Awakening: Into the Stars
details.short_description: Become the one and only Captain of the Colony Ship Oberon as it cruises towards the Planet Zaenus with a single goal in mind: to colonise it and make it into a brand-new home for humanity. Such a huge task might seem daunting, but don’t worry, for you are not alone on your journey...

details.title: Loya
details.short_description: Command walking fortresses to battle giant monsters in this open world survival rpg! Play alone or bring your friends to explore, farm, fight, build and craft to unravel the mysteries of Loya!

details.title: First Blood : Persian Legends
details.short_description: First Blood : Persian Legends is a linear story-driven real-time-tactic strategy game based on ancient Persia, Sassanid Empire. Our story is heavily inspired by true events. Can you help saving the Sassanid Empire from within?

details.title: Whisperwood Werewolf
details.short_description: Whisperwood Werewolf: open-world action adventure RPG. A villager becomes a night-walking werewolf; as Revna, explore, upgrade, uncover secrets, and hunt it; talk to all characters for clues.

details.title: AI Kills All Humans
details.short_description: AI Kills All Humans is a Tactical RTS game in which you play as an AI sending robots to kill all humans. You however don't have direct control of your robots, but robots independently decide how to execute your commands, like a general telling troops to attack, but troops themselves decide how.

details.title: Squiigee
details.short_description: Use your momentum to swing, launch and fly, cleaning cityscapes in record time to earn some sweet, sweet cash!

details.title: Trivals
details.short_description: A team hero sport with one rule: no passes, no score. Pass to charge the Elderball, borrow your teammate’s power, and take down the enemy Guardian, a goal that fights back and evolves with every hit.

details.title: Small Kingdoms
details.short_description: Small Kingdoms is a streamlined grand strategy and RTS game with procedurally generated campaigns. Build up your cities and armies on the world map and command your troops on the battlefield. Rule a medieval fantasy kingdom and conquer your rivals.

details.title: Micro Rogue
details.short_description: Fight, Upgrade, Repeat! Micro Rogue is an action roguelite where you battle room by room against enemies that upgrade just like you. Build your power, outsmart evolving foes, and see how far you can climb before either side breaks the game!

details.title: Herosbine : The Unknown Island
details.short_description: Explore a mysterious open world, battle hundreds of uniquely assembled Herosbines, and claim their Hero Parts to combine their powers and shape your own combat style. Guide Tim through a story-rich journey of grief, identity, and self-discovery.

details.title: Dungeons of Edera 2
details.short_description: Return to the land of Edera, where you play as a sword-for-hire, exploring environments, competing for contracts, and waging guerrilla warfare to become a legendary mercenary, alone or with friends.

details.title: Outlaw Raiders
details.short_description: Lead your outlaw crew on raids to rob, steal, and fight for riches. Build up your camp and recruit more outlaws so you can become the ultimate outlaw.

details.title: DOLOS: Your Best Future
details.short_description: A sci-fi political thriller. Live the life of an operator of DOLOS, a social regulation system predicting everyone's future. Analyze applicants' profiles and decide about their lifetime career. Apply DOLOS' logic or find how to counter it ... but don't get fired!

details.title: Machina of the Farthest
details.short_description: "Wouldn't it be awesome to fly?" Travel to the world's end in this warping-boomerang adventure with its beautiful pixel art.

details.title: Drone Operator Guerilla Warfare
details.short_description: Drone Operator is a game where you will use civilian drones to conduct military operations against an overwhelming occupying force. Use your technical skills to turn harmless flying toys into deadly weapons, and outsmart your enemy. But remember - stay vigilant.

details.title: Good Luck, Little Truck!
details.short_description: Good Luck, Little Truck! Is a genre-bending cozy navigation puzzler/narrative delivery sim. Set in a recovering post-collapse world where robots and humans coexist, help North Pacifica Island bounce back one delivery at a time!

details.title: Mind Vessel
details.short_description: An autobattler roguelike in which you are a Vessel formed by the unification of dead people's spirits. Dismember and graft them to customize their abilities, as you use them to find a way out of the void.

details.title: Silence of Elven Mage Rin
details.short_description: A puzzle game featuring a beautiful elven sorceress.

details.title: Catacombs Of The Yokai
details.short_description: Catacombs of the Yokai is an indie single player psychological survival horror game in which you must explore the twisted depths of randomly generated catacombs filled with enemies inspired by Japanese/Taiwanese urban legends and myths.

details.title: SpaceDominator
details.short_description: SpaceDominator is strategy fantasy open world where you can discover universe! Contact other civilizations, make friends or enemies, start trading or fighting, expand your own area or help others to expand, increase your intelligence level.. and much more! Follow developing http://discord.gg/cqEZJ5J

details.title: Spellcraft
details.short_description: Spellcraft is a new type of strategy game: a Real-Time Battler where you actively command an entire team of heroes and cast spells to outplay your opponents. Wishlist now and play in Preseason 2!

details.title: Firearms Factory
details.short_description: A strategy-management game centered on weapons production and wartime logistics. Your candy factory is forced, by government order, to arm the military throughout both world wars. Set up production lines, supply the front lines, keep your workers alive, and determine the outcome of the war.

details.title: Tianfang Funland
details.short_description: After being stranded in a decaying amusement park, an elementary school student and his estranged older brother discover that the city they grew up in has been tampered with. Tianfang Funland is a surreal adventure game with retro game visuals that bring players to 2010s Beijing.

details.title: Hop Hop Delivery!
details.short_description: HOP HOP DELIVERY it's your little delivery company! Your goal is to find and deliver animals and objects in all genre, through crazy, creative and deformable levels, using different types of vehicles impacted by physics!

details.title: Peggy's Farm
details.short_description: Combine the cozy crafting of a farming sim with the satisfying physics of a pachinko game.

details.title: Rewind And Reclaim
details.short_description: REWIND and RECLAIM is a horror adventure where time moves when you move. Explore different outcomes for each movies by using your wits and your environment. Uncover their behind the scenes to unfold the story linking them all and protect your familly from the curse that took your mother's life.

details.title: Kelp Keeper
details.short_description: Take on a vital role in the ecosystem in this action-packed bullet hell. Control a charming sea otter and protect the kelp forest from an endless onslaught of devious sea critters. Skillfully dodge attacks, grab your prey, and eat them all at the surface for a huge satisfying snack.

details.title: Ashwood Conspiracy
details.short_description: Ashwood Conspiracy is a dark Slavic mystery adventure. Follow in your late uncle's footsteps to uncover the truth behind the town’s most devastating event. Find, collect, and combine items to solve puzzles and overcome obstacles. Will you dare to finish what your uncle started?

details.title: Warbound
details.short_description: Build a battlefield that evolves from Stone age battles into futuristic mechanised warfare. Demo is LIVE

details.title: A Totally Realistic Stealth Game
details.short_description: Become a stealth soldier fighting through enemy lines using whatever methods you see fit to stay undetected in this first-person shooter. Take a slow, methodical approach or go guns-blazing; as long as you remain undiscovered, any means to success is viable.

details.title: Sova
details.short_description: Descend into a surreal sci-fantasy world in this narrative-driven action roguelite, where every run reshapes your story. Sova’s expressive combat meets deeply branching dialogue and world-shifting decisions. Compose your violence, rewrite your past, and bend a crumbling realm to your will.

details.title: 妖精牧场 - Fairy Ranch
details.short_description: Fairy Ranch is a fast-paced multiplayer co-op management simulation game. Players engage in a variety of production activities across diverse biomes—including grasslands, forests, deserts, mountains, and snowy plains—gathering products to complete orders.

details.title: ZOMBIE KEBAB VR
details.short_description: Cook kebabs and fight zombies in this fast action game. Explore streets, gather ingredients, and feed survivors. Unlock new tools and recipes as you survive each night. Fast, funny, and brutal. Known online as the “4 a.m. fast-food simulator”

details.title: 机影：夏夜梦寻
details.short_description: "A Midsummer Night's Dream with the Android Girl" — As Deputy Director of the AI Oversight Bureau, navigate the cyber metropolis alongside your robot assistant, Dill. Investigate rogue AI cases, uncover the truth behind dreams, and unlock multiple endings.

details.title: Starball Pachinko
details.short_description: Spend the night in a back-alley izakaya where a fox-masked owner pours the drinks and the regulars wear festival masks. Play the old pachinko machine in the corner, build your board, and win prizes that help them. A cozy pachinko roguelike.

details.title: Love in Space
details.short_description: A Sci-Fi Karaoke-Musical where your choices shape the story and your decisions become the lyrics. Escape Earth, make questionable friends, find unexpected love, and sing your way to a better future. And don't worry about hitting the right notes, you've got bigger things to worry about.

details.title: Peddlers Between Pulsars
details.short_description: Peddlers between Pulsars is a story focused shop sim with light logistics. Play as one of five peddlers as they try to fulfill odd tasks from a frustrated researcher.

details.title: FATAL HEELZ
details.short_description: Third-person, cyberpunk-vampire brutal action game. Play as Silo, a female vampire-assassin. Kill your target and uncover the secrets behind the organization you work for.

details.title: Eclipsi
details.short_description: Embark on an epic 3D space shooter adventure featuring dynamic space combat and thrilling planetary exploration. Battle in single or multiplayer modes from 1v1 to 5v5, strategizing to achieve victory through base destruction, resource collection, or base capture. Dominate with our ranking system!

details.title: COMING HOME
details.short_description: A retro slasher horror game, with a focus on home defense. In the dead of night, you hear someone lurking outside - but you are not defenseless. Watch the cameras, barricade your doors, and have your gun at the ready - anything to keep the Sundown Rippers from claiming their next victim.

details.title: Fio and the Doomed City
details.short_description: A “city-building” x “tower defense” SLG by a young girl, Fio. Fio and her guardians, the Flora Bears, are building a city in the last city of humanity. Increase facilities, residents, and resources, and prepare for battle. Withstand enemy attacks and defeat the boss with your big beam cannon!

0 2 8 is a first-person inspection and management game set at a vertical passenger transit station. Serve a penal shift, inspect arriving train modules, manage limited holding space, and decide who goes up, who waits, and who is sent back down.

details.title: Neighbor's Wife
details.short_description: Your neighbor is always busy and doesn't have much time to spend with his wife, which makes her feel lonely and sad. You are the only one who can save their marriage!

details.title: Pote Pote Dream
details.short_description: Pote Pote Dream is an action RPG where Pote Pote, a timid teddy bear who cannot fight on his own, summons allies to battle. Set in the dream world of his owner, a girl, Pote Pote fights against her inner troubles to save her.

details.title: Travellin Cats in England
details.short_description: Find many cats hidden across England in this cute hand-drawn hidden object game by Travellin Cats - the original viral hidden cat game creator! Can you find them all?

details.title: Aerocore
details.short_description: Aerocore is a liminal walking simulator about the future they promised you and never arrived. Explore the corporation's simulation environments in this atmospheric experience. Alter the architecture by solving puzzles in impossible spaces and lose yourself in nostalgic aesthetics.

details.title: Anemorie
details.short_description: A girl with a fragile heart. A gift to see forgotten memories. Dive into Anna’s world where every object holds a story—and one memory may change her life forever.

details.title: Other World Strike: Helicopter Rescue
details.short_description: A third-person helicopter action shooter featuring realistic physics-based flight enhanced by alien technology. Extract stranded soldiers before hostile alien forces capture them across open maps set in three distinct biomes, with optional first-person gameplay and four selectable camera views.

details.title: 2 FAST 4 YOU
details.short_description: Race through challenging levels and annihilate killer bots. Master your movement to create your own fastest paths to the finish line. Use unique abilities to speedrun your way to the top of the leaderboards. Catch and banish the evil folder - your cat’s life depends on it!

details.title: Dungeon Ward
details.short_description: Dungeon Ward revives old‑school grid‑based dungeon crawlers and focuses on fast‑paced combat with flexible character progression. Level up, master powerful skills, and defeat challenging bosses in this action‑packed RPG.

details.title: Rise of Lambs : Awakening
details.short_description: 《Rise of the Lambs: Awakening》 is a 3D Roguelike where you play as a young lamb. After a brutal coyote pack invades your peaceful sheep tribe, you must protect your home, uncover the truth, and awaken your powers to stop the war and save the world from apocalypse.

details.title: Rogue Battalion
details.short_description: Command your troops in Rogue Battalion, a WW2 auto-battler blending strategy and action! Build your forces, unlock upgrades, and use powerful abilities like airstrikes and artillery to survive relentless waves. With meta progression and endless tactics, every run brings new challenges.

details.title: Blitloop
details.short_description: A fast-paced, side-scrolling retro shooter where you play as “Blit" on a mission to rescue orb pods. Blast enemy swarms and face off against bosses in this bullet-hell shoot 'em up. Earn power-ups and get ready for fluid arcade action in a stylish world with an 80s synthwave soundtrack.

details.title: Grow Wild
details.short_description: Plant trees and wildflowers, create wildlife habitats, and discover hundreds of creatures in this cozy relaxing nature game. Transform empty landscapes into living ecosystems as you bring nature back to life!

details.title: Storm Settlers
details.short_description: A survival citybuilder set in a desert afflicted by relentless sandstorms. Build, farm, research, clear sand and protect your people from the storms. Will you find water or desolation? Will your settlement thrive or be buried in sand?

details.title: Between the Lines
details.short_description: In this pre-smartphone-era text adventure, use that good ol’ T9 phone to text your way through the highs and lows of school days. Choose replies piece by piece to shape your own story. Friendships grow; feelings get complicated; secrets flicker. Every reply matters—it all happens Between the Lines.

details.title: Lost Zone: Survival
details.short_description: You wake on a barren island with no memory - the newest contestant of a survival TV show. Feed the Pit to bring the island back to life, build a raft and row out to strange islands rising from the sea. Loot fast: every island has its own way of ending.

details.title: psy-relic
details.short_description: A cooperative horror game in which you collect "psy-relics" that have abnormalities caused by psychic phenomena.

details.title: The Ardron Universe
details.short_description: Your choices carve scars across realms. One universe. Multiple games. No second chances.

details.title: Wild Terrain
details.short_description: You're a wild pig on a quest to find all of your missing piglets. Smash obstacles, forage through trash for food, discover special mushrooms, and poop flowers to restore balance as you grow closer to your piglet family and the wild around you.

details.title: Curry Princess GOLD
details.short_description: A casual kawaii action game where you collect falling spices, earn gold, and cook delicious curry.Including Classic mode, Story mode, and 2P mode offers both competitive and cooperative play. There is also a curry catalog and leaderboards.

details.title: Zomb Zerro - 999
details.short_description: Psychological VR horror built around immersive physical interaction. Protocol 9-9-9 is compromised deep in a secret mountain facility. Science collided with occult rituals - something horrific awoke. Explore, scavenge scarce ammo, fight for survival, and uncover the truth.

details.title: The Dropouts
details.short_description: A spooky choices-matter mystery set in 2004 Switzerland. Many students have disappeared in Noirmont High over the past century. You're Lou, you just transferred here, and weird stuff immediately starts happening... will you be the next dropout?

details.title: Mindwarp: Island Detective
details.short_description: Up to 4 players in online co-op. Talk to characters, learn their stories, search for clues and pass judgment before sunset in this unique detective.

details.title: Digital Legacy of Zero
details.short_description: Battle with creatures you collect to defeat the evil Ruler of the Digital World. Hack and slash through enemy domains, upgrade your basement to achieve ultimate evolutions, and summon legendary beasts. Unlock powerful upgrades with devastating combos to conquer the Digital World.

details.title: Stellar Raven
details.short_description: On a flying laser tank, fight the armed forces of the Empire and, after overcoming several planets, meet the Empress and fight her in a mortal battle.

details.title: Escape Velocity
details.short_description: An explosive first-person puzzler!

details.title: Crow Boss
details.short_description: Feared for countless acts of brutality, the former warrior known only as Boss returns from the depths of Limbo. Betrayed by those he once served, he now walks among the living once more, driven by a single purpose: to take revenge on those responsible for his downfall.

details.title: Morphing
details.short_description: Morphing is a 2D adventure puzzle game where you possess the ability of morphing. This power allows you to transform and acquire the traits of certain objects or creatures. Use this unique skill to overcome challenges and explore the world.

details.title: Embers Of Spiritflame
details.short_description: Embers of Spiritflame is an Emotional Point & Click detective adventure about the exploration of an old abandoned house. Inside, you go through comic book-inspired levels and begin to uncover why everyone is missing. View events and memories of the place and piece the story together.

details.title: UnderPath
details.short_description: UnderPath is a single-player horror FPS that takes you into a dark, dangerous world. Explore abandoned locations, fight zombies and demons, solve puzzles, and shape your fate in an atmospheric open world filled with challenges.

details.title: Touhou Chronicle of Youkai Prayers
details.short_description: "Touhou Chronicle of Youkai Prayers" is a Touhou fan-made roguelike action game.Due to a Kedama incident in Gensokyo, Flandre Scarlet eagerly takes the initiative to resolve it. Or rather, she's actually just causing chaos, definitely not trying to solve anything!

details.title: Starlight Brigade
details.short_description: Starlight Brigade is a realistic space action-adventure game with a precise combat system and full 6DOF controls. You command the Wayfarer, an aging light cruiser centuries past her time. Plot missile salvos, hunt down your enemy, design munitions, manage your crew, and send engineers to fix damage.

details.title: THE HELMINTHS
details.short_description: The Helminths is a 2D pixel art platformer that pays homage to classic games and blending environmental puzzles, precision platforming, and fast-paced action. Confront the grim realities of exploitation in dystopian sci-fi world and embark on a dark journey of survival.

details.title: Liber Magus
details.short_description: Liber Magus is a magic extraction game where every dungeon run is a test of your magical talent. Build your own spells, push through dangerous dungeons and extract with your reward.

details.title: Melted Time
details.short_description: Candle, your path is full of puzzles. Can you handle it? Hurry, your time is already melting away.

details.title: Quarter Lie
details.short_description: A narrative adventure game where you take on a role of a fake exorcist on a demon-ridden ship in a long sea voyage. Remember; you can’t lie your way out of everything!

details.title: Cambrox
details.short_description: Cambrox is an online co-op or single player creature-collection adventure with over 200 unique Cambros. Battle with your Cambros against other trainers and see what the world of Hoch has in store!

details.title: ASTHENIA
details.short_description: Separated from his partner Eve, Adam is cast into a decaying world ruled by cosmic entities. To survive, he must fight distorted foes and unravel the mysteries of a brutal war and a ravaging disease, wielding a primordial gauntlet and tainted artifacts to escape before he is consumed by Asthenia.

details.title: Deeplands
details.short_description: Explore the Deeplands, an ancient underground world harboring the remnants of a lost civilization. Fight and parkour your way through destructible caves and dungeons, acquire mysterious powers and tools to grow stronger and recover the ancient dwarven crown in this open-cave roguelike platformer!

details.title: Project TurboBlast
details.short_description: Drift, boost, and spin around corners at BLASTING SPEEDS in this stylish Singleplayer + Multiplayer Arcade Racing game, Blending the familiar drifting of Kart racers and tight responsive handling of classic Anti-Gravity racing games. With a focus on being easy to pick up but difficult to master.

details.title: Wish Of Hers
details.short_description: Wish of Hers is a round-based 2.5D roguelike about surviving in unstable dreams. Each run is shaped by unlocked abilities, combined aspects, and your decisions. Experiment, adapt, and break your own builds!

details.title: Epoch Reset
details.short_description: Unravel a narrative-driven 2.5D anime adventure as Hector, a dirt-poor genius and creator of the world’s first time machine. Travel between timelines, meet intriguing characters, and explore futuristic cityscapes as you seek to save reality from time-bending forces beyond imagination.

details.title: Eco: Planet Reboot
details.short_description: Imagine taking down a megacorporation with just a vacuum. Join Eco, a robot with one mission: save the world from the greedy billionaire Smogborne. Vacuum up your enemies, absorb and expel elements throughout the world to solve puzzles, and heal the corrupted biomes.

details.title: Chaotic Conundrum
details.short_description: Hit the ground running in a frantic and fast adventure through a broken world made of lost fragments of time and space. Featuring a 90s-graffiti artstyle and a headbanging dynamic soundtrack.

details.title: Legend of the Corndog(s)
details.short_description: Finding yourself out of food, you decide to venture into the outdoors for the first time in an embarrassingly long time in order to satiate your growing hunger.

details.title: Race to Ruler
details.short_description: Race to Ruler is a deck-building roguelike where your cards are your army as you embark on a journey to defeat the ruler of an empire. Draft and train new units, summon epic beings, defeat your rivals, and claim the crown.

details.title: Boss Slayers
details.short_description: No game to play with a friend? Now you're a team of boss hunters. Challenge the most dangerous monsters! Dodge rains of projectiles, seize the right moment to attack and discover the weaknesses of cunning bosses.

details.title: Silks & Glory
details.short_description: Build your racing legacy in a premium horse racing game with a full single-player career, direct jockey gameplay, deep stable management, worldwide competition, online leagues, 2–4 player split-screen, and LAN multiplayer.

name: Detective NEKKO - ディテクティブネッコ -

details.title: Detective NEKKO - ディテクティブネッコ -
details.short_description: Mystery adventure where no one dies. Use your “ability to see too much” to uncover an inconvenient truth.

details.title: L8R SK8R
details.short_description: L8R SK8R is a 3D platformer inspired by the classics of the fifth generation but with a unique twist that will make you feel like a speedrunner.

details.title: speak of my sin
details.short_description: Speak of My Sin is a word reasoning game - players are supposed to find the truth of the cases, restore the story in a number of interrelated cases and finally detect the identification of “me”, speaking out “my” sin.

details.title: Path to Perdition
details.short_description: Path to Perdition is a challenging roguelike auto-battler. Assemble and lead a party of adventurers through unforgiving lands. Equip them with items to unlock skills, modify those skills with relics to create unique effects, and combine those effects using tactical positioning to crush your enemies.

details.title: Fall of the Final Age
details.short_description: Take command of the last Stronghold of humanity, fighting back against the advancing monsters. Decide where to prioritize the forces of your Heroes, as the number of turns before the invasion is limited. A turn-based tactical strategy with RPG and roguelike elements.

details.title: Gorilla Attack 2: Rampage
details.short_description: Your favorite gorilla (kind of) is back! Smash a massive new city, take on unique challenges, and interact with a fully destructible world. Team up with friends or let them join your chaotic VR adventure!

details.title: King's Courier
details.short_description: King’s Courier is a free roam, party-based RPG. Carry out perilous quests for the King while exploring dungeons, enchanted forests, deadly swamps, and monster-filled caves. Build your party, learn magic, battle in real-time or turn-based, solve puzzles, and uncover the kingdom’s secrets.

details.title: Erehwon(エレフォーン)
details.short_description: The gear you acquire completely transforms your party’s roles. Erehwon is a loot-driven dungeon crawler where you progress by reshaping your builds around the gear you find.

details.title: Tutankhamun – Builders of the Eternal
details.short_description: A 3D city-builder where you farm the Nile, worship powerful gods, train armies, trade with distant regions, and construct monumental works worthy of ancient Egypt.

details.title: Starweaver
details.short_description: Deckbuilding roguelike game where you become a Priestess of Light and restore a sky consumed by darkness. Discover key cards, place stars across the sky, break curses, and complete constellations. Before it's too late, stand against the God of Night and drive back the darkness.

details.title: Tale Of The Tape
details.short_description: Tale of the Tape is a visceral, high-impact boxing experience where every punch carries consequence.

details.title: Gift of the Primordials
details.short_description: A fantastical ecology puzzler. Balance soil nutrients by carefully arranging plants, and support a habitat for the local creatures! Uncover the mystery behind the crisis of the Kaanvell plateau!

details.title: STEEL PRINCESS
details.short_description: Explore an open field, hunt powerful enemies, unlock and evolve skills, and choose which bosses to face first in this Souls-like 3D action RPG.

details.title: Fragments of Self: Thoughts
details.short_description: My life has changed drastically: a new country, university, dormitory, work. Drowsiness and fatigue have become a habit, just like the silhouettes I’ve started seeing in my peripheral vision.

details.title: Syncron Arena
details.short_description: Reject mindless stat checks in this evolved Souls-like Auto Battler! Master Time Freeze, Parry, & Poise Break to dominate the battlefield. Use "Logic Bridging" to craft god-tier builds that defy common sense. You aren't just a spectator—conquer the broken world as a decisive ally.

details.title: Time Crack
details.short_description: A thriller and mystery visual novel about broken trust and the search for truth, when a high-school student is accused of his parents’ brutal murder. Every choice might bring you closer to the truth... or end in tragedy.

details.title: Quinquennial
details.short_description: An RPG adventure featuring real-time dungeon crawling, exploration, and turn-based tactics battles! Choose your character class. Fight, loot, level up, gain perks, improve stats and skills. All-original 3D voxel graphics, interactive environments, many different dungeon styles, crafting, and more.

details.title: ReThink | Evolved Free
details.short_description: ReThink | Evolved Free is a free first person puzzle game in a peaceful futuristic setting, that features a variety of Puzzles that utilize Lasers and the behavior of light and it's colors to create challenging problems to solve. The game features a somewhat toned down difficulty progression.

details.title: Summer Syndrome
details.short_description: "Summer Syndrome" is a sci-fi mystery visual novel set in the near future. Eerie plane crashes, shadowy organizations operating in the dark, and the increasingly prevalent "Summer Syndrome"... Players will experience a non-linear narrative through chapter-based choices and uncover the truth.

details.title: Diabolocracy
details.short_description: Diabolocracy is hatemail for corporate bureaucracy in roguelite turn-based tactics form. Build your team of corporate hellions, battle other Sins for supremacy, survive meetings, and choose your SIN-ergies wisely. Can you complete your hostile takeover before the boss gets back from vacation?

details.title: G Squad
details.short_description: Run the gauntlet with G Squad in this hand-crafted autobattler with roguelite and RPG elements, designed to scratch the strategy itch without the spreadsheets. 9 unique heroes, in-run rewards, permanent progression, and boss challenge modifiers to test yourself against.

details.title: Avemary Rocket -Captain Patchwork-
details.short_description: Join our brave captain on this action adventure in space! You'll be riding The Patchwork, a less than ideal spaceship, but enough to get away from pursuers. However, you'll be facing malfunctions, fires, enemies attacking... When it rains, it pours.

name: The american dream of Gunther Aims

details.title: The american dream of Gunther Aims
details.short_description: A retro puzzle shooter built around ricochets, where every shot counts. You play as Gunther, a revolver and a family man, in a constrained turn-based system: one action at a time, until it fully resolves.

details.title: < STRECT >
details.short_description: Control your ship and destroy all the enemies and bases that have appeared through teleportation! < STRECT > is a score-attack vertical shooter for 1 or 2 players. Enjoy simple shoot-and-dodge gameplay, rich destruction effects, and tons of hidden features.

details.title: Dadum The Dice
details.short_description: Plan, roll and outsmart your enemies in this turn-based tactical puzzle adventure. Show a higher number to defeat foes, discover new mechanics in every world, and face challenging bosses that twist the rules. Think ahead, take your time… and master the Great Die.

details.title: Dribble Deck
details.short_description: Dribble Deck is a basketball card game about leading your team through a tough league. Build a deck, upgrade players and trade with NPC’s. Master the game’s flow as you face ruthless coach bosses. The owner has already written you off so you’ll have to win every match or get cut before the finals.

details.title: Scraps Of The Machine
details.short_description: FPS Mech Action! Pilot a mass of steel through a single player campaign set in a desolate landscape. Target enemy armor or weapons to wear them down piece by piece, find upgrades to improve your mech or change its loadout, and survive in a world of rust and decay. Discover, Destroy, Scavenge.

details.title: GIGANTIC☆MAIDESTRUCTION
details.short_description: A giant maid wreaks havoc on the city under the pretext of defeating enemies! Gigantic Destruction Action Game!

details.title: Walls of Fate
details.short_description: Rule a fortress on the brink of collapse: listen to the residents’ requests, manage limited resources and time, strengthen relationships with key characters in the fortress, and move closer to solving the mystery of the ruler’s disappearance.

details.title: Periphery
details.short_description: Periphery is a psychedelic action-horror game. Uncover the truth about your workspace, get introduced to the locals and their gnostic fascination. Warp into the pixelated world of Periphery and experience surreal world built on mystery.

details.title: Monarch: The Tainted Kingdom
details.short_description: Monarch: TTK is an Action Monster Taming RPG where strategy dictates the flow of combat. Capture monsters, gather their loot to build custom skillsets, and master an engaging Timeline-based combat system. Uncover the secrets of the Archs and break through the corruption plaguing the Continent!

details.title: Loaded Dice
details.short_description: Wager. Survive. Profit. Throw your friends around and bet against them to show who's faster, better, and smarter in this fast action-strategy party game.

details.title: The Jotun Queen
details.short_description: Embark on a journey to a land inspired by real world mythology and meet a cast of colourful characters. Fight tactical battles and save the world from the icy hatred of The Jotun Queen

details.title: Edge on Truth
details.short_description: Explore the settlement, gather clues, interact with its inhabitants, and uncover a conspiracy. Your actions shape your relationships with the locals – will they help you, or deceive you? Your choices will determine whether the protagonist can escape, or if his tragic fate will repeat itself again.

name: Survivor of Egypt: The Ancient Curse

details.title: Survivor of Egypt: The Ancient Curse
details.short_description: Build your inventory. Break the horde. Escape the curse. In this Egyptian action roguelite, arrange gear, transfer item abilities and forge powerful synergies. Fight solo or challenge recorded player runs in optional asynchronous PvP. How long can you survive?

details.title: Kero Quest 64
details.short_description: Kero Quest 64 is a Collectathon 3D Platformer inspired by other games in the genre, especially those from the late 90s. You take control of Kero, a blue frog seeking to stop a prince from spreading evil Shards across the Kingdom of Bunnabaria!

details.title: MicroJumper
details.short_description: A tiny 2D precision platformer where you navigate the human body as a pathogen. Evade relentless white blood cells, master newfound abilities, and use power-ups while you search for a new home.

details.title: Heroic Musical Chairs
details.short_description: Face off against your friends and family in this epic take on musical chairs! Play locally or online as tiny wizard athletes ready to do anything to win. Special powers, dirty tricks, and dozens of crazy arenas: when the music stops, chaos begins!

details.title: Pizza Super Slice
details.short_description: Cartoon-exploration-platformer in which you play as an living slice of pizza. Explore a strange, cartoon town full of little secrets, dark corners and secret passages. There's something interesting in every nook and cranny!

details.title: Acornia: Mirror Worlds
details.short_description: Acornia: Mirror Worlds is a bake-and-brawl management adventure game! Run your shop in one dimension, fight angry spirits in the other. Your special skill? Stuffing your bottomless cheek pouches with treats - to plate up or shoot up enemies!

details.title: Take Me to the Ending!
details.short_description: Huh... umm...? Meet Yuu, our hero who just can't jump high enough to escape their tiny little world. But wait—here comes YOU, the super hacker extraordinaire! 💻✨ Hack Yuu's parameters, tweak the world itself, and guide them all the way to their happy ending! Let’s get hacking!

details.title: CE-III Protocol: Last Drop
details.short_description: Dozing off in class won't kill you… unless you wake up in a strange, creepy place surrounded by monsters. On the bright side, you're not alone, nor completely defenseless. But to escape this nightmare, you'll have to do more than just survive…

details.title: Mei tales
details.short_description: "Mei tales" is a narrative card game set in a Chinese fantasy world. In the game, you can choose one of several protagonists to seek out companions, make decisions, and accept the twists of fate, embarking on a legendary journey uniquely your own.

details.title: AERA Flying Heroes
details.short_description: An adventure for all those who dream of conquering the skies. Choose your pilot, upgrade your ship, and make battles against waves of enemies and colossal bosses. Collect stars, unlock new missions and write your legend.

details.title: Jailbreak
details.short_description: An asymmetric PvP prison escape game for up to 8 players, where prisoners loot, craft, and scheme their way to freedom while the guard tries to shut the whole mess down. Work together, make bad decisions, and do whatever it takes to break out.

details.title: Banquet of Nausea
details.short_description: Banquet of Nausea is a dark fantasy RPG made in RPGMaker. You will play as Liya — a girl on an epic quest to find her lost kin. Explore sacred ruins, purge festering abominations, and forge bonds with survivors whose fates lie in your hands.

details.title: PARALLAXIS
details.short_description: PARALLAXIS is a hardcore, First-Person Slasher, with mind-bending GRAVITY mechanics. Be fast, relentless, optimize your path - even if that means breaking the laws of reality.

details.title: Satoyama Note: Spring Walk
details.short_description: Satoyama Note: Spring Walk is a point-and-click game where you explore the woods in the springtime. Talk with animals and observe plants as you head through the forest on your journey to enjoy a meal under the cherry blossom tree!

details.title: Fecal Freighter
details.short_description: Become a sewage truck operator and survive the foul dangers: drive your ZIL, battle sludge demons, complete tasks, explore a grim world, and uncover the mystery of an alien conspiracy.

details.title: Malloc
details.short_description: Malloc is a short atmospheric exploration game. Wander through a nostalgic city on a summer afternoon, explore on foot or in a utility mech, meet the residents, and bring the district back to life one small repair at a time.

details.title: 能動的ダンジョン
details.short_description: This game is a simple, high-difficulty RPG for people who are tired of the same old turn-based command-based RPGs.

details.title: EverCastle
details.short_description: Evercastle is the story of a young girl who sets out on an adventure to the mysterious castle. In this magical action RPG, you must master various spells to overcome monsters and traps, defeat powerful enemies, and reach the castle's depths to rescue beloved family.

details.title: Frontier Control : Invasion
details.short_description: Frontier Control: Invasion is a Real-Time Strategy survival game in which you play the commander of a human space colony under the attack of outer space robots. Build your base, train your colony, and fight herds of enemies and bosses.

details.title: Dr.Mememe want to sleep
details.short_description: The lazy genius scientist "Dr. Mememe," who just wants to sleep forever, has invented Kawaii Sheep that induce sleep with their mysterious healing powers. An exponentially cute sheep-carrying game with expanding production × easy 3D action for casual enjoyment.

details.title: DebugDebut
details.short_description: A debugging simulation game in which you complete debugging requests from a game generation AI that suddenly appears. Debug games of various genres and aim to win high rewards.

details.title: Don't Forget the Phone
details.short_description: Experience a point & click time management game that puts your multi-tasking to the test. Complete all of your tasks before sunrise, but watch out for anything that may have escaped the lab below.

details.title: The Shadow Beneath
details.short_description: Rescue Akhenaten, the banished pharaoh, from an eternity beneath the sands. Wield the gifts of Aten's last disciples, unleash sacred techniques and battle the relentless guardians of the forgotten tombs in a fast-paced Action Roguelike.

details.title: Word To Angel
details.short_description: Play as five human heroes in this pacifist 2D RPG taking place in a world where some friendly (and not so friendly) angels conduct balance and harmony together... and where your only instruments for fighting are words and melodies.

details.title: Bake Until Done
details.short_description: Bake Until Done is a baking-themed, turn-based roguelite. Take control of a muffin as you battle devious desserts to break the spell of a magical bakery that is endangering your town. Fight back with your muffin’s morsels, but be careful not to lose too much…

details.title: Strider Arena
details.short_description: Strider Arena is a fast-paced mobility mech arena fighter designed to be played with a group of friends. Inspired by the likes of Titanfall 2, Armored Core, and Hawken, kit out your strider, drop into the arena, and make sure your team is the only one left standing once the smoke clears.

details.title: Infested
details.short_description: Infested is a simple First Person Shooter. You will encounter many zombies as you fight your way through the zombie-infested city. Will you make it to the hospital to find the first infected victim? Only with its DNA samples will science be able to create an antidote.

details.title: MachineCorps
details.short_description: Build factories, solve puzzles, and send robots to explore the desert planet of Drath. With each release comes a new planet with stranger challenges, smarter enemies, and more advanced tech. It will take a logical mind, cunning, and a yearning for adventure to succeed. Do you have what it takes?

details.title: Ceaseless
details.short_description: An unknown element has escaped containment and is devouring the universe! Assemble a powerful, layered starship, collect synergistic modules, explore an infinite world, and battle enemies in fast paced, interval-based combat to stop it.

details.title: The Stick Figure Game
details.short_description: The most convoluted game of capture-the-flag we've ever seen! In this turn-based strategy game, make choices to bring new units into play, position forces, fire on the enemy, dig tunnels to avoid enemy line-of-sight, and more. Play solo vs the computer player, or head-to-head against a friend!

details.title: Metronome
details.short_description: Metronome is a short semi auto-biographical interactive story about the life of a British musician spanning from the early 90s to the late 2020s.

details.title: MEDIX
details.short_description: You are not here to win the war, but to save whom you can before the line breaks. A narrative real-time strategy where you lead a unit of war medics across hand-drawn battlefields and race to reach the wounded as your army retreats before an overwhelming foe. Keep hope alive amidst the chaos.

details.title: Rabanaz
details.short_description: A roguelike deckbuilder set in a steampunk casino run by ravens. Rewire the machine in your favour and they won't take it quietly. Blend your chips into new colours and change what "random" means to steer a run toward the build you have in mind.

details.title: Eggstraordinary Goose Chase
details.short_description: Not your everyday goose chase—this time, the goose is on the hunt! Sprint through vibrant levels, dodge obstacles, collect berries, stomp enemies, and take bold risks! Keep running, push your limits, and reclaim what’s yours!

details.title: Echoes From Below
details.short_description: Echoes From Below is a mystery dungeon tactical RPG. Lead four hunters into the dungeons, where every fortune you bring home comes at a price. Fight side by side as bonds grow into love, rivalry or grief that changes how they fight, and the dead never return. How many will you bring home?

details.title: Everise
details.short_description: Reach the top of the Tower before raiders destroy your town. Scavenge the furniture and loot monsters to collect resources along the way, then empty your inventory down balconies to upgrade and defend your town!

details.title: Garden of Ants
details.short_description: Become the architect of a thriving ant colony in this real-time simulation. Establish and evolve your ant colony, grow specialized worker castes, cultivate fungus, and explore a living world above and below ground where day and night bring shifting challenges and resources.

details.title: Mouse Holme
details.short_description: Your precious mouse home has been destroyed! 🐭 Start from scratch, build a thriving nest... and defeat the villainous cats! 🐈

details.title: Light Up the Dark
details.short_description: Light Up the Dark is a colony survival sim set in a dark world filled with unseen horrors. Collect, build, automate, research techs, and explore the procedural map. Manage three classes of colonists; keep them sane, or make use of their insanity. Solve endless interesting problems, your way.

details.title: Sea Sniffers
details.short_description: Dive! Punch! Catch! Sea Sniffers is a unique take on collecting fish where you play as a seal that throws a mean punch! Upgrade your gear, ship and companions to become the best Sea Sniffer!

details.title: SAIGAI
details.short_description: You wake from cryosleep aboard a drifting deep-space freighter. The crew is gone. The ship is dark. Something is moving through the corridors with you. Search the vessel, uncover what happened to the crew, and learn what this ship was never meant to carry before it finds you.

details.title: Jordi & Oslo: The Lost Tail
details.short_description: Jordi & Oslo and the Lost Tail is a humorous point and click adventure game. Explore beautiful watercolour- painted locations, interact with quirky characters, and solve witty puzzles to help Jordi and Sigrid investigate the disappearance of their missing friend Oslo.

details.title: WorldShards
details.short_description: Build, explore, and master professions in WorldShards - a life sim sandbox MMORPG. Create your dream island paradise and journey through an exciting world.

details.title: Fellowship of the Oak
details.short_description: Fellowship of the Oak is a cozy crafting sim where you gather a fellowship of heroes, providing them with everything they need to succeed on their adventures. Build cozy homes, craft gear, farm provisions and manage expeditions in order to collect powerful loot!

details.title: Color Lim
details.short_description: Set in a post-apocalyptic world, Color Lim follows Lim, a colorless slime on a quest to find his true color. Change colors to navigate, transform into enemies to use their abilities, and solve puzzles to shape Lim's unique journey.

details.title: RevenBlade
details.short_description: RevenBlade is a 5v5 third-person hero shooter with a focus on melee combat, mechanical outplays, and mobility with lots of verticality.

details.title: Cantos
details.short_description: A persistent RTS where survival comes before expansion! Secure a foothold, outlast rivals, and earn the right to build your colony in shared servers shaped by players or on your own in single-player!

details.title: BAKA TAO
details.short_description: What begins as an ordinary road trip slowly takes an unsettling turn when an unexpected encounter leaves you searching for answers in the surrounding wilderness.

details.title: Ember Gold Valkyrie
details.short_description: "Ember Gold Valkyrie" is a 2.5D pixel-art roguelite action game where you aim for the top of the arena with diverse skills. Saddled with a billion-gold debt, a young girl fights on for her freedom and wish in an arena where victory means gold.

details.title: FLESHBAG
details.short_description: FLESHBAG is a 3D physics sandbox about one very unlucky guy. He has organs, a brain, a face and a voice, and he has opinions about your machines. Build him a mixer, crusher or a cozy cabin. He will complain about all of them.

details.title: Our Fleet Is In Orbit
details.short_description: A single-player space-strategy roguelite about reconquering a shattered empire across a procedurally generated galaxy. Plan fleet battles that unfold on your orders, and drive ground invasions front by front across the planet below. Every ship, crew, and army you lose is gone for good.

details.title: Human Forge
details.short_description: Human Forge is a game where you create humans and put them on air to make money. Draw a face, mix traits to create a human, then put them on the show. Every three days, God comes to collect your earnings. Fail and you're fired, but survive to the end and surpass God.

details.title: Nostalgiallo
details.short_description: A surreal point-and-click with vote-based combat, taking place in a corrupted world based on Spanish "Tebeo" slapstick comics.

details.title: dungeons and glory
details.short_description: Dodge enemy fire alone or in online co-op as you raid 5–25 minute portal expeditions. Shape your build through equipment, skills, stats, and risky loot, defeat the boss, and bring your haul home—assuming the Directorate’s plan survives contact.

details.title: OVERQUOTA
details.short_description: Build compact machine networks, route packets, manage heat, and crush rising quotas in this factory-building roguelike. Buy new machines, stack powerful relics, and survive run-changing Boss Blinds.

details.title: Planet Gray Starlight Episode
details.short_description: An adventure game where you travel through the galaxy together in a shiny spaceship.

details.title: Alien Exterminators
details.short_description: Grab your gear, take a contract, and exterminate hostile alien infestations with up to three friends across unpredictable planets full of chaos, danger, and bad workplace conditions.

details.title: The Cardkov
details.short_description: Turn poker hands into weapons in this single-player, top-down extraction shooter. Collect discarded cards in the city's cold back alleys, build a hand, and use your new weapon to uncover the factory's secrets. Grab one more card, or make it back alive with the hand you've got.

name: QUIT! - The Japanese Art of Resignation

details.title: QUIT! - The Japanese Art of Resignation
details.short_description: Your boss won't let you quit. So this is a boss fight. Read the excuses, answer with strategy cards, and put the evidence on the table. A resignation-negotiation ADV.

details.title: Late Stage Gambling
details.short_description: Here you don't pick up loot. You gamble for it. In this top-down shooter roguelike, you wager before every wave to get your gear. The higher the stakes, the stronger the rewards and the more it hurts when you lose. Fight through a blood-soaked casino to pay off a debt built to kill you.

details.title: Before The Meteor
details.short_description: A cinematic third-person adventure built around exploration and discovery. Travel through breathtaking landscapes, encounter dangerous creatures, and uncover the mysteries hidden across a vast and mysterious world.

details.title: Ruru & Lala: Wonder World Adventure!
details.short_description: Ruru & Lala is a 2D action-puzzle game where you control two characters simultaneously. After Ruru is pulled into a mysterious mirror, she meets Lala, another version of herself from the mirror world. Together, embark on a great adventure through a mysterious world!

details.title: Dragons Invasion
details.short_description: Dragons Invasion is a Souls 'Em Up. A 2D horizontal shooter where you roll like Dark Souls and swap colors like Ikaruga. Absorb shots, fill your power gauge, and destroy dragons — solo or in local co-op.

details.title: Little Magic Fish Story
details.short_description: Little Magic Fish Story is a life sim and party-based action RPG. Farm, cook, fish, and raise animals in Anyu Town. Turn harvests into supplies and command companions in the Silent Forest. Amid warm days and strange disturbances, the adventurers' story begins.

details.title: WARDER
details.short_description: You are a police officer sent to investigate a call from an abandoned mansion. Deep beneath the mansion lies a hidden medical facility connected to the mysterious Dr. Warder. Explore, solve environmental puzzles, and hide from the doctor as you uncover what happened inside his facility.

details.title: Cravecrops - Farming Defense
details.short_description: Grow suspicious experimental plants by day and defend your plantation from hordes of addicted animals by night. Sell your harvest, upgrade your defenses, and expand your operation in this farming defense roguelite.

details.title: Pressure Express
details.short_description: Pressure Express is a 1–4 player co-op party roguelite where delivery droids operate a submarine, manage failing systems, protect temperamental cargo, and survive the dangers of a flooded world.

details.title: Dead Broke
details.short_description: Wanna run a cursed graveyard with your friends? You’ll regret it. Probably. An online co-op (up to 4) physics-based game about you, definitely not ending up Dead Broke.

details.title: HOPENOTHING
details.short_description: Tactics RPG × Cross-Species Bonds. You play a human who can wield every weapon type. Torch enemies on the grasslands, call down lightning in the rain. Every choice leads toward one of many endings. A story of joining hands with the companions you hold dear, in search of hope.

details.title: Volcaris: Ashen Secrets
details.short_description: A card-based roguelike strategy game set on a volcanic island. Each cycle is a race against time: gather resources, craft equipment, collect artifacts, and build up your settlement for the inevitable eruption.

details.title: Moving Pieces
details.short_description: Moving Pieces is a first-person psychological horror puzzle adventure game. Explore a convoluted mansion, collect key items, and solve physical puzzles without combat or death. Assemble tactile jigsaw puzzles, decode ciphers, and break reality in this atmospheric puzzle-based narrative mystery.

details.title: Nibble Ville
details.short_description: A cozy farming adventure where you befriend adorable Nibbles, discover new seeds, and begin a new life on a mysterious island.

details.title: yttrium X
details.short_description: Zellia Mots goes awol and steals yttrium X the Plutocracy of Yeoman's secret Mech in this PvE mech brawler!

details.title: PuPuPoPu Company
details.short_description: A cute, wacky top-down PvE extraction shooter. The world's fading, so a duckling with flashy feet and flawless blush starts a paint-spraying company. Blast away pollution in a hail of paint and give this black-and-white world its color back. Rescue critters, pack 'em to go—extract. Clock out!

details.title: Bound Together
details.short_description: Bound Together is a roguelike deckbuilder about Stitch, a crochet doll hero, battling sticker foes and toy bosses throughout an ominous attic. Aid Stitch by drafting cards and sewing them together for use in battle. Powerful enemies force you to make clever choices to craft a strong deck to survive.

details.title: MAT-O
details.short_description: Humanity is gone. As an organic being, explore an abandoned research facility, uncover traces of the past, and discover the mystery of your existence.

details.title: LILITH
details.short_description: Every head is a world. LILITH is a folk-art puzzle-platformer set inside nesting dolls: climb into heads, hang characters on your tree to wear their skills, and descend through an İstanbul of graveyards, malls and rooftops, until you find the man in the shower.

details.title: Nordic Sprint
details.short_description: A classic-style cross-country skiing game where technique, stamina and drafting decide the race. Climb the World Cup with 20 abilities, race sprint, biathlon and relay in changing weather and wind – solo or in online multiplayer with up to 12 players.

details.title: The Sundered Anvil
details.short_description: A party of greenhorn adventurers acquires a contract to retrieve an anvil stolen from a remote village, only to discover the job is more than they bargained for.

details.title: Spur of Life
details.short_description: You’ve woken into a world that wants you slaughtered. No weapons. No combat. Escape the oppressive, liminal space that doesn't want you, as things that shouldn’t be there hunt you from the dark.

details.title: Soulstone
details.short_description: Be anyone, go anywhere, do anything. Live a new life in a fantasy world.

details.title: Crawlbound
details.short_description: Survive a grid-based roguelite by selecting game altering bugs to endure each level. Dodge traps, battle bosses, and draft upgrades to build your run. Spend your loot on permanent upgrades to push deeper into the dungeon.

details.title: Video Game Store Simulator
details.short_description: Build and run your own video game store in this first-person retail management simulator. Order new titles, unpack deliveries, stock shelves, set prices, serve customers at the register, and reinvest your profits to customize and expand your growing business.

details.title: ワカレタナビ
details.short_description: This is an action-adventure game where you navigate an unfinished title riddled with bugs, relying on guidance from a navigator. However, interacting with certain stage gimmicks apparently causes my personality to switch...

details.title: BoneHeads
details.short_description: BoneHeads is a physics-based sword-fighting party game where every swing is under your direct control. Fight locally or online with up to 4 players, and keep battling as every bone you lose becomes a weapon.

details.title: Blue Blood Love Song
details.short_description: A multi-ending visual novel blending romance, sci-fi, and mystery. A perfect reunion gradually gives way to unsettling inconsistencies. As your relationship with him deepens, you must choose between trust and doubt—and every decision may change your bond and the ending that awaits you.

details.title: 野生机
details.short_description: Step into BIO: Wild Machine—a hand-drawn biopunk world created by the author, and explore the perilous "New Tower of Babel," a city once a milestone in human life technology, now in decline. You must reinvent yourself, battling powerful enemies and unknown fears in harsh turn-based combat.

details.title: The Old Forge
details.short_description: Explore a open world inspired by 1990s Poland. Scavenge, build, craft and dig your way through forests, villages and industrial ruins surviving the zombies, harsh weather and the constant fight for food, warmth and safety.

details.title: Claim the Gods
details.short_description: Would you dare to defy the gods? Claim their power? Then battle in this roguelike deckbuilder where you can win new cards, power up and Claim the Gods! But be warned mortal, if you fail, there will be consequences!

details.title: Hollow Ones
details.short_description: Hide away from the end of the world in Hollow Ones, a mid-apocalypse narrative horror game.

details.title: Songkran Hazard: 4Lom
details.short_description: Lock, load, and stay dry! Step into the soaked slippers of Rookie Cop “Lee” in this high-octane survival “horror?”. Armed with water guns and wet powder, escort Anchan through Bangkok's chaotic Silom Road during the wildest Songkran outbreak ever. Can you survive the Songkran hazard?

details.title: Water's Bounty
details.short_description: Set across a vast global map, Water's Bounty thrusts you into a sea full of nonstop dangers. You'll navigate a world dominated by the ruthless Ronek Trading Company; a commercial empire branding all independent merchants as pirates to protect their monopoly.
publishers: Not Allowed to Die Gaming Studios

details.title: Chronicles of the Six Sages
details.short_description: This game is a Turn Based JRPG with real time mechanics in order to overcome the enemies attacks. The game features a fully unique gear system, allowing for the player to fully customize their party to their choosing

details.title: Banners & Frontlines
details.short_description: Hold the line in a single-player, turn-based card strategy game. Combine infantry, archers and cavalry, commit reserves and pull battered troops back to reform. Fight historical campaigns or keep a mercenary company alive through contracts, recruits and captured banners.

details.title: Gas Station Simulator
details.short_description: A gas station and convenience store tycoon. Stock shelves, pump fuel, and ring up sales. Grow from a humble roadside stall by pricing stock and unlocking licenses to upgrade your shop. Set out every product by hand, tidy up what customers leave behind, and grow a thriving business.

details.title: LOVE alt delete
details.short_description: DATE. DESIGN. DESTROY. A psychological chat simulator between you and two digital personalities who desperately want to be people. Type keywords to control them, uncover their secrets, and choose their fates.

details.title: Wall of Symbols
details.short_description: A roguelite siege defense played on an alchemist's table. Spin, place, and let symbols ripen into forms your deck never held. Every neighbour feeds the next, and one transmute turns the whole board into damage.

details.title: Questing
details.short_description: A satirical love-letter to classic 16-bit adventure games, about a chosen hero who never wanted to be chosen.

details.title: Burnout Inferno Office Girl
details.short_description: Tokyo, 1992. Office worker Satomi endures one absurd day after another. When she hits her breaking point, she can download alternate versions of herself from other worlds. Borrow their unique personalities and abilities to fight back against work, relationships, and life's everyday nonsense.

details.title: Age of Enlightenment
details.short_description: Shape the destiny of the world as an 18th century ruler. Forge alliances and prepare your armed forces to expand your domain and colonize new lands. Or focus on internal development and help your subjects thrive with prudent economic policy and lawmaking. The choice is yours in Age of Enlightenment!

details.title: Schizophrenia: R.EM. Protocol
details.short_description: Schizophrenia is a game where you have to not go crazy and get out of the bunker. Use all the items you can find to survive. Remember. The main thing is not to go crazy. And further. Don't make loud noises. They can hear you.

details.title: Madness Afloat
details.short_description: Pilot customizable steamships through a Lovecraftian Polynesian archipelago. Explore and survive handcrafted missions, manage cursed cargo, and balance sanity against power. Face the deep alone or in optional co-op expeditions.

details.title: The Dark Aegis
details.short_description: The Dark Aegis blends visceral third-person combat with deep base building. Build up your fortress between missions, then defend it from relentless alien hordes solo or with up to 4 players.

details.title: High Rollers: Dice Drop Duel
details.short_description: Challenge your friends to high stakes arcade puzzle action in High Rollers: Dice Drop Duel! There's something for all types of players with a variety of solo, multiplayer and online modes.

details.title: Decaying Salvage
details.short_description: A modern sci-fi survival horror built for people who miss fixed cameras, puzzles, scarce ammunition and being afraid to open the next door.

details.title: Mechs and Muskets
details.short_description: Mechs and Muskets is a 2D isometric tactical RPG set in an alternate Napoleonic era where mechs rule the battlefield. Customize your squad with unique mech parts and abilities, and lead them through turn-based strategic combat in a story-driven campaign

details.title: Club Defenders
details.short_description: Club Defenders is a co-op action tower defense game where music becomes humanity’s ultimate weapon. Build towers, control enemy paths and stop alien invasions inside vibrant nightclubs with weapons and instruments. Master four powerful music genres that shape every strategy and combat ability.

details.title: Re:VER PROJECT -TOKYO-
details.short_description: "Re:VER PROJECT TOKYO" co-developed by Toei Animation and indie developer Nestopi, is a survival suspense adventure game set in modern Tokyo depicted in pixel art. Yukinori Amane whos falsely accused of a crime, uses his survival skills to evade the police and uncover the real culprit.

details.title: Shaft 29
details.short_description: You are alone in Shaft 29...Descend into old, pitch-black, and hazardous labyrinth to restore the failing power grid. Scavenge the dark for scrap, repair components in safe room, and brave anomalies hiding in the depths. Keep the lights on, and keep moving down...

details.title: Japanese Salaryman
details.short_description: A 1990s office-noir RPG. By day, survive office politics at METTA and protect your relationships. By night, hack into company servers in grid-based hacking puzzles, spy on people for upgrades, and sell stolen secrets to escape crushing debt.

details.title: Untold Tales: A Scarlet Way
details.short_description: Meet Devil May Cry about Little Red Riding Hood. A Scarlet Way is an isometric hack-and-slash where Scarlet wields her beloved scythe to tear through enemies in a dark Victorian fantasy world — all to the sound of heavy metal and dubstep.

details.title: Draft Fever Bowl
details.short_description: Draft Fever Bowl is a competitive multiplayer football management game focused on scouting and the draft. Study prospects, outsmart rivals on draft day, and trade with real teams. With no visible attributes, success depends entirely on your eye for talent. Enter the war room.

details.title: Thor's Wrath
details.short_description: Embody a formidable and somewhat brute warrior, face hordes of enemies alone while protecting the city's treasures. Your goal is to climb the ranks of the best warriors ! The real challenge lies in your ability to wield yourhammer and cast spells with precision.

details.title: Umblight
details.short_description: Descend through the corrupted underworld in Umblight, a gearpunk roguelike deckbuilder about merging your cards together. Build a deck of shadow and light cards strong enough to survive, but is it enough to reach the bottom of the world?

name: Croak Crusader: the Champion of Canada

details.title: Croak Crusader: the Champion of Canada
details.short_description: Do you dare save the Land of the Maple Leaf? Croak Crusader is a fast-paced, momentum-based action platformer featuring tight controls, explosive combat, and a versatile grapple mechanic.

details.title: Founders
details.short_description: Founders is a city-building survival game for 1-10 players, where medieval robots with evolving memories and unique personalities create a truly living world. Build and defend your city against relentless threats while shaping your character’s skills.

details.title: Love's Time Cycle
