details.short_description: A grand sci-fi romance healing masterpiece. Overnight, the beautiful girl around you have falling in love with you. Just as you think you can sink into this sweet trap, the one you love suddenly bids you farewell. In this endless cycle, will you be able to reclaim the love you’ve lost?

details.title: Baba Yaga
details.short_description: A turn-based roguelike game of strategic combat and sinister magic. Decimate the king’s loyalist forces, grow your powers, and discover the reimagined origin story of Baba Yaga, the most feared witch of Slavic folklore!

details.title: Mind The Trunk
details.short_description: Up to 4 friends. One abandoned station. Strip it. Launch it. Sell it. Keep breathing: your oxygen runs through a hose, and it runs out fast. Get back to the lobby or get nothing. Something else lives here. It doesn't want you dead. It wants to play.

details.title: Vagabones
details.short_description: Vagabones is a class-based roguelike action-adventure game for 1-4 players! Battle fierce foes, play minigames, solve puzzles, and collect treasures as you venture through the Shadowmoon Kingdom to defeat the Calico King!

details.title: Witchling Grove
details.short_description: Witchling Grove is an action-rpg, arena-shooting roguelike.

details.title: TritonXR: Reality Warfare
details.short_description: TritonXR turns ANY space into a dynamic combat arena with your friends - duck behind your living room couch to reload, throw a grenade down your hallway or jump over your bed to avoid an attack. This is the world's most advanced XR FPS.

details.title: Galaxy Frame
details.short_description: Galaxy Frame is a space Roguelite game players control their aircraft to survive the attacks of alien insects. By understanding the characteristics of aircraft, skills, and props, players can build their own decks and challenge stronger enemies. Arcade mode to challenge the world leaderboard.

name: 井底-与奇迹邂逅的井底之人

details.title: 井底-与奇迹邂逅的井底之人
details.short_description: 《井底》是一款2024年3月立项的文字类galgame，题材是“超能力悬疑推理故事”，画风是日系校园风格的 故事主要讲述了游戏女主王语韴作为一个业余“侦探”，遇到各种疑难问题，并在侦探事务所所长天翔及其妹妹天音的帮助下，解决案件的故事。 游戏主要使用鼠标点击来推进剧情

details.title: Far From The Darkness
details.short_description: A first-person multiplayer game inspired by the Werewolf concept. Depending on your role, investigate and hunt werewolves or betray your squad. Strategize, collaborate, and survive while communicating through proximity chat!

details.title: Celestial of Dolls
details.short_description: Lead a humanoid squad from a roaming settlement base into a Dyson megastructure built by runaway AI under a binary star system. Fight the AI Guards, the Empire, and the Humanoid Cult, use Scarlet Particles and terrain tricks, and escort Io to rewrite civilization’s fate.

details.title: Gatto's Pizzeria
details.short_description: Run a cozy first-person pizzeria as an adorable cat! Prepare authentic Neapolitan pizzas step by step, serve hungry human customers, and upgrade your restaurant with new recipes, ovens, and decorations while relaxing in a hand-drawn 3D kitchen.

details.title: Steam & Heather
details.short_description: A cosy railway management builder set in 19th-century Scotland. Shape the land, lay track, connect industries, and watch towns grow as steam reshapes the Scottish landscape.

details.title: Arjybeasts
details.short_description: Arjybeasts is a Turn-based RPG where colour means everything! Draw your own PNG, battle and delete other images, open chests and make space so that HE can install things. Combine creativity with strategy and uncover a mystery by viewing the computer from different perspectives.

details.title: No Way Home: BLAMMO!
details.short_description: No Way Home: BLAMMO! is a tactical arcade roguelite that's all about fast-paced twin stick space combat. Every run is a new adventure!

details.title: City of Dolorosa
details.short_description: You've just died—and your trial for the ultimate sin begins. City of Dolorosa is an interactive fiction and first-person exploration game with handmade india ink graphics. Meet the Five Great Powers and uncover all the secrets that lie within Dolorosa, the cruelest city in Hell.

details.title: 徨恍 Aware
details.short_description: You will play a detective and go back to winter Peking more than seventy years ago. On the eve of the peaceful liberation of Peking, you will feel the cold, nothingness, exploration, pursuit, drama and gunshots in the process of searching for missing persons.

name: Talewarden: Riders of the New Day

details.title: Talewarden: Riders of the New Day
details.short_description: In this adventure visual novel, you travel across an alien planet stuck in an endless sunset. Shape the fates of 7 companions from different worlds. Uncover the truth about anomalous locations, hidden corridors, and a child who aged in a day. See what remains of a world abandoned by its creators.

details.title: Exovia
details.short_description: Exovia is a physics-based mining and automation sandbox in space. Survey asteroids, engineer zero-G logistics without conveyor belts, and design complex Newtonian factories. Turn floating chaos into perfect order and experience true inner peace as you solve one satisfying problem and then the next.

details.title: Traceback
details.short_description: Traceback is a next-gen ultra-realistic bodycam shooter built with the power of Unreal Engine 5. Make every move count — your choices decide who survives. Prepare for intense bodycam firefights where precision matters, and every decision shapes the fate of your mission.

details.title: Abyssal Echo
details.short_description: Abyssal Echo is a stylized third-person adventure game. Players awaken in a world of absolute darkness, exploring their surroundings by emitting visualized sound waves. Players must evade horrible creatures, collect a sufficient number of items, and ultimately escape from the extraction point.

details.title: Rust Onslaught
details.short_description: Rust Onslaught is a top-down shooter where you play as the robot R-75, as he takes out everything he sees. Humanity Is Dead, Robots Own The Earth, and you have become a danger.

name: 花岬-The Endless Elegy at the Flowercape

details.title: 花岬-The Endless Elegy at the Flowercape
details.short_description: "The Endless Elegy at the Flowercape"is a dark fantasy style pixel Arpg. Players will travel in a world ravaged by natural disasters and tyrannies, encountering various companions, overcoming endless sadness and despair, until they reach the end of the world called "Flower Cape".

name: To Shake, or Not to Shake

details.title: To Shake, or Not to Shake
details.short_description: Your late grandfather left you his bar. Listen to the order, pick the ingredients, layer and shake — but the bartender drinks too: drink and your hands start to shake, stay sober and the voices in your head won't stop. A story-driven bar sim where every drink comes at a price.

details.title: Kill the Stream
details.short_description: The end of the world, streamed live. Climb a deadly tower broadcast in real time to gods, mystical creatures and demons. And you're just a pathetic guy picked at random to represent humanity and challenge the tower.

details.title: Tape Us Out
details.short_description: Tape Us Out is an asymmetric, online co-op puzzle game. Players are sucked into a VHS tape and must face challenges of logic, coordination, and communication within the universe of old movies to find their way back to reality.

details.title: Dungeon Dominator
details.short_description: Build and expand your own warm, cozy dungeon where your minions live miserable lives and do their evil things. Take part in thrilling battles against humans, angels, and powerful bosses, defending your domain. Conquer the world by commanding an army with a wave of your hand!

details.title: Valiance
details.short_description: A fast paced FPS where you create your own character by choosing your arsenal of abilities and weapons. Craft your build and chain together devastating ability & weapon combos to rip apart hordes of ravenous monsters.

details.title: Compress(space)
details.short_description: A mind and space-bending puzzle game where you fold space to cheat your way through puzzles. Master space manipulation and reach beyond the stars to uncover the mystery at the end of the universe.

details.title: Bound Beyond
details.short_description: A dark, mystical first-person adventure. Investigate the disappearance of a renowned archaeologist. Explore locations where shadows may hide a threat, and every sound can be your final mistake. Solve immersive puzzles and use sound, physics, and tools to survive before an ancient secret consumes you

details.title: SUPER ADVENTURE
details.short_description: Turn around to parry and block! Equipped with a shield on your back, jump your way through vivid levels, meet funny characters, and face challenging bosses. Fight using a quick-firing Alien Blaster or a melee-focused sword! Choose the path you want to go in this SUPER ADVENTURE!

details.title: Grapple Car
details.short_description: A car with a grappling hook! Twist and turn with tight driving controls around colorful tracks to complete challenges, customize your car, and race for a spot at the timed global online leaderboards.

details.title: Into the Rootforge
details.short_description: Into the Rootforge is a unique fusion of runner, roguelike and card-based action combat. Master customisable attacks to delve further with each attempt. Uncover the secrets of the Rootforge and grow your true power through the skill trees of The Garden.

details.title: Clawback: Police Corruption Simulator
details.short_description: A narrative-focused crooked cop game. Manipulate death investigations and file false evidence to reap ill-gotten gains in a dystopian future. Save yourself.

details.title: Miniature Painter Simulator
details.short_description: Take up the amazing hobby of miniature painting! Run your own online store selling your painted miniatures & handling various jobs from clients. Create the most amazing miniatures with minimal limitations and even import your own custom models! Take a seat, grab a brush and relax.

details.title: Swarm Chess
details.short_description: Chess with thousands of pieces. Place your towers then relax and watch the chaos of battle unfold in this incremental auto battler.

details.title: Hell Loop
details.short_description: A rogue-like dungeon crawler with Chinese mythic horror. Play as an ancient butcher, trapped in the cycles of the underworld. Seek redemption, gain the aid of heavenly gods, and fight for freedom—and for the wife you still love.

details.title: Full Steam Undead
details.short_description: OPEN WORLD STEAM TRAIN + ZOMBIE VR ACTION! Ride the rune train, explore Necropolis Island and slay the undead. For Queen Victoria, it's time to roll: all aboard for undead destruction!

details.title: Dreamcraft: Lumberjack
details.short_description: Chop the sick trees to purify the forests. Gather lumber, upgrade your axe, and improve stats. No rush, no stress, relax in cozy and beautiful lands, rescue animals, and unravel the secrets of the wilderness. Nature must be preserved so cut the shadow and restore the light!

details.title: 拉斯普特的龙与魔女
details.short_description: 由蒸汽和魔法驱动的世界——人类创立的先进都市拉普斯特 肩负重任的落魄贵族之子于此邂逅龙与魔女 在友情与爱恋的迷宫不断回旋，指向出口的答案究竟为何？

details.title: 3Souls
details.short_description: A world at the crossroads of forgotten technology and magic, filled with grim guardians and anomalies. Guide three heroes through the mysteries of a floating archipelago, upgrade your camp, and unlock their potential in an isometric action RPG with immersive mechanics.

details.title: COCOBOY
details.short_description: Rediscover the lost ‘80s platformer COCOBOY in an alternate 2005! Hack a forgotten game with bizarre mods, decorate your bedroom with rare collectibles, and scour the forums of a budding fandom for clues to deeply puzzling secrets. Demo Disc is available now!

details.title: Omega Redux
details.short_description: An episodic sci-fi adventure where you explore doomed open worlds one hour before their destruction. As a relic hunter and his playable robot companion, search for strangely meaningful artifacts while cinematic catastrophe approaches with every passing second. Get out in time—or meet the end!

details.title: 1992: Rasputie
details.short_description: Take a place of a politician in the post-Soviet space and immerse yourself in the struggle for power amid the ruins of the former empire. Your decisions will determine the path of the young state's development.

details.title: MaskuLand Survival
details.short_description: You are Masku, an explorer who crash-landed in an unknown world carrying a rare cure for your son! To breathe you need special Masks, each one grants you a unique ability! Repair your balloon and get supplies, fight you way back home! His life depends on you! You need to SURVIVE!

details.title: The Guiding Spirit
details.short_description: Mix and match hundreds of traits, flaws, and skills to design unique heroes with complex personalities and ambitions. Watch them love, hate, help, and hinder each other. Roll the dice and become the Guiding Spirit of your group of misfits in this story-rich fantasy campaign simulator!

details.title: Di Renjie:  The Legendary Investigator
details.short_description: Become a legendary detective of ancient China! In "Di Renjie: The Legendary Investigator", play as Di Renjie, solving thrilling cases across Bianzhou and Bingzhou in the Tang Dynasty and uncovering the truth.

details.title: Whist
details.short_description: Become a healer in Whist – a single-player turn-based RPG. Challenge cunning diseases. Learn the art of healing, brew and stock up on potions, and solve puzzles. Plan your moves ahead, allocate your talents, and don’t rush to reveal all your cards — illnesses are not as simple as they seem!

details.title: Everything is Gun!
details.short_description: Dominate in a brutal, lightning-fast old-school FPS. Modify yourself into the perfect weapon, unleash mass destruction, conquer runs, invade others, and ascend to global supremacy. Prisoner #11 18 1978, you now belong to A1KTRZ. Your survival is broadcast to billions. What will remain of your soul?

details.title: IZEA:10puzzle Rogue-Lite RPG!
details.short_description: "Make 10 is mightier than the sword!" IZEA is a fresh strategic battle game that fuses “Make 10” × Puzzle Calculation × RPG × Roguelite. Use number cards and arithmetic operators to calculate the enemy’s designated Weak Number and fight your way to victory!

details.title: ARTIUS: Pure Imagination
details.short_description: ARTIUS is a fast-paced, momentum-based 2D platformer where you play as artists battling to preserve creativity in a world on the verge of artistic extinction! Dash, swing, and smash your way through a vibrant, hand-drawn world in this adrenaline-fueled platformer where art is your strongest weapon.

details.title: Slain 2: The Beast Within
details.short_description: A brutal gothic hack-and-slash where old-school gameplay and heavy metal collide. As Prince Akran, wield the sentient blade Bathoryn and embrace your werewolf fury, and battle through a dying world against the forces of Vroll. The quest begins now.

details.title: Tamer Town
details.short_description: Build and manage a town where humans and elemental creatures live and work together. Design neighborhoods, match Mokiton to jobs, and keep them happy to boost production. Produce and sell goods, then invest in new homes and land as your town grows.

details.title: The Black Bahr
details.short_description: The Black Bahr is a sandbox colony simulation RPG blending ocean exploration, crew management, and dynamic faction politics. Freely chart your course as a pirate, merchant, or honorable captain, shaping your destiny across the open seas.

details.title: Spirit of Diwata
details.short_description: Heal instead of fight. A co-op action JRPG inspired by SNES classics, for up to three on one screen or online. Play instruments to calm the angry creatures of an Asian fantasy world, and watch each one become a friend who brings a little more hope.

details.title: Ocean City Killer
details.short_description: Ocean City Killer is an open-world corporate dungeon crawler. You play as Rick Atlanta, a private eye investigating the death of a former colleague. What starts out as a routine case pulls you into the dark labyrinth of a seedy megacorp. Hop in your muscle car to explore the city!

details.title: Pileus Bad Trip
details.short_description: Put yourself in the role of a surviving village mushroom and try to fix what happened while you were asleep!

details.title: Rise of the Spellbaker
details.short_description: In Rise of the Spellbaker, a charming hand-crafted, fairy-tale inspired Action-Adventure, one Witch finds herself to be the sole survivor of an unknown plague. With no-one but your loyal Cat Familiar by your side, set forth into the corrupted land.

details.title: Skyland Farmer
details.short_description: In Skyland Farmer, farm in peace on your own Sky Isle. Till the fields, enrich the soil and breed better crops in this farming sim. Sell your harvest at your farm stand or put it to the test in contests. Your endless farming life starts here!

details.title: DIGGY DIGGY
details.short_description: In DIGGY DIGGY, you dig up rare fossils, collect shiny minerals and showcase your findings in a museum. Explore unique locations and bond with eccentric townsfolk in this delightfully silly, cozy adventure.

name: Yami Kare - His mind trying to bind me mentally

details.title: Yami Kare - His mind trying to bind me mentally
details.short_description: This game is a confinement suspense & love romance escape game in which the main character, who has lost her memory, aims to regain her memory and escape from the room she was confined in.

details.title: Drone Armada
details.short_description: Pilot and command massive drone swarms in real-time action-strategy battles. Research powerful tech, upgrade your fleet, and adapt your tactics to push back the invasion spreading across Kaelisia.

details.title: Endwell
details.short_description: One determined cat, one big backpack, and a whole lot of deliveries to make! As a Cat Courier, it's your job to deliver packages across a cozy town on the eve of the world's end. Help residents find connection, hope, and meaning before the last sunset.

name: Two Realms: Whispers from the Rift

details.title: Two Realms: Whispers from the Rift
details.short_description: Point & Click Fantasy Thriller: A burst of light - a crystal devours your little brother's life force. Desperate to save him, you must uncover the truth behind magic, while a dread mage closes in to tear the crystal from your hands - and with it, all hope.

details.title: IN SILICO
details.short_description: In a distant future humanity is enslaved in a simulation. Now that you are awake, can you escape from reality too?

details.title: Gatekeeper's Week
details.short_description: Become a guard of the glorious kingdom of Cardenia! Your task is to let only law-abiding travelers into the city, while repelling bandit attacks and sending swindlers to jail! Be attentive and vigilant! For the glory of the King!

details.title: Taptron 1999
details.short_description: Taptron 1999 is a short roguelite clicker where you must prevent Y2K using the power of a mouse click.

details.title: Burger Rush Simulator
details.short_description: Burger Rush Simulator is a fast food simulator where you manage your fast food restaurant, order supplies, restock containers, take payments at checkout and drive-thru, prepare meals, hire staff, expand your kitchen and dining area, and unlock features like storage and touchscreen checkout.

details.title: Typing Valley
details.short_description: Typing Valley is a cozy farming game powered by typing. Type to gather, plant, harvest, and run a cozy restaurant that brings warmth and happiness to the town. Start now, and let every keystroke become visible growth.

details.title: Pingbert's Snow Ride
details.short_description: Slide, soar, and deliver! Join Pingbert, the upbeat penguin mail carrier, in Pingbert’s Snow Ride—a fast-paced, endless platformer where you'll slide down snowy slopes to deliver mail at high speed!

details.title: Bloodstone Rising
details.short_description: Bloodstone Rising is a high-intensity co-op FPS roguelike. Gather your fellow space dwarves, mine resources, forge upgrades, and fight off relentless zombie hordes as you reclaim your ancestral kingdom.

name: アスクギア リブースト

details.title: アスクギア リブースト
details.short_description: A new, straightforward RPG! Hot scenarios and battles that go right to the heart of JRPGs. For those of you who still feel your youth in the RPGs of the PS1 and PS2 generations, this is the game for you.

details.title: Conjunctivitalizer
details.short_description: Take on six stages of vertical shooting mayhem full of looney pixel art characters and locales. Gamers who are tired of bullet hell and Compile-like shooters can finally rejoice.

details.title: Rendagor
details.short_description: Rendagor is a 2D Top-down Shooter starring a service bot. Just a simple machine... or something more? Uncover dark secrets in Story Mode or master the challenge of Arcade Mode. Shoot, smash, and demolish enemies and destructible environments with a devastating arsenal.

details.title: Simulario
details.short_description: 2D physics based game. Particle physics, soft bodies, rigid bodies, motors, jet engines, forces, vehicles and space ships, explosions and realisic destructability - all kinds of physics stuff. The game contains very different levels, that utilize various aspects of physically simulated world.

details.title: Grill'd: The Vanishing
details.short_description: [Grill'd] is a dinner party detective game played from the first-person perspective of a royal investigator. Trapped in a mansion located in the estate of a fallen aristocrat, collect clues about the cases, connect them to one another, and interrogate the suspect to uncover the truth.

details.title: Fate's Masquerade: Otome Visual Novel
details.short_description: In this animated, manhwa-inspired otome, romance the princes you were meant to hate. First, earn their affection and try not to die. Then save the empire, or burn it to the ground. Fairytale romance or villainess revenge? You decide.

details.title: Yuki-Tundra
details.short_description: Build your store empire, help the local community and keep the shelves stocked in a bid to boost your stores reputation while you rise from the ashes. Yuki-Tundra blends the casual store management genre with classic RPG adventures.

details.title: Goblin God
details.short_description: In Goblin God, you rule a tribe of chaotic goblins! Build villages, defend against evil humans, and unleash divine powers to shape the world (or cause mayhem). Each island brings new challenges—will you lead your goblins to glory or just enjoy the chaos?

details.title: Shadow of Backrooms
details.short_description: Shadow of Backrooms is a co-op horror game set in endless liminal rooms. Explore the Backrooms with up to 4 friends, solve puzzles and escape the entities before they catch you. But be warned: you are not alone.

details.title: Skippy's Grand Escape
details.short_description: Escape increasingly complex mazes as fast as possible. Select skills tactically for each level. Optimize your path. Watch out for enemies, traps, anomalies and more in this space themed top down maze runner.

details.title: Particles of Reality: Remembrance
details.short_description: Congrats! You've landed a dream job as a paranormal scientist with the government! Downside? Outside contact is limited and monitored. You learn it is 'who' (not 'what') you are researching, and... you're the reason these supernatural beings are here? Ignore the lurking Guardians of Reality...

details.title: Wandering Within
details.short_description: Wandering Within is a 2d solo survival game where you have to cross a hostile desert to unravel the mysteries of a legendary chest. Gather resources, find water and build tools to increase your chance of survival

details.title: Sonic Valkyria: KANON
details.short_description: "Every time you shoot an enemy, music is born." The heartbeat of rock becomes your aim. An impulse shooting game with anime song rock and lock-on! "Sonic Valkyria: KANON"

details.title: Eight Bells
details.short_description: A pixel-art naval roguelike in the spirit of FTL. Command a Navy warship room by room, crew it with humans, merfolk and stranger things, and hunt pirate captains in real-time-with-pause broadsides on a sea where 10+ monsters lurk. Keep your crew alive. Keep the sea outside.

details.title: Liquid Lungs
details.short_description: Liquid Lungs is a high-speed FPS blending fluid parkour with intense combat. Inspired by free-running action games and fast-paced shooters, it delivers a seamless mix of movement and marksmanship in a dystopian world. Run, jump, and fight in a nonstop adrenaline rush where every motion counts.

details.title: Tomebound
details.short_description: Rescue corrupted books from your library, harness their power and rally their forces to fight for you in this hexgrid tactics deckbuilder! Combine cards to create uniquely powerful spells. With thousands of permutations to explore every turn, no two battles will ever be the same.

name: RAEV: Kingdom on the Distant Shores

details.title: RAEV: Kingdom on the Distant Shores
details.short_description: From a humble campfire to a multi-city kingdom, lead with grace in RAEV: Kingdom on the Distant Shores: a unique kingdom builder where every decision shapes the fate of your fox citizens and the legacy of your continent-spanning kingdom. With a freeform building system, no grids, no limits.

details.title: Rogue Maze
details.short_description: Tower defense is reinvented in this maze-defense roguelike! Design devious labyrinths fit to exhaust the unfortunate souls that enter by using special tiles that act as both your "towers" and pathway. Deploy gadgets, distractions, and tools to stay a step ahead!

details.title: Tricky and the Dream Caster
details.short_description: A surreal, retro-inspired, free form 3D platformer that takes you through a world of dreams and nightmares!

details.title: Bite the Crown
details.short_description: In a world ruled by sugary tyrants, an unlikely hero rises from the shadows: Pom the Mold. Build your secret guild, gather rogue treats, lead the rebellion and battle through candy-coated chaos to topple the Candy Kingdom. The Sweet Revolution begins—bite back!

name: Shadows of Midnight - They Watch Me Sleep

details.title: Shadows of Midnight - They Watch Me Sleep
details.short_description: The game is a narrative-driven horror experience inspired by the Silent Hill and Fears to Fathom franchises. Live through two terrifying stories: a man’s summer getaway turns into a nightmare at a shady hotel, and a child grows up knowing something watches from the forest—always waiting.

details.title: LingoRogue
details.short_description: The language flashcard roguelike. LingoRogue is a dopamine machine of a deck-builder. Find the cards you need to spin crazy combos off your words. Play with endless variety and learn new languages without effort.

details.title: Switcheroo
details.short_description: A kangaroo named Jade escapes from an evil mad scientist who's obsessed with color! Along the way, she'll hop past vibrant obstacles, kick pesky robots out of the way, and use her new color-switching powers to solve the lab's mysterious puzzles.

details.title: Galo's Strife
details.short_description: 『ガロゥズストライフ』は、人間が異形の怪物に変わる事件の最中、超常の力を得た主人公の少年ガロゥと少女ハイマを中心に描くダークファンタジーRPGです。バトルやイベントシーンでは、鮮やかなドット絵のキャラクター達が賑やかに動きます。仲間を集め「ルラガルド」へ旅立ちましょう。

details.title: Argol II - Curse of Nemesis
details.short_description: Argol II - Curse of Nemesis is an action, platform and adventure game. The action takes place in mythological times. Argol and his companions must face Nemesis the goddess of vengeance.

details.title: THE FATUM
details.short_description: The Supreme Committee congratulates you on your promotion. Your task is to identify citizens infected by the unknown virus. Interrogate, inspect, pass a verdict. Test your deduction in a world of total control. Remember: the Standard above all.

details.title: 90FX
details.short_description: Straight from the 90s, 90FX recreates the feel and experience of once revolutionary racing games of the early 90s. 90s Kids will remember this.

details.title: Bloodfly Keeper
details.short_description: Breed unruly bloodflies, craft forbidden cures, and rise from outcast to underground healer in a city ruled by a corrupt medical regime.

details.title: Evolized
details.short_description: Evolized is a fast-paced evolution roguelite where your creature changes in real time. Build your biology, push deeper into a storm that escalates the world every minute, and extract before you are wiped out.

details.title: Typewriter Monkeys
details.short_description: Infinite monkeys with infinite typewriters will eventually write Shakespeare... right? Find out in this cozy automation idler! Strategically place different kinds of monkeys with typewriters then level them up as you type longer and longer words!

details.title: Blackmail Directive
details.short_description: A gripping visual novel set in modern-day Japan, featuring cute anime-style heroines and branching storylines that lead to multiple endings. Every choice you make shapes the story—and determines Arisa's fate.

details.title: Fear Hour
details.short_description: Insane mistakes brought you to a life-or-death judgment. Fight off a terrifying Killer, or kill those who trespass on your territory in this tense (1v5) online experience. Where following your instincts might help you escape, or kill them all.

details.title: Super Blood Hockey: Rogue Manager
details.short_description: A sports game where you don't control the players, instead play as a shady coach and build a deck of dirty tricks to become season champion. A hybrid of roguelike deckbuilder, auto-battler, and high action arcade hockey.

details.title: Plate And Profit
details.short_description: Can you make rent with a spicy bowl of lettuce and ketchup? Run a chaotic kitchen in this Cooking Roguelite! Manage ingredients, build your synergies and strategies with spices and decor, and serve customers before their patience runs out.

details.title: ZLEEPI
details.short_description: ZLEEPI is an exciting hyper-speedy 2D platformer, where you play as a cute alien escaping Area 51! Use your PVC pipe to bounce off of walls, floors, and ceilings to get to the exit as quickly as possible! All while eating pipin' hot pizza slices on your way!

details.title: Findosaurs
details.short_description: Casual hidden creature game featuring dinosaurs and other prehistoric life illustrated in a lumpy potato fashion living in ecosystems. Lesser known dinosaurs, non-dinosaur archosaurs, synapsids, temnospondyls are represented alongside the charismatic mega fauna.

details.title: Manaftory
details.short_description: Collect resources, build machines, and automate everything. Explore magical lands, face hostile creatures, and turn their loot into part of your factory system. This is your Manaftory — a magical factory powered by mana.

details.title: LED Bringer
details.short_description: The sun has gone out, and darkness has consumed the planet. You ended up here by accident, but now you must become a glimmer of hope. Even if it's just… an LED. Take control of a combat drone, expand your base, navigate the darkness, and uncover the secrets of a dying world.

name: 西游肉鸽：杨戬的100种死法

details.title: 西游肉鸽：杨戬的100种死法
details.short_description: "Roguelike Journey to the West: 100 Ways to Slay Erlang Shen" is a 3D light-strategy roguelike that blends shooting, action, and tower defense into fast-paced gameplay. Gameplay:Auto-attack while equipping any 6 weapons—survive 20 waves, defeat all final bosses to win!

details.title: Friendship Simulator
details.short_description: Experience old school couch split-screen gaming as if you had friends.

details.title: The 7th Shift
details.short_description: Work the overnight shift alone at Founder's Choice Market. Inspect shipments, decide what’s accepted or denied, and stock the shelves. But be careful, your performance is being evaluated, and it determines your fate. Escape after seven shifts or be forced to join the staff that never clocks out

details.title: Breadieval
details.short_description: Create unique baked goods by combining ingredients you find at the market. Befriend the puppet villagers by baking their favourite recipes or by combining tasty flavours. Have fun, you don't have to follow a recipe here.

details.title: Captain Speedfin
details.short_description: Captain Speedfin is stuck with an hourglass and needs to be fast! Race against the clock through 60 challenging levels of pirate parkour, where every second counts. Grab your treasure and get out before time runs out!

details.title: Chronoscript: The Endless End
details.short_description: “Chronoscript: The Endless End” is an exploration-based action-adventure game where you, an editor trapped within a manuscript, must unravel a thousand-year story that writes itself beyond its end—across 2D pages and a 3D manor.

details.title: Waffles' Cranked Stories
details.short_description: Waffles' Cranked Stories is a selection of mini-games set in the same universe as Inspector Waffles, originally released exclusively on the Playdate console. This time, follow the adventures of Chance and Spike and discover new stories that expand on the previous ones!

details.title: Faraway Galaxy
details.short_description: Faraway Galaxy is a new roguelite deckbuilder framed as a bizarre tabletop adventure narrated by a battle-hardened space wolf. Master intense tactical battles and meaningful choices between them. Fight alien pirates, collect artifacts, and uncover new encounters!

details.title: A Trivia Roguelike
details.short_description: Your actions are dictated by trivia questions and answers in this roguelike RPG with a trivia twist. Collect loot and level up to impact your chances of survival, take down dangerous foes and defeat the evil Trivia Arch Lich.

details.title: SHROT
details.short_description: Welcome to SHROT! A fast, funny, and unapologetically stupid first-person boomer shooter where a Slavic trucker gets stuck in an alien apocalypse and handles it the only way he knows how: with beer, cigarettes, and unresolved anger issues.

name: Before the Silence Claims: In Absentia

details.title: Before the Silence Claims: In Absentia
details.short_description: "The truth is not found in what you see… but in what you tune into." Survive a deceased scientist's memories in a strange 1930s German town. Manipulate frequencies to reveal what is hidden, face unsettling entities, and keep an impossible promise in a tactile, HUD-less psychological survival horror.

details.title: From Ruins – A Detective Adventure
details.short_description: A new-gen detective adventure combining deduction gameplay with a gripping story full of twists and turns. Gather clues, establish connections, and solve a series of increasingly challenging cases. Will you uncover the feud that began at the end of the world?

details.title: Temple Siege TD
details.short_description: Relaxing 3D fantasy tower defense game with an RPG/MOBA vibe: Hero-towers, distinct roles, unique abilities, powerful combos and rising challenge.

name: 伴我同行 Walk alongside me

details.title: 伴我同行 Walk alongside me
details.short_description: "Walk Alongside Me" is a tactical roguelike deckbuilder. Command a dynamic duo, using seamless rotation and card synergy to build a unique combat system on your quest to rescue your family and save the world. Choose your heroes and begin your journey!

details.title: White Crow Castle: Loop
details.short_description: A fantasy mystery otome RPG with time loop mechanics. Explore a cursed castle, collect clues, solve puzzles, make critical choices, and experience branching storylines, emotional bonds, and life-or-death survival in an inescapable cycle.

details.title: BloodSpiller
details.short_description: Brutally blast through Dracula's minions and rescue your girl in this retro action platformer. Upgrade, discover, and destroy with retro flair and modern attitude.

details.title: Gardoon
details.short_description: The blackjack roguelite of the Persian Book of Kings. Beat the Deev at 21 to win the right to rule on a hero's prayer, then grant it or deny it. Five chapters of Rostam and Sohrab, four starting decks, and a demon that plays to win.

details.title: Amazon Warrior
details.short_description: A Puzzle with Bossfights! Join Tayana and save the Amazon exploring amazing Scenarios, Enemies and Bosses! An Evil is haunting the heart of the Amazon! Among breathtaking landscapes, forge powerful alliances and unleash divine powers to survive deadly trials and shape the fate of the forest.

details.title: RTG
details.short_description: RTG is narrative sci-fi puzzle/platformer about a guy with no memories stranded inside strange world, where initially nothing makes sense. Solve gradually challenging puzzles and, piece by piece, unravel mystery behind what you see and experience.

details.title: Mimix
details.short_description: Create equipment through synthesis and break out to face incoming heroes in this strategic roguelike auto-battler. With limited actions, choose and combine materials to build the optimal loadout. Battles are fully automatic, making preparation the key to victory.

details.title: COUNTERSUN
details.short_description: A classic real-time strategy game set in 1953, the year a second sun rose. Build a base, mine ore, chop wood, drill for oil and command armies on land, sea and air against the Umbral. Two campaigns, ranked online, skirmish, LAN and a map editor.

name: ナカノ人格移植研究所

details.title: ナカノ人格移植研究所
details.short_description: "The Nakano Laboratory" is a loop-based mystery 2D adventure game. Within each loop of 15 minutes, you take over researchers' bodies to gather clues around the ship, then present your evidence at the meeting.
developers: 麺屋すぱいす 東京支店
publishers: 麺屋すぱいす 東京支店

details.title: LIKVAR: ZOYA
details.short_description: You are assigned to Zoya, a candidate with 30 days to become a Likvar—a superpowered field operative. Manage her condition, send her on dangerous missions, and report or alter the results. Your choices shape her performance, trust, and future.

details.title: Stunt Paradise 2
details.short_description: Stunt Paradise 2 - more speed, more explosions, more madness! Jump over ramps, dodge lasers, buzzsaws, and rockets while performing insane stunts. With new traps, improved graphics, and pure arcade chaos - get ready for the ultimate stunt challenge!

details.title: Corban's Station
details.short_description: In this first-person puzzle exploration game, walk the liminal spaces of a long-abandoned service station. Reprogram aging computers, physically reroute damaged and fading connections and restore fragments of their waning memory.

details.title: MonstrousPark+
details.short_description: A workplace ensemble visual novel about sixteen cast members — monsters — working at a small amusement park that opens only at night.

details.title: Barge
details.short_description: Grow crops, raise animals, and harvest resources that you can sell in towns you pass as you and your barge float down an endless river in this top down, pixel art, farming sim.

details.title: Beerhouse Simulator
details.short_description: Brew beer your own way! First-person homebrewing simulator where every batch can go brilliantly wrong or surprisingly right — and clients might just notice the difference, or not. Brew, experiment or cause total beery mayhem.

details.title: Broom Broom
details.short_description: Grab your broom, fly over to people in need and brew them potions after a catastrophic snowstorm has hit your village! Talk to your lovely (but mostly grumpy) neighbours as you find your place in this short and cozy adventure.

details.title: Wall Street 1929
details.short_description: Wall Street 1929 is a business sim set in the Great Depression. Start before the crash and live through collapse and recovery. Found companies, acquire shares, buy real estate, run charities, and bid on collectibles to build your empire.

details.title: 无言初雪与奇迹书
details.short_description: 江城是个很少下雪的南方城市。 倘若是哪个冬天见到了，就随手纪念一下吧… 在难以成团的雪籽融化成水之前，在眼前的人尚未走远消失之前 将“白色的奇迹”封存在相片里，记录在记事本里，铭刻于脑海里……

details.title: Drawing Dead
details.short_description: A grid-based roguelike deckbuilder where you swap cards to trigger cascading poker hands, or sacrifice them for power. Summon demons, strike bargains, and enchant your deck into an infernal scoring engine.

details.title: Kneel!
details.short_description: A dark, stylized simulation about control and devotion. Build influence, exploit human weakness, and reshape a forgotten city districts through faith, fear, and obedience.

details.title: Kindling Hour
details.short_description: A short psychological horror text adventure guided by a single candle. Random encounters and fragments of lost memories weave a story in the dark. Eerie and unsettling, yet a little cute and quirky. A narrative experience to gently light a fire in your heart.

details.title: Silver Lake National Park
details.short_description: Welcome to Silver Lake National Park, where Ranger Logan keeps the trails clear, the campfires warm, and the supernatural community hidden in plain sight. He's a werebear who learned long ago not to fight what he is. These days he makes sure everyone feels at home, even when he can't always feel it.

details.title: Astefactor
details.short_description: Mine asteroids, process resources, upgrade your equipment, repeat. Ah, and also defend your factory, because it seems like quite a few folks are interested in that strange device you just found. Who knows why? There's no way it's of some universal importance, right?..

details.title: Disordered
details.short_description: A detective wakes up beside a corpse, and with no memories. The evidence points to him. Everyone thinks he’s the killer. Unravel the truth before time runs out in this hand-drawn detective mystery adventure set in 1990s Thailand, where every memory hides a lie.

details.title: A.N.R.S - Heroes Assemble
details.short_description: "A.N.R.S（Alliance of the Never Rest Spirits）- Heroes Assemble" is a 2D side-scrolling action game featuring multiple protagonists. Players take control of robots and heroes with distinct combat styles to overcome disasters and enemies across different regions.

details.title: Karma Exorcist
details.short_description: The underworld lies in ruins, ravaged by evil karma. In this unknown and perilous realm of the dead, you must fight against demonic forces, collect mystical artifacts, face the Yama Kings and the Ghost Emperors, sever the Karma, and reforge the path of reincarnation.

details.title: Captain Contraption’s Safari Park
details.short_description: A pixel-art run based safari park sim. Clone lions, medieval knights and sentient trucks into a park with no fences, then route your visitors past the chaos. You control the paths, the buildings and your robot staff. The one thing you don’t control is the animals.

details.title: Sheep Counting
details.short_description: A recreational software for counting sheep, observing puzzles, and befriending an indoor air-conditioning unit.

details.title: ORK
details.short_description: One day, a mighty quake shakes the land — Colors fade away, this wasn’t planned! “This is bad!” cry five odd friends in stride, They gather, rise, and run side by side. Use their skills, push through each stage, Reach the goal in a 2D side-scrolling rage!

details.title: Kafka at the Station
details.short_description: I found myself at the station. The story unfolds as you type commands on your keyboard. As the days repeat, I keep wondering what I can do for her. A command-driven adventure steeped in nostalgic pixel art and sound.

details.title: The Element Of
details.short_description: The Element Of is an element bending roguelite dungeon crawler set in a strange fantasy world. Choose from a variety of elements all with their unique playstyles to fight through floors of enemies and gain rewards that make you and your element stronger.

name: The Story about princess 8 out of 10

details.title: The Story about princess 8 out of 10
details.short_description: Once upon a time, there was a perfectly average princess — 8/10 at best. No singing animals, no magical destiny. Just an annoying father-king and a whole bunch of creepy barons trying to marry her off.

details.title: Tad-Bubble!
details.short_description: Tad-Bubble is a boss rush shoot ‘em up for the Game Boy Color! Fight off waves of dangerous boss bugs, boss fish, and boss more in this brand-new retro experience.

name: Blooming Solitude: Priestess of Hanafuda / 花札ノ巫孤

details.title: Blooming Solitude: Priestess of Hanafuda / 花札ノ巫孤
details.short_description: Hanafuda × Roguelite × Action! Explore dungeons, collect Hanafuda cards, and grow stronger as a Miko. Battle enemies with the power of your cards, then face powerful bosses in Hanafuda battles. Form winning hands and unleash devastating attacks!

details.title: Heartreasure: Recolor the World
details.short_description: “This world was never meant to be so blank!” Help Mary, a fairy Mendako who can’t remember her precious friend, as you find hidden hearts to bring color back to the world! A point-and-click hidden object adventure…Wait, why did the world disappear in the first place?

details.title: OILST
details.short_description: OILST is a relaxing puzzle game about reducing numbers to zero by stamping tetrominoes. Levels are hand-crafted to surprise, delight, and engage but not break your brain. Settle back, take your time, and enjoy.

details.title: BDO
details.short_description: Build and lead a boxing academy in a deep management simulation. Recruit and develop fighters, plan camps, manage contracts, health and morale, then compete across a living world in single-player or a multiplayer universe.

details.title: By Your Name
details.short_description: BY YOUR NAME is a nonlinear psychological thriller about exploring a cursed mansion, recovering other people’s memories, and uncovering the lives of those whose names nearly vanished along with their past. Explore the house. Return the names. And decide how this story should end.

details.title: Grumble Burger
details.short_description: Grumble Burger is a first-person cooking thriller where you take over your late Uncle Frank's food truck. Frank believed the bond between cook and customer was paramount. However, you'll soon discover that orders are handled differently here. And the customers are not your typical diner patrons...

details.title: Titan Sword
details.short_description: Sword. Giant. Boom. Grab a massive sword, hunt titans, and cut through everything in your way.

details.title: Break Free
details.short_description: Break Free is a First person speedrunning game about breaking free of your restraints, including the level itself.

details.title: YokaiRou: Shoppe of Mystique
details.short_description: A cozy supernatural mystery about listening to your customers' stories, uncovering the yokai troubling them through divination and deduction, and finding the right ritual to set things right.

details.title: Demon Kitty: Trials!
details.short_description: Demon Kitty: Trials! is a hidden object adventure that plays like a roguelite. Help countless kitties across multiple runs, find lost objects in mysterious ancient ruins. Gain powers, transform your kitty, find the objects and collect as many kitties as you can!

details.title: The Last Code
details.short_description: Your gun shoots, pulls and pushes. Move objects and enemies, solve puzzles and use portals in this 2D sci-fi puzzle-platformer. You are an AI awakening on a space station overrun by machines.

details.title: Neironaut
details.short_description: Solve a mysterious case of disappearance with an unexpected help from your own dreams!

details.title: Odd Shop
details.short_description: Manage a haunted pawn shop in this cozy horror game. Cursed items are your most popular wares, but keeping them all under one roof can have deadly consequences. Upgrade and maintain the shop to build a retail reputation that cannot be denied...or make your money and get out before it’s too late.

details.title: SoulGraft
details.short_description: The spell-crafting bullet heaven where you earn your god-tier endgame. Graft runic circles to your soul, then unleash your creations on the daemonic hordes. Create 10^30 possible spell combinations and ascend to godhood.

details.title: Rage and Fury
details.short_description: Rage and Fury is a fast-paced 2D beat ’em up built like a lost ’90s action movie. Fight through the streets, unleash devastating combos, turn the environment into a weapon, and follow Logan Hunter through a cinematic story packed with action, attitude and humor.

details.title: Atomic Hockey
details.short_description: Every hockey player is strapped to their own rail. So what now? You pass... and you pass before the bomb goes off under your stick. Atomic Hockey is a wild couch game for up to 12 people. Each of you controls hockey players on rails, trying to beat the other team. Usually not the way you’d expect.

details.title: Feet in Food
details.short_description: What could possibly be better than food? That’s right! Feet in food! LOTS OF FEET! Create food arrangements around the girls, then wash their feet clean of all the food and sauces afterward. You wouldn’t want them to stay dirty, would you?

details.title: Her Milk, My Coffee
details.short_description: The tastiest coffee is made with milk. Or, more precisely, with her milk... Brew coffee, add all kinds of ingredients, serve it to cats, and make money. And you are going to need a lot of money, because you will be spending it all on gifts to take the cow girl on dates.

details.title: One More Planet
details.short_description: Mine asteroids, build defenses, and conquer planets across distant galaxies. Explore open space, complete missions, unlock new technologies, and defend your settlements against attackers. One More Planet is an action & exploration game set in a physics-driven 2D space sandbox.

details.title: 小角色
details.short_description: 这是一个增加了移动维度的类杀戮尖塔卡牌DBGrogue游戏。构筑中的移动维度将发挥重要作用，你将扮演武士，刺客，猎人，法师等角色体验一段战胜心魔的故事。

details.title: Delete the World
details.short_description: Delete the World is a completely normal visual novel… unless you decide to help her kill everyone.

details.title: Math and Guns
details.short_description: Math and Guns is a top-down roguelite shooter where every right answer reloads your gun. Pick the problems you want, or bring your own flashcards, then fight through seven floors of the Necromancer’s base to rescue your captured squad.

details.title: Stroom
details.short_description: Stroom is a precision platformer built for speed. Master the dash, chain your moves and find the fastest path through 100 handcrafted levels across 5 worlds.

name: The Attic: Fear of the Dark

details.title: The Attic: Fear of the Dark
details.short_description: The Attic is a first-person psychological horror set in a haunted house. Explore forgotten rooms, solve challenging puzzles, and gradually uncover the family’s haunting story. The atmosphere is full of tension and psychedelic vision.. Don’t let fear and tormenting memories take control over you.

details.title: Envido
details.short_description: Grab your cards, play against wandering souls, unlock items at the pub and win all the matches to survive. Scheme your plays, perfect your bluffs and make strategic decisions based on your macumbas. Your match against Mandinga is about to begin!

details.title: Quantum Quartz
details.short_description: Steampunk pixel-art precision platformer where you toggle platforms on and off using colored crystals. With only one active at a time, each grants a different movement ability, changing how you move and how the level works, blending high-skill platforming with spatial puzzles.

details.title: Lunaton: Rescue mission
details.short_description: 🐾 Transform an abandoned island into a thriving resort! Time moves in real time, and the seasons change weekly. Hire townspeople, collect evening profits, tend to your farm, and explore the neighboring mystical islands by train at your own pace.

details.title: Discard All Hope
details.short_description: Combat brutal enemies in this mechanically deep, horror-themed looter-shooter. Players make split-second decisions with their deck to do everything from cancelling enemy attacks, detonating status conditions, or healing themselves. Collect hundreds of spells, mutated by dozens of modifiers!

details.title: Compact Colonies
details.short_description: Compact Colonies is a survival base-builder with roguelike elements, where every tile counts. Manage scarce resources, grow a tiny settlement, and keep your people fed, faithful, and defended in a finite world full of strategic trade-offs.

details.title: Starshard Brigands
details.short_description: Starshard Brigands is a first-person dungeon crawler with grid-based movement, where shifting loyalties and hard choices shape your fate. As a nameless mercenary in a fractured world, decide where you stand—or stand alone.

details.title: Rising Fox
details.short_description: Embark on an unforgettable adventure. Explore a mysterious world, uncover the secrets of the Zoodiacs, and face a threat that could destroy everything. Save your village as you dive into a story where nothing is as it seems.

details.title: Brutal War
details.short_description: A game of dark humor and political and social satire. Crude and realistic references in a 3D first-person shooter. Prepare to see some very strange things in this strange game. LET'S KILL THE NAZIS TOGETHER!

name: Bitsies: I Caught a Strange Creature Roaming on My Desktop and Now I Raise Them in My Tiny Garden

details.title: Bitsies: I Caught a Strange Creature Roaming on My Desktop and Now I Raise Them in My Tiny Garden
details.short_description: A desktop hunting game. Catch tiny creatures that appear on your desktop, bring them to your peaceful garden 🏝️ Take care of them as they grow, evolve, and fill your space with quiet cozy life.

details.title: Ganymede
details.short_description: Hack and slash your way through a space station overrun with aggressive alien creatures. Collect upgrade orbs to extend your abilities and conquer convoluted movement puzzles.

details.title: Lead The Dragon
details.short_description: Join your crew and conquer the narrow roads of America. Explore the open world, earn respect and money by competing in street races, but breaking the law will bring you serious trouble with the police.

details.title: Joaquin Simulator
details.short_description: Help retiree Joaquin on his road trip through Brazil. It's a 2000 km journey full of challenges, and nothing is simple in Brazil. You must eat, drink, smoke, earn money, deal with corrupt cops, all to reach a party to save democracy in Brazil.

details.title: I AM NIGHT
details.short_description: A folk horror roguelike deckbuilder where you tear apart and scrap together cards to face monsters, unravel mysteries, and survive a world forged in fear. Set out on a brave, twisted adventure of self-discovery.

details.title: WOLF OF THE DESERT
details.short_description: Infiltrate Qamaria tower. Sneak through shadows, observe your surroundings. Gather ability chips to destroy and hack security devices, vanish, teleport past enemies, outsmart them using clones. Combine and upgrade ability chips for the ultimate loadout and bring down a corporate empire.

details.title: The Perfect Prince
details.short_description: An imperfect boy takes the perfect prince's place. Explore a watercolor storybook that unfolds as you walk, and battle with words you collect in this 2D adventure. As its gentle world grows uneasy, your choices—and how you win—shape the story.

details.title: 缘之绳
details.short_description: 《缘之绳》是一款角色扮演多结局养成游戏。你自灵木中醒来，被清冷的剑仙师尊带回门派，成为了她唯一的弟子。在这未来的日子里，选择自己的道路，无论是刀枪剑戟、琴棋书画；还是采药掘矿、狩猎捕鱼，又或是锻打缝纫、制丹谱曲，相信你都能成就一番不俗的伟业。因缘际会之下，这段找寻身世的成长之旅，会邂逅怎样的故事，最终又会走向何方？

details.title: Combo Vectors
details.short_description: Evade enemies and their attacks and fight back using the Braille alphabet in Combo Vectors, a short and minimalist action roguelike.

details.title: Witherheart
details.short_description: Witherheart is a turn-based roguelike deck-building game with grid-based combat. Build your deck, reposition on the battlefield, and make tactical decisions where every card and every step can turn the tide of a fight.

details.title: WorldLattice
details.short_description: A relaxing world-building toy where players paint modular tiles to create small handcrafted environments.

name: Itachi: Haunted Abodes　Wandering Through 2000s Tokyo Culture

details.title: Itachi: Haunted Abodes　Wandering Through 2000s Tokyo Culture
details.short_description: Itachi: Haunted Abodes is a paranormal suspense adventure that has you wandering through 2000s Tokyo's subculture scenes!

details.title: Edge Ember
details.short_description: Edge Ember is a top-down action Roguelike game. You will play characters of different professions, embark on a threatening journey, challenge forces from all sides, and find the answer to save the city-state and the tribe.

details.title: Ötzi
details.short_description: Ötzi is a Neolithic survival and crafting game. Hunt, fish and forage so you don't starve. Craft tools, clothing and shelter to withstand the cold, wind and rain in a living ecosystem, solo or in co-op for up to four.

details.title: Her Crown of Blood
details.short_description: A sinful child is damned to hell. Her mother follows her. An indie horror RPG.

details.title: PROJECT LEVELS
details.short_description: PROJECT LEVELS is a creative multiplayer sandbox where you and your friends can build worlds, create interactive experiences and bring your ideas to life together.

details.title: Word Chain Dungeon
details.short_description: This is a roguelike game where you explore a dungeon through a word chain. You can move and attack by entering words. Use your vocabulary skills to reach the deepest level of the dungeon!

details.title: Mahoshii Swap
details.short_description: Mahoshii Swap is a 2D platformer with retro roots and a unique twist. Play as Shiina and other characters, each with distinct abilities, and swap between them to conquer challenging levels. Classic in spirit, but powered by fresh mechanics that reinvent the genre.

details.title: Last Drone War
details.short_description: You lose the war! Pilot FPV drones, helicopters, and fighter jets to unleash devastating firepower - and become a true ACE of modern warfare.

details.title: Stillwell
details.short_description: Minesweeper meets horror. Deterministic grid puzzles with clear rules. Use your lantern, flashlight, and chalk to escape before your oxygen runs out.

details.title: Escape the Doom
details.short_description: A physics-based endless runner that demands precise vehicle control. Fly fast and dodge hazards as you race through time to escape the impending Doom.

details.title: Parabless
details.short_description: Explore life and spiritual warfare in Parabless card game. Grounded in a biblical moral code and driven by artistic expression, every card represents a facet of existence in a broken world.

details.title: LineForgeBlackSmith
details.short_description: A blacksmith shop with a "line" of unique adventurers! Use your memory and timing mini-games to quickly identify each customer's preferred weapon and forge it. In the Battle Phase, your armed customers fight. Power up your regulars (MVPs) and defeat the bosses. Become the busiest blacksmith!

details.title: Daybreak Torch
details.short_description: DaybreakTorch is a pixel-art party-based RPG that combines real-time tactical combat with traditional sRPG's squad building. Assemble your own elite hero squad and embark on a heroic, classic adventure set in a mythological world.

details.title: Void Crawlers
details.short_description: Void Crawlers is a Top-down Rogue-Lite Incremental Shooter, there are 3 initial games modes, Arcade - Room to room combat, Gauntlet - 30 minute invasion, and Story - A combination of Arcade and Gauntlet mode with a story on top.

details.title: Kitty Haven
details.short_description: FInd the perfect spot for picky little furballs: whether they’re greedy, have sensitive noses, or keep getting into stubborn cat fights, arrange the space to bring back peace. Create your own haven by unlocking items and new residents. Solve puzzles and decorate the ideal sanctuary for your kittens!

details.title: Essentia: A monster catching adventure
details.short_description: Isometric dungeon crawler with procedurally generated levels. A wide variety of cute monster characters to collect. A turn-based battle system with unique mana mechanic. Uncover the secrets of the calamity that has left this world in chaos.

details.title: Why's It Getting DARKER?!
details.short_description: The light is your only lifeline. Descend into a crushing, thalassophobic abyss where every photograph could be your last. Investigate unpredictable deep-sea horrors and explore the vast, dark unknown - all while being 'assisted' by a darkly sarcastic AI.

details.title: Space Hood
details.short_description: Defend your outpost in this tower defense with a raiding twist. Battle the ruthless Nova Roma Corporation as you build, loot, and survive relentless assaults.

details.title: Bloodshot Eyes
details.short_description: THIS IS A WORK IN PROGRESS!!! IGNORE EVERYTHING ON THE PAGE!!! DEMO IS UPDATED PRETTY REGULARLY.

details.title: Quiz Hero Chinese Numbers
details.short_description: A cozy educational RPG where every action is powered by quizzes. Learn Chinese numbers as you explore, solve puzzles, battle corrupted creatures, and help purify the four Elemental Crystals - Earth, Water, Air, and Fire.

details.title: The Grand Praetor
details.short_description: As the seventh heir to the Empress, you have been appointed Grand Praetor to investigate a string of serial murders.Will you seek the truth and expose the conspiracy—or indulge in pleasure and power, doing as you please?

details.title: Tabletop Inc.
details.short_description: Start a tabletop game company in your bedroom workshop! Develop unique genres and themes, assemble the game boxes yourself, pay your bills, hire your friends, upgrade your workshop, and design even better games in this cozy management tycoon.

details.title: AKIBA LOVE
details.short_description: AKIBA LOVE is a dating simulation game, in other words, a G·A·L·G·A·M·E! During your half-year exchange at Japan's Inada University, as a hardcore otaku, you will meet, get to know, and fall in love with five heroines, experiencing a romantic comedy of your own!

details.title: Midnight Therapy
details.short_description: A fake therapist loses her magic and must face real patients with nothing but words. Manage appointments, money, and emotional collapse in a narrative RPG about lies, deduction, and cognitive dissonance. Are lies your weapon... or your redemption?

details.title: Cozy Rabbit Hole
details.short_description: Cozy Rabbit Hole is a 2D survival horror game. Explore the deep rabbit holes, fight or dodge monsters, gather resources, craft weapons and power-ups. Balance curiosity with caution, and find enough supplies to survive the harsh winter.

details.title: Cozy Forest
details.short_description: Restore a sleepy forest with adorable animals. Explore, craft, and decorate a cottage-core haven at your own rhythm—no timers, no hassle. Progress continues while you’re away!

details.title: My Dear Farm
details.short_description: Grow, decorate, and unwind in My Dear Farm for PC—a cozy farming sim with HD visuals, improved controls, exclusive PC events, and Steam Cloud. Build the farm of your dreams and show off your style!

details.title: New Rule
details.short_description: Président, the card game everyone knows, with a twist: after every game, the table votes a new rule. Bluff on your tax cards, snitch on a rival, gamble your jokers on a slot machine… The rules pile up game after game, and no two tables ever play the same game.

details.title: Fractured Library
details.short_description: An enchanted library - once bustling with life - now swirls with dangerous magic that is weakening barriers between worlds, causing some strange things to happen. Travel to the worlds within the pages to help the eccentric yet lovable librarian restore the library to its former glory.

details.title: Against All Skies
details.short_description: Uncover the true cost of power in this party-based RPG deckbuilder with roguelite storytelling. Navigate treacherous sky islands, build unique decks for a crew of unlikely heroes and breach the storm to deliver revolution to the skies.

details.title: Lethal Grace
details.short_description: Order received. Target identified. Proceed with elimination. Play as Grace, a killer android, in this dynamic shooter.

details.title: Legless
details.short_description: A co-op game where you have no legs. Search different maps and clear trials to appease Gods and earn your freedom - all while a giant, quirky pair of legs hunts you down.

details.title: A Dialogue Within
details.short_description: A psychological narrative experience where perception fades and reality unravels. Explore, observe, and feel the descent into the human mind.

details.title: Shadow Business
details.short_description: A single-player crime auto-battler: your gang against theirs. Drag your crew into the lanes and watch them punch through enemy lines. Wreck the rival limo before the cops arrive!

details.title: Antropico: Colonies
details.short_description: A large-scale space strategy game focused on building and maintaining power within a simulated galaxy. Build, develop, and survive in a galaxy shaped by history and consequences.

details.title: Arcane Souls
details.short_description: Enter a fantasy world full of magic in this action soulslike RPG. Master deadly combat, shape your own unique spells, and face colossal bosses. Survive the unforgiving challenges alone, or spill blood alongside a friend in full online co-op.

details.title: Project Substrata
details.short_description: Dig, build, connect—and watch your factory come to life. Shape the terrain, link mining and production lines, and manage power in a first-person base-building and automation game. Restoring a ruined planet is our long-term development goal.

details.title: Legion Draft
details.short_description: An async PvP card auto-battler filled with dogs! Each card represents an ever-growing troop of soldiers. Draft, recruit, and build a powerful legion. Discover fantasy races reimagined as different dog breeds, explore unique synergies, and outsmart your opponents to become the ultimate strategist!

details.title: Intrigue Romance
details.short_description: Step into Asterhaven’s open world for a strategic RPG with boundless possibilities! Interact with 1,500+ rNPCs of diverse classes, ethnicities and personalities, forming a vast social network and branching storylines.Every decision triggers a butterfly effect, altering the world’s trajectory.

details.title: The Umbral Seal
details.short_description: WoW raid mechanics meet FTL's pause-and-plan combat. Command 5-20 heroes through 30+ tactical boss encounters. No grinding. No filler. Pure single-player boss-rush strategy.

details.title: Elestrals Awakened
details.short_description: The elemental forces that once held balance have begun to unravel. Long ago, divine power was shattered across the stars, giving birth to the creatures now known as Elestrals. As darkness stirs and conflict brews, the Gods call upon new Champions to rise. Will you protect the world?

details.title: Flavio The Ghost Clown
details.short_description: Battle challenging bosses in this Run & Gun action game. Generate resources in a tycoon-style workshop and upgrade your equipment in the shop to guide Flavio through these bizarre battles!

details.title: Quarantine Zombies 2: Day Zero
details.short_description: From the lead game designer of Quarantine Zone and Quarantine Zombies comes a new mix of inspection sim and open-world shooter in Chicago. Determine the stage of infection and transport infected refugees through hostile streets to the Captain before they turn. Continue Hank and his brother’s story.

details.title: Card Cricket Quest
details.short_description: Card Cricket Quest is a single-player roguelite deck-builder that combines deep card-matching gameplay with the ball smashing action of cricket! Complement your deck with outrageous special cards, wield powerful willows, and collect obscure trinkets to become a cricket legend. One RUN at a time.

details.title: Mt. Quack Legend
details.short_description: A single player 2D anime rogue-lite RPG. Join a new born duck girl's adventure in a aggressively cute world. Beat up cute wild creatures and level up to different bird classes as you explore this place.

details.title: Deep Hunger
details.short_description: A short incremental game about cleaning the ocean, and feeding the insatiable hunger of a deep sea creature.

details.title: WishBreaker
details.short_description: A genre-fusion ARPG. Every class plays differently, Warrior plays as Hack n' Slash, Rogue as Stealth rougelike, Cleric is decision based, Druids play creature collecting/farming, Wizards are puzzles, secrets, and code casting and many more! PVE and PVP including Bullet Hell and Soulslike areas!

details.title: GambaSim
details.short_description: Build and expand your own casino in a high-stakes gambling and manager simulator. Play classic casino games, beat rival casinos with unique playstyles, and climb through increasingly dangerous tiers where every bet can make, or break, your future.

details.title: Pizza Agent
details.short_description: Pizza Agent is a co-op simulator combining pizza shop management with undercover alien investigation. Craft delicious pizzas, manage your stock, keep customers happy. And secretly scan customers to catch shape-shifting aliens. Cook, serve and scan !

details.title: Shadow Hills Manor
details.short_description: Shadow Hills Manor is a first-person psychological horror experience focused on exploration, puzzle-solving, and looting. Break into the manor left behind by greed and decay. Search for valuables, but the more you take, the angrier the manor becomes. Your choice of greed shapes how the manor reacts.

details.title: Reign & Shuffle
details.short_description: As an emperor, rule your dynasty and handle state affairs year by year. Each decision you make will shape its destiny. Will every choice today alter your dynasty's future trajectory? Classic roguelike card gameplay collides with real historical events—what sparks will fly?

details.title: Valhalla, Vikings, Ragnarok!
details.short_description: Valhalla, Vikings, Ragnarok! It's a co-op game about a band of funny Vikings who must raid villages across all nine realms to pay off their debt to Hel and carve their path to Valhalla! Grab the treasure and carry it to the ship! Fight off the weak, hide from the strong, and do it all for the loot!

details.title: TILLY'S ROLL
details.short_description: A turn-based creature dice battler where every roll counts! Capture creatures, collect dice, and battle with strategy and luck to win THE CROWN JEWELS TOURNAMENT!

details.title: Abyss of Kings
details.short_description: A Dark-Fantasy Action-Adventure inspired by the Kingsfield series. Explore the remnants of an underground civilization and battle sentient chess pieces. Discover magical rings and use them to create your own spells. Meet the last inhabitants of a dead kingdom and escape the Abyss.

details.title: Spectral Report
details.short_description: Enter abandoned locations as Spectral Reporters to prove the existence of ghosts. But beware: sanity is fragile, and not everything you see is real. Cooperate with your team, investigate the place, take evidences, and finally prove that ghosts are real.

details.title: 红夏
details.short_description: 《红夏》是一款以剧情体验为主的视觉小说游戏。八月末的某天，二十多名师生被神秘地困在学校里，等待他们的将是一场自相残杀……

details.title: Where Dragons Once Ruled
details.short_description: Step into the wings of a young dragon, one of the last. Roam diverse biomes, meet strange creatures, glide, breathe fire, and uncover an emotional story told through platforming and exploration. The journey of a dragon awaits.

name: The Other Side of the Wall

details.title: The Other Side of the Wall
details.short_description: Julian Reed is a 13-year old student at a New England all-boys Catholic boarding school in the early 1980s. When people begin disappearing and no one else seems to remember they ever existed, Julian investigates, with the help of a girl he has never seen, separated from him by a wall.

details.title: Engagement Protocol
details.short_description: Free game for game developers that that showcases various game development tools that support player engagement.

details.title: Creepy Cases Teen Detective Club
details.short_description: The mysterious death of a girl on the municipal school sports field shook the small town of Sky Cliffs. Haunting days pass, and amid disappearances, paranormal activity, and ghosts, the Teen Detective Club takes on the investigation of these frightening cases.

details.title: Home Share
details.short_description: A Horror Adventure game where you settle into your new home while creepy neighbors are watching your every move, waiting for the perfect moment to make it theirs.

details.title: Orb Orb Magi
details.short_description: Orb Orb Magi is an arcade Pinball Bulletheaven inspired by action roguelites and early Pinball videogames. Play Pinball like a Magical Girl with lots of different weapons and upgrades.

details.title: Murderplanet
details.short_description: Fight to the death in the arena-based action game show, Murderplanet. Make a loadout of ridiculous and broken synergies to weave and cleave through hordes of enemies. Survive each wave, stake out Capture Points, earn heaps of cash and further customize your runs for maximum arcade chaos.

details.title: Blind Spin
details.short_description: A 1-4 player fusion of Roulette and Poker. Bet on a rigged wheel with hidden odds and bluff your opponents to steal the pot. Use items to cheat and sabotage your rivals. Who will end up the richest?

details.title: Keyboard Smash
details.short_description: Run a shop. Help weird customers. And definitely make everything worse!

details.title: Dream Travel
details.short_description: 来一场在现实与梦境中的探索与冒险吧！平淡的暑期宅家生活、奇幻的野外回合战斗、惊险的图形机关解谜、生死攸关的鱼儿推理和毛毛虫的房间逃脱……丰富的剧情和玩法等着你来体验！

details.title: Island Of Ash
details.short_description: A 3rd-person action-adventure inspired by cult classics. Explore a unique, solo-developed world and vanquish foes in intense battles. Level up your hero and reveal the secrets of a civilization that crumbled into dust five centuries ago.

details.title: Dice and Daydream
details.short_description: Roll five dice, use limited rerolls to shape the result, and play cards powered by your dice total. Combos like pairs and straights trigger bonus effects. Build your deck in a childhood-daydream roguelike deckbuilder.

details.title: Necroblobicon
details.short_description: Necroblobicon is a roguelike where your enemies become your army. Raise the dead, gear them up, and arrange them around positional relics on a 5x5 formation. In battle, you pick who dies first and who gets back up on your side.

details.title: Herd
details.short_description: Build your set, outplay your rival, and win the Mélodus in a cute musical card battler where every match becomes a live performance.

details.title: Peak or Die
details.short_description: Peak or Die is a narrative-driven survival game about leading a team of adventurers up a deadly mountain, where every decision has lasting consequences. Manage oxygen, food, and team morale while facing moral dilemmas, random events, and an unforgiving environment. Reach the summit — or fail trying.

details.title: The Duke is Dead
details.short_description: Duke Damian has been murdered! Collect clues, solve puzzles, and deduce the killer. Follow a growing trail of crimes and unravel the conspiracy tying them all together.

details.title: Confined Space
details.short_description: Pilot a customizable spaceship, battle through procedurally generated arenas, and adapt your build with modular abilities to survive escalating enemy waves in this fast-paced 2D top-down roguelike shoot ’em up

details.title: Vocal Horror Stories - Gaja
details.short_description: The first episode of a voice-sensitive episodic horror game, in which you play as Shivani, a young woman battling with phonophobia. Why did her mother go missing? Who is the elephant-headed entity she keeps seeing? Can you speak to him?

details.title: Fishy Dish
details.short_description: Create and sell sushi in this roguelike inventory-management sushi-builder game. Collect fish, sauces, and tools, arrange them on a grid to trigger synergies, survive each round’s sales target, and build the ultimate sushi lineup.

details.title: General Chaos - MAJOR SNAFU
details.short_description: "Currently, GENERAL CHAOS - MAJOR SNAFU is considerably more than halfway to the finish line! This time around, its a sprite-based, multiplayer PC Game that uses an Xbox-style Game Controller &/or Keyboard & Mouse .

details.title: GENKAI SHURAKU
details.short_description: Rebuild a collapsed remote village in this crafting–farming–settlement game. Gather resources, cook, manage fields, survive raids, and run a small stall to restore the community.

details.title: Never Clean
details.short_description: Clear mountains of trash, sell the junk, and finish building an abandoned park! Take a break from work and have some fun, but remember: your boss is watching you from his window. Complete bizarre tasks, crack the code to the safe, and discover what your boss is really hiding.

details.title: Shadow Seeker
details.short_description: Shadow Seeker is a 2D survival-horror action game with a noir detective story. You are Carlos Ramirez, a detective from the Amorita Police Department. You must solve a mysterious case while braving the looming evil that awaits you at every turn.

details.title: Asteroid Hopper
details.short_description: Asteroid Hopper is a cute space adventure puzzle game set in a colorful cosmos. Hop between asteroids, explore, optimize your path, manage resources, and survive in the hazardous depths of space.

name: Black Sailors: Bay Of All Saints

details.title: Black Sailors: Bay Of All Saints
details.short_description: Command a fleet of formerly enslaved people who became pirates in Brazil’s Bay of All Saints. Challenge colonial oppression, fight for freedom, and rewrite Atlantic history in turn-based tactical naval battles.

details.title: Faryloopa
