details.short_description: Build the board. Play the cards. Roll the dice. Faryloopa is a roguelike deckbuilder meets boardbuilder where every run is a new layout, new synergies, and bigger scores to chase.

details.title: ALLARA
details.short_description: Allara is a 2D pixel-art Metroidvania soulslike set in pre-colonial East Siberia. Play as a shamanka defending her homeland, exploring mythic realms of the sacred world tree, battling brutal bosses, uncovering relics, and mastering a strategic single-skill combat system.

details.title: Mahfam: The Cursed Village
details.short_description: In 1970, eighteen children vanished overnight across eight Iranian villages. Two were later found near Mahfam Village. According to their accounts, Mahfam is no ordinary place but a terrifying site inhabited by supernatural beings. Photographer Farshid heads toward this village of horror.

details.title: Chug It 🍺
details.short_description: Grow it. Brew it. Chug it. Run a cozy fantasy tavern, farm your own ingredients, cook food and drinks by hand, and serve a wide cast of customers. Play solo or in 4-player co-op, and let golem helpers handle the chores.

details.title: Wrongbots
details.short_description: Annihilate robot hordes and survive in this roguelite shooter. Hack or smash productive machinery. Grab resources and craft cool items. Swap body parts with glamour or extravaganza. Modify your weapons to absurdity. See how clever AI has become?

details.title: Ammo Station Simulator
details.short_description: Manage your gun shop in Ammo Station. By day, sell and repair weapons. By night, team up with friends to rob warehouses and smuggle illegal arms. Rise from a respectable shopkeeper to the city's ultimate gun baron in this first-person simulation.

details.title: Dawnrazor
details.short_description: Step into the decaying world of Kagenovia in Dawnrazor, a story-driven 8-bit action adventure! Take control of Zedekiah, a betrayed knight reborn through parasitic vampirism, as he fights through blood-soaked ruins and biomechanical horrors.

details.title: The Backrooms : Lost Guest
details.short_description: The Backrooms : Lost Guest is a visually realistic, co-op survival horror exploration game developed with UE5, supporting 1 – 6 players. Evade terrifying creatures and deadly hazards while solving room-based puzzles to find your way out of the Backrooms. A chilling adventure awaits you…

details.title: 這個觸手…是我的…隊友！？
details.short_description: "Is This Tentacle… My Teammate?!" is an exploration RPG blending dark fantasy, alternative history, and character-driven narrative. Set in 17th-century in Kingdom of Lancaster . A young girl meets a mysterious tentacle monster, they embark on an extraordinary fantasy adventure together.

details.title: Down We Go
details.short_description: A roguelite horror descent across the dimensions under the whim of a supercomputer planet; you are a delver, tasked with exploring, researching, and cataloging what you can find.

details.title: DELUCID
details.short_description: An atmospheric horror game set within an inescapable dream. Trapped in a dark forest, you must explore, forage, and uncover rare ingredients to craft the one potion capable of waking you up.

details.title: Monster Meals: Big Bite Diner
details.short_description: Cook bizarre meals for hungry monsters using ingredients you gather while exploring. Upgrade your diner through a daily loop of exploring, cooking and serving. Play solo or with friends in full co-op.

details.title: Pirate Troops
details.short_description: Follow the journey of Sammy Shortlegs in this fun yet mysterious tale! Uncover the whereabouts of powerful pirate relics lost to time, and confront the terrifying Shadowbeard.

details.title: Primus Numen
details.short_description: A turn-based, grid-based, tactical RPG where you combine classes and join together to unleash an evolving Nexus Beast.

details.title: Revery Effect
details.short_description: Revery Effect is a 2D side-scrolling sandbox game. Players survive in a fantastical world and are free to destroy and build anything they can imagine.

details.title: Freedom Inside
details.short_description: You've found yourself in a madman's game. Solve his intricate puzzles and escape his nightmarish lair before you become his next victim. Every second counts.

details.title: Non Eternals
details.short_description: A single-player command action RPG with MMORPG-style combat. Features a quirky system where placing skill commands next to the UI boosts their power! Rescue the creators from the Dark Lord, who manifests their inner darkness as monsters!

details.title: SteamPanic: Last Shift
details.short_description: In this game, you'll take on the role of an engineer repairing machinery in a steampunk factory. You must keep an eye on the latest "marvels of technology"—they break down constantly, and the management isn't too happy about that.

details.title: Dick Shortson. The Detective.
details.short_description: Dick Shortson – The Detective. You've been hired by a woman to find her missing mother. Grab your gun and uncover the secrets hidden in another godforsaken village. Shoot, solve puzzles, and catch the vibe.

name: Blue Detective: A Hotel in Scarlet

details.title: Blue Detective: A Hotel in Scarlet
details.short_description: As a weird detective, you solve mysteries with your colorful sidekick. Everyone you meet in this bizarre world has a peculiar disease. A unique talent, or a mere curse? You must get to the bottom of it all. Investigate murders, search for clues and complete the puzzle.

details.title: Slot Machine Gun
details.short_description: A roguelike deckbuilder shooter where you wield an ever changing weapon : The Slot Machine Gun! Every reload spins up a fresh combo of guns and chaotic effects to create game breaking synergies.

details.title: Blood Builder
details.short_description: In this dark, yet cozy, world, you will collect resources, craft, and build to restore Dracula’s former home to its past glory. Attract juicy mortals to the inn, harvest their blood, and serve it to traveling vampires to regain your reputation within vampire society. Will you become a vampire lord?

details.title: Dreamer's Glade
details.short_description: Build up the town of your dreams! Uncover the secrets of the Dream World. Master new skills, befriend villagers, and trace the tracks of a forgotten civilization in this magical pixel-art life sim RPG.

details.title: Drone Wars: Season 1
details.short_description: After the mysterious collapse of the United States, corporate paramilitaries fight over crates of pornography and other valuable resources in war-torn territory, where physical media has become as rare as electricity.

details.title: DarkFactory
details.short_description: Work together and get your hands dirty! To meet the grueling quotas, you must resort to manufacturing illicit goods. Balance efficiency with risk, manage roles in real-time, and deal with inspectors by any means necessary. A frantic factory action game where "evil decisions" save the day.

details.title: Don’t Touch My Potato!
details.short_description: Grow your farm by day, build your defenses in the evening, and protect the Potatron from zombie and alien attacks at night.

details.title: Nonet Beat
details.short_description: NonetBeat is a TPS action game starring three charming heroines. Each with unique combat styles, they obliterate hordes of monsters with magic! Sandbox stages let you destroy terrain for dynamic battles. Collect magic and unleash dazzling combos in thrilling hack-and-slash action!

details.title: Lethargy
details.short_description: Lethargy: Wake up or sleep forever! With the RAV drone, explore, run, escape, or destroy terrifying enemies. In this third-person shooter! Is it a nightmare or reality? Discover the truth before the line between sleep and wakefulness blurs.

name: 汉末 - 谋时: Hanfall-Age of Stratagems

details.title: 汉末 - 谋时: Hanfall-Age of Stratagems
details.short_description: Enter the turbulent world of late Han China in a single-player historical strategy game. Ink-wash landscapes and paper-inspired visuals frame an age of rival powers, human ambition and uncertain futures. Discover your own chapter in a changing era.

details.title: Forest Whiskers
details.short_description: Rescue kittens, care for your growing cat family, and watch new generations inherit their parents' traits. Explore, craft, train your cats, and bring the forest back to life.

details.title: Super Space Crystals
details.short_description: Flow through a glowing field of musical crystals in this relaxing and immersive zen bullet hell. Shatter the crystals to collect their magic and upgrade your powers. Fend off enemy spacecraft, and save the galaxy from The Fraternal Brotherhood of Evil Magic Space Robots - or just enjoy the vibes!

details.title: Death Falls: Zombies Are Coming
details.short_description: Death Falls is a zombie tower defense game with you on the front line. By day, build towers and fences, scavenge weapons and recruit survivors. By night, fight beside your defenses as the horde closes in. Survive each stop, fix up your RV and drive on.

details.title: Little Mages 3D
details.short_description: Blast through undead hordes and build a devastating spell loadout in this retro first-person arena roguelite! Choose your mage, combine spells and perks, defeat bosses, and grow stronger between runs. Play solo or with up to 4 players in LAN co-op.

details.title: Community Kitchen Simulator: DayShift
details.short_description: Run a small community canteen. Buy food at the corner shop and carry it back, cook, serve people one plate at a time, wash up, and decide whether someone without a meal ticket gets fed. Then close for the night and do it again tomorrow.

details.title: Wadar and and: another dimension
details.short_description: Wadar and and is a 2d platformer where nothing is guaranteed

details.title: Mayonaka no Yaiba
details.short_description: After falling from the fourth floor of his school and losing nearly a year of memories, high school student Chenxing is caught between two conflicting romantic pasts. When a girl in white and the blade of light known as the Night Blade appear at 3 a.m., he must choose whose truth to face.

details.title: French Tax Simulator
details.short_description: Take on the role of a tax inspector and track down tax evaders! Your mission: to reduce the public deficit. Cross-check the supporting documents, uncover inconsistencies and decide who to audit. Your career in the civil service depends on it....

details.title: Between Us
details.short_description: You were just supposed to bring medicine home to your wife. Now you're trapped in a seemingly endless cornfield. In this first-person psychological horror, your only companion is your own voice in your head. Talk to your alter ego, step through portals into your dark past, and try to find a way out.

details.title: A Weird Village
details.short_description: Welcome to A Weird Village, a chaotic multiplayer game where little animals fight over territory, unlock ridiculous powers, destroy pretty much everything in sight, and eventually tear the enemy village to pieces. Pick your favorite little creature, grab a weapon, and join the mayhem.

details.title: Battle to Go
details.short_description: A short incremental auto-battler where you build and command a growing army of tiny pixel soldiers. Unlock new troops, research powerful upgrades, and push through increasingly dangerous goblin armies in automatic battles.

name: The Hearts of War Avert 2: Furies Vengeance

details.title: The Hearts of War Avert 2: Furies Vengeance
details.short_description: Command your armies and conquer her heart! A new student joins a gaming club where friendships, rivalries, and possible romance unfold between actual real-time strategy matches. Get to know Lillian, Rina and Yara in a story-driven visual novel where the game at the table is only part of the story.

details.title: Scrub, Little Sub!
details.short_description: Scrub, Little Sub! Boost, bounce, and barrel roll your way through diverse aquatic biomes and flooded industrial structures as you clean up the ocean in this 90's-inspired collectathon adventure!

details.title: Uprooted: Meal Replacement Game
details.short_description: Don’t play with your food, fight with it! Build up your farm with different equipment, tools, and abilities, then grow powerful crops to throw at your opponents. Stop an evil tech start-up from destroying your farm in this turn-based battling twist on the classic farming game formula.

details.title: Snap out.
details.short_description: A doomscrolling adventure. Scroll a feed that never ends, answer the five people who keep asking, and take the X in the corner before it erodes away. However long you stay decides how dark the platformer you escape into gets.

details.title: Rescue the Celestia
details.short_description: Command a deep space rescue operation in this space management game, where you manage a fleet of ships, build bases, coordinate resources distribution, and explore uncharted planets to find and save the scattered crew of the ISS Celestia.

details.title: The Feather King
details.short_description: A match-3 RPG comedy roguelike. Combine runes to trigger spells, arrange them strategically, then blast down your opponents with a barrage of arcane fury. Discover a cast of colorful characters as you navigate through the Feather King's realm in this farcical, story driven adventure.

details.title: Starmadillo
details.short_description: As an armadillo space archaeologist, you've crashed onto a mysterious planet. Luckily you're equipped with a Mobile Defense Unit (MDU) that can defend you from danger, but its capabilities were severely reduced by the impact. In true Metroidvania fashion, explore this alien world and find a way home

details.title: Bad Dubs
details.short_description: You’ve moved out on your own! Now you have to pay rent, buy food, and survive by taking on dubbing jobs. Accept absurd projects, make money, and improve your skills until you achieve your dream: starting your own dubbing company. Because dreams are free. Rent isn’t.

details.title: RUNGEON: Auto Roguelike
details.short_description: Fight through 100 dungeon rooms in this roguelite RPG with automatic turn-based combat. Choose upgrades after every victory, build your hero, defeat powerful bosses, and see how far you can survive.

details.title: Travellin Cats in Canada
details.short_description: Find many cats hidden across Canada in this cute hand-drawn hidden object game by Travellin Cats - the original viral hidden cat game creator! Can you find them all?

details.title: Tin Happens!
details.short_description: Tin Happens is a realistic squash game built by squash players. Master drives, crosscourts, drops and boasts, outplay challenging AI, compete locally or online, and experience the speed, tactics and pressure of the sport.

name: HOI! あっちむいてロケット

details.title: HOI! あっちむいてロケット
details.short_description: Lose at "look away" and you become the rocket. Once you're the rocket, crash into another player and pass it on. A party game for up to 4 players. Local, or online with friends.

details.title: Acorn Heist!
details.short_description: A rock-paper-scissors roguelike deckbuilder. See your opponent’s hand and read what they’ll throw next — a battle of wits, not luck. Build your deck, play after the reveal, force wins, and break the rules of rock-paper-scissors to steal acorns from the forest’s cute animal-eared girls.

details.title: Lab Loonies
details.short_description: Lab Loonies is a physics-based descent into madness where "logic" is a suggestion the developer ignored. In this 1-4 player lab experiment, the platforms are lying, the physics are "opinionated," and the Narrator is actively rooting for your demise. Make good choices, or don't. The Lab doesn't judge

details.title: Abyss Prowler
details.short_description: Abyss Prowler is an arcade inspired top-down arena shooter where you should always stay on the move to survive. Dash, reposition and strike. Demo is available.

details.title: Soundscapes
details.short_description: Soundscapes is an interactive music sandbox where your songs shape the world around you.

details.title: RiffHammer
details.short_description: RiffHammer is a rhythm-driven hack-and-slash where you annihilate enemies to crushing metal beats. Wield genre-infused weapons, rage through procedurally generated dungeons or handcrafted scenarios—and import your own music if metal isn’t your thing.

details.title: Alien Colony
details.short_description: Lead a squad of four cloned marines through an infected mining colony where every death creates a new soldier, but slowly destroys what remains of your humanity.

details.title: Auto Arcana
details.short_description: Devise the ultimate spell rotation and watch it obliterate your foes in this roguelike auto-battler. Seek forbidden knowledge to craft overpowered spells, assemble devastating combos, and break the game.

details.title: Aelwater
details.short_description: Memory has weight. The departed are not gone. Step into a village drowned by flood and memory, and search for the final answer about guardianship and farewell among the shattered past.

details.title: Colors of Memory
details.short_description: A cozy adventure across two realities — a mysterious world of memories and the land of the living, where every choice matters. Wander the edge of forgetting, uncover lost stories, and find your own path — one that might change everything and paint the world in a whole new light.

name: The Xu Jing Chronicle: Illusory Dream

details.title: The Xu Jing Chronicle: Illusory Dream
details.short_description: “The Xu Jing Chronicle: Illusory Dream” is a choice-driven visual novel. Some old peculiar research notes, inadvertently unlocked a gateway through time and space. What is illusion? What is reality? Make your choice and unlock exclusive endings. But there is only one truth!

details.title: Proto Trigger
details.short_description: An arcade shoot'em up with unique power-infusion gameplay. Face down an unknown army alone or with a friend in online or local co-op. Navigate the cosmos to save the remants of humanity, or join them in extinction!

details.title: When Voices Died
details.short_description: When Voices Died is a game of puzzles and silent emotions. Amid distant echoes and broken memories, you rebuild paths that reveal forgotten feelings — and the weight of choices that still echo.

details.title: Architect Fray
details.short_description: A dramatic Deckbuilding RPG featuring artwork by Satoshi Matsuura. Carry only a few cards into the dungeon. Master preparation, time your Parries, and dive into a story where every skill holds a memory. A massive scenario awaits in this fusion of strategy and narrative.

details.title: NORMA: Story of One Platform
details.short_description: Explore the secrets of this world and discover what the local government, working alongside powerful corporations, has planned in its pursuit of complete control over the population.

details.title: The Archaeologists
details.short_description: The Archaeologists is a single-player settlement builder. Establish multiple settlements through manufacturing and trade. Raise great structures across the mountain to link them into one interconnected economy. Dig into the rock to unearth valuable artifacts and uncover a forgotten past.

details.title: C6: Frontlines
details.short_description: C6: Frontlines is a bullet hell co-op roguelike where only YOU (and your friends) can bring the Azapall galaxy to peace. Wield 30+ weapons and gadgets of mass destruction to even the playing field, wave after wave, against a seemingly endless onslaught of evil!

details.title: Trial By Magic
details.short_description: All spell casters must one day prove their skill in the TRIAL BY MAGIC Those who overcome this deckbuilding challenge are forever known as Wizards, a title carried with pride. Those who fail are branded Wimps, forever shamed. So the question to you, spell caster, is: ARE YOU A WIZARD OR A WIMP?

details.title: ShrednSpread
details.short_description: A mysterious egg crashes to Earth. Out pops a tiny Kaiju — hungry, googly-eyed, and impossible to please. What do you do? Easy: order snacks, shred them, and spray-feed the little monster until it grows... and grows... and grows.

details.title: Motorsport Park Manager
details.short_description: Build and customize your own motorsports park in this classic tycoon simulation. Start with local go-kart tracks and grassroots circuits, and grow into a world-renowned racing destination.

details.title: ARO: Tales In The Dome
details.short_description: "ARO: Tales in the Dome" is a 2D hand-drawn action-adventure game. Play as Aro and explore an elemental world sealed beneath the dome. As the journey unfolds, uncover the hidden conspiracy and face the truth about the world, the dome, and yourself.

details.title: Is This Farming?
details.short_description: A co-op first-person farming game where your crops fight back. Till, plant and water, then grab your hoe when the harvest wakes up swinging. Ship what you beat, craft turrets and bombs, and take down Guardians with up to three friends, or on your own.

details.title: Pray To The Darkness
details.short_description: Tread the path to redemption or cling to your past. Shape destinies or submit to strangers. New society. New secrets. New path. Pray To The Darkness is a narrative psychological horror exploring the complexity of human fate and the world around us.

details.title: Frex: Ambivalence
details.short_description: A high-speed action game blending fluid movement and stylish sword combat, as you push through intense stages and confront enemies shaped by a broken world.

details.title: Miracle Revolution
details.short_description: A fantastical Bullet Hell game where you absorb and control enemy bullets to create your own firepower! Manipulate food-infused bullets to break through any formation, and use the power of Eggs to overthrow the wicked food goddesses!

details.title: Pet.Net
details.short_description: Hatch and raise your very own PET, evolve them, train their stats, compete in competitions AND MUCH MORE! Designed for either active or passive play, sitting in the corner of your screen while you work on other things.

details.title: Bit Crusher
details.short_description: Roam an open world in your pickup truck, smash stuff into bits, then trade them in for better upgrades, vehicles, and new zones. Explore the island, discover hidden paths and carve your own adventure across the world!

details.title: Sushi Go Party!
details.short_description: Order up! Grab delicious sushi dishes and collect winning combinations in the award-winning board game, Sushi Go Party! With colourful characters, simple rules and plenty of tasty tactical twists, Sushi Go Party! serves up culinary competition for newcomers and seasoned strategists alike!

details.title: Cardaver
details.short_description: Cardaver is a tower defense, deckbuilder, with roguelike looping gameplay. Using a wide variety of monsters and spells to defend each lane, help the Dragon Queen protect her Castle Kingdom against an army of fantasy do-gooders and tyrannical princesses.

details.title: Idle Chibi Knight
details.short_description: Chibi Knight returns in an idle dungeon crawler! Fighting and exploration happen automatically while you cast spells, acquire loot, unlock new skills, level up your attributes, and push deeper. Replay as multiple classes in this casual, incremental RPG.

details.title: Caribbean Tide
details.short_description: Sail the 17th-century Caribbean as John Nelson. Smuggle or trade, upgrade your ship, manage your crew and colony, and uncover buried truths across 10+ ports, 50+ branching quests, and a vast open world shaped by shifting alliances and moral choices.

details.title: Ragga-Dagga
details.short_description: An Action Roguelite where Aggressive Play is Rewarded Handsomely! Explore a Non-Euclidean Dungeon filled with hidden mysteries in this oh so cute adventure about a catling and his sentient floating sword!

details.title: Petty Kings
details.short_description: A pixel art Survival RTS where you rebuild a fallen kingdom by day, defend against brutal night raids, and march out to crush enemy outposts. Take back your crown!

details.title: Soulscape2 Fragments of The Present
details.short_description: Dive into a dark cyber noir conspiracy in this solo developed, story rich CRPG. Set in a dystopian near future, guide Blake Turner and his squad through isometric exploration, deeply strategic turn-based combat, branching dialogue, and infinite post game progression.

name: Super Carpark Walking Parking Simulator Turbo

details.title: Super Carpark Walking Parking Simulator Turbo
details.short_description: Super Carpark Walking Parking Simulator Turbo is the definitive animated carpark chaotic parking simulator!!! Park cars before its too late!

details.title: Haunted Room! Urami-chan
details.short_description: In this "life-intervention watching game," you control the earthbound spirit "Urami-chan." Travel between an apartment's past and present to change the murdered resident's future. The game unfolds in semi-real time, tasking you to watch over the resident and intervene.

details.title: Furry Defenders​​
details.short_description: In Furry Defenders, where the Demon Clan covets the Dragon Veins and incites war among all races, you will play as Cynton, the Dragon Bloodline Warrior. Rally your allies and set masterful traps at crucial passes to outsmart the looming threat of the Demon Army.

details.title: Ismene
details.short_description: The story of Ismene, floating through space with her trusted robot companion, trying to figure out where she is going, and where she came from.

details.title: Taishō Romance Theater
details.short_description: A romance-suspense visual novel set in Taishō Japan. Amnesiac actor Kotori Sakuma grapples with a dear friend's bizarre death, the awakening of his magic, and the blood ties that haunt him. As the truth unravels, shape Kotori's final choice: return to his bloodline's embrace, or pursue true freedom?

details.title: 🎧 Yellowcake - The Audio Game 🎧
details.short_description: A first-person audio game, telling the tale of a blind yet gifted hero. Make your way through a 3D environment without receiving any visual cues. Put all your faith in your ears and help our hero in his quest to uncover the sinister secrets of these twisty uranium mines, which he calls his home.

details.title: THREAT VECTOR
details.short_description: Battle across the solar system as annihilation looms over mankind in this action sci-fi horror FPS. Powered by id Tech, THREAT VECTOR delivers classic FPS combat throughout a suite of concise, potent levels infested with deadly horrors… and loaded with enough firepower to destroy them all.

details.title: Gretel's Honesty
details.short_description: A comic-like visual novel, expressing a new story based on the fairy tale “Hansel and Gretel”.

details.title: Dignaut
details.short_description: Take on a peaceful mining mission that leads to something far more mysterious. Dig, upgrade your tools, and slowly awaken an ancient alien temple buried beneath the surface, bringing its forgotten music and light back to life.

name: 恋爱泡馍！青春老陕：Shannxi Love Story

details.title: 恋爱泡馍！青春老陕：Shannxi Love Story
details.short_description: Shannxi Love Story is a visual novel-style game set against the backdrop of university life in Shaanxi, infused with local cultural flavors. Discover Chinese culture through a brand-new lens, explore the youthful spirit of Xi'an, and discover the myriad possibilities life has to offer.

details.title: In Another World
details.short_description: In this Isekai Anime RPG. Enjoy a more realistic skills system. Bring a race to extinction. Or live the quiet life farming in a pocket dimension. Fast paced real-time combat. Mostly medieval ecstatic. Hope you enjoy and find all and more of what you are looking for in another world.

details.title: Rage of the Elder Gods
details.short_description: Rage of the Elder Gods is a turn-based tactical game blending board game mechanics with RPG elements. Hunt down fanatical cults across the mythical locations of H.P. Lovecraft’s universe. Face cosmic horror and survive the madness!

details.title: Appa
details.short_description: Appa is a surreal narrative-driven card battler about two siblings dealing with the death of their father. Predict, counter, and outmaneuver manifestations of grief while uncovering a heartfelt story somewhere between dreams and reality.

details.title: Blade of Mercy: Bloody Countess
details.short_description: Blade of Mercy: Bloody Countess is a 2D action with metroidvania elements set in a 16th-century fantasy world, drawn with cozy pixels. Explore a mysterious realm, battle ruthless enemies, and uncover powerful weapons and abilities. And remember: beer is the best medicine in these grim times!

name: Stellar Freight: Echoes of the Void

details.title: Stellar Freight: Echoes of the Void
details.short_description: Take command of a freight ship traveling through deep space. Every jump brings danger, every decision matters. Manage your crew, upgrade your ship, trade, fight, and survive in a hostile galaxy where resources are scarce and every day could be your last.

details.title: Grimmdustry
details.short_description: Grimmdustry is an automation game with adventure and RPG elements. After finding yourself stranded in a medieval world full of fantasy tropes, use your knowledge of modern technology to find a way home, or use it to make this new world your own!

details.title: UrbexCAM
details.short_description: Horror based Urban Exploration Game

details.title: Coasteroid
details.short_description: Build stellar rollercoasters across alien worlds, carve tunnels through planets, and launch trains into orbit. Customize every track element, scenery decoration, and environment before subjecting riders to the forces of the universe! The galaxy is your theme park!

details.title: Lingering Soup
details.short_description: Lingering Soup is a deckbuilding and management roguelite. Unwilling to be reborn, you run a spicy hot pot stall for Meng Po, serving souls one last meal. Combine cooking cards and relics to help them let go of the past. Can you do the same?

details.title: Mimi's Restaurant Helper
details.short_description: Put on your chef's hat and make food, clean the dishes, take orders and more in Mimi's Restaurant Helper. Become a chef and serve beautiful, hand drawn dishes!

details.title: Cold Steel
details.short_description: A classic RTS with a major twist. Your units are fully autonomous drones. Every unit runs code which you design using an intuitive visual coding interface. Automate everything from mining, to combat, even unit production.

details.title: Path of the RNGesus
details.short_description: Play as literal reincarnations of the RNGesus in this curated rollathon experience. Hoard items and perks, manipulate RNG and optimize synergies to vanquish the unholy, non-deterministic chaos that plagues the land.

name: Journey To The Center Of The Lost Waterpark

details.title: Journey To The Center Of The Lost Waterpark
details.short_description: In this first and third-person experience you visit a waterpark unlike any others you have seen before. Your adventure leads you through eerie and beautiful surroundings with puzzles and obstacles while you uncover the secrets of The Lost Waterpark, driven by a Lovecraftian Story.

details.title: Gothic Scythe
details.short_description: 敵の猛攻を掻い潜り、撃破していく高難易度アクション。大鎌使いとなりホムンクルスに支配された街を取り戻しましょう。

details.title: Radiant Sky
details.short_description: You and a group of adventurers must travel the world and unite the factions of weather spirits to stop constant natural disasters and stop an inevitable world ending catastrophe once the sky turns "radiant".

details.title: NCH: Chronos Rebirth
details.short_description: A sci-fi narrative visual novel focused on historical intervention, espionage, mind games, and tactical choices. You are a life scientist from the future, sent back to the eve of the Great Cataclysm. How will you rewrite the past to change a divided future?

details.title: Brickstrike
details.short_description: Brickstrike is an online multiplayer first-person shooter set in a fully destructible and buildable voxel battlefield. Team up to dominate in a variety of competitive game modes. Featuring a variety of official and player-created maps. Enlist today!

details.title: Star Squadron
details.short_description: Star Squadron is a narrative-driven space combat simulator built for maximum immersion. Command your wing with freeform voice recognition and experience a dynamic campaign that calls you by name using our proprietary Voice Mimic System. Don't just play the game—live it.

name: Krodha: A Tale of Vikram & Betaal

details.title: Krodha: A Tale of Vikram & Betaal
details.short_description: Krodha is a Dice + Deck + Slot-building roguelike rooted in the Indian legend of Vikram and Betaal. Draft your deck, slot cards into a board, roll the dice and piece together a mystery told by three "very" unreliable narrators.

details.title: Cards of the Abyss
details.short_description: Cards of the Abyss is a roguelike deckbuilder where movement is your only defense. Move on a grid, dodge enemy attacks, trigger countless chain-reactions and unleash overpowered card combos as you dive deeper into the Abyss.

details.title: Battles of Chaos
details.short_description: Battles of Chaos is a medieval fantasy real time strategy and tactics hybrid game, blending the best elements of the two genres. Play great, realistic open-field battles or sieges in single-player, cooperative or PvP mode, where the emphasis is on combat, with base building elements.

details.title: Those Far Stars
details.short_description: Discover a vast, procedural galaxy as a lone pilot. Trade, fight and explore alien worlds with turn-based encounters. Upgrade your ship, gather relics, and uncover secrets lost to time and space.

details.title: Nova Assault
details.short_description: Step into Nova Assault, the first-person extraction shooter that blends immersive realism with strategic depth: extract valuable resources, survive high-risk missions, and amass wealth through a dynamic in-game economy and advanced progression system.

details.title: Mirria
details.short_description: An atmospheric casual puzzle game where players navigate a strange cryptic world that blurs the line between dream and reality. Using inspection and memory, uncover hidden anomalies between mirrored worlds.

details.title: Gladiators of Roma Revixit
details.short_description: Gladiators of Roma Revixit is a unique, story-driven roguelike, set in world in which, after the nuclear fallout, a new Rome and thus a new colosseum rises from the radioactive-ashes. Rise the ranks, enjoy the celebrity of being a Gladiator, and make decisions that impact the story.

details.title: ORMS
details.short_description: An atmospheric narrative puzzle-adventure set on a surreal Nordic island. Guide young Sam and his companion Kira through two shifting realities - switching between a world of terrifying shadows and a world of light to solve puzzles and reignite the broken lighthouse

details.title: Hadvoron: The Godhunters
details.short_description: Find the way through the Shattered Cities while slaying numerous enemies and looting infinitely stacking items, in this Roguelike combining fast paced third person combat system and exploration. Playable Singleplayer or up to 4 players.

details.title: STAR FISH
details.short_description: Cast your line from your cozy asteroid home and reel in Space Fish, each with their own unique feel! Sell catches, upgrade gear, and tackle legendary fish with unique challenges when reeling them in. Customize your asteroid home! Because nothing says “Gone Space Fishin” like a well-furnished rock.

details.title: Hunger Lane
details.short_description: A story-driven horror platformer about a boy uncovering the secrets of a quiet city where monsters hunt humans after dark. Will you discover what lies behind the disappearances before it finds you?

details.title: Neon Dystopia
details.short_description: Raid the underbelly of Neon Dystopia with your crew. Grab all the loot and extract! Or die and lose it all... A co-op synthwave/cyberpunk extraction roguelike.

name: Kamiya Detective Agency: High School Girl Vanished in The Summer

details.title: Kamiya Detective Agency: High School Girl Vanished in The Summer
details.short_description: A mystery set in Fukuoka, Japan. Former cop Kengo Kamiya and assistant Hikaru tackle a high school girl's disappearance. A "Photoreal Novel" fully utilizing actual photos and AI. Enjoy snappy banter and unexpected twists in this simple, choice-driven mystery visual novel.

details.title: BaeSplit: Chaos Down Under
details.short_description: A turn-based RPG featuring Hakos Baelz and her friends from hololive! Discover a re-imagining of the Outback as you join Bae on a quest to save her homeland and herself.

details.title: Cafe Connect
details.short_description: Repair, upgrade, and build PCs for your first customers to pave your way to self-employment. Open your own internet café, build custom gaming PCs, and expand your shop step by step. Your success starts with a screwdriver.

details.title: Operation Paranoia
details.short_description: Operation Paranoia is a psychological survival horror in which you browse the dark corners of the deep web, uncover conspiracy theories, and hide from relentless killers. Manage your food and medicine supplies, run your vlog channel, and survive another day.

details.title: HOMUNCULCHU
details.short_description: Guide fragile homunculi with limited lifespans through humanity's final bid for survival across six hostile worlds.

details.title: Iron Dogs
details.short_description: In Iron Dogs, take the helm of 1940's inspired aircraft in a colorful retro-inspired arcade flight-sim where you will blast hordes of enemy aircraft, naval vessels and more! Engage in dogfights (literally) with hostile aircraft, while flying through beautifully hand-crafted environments.

details.title: Sprig
details.short_description: Sprig is a cozy 3D exploration game about discovering real-world animals, solving gentle environmental puzzles, and filling your nature journal as a curious rabbit. Explore peaceful, no-stress levels at your own pace in a short, wholesome adventure with a clear ending.

details.title: DAMNED
details.short_description: DAMNED is a nerve-wracking survival/management experience where you are the only one who can keep a colossal dam from collapsing.

details.title: Rebel Talos
details.short_description: Pilot your TALOS mech to defend humanity’s last bastion in this high-speed action roguelite. Craft overpowered builds, crush the Automata Empire, and expand your arsenal every run.

details.title: Orbital Code: 2044
details.short_description: Become a top secret agent in VR and embark on a continent-spanning stealth action adventure. After Corp One's plan to seize New York City by force is leaked, a covert international taskforce of former special operations members sends you to infiltrate the megacorp's heavily guarded downtown HQ.

details.title: Trouble in Our Skies
details.short_description: A retro PS1-style action game set in a lo-fi cyberpunk metropolis, where fast-paced movement meets chaotic clean-up-and-combat gameplay. You are Lammy, a dormant caregiver bot revived to save a sky city from total collapse.

details.title: Normandie
details.short_description: Normandie is a narrative ocean crawler set in the wake of World War II. Suit up as Charlie, a rookie salvage diver aboard the Shomesh. Work with your crew to explore the wrecks of the legendary ocean liners that once ruled the Atlantic.

details.title: Nodebreak
details.short_description: Nodebreak is a fast-paced, kinetic precision puzzle game, where you launch from node to node at breakneck speeds in an interconnected branching node network. It is an easy to understand, but hard to master test of reflexes and spatial awareness!

details.title: Tenancy
details.short_description: Tenancy is a roguelike deckbuilder about managing the costs, risks, and unique effects of angry little ladies so you can live off their paychecks. While tenants may be lackluster on their own, when played together they can be extorted for maximum value!

details.title: Apocalypse Jumpers
details.short_description: Welcome to the end of world(s)! Jump from one apocalypse to the next, upgrading your abilities to defeat the hordes that threaten the fabric of the universe.

details.title: Sutra Pilgrim
details.short_description: Sutra Pilgrim is a 2D Metroidvania inspired by Journey to the West. Awaken from an ancient seal as a monkey demon and seek the Sutra Pilgrim. Transform to explore hidden paths, collect artifacts and legendary weapons, meet allies, and face Yaoguai Kings to uncover the secrets of the journey west.

details.title: Pitchfork Perfect
details.short_description: Jam to the tunes of Pitchfork Perfect - a Bullet Heaven Rogue-like Rhythm game. Press, tap and hold to the beat to cast spells and abilities to fight off swarms of heavenly forces led by oppressive bosses! Will you face the music? Or will you stay silent?

details.title: Remake17
details.short_description: Remake17 is a galgame. You play as student Liang Yu, who travels back to high school ten years ago after an accident. Amid memory and reality, you'll find overlooked traces and the fates of three girls. Facing reality and illusion, regret and dreams, what will you choose?

details.title: 魏识的夜晚
details.short_description: Wei Shi becomes your reflection in your senior year. Drifting without a fixed self, they set out into oblivion—or piece together fragments of an unfamiliar youth. With your friends, they tend each other's restless hearts and share what it takes to find happiness.

name: Redacted by the Sadistic Princess from Another World?!

details.title: Redacted by the Sadistic Princess from Another World?!
details.short_description: Socially awkward game developer Yaemori Nowa receives more than she bargains for when two characters she created for her indie smash hit eroge, Utter Obedience: Conquered by the Sadistic Princess, appear in her apartment. What's a hopeless lesbian to do?!

details.title: Culling Daisies
details.short_description: A dark yuri visual novel about a girl so terrified of being alone she will stop at nothing to ensure her loved ones can never leave her.

details.title: Impossible Machine
details.short_description: My uncle invented a machine capable of changing the world... and then disappeared. Impossible Machine is a 2.5D point-and-click adventure where you explore, talk to characters, and build solutions as you try to unravel a mystery. No minigames. Lots of terrible jokes. What could possibly go wrong?

details.title: Null Signal
details.short_description: The machines won. You wake in a forsaken world where you must scavenge, build and explore to survive on your own or with friends. As nature encroaches due to humanity's absence, will you ally with it or use the technology that destroyed us to empower yourself?

details.title: Survival Exorcist
details.short_description: Survival Exorcist: A solo dev medieval survival horror with 2000s visuals. Board the sacred train and deliver it to the castle to purify ravaged plague lands. Hunt corrupted beasts with your crossbow or use dagger in stealth across diverse environments in this atmospheric experience.

details.title: Might of Fate
details.short_description: A classic JRPG-style game about the conflict between magic and humanity in a medieval world. Experience Fate's story from his carefree childhood to becoming a powerful warrior. Assemble a party and master the combat stance system to change the fate of the world.

details.title: Supernova Deliveries
details.short_description: Haul cargo across a rusty asteroid belt in a duct-taped space truck. Your trailer swings with real zero-g physics, how you pack it moves your centre of mass, pirates want your load and Vito the loan shark wants his money. Don't forget to HONK.

details.title: Drained Creatures
details.short_description: Drained Creatures is a multiplayer 3D arena brawler for up to 8 players locally, playable using gamepads only.

details.title: Self-Replication /// Destruction
details.short_description: A third-person shooter set in a crumbling megastructure. Fight drones, explore its sectors, and survive in a system that has spiraled out of control.

name: Mana and Merlin: A Wanderful Adventure

details.title: Mana and Merlin: A Wanderful Adventure
details.short_description: Mana & Merlin: A Wanderful Adventure is a 3D open-world platformer filled with fun and exploration, inspired by classics like Banjo-Kazooie. Join Mana on a journey to learn magical abilities and help restore her master to his rightful body.

details.title: Chimaera Evolution
details.short_description: Pixel art monster-capture RPG with tactical turn-based combat. Track elusive Shiny Chimaeras, cross-breed perfect genes through egg breeding, and craft survival gear to conquer a vast world. Master evolution and build the ultimate squad.

details.title: Digital Civilization: Evolution
details.short_description: Build your own empire! Evolve from a primitive civilization and rise to become the strongest and greatest empire of all! Manage resources, construct buildings, and engage in diplomacy with other nations, as you grow your civilization step by step into an unstoppable powerhouse.

details.title: Beast Survivor 3D
details.short_description: Battle thousands of monsters in this 3D action-survival game. Harness elemental resonance to unleash magic, from ground spikes to celestial meteors. Adapt your evolution mid-combat, using rapid skill combos and domain buffs to reign as the apex predator of this savage world.

details.title: Annexation
details.short_description: Annexation is a fast-paced real-time strategy game with old-school roots. Build bases, train armies, and outmaneuver your enemy to claim victory. Start by playing the campaign and then challenge yourself in Arcade Missions, which bring the intensity of multiplayer RTS into a single-player setting.

details.title: Oneiron Expanse
details.short_description: Your world is abruptly erased. Only the Oneiron Expanse remains; a Plane where your mental state evokes lethal potential. Embark on a deckbuilding odyssey where every card is a fragment of your will. Find the Dreamwright and dream your reality back into being... before your memories fade

details.title: Clickomorph
details.short_description: Hover over enemies to kill them... Until you choose an ability! Each new ability offers a new playstyle! Build a small auto clicker army, shoot your enemies as an archer, summon a Soul Reaper to assist you or even play a mini rhythm game! And more!

details.title: 请在正确答案处咬下
details.short_description: When obedient top student Fang Zhu discovers her childhood friend Jiang Xiangyi is secretly a werewolf, she risks her own academic standing to protect him from their suffocating school environment, toxic classmates, and an unfeeling teacher.

details.title: The Creature Mafia
details.short_description: A 1920s Prohibition-era action RPG where you capture creatures to take on the mob! Set in 1926 Kansas City, The Creature Mafia mixes a realistic world with cartoonish creature combat. Your creatures’ lives are in your hands - can you prevail against the full might of the mob?

details.title: You Are Family
details.short_description: You’re looking to disconnect in a secluded country house. A family welcomes you in. Soon, you’ll discover that feeling at home here… may be more real than you imagine.

details.title: SINEK
details.short_description: Sinek is a dark, cinematic adventure game set in a post-apocalyptic bunker, where you guide a swarm of flies to explore a world filled with silent stories of human resilience.

details.title: Skymote
details.short_description: A tower defence deckbuilder with roguelike elements. Build a deck, raise towers, cast spells, and discover unexpected synergies to turn your floating island into a fortress the sky can't break.

details.title: Vertical Momentum Revival
details.short_description: Engage in fast paced vertical PVP combat. Jump straight into the action on the rooftops, or flank your enemy through the alleyways below. Choose from a variety of movement abilities to compliment your playstyle. Play any existing maps, or create your own!

details.title: Renegade Run
details.short_description: Renegade Run is an immersive deckbuilder that puts you in the pilot seat of an experimental starship. Discover anomalies, carve your path, and face powerful enemies as you battle your way back to Sector 0.

name: Co-Ed Casualty: A Chandler Chase Case

details.title: Co-Ed Casualty: A Chandler Chase Case
details.short_description: Spring break at Briarwood College turns lethal when a student is found dead on campus. Journalism major Chandler Chase finds himself caught in a murder investigation he never asked to be part of. Interrogate suspects, solve puzzles, and unravel a conspiracy someone is desperate to keep hidden.

details.title: Doctor Kairokos
details.short_description: Play as scientist Doctor Kairokos, use a time machine remote controller and find your missing assistant in this 3D adventure game.

details.title: The HOUSE
details.short_description: Inspired by Balatro and Vampire Survivors. In every casino game, the house always wins. In The HOUSE, you are the casino. A NY mob family runs the most crooked casino in Vegas — and you're their engineer. Rig the machines, break the odds, and launder a fortune one gloriously broken payout at a time.

details.title: Haunted Uni Love
details.short_description: Romance × Mystery × Ghost Story The heroine, who has just stepped into university life, never imagined she would soon find herself in a bizarre yet sweet campus life. With a series of haunting events happening, the heroine holds the key to solving everything.

details.title: Yani Again
details.short_description: Yani Again is a high-speed action game. Shift between reality and cyberspace, explore dangerous tracks hidden across the world, and overcome every challenge at extreme speed.

details.title: 薪世录
details.short_description: Xin Shi Lu is a thrilling action-adventure RPG. Meet Fan Xin and start a new life. Explore a mysterious world, grow stronger in combat, and forge bonds with companions. Expand your influence and define your own legendary story.

details.title: Money Trees
details.short_description: Punch trees, deposit coins, and buy upgrades until you're harvesting millions from this fortuitous world. But how much can you earn before your time is up...?

details.title: Clickerite
details.short_description: Clickerite is an incremental mining game where you must collect materials, craft powerful tools, and battle evil monsters in a cube-dimensional world!

details.title: Every Wednesday
details.short_description: A laundromat. Every Wednesday. And stories that stay. Join Hideki in a small laundromat in the heart of a restless metropolis, where smartphones are not allowed and strangers slowly become part of each other’s lives.

details.title: Beyond: Fire & Ice
details.short_description: A mythological action RPG where Fire and Ice collide. Play as Shangdi, the Emperor of Flames, and Skadi, the Ice Queen, as they battle through the war-torn world of Athos to uncover the dark force manipulating their kingdoms.

details.title: End of Eden
details.short_description: End of Eden is an open world RPG where you arrive unwanted on a cursed island and must earn every inch. Master tight melee, archery and magic. Join a faction, grow deep talents, craft gear, and explore a living world with real routines, tough bosses and meaningful quests.

details.title: Haamupeli: Wrath of the Iku-Turso
details.short_description: Haamupeli: Wrath of the Iku-Turso is a fantasy-themed action RPG adventure game about vanquishing an ancient threat. Recruit allies, find powerful items, develop your character and interact with the game world and its inhabitants to archieve your goals.

details.title: Crystalia
details.short_description: Crystalia is a first-person tower defense game mixing automation, management and exploration set in a utopian sci-fi world built on crystal extraction. Dig into caves, build autonomous defense zones and uncover the history of a civilization shaped around crystals.

details.title: Sato
details.short_description: Manipulate space and time in this planetary puzzle-platformer. Learn the rules to unravel more of the world and the secrets within. Do you remember? 183 15.

details.title: Bulbo's Belief System
details.short_description: Bulbo's Belief System is a puzzle-platformer where knowledge is both a tool and an obstacle. Bulbo believes everything he's told, letting him see, move, and interact, but he can forget! Erase walls from existence, ignore gravity and manage conflicting beliefs to solve cute mind-bending challenges.

details.title: Heretic Red
details.short_description: In this story-rich detective game, uncover clues through a card-like system to solve a series of bizarre murders. Combine pieces of evidence to build your case against the most likely culprit from within an eclectic cast of unusual characters.

details.title: Ethereal: Clash of Souls
details.short_description: Ethereal is a 6v6 third-person MOBA featuring a first-of-its-kind class system and extreme vertical lane design. Fly, climb, teleport, and destroy as you push lanes to defeat the enemy Elder. Play Early Access for exclusive skins, premium currency, monthly patches, and direct dev feedback.

details.title: WILDERLOCKE
details.short_description: WILDERLOCKE is a tactical monster-taming roguelike. Build up a team of diverse & powerful monsters. Find the perfect combinations of moves, passives & stats to create devastating synergies. Triumph in increasingly challenging 2v2 turn-based battles and become unstoppable.

name: PLEASE KNOCK: The Sloppy Researcher's Life

details.title: PLEASE KNOCK: The Sloppy Researcher's Life
details.short_description: PLEASE KNOCK: The Sloppy Researcher’s Life is a top-down story adventure game about an unusual research life between a sloppy senior student and a helpful junior.

details.title: We'll Always Have Callisto
details.short_description: Your senior class trip to Callisto has been doomed by time anomalies and untold apocalypse. Rewind the week, save your classmates, and fight back with real-time combat powered by collectible Galactic Baseball League cards. A pixel RPG about what it means to be a hero at the end of the world.

details.title: Abhay
details.short_description: A first-person, story-driven psychological horror game. Play as Abhay, a teenage boy searching for his missing sister in a cursed village. Face possessed villagers, uncover a sinister cult, and survive as his past and present spiral into darkness.

details.title: Resolute Bay
details.short_description: Forelegs are better than two as you journey across mountains, thickets and plains in search of your lost herd. Master Fight, Flight and Freeze responses to fend off foes in snappy, turn-based battles of wits, then take in the scenery and have a good roll before trotting on.

details.title: Crimson Tale
details.short_description: Crimson Tale is a short first-person narrative puzzle game where Elizabeth uses blood magic and vampire powers to defy the oppressive nobility. Avoid sunlight, travel through time, and hunt the Golden Guard to end their reign.

details.title: Memoridian
details.short_description: Special knights and explorers that study and fight against the dangerous creatures called Memories. These are dangerous creatures that one day started showing up one by one. Uncover the truth about their origin while protecting your town.

details.title: Starcatcher
details.short_description: Wish upon the starry sky for the power to slay your enemies in this hack 'n' slash action roguelite.

details.title: Road To School
details.short_description: Road to School is a physics-based parkour platformer where you ride a bicycle up a treacherous mountain. Jump, balance, and explore hidden paths while tackling brutal challenges on your journey to school. Play alone or with friends in a co-op experience.

details.title: Cereal Reaper
details.short_description: Cereal Reaper is a top-down turn-based RPG with a heavy focus on exploration. Talk and fight your way into finding the greatest breakfast item of all time.

details.title: Puzzle Mage
details.short_description: Puzzle Mage is a top-down game where you replace traditional ARPG combat with spellcasting puzzles.

details.title: Gata Guressi
details.short_description: Learn to communicate with the people of Hierre by speaking their languages and understanding their cultures in this sci-fi translation game. Use your translation skills to navigate Kallay Tirridor, uncovering its dark secrets while solving the sudden disappearance of your brother.

details.title: ToMyX
details.short_description: Inspired by its creator's love life, face his ex-girlfriends in a blend of arcade action, puzzles and Visual Novel. Survive a surreal TV show where memories become battles and feelings become gameplay. It all really happened... more or less.

details.title: Celestial Crusader
details.short_description: Strategic isometric roguelike in waves. Position mobile defense units, combine elemental powers, and use cards to protect the portal. Fight, die, and evolve!

details.title: William 2
details.short_description: Explore a connected world of villages, snowy mountains and underwater passages in William 2, a 2D action-platformer. Complete quests, battle enemies, collect treasures and unlock new paths as you face bosses inspired by the Seven Deadly Sins.

details.title: ProtoPunk
details.short_description: ProtoPunk is a fast-paced, steampunk movement FPS. Gun down clunkers with your revolver to gain speed. Slow the gears of time to sharpen your aim. Slide and boost through the city to uncover your past and stop the corruption choking it.

details.title: Patchland
details.short_description: Patchland is a relaxing strategy game where you create your own world by building it from scratch using tiles. Connect various biomes, earn points, complete quests, and add animals to the map to create increasingly larger and more beautiful landscapes.

details.title: Rimefall
details.short_description: Your colony ship has landed on an alien planet — but the environment kills electronics. Salvage the ark, survive the early years, and build a nation as your society regresses to medieval with remnants of modern knowledge. Grand strategy with simulated population and turn-based combat.

details.title: Spirits: Unbound
details.short_description: Build your own deck of Spirits to battle in Spirits: Unbound. Play against opponents, then alter your cards with stickers, to make them incredibly powerful.

details.title: Rovi's Diary
details.short_description: Rovi's Diary – A 2D pixel-art adventure with anime storytelling. On planet Lumira, an ordinary girl Rovi is chosen by "Starlight." She grows from a passive observer into a protector, teaming up with Faye and Alice to uncover the mystery behind cosmic invaders.

details.title: Tactics of Scarlet
details.short_description: Tactics of Scarlet is a Japanese-Style Tactical RPG inspired by the classics from the GBA era. Cross swords through 3 campaigns with radically different gameplay as you discover multiple sides of the story.

details.title: Skydeck Swords
details.short_description: Bring a sword to a ship fight! Become a pirate and command a fleet of ships armed with massive, hull-mounted swords in this unique roguelike deckbuilder. Navigate across the stars to rescue your crew and steal all the riches!

details.title: Dream Disc Delivery
details.short_description: The world is ending, but everything will be alright. Bike around the seaside town of Lighthouse City as you enjoy your last days on your home planet. If you ever get lost, you can use collectibles to improve your map. Just be sure not to crash!

details.title: Dr. Oops!
details.short_description: Treat bizarre patients, solve outrageous medical mysteries, and pay off your crushing debt in this dark comedy deduction adventure! Every diagnosis relies on your observation, deduction, and some real-world knowledge. Pay off your debt, or skip a payment if needed, and fight for your freedom.

details.title: Turbo Trigger
details.short_description: Turbo Trigger is a local arena shooter for up to 4 players. Die, buy a better weapon, respawn, and get your revenge. Nobody sits out — the round doesn't stop until the final second.

details.title: Moonlight
details.short_description: Moonlight is a survival crafting game set in a dynamic alien world that shifts around you. Change the landscape of a beautiful, deadly, procedurally-generated 2D world by growing food, encountering strange creatures and building powerful machines that will help you escape this awful place... maybe.

details.title: Alakadabra
details.short_description: Alakadabra is a multiplayer PvP game about wizards dueling in a simulated world. Sign up for the year's biggest magic tournament, choose from a great many spells and abilities, and mind where you stand: wood catches fire, water freezes solid, and that bridge is not to be relied on.

details.title: Beer Barons
details.short_description: From a small-time alcohol dealer to a beer baron, produce and distribute various types of beer throughout the city of Beerland. Expand your empire with real estate, businesses, employees, and more.

details.title: Daydream Drifters
details.short_description: A roguelike stealth horror where dungeons, enemies, and items are procedurally generated. With dynamic events over time and changing weather, hide from enemies with distinct abilities—or prepare to fight. Explore 3 seamlessly connected random dungeons and survive the daydream.

details.title: SteelFall
details.short_description: Pilot an armored mech and fight giant kaiju with steel fists and an arsenal of ranged weapons. Punch, parry, and shoot your way through a world overrun by monsters in a third-person beat ’em up where every hit shakes the ground.

details.title: OmniGun
details.short_description: Obliterate hostile automatons in this vibrant physics-based roguelite FPS. Master the OmniGun, a prototype gun capable of firing any ammunition imaginable as you shoot, explode, burn, shock, slice, freeze, shrink, and impale your way to the exit.

details.title: Flushed Forward
details.short_description: Control a limbless sewer creature on board a large speed boat pursued by a massive sewer tidal wave in this Arcade experience! Defend against enemies by vaulting across your boat to stomp on their heads!

details.title: BLACKFRAG
details.short_description: BLACKFRAG is a fast-paced competitive arena FPS focused on precision gunplay and intense multiplayer combat.

details.title: Marble Machina
details.short_description: You wake up in a surreal factory with no memory of how you arrived. Punch cards operate strange machines, floors rise and fall beneath your feet, and teleporters lead who knows where. You’re fairly sure you haven’t gone mad. Still, just to be safe, you’d better collect all your marbles.

details.title: Stargazer Simulator
details.short_description: Go from zero to a real amateur astronomer. Join the astronomy club, set up your own telescope, start with your first bright star, and go on to find the Moon’s craters and distant galaxies in the real night sky. Every star you learn in the game is really up there tonight.

details.title: Spy Diner
details.short_description: "Spy Diner" is a click-and-run adventure game combining restaurant management and spy infiltration. Players run a diner by day next to the century-old "Old Chiang's Braised Pork Rice" as a good neighbor, and execute takedown plans by night under handler orders.

details.title: Mighty Tiny Railways
details.short_description: Build a steam railway where the network you build determines how it operates. Deliver cargo and passengers on time, grow towns and industries, and optimize your network. Invite a friend to build together in online co-op.

details.title: THE SHOW
details.short_description: A 1–4 player co-op horror extraction gameshow. Enter deadly labyrinths, solve puzzles, steal valuable loot, and build a fortune for the masses' entertainment. Push your luck, go deeper, and extract before you lose everything...

details.title: Gravitten VR
details.short_description: Grab, climb, and turn your world upside down! Become Gravitten, the gravity-defying kitten, and master the environment's shifting physics. Experience 5 distinct biomes where up is down and left is right.

details.title: SIDEROS
details.short_description: Iron, the fundamental element of the world, was cursed by the magic lords of earth, water, air and fire to rust. In this high fantasy turn-based RPG you take the role of the iron knight in his quest to stop rust from destroying the world.

details.title: PODER
details.short_description: Run a district in a 12-million Latin American megacity in a political strategy about power, compromise, and dirty deals. 100+ starting combos, 75 population groups, and no decision without consequences. Can you do better than those you love to hate?

details.title: Cyber Demon Protocol
details.short_description: An antique computer has granted you the ability to summon cyber demons. Seeking power from demons is like dancing on a tightrope, from Lawful Good to Chaotic Evil, how will you choose? Will you collude with the wealthy, politicians, stars, and artists, or change this decadent society?

details.title: Plesiotopia
details.short_description: A wholesome marine sanctuary sim, where you take care of giant sea reptiles from the dinosaur era. Nurse ichtyosaurs, plesiosaurs and mosasaurs, train them for the wild, then search the Pacific Ocean for a suitable marine ecosystem where you can release them.

details.title: ESCAPE: Orphanage
details.short_description: A psychological thriller set in Scarlet Orphanage, where every choice shapes the fate of the residents. Nothing is as it seems. Are you facing ghosts… or something far worse?

details.title: Backpack Roguelike
details.short_description: Arrange, merge, and synergize gear inside a growing backpack, then survive real-time waves and brutal bosses. Every slot shapes your build in this strategic action roguelite with persistent progression. Experiment, adapt, and turn limited space into your strongest weapon.

details.title: Slime Game
details.short_description: Slime Game is a retro rage platformer for the modern day! Run and jump through over 70 levels, all while collecting power-ups, stomping enemies, and finding hidden collectibles.

details.title: Franky Psychedelic Adventure
details.short_description: Join Franky on an epic journey across breathtaking dimensions to reclaim the stolen cookies. Harness powerful psychedelic abilities to overcome challenges, master impossible obstacles, and conquer extraordinary worlds.

details.title: Their Sky
details.short_description: Their Sky is an idle deck-builder. Select cards and strategies as you build decks that can win on their own. Rather than managing moves, Their Sky all in on deck building: turn your favorite cards into self-running engines.

details.title: Mayak
details.short_description: A signal from a star // 3571 → 3559 → 3557 → … → 0 // 336 years remain // You and her, staring up at the sky. A hand-drawn sci-fi adventure about first contact.

details.title: Tim & Harpy
details.short_description: Tim & Harpy is a revival of the classic retro 3D platforming collectathon adventures. Explore rich, unique worlds, gather many different items, and help the duo save the planet while meeting new friends along the way.

details.title: Master of the Mow
details.short_description: Become the Master of the Mow. Cut grass, clear trash, and uncover buried treasures across the overgrown grounds of an old manor estate. Upgrade your tools and grow stronger with each trinket you sell and solve the mystery of why the grass grows back every morning. Rise and mow...again. And again.

details.title: RogueBike GP
details.short_description: Race, rebuild, and adapt! create the optimal racing team and chase the world championship in this 2D Motorbike Roguelike.🏭🏍️🏁

details.title: Jerry the Zombie Slayer
details.short_description: Shoot, loot, craft, and explore in this absurdly funny roguelite against hordes of different zombies. Every death gives you the chance to build and upgrade your base… and your ego. How long can you survive?

details.title: No Death In Wild West
details.short_description: Play as time travelers wiping out cowboys with high-tech weapons. Overcome brutal terrain against an unforgiving timer. Master unique heroes with different movement styles to conquer the Wild West.

details.title: OS95 Plus!
details.short_description: OS95 Plus! is the newest first person puzzle adventure game from Gev Creates. You're stuck in a mysterious facility and are forced to indefinitely partake in software testing. You must navigate rooms and solve puzzles to escape and uncover the truth behind the experiment.

details.title: Knightwatch
details.short_description: By DAY - Build defenses and towers. BY NIGHT - grab weapon of your choice and fight off relentless waves of zombies, undead, werewolves and other monsters. In a FPS x Tower Defense game where you defend a winter town overshadowed by the King’s castle.

details.title: Kuny-Kuny Hog
details.short_description: A porky bullet hell, as chaotic and radioactive as it gets. Go after your acorns while you blast through by shooting and using your trusty roman shield to bounce back projectiles and mutant squirrels. Grab all the power ups you can in the midst of the battle!

details.title: Die to Play
details.short_description: Die to Play — a deckbuilder with dice, set on a cozy retro computer inside a medieval English mansion filled with horrors and mysteries.

details.title: Burakku Jakku Samurai
details.short_description: A tactical pixel-art roguelite. Manage your Ki up to a lethal limit of 21. Bend the rules of the duel with special cards to alter combat conditions. Risk it all to hit exactly 21 for a Perfect Focus lethal strike. Plan your route and survive. Your strategy is your sharpest weapon.

details.title: Gabby's Odyssey
details.short_description: Embark on a journey through the fantastical world of Larion in this action-adventure inspired by timeless classics of the genre. Solve clever puzzles, overcome perilous dungeons, and unlock new abilities — while discovering that imagination is not a weakness, but a force that can change everything.

details.title: VASED
details.short_description: VASED is a simple, yet challenging fast-paced arcade against-the-clock puzzle game about vases.

details.title: Gumblaster Mayhem
details.short_description: Gumblaster Mayhem is a 3D retro-style first-person shooter game where you, as a player, shoot out some gumballs using the three weapons that you must use to take down the sour mutants to survive.

details.title: Labyren
details.short_description: Labyren is a medieval-themed Tower Defense game centered on multi-waypoint mazing and vision. While traversing through the campaign, discover countless unique strategies building with your ever-expanding arsenal and unravel the story underneath!

details.title: AEROCUBE
details.short_description: AEROCUBE is a Ski-Fi Roguelike + First-Person Boomer Shooter in a huge mysterious cube that always rotates randomly. Each room of AEROCUBE is different, but one thing stays the same: something’s always behind you, ready to kill.

details.title: Voidwatch
details.short_description: Voidwatch is a silky-smooth space shooter roguelike. Hop from planet to planet, facing off against the Cult of the Void as you fight to free the galaxy from their clutches. Collect new weapons and powerful modifications to improve your Voidhawk Infiltrator starship & lay waste to your foes!

details.title: Rodent Company
details.short_description: Battle enemy pests using randomly generated toy guns, powerful perks and unique abilities! Join with friends in up to 4-player couch co-op and gather the best arsenal to win!

details.title: coalescent || tidal rapture
details.short_description: In the ocean depths, merpeople are evolving, and there are whispers of a new form of connection. Dive into deep waters, deeper desire, and trying to get over your ex in this hypnagogic 3D swimming adventure game and dating sim about separation and entanglement.

details.title: Erulean Angel: Fantasy Commander
details.short_description: Set out on a grand adventure of exploration, strategy, and mystery in Erulean Angel: Fantasy Commander. Immerse yourself in a handmade world as you craft armies to outwit your opponents in fully simulated autobattler combat.

details.title: Witch & Dragon: Hope of Elements
details.short_description: Harness elemental chains to defeat foes, collect treasures, and craft unique builds in high-risk, high-reward adventures. Witch & Dragon: Hope of Elements is a roguelike with elemental gameplay, RPG mechanics, and turn-based tactics. Join Elise and dragon Pipi on their magical journey.

details.title: Fishing Girl's Fantasy
details.short_description: In an enchanting and mystical world, a healing and delightful adventure awaits! Welcome to Fishing Girl's Fantasy, a casual game that seamlessly combines exploration, fishing, and restaurant management. Immerse yourself in this fantastical experience filled with wonder and charm.

details.title: Suspect None
details.short_description: Suspect None is a top-down open-world game where you explore the city by day and plan and pull off heists at night. Follow the story and take part in activities around the city.

details.title: SlopTuber Simulator
details.short_description: SlopTuber Simulator is a short incremental adventure about filling the internet with worthless video content for fun and profit (Mostly for profit)!

details.title: Whispers of Elenrod
details.short_description: Deck-building meets strategy map exploration. Craft powerful decks. Discover mysterious artifacts on procedurally generated maps. Defeat enemies in turn-based combat and gain experience to evolve your hero. Create your best build…and find all the Whispers of Elenrod!

details.title: Gold Rush
details.short_description: Stake your claim on the frontier in this fast-paced Wild West RTS.

details.title: Atomic Age
details.short_description: Criminal case in the cabaret stage Atomic Age, a comedic, retro-futuristic 2D point & click adventure in the shape of the 50th and 60th years
developers: Matthias Huber, Jill Peeters, Chris Kohler

details.title: Astro Loopers
details.short_description: What if you could rewind time — and team up with your past self? Astro Loopers is a Sokoban-style puzzle game set in a cosmic universe, where every move echoes through time. Your past characters repeat their actions as time loops stack up — coordinate them to solve increasingly mind-bending stages.

details.title: Cthulhu 1920
details.short_description: Step into the eerie world of Cthulhu 1920, a strategic card game where sanity is your lifeline. Players navigate a grid-based playfield, battling enemies, collecting items, and using weapons and long forgotten artifacts to survive.

details.title: Dive and Glide
details.short_description: Dive, glide and smash your way through colourful sky-high challenges! Explore floating islands, earn stars to unlock new worlds, and master wildly different courses filled with rings, obstacles, enemies and secrets. Race your friend, race a penguin, fight aliens, hours of fun for everyone.

details.title: Rolling Rogue
details.short_description: Explore dungeons in a stylish roguelike with turn-based combat. Use a deck of dice to give your abilities unique effects. Create your own dice and combine them with equipment, carving your way through hordes of enemies.

details.title: My Death as a Duchess
details.short_description: My Death as a Duchess is a survival game where the player embodies a duchess taking control of a cursed duchy. This game combines both narrative intrigue and strategy, alternating phases of managing the duchess's schedule and the unfolding of her day in the form of a graphic novel.

name: The Darkside Detective: Backside of the Moon

details.title: The Darkside Detective: Backside of the Moon
details.short_description: You'd think that after 20+ cases, there'd be no crime left in Twin Lakes - but that's not how crime works, rookie. Six new mind-melting mysteries await Detective McQueen and Officer Dooley - just as soon as they get the mustard out of Dooley's gun.

details.title: One Arrow
details.short_description: Freeze your arrow in midair and then use it as a platform in this challenging precision platformer. Carve your own paths, outsmart your enemies, and uncover the secrets of your magic arrow.

details.title: Bloomed Ghoul
details.short_description: Eat your enemies and replace your body parts. A ghoulish action roguelike where your abilities, weapons, and power come from what you choose to become.

details.title: Femboy Detective
details.short_description: Dark yaoi horror game about learning who to trust. Investigate leads, interrogate suspects, and unravel a doomsday conspiracy in the search for your missing friend.

details.title: Sweet Dreams in Midnight Kingdom
details.short_description: Sweet Dreams in Midnight Kingdom is a medieval puzzle game where the player, a king, has his divine right to rule tested when tasked with putting his own subjects to bed before the sun rises. Use logic and patience to solve each level in this grid-based, hand-drawn game.

details.title: Intersecta
details.short_description: "Intersecta" is an intense tactical top-down space combat game with a stylized sci-fi aesthetic. Devoid of humans, the game is set in another dimension where only cybernetic insects have evolved. The player takes control of an Intersecta fighter pilot hoping to survive an intergalactic invasion.

details.title: Dokuro・Maguro
details.short_description: Awaken in a psychiatric hospital and become trapped in an endless loop of madness. Explore bizarre hellscapes, battle monstrous tuna creatures, and fight your way out of a surreal nightmare in this absurd escape horror FPS!

details.title: Yrdenwatch - The Dragon from Lidoriya
details.short_description: This game is about piloting a giant mech with wings that has multiple guns attached to it. It's explosive, fast-paced, skill-based, and full of gun violence. It's also a story-driven game where you explore a spaceship and talk to your fellow crew members!

details.title: Meal Quest
details.short_description: Explore the magical world inside your fridge, plan meals, and fight your way to the Dream City. Your in-game nutrition choices grant you combat bonuses that reflect each vitamin’s actual role in the body.

details.title: Deadlight Manor
