details.short_description: A stylized survival horror built on community. Squad up with your team, battle endless waves of the infected, and let your stream audience fuel the chaos in real time.

details.title: Friends of a Feather
details.short_description: An absurd adventure RPG: ruin weddings, break into dinosaur mansions, and sleep with 3 or 4 opossums.

details.title: Frozen Echo
details.short_description: Venture into the endless frozen wastelands alone or with friends. Stay warm, manage and upgrade your camp, hunt, and learning your skills to survive the harsh cold and wolf attacks.

details.title: Purrfect Collars
details.short_description: Purrfect Collars is a cozy single-player shopkeeping adventure. As a witch, design collars, enchant them with potions, manage your shop and meet interesting new customers! Each collar holds meaning, every cat a story!

details.title: CrossSwords: FPS Crosswords
details.short_description: Solve the crossword and start shooting! Race your opponents to solve clues, earn ammo and power-ups, and then fight in an arena built from the crossword grid itself. Battle friends and players online!

details.title: VPetlings
details.short_description: Raise your own virtual pet right on your desktop. Choose your favorite, take care of your companion, play together, train for battle, and help them evolve! They will always be there, keeping you company while you work, play, or browse.

details.title: Zantar & Other Stories
details.short_description: Acclaimed artist and solo developer Mitchell F. Chan tells six funny, gripping, and heart-breaking stories about a fictional video game, the ambitious CEO driven to make it the most valuable platform in the world, and the would-be millionaires who are pulled into its orbit.

details.title: BoB - Battle of Bots
details.short_description: Welcome to BOB, a heavy metal bullet-heaven roguelike Mecha game where your skills are the only thing standing between humanity and endless waves of berserk bots! Survive as long as possible while obliterating waves of enemies, terrifying bosses and the megalomanical AI DAVE!

details.title: Evelume
details.short_description: An atmospheric 2D adventure about a schoolkid in a small town where adults are stuck in a gray, monotonous life. Explore, fight, solve puzzles, and try to uncover the something that has drained people of joy.

details.title: Meowniverse
details.short_description: Merge endless cats on your desktop! Every cat you adopt becomes a unique part in your Collection. Evolve your cats, complete the Collection, and enjoy their company. They’ll embark on adventures, bringing you coins and fish! Get ready to huff cats and let their sweet meows lift your spirits!

details.title: Runic Prophecy
details.short_description: Runic Prophecy is a challenging third-person soulslike action RPG set in a dark fantasy world. Explore Eyjusheim, unleash magic and a dragon in combat, battle supernatural creatures, and uncover the hidden lore of a shattered world.

details.title: The Exalted Descendant
details.short_description: Rebuild a fallen species in this dark sci-fi 4X strategy game. Extract and refine real elements, command drone swarms, and make tough choices as you guide The Exalted Descendant toward resurgence—or extinction—in a procedurally generated galaxy. No diplomacy. No mercy.

details.title: Expendabots
details.short_description: Expendabots is a 1–4 player co-op horror-extraction game where expendable robots explore ever-changing islands and terrifying dungeons. Outmatched and vulnerable, you’ll need to stay quiet, hide from hostile creatures, survive the horrors, and extract with your squad before the island is lost.

details.title: Desouled
details.short_description: How many times have you wished you could forget and simply sleep? Desouled forces you to look at what we avoid seeing: stories that are raw, cruel, at times inhuman. But real. In a relentless fight, dodging is your only defense. You can't win, only survive.

details.title: Flutterfield
details.short_description: Flutterfield is a cozy and relaxing idle game. Buy butterflies and raise them in real time, or catch fully grown ones yourself. Unlock, upgrade, and customize habitats while filling your collection with real-life butterfly species!

name: Chrysanthemum: On the Way to Sweet Dreams

details.title: Chrysanthemum: On the Way to Sweet Dreams
details.short_description: A high school senior with superpowers longs to confess her feelings to her chemistry teacher, but the island’s mysterious anomalies turn her world upside down. A non-linear otome visual novel filled with sinister mysteries and complicated choices.

details.title: Fake World 2: Real World 1
details.short_description: Fake World 2: Real World 1 is a VR first-person shooter where weapon color matters. Match red and yellow weapons to enemy attacks while you grapple, jetpack, and teleport through surreal sci-fi environments in a fast-paced, atmospheric campaign.

details.title: Keep Crafting
details.short_description: Keep Crafting is an asymetrical cooperative party game : One player must guide the other players using a manual to craft complex items !

details.title: Drift Market
details.short_description: Destroy supermarkets, fight absurd bosses, and turn your trolley into a weapon of mass destruction! Drift through chaotic stores as a furious mutant fruit and unleash over-the-top, physics-driven mayhem in this ridiculous smash ‘em up.

details.title: Taste of Power: Medieval
details.short_description: Master the art of war in brutal action-RTS across an alternate medieval world. Lead Europe, China or the Timurids to supremacy through strategic brilliance and lightning-fast tactics. Expand your realm, advance powerful technologies and lead massive armies. DISCOVER NEW HORIZONS OF THE MEDIEVAL WARS

details.title: Chain Shotgun
details.short_description: Chain Shotgun is a fast paced movement shooter where your only weapon is the multi-barrelled CHAIN SHOTGUN. Two barrels are way too few! With an up-to-infinite amount of barrels, it can shoot anything from sniper rounds, rockets, slime - LEGS? Why not even load it with yourself?

details.title: Be the Block
details.short_description: Be the Block is a Sokoban-inspired 2D puzzle game where you don’t just push the blocks, you ARE the blocks. Solve a collection of carefully hand-crafted puzzles that are by design simple yet challenging.

details.title: SCRIMBLO SCRAMBLE
details.short_description: Put it all on the line in this roulette-themed incremental game where you torment your scrimblos in order to manage and eventually escape hell.

details.title: WOOJOO
details.short_description: Pilot your ship through a changing star system in this single-player space adventure. Mine and salvage, take escort and raid contracts, then invest your returns in ship upgrades, bases, and a fleet. Survey planets and choose your place among rival factions.

details.title: The Monsters' Child
details.short_description: This is a daughter-raising game set in a world of monsters. As a monster chosen to be her guardian, you’ll raise the only human girl in the world, helping her learn, make friends, and explore a world that is both unfamiliar and welcoming.

details.title: Ore Heads
details.short_description: Head Office is hiring! Dig through seven huge mines in co-op for up to 8 players, fight your way through sealed dungeons, build a home on your own plot and climb the company ladder from Intern Digger to Chairman of the Boulder in this cozy voxel mining game.

details.title: BAJAMAR
details.short_description: BAJAMAR is a first-person point-and-click mystery adventure on an abandoned lighthouse island. Explore, examine everything, combine what you find and solve logical puzzles to follow the trail your brother left for you alone. No combat. No hand-holding.

details.title: Valley of the Omen
details.short_description: A folk horror action platformer in which you play a boomerang-wielding warrior on a quest for revenge. As Aoife, an orphan raised to hunt monsters, you will face the demonic hordes of the sorceress Morrakhad across abandoned villages, cursed cathedrals, and flooded graveyards.

details.title: ENGINEBOUND
details.short_description: ENGINEBOUND is a first-person survival game about a train that is bound to your soul. Keep its fire burning, drive an endless procedurally generated line, craft your way up the engine bond, and hold off the monsters that hunt in the dark.

details.title: Something Under
details.short_description: Dig, dodge falling rocks and collect gems in an underground action-puzzle game. Play solo at your own pace, or share the cave in split-screen and local co-op over WLAN. Read the terrain, plan your route and bring everyone back as the caves get stranger below.

details.title: Grunt
details.short_description: Medieval Grunt Simulator. Wage battles of thousands as a king and then survive them as a common footsolider.

details.title: Satellite Odyssey Horizons
details.short_description: Voxel survival in the Satellite Odyssey universe. Explore whole planets from 400 thousand to 40 million blocks: gather, craft and build, hunt, and beware of bandit camps and infected settlements. Free on official servers. The Full Version adds your own offline world and your own server.

details.title: Abyss at Hand
details.short_description: Form an adventuring party on your own or with friends, and set out to defeat this world’s Demon Lord! Abyss at Hand is a multiplayer action-adventure game for 1–4 players. Experience thrilling, adrenaline-pumping battles in a vast fantasy world!

details.title: Cripta
details.short_description: A co-op roguelike for up to five heroes. Descend a crypt that changes every run, pick gifts, curses and relics, level your skills at the anvil and face the Kings of six worlds, alone or with friends, all the way down to the Hollow Seraph.

details.title: Luck & Doom
details.short_description: Your hero stands at the center. Turn the world around them and shape their fate! Build your piece pool, rearrange tiles, collect gear and develop your hero. Every turn costs time. Find your chance to win amid the chaos of fate before the demon lord arrives.

details.title: New Hope
details.short_description: Post-apocalyptic colony survival where you give the orders and then hold the wall yourself. Build a fortified base, send squads on risky expeditions for supplies, and fight beside your settlers in third person when zombies and mutants come for the gates.

details.title: Dream Dwelling
details.short_description: Your aunt is gone, leaving you a cottage and a big debt. Little by little, paint it pink, add a desk by the window and pair furniture into Combos for maximum Charm. Then sell it as someone's dream home. Build houses, open shops and unwind in Dream Dwelling!

details.title: The Last Lesson
details.short_description: A first-person horror puzzle game where technical problems have physical consequences. Solve challenge rooms, navigate procedural corridors, and survive the Teacher hunting you through the school.

details.title: The Push West
details.short_description: Isometric stealth action in a forest village seized by modern soldiers. Sneak through moonlit camps, hide in tall grass, whistle guards away, then burn their ammo and cripple their trucks before dawn. Every raid is a freshly generated map. One hunter, a bow, a knife.

details.title: Mushroom Sweeper
details.short_description: First-person mushroom hunting in CryEngine. Sweep a procedurally generated forest, clear the forest floor, track mushrooms with the Sporevision and uncover whole mushroom patches in a Minesweeper-style minigame. Save your grandpa by recovering his mushroom inventions in exchange for prized specimens

details.title: RamiRami
details.short_description: A roguelite deck-building game where you fight with Rami. Be careful to choose wisely the cards you decide to add into your deck after each game ! Discover a strange path through a dreamlike world, collect cards and face bosses with twisted rules, alone or with a friend !

details.title: Aesirbard
details.short_description: Aesirbard is a fantasy Norse-inspired Metroidvania of hard steel and old magic. Sent back from the gates of Hel, fight the corrupted and the restless dead, and rewire the hidden power that underpins the world to free a village trapped by its own ward.

details.title: Shockline
details.short_description: Play as a super-speed dog in a city facing disaster. Race through streets, rescue civilians, and disarm bombs before time runs out. Slow the action to make tight turns, dodge danger, and push for a better score across three modes and three districts.

details.title: Typers Combat 2: Type Harder
details.short_description: Every correct key is a punch. Out-type your rival to land the hits, then end the match with a brutal cinematic execution, X-ray bone breaks included. A 3D typing fighter with a first-person story mode, 10 bonus stages and a fighter you build yourself.

name: MeowMeow TCG: Rip & Ship Streamer Simulator

details.title: MeowMeow TCG: Rip & Ship Streamer Simulator
details.short_description: Start your card-opening streamer career together with your cat companions! Complete pack-opening orders from viewers and grow your fanbase. Decorate your own streaming room. Get cards through various trades and events! Come and collect all the Cat Cards!!

details.title: 红尘游记
details.short_description: Hong Chen You Ji is a 2D top-down pixel wuxia action RPG. Play a village-raised youth seeking his origins among sects and officials. Real-time combat uses movement, weapons, and martial arts. Day, night, weather, and seasons change what you can do. Be a hero, doctor, or escort on your own path.

details.title: BSC: Custodial Program
details.short_description: Live and work in the backrooms as a Custodian in this first-person survival horror. Clean up after retired custodians and hunt for artifacts to earn your freedom. ▙▟▛█▜▚▞ is already in there, waiting.

details.title: AI ROBO STADIUM
details.short_description: Physical AI, on your own PC. Train legged robots with real reinforcement learning (PPO), then pilot the AI you raised in obstacle races and sumo bouts. You design the rewards; the AI figures out how to walk. Training runs on your CPU, and you can keep playing while it learns.

details.title: Witch Collage
details.short_description: A deck-cutting roguelike where you slice cards with a magic dagger and piece them together. Create your own cards and survive the witch's game.

name: Water Margin: Rise of the Outlaws

details.title: Water Margin: Rise of the Outlaws
details.short_description: A story-driven grid tactics RPG set in China's classic Water Margin. Fight beside Shi Jin, Lu Zhishen and Lin Chong through the novel's famous scenes and choose how they end. Walk the Righteous, Pragmatic or Ruthless path: heroes join or leave you for it, and the fallen stay dead.

details.title: Bad Call
details.short_description: Bad Call is a social game for 3-6 players set in an underground bunker. You're locked in separate rooms. Win challenges, trade code digits, forge alliances, and lie over the phone. Everyone needs the same exit code, but not everyone will escape.

name: Something Outside Wants You to Die

details.title: Something Outside Wants You to Die
details.short_description: Survive a paranormal home invasion caused by a case of mistaken identity. Attempt to prove you're not who it seeks as your house degrades and becomes more difficult to navigate. Something's Outside, but it's only a matter of time until it gets in.

details.title: One Last Dance Please!
details.short_description: A rhythm-driven incremental game where every beat builds a bigger party. Rally your dance crew, earn cash and go wild with upgrades. Draw your own characters and bring your favorite music. The bills can wait for one last dance... right?

details.title: The Bastion Protocol
details.short_description: The Bastion Protocol is an idle tower defense game where a lone tower faces relentless enemy waves. Earn Entropy from kills, strengthen your build, and survive until your tower falls. Turn each run’s rewards into lasting upgrades and return stronger.

details.title: Abyssgate
details.short_description: The Abyssal Gate has opened. Abyssgate is a Wizardry-style dungeon crawler. Make a party of six and step into the dark one square at a time. Don't go easy on the monsters. If you do, you die.

details.title: AlcheMice
details.short_description: A tarot roguelite deckbuilder. Play a card to move like a chess piece: the knight's jump clears traps and reaches high ground. Strike with action cards and brew alchemy into your deck. Three days, then the loop resets at dawn and you keep only your deck and whatever you locked in the chest.

details.title: Medival Adventure
details.short_description: Gather resources, craft tools and build your settlement. Explore a medieval world with villages, wildlife and a day/night cycle. Medival Adventure is in early development: play solo or test experimental multiplayer with a trusted group.

details.title: Trench League
details.short_description: Punch your way to the spiked steel ball and smash it into the enemy cage. The side with the most breaches wins. Knock rivals out and the Reclaim drags them off. Face opponents from different planets of the Solar System and fight your way to the Solar Final! Test your skills against real opponents!

details.title: Hermetica
details.short_description: A world after a great war. Only one reference box survived, and you have it. The vendor sends robots in for inspection, but doesn't always tell the truth. You find where he lied and decide whether the robot goes into battle. Every shift starts at a desk. ...

details.title: Surfin' Landes
details.short_description: Welcome to Contis, a little beach in the Landes, southwest France. In this 100% co-op pixel art game, become lifeguards: one surfs, the other flies a parachute. On the menu: beer, rescues, giant fish, piranhas, dolphins, pelicans, bazookas, a dog… and ever more beer.

details.title: Thicker than Ichor
details.short_description: Blood is thicker than water. Ichor is thicker than both. Aliens spliced you by mistake, and now you're whipping, shooting and punching your way out of a mutated hotel in a totally fictional city in a first-person roguelite brawler.

details.title: Starlock Arcana
details.short_description: Explore the star-cursed world of Starlock Arcana as an undead mage on a quest to vanquish the Star of Doom. Venture into ancient dungeons, discover powerful spells and battle fierce enemies! Grow ever stronger, choose the spells that suit your playstyle, and bring an end to the star curse!

details.title: You Can't Deliver
details.short_description: All you have to do is deliver a pizza. What could possibly go wrong? In this game, the entire environment stands in your way. Dodge nasty traps, fall victim to absurd surprises, and try again. A rage game with one simple mission: Get the damn pizza to its destination.

details.title: Little Desk Farm
details.short_description: Run a pixel farm on your desktop. Grow crops, hire farmers, raise chickens and arrange buildings your way. Assign farmers to sow, water and harvest, then sell crops to expand your land. Check in on the farm now and then while you work, study or take a break.

details.title: Baseline Boss: The Basketball Manager
details.short_description: Coach a pro basketball team from the bench: pick your starting five, sign talent and make the calls live on a tactics board that cuts to comic highlights. A bold cartoon manager with story mode, trash-talk duels, voiced commentary and a real simulation underneath.

details.title: His Umbrella Is Dry
details.short_description: Hong Kong, 1999. The rain won't stop. Your uncle says he'll be away a few days and leaves you his paper offerings shop. Write names for the dead, build paper cars, take the money, count the change. Tonight's customers come in from the rain. One umbrella is dry. Uncle's rule: dry umbrella, no name.

details.title: Task Bar Throne
details.short_description: Rule a cozy pixel kingdom that lives above your taskbar. Farm, fish, trade and raise a castle while you work — then step into a court full of companions, deals and intrigue, where every decision you make leaves a mark.

details.title: ABYSS CHRONICLES
details.short_description: Six bloodlines sealed in stone. An abyss that remembers. Wake your race, carve through living hordes and drowned giants, and chase build-defining loot down to 11,000 meters in a dark side-scrolling hack-and-slash ARPG.

details.title: Cozy Restoration Workshop
details.short_description: Give forgotten treasures a second life in a cozy restoration workshop. Take them apart, scrub away grime, remove rust, polish and rebuild them by hand. Restore 18 distinct objects, try them out, and display your work in a personal collection.

details.title: LittleHeartRiddle
details.short_description: A transformational magical girl RPG where you command beasts to clear dungeons."Kohaku," a girl who gave up on being "cute," awakens in a sweet yet eerie World of Sweets. Accepted by the mysterious Lucia, she transforms into a magical girl to conquer perilous dungeons and retrieve her lost memories.

details.title: Totally Invited: Party Heist Simulator
details.short_description: Crash parties, blend in with guests, and escape with the valuables in this co-op stealth heist simulator. Then clean up your haul, stock your shop, and set your prices. Turn stolen goods into a growing business, fund your next heist, and watch out for thieves. Apparently, everyone has the same idea.

name: Unidentified Frying Objects: Idle Cafe Empire

details.title: Unidentified Frying Objects: Idle Cafe Empire
details.short_description: Run a cafe for hungry aliens with no taste. Invent terrible recipes, automate your kitchen, play the galactic stock market, feed a black hole, and relocate across the stars to cook the legendary Omni-Meal. A quirky idle game with a news ticker that never stops.

details.title: Overtime at Holiday's
details.short_description: Cleaners Bill and Jules land a weekend job at Max Holiday’s mansion - until they find him dead in the pool. Trapped in an endless overtime loop, they must move his body around while solving quirky puzzles. A darkly funny retro adventure where "Weekend at Bernie’s" meets "Groundhog Day"!

details.title: Test Your Luck: Gacha Simulator
details.short_description: Welcome to GachaOS, the premier gacha gaming platform for whales! Play a gauntlet of incremental gacha games with Moby, our helpful Gacha Assistant. Build your fortune, then burn it all pulling characters, ripping packs, or opening crates. Unlucky? With GachaOS, turn your misfortune into fortune!

details.title: SLICE SURPRISE
details.short_description: Throw a blade. Cut stuff in half. Like, exactly in half. Pumpkins, piggy banks, one very nervous dragon. Climb a tower where every floor has one little rule, keep every weapon you buy, and take down bosses who hit back. One more floor? Sure. Just one.

details.title: Kipper: The Mountain Lizard
details.short_description: Kipper: The Mountain Lizard is a retro-styled 2D precision platformer. Help Kipper tidy the mountain by collecting every gem and balloon.

details.title: Dode
details.short_description: Dode is an online creature-capture RPG on hex-voxel worlds. Tactical-combat focused, with a cozy side. Featuring endless unique loot, ability customization, and base creation. Explore, capture, train, battle, craft, farm, and build - as you quest aside the elemental Wardens in their Mana Wars.

details.title: Pie Paw
details.short_description: Pie Paw is a cozy bag-building roguelite where you draw, upgrade, and combine dice to outscore animal rivals. Shape every roll with special dice, items, and companions as you travel a branching road in search of pies.

details.title: Dark Looter
details.short_description: Dark Looter is a browser-based hacking simulation game. Build your rig, steal files from virtual institutions, mine cryptocurrency, and climb the hacker ranks — all in a persistent online world.

details.title: The Stars Are Never Still
details.short_description: The Stars Are Never Still is a 2D space sandbox. Shape a galaxy and watch 16 unique races colonize, trade, ally, betray and wage war. Observe, or intervene with technology, aid, discord, disasters, new life—even black holes. Chronicle millennia of history. No set goals. No empire lasts forever.

details.title: Crappy Driver
details.short_description: Crappy Driver is a physics-based vehicle builder where you deliver passengers and packages, hoping you don’t lose them along the way. Build from weird parts, drive to the next stop without falling apart and make your vehicle stranger with every ride.

details.title: Project: Esper
details.short_description: A massively expansive traditional roguelike where literally anything is possible. Polymorph your foes into swords, mind control an aberration with five heads, or create your own pocket dimension. Break the rules, build the indomitable, and pray nothing finds a loose thread.

details.title: No One Will Miss Me
details.short_description: An existential horror visual novel. Play as a voice inside a troubled mind. Identify her cognitive distortions, shift her perspective, and win the debate that decides whether she lives or dies.

details.title: Runic Conflux
details.short_description: Roguelike deckbuilder with 200+ cards/items. A unique elemental resource system and rune (status effect) combinations. Choose 3 of 5 heroes each run.

details.title: Postal Bots
details.short_description: Fight hordes of robots in this roguelike twinstick shooter! As the last human run delivery company on Earth, it's your task to destroy AI delivery robots and keep a human face in the postal delivery service. Make deliveries and grab loot to upgrade your run and improve your robot smashing firepower.

details.title: hooooook
details.short_description: Gold Miner + Roguelike — Classic hook-and-grab gameplay fused with roguelike building. Hooks with unique abilities ; hundreds of relics can be freely combined to forge your own playstyle. Venture deep into the earth — mines, swamps, tombs… each new zone hides its own mechanics and threats.

details.title: Portals and Ducks
details.short_description: Surf a ramp. Shoot a portal. Keep every bit of your speed. A first-person game where the surfing is forgiving and the depth is in your portals - put a boost on one, a jump on the other, and use both in the same run. Levels are short. Restarts are instant.

details.title: Anvil United!
details.short_description: Anvil United! is a action-adventure for up to four players focused on crafting, management and skill. Gather materials, follow recipes, avoid hazards, optimize and manage your team. Become a legendary blacksmith and save the Kingdom!

details.title: How to Chemistry
details.short_description: How to Chemistry is a first-person co-op chemistry simulator, where you run your own lab with no safety regulations. Get an order, use your chemistry skills and deliver.

details.title: Factory Tour →
details.short_description: Factory Tour → is a 3D horror game where you explore a mysterious robot factory.

details.title: ColdCall: Telesales Sim
details.short_description: A dark-comedy telemarketing sim. You're 18/24/35, broke, and cold-calling strangers to sell them wealth products. Everything they say flies at you: dodge the insults, catch the agreement, drag the rope past the deal line and stamp it. Rent's due. Don't let them hang up. Partly inspired by Undertale.

details.title: Tactics to the devil dungeon
details.short_description: Build a party of companions who each carry a signature, shape their classes and skills, then choose every move and attack in a dark fantasy turn-based tactical RPG where range, elevation and terrain decide the fight.

details.title: NO EXIT
details.short_description: A survival horror FPS where you face hordes of zombies, explore abandoned environments, gather resources, and fight to survive.

details.title: Starcore: Through the Void
details.short_description: Pilot a lone gunship on a desperate mission to save the rebellion in this fast-paced 2D space shooter. Dodge deadly bullet patterns, master multi-phase boss encounters, and fight across nearly 20 bite-sized stages. Do you have what it takes to survive the void, Commander?

details.title: Shadow Princess: Crystalbound
details.short_description: A 2D platformer focused on midair movement where you can place crystals anywhere in any level to help you reach the end of the stage.

details.title: Realpolitiks 4: Back to the Roots
details.short_description: Realpolitiks 4 returns to its roots. Lead your chosen nation in an accessible real-time strategy game. Develop your economy, shape politics, forge alliances and plan military operations. Face the crises of the 21st century and chart your own path to power!

details.title: Somnium: Hypnagogia
details.short_description: Somnium: Hypnagogia is a psychological horror visual novel set on a night where dreams, nightmares, memories and reality bleed into one another. As you drift from dream to dream, your whispers will decide where the night ends up.

details.title: Wasteland Bites 2
details.short_description: Wasteland Bites is a horror-based food truck sim. You've expanded your operation with a decked-out caravan! Explore deeper into the wasteland in search of new delicacies. But be warned. The freaks only get more dangerous the further out you wander.

details.title: Burgerama Anomaly
details.short_description: Serve or die in a late-night pedestrian underpass kiosk. Prepare different burgers, fry ingredients, and manage your supplies - all while inspecting your customers for inhuman traits. Follow the night's rules, survive various hazards, and uncover the truth behind the mutations.

details.title: Pay to Think
details.short_description: An incremental game centered on intelligence as its core asset. Once, humanity became the master of the Earth by virtue of its intelligence; now, intelligence has found a new master. Intelligence no longer belongs to the smartest humans—it belongs to whoever possesses it.

details.title: Shameless Supreme
details.short_description: Shameless Supreme is a story-rich pixel RPG with turn-based combat and dark humor. Explore crumbling worlds, build your party, and combine status effects for deadly reactions. Use optional mic-powered trash talk to weaken enemies and break their defenses. Survive, and find your way home.

details.title: The Last Dry House
details.short_description: October 1999. The dam has failed, and yours is the last dry house on the hill. Each night strangers climb out of the floodwater and knock. Type any question you like through the door. Some are survivors. Some drowned days ago, and they don't know it yet.

details.title: KINETIC SINGULARITY
details.short_description: Harness the raw power of a collapsing reactor core in this minimalist physics rogue-lite. Launch kinetic sondes into a dynamic matrix, trigger high-energy chain reactions, and balance the fatal risk of the Overcharge mode. Every shot counts. Can you survive the singularity?

details.title: The Dig Show
details.short_description: The Dig Show is a cozy digging game about finding treasures on a fake TV stage. Use a metal detector, wash the dirt off your finds and show them on air. Viewers pay to watch. Upgrade your gear and dig a little deeper every day.

details.title: DWARKA
details.short_description: Dive beneath the waves in DWARKA, a first-person underwater exploration adventure in development. Prepare your gear, sail aboard SAMUDRA, manage oxygen, and investigate ocean mysteries. The full game is planned for solo play and online co-op for up to four players.

details.title: Burnline Madness
details.short_description: Race, brawl and boost through traffic in Burnline Madness, a single-player motorcycle combat racer. Punch and kick rival riders, switch between unlockable weapons, chain takedowns and spend your earnings on bike upgrades across five distinct routes.

details.title: Rúnafall
details.short_description: A retro-styled co-op action roguelike in Viking-age Norway. Raid as one of five black-metal Vikings, carve through draugr, trolls and corpse-ravens, and topple the monsters who rule three cursed regions, to an original industrial metal score by Norway's Melt Motif. Solo or with up to three friends.

details.title: Trick or Mistreat?
details.short_description: On Halloween, monsters also dress up as humans, but they don’t have such a pleasant temperament. Trick or Mistreat? That is the law of the monsters.

details.title: Higanbana
details.short_description: A co-op souls-like, where a young Samurai and cursed Doll work together to traverse an abandoned land swarmed with Yokai. Together with a spear and magic, they must defeat the challenging foes and unforgiving bosses to restore the Dolls original body and save the Samurai’s village.

details.title: Saikei: A Zen Water Garden
details.short_description: A tiny voxel world in a glass jar that sits in the corner of your desktop, on top of your windows, while you work. It carries on without you: water flows, koi and crabs go about their day, and night falls when it does outside. Reach in to dig, pour and build whenever you like.

details.title: Fors Magika
details.short_description: Fors Magika is a strategic card game where your hand is your battlefield! Choose a wizard, cast elemental spells, use Blessings and Curses, and outsmart your opponents. Uncover the enemy wizard and defeat them in fast-paced battles where every card counts.

details.title: Ink And Table
details.short_description: A cute action roguelike where you play a tiny doll defending a girl’s possessed home, one tabletop at a time. Dodge bullet-hell barrages with simple left-right movement as you command flying swords and fire ink bullets at haunted teacups, ink paintings, and even braised pork.

details.title: Double Trouble Delivery
details.short_description: A two-player online coop physics game. One of you drives, the other keeps the packages balanced. Solve mini-games, dodge obstacles, and find the right house before the dogs steal your cargo.

details.title: Manga Shop Simulator
details.short_description: Sales by day, loot hunting by night. Stock the shelves of your shop with fresh manga volumes and serve your customers. By night, open your eyes in a dungeon spilling off the page, defeat monsters and collect your loot. What will you find to display in your shop?

details.title: Just Be Alive
details.short_description: You can't attack. You can only dodge. Team up in 1–4 player co-op (friends or bots) and climb a tower full of cute bosses and mechanics. If at least one of you is still standing at the end, the whole team wins.

details.title: Forgotten Tactics
details.short_description: Fantasy grand strategy on the map, turn-based tactics on the field. Govern 71 counties, strike treaties and break them, while 17 rival houses and roaming fiends move at once. When armies meet, lead your champions into skill-card battles where one careless push can cost a whole company.

details.title: The Somnus Fracture
details.short_description: First-person psychological horror. Alex Reed signed up for Project Somnus to finally sleep. Every session drops him into a dream built from his own past, and something that knows his name is waiting there. Hide, run, and put back the life he can’t remember.

details.title: Gemwood
details.short_description: Run a cozy jewelry workshop in the woods. Mine for gems, cut and polish them, then design rings, necklaces and brooches for your animal customers. Mix metals and decorations, wrap each order and haggle over the price, or craft freely and display your favorites.

details.title: Little Rug Shop
details.short_description: Run a cozy little rug workshop. Draw rugs for your clients on an iPad, tuft them stitch by stitch, flip the frame for the big reveal, then shave and carve them by hand. Worn rugs come in too: wash out the stains and re-tuft the damage.

details.title: NIGHTSOMNIA
details.short_description: Work the night shift as a federal crisis analyst. Investigate kidnappings, disappearances and threats via live messages from people in danger. Trace phones, review CCTV and search databases as time runs out. Your decisions determine who makes it home. Not every threat comes from outside your agency.

details.title: Shadow Fruit Duel
details.short_description: Shadow Fruit Duel is a chaotic 2-player arena brawler starring adorable fruit ninjas! Dash, strike, throw weapons, and outsmart your rival across colorful arenas packed with traps and hazards. Grab power-ups, turn the battlefield to your advantage, and fight for fruity glory!

details.title: Hamster Special Agent
details.short_description: Hamster Special Agent is a 2-player co-op platformer! Become two chubby hamsters and work together to deliver cargo through seesaws, lifts, and spinning obstacles. Keep the crate from falling, reach the finish line together, and aim for a three-star clear!

details.title: Spadegrave
details.short_description: What if poker hands were your greatest weapons? Spadegrave combines roguelike deckbuilding with poker-inspired combat. Build pairs, full houses, and four of a kind to unleash powerful effects, outplay enemies with higher cards and trumps, and bend the odds with game-changing relics.

details.title: Conveyor Crew
details.short_description: A 1970s analog horror where you descend into a dark 3D warehouse to scavenge parts for your conveyor puzzles while something stalks you in the shadows. Think harder to survive less, or survive more to think less. At Ironside, your survival is just a bonus.

details.title: Another Shoplifting Simulator
details.short_description: Pocket snacks. Dodge guards. Profit. Sneak your way through the store as the shoplifter to make enough money, with the goal doubling daily in this casual FPS simulator!

details.title: Tavern Maid's Daily Life
details.short_description: In 'Tavern Maid’s Daily Life' you play as a maid working at the 'Red Fox Tavern', serving all kinds of customers and enjoying a cozy, eventful everyday life. Between casual chats and daily chores, you’ll gradually uncover the deeper stories and mysteries of the fantasy world around you.

details.title: Beachside Cafe Simulator
details.short_description: Run your own dessert restaurant in a French beach town! Cook crepes, waffles, ice cream and more. Serve tourists and locals, and expand your menu. Manage supplies, hire employees, upgrade your equipment, and grow your space to build your dream seaside dessert spot.

details.title: Souls of the Dead
details.short_description: A bio-catastrophe has engulfed the world, transforming people into bloodthirsty creatures. The only way to stop this plague is to damage the infected's brain. Try to survive this hell – alone or with a partner – while trying to maintain the line between a human and what you're forced to destroy.

details.title: Pattern Ring
details.short_description: A roguelike alignment deck builder. Where you align your runes to cast spells to defeat enemies. Build your deck and craft your spells to meet the challenges ahead. Feed and grow your companion to aid in battle. Before it's too late, journey to the center of the maze and restore the Pattern Ring.

details.title: The Bestest Alchemist
details.short_description: Solve puzzles and brew potions in The Bestest Alchemist, a strategic puzzle roguelike! Freely arrange ingredients to create magical combinations, discover 100+ new recipes, and upgrade your collection to build powerful synergies. Your journey to becoming a master alchemist starts now!

details.title: Aetherion
details.short_description: Aetherion is a 2D action-adventure with exploration, combat and terraforming. Travel through five connected realms as Spark and reshape their landscapes. Your actions affect the Essence Light that holds the world together: where it fades, decay spreads.

details.title: Sherpa's Caravan
details.short_description: 🏔 🚐 ⛺️ 📦 🍳 🛶 Explore a cozy open world as a sherpa driver in your van! Deliver cargo, cook food, craft gear, and explore mountains, lakes, and hidden trails. Sail in boats and kayaks, dive underwater. Meet old friends and upgrade your van! A camping atmosphere and next-gen graphics

details.title: Fix & Flick
details.short_description: Congratulations! You have been selected as this year's officer for the SICRED SYSTEMS Game Weeks. Your assignment is to buy, sell, and fix second-hand consoles while managing your shop. Serve customers. Uncover secrets. Complete your duties. We look forward to your outstanding service.

details.title: Warp Marked
details.short_description: Warp Marked is an incremental space exploration game. Explore a mysterious uncharted dimension, navigate around its dangers, learn its secrets, and return stronger with every launch!

details.title: Worm Game
details.short_description: A puzzle game in which you play as a worm. Push boxes to open the way forward, but beware - it's not so easy to back up when you're a worm.

details.title: Corner Dungeon
details.short_description: Lightweight desktop idle battler. The ultimate workday distraction.

details.title: Force Tilt
details.short_description: A 3D, First-Person, Physics based, Puzzle Platformer.

details.title: Novanoom
details.short_description: A colorful isometric sci-fi action-adventure. Explore handcrafted alien biomes with T.O.A.S.T.E.R., your companion drone, fight strange creatures in real time, and craft tools from what they drop to open hardlight bridges, shortcuts, and the way to the next biome.

details.title: Argosy
details.short_description: Buy low, sail far, sell high. A medieval trading sim with a living economy: build routes, factories and fleets, outwit rival merchants, and rise from humble trader to lord mayor and beyond. Play solo or online.

details.title: Go To Hell
details.short_description: Descend into hell, fight with mouse clicks, collect loot, die, and return stronger. A dark Incremental-RPG about permanent progression and one more attempt.

details.title: TEST 5
details.short_description: Act as AIB Test 5, operate within a surreal virtual skyscraper, wield an extensive arsenal of weapons and gear, defeat hostiles, collect loot, and complete an infinite stream of test trials.

details.title: Hoppyscotch
details.short_description: Hoppyscotch: a puzzle game about frogs, and equity. Hop into the pond, and create accessible pathways to help get all your froggy friends home together. After all, nobody deserves to be left behind!

details.title: No Critters Were Harmed!
details.short_description: No Critters were Harmed is a co-op dungeon-delving adventure for up to four players where players must rush against the clock to escape a collapsing dungeon with a powerful MacGuffin that works to thwart their escape. Treasure, glory, and really cool hats await those who make it out alive!

details.title: Very Disco, Disco Very!
details.short_description: Everyone locks in moves at once, then the simulation takes over. A dense, chaotic programming game for 1 to 8 players where pushes, cards, and chain reactions ensure nothing goes as intended.

details.title: Gravity Goblins
details.short_description: A gravity-bending roguelite collectathon where you ascend an ever-shifting tower. Manipulate geometry to your whims, snag some coins, and play the night away at the local arcade! You'll need all the upgrades and trinkets you can gather to discover the secret buried at the top of The Old Stipe...

details.title: Lulu Dimensional Leaper
details.short_description: Warp through the stage at high speed, dodge attacks, close the distance in an instant, and overwhelm powerful foes in this easy-to-play, exhilarating 2D action game! Enjoy the cool action of a cute girl, along with plenty of meta, lighthearted conversations!

details.title: Duckbound
details.short_description: Welcome to Duckbound, a light-hearted turn-based RPG where mischief meets quackery.

details.title: Carmagist
details.short_description: Civilization vs. the Demon Lord?! Carmagist is a deck-building strategy game set in a ruined world where the Demon Lord has shattered civilization. Lead a nation on the brink of extinction and build up Tech, Funds, and Population to reclaim the future — every choice shapes your nation’s fate.

details.title: Wild Shapers
details.short_description: Weaken enemies with Runes, then consume their weaknesses with a Heavy Attack to unleash chain reactions. Develop your Runes and your hero’s signature abilities to change how you fight in this fast-paced hack-and-slash action roguelite.

details.title: Dungeons & Meows: Hero Cats
details.short_description: Find hidden cats in a medieval fantasy setting. Use heroic skills to rescue kittens in a charming hand-drawn hidden object game.

details.title: Fossil Quest
details.short_description: You have always dreamt of creating your own dinosaur museum and now you finally have the space to do it! Dig for fossils, assemble your exhibits and create the museum of your dreams in this relaxing, wholesome life sim.

details.title: Pollinate or Die
details.short_description: Master a variety of abilities to attack, evade and control waves of enemies and epic bosses. Pollinate beautiful flowers to receive strong buffs. Rejuvenate Earth by cleansing pollution, unlocking many fun special abilities. Save your friends and unite the bees.

details.title: ACCURSED
details.short_description: Investigate the cursed town of Midnight Falls in a roguelike horror RPG. Scavenge powerful relics, outlast vicious foes, and cut down the awakened Ancient Deity before it devours everything. Every run is different, and the town hides secrets in every shadow.

details.title: Tarnex Warfare
details.short_description: Command modern military units along a dynamic frontline, plan operations, and fight battles on maps based on real-world terrain.

details.title: You Remembered
details.short_description: Type letters that fall and become part of the world. Use their shape and attributes to navigate the puzzles and secrets.

details.title: King of Freshwater
details.short_description: "King of Freshwater " is a fish-themed Boss Rush action game featuring intense combat and knockback mechanics. Players control a small fish challenging dozens of larger aquatic predators in brutal battles.

details.title: Aircraft Dispatcher: Ground Operations
details.short_description: Take charge of airport operations. Manage aircraft maintenance, ground support, equipment, and taxiway movements, then leave the office to inspect aircraft, investigate damage, clear FOD, respond to emergencies, and keep flights moving safely and on schedule.

details.title: MegaGum
details.short_description: Play as Uja, an orphan searching for answers in this 3D action adventure platformer. Harness the properties of Gum to stick to walls, inflate, and make your way through the MegaGum factory. Face Mister Gum and his mysterious creations to uncover the secrets hidden behind its colorful facade.

details.title: What Floor?
details.short_description: What Floor? is a first-person analog horror game where you operate a sealed control room on Level −7. Monitor elevators descending from the surface, inspect passengers for signs of biological impostors, and decide who is allowed to reach the Colony below.

details.title: Unfair Dungeon
details.short_description: A cruel and simple movement clicker game. Starting with a 1-in-4 chance to move as planned, can you collect the Coin of Rehtaeh and escape in 10 steps? Rage, upgrade, persevere, and discover multiple endings.

details.title: Begraved
details.short_description: A cosy & dark first-person co-op dungeon crawler where you loot cursed crypts, dodge traps, and flee from things that should not move. Escape with treasures snatched from the dead. Decorate your hideout, uncover buried secrets, and remember: the Taxman always comes for his due.

details.title: Golden Self
details.short_description: A fast paced action roguelike focused on precision combat and punishing boss fights. Embark on a mythic journey to discover your Golden Self.

details.title: GAS
details.short_description: A co-op road trip horror for 4 players from the fan of Spintires, MudRunner and SnowRunner. Loot by day. Survive the night. Defend your car from skeletons, monsters and bad decisions. Go GAS! Go FUN!

details.title: Project: Story about
details.short_description: An RPG where you live life after life in a constantly evolving world, and your choices and relationships influence future cycles.

details.title: In Vino Veritas
details.short_description: Explore a desecrated cathedral to find your missing wife in this psychological horror adventure. Uncover the dark truth behind the Elohim, solve ancient puzzles, and survive a chilling journey where faith and reality collide. The Bible was mistranslated; the truth is much darker

details.title: Codex Arcana: Grimoire of Monsters
details.short_description: Summon an army of Monster Girls to face your enemies in strategic battles! Defeat the Dark Lord's minions and expand your collection with cool, fierce and cute Monster Girls of all variety in this "Capsule Monsters" inspired game!

details.title: Darn Guy Adventures
details.short_description: Darn Guy Adventures is an RPG adventure following the titular Kishan "Darn Guy", Tinta and Norton as they are sent into a mission they are utterly underqualified for. Encounter verbose bushes, mathematical rocks and very loud wolfmen on the quest to save a town with an expiration date.

details.title: Revenant Maze
details.short_description: A first person, action-roguelite that centres around going fast. Enter a procedurally generated maze filled with prototypes and architects intent on defeating you. Create the strongest synergies and blitz all in sight.

details.title: Unlucky
details.short_description: A bullet-heaven wave-based survival gambler roguelike where gambling-powered abilities determine your fate. Survive endless waves in an open world, level up with randomised upgrades, and master the chaos with luck on your side... hopefully.

details.title: Astrolander
details.short_description: Astrolander is an action-packed modern take on retro platformers featuring innovative 2.5D+3D gameplay and unique optional local co-op chaos! Attack enemies with your CDjector, dodge cassette launching boomboxes, and more on your quest to save the Most Valuable Programs!

details.title: Ember Glimmer
details.short_description: This is an anime-styled 3D third-person shooter that seamlessly blends real-time combat with loot mechanics. It features a diverse weapon system including a wide range of distinctive firearms and melee weapons, with combat enhanced by characters' elemental specialty skills.

details.title: DHALMAN
details.short_description: DHALMAN is a single-player action adventure featuring Metroidvania exploration and fighting gameplay across countries, with curry restaurant management between battles. Join DHALMAN on a flavorful journey to face evolving bosses, discover new worlds, and build the world’s greatest curry restaurant.

details.title: VoxelForge
details.short_description: Build block by block. Furnish down to the smallest detail. VoxelForge is a single-player creative building game combining a cubic world, realistic materials and built-in interactive furniture. Design your home, shape its surroundings and explore your creations in first person.

details.title: Plunderfall
details.short_description: A co-op action-adventure where you sail a flying ship through floating islands and plunder loot for gold to meet the Captain's demands.

details.title: Before the Walls Break
details.short_description: Build your village, fortify your walls, and survive relentless waves of enemies in this strategy tower defense game with resource management and active battlefield abilities.

details.title: Shadow Rush
details.short_description: Slay hordes of Shadow Demons in this Action RPG with roguelike elements. Fast-paced combat, quick runs, build experimentation, and re-rolling characters. Spells are collectable, equip-able 'Shards' that trigger when you attack. CAN YOU BEAT THE SPEED OF DARKNESS?

details.title: Zero Trust
details.short_description: An action hacking simulator set in a fully simulated world. Choose your path, craft your own tools, exploit vulnerabilities, and build your reputation. Every company, hacker, and law enforcement agency operates independently — nothing happens by chance. Every playthrough is unique.

details.title: 黑土无归
details.short_description: As an ordinary truck driver seeking the truth behind his father's demise, you must pierce through a web of conspiracy fueled by tech-obsession and a rapidly shifting era.

name: Build It Up! - The Holy Roman Empire

details.title: Build It Up! - The Holy Roman Empire
details.short_description: Build thriving cities in the Holy Roman Empire! Manage resources, production, and trade in a complex economy. Plan defense and siege. Expand your empire through military might or diplomacy and claim the imperial crown!

details.title: Quarantine
details.short_description: A co-op multiplayer survival game where players run a quarantine checkpoint together during an outbreak. Inspect survivors, manage shared resources, argue over decisions, and survive the consequences... or sabotage each other when panic sets in.

details.title: Crow Heist
details.short_description: The HOA have taken everything from Crowley... His nest, his ability to fly, and most important of all, his trinkets! Break into their homes as Crowley for revenge in this 2.5D Platform Comedy game. Unlock their drawers, break their belongings, and steal everything you can to rebuild the crow's home!

details.title: Please The Orb
details.short_description: Please The Orb is a roguelike puzzle deckbuilder about creating game-breaking chaos. Draft bizarre artifacts, arrange them on a grid, and trigger massive cascading chain reactions. Deceptively simple to play, but infinitely complex to master.

details.title: Nascentiar
details.short_description: A classic turn-based roguelike dungeon crawler with D20 dice combat. Three unique classes — a soul-projecting Cultivator, a monster-recruiting Mask Master, and a shadow-stalking Rogue. 117 monsters, randomized identification, and procedural dungeons make every run a new adventure.

details.title: Magic Store Simulator
details.short_description: Inherit an abandoned magic shop and bring the neighborhood back to life. Renovate, upgrade, and customize your shop to attract more customers. Unlock new workshops and expand your product range to meet their needs.

details.title: Eternal 4 Rounds
details.short_description: A dynamic low-poly Tower Defense. Command mobile squads and repel attacks from 4 factions. Collect gold from settlements during battle to craft equipment—the currency for hiring new troops. Defeat titanic bosses, upgrade your camp, and unlock elite tiers for your army!

details.title: Mythalia
details.short_description: Build your team and challenge the tower in this turn-based roguelite monster catching game. Unlock new beasts and upgrades as you play, discover mutations and champions in the 2v2 designed system.

details.title: After Hours
details.short_description: Survive until 6:00 AM in a cooperative asymmetric horror game. Watch cameras, control doors and lights, guide teammates, and complete deadly tasks inside a hostile facility. Communicate under pressure as systems fail, monsters adapt, and one mistake can get you killed. Finish the work. Repeat.

details.title: Settle
details.short_description: A cozy puzzle about decor and history. Explore different eras by arranging authentic items from diverse cultures. Restore harmony to interiors of the past and enjoy the meditative flow.

details.title: Belua
details.short_description: Build a team of monsters, plan your moves carefully, and escape this unjust prison. This unique mash-up of turn-based combat and auto-battlers requires strategy and wits. Every win unlocks a new cute or creepy creature to join your side.

details.title: The Last Ember
details.short_description: Fight endless hordes of enemies in a fast-paced roguelite bullet heaven while bringing life back to a dying wasteland. Capture territory, grow stronger, and discover powerful upgrades that transform you from a fragile spark into an unstoppable force.

details.title: Resonant
details.short_description: Transcend bodies, time, and worlds. In this narrative hybrid of Point & Click Adventure and 2D Platformer, you are a formless Traveler. Shift between post-apocalyptic ruins and neon cyberpunk cities. Solve puzzles, master platforming challenges, and unravel the nature of consciousness.

details.title: Clatter Throne
details.short_description: Your dice are alive! Recruit heroes, arm them with spells one side at a time, roll, and fight for the Clatter Throne in this tabletop roguelike autobattler.

details.title: Formula Rogue
details.short_description: You don’t drive – you make the call. Racing manager meets roguelite deckbuilder: Command two drivers with radio cards through practice, qualifying and race. Gamble on tyres, react to rain and safety cars, and build a team dynasty across eras of new regulations.

details.title: It's Not Me
details.short_description: Become a nameless Princess inside an unfinished video game from 1986. Explore, interact and choose your responses in a narrative adventure about identity and self-determination, with nine chapters and four endings shaped by your choices.

details.title: Mulligan Mayhem
details.short_description: Golf, but the course is cursed. Tee off in peace, then fight the undead horde that wakes the moment your ball lands. Launch zombies with your driver, bowl them into each other and knock them into water hazards, with up to 4 players in couch or online co-op.

details.title: Dead Apples Dream
details.short_description: The hitchhiker who went missing playing the "Dead Apples Dare"...it turns out she recorded a second tape. Tranquil green spaces change to dark corridors...it's like she's stuck in a dream...or nightmare. Watch to the end to solve the mystery...and remember to leave room for pie.

details.title: Bloomsgrove
details.short_description: Bloomsgrove is a short incremental game about a ghost in a forgotten tomb overgrown with plants. Tend to your grave by harvesting various weeds and plants while uncovering memories of who you once were.

details.title: Puppetria
details.short_description: A slightly unusual tea party in an old mansion. As you serve tea and sweets, teapots begin to dance and little ghosts appear... Your job is to quietly smooth over the mansion's lively welcome. Keep an eye on each new surprise and make sure the tea party stays elegant until the very end.

details.title: Operation Knockback
details.short_description: Grapple-hook and shotgun-blast your way up a gigantic tower on a dying planet. Explore unforgiving biomes and create shortcuts by exploiting push-n'-pull physics. Mistakes are not allowed. 50% of developer profits after platform fees goes to charity.

details.title: Feuds
details.short_description: A turn-based game of feuding rulers. Take a realm one contested land at a time, and settle every claim in a compact tactical battle where each unit you place is a promise, each arrow a threat, and every tile you hold is counted when the dust settles.

details.title: Revenant of Tsushima
details.short_description: Explore haunted shrines and lantern-lit graveyards in a first-person Japanese folklore horror adventure. Collect wandering spirits, investigate strange clues, and uncover the secrets beyond the torii gates.

details.title: Holdout!
details.short_description: Holdout! is a chaotic co-op tower defense roguelite. With friends or solo, mine ore, smelt bullets, assemble ammo and haul it to your towers while bugs swarm toward the core. Between waves, buy new buildings and pick challenge cards.

details.title: KINGDOM ROAD
details.short_description: You fall asleep after work with your bugs unfixed, and wake up inside your own game. Build a deck from the Summon Cards you created, and turn the tide of real-time battles with tower placement and well-timed hero summons.

details.title: Archive Protocol
details.short_description: Fight, build and preserve what remains. VEIGLER: Archive Protocol combines top-down action roguelite combat with base building and tower defense. Expand your Signal Network, defend the Broadcast Core and recover lost Archive data before you extract.

details.title: The Edgelands
details.short_description: A cyberpunk city builder. Start with a desert wasteland. Build the roads, zone the blocks and turn a stretch of dust into a sprawling megacity of neon and towering Spires. Keep the streets under control, strike deals with megacorps and build your own version of utopia.

details.title: Necrosurge
details.short_description: A roguelite reverse tower defense game. You are the necromancer, and for once the Inquisition has to defend. Before each raid you set up your horde on the battlefield. Then your undead march, and the fortress strikes back. Between raids, you cross the campaign map towards boons, events and bosses.

details.title: CastleBonk
details.short_description: Charge your jump, miss the ledge and fall hard. CastleBonk combines merciless Jump King climbing with Souls-like combat: parry, roll, defeat giant bosses and find out who you were before you woke up at the foot of the castle.

details.title: Star Han: Mech Generals
details.short_description: Three Kingdoms generals pilot war mechs in a turn-based roguelite where placement is power. Fit weapons, shields, thrusters and stratagem chips into your Module Grid, chain adjacency bonuses, and borrow Gold when you need it, if you can stay ahead of the interest.

details.title: Mystery House
details.short_description: A first and third-person horror revival of Roberta Williams' Mystery House - the 1980 classic that invented the graphic adventure. A game night in an abandoned Victorian House turns deadly. Solve its puzzles, uncover a buried legacy, and escape before the house kills you.

details.title: ENTWINE
details.short_description: A first-person psychological horror videogame. In St. Agnes’ Forest, Man bears a mark he cannot wash away. Walk the opened body of photoreal 1990s Americana as Lucas, an ex-police officer; search the estate, defenseless, in an ever-changing nightmare. “At the end of my life, I find the devil.”

details.title: SHAROTANK - ROAD TO KYSHTYM
details.short_description: Drive a spherical tank across the dried remains of the Aral Sea. Scavenge resources, haul heavy cargo with a magnetic trailer, upgrade modules and survive encounters with mutated machinery.

details.title: SketchBrawl
details.short_description: Sketchbrawl is an auto-battler: draft squads from six factions, deploy them on the grid, and watch hundreds of units clash on their own. Promote squads to ★★★, let your commander’s skill turn the tide, and survive ten rounds to clear the Arena.

details.title: RABAUKEN - Spirit Resort
details.short_description: Build a spirit resort. Research. Expand. Idle. Crowd-control spirits. Repeat. An automation game designed to be played on the side.

details.title: ISO-CORE
details.short_description: Farm, craft, build, and explore a Beautiful isometric pixel art world. Explore new places and find new biomes to expand your list of items, buildings, and recipes.

details.title: Rover's Tale
details.short_description: A creature-collecting metroidvania, in a world where dogs live on forever amongst the stars as Space Rovers! Become a LAIKA Rover! Catch & research creatures, then use their abilities to explore a new frontier! Upgrade & customize, as you help your canine companions to unravel an ancient mystery!

details.title: Snow White Ashes
details.short_description: Lose your heart in this dark fairy-tale romance! Once upon a winter night, you enter the woods in search of a beast. But the hunter you find is so charming and sweet–is he truly the monster you seek?

details.title: Trizna
details.short_description: “Trizna” is a classic plot-driven 2.5D metroidvania filled with intense battles utilizing the unique features of weapons, evasions, parries, and counterattacks. Explore the mysterious and eerie realm deeply intertwined with pagan beliefs, with blade, magic and a keen mind.

details.title: 风旅人 Wind Traveler
details.short_description: This is a semi open world ARPG game with HD2D pixel style. In the game, players will play the role of the story protagonist "Red haired Suka" and embark on an exciting adventure in a beautiful continent called Wind Canyon.

details.title: Dicewood
details.short_description: A tiny pack of tiny creatures was lost in the woods. The food was scarce, they had to choose who will be left behind... Fight through the dark forest and save all the creatures.

details.title: Just do it ! (干就完了! )
details.short_description: This game combines Mount & Blade: Warband and The Elder Scrolls V, featuring battles in a magical, multi-racial world. Be a mercenary, lord, or wealthy tycoon. Play solo or online for fun!

details.title: When Livia Disappeared
details.short_description: A fantasy visual novel set in the 1920s. Perform ritual magic, craft potions, and uncover the secrets of the Order that maintains the balance between worlds.

details.title: YAKOH SHINOBI OPS
details.short_description: Four ninjas speed through the darkness, moving as one to fulfill their mission. YAKOH: This is the way of the ninja—a mission undertaken by the shadows known as Shinobi. A new-generation cooperative Shinobi stealth action game brought by ACQUIRE Corp. and SHUEISHA GAMES.

details.title: Pin-Crawl
details.short_description: Pin-Crawl is a dungeon crawling pinball rogue-lite! Bop, bash and dash your way through a dungeon of weird and wacky foes as you collect abilities and upgrades on your way to defeating the Evil Sorceress!

details.title: Vizarri
details.short_description: A monster-taming RPG set on the planet of Valaar. Capture and train mystical creatures known by the locals as Vizarri. Battle other trainers in tactical, turn-based combat on a dynamic grid. Explore islands, collect items, and outsmart a rising enemy force. These are the Adventures of Valaar.

details.title: Jet Birds
details.short_description: A challenging, physics-based, 3D platformer where you fly jetpack-powered birds through ring circuits suspended through nature. Not a casual flying game or a flight simulator, but a precision platformer that demands (and rewards) determination and practice.

details.title: Lecture Me Later
details.short_description: Just having a pleasant chat with one of the most popular guys in the University. Nothing weird about that, right? So why is he kinda... different than you've imagined?

details.title: Rebuilt: Last Settlement
details.short_description: Manage the last farmhouse settlement in a zombie-infested city. Grow food, craft weapons, send teams to scavenge, and defend your settlement every night from relentless zombie hordes until you are strong enough to escape.

details.title: Amara
details.short_description: Manage and grow your cozy café from scratch in a world full of adorable talking cats. Craft authentic coffee drinks inspired by real barista techniques, upgrade your shop, serve your fluffy customers, and become beloved by all.

details.title: Slay the King
details.short_description: Chess, but you build an army, bolt game-breaking augments onto your pieces, and tear through realms of enemies. Exploding pawns, bishops that cleanse the board with holy fire, a king that ascends into a demon slaying god. Stack upgrades, ascend, get rich, Slay The King.

details.title: 吾之半身乃纯白恶魔
details.short_description: 黑神露娜，是一名喜欢「中二幻想」的普通高中少女。 某一天，一场意外让她的日常彻底改变。一位与她有着不可思议联系的神秘少女突然出现，原本平静的校园生活，也随之卷入了一连串难以解释的事件。 当真相逐渐浮出水面，她们将如何面对彼此、面对命运，又将做出怎样的选择？

details.title: Station Between
details.short_description: A cozy, small-scale, coffee shop and talking simulator. As a raccoon barista, you have a gift for warming people’s hearts: brew coffee, match flavours to your customers and discover their stories. Help travellers sort out their final errands before they catch their last train.

details.title: Expand TD
details.short_description: Expand TD is a tower defense roguelite. Explore the map between waves, build your defenses, and discover useful locations, strange encounters, hidden rewards, and dangerous threats on every run.

details.title: Armored clash
details.short_description: "Armored Clash" - Modern Main Battle Tanks in Combat, All Preparations Complete

details.title: That Cozy Cat Game
details.short_description: A relaxing online co-op game where you and your friends explore a colorful island as customizable CATS. Go fishing, chat, find new discoveries, earn kibbles, and dress up your cat.

details.title: BACKROOMS PINTEROI
details.short_description: BACKROOMS PINTEROI: Explore the endless Backrooms on your own or with your friends. Survive ‘terrifying’ entities, solve puzzles, manage your resources and find your way out. Each level features new puzzles, entities and things to discover. Two new levels are added every month :)

details.title: Virus Promoter
details.short_description: Welcome aboard, Virus Promoter! One card sparks a chain reaction. One Trinket bends the rules. One combo sends the numbers spiraling out of control! Build your outrageous deck and spread your viruses on an unprecedented scale! Your success is the world's catastrophe!

name: Strange Tales from a Chinese Studio 2: Fox Sister

details.title: Strange Tales from a Chinese Studio 2: Fox Sister
details.short_description: Late Tang turmoil unleashes ghosts and fiends, turning the Sixteen Prefectures of Yan and Yun into a haunted wasteland. Play as a general’s second son, journeying south with your ghost elder sister and fox-spirit younger sister for the fabled paradise. Will you find it?

details.title: Giantess Naval Defense
details.short_description: Giantess Naval Defense is a “Giant Girl vs. Kaiju Naval Artillery Defense Game” where you control Orca, the only giant beast humanity can rely on, and fight back against hordes of invading kaiju with devastating naval gunfire.

details.title: Stream Snipers
details.short_description: Stream Snipers is a multiplayer battle game about doing ANYTHING for content! Fight your friends for followers, grow your totally real audience, get rich taking on ridiculous challenges from chat, and strive to stay alive in the deadliest live competition.

details.title: TreeLine
details.short_description: Grow strange trees that don't exist in the wild, chop them down swing by swing, fill the morning truck, and pay off what you owe — one day at a time. A first-person orchard sim about honest work and heavy debt.

details.title: Haunted Cleaner
details.short_description: Haunted Cleaner is a relaxing, light puzzle and narrative game about tidying up and decorating the homes of the deceased. Play as a psychic cleaner, uncover the stories left behind and help lingering ghosts find peace. Remember, every place tells a story, you just need to listen.

details.title: TAMBOURINE
details.short_description: A priestess is hired to exorcize an apartment building with a TAMBOURINE. Parry and torment ghosts in this first-person survival horror as you make your way up the building. Find the mementos that will allow you to complete the exorcism.

details.title: Nowhere Dawn
details.short_description: Nowhere Dawn is a survival action game set in a collapsed world. Move through cities and towns haunted by the infected, and follow the traces left behind by those who disappeared.

details.title: Operation Serval
details.short_description: Operation Serval is a tactical multiplayer armored warfare game where you command tanks and combat vehicles against enemy teams on realistic battlefields, where positioning and precision decide the outcome.

details.title: Night Mass
details.short_description: You’re a Priest defending your Church from the horrors that come each night. Gather resources, explore the forest, and build your defenses while the sun is still shining. When darkness falls, stand your ground, survive until dawn, and let the Night Mass begin!

details.title: Pale Cantons
details.short_description: A first-person sandbox RPG set in a secluded canton ringed by impassable mountains. Learn trades, fight, barter, earn the locals’ trust, and search for your missing sister but remember: the only way out leads through an ever-changing labyrinth.

details.title: RETROBOTS
details.short_description: The year is 2109, and RETROBOTS is the world's most chaotic sport. Select your Retrobot, customize and tune it to perfection, and enter the battle. Smash, slam, launch, and destroy your opponents in arenas across the world. Are you ready to KICK SOME BOT?

details.title: The Arrow
details.short_description: The Arrow is a retro wave-based horror shooter set in a world reshaped by a religious military sect. Fight alone or with friends as you push through war‑torn ruins in a crusade to spread the one true god.

details.title: Sushi Restaurant Simulator
details.short_description: Manage your own sushi restaurant, cook Japanese specialties, serve customers, manage inventory, hire staff, upgrade your equipment, and build the sushi restaurant of your dreams.

details.title: Halls of Jötunn
details.short_description: Halls of Jötunn is a first-person atmospheric dungeon crawler set in a forgotten Norse world after Ragnarök. Explore ancient ruins, survive brutal tactical combat, uncover lost True Names, and fight your way home to the family waiting beyond death.

details.title: Party Ships
details.short_description: Party Ships is the party brawler that's secretly a physics sandbox. Mix ridiculous items into accidental synergies and unleash them on your mates! Last one standing wins. Simple... right?

details.title: Feetball
details.short_description: A fast-paced first-person football game where precision, skill, and chaos collide. Take full control of every touch, tackle, and strike with realistic ball physics and fluid physical movement. Master the pitch with friends, or team up with others looking to dominate.

details.title: Lazare's Sacrifice
details.short_description: The guillotine awaits. Your only escape? A deck of cards. Play for your life against legends of the French Revolution in this gripping narrative deckbuilder. Solve puzzles in the depths of prison to uncover the truth of your captivity. Cards, health, sanity... What will you sacrifice to survive?

details.title: Ad Reditus
details.short_description: A hand-drawn roundtrip roguelike deckbuilder about a pilgrimage and a ring that wants to change you. Build your deck on the way out. Decide what it becomes on the way back.

details.title: Tiny Biomes
details.short_description: A build-your-own aquarium sandbox. Shape the glass, sculpt the substrate, design every plant, hang the lights, then stock the water and live with what you made.

details.title: Duco
details.short_description: A roguelike survival game where you can also interact with NPCs, encounter gangs, and build a small settlement of your own… but with cards. Loot, craft, and survive. Unlock characters and maps, and combine them with traits to create unique runs.

details.title: The Great Bitcoin (Non-)Heist
details.short_description: You paid 99 cents for a busted database full of jumbled interrogation transcripts from four people. The seller promised clues to a Bitcoin case worth over $500,000. 99 cents! What a steal! Shame this thing only lets you search, search, search. The thinking's on you.

details.title: Incinerator Inc
details.short_description: You are a pyro for hire. In Incinerator Inc, people come to you with their problems and you make their problems… unrecoverable… It’s a easy business model. Because some stains only fire can shift.

details.title: Dronefall
details.short_description: Dronefall is a deck-building tower defense game where you defend humanity's last cities against relentless drone swarms.

details.title: YO UP!
details.short_description: YO UP! is a chaotic co-op physics building game where one wrong move can collapse everything. Build unstable towers solo or with friends, climb floating islands, and reach for space... if your tower holds.

details.title: Flight Date
details.short_description: Getting everyone in the same place should be easy… right? Flight Date is a logic puzzle that turns seemingly simple meetups into absurdly complicated travel plans. Untangle the logistical chaos, find the right routes, and share in the little moments each meetup leaves behind.

details.title: Fractal Flyers
details.short_description: Fractal Flyers let's you fly through Real-Time 3D fractals using FPV drone controls (or traditional winged controls) — Lose yourself in the music across multiple hand-animated challenge levels and soar through the leader-boards.

details.title: The Line Must Not Stop
details.short_description: Take control of a crumbling metro line in a cyberpunk world. Transport passengers, build and upgrade your trains, enhance your systems, and complete various missions. Fight off threats, automate transit, and bring THE LINE back to life!

details.title: Loaded Dice
details.short_description: A dice-driven roguelike where you build an unpredictable deck, chain devastating charms, and roll massive Yatzy combos to hit the target score before your luck finally runs out.

details.title: Fates of Command
details.short_description: Shields up, red alert! YOU are the captain. Experience the thrill of command in this captain's chair roguelike: engage in combat, manage your crew, upgrade your ship, explore, make scientific discoveries and perform a dash of diplomacy.

details.title: THE OMEGA REACH
details.short_description: Reach for the stars, gather their instruments, and curate the best collection in the universe! THE OMEGA REACH is a point-and-click museum simulator (and dungeon crawler) where you are a musical genius.

name: Guardians of the Abyss: Rogue Protocol

details.title: Guardians of the Abyss: Rogue Protocol
details.short_description: Fast-paced roguelite where you switch combat styles mid-fight, destroy the world around you, and survive an ever-escalating challenge. Adapt, master your skills, and push your limits as each run becomes faster, deadlier, and more unforgiving.

details.title: SKY DRIFT
details.short_description: Cute but challenging roguelite platformer-inspired game where you fly through a strange oversized world with a broken rocket and limited fuel. Avoid deadly obstacles, collect gems, and upgrade after every crash. No checkpoints. Start over and fly further.

details.title: Kegs of Eternity
details.short_description: A roguelite deckbuilder starring seven stubborn dwarves. Build unique decks, slay cursed monsters, crawl procedural dungeons, drink plenty of beer, find broken synergies, and rebuild your ruined town, one keg, one combo, one dwarf at a time.

details.title: Nothing Ever Happens Here
details.short_description: A British life sim set in a real town, with a real Grandad at its core. Can you turn your life around, save his pub, and make something of yourself?

details.title: Keeper of The Strait
