details.short_description: You are the gatekeeper of a vital strait. Inspect manifests, collect fees, and block hostile ships in this hybrid of bureaucratic simulation and tower defense. When diplomacy fails, deploy tanks and bunkers to protect your base.

name: Death Line: Don’t Stop 斩杀线：极限生机

details.title: Death Line: Don’t Stop 斩杀线：极限生机
details.short_description: If life’s pressure were a physical shredder, could you outrun it? > Balance Health and Wealth on a razor’s edge in this minimalist survival-gambit. Utilize "Class-based Speed" to outsmart Death. Can you tear through the veil and reveal the truth behind the machine before your strength fails?

details.title: Veil of the Black Ark
details.short_description: A classic fixed-camera survival horror game set in a cursed medieval town. Search for your missing sister, solve puzzles, survive the roaming dead and unveil the secrets of the Black Ark.

details.title: BODY COUNT
details.short_description: Drive to catch bodies, crash to rewind time. Road rage at your past selves in this physics-driven, arcade-style game!

details.title: Glitch Forest
details.short_description: A reverse bullet hell roguelite where weather reshapes the battlefield every 5 minutes! Combine active items, skills, and relics into game-breaking builds. Activate beacons, crush elites, and return to base stronger every run!

details.title: one more bottle
details.short_description: In ONE MORE BOTTLE, every cap you twist off hides a tiny puzzle, a prize, or a wish. Collect caps, build your shelf, and chase the rare one stamped 再来一瓶 — One More Bottle. A cozy solo puzzle-meets-gacha about luck, patience, and the hope that the next one will be the lucky one.

details.title: Bot.by.Bot
details.short_description: Build and program customizable robots using simple logic systems to overcome clever grid-based challenges and help Robby reunite with his friends.

details.title: Idle Resistance
details.short_description: The machines never stop attacking. So you must keep firing. Recruit gunners, unlock deadly weapons, and plan your way through a sprawling skill tree to break through the next wave.

details.title: Satellite Odyssey Online
details.short_description: Survive in a huge living world seen from above. Every rock and tree has real properties: gather, smelt and craft your way from a stone axe to a musket. Build a home, hunt wild animals, join a clan and claim your place on the official server.

details.title: Tiny Tenants
details.short_description: Tiny Tenants is cozy real estate management game about greed, trust and tiny lives. Bid on flawed properties, renovate homes, and keep your tenants happy while growing your business.

details.title: Lumen Nexus: Core
details.short_description: A sci-fi factory automation game where resources move as light instead of belts. Build production chains, expand across asteroid islands, trade your resources, research new systems, and keep your growing factory flowing under rising pressure.

details.title: Sheepping
details.short_description: Sheepping is a relaxing farm simulator in which you take care of your sheep, shear fluffy wool, spin it into yarn, and weave it into cozy clothing.

details.title: Sandbox Zombies
details.short_description: An action level editor. With zombies. Carefully set up your own elaborate scenarios, or revel in causing chaos. With no innate goal, Sandbox Zombies trusts you to find fun in creativity and mischief. Explore a depth of systems and share your levels with friends.

details.title: Peace Island
details.short_description: Twenty years ago, the paradise was revived. After the signing of the "Tide City Peace Agreement", the Atlantic United States and the Blazing Sun Empire hired desperate individuals to delve into the cursed inner islands in search of those lost angels.

details.title: Latticefall
details.short_description: Latticefall is a slow-burn colony sim. The disaster doesn't strike — it creeps: an infection seeps quietly across the land. Build your settlement, hold the line, and reclaim ground one step at a time — paused and deliberate, never twitchy. Every advance has a price; you see it before you commit.

details.title: Birth of Nation
details.short_description: Birth of Nation is an alternate‑history strategy game blending interactive movie gameplay. In cinematic experience players can make choices affecting the plot and resources to manage a refugee nation, engage in diplomacy and trade, and ultimately gather forces for tactical battles against foes.

details.title: Popcorn Idle
details.short_description: Popcorn Idle is a cozy idle automation game about the simple joy of popping corn. Earn money, buy upgrades, automate and turn up the heat to boost production. Grow bigger numbers, unlock flavors and combine effects. Fill the whole machine with colorful, tasty popcorn, one crunchy pop at a time.

details.title: Who's Calling?
details.short_description: A home invasion thriller where your phone is your main enemy. The everyday routine, office work, and chores turn into a trap when an unknown person starts tracking every step you take. You've never been able to say no. Now you'll have to.

details.title: GUNBUTCHER
details.short_description: 90 seconds. An alien horde, ridiculous weapons, and zero time to breathe. Exterminate them all or die trying!

details.title: Chibits: The King's Tomb
details.short_description: Collect, train, and battle Chibits in a fast-paced roguelike card game. Manage your creatures between runs, master tactical combat, and travel through a branching galaxy where every choice shapes your destiny.

details.title: Co-op Chaos in Berlin
details.short_description: 4-player co-op bullet-heaven Survivor-like set in robot-overrun Berlin: auto-fire ridiculous weapons and choice-of-3 your way to broken builds. Solo works. Friends recommended.

details.title: Hyperspin
details.short_description: Hyperspin is an experimental rhythm game where you control a circle that spins on a circle, and you tap circles. There are lots of circles.

details.title: I Need To Go
details.short_description: A naive metalhead wakes up in a strange, dreamlike cave with no idea how he got there, and no sign of his girlfriend. A fully voiced pixel art point-and-click adventure where humor meets the heart.

details.title: Leap Galaxy
details.short_description: Leap Galaxy is a 2D platformer with a minimalistic aesthetic and gameplay that puts speed and flow first. Take advantage of momentum and master the recoil of your shots to reach insane speeds and beat each level as fast as posible!

details.title: Desecrated Deck
details.short_description: Desecrated Deck is a first-person psychological horror card game where you face a spectral opponent in a forbidden occult ritual of Rock, Paper, Scissors, powerful Item Cards, and supernatural Perks. Win the game — or discover what happens when you don’t.

details.title: 咏唱魔女 witch's Aria
details.short_description: "Witch's Area" is an RPG game with a core gameplay mechanic centered around combining cards to create spells, featuring light strategic roguelike elements. Combine different cards to craft your unique spells and uncover the truth behind the little witch's cyclical dreams!

details.title: Monad Tachyon
details.short_description: Accelerate beyond the speed of sound! Monad Tachyon is the ultimate high-speed Metroidvania .

details.title: MESS
details.short_description: MESS is a multiplayer first-person jailbreak game where strategy, deception, and survival collide in a prison environment. Experience yourself in a role of Warden to maintain order, or Prisoner to try to break free and escape the prison.

details.title: CactusBandido
details.short_description: Love your friends? Too bad: in Thorn City, you're going to steal their loot. Face off with up to 6 players, outsmart the sheriff, and let the richest cactus win!

details.title: Echo Era
details.short_description: Build a party, explore a kingdom under tyranny, and choose your battles in this classic-style JRPG. Recruit adventurers by class, uncover side quests and secrets, and face enemies in turn-based combat. The goddess has called, now lead your journey to where ever it may end.

details.title: Make Them Mine
details.short_description: An incremental game where you build slime-shooting cannons to mine gold... wait, what? That's right: build cannons on a grid and shoot slimes to mine gold, smash enemies and activate mysterious mechanisms. Complete the skill tree to unlock new cannons, slime upgrades, and new mechanics.

details.title: Rokujo Hitoma
details.short_description: A 1-bit action-adventure, a shy shut-in descending from his tiny six-tatami room into the underground. Top-down exploration, enemy battles, key hunting, and the power of true friendship. (There is no friendship.)

details.title: Mindvale
details.short_description: Master frantic bullet-hell runs, turn hard-won knowledge into game-breaking builds and bring resources back to the surface. Craft, expand your base against the ever-enclosing corruption, produce more to heal your land’s mysterious affliction and defeat the Death Core.

details.title: Camedieo
details.short_description: A score chase roguelike deckbuilder played with dice. Every hand splits in two: the dice you Cast and the ones you Outcast. The points from each are multiplied together to produce your score. Collect cameos, upgrade your deck using cups and try to break the scoreboard!

details.title: Empty Throne
details.short_description: Create your hero, recruit a warband and lead them across a dying kingdom. Battles unfold in real time in 3D while you play cards from your hand. If your hero falls, the run is over.

details.title: Manei Monogatari
details.short_description: 1939, Manchuria. Build a life and make films at the Man’ei studio in this historical adventure. Plan your days, assemble a crew, and navigate censorship, ambition, and survival. Your choices shape your relationships, your films, and your ending.

details.title: The Word
details.short_description: Decipher hundreds of cryptograms that recount the story of Jesus Christ. From His birth and baptism, to His many healings and teachings, and ultimately to His death and resurrection.

details.title: Ever Closer Union
details.short_description: Ever Closer Union is a turn-based political strategy game where you slip into the role of the President of the European Commission and guide the EU through the next term. Win over 27 member states, push your Agenda forward, deal with events and both national and European Parliament elections.

details.title: SPSPSP
details.short_description: SPSPSP is a shoot 'em up deckbuilder where you draft your own targets. Chain enemy synergies to inflate their scrap value, then shoot them down to cash out. Survive the wave you just empowered. The toll rises every cycle. Greed is the difficulty slider.

details.title: Rise To Valor
details.short_description: A 2D/3D Hybrid Turn-Based RPG set during WW2. Utilize all of the abilities at your disposal to beat back the German war machine.

details.title: Things Left Unsaid
details.short_description: A tiny, cozy, hand-drawn ASMR game. Every antique arrives in loose pieces: click them back together, brush away the dust, trace the cracks in gold lacquer, and press the wax seal. Then haggle with quirky collectors at your counter. Each piece holds a story left unsaid.

details.title: Babylumns
details.short_description: Babylumns is a fast-paced versus puzzle arcade inspired by 90s arcade and 16-bit classics. Match, combo, and unleash character abilities in tense, replayable battles.

name: Professor Mong Mong: The Window to the North

details.title: Professor Mong Mong: The Window to the North
details.short_description: Investigate a haunting mystery inspired by Nordic folklore in a story-rich 2D point-and-click adventure. Explore the remote Faroe Islands, uncover forgotten secrets, solve paranormal puzzles, and discover what lies beyond the Window to the North.

details.title: Solbound
details.short_description: Fight, salvage and trade across the moons and rings of a solar system nobody can leave. Take what you can carry. Read what the dead left behind. Everything you do is remembered.

details.title: Echoes of the Veil
details.short_description: Jack Graves has been invited to a mysterious mansion by a killer who has yet to finish their work. Investigate supernatural echoes, uncover the next victims, and stop the culprit before it’s too late.

details.title: Idle Misadventures
details.short_description: Recruit a party of classic RPG heroes and send them adventuring for levels and loot. Conquer the realm, then retire your heroes to unlock new classes, mechanics, and meta bonuses that make the next generation even stronger. Play actively to speed your progress, or idle your way to victory!

details.title: Falcons of the Red Planet
details.short_description: As part of a dedicated combat astro-fighter squadron of the Red Mars Space Force, you must defend the solar system from the oppression of the ruthless Alliance of Empires.

details.title: Boiler & Blood
details.short_description: Build and command a dieselpunk war train, manage its crew, and wield forbidden sorcery in a real-time-with-pause tactical roguelite. Destroy the enemy command train before the pursuing army catches you.

details.title: Songs of the Shoals
details.short_description: Cast a line, sail between islands, and bring your catch home in a single-player fishing adventure. Sell fish, take harbor commissions, upgrade your gear, and explore coastal villages under changing skies. Take a seaplane flight for a new view of the sea.

details.title: Night to Reticle +6
details.short_description: Nozomu follows his wife to Kyushu and meets the enigmatic KANA. Accept or refuse his nightly “invitations”? Replay the six-day story to uncover the truth. A choice-driven BL psychological adventure with a seme (top) protagonist. The complete edition of the free game Night to Reticle.

details.title: Three Kingdoms The Mainland
details.short_description: 在群雄割据的三国乱世中，从零开始建设村庄，发展势力、抵御敌军，最终统一天下。

details.title: KalshwK
details.short_description: Get aboard the Ghost Train and fight with 99 lives worth of hardship to forge your own destiny with the unnatural grasp of KalshwK Desert : Top-Down 2d Roguelite Shooter

details.title: Sceadu Eard
details.short_description: Sceadu Eard is a hardcore retro-style open-world dungeon crawler set in an eerie dark fantasy world. Craft gear at your base, gather resources, master methodical combat, unlock new paths and return safely from each expedition.

details.title: Hazardous Employment
details.short_description: Hire expendable heroes, arrange their formation, and send them into automated fantasy expeditions in this darkly comedic guild-management roguelite. Manage contracts, injuries, morale, payroll, and debt—then file the paperwork when your best employees fail to return.

details.title: Bad Ideas Game Jam Collection 2026
details.short_description: The Bad Ideas Game Jam Collection 2026 is a showcase of 50 short-form videos and single-player games that encompass a variety of genres from visual novels, platformers, rpgs shooters, rhythm, and puzzle games. Each following a theme of trying to make games that think Outside the Box!

details.title: The Dangers of Liminality
details.short_description: A first person survival horror game set in The Backrooms. Explore and survive in this liminal expanse of many levels while maintaining your sanity, with realistic yet distinct graphics. You may attempt to run or fight, but how far will that really get you?

details.title: Walls Have Eyes
details.short_description: A racket. A ball. A court that fights back. A first-person adventure built on real squash, set at night in an old mansion turned squash club, where the creatures you face are part of the courts you play in.

details.title: RIDGERUNNERS
details.short_description: RIDGERUNNERS is a first-person mountain racer. Build speed downhill and fly between checkpoints using gravity and your weapons. Find the fastest route, race ghosts and live players, and climb the global leaderboard.

details.title: HUEMON
details.short_description: A creature collector where your whole team fights at once. Field five HUEMON on a grid where one jumps over others, another anchors nearby enemies, and positioning beats raw power. Collect them across a world still learning to be colorful.

details.title: Hollow Heart
details.short_description: Hollow Heart is a growth‑simulation game about forbidden human transmutation and twisted sisterly devotion. As the elder sister, you gather materials, rebuild your little sister’s soul and body, and attempt to revive her in a more “perfect” form.

details.title: The Witch and the Wish
details.short_description: You are the Holy Lady of the Kanan Empire, repeating your accustomed life day after day, thinking that your life will never change. However, one day, an unexpected event occurs, and you can no longer return to the temple. What choice will you make?

details.title: Hell Operators
details.short_description: Command a squad of military operators in a satirical hellscape. Enemy hordes don't come in waves, they fuse and evolve into emergent ecosystems. Each operator has their own class, gear progression, and permanent upgrades in the form of cybernetic implants, DNA extensions, and paranormal abilities.

details.title: Lumory: A Distant Summer
details.short_description: Wander through bright liminal spaces shaped by distant summer memories. Ride a childhood scooter, reveal hidden paths with Dream Vision, and capture surreal moments with your camera. No combat—just calm exploration.

details.title: 盲盒指挥官
details.short_description: Blind Box Commander is a toy brick-style RTS with deckbuilding, blind box draws, and classic base tech. Build a 24-card deck, expand your base, unlock units, and adapt your tactics in real time as every match delivers new combinations and fresh strategic battles.

details.title: BrokenLore: DON'T PLAY
details.short_description: A first-person psychological horror game where a mysterious experimental video game invades reality. Face five increasingly disturbing levels and survive their consequences as Hideo slips toward identity loss.

details.title: Robot Rhapsody
details.short_description: A turn-based RPG following Selva, a retired mercenary; Aurum, a poetic "robot bard"; and allies including engineers, luddite artists, and survivors fighting back against AI-controlled "utopias". Recruit machines to your side, upgrade with salvaged tech, & explore bizarre pockets of human resistance.

details.title: Cutout
details.short_description: Dismember your enemies and steal their limbs to gain new powers in this side-scrolling action horror game set in a grim, handcrafted fairy tale world made of paper. Rebuild Lena, child of the forest, and shape who she becomes through the choices you make.

details.title: Rebounder
details.short_description: Nail the run. Deliver your line. Rebounder is a hand-crafted precision platformer about a roughneck worker recruited for a hazardous job on a distant planet. A tough-but-fair gauntlet set in a surreal comic-book world of ink, paper, and print.

details.title: Exile 2097: Space Odyssey
details.short_description: Exile 2097: Space Odyssey is a near-future hard sci-fi epic. Lead the Human Continuity Government, build solar-system colonies, upgrade space stations, shape society, uncover the AI rebellion threat, and guide humanity’s final return to Earth amid unknown dangers.

details.title: PANGIT
details.short_description: A special agent infiltrates the restricted territory of a former military base and faces the greatest challenge of his life. He must escape the zone by surviving among warring factions and the infected, and uncover the secret of the labyrinth where the mysterious Pangit is hidden.

details.title: Cardboard Cowboy
details.short_description: Cardboard Cowboy, the cardboard Wild West shooter. Blast through handcrafted paper shooting galleries, dual-wield makeshift revolvers and shotguns, and chase high scores across three outlaw-filled regions. Beat timed weapon challenges. Collect tarot cards. Unlock the ultimate cardboard loadout.

details.title: Soom
details.short_description: SOOM is a quarter-view 3D action-adventure built around parrying and counterattacking. Become a totem deity who once granted human wishes, and set out to pursue a wish of your own in a world where stagnant wishes have turned into monsters.

details.title: Big Cock Inc.
details.short_description: A cozy farm sim where you arm your cocks with AK-47s and bet the rent on them in club fights. Breed the best chickens, steal and sell their eggs, send the rest down the conveyor to the fryer, and serve them through your own fried chicken drive-thru.

details.title: Yemen: The Lover
details.short_description: You travel to a remote village in Yemen to meet the woman you fell in love with online. But the locals warn you that nobody lives there anymore. So who has been waiting for you?

details.title: BloodBuild
details.short_description: BloodBuild is a roguelike deckbuilder built around build-crafting, where the challenge isn't collecting items - it's making them work together. You progress by fusing, enchanting and combining your loot into ever more powerful builds, against ever stronger enemies.

details.title: Crown of Jerusalem
details.short_description: Rule a kingdom, lead its knights, and choose the turning points of the Crusades. November 1177: the Leper King, sixteen and ill, faces Saladin's army. Ride out, or wait for help? A historical strategy game of the Crusader states, 1098–1191, with 1,500+ real figures, field battles, sieges and duels.

details.title: Creative Racers
details.short_description: Race for first place using offensive and defensive items on the other players while the course booster to gain speed as well dodging hazard. Play for fun online with friends or others. Or speedrun for for glory. Have fun your way in this fun and cute racing game.

details.title: Worst Wizard
details.short_description: Burn 100,000 marshmallows in a single stage. A wizard, furious that someone put sugar in his coffee without asking, wipes out the cute horde with fully automatic spells. Grow your skill tree, unlock new spells, and make every run flashier and more brutal in this incremental game.

details.title: PROJECT Ω / MEG
details.short_description: A bullet hell where an android girl dodges for you. Build her dodge AI, weapons and outfit, switch her dodge AI for each barrage, and BREAK through brutal patterns from rival girls. Lose, rebuild, retry. As her researcher on PROJECT Ω, you were never told what it is really for.

details.title: Afterglow Interstate
details.short_description: A relaxing synthwave motorbike ride through neon cities, glowing seas, desert dunes, aurora skies and zero-gravity tubes, all moving to an expanding soundtrack. Just drive, or take on the beat, your echo, and your friends whenever you feel like it.

details.title: RhizoMana: Arbor Magna
details.short_description: A cozy adventure for a magic academy graduate: restore the disrupted mana flow, grow the best garden, unravel the mysteries of alchemy, and save a remote village from rampaging slimes.

details.title: True Cult
details.short_description: True Cult is a 2D auto-scrolling shooter blending roguelite progression with shoot 'em up action. Lead a procession escorting the Pretender to the site of their sacrifice: the Holy Hole. Enrich the Cult, obtain powerful relics, upgrade your cultists, and sacrifice every Pretender!

details.title: Limbs for Lives
details.short_description: Co-op survival after a plane crash. Every survivor is missing something: legs, arms, sight. Nobody makes it alone, so build, hunt and call for rescue together

details.title: Em the Emissary
details.short_description: Join Em the Emissary in an adventure to restore the hearts of his friends, in a cute 3D platformer! After Dis the Disciple was given the Scales of Ma'at, the jackal began weighing everyone's hearts without any counterbalance, forcing beings into a state of unrest and in need of saving.

details.title: Beaver Kart
details.short_description: Race to save the zoo! Eight animal racers, eight homemade rides and an adventure beyond the finish line. Explore colorful hubs, stack power-ups and tackle Grand Prix and boss showdowns. Drift, boost and battle solo or race friends in 2–4 player local split-screen.

details.title: Downvolt - Downhill Electric Scooter Racing
details.short_description: Race downhill on electric scooters in a multiplayer game built around speed, steep descents and competition. Ride with friends, push your limits and brake sometimes.

name: It's Always Grey: Serial Detective Stories

details.title: It's Always Grey: Serial Detective Stories
details.short_description: It's Always Grey is a detective mystery serial, inspired by real true crime cases. In a city of perpetual rain, Detective Molly Grey investigates a horrific discovery made years after the crime took place. Search for clues, highlight critical evidence, and connect the dots to find those responsible.

details.title: Curse of Beauty
details.short_description: Beauty demands sacrifice. Here, it's literal. Clock in at a factory that makes cosmetics out of people. Mix the ingredients, follow instructions, and try not to dwell on what you're doing. By the end of your shift, your hands will still be dirty.

details.title: Good Boy Good Waves
details.short_description: Set out on a relaxing paddleboard journey across scenic island waters with your faithful canine companion. Catch the rhythm of gentle waves, balance your board, explore peaceful coastlines, and uncover tranquil island secrets together.

details.title: Pull Over!
details.short_description: A co-op detective horror game set at a roadside militia checkpoint in 1991. Check papers, search cars and make quota by morning. Some of the drivers aren't human. Spot them and shoot first

details.title: Silentes: Cursed Children
details.short_description: Explore Brazilian cities threatened by supernatural roots in this top-down 2D RPG. Investigate the source of the calamity alongside three heroes with special abilities tied to Brazilian folklore.

details.title: Amberly Hollow
details.short_description: A Life Sim RPG set in an isolated village. Train and master a variety of skills, collecting resources and rewards as you complete quests, upgrade your home, and discover the secrets of the village of Amberly.

details.title: Look Far
details.short_description: A narrative adventure that begins inside a star. You are a carbon atom, born alongside a beam of light. Your paths part. Drift through oceans and forests, and into a human life. Six and a half billion years pass for you. For the light, not a second.

details.title: Fondaco – A Venetian Merchant's Tale
details.short_description: January 1400: you are a novice merchant, unknown and with a couple of ships. Rise to the top of the Mediterranean markets, where events and rival companies can sink your trading house. Open Fondaco abroad, produce, trade and fight when you must: shape the future of the Mediterranean.

details.title: Kazu the Cassowary
details.short_description: Run, leap and claw-kick through an Australian-inspired world in this colorful single-player 3D platforming adventure. Help Kazu rescue his captured parents, explore varied landscapes and discover secrets along the way.

details.title: Beakwood
details.short_description: As a stork, deliver packages across Beakwood, a cozy town that changes with every season, while a gang of jealous, gadget-crazed hawks glide, hover and rocket in to sabotage your route.

details.title: Mop & Plot
details.short_description: Clock in, clean up, and watch your back: in this chaotic online social deduction game for up to 12 players, paint walls, scrub floors, and finish the job while hidden Saboteurs wreak havoc. Use proximity voice chat to spot the culprits and vote them out!

details.title: Corrupted Seal
details.short_description: A dark action RPG in pixel art. The seal that held back the Corruption has been broken. Fight with sword, bow, staff or wand, hunt for loot, grow your seal trees and close the Rifts before the Abyss swallows the world.

details.title: One More Sin
details.short_description: Become a demon summoner in this roguelike deckbuilder. Discover forgotten sorceries, cursed enchantments and powerful creatures as you craft the perfect deck to crush your enemies and serve your dark queen.

details.title: Shenanigans Party
details.short_description: A chaotic free-for-all party brawler for up to 16 players. Shove, launch and dash rivals off the map across a dozen fast-paced minigames, then roll the dice on the party board between rounds. Cute characters, absurd chaos, zero mercy. Solo with bots or online.

details.title: Solaris
details.short_description: Solaris is an immersive first-person action game set in an alternate, post-apocalyptic Soviet satellite Poland. You are Irka: a skilled rooftop runner and courier. Sneak, run and climb the roofs of the destroyed city to find a cure for your grandma infected by a mysterious disease called Solaris.

details.title: PAPER.VOID
details.short_description: Pilot a paper plane through an infinite monochrome dimension. Collect VOID Cubes, survive your own deadly trail, and face the END of reality.

details.title: Oaks vs Orcs
details.short_description: A roguelike kingdom builder with fast runs & crazy builds. Draft cards to grow a stronghold of deadly plants. Route the river to chain powerful bonuses across your tiles. Survive the orc siege and watch your army crush the horde.

details.title: The Night Archive - Sable's
details.short_description: One night alone at the campground he loved as a kid. Closed for years, chained at the gate, rotting. A friend arrives at sunrise. Episode 2 of The Night Archive.

details.title: Tomb Zombies
details.short_description: Chaotic Republican-era China shrouded in dark fog. Play as a wandering Taoist with peachwood tools and cinnabar talismans, defeat ghosts and flying jiangshi to calm evil spirits.

details.title: I Think I Killed Someone
details.short_description: A non-linear psychological horror puzzle mystery where you suffer from dementia and wake up next to a dead body in your apartment. Piece together the seven days of your life in chronological order to uncover what really happened over the past week.

name: Last Wail of the Sea King

details.title: Last Wail of the Sea King
details.short_description: Explore the body of a dying sea beast in this first-person RPG with JRPG-inspired turn-based combat. Recruit bizarre companions, battle mutated creatures and uncover the secrets of the Sea King.

details.title: Temp Agency
details.short_description: Temp Agency is a chaotic office co-op game where you and a friend race against the clock to survive increasingly ridiculous office jobs through different levels and offices. Answer phones, deliver packages, brew coffee, and work together to keep the office running. Or at least try to.

details.title: Monochrome Rainbow
details.short_description: Monochrome Rainbow is a surrealist card game

details.title: Gacha The Frog
details.short_description: Collect and play with cute frogs in a cozy physics simulation. Use the machine to get new frogs, play mini-games to improve the odds of getting legendary frogs and manage your space so you can keep playing. Can you complete the album?

details.title: 塑时者Derealization
details.short_description: "Derealization" is a visual novel that combines Japanese campus youth, suspenseful loops, and supernatural combat. The main characters in this work are voiced by professional Japanese actors. Inserting original animation clips into the climactic scenes greatly enhances the impact of the plot.

details.title: Humbuggest
details.short_description: Ziggy wants the crown and will do anything to steal it, even if it means breaking the law by breaking the laws of physics. Manipulate time and solve fourth-wall-breaking riddles in this comedic 2D puzzle-platformer filled with classic pixel art.

details.title: Zorehrai: Space Formations
details.short_description: Start with your own character and a small ship in a world that lives independently of the player. Develop your skills, explore space, trade, build industry, and grow your fleet to survive real-time battles against hostile fleets—and something far more terrifying lurking in the darkness.

details.title: Catino Town
details.short_description: Raise cute creatures that can transform into over 150 unique evolutions! Play games, decorate their home, and explore their world!

details.title: Shieldlinked
details.short_description: In this turn-based tactical RPG, coordinate your attacks with close allies to overcome the enemy with the unique Link system. Win battles through clever planning, spare opponents to earn their equipment or recruit them to your cause, and resist those who sow division.

details.title: Largely Legal Monstrosity
details.short_description: Summon then enslave all-consuming astral horrors for profit in this incremental bullet heaven. Craft your build in a race to disrupt ineffectual antiquated market leaders. Between rounds invest in infrastructure to power up and secure your place in the largest monster creation event in history!

details.title: ToFaYun 2000: Origin of the Lawcast
details.short_description: 《桃花源二千: 離律之源》是一款香港漫畫風格的推理視覺小說。二千年前的桃花源至今仍然存在，只是暗中觀察著現世的變遷，發展出另一種世界文明。你將化身玄族人，透過道法與現世科技融的「手乩」搜集線索、選擇走向與推理劇情。然而玄族官府的高壓管治，令人變得相當警惕，你必需注意言行，在適當時候切換「謹慎模式」，否則會令人對你起疑，甚至招來橫禍。另一方面，自然界無處不在的「泛靈」，在對你作出誘導的同時，背後似乎有著某種不明的動機。你能否從不起眼的細節，找出恐怖襲擊的元兇，阻止一場人為災難？

details.title: Freewake
details.short_description: A team-based strategy and space simulation game where allies build an empire together while competing to control it. Explore, trade, colonize, scheme, and fight tactical battles shaped by stealth, sensors, and deception.

details.title: Orkoriz
details.short_description: Orkoriz is a stealth-action game set in the war-torn ghost city of Vuhledar. Infiltrate the ruins as NAFO agent Badabumov, navigate ork-infested streets, and uncover the fate of its citizens.

details.title: The Time-Seeing Cat: Prologue
details.short_description: The world has already ended once. Knowing what awaits, the protagonist returns two months into the past. Foresee future events, change people's fates, and even use knowledge of the future to overcome powerful bosses. A suspense-driven JRPG where knowing the future is itself part of the gameplay.

details.title: Blame the Wind
details.short_description: A turn-based artillery duel across a destructible city skyline. Read the wind, set your angle, and lob a banana or a baguette or scalding regret at your rival. 16 silly fighters to unlock, one-button GIF export, and CRT + EGA retro modes. No grind, no pay-to-win, no FOMO. Just couch chaos.

details.title: Odin's Fate
details.short_description: Discover Norse mythology in a story-driven Tower Defense game. Defeat hordes of enemies, develop your abilities, unlock new heroes, recruit Einherjar, manipulate time, and change your fate, Odin, son of Bor! Will you manage to stop the impending Ragnarök?

details.title: Sonar & Silence
details.short_description: Your sensors are your only eyes. Read sonar echoes to distinguish wrecks from mines and locate enemies in a tactical submarine exploration and combat game. Venture into hostile waters, mine resources, gather intelligence, and upgrade your submarine between dives.

details.title: ROUDO OF THE HERO
details.short_description: A time-attack-style 3D action game where you control a cast of unique characters as you race from the grasslands to the Demon King’s Castle. Will you fight the enemies, or ignore them and rush ahead? The ending changes depending on your route and the time it takes to complete the game.

details.title: The Lost Cape
details.short_description: The Lost Cape is a first-person survival game set on a mysterious tropical island. Explore, build, hunt, and uncover its secrets. When night falls, beware of a blind creature that hunts by sound. Play solo or in online co-op and find a way to escape.

details.title: ACT OUT
details.short_description: A chaotic online party game of 3D charades. Grab a floppy puppet, act out your secret word on a live theater stage, and race your friends to guess it before the clock runs out. Push-to-talk voice, custom Workshop maps, and a winner's podium. Best with 3+ friends.

details.title: Ship Happens: Pirates Wanted
details.short_description: A co-op game for 1–4 players where you and your friends dream of becoming fearsome pirates, but for now you're sailing in a leaky tub you call a ship. Patch holes, put out fires, raid weaker ships, flee from stronger ones, and upgrade your vessel. Work together, because at sea... Ship Happens!

details.title: Documancy
details.short_description: An incremental management game where you use magical documents to empower an auto-battling warrior. Every victory unlocks a new document, introducing a new way to improve your warrior. What will the next one do?

details.title: Cat Stack
details.short_description: Kidnapped by cats! In this frantic physics-based roguelite, your goal is to balance an endless tower of kitties on your head. Dash back and forth to keep your balance, survive chaotic events, and use special cats with unique powers to keep the stack from collapsing under its own weight.

details.title: Cyberlink Chaos
details.short_description: Cyberlink Chaos is a fast paced online multiplayer arena-slasher. Jack into your PMNCU and fight in the cybernetic forever war. Encased in metal, your soul is reborn - will you fight?

details.title: Urban Green
details.short_description: A romantic visual novel about love, life and loserdom. Take the role of Jack, a young man starting a new job at an environmental charity in search of a jumpstart to his stalled life. What he'll find, be it love, heartbreak, or just more of the same, is up to you.

details.title: DATUM: Rescue One
details.short_description: A single-player helicopter search and rescue game. Fly through storms and darkness, locate survivors with FLIR, confirm with your searchlight, and bring them home. No weapons. Only the sea, the night, and time.

details.title: Alice in BLUE
details.short_description: Alice in Blue is a deckbuilding roguelike strategy game featuring tactical roulette combat. Slot cards onto a spinning wheel, adjust their positions, and unleash powerful card synergies to overcome the dangers of a bizarre dream world.

details.title: Freeze, Dummy!
details.short_description: Freeze time, hang your bullets and grenades across a frozen world, shove enemies into each other's crossfire, then let time run and survive the chaos. A physics-driven FPS sandbox about directing explosions: chain reactions, style scoring, replays.

details.title: Mana Alchemy
details.short_description: An open-world bullet heaven RPG. Explore a cursed island, forge spells via alchemy, and arrange them in your grimoire like a puzzle. Mow down monster hordes and hunt your 7 ruling sisters. Your final choice—execute or forgive them—determines the ending of this dark fantasy.

details.title: CAPTIVE LOVE♡MELTY HOLIC
details.short_description: Ruito, a popular underground idol, is suddenly kidnapped and confined in an unfamiliar abandoned building. Blocked by tricky traps and relentlessly pursued by obsessive stans—can Ruito safely escape this building of madness...?

details.title: Anomaly Logistics
details.short_description: Entities, objects, and domains that defy the laws of physics to wield powers beyond human comprehension—these are collectively known as "Anomalies." Suppress these myriad Anomalies, strip them of their power, and harness it to descend into the deepest abyss. What truth lies waiting at the very end?

details.title: Coin to Crown
details.short_description: Build your adventuring career in a fantasy tactical RPG for 1–4 players. Take guild contracts, travel between towns, and master turn-based battles with timed blocks and dodges. Discover traits through your deeds, upgrade your gear, and rise through the ranks.

details.title: Observation Protocol: The Observed
details.short_description: A first-person psychological horror where you wake, again and again, inside a facility that studies you. Each cycle the rooms change, the pattern deepens, and something begins to take shape. The longer you observe, the harder it becomes to tell where the simulation ends.

details.title: Last Drop Tavern
details.short_description: A psychological roguelite gambling game set in an oil-painted bar between this life and the next. You and a rival take turns dropping coins into a single glass; whoever makes it overflow loses their chance at the afterlife. No interface, no numbers, just the rising liquid and the coin in your hand.

details.title: FatCat Nexus
details.short_description: A challenging 2D action platformer featuring unique weapons, precise gameplay, and intense combat. Master your arsenal and defeat dangerous enemies in a world full of challenges.

details.title: Pnevmo-Capsula: Dieselnautica
details.short_description: Navigate a mail capsule to deliver a crucial letter to the Captain across a flying scrap-city. Collect lamps: the toll for passing Checkpoints - solve physics puzzles, dodge traps and fines. If you don’t have enough lamps, the hammers will crush you. A grim puzzle-platformer where every lamp counts.

details.title: Midwatch Engineer
details.short_description: You are a ship engineer, keep watch at night, build and repair stuff on a lathe and a milling machine by day. In this Game you will machine parts from raw metal instead of just combining items to craft. You directly control the axis of the lathe.

details.title: The Hanging Game
details.short_description: Hangman on paper is over. Here, you are in the noose. Explore a malevolent graveyard for letters while an eerie, deceptive voice whispers in your ear—learning from your mistakes and actively lying to you. Can you solve the word before the rope snaps?

details.title: Spell Breakers
details.short_description: Build your Spell Deck, defeat your rivals, and aim for the top of the mysterious tournament, Spell Breakers! This is a new kind of auto-battle roguelike game where collecting over 300 spells is the key to victory!

details.title: Pfand Raiders
details.short_description: Dash and ride through a rock festival in this absurd, music-driven co-op runner! Dodge obstacles to the beat, loot empty cans ("Pfand"), cash them in for beer and burp everything out of your way. Will you make it to The Butcher Sisters' show in time?

details.title: Deviled Dice
details.short_description: Beat the devil at his own game by cheating harder than he does in this tabletop-style roguelite dicebuilder. Rig your dice for suspicious luck, conveniently swap the rules mid-game, and cunningly combine relics from other tabletops to set the scorepad on fire!

details.title: Wēlandes
details.short_description: Solve ancient mysteries in the ethereal world of Anglo-Saxon Britain. You are the spel-wefa, use your magical translation devices to help the gods, beasts, and gentlefolk of Old English poetry. Journey the ageless chalk hills surrounding Wayland’s Smithy; unearth the stories that wander within.

details.title: Dragon Tribe Chronicles
details.short_description: An epic strategy deck builder RPG where You play as one of the last True Dragons. A shapeshifting being capable of harnessing the power of slayed beings.

details.title: The Caretakers
details.short_description: Infiltrate contaminated residences and deal with their mutant pests using the most advanced tech of the 1960s. Set up a base and observe, probe, and most importantly, survive the grotesque creatures in this online co-op horror game.

details.title: Lumenweld
details.short_description: Lumenweld is an open-world survival crafting RPG set in a luminous neon-fantasy wilderness. Build a home, gather resources, craft gear, complete quests, and hunt deadly creatures. Every pursuit builds its own skill, letting you forge a character shaped by how you play.

details.title: Cendres
details.short_description: Cendres is an isometric 3D action roguelike. Explore seven floors of procedural dungeons, dodge their guardians’ attacks, and shape your build through loot, forging and skill trees. Every descent is a new attempt.

details.title: Bloom Control
details.short_description: Eradicate the Bloom in this high-energy active incremental. Hack into powerful security weaponry at infested target sites as the only AI fast enough to outpace the spread. Control and destroy the hostile growth before your transmission window closes.

details.title: Ocularis
details.short_description: An ancient intelligence has forgotten how to learn, so it built a place to watch you do it. Explore its abstract chambers in a first-person puzzle game with no words to guide you: experiment, observe, and master its rules. The more you understand, the more it begins to understand again.

details.title: Sisters of Solitude
details.short_description: Explore a haunted convent with your EMF detector, tape recorder, and camera. Uncover the fate of four ghostly sisters and the mystery behind the murder they commited. Every room hides a clue, every shadow a warning, and the truth waits for those who dare to seek it.

details.title: HIIT: Stranded on Zaruma
details.short_description: Trapped on the mysterious planet Zaruma, use tools like the Drone, Scanner, and Hookshot to explore the ruins of an ancient civilization and uncover what happened before your arrival.

details.title: Happy Village: The Broken Timeline
details.short_description: A narrative RPG of three intertwined stories, hidden secrets, and a broken timeline only the player can repair. Every ending reveals new paths, if you know where to look.

details.title: Alchemist's Arcana
details.short_description: A narrative puzzle game where you return to your hometown as an Alchemists' Guild clerk and unexpectedly become the acting alchemist. Relearn forgotten alchemy, help the townsfolk, and survive with your companions in a world slowly falling apart.

details.title: Forgotten
details.short_description: A first-person psychological horror game. Shipwrecked on a remote island, Evelyn searches for the missing lighthouse keeper, her only way home. But the people of this island were forgotten long ago. Explore, solve puzzles and hide as you uncover who they were.

details.title: It's Snow-Kei
details.short_description: Plow a whole town in a tiny kei truck. Clear driveways and lots one satisfying lane at a time, upgrade your truck, make friends (or enemies) and get paid. Keep on plowing, and don't ask too many questions.

details.title: Coin Frenzy
details.short_description: Coin Frenzy is an incremental game about launching coins and growing your rewards. Upgrade coin values, launch more coins, and boost your sectors. Earn skill points, rebirth into the skill tree, and unlock new ways to fill and collect your board

details.title: TITAN'S CELL: NYMPH
details.short_description: Collect and breed quirky Nymphs inside a universe-sized Titan. Build a team of three for turn-based card battles, choose your route through roguelite expeditions, explore solo or in online co-op with up to 3 players, and test your strategy in real-time PvP.

details.title: Shift Knight
details.short_description: Shift Knight is a horror typing game and a supernatural mystery. Every night the dead rise from the graves along the only road home, each carrying a word. Type it before it reaches the truck. Nobody will say where they came from, and the Order keeps sending instructions.

details.title: Pharmacy Next to the Dungeon
details.short_description: Run a small pharmacy beside a dungeon and care for adventurers! Process and combine ingredients to brew potions, diagnose adventurers with various tools, and prescribe the right remedies. Help adventurers on their journeys and grow your pharmacy in this fantasy management sim!

details.title: Multipolar
details.short_description: Multipolar is a single-player grand strategy game set in the near future. Guide your country through the turbulent times of a multipolar world, using diplomacy, influence, information and special operations. Depending on the country you select, you may go for global domination or for survival.

details.title: Atheria: Monster Tactics
details.short_description: Step onto the battlefield, assemble your ultimate squad of powerful monsters, and master position based card combat. Collect hundreds of unique creature cards and outsmart your opponents in deep, turn-based grid battles.

details.title: Street Witch
details.short_description: A lurid trashy old school FPS. Fight street goblins in frantic scrappy gun fights, kick doors, do magic and get your cat back.

details.title: Hello Mr. Drift!
details.short_description: Part-time courier, full-time drift addict! Race against the clock, dodge obstacles, deliver packages, and drift your way to meeting your quota without breaking the goods.

details.title: Those We Serve
details.short_description: The king is murdered. You are killed too. But death isn't the end. Relive the same cursed day in a turn-based RPG where perfectly timed parries, dodges, and your decisions determine whether you survive long enough to uncover the truth.

details.title: VOIDCORP
details.short_description: Co-op mining in an endless dangerous voxel cave system. Blast & dig with real physics, haul the ore up the lift and sell it to the Company. Black holes, spider nests and worse wait in the dark below. Dig deep, get paid, and don't get left behind.

details.title: Emerald Utopia
details.short_description: Emerald Utopia is a 3d atmospheric, platformer, metroidvania game focused on vertical exploration. Here you'll explore diverse, interconnected worlds to find your missing wife, who vanished years ago during the world's shattering.

details.title: Lost in the Post
details.short_description: Fly a rickety hot-air balloon with 2-4 friends and deliver the mail across a world that wants you dead. Work the burner, drop the ballast, catch the parcels, slap your crewmates, and try not to fall out. We always deliver. Mostly.

details.title: Orbit Wreck
details.short_description: Blast through waves of enemies in OrbitWreck, a fast-paced 2D space shooter! Pilot unique ships, dodge deadly attacks, collect Scrap, and unleash powerful special abilities.

details.title: Pinwick
details.short_description: Every haunted house was built by someone. You build yours one room at a time: saw, glue, velvet, patience, a photograph of everything you finish. Each room is perfect when you latch the glass at night. Some mornings, there are improvements.

details.title: The Gilded Sprig
details.short_description: Build a cozy botanical shop, craft fragrant products, gather rare ingredients, grow plants, and discover new recipes. Hire helpers, delight your customers, and turn a little shop into a flourishing business.

details.title: Spellriggers: Unification Protocol
details.short_description: Heroes of Might and Magic meets Homeworld. Five Spellriggers, six schools of magic, randomly drawn loot cards and generated battlefields: no two runs alike. Build your fleet, master cosmic-scale spells and conquer the galaxy sector by sector.

details.title: BEAUTY OR THE BEAST
details.short_description: BEAUTY OR THE BEAST is primarily a 2.5D action game, with some rhythm game elements. Defeated enemies become the player's fans. Only the character with the most fans among your allies will get to fight the boss. Otherwise, you'll end up playing a rhythm game. Gain fans and become the main character!

details.title: ScrapCrew: Running on Fumes
details.short_description: Command a squad of distinct personalities in this turn based tactical RPG. Drive armored vehicles through a harsh wasteland, salvage scrap to upgrade your convoy and shape your squad’s combat style and narrative through a dynamic influence system. Can you reclaim what was stolen?

details.title: Clicky Keys
details.short_description: Clicky Keys is a tower defense game where your keyboard is the battlefield. Every key activates a weapon. Fight off enemies and make the right upgrade choices to survive. Can you reach day 20?

details.title: Dendrophobia
details.short_description: A twisted pixel-art horror thriller about death, ancient gods, and a persistent waiter. Explore The Willow’s Embrace hotel, solve puzzles, and gather paranormal evidence. Challenge the madness to find a way out and avoid becoming part of an eternal nightmare.

details.title: Graveyard Warden
details.short_description: Inherit a neglected graveyard, prepare graves, craft coffins and tombstones, and manage daily burials. Restore your cemetery, explore the surrounding area, and uncover the secrets behind your inheritance.

details.title: Trimson
details.short_description: TRIMSON is a system-driven zombie survival game where you play as a rescue operative sent into infected zones to save survivors. Every injury, infection, resource, and survivor lost has lasting consequences.

details.title: The Sworn
details.short_description: A deep US police precinct management simulation. You are the Captain. Hire officers, manage your fleet, respond to a living city, and carry responsibility for every officer under your command. The job has a cost. So does ignoring it.

details.title: Into the Dust
details.short_description: Top-down tactical co-op extraction shooter. Up to four players scavenge, fight, and rebuild in the harsh, post-apocalyptic wastelands of Dust Bowl America.

details.title: The Stalked 4
details.short_description: Desperate for work, 27-year-old George signs up for the remote lighthouse job. What starts as beautiful and peaceful scenery slowly turns unsettling day by day. Is it just your mind playing tricks on you? Or is someone else here...?

details.title: Novus Terminus: First Flags
details.short_description: Novus Terminus: First Flags is a cozy logistics city builder. Found settlements, design road networks and watch your carriers transport goods from flag to flag. Three unique clans, visible supply chains and a handcrafted low-poly world await you.

details.title: Lynehold
details.short_description: Break through enemy waves and destroy their base in this tug-of-war PvP auto battler inspired by Direct Strike. Counter your opponent, unlock formation bonuses and strengthen your army with items and upgrades. Balance economy with aggression, then watch your strategy unfold. Play 1v1, 2v2 or 3v3.

details.title: Dice Crawler
details.short_description: At the bottom of the dungeon lies the rotting corpse of a dead god, festering and devouring the land above. Descend into the depths. Slay the monsters. Resurrect the god. Dice Crawler is a dice-based roguelite game.

details.title: Victorian Pier Tycoon
details.short_description: Build and manage your own Victorian seaside pier in this nostalgic pixel-art tycoon game. Construct steam-powered rides, balance the delicate needs of the Aristocracy against the Working Class, and maintain structural integrity. Will your resort become a world wonder, or crumble into the sea?

details.title: TetraDice
details.short_description: Forget everything you know about falling blocks. TetraDice blends classic arcade strategy with Roguelite powers and dice-driven chaos. Bend gravity, unleash explosions, and use 50+ Perks to survive and beat the high score.

details.title: RUIN'S HOUSE
details.short_description: A unique fusion of "Lady" × "Haunted Mansion"—a 2.5D horror action experience emerges! Who is the lady? What happened in this place long ago? Collect the scattered Fragments of Memory throughout the mansion and uncover the truth!

details.title: VilaGod
details.short_description: VilaGod is a god simulator where you shape the destiny of civilizations on giant maps. Unlike other god games, every action generates dynamic chronicles: from political revolts to legendary discoveries, watch your world's history unfold in 14 different languages

details.title: Poop Deck
details.short_description: Step onto the Poop Deck™ in this chaotic online co-op game! Collaborate with your crew to keep the dysfunctional ship moving. Repair engines, patch leaks, and manage crises as you race to the destination. Can your team survive before the vessel falls apart?

details.title: Portal Fall
details.short_description: Portal Fall is a turn-based roguelike where your skill set evolves mid-combat. Battle endless waves of enemies across fractured realities ruled by an ethereal Jester.

details.title: Burned Out!
details.short_description: Burned Out! is a chaotic office co-op game for 1-4 players where pointless computer tasks and paperwork spiral into full-blown workplace mayhem. Type, print, sign, stamp, staple, and deliver orders while the backlog keeps growing. Coordinate through workplaces designed to break you.

details.title: Thorner
details.short_description: Thorner is a horror visual novel with multiple endings. You attempt to escape your past by fleeing to the wilderness, but spilled blood can never be forgiven. The land knows what you did. The land judges. Thorner awaits.

details.title: The Warden's Rite
details.short_description: The Warden's Rite is a fantasy tower defense game set in a world consumed by the Fire God. You are humanity's last hope. As the Warden, command Earth, Air, and Water with the power of the Elemental Gods. Combine elements to create traps, block paths, and place towers to set your strategy.

details.title: ONIGASHIMA: Awakening
details.short_description: A predictive deck-building RPG! Build your strategy from over 300 cards! Form powerful formations with unique animal companions! Master countless combinations and claim overwhelming victories! Your adventure to defeat the ONI begins now!

details.title: OKEYABILITY
details.short_description: Rediscover the thrill of Classic Okey (Tile-based Rummy) in a neon-lit, robotic atmosphere! Enjoy traditional rules or use unique abilities to shift the balance. Define your strategy, customize your robot, and claim your spot at the table of the future!

details.title: Euphorbia Milii
details.short_description: A ruined research station reclaimed by nature. Days pass, resources disappear, and decisions leave lasting marks. Euphorbia Milii is a narrative, text-based roguelike RPG where existence costs more than survival. This is vegetation…

details.title: The Last Shift
details.short_description: Psychological horror meets an old-school text adventure during a lonely night shift at a police station. Type commands and solve puzzles as sounds, lights and movement in the office echo what you read. How long can you keep your eyes on the screen?

details.title: Spikehead
details.short_description: Spike your friends from below in this fast-paced local multiplayer party game!

details.title: Homo Sovieticus
details.short_description: Homo Sovieticus is a short, indie psychological horror that tells a story of a secret Soviet experiment that you are now a part of. Will you be strong enough not to break and let yourself slip into madness?

details.title: Silent Click
details.short_description: A first-person psychological puzzle horror where you escape control using a TV remote. Explore surreal rooms filled with CRT televisions, switch channels to solve logic-based puzzles, and uncover a haunted smart home system that constantly observes you.

details.title: Crossline
details.short_description: You are an ecologist forced onto a sudden rescue mission inside a secret complex. Face parallel worlds and creatures unknown to science. Piece together the events that led to the tragic disaster and uncover the facility's dark secrets before the cold and madness consume you.

details.title: Exul: Beyond the Gate
details.short_description: Exul: Beyond the Gate is a top-down retro-sci-fi action RPG shooter where you play as an Exul on his journey to an unknown galaxy. Play with your friends in a Co-Op experience where you loot, shoot, pilot, explore, trade, and much more — all to stay alive.

details.title: Eilands
details.short_description: Create and explore your own islands. Sculpt the land, plant trees, draw paths, place and build houses. Inhabit your creations. There is no combat or management, just the joy of creating and experiencing your own island.

details.title: DEADRIFT
details.short_description: A fast-paced sci-fi shooter where a failed experiment unleashes mutated horrors inside a secret research facility. Armed with experimental weapons, you must fight through swarms of twisted enemies, and survive the collapse of a world-breaking project.

details.title: Arc of Icarus
details.short_description: Build and lead your colony on a lost ringworld, where deadly conditions await on both sides while the world keeps turning! Progress through technological evolution, survive cultural revolution, and govern with a wise and steady hand!

details.title: Code Cross
details.short_description: A game where you must solve puzzles to see the full picture.

details.title: Recursive Nightmare
details.short_description: A first-person psychological horror game where you can't fight back. Hide, run and listen as creatures hunt you through flooded, dreamlike nightmares that never let you catch your breath. Someone is turning your fear into power.

details.title: My Hardware Store
details.short_description: Build your own hardware store – solo or in multiplayer with up to 8 players! Order over 50 products, set prices, hire employees and expand your shop in a huge open world. Over 100 hours of content – from a small shop to a tech empire!

details.title: Doughn't Panic!
details.short_description: A co-op adventure where 2 players share the controls of a single pizza, bound by a spell neither asked for. Explore a world never built for your size.

details.title: Evac
details.short_description: Co-op marines vs. the alien hive. Fight through infested outposts where the layout shifts every round, call the dropship and get out. Every marine who dies rises as one of them. 1–16 players, with AI filling any empty slot.

details.title: Video Gamer Legacy
details.short_description: Run a shop that buys, restores, and sells old games. Money isn't the score. Influence is, and you only earn it two ways: preserving games, and treating people well. Spend it to save the companies that really went under, and put the consoles they never got to make on your shelves.

details.title: Dustlings: The Hidden Wilds
details.short_description: You stumble into a mysterious, uninhabited wilderness—but you're not alone. The little beings that glow at night will be your closest companions. Bond with extraordinary plants and animals, build a home together, explore the wilds, and follow scattered diary pages to uncover the truth.

details.title: Scavenger Survivors
details.short_description: In this 1-4 player top-down roguelite/survivors hybrid, the machines already won. Now, you scavenge! Play as fat scavengers hauling loot from the ruins of the world. Grab and throw anything that isn't bolted down, cram it into your armored RIG, and survive the robot swarm until extraction.

details.title: Ogre Stampede
details.short_description: Ogre Stampede is a physics-based bullet heaven with incremental upgrades set in a chaotic mosh pit. Waves of hopelessly stupid trolls and ogres are running wild and pushing and shoving each other around. Level up your strength and fight to be the last one standing and become the new chieftain!

details.title: House Heroes
details.short_description: Cut, paint and screw your way to success, alone or with friends. Bring back the House Heroes team and fight against the real-estate mafia in this local coop construction simulator adventure. Will you be able to save your failing family business?

details.title: MASH Commander
details.short_description: Manage camp morale and army resources in harsh conditions. Direct the flow of wounded, take control of individual cases, and develop your skills and those of your staff. Live in the camp and come to know the people you command. Meet expectations in Survival Rate and Camp Efficiency, or be replaced.

details.title: Aeriea
details.short_description: Aeriea is a tower-defense × roguelike × survivor game where positioning, weapon builds, and tower placement work in tandem. Maneuver through waves of enemies, fortify your defenses, and outlast the storm in timed survival skirmishes — every run is a fight for survival.

details.title: Gorilla Warfare
details.short_description: Apes together strong. Explosively strong. Gather your friends, pick your grenade, and wreck the arena until you're the only one left standing.

details.title: Tiny Archer
details.short_description: Tiny Archer is a roguelike action adventure. Explore a shifting archipelago, grab wildly different treasures, and grow into something you didn't expect - every run is a new growth curve. Work your bow with wit, and you might shoot through the fog and survive.

details.title: Slime Vendor
details.short_description: Raise slimes. Sell them to dungeon lords. Feed them, clean them, pet them, learn which one hates the cold — then crate them up on delivery day. Catch rare slimes in the wilds, breed new ones, and get to know your strangest clients: the dungeon lords.

details.title: A Sea of Ashen Tulips
details.short_description: A Sea of Ashen Tulips is a fantasy Text-based RPG where players control a former mercenary who searches for allies in investigating and combatting a colonial occupation.

details.title: KRUSHPIT
details.short_description: KRUSHPIT is a Real-Time Indirect PvP roguelike survival set among brutal concrete blocks and rusty garages. Obliterate mutants, evolve skills, spin slots, and create OP builds! Survive the chaos or join the PvP ladder to crush everyone and dominate the leaderboard!

details.title: Brassfang
details.short_description: Explore a castle filled with monsters and strange experiments in this steampunk action RPG metroidvania. Combine vampiric and mechanical powers, face challenging bosses, and create unique builds through randomized upgrade choices.

details.title: BULLETPROOF
details.short_description: A story-driven retro FPS set in early-2000s Seattle. Dismantle the criminal empire you built in a brutal campaign of revenge behind a bulletproof mask.

name: gumball: a rogue-like peg poppin' blast

details.title: gumball: a rogue-like peg poppin' blast
details.short_description: a rogue-like peg poppin' blast! dispense gumballs, pop pegs, and stamp your candy-coated arsenal with game-breaking modifiers on your way to mastering the pegs. built solo from from my wife's basement in utah, gumball is a vibrant peg breaking physics rogue-like where every run rewrites the rules.

details.title: RUNLENGTH
details.short_description: You are PID_0x7F, a rogue process fighting to survive inside a dying computer. Outrun the system's daemons, solve living data-structure puzzles, and reconstruct the truth your creator tried to delete — before the machine wipes you for good.

details.title: D.I.P.
details.short_description: Rush to the bucket, dip into the paint, hook onto the ceiling, and smear your colorful body all over the walls... Oh, and you're a cute dormouse. Paint fast, grab bonuses, and become the top dormouse among your friends in D.I.P.: Dormouse Is Painting, a chaotic local party game for up to 4 players.

details.title: Fling-A-Ring
details.short_description: A retro-styled stretch-and-release physics game. Your ring will zoom about colorful procedurally generated arenas of increasing difficulty filled with whimsical obstacles and collectable sparks and powerups.

details.title: Witch Hunt 0
details.short_description: "Witch Hunt 0" is a magic-focused, stage-based boss rush 3D action game. Take on the role of the witch Astera. To reclaim her lost powers, she must craft spells, tame defeated enemies as familiars, and conquer the formidable foes that stand in her way.

details.title: Kimbap Factory
details.short_description: Automate the ultimate Korean kitchen. Route belts, watch ingredients transform, and physically assemble each kimbap roll step by step. Discover new recipes, fulfill requests, and expand your kitchen at your own pace. No pressure, no timers, just a satisfying and unique casual factory experience.

details.title: Tropical Romance
details.short_description: At an elite academy for fruit-family heirs, Geum Gyuri, a kumquat farmer’s daughter, is drawn to a pair of polar-opposite twins—only to uncover the “rotten” truth beneath the school’s “fresh” facade.

details.title: Chubby Farm
details.short_description: Welcome to Chubby Farm! In this relaxing and stress-relieving Roguelike deck-builder, freely place your round little pieces, combine special items with animal buddies, and trigger wild, mind-blowing chain reactions! Get ready to be overwhelmed by cuteness and dive into an unstoppable farm party!

details.title: 404: The Absent God
details.short_description: A hand-drawn 2D metroidvania. Planet 404 doesn't exist on any map, but Vexya lands there anyway, on the trail of her missing mentor. Explore, shoot, unlock new abilities, and beat the Zorgs to the Eye of Vyr'Nox, relic of the Absent God.

details.title: 旧梦夏日
details.short_description: On her twelfth birthday, Xiaohan makes a wish—but more than candlelight fades. Her reflection blurs, and her best friend Xiaoyu disappears. Through dual perspectives, explore a dreamlike millennium town, battle with card marbles, and uncover its hidden truth.

details.title: Broken Cycle
details.short_description: Broken Cycle is a dark-fantasy auto-battler RPG that lets you build a team of up to 5 mercenaries and send them to clear dungeons automatically while you engineer their battle tactics and loot, craft, and enchant their gear.

details.title: Echoes of Memory
details.short_description: Japan, 1992. Neurophysiologist Ren Adler travels to Mizunari to investigate missing people, memory gaps and contradictory evidence. Search the village, connect analog clues and make decisions that can have lasting consequences.

details.title: FIVILYN
details.short_description: A psychological RPG where you switch between two perceptions of reality and discover that not everything sweet is innocent.

details.title: Songs of the Past
details.short_description: Go on an adventure and become a mighty hero who will save the world from an evil villain! ♫ Songs of the Past ♫ is a story-rich RPG where you choose from 6 classes, travel across regions, solve puzzles, complete quests, recruit companions & uncover the mystery of the magical songs shaping the world!

details.title: The Death... And After?
details.short_description: You are in a coma. Reality is shattered, and the laws of logic no longer apply. "The Death... And After?" is a psychological horror game where you must navigate eerie hospital labyrinths and dark caverns of a fading mind. Is it a dream, or is it death? And what awaits us after?

details.title: Rogue Gambit
details.short_description: Chess, but every run is different. Draft jesters, wizards and bureaucrats, forge strange abilities onto them, and climb a branching map of battles, relics and bad bargains. A roguelite for people who thought they were good at chess.

details.title: Coin Fall
details.short_description: Coin Fall is a short coin pusher incremental game. Every coin helps you unlock new pushers and chase jackpots. Discover special coins and trigger bonus mini-games, all in pursuit of the ultimate ticket prize!

details.title: Jacob's Islands
details.short_description: Jacob’s Islands is a minimalist pixel art platforming adventure where you explore mysterious islands, uncover secrets, and take time to enjoy the beauty of nature.

details.title: Code Alone
details.short_description: A programming puzzle game where you step into the role of a gameplay programmer, write code to build the core mechanics of a wide variety of games, and solve increasingly challenging development problems.

details.title: BLACK WALLS
details.short_description: Explore a silent, impossible world of puzzles and obstacles. Make symbolic choices whose consequences may not be clear, your decisions shape your ending. Choose Chill Mode for a calm, mysterious journey with nothing hunting you, or Horror Mode for fear, danger, and something that wants you dead.

details.title: My Brother Hacker
details.short_description: Your brother is gone. He left behind a USB stick with an unknown system and an AI that teaches you to hack. Break into networks, uncover who he really was, and question everything you find. A terminal-based hacking thriller set in 2036.

details.title: Naron
details.short_description: Co-op mining roguelite for 1-4 players. Dig into a dying moon, complete objectives and fight your way back to your drillship. Every step of progress makes the return more dangerous. Tunnels can collapse and bury you. 47 crews failed to reach the core. How deep will you go?

details.title: glitch.exe
details.short_description: glitch.exe is a free-to-play hacking horror game where you infiltrate corrupted systems, uncover hidden secrets and piece together a story that was never meant to be found. Explore a unsettling digital world full of mystery, tension and things that should not exist.

details.title: FLS: Fleeting Light and Shadows
details.short_description: A story-driven vertical space shooter made by young, passionate devs. Play as EOX-375, a robot born of a fallen golden age. Journey into post-apocalyptic peril, avenge humanity against its instigator, and seek one unverified truth: the future need not follow set rules. What do we exist for?

details.title: Caravanier
details.short_description: Lead a post-apocalyptic caravan through the dark wreckage of a fallen colony ship. Caravanier is a 2D top-down trade-based RPG where you exploit lucrative trade routes, barter with rival survivor factions, stave off the encroaching darkness, and shape the fate of this divided world.

details.title: ECHO//NULL
details.short_description: An isometric action MMORPG of androids and erased cities. Wake in Cradle-19 as a Ninth Generation Wanderer, fight machines with blade and Drone, shape your build with Plug-in Chips, and remember the places the world was made to forget.

details.title: Abdication
details.short_description: Fight through this corrupted monarchy in order to take the king's power and the crown, and destroy it to free the kingdom, all with a yoyo. It's too powerful to let anyone else wield it, so protect it at all costs!

name: Petals and Pots: Plant Shop Simulator

details.title: Petals and Pots: Plant Shop Simulator
details.short_description: Run your own cozy plant shop! Order supplies, stock shelves, and serve customers. Plant, water, and repot houseplants, restore and decorate your shop, and customize your character. Grow your business, meet the locals, and help a struggling little town bloom again.

details.title: The Radio Tower
details.short_description: Your job is to climb the tallest towers in the world to maintain them, this time you were called urgently to fix the only tower providing cover to the small Crimsonpine city that is currently on quarantine.

details.title: Read of Mask
details.short_description: A first-person psychological puzzle game set in Eastern Europe, 1999. Explore a surreal black-and-white world, decipher an invented alphabet using a reality-altering mask, and unlock the story letter by letter.

details.title: Way of the Warrior
details.short_description: Become a samurai in Way of the Warrior, a souls-like PvP and boss rush game. Face other players in intense duels or fight a gauntlet of powerful warriors in a world inspired by feudal Japan. Parry, dodge, feint and attack until only one of you is left standing.

details.title: Click Here!!
details.short_description: You’ve installed “U,” the so-called “best” UI software. It promised maximum productivity, but in reality, it turned out to be a nightmare that throws your PC into total chaos?! Conquer the worst interface ever created and force it to uninstall!

details.title: Blade & Burgers
details.short_description: Make burgers, whale in a pay-to-win game, and simp your heart out in this parody roguelite made as a “love” letter to mobile microtransaction grindfests. It’s not the Darkest Dungeon. It’s the greediest one.

details.title: Mystery of the Sacred King
details.short_description: You are the Lawspeaker, a defender of justice. Decode local rituals. Seek the truth. Dismantle conspiracies to save the innocent from execution. Put an end to the deception by revealing the mystery of the Sacred King in this deduction puzzle game.

details.title: CORVIDTALISM: Win at Life
details.short_description: Help a lazy low life get back up on his feet. Make him work, use persuasion, ignore his cries, and make choices for him. "Don't say you don't want to win at life."

name: Churrasco: Trying to Cook in Peace

details.title: Churrasco: Trying to Cook in Peace
details.short_description: Be the family BBQ master and try to grill in peace while your chaotic relatives turn everything upside down. Manage the grill, handle food orders, complete quests, and capture memories.

details.title: EverestBaseCamp
details.short_description: Manage Everest Base Camp, prepare climbers for dangerous expeditions, and guide your team from early route pushes toward an eventual summit attempt.

details.title: Click-A-Bao
details.short_description: Click the buns, catch the buns, don't eat the buns. A hidden objects game where you don't have to find everything. You'll unlock bun helpers that will search the pictures with you! Decorate your office, get new pictures, upgrade your buns and collect them all!

details.title: Aleph's Garden
details.short_description: A platform-puzzle Metroidvania where knowledge unlocks the garden—learn, open new paths, and solve mysteries in more than one way.

details.title: Cinema Deals
details.short_description: Play as a cashier in a cinema theater! Take orders, print movie tickets, prepare popcorn, drinks and more! And don't forget today's deals!

details.title: One-Time Trigger
details.short_description: Carefully observe the seven patients. Identify the one who doesn't belong, fire your one and only bullet, and complete the test. Shoot the wrong one and you die. You get only one chance.

name: Night of her vanishing in fireworks

details.title: Night of her vanishing in fireworks
details.short_description: The Night She Disappeared in the Fireworks is a short visual novel set in a small Chinese city and centered on esports. You play as Liu Lan, a high school esports player, as he faces three life-changing matches and, together with two heroines, witnesses a fate rewritten by fireworks.

details.title: Necro Pop
details.short_description: Necro Pop is an all-new action genre platformer we lovingly refer to as Arcadevania. On your adventure, you will discover new abilities, upgrades, secrets. You can free your ghostly friends using multiple combat abilities, magics, and maybe even a minion across multiple re-playable dungeons!

details.title: RePair in the Space
details.short_description: RePair in the Space is a game where an alien and a robot must repair their ship.
