Whether playing with a friend or embarking on this journey alone, you’ll have to craft and use items to fix every sector of the ship, battling against time, haste... and sometimes against your friend or even yourself!

details.title: Farlane
details.short_description: Command a Nomad-class Frontier Runner and lead your crew on the edge of a fading galactic empire. Take on freelance contracts, explore unstable farlanes, upgrade your ship, and survive where civilization ends.

details.title: Becoming None
details.short_description: Becoming None is an RPG about the loss of identity and homogenization. Experience a story told through collectable memories you can view at your own pace, alongside deep turn-based combat, customizable classes, and countless secrets.

details.title: Divination & Survivors
details.short_description: Survive spirit hordes in an ink-wash bamboo grove. Toss three coins on level-up, pick an upgrade, and evolve five skills from 64 hexagrams. Face three bosses, then see how the hexagrams you formed shape a reading on the theme you chose.

details.title: Little Dao
details.short_description: Little Dao is a 3D eastern fantasy MMORPG where players explore a floating mainland shaped by the rivalry between Ru and Mo, battle otherworldly monsters in real-time combat, complete quests, improve gear and skills, and build guild power with friends.

details.title: Exodus of Descent
details.short_description: Descend into an online third person PvE RPG dungeon looter inspired by RuneScape and Dark & Darker. Party up with your friends to solve escape-room type puzzles, collect over 150+ lootable items, level up your character, create unique classes and unlock new abilities. Escape Your Descent!

details.title: Triple Treble Triumph
details.short_description: How many genres have you mastered? Is it enough to play 3 of them simultaneously? Triple Treble Triumph puts 27 games into 1. Accept its trial to prove how much of a Gamer you are.

details.title: Archangel: Demon Rush
details.short_description: Build your fortress while the horde is already attacking, then fight inside it. Freely place turrets and combine brutal weapons, cards and abilities until a desperate defence becomes an unstoppable demon-killing war machine in this third-person action roguelite.

details.title: Death the Guitar
details.short_description: "Death the Guitar" is a pop and violent 2D Platformer action game. The player is a killer electric guitar whose owner was murdered, and the goal is to take revenge on the humans by manipulating "sound" and "electricity".
developers: トロヤマイバッテリーズフライド

details.title: The Chronos Event
details.short_description: Bend time to your will in The Chronos Event, a fast-paced third-person roguelite shooter. Rewind the clock, team up with your past selves, and battle hordes of enemies. Master time-looping, gain game-changing upgrades, and face down a hostile future in this time-bending sci-fi adventure.

details.title: Rise Of The General
details.short_description: 246 BCE. Pick one of 9 lives, from a slave in the headman's grain store to a kid raised by hill bandits. At 16, the levy takes you to war. Climb from conscript to general in a narrative war RPG with turn-based 5v5 battles, duels, and no plot armor.

details.title: Crab Rhapsody
details.short_description: Earn Claw Coins and become unstoppable! Help Mr. Claw stop Crab-GPT and its agents from monopolizing music copyrights. Build your band, unlock ability dressup, and buy Claw Chips anytime, anywhere to upgrade weapons, trigger wild combos, and craft insane builds.🤘🦀🎸

details.title: Where is My Son?
details.short_description: Step into a story of mystery, drama and the supernatural as a father searches for his missing son. Solve puzzles, follow clues and uncover the hidden truth.

details.title: Emblems: Sunless Vow
details.short_description: Unravel a mystery where you know the outcome from the start…in this turn-based roguelite RPG. A strange mage and his two captives must regain their memories to escape from a hostile void. But can they stop *arguing* first? A playful character drama with unusual combat.

details.title: Money Glitch
details.short_description: Create and manage your own online shop in the shadows of the Darknet. Build factories, craft products, and ship orders by hand. Keep your reputation high to dominate the underground economy.

details.title: The Battle for Vega
details.short_description: Inspired by the classic Space Invaders, The Battle for Vega takes the old-school gameplay you know and love and adds new features that make it a fresh and exciting experience.

details.title: The Truth
details.short_description: A psychological horror experience where a routine investigation turns into something far more unsettling. Explore, solve puzzles, and uncover the truth hidden within the house.

details.title: Subway Outbreak
details.short_description: In Subway Outbreak, defend and rebuild your metro station against mutant hordes in this pixel strategy game. Manage tasks like fortifying defenses, launching assaults, and gathering resources to survive 30 days of increasingly fierce attacks. Lose by death or generator destruction.

details.title: Magic Potion Liberators
details.short_description: A bullet heaven action game that gives you a comfortable feeling of being a warrioress. Knock down the onrushing monsters and push forward deep into the enemy territory! Create powerful builds with reinforce potions and crush the witch's servants!

details.title: Dungeon Cleaner
details.short_description: IT'S NOT CLEANING, IT'S SAVING THE WORLD. Grab your trusty detergent and join the bubble guy in this rogue-lite with unique mechanics. Bounce on walls doing acrobatic stunts, meet charismatic characters and dive into dungeons to clean up the chaos that plagues the world of Dungeon Cleaner.

details.title: Endless Samurai
details.short_description: A turn-based action RPG centered around parrying. Roguelite × Loot draws you into the Infinite.

details.title: Valley of the Old Masters
details.short_description: You are an inspiration-seeking wandering artist who mysteriously ends up in a faraway Valley. Will you find the inspiration you crave, or will you be lost to the mysteries of the Valley?

details.title: Mental: The Dark Night
details.short_description: Mental is a single-player exploration and psychological horror game with multiple stories and maps to uncover. Immerse yourself in a captivating visual and auditory experience as you take on the role of an investigator at a paranormal research company.

details.title: The Razorform
details.short_description: Infiltrate a classified research facility and unleash the Razorform, a time-warping entity from a dimension of nightmares and chaos. Spray gunfire, uncover military secrets, and slice through enemies with electrified blades. The Razorform is a single player atmospheric sci-fi action game.

details.title: Blazing War World
details.short_description: 3D Apocalypse Level-Based Action Game. Players navigate radiation-ruined areas, using walking, jumping, shooting, exclusive ultimate skills to fight mutated zombies, wasteland thugs, agile creatures, elites. Core goals: defeat bosses or finish tasks to advance, with classic level challenges.

details.title: Crescent County
details.short_description: Crash headfirst into this witch-tech world, drifting and driving on the back of your new motorbroom. Make deliveries, trick out your broom, and race your new friends (and crushes) as the sun sets. Get into gossip, sort your life out, and discover what it means to find home.

details.title: Chromahertz
details.short_description: Chromahertz is a colorful and dangerous bullet hell boss rush game. It's all about weaving and warping through patterns to evade and reflect bullets. Be careful where you stop!

details.title: System Purge: Hollow Point
details.short_description: Faced with a horrifying tragedy, you must delve into a flowering realm of memories and nightmares to save your dead lover. SYSTEM PURGE - Hollow Point is a challenging, atmospheric, and action-packed 2D platformer.

details.title: Survivter
details.short_description: Arenas, dungeons, rooms, a huge amount of monsters and bosses. Roguelike + first-person autoshooter. Unique weapons, various modifiers for the character. All this is waiting for you in Survivter.

details.title: Murder on the Stella
details.short_description: It's a murder mystery. It's an adventure. It's a cruise vacation simulator. It's different each time you play.

details.title: Wild Area
details.short_description: "Wild Area" is a game of survival and adventure while exploring wild areas. It is a rogue-like survival RPG game that produces production through gathering and hunting during the day, or goes on an adventure, and defends against zombies at night.

details.title: Desktop Trains
details.short_description: Turn your taskbar into a railway line! Help Sonya restore the railway after the cataclysm. Transport people and cargo, build new routes, and unlock shiny new trains in this cozy idle game for your desktop!

details.title: BITGUN Survivors
details.short_description: The first of its kind open-world vampire-survivors game. Explore a dynamic environment, encounter random events, and adapt to survive a zombie outbreak. With upgrades and challenging gameplay, test your skills and adaptability to increase your chances of survival.

details.title: Regen Protocol
details.short_description: Sci-fi progression/idler game with many unexpected twists. Build modules, set protocols and help your ship grow to get it back to it's desired destination after the ships Regen Protocol is initiated.

details.title: Super Vecter Elite Turbo
details.short_description: Explore, fight and race across the real world in the sequel to one of the best runner games out there. Real cities, real mountains, real scale, all waiting for you to discover and unlock. Customize your ship, unlock new ones, and fight enemies at crazy speeds.

details.title: RECURSOR
details.short_description: An action rogue-lite inspired by platform fighters

details.title: Total World Liberation
details.short_description: Open World Survival Automation Crafting Building Turn-Based game, yup that's a huge mix of genres and it works!

name: My Hidden Pets: Find My Duck

details.title: My Hidden Pets: Find My Duck
details.short_description: Step into the unique world of duck searching. Bring a friend and see how many ducks you can find in the latest adventure of the My Hidden Pets series

details.title: ノロワレサイクル
details.short_description: Mayuhara City, Tokyo. The wounds of the mass suicide event of Mayuhara Academy from eight years ago have finally begun to heal. The rumors of the “Mayuhara Curse” are still whispered amongst the students.

details.title: Legend vs. Legion
details.short_description: Legend vs. Legion is a roguelite HERO defense! A twist on the traditional tower defense game, play as a legendary hero empowered by a random arsenal of powerful spells and artifacts. Defend against hordes of monsters using strategy and reflexes, and save the realm of Valia.

details.title: Sea of Brave: Beast Island
details.short_description: Prisoners on a legendary island! Rescue your crew in this turn-based roguelike deckbuilder. Think carefully about every move: your actions decrease each enemy's countdown, bringing them closer to their turn. Combine transformations, manage your energy, and escape Benryu!

details.title: Tinycraft
details.short_description: Demons from another world are coming, leading the allied forces of the Six Races to resist them. Choose your hero, build and continuously strengthen your team, and enjoy the collision of traditional RTS and Rogue mechanics in this world of sword and magic!

details.title: Rise of Realms
details.short_description: Rise of Realms is a 4X RPG, for 1-6 players, in a medieval fantasy setting. Command an empire and recruit heroes to lead your armies. Use your tactical abilities to conquer the lands and reshape them in your image. Wishlist now.

details.title: Dangerous Connections
details.short_description: 1987. The Soviet Union is cracking from within. As special agent Dan Morris, navigate a world of shifting loyalties, covert operations, and ideological fractures in this story-driven Cold War FPS.

details.title: Gummy Nightmares
details.short_description: Step into the enigmatic world of Gummy Nightmares as a little boy who wakes up in a mysterious amusement park with no memory. Explore, solve puzzles, and uncover lost memories while evading sinister plushie robots. Use weapons, set traps, and find hideouts to survive and reveal the truth.

details.title: SkullStars: Supernova
details.short_description: SkullStars: Supernova looms over us in the funk of outer space! A 2D anime fighting game with stylish 3D models. Fight your way to become a SkullStar with an electrifying soundtrack. The five points of the universe will reconnect!

details.title: Palettopia
details.short_description: Paint beautiful island cities with a brushstroke in this cozy puzzle game. Explore endless islands and solve puzzles while balancing the serene landscapes and your growing urban districts. Discover vibrant biomes and their adorable inhabitants as you paint your own perfect utopia in Palettopia.

details.title: Fortune and Glory
details.short_description: Fortune & Glory is a text-parser action RPG about leaving home to become a hero! Decide who you are as you explore an ailing world in a detailed retro-inspired style. Gain help from your personalities and their internal dialogue to solve puzzles and fight monsters in a realtime battle system.

details.title: Department of Gravity Management
details.short_description: Starting a new job is tough. But when your boss is a clueless AI, things get weird. Navigate your way through a seemingly abandoned space station in this gravity-defying FPS Metroidvania. Solve physics-based puzzles, interact with tools in your environment, and find out what happened.

details.title: Path For The Seeker
details.short_description: Path For The Seeker is a detective adventure in which a young nun investigates the disappearance of a famous inventor in a city on the border of two worlds.

details.title: Legend of BAKEHIME
details.short_description: A thrilling Japanese-style action game featuring Saya, a half-yokai princess who fires spiritual arrows from her bow, and Jubei, her kind-hearted retainer who wields a spear with mastery. Together, they stand against waves of terrifying yokai through the power of their bond!

details.title: IconicQuest
details.short_description: For players who remember when MMOs respected their time. A pixel-art, top-down MMORPG with real-time skill combat, branching class specializations, and loot worth keeping. Built solo, in the open.

details.title: Endless Night Sonata
details.short_description: Endless Night Sonata is a hand drawn metroidvania with classic style animation. Follow the quest of Nicodemos in the "Worlds-in-middle", an unforgiving and dangerous land controlled by demonic forces on a epic mission to find his purpose...

details.title: I'M YOUR HOST
details.short_description: An audio deduction game where you have one task: restore a series of lost podcast episodes.

details.title: Ariki
details.short_description: A co-op colony sim for up to 10 players. Wash ashore on a Pacific archipelago, raise a village with colonists who work the land, win over rival villages in dance-offs, then sail your canoes side by side and navigate by the stars to new islands.

details.title: Sticks and Stones
details.short_description: Post-apocalyptic survival simulator set after an asteroid impact.

details.title: DesktopDaily
details.short_description: Ami Koharune and Tsukuyomi-chan live on your PC. Chat with voiced characters whose gestures match their words, or watch them cook, read and sleep in a shared home that doubles as a live wallpaper. Free to download, with trial credits for chat.

details.title: Dark Watching Chapter 2
details.short_description: After crossing the bunker, you reach the shopping mall, but you quickly realize that there is even more of the virus there…

details.title: DRONES
details.short_description: A roguelike deckbuilder where you build the enemy's deck, not your own. In this physics-based auto battler, you choose which monsters invade and discard the ones you can't counter. Buy, equip, and position autonomous drones, then watch them fight. Find the synergies that save the solar system.

details.title: Record Studio Tycoon
details.short_description: Run a record label from one room in 1950 through seven decades of changing taste. You decide who gets signed, what they’re paid, and how their record sounds. When the reviews come in, there’s no one else to blame.

details.title: HoraitoYugi
details.short_description: In the village of Horai, where autumn lasts forever, girls clash with swords and cards in a board game-style battle for up to four players. Master positioning, mind games, and tactical maneuvers to emerge victorious in this never-ending game.

details.title: Catriarch
details.short_description: Your subjects are dumpster cats. Your kingdom is an abandoned building in a human city. Your reign is threatened by dogs, fleas, collar bells, bad valerian harvests, fish-bone fortunes — and your own terrible decisions.

details.title: Perihelion
details.short_description: Master orbital combat and bend gravity to your advantage in this space combat roguelite. Launch from your carrier, tackle tactical missions, build crew relationships, and upgrade your ship between runs as you slowly unravel the mystery of a lost sister ship.

details.title: Surging Blood
details.short_description: A dark journey shaped by blood and alchemy. A FPS inspired by retro PS1 aesthetics, and a universe blending steampunk and victorian gothic. Will you uncover the fate of Cinderval?

details.title: Now You're Cooking!
details.short_description: A roguelike deckbuilder about running your own restaurant. Cook delicious meals, build an extravagant menu, and keep your patrons happy. Did I mention that rent doubles every month?

details.title: 永恒地牢与刹那之恋
details.short_description: 《永恒地牢与刹那之恋》是基于AI实时推演的动态叙事AVG。在这个视觉小说内，输入你独一无二的选择生成新的世界线与游戏CG。

details.title: Space Hauler
details.short_description: Space Hauler is a space flight sim set around Saturn's largest moon, Titan. Fly your spacecraft using realistic aerodynamics and orbital mechanics, take on contracts, and build your career as a pilot-for-hire.

details.title: Chrysalis: Chrome Butterfly
details.short_description: Chrysalis: Chrome Butterfly is a neo-noir cyberpunk thriller. You play Wendy, an agent with gaps in her memory, investigating a disappearance in Neo-Kyoto. Fierce firefights give way to detective work — until it turns out reality itself is an illusion. But is the truth worth knowing?

details.title: PIECES OF THE DEEP
details.short_description: An auto-run roguelite set in the deep sea where split-second decisions decide survival. Explore procedurally generated underwater dungeons, defeat bosses, and recover relics of a lost civilization. Return with materials to rebuild technology and push further into the depths.

details.title: Mistbound Silent light
details.short_description: Mistbound: Silent Light is a knowledge-based horror where your voice is your greatest power and your worst enemy. Solve intricate puzzles with your voice or master the fog's secrets in silence to survive.

details.title: Failover
details.short_description: Take command of civil air defense under constant threat. Build radar networks, manage power and resources, and decide when to sound the sirens. Every choice has consequences. Hold your cities together as escalation turns survival into strategy.

details.title: Streamer vs. Chat
details.short_description: An interactive game with Twitch and Kick integration where every message matters. You vs. your Chat. Are you ready to fight against your viewers?

details.title: Minesleeper
details.short_description: You wake up in a distant part of the universe 27.000 years after being deployed on an urgent mission to save humanity from extinction. A minesweeper gets a dangerous makeover in this hexagonal roguelite. Outsmart devious puzzles, bend the odds, and turn failures into triumph.

details.title: When I'm Not Drawing
details.short_description: In this cozy life-simulation RPG, you play as a young artist who moves to a new city to pursue your dreams. Plan your schedule, balance life and career, explore the city, and meet new friends! Live a fulfilling year on your own, at your own pace.

details.title: Adaptive Wilds
details.short_description: Learn the land. Make a life in it. Adaptive Wilds is a hardcore survival RPG with deep character progression, interacting physical and psychological states, and a wilderness you can reshape. Develop your skills, work with NPCs, experiment with nature, and explore dream realms.

details.title: Sky Pirates
details.short_description: Set sail with your friends aboard a flying pirate ship! Explore mysterious islands, plunder ships and treasures, and amass a fortune… But beware: the richer you get, the more you attract unwanted attention!

details.title: 2080 - Operation Sunshield
details.short_description: Can a giant umbrella save Earth? Be part of the most important mission in human history and join the crew onto a daring trip into space! Will you save mankind from global warming? Be the engineer of our future in this humorous hand-drawn point-and-click-adventure (alpaca inside).

details.title: Trip to the Core
details.short_description: Build three decks at once in a roguelike deckbuilder where 15 rebels fuse modular gear into broken combos across five shifting acts.

details.title: PowerCorp
details.short_description: A space sim survival where each decision costs power. Every system drains your dying reactor. Pilot a crippled spacecraft across a real-scale solar system using true orbital mechanics, manage critical systems, scavenge for resources, while you try to uncover why humanity seems to have disappeared.

details.title: Arcane Spellforge: Core Defense
details.short_description: Forge spells with your hands, build tactical defenses, and unleash devastating power in VR. Upgrade modular weapons and towers, adapt your strategy, and survive relentless waves of robotic enemies attacking your core from every direction.

details.title: HANAE // PRIMARY
details.short_description: A first-person psychological story game: You are Hanae, trapped in a distorted game world. Evilnae wants to take your place and rebuilds everything after every escape attempt. Find the cracks, write everything down and escape... before it's too late.

details.title: CastleOn Scriptum
details.short_description: Build a castle and defend it from your enemies! Construct towers, place traps, train and command units in this historical, manuscript-themed mix of Tower Defense and classical Real Time Strategy.

details.title: Death Denied
details.short_description: Death Denied is a brutal, fast-paced top-down action game focusing on skull-crushing close combat in medieval England. Every encounter is an unforgiving deadly dance. Break walls, bones and necks. Strike with precision. Embrace divine blessings that modify the way you fight.

details.title: Sunset Survival: Miami
details.short_description: Gear up, get out, and survive the neon-soaked apocalypse. Sunset Survival: Miami is a top-down PvE extraction shooter. Raid a mutant-infested Miami for vital supplies, blast your way through enemy hordes, upgrade your base, and unlock powerful skills. Can you make it out alive?

details.title: MilkCap@
details.short_description: This is a third-person milk delivery adventure where you take on active delivery challenges inside procedurally generated towers. * Please note that this game is currently under development; the description above outlines features that will be included in the final, completed version.

name: Red Spider2: Exiled Remastered donation ver.

details.title: Red Spider2: Exiled Remastered donation ver.
details.short_description: A cinematic Hong Kong Noir visual novel. In 2007, an assassin defies orders to kill her savior and becomes a fugitive. Explore her fate through 1,300+ visual cuts and 6 branching routes.(Full story is free via the demo version. This paid edition supports Steam Achievements and the creators.)

details.title: 叉车推箱 | Forklift Sokoban
details.short_description: Forklift Sokoban is a sokoban-style puzzle game: you drive a forklift with an old TV face in a tidy grid world. Forward, reverse, turn, raise and lower the forks — push, lift and stack boxes, hold buttons, power up machines and wake them. Every level hides an “oh, that works too” solution.

details.title: Eldritch Survivors
details.short_description: Eldritch Survivors is a Lovecraftian roguelite where you kill swarms of enemies, gain insight to the Mythos, and unlock otherworldly powers. Can you survive long enough to stop The Cosmic Conspiracy’s nefarious plans?

details.title: Crazy Alchemy
details.short_description: Crazy Alchemy is a roguelike where you take over a bankrupt alchemy workshop, draw ingredients from a bottomless bag, shake your cauldron to merge them, and combine tools to fulfill commissions and get the workshop back on its feet.

details.title: Kyrie
details.short_description: Kyrie is a first-person parkour roguelite built for speed. Sprint, slide, wall-kick and parry through procedurally generated worlds, outrun what hunts you, beat each world's boss and chase a better time, solo or in online co-op.

details.title: FUCHI's Chick: Mini Many PANIC
details.short_description: Up to 4 players hatch baby chicks and lead them to the shipping yard! A cute, chaotic party game starring the deadpan chicks of FUCHI, the illustrator behind the hugely popular LINE stickers. Lead a wobbly parade, dodge thieves and enemies, and dress up in collected outfits. Play locally or online.

details.title: Project Polaris
details.short_description: Project Polaris is an action roguelike following Eunhasu's story. Combine weapons and drones to create your own combat build, and shape her fate as Corruption changes her appearance, abilities, and how others react to her.

details.title: The Last Bookshop
details.short_description: Reopen your father's bookshop. Stock the shelves, find the right book for each reader, and make friends around town. Follow the trail of your family's missing books.

details.title: Dark Gothic Doll Party
details.short_description: Before her mainspring stops, a wind-up doll girl climbs a gothic clock-tower theatre to meet its master. A bullet-hell shooter across five acts and an extra stage: gather screws to buy time, face six doll bosses, and reach one of four endings that change with difficulty. Relief Mode included.

details.title: KaroKowe Jam
details.short_description: Pick a song, mute your instrument's stem, and play along with the rest of the band. Slow it down, loop the hard parts and record your take. Coming soon.

details.title: Gravity Caverns
details.short_description: Explore vast underground caverns in this physics-based spaceship adventure. Master gravity, manage your fuel, recover containers, assist scientists, and overcome hostile robots. Navigate 30 challenging levels and safely return to your starting platform!

details.title: Diving Club
details.short_description: Diving Club is a pixel-art diving game. Dive from springboards, high platforms and 20 m cliffs. The judges score each dive on difficulty and execution. Win competitions, grow your club and work your way up to the World Games. Compete against other players in online tournaments.

name: Sylvia Sparrow and the Witch's Paintings

details.title: Sylvia Sparrow and the Witch's Paintings
details.short_description: A Short Hike meets a late-night Adult Swim show. A witch just set her cat on fire, and now she wants Sylvia Sparrow to hunt down her lost paintings. Adventure across Witch Isle and meet mean, creepy, ugly and brutally honest characters who’ll help you find every last one.

details.title: Seed & Deed
details.short_description: You rented a farm without reading the contract. Cut the weeds, plant, sell, automate and survive a landlord who keeps adding clauses. A cozy pixel-art incremental with a real ending: buy the deed before the fine print buys you.

details.title: Mad Rat Cafe
details.short_description: Top-down roguelite about a post-apocalyptic cafe where you cook orders and shoot your way through mutant waves. Fix broken kitchen machines and stack wild upgrades to survive every shift.

name: 迷宫：秘能探险 Maze: Arcane Adventure

details.title: 迷宫：秘能探险 Maze: Arcane Adventure
details.short_description: A top-down single-player game blending maze exploration and mechanism-based puzzles. Seek treasure chests with limited sight and fading memories of explored paths. Mix and match arcane items, solve puzzles along the way, and find a way to survive monsters and disasters.

details.title: Rugby Playbook
details.short_description: Rugby, played with cards. Take a village club from the cow field to the World Cup, one cup at a time. Read what the other team is about to do, play your hand, win the scrum, keep the referee sweet. Between matches, fill your playbook, fight for the table and grow your club.

details.title: Mead & Embers: A Viking Tavern
details.short_description: Take over a Viking tavern in the cold North and make it shine again: build it up, furnish it and look after your guests. With a living village, a tech tree and a winter that is a real opponent. Keep the embers alive.

details.title: Quagmire
details.short_description: A co-op strategy game for 1 to 4 players. You sit in a Cold War bunker, command your branch of the army on a flickering map, and try to meet the state's quota before the money runs out. Every tank you lose comes out of your budget. Everything goes wrong anyway.

details.title: Project Galaxia
details.short_description: Earth is dying, and humanity has bet everything on its colony ships. You're in command of one. Out there, 467 million stars are waiting, and every planet and moon can be visited. How you survive is up to you: drain the worlds dry, trade with the other commanders... or take what's theirs.

details.title: Othria
details.short_description: Othria is a dark pixel-art action RPG with survivors-like autocast combat. Fight endless hordes, watch them burst into loot, craft gear with orbs and grow your passive tree. Beat each island's boss to open the next. One permanent hero, nothing resets: every level, item and point you earn stays.

details.title: Driving At Night
details.short_description: Et la ville Ses lumières qui défilent Comme des phares dans l'espace Et nos peurs Ont des airs d'espoir Vues à travers la glace

details.title: SilentCordon
details.short_description: SilentCordon is a 3D top-down tactical shooter. Enter a city under lockdown, alone or in 2–4 player co-op, to find your missing sister. Scout enemy positions, use cover and tactical gear, and complete rescue and escort missions. Face off against other players in deathmatch and bomb defusal.

details.title: Rush 60 Seconds
details.short_description: Innovating on the vampire survivor-like game type, instead of slowly spawning monsters endlessly, all monsters are generated at once on a large map. Within 60 seconds, the more monsters you kill, the more rewards you get.

details.title: Bloodrights
details.short_description: An unknown disease has wiped out half of the city's population. The main characters managed to survive the outbreak. However, it's not as if everything went without consequences

details.title: Márgalo
details.short_description: A first-person psychological survival horror adventure. Explore surreal liminal spaces, solve puzzles, and uncover what the true nightmare really is: your dreams or reality?

details.title: Drift Isle
details.short_description: Sail a shipful of clay heroes between drifting islands. By day they go ashore on their own to hunt and gather; at dusk they muster on the pier; by night they hold the ship against the horde. Recruit, promote, forge, refit, and face nine difficulties and world bosses a whole season shares.
developers: 亞瑟先生 Mister Arthur Games
publishers: 亞瑟先生 Mister Arthur Games

details.title: Naval Latitudes
details.short_description: Naval Latitudes is a turn-based naval strategy game that combines classic Battleship-style combat with tactical card play. Deploy your fleet, manage your resources, and unleash powerful abilities to locate and destroy enemy warships. Every ship section lost weakens your arsenal of cards!

name: Circuit Depot - Retro Computer Shop Simulator

details.title: Circuit Depot - Retro Computer Shop Simulator
details.short_description: Run a small-town computer shop in 1999. Buy broken PCs for a few dollars, open them up, find the fault and repair them, build custom machines for customers, stock the shelves and grow the store. Then close up shop and play the games on the computers you saved.

details.title: Sunderkin
details.short_description: Venture into a broken land and forge a hero strong enough to overthrow its tyrant. Loot gear, collect spells, and combine them into a build of your own. Then put it to the test in brutal turn-based duels where every blow counts.

details.title: Gnolf
details.short_description: Gnolf is an incremental mini-golf automation game, in which you play as a gnome building a golfing rube goldberg machine in an attempt to win a goddess's favor.

details.title: The Last Bureau
details.short_description: In this pessimistic and atmospheric grid-based horror game, you wonder if still being alive really is a blessing, or a fate much worse than death.

details.title: Porta Patrol
details.short_description: A co-op comedy game for 1-4 players running a porta-potty service at music festivals. Drive the tanker, pump out full toilets, pressure-wash the mess, crane-lift cabins with someone still inside and hose down gatecrashers. Keep the festival clean to win bigger contracts. It's just another shift.

details.title: The Wolf Is Dead
details.short_description: The Wolf is Dead is a murder mystery game. When the Big Bad Wolf is found murdered at a party for his biopic, you're called in. Interrogate suspects, investigate the scene of the crime and use this to travel back in time and reconstruct the events of the evening. Who killed Alexander Wolff?

details.title: Glitch Hunt
details.short_description: Shoot > Loot > Hack > Die > Repeat. Glitch Hunt is a cyberpunk action-RPG roguelike. Capture droid enemies, equip and evolve them. Hack and control powerful turrets. Synergize skills and an abundance of gear to build your playstyle. Explore procedural maps and destroy SINUS, humanity's AI “saviour”.

details.title: Beckon
details.short_description: Salvation lies deep beneath blood-soaked earth. Survive horrors born of Scottish folklore alone or with your friends - improve your camp, hunt and forge powerful weapons and find ancient, game-altering magic. From the dark, you hear her Beckon - eat a hearty meal and get ready to descend once again.

details.title: Snowtracked
details.short_description: Feel like a kid again. The door is open to a beautiful winter landscape. Wrestle your way over rocks covered in thick snow. Build anything you want, stick by stick. Play solo or with your friends (1-4).

details.title: Badger Tactics
details.short_description: You stole and lost your sister's favorite figurines. Get them back or face her wrath! Fight, collect, and track down the missing figures before SHE finds you. In this retro turn-based tactical RPG, your fate is decided by the roll of the dice!

details.title: Deflectorium
details.short_description: Deflectorium: 2D sci-fi rogue-lite singleplayer. Deflect deadly shots back at your enemies to become unstoppable. With unique deflection system, you'll dominate battles while upgrading your skills and stats. Prepare for adrenaline experience where defense isn't just a tactic but an art.

details.title: Eternal Remnant
details.short_description: Dive into the unforgettable tale of two siblings on the run in this emotional RPG journey. With only their wits and a cursed power too dangerous to control, they must fight, explore and scavenge to survive in an unfamiliar world. Will their bond be strong enough to endure the road ahead?

details.title: A Ruthless World
details.short_description: Embark on an adventure through a ruthless, puzzle filled 80s-inspired world.

details.title: Throwing Hands
details.short_description: Jump and dash your way to victory in this vibrant side-scrolling platformer. Navigate through stunning environments and intricate puzzles on your quest to punch powerful enemies and save your kingdom.

details.title: Luminous Nights
details.short_description: Embark on a HeartsLike action-RPG inspired by 1001 Arabian Nights. Master fast-paced melee combat and powerful magic, unlock new abilities and weapons, explore the mystical city of Noor through 3D platforming, and rally memorable allies against the Masked King.

details.title: Nokai
details.short_description: Sail north alone or with friends through dangerous waters, chart uncharted islands, and embark on an unforgettable voyage. The farther you venture, the stranger and deadlier the world becomes. The truth lies beyond the horizon.

details.title: 3 DAYS: Ghosts of War
details.short_description: In the heart of the Afghan wilderness, amidst the chaos of war, you awaken to the stark reality of your mission: three days to navigate the perilous landscape, uncover hidden truths, and confront the ghosts of the past.

details.title: The Walker
details.short_description: The Walker is a single player survival horror game. Peaceful days have passed, you no longer work to eat, but try to survive. Find out what's behind all this, hope you make it out alive.

details.title: Multi Idle
details.short_description: An idle RPG featuring a large focus on the customization of your play style to make every run unique. Create unbreakable skill combinations and advance your fighter to the point that even boss monsters will fear their strength!

details.title: Monomon: The Black Sun
details.short_description: In the city of Otnorot, a horrific sinkhole has appeared, destroying a part of the town. Follow Conner and Tallulah and see if they survive the destruction.

details.title: Greed Hunters
details.short_description: Collect artefacts. Trade them for power. Betray your friends. Greed Hunters is a chaotic roguelike for up to 8 players, where even the worst artifacts fuel your rise to dominance.

details.title: BOOOOST!!!!
details.short_description: BOOOOST!!!! is a skill-based, sci-fi themed action platformer with some narrative driven elements and some minor puzzle elements.

details.title: Trailer Park Life
details.short_description: Build and manage your own trailer park to either become a peaceful haven or a pit of unruly partiers. Expand on services and amenities to keep tenants happy. Manage staff to keep your park safe and clean or let chaos run amuck and risk it all for higher gains.

details.title: Gold Digger
details.short_description: An incredibly exciting incremental game about hovering your mouse over shovels and moles.

details.title: Frontworks
details.short_description: Build a war factory on a hostile alien world. Extract raw ore and refine it into complex components. Automate logistics, manufacturing and army recruitment. Defend against huge waves of native robots and alien wildlife, then send your army to raze enemy bases for planetary domination.

details.title: Lock 87
details.short_description: Work the night shift at Lock 87, a canal checkpoint in a brutalist dystopian 1992. Inspect vessels, authorise passage, and earn enough to escape the district - while strange transmissions and security footage suggest you may not be alone.

details.title: Darkness Requiem
details.short_description: Fear not only what the darkness hides, but the power that draws you toward it. Darkness is a top-down dark fantasy action game where light is your only refuge.

details.title: IllumaNet
details.short_description: Build a living network across the dark. In this strategic incremental game, connect distant stations with pulse bridges, turn every cycle into Data, and manage limited Grid Power as you scan the unknown and expand into strange new biomes.

details.title: Absurdocracy
details.short_description: Satirical strategy card game with a single-player Campaign and PvP Multiplayer. Absurdocracy is nothing like real life. Your strategy will most certainly make sense, and the best one will indeed win. Discover cards, build tactics and embark on a very serious quest with these totally fake characters.

details.title: Eldritch Wildlife Tours
details.short_description: Eldritch Wildlife Tours is a cozy, Lovecraftian 2-player co-op / solo exploration and adventure game where one role charts a course to cosmic sea creatures based on collective sightings and takes promotional photos while the other safely steers a tour boat full of paying passengers.

details.title: Ardeo Chronicles
details.short_description: Recruit legendary heroes and lead them into brutal turn-based encounters. Draft abilities, gather loot, sacrifice powerful spells to invoke godlike powers and forge your ultimate party in this roguelike fusion of turn-based tactics and RPG.

details.title: Hit The Floor
details.short_description: Eight legs, three guns, bullet heaven chaos. Play as a mobster spider in this top-down roguelike shooter, where you tri-wield weapons and stack incremental upgrades to annihilate endless enemy waves.

name: Catch A Pack: Incremental Card Game

details.title: Catch A Pack: Incremental Card Game
details.short_description: Open large packs of cards in this 90s nostalgia-steeped incremental game. Build your dream board with super duper rare cards, click frenetically and chain massive combos. Can you catch them all?

details.title: Gooboventure
details.short_description: A hand-pixeled platformer about a blob of goo. Ledges carry you up, ceilings don't drop you, narrow cracks are doors. Goo is both your health and your ammunition, and it comes from fighting. Find your scattered neighbours before winter.

details.title: Voluntary Consent
details.short_description: Your job is something between an autopsy and a survey. In this detective visual novel, you are an interrogation inspector who extracts information from still-living brains. Every day you analyze documents, gather evidence, and make a tough choice: to follow conscience, duty, or voices in own head.

details.title: Runechain Towers
details.short_description: In this strategic tower defense game, combine towers with different functions, make use of environmental elements, and reshape enemy paths to withstand wave after wave of attacks.

details.title: Gnome More Work
details.short_description: A cozy incremental clicker about helping little gnomes grow a giant tree. Gather resources, recruit gnomes to do the work for you, build up their village, and bet it all on a variety of minigames!

details.title: Sorcerech
details.short_description: Sorcerech is a 2D Pixel Metroidvania where you switch between unique magic and cybernetic forms, battle enemies, solve puzzles, and make choices that shape your journey toward multiple endings.

details.title: Grench It!
details.short_description: One goblin wants to become the greenskin boss with a single stolen wrench. Hopeless, right? Well, that goblin is you now. Build walls and turrets, swing your wrench sometimes, and beat the pirate rats. Steal their ship, make it stronger, and let's go back proudly to the tribe who kicked me out!

details.title: A Lovely Day in Hell
details.short_description: A point-and-click adventure where your only verb is SUMMON, and the only things you can summon are the four dead people you still remember. Every one you spend is gone for good. Hell is a hierarchy, everything in it has a price, and nothing on screen tells you what it is costing you.

details.title: Legendary Drinking Story
details.short_description: Every neighborhood had someone like him. Relive memories that began in the alleys of 1999 through first-person brawling. Read attacks, judge the distance, and find your opening after a step or dodge.

details.title: Yeet Animals Gently
details.short_description: Flick a ball at a pen full of very cute animals. Each hit drains a stamina bar, and an empty bar sends one sailing over the fence to land on its feet. Every landing pays. Spend it on a skill tree, unlock new species, and move to a new arena.

details.title: Stone Gambit
details.short_description: Stone Gambit reimagines chess in an epic fantasy world. Assemble armies of diverse pieces, create your own formations, strike from afar, and crush your enemies. Lead the weakest of the Seven Clans, challenge the mighty, and prepare for ranked online battles.

details.title: Midnight Hotel
details.short_description: Midnight Hotel is a cooperative survival game for multiple players, where you take on the role of staff at a terrifying hotel operating exclusively during the night hours. Check in guests, manage the property, keep the hotel running - and survive until dawn.

details.title: Regicide: Chess Roguelike
details.short_description: Forget checkmate. Every capture scores in this chess roguelike deckbuilder. Gather powerful floppy disks, rig your pieces (and theirs), and ignite cascading combos as you chase scores you have no right to reach.

details.title: Torizon Telecom
details.short_description: Torizon Telecom is a text-based FPS game set in a vast world composed entirely of text. “Telecom”—a world where everything is text. “Telecom”... But does any other world exist beyond “Telecom”...? Or is “Telecom” the only one that exists...?

details.title: SHADOW WIZARD MONEY GANG
details.short_description: A game about greed. A chaotic heist co-op roguelike shooter where wizards blast through rooms, gamble with magic, and turn money into health, power, and upgrades. LEGALIZE NUCLEAR BOMBS

details.title: AMIMI
details.short_description: A child and a mysterious creature explore a magical world where every corner hides a surprise. Meet curious characters, experiment with inventive puzzles, and discover a story of friendship, transformation, and nature.

details.title: No Beer Left Behind!
details.short_description: 2D sokoban puzzle game with pixel art and an 8-bit soundtrack. You play as a dwarf tidying up his cellars. The goal is simple: get every barrel onto its marked spot, and the level is solved. But sometimes you need to drink a beer!

details.title: GERPHYON: The Ender Mansion
details.short_description: Will you survive 1000 rooms of pure arcade/horror pressure? Or will you crumble as soon as the lights begin to flicker and find yourself desperately running for your life from the indescribable, aberrant 'FRIENDS' crawling through the bowels of this complex?

details.title: Rusted Frontier
details.short_description: Haul chaotic cargo, drive fully physically-simulated vehicles, and build ambitious projects across a forgotten frontier. Solo, or co-op chaos with up to 4 players.

details.title: DARKDRAW
details.short_description: Descend into the Abyss with a fading torch. Darkdraw is a roguelike deckbuilder where every battle is fought on a board, creature against creature, and the dying light changes the rules. Pick your clan, build your deck, keep your flame alive.

details.title: Dillaball
details.short_description: Shoot, roll, and break your way through the city in this fast-paced pinball-like arcade action game. Collect money to buy increasingly chaotic abilities to spice up your runs, call your friends and put on the headphones for some pop punk tunes and blast off!

details.title: Land of the Dead Trees
details.short_description: "Lands of the Dead Tree A Rogue-Like / Extraction RPG" Walk the thin line between life and death as you struggle to restore a shattered world. Lands of the Dead Trees draws you into a breathtaking realm beyond your wildest dreams - where danger lurks at every step, and survival demands courage.

details.title: Castle Away
details.short_description: Build and command your own flying fortress. Battle your way through a hand-drawn realm and craft the strongest keep imaginable. Will your castle hold up against the Archdemon?

name: The Shattered Mind of Lucas Hayes

details.title: The Shattered Mind of Lucas Hayes
details.short_description: A first-person walking simulator focused on atmosphere and introspection, where players explore surreal spaces, discover memories, and move at their own pace through a calm, dreamlike experience.

details.title: Forgotten Flower
details.short_description: A mysterious adventure focused on exploration, puzzle-solving, and choice-driven progression as two young nobles navigate a mansion that warps into a mysterious and dangerous world after a sudden disaster. Will you uncover the truth hidden within its shifting halls before the darkness consumes you?

details.title: Corridors
details.short_description: Explore an abandoned hospital, solve puzzles, and uncover a nonlinear story where your choices have consequences. A hardcore psychological horror game in pixel art.

details.title: Dead Wave
details.short_description: Dead Wave is a first-person zombie survival horror game where a mysterious radio signal is the only thing standing between you and the end of the world — or the thing that caused it.

details.title: Boing Boing Bros
details.short_description: Boing Boing Bros is a chaotic pinball-like action roguelike where you blast and boing your way through increasingly larger amounts of enemies. Use powerups, stat upgrades, and your boing skills to fight bosses, clear waves of enemies, and boing with your friends.

details.title: WitchOver
details.short_description: Watch the witches.Don't miss the anomalies.Despairing witches slowly lose themselves and become monsters. 12:00 AM – 6:00 AM.Your job is to manage the “witches.” As the caretaker of a facility, monitor the witches who possess dangerous powers and resolve any anomalies that occur within the facility.

details.title: Dungeon Chess
details.short_description: Dungeon Chess is a turn-based strategy game with roguelike elements where the setting simulates a chessboard.

name: Breaking Up Is Hard To Do

details.title: Breaking Up Is Hard To Do
details.short_description: When you tell your girlfriend you want to break up, she refuses to accept it. Is your resolve strong enough to become single or will you cave and stay together? A 30-minute visual novel - Breaking Up Is Hard To Do

details.title: Rituals & War: Shan Hai
details.short_description: In the mountains and seas of pre-Qin myth, the way to Heaven is severed; the gods are silent. A turn-based tactical card game with hand-painted ink-wash art: read clues to enemy moves, sequence your actions each round, then cross swords on one shared timeline. One miscalculation can turn the tide.

details.title: COLDFILE
details.short_description: A tactical third-person stealth game, solo or in online co-op. Hide in the shadows, move quietly and outsmart guards who see and hear you. Climb, take cover, grab and interrogate enemies, and choose for yourself whether to kill, knock out or slip past them unseen.

details.title: Zombies Per Minute
details.short_description: An orbital AI dropped you on Earth to take it back. She judges you on ONE number: how many zombies you can kill per minute. Automate a factory that turns raw ore into mass extermination. Stack wild upgrades and keep ammo flowing so hordes melt at your walls. When you fall, drop back in stronger.

details.title: Rush B: Esports Manager
details.short_description: Take control of a fps esports team and lead them from underdogs to world champions. Scout talent, develop players, manage personalities, and adapt your strategy in a deep, realism-driven management sim. Are you ready to break records and leave your mark on the esports world?

details.title: Yarn-Ball!
details.short_description: Yarn-Ball! is a multiplayer sandbox game where you can create & explore various worlds as a silly cat!!! :3

details.title: Fly to Butterfly Valley
details.short_description: Her eyes were glued to those wings as they danced across the clear blue sky, heading towards a new world.

details.title: Scratchcard Hero
details.short_description: Get to scratchin' in this realtime rogueli*e deckbuilder where all your cards are lottery scratch-off-micro-game tickets! Make your build of scratchcards and gadgets, and 1v1 battle other scratcher enthusiasts on your way to the source of your town's gambling problems.

details.title: UNRETURNING
details.short_description: No one is known to have reached the end of the abyss, but one thing is certain: something must be there, and it must be seen. Explore the depths of the abyss in a game that blends adventure, horror, and dark fantasy. This time, it’s not about the destination, it's about THE JOURNEY.

details.title: AAS Mos Apocalypse
details.short_description: A small accident was occurred in the laboratory, which lead to an apocalypse. Not just an apocalypse, but a 'mos apocalypse'. What's a Mos? It's is a bigger version of a mosquito. Those mos are the reason many people have gone missing. Play as every member of the AAS team and stop the apocalypse!

details.title: Cosmorons
details.short_description: The Overlord demands you Conquer the Universe! Grab your friends in a 1-4 co-op roguelite shooter and deploy as grappling robot Drudges. Battle the alien swarms, complete missions and destroy the Cosmos! Stack outrageous upgrades to build the Ultimate Drudges or delve deeper into the Universe!

details.title: Brickhaven
details.short_description: Create your gang from nothing. Start off with just yourself and take it from a single member to a sprawling criminal empire. Extort businesses, deal drugs, sell guns, and much more. Customize your gang to partake in whatever crimes you want them to. What kind of boss will you be?

details.title: Isometria
details.short_description: Explore an isometric world solo or with friends. Battle goblins, giant crabs, mysterious machines, and powerful bosses to gain their powers. Build a community and help the locals take back their world!

details.title: Mononoke No Kuni
details.short_description: Restore villages, purify yokai, and reclaim a lost world in this Japanese-inspired action-adventure set in an otherworld inhabited by Mononoke. Journey through the corrupted Mononoke no Kuni, recover the stolen soul of Musashi the Shiba Inu, and set out on a grand adventure to return home.

details.title: Infernae
details.short_description: Where you walk, death follows. Duel those who resist in challenging, adrenaline-filled boss battles. In this hack-n-slash bullet hell, don't run from bullets — weaponize them. Fear is no shield.

details.title: Undermaze
details.short_description: Driven from the surface, your faction settles on the inner walls of spherical caverns and searches for the resource that will bring it back to the surface — before pollution catches up with it. But the next cavities are blocked by mazes: guide your heroes turn by turn and design your own maze.

details.title: BROODSAC
details.short_description: BROODSAC is a 2.5D survival management game where every visitor could save your community or destroy it. Manage your resources, interrogate strangers at your door, and decide who deserves your trust as an invisible threat spreads.

details.title: The Neath
details.short_description: Beneath you go. Below the bones of the earth and lower into the darkness. Find your way through twisting passages past vile monsters. Explore, discover and conquer your way to greater depths and greater rewards.

details.title: The Whims of the Gods
details.short_description: The Whims of the Gods is a strategic, cooperative city-builder created for joint gameplay in online co-op mode. Build and protect the ancient city, face enemies, and manage resources together! 🏠

details.title: Moons That Belong
details.short_description: Embark on a journey of strategy and domination in Moons That Belong, a 2D space strategy game that challenges your tactical prowess. Command your fleet, conquer planets, and outsmart your opponents in this visually captivating and intellectually engaging adventure.

details.title: Sternly Worded Adventures
details.short_description: Sternly Worded Adventures is a roguelite word puzzle RPG inspired by Bookworm Adventures where you travel through a forested peninsula with Yorkshire-sounding place names fighting monsters with the power of words to uncover whatever dark secrets may be lurking beyond.

details.title: Nomad: Steppeborn Saga
details.short_description: Nomad: Steppeborn Saga is an open world co-op survival crafting adventure set in a vast, ever changing world of nomadic culture. Explore, trade, forge alliances, and face threats while packing up camp, migrating, and forging your legacy.

details.title: DRINKRIME
details.short_description: On the first day of a long weekend, you pick up a talking liquor bottle on a bridge. It's Jin, a demon judged by the Demon King. Cursed to stay by his side, you team up to Jinterrogate sinners hiding around town. A Fill-in-the-Crime Interrogation Adventure in retro, limited-palette pixel art.

details.title: Simulacro
details.short_description: In this first-person philosophical journey, Poísis, an enthusiastic art student, explores a mysterious island in Greece. As she solves the local puzzles, she uncovers traces of its ancient inhabitants, leading her to question her own reality.

details.title: 嘉离代战
details.short_description: One Chariot. Thousands of Enemies. Fight numbers with speed. Break formations with precision.

details.title: Dead Meat
details.short_description: A murder mystery interrogation game - where you can ask the suspects literally ANYTHING! Dive into a macabre conspiracy of burgers and billionaires, getting up-close and personal with an eccentric cast of cold-blooded killers - using voice or keyboard.

details.title: Neon Extermination
details.short_description: In this cyberpunk FPS, players navigate a dystopian city corrupted by a malevolent computer virus. You, armed with weapons and skills, unravels the secrets behind CyberCorp's experiments.

details.title: Fraudulent Idols
details.short_description: Investigate the sprawling pharmaceutical mega-facility, STRATA, where every choice matters. Uncover hidden secrets, forge alliances, solve complex puzzles, and fight your way through a cyberpunk conspiracy in a true immersive sim where no two playthroughs are ever the same.

details.title: Elementum
details.short_description: Elementum is a spell-crafting roguelike with bullet-hell elements. Fight your way out by defeating a wide range of enemies and discover a variety of spells and items to customize your build and play style!

name: Consult Me Before Opening A Snack Shop

details.title: Consult Me Before Opening A Snack Shop
details.short_description: What, you want to open a snack shop? Better call me!

details.title: Horn of Balance
details.short_description: Explore an intricate new world of secrets and adventure. Features solid 2D Zelda-like gameplay, 12 vast non-linear dungeons and a wholesome story about the young golem Linden.

details.title: Soaked
details.short_description: Soaked is a multiplayer platforming sandbox. Push, grab, throw, dive, crawl, climb, spin, and dig into a variety of game modes!

details.title: Cut the Cards
details.short_description: Create your own cards in this roguelike deckbuilder by cutting and pasting throughout your deck! Journey to the chasms, fighting off dragons and Boviks alike as you manage scarce resources.

details.title: Upon Dusk
details.short_description: Welcome to the world of Upon Dusk, a new PvPvE survival shooter. Set in Avalon, you were sealed in a city that was left for dead while the government finds out what went wrong outside the walls. Will you survive?

name: Ordinary Stickman Goes For A Walk

details.title: Ordinary Stickman Goes For A Walk
details.short_description: Ordinary Stickman Goes For A Walk is a 2D platformer with lots of different mechanics and a little bit of humor down the road.

details.title: Polyroll Pocket
details.short_description: An all new, Pocket-Sized adventure starring Polyroll! Kaiser Kiwi has landed on the moon with a diabolical plan to wipe out the Polyrolls. You'll need to uncover secrets, reclaim the stolen batteries from Kiwi's goons, and power up your rocket ship to blast off for the final confrontation!

details.title: My Dear Neighbor, edition 404
details.short_description: My Dear Neighbor, edition 404 is a survival horror game that tells the story of your neighbor. Go to your neighbor's house and end up in a glitchy nightmare. Fight your way out of this glitched nightmare amid bugs and nightmarish visions in this psychological horror game.

details.title: Ark Odyssey
details.short_description: Ark Odyssey is a top-down arcade shooter that lets you command an army of starships to fight against the force of void! Gather your fleet into formations, and build your team of evolving synergistic compositions. Order your army of Starforce through space and protect the cosmos!

details.title: Heptic Arena
details.short_description: Squad up, hunt monsters, and crush the competition! Chase fame and fortune in Heptic Arena - the galaxy’s deadliest game show where infamy is power and ratings are king. Step into the spotlight and make them watch!

details.title: EINS
details.short_description: Narrative focused 3rd Person Drama-Horror experience set in the near future! As Lauren begins her new job in the global tech company, she is about to learn what hides behind the mirror.

details.title: Imagisty Card Collection
details.short_description: You are playing a casual game “I want to spin more gachas!” “I achieved something more by collecting more things!” Have you ever wondered...? Imagisty Card Collection is a simple game that focuses on collecting cards by opening packs of cards like a trading card game!

details.title: REVENGE CRYSTAL
details.short_description: Awaken in a fallen knight’s body, kept alive by a mysterious living crystal. Explore a ruined world with top-down Soulslike combat, elemental magic, and Metroidvania progression. You are not the knight—you are the will driving him.

details.title: Xplorite
details.short_description: Explore, fight, and uncover the secrets of planet Nargal in Xplorite, a hand-drawn action-exploration Metroidvania. Battle enemies, discover powerful upgrades, and explore hidden paths. The research team disappeared. Now it’s your turn to find out why.

details.title: Hexistence
details.short_description: Hexistence is a Tower Defense Roguelike Deckbuilder. Expand a procedural map, build towers, and cast spells while managing your hand in real time. Optimize your resources to survive increasingly demanding waves!

details.title: Slimeception
details.short_description: Who's sus?! Work together to find out who's lying to you.

details.title: Scourge of the Reptiles
details.short_description: Command dinosaurs. Master tactical combat. Shape your fate. Scourge of the Reptiles is a party-based tactical RPG set in a prehistoric low-fantasy world, where a devastating meteor grants magical powers to humans, elves… and dinosaurs. The result? War. Chaos. And something far worse.

details.title: Wretch
details.short_description: Find the violent stalker hiding inside an abandoned school. Piece together broken lore and solve a long lost mystery. What happened here and who's to blame?

details.title: Project JS
details.short_description: You are the one chosen by Nezha. This time, you will carry out justice on behalf of Heaven. The player takes on the role of the next Jishen, successor to the novel’s protagonist Jay, becoming the chosen one of Nezha and using pog card to battle demons and spirits.

details.title: Over Package!
details.short_description: Over Package! is a chaotic, physics-based multiplayer party game. Clash with your friends in hilarious arena brawls to deliver cargo. Outsmart rivals with dynamic environmental destruction, leverage chaotic physics, and turn every delivery into absolute combat logistics madness!

details.title: ChessBox
details.short_description: The match alternates between 2 minutes of chess and 2 minutes of boxing. First to KO or Checkmate the opponent wins. Brains or brawn? In ChessBox, one will win.

details.title: Pixel Vale
details.short_description: Pixel Vale is a medieval fantasy city-builder game, focused on building up your city while managing external threats. Fight or trade with other cities, explore through the fog of war, and defend against goblin raids. Research new buildings to expand and keep your citizens happy.

details.title: Entered
details.short_description: Entered ■■■■■■■... A retro-style horror visual novel branching into various horror subgenres.

details.title: Ludus Saltuum
details.short_description: A third person 3d platformer! Jump forward, unlock skills and buy upgrades! All at your own pace! Handcrafted levels procedurally presented! How far can you get? 🇧🇷

details.title: Kotamas
details.short_description: A cozy pixel dog who lives on your desktop and runs your focus sessions. Start a pomodoro and he naps while you work, quietly clears the distractions you choose, and celebrates every block with you. Play fetch on your breaks, pick from nine breeds and counting, and never work alone again.

name: The Labyrinth At The End Of Time

details.title: The Labyrinth At The End Of Time
details.short_description: The Labyrinth At The End of Time is a retro inspired platformer. Run, jump, dash, die and repeat to get back home, all the while getting ridiculed by a fifth dimensional weirdo in control of this brutalist absurd world that's out of some deranged nightmare.

details.title: The Lost File
details.short_description: A first-person psychological horror. Investigate serial murders in locations that exist on no map. Each location has its own fixed laws of survival. Break them — and you die.

details.title: Chromatic Boom
details.short_description: A challenging, short, colorful, and high-energy arcade game. Move your character, shoot and teleport. You will pass between lasers, cross portals and color the levels as you succeed. A difficult challenge in a minimalist experience of just under an hour.

details.title: UNBIASED
details.short_description: Salvation or Damnation? Measure the worth of human souls in this psychological anime & FMV visual novel about moral dilemma! Will you allow your prejudices to call the shots? Or can you remain unbiased?

details.title: Ashes of Berlumvale
details.short_description: Ashes of Berlumvale is a hand-drawn 2D horror detective game. Return to a ruined war-orphan asylum in 1951 to reclaim your past. Survive terrifying ghostly encounters, relive the victims' final moments, and use brutal deductive reasoning to uncover the dark truth behind a tragic fire.

details.title: The Lonely Golem
details.short_description: A retro style fantasy adventure combining open world exploration with turn based combat. Travel the seven realms fighting your way through elemental dungeons as you search for a way to cure the enchanted forest from a poisonous blight...

details.title: Obsidia
details.short_description: Obsidia is a 2.5D action/adventure game 2.5D inspired by Zelda and Silent Hill in which you are a hazmat technician. Explore the city of Sibodia, fight against tainted entities and solve environmental puzzles to get out of a city which remembers your actions, leading to one of many endings.

details.title: Babelled
details.short_description: Build your way back to space in BABELLED, a co-op tower-building adventure. Stranded on a strange planet, scavenge BABELBLOCKS and stack a path to your spaceship. You and your fellow BABELBOTS must leverage all of their BABELTECH to brave strange sky biomes and build a tower to the heavens.

details.title: 牛马兄弟职场记
details.short_description: Cow & Horse Bros.: Office Diaries is an anthropomorphic workplace sim. Featuring cel-shaded anime art, it recreates real office routines & teamwork with funny stories. Casual story-focused gameplay, simple controls for relaxing spare-time fun.

details.title: Until Mom Comes Home
details.short_description: After a tragic event changed his life forever, Ethan moves to Rottenpine with his mother. As strange occurrences begin to shake the town, the boundary between reality and nightmare slowly starts to crumble.

details.title: Gun Game
details.short_description: Gun Game is a tense psychological party game for two friends where trust is too expensive. Bluff, compete in agility and try your luck in dangerous mini-games! Do you trust your friend?

details.title: Knight Vows
details.short_description: KNIGHT VOWS is a dark medieval visual novel set in the 13th century. You are a newly initiated knight of the Order of Saint Féran, a religious order that spreads its faith through iron and blood. Will you remain faithful to your vow... or to your humanity? Your choices will speak for you.

details.title: Kyklos
details.short_description: In this Turn based RPG You must seek out the first gate lost to time. While many myths relate to its existence, only yours will lead to eternal enlightenment. Go out and explore towns, temples, and caves which depths seem to grow stranger the deeper you go.

details.title: Almost At Pity
details.short_description: Almost At Pity is a turn-based roguelike deckbuilder where your gacha pulls define your run! Limit break your characters with limited resources, master powerful synergies, and conquer the final boss

name: A Very Scary Hairy Bike Ride

details.title: A Very Scary Hairy Bike Ride
details.short_description: You’re Bigfoot. You have a bicycle. And it’s really hot. Ride across the country with your friends, survive the wilderness, and try not to completely destroy your bike (and yourself) along the way!

details.title: PeachBlossomPastry
details.short_description: Peach Blossom Pastry is a single-player cooking simulation game that lets you enjoy making traditional pastries in first-person, immersive style. There are no customers and no orders. With a recipe in hand and all ingredients ready, all you need to do is to enjoy the pleasure of making pastries.

details.title: User.exe
details.short_description: User.exe is a psychological horror experience set in WinShade, a forgotten operating system from the early 2000s. Inside lives User, a trapped virtual assistant asking for help to finish a failed mission: install a virus to destroy Admin, an entity tied to urban legends and missing people.

details.title: BirdBots
details.short_description: Master a unique skill-based flight system in a post-apocalyptic world. Play the story, survive procedurally generated tunnels, or compete with up to 6 players in multiplayer races and Last BirdBot Standing battles.

details.title: Strike King
details.short_description: Explore the strange world of competitive bowling as you climb the ranks to become the Strike King. Wield 100+ unique balls as you struggle against eccentric bowlers armed with an arsenal of elements, obstacles, and outlandish abilities in this bowling roguelite.

details.title: 検索探偵パテ太郎
details.short_description: Search Detective Patetaro is a free mystery adventure set in a shopping street in 2050. Trace patents, designs, and trademarks with young detective Patetaro, compare testimony and clues, and eliminate impossible answers one by one. All 5 episodes free. Your search query becomes your deduction.

details.title: Here, There Be Monsters
details.short_description: Hunt legendary deep-sea beasts through unpredictable waters, where every passing day drains your vital resources. Choose to hunt bounties, prey on merchant fleets, or turn to piracy just to survive.

details.title: Into the Barrel
details.short_description: This is a single-player, first-person, roguelite action game. Fight bloody battles alongside the weapon in your hand, accumulate wealth and experience through each kill, strengthen yourself, tear through the planet, and become the strongest.

details.title: Legumi Lagoon
details.short_description: Uncover the lost histories and legends of the mysterious Legumi in a stressfully relaxing survival RPG like none other.

details.title: Paracampus 2015
details.short_description: ParaCampus 2015 is a multi-ending college sim. You're a freshman in 2015—plan your days, shape your path. Grind for grades, master skills, or dive into clubs, part-time jobs, romance, and campus exploration. Endless side stories await.

details.title: Luman Lars: Dichotomy
details.short_description: Two worlds. A 2D pixel-art open-world action-adventure where your playstyle reshapes your abilities, the soundtrack reacts to your every move, and your choices decide which truth — and which ending — is real.

details.title: Brews & Kings
details.short_description: Brew on an island where the hills, springs, and fruit decide how the drink tastes. Hire masters and link their workshops into a line. When the brew's ready, the workers, the merchants, and even the Queen come calling, but that's life. You can't please everyone.

details.title: FruitSnoot
details.short_description: Capture fruit, grow your tail, chase rare finds, and unlock quirky characters and equipment in a cute, chaotic action roguelite.

details.title: Boot the Beet
details.short_description: Boot the Beet is a high-impact arcade brawler where the only thing between your harvest and a swarm of hungry aliens is a heavy steel toe. Forget guns and magic—this is about the raw stopping power of a well-placed kick.

details.title: Seedfall
details.short_description: Earth’s time is up. In this cooperative Idle RPG, secure humanity's survival by controlling alien fauna with nano-parasites. Automate complex resource chains, unlock 30+ unique skills, and team up in massive Global Missions. Your squad evolves even while you are offline.

details.title: Squid Arrives：Make Squid Great Again
details.short_description: In XXXX, deep-sea squids receive "nuclear food" from the islands. This unnatural feast triggers their awakening, reviving the lost memory of cephalopod world domination. Note: Inspired by fried calamari. Contains allegory. Don't overthink it! (laughs)

details.title: Plume
details.short_description: Plume is a roguelite about a tribe of birds ravaged by a volcano. As one of its last survivors, fight your way through randomly generated levels, gather and grow powerful items to create the ultimate build, and rebuild your village to its former glory!

details.title: Kint
details.short_description: A text-based fantasy multiplayer RPG where all players must decide what lore is true. Explore the world of Seram, learn everything you can. Resolve conflicts between lore by voting each week. Can you solve the mystery behind the Kilns?

details.title: Spellstride VR
details.short_description: Your legs get you there. Your spells get you through. Move to advance, look to aim, and choose the right spells as enemies approach. Take on a new route every day, level up your wizard, and collect loot in this movement-driven VR spellcasting game.

details.title: Dungeon Roller
details.short_description: Roll into action with your snowman warrior as you journey through dungeons filled with enemies, traps, and challenges. Each new chapter brings more danger—can you survive them all?

details.title: Attractor K7
details.short_description: Solo & co-op PvE extraction shooter inside a grim Megastructure. Deep within these concrete walls, a terrifying anomaly has emerged: the Refracture. You are no hero here. You are just a disposable resource, a common liquidator.

details.title: TANKLE
details.short_description: Tankle is an amazing action packed multiplayer or singleplayer top down shooter, you have to dodge bullets and defeat enemies to progress and grow stronger!

details.title: BUSINGO
details.short_description: BUSINGO is a first-person survival game for solo or co-op play in a dry, post-apocalyptic world. You travel in one bus, search for water and fuel, and customize the bus. Theft and violence affect your reputation with the factions along the road.

details.title: Word Hack
details.short_description: Word Hack is a roguelike deckbuilder where you hack your enemies by finding patterns in their names. Gain prestige, spend it, and trade programs to hack enemies and friends! All in a terminal user interface (TUI) style presentation.

details.title: Backpack Syndicate
details.short_description: Your backpack is your build. Explore first-person dungeons, take on enemies in this backpack auto-battler, and unlock new characters as your syndicate grows.

details.title: Editor Simulator
details.short_description: Go from a broke video editor to an industry icon working with top creators and making serious money. Land clients, improve your skills and upgrade your setup as you climb your way to the top of the industry.

details.title: Bluff or Bust
details.short_description: Bluff or Bust is a multiplayer social deduction game inspired by Persian Gol ya Pooch, where players hide and track a Goal ball using observation, intelligence, and reading body language.

details.title: Scindistella
details.short_description: Scindistella is a fast-paced space arcade game about a large-scale war between two powers. Take part in fighter battles, destroy cruisers and stations, fight in planetary orbits, and invade enemy systems.

details.title: INK MAZE
details.short_description: Chart your own path through a fog-shrouded dungeon in INK MAZE! Design cryptic treasure maps to solve puzzles, outsmart traps, and collect loot hidden within the mist. But when you reach the depths of the maze, will you still be able to decipher the symbols you charted long ago?

details.title: Grey Legend: Survivors
details.short_description: Your survivors will bond, break under pressure, and make memories together. Your choices will guide their fate in a post-apocalyptic tactical RPG. Explore the secrets of the outside world through high-stake encounters. Unlock new ways to play, and try again. Find your way to rebuild human society.

details.title: 5 Blocks of Happiness
details.short_description: When expecting mother Clementine is placed on strict bed rest, Julian decides to bring the world to her. Help him build a cozy neighborhood right outside their door. Fulfill your neighbors' daily cravings, stock adorable shops, and keep the town's Happiness high.

details.title: The Last Errant
details.short_description: The Last Errant is a challenging turn-based tactical deckbuilder. Build your deck, master unique classes and variants, manage your sanity, evolve and mutate your cards, and outsmart your enemies in deeply tactical grid-based battles.

details.title: MEGAPAIN
details.short_description: A dynamic retro shooter with intense arena battles and co-op mode! Gear up with pistols, assault rifles, and rocket launchers to annihilate hordes of mutants solo or with friends. Every arena is a new challenge, every firefight is pure action! Inspired by the FPS shooter legends of the '90s-'00s.

details.title: Taco Stand
details.short_description: A horror game where you manage a taco stand. Make tacos, serve customers, and get through each night.

details.title: Petaltone
