details.short_description: Plant, tend to, and grow a musical garden masterpiece! By mixing and mastering different Plants, Mods, and Gardening Tools, you can create a synthesized symphony entirely unique to you!

details.title: A Light Touch
details.short_description: A Light Touch is a puzzle adventure game where you play as a guiding light, protecting a small chick from danger. Together you solve puzzles and explore a mysterious world consumed by darkness. Can you uncover its secrets and restore light to the world?

details.title: Memories Loaming
details.short_description: A horror anthology about people working along a remote highway in Labrador, Canada. Try to remain balanced and lucid at your normal job. Also, there's a bear.

details.title: Inside the Samosbor
details.short_description: A first-person co-op horror game for 1–4 players set in the world of Samosbor. Explore contaminated residential blocks, find a way out, and evade monsters and anomalies. Beware of liquidators who may mistake you for the infected. Get out alive.

details.title: Changer Seven
details.short_description: 3D Single-Player Action-Adventure! Explore a Vibrant World, Recruit Colorful Teammates, and Swap them during Combo-Driven Battles! ❤️ A Love Letter to the Toku-Sentai, Shounen Anime, Mahou Shoujo, and Classic Morning Cartoon Shows of our Childhood!

details.title: Contact Protocol
details.short_description: Contact Protocol is a starship job simulator set aboard a corporate vessel bound for Jupiter. Investigate incoming ships, uncover suspicious activity, and make impossible choices as you protect your crew - while the company watches your every move.

details.title: Data Trader
details.short_description: Data Trader is a cyberpunk strategy game where information has become the world's most valuable resource. Buy archives, trade classified data, command agents, and uncover the truth about who you really were.

details.title: The Fancy Pants Adventures Online
details.short_description: Relive the classic Fancy Pants Adventures with your friends in an epic online arcade. Play through the story, mess around in platforming sandboxes, challenge each other to some friendly PvP, or tour through a round of Fancy Golf together.

details.title: Dragon and Mahjong
details.short_description: Dragon & Mahjong is a mahjong-combat roguelite. Play as three unlikely heroes from three very different walks of life, escape the endless games of exploitation, and take on the evil goblin corporation that rules the city—all to break free from the Debt of Fate.

details.title: RANOKA
details.short_description: Command the dead in hex-grid tactical battles. Climb a 40-floor soul-devouring tower as Ranoka, a child necromancer born in its grave, raising fallen heroes, recruiting rivals, and uncovering why the tower hungers.

details.title: Daxi King: Seven Kills Reincarnation
details.short_description: Daxi King: Seven Kills Reincarnation is a Chinese Dark Fantasy Roguelite RPG. You will play as Zhang Xianzhong, the Daxi King and peasant rebellion leader of the late Ming Dynasty. Sacrificing to evil gods to gain overwhelming power, you will unleash endless slaughter!
developers: 骷髅猫工作室 (Skull Cat Studio)

details.title: Anti-Anti-Cheat: a musical action game
details.short_description: This is a musical action game where you need to dodge many enemy bullets appearing to the rhythm of music. Can you defeat Anti-Cheat?

details.title: Slots & Slaughter
details.short_description: You're a broke gladiator whose entire kit is locked inside a slot machine. Spin to gear up, gamble on the reroll, and win your freedom. Or die a legend who gambled it all away.

details.title: Battle of the Kyoshin
details.short_description: A miko gal and a Kyoshin go head-to-head with an enemy Kyoshin! Power up your Kyoshin as you fight, and take them down! Finish them with a trump-card Kamiwaza!

details.title: Legacy of Epstein: Noncompliance
details.short_description: Scandal strikes the nation and J. Epstein is in the thick of it. What follows is a web of mystery that exposes the institutions that are rotten to the core. Who's compromised?

details.title: This Flash Contains Horrors
details.short_description: Psychological horror collection, which includes 5 games: GambleHeart, ROMASHKA, You Are Doxxed, B*tch!, LOOP and COLORFOOD Inc. These are stories about anxiety, pressure, and internal tension linked by a shared atmosphere.

details.title: The Tape: Origins
details.short_description: The clock is ticking. Investigate real found footage, uncover the cult's secrets, and solve escape-room puzzles to escape the hotel before they return to sacrifice you.

details.title: Grey Heritage: Counter Gambit
details.short_description: Grey Heritage: Counter Gambit is the grand finale to the tactical RPG trilogy. Command a massive cast of returning heroes in the series’ most strategic entry yet. Master evolved turn-based combat, guide your army through tactical challenges, and witness the conclusion to every character's story.

name: 三位一体！超異常混沌賭博遊戯～アルティメットカオスギャンブルバトル～

details.title: 三位一体！超異常混沌賭博遊戯～アルティメットカオスギャンブルバトル～
details.short_description: Welcome to ULTIMATE CHAOS GAMBLING BATTLE! Playing cards, mahjong, and hanafuda—all mixed together! Behold an unprecedented incremental gambling roguelike! In three completely different modes, watch your bankroll skyrocket at a breakneck pace!
developers: キザミレモントースト

details.title: Fluffy Spider
details.short_description: A fluffy spider. Tricky jumps. A web to call home. Explore a colourful 2D platformer, find secret worlds, then build a network of insect traps in your idle hub. Collect silk, unlock talents and characters, and fill your radio with original songs.

details.title: The Silent Fare
details.short_description: A psychological horror anomaly game where you observe your apartment, report strange changes, and uncover a disturbing story hidden in the environment.

details.title: GridLock
details.short_description: Command a 3-soldier squad against AXIOM, a rogue AI spreading across the battlefield. Every turn the Grid grows, buffing enemies and punishing your troops. Destroy every Node before 75% of the map is consumed. Fast, tight, tactical.

details.title: This Week
details.short_description: A hardcore parkour game that tells the story of Ania, a kid with mental health issues and a lot of stuff to go through in life. Meant to make you experience how someone feels in a weird, but familiar way.

details.title: Shipolis
details.short_description: Shipolis is a cozy naval city builder and resource management game. Explore archipelagos with your ship. Build cities and expand in several regions. Manage production lines and automate with trading routes. Play at your own pace to build great wonders and uncover all the mysteries of the world.

details.title: Havenrail
details.short_description: “The Last Train of Humanity” is a survival strategy game. Manage your train, oversee resources, and make tough decisions that determine the fate of your passengers. Will they survive the perilous journey?

details.title: 90 Minutes Till The World Ends
details.short_description: 90 minutes remain until the world ends. Will you face the end with regret or go out with a bang?”

details.title: Escape the Exomoon
details.short_description: ESCAPE THE EXOMOON is a narrative driven cyberpunk survival horror game. Hack, hide, and fight your way across an abandoned space colony and learn the terrifying secrets within. Will you sacrifice your sanity for survival?

details.title: Yominosono
details.short_description: A first-person horror exploration where Japanese mythology meets thalassophobia. With no power to resist, observe and evade as you wander the otherworld of Yomi. Flee, or bear your karma and seek atonement—your choices shape the ending. Yomi sees all that you are.

details.title: NAIRI: Blinding Light
details.short_description: A hand-drawn adventure blending visual novel storytelling with point-and-click puzzles. Explore the lush Penguin Lagoon and descend into the ruins of ancient civilizations. Beneath the city’s foundations, a colossal beast stirs…

details.title: By the Dead
details.short_description: Explore the dark, fight the un-dead forces, gather valuable resources, craft for survival, build safe shelters, and survive the night in this eerie open world survival crafting game!

name: Three Axes Bar: Paid or Pain

details.title: Three Axes Bar: Paid or Pain
details.short_description: Three Axes Bar: Paid or Pain is a rogue-lite with elements of horror, at the center of which stands the story of a broken man. Modify your body, explore the bar, and break the rules! Your main task is to survive and remain human, whatever that may mean…

details.title: Uphill Both Ways
details.short_description: Two penguins, one snowball. Lean together to roll it down a six-world mountain, grow it huge, bowl through cheering crowds and chain big-air combos, then ride it all the way back up. Co-op physics comedy for two, online or on one PC, or solo with a stick per penguin.

name: Onka: Echoes of the Spirit Prison

details.title: Onka: Echoes of the Spirit Prison
details.short_description: Even those you fear once had lives of their own… Explore a Japanese manor in another realm, solve puzzles, and escape vengeful spirits as you uncover a family's past in this story-driven 3D Japanese horror adventure.

details.title: Animal Chaos
details.short_description: Animal Chaos is a 2–5 player physics party game where oversized, round zoo animals run, roll, fight, race, and try to escape. Work together, panic in proximity voice chat, betray each other by accident, and survive the chaos.

details.title: BowlTown碗镇
details.short_description: 欢迎来到碗镇。这是一则虚构的现实故事，讲述了少数群体的困境和自救。碗镇的居民几乎都是是兽人，如果你仔细观察会发现，他们在历史和现实中都有自己的名字，他们的故事也似曾相识。你是偶然逃到碗镇的兽人厨师，在碗镇流动设宴款待居民，在食物与交谈之中，完成自我和居民的治愈。

details.title: Weave & Wander
details.short_description: Weave & Wander is a cozy, atmospheric adventure where you play as a small spider finding its way through a vast, living world. Climb across walls and ceilings, weave your own paths, and leap through the unknown as you journey from the depths of a cave into the wild beyond.

details.title: Things to Forget – Lighthouse
details.short_description: Adam Foster, a 23-year-old office worker whose life is turned upside down after a breakup with his girlfriend. In an attempt to escape from himself, he takes a job as a lighthouse keeper, hoping to clear his mind. He could never have imagined the horror he would have to endure at his new workplace.

name: The Journey of the Gnomes: The Battle of the Elder Isles

details.title: The Journey of the Gnomes: The Battle of the Elder Isles
details.short_description: One gnome wizard against an entire army of darkness. Journey of the Gnomes is a fantasy survivors-like, bullet heaven game. Cast powerful spells, mighty elemental synergies, and survive the shadow horde!

details.title: Astral Trial
details.short_description: This is a deck-building game (DBG) that emphasizes symmetrical strategy. Your enemies, like you, possess decks, energy, and relics. Optimize your strategy, build your deck, challenge powerful female bosses, and save the world from collapse.

details.title: Terra Ninfa
details.short_description: A laid-back puzzle/exploration game about reviving forgotten, dried-up landscapes and turning them into picturesque dioramas. Manipulate water, irrigate all the plants, bring a wild beauty to a neglected world while discovering the secrets of the Nymphs.

details.title: Wasteland Light
details.short_description: Light of the Wasteland is a PvE survival game. Build your base in a wasteland, scavenge for supplies, gradually arm yourself, and fend off the creatures. When faced with insurmountable monster, you can awaken a mysterious power within your body, temporarily transforming to turn the tide of battle.

details.title: IRON-PLUNDER
details.short_description: THE PLUNDER AWAITS! “KING ORANGE” and his fiendish collectors have stolen “The Chief’s” comic book collection and only “Deathwish Newyork” can get them back! Blast the hell out of "KING ORANGE'S" facilities and secure the IRON PLUNDER!

details.title: Tales of the Otherworld
details.short_description: A single-player and multiplayer game paying homage to classic MMORPGs: Explore the MU Continent featuring low-number stats, AFK auto-battles, co-op play, farming, and fishing.

details.title: Corocoro Friends
details.short_description: Roll, stick, and carry everything. "Coro-coro Friends" is a chaotic physics puzzle action game where you roll a sphere, cling to objects, and solve challenges in creative ways. Play solo or with a friend—cooperate or sabotage your way to the goal.

details.title: Pact of the Black Tide
details.short_description: A narrative point-and-click adventure game blending puzzles and wit. Explore, interact with a cast of colorful characters, combine items, and manipulate reality through an integrated magic system. Humor, adventure, and discovery await to bring you into new and unexpected worlds.

details.title: The Blood Knight: Episode Dawn
details.short_description: Defeat, Devour, and Forge. The Blood Knight is a Turn-Based JRPG inspired by the classics. Guide Zeno Trillion, a boy who can turn objects into something more. Master unique skills and equipment, unleash Zeno's Critical Skills, and lead companions through a journey full of twists and turns.

name: Outbreak The Fedora Files: What Lydia Knows - Known Factors

details.title: Outbreak The Fedora Files: What Lydia Knows - Known Factors
details.short_description: Join Lydia as she takes her fight to expose the corruption in Cypress Ridge to City Hall in the second part of the visual novel series What Lydia Knows.

name: Detective Turner: If Looks Could Kill

details.title: Detective Turner: If Looks Could Kill
details.short_description: A point-and-click noir murder mystery where you literally read the room. Search for clues in text, photograph evidence, and interrogate suspects in visual novel-style conversations to solve the murder of a fashion icon.

details.title: Block Crime
details.short_description: Imagine GTA, but in a blocky style with a living online RP world. Block Crime is a crime simulator where you choose your role: police officer, gangster, or ordinary worker. Take over districts, participate in gang wars, create businesses, and become the boss of Los Palms city!

details.title: Afterlight Survival
details.short_description: Open-world sandbox survival horror combining base-building, crafting, and tower defense. Scavenge for supplies and build your home while evading what's left of the government and the undead it created. Play solo or online co-op with up to 4 players.

name: Lights Out Chapter 2 The Unseen Reckoning

details.title: Lights Out Chapter 2 The Unseen Reckoning
details.short_description: Alone again and abandoned in the house, this time even darker than usual. You return as Jack and set out to search for your missing Friend.

details.title: Under A Groove
details.short_description: 'Under A Groove' is a rhythm game that's fun just to watch, even if you're only playing the music video. A stylish rhythm action game where visuals and music sync perfectly—simple to play, deeply satisfying to master.

details.title: Evil thought
details.short_description: Awakened by a brainwave separator in an artificial resurrection experiment, you fall into a mental maze blending reality and dreams. Corroded by the inner "Earth Mother", you follow your grandmother’s clues through distorted campuses, decayed buildings, secret labs and strange memory plains.

details.title: USURPATIO
details.short_description: In a world where humankind has begun to create life on its own terms, the eighth sin emerges. USURPATIO.

details.title: 雨の日に見た想月
details.short_description: A Monar RPG about a suicidal student who adventures through another world to prolong his life. Travel between a fantastical and unknown other world and the suffering-filled reality, saving him from his fate of death.

details.title: SCP-939: With Many Voices
details.short_description: PSX-style survival horror set in a post-Soviet SCP universe. As a Foundation Agent, investigate rumors of missing people's voices. Evade SCP-939 - a blind predator tracking sound and mimicking human speech. Gather intel to call the MTF, and choose between strict orders and saving locals.

details.title: Manifest Unknown
details.short_description: In this narratively driven train Sim, you’re the driver of a train full of mysteries. Your family is counting on you. Will you stay on schedule and follow orders, or risk stepping off duty to uncover the secrets hiding along the line? The choice is yours.

details.title: Susuki Kaidan
details.short_description: A first-person survival horror set in the dying fields of Sengoku Japan. To reach Kyoto and escape the war, a lone survivor must cross endless fields of susuki grass while the White Ghost watches from within.

details.title: Outage: Trespass
details.short_description: Trapped in a dark mansion, you must escape a violent hunter, his deadly traps, and the mutant creatures inside the mansion. Explore, loot supplies, craft weapons, hide, and fight your way out alone or with friends.

details.title: All You Can Reap
details.short_description: A short incremental game about feeding a Demonic Altar by reaping squirming field of Critters. Reap, grow, and slowly descend into hell!

details.title: Rocky Up
details.short_description: A challenging 2D platformer with mouse-only controls and only natural sounds. Jump, jump, and jump all the way to reaching the mountains top.

details.title: Time Flow
details.short_description: Take on the role of a creature exploring the surface of a living island, inheriting its powers to control the flow of time for objects, enemies, and yourself. Overcome a variety of dynamic, time-based challenges to heal the corrupted environment.

details.title: My Farm 2
details.short_description: A city family inherits an abandoned farm. Cultivate your plots, raise your animals, repair and transform a run-down estate into a thriving farm. Take part in village life, face the surprises of the seasons… and uncover the mysteries hanging in the sky.

details.title: Sandwatch
details.short_description: Sandwatch is a rhythm game where you hit two types of notes falling from above with perfect timing. Freely bind and press your keys as you follow the trajectory of the hourglass.

details.title: JoustVille
details.short_description: A ruined name, an empty manor, a single horse. It's all that's left. Bond with your horse, take up the lance, and ride into a world that watched your family fall, but hasn't heard of you. Yet. Will you be a knight to remember? A medieval jousting RPG of horses, heraldry, and reputation.

details.title: Paintra
details.short_description: Leap, roll, and swing through a vibrant watercolour world under threat by the spreading Smudge! Master momentum-based platforming, launch yourself with a trusty boomerang, and chain moves together to unlock secrets in this challenging, physics-infused 2D platforming adventure.

details.title: Super Optimal Amount of Punching
details.short_description: Punch everything. Learn nothing. Lord Evil's shining nipples await you.

details.title: Dalam Kelam: The Night Shift
details.short_description: Welcome to the night shift. Your tasks are simple: follow the nightly janitorial routine and ignore all disturbances. Last seven nights to earn your transfer to headquarters.

details.title: CANNABIS
details.short_description: Beast-themed drug novel RPG

details.title: Paws Up!
details.short_description: A challenging precision platformer where cats jump up dark, ominous and fantasy type environments. Master tight jumps and timing, customize your cat with collectible outfits, and seek out what awaits for your cat at the top!

details.title: Polyzonia
details.short_description: An ecosystem sim set in the Amazon rainforest. Grow plants, create habitats for animals, and click to hunt prey, pollinate flowers, eat fruit, and poop to spread seeds. Unlock automation and make the rainforest grow and thrive on its own.

details.title: Idle Squares
details.short_description: Claim tiles one by one in this cozy idle fantasy strategy game. Harvest resources, unlock upgrades, and prestige to grow stronger, then automate it all. No single path to victory. Click your way across each map or play hands-free. Clear every tile, complete every map, and conquer the whole Atlas.

details.title: Hamster Time
details.short_description: Your desktop hamsters run on their wheels in response to your keyboard and mouse input. Get things done with friends while collecting cute hamsters and stylish wheels. Enjoy a variety of multiplayer modes, plus a timer and to-do list.

details.title: Timeseeker: Hands of Fate
details.short_description: You have the cursed power of seeing when everyone around you will die. In a crumbling post-Soviet town full of secrets, every choice to save someone costs you something. A dark pixel art RPG where a simple act of compassion may have a price - how much are you willing to pay?

details.title: Farming & Supermarket: Clicker
details.short_description: Click, harvest, and build your own retail empire! In Farming & Supermarket: Clicker, process raw crops into valuable goods, design your store, and sell to customers. Start with a simple click and grow into a massive supermarket tycoon!

details.title: Heroes of the Underworld
details.short_description: An open world party-based RPG with turn-based combat. Heroes of the Underworld is a comfy yet challenging mid-sized adventure in a vast fantasy world, inspired by 90s games and comic books.

details.title: Whose Story (아무개전)
details.short_description: A Korean-style action roguelike set in a dark Joseon-inspired world. Fight supernatural enemies and survive ever-changing dungeons.

details.title: Seaforge: Shores of Atlantis
details.short_description: Beneath the waves, the world of Atlantis awaits. Build your home base on sunlit Mediterranean shores, then dive into sunken ruins to uncover secrets of the deep. Get stronger, dive deeper, and battle dark forces with up to 3 friends in this underwater survival crafting odyssey!

details.title: Nightmare Journey 1135
details.short_description: A horror adventure through wandering nightmares “The escape game is over.”

details.title: Insomnia Club
details.short_description: A grounded emotional visual novel about urban insomnia, moral dilemmas, and intimacy. By day, you monetize insomniacs' pain and privacy. By night, you seek help at a real Insomnia Club and meet the women treated as collateral. Are you helping them—or turning them into a better product?

name: Choice of Life: Become a Witch

details.title: Choice of Life: Become a Witch
details.short_description: Leka has always dreamed of becoming a witch. But the real magical world turned out not to be what she had imagined. Will she be able to uncover all its secrets? Including the one that connects her to magic.

details.title: Snooze Control
details.short_description: An arcade driving game about mastering the art of the nap - while driving! Steer a brakeless truck through traffic on never-ending roads while skillfuly managing your Snooze-O-Meter - read the road, pick your moment, and keep the truck in control.

details.title: Tiny Track Labs
details.short_description: Build a tiny toy race track piece by piece: loops, wall rides, barrel rolls, jumps, a 3-lane viaduct and portals. Then sit back. Little toy cars race, flip and crash on their own, and a tiny mechanic runs out to fix them. A relaxing idle racer you watch grow.

details.title: Hound Riders
details.short_description: A western post-apocalyptic roguelike deckbuilder where cards are bullets. Build your ammo, chain blood-magic combos, and target enemy aim spots in tactical turn-based duels. Explore a cursed wasteland in a nonlinear map where every route, shot, and choice matters.

details.title: Murals
details.short_description: Express yourself through stylized combat in the hand-painted worlds of Murals, a twisted isometric action-adventure where fairytales have gone spectacularly wrong. These are not the tales you were told.

details.title: RogueVirus
details.short_description: Grid-based action roguelike where you face chaotic encounters against computer viruses. Build and upgrade your antivirus using a vast array of commands and add-ons in order to survive.

name: Alice is Dead: Hearts and Diamonds

details.title: Alice is Dead: Hearts and Diamonds
details.short_description: A point and click noir mystery, set in a grim and corrupt Wonderland. Alice is Dead: Hearts and Diamonds is a complete remake of the classic Flash game trilogy, including all new art, added puzzles, expanded lore, and plenty of secrets for old and new fans alike.

details.title: C.C.C.: Contract Cleaning
details.short_description: You're a contract janitor in Cosmo Clean Co.'s Contract Cleaning division. Your weapons fire on their own. Your real job is vacuuming up shards, filling pods, and hitting today's quota. Then call your ride home and make it aboard alive. Solo or co-op with up to 4 players.

details.title: The Legend of Trump
details.short_description: Play as a raging businessman with a mission, take over the Cashlandia strip one hotel-casino at a time. Use bribes, gaudy furniture, and addicting games to keep people in your casinos and make the most cash. Take over the strip, building by building, and become the Legend.

details.title: A Monk's Quest
details.short_description: You’re a monk exploring a vast sandbox world with living, simulated villages, where everyone has a life and a story. Mine, craft, and fight corrupted spirits in the wild. Then return to the villages to build a home, make friends, and master the art of prayer to help them fulfill their dreams.

details.title: Pounce Brigade
details.short_description: Recruit a brigade of cats, arrange them on the living-room rug, and combine their talents in this auto-battling roguelite. Protect a nap or take on enemy packs through twelve rounds, solo or in private two-player co-op.

details.title: Emergency Warp
details.short_description: Command a customizable Starship in this tactical space defense roguelite. Intercept missile swarms, deploy combat drone wings, and mine hostile asteroid belts. When your shields fail, do you risk everything for more loot—or initiate an Emergency Warp to escape with your haul?

details.title: Dark Dawn: Stellar Expanse
details.short_description: 《Dark Dawn: Stellar Expanse》 is an interstellar strategy game set in vast deep space. As explorers, players chart paths in a seamless universe: uncover secrets, fight battles, build stations, trade, and shape factions via diplomacy. You define the universe’s scale and destiny.

details.title: LAKESIDE HEAVEN
details.short_description: For every long story, there is also a short one.LAKESIDE HEAVEN is a short game rooted in dystopian science fiction, packed with a variety of gameplay experiences within its relatively brief runtime.

details.title: Hazard Shift
details.short_description: A third-person PvE extraction shooter for 1–4 players. Fight corrupted machines, scavenge gear, and reclaim city sectors. Harvest corruption to power your squad’s weapons and equipment, every shot drains your shared energy. Extract with your loot and build up your base for the next shift.

details.title: Frost 2 - Survival Roguelike Deckbuilder
details.short_description: Lead a tribe of survivors across a frozen wilderness, with only one step ahead of a deadly storm. Gather resources, improve your deck, and make difficult decisions as the journey slowly wears on your group.

details.title: Swaggerfall
details.short_description: Swaggerfall is a first-person open world fantasy RPG that plays in the terminal. The graphics are ascii based and limited to what the command line offers. Playable with keyboard or gamepad.

details.title: Beezarr
details.short_description: Endless insect swarms, over a dozen bosses, 16 weapon evolutions: fight through 4 worlds as a tiny bee, rescue eggs from guarded nests and hatch 39 pets that fight by your side – from a goldfish to a cat with a minigun. A honey-sweet survivors-like for PC & Steam Deck.

details.title: 战国立志传
details.short_description: 《Warring States:Path of Power》 is a role-playing game set in ancient China’s Warring States period. Play as a historical figure and experience their story, or create your own character and begin life as an ordinary person.

details.title: Idle Wardens
details.short_description: A pixel-art fantasy idle RPG. Walk the Knight and Wizard paths as one Warden, turn your estate into a self-running production line, and push north through fog-covered lands toward the Abyssal Anchor. Progress keeps going while you are away.

details.title: Marble Factory
details.short_description: A physics roguelite about building a machine, then losing control of it. Place machines on the board, take your shot, and let the marbles bounce. Every impact pays in Score, Gold and XP. Upgrade between waves, choose your element, and see how far your factory goes.

details.title: Bored to Depth
details.short_description: Drill against the core, against the odds, and against the bureaucracy.

details.title: The Anomaly Inspector : Hotel Anatolia
details.short_description: Congratulations, you have been hired as the new Anomaly Inspector for Hotel Anatolia. Good Luck!

details.title: Winter Batch
details.short_description: December 1988, Czechoslovakia. Your uncle ended up behind bars. Winter Batch is a first-person life simulator where you survive a brutal countryside winter, illegally make alcohol, and earn the money to get him out.

details.title: EX-Traterrestrial
details.short_description: EX-Traterrestrial is a Stealth Horror Game about sneaking into your ex's house in order to save her from her alien captor. Stay quiet, avoid the aliens hunting for noise, and hide under furniture to escape detection. Uncover the truth behind the abduction, if you dare.

details.title: Board Game Tycoon
details.short_description: Start your own board game publishing company! Combine themes and mechanics, name your games and customize their covers. Have your prototypes playtested, refine your ideas and publish your games. Invite creators, win over fans and critics, and create your first hit.

details.title: Hieroheart
details.short_description: Hieroheart is an action-adventure RPG set in an AI realm where ancient mythology meets living code. Master magical glyphs, nurture and evolve AnimAI companions, build your own camp, and uncover the mysteries of strange and beautiful worlds.

details.title: petrichor
details.short_description: 'petrichor' is a single-player FPS set in a post apocalyptic Ireland. Journey across a flooded landscape and venture into hostile bunkers to save a cursed land.

details.title: Walled Project: K
details.short_description: This is a nostalgic survival role-playing game where players need to make good use of the various resources in the walled city, and build connections with people in order to complete undercover missions or uncover deeper secrets.

details.title: Hollowfall
details.short_description: Hollowfall is a fast first-person dark fantasy roguelite. Cut through rising hordes of Hollows with sword, bow and Shockwave. Between Nights, forge your weapons and change what they can do, then climb to the Hollow King. Fall, and the cycle begins again, but you return stronger.

details.title: Mikitti: Pirate Cats
details.short_description: Four cats, one pirate ship! Team up in 4-player co-op to steer, shoot, resupply and repair. Battle the navy and a giant Kraken. Grab more loot or sail home safe? Pick your skin, grow beautiful Cat Tower Island, and build new ships and weapons for bold adventures with friends!

details.title: Curiopia: Fresh Finds Daily
details.short_description: Here is a tiny island on a shallow sea, where animals sail in for curious finds. Build your world and shop from voxels; fish, cook, and stock your shelves. Invite friends to build and live together. A slow, cozy island life in pen and wash.

details.title: Engines of Hate
details.short_description: You're a mercenary space-ship captain. Drop war machines and infantry from orbit, call down orbital strikes, and micro every unit in slow motion. No base building, no mining, just combat. Every unit you lose costs Credits to replace.

details.title: Don't Give Up, Pal
details.short_description: So she won't die. So she won't break. So she can live just a little longer. I push her forward. Don't Give Up, Pal is a combat simulation where you upgrade and deploy, again and again.

details.title: Stick Desktop Expedition
details.short_description: A cozy desktop idle RPG where your stickman squad auto-battles! Train your companions, choose their weapons and skills, build your camp, and send them on adventures while you work or relax.

details.title: Tiny Shaders
details.short_description: Tiny Shaders is an open-ended programming puzzle game about building image-processing algorithms. Connect simple blocks to design complex circuits, and optimise your solutions.

details.title: Radar Shadow
details.short_description: Somewhere on the other half of the map is the enemy's base. You don't know which hex it's on, and they don't know where yours is. No soldiers to click on: you run a country's radars, air defence and drone strikes, and design every drone and missile yourself.

details.title: Hold Morale
details.short_description: Hold Morale is a turn-based tactics game with roguelite campaigns. Master classic grid battles on land, at sea, and in the air, customize your units with retrofit kits, and combine more than 80 modules. Keep your troops' morale up: if it hits zero, your front collapses.

details.title: Oreflow
details.short_description: A calm single-player automation game set in your hometown's abandoned mine. Mine ore by hand, build drills, crushers and conveyor lines, fix bottlenecks, and restore the deep lift to uncover what happened to your father.

details.title: Case 27: Noema
details.short_description: The architecture of the visible does not belong to material bodies, but to the numinous abyss we sculpt around them.

details.title: Me, a Robot?
details.short_description: You wake up in the body of a household robot. Explore endless rooms, uncover clues with your extendable arms and sensors, and discover why you became a robot. Look closely—everything in this mansion is a clue.
developers: ぬくもりロボット工房
publishers: ぬくもりロボット工房

details.title: Reliquance
details.short_description: Keep out a lurking monster while playing a game that seems strangely connected to reality. Open doors that hold your past hostage as you work together with a familiar face to fulfill a promise you once made.

details.title: Echo Sequence
details.short_description: An isometric, top-down roguelite shooter where your deaths are your squad. Die, and your last life fights on as an Echo, repeating every move and every shot. Die again and there are two. Plan across loops, split the work between your past selves, and clear each level together.

details.title: Master of Treasure
details.short_description: Sweep an endless procedural coastline with friends and dig up treasure no one has ever seen. Every coin, gem, relic and fossil is generated in 3D and is practically one of a kind. Level up, upgrade your gear, and see how far out you are willing to go for the rarest finds.

details.title: Hex & Hunters
details.short_description: Hex & Hunters is a fast-paced action roguelite where you program your own dungeons and create complex projectiles to battle through rooms of various enemies, unlocking new biomes, items and foes.

details.title: Other World
details.short_description: 异世界恋爱冒险RPG哒！想要经历冒险吗？想要和异世界的女孩子们甜甜恋爱吗？那就来吧——！！扮演主角希亚，经历冒险，与同伴邂逅，并和她们恋爱！从逐渐相遇的多名女主角中，选择自己喜欢的五位，和她们积极相处，成为恋人，度过在异世界的一生吧！（旅人啊，请你倾听，那平凡少年的一生。）

details.title: Dino Dare
details.short_description: Dino Dare is an impossible physics platformer and level maker with hours of replay value and super fun challenges. Each level may require logic, skill, and force to solve. Run, jump, and power through many challenging platformer levels.

details.title: Tropical Fishing Island
details.short_description: An incremental, relaxing, collectathon fishing game with D&B soundtrack and a PS2 visual style.

details.title: Black Zero
details.short_description: Fight rebels, mercenaries and the infected all at once in this top-down co-op shooter for 1–4 players. Play on the couch or online, and stop a weapon with no cure before anyone can use it.

details.title: Angela's eye
details.short_description: Angela is a blind young girl. Her only guide is the mystery of a ringing bell. Living as an adopted child of a noble family, Angela returns home to find an unsettling atmosphere. Hunted by an unknown enemy, her only reliance is the bell you ring. Run or hide to evade terror and escape.

details.title: Mars Tactics
details.short_description: The Red Planet is at war. Lead either Capital’s corporate army or Labor’s worker revolutionaries and wage war across a vast strategic map, then assume direct control in turn-based tactical battles featuring artillery, vehicles, and fully-destructible environments.

details.title: Light Odyssey
details.short_description: Light Odyssey is a soulslike boss rush where every battle is a test of mastery. Play as Bandi and fight to restore light to a world consumed by shadows. Face off against towering colossi in three deadly phases that demand precision, patience, and adaptation.

details.title: Abyss Fantasia
details.short_description: In the city of Cynthia, the young girl Eucaly, in order to find her lost past, steps into the abyss at the edge of the city. Along the way, she will experience complex and treacherous emotions, encounter various strange creatures, and finally uncover the deepest secrets of the Abyss.

details.title: MARINES VS GOD
details.short_description: One of you is God. Up to four friends are Marines on a mission. Finish the objective before time runs out while your friend summons monsters, drops meteors, and ruins your plans. Can the Marines outsmart God?

name: Degrees of Love ~ Beyond Eternal Promise ~

details.title: Degrees of Love ~ Beyond Eternal Promise ~
details.short_description: This is a story about fulfilling a promise made before birth. A guidepost for the journey home—reclaiming the time lost by fulfilling the promise the two made in the past. At the end of a journey spanning countless years, with an eternal promise in their hearts.

name: Chop or Die: Axe of War

details.title: Chop or Die: Axe of War
details.short_description: The world is overrun by wood mutants! Chop trees, gather resources, upgrade turrets, fortify your base, and enhance your Cyber Dog. Fight off nightly mutant hordes and save the planet from a forest apocalypse!

name: プライマリ・ブルーム

details.title: プライマリ・ブルーム
details.short_description: 高度なAI技術の発展により、大きく変化した世界。主人公のザニアはただ一人、人の手から生み出された植物たちを取り戻すため、研究を続けています。部屋で植物を育て、咲いた花をSNSで世界に広めていく、ドット絵・横スクロールのSF×ガーデンシミュレーションです。

details.title: PROTECT MIEKO
details.short_description: Eat the barrage. Turn it into firepower. Pilot Tama, an invincible shield drone, dive into the hail of bullets, and keep Mieko's fighter alive. The more bullets you absorb, the harder her guns hit. A roguelike side-scrolling shooter.

details.title: Vroom Boom
details.short_description: Arcade car combat with big jumps and bigger booms. Launch off ramps, fire rockets, drop mines and set off your car's special. Fight a battle royale against 8 to 12 bots, survive waves and bosses to unlock new cars, or take on a friend in split screen or online.

details.title: More Minions
details.short_description: 100% hand-drawn by me! More Minions is a fantasy roguelike autobattler where you recruit and equip units, arrange small army cards, and watch them fight automatically. Let your plan play out or intervene with tactical item cards and mid-battle repositioning.

details.title: Freaky Wheels
details.short_description: Fight your way out of an isolated desert cult in a physics-driven vehicular combat roguelite. Drift, shoot, unleash abilities and upgrade a roster of weaponized rides as you uncover the alien secrets hidden within your former home.

details.title: PSyChE DiVE
details.short_description: In this 2D shoot ‘em up, you play as Caroline, a psychologist that uses her meditation powers to help people! One day she meets a strange “person”, it will make her go through challenges before her life returns to normality! How will this story end?

details.title: Sparkborn
details.short_description: An atmospheric 2D metroidvania set in a world changed by a mysterious cataclysm, where many living creatures have vanished and toys have gained consciousness. Explore interconnected locations, unlock new abilities, fight enemies, and uncover the mystery behind this new form of life.

details.title: The Grander
details.short_description: Settle a 10,000 year war in this comedic Top Down Action RPG where God is just a guy in jeans. Gather powerful weapons and even more powerful allies as you dash, slice, shoot, and bomb your way through a war-torn world.

details.title: Padlova Street
details.short_description: Guide Kapo through an acid-soaked apocalypse of deadly traps, crawling foes and flying enemies. Padlova Street is a hardcore 2D platformer: time your jumps, risk it for stars and beat your best time. Learn the route with checkpoints in Light or climb the leaderboard in Hardcore.

details.title: MAGEKIN
details.short_description: Battle rival mages, collect spells, and build ridiculous combos in a third-person multiplayer arena. Grow stronger as you fight players and waves of monsters, grab powerful loot, and finish with the highest score to win.

details.title: House of 21
details.short_description: Fight cursed enemies in a blackjack roguelike deckbuilder set inside a phantom casino purgatory. Push your luck, upgrade your cards with unique badges, collect relics, and uncover strange events as you battle your way out of the House. If the House lets you…

details.title: Underground Sweeper
details.short_description: A side-scrolling exploration game with light looting and incremental progression. Explore underground ruins, defeat monsters, collect and sell loot, upgrade your gear and abilities, venture deeper, and pay off your debt.

details.title: Two Happy Geese
details.short_description: Two Happy Geese is a pixel-art 2D platformer about a white goose on a mission to rescue his kidnapped brother. Make your way through varied levels, battle enemies and bosses, and use every weapon you find along the way.

details.title: KANKERI: Can Kick Clash
details.short_description: Kick the can to start. Spotted? Race the Oni (the seeker) to the can and kick it first. That's kick-the-can, but this time it's a fight. Kick the can, level up for weapons and gadgets, take down rivals, and kick it again. Online asymmetric multiplayer: 2 Oni vs. 6 hiders, 5-minute rounds.

details.title: Yellow Noise
details.short_description: Dungeon Crawler Survival Horror where exploration is your greatest weapon. Explore a warping city, where reality is slowly unraveling. Survive terrifying creatures, manage your physical and mental condition, and find a way out of the maddening cosmic truth about the world around you.

details.title: ACCURSED
details.short_description: Bear your vows in ACCURSED, a 2D narrative-driven soulslike, hand-drawn in worn fantasy and shades of burning autumn. Bequeathed upon a fading world as a herald of Death, may you find your peace within what remains.

details.title: Crytter Crawlers
details.short_description: Crytter Crawlers is a 2.5d Creature-Collecting Bullet-Heaven Deckbuilding Roguelike where YOU play as Cryptids! Find dozens of Crytters! GROW your Crytters into several stronger forms, earn new weapons, discover new upgrades, and fight back against a multitude of post-apocalyptic threats!

details.title: Open Daily in NYC
details.short_description: Gloria is off to mind her grandkids, so the old shop is yours. How you make each coffee and run the kitchen decides who walks in, as strangers become regulars whose New York lives you uncover. Neighborhood shop, city hotspot, or a chain? Or skip work and buy what real life never let you afford!

details.title: Ragequit Royale
details.short_description: Dice luck meets ruthless card sabotage! Choose your fantasy miniature, steal played cards and send your rivals backwards. In Ragequit Royale, reaching the finish takes more than a lucky roll.

details.title: The Trial of Kharzoid
details.short_description: The Trial of Kharzoid is an arkanoidvania, that is, a brick-breaker set in a gothic world. Explore ancient ruins, fight huge bosses and eat chicken you find in walls!

details.title: Deadly Bloodline
details.short_description: Survive the horrors of Angel Hill as James K. Sam and his family. As they struggle to escape the city, they must face murderous demons and fight for their lives! In this pixel art survival horror adventure, will you help James and his family make it out of Angel Hill alive?

name: ロロりんご♪－オオカミさんと、おとぎのパズル－

details.title: ロロりんご♪－オオカミさんと、おとぎのパズル－
details.short_description: Make music with apples in a world of fairy tales. Connect different kinds of apples with a single stroke to create chains and complete challenges. Play puzzles like little pieces of sheet music, and wander through familiar stories. But something is strange… the characters are turning into wolves…?

details.title: Alchemist
details.short_description: Alchemist is a re-playable narrative game which puts you in the shoes of an Alchemist in a medieval fantasy world. Craft potions, earn Tarot Cards, and seek knowledge, taking what you learn into the next playthrough to unlock hidden secrets.

details.title: Islands Collide
details.short_description: Islands Collide is a bullet-heaven roguelite about ramming islands. Crash into other islands to weld them on for good, clear whoever lives there, and grow bigger with every crash, until the sea raises a living continent to swallow you.

details.title: Order Of The Jarl
details.short_description: Answer the Jarl's summons and wield magic and blades in shifting dungeons to rescue the Right Hand from the Archdruid. In this first-person dungeon crawler, delve into '90s-inspired combat, loot items, face strange creatures, and unforeseen danger in a roguelike world where death = starting over.

details.title: Fleeting Light
details.short_description: Fleeting Light is a speedrun platformer. Racing through dark and gloomy cities, cut off from the Selfish Sun's light, across 50+ short, dopamine-fueled courses. Beat levels. Then beat your best time. Then crush everyone else's.

details.title: 無慈悲な笑顔Re
details.short_description: A remake of an exploration-based adventure game about gods and girls. Return once more to their story—and uncover the truths that were never told.

details.title: PEAK MALE FANTASY
details.short_description: Horde-survival action RPG with 1-4 player online co-op. Thousands of monsters on screen, heavy gore, massive bosses. Collect loot, socket gems, upgrade your gear and skills. All progression is persistent: every run makes you stronger. How long can you survive?

details.title: Your Complaint Has Been Received
details.short_description: A story-driven adventure about municipal maintenance. The pipes leak, the van's broken down, and you're the new boss. Explore courtyards and offices, deal with residents and coworkers, and choose how to solve their problems.

details.title: Cursor Quest
details.short_description: Cursor Quest is an action RPG where your mouse cursor is the character. Swing weapons with your movement, dodge attacks, gather resources, train skills, craft gear, explore dungeons, and grow your cursor into a fantasy hero.

details.title: Veilreach
details.short_description: Descend into The Lost Temples of Veilreach, a roguelike deckbuilder where OSR dungeon crawling meets tactical poker-hand synergies. Master unique abilities and talents, and build a powerful deck to survive dungeons where every choice has a brutal consequence.

details.title: Vacancy: Hotel Inspection Simulator
details.short_description: Every room needs your approval. Inspect hotel rooms and a presidential suite, uncover overlooked faults, photograph the evidence, and decide what happens next. Clear it for guests, send housekeeping, call maintenance, or close the room.

details.title: Save Some Princess
details.short_description: Survive the horde in this fun action RPG roguelike. Discover millions of build combinations with unique hero abilities, itemized loot, and procedurally generated levels. Play by yourself or with up to 3 friends. Are you ready to descend into hell to save some princess?

details.title: MOONHIDE
details.short_description: MOONHIDE is a dark fantasy card roguelite where every choice shapes your run. Fight turn-based battles, build powerful ring combinations, balance Blood and Humanity, and adapt to shifting moon rules as you push deeper into the night.

details.title: Autork
details.short_description: Aut’ork is a strategic auto-battler where you build an army from the ground up. Shape your composition, experiment with powerful combos, and lead your race to victory in PvE or PvP battles.

details.title: Starmax
details.short_description: Starmax is a base building roguelike bag-builder: a deck-builder where you draw from a bag instead of a deck. Shape your bag, build your base, and combine the two into one engine. Explore hostile planets in a sci-fi universe, scavenge for resources, and ship your cargo before your base is overrun.

details.title: Visceral
details.short_description: A turn-based horror roguelike where your flashlight is your best weapon. Awaken on a cursed farm, reveal the monsters hiding in the dark, and put them down with 51 weapons and 91 omens. Every run is randomly generated. Survive the night, or be torn apart trying.

details.title: Assault Zeta
details.short_description: Pilot your alien space ship in an assault to wipe out all Earthling civilization. They're no match for your technology, but they won't go down without a fight. ASSAULT ZETA is an old-school, UFO-flight simulator. Master the unconventional alien spaceship and unleash destruction on the resistance!

details.title: Happy Hour
details.short_description: A first-person adventure game focused on relationships. Explore the office, meet characters, build and manage connections, and guide the story through your choices.

details.title: Pythagoras
details.short_description: Test your mathematical skills. Master trigonometry to solve its mysteries and explore the fascinating world of mathematical experiments. Explore Pythagoras Space station in this sci-fi first person puzzle game.

details.title: Musicasa
details.short_description: Unbox tiny instruments, arrange them on your desk, and connect them to bring your space to life with sound. A story unfolds through the strangers who write to you: read their letters, answer with songs, and watch every reply shape what comes next. Get closer to the truth, one letter at a time.

details.title: Zozo and the Lost Dreams
details.short_description: Help Zozo find his way home in this cartoon-inspired casual Metroidvania platformer. Pillow-fight sentient pastries, train under an octopus master, and brave a cybernetic jungle as you explore the vibrant landscapes of Zozo's dreams.

details.title: Home Wars: Battlefield
details.short_description: Fight in an epic first/third-person battlefield with your friends! In this cooperative PvE game, there are 3 factions, all fully playable: Army, Insects, Dinosaurs. Hundreds of allied/enemy bots on screen! Old school fun, baby!

details.title: The Vow: Vampire's Curse
details.short_description: You are Sir Richard in a tactical card battler set in a dark fantasy roguelike. Master your cards, execute deadly combos, and survive cursed nights to rescue your fiancée from the vampire’s grasp.

details.title: Calame
details.short_description: In this turn-based tactical RPG, renown can change the course of a war. Lead Kenmare and the Panthers against the King of Light, shape the Chronicle through your choices, and wield the Legend to turn battles around.

details.title: Satellite Odyssey: Jupiter
details.short_description: 🪳🤖 Rogue machines, mutant insects, and jazz echoing through deep space 🎷🎶 A stylish blend of survival horror and noir detective mystery wrapped in a decopunk aesthetic. Beautifully unsettling.

details.title: 见诡
details.short_description: A single-player Chinese folk horror RPG puzzle game. As a photographer, you venture into mysterious places with two paranormal vloggers. Explore scenes, gather clues and reveal hidden truths through environmental interaction. Full playthrough takes 2 to 5 hours.

details.title: Devilbreath: The First Seal
details.short_description: Devilbreath: The First Seal is a dark fantasy tactical RPG set in a medieval frontier, where an ordinary village boy follows a hell-born mist into a dying forest to find its source—and stop it before his village is lost.

details.title: Fables of the Kingdom 3
details.short_description: Fables of the Kingdom 3 is a new chapter in the fairy-tale time-management strategy series. Manage resources, construct buildings, and wield powerful spells to protect the Great Tree of Life and stop the mad sorcerer Balen.

details.title: Altalis
details.short_description: A puzzle Metroidvania game!

details.title: WESTLINE
details.short_description: You are the lone conductor of an aging freight train, hauling precious cargo across a dying desert. The world wants what you're carrying, and it will stop at nothing to take it. Keep your train running, fight off the nomads hunting you down, and push forward to the next station.

details.title: Hawkins & Sons Detective Agency
details.short_description: A detective visual novel set in Victorian London. Play as a veteran detective and his young daughter, investigate scenes through point-and-click gameplay, question suspects, and make tough choices that shape the story.

details.title: Fun World
details.short_description: Explore the Nightmares of Fun World — a once-cheerful children’s park that has fallen into ruin, now twisted and corrupted by dark forces beyond understanding. What was once filled with laughter and bright colors is now drenched in shadows, echoing with distant sounds you can’t quite explain.

details.title: Key Krusher
details.short_description: Krush the keys coming at you in this arcade-style typing game.

details.title: Twinkle Seek
details.short_description: Go search for sparkles to the ends of the world!

details.title: Don't Lose Your Head
details.short_description: Destroy your friendship by playing this challenging co-op game about two skeletons sharing a single head. Help each other to get out of a deep cave, be mindful of your jumps and remember - DON'T LOSE YOUR HEAD!

details.title: Medium Chronicles: Room 644
details.short_description: You must speak to survive. But speaking might kill you. Whisper rituals into your microphone — while a demon hunts every sound you make.

details.title: Ironfall
details.short_description: A survivors-like roguelite in a fallen kingdom of rune-forged relics. Pick one of 20 heroes, cut through endless swarms, fuse weapons and items into powerful evolutions, and raise the Run Curse until the Reaper himself comes for you.

details.title: Glassbound
details.short_description: Tiny creatures grow in glass bottles at the bottom of your screen while you work. Summon and fuse 200+ beings. Befriend a town of animal folk, or snoop on them and steal their secrets. Every choice tilts your compass toward Light or Darkness.

details.title: Video Poker Infinite
details.short_description: A casino-style video poker based incremental game. Play classic Jacks-or-Better based video poker while building and upgrading your pay table. Unlock powerful abilities to boost your odds and payouts. Play minigames like blackjack and roulette to enhance your progression.

details.title: We Die Standing
details.short_description: Arcs, Rings, Power, Annihilation, Courage, Comradeship, Worlds, Earth, Humans, Creatures, Flood, Scourge, Starvation, Crisis. Through All, One Must Fight Unless He Dies Standing.

details.title: Occupancy
details.short_description: A detective is interviewing a survivor about a night that doesn't add up. Step into their fading memory, swap between survivor and detective to find what doesn't match the evidence, and help them remember what really happened. Something is keeping the night buried, and it knows you're looking.

details.title: Endangered
details.short_description: Humanity wiped out your species. Now you're fighting back. Play as evolved animals in a brutal roguelike hack-and-slash! Hunt down humans, adapt to a collapsing world, and collect nuclear launch codes to end the fight... permanently.

details.title: Islecraft: Island Architect
details.short_description: Sail to uncharted isles and build settlements as an island architect in this minimalist city builder. Inspired by ISLANDERS.

details.title: MORI
details.short_description: Experience lightning-fast combat as self-proclaimed Grim-Reaper Mori. Armed with nothing but a scythe, cloak and a lust for revenge, carve your way through a criminal empire and discover what it means to lose yourself.

details.title: OVERRIDE PROTOCOL
details.short_description: Hack hostile AI systems in a cyberpunk hacker sim. Build proxy routes, poison live context, breach secured nodes, steal the payload, and wipe the logs before your trace burns.

details.title: Wayward Crown
details.short_description: You don't command the heroes — you bait them. Wayward Crown is a kingdom-management sim where every adventurer has their own greed, glory, and fear. Place bounties, build a town, balance the gold, and watch your realm run itself.

details.title: Here's My Target
details.short_description: Contract killing is just another public service. As a regulator, it's your job to review the documents, listen to the client, and decide the fate of every target, then hope you made the right call.

details.title: Reactor 13
details.short_description: Reactor 13 is chaotic local co-op for 1–4 players. Grab, wash, charge, and craft Dark Matter blocks to power everything from one house up to a whole planet. Overcharge for huge output; the chain reactions are half the fun, the meltdown is not. Play solo or have someone else to blame.

details.title: Shadows of Absence
details.short_description: After years of missing out on life, the journeys, the friendships, the experiences, you are prescribed an experimental medication to help you reclaim your life. The side effects were supposed to be minor, but as you drift off to sleep, you wake up in your childhood home.

details.title: Shadow over Bishkek
details.short_description: Shadow Over Bishkek is a 3D Action/RPG with the top down camera view. A student from Bishkek gains the superpower to travel to the Darkland and interact with ghosts. During the day, he lives an ordinary life of a student, but at night, he fights evil spirits.

details.title: Visitant
details.short_description: Hire & level-up hunters, accept contracts to investigate paranormal activity at haunted locations and collect evidence using an arsenal of tools in this psychological horror ghost-hunting simulator, alone or with friends. But it won't be easy! The tormented spirit terrorizes those who meddle with it

name: Sakura Exchange: A Thai in Japan

details.title: Sakura Exchange: A Thai in Japan
details.short_description: Spend one fleeting school year in rural Japan as a 17-year-old Thai exchange student. In this wholesome, slow-burn romance visual novel, join a club, grow close to one of five girls, and decide whether to board the train home or stay for one more spring.

details.title: Wukong: Time to Deal
details.short_description: Embark on your Journey to the West!《Wukong: Time to Deal》is a Journey to the West roguelike game featuring core deck building and demon slaying gameplay. Experience random adventures and rich rewards, with distinctive desktop interactive content offering relaxed casual gameplay.

details.title: Synarchy
details.short_description: Every space game hands you a gun. Synarchy hands you a ledger. Found a corporation with one ship, then haul, trade and build a fleet across 250 star systems in one shared, always-online galaxy where the news moves the markets in real time.

name: Pooh's Parables: Regarding the Dream Thief

details.title: Pooh's Parables: Regarding the Dream Thief
details.short_description: Help the Sandman as Winnie-the-Pooh, Christopher Robin, Piglet, and more of your familiar friends combine their special abilities to solve puzzles with light platforming elements, best foes in turn based combat using engaging Action Commands, and bring back everyone's stolen dreams!

details.title: The Forsaken Crown
details.short_description: Master unforgiving combat in a minimalist world. This low-poly Soulslike challenges your reflexes with precise dodge rolls and brutal timing. Explore bleak landscapes with a charming retro flair and conquer monumental bosses.

details.title: VeilRaun
details.short_description: Become an Explorer of fractured realities in Veil Raun, a third-person dark fantasy action RPG. Take expeditions beyond the Veil, battle Hollows, rise through the Explorer ranks, and uncover the mystery behind the Fracture.

name: Little Boy : Small Steps, Big Changes

details.title: Little Boy : Small Steps, Big Changes
details.short_description: Little Boy, a narrative game where you play as a robot assistant helping people find happiness!

details.title: Dimensional Breach
details.short_description: 4-player online co-op. The rifts are open, and every dimension hides a different threat. Dive in with your friends, tear the nightmare out by its roots and seal the breach or be lost to the dark.

details.title: Marrowood
details.short_description: Haunted by the suppressed memories of your childhood, you receive a letter from the town you grew up in. They need you to rebuild your family's farm. It's time to remember, welcome home.

details.title: Indian Paranormal Files - Sleepover
details.short_description: What starts as a normal sleepover quickly turns into a terrifying paranormal nightmare. Explore the house, investigate strange occurrences, solve puzzles, and uncover the truth behind the haunting before it's too late.

details.title: Gnomes In Space
details.short_description: An online co-op adventure where Gnomes must pilot a starship through space to find a cure for their dying home world. Accept missions from the Elder Gnome, avoid danger, and upgrade your ship, weapons, and tools to keep your crew alive.

details.title: Contract Terminated
details.short_description: Lead your band of mercenaries and figure out a way to survive on a hostile planet in this oldschool 1980s-style party-based RPG with pixel graphics. Features a mix of grid-based movement, turn-based tactical combat, and first-person dungeon crawling just like the classics.

details.title: Churrolandia RPG Countdown
details.short_description: Two beings from the future threaten the fate of Churrolandia and the entire universe. Join Churro and his friends in this turn-based JRPG, master the Countdown System, explore a world full of magic, and prevent time from coming to an end.

details.title: Survive the Horde
details.short_description: Face overwhelming hordes of the undead in a hyper-realistic post-apocalyptic world. Build defenses, wield devastating weapons, and unleash powerful abilities as you tear through swarms of zombies in this adrenaline-fueled first-person survival shooter.

details.title: Rollgeon
details.short_description: Build your own collection of customizable dice and battle your way through the dungeon in this turn-based roguelike. Roll, reroll, and create powerful combos inspired by the classic dice game Generala. Enchant your dice, manipulate the odds, and discover new builds with every run.

details.title: The Door
details.short_description: The Door is a first-person horror adventure game. To escape from a dream, the protagonist must confront his past and continue moving forward. What lies beyond the red door? And what truth is hidden within the protagonist’s past?

details.title: Hexborne
details.short_description: Draw one unbroken path across a hex battlefield. Tiles you cross become attack, armor, healing and gold, and how you reach each foe picks your strike. Dark fantasy roguelite RPG. Chapter 1 demo.

details.title: DUSTCROW
details.short_description: DustCrow is a space-salvaging and exploration zero-G VR game where you strip derelict wrecks for scrap, manage your tools and equipment in a zero-G environment, and play in a live, player-driven economy. It's just industrial tools, tactile physics, and the daily grind in the vast emptiness of space.

details.title: Gummy Tummy
details.short_description: A co-op mining game set in a world made of candy. Bite tunnels through gummy terrain, haul loot and a bellyful of sugar back to the hub, then craft sharper teeth, bigger stomachs and soda-bottle jetpacks to dig deeper. Push past your tier and your teeth corrode go see the dentist!

details.title: 3100: Far from Earth
details.short_description: Stranded far from Earth in the year 3100, repair your ship, solve environmental puzzles, and uncover what waits beyond the stars in a hand-drawn sci-fi point-and-click adventure.

details.title: Card Shop Duelist
details.short_description: Run your own trading card shop. Rip packs chasing the big pull, price the shelves, hire staff, and duel your customers in Battleforge, a full TCG built into the game. Play solo or with up to seven friends online.

details.title: Together Forever!
details.short_description: Together Forever! is a fast-paced ricochet roguelite where pachinko physics meets backpack management. Launch bouncing balls with flipping gravity, discover crazy relic synergies, and help an angel and demon couple defend their forbidden love against the hordes of Heaven and Hell!

details.title: Dicey Darlings
details.short_description: Dicey Darlings is a tabletop-style, turn-based tactical roguelike. Lead standees across hex battlefields as physical dice tumble into play. Choose your route, combine skills and items, and use positioning and terrain to beat tough foes. The dice bring chance. You choose your next move.

details.title: Xoul:Sync
details.short_description: Xoul:Sync combines auto-battler combat with spatial inventory management. Assemble three Xouls, arrange items in the Sync Case, and choose your route to the next boss.

details.title: With flowers, fringe of fondness
details.short_description: Life is suffocating. Almost crushed by the authority known as "normal." Tuyu, who spends their days asking themself, "Do I have a place in this society?", meets a certain friend at university. Those living on the margins find joy, suffer in their insignificant days—and attempt to resist the world.

details.title: Purpose of Visit
details.short_description: Their papers say one thing. Their answers say another. Staff a booth on a tense border, question every traveller, and drag the lie they just told onto the document it contradicts. One of them is a spy. Approve the wrong face and it makes the evening news.

details.title: Feudal Factory
details.short_description: Build your kingdom, automate your production chains, and defend your lands against relentless hordes! In Feudal Factory, combine rail and cart automation with strategic medieval-fantasy fortress management. Extract ores, forge your equipment, train your army, and hold off incoming enemy waves!

details.title: Above Land: Rhapsody
details.short_description: A chaotic 1-3 player co-op action roguelite above the clouds. Grab a toy. Save the world.

details.title: Rock Wager Scissors
details.short_description: Rock Wager Scissors is a logic & gambling game, where you get rich by adapting to your opponent's playstyle in Rock Paper Scissors. Make bets, use perks, study past moves, figure out your opponent's playstyle, and go all in!

details.title: Mega Sokofox World
details.short_description: Help Sara, the fox, overcome anxiety and leave her comfy labyrinth, to visit her beloved vampire girlfriend in this 16-bit Sokoban Adventure for the Mega Drive!

details.title: Nodus Attrition
details.short_description: Expand your base to reach the enemy threat. This is tower offense

details.title: The Final Showdown with AI!
details.short_description: A forum-battle game with bullet-hell combat. Su Shihe loves settling online disputes—until he finds himself against everyone. Caught between progress and salvation, what will he choose?

details.title: One More Credit
details.short_description: A PvE roguelike autobattler about building cartridge combos. Spend credits between fights to buy, arrange, and upgrade cartridges, then beat arcade bosses before your lives run out.

details.title: VALTERION: THE LOST EARTH
details.short_description: VALTERION: THE LOST EARTH is a sci-fi colony-building strategy game. Lead 50 survivors on Elyra, build a thriving colony, develop its economy and research, return to the stars, and search for the lost path back to Earth.

details.title: The Emperor Penguin Incident
details.short_description: "All Antarctic researchers dead. Cause of death: Emperor Penguin attack?" Log into the isolated 'Amundsen-4' server. Extract and combine [keywords] from fragmented emails, chats, and logs to uncover the truth behind the bizarre disaster.

details.title: One Button Sports
details.short_description: Sports disciplines with one button. The right moment is everything. Playable now: javelin only. Solo, with friends on the same screen, or online. More disciplines will follow. Demo — not the full game yet. From a solo developer.

details.title: Automotive Empire
details.short_description: Start with one kart in a small garage. Expand your team from karting to the pinnacle of motorsport. Compete against 172 teams in 21 championships. Design every part, build and expand your campus. Enter the road car and racing parts markets and face another level of competition.

details.title: Archechord
details.short_description: Tap out rhythm patterns on the beat, unleashing skills to break through the swarm. In this rhythm roguelite, experience a musical journey through each character's inner world.

details.title: Twisted Wicked Bloops
details.short_description: Oh non ! Il faut maintenant travailler 15h par semaine pour toucher le RSA ! Encore un coup de Bloops, complètement déconnecté de la réalité. Terminez les niveaux de ce jeu de plateforme pour continuer à toucher vos droits et découvrir qui est le vrai parasite de la société (spoiler : c'est Bloops)

details.title: SPARK//RUSH
details.short_description: SPARK//RUSH is a high-speed rhythm-action game. Shoot, slash, and dodge through intense rail stages driven by electronic music before facing colossal bosses.

details.title: One Last Fish
details.short_description: A cozy fishing idle game that sits anywhere on your desktop. Catch rare fish, buy upgrades and customize your island while you study, work or relax!

details.title: The 12 CZ: Final Battle
details.short_description: All The End and his followers were repelled but fled to the wilds to hide and plague the land. So the CZs united, ventured into enemy territory, slaying demons, collecting artifacts, and fighting together to grow stronger until All The End's utter defeat.

details.title: Rays of HOPE™
details.short_description: Step into the imagination of a child and play as their favorite superhero cowboy action figure brought to life as the world around you transforms into the adventures they always imagined.

details.title: VtuberCompanySimulator
details.short_description: Take your place as the head of a VTuber agency, run the company, and guide your VTubers as they grow in this management simulation. Type what you want to say, choose how the company responds, and handle each crisis your way.

details.title: GRIMLIFE
details.short_description: GRIMLIFE - An open-world survival RPG set in a world ruled by the undead. Befriend fellow survivors as you search for supplies, fight through hordes of infected, and navigate a treacherous world.

details.title: Paint World 98
details.short_description: Experience the internet of 1999 through an interactive desktop. Solve puzzles, chat, browse, play games, discover secrets, and explore at your own pace.

name: A Game About Picking Up Trash

details.title: A Game About Picking Up Trash
details.short_description: Clean up the forest! Start small and gradually restore nature's cleanliness. Collect, upgrade, improve your tools, and enjoy the calm process of bringing the forest back to life.

details.title: Beaked!
details.short_description: Beaked! is a tile-based puzzle-platformer about sound manipulation. Following a little Starling in an abstract world of wooden toys, players will learn to peck buttons, mimic noises and trick people -- all to reach the finish.

details.title: Build&Boom
details.short_description: Build&Boom is a chaotic competitive party game. Builders race to raise a structure from the blueprint while Saboteurs rain rocks, drones, tomatoes and traps down on them. Play three modes from 1v1 to 3v3, online with friends or in local split-screen.

details.title: Decayed Cases: Archive 22
details.short_description: The peaceful, familiar everyday life is completely turned upside down by the chaos that has erupted at the base. The silence of the archive is dissapear, leaving nothing but survival. Will I ever get to tell the story of everything I’ve been through, or will I, too, become a part of the archive?

details.title: Snake Draft
details.short_description: The fantasy football roguelike. Snake Draft is about finding synergies and building your dream team. With 100+ unique athletes shuffling between 22 in-world teams, each run offers a new puzzle to solve. Draft studs, find sleepers, and build a team that is locked in for a championship run.

details.title: Gnomes Go Boom
details.short_description: Garden gnomes vs. gardeners. Gnomes run screaming "lolololo", then freeze into a perfect ceramic statue among 300 identical ones. Gardeners hunt in first person with a water sprayer: statues drip, live gnomes steam. Spray the right one before it goes BOOM. 2–10 players online.

details.title: Mongle: Cozy Days
details.short_description: A cozy butler simulator where you serve Carrot, a bunny girl who likes things her way, and enjoy the simple pleasures of everyday life.

details.title: Modern Frankenstein
details.short_description: Experience the chilling survival horror reimagining of the Frankenstein legend set in a fictional modern time. Dr Frankenstein's experiments have led him to discover the secrets of life beyond death, a new reality. His monstrous creations roam the halls of his home, his only family.

details.title: VR PC Assembly
details.short_description: Build, fix, and upgrade PCs with your own hands in VR. Run your own workshop, one customer at a time, and build a thriving computer repair business in your very own room.

details.title: Backpack Jianghu 2
details.short_description: Start as a young martial artist. Seek legendary weapons and secret manuals, combine techniques to forge your own fighting style, and turn humble moves into devastating attacks! Fight your way to the summit of Mount Hua, claim the title of the greatest, or challenge real players in live PvP!

details.title: Tarmac Tycoon
details.short_description: Turn a tiny airfield into a roaring multi-runway hub. Draw blueprints and watch your crews build them tile by tile, then keep every passenger, suitcase and fuel truck moving, from a three-seat prop plane to a sky full of airliners. Contains high amounts of jet fuel.

details.title: Fogblower
details.short_description: Fogblower is an incremental game. Clear the fog with the fan on your little boat, discover treasures and strange creatures of the deep, and upgrade your boat until one day you can reach the mainland and earn your freedom.

details.title: Claw & Keel
details.short_description: Build your broadside. Gather your crew. Pick your trouble. Fit cannons, gear and a motley crew of animal scoundrels aboard your ship, then watch clever placement pay off in cannon fire. Refit and take on your next target in this pirate adventure auto-battler.

details.title: Feramek Protocols
details.short_description: Build and program a squad of up to six Ferameks in this single-player auto-battler. Hunt wild machines for blueprints and Feramek Orbs, create combat Protocols, issue live commands, and outsmart rival Engineers on your path to becoming the Archengineer.

details.title: Lamp Demon
details.short_description: Recruit monsters, configure your skill pools, and start the chasing lights with one click. Light effects illuminate the board as monsters attack in succession. Defend the Demon Heart against wave after wave of heroes.

details.title: RIDER
details.short_description: A cyberpunk action platformer set in an underground city where the people the surface pushed out make their lives. You are the Rider, a courier who takes the jobs no one signs. Deliver, descend, and come back alive.

details.title: Backpack Dungeon Delver
details.short_description: A tough turn-based dungeon game built on backpack management. The signature Forging system lets you fuse backpack components into powerful combos of your own. Delve deep, from rats to demon lords—how many floors can you last? Super fun! Public playtest coming soon!

details.title: MEAT-GRINDER
details.short_description: Have a human MEATGRINDER with Obi the freelance hitman! Fulfill contracts all over the planet, open a beer, turn off your brain: it's time to kill and solve the financial problems of Obi and her peculiar family!

name: 秘封最后旅 ~ Edge of Realm

details.title: 秘封最后旅 ~ Edge of Realm
details.short_description: A Touhou fan game and a 2D pixel shooting survival game, telling the story of Renko looking for her friend Merry in the destroyed Gensokyo, finding the truth about the destruction of Gensokyo and saving the world.

details.title: Hyper Tanks
details.short_description: Choose your tank and fight in neon-lit arenas where shots ricochet off walls! Beat challenging campaigns solo or in co-op, or battle your friends and bots in explosive multiplayer modes. Use powerups, special weapons and tank abilities to survive the mayhem of Hyper Tanks!

details.title: War Trigger
details.short_description: Destroy, smash and blast your way to victory! Use advanced weapons and vehicles to dominate the battlefield.

details.title: Hexplorando
details.short_description: Take a trip around the world in this cozy hex-tile puzzle game. Rebuild iconic locations from New York to Sydney, unlock and collect landmarks with real photos and stories, and build landscapes of your own. 🗽🗿⛩️🕌

details.title: Cartomantic
details.short_description: A tactical Tarot roguelite deckbuilder, where positioning matters just as much as the cards themselves. Craft decks of Minor and Major Arcana, create powerful combos, make your power reach the millions, and overcome the formidable Arcana Trials to see what lies within.

details.title: Clown Meat
