details.short_description: Clown Meat is a Precision Platformer with an emphasis on speedrunning and replayability. Tumble through a butchered world where humanity is barely a memory on your naïve journey to cheer up the monolithic clown that came from the Depths of Jupiter.

details.title: Fallen Symphony
details.short_description: The world of Fallen Symphony is full of heated battles, engaging puzzles, and fearsome dungeons. Prepare yourself for a unique battle system which is inspired by brawlers from late 90s and gameplay based on the JRPGs of old.

details.title: Ecumene Aztec
details.short_description: Ecumene Aztec is a brutal action-adventure game with stealth elements, set in the time of the Aztecs. Take on the role of a fugitive who has escaped being sacrificed. Fight, climb and survive in a dark and bloody world. Decide which side of the conflict you will take...

details.title: Lazy Jiangshi
details.short_description: A visual novel about lazy jiangshi Mao and her even lazier mistress.

details.title: Endfaryth
details.short_description: In 5135, a substance called Ash poisoned the sky, and an endless snowstorm consumed the world. You awaken from darkness with no memory of your past. Faced with fragile warmth, will you forget what was and cling to the present, or venture into the frozen wilds to uncover the truth of who you were?

details.title: SKROLL
details.short_description: Wake up, junkie. Your brain is hungry and only infinite scrolling can satisfy it. Manage dopamine, battery, and sanity in this survival roguelite about digital slavery.
developers: Emilio Rivas, Luis Suárez, Rubén García

details.title: Curse Chapter: Dawnthief
details.short_description: Plunder all the treasure worth taking from the exotic wilderness with your band of rogues. Jump, kick and sling your chain mace to smash and climb your way through any obstacle. Face off against beasts and hopeful heroes that rise up to stop you.

details.title: Beat Weaver
details.short_description: 3D multi-track rhythm action with space-time bending mechanics that reward your style as much as your precision. Hit notes and switch tracks to add instruments to the mix. Become a remix machine, enter the flow state and uniquely approach each song of a highly replayable, genre-defying soundtrack.

details.title: The Orphaned House
details.short_description: Step into the mystery of The Orphaned House. Explore its rooms, manipulate the environment to solve puzzles, and follow your intuition to uncover every hidden secret in this atmospheric adventure game.

details.title: Hardware Simulator
details.short_description: Build your hardware empire from scratch! Experience real business with product sourcing, dynamic pricing, online orders, and delivery management. Boost your popularity, expand your store, and become the country's most successful hardware merchant!

details.title: Bad Magpie
details.short_description: You are a magpie with one wing, a missing flock, and an unhealthy obsession with a fallen star. Steal shiny trinkets, cause chaos, and stick your beak where it doesn’t belong.

details.title: Boing Boing Animals
details.short_description: Raise Tamagotchi-style pixel animal friends right on your desktop! Care for slimes from outer space and help them grow into bouncy 'Boing Boing' Earth animals. Feed and play with your adorable friends while completing the Codex! Your tiny companions will always be by your side.

details.title: ROTETRA
details.short_description: ROTETRA is a twisted tetromino stacker where you spin the whole board and juggle multiple pieces at once!

details.title: Iron Bramble
details.short_description: Momentum-based platforming built around expressive movement and tight gunplay. Master your elastic grappling hook to explore a vast, cyber-gothic megastructure, where robots piloted by the souls of the dead do penance for their sins.

details.title: Ethral
details.short_description: Play as a young hero in a retro pixel top-down adventure: explore the land of Ethral, find secrets, conquer dark dungeons, and collect shards to restore the Ethral Pendant to defeat the Pirate King!

details.title: Midnight Train: New Moon
details.short_description: A 2D exploration-based horror adventure game set in a creepy train and mysterious buildings.

details.title: DEATH A LIVE
details.short_description: Your rock band needs a crowd. Neon wants you all to herself. You've got 30 days to fill the venue in a cyberpunk rhythm-action adventure of love, madness and yandere psychological horror. Explore the city, take the stage, and watch what you say. One wrong answer could be your last.

details.title: Dominus Manager
details.short_description: Take the mantle of a Lanista in ancient Rome. Build your ludus, scout and train fierce gladiators, manipulate political factions, and schedule high-stakes arena battles in this deep management simulation. Blood entertains the crowd, but gold builds an empire.

details.title: Tactical Squad
details.short_description: Outthink your opponent in brutal 1v1 turn-based firefights. Lead a six-unit SWAT team or criminal crew, blast through walls, destroy cover, and attack from unexpected angles. Hone your tactics in a challenging single-player campaign, then settle the score in PvP.

details.title: Sudden Death Golf
details.short_description: Minigolf that ruins friendships! Ball-to-ball collisions, crazy powerups, chaotic game modes and a powerful map editor. Nobody said it would be a fair fight :)

details.title: Merge Mutants
details.short_description: Merge Mutants is a fast-paced top-down survival shooter where hostile scientists try to keep you locked up. Synthesize their remains into healing, abilities, and loyal mutants, then merge matching units into bigger and more powerful ones. Break out of the lab or die trying.

details.title: BAUSFIGHT
details.short_description: BAUSFIGHT is a fast-paced battleground for 2–8 players, packed with short multiplayer modes. Choose a weapon-based class, master its unique abilities, and unleash wild combos to ruin your foes’ day. Fight solo to be the last one standing, or team up with friends and conquer the lobby together.

details.title: On & Under
details.short_description: Build a fantasy settlement, guide unique villagers, reshape a fully destructible world, and lead your people in real-time battles against monsters, raiders, and rival factions. Raise a homestead, a druid's grove, a wizard's spire, a necromancer's deep lair—or something only you can imagine.

details.title: Solakrats
details.short_description: The Commandments never change: Awaken for the first time, climb down into the depths, and claim your birth halo. But the world turns, it lies to you. A full inversion twists directions, down becomes up. And after all, it's your home, and that home is the lie. So... which way is down now again...?

details.title: Stem The Tide
details.short_description: Lead the last bastion against the Swarm in this hybrid auto-battler and roguelite. Build your camp, recruit and merge units, create faction synergies, upgrade your warriors, and survive procedurally generated waves of monsters to save the world from destruction!

details.title: WireDive
details.short_description: A PS2-inspired grappling action-platformer set in a high-fantasy realm under siege by eldritch invaders from another dimension. Wield arcane technology, build momentum and swing through each level as you destroy every Blight and chase faster times.

details.title: Dominus Orbis Maris 1400: Mare Nostrum
details.short_description: DOM 1400: Mare Nostrum is a strategy and economy game set in the 15th century Mediterranean. Build trade routes, meet the needs of the social classes and dominate the market in a bottom-up economy driven by scarcity. At sea, the wind decides the battles. In development.

details.title: Dark Money
details.short_description: An incremental, true-crime-inspired money-laundering game. Build a criminal network from back-alley cash drops into a global empire of shell companies and corrupt governments. When a journalist reaches out, will you blow the whistle or embrace the dark side?

details.title: Bub
details.short_description: A narrative adventure game about turning your memories into art while you still can. Made with slashes of ink and paint and thousands of cut paper pieces, Bub is a deeply personal, living, breathing game world.

details.title: Dead Star Prison
details.short_description: Dead Star Prison is a unique combination of Deck Building and strategy based Auto-Battling. Build you deck of prisoners and be sure to place them in the most strategic position on the battleground to conquer your enemies in either PVP mode or the single player story mode.

details.title: Curious Calvin
details.short_description: Join Calvin - a small, curious, and kind-hearted creature - on a quest for answers deep underground. Navigate treacherous tunnels, effortlessly swap between three unique forms, and aid other creatures in need along the way.

details.title: Used Car Dealer Simulator
details.short_description: Buy and sell used cars Find cars at the right price, add them to your dealership, and sell them for profit. Run your own car dealership Manage your car lot, organize your vehicles, and grow your business step by step.

details.title: ShipIt Galactic
details.short_description: Manage and grow your intergalactic shipping company! Play alone or with friends as you fly your truck, pick up deliveries and process them in your hangar. Purchase machines, place conveyor belts, hire drivers, and build the best logistics company in the galaxy!

details.title: Fat Justice
details.short_description: You are the newly appointed Judge in the Stone Age trying to keep a chaotic island from falling apart. Listen to bizarre testimonies while balancing absurd laws and deadly politics. Pass judgment, shape the island's fate, and uncover the truth behind your father's mysterious disappearance.

details.title: Cars and Guns: Paper Parts
details.short_description: The world is flat. Everything is cardboard. Your soul is like a car made of paper parts. No thing can reach the end. Can you make it to the Garage of the Queen of Ice? Drive, scrap, and find your way through a universe made of paper and ink.

details.title: Rummy Attack
details.short_description: "Rummy Attack" is a unique Roguelite Card Battler based on Rummy rules! Place cards on the field to create "Melds" (Sets or Runs) to unleash skills. Build your deck and overcome physical gimmicks like ground fissures to defeat the final boss. Choose between Tactical Move or High-Speed Time Mode!

details.title: Mind Mirror
details.short_description: A puzzle game set in a millennial-era household. Featuring immersive, retro-styled puzzles full of nostalgic vibes, alongside abundant dreamlike elements.

details.title: Intercept Course
details.short_description: Intercept Course is a tactical space auto battler where you command a starship caught in a temporal rift while chasing a tech thief. Recruit a crew, survive with limited resources, and modify your starship to face rival factions stuck in their own conflicts across every corner of the multiverse.

details.title: Boreal Steel
details.short_description: A physics-driven WWII tank game set in a fog-bound northern forest. Push pines over with your hull, and fight where every plate, module and track can be hit, and every HE shell can set the woods alight.

details.title: The Dust Remembers
details.short_description: A fallen world. On the wasteland, survival is all that matters. You walked alone—until you met them. Together or against, Trust or doubt, Closer or apart. Every choice leaves a mark, changing the story and your ending. Your decisions define this journey.

details.title: NPC Survey Team
details.short_description: NPC Survey Team is an information-verification simulation game. Cross-check employee credentials, uncover suspicious anomalies, and conduct in-depth investigations on non-compliant female employees.
developers: おいなりソフト(肩引こ）

name: The Girl I Like Is a Freak Like Me?!

details.title: The Girl I Like Is a Freak Like Me?!
details.short_description: A cute and silly yuri visual novel about two closeted fujoshis who attend a prestigious all-girls boarding school. Let the BL brainrot commence ☆

details.title: Calling
details.short_description: A short sci-fi adventure where you tune a damaged communications device, follow voices buried in the noise, and make choices to find your way forward.

details.title: Stay Extinct
details.short_description: The wall was built to keep something in. On a sealed dinosaur island only the hunters are infected: raptors, a T-rex and diving pterosaurs stalk the healthy herds, and you. Build and electrify a base, explore the tunnels below, alone or in 4-player online co-op. First-person retro survival horror.

details.title: NO SHELTER
details.short_description: Survive a relentless storm, escape a mysterious entity, and uncover the truth behind tornadoes that appear from nowhere. Explore a world between reality, nightmares, and forgotten memories.

details.title: 末日後書店
details.short_description: The perfect AI shut down without warning. Without its guidance, technology regressed, society crumbled, energy ran short, and the world fell into chaos. As a bookstore owner, listen to customers' stories with your android partner, offering food and the scent of books as a brief respite.

details.title: 1999 Lockdown Unit
details.short_description: Autumn 1999: A rainy night, a sudden quarantine. As a virus mutates your neighbors, barricade your apartment, survive the lockdown routine, and outlast the nightmare.

details.title: Overflow: Roguelite Network Builder
details.short_description: A tense minimalist network roguelite. Draw Traces between Nodes, let your Runners carry Signals to your Hubs, and hold the system together as pressure escalates. One overloaded Node ends the run, instantly and permanently. Upgrade between Cycles, trigger emergency abilities, and delay the crash.

details.title: Undaria
details.short_description: Undaria is a co-op PvE extraction RPG about exploring a kingdom that dug too deep. Ride the Great Lift into vast stylized voxel caverns, fight the Blighted, and return with loot and survivors to rebuild the town, repair the Lift, and open the way to deeper layers.

details.title: Palimpsest: Where Magic Remembers
details.short_description: A hand-painted magical sky-world full of fantasy and adventure. Relive the memories in its ruins, befriend the fantastic beasts you are forced to fight, and decide the future of magic.

details.title: Mountain Rescuers
details.short_description: A co-op zombie FPS for 1-4 mountain rescuers who are not very good at rescuing. Arrive by flying rowboat, find the one survivor on each peak and keep it quiet: noise brings the horde. Sell the bodies to the butcher, buy bigger guns, try not to shoot your friends.

details.title: STEELHOWL
details.short_description: Build your own mech and take it into battle. Boost to close the gap, take down enemies with a range of weapons, and send your repair companion to recover parts. Refit your mech for the next operation in this third-person mech action game.

details.title: My Stupid Friend
details.short_description: A gay dating sim combining old-school map/HP dating systems with visual novel stories. Summerdust is never short of muscular guys. Some are cute, some are ridiculous. Who will you date?

details.title: Encirclement: WW2
details.short_description: A minimalist and approachable grand strategy game combined with pixelated top-down RTS. Encircle the enemy and watch each individual soldier fight!

details.title: Channel 666: Nightmare on Tape
details.short_description: Channel 666 is a Roguelite, Turn-Based Dungeon Crawler with endless challenges within. Choose your gang and see just how deep the horror classics go!

details.title: ACID DROP DOWNHILL: WITH UZI
details.short_description: Downhill as far away as you can from a nuclear explosion on your skateboard // snowboard or surf while shooting it with uzi to do tricks. Hope you are faster than the nuke. ACID DROP DOWNHILL IS THE BEST YOU EVER FEEL

details.title: Splash Bash: Hot Springs Party
details.short_description: A two-player party game! Team up or go head-to-head, and get this hot spring town buzzing again!

details.title: Eldritch Drift
details.short_description: A cartoon-goth kart racer where drifting wakes the gods. Forge runes into spells, blast rivals with plasma, rift bombs and walls, and race six ghoulish drivers through a haunted mansion and a temple adrift between worlds, alone or in 2-4 player split-screen.

details.title: Bin There
details.short_description: sneak out at night, dig through the neighbours' bins for little treasures, trade them with a town of animal shopkeepers, and bring the good stuff home to make your den the coziest one on the block. a small cozy pixel game about trash critters.

details.title: Not Yet Recorded
details.short_description: A broadcast tape from 1955 is still warm. Rae Calloway, night host of a 1997 call-in show, falls asleep listening to it and wakes on the morning it was recorded. Take the calls, pin what the town says, and change what happened. Only she will remember.

details.title: SORE CRATEBREAKER
details.short_description: SORE CRATEBREAKER is a first-person incremental horror game with lots, lots of crates.

details.title: Cupid's Bargain
details.short_description: A matchmaker summons a pair of devilishly fine deities to help save her dying club because, like, who needs a soul anyway? Go fall in love and sell your classmates’ souls in this horror romantic comedy!

details.title: Skeletons and Stuff
details.short_description: Four heroes and thousands of skeletons. Take a wizard, a huntress, a barbarian or a pirate through seven battles against a horde that keeps growing, pick a new card every time you level up, sign dark pacts you might regret, and take on the Bone King.

details.title: Barrowhold
details.short_description: A co-op roguelite for 1–4 players that blends dungeon crawling and tower defense. Descend into the dungeon, grow stronger fighting monsters and bosses, and turn your loot into a fortress that can hold back the goblin horde. Can you last 100 days, until the Archmagus comes for you?

details.title: Yonder Shores
details.short_description: Yonder Shores is a relaxing island diorama builder. Sculpt land from the sea, place cozy coastal cottages, and design charming harbours that adapt to the terrain. Featuring dynamic wildlife, weather, and zero timers or failure states, craft your peaceful seaside sanctuary at your own pace.

details.title: No;Heaven
details.short_description: No;Heaven is a short, single-player FPS featuring anime-style characters and gritty visuals reminiscent of early 2000s games. A young woman who has lost everything, including those she held dear, takes up arms. Witness where her path of revenge leads.

details.title: Broom - The Card Game
details.short_description: A solitaire inspired by the italian game "Scopa". Complete the challenges before you run out of cards! Empower your Cups, collect Coins, transmute with Clubs, and cut through with Swords. And don’t forget the Brooms!

details.title: Touhou Chihaya Battle Festival
details.short_description: A fan-made Touhou Project 5v5 and 3v3 multiplayer battle game. Most of the Touhou cast is here, with free choice of items, lanes and skill loadout. Even leaving mid-match is free: something came up? No problem, your teammates take over your character. Oh, and a rabbit delivers your items.

details.title: Ashenreach
details.short_description: Home lies in ashes. Follow a fallen star into Ashenreach, an old-school online RPG for small groups: tab-target combat, 4 classes, 260 voiced quests, dungeons, a raid, 14 crafts, your own home. Closed playtest: December 2026, dates to be announced.

details.title: Desktop Trickshot
details.short_description: Desktop Trickshot is a desktop companion game where you can enjoy a variety of trickshots anytime, even while working on other things. Earn gold in different ways to unlock new trickshots, new cats, and new hats!

details.title: GUNGRAVE G.O.R.E: BLOOD HEAT
details.short_description: Full Rebuild with Unreal Engine 5, GUNGRAVE G.O.R.E BLOOD HEAT delivers stunning visuals and an evolved action system. Experience the explosive fusion of stylish Bullet Ballet and Gunkata in an immersive, adrenaline-pumping action spectacle!

details.title: L'Agence - The Hearts of Paris
details.short_description: Paris, 1888. In debt after taking over her grandmother's marriage agency, Marie has 7 days to find a wife for her creditor's nephew. But everyone in this case is lying! In this Ace Attorney-style detective visual novel, unmask the client and the suitors, and let love triumph!

details.title: UNHOST
details.short_description: You are a paranormal detective in an abandoned hospital. Monitor surveillance cameras and use a remote-controlled robot to capture anomalies. Collect evidence, explore your surroundings, make contact with ghosts. Survive seven nights of horror and uncover the truth.

details.title: Sin or Suffer
details.short_description: Sin or Suffer is a brutal mix of survival-horror and JRPG. Locked in a medieval prison, you awake amidst a cold silence. The guards are gone; inmates and madness own the place. Something terrible lurks underground. But the only way to the truth is down.

details.title: Appetite of the Abyss
details.short_description: Appetite of the Abyss is a survival cooking roguelite about hunger, discovery, and consequences. Learn what an abyssal creature craves, prepare meals to satisfy it, and protect your tribe. Will you master its appetite, or suffer its wrath?

details.title: MioAquaria
details.short_description: Build and manage a cozy underwater sandbox aquarium run by cats. Discover fantasy sea creatures, research upgrades, send expeditions, and balance fish, staff, and visitor needs to become the world’s top aquarium.

details.title: One Last Push
details.short_description: Survive the horrors of WW1 in this intense PvE survival shooter. Scavenge supplies, earn your regiment’s respect, and fight for reinforcements before you become another name lost in the mud.

details.title: Millennium Slumber
details.short_description: Survive 400,000 years on a planet infested with an alien calamity! Gather resources, build a base and defend against hordes of nocturnal monsters in this rogue-like with cryostasis mechanics.

details.title: Setsuna
details.short_description: Play as "Setsuna," an android assassin. In this cyberpunk-themed 2D action-adventure game, traverse a futuristic metropolis ruled by a super-corp alongside your accompanying AI, clash with powerful enemies, collect abilities to explore the unknown, and search for the meaning of your existence.

details.title: Indie GameDev Sim
details.short_description: Become an indie game developer. Take client orders, buy new assets, build your own 2D games in a simple level editor, playtest them and send the finished builds to your clients for feedback and payment.

name: BOKUKAN5 TOKYO (HND) I am an Air Traffic Controller

details.title: BOKUKAN5 TOKYO (HND) I am an Air Traffic Controller
details.short_description: The latest air traffic control puzzle is here! Set at Tokyo International Airport (HND/RJTT), experience two ways to enjoy the airport: Air Traffic Control Puzzle and the all-new Terminal Side. BOKUKAN evolves into a game where you can immerse yourself in the airport experience.

details.title: Excabyte
details.short_description: Excabyte is an incremental mining game where you start with a single miner and build your own mining empire. Extract valuable resources, purchase powerful machinery and avoid disasters.

details.title: Metaversus
details.short_description: A round-based 4v4 competitive shooter. Build defenses and routes, buy weapons and gadgets, then fight for territory with one life per round. Surviving structures carry into the next build phase. Request playtest access below.

details.title: Baleful Tactics
details.short_description: You are a demon lord, using history’s famous dead to climb the ranks of Hell. Their traits determine your play style. Death leaves them with a wound. Decide who to save, star-up, gear up or sacrifice for more power. Achilles, Genghis Khan and Cleopatra, await your command!

details.title: Last Pasture
details.short_description: Enemies swarm every night. Gather resources, upgrade your weapons, and protect your livestock alongside your companions.

details.title: Debt & Daylight
details.short_description: Aim every coin drop in a tactile 3D coin-pusher roguelike. Upgrade the machine, chase special coins, and beat six midnight bills before debt takes it all.

details.title: Froggy's Delivery
details.short_description: A chaotic co-op cooking and delivery game. Team up with your friends, cook food on the go, keep the orders coming, and somehow make it to the customer intact!

details.title: FALLBREAKER HORIZON DEFENSE FRONT
details.short_description: Pilot your aircraft to smash falling blocks before they raise the sea! Use fuel to speed up, slow down, and turn. Land on your carrier to refuel, or keep smashing to boost LINK and your score multiplier. Game over if rising seas or a direct block hit sinks your carrier.

details.title: Barista
details.short_description: A cozy audio game. Be a barista in a wacky world and listen to your customers' funny stories. Designed to be fully playable without sight.

details.title: Arkforge-方舟锻造
details.short_description: A space sandbox game. Build your mobile factory ship to mine, smelt, produce, fight, and research in space. Design unique ships, equip them with various modules, and set up production lines to supply your fleet.

details.title: Chessboxing Arcade
details.short_description: Chess Boxing Arcade is a 2D arcade take on the real sport: alternate between timed chess rounds and fast-paced boxing rounds. Win by checkmate, knockout or the clock against adaptive AI, friends locally, or opponents online.

details.title: DoBato: Coo Coo Collector
details.short_description: Fly over real Tokyo, from old downtown streets to the city center, as the leader of a pigeon flock. Land at pigeon spots, wait, and strays join you one by one. Gather white, brown, black and pied pigeons, each with its own perk, and race home with 1,000 birds. A heartwarming pigeon-gathering game.

details.title: Old Yon. New thief
details.short_description: The abandoned port of Old Yon. Bandits at the gates. You're a thief with no memory and a 200-mark debt. Pick pockets, sell to the fence before the loot goes stale, and save up for better gloves. Greed, Empathy and Paranoia argue in your head. Whatever you do, stay calm: anxiety draws the shadows.

details.title: Prospects
details.short_description: Strip the solar system of its bountiful resources, all for the betterment of mankind - and your corporation's bottom line. Build and command your fleet of industrial vessels, establish manufacturing outposts, and seek out the richest prospects to expand your mining empire.

details.title: Rabbit's Tale
details.short_description: Rabbit’s Tale is a hand-drawn metroidvania where portals lead into roguelike runs, and every boss you beat brings back a new power for the open world. Hunt the oppressive Steam Order, search for your kidnapped family, and survive with a symbiotic companion.

details.title: Witch Slide
details.short_description: Skate and explore a fantastical world of ice and snow on your own or team up with other witches. Carve spells into the snow, overcome challenges and race your friends! Singe-player and 2-4 player online co-op supported

details.title: Dr. Emmerson's Nocturnes
details.short_description: Dive into the worlds of the best classic weird fiction and cosmic horror writers. Try out our original approach to bringing literature into the interactive medium. Relax and let Dr. Emmerson guide you through all the colors of dread.

details.title: The Bornless
details.short_description: Welcome to The Bornless, an action horror FPS. Face off against other players, summon demons, and build factions in a Lovecraftian world. Use Black Magick, acquire powerful weapons, upgrade your Safehouse, and strategize to survive.

details.title: October Nightmares | Cauchemars d'octobre
details.short_description: Explore a Montréal neighborhood in the 70s, investigate a supernatural phenomenon that inflicts nightmares on its residents, and delve into the depths of the world of dreams to save their lives. October Nightmares is a point & click cosmic horror game where exploration mixes with puzzle solving.

details.title: Untethered
details.short_description: Untethered is a space survival-sandbox set in our own cosmic backyard. Explore zero-gravity environments, build and operate realistic space stations, and fight to stay alive in the unforgiving realm of deep space.

details.title: Kimekyawa♥GenkaiBeat-chan!!
details.short_description: Smash the cute monsters with fun! This is a rhythm game with easy controls!

details.title: Safo and The Moon Warriors
details.short_description: In a world where the sun no longer rises, Prince Safo must rescue his sister from Argus, a mysterious one-eyed monster. Joined by diverse companions, this adventure RPG features beautiful illustrations and a novel-like story as players uncover secrets in this sunless world.

details.title: They Speak From The Abyss
details.short_description: Lost in a cursed world. Surrounded by the tortured souls of the damned. Is the only way out truly a baptism in blood? Face demons head-on, talking or fighting your way through this surreal, psychological horror, dungeon crawling RPG.

name: Thesis of Love 心动论证

details.title: Thesis of Love 心动论证
details.short_description: During the endless summer in Chishima, you join a graduate program hoping to become worthy of your crush. Little do you know what awaits... In this otome dating sim, experience campus life with three lab members trapped in toxic relationships. Your choices may lead them to new paths.

name: 死んで死んで強くなれ！…？

details.title: 死んで死んで強くなれ！…？
details.short_description: A deadly RPG with a new system that makes you stronger by dying and suffering.The graphics are a combination of dots and 3DCG. No matter how many times you die. No matter how many times you die. Don't give up hope.

details.title: Ravenous
details.short_description: Spin the world to control the horde, compress enemy remains into the ultimate "Scrap Bomb," and smash it down on their heads! Experience the new-sensation rolling action of Ravenous!

name: 紅茶とともに飲みこんで

details.title: 紅茶とともに飲みこんで
details.short_description: Is there something you wish to forget or remember? You are running a cafe, harboring a specific purpose within your heart. An ADV where you use tools like a pipette that extracts emotions and medicine that erases memories and feelings to select, manipulate emotions, and intervene in fate.

details.title: Dragons Invade Scotland
details.short_description: Match-3 Tower Defense. Defend real Scottish castles from waves of dragons. Real Scottish stories and legends. Includes a full map of Scotland to scale where 1 tile is 19.5 meters.

details.title: Factories in Factories in Factories
details.short_description: Build a fractal world. Automate the automation of your automation. Put Factories in Factories in Factories.

details.title: Avante! Atlantis
details.short_description: Lead the world's greatest Strategists through a virtual war. Decide how humanity will approach the mysterious island of Atlantis.

details.title: WATERTRIX ONLINE
details.short_description: A Tetris-style puzzle game where you control water to battle enemies! It's a casual game featuring cute characters and beautiful water that will soothe you. You can compete in 1v1 online matches and challenge rivals from all over the country.

details.title: Plumber Simulator
details.short_description: Become a plumber and restore water flow in suburban homes. Unclog toilets, replace sink traps, renovate bathrooms - the residents can only count on you during an emergency.

details.title: World on a Plate
details.short_description: Cook your way around Europe in this cozy co-op kitchen adventure for one to two players. Prepare authentic regional dishes, keep your kitchen running smoothly, and manage busy restaurants across diverse European cultures and cuisines, while uncovering Grandma’s story behind her legendary restaurant.

details.title: What a Wonderful Venom World
details.short_description: "What a Wonderful Venom World" is a difficult survival sim. All food is poisoned, and you must find an antidote through endless trial and error. Face countless deaths and share info with other players to speed up your research. This game is for players who enjoy a serious challenge.

details.title: Traffic Check
details.short_description: An arcade racer where traffic is your weapon. Slam cars into each other, drift, boost and keep scoring even after you crash. Every map is procedurally generated, with new highways, biomes, towns and back roads to tear through, solo or up to 4-player splitscreen. Never stop burning

name: Misty Valley: A Cozy Fishing Tale

details.title: Misty Valley: A Cozy Fishing Tale
details.short_description: Welcome to Misty Valley, cast your line, sail to hidden islands, and uncover secrets of the sea. Befriend charming villagers, tend your farm, and explore a world full of wonder, mystery, and gentle adventure. Your story begins where the mist meets the tide.

details.title: Road Valkyries
details.short_description: Rider Valkyries is an adventure game blending open-world riding, romance, life together, and motorcycle racing and combat. The neon never fades, and the engines are roaring. Welcome to a vertical city where every road climbs and every turn leads somewhere new — Cyber Chongqing.

details.title: Illusive Domain
details.short_description: Deflect, parry, and defeat your opponents through intense boss rush action. Fight for you and your allies’ freedom, lest you remain entombed forever more.

details.title: Voidwood
details.short_description: Voidwood is a 1-4 player co-op survival horror game, where your voice can save your friends or give them all away. By day, you scavenge an inviting, cursed forest. By night, you survive the hunt. Push your luck, go deeper, and speak carefully. The forest is listening.

details.title: Mirealle
details.short_description: A cozy isometric puzzle adventure about a girl who sets out to find a cure for her loyal dog, Zephyr. Rotate the world, wake ancient mechanisms and find out why it broke into floating islands.

details.title: The Secret of Weepstone
details.short_description: In a hand-drawn black and white dungeon crawler RPG inspired by classic D&D of the 80’s - Roll Dice, Fight Monsters, Loot Dungeons, Embrace Death, and unravel The Secret of Weepstone.

details.title: SOS Recordings
details.short_description: A lone mountain in northern Japan. Two hikers rescued alive from its silent maw. In their wake, a perfect SOS made of tree trunks, built years before anyone was lost. Based on the real unsolved 1989 SOS Incident. The recordings are waiting.

details.title: Wardens of Avalon
details.short_description: Restore the former glory of a corrupt Camelot in Wardens of Avalon, an Action RPG set in a Dark Arthurian world. As a new member of the Twilight Knights, establish your fiefdom, explore, craft and gear up for thrilling adventures against the fallen Knights of the Round Table, alone or with friends.

details.title: ALL ADRIFT
details.short_description: A Cosmic Surgery RPG where fire gets wet and water burns. This universe is written in Declarations: operate on a sentence, and reality follows. Take your scalpel to species, creeds, even a planet's nature, and your doctored lines become scripture, then cosmic law. Just paperwork, Imperial Agent.

details.title: The Lost Wild
details.short_description: True fear is primal. Embark on an evasion-based survival horror experience against nature’s ultimate hunters — dinosaurs. Explore overgrown research facilities nestled in a lush wilderness. Be resourceful as you evade, distract, survive, and unravel the mystery at the heart of the island.

details.title: 世界不需要败犬 - ThEeNDoFMYwOrLd -
details.short_description: 是要靠自己的双手夺回属于自己的一切，还是用自己的双手「毁灭」这一切——一切的一切，只在「她/他」一念之间。 在这一切走向终局之时，「他/她」是否会后悔遇见对方呢。 ——这是一段在「沉默的误会」中，爱与恨交织的故事。「在还能做出选择之时，不要让自己后悔。」

details.title: Worms: Galactic Tactics
details.short_description: Worms makes an explosive leap into tactical roguelike combat! Battle across destructible arenas, mod classic weapons and unleash devastating strategic combos as you fight for survival, riches and glory!

details.title: Whatever It Takes
details.short_description: Whatever It Takes is a hardcore first-person Action RPG in a dark fantasy setting. As a fallen god, master elemental magic, absorb enemy powers, and engage in tactical duels. Use a harpoon for traversal and shape the Omnisphere’s fate through your choices. Reclaim your throne. Whatever it takes.

details.title: Ball Kicking Simulator
details.short_description: Kick balls, score goals, and send your friends tumbling in a physics party game! Play alone or join your friends in online multiplayer, PvP and co-op minigames. Try ridiculous football trick shots, experiment with different balls, and hope your next kick doesn't end in a faceplant!

details.title: Schnudergoof
details.short_description: Figure out the demonic secrets of MANA – A freakish phone that has fallen into your hands. Can you make it through the Upper Echelon? Solve riddles from fallen angels, cyber with demons on GRINDAER and choose well who you are talking to. Do you believe: if I can eat god, god has to exist?

details.title: Blind Dial
details.short_description: A pixel-art co-op action RPG for 1-4 players, online or on one screen. Dial a Gate to worlds nobody has charted, fight your way down, and decide when to turn back. What you bring home rebuilds the base. What you lose stays out there.

details.title: DELF
details.short_description: Explore a dark and dangerous cave with your team. Gather resources, craft equipment, and manage your oxygen and stamina. Evade the creature lurking in the depths, work together, and find your way out alive!

details.title: STICKMAN DESKTOP MALWARS
details.short_description: A physics stickman brawler on a living computer desktop. The taskbar is the floor, windows are platforms and every app opens a new arena. Brawl as eight ragdoll fighters, each with their own attacks, or be the giant mouse cursor: charge a RAM, run VirusGuard on them and open a black hole.

details.title: ルルイエの子守唄
details.short_description: A Cthulhu Mythos mystery played like a tabletop RPG, with no Keeper required. In a snowbound city, uncover the truth about the girl you found in a park by linking the evidence you collect and rolling the dice. Japanese text only.

details.title: Internet Cafe Simulator 3
details.short_description: Internet Cafe Simulator 3 is a first-person business simulator where you build and manage your own internet cafe. Assemble PCs piece by piece, customize your space, and hire staff. Keep customers happy and reinvest your earnings to grow your business.

details.title: The Last Coin
details.short_description: Bet your soul against other players in a casino you can't escape. Take turns dropping coins into a glass of whiskey about to overflow, keep your hand steady and cheat with items. Whoever overflows it loses their soul.

details.title: Soul Gear
details.short_description: A retro-evolved 3D Metroidvania that fuses the fast-paced third-person shooter gameplay with strategic RPG spellcasting! Play as Auruma, a soldier from the steampunk town of Iron Junction, and uncover the mystery surrounding her people as they realize their reality is a lie.

details.title: INTAKE
details.short_description: Cut tape, adjust the scales, and label boxes in a small underground inspection room. Compare each delivery with its sample: Intake or Detain. Complete eight inspections a day for eight days. One wrong decision sends you back to that morning.

details.title: Biofactory
details.short_description: Build your living factory using organs and fleshy biomachines. Combine your pulsating machines to automate and scale up production. Mine, harvest, produce and assemble weird materials in a grimdark biopunk setting. You are an evolving hive-mind brain, driven by one instinct: The factory must grow.

details.title: One More Shift
details.short_description: Welcome to the family! Our company turns yesterday's waste into everything you use today. In this factory roguelite you build the line behind a giant recycler, turn scrap into anything from toasters to salvage robots and meet the quota. Mr. Quota is watching. Fondly.

details.title: Semaphore
details.short_description: A train simulator with systemic horror. You are the driver and the conductor of a night train in the People's Republic of Ordovia. Drive the train, meet the passengers, check their papers and look after them. Solve the mysteries of Ordovia's railways and fulfil the state's plan.

details.title: Brennia
details.short_description: Brennia is a fantasy RPG featuring turn-based combat and an open world. Explore biomes, solve puzzles, and craft gear for your next dungeon run! Between expeditions, grow crops and expand your island. Play solo or with up to three friends.

details.title: THE SUNDERED AEGIS
details.short_description: A strategy and tactics simulation in which humanity, having gained routes between star systems through great Gates, has split into ten warring nations. Research technology, design warships, organise fleets and command them in battle as you seek to unite the human world under the nation you lead.

details.title: MENHERA RAFFLESIA -CLASSIC REMASTER-
details.short_description: Five girls, five twisted forms of love. The 2017 yandere psychological horror visual novel MENHERA RAFFLESIA returns in HD while preserving the original atmosphere. Follow five heroine routes, make your choices, and discover all 11 endings.

details.title: Warlock: Dungeons & Dragons
details.short_description: Play as Kaatri in Warlock, a single-player, third-person action-adventure set in a D&D-inspired open world. Wield forbidden magic to bend the rules around you. Across exploration and combat, every challenge is a test of creativity, preparation, and cunning.

details.title: Shattered Realms
details.short_description: Battle hordes of enemies, unlock powerful abilities and new characters, and conquer unique bosses in this dark fantasy roguelite ARPG packed with loot, upgrades, and deep build customization. Traverse the Shattered Realms and reclaim the fragments of a broken world.

details.title: Economic Miracle
details.short_description: Take charge of any nation and lead it to greatness in the most ambitious geopolitical simulator of the modern era. Manage economy, laws, military, and diplomacy. Build the future without compromise!

details.title: Werewolf: The Apocalypse – Rageborn
details.short_description: Set in the World of Darkness, Rageborn sees Taylor rise as a pack leader to become Gaia’s fiercest warrior. Master three forms of the Garou, explore the wilds of Alaska, and confront the Wyrm in this visceral action-adventure metroidvania.

details.title: Mysticore: Towers & Timber
details.short_description: Mysticore is a survival strategy game for 1-4 players. Explore the shattered realms, build your base and defend it against massive enemy waves - all while leaving the busywork to your gnomes.

details.title: Warhammer Age of Sigmar: Deathmaster
details.short_description: Play a sneaky, ruthless Skaven assassin and slay your way up the ranks of the ratmen in this grim and dark new 2D stealth-action platformer. Escape. Kill. Ascend. Become a Deathmaster.

details.title: Necrofane
details.short_description: A dark power is rising. Defeat the necromancer and his generals before they conquer the kingdom. In this old school dark fantasy RPG, explore cursed dungeons, battle monstrous foes, master forbidden magic, and gather powerful loot in a world teetering on the edge of ruin.

details.title: The Little Ones
details.short_description: Join the little guardians of the earth in an adventure that adds a touch of strategy to the top-down shooter tradition. Plan every move, meet new allies, unlock weapons and abilities to hunt down evil humans and return these lands to their rightful owners.

details.title: The Last Raccoon
details.short_description: Survive as a raccoon in an abandoned mansion filled with zombies. Solve puzzles inspired by dark fairy tales and explore to uncover whether the world is worth saving.

details.title: Car For Sale Together
details.short_description: Car For Sale Together is a co-op car trading simulation where you and your friends build a dealership from scratch. Explore the town, find cars, negotiate deals, complete side activities, uncover mysteries, and grow your shared business together.

details.title: Doctor Dreams Simulator
details.short_description: A Simulator/Adventure game where you attend, craft, manage, and enter the nightmares of your patients. Each dream changes the rules and combines exploration, combat, and stealth.

details.title: Trapout: Dungeon Run
details.short_description: A fast-paced first-person precision platformer where every millisecond counts. Run through deadly obstacle courses, race against player ghosts instantly, and create ANYTHING with the built-in level editor

details.title: Museum: Escape with Friends
details.short_description: A co-op adventure about a night in the living museum. Together, explore the halls, solve puzzles, and evade hostile exhibits. Your flashlight will guide you, but is it enough to escape?

details.title: Panda Flora
details.short_description: A cozy first-person game where you run your own flower shop. Grow flowers in your garden, make bouquets by hand to match your customers' wishes, and grow your shop step by step. Unlock new flowers and complete your album.

details.title: Tricolore: Learn French
details.short_description: Learn French at every level in a cozy, illustrated adventure. Explore 8,000 verbs, 2,000 grammar exercises and everyday conversations. Discover French classics, history and exam practice. Build your listening, speaking, reading and writing skills. Fully offline.

details.title: Indian Truck Simulator
details.short_description: Be the trucker India runs on. Drive a painted truck down the Grand Trunk Road and Delhi's expressways, on nearly 1,800 km of road built from the real map. Beat the deadline, mind your diesel and your sleep, and stop at a dhaba for chai.

details.title: PUNKCAKE BUFFET
details.short_description: The best pixel spaghetti of your life. Prepare them and fork them perfectly in this fresh new arcade puzzler. Delect yourself and others. Get 5-star reviews. But be quick! The people are hangry. Play this new and extended version of Spaghetti Celesti: Devour the Heavens, also known as Spaghettris.

details.title: Attack on Humans
details.short_description: Your friends suck. Literally. Become mosquitoes in this 2–4 player co-op stealth comedy. Sneak into homes, feed on sleeping humans, and escape before sunrise. Whisper in proximity chat—your mic can wake them. Get greedy, get loud, get swatted.

name: To Pee or Not to Pee: พี พี่ พี้ พี๊ ผี

details.title: To Pee or Not to Pee: พี พี่ พี้ พี๊ ผี
details.short_description: A cute Thai horror anomaly game where you explore dark hallways with your flashlight, spot ghosts, investigate strange anomalies, solve spooky puzzles, and try to make it to the toilet without an accident!

details.title: Arctic Research: Dig Them Out!
details.short_description: Dig through snow and ice to uncover prehistoric fossils in an Arctic research simulator! Extract and clean bones, analyze DNA, reconstruct ancient skeletons, and customize dioramas. Explore the frozen wilderness, upgrade your research station, and uncover secrets buried since the Cold War.

details.title: GORAL: Highlander Simulator
details.short_description: Become a young shepherd in the 1930s Tatra Mountains. Herd sheep, make traditional cheese, and face wolves and unpredictable mountain weather. Start with no sheep of your own, earn your keep, survive each season, and build a flock of your own.

details.title: Ambulads
details.short_description: Rescue accident victims in a physics-based co-op game where your patient’s health determines your payday. Expand your ambulance, improvise with absurd tools and sell loot on the side.

details.title: Trauma Room
details.short_description: Get ready for the most ridiculous (but also realistic) problems you can run into at the vet clinic. Today is the perfect day to help our furry and aquatic pals! And best of all, you can treat them all together with your friends in online co-op!

details.title: MULTIMATUM
details.short_description: MULTIMATUM is a fast-paced top-down shooter with roguelite elements about unfortunate multiworld adventurers, trapped in isolated worlds. Fight the protagonists’ tormenting past projections and return the blade of God to its owner in order to return home.

details.title: Munchy Lair
details.short_description: Munchy Lair is a 2D strategy game fusing turn-based snake combat with roguelite tower climbing. Plan WASD paths, preview enemy moves, then resolve. Kill snakes by collision, grab items, buy buffs, advance floor by floor within a turn limit. Endless mode unlocks after three boss layers.

details.title: Ponchyo: A Platypus Adventure
details.short_description: Ponchyo: A Platypus Adventure is a charming 3D platformer collectathon full of adventure - and a hint of nostalgia! Play as Ponchyo the platypus and journey through a variety of vibrant worlds. Collect coins and discover new furniture to decorate your home.

details.title: Blunder Construction
details.short_description: Master the occult art of block stacking in this chaotic physics blockbuilder. Discover and combine forbidden magicks to find the most brilliant and deranged build styles. Push your luck to build the tallest, grandest monuments. Impress the king... or else.

details.title: Ninja JaJaMaru: Yokai Night Parade
details.short_description: Ninja JaJaMaru-kun returns in a yokai-filled hack-and-slash action game! Stray into a dungeon party, defeat dancing yokai, master flashy Ninpo, and amass an arsenal of ninja gear! Clear special "Yokai Night Parade" rules for loot, decorate your base for stat boosts and save Princess Sakura!

details.title: Guardians Planetfall
details.short_description: From the creators of Guardians Frontline, Guardians Planetfall drops you into a galaxy-wide war for the fate of humanity. Fight assembled into squads of up to 4 soldiers in fast, tactical VR combat across space and dangerous planets filled with aliens, Void soldiers, and massive war machines.

details.title: GunSlaw VR
details.short_description: A flexible free-to-play online multiplayer VR shooter featuring a wide variety of voxel-based gamemodes. Build, destroy, shoot, repeat!

details.title: Seclusion: Islesbury
details.short_description: Seclusion: Islesbury is a new horror point-and-click adventure in the vein of genre classics such as Scratches and Dark Fall. Can a decade-old murder case be solved? Is it safe to wander on these streets? Will anyone help you in this town? Find it out in this tale of personal tragedy.

details.title: Usurpator
details.short_description: USURPATOR is an EXTRACTION MELEE SLASHER. Rally your allies, clash with rival players, and battle the forces of evil. Master powerful weapons, unlock new talents, and carve your path to glory—then fight to make it out alive.

details.title: Galaxy Pilgrim
details.short_description: High-stakes physics platformer where you can't walk so you fly! Boost a reluctant engineer through chaotic pinball levels dodging deadly traps and collecting ore for his country.

details.title: Fear Tide
details.short_description: Fear Tide is a single-player zombie extraction survival game where you and your dog brave infected zones for the supplies keeping your bunker alive. Fight together, track valuable resources, carry what you can, rescue survivors, and extract before the horde closes in.

details.title: Kiwi Boing
details.short_description: Triple-jump, air dash, plant your beak on walls, leap off and more in this 3D collectathon platformer about a flightless bird that gets everywhere anyway. You crashed on tiny open-world islands, and you have places to be. Find secrets, Meet the locals, fix your plane and F off home (F is for Fly).

details.title: Chaincast
details.short_description: A PvP roguelike auto battler where you build a squad and arrange their skills into escalating combos. Battle rival squads and set off a chain reaction that grows stronger with every link.

details.title: Hole Punch Cocktail
details.short_description: "Drink. Kill. Drink. Kill." Enter the dream of Ms. Hangover, a young office worker with a slight alcohol dependency, fight against a twisted reality, and successfully finish your daily routine.

details.title: Dust till Dawn
details.short_description: A retro-paranormal powerwash simulator, where you're a maid restoring a quiet rural Japanese village. Dust, mop, squeegee to your heart's content...but don't stay too late!

details.title: RAT CITY: Ratocracy
details.short_description: Build and Manage a Rat City. Run it into the ground. Literally. Keep your Rats happy and productive. Create for them a glorious colony in the dirt! The never ending demand for the production of products to consume is all consuming. Wait, is this real life? No, it's RAT CITY!

details.title: R.override
details.short_description: Explore an alien planet as a fierce little rover on a mission to rescue a lost crew and uncover their secrets.

details.title: Nymble 2
details.short_description: Jack returns in Nymble 2, a turn-based puzzle-platformer where every step and jump matters. Solve 100+ handcrafted levels filled with new enemies, traps, and hazards that react when you move. Find the seedling, plant it, and climb the beanstalk to reach the next level above.

details.title: Monster Fantasy
details.short_description: Hunt giant monsters and build a beautiful home! Monster Fantasy is an action RPG with cozy life-sim elements. As an amnesiac hero, explore Eldoras, battle monsters with companions, befriend villagers, and enjoy fishing, cooking, gathering, and crafting.

details.title: ACORN: Seed of Resistance
details.short_description: Exploration, party building, and against-all-odds heroism in 15-minute roguelike adventures. Shape your rodent companions into a formidable fighting force and unleash them in brutal auto battles to retake your woodland home.

details.title: Scrappers: Adhokin
details.short_description: Build your hideout with wasteland salvage, then head out again. Scrappers: Adhokin is a solo top-down extraction shooter with base building and resource management. Place structures and furniture, manage power and fuel, and return alive with gear, blueprints, and loot.

details.title: PATRICIDE
details.short_description: "PATRICIDE" is an adventure RPG about girls who killed their father. It features a story of love and hate, hybrid action and turn-based combat, and cute anime-style heroines. Master the "Emotion System" to weaken enemies through empathy, and survive a ruthless, suffocating modern society.

details.title: Toziuha Night: Nosferatu's Curse
details.short_description: Eight years have passed since the battle against Dracula, the hero of Transylvania who succumbed to the power of darkness. However, peace is once again in danger. A pair of young alchemists will fight against the curse of the demon who goes by the name Nosferatu.

details.title: Boba Bears
details.short_description: Run a cozy boba shop 🧋 for bears, discover hidden drink and topping combos, decorate your space, prep ingredients through playful minigames, and meet new bear customers at your own pace. No timers, no pressure, just sweet drinks, curious experiments, and soft village moments.

details.title: NOSTRA
details.short_description: A dark fantasy RPG where side-view party battles turn on timing: build Boost, raise a Ward, parry on the frame and break the guard. Loot rolls with affixes, sets and runewords. Three kingdoms hold a fragile peace while something older stirs. Play the alpha demo now.

details.title: Motorsport Manager 2
details.short_description: Motorsport Manager returns after a decade. Build your racing team, develop faster cars, and make the calls that beat your rivals in reactive racing. Your decisions shape a living world of personalities and rivalries. Build your racing legacy.

details.title: MobMower
details.short_description: Enter the chaos of MobMower! Shred through endless hordes of lethal monsters to claim back your land in this intense auto-shooter. Choose your hero, drift through enemy waves, and manage an arsenal of spellbooks and weapons. Rescue companions, rebuild your village, and unlock powerful synergies!

details.title: Crimson Grace
details.short_description: Crimson Grace is a supernatural Gothic horror RPG where your skills, dice rolls, and choices decide the terrible fate of the Blackwell household. Will you weave a web of lies and get away with murder, or will you give in to the otherworldly forces urging you to take your sweet, bloody revenge?

details.title: JUJUTSU KAISEN RUMBLE: SURVIVATON
details.short_description: Survive, Exorcise, Change the game JUJUTSU KAISEN RUMBLE: SURVIVATON is a survivors royale where you battle cursed spirits and rival sorcerers, growing stronger throughout the match. Outscore your rivals and fight to be the last player standing victorious.

details.title: Mini Gladiators
details.short_description: Mini Gladiators is a minimalist gladiator roguelite with satisfying ragdoll physics, where your choices can turn your little fighter into an unstoppable force that gets the crowds going and enemies flying.

details.title: TL;DR
details.short_description: A typing incremental game where you type real novels. Work through 15+ classics, turn every word into gold, and keep upgrading until whole pages fill themselves faster than you can type. Too long; didn’t read. Type it anyway.

details.title: LootHold
details.short_description: Loot the day. Hold the night. LootHold throws you and up to three friends into a world the machines won. Strip the ruins by day, race the sun home, spend the loot on guns or defences. Then hold your bunker through the night against waves of bloodthirsty robots. Survive to take the fight to them.

details.title: HARDcheologist
details.short_description: You are an archeologist descending through mysterious and ever-changing ruins using only your weapon's recoil to control the fall. Shoot, try not to touch the ground, reveal secrets and survive. How deep can you go? What lies hidden in the depths of this pyramid?

details.title: 灵魂甜品 Soulcake
details.short_description: Soulcake: A fantasy‑romance AVG with yuri (LGBTQ+) & female-dominant dynamics. As the female lead, you can travel into others’ minds, gather ingredients to bake desserts filled with emotions. People come to you with their secrets. Forge bonds with them and…uncover the truth behind your ability.
developers: 自己的房间  Room of One's Own
publishers: 自己的房间  Room of One's Own

details.title: Company Captain: Westashes
details.short_description: You are the captain of a free company... one among many roaming this mercenary world, growing, falling, earning and betraying just as you do. The world will not bend for you, nor wait: the other companies are already writing their stories. Yours will be decided in steel, gold and a name.

details.title: QUANTUM HEART
details.short_description: QUANTUM HEART combines the thrill of dodging bullets in shoot 'em ups with the build variety of modern roguelikes. Graze enemy bullets to charge energy and unleash devastating powers. Take the elevator to the only city on Earth and depose the system that robbed your heart.

details.title: Stellar Mole
details.short_description: You will play a role of Agent Vanø—infiltrating an alien colonial corporation. Your mission: gather Earth intelligence for alien while weaponizing every dirty trick to torment your alien colleagues, dismantling their operations from within.

details.title: Quiet Express: Cabin 909
details.short_description: “Do you know anything about Cabin 909?” In Quiet Express: Cabin 909, you spend seven days on the titular train, journeying from one side of the continent to the other.

details.title: MMORPG NPC Simulator
details.short_description: Play as an NPC in a living MMORPG world. Run your shop, trade with players, give quests, and send raid parties after rare loot. Build your reputation, unlock Game Master abilities, and take control of the server from within.

details.title: BrokenLore: MIKI-CHAN
details.short_description: A first-person psychological horror game set in a Japanese high school. Meet Miki-chan, your personal virtual assistant, and survive a nightmare where jealousy and obsession distort reality.

details.title: AZUR
details.short_description: AZUR is a fast-paced PvP survival FPS on the French island of Belmas. No crafting, no extraction: drop into persistent servers, complete missions, and secure rare gear via Black Drip drops, with the risk of losing everything.

details.title: Factomancer
details.short_description: The Order sends you on a mission. Armed with technology powered by magic, build production chains, plan, transform, optimize, and prepare for the unexpected. In this automation roguelite, the Eye of the Order watches your moves: failure is only a step toward perfection.

details.title: Burdenfall
details.short_description: Burdenfall is a story-rich roguelike deckbuilder about personal growth and inner struggle. Ascend a mysterious castle with your shapeshifting companion, whose transformations shape and evolve your deck. Survive the climb and uncover the truth behind the Weeping Crown’s message.

details.title: Element TD 3 - Tower Defense
details.short_description: Element TD 3 takes the tradition of combining powerful elements for unique towers and adds heroes. Infinitely replayable and endless, this is a Tower Defense that blends classic gameplay with modern additions. Play with up to 8 players cooperatively or competitively.

name: Rizz Dungeon: Skeleton Key to My Heart

details.title: Rizz Dungeon: Skeleton Key to My Heart
details.short_description: Fighting is hard, right? Let your party do it for you! Romance Monster Girls and traverse the Dungeon! Hopefully they'll all get along... right?

details.title: Sweatpants Savior: Worlds Beyond
details.short_description: Shipwrecked in Antarctica, survivors cross the frozen glaciers and step beyond an ice wall into the boundless Great Thousand Worlds. A sandbox RPG centered on exploration and experimentation, featuring deeper systems, a vastly expanded world, and long-term progression shaped by player choice.

details.title: Laica
details.short_description: Live with Laica, a mysterious girl alone aboard a drifting space station, and explore the nightmare spreading beneath your quiet days together. A first-person sci-fi adventure that fuses survival horror with a slow-burn relationship. Is what waits ahead love, or despair?

details.title: Model Kit Studio
details.short_description: A rich and relaxing model-building simulator. Enjoy the meditative flow, meet fellow builders, and unwind to a soothing soundtrack as you build, pose, paint, and display your collection.

details.title: Masquerade: Penumbra
details.short_description: Fantasy visual novel with political intrigue, branching narratives, and romantic themes. Set in a world of underworld intrigue, where masks become identities and no one is safe. The game places an emphasis on character-driven storytelling.

details.title: Hello World
details.short_description: A colony sim with turn-based tactical combat, set in a lush, living apocalypse. Build a community of humans and robots while a bioengineered jungle devours the world around you and rogue machines fight you for what's left.

details.title: Jiří Kára Simulátor
details.short_description: Jiří Kára Simulátor is a retro FPS inspired by the 90s Czech legend. Explore various districts of post-communist Prague in a fast boomer shooter. Fight your way through pubs, dirty streets and defeat bosses. No common weapons, only street scrap, crowbar and gloomy wild atmosphere.

details.title: Rift Fishing
details.short_description: Rift Fishing is a multiplayer chatroom-focused fishing game. Fish through rifts into other worlds to catch mysterious creatures and artifacts. Make friends worldwide, paint together, and jam by the cozy campfire.

details.title: Prospice: Anomalous Logistics
details.short_description: Haul cursed cargo across a haunted island, where the terrain can take your life and every road bears the scars of the past.

details.title: Chill Planet
details.short_description: A deck-building adventure game about a group of girls traveling across Japan in a world doomed by an incoming meteor. Collect items, craft powerful builds, and play your cards wisely as you journey toward Hokkaido!

details.title: Eldritch Horror: Digital Edition
details.short_description: Uncover ancient cults, battle horrific monsters and thwart the rise of unfathomable Ancient Ones in a 1920s-themed adventure. In this faithful adaptation of the classic board game, you must race against time to save humanity from ancient powers and dark secrets before all is lost.

details.title: Campus Confidential
details.short_description: Campus Confidential is an LGBTQ slice-of-life dating sim with a supernatural subplot. Enjoy your campus experience, choose your subjects, study hard (or not), meet potential love interests of different genders... and try to uncover the mysteries shrouding the campus!

details.title: Gate Guard Simulator
details.short_description: Step into the boots of the castle guard. Inspect seals, expose smugglers and reveal witches. You decide who enters and who’s turned away. Will you uphold the law, or break it for your own gain?

details.title: Inkblood
details.short_description: You're an Inquisitor following a trail of death. A cult is at work, your predecessor has vanished, and the region teeters on the edge of chaos. Find the truth. Uphold the Inquisition. Do not fail.

details.title: Your Painting, Sir
details.short_description: A puzzle game about forging paintings using newspaper cutouts. Fool your legally blind boss or lose your job!

details.title: Ascenders: Beyond the Peak
details.short_description: ASCENDERS: BEYOND THE PEAK is a turn-based exploration roguelite where survival is vertical. Lead a team of alpinists to recover ancient artifacts from cursed peaks, prepare your expedition, evolve your climbers, master rope mechanics, and face H.P. Lovecraft-inspired horrors within the mountain.

details.title: The Pines
details.short_description: A psychological horror RPG where every choice has consequences. After a failed case, former detective Edward Walker arrives at The Pines, a secluded retreat with therapists on site and the promise of peace. But beneath its carefully constructed calm, something is deeply wrong.

details.title: What's in the box?
details.short_description: OPEN CONTAINERS! Seriously, just buy a container and… OPEN IT! What’s inside? - A MYSTERY! Find a rare item, fix it, and sell it for as much as possible in this first-person incremental game!

details.title: One Iced Latte: Milk Song
details.short_description: Idol baristas, Samurai baristas, VTubers baristas, Robot baristas! The Coffee War has taken over Tokyo! You are Ken Katsuki, a young master and the new manager of Milk Milk Coffee. Help sweet Moka win the Barista Cup! ☆

details.title: SinsKiller
details.short_description: SinsKiller is an isometric action arcade shooter set in a Dante-inspired Hell. Play as a fallen battle-mage wielding arcane power to obliterate demonic hordes and face brutal bosses. Face your sins. Kill them. Earn your redemption.

details.title: Dead 4 Now: Extraction
details.short_description: Survive the outbreak or become it in a PvPvE FPS extraction shooter. Scavenge loot, use experimental stims, and fight to extract as a survivor. Or enter a raid as a zombie, hunt other players, and evolve into a monstrous boss.

details.title: Where is my sword
details.short_description: A mismatched duo—a wicked demon god and a kind-hearted fox girl—is gathering followers!? Travel across many lands and survive hectic yet strategic real-time battles by rummaging through your bag for just the right item! Fight your foes or turn them into followers... What awaits at journey's end?

details.title: Pathways Lost: Reclaim
details.short_description: Send customised troops and your powerful mech into battle in this strategic auto battler. Spawn units, equip gear, unlock skills and reclaim lost worlds. Optimize your army and master ever increasing challenges. Fast-paced matches, endless depth.

details.title: Screams of the Abyss
details.short_description: Descend into the abyss, following the trail of a vanished expedition. Piece together their story through the recordings they left behind and uncover why none of them ever returned to the surface.

details.title: TrainSim: Point & Call
details.short_description: Find the sweet spot between speed and precision as you step into the driver’s seat and run trains across cities and vast landscapes. The game focuses on authentic handling and time management, delivering a tight, goal-driven, fully immersive cab experience.

details.title: Pemkie Island
details.short_description: Pemkie Island is a monster taming RPG adventure, in a roguelite format. Travel across the 5 different regions while discovering and taming unique creatures called Pemkies. Master their traits, choose the right skills and build the best team possible to restore balance!

details.title: Godless Dawn
details.short_description: Godless Dawn is a ruthless action RPG set in a dark fantasy world. Descend into cursed dungeons, uncover the stories behind fallen souls, and reveal the truth hidden behind the silence of the gods.

details.title: Manum
details.short_description: A fast third-person 4v4 battlemage arena where you build your mage mid-match. Loot spells, combine them freely, and fight for capture points.

details.title: Stack Order
details.short_description: Stack Order is an enigmatic deckbuilding adventure. Engage in tense one-on-one card duels, use strategy to stack up synergies, and uncover the source of the corruption spreading over this mysterious, handcrafted world.

details.title: Hemlon the Grey
details.short_description: Hemlon the Grey is a deflection-based 2D Souls-like where life and death are decided by a blade. Follow the story of Hemlon, a half-demon warrior, as she uncovers the dark secrets of the Reinz Republic and the Broken Wings.

details.title: Muv-Luv: Tactics Kalidasa at Nightmare
details.short_description: The heir to the legendary "Muv-Luv Alternative" series, "Muv-Luv: Tactics Kalidasa at Nightmare" is a tactical simulation RPG devoted to pure gameplay excellence.

details.title: FEMBOY SLEEPOVER - Episode 1
details.short_description: You're invited to the Femboy Sleepover! In Episode 1 get to know your new femboy roommates, but watch out— your succubus might have other ideas...

name: Castaway Diary: Portal to the Unknown Isles

details.title: Castaway Diary: Portal to the Unknown Isles
details.short_description: Castaway Diary is a bright and charming anime-style survival adventure. Are you ready to escape to a relaxing island life with a group of lovely girls?

details.title: Elderfeast
details.short_description: Hunt. Carve. Cook. Elderfeast is a co-op action game where the monsters are the menu. Hunt Lovecraftian horrors across the galaxy and slice them apart for ingredients to make your next meal. The better you cook, the stronger you become, but there's always something more terrifying to hunt next.

details.title: Rocksowers
details.short_description: Co-op Survival Sandbox meets Bullet Hell. Explore the corrupted surface on a moving base, scavenge for resources and craft GAME-BREAKING weapons using many unique modules to defeat ever-stronger foes. Fight to reclaim what The Bloom took from humanity!

details.title: wonderful florescence
details.short_description: Winter is drawing near.As a girl from the Lower City, you'll journey to Midcity and meet the people who will change your life—and whose lives you'll change in return. Experience a heartfelt story of dreams, growth, and unexpected encounters.

details.title: Music Business: Nightclubs & Festivals Simulator
details.short_description: Build your nightlife empire in this first-person management simulator. Physically manage your stock, set up your equipment, and serve customers in real-time. Can you turn your small local club into the city's hottest spot without spiraling into chaos?

details.title: Creepy Horrors: Blood Cult 2
details.short_description: Build your roster of Creepy Horrors in this spooky occult creature-collector RPG. Crawl through crypts collecting cursed curios and ingredients, combining them to summon adorable Horrors, wielding them in strategic 3v3 battles against rival sects. The Crypts are calling. Will you answer?

details.title: DARK MACHINE THE GAME
details.short_description: DARK MACHINE THE GAME is a team-based mecha action shooter where your custom machine evolves through three combat classes. Clash in up to 7v7 PvP or battle overwhelming hordes in PvE across destructible, ever-changing arenas.

details.title: Project Prison: Prologue
details.short_description: Start as a small-time dealer in a prison full of the world’s most ruthless inmates. Push pills, craft contraband, smuggle it past drones, dogs and cops, and hire a crew. Then the gangs come for you. Fight to survive and build a criminal empire from behind bars.

details.title: Money Under the Bed
details.short_description: You complained to a strange roadside statue about being broke—and the next day, a jar of money appeared under your bed. How do you plan to spend this windfall? Of course, you’re free to squander every cent... as long as you can survive until tomorrow.

details.title: SaviorS : Oath of the Blade
details.short_description: SaviorS: Oath of the Blade is a roguelite action RPG with flexible party building and deep, beat 'em up–style combat. Choose your path on the world map and combine companions, sword skills, spells, and gear to face powerful foes. Grow your favorite party and see the journey through together.

details.title: WATERFUL: a tiny oasis builder
details.short_description: A relaxing puzzle game inspired by nature. Dig riverbeds to guide water through desert valleys and grow a variety of plants, then zoom in to discover hidden animals drawn to new habitats. Earn points for your discoveries and unlock new contraptions to transform the dry landscape into a lush oasis!

details.title: Brush Burial: Bruiseland
details.short_description: You are a hunter of men, and your quarry is numerous, armed, and afraid. Bind and break them. This is a first-person immersive sim with tightly interconnected environments, sleek and sadistic melee combat, and over a hundred cosmetics to unlock.

details.title: WARD 107: SILENCE
details.short_description: WARD 107: SILENCE is a first person psychological horror. Your microphone is the key: use your voice to solve vocal puzzles and uncover the atrocious experiments of Project H.O.P.E. Speak to progress, but silence is your only defense when they hunt you. Make noise, and you die.

details.title: Spellogger
details.short_description: A slow-paced, cozy fantasy RPG where you play as a Wizard Lumberjack. Take on daily tasks and upgrade your character in a relaxing work cycle similar to Stardew Valley, while setting out on Elder Scrolls-style quests and exploration.

details.title: Barbie™ Horse Ride & Rescue
details.short_description: Start your Western horse riding adventure with Barbie at Roaming Hearts Rescue Ranch. Rescue and rehabilitate charming horses, test your riding skills and customize your style as you uncover the mysteries of Moonrise Valley!

details.title: ESTELLA - The Sin of Time -
details.short_description: Switch between multiple protagonists in this suspense visual novel and follow the event of the three days leading up to Halloween. Piece together clues from each perspective to uncover the truth, as your choices reshape the fates of the others.

details.title: 囚人カウンセリング
details.short_description: An interactive prison adventure. You play as a psychiatrist, working one-on-one with inmates who have committed crimes. Use case files to choose appropriate responses and hand out items from the drawer to maintain their trust. Your choices can either open up or close the inmates.

details.title: Bloodfell
details.short_description: Tear through Hell with devastating weapon and spell builds in this gothic action roguelite. Hunt powerful loot across five procedural biomes, risk another floor, and rebuild Ashenhold for your next descent.

details.title: Age of Transport - Blue Marble
details.short_description: Classification yards, waybills and live dispatch — on a 1:4-scale Earth. Build a multi-modal freight empire across rail, sea and air through twelve eras of transport history, in a persistent world shared by up to 255 companies.

details.title: Backrooms
details.short_description: Explore an abandoned liminal space. Uncover dark secrets through eerie exploration and environmental storytelling. Evade unpredictable supernatural entities and face psychological horror. Will you reveal the truth or become another lost soul?

details.title: MetalMercs
details.short_description: Destroy. Salvage. Upgrade. PROFIT! Command your own mercenary company in real-time-with-pause tactical mech combat. Hire pilots, customize your mechs, and take contracts across a war-torn universe filled with riches, glory, and bitter defeat.

details.title: Mutant Hunter
details.short_description: As the numbers of combat ready soldiers in the ranks of the remaining army continue to dwindle, High command devised a plan to use convicts as manpower via mind control. Now your task is to hunt mutants around the sector using this experimental technology.

details.title: Deck of Memories
details.short_description: Deck of Memories is a nostalgic deckbuilding adventure about the stories your grandfather left behind. Explore fragments of his life as a lighthouse keeper, manifested inside atmospheric dioramas. Craft and combine cards to restore these memories and discover the secrets they hold.

details.title: Nephelia: Through the Clouds
details.short_description: Take control of your own airship, hire people for your crew, help them on their personal stories, follow the trail of a whimsical inventor of the colonisation era, trade, fight, discover, and try to stay afloat.

details.title: LIVING HELL
details.short_description: A co-op horror where you must escape a city in ruins, as solar radiation twists animals and humans into terrifying mutations. From the creator of DEVOUR.

details.title: Gang of Frogs
