details.short_description: Sail through the galaxy as a fearless outlaw frog. Plunder loot, upgrade weapons, eat flies and fight through hordes of monstrous bugs in an intense 1-4 player co-op shooter.

details.title: Retro Game Store Simulator
details.short_description: Run your own Video Game Store in 1984. Everyday until the end of 1989 gives you the opportunity to stock shelves, cycle your inventory, manage your prices, and analyze historical trends to make your game store profitable. Use era-relevant technology and systems to prove that gaming is not dead!

details.title: Metro Station Designer
details.short_description: Think you could design a metro station that actually flows? Build multi-level concourses, platforms, ticket gates, and escalators in this crowd simulation game. Send over ten thousand rush-hour commuters through, scrub the replay, and refine your layout until the whole station runs smoothly.

details.title: Diviner
details.short_description: Explore isometric dungeons and derelict castles, defeat dark foes in first person turn based combat, customize your build and create gear arrangements with a slot based inventory. You have been tasked by the Diviner to rebuild a dead lord’s body by obtaining their organs scattered across the lands.

details.title: TrophyRC
details.short_description: A scale off-road trial experience. Customize your crawler and conquer challenging obstacle courses. Remember, it's not about speed, but accuracy and precision!

details.title: Moon Princess
details.short_description: 🌙A daughter-raising game in a world of wuxia and mythology — raise her as a martial arts master in a rich wuxia world. Train, fight, manage, and shape her future! With 50+ branching endings and 60+ story characters, forge your one-of-a-kind heroine and change the fate of the Jianghu!

details.title: Pixel Frenzy
details.short_description: Pixel Frenzy is a fast-paced first-person shooter game where you create your own combat style in fully destructible environments. Defeat the pixel monsters invading the real world. Grab your weapon and save the world by destroying everything in your path!

details.title: Ginga Legends
details.short_description: A football roguelike deckbuilder with tactical depth on and off the pitch. Build your club, chain the perfect play, and climb from amateur pitches all the way to the top league.

details.title: Burn It Back
details.short_description: A survival RTS in a frozen taiga. Settle the surface for the bunker below, meet its quotas, and every night burn back a living tissue that grows, adapts and remembers.

details.title: Tea by the Sea
details.short_description: A cozy tea shop by the sea in a strange digital world. Grow tea, make drinks, get to know the locals, and decorate your shop. Enjoy quiet days in this seaside town while discovering the unusual things happening around you.

details.title: Capital City
details.short_description: Capital City combines city, resource, and transport management within an infinite steampunk fantasy world. Mine resources, build factories and logistics networks. Transport raw and processed materials and goods to your city to ensure it keeps growing and expanding.

details.title: Magna Conquest
details.short_description: Lead a kingdom in a real-time medieval fantasy grand strategy where the campaign world and battles unfold simultaneously. Command armies of up to 100,000 units while shaping your realm through diplomacy, kingdom management, research, and legendary heroes in single-player or campaign multiplayer.

details.title: Immortal Loop: Doom Cycle
details.short_description: Transported to a cultivation world, you face apocalypse in one year. Every world‑ending catastrophe sends you back to the start. Keep resources and boost your aptitude across loops. Explore, uncover secrets, seek treasures, and survive doom in this real‑time action cultivation RPG.

details.title: Pro Yakyu Front Office
details.short_description: Take charge of a fictional Japanese pro baseball club as general manager. Draft players on your scouts' judgment, set the lineup and the rotation, earn from sponsors and the ballpark, manage the payroll, and answer to the owner. The games play themselves; the decisions are yours.

details.title: Dwarven Digging Machine
details.short_description: Command dwarves as they build a huge dwarven digging machine. Harvest resources, find powerful artifacts, defend against your foes and conquer the underground in this incremental strategy game.

details.title: Holon
details.short_description: Build factories inside factories. Extract shapes, automate production, and deliver increasingly complex designs to the Hub. Enter a Nest to build its machinery, reuse it as a single building, then fit smaller Nests inside larger ones to take your factory further. About this game

details.title: Touhou Recastlift
details.short_description: Cards you play come back to your hand over time. Team up two Touhou Project characters and battle with a deck of just 10 cards in this 1v1 card game. Which card to play when, and which to bring back first? Reading your opponent decides the match. Free to play, no gacha.

details.title: Bonbaran!
details.short_description: Bonbaran! is a 2D action puzzle about using bombs and digging to make your own way. Place, stack, kick, ignite, and chain bombs, reshape terrain, and find your own solution. If an attempt fails, take control partway through the replay and try a different move.

details.title: Auction Simulator
details.short_description: Build an auction career where every bid is a tell. Buy, research and sell valuable objects, read rivals in poker-inspired psychological auctions, build collections, run your own auction house, or become a dealer in the dark market. Every bid is information. Every object could be an opportunity.

details.title: Shard Squad: Onyx Rising
details.short_description: Build a squad of elemental Shards in this roguelike auto-battler. Draft, position and level up your team, collect Relics, and chart a branching path through events, shops and bosses, or face other players’ squads in asynchronous multiplayer.

details.title: Fangjie:Shattered Altars
details.short_description: Wake in a shattered voxel world and set out to restore its lost altars. Explore wilds that are different every time, shape your playstyle with a class, skill tree and styles, tame nearly forty companions, and take on bosses with NPC allies or friends on Steam.

details.title: THE CROSSING
details.short_description: Explore a world inspired by the landscapes of the Gobi Desert behind the wheel of a rally car. Find your way using nothing more than a paper map, amongst vast steppes and seas of dunes. A sensitive and intimate story of Misheel’s return to the land of her childhood.

details.title: MEGALITH
details.short_description: Traverse an endless winter alongside the last human on Earth.

details.title: Grumpy Hero Grinder
details.short_description: A satirical tower defense roguelite with chaotic real-time combat. Play as a dungeon boss defending your home from hordes of vicious heroes. Place deadly traps, expand your dungeon, grow stronger, meet and help other creatures - all to get back to your well-deserved nap!

details.title: Dreamcore: Liminal Spaces
details.short_description: Step into a surreal dreamlike world in this atmospheric walking simulator. Explore strange liminal spaces, wander through mysterious environments, and experience a world where reality follows the rules of a dream.

details.title: Windrest Chronicle: Dragonport Diner
details.short_description: Your hometown rests on a great sea dragon. Farm, fish, forage, and explore as it carries your town across the ocean. Gather ingredients, cook for locals and travelers, restore the diner, discover recipes, make friends, and fall in love. Make Dragonport the warmest light on the sea.

details.title: A Mission Full of Cats
details.short_description: A Mission Full of Cats is a hidden object game where you help Fofiño bring all the cats back to Gattaca! This intergalactic vacation is coming to an end, and it's time to track down all the cats scattered across the universe!

details.title: HYPERDROP: A Pachinko Roguelite
details.short_description: Build impossible scoring machines in HYPERDROP, a hypnotizing physics-based pachinko roguelite bursting with satisfying chain reactions and game-breaking combos.

details.title: C.A.G.E.
details.short_description: C.A.G.E. is a satirical first-person narrative adventure where your choices influence the story. Guided by an entity with questionable morals, you must navigate through corporate gaslighting and environmental oddities to complete your tasks. Your empathy is a glitch, compliance is your currency.

details.title: 幽囚の魔法使い
details.short_description: “The Imprisoned Magician” is a fantasy BL visual novel that explores the bond between master and apprentice. Aim to become a fully-fledged magician under the tutelage of a master with a troubled past.

details.title: Idol Manager: Virtual Venture
details.short_description: The management simulation game Idol Manager depicted the good and bad sides of the idol industry... another entry in the series is here! This time, the focus is on virtual streamers! Manage a new streaming agency and raise your staff to become the best agency in the industry.

details.title: Insert Disc
details.short_description: A DVD screensaver inspired roguelike where you flick the logo inside your CRT TV and hit pegs to rack up tons of points. Endless bouncing among the stars and chill ambience combine for a mind-numbingly satisfying experience. Maybe this time, the logo will hit the corner!

details.title: Resurgis: Rise of the Dead
details.short_description: Resurgis is a 3D dark fantasy action game blending souls-like combat with rogue-lite dungeon crawling. Dismember your enemies with brutal finishers, draft cards in every room to build your unique playstyle, and master a relentless loop where death is only the beginning.

details.title: Obscurium
details.short_description: Walk a darker Brazil and uncover the creatures its folklore keeps in the deep forest, monsters most players have never seen. A roguelite deckbuilder: sacrifice cards from your hand to summon onto a four-lane ritual board, and seal each one into your grimoire.

details.title: Full Belly Breakout
details.short_description: Navigate the hidden dangers lurking within a wide variety of dishes, savor every bite, fill your stomach, and escape from a terrifying cell. An overwhelming dining experience where eyeballs crawl out of plain rice, sharks burst from soup, and entire universes unfold upon your plate.

details.title: Bathory - Heritage of Blood
details.short_description: Play as Ursula Bathory, the vampire Princess, awakened from a centuries long slumber to claim her throne of blood in this Vampire Soulsvania inspired by Castlevania, Nosferatu and gothic victorian literature classics.

details.title: Scholar Adventure: Lost Night
details.short_description: An ancient prophecy is about to awaken. Guided by a mysterious artifact, William ventures into Azig, where a secret society, ancient temples, and opposing forces await, trapped beneath the eternal sun. Uncover the truth that could change the fate of these lands.

details.title: Finding Frankie 2
details.short_description: Trapped inside a deadly televised game show, you must parkour through a massive obstacle complex. Wall run, rail grind, and vault past twisted traps in the final season. Win the $10 million prize, or die trying. Frankie is waiting for you and he’s not holding back.

name: Lair Land Story 2: Mist of Sea

details.title: Lair Land Story 2: Mist of Sea
details.short_description: After traveling far to the southern end of Lair Land, seven knights have reached Chainch Bay. Settled in a small tropical fishing village surrounded by ruins, they will spend the next few years building a new life here while facing the most challenging quest they will ever meet.

details.title: Dungeons of the Amber Griffin
details.short_description: Play as a group of daredevils who explore the world of dark fantasy in search of fame, amber and gold. Experience the classic mechanics of the iconic ‘90s Dungeon Crawlers with a new twist. Solve the mystery of the ghost that haunted the ruins and discover a bestiary based on Kashubian beliefs.

details.title: Pathbreakers: Roaming Blades
details.short_description: Pathbreakers: Roaming Blades is a turn-based tactical RPG where you lead a company of mercenaries in a medieval fantasy world. Try your hand at mercenary work, trading, or exploring, and keep your crew well stocked for brutal combat in a procedurally-generated open-world campaign.

details.title: Void Soul Awakening
details.short_description: Void Soul Awakening is a hyper fast action roguelite blending hack and slash combat, third person gunplay, and sorcery. As a wandering soul trapped in an ever shifting cosmic prison, master a massive arsenal, swap between powerful classes, adapt to every run, and fight your way to the Keeper.

details.title: Kalyskah
details.short_description: Fight as a vampire while exploring a dark fantasy open-world in this 3rd person RPG. Make choices to affect the betterment of humanity– or yourself; strengthen your vampiric skills to fight bandits, trolls, and undead; and entertain yourself in fully animated seductive scenes.

details.title: Beasts of Steel
details.short_description: Beasts of Steel is a WWII combined-arms game. Fight as a rifleman, tank crew or pilot in the same battle, on maps generated from real landscapes, or command the whole war in a turn-based campaign. Play online with up to 64 players, or offline with bots in battles of up to 128 soldiers.

details.title: Bloodstained: The Scarlet Engagement
details.short_description: Unravel the dark history of the Bloodstained universe and explore a hauntingly immersive 16th-century England steeped in a 2.5D gothic atmosphere, enthralling players in strategic battles, crafting, and exploration across a sprawling, cursed land.

details.title: Everbloom
details.short_description: Everbloom is a cute and cozy social farming sim set in a world of whimsy - grow buckets of popcorn right on the plant and make chocolate milk by feeding your cows candy bars. Grow, care, build, decorate, and explore the world of Everbloom solo or with your friends.

details.title: Absym
details.short_description: Absym is a unique souls-like that challenges you to survive between two dimensions: the decaying Nihilor and the corrupted Absymalith. Fight, explore, and use Rift Dancing to shift between worlds in real time. Every choice draws you closer to redemption... or corruption.

details.title: Graytail
details.short_description: A small island in the Pacific. The greatest female pilot has vanished. Suffering from severe headaches, our protagonist depends on medication as they search for her, but... What is real and what is hallucination? A Zelda-like mystery adventure to uncover the island's truth.

details.title: ONTOS
details.short_description: A sci-fi mystery set on the repurposed moon hotel Samsara. Uncover cryptic experiments, face unsettling encounters, and piece together a mind-bending narrative. The deeper you go, the more the truth unravels as you confront the ultimate question: What is reality?

details.title: Crazy Taxi: World Tour
details.short_description: Play as Axel in an all-new, high-octane adventure as he sets out to recover his stolen taxi and chase down a mysterious organization causing chaos around the world. Race through iconic locations and tackle extreme missions in the long-awaited return of the classic series.

details.title: Asbak
details.short_description: Asbak is a 2D action roguelike where you play as a corporate demon hunter in a demon-ridden urban Southeast Asia. In a dangerous world where demon hunting is a profession, your rare talent is used to slay demons and earn a living.

details.title: Crownbreakers
details.short_description: Crownbreakers is a striking and snappy turn-based card brawler where magic meets punk and demonic billionaires rule the city. Crash through their districts, build your deck, and throw every card like a punch. Be the guillotine that frees Cascade from their soul-crushing rulers.

details.title: THE JOY OF CREATION
details.short_description: The lines between creation and creator blur, in this first-person psychological horror game inspired by Five Nights At Freddy’s.

details.title: PVKK: Planetenverteidigungskanonenkommandant
details.short_description: Operate your planetary defense cannon to fend off an interplanetary invasion from the comfort of your cozy bunker. You’re here to stay, so obey your superiors, press the right buttons, and sip your daily tea ration - it's good for you.

details.title: Artificial Detective
details.short_description: Artificial Detective is an action-adventure where you step into the shoes of a robodetective in a dystopian city overrun by rogue robots. Lead your underdog team of a military robodog and a human girl as you fight, hack, and outsmart your enemies to uncover why humans are gone.

details.title: Blighted
details.short_description: Battle through a psychedelic Western nightmare in this Metroidvania action RPG from the creators of Guacamelee! and Nobody Saves the World.

details.title: Middle Ages: Peasants & Knights
details.short_description: Survive in an open world inspired by 14th century Europe. Immerse yourself in crafting based on real historical methods and experience true inventory system and realistic resource management. Take control of your destiny and embrace a world full of possibilities.

details.title: Front Edge
details.short_description: The «Front edge» is a real-time multiplayer tactical game dedicated to a clash between the modern armies of the world’s leading countries. Great attention is paid to logistics and control of small groups of troops on various maps.

details.title: Noblemen: 1941
details.short_description: Noblemen: 1941 is a third-person shooter mixed with real time strategic elements. Set in a gritty, alternate reality World War 2, you will deploy units, build fortifications, capture and defend key locations, use powerful abilities, and manage resources across a vast multi-faction campaign.

details.title: Pebbles Quest
details.short_description: The Princess has been kidnapped by evildoers! It is now Pebbles Quest to breach the Castle, face a gauntlet of traps and trials, all to rescue his one true love.

details.title: City of None
details.short_description: A metropolis crumbles into ruin as powerful Barons satisfy their greed upon souls lost in time. You are but one spirit, with a wooden body left to rot in the wild…

details.title: My Time at Evershine
details.short_description: Be the Governor of a brand-new settlement on the fringes of the Free Cities, facing the almighty Duvos Empire. Recruit settlers, build infrastructure, tame the wilds, and lead your people to become a new cornerstone for the Alliance in this adventure-packed simulation RPG!

details.title: SACRATA
details.short_description: SACRATA is a Diablo-like roguelite looter with horde-survival combat. Fight through relentless hordes, create skill builds, unlock a roster of heroes, challenge formidable bosses, and claim ancient Relics. Experience the thrill of intense combat and ultimate destruction!

details.title: Golf With Your Friends 2
details.short_description: Golf With Your Friends is back, and this time it means fore. Up to 12 players, Chaos Mode, a new level editor, and enough questionable shots to end any friendship.

details.title: KINGDOM HEARTS IV
details.short_description: Our hero Sora awakes in the unfamiliar world of Quadratum. As he looks for a way to return to his world, his friends Donald and Goofy head for the Underworld to try to find him. Wield the Keyblade in fast-paced battles that match to your own play style.

details.title: The Subminer
details.short_description: An atmospheric underwater drilling roguelite beneath the icy crust of Enceladus. Pilot your submarine, explore the depths, mine resources through procedural caves and upgrade your base. Each dive is darker and more dangerous, and you must face the terrors lurking in the shadows. Live. Dive. Repeat.

details.title: VERISMO
details.short_description: A ghost and a carnival clown plot revenge on the man who ruined their lives. An operatic-tragedy visual novel set in 1920s Sicily.

details.title: 异世轮回录：If
details.short_description: 诸君！这个世界很无趣。生为牛马，我只是一个行走的NPC。谁不想当主角？ 在地球OL已经不可能办到了。但至少在异世轮回录中，我们可以！《异世轮回录：If》是一款多结局多周目轮回式人生模拟团队卡牌肉鸽游戏。你被女神召唤来到剑与魔法的异世界，新的人生你要选择怎么样的天赋？本以为是一次王道转生，但没想到这个世界危机重重，选错一步就只能迎接死亡。无数次轮回，你一点点探寻这个世界的隐秘，在最后的世界线，或许就是所有人都能幸福的Happy End?

details.title: MAW
details.short_description: What's it like to be queer in a totalitarian regime? Explore your identity as a wolf detective working for the state. Sniff for clues. Interrogate or date other characters. Make lasting choices. Will you fight your instincts or embrace who you really are and face the consequences?

name: The War of the Worlds: Siberia

details.title: The War of the Worlds: Siberia
details.short_description: The War of the Worlds: Siberia tells a story of one young Student, running from law and martian invaders whose Incursion into Europe in 1896 threatens the entire civilisation and all that makes us human.

details.title: Precinct IX
details.short_description: Precinct IX is a cyberpunk police management and turn-based combat game. Receive visitors, manage cases and resources, dispatch unique officers to unstable scenes, and change case outcomes—and your relationships—through dialogue, command, and battle.

details.title: THE LIFT: Supernatural Handyman Simulator
details.short_description: You are a handyman renovating a massive research facility abandoned after a mysterious incident. The Lift is an eerie first-person simulator with satisfying house-flipping gameplay, a mind-bending story, and a highly interactive world inspired by Soviet sci-fi and the SCP Foundation.

details.title: ARMED FRAME
details.short_description: A fast-paced TPS & FPS where you control a mech in battle. Customize 12 parts: head, torso, arms, legs, booster, FCS, and 6 weapons. Weapon and frame colors are changeable. Use weapons, jump, boost up, run on walls, do rapid boosts, quick turns, and high boosts.

details.title: Häxeri
details.short_description: Häxeri is a grid-based first-person dungeon crawler DRPG with turn-based combat. Form your own party, explore and map the sprawling corridors of the dungeon, and battle the monsters therein. Gain extra turns by exploiting their weaknesses, but be careful or they will exploit yours!

details.title: Liminal Point
details.short_description: Classic Survival Horror. Drawn to Ashen Point by a cryptic voicemail, Lyra returns to the island where her band’s story ended in tragedy. Shrouded in fog and prowled by horrors, confront deadly creatures, explore the desolate town, and reveal the truth behind the night that changed everything.

details.title: Underground Security Inc
details.short_description: Defend your dungeon against relentless waves of “heroes”. Manage your minions, mine ores, construct traps and cast spells to strengthen your defenses. Each run brings new challenges in this roguelite dungeon defense game.

details.title: Unsound Love
details.short_description: Unsound Love is an open-world horror escape room where nothing is explained. You are born into a new world through the backseat of a wrecked car. Trapped in a time loop. Understand it — or stay trapped forever.

details.title: Conversations with My Imaginary Friends
details.short_description: A free collection of explorable scenes capturing conversations spanning two decades between the creator of To the Moon and the fictional characters they've created. About life, making games, and everything in between.

details.title: Hive and Harvest
details.short_description: Death is dying, and five hives are fighting over the rot that's left. A trading card game about insects you grow from parts, a card at a time. Plant a parasite in an enemy creature, seed it with spores until it changes sides, or just break it and race your opponent to the pieces.

details.title: MOLTYN
details.short_description: MOLTYN: Superhero destruction sandbox where every pixel is simulated: rock, water, lava, ice and metal melt, flood, freeze and collapse for real. Every power of the earth, 18 missions, kaiju fights, free-play worlds and CREATE, a level editor with level sharing. Early Access 12 Nov 2026.

details.title: Grampage: Life at 67
details.short_description: YOUR RETIREMENT ISN’T GOING TO FUND ITSELF! Pension not cutting it? No problem. Grab up to three fellow retirees, pull off outrageous heists, and steal your way to the retirement you deserve. Work together when you have to, but remember: only one of you gets to retire!

details.title: CONQ: CROWN OF NO QUARTER
details.short_description: You were promised the heavens, but found only eternal purgatory -- unable to escape, unable to truly die. Gather your forces across sea and land, show no mercy, and give your enemies no quarter. It's time to bleed again.

details.title: Slab Drifter
details.short_description: Slab Drifter is a space-based tactical physics destruction game. The Slab was fractured. The Lords were born. All that remains are corrupted machines and the drifters who scavenge among them. Pilot your drones to hunt the massive Lords and discover their weaknesses.

details.title: AROTA - Tire God
details.short_description: My friends and I grew up as simple creatures. See round object. See hill. Must roll object down hill. The first time we let it roll, we had only one thought: We need a bigger hill. If you are like us, you'll find yourself cheering for a tire to go just a little further.

details.title: MISSING PLAY
details.short_description: MISSING PLAY is an asymmetrical multiplayer horror game where one player faces off against the rest. Play as a survivor, cooperate with your teammates, complete objectives, and escape… or become the monster and do everything you can to stop them. It's free and will remain free.

details.title: The Arch-Enemy of Hy-Brasil
details.short_description: 勇者が敗北した世界で目醒めたあなたは、魔王を倒すために冒険に向かうことになる。停滞した世界で最後にあなたが選ぶのは再生？ それとも、破滅？

name: Chat, Should We Head Over There?

details.title: Chat, Should We Head Over There?
details.short_description: An extraction roguelite where you're not the player, you're a viewer. SIA, a rookie streamer with ten subscribers, heads into the Backrooms to grow her channel. Tell her where to go, what to grab and when to leave. Only what she carries out alive is hers. Use it to make her stronger and go deeper.

details.title: Last Ditch Effort
details.short_description: Enter a grimdark world consumed by endless war and join Igor on a desperate mission in Last-Ditch Effort, a pixel-art character-action game featuring fast-paced combat, handcrafted animation and stylized comic-book storytelling.

details.title: Akiiwan: Relaxing Survival
details.short_description: Fall into a chill survival adventure, with a talking campfire as your guide. Explore, craft, fish and hunt during the day, and ask your fire three questions each night. Choose wisely: Winter isn't the only surprise in this beautiful, hand-drawn world. Playable in cosy or realistic mode.

details.title: Sword Dancer
details.short_description: Inspired by Gongsun Daniang, the legendary sword dancer of Tang Dynasty China. Chart her blade-dance through enemy ranks—every step is set before the first strike. Route planning × roguelite building: choreograph the perfect dance, then watch it cut through the chaos.

details.title: Wind Runners
details.short_description: Wind Runners is a high-speed bullet-hell dogfighting roguelite where you start as a lone pilot, turning each flight into a fight for freedom. Face the ruthless technotheist Realm, take on relentless fleets and colossal bosses, and let your victories ignite a growing resistance across the star system

details.title: Rune Fencer Illyia
details.short_description: Traverse a massive, ruined and beautiful world in this intense, atmospheric action platformer. Steal enemy abilities and fight them back with their own runic magic and deadly swordplay, as you attempt to find your lost twin sister in the sunken kingdom of Ithos.

details.title: BEAST NEGOTIATOR
details.short_description: Fighting isn't the only way. Explore dungeons, negotiate with the monsters you meet, and recruit them. Command your party in side-view turn-based battles - a 2D dungeon RPG built around befriending monsters.

details.title: The Way of Wrath
details.short_description: Forge your path as a Bronze Age tribal chieftain in this epic strategy RPG. Lead your tribe in a fight for survival against all odds as the elements, time, and a relentless foe seek to wipe your people out.

details.title: Unsung Warriors
details.short_description: Unsung Warriors is a 2D action-adventure game. The game can be played solo or in couch co-op mode. Enjoy beautiful handcrafted levels. Fight against ferocious enemies and discover the many secrets of this ancient world.

details.title: Send & Defend
details.short_description: Send & Defend is a competitive multiplayer tower defense game. Carve your own maze, build towers and send creeps to grow your income. Watch your rivals, steal their lives and be the last one standing.

details.title: IKUMA - The Frozen Compass
details.short_description: Embark on a haunting journey into the cold in this narrative adventure - either alone or with a friend. IKUMA tells the story of Sam, a teenage boy who finds himself stranded in the Arctic with his dog. He must face not only its harsh environment, but also something lurking deeper in the shadows.

details.title: Octopus City Blues
details.short_description: In a world of ice, the last human city is tearing itself apart. Explore the underbelly of a monstrous metropolis in a surreal adventure about everything and nothing.

details.title: Keepguard
details.short_description: Keepguard is a medieval tower-defense roguelite where the map is your build. Expand and defend your kingdom: bind towers to powerful rites, uncover unusual relics and create game-breaking synergies to keep back the endless hordes.

details.title: Star Shift Legacy
details.short_description: The year is 2357. Humans have explored the stars and colonized many worlds under the authority of the Earth Systems Alliance (ESA). Amidst the chaos of a civil war, what would be your legacy?

details.title: ARTIFICIAL
details.short_description: ARTIFICIAL is a physics based first-person puzzle platformer inspired by Portal & Half-Life series. Interact with the environment, pick up and throw objects, sneak around enemies, control intricate physics-based mechanisms and learn how to survive in the underground colony of the Asteroid 2031 XT

details.title: Sandtable Engine
details.short_description: Welcome to the sandbox world full of creativity! With a free and open gameplay mode and a creative platform, whether you are a player or a developer, you can find highly scalable gameplay and game modes, or DIY your own game ideas here!

details.title: Food Industry
details.short_description: Build and expand in agriculture, industry and commerce. Evolve in the food industry sector, and weather the storms by helping your people build the new world.

details.title: Lost Viking: Kingdom of Women
details.short_description: While traveling to the East the Vikings fall into a trap. Ragnald is saved by the accompanying wolf and must find his loved ones. The Viking and his companion are forced not only to survive, but properly manage time, space and energy to achieve the goal.

details.title: Do Not Buy This Game
details.short_description: Are you really reading this to find out more? ...FINE! If you DO buy this game, expect me to narrate in your ear for around 2 hours about your poor life choices, all while I'll try to create something resembling a game for you to walk around in.

details.title: Mirror
details.short_description: Mirror is a two player co-op puzzle platformer set in a split screen world where one's actions are reflected in the other's. As two lost souls, you complete each other. Find a friend and experience this meditative puzzle by ensuring both of you have always a path forward.

details.title: Looks Fine on Paper
details.short_description: Looks Fine on Paper is a spatial logic puzzle game. Deduce each room's shape and position from area requirements and clues. Resolve interconnected constraints involving rooms, doors, windows, and furniture. Every decision can affect the entire layout. Can you satisfy every condition at once?

details.title: Wing It
details.short_description: Design your own aircraft in the hangar, from the wing shape to the engines, then fly cargo across an endless world with changing weather. Save your missing grandmother's airfield in a story that grows with every update. And if you crash, your plane breaks apart piece by piece.

details.title: Wainhold
details.short_description: A competitive economic strategy game in the spirit of the golden age of RTS. Every ware is carried by hand from flag to flag, seasons reshape your land, and borders move only by force. A deep economy, a living world and fair play against AI or rivals in one system.

details.title: The Last Of Morvein
details.short_description: You are an aristocrat, the last survivor of Morvein. Explore a dark metropolis of Gothic architecture and Victorian elegance. Battle hellish creatures and uncover the mystery behind the fall of a city where death was only the beginning of the nightmare.

details.title: Epiphora
details.short_description: An introspective exploration of the human condition conveyed through the work of a taxidermist. Your knowledge will be the blade with which to explore depths once stitched shut. A reinterpretation of the MetroidBrainia genre, where puzzles and perception intertwine with the eternity of flesh.

details.title: Sunflower Dance
details.short_description: Atlatonan is a 19 year old who starts her journey to Granda Oaso, the biggest commune in Gardesta, as part of the Cultural Exchange Program. Learn new things, make new friends, and find love~ This is a Solarpunk slice of life about learning stuff and enjoying whatever that makes you happy.

details.title: Singing Attorney: Verdict by Midnight
details.short_description: Expose the contradictions. Deduce the lyrics to the truth. Find the holes in the testimony. Tear it apart with evidence. Amnesiac rookie lawyer Kanade must defend a star streamer accused of murder. Why was the dead man clutching an old handheld? A courtroom mystery where deductions become lyrics.

details.title: Carrot Kingdom!
details.short_description: A rabbit and carrot puzzle-platformer! Stretch your ears to grab the carrots!

name: 敲敲小镇：桌面锻造物语

details.title: 敲敲小镇：桌面锻造物语
details.short_description: Type to mine, smelt, and forge gear with random affixes. Welcome residents, battle monsters and village trials. Stronger residents mean faster automated production. Start with one blacksmith shop and grow your town!

details.title: Tea & Fae
details.short_description: In late-19th-century London, Rorenna runs the shabby little tea shop her parents left behind. Grow tea, serve your guests, and brew a cup worthy of the fairy kings to earn their approval and revive The Romance Tea Room. Based on the author's original novels, with multiple romance endings.

details.title: SHOCKWAVE
details.short_description: An anti-gravity racer drawn in pure light. Seven wireframe tracks, eight ships and real racing physics — the desktop edition of a racing game built for the 1982 Vectrex, the console that drew with an electron beam.

details.title: JK in RPG
details.short_description: An outgoing high school girl, Akemi, was summoned to Isekai after school! To find her way home, she embarked on a journey to save the world with a female warrior, Pina...

details.title: Gnomageddon
details.short_description: Roguelike tower defense meets the gnome apocalypse. Pick upgrades, build towers and defend your garden from hundreds of thousands of gnomes.

details.title: Her Little Witch
details.short_description: A cozy yuri visual novel with dual perspectives, choices, and multiple endings! An otherworldly witch ends up living with a socially anxious manga artist. Through misunderstandings, unspoken feelings, and ordinary days, two very different girls slowly become part of each other's lives.

details.title: Touhou Kourindou: Appraisal Records
details.short_description: Run Kourindou, Gensokyo's odd little curio shop. Dig up strange things from the Outside World, work out what they do, and sell them to Marisa, Reimu and the girls of Gensokyo, all while a scarlet mist creeps over the sky. A cozy Touhou Project fan game of appraisal puzzles and haggling.

details.title: Whispers of the Veil
details.short_description: Whispers of the Veil is a first-person stealth game. Blend into the shadows and use your wits and tools to navigate the city's dangerous streets. Uncover a secret plot that threatens to cause the city's downfall as you explore a world in upheaval, caught between tradition and emerging technology.

details.title: Steel Tide
details.short_description: Tanks, warships, jets and a nuclear silo. Rain blinds your scouts, night hides the enemy's assault, and one warhead can end it all. Fight through the Gulf War of 1990–91 under other flags, outwit four levels of AI, or face friends on PC, phone and browser in the same match.

name: The Casket Of The Bygone Witch

details.title: The Casket Of The Bygone Witch
details.short_description: The Casket of the Bygone Witch is a horror/ghost-story/suspense/yuri visual novel. After the abandoned old lab was sealed, student deaths occurred, spreading a witch-curse legend. Protagonist Bai Yu investigates the witch after her friend dies there from the “curse.”

details.title: Tinycube Tales
details.short_description: A funny, colorful 2.5D platformer for the whole family! Play as 11 unlockable cube heroes, stomp mischievous animals, dodge giant rolling boulders and face huge bosses across 7 wild worlds, with a controller or keyboard.

details.title: BEHOPPER
details.short_description: BEHOPPER is a skill-based bhop and surf game. Run timed courses, explore procedural worlds, or build your own maps. Race against ghosts, earn medals and watch replays.

details.title: Railmorrow
details.short_description: A first-person life and travel simulator set in an open world. Begin your journey in Tikhorechye: buy tickets, explore 20 stations, ride trains and buses, trade between cities, work, and buy cars and houses. Where will you go next?

details.title: Looooong Trip
details.short_description: Loooong trip is a physics-based co-op sandbox adventure for 1–4 players! Drive, loot, crash, upgrade your car, and cause absolute chaos on your way to Vegas.

details.title: SideStamp
details.short_description: Roll, slide, and spin your way through this colorful 3D puzzle game. Explore over 100 handcrafted puzzles that reveal the essence of rotation as the fourth dimension.

details.title: Flarefall
details.short_description: Flarefall is a co-op horde RTS for 1–4 players. Land on the Florida coast, build one shared base by day and hold it by night against the horde, with present-day infantry, armour, boats, helicopters, air strikes and a destroyer's guns.

details.title: 汉末霸业·再起
details.short_description: 《汉末霸业·再起》是《汉末霸业》制作组全新打造的2D大型三国策略游戏。玩家将扮演一方君主，在辽阔的汉末百郡大地图上纵横征伐、逐鹿天下。游戏融合战略战斗、城池建设与内政经营，并通过城内NPC互动还原汉末城镇风貌。在传承《汉末》经典的基础上，进一步拓展战略地图与玩法体系，带来更加丰富的三国历史模拟体验。

name: Dankest Dungeon: Cleanup with friends and magic

details.title: Dankest Dungeon: Cleanup with friends and magic
details.short_description: Use a variety of magic and tools to tidy up millions of physics-based coins and items. Upgrade your abilities and clean up the dungeon faster with 1-4 players online!

details.title: The Sound of Fury
details.short_description: A young virtuoso follows the Devil into hell to save a friend. Make enemies dance to your tune with expressive ground and aerial combos in a surreal, poetic hack & slash adventure. Journey through humanity’s darkest chapters, face forgotten demons, and risk losing your soul.

details.title: Deadtone
details.short_description: Hold the last fortress against hundreds of thousands of zombies in Deadtone, an incremental tower defense game. Set your firing lines, call in air support and grow stronger with permanent upgrades. Take the world back, region by region.

details.title: 银茧 Argent Cocoon
details.short_description: Humanity has fallen, the ruins a breeding ground for the Insecta. Through the Argent Cocoon, they rewrite genes. Evolution is the unquestioned law. You, a gifted Eularva, are meant to surrender your soul to the Great Collective Consciousness. But exploring deeper, you question that destiny.

details.title: Ringwyrm
details.short_description: Ringwyrm is an immersive action horror game with survival elements. Explore a nonlinear interconnected world, meet a large cast of memorable characters, slay a huge cast of sickly monstrosities and avoid myriad diseases and ailments.

details.title: Canal Tycoon
details.short_description: Canal Tycoon is a unique transport builder set in the canal’s golden age, with mechanics not seen elsewhere in the genre. Move industry’s goods across period-map landscapes, manage contested water, politics and rivals, automate operations to reduce grind, then survive the railroads.

details.title: Rogue Fortune
details.short_description: A fast-paced action roguelite where your treasure is your health bar. Gamble your gold for the power to survive a hostile temple that wants it back. Arrange geometric relics into a puzzle grid to build devastating synergies.

details.title: NOEMATICA: Digital Dollhouse
details.short_description: Behold the humble Noem! Beguiling and silly-pilled, fully customizable, monstrous or adorable: with an n-dimensional vector space of fantasies and memories. An urban digital dollhouse, constructed top-to-bottom with a focus on simulation fidelity.

name: The Eminence in Shadow: Phantom Echoes

details.title: The Eminence in Shadow: Phantom Echoes
details.short_description: Lurk in the shadows and hunt the shadows. The curtain rises on The Eminence in Shadow: Phantom Echoes, a full-scale action roguelite game!

name: Jay and Silent Bob's Joint Venture

details.title: Jay and Silent Bob's Joint Venture
details.short_description: Turn a rundown backyard into your own cozy cannabis farm. Crossbreed plants to discover unusual effects and grow the strains your neighbors need. Build friendships as you explore the town with Jay and Silent Bob, surrounded by the spirit of ’90s comedy.

name: KAIMA MV: Mistress of the Void

details.title: KAIMA MV: Mistress of the Void
details.short_description: the world is getting eaten up... will you survive? take control of SEARINA in the fight against the evil prince VIDO, and try to reclaim the world of KAIMA! this version of the game includes brand new art and storylines, so even older fans will have something new to enjoy!

details.title: Ignite the Depths
details.short_description: Ignite the Depths is an atmospheric dark-fantasy PvE dungeon crawler set within a sprawling, hand-crafted labyrinth. Descend into the darkness alone or unite with up to 4 players in a co-op adventure. Will you conquer the Abyss?

details.title: Croaking Buzz
details.short_description: Croaking Buzz is an asymmetric co-op platformer, starring a frog and a particular mosquito, capable of spawning and manipulating bubbles. Play together helping each other to overcome challenges based on physics, coordination and emergent gameplay!

details.title: MoonHack
details.short_description: MoonHack is an emotional cyber-noir adventure game where songs rewrite the rules of the world. The story segments are closely integrated with 3D rhythm-action gameplay synchronized with vocal performances, and through songs, the rules behind a system that controls happiness will be rewritten.

details.title: Nightshift Remastered
details.short_description: Welcome to the Nightshift! Spend six nights at a totally normal office job in this branching narrative. Bond with your dayshift coworker, uncover fantastical mysteries, and experience unexpected transformations. With an optional card game and plenty of endings, what will you make of your time here?

name: Can you cook my last meal?

details.title: Can you cook my last meal?
details.short_description: A game where you become a prison chef and cook the final meals of death row inmates. Read each prisoner’s profile, choose ingredients, prepare the meal, and talk with them.

details.title: American Navy SEALs
details.short_description: Lead an elite Navy SEAL fireteam into a cinematic next-gen tactical shooter powered by Unreal Engine 5. Command your squad, master authentic weapons, and fight through deadly global missions where every order, every shot, and every life matters.

details.title: Let 'Em Cast
details.short_description: Let 'Em Cast is an action roguelike for 1–4 players where wizards battle hordes of everyday junk brought to life. Craft your own devastating spell combinations and blast your way across the fragments of a shattered magical world.

details.title: Oath Eternal
details.short_description: A dark fantasy RPG inspired by the Metroidvania and Extraction genres.

details.title: Nascor Descent
details.short_description: Awaken in a tower beyond death, where five realms conceal unspeakable horrors. Fight your way through a labyrinth of deadly traps and monstrous foes, and let your morality shape your path to salvation. Will you reclaim your life, or be lost to the depths forever?

details.title: Marginalia
details.short_description: Read the shared action order, move one unit at a time, and bring your expedition home alive in a hex-grid tactical SRPG.

details.title: MARY - メアリ姫の奪還
details.short_description: Add a single letter to a choice in this text adventure. Follow the original path, turn the odds in your favor, or create a completely ridiculous outcome. Shape the story with just one letter. *Japanese language only.

details.title: FATHOM
details.short_description: Send your crew deep into an alien ocean in this pixel-art desktop companion idler. Research strange creatures, harvest and refine resources, expand your deep-sea research platform, and discover the secrets lurking beneath the waves.

details.title: Scrambled Ships
details.short_description: A Yacht Dice Roguelike set on a ship with a mysterious figure, trapped in an endless game night atop a sunset cruise. Think outside the box, buy items, and progress through the rounds, or fall to the ever-increasing score targets.

details.title: VOTUM
details.short_description: Votum is a turn-based roguelite inspired by Ancient Rome. In the ruins of Aeterna, champions chosen by the Sibyl face tactical battles and harsh choices as they venture into the temple to uncover the source of the Soul Affliction.

details.title: Anchor
details.short_description: Anchor is a large-scale underwater multiplayer survival game. Build your base, craft tools and weapons, explore, loot and prepare for battle. Every player is a potential threat in a persistent world where bases can be raided, alliances broken, and the ocean itself hunts you.

details.title: Oni Hunters
details.short_description: Journey through Gironia's lands, where monsters roam and secrets await. Battle, fuse creatures, and decide your fate in the grand Monster Jubilee. Ready for the adventure?

details.title: Legends of Astravia
details.short_description: Dynamic battles, twisting dungeons, and countless secrets await you in the magical world of Astravia. Journey alongside your companions as you unravel the mystery of your past and uncover the truth behind a mysterious trio’s plot... before the Cataclysm brings forth another age of ruin.

details.title: Come Bye: Sheepdog Simulator
details.short_description: Learn to herd sheep the way real shepherds do: with a whistle and a faithful sheepdog. Send your dog wide around the flock, then ease them down the lane and through the gate. Push too hard and fear spreads until they bolt; hang back and they wander off to graze. Bring every last one home.

details.title: Adrorium
details.short_description: Build your ship, defend against drone waves and explore hundreds of sectors filled with stations, asteroids and planets with lots of POIs. The ship systems can be controlled via consoles with several hundred buttons. Craft equipment and blocks, loot the POIs and disabled drones.

details.title: Cyberdelic
details.short_description: Cyberdelic is an immersive FPS - Use a combination of weaponry to pierce hostile shields, armour and flesh. Swap out cybernetic components to best suit your combat encounters. Explore an interconnected environment acquiring additional tools to your arsenal.

details.title: We Stay Behind
details.short_description: We Stay Behind is a single-player third-person mystery between dreams and reality. A comet is on course to destroy a small town but its inhabitants refuse to leave. Interview the people of Laburnum Creek, explore a beautiful national park and unravel the secrets of this picturesque town.

details.title: The House In The Hollow
details.short_description: With graphics inspired by the 1920's Art Deco period, and a chilling soundtrack, the "House In The Hollow" will take you on a journey filled with mystery, horror, and magic, where you are the master of your own fate.

details.title: Unstitched
details.short_description: A social deduction party game for 4–15 players set in a creepy dollhouse. Run minigame errands by night, accuse by day and unmask the Rag Doll. Play online, against bots or Face to Face: one copy on the PC, everyone else plays from their own phone.

details.title: Feudums
details.short_description: Lead your noble house through brutal wars, shifting allegiances and economic strife in an asynchronous multiplayer 4X strategy. Shape the narrative with or against real players in a medieval world where diplomacy isn't binding, there is NO pay-to-win, and only strategy determines your legacy.

details.title: ARES
details.short_description: ARES is a VR Milsim platform with interactive features, simulated combat scenarios, and customization options. Play solo or online with other players in different gamemodes across an open milsim sandbox experience rooted deep in player-driven campaigns missions, & scenarios. Gear up and embark!

details.title: CLUTCH
details.short_description: CLUTCH is a cinematic open-world action-driving game where the worlds of professional and underground street racing collide across the French Riviera.

details.title: Magicians: The Devil's Deal
details.short_description: Magicians: The Devil’s Deal is a narrative driven FPS where stage magic becomes real. You play as Jacob Menteuro, a fallen illusionist bound by a pact with The Devil and cast into Hell. Master deadly tricks, steal the powers of rival magicians, and escape the infernal world of Theatreland.

details.title: The Free Shepherd
details.short_description: Run fast and free as a sheepdog in a beautiful but troubled world. Herd masses of lost sheep to a secret refuge. Discover a mysterious calamity that only you can stop.

details.title: Godsend
details.short_description: Godsend is a melee slasher set during the Crusades, where you must defend the grail against endless waves of enemies. You only pass the wave if you max your Fear meter out - which you can do by *rapidly* defeating enemies or using "Intimidator" items to help. Original Soundtrack by Shaun Finnegan.

details.title: WRAITH OPS
details.short_description: WRAITH OPS delivers snappy gunplay, fast movement, and objective-based combat with a focus on teamwork and skill. No grind, no gimmicks. Just pure infantry action where every fight matters. Get in, squad up, and take control.

name: M.E.C.H.A.: Memory Erasure Control of Hover Attractor

details.title: M.E.C.H.A.: Memory Erasure Control of Hover Attractor
details.short_description: M.E.C.H.A. — an indie survival shooter in a dystopian cyberpunk world! Scavenge for resources, build your relationship with Rika, and upgrade your gear in the world of androids. Experience the gameplay mix of dating simulator and bloody action with all the consequences.

details.title: Conan: The Black Pyramid
details.short_description: Sword & sorcery meets cosmic horror in a brutal Roguelite action RPG. Fight as Conan and other legendary heroes, forge devastating builds, and seek the truth inside an ever-changing labyrinth beyond time. Face the Black Pyramid alone or with a friend in online co-op.

details.title: ワタシがVtuberデス
details.short_description: Genre: VTuber × Comedy × Despair × Exploration Adventure

details.title: Scratch The Cat
details.short_description: Grab your headphones and step up to the turntable in Scratch The Cat - a vibrant action-adventure 3D platformer. Play as DJ Scratch, explore a sprawling musical world, fight bosses, and reclaim your stolen records. Turn up the volume and set the stage for the purr-fect comeback.

details.title: Monster Cuisine
details.short_description: Best a beast and serve a feast in Monster Cuisine, an action-RPG where you're a tavern keeper hunting fabled creatures in a forbidden forest to cook mythical meals and grow your business. Craft unique weapons and armor sets to take on stronger monsters that are as delicious as they are dangerous.

details.title: Rulehouse
details.short_description: Think you know chess? Forget some of that. Rulehouse is a pawn chess adventure where every stage rewrites the game. Travel the globe and beyond, master an ever-changing board where new pieces, twisted variants, and cunning opponents keep you guessing from first move to last.

details.title: IM:VVI Galaxy Runaway
details.short_description: Crash-land with Team VVI’s three mercenaries on a mysterious planet inhabited by strange birdfolk. Explore unique civilizations, face enemies in combat that blends rhythm and strategy, interact with curious locals, and uncover the conspiracy surrounding the planet’s nature spirit.

details.title: GRIDLANDS
details.short_description: GRIDLANDS is a PvE extraction shooter set in a fallen world where sentient machines hunt what remains of humanity. Scavenge, survive, and extract through hostile industrial dead zones where every run could be your last.

details.title: Carnholt
details.short_description: Build your victory upon the corpses you leave behind. Carnholt is a roguelike deckbuilder in which death is not the end, it’s just another card to play. Craft a deck of wild creatures and powerful spells, fight in tactical battles, and slay a God that refused death.

details.title: Respect The Horde
details.short_description: You're outnumbered. Outsmart them. Lure hordes of zombies into deadly traps, shape their path with obstacles, and grow stronger with every kill. But know when to walk away before overconfidence and greed turn your strategy into uncontrollable chaos.

details.title: In Perfection
details.short_description: A writer is trying to finish his "perfect work," but things keep getting in his way. He is poor and full of anxiety. In this retro lo-fi visual novel, fix the problems with point-and-click, explore the depths of consciousness. Forgive yourself? or stare into the dark and fall deeper? It's up to you.

details.title: Girlfailure Art Club
details.short_description: Fall in love again with the cringey otaku girls who spent their school days drawing in the corner. Packed with 2010s otaku culture, memes, and second-hand embarrassment, this visual novel lets you relive a painfully cute youth with the oddballs of a Japanese art club!

details.title: World Railway
details.short_description: World Railway is a sim management game and you're a conductor reviving an old train. Produce and gather resources in stations via loops, process and manage onboard. A new world unfolds with the wheel's rumble. On your journey, forge bonds and witness the seasons.

details.title: Falling Apart
details.short_description: Falling Apart is a disturbing point-and-click puzzle adventure about a man descending into his own fractured mind through hypnosis.

details.title: Papaya Plaza
details.short_description: Rebuild a faded tourist town as its new mayor! Place shops and decorations, staff them with quirky villagers to earn cash each day, and help out with their favours. Every night the judges score your town, so rank up, unlock new buildings, and get that coveted 5-star rating. Peep peep!

details.title: Where Dolls Hang
details.short_description: Where Dolls Hang is a psychological survival horror game inspired by Mexican folklore, set in 1998. Investigate an island filled with hanging dolls, eerie mannequins, and horrifying rituals. Explore the forests and interiors with your camcorder, find VHS tapes, and uncover what happened.

details.title: Mineral Zone
details.short_description: Build a factory by day, defend it by night. Mine ore, automate it over belts and keep the grid alive, then hold the line with towers your factory feeds and your own ship in the fight. Solo or online co-op for up to 4 players.

details.title: Hero of the Kingdom IV
details.short_description: A lovely adventuring RPG. Journey across a picturesque tropical island and shape your own destiny for the first time in the series. Enjoy complete freedom in solving quests. Use thoughtful logic, master the art of bartering, and explore peacefully at your own pace.

details.title: Road to Jukai
details.short_description: You work the night shift as a taxi driver in a remote region of Japan. Not all of the odd passengers you pick up after sunset are what they seem. Sometimes it's safer to just keep your eyes on the road, especially when a fare leads to the strange, massive forest the locals whisper about.

details.title: Perceptum
details.short_description: A psychological horror game where you play as a medium investigating the disappearance of a family. Explore a house with an oppressive atmosphere, close your eyes to hear the beyond, use your mirror to see what should not exist and uncover the truth hidden within its walls.

name: ROTRDS - Rat, Ox, Tiger, Rabbit, Dragon and Snake

details.title: ROTRDS - Rat, Ox, Tiger, Rabbit, Dragon and Snake
details.short_description: ROTRDS is a visual novel RPG inspired by traditional Korean mythology. Only half of the Twelve Zodiac guardians remain with fragmented memories. Gigi has less than a week to gather all the Oksae seals and save the world.

details.title: All Army Attack
details.short_description: Hold onto your clucks! All Army Attack is a chaotic large-scale roguelike auto-battler. Unite animals and plants, build an army that spills off the screen, gamble it all with every battle, and fight your way toward a formidable cosmic threat!

details.title: Blackroots
details.short_description: Blackroots is a co-op fantasy/horror game where players work together or alone to resist a dark force known as Ul'vorran.

details.title: Smoke and Steel
details.short_description: Lead a nation through early 18th-century Europe in Smoke and Steel, a turn-based wargame combining grand strategy with tactical battles. Choose diplomacy or war. Build your economy, forge alliances and negotiate trade deals, then command your armies in battle. Outthink, outflank, outlast.

details.title: Dungeon Treaders
details.short_description: A classic-style 3D dungeon crawler that blends nostalgic challenge with modern comfort. Enjoy flexible character creation and a classic world, now with streamlined, trial-and-error gameplay.

details.title: UN:Me
details.short_description: UN:Me is a soul triage adventure. Four souls share one girl’s body, each certain it is the real one, yet only one can remain. Through dialogue you search a beautiful, unsettling world for its true owner, fleeing the traumas that surface as you go. When only one can stay, which will you keep?

details.title: PANLINE
details.short_description: Welcome to post-scarcity! But you’re not on the list. Deliver to make a living off-grid while PANLINE, the abundance engine that keeps the city endlessly supplied, begins to change. Earn currency, favors, kit upgrades and work the runner scene to unlock new contacts and fixers.

details.title: PNEUMA Division
details.short_description: Pneuma is an online co-op sci-fi paranormal investigation game for up to 4 players. Operate advanced paranormal tech to investigate, analyze, and outmaneuver deadly ghosts before you are possessed. Speak rituals aloud with your own voice to bind, expose, or provoke what hunts you.

details.title: Monster Prom 5: Monster Retreat
details.short_description: Get ready for the ultimate winter war in this hilarious narrative adventure with dashes of strategy and romance! Visit snowy locations, recruit from a pool of over 80 wacky characters onto your team, and destroy your opponents in a fierce snowball fight to the death. Oh, and date hot monsters too 😉

details.title: This Is Not For You
details.short_description: After a ghost ship crashes into an isolated lighthouse, Ulysses’ memories come back to trap him in an endless, twisting maze full of riddles, blood, and magic. Draw your own map, and find a way to burn it all down.

details.title: RadCity: A Post-Apocalyptic Adventure
details.short_description: RadCity is a narrative-heavy, top-down journey through a dark, irradiated city. In a post-apocalyptic world, environmental storytelling and meaningful decisions shape your survival. Supplies are running out, the undead are everywhere, and it's hard to trust people anymore. Find a way out.

details.title: LitGirls: Bookbound Dungeons
details.short_description: LitGirls: Bookbound Dungeons is a dungeon-crawler RPG where classic literature meets anime Girls! Assemble a party inspired by legendary characters such as Alice, Juliet, Dante, and Raven, then lead them into treacherous dungeons crawling with monsters, traps, treasure, and otherworldly horrors.

details.title: The Hole Never Ends
details.short_description: An intense VR adventure where you crawl through twisting caves, face unseen terrors, evade creatures, mine for relics, and upgrade your gear as you descend deeper into the hole.

details.title: Glimm&Grimm
details.short_description: Glimm&Grimm is a RTS | TD. Set in the far dark Future! Using Ones Glimms and their Unique Abilties, Defenses, and Powers against the Nightmares of the Grimm, that are longing for ones Soul! There are Many Areas, causing varied Strategies along with changing Wheather, Seasons and Obstacles over Time!

details.title: GlagStone
details.short_description: A 1-bit story-driven city builder inspired by late-80s Macintosh aesthetics. Rebuild a remote northern island settlement between warring nations and uncover the mystery at its heart.

details.title: Anhedonia: Sanctuary of Ash
details.short_description: A third-person medieval dark fantasy adventure RPG with survival horror elements. As Edgar, a former priest with a fractured memory, explore a ruined world, solve environmental puzzles and uncover its secrets. Face twisted creatures and perform exorcisms to free the possessed.

details.title: Neidfyre
details.short_description: Neidfyre is a turn-based duel game forged in fire and steel. Step into a cursed land of no escape. Survive against those who stand in your way and fulfill your purpose.

details.title: Forgotten Terror
details.short_description: Moving into a close senior's home, but nightmares follow. Terrifying ghostly figures, a senior who seems to be hiding something. What secret lies behind the door that cannot be opened?

details.title: WIRED TOKYO 2007
details.short_description: — Dive into Tokyo. Dive into the past. — WIRED TOKYO is a vertical 3D action game where you climb toward the vast skies above Tokyo. To unlock new abilities, you may have to deliberately “dive” from above. A climbing game where falling has meaning — that’s WIRED TOKYO.

details.title: KERO CORP
details.short_description: Type nonstop, stack efficiency, automate production, and then prestige to push the system harder. Build your froggy workforce to generate insane levels of passive income. Never stop typing. Never stop making money.

details.title: Mega Man: Dual Override
details.short_description: Mega Man returns in 2027 with a brand-new entry in the classic action platforming series! Override challenges and blast down legions of robots while springboarding across a new array of futuristic frontiers!

details.title: Sealbreakers
details.short_description: A top-down 3D roguelite brawler where a disgraced warrior fights immortal tyrants in a collapsing reality. Break the world back with nothing but fists.

details.title: Overbit
details.short_description: A 4th-Wall-Breaking Pixel Art Horror/Comedy RPG with Rhythm based Bullet Battles happening inside a Retro Operating System

name: In a World Full of Zombies I'm the Only One Who Doesn't Get Attacked: Road to Heaven

details.title: In a World Full of Zombies I'm the Only One Who Doesn't Get Attacked: Road to Heaven
details.short_description: A man the zombies will not attack fights to protect his allies and base as they journey toward Heaven. Prepare defenses, deploy allies, upgrade equipment, and set traps to survive the horde in this RTS and tower defense hybrid.

details.title: It Works: Electronics Repair Simulator
details.short_description: Step into the shoes of an electronics technician and repair damaged devices: receivers, phones, speakers, and more. Solder, diagnose, replace components, earn money, and grow your workshop!

details.title: Terminal War
details.short_description: Terminal War is a grounded, team-based third-person shooter set in a fractured America during the late 1990s. Engage in intense combat across war-torn cities, forgotten towns, and contested territory where every bullet, every strike, and every decision counts.

details.title: Kalit
details.short_description: A unique survival adventure, animated in a 1930s rubber hose style! Fight to survive: capture creatures, farm, mine, and craft everything you need: from gear and vehicles to your base. Explore strange lands and an underwater world of shipwrecks, dangers, and hidden wonders.

name: Heroes of Might and Magic III Remake

details.title: Heroes of Might and Magic III Remake
details.short_description: Rediscover the critically acclaimed turn-based strategy classic and its two expansions, faithfully rebuilt in full 3D and 4K. Explore a vibrant fantasy world and lead mighty heroes in epic battles.

details.title: BLOK
details.short_description: BLOK is an Orwellian psychological horror game set in post-communist Poland. You play as a political exile who fled the country during the communist regime. Years later, after the system’s collapse, a strange letter from your mother draws you back home. But something is deeply wrong.

details.title: JungoJam
details.short_description: JungoJam now boasts a hip downtown strip, tranquil beaches, and islands perfect for unleashing your creativity. Here, you can be anyone you dream of! Team up with friends from across the globe to explore an interactive wonderland, design your Original Characters！

details.title: SuperWEIRD: Automation Roguelite
details.short_description: An automation roguelite for 1–4 players. Set worker bots to craft and deliver supplies while fighting bots battle the Goofy Goo. Piece a broken planet back together, strengthen your production network and try new strategies on each run.

details.title: Descent Of Lunaris
details.short_description: Assemble your squad and explore a lunar base where cosmic horrors warp your reality, challenge your strategy, and break your sanity. Descent of Lunaris is a grid-based dungeon crawling RPG inspired by Wizardry and Shin Megami Tensei.

details.title: POSTAL 2 Redux
details.short_description: POSTAL 2 Redux lets you loose in the most chaotic sandbox shooter ever, fully reimagined for a new generation. Survive a week in Paradise, Arizona - buy milk, return books, or go completely POSTAL with an arsenal of weapons. The choice is yours…but good luck staying out of trouble.

details.title: Frame of Suffering
details.short_description: Master both man and machine to escape the Ancient Temple. Customize your Hero and a modifiable Combat Frame to slay hordes and gatekeepers. Scavenge tech, uncover the Temple's history, and evolve your build in this Sci-Fi Action RPG. You're a prisoner - freedom lies at the heart of the Temple.

details.title: ABYSS REBEL
details.short_description: ABYSS REBEL is a tactical RPG focused on turn-based combat and character progression. In a dark, frozen world, assemble a squad, sail to the most dangerous archipelagos in the universe, and defeat the lurking dark forces with strategy, heroes, and mechs.

details.title: Westlanders
details.short_description: Survive a wild-west open world alone or with friends. Travel the land with your wagon, build settlements, fend off foes, and weave a powerful economic network across the wilderness. Forge your legacy in the Westlands.

details.title: Next In Line: Supermarket
details.short_description: Become a cashier at a charming local supermarket! Scan, bag, and total up groceries for a quirky stream of customers. Each checkout is cozy, complete with mini-games. Carefully bag your items, restock inventory, upgrade the mart, and keep the line moving.

details.title: Mind's Edge
details.short_description: Leia's 12th birthday turned into a nightmare when masked, unidentified individuals kidnapped her. Following the traces, Vincent and his childhood friend Antonio arrive at an abandoned mansion, where they run across something they never expected.

details.title: Antichrist
details.short_description: As a journalist, you made headlines back in 2006 with a groundbreaking story. Years later, an anonymous call tied to that very event leads you to an horror house. But this house may belong to the Antichrist believed to appear at the end of days. You’re chasing a story… but it might be your last.

details.title: Project ReMind
details.short_description: In this realistic first-person puzzle game, you’ve created the first Artificial Consciousness. Moments after its birth, it says goodbye and disappears. Every puzzle you solve restores a fragment of your shattered memories, but something not quite human has altered them. Is your mind still your own?

details.title: War Alert
details.short_description: As the frontline crawls through ruins and smoke, you command infantry, armor, and air support to shape the chaos. Capture points, break lines, encircle and counter-encircle. With no pay-to-win, only clear strategy and teamwork earns victory.

details.title: No Walls In Heaven
details.short_description: No Walls In Heaven is a first-person exploration platformer about losing yourself in the hostile vastness of the cosmos. Grapple, leap, and fight your way through the towering concrete and metal landscapes of a lost megastructure that seems to disobey all laws of physics and reality.

details.title: NO PAROLE
details.short_description: Up to 16 players, one prison, friendly fire on. Raid a city where the dead get back up unless you burn them, haul the loot home and hold the walls when the government comes to bury the evidence. Then it sets the city on fire. Your crew dies for good. You don't. You just don't know why yet.

details.title: Rent A Car Together
details.short_description: Rent A Car Simulator. Start by renting your first car. Expand your rental car fleet by purchasing different vehicles and grow your car rental business. Drive your cars and get them fixed when they break down. Find new customers. You can also develop your Rent A Car business by playing Co-Op.

details.title: GraveDiggers
details.short_description: Online co-op horror for 1 to 6 undertaker cats. Every day, find the body, drag its coffin across a cursed Louisiana swamp and bury it before sunrise. Skeletons, Lazarites and the midnight mist will try to stop you. Eat cheese whenever you can.

details.title: Railborn
details.short_description: Railborn is a survival game where you build your train piece by piece. Navigate a world entangled by branching tracks. Find rare plants to cultivate on your farms. Upgrade your train - manage its power systems, direct resource flow, and distribute water. Designed for 1 to 4 players.

details.title: Starship Salvagers
details.short_description: One last haul. Dive a dead starship deck by deck: clear sealed rooms of aliens, bolt salvaged upgrades onto your suit, keep your kill multiplier alive and bring down the boss waiting at the bottom. Six contractors, five story tiers and an Endless mode for the greedy.

details.title: NO LAW
details.short_description: Welcome to Port Desire, a city that doesn't belong to anyone, but where everyone wants a piece. You’re Grey Harker, an ex-military attempting to live a quiet life after near fatal injuries in the field. All you want now is peace - but in a city of no laws, what you want isn’t always what you get.

details.title: W.A.R.D.
details.short_description: Assume control of an evil intergalactic megacorporation in this sci-fi tower defense. Build a mining infrastructure on alien moons and exoplanets, exploit their precious resources, and defend your operation against defiant natives.

details.title: Cards & Cannons
details.short_description: Build your own realm and turn every path into a devious trap in this roguelite tower defense deckbuilder! Crush endless enemy hordes with mighty spells and crazy builds in unique runs. Defeat powerful bosses and conquer world after world in this colorful medieval madness!

details.title: Flame and Blame
details.short_description: A first-person co-op comedy for up to 4 firefighters who are very bad at their job. Drive the truck, blast the fire, rescue the panda, and blame each other when it all goes up in smoke. Bad at fires. Great at friendship.

details.title: Former Future
details.short_description: Vaporize evil robots and reclaim Saturn’s cities in this strategic shooter. The path you choose shapes the enemy's strength, the tools at your disposal, and the final stand you'll face. Overcome adaptive AI in solo or co-op play where distinct characters and synergistic abilities reward teamwork.

details.title: The Detectorist Guild
details.short_description: A cosy village-life RPG set in Yorkshire, England, in 1999. Follow James as he explores a quintessential British village with his metal detector, uncovering lost treasures and slowly unravelling a dark mystery that draws him and his family into its depths.

details.title: ARIDA 2: Rise of the Brave
details.short_description: Journey through the 19th-century Brazilian backlands in this narrative, culturally rich adventure. Face the drought to explore arid biomes, craft and manage resources, complete quests, and guide Cícera to Canudos - the mythical village promising to change the story forever.

details.title: Understory
details.short_description: Raise two fox cubs in a lively forest. Hunt and play with them and watch as they learn and copy your behavior. Make memories that outlast time itself Not suitable for children or people that are easily disturbed

details.title: 魔王3：新秩序
details.short_description: Falsemen 3 is a fantastic adventure game based on an independent world view. In the game, players will play a group of non-positive characters and experience the magnificent epic of the times in the story of struggling with the empire.

details.title: Ghostarium
details.short_description: Ghostarium blends haunted house management, ghost catching, and otherworldly exploration. Venture into another world and capture ghosts to work in your haunted house! Build your ghost collection, expand your attraction, and turn visitors’ screams into cash!

details.title: Warden Tycoon
details.short_description: Build a prison from an empty plot into a four-level giant, then run it. A thousand inmates each have needs, moods, friends and grudges. Feed them, keep them busy and watch them closely, or they will fight, riot, smuggle, dig and climb their way out.

details.title: JETLINE
details.short_description: A jet-powered roadster with a suction fan, loose in all of Budapest. Grab a wall and ride it up to the roof, backflip over spike strips, lose the police in the back streets, and race across the real city, by night or by day.

details.title: Killbot General
details.short_description: Satisfying roguelite tactics packed in 5-minute battles. Controller-friendly with emphasis on tactics, not speed (low APM), no micromanagement, all in a wild and irreverent roguelite campaign for solo or co-op. Put anything you want on your flag...

details.title: Neverlooted Dungeon
details.short_description: Venture deep into the Neverlooted Dungeon in search of its legendary treasure, and face its treacherous, deadly traps. Using your creativity and magical items in a highly interactive physics-based world, find your own ways to outsmart the dangers, and be the first to uncover its darkest secrets.

details.title: Lumen Keeper
details.short_description: Build a fortress on a planet shrouded in fog. In this blend of tower defense and action roguelite, strengthen your defenses, wipe out hordes of aliens, and collect their energy to push back the fog.

details.title: HADAL: Into the Mariana Trench
details.short_description: Pilot real research submersibles from a ship off Guam to the floor of Challenger Deep, 11 km down. No monsters and no timers: your battery, your hull and how deep you dare to go decide every dive. More than 50 real species to find, each with a scientific source.

details.title: Dead North
details.short_description: A hardcore survival game set in the north, solo or in co-op for up to 4 players. Built as an immersive sim, it has no scripted encounters. Fire a gun and everything in earshot hears it. Steal from a village and they remember your face. Light a fire at night and something will come to see it.

details.title: Panic in Puzzle World
details.short_description: Panic in Puzzle World is an action-packed 2D platformer in the spirit of console classics. Play as Tide and breathe fire, slash with your claws, bounce on bad guys and glide with your wings to put a stop to the robot menace taking over the land, block by block!

details.title: Tidy Up
details.short_description: A peaceful cleaning and organizing game where you explore different locations, collect trash, clean stains, and arrange items to turn mess into perfection.

details.title: Still Above: Orbital Refuge
details.short_description: A 3D space-station survival builder. The Earth below is gone; your station is still falling. Salvage the orbital graveyard, fit out empty hulls rack by rack, and keep air, water, power and fuel flowing long enough to turn one fragile module into humanity's last refuge.

details.title: Cthulhu's Cleanup Crew
details.short_description: You’re Employee #1 at Cthulhu’s new reality repair business. In this relaxing restoration game, clean up impossible disasters with a cosmic paint gun and upgrade your gear and workspace. Just try to ignore whatever’s screaming behind the walls.

details.title: Super Cucumber
